In recent times , the ravaging armies of the Goblin War resulted in many of these settlements being deserted . Inhabitants .

title: Storm King
description: Storm King The Storm King was the most valuable warlord of the Yikarian Empire in 1367 DR , and served as the Lotus Emperor ' s right hand . Activities . The Storm King acted as the Emperor ' s adviser , general , and executioner , and was even a potential successor to the throne .
description_long: Storm King The Storm King was the most valuable warlord of the Yikarian Empire in 1367 DR , and served as the Lotus Emperor ' s right hand . Activities . The Storm King acted as the Emperor ' s adviser , general , and executioner , and was even a potential successor to the throne . Contrary to others to hold his position in the past , the Storm King appeared content to serve the Emperor without attempting to hurry along his demise . Tamalynda , the Whisperer , spread ideas that the Storm King ' s lack of ambition was a fault in any potential leader , but the Storm King calmly ignored these attacks , which made her extremely nervous .

title: Storm King ' s Thunder
description: Storm King ' s Thunder Storm King ' s Thunder is a 5th - edition Dungeons & Dragons adventure set in the Savage Frontier region of the Forgotten Realms . It takes four to six characters from levels 1 – 5 up through level 10 . This adventure takes place after the events described in " Hoard of the Dragon Queen " and " The Rise of Tiamat " , but does not directly depend on them .
description_long: Storm King ' s Thunder Storm King ' s Thunder is a 5th - edition Dungeons & Dragons adventure set in the Savage Frontier region of the Forgotten Realms . It takes four to six characters from levels 1 – 5 up through level 10 . This adventure takes place after the events described in " Hoard of the Dragon Queen " and " The Rise of Tiamat " , but does not directly depend on them . It is not set in a particular year , but is assumed to be after the Year of the Iron Dwarf ' s Vengeance , 1485 DR , and the orc conflict known as the War of the Silver Marches . Index . Locations . The " Storm King ' s Thunder " contains a brief description of about 165 , in case the adventurers pass through any of them during their travels while they seek ancient relic s . Over thirty of these locations have suggested encounters for the players to gain experience , treasure , magic items , or to move the story along . In addition , there are three featured encounters that can potentially help the party toward their goals .

title: Storm Rune
description: Storm Rune The Storm Rune was a merchant cabal that operated in the city of Stormhelm in Eskorn , Returned Abeir . Activities . Members of the Storm Rune , merchants and landlords who met in secret and kept their identities hidden from the lower - ranking members , worked together to increase their wealth and status in Eskornar society , by manipulating the knights of Eskorn , making king ' s edicts or the knights seem tyrannical to the common people , and by slowly shaping popular beliefs .
description_long: Storm Rune The Storm Rune was a merchant cabal that operated in the city of Stormhelm in Eskorn , Returned Abeir . Activities . Members of the Storm Rune , merchants and landlords who met in secret and kept their identities hidden from the lower - ranking members , worked together to increase their wealth and status in Eskornar society , by manipulating the knights of Eskorn , making king ' s edicts or the knights seem tyrannical to the common people , and by slowly shaping popular beliefs . They never committed violent or overtly unlawful deeds , taking care to avoid being noticed by the the public eye . They normally employed spies , adventurers , and intermediaries to advance their agendas . History . In 1479 DR , some members of the Storm Rune were supporting Prince Flandarr Roaryl ' s claims to the throne .

title: Storm Silverhand
description: Storm Silverhand Storm Silverhand , called " The Bard of Shadowdale " , was one of the Seven Sisters and a Chosen of Mystra . Appearance . Storm was 6 feet , 2 inches tall and kept the silver hair she shared with her sisters so long that it came down to her knees .
description_long: Storm Silverhand Storm Silverhand , called " The Bard of Shadowdale " , was one of the Seven Sisters and a Chosen of Mystra . Appearance . Storm was 6 feet , 2 inches tall and kept the silver hair she shared with her sisters so long that it came down to her knees . Also like her sisters , she was astonishingly beautiful and had a regal bearing even while wearing road - stained leathers . Personality . Storm was known and loved by many in her home of Shadowdale and elsewhere in Faerûn . She was high - spirited , fearless , merry , and possessed a lust for life that grew greater when she saw other happy people . She also had a vengeful streak , which was aimed at the Zhentarim , thieves and swindlers , people who carelessly started fires or despoiled the land , and any ruler who acted maliciously . Storm treated children as equals and took the time to listen to what they had to say as well as play with them . She was a good teacher and an inspiration to many . As a youth , she was selfish and rebelled against authority . Although she grew out of this , she still empathized with youths who felt poorly treated by authority figures . History . Pre - Spellplague .

title: Storm Which Destroys
description: Storm Which Destroys The Storm Which Destroys was a holy slayer organization in Zakhara comprised mostly of fanatical moralist s . The symbol of the Storm Which Destroys was an obsidian blade . Activities .
description_long: Storm Which Destroys The Storm Which Destroys was a holy slayer organization in Zakhara comprised mostly of fanatical moralist s . The symbol of the Storm Which Destroys was an obsidian blade . Activities . Some considered the Storm to be a covert force of the Pantheon , but rumors abounded that the Storm was too extreme for the likes of the Pantheon . Organization . Rimaq al - Nimar of I ' tiraf was rumored to give orders to the Storm . Base of Operations . The Storm used Al - Sayaj Mountains within the Pantheon Lands as their base .

title: Storm armor of the earth ' s children
description: Storm armor of the earth ' s children Storm armor of the earth ' s children is a suit of magic full plate armor and grants the wearer resistance against cold , electricity and fire . Although magic armor usually broadly resizes to fit its wearer , this armor will only resize to fit dwarves , gnome s or halfling s . It will fetch in excess of 110 , 000 gold pieces .
description_long: Storm armor of the earth ' s children Storm armor of the earth ' s children is a suit of magic full plate armor and grants the wearer resistance against cold , electricity and fire . Although magic armor usually broadly resizes to fit its wearer , this armor will only resize to fit dwarves , gnome s or halfling s . It will fetch in excess of 110 , 000 gold pieces .

title: Storm bell
description: Storm bell Storm bells , also called storm gongs , were easily the largest musical instruments throughout Zakhara . Description . These massive metal cylinders and plates were struck with large pieces of wood wrapped in protective cloth .
description_long: Storm bell Storm bells , also called storm gongs , were easily the largest musical instruments throughout Zakhara . Description . These massive metal cylinders and plates were struck with large pieces of wood wrapped in protective cloth . Some storm bells were small enough to be carried in a cart pulled by oxen , but others were so large that they were permanent fixtures on buildings . History . Though the modern cities of Zakhara used these items to draw crowds to important events or announcements , the historical purpose of a storm bell was to announce the coming of a deadly sandstorm out in the open desert . The sound of a storm bell rung clearly for miles , granting the desert tribes plenty of warning before an approaching sandstorm . Storm bells were also positioned along cliffs surrounding particularly deadly reefs to warn sailors of treacherous water .

title: Storm dragon
description: Storm dragon Storm dragons were a type of dragon . Description . Storm dragons had snake - like bodies with deep purple scales and broad wings .
description_long: Storm dragon Storm dragons were a type of dragon . Description . Storm dragons had snake - like bodies with deep purple scales and broad wings . Their heads were broad and flat , with a long , sharp - angled snout and a series of horns and ridges extending back from the jaw , cheeks , and forehead . Their eyes crackled with lightning . Habitat / Society . Storm dragons often competed for territory with blue dragon s , and thus did not get along .

title: Storm giant
description: Storm giant Storm giants were extremely intelligent giant s who lived on cloud islands . Their vision was adapted to underwater conditions , where they saw equally as well as they did in the air . They spoke Jotunuvar and Jotun .
description_long: Storm giant Storm giants were extremely intelligent giant s who lived on cloud islands . Their vision was adapted to underwater conditions , where they saw equally as well as they did in the air . They spoke Jotunuvar and Jotun . Description . A storm giant stood about 26 feet tall and weighed over 3 , 000 lbs . They tended to wear fine tunics and belted sandals . There were two ethnicities of storm giants ; most had pale , light green skin and dark green hair and eyes , but a small number had violet skin , dark blue hair , and silver eyes . Abilities . Storm giants were responsible for throwing lightning bolts across mountain peaks . Society . The head of a storm giant " ordning " was called a " paramount " . In storm giant society , any act of mercy or charity towards a sentient being was seen as good .

title: Storm giant aerie of Lake Woe mountain
description: Storm giant aerie of Lake Woe mountain The storm giant aerie of Lake Woe mountain was the home of a small tribe of storm giant s who played a significant role in the War of the Hart . Description . The aerie was located at the summit of Lake Woe mountain , which itself grew out of the center of Lake Woe .
description_long: Storm giant aerie of Lake Woe mountain The storm giant aerie of Lake Woe mountain was the home of a small tribe of storm giant s who played a significant role in the War of the Hart . Description . The aerie was located at the summit of Lake Woe mountain , which itself grew out of the center of Lake Woe . It was almost always covered in storm clouds ; when it was clear , thousands of birds tended to gather there . The aerie consisted of a fortress palace of spired buildings interconnected by elevated walkways , a few other structures , and a large garden park . The buildings were of course enormous , beings sized for giants . The spires were silver - plated and had alabaster roofs . The entryways to several of the buildings were covered in elaborate , many - colored frescoes and mosaics . Many stone statues of gargoyle s decorated the curtain walls . It was said to be one of the most magnificent palace complexes in all of Faerûn . Four manor buildings connected to each other by catwalks formed the bulk of the palace structure , and this was where the storm giants lived and socialized . They were relatively simple inside compared to the elaborate exteriors of the buildings .

title: Storm of the Dead
description: Storm of the Dead Storm of the Dead is the second book in the Lady Penitent trilogy by Lisa Smedman . Summary . Storm of the Dead follows up the events of the " Sacrifice of the Widow " , with the diffusion of Vhaeraun ' s cleric s with Eilistraee ’ s priestesses due to the death of Vhaeraun at the hands of Eilistraee .
description_long: Storm of the Dead Storm of the Dead is the second book in the Lady Penitent trilogy by Lisa Smedman . Summary . Storm of the Dead follows up the events of the " Sacrifice of the Widow " , with the diffusion of Vhaeraun ' s cleric s with Eilistraee ’ s priestesses due to the death of Vhaeraun at the hands of Eilistraee . The goddess of the dead , Kiaransalee joins the " sava " game between Lolth and Eilistraee as a neutral faction . Immediately , Eilistraee was placed at a disadvantage from the double - front of Kiaransalee ’ s and Lolth ’ s followers . Right off the bat , there were conflicts between the former followers of Vhaeraun and the priestesses of Eilistraee , represented in the rebellious nature of Kâras and the strictly traditional personality in Cavatina Xarann . More pressing matters are at hand when " Faerzress " is discovered to be afflicting the magical power of the drow alone . Its influence is spreading across Faerûn , affecting the power of the drow mage s and even priestesses and clerics . Q ' arlynd Melarn traveled to Sshamath after leaving the Promenade of the Dark Maiden in the " Sacrifice of the Widow " .

title: Storm of vengeance
description: Storm of vengeance Storm of vengeance is a conjuration spell that calls a vicious thunderstorm that rains acid , thunder , and hail . Effect . This spell creates an enormous black storm cloud .
description_long: Storm of vengeance Storm of vengeance is a conjuration spell that calls a vicious thunderstorm that rains acid , thunder , and hail . Effect . This spell creates an enormous black storm cloud . Lightning and crashing claps of thunder appear within the storm . Creatures beneath the cloud must succeed at Fortitude saves or be deafened ( see " blindness / deafness " ) for 1d4 x 10 minutes . If you do not maintain concentration on the spell after casting it , the spell ends . If you continue to concentrate , the spell generates additional effects in each following round , as noted below . Each effect occurs during your turn .

title: Storm rider ' s pearl
description: Storm rider ' s pearl The storm rider ' s pearl was a marid item used by the Great Padisha of the Marid . Storm Rider ' s Pearl . The " storm rider ' s pearl " was similar to the " traveler ' s pearl s " but also allowed the Padisha to alter wind , summon storms , and to change the tides .
description_long: Storm rider ' s pearl The storm rider ' s pearl was a marid item used by the Great Padisha of the Marid . Storm Rider ' s Pearl . The " storm rider ' s pearl " was similar to the " traveler ' s pearl s " but also allowed the Padisha to alter wind , summon storms , and to change the tides . It was not consumed upon use like the " traveler ' s pearls " .

title: Storm shield
description: Storm shield Storm shield was an abjuration spell that absorbed electric effects that passed close by . Effects . This spell created an amber colored ball of glowing light at target chosen by the caster .
description_long: Storm shield Storm shield was an abjuration spell that absorbed electric effects that passed close by . Effects . This spell created an amber colored ball of glowing light at target chosen by the caster . Any electrical effect that passed close to the shield was attracted to the shield and absorbed .

title: Storm star
description: Storm star A storm star is a magical morning star of ancient design , thought to have originally been devised in Netheril . Many variants of the weapon exist , with most being cast in electrum - plated steel . They are among the longest and heaviest of morning stars .
description_long: Storm star A storm star is a magical morning star of ancient design , thought to have originally been devised in Netheril . Many variants of the weapon exist , with most being cast in electrum - plated steel . They are among the longest and heaviest of morning stars . Storm stars crackle with spectacular , though completely harmless , arcs of lightning when wielded . This weapon allows its wielder to unleash a more dangerous " chain lightning " spell called a " battle bolt " . It is worth between 1 , 500 and 15 , 000 gold pieces .

title: Storm walk
description: Storm walk Storm walk is a spell of the evocation school used by sorcerer s , most often those with a taste for the entropic forces of wild magic . " Storm walk " , when cast , makes each step of the sorcerer for a brief , momentary stride of five feet impact the ground with a thunderous clap , injuring a creature of the sorcerer ' s choice fifty feet or less away from their original location . The spell ' s power is determined by the sorcerer ' s charisma , as well as the sorcerer ' s degree of experience .
description_long: Storm walk Storm walk is a spell of the evocation school used by sorcerer s , most often those with a taste for the entropic forces of wild magic . " Storm walk " , when cast , makes each step of the sorcerer for a brief , momentary stride of five feet impact the ground with a thunderous clap , injuring a creature of the sorcerer ' s choice fifty feet or less away from their original location . The spell ' s power is determined by the sorcerer ' s charisma , as well as the sorcerer ' s degree of experience . As one of the most basic spells cast by sorcerers , " storm walk " the power needed to cast " storm walk " recharges instantaneously .

title: Stormazîn
description: Stormazîn The stormazîn was the high priest of Annam All - Father for all giant tribes , acting as a spiritual father for all giant priests of all giant deities . Selection . A " stormazîn " was the Great Priest of Annam for life ; a new " stormazîn " was elected by all of the giant tribes upon the death of the previous holder of the title .
description_long: Stormazîn The stormazîn was the high priest of Annam All - Father for all giant tribes , acting as a spiritual father for all giant priests of all giant deities . Selection . A " stormazîn " was the Great Priest of Annam for life ; a new " stormazîn " was elected by all of the giant tribes upon the death of the previous holder of the title . The " stormazîn " was always a male , and upon taking the title , he would advance to become the most powerful cleric of any giant . Duties . The duties of the " stormazîn " included taking care of Annam ' s grand temple , located in the Ice Spires northeast of Hartsvale ; training lesser priests , even those of the other giant deities ; traveling to various giant steadings to perform ritual ceremonies ; determining new religious laws ; and acting as a judge when disputes arose amongst priests . The " stormazîn ' s " power was limited to the religious sphere , but he was respected by giants from all societies . Most " Jotunbrud " chieftains , no matter their race , would heed the " stormazîn ' s " advice . Traditionally , the " stormazîn " offered it only rarely .

title: Stormblades
description: Stormblades The Stormblades were an adventuring company from the city of Tsurlagol in the Vast . History . The Stormblades were based in the city of Tsurlagol , but had come to Harrowdale in the Dalelands by 1370 DR .
description_long: Stormblades The Stormblades were an adventuring company from the city of Tsurlagol in the Vast . History . The Stormblades were based in the city of Tsurlagol , but had come to Harrowdale in the Dalelands by 1370 DR . There they were hired by Stablemaster Alark Phlamtryn of the Redmark inn to guard the inn ' s staff against treasure - hunters and thieves who ' d harass them .

title: Stormcloak
description: Stormcloak Stormcloak was a divine magic spell available to priests of Umberlee , the Sea Queen . It protected an individual from death by storm at sea when activated . Effects .
description_long: Stormcloak Stormcloak was a divine magic spell available to priests of Umberlee , the Sea Queen . It protected an individual from death by storm at sea when activated . Effects . To cast this spell , the priest had to touch the beneficiary . When cast upon a living being , this spell lasted for up to a year or until it was activated by speaking a secret word , whichever came first . To be effective , " stormcloak " had to be activated while the recipient was threatened by a storm in a sufficiently large body of water ; perhaps about to be dashed upon some rocks , struck by lightning , battered by flying debris , or capsized and drowned . The recipient could be in a vessel , or above or below the water , as long as the secret word could be spoken . Once triggered , " stormcloak " guaranteed that the protected person would not die as a result of the storm . Events were ordered by whatever means necessary to ensure the safety of the individual regardless of how improbable and coincidental the sequence of events may have seemed . Priests of Umberlee were not allowed to cast this spell on themselves or each other . Components .

title: Stormgale
description: Stormgale Stormgale was a high - ranking member of the Cult of the Howling Hatred at the Monastery of the Yellow Rose . History . In 1491 DR , Stormgale led two plots to access the elemental node under the Monastery of the Yellow Rose .
description_long: Stormgale Stormgale was a high - ranking member of the Cult of the Howling Hatred at the Monastery of the Yellow Rose . History . In 1491 DR , Stormgale led two plots to access the elemental node under the Monastery of the Yellow Rose . First , his right - hand agent Bloodwind tried to master a ritual involving many cultists who had infiltrated the monks . Afterward , Stormgale himself decided to kidnap some monks , planning to use them as sacrifice to open a " gate " to the Elemental Plane of Air . Rumors and Legends . Around 1491 DR , an adventuring party hired by Grandmaster Perrywinkle Shin to find the missing monks ruined his plan and Stormgale was defeated .

title: Stormhelm
description: Stormhelm Stormhelm was the capital and the only proper city of the kingdom of Eskorn , Returned Abeir . Government . As of 1479 DR , Stormhelm was ruled by King Ornan Roaryl .
description_long: Stormhelm Stormhelm was the capital and the only proper city of the kingdom of Eskorn , Returned Abeir . Government . As of 1479 DR , Stormhelm was ruled by King Ornan Roaryl . When he was traveling , the king appoint his trusted servant , Lord Mreskan Haundle , as his seneschal . Architecture . Stormhelm architecture was dominated by a haphazard stone layout , with many undeveloped areas and forested zones instead of blocks of buildings . The city was unwalled and had muddy roads flanked by gravel footpaths . Stormhelm was the only place in Eskorn with dwellings that had ornate entry halls , lavishly furnished and used only for entertaining guests . Its largest building was a stone fortress called the Throne Hall , home of the royal family . History . Stormhelm was named after a legendary human hero who fought and died during the rebellion against Eskornamundyr . The city was originally a dragon settlement made by dwarven slaves , and rebuilt by humans after Eskorn gained its freedom .

title: Stormkeep
description: Stormkeep Stormkeep was a tower located in the Fallen Lands in the Savage Frontier . Description . The tower had the shape of a sharp fang .
description_long: Stormkeep Stormkeep was a tower located in the Fallen Lands in the Savage Frontier . Description . The tower had the shape of a sharp fang . From the summit of the tower , lightning bolts constantly struck at passing clouds . Along with the slender and tapered walls , there weren ' t any visible doors or windows . The entire structure seemed carved from a single giant unique piece of obsidian . Inside the tower , there were large vats , inside which , in luminescent oils , there were immersed limbs that would attach themselves to any open wound if placed there . If an person covered themselves in the oils instead , they were healed in a very short time . History . According to the rumors that were circulating in the Fallen Lands , the only way to access the tower was to stumble on a nearby stone that was the site of an always - on " portal " . According to other stories , dragons came to the tower to feed on the limbs or to seek treatment , attacking any intruders in their path . Many other stories told of Netherese wizards who were asleep in a trance state for ages .

title: Stormsoul genasi
description: Stormsoul genasi Stormsoul genasi , were one of five common subraces or " manifestations " within the genasi race . Like all genasi manifestations , they could be manifested by experienced genasi who had a different primary manifestation but had trained themselves otherwise , or have acquired the manifestation as a result of hidden ancestry or environmental conditions . Description .
description_long: Stormsoul genasi Stormsoul genasi , were one of five common subraces or " manifestations " within the genasi race . Like all genasi manifestations , they could be manifested by experienced genasi who had a different primary manifestation but had trained themselves otherwise , or have acquired the manifestation as a result of hidden ancestry or environmental conditions . Description . Like most genasi , Stormsoul Genasi looked generally human with the exception for some distinguishing features . Stormsoul genasi " szuldar " were often silver in color , and most of the race had crystalline spikes in place of hair , though there were exceptions . The skin of the Stormsoul genasi was usually pale purple .

title: Stormwarden
description: Stormwarden Stormwardens are two - blade ranger s trained in an ancient fey tradition . Stormwardens are charged with the defense of the natural world , whether it be the Feywild or the Prime , twirling their dual weapons into a tempestuous assault that threatens to slay all who bring harm to the wild . Abilities .
description_long: Stormwarden Stormwardens are two - blade ranger s trained in an ancient fey tradition . Stormwardens are charged with the defense of the natural world , whether it be the Feywild or the Prime , twirling their dual weapons into a tempestuous assault that threatens to slay all who bring harm to the wild . Abilities . Stormwardens are furious foes and hone their skill with dual weapons into a series of deadly techniques . Even approaching a stormwarden can be dangerous since the rangers are taught how to swing their weapons , usually blade s , around them to impose a physical barrier . These abilities are made even more dangerous by an arcane connection with the Feywild that give stormwardens a few magic al traits . All stormwardens , even if they are not themselves fey , emulate the teleportation abilities of the eladrin and attacks made by experienced stormwardens often carry with them an electrical charge . These uncanny abilities make stormwardens altogether more deadly . However , stormwardens remain warrior s by nature , and are trained in the use of exploit s rather than spell s .

title: Storvald
description: Storvald Jarl Storvald was the ruler of the frost giant s sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . History . Storvald was one of the giant lords at time of the shattering of the ordning .
description_long: Storvald Jarl Storvald was the ruler of the frost giant s sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . History . Storvald was one of the giant lords at time of the shattering of the ordning . In the late 1480s or early 1490s DR after the disappearance of storm giant king Hekaton all giant lords started their path to reshape the ordning . Storvald first led his minions to reclaim Svarborg on the Sea of Moving Ice , the ancestral home of the frost giants , and managed also to enslave a pair of white dragon s . Later Storvald ' s plan to find the fabled Ring of Winter in order to start a new ice age , gaining to frost giants the supremacy . Later he gained the submissions of a tribe of Northlander barbarians and the alliance of the Zhentarim wizard Nilraun Dhaerlost , also interested in locate the Ring . So he send his minions in search of the artifact . Often Storvald went out of Svarborg with his colossal warship " Krigvind " to hunt whales .

title: Straits of Koryo
description: Straits of Koryo The Straits of Koryo were the channels of water lying between the Koryo Peninsula and the island of Saishu and the other small islands between them . Tides . The Straits of Koryo were famed for their huge tidal ranges and speeds : the water could rise a distance of 30 feet ( 9 .
description_long: Straits of Koryo The Straits of Koryo were the channels of water lying between the Koryo Peninsula and the island of Saishu and the other small islands between them . Tides . The Straits of Koryo were famed for their huge tidal ranges and speeds : the water could rise a distance of 30 feet ( 9 . 1 meters ) in only two hours . Low tide exposed the sea bed by the shore . Fauna . The Straits of Koryo were home to prides of sea lion s that menaced sailors , and huge orange crabs called dikanie . Hazards . When the tide went out , an unwary sailor could find their boat beached for hours in the mud . Worse , they became prey for the dikanie . Notorious pirates Crow Dz Pong and Rantoon Gwa plied the Straits of Koryo , harassing the coast between Pyong Do and the Ziyero Ridge . History . The fishermen of In ' ani and Ansong , on either side of the Straits of Koryo , had eliminated the dangerous prides of sea lions before 1357 DR . For this and other achievements , they were claimed to be the best in the world .

title: Strange Bedfellows
description: Strange Bedfellows The Zhentarim are indeed about to attack Loudwater . They have allied with a group of devil s and a surviving member of the Calishite Rensha family who used to rule over Loudwater . Otar , the Green Regent is leading an expedition to Silverymoon to see if he can gather allies to help defend against the upcoming attack .
description_long: Strange Bedfellows The Zhentarim are indeed about to attack Loudwater . They have allied with a group of devil s and a surviving member of the Calishite Rensha family who used to rule over Loudwater . Otar , the Green Regent is leading an expedition to Silverymoon to see if he can gather allies to help defend against the upcoming attack . Part 3 of the Tides of War miniseries was never published , somewhat spoiling its effect on the campaign . Information on the plot was taken from the following module .

title: Strasus Thingoleir
description: Strasus Thingoleir Strasus Thingoleir , nicknamed the " Bold " , was a talented archmage and adventurer living in Yhaunn in 1358 DR . Personality . Strasus was a dour old man with a bushy beard .
description_long: Strasus Thingoleir Strasus Thingoleir , nicknamed the " Bold " , was a talented archmage and adventurer living in Yhaunn in 1358 DR . Personality . Strasus was a dour old man with a bushy beard . Activities . Over the years Strasus built quite the reputation for saving the day at the last second with a powerful spell . History . Strasus was well - known for standing face to face with a red dragon and blasting it to bits with his magic . Though he was heavily singed from the fray , he lived to tell the tale and increase his legendary status .

title: Strategic charge
description: Strategic charge Strategic charge was an abjuration spell that let one dodge blows better while armored . Originally , it was unique to blackguard s and paladin s of the Red Knight , but other lawful orders eventually adopted this spell . Effects .
description_long: Strategic charge Strategic charge was an abjuration spell that let one dodge blows better while armored . Originally , it was unique to blackguard s and paladin s of the Red Knight , but other lawful orders eventually adopted this spell . Effects . For a few seconds ( longer for more experienced knights ) , the caster was able to move into or out of combat with less chance of injury from opponents taking the opportunity that such a move granted . Components . Only a verbal component and the use of the caster ' s holy symbol or divine focus were needed to cast this spell .

title: Streams of Silver
description: Streams of Silver Streams of Silver is the second book in the Icewind Dale trilogy by R . A . Salvatore .
description_long: Streams of Silver Streams of Silver is the second book in the Icewind Dale trilogy by R . A . Salvatore . It was later reissued as book five of the Legend of Drizzt series . Summary . In the first part of the book , the four companions Drizzt Do ' Urden , Bruenor Battlehammer , Wulfgar and Regis , set out on their quest for Mithral Hall . From Icewind Dale they first reach the city of Luskan . There Drizzt and Bruenor have to deal with Whisper and her gang to obtain a map of that area of the Realms , while Regis and Wulfgar get involved in a tavern brawl . The party then crosses the Crags where they have to face a band of orc s and the Uthgardt of the Sky Pony tribe , which unleashes a Spiritual Beast against them . Artemis Entreri , who is hunting for Regis , captures and interrogates Catti - brie . He learns of their quest from her and goes on the party ' s trail bringing her along . Also Dendybar the Mottled , a wizard of the Host Tower of the Arcane who is interested in the companions , believes Drizzt is in possession of Crenshinibon . The assassin and the wizard end up joining forces .

title: Street of Lances
description: Street of Lances The Street of Lances was a street in the Sea Ward of Waterdeep . Geography . The road was located at the very north of the ward just south of the Trolltower and intersected with the Street of the Singing Dolphin .
description_long: Street of Lances The Street of Lances was a street in the Sea Ward of Waterdeep . Geography . The road was located at the very north of the ward just south of the Trolltower and intersected with the Street of the Singing Dolphin . Inhabitants . The street was walked by broadcryer s who peddled their broadsheet s to passers - by .

title: Street of Ser - Ukcal
description: Street of Ser - Ukcal The Street of Ser - Ukcal was a road in Myth Nantar leading south from the Fire Fountain at the city ' s centre , to the South Gate at its edge , and was the usual point of entry to the city for most visitors . It was paved with white stones , and had many arches overhead , which , as of 1369 DR , made it tricky to negotiate .
description_long: Street of Ser - Ukcal The Street of Ser - Ukcal was a road in Myth Nantar leading south from the Fire Fountain at the city ' s centre , to the South Gate at its edge , and was the usual point of entry to the city for most visitors . It was paved with white stones , and had many arches overhead , which , as of 1369 DR , made it tricky to negotiate .

title: Street of Steel
description: Street of Steel The Street of Steel was a prominent avenue located in the City of Brass on the Elemental Plane of Fire in 1367 DR . This street was found within Keffinspires . Activity .
description_long: Street of Steel The Street of Steel was a prominent avenue located in the City of Brass on the Elemental Plane of Fire in 1367 DR . This street was found within Keffinspires . Activity . The ring of hammers on steel dominated this avenue as azer smiths pounded out metallic weapons and armor for the efreeti legions . The azer worked around the clock for the Sultan who would not allow them to take commissions from " ins " without his explicit permission , which he only gave on rare occasions .

title: Street of Stelae
description: Street of Stelae The Street of Stelae was a prominent avenue located in the City of Brass on the Elemental Plane of Fire in 1367 DR . Activity . This street was one of the main avenues of the city , running west from the Charcoal Palace in the Pyraculum to the harbors .
description_long: Street of Stelae The Street of Stelae was a prominent avenue located in the City of Brass on the Elemental Plane of Fire in 1367 DR . Activity . This street was one of the main avenues of the city , running west from the Charcoal Palace in the Pyraculum to the harbors . Hundreds of large pillars lined the street , decorated with scenes of the efreet dominance over the other races of the Plane of Fire .

title: Street of the Ajami
description: Street of the Ajami The Street of the Ajami , or Ajami Street , was located in Huzuz , the City of Delights , in 1367 DR . Description . The Street of the Ajami was adjacent to the Caravan Boulevard , branching off to head northwest to exit Huzuz near the Caliph ' s Harbor where it met the River Road .
description_long: Street of the Ajami The Street of the Ajami , or Ajami Street , was located in Huzuz , the City of Delights , in 1367 DR . Description . The Street of the Ajami was adjacent to the Caravan Boulevard , branching off to head northwest to exit Huzuz near the Caliph ' s Harbor where it met the River Road . The Street of the Ajami formed much of the southwest boundary for the Craft District , bisected the Warehouse District , and formed a small portion of the northeast borders of both the Central District and Pilgrims ' District . The street also lined a portion of the Court District where it bulged up into the southern Craft District .

title: Street of the Inns
description: Street of the Inns The Street of the Inns was located in Huzuz , the City of Delights , in 1367 DR . Description . The Street of the Inns branched off of the Pilgrims ' Route to head directly north into the vast courtyard that housed the Golden Mosque and the Palace of the Enlightened Throne .
description_long: Street of the Inns The Street of the Inns was located in Huzuz , the City of Delights , in 1367 DR . Description . The Street of the Inns branched off of the Pilgrims ' Route to head directly north into the vast courtyard that housed the Golden Mosque and the Palace of the Enlightened Throne . The Street of the Inns led foot traffic to the various mosques , while the Palace Lane branched off toward the palace .

title: Street of the Last Houses
description: Street of the Last Houses The Street of the Last Houses , also referred to as the Boneyard by the lower classes , was a necropolis located in the City of Brass in 1367 DR . The Street of the Last Houses was found in the Plume ward of the city . Activities .
description_long: Street of the Last Houses The Street of the Last Houses , also referred to as the Boneyard by the lower classes , was a necropolis located in the City of Brass in 1367 DR . The Street of the Last Houses was found in the Plume ward of the city . Activities . The efreet honored dead individuals of note including mages , nobles , and wealthy merchants by interring them into the small necropolis . The poor and lower classes of the City of Brass viewed any type of burial as a repugnant form of heresy .

title: Street of the Learned
description: Street of the Learned The Street of the Learned , or the University Road , was located in Huzuz , the City of Delights , in 1367 DR . Description . This street was so named because it provided the most direct route for students commuting to the ferries that crossed Al - Sarif River to the great university , Al - Bidir Sallah .
description_long: Street of the Learned The Street of the Learned , or the University Road , was located in Huzuz , the City of Delights , in 1367 DR . Description . This street was so named because it provided the most direct route for students commuting to the ferries that crossed Al - Sarif River to the great university , Al - Bidir Sallah . The Street of the Learned was adjacent to the Street of the Ajami in the Craft District , passing northeast though the district to exit the city and connect with the River Road and the ferries .

title: Strengthen water creature
description: Strengthen water creature Strengthen water creature was a spell unique to Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Effects . This spell increased the physical capabilities of creatures that lived in water , breathed water , or were from the Elemental Plane of Water .
description_long: Strengthen water creature Strengthen water creature was a spell unique to Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Effects . This spell increased the physical capabilities of creatures that lived in water , breathed water , or were from the Elemental Plane of Water . Creatures affected by this spell had stronger attacks and were more resistant to attacks of all kinds . They could also survive outside of water for the duration of the spell . " Weaken water creature " was the reverse of this spell and had the exact opposite effect . Components . This spell required a glass of water to cast .

title: Stretch spell
description: Stretch spell Stretch spell was a spell used by many sorcerer s early in their training . " Stretch spell " allowed sorcerers to bend the fabric of space to extend the reach of their spells , for a moment , by a number of feet dependent upon their natural agility and reflexes . " Stretch spell " was somewhat easy to cast , taking only an instant to use , and could be cast again after a rest of a few minutes .
description_long: Stretch spell Stretch spell was a spell used by many sorcerer s early in their training . " Stretch spell " allowed sorcerers to bend the fabric of space to extend the reach of their spells , for a moment , by a number of feet dependent upon their natural agility and reflexes . " Stretch spell " was somewhat easy to cast , taking only an instant to use , and could be cast again after a rest of a few minutes .

title: Striders
description: Striders The Striders , also called the Newts , were part of the standing army of the efreet in the City of Brass on the Elemental Plane of Fire . Organization . The Striders were a well - disciplined cavalry consisting of firenewt s .
description_long: Striders The Striders , also called the Newts , were part of the standing army of the efreet in the City of Brass on the Elemental Plane of Fire . Organization . The Striders were a well - disciplined cavalry consisting of firenewt s . Their ranks were 10 , 000 strong . Activities . The Striders were often used to attack fierce resistance from azer scattered across the Elemental Plane of Fire . Base of Operations . The City of Brass served as the base of the Striders , though they spent much of their time in the field at conquest .

title: Striding Giant Rapids
description: Striding Giant Rapids The Striding Giant Rapids was the name for a sections of rapids located around a petrified giant in the middle of the River Rauvin , just downriver from Everlund . Geography . Striding Giant Rapids was located just out of sight and to the west of Everlund in the Rauvin Vale .
description_long: Striding Giant Rapids The Striding Giant Rapids was the name for a sections of rapids located around a petrified giant in the middle of the River Rauvin , just downriver from Everlund . Geography . Striding Giant Rapids was located just out of sight and to the west of Everlund in the Rauvin Vale . Description . The Striding Giant was a statue ( in fact , a petrified hill giant ) of a giant stepping through the waters of the river . The statue caused a " snag " in the river . The water in that area was considered rough ; in the spring , runoff made the water deeper and more treacherous . History . Rumors of a terrible fate for anyone who disturbed the Striding Giant ensured that the obstacle was not removed from the river .

title: Strife domain
description: Strife domain The Strife domain was a deity domain that granted strife - related powers to divine spellcasters . They could inflict more damage on a foe in a group when using certain powers , or sow doubt in two enemies , hindering their combat ability . Deities with the Strife domain .
description_long: Strife domain The Strife domain was a deity domain that granted strife - related powers to divine spellcasters . They could inflict more damage on a foe in a group when using certain powers , or sow doubt in two enemies , hindering their combat ability . Deities with the Strife domain . The Strife domain was provided to divine spellcasters by Cyric and Lolth , and by Tiamat .

title: Striking wave
description: Striking wave Striking wave was a divine magic spell available to priests of Umberlee , the Bitch Queen . It created a large wave in a body of water that could be directed by the caster and heavily damage or destroy creatures , objects , vessels , and structures . Effects .
description_long: Striking wave Striking wave was a divine magic spell available to priests of Umberlee , the Bitch Queen . It created a large wave in a body of water that could be directed by the caster and heavily damage or destroy creatures , objects , vessels , and structures . Effects . Some part of the caster ' s body had to be in contact with a sufficiently large body of water for this spell to be effective . When cast , " striking wave " formed a large swell of water 10 to 100 ft ( 3 to 30 m ) wide as chosen by the caster . The wave traveled in a direction indicated by the caster and the course could be changed but required the caster to concentrate at the expense of doing anything else . The point of origin of the wave had to be within 105 ft ( 32 m ) of the caster ( more experienced casters could extend this range ) but the wave could travel for several miles ( kilometers ) before subsiding harmlessly . In order for " striking wave " to do damage , the last 60 ft ( 18 m ) of its journey had to be in a straight line for it to build up momentum or else objects in its path merely rode the swell of the wave or the impact was nothing extraordinary .

title: Strog Thunderblade
description: Strog Thunderblade Strog Thunderblade was the military leader of Goldenfields sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . Activities . Strog was the leader of the military force of Goldenfields .
description_long: Strog Thunderblade Strog Thunderblade was the military leader of Goldenfields sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . Activities . Strog was the leader of the military force of Goldenfields . However , thanks to all the local good foods and beer , he became very lazy , waking up late in the morning and falling asleep very early . Personality . Strog was an easygoing individual , loved by the abbot Ellardin Darovik for this reason .

title: Strogue Sstar
description: Strogue Sstar Strogue Sstar was a dwarf ruler in the Frozenfar . Personality . Unlike most dwarves , Strogue had no fear of magic .
description_long: Strogue Sstar Strogue Sstar was a dwarf ruler in the Frozenfar . Personality . Unlike most dwarves , Strogue had no fear of magic . Possessions . In battle , Sstar wore magical armor . History . Around 1358 DR , Strohue Sstar ruled the isolated city of Ironmaster . In 1366 DR , Sstar still ruled in the dwarven city .

title: Strohm I
description: Strohm I King Strohm I was the first king of Tethyr after the fall of the Shoon Imperium , having slain the Imperium ' s last emperor Amahl Shoon VII . Description . Strohm I was born with only a single arm , but this did not stop him from becoming a powerful warrior .
description_long: Strohm I King Strohm I was the first king of Tethyr after the fall of the Shoon Imperium , having slain the Imperium ' s last emperor Amahl Shoon VII . Description . Strohm I was born with only a single arm , but this did not stop him from becoming a powerful warrior . One of his nicknames was " the Left Hand of Vengeance " . Strohm I was also a powerful magic - user . He was said to have destroyed the Calishite city of Kyrakkis single - handedly with his magic . Activities . Strohm had the royal palace known as " Sa ' Tel ' Qussiar " constructed within the city of Zazesspur to serve as his residence . In later times , the location would become known as Alisande Court . Strohm also ordered the construction of a wall with magic wards to surround the ruins of Shoonach to contain its evil within . Relationships . Strohm I was an elf with Suldusk heritage . His father King Silvyr Ithal ' s father was a half - elf whose human bloodline was descended from King Darrom Ithal , and so Strohm , despite being an elf , was still of the royal Tethyrian line . Strohm married the granddaughter of former King Priam Tornamn , who had been a friend of his father ' s .

title: Strohm II
description: Strohm II King Strohm II was a half - elven ruler of Tethyr , the second king of the Strohm Dynasty . He was also the founder of the town of Mosstone . Description .
description_long: Strohm II King Strohm II was a half - elven ruler of Tethyr , the second king of the Strohm Dynasty . He was also the founder of the town of Mosstone . Description . In addition to being a king , Strohm was a druid . He was known as the " Stag King of Tethyr " . Relationships . Strohm II was the grandson of Strohm I , the previous ruler . He was the great - great - great - grandfather of Strohm III , who succeeded him . History . Strohm II was born in 540 DR . He succeeded his grandfather as king of Tethyr in 662 DR . In 687 DR , Strohm II founded the druids ' town of Mosstone . After the Fall of Myth Drannor , Strohm II provided a safe haven for the refugees both in his own court and in Tethyr ' s forests . After the defeat of the small nation of Tathtar in 731 DR , Strohm II officially made the region Elestam of Tethyr . This territory would later become the kingdom of Erlkazar . After living nearly two centuries , the Stag King of Tethyr died in 735 DR . He was succeeded by Strohm III . Appendix . Trivia . One of the designers of the " Lands of Intrigue " boxed set was named Keith Strohm .

title: Strohm III
description: Strohm III King Strohm III was a king of Tethyr . He was perhaps most famous for an epic battle he waged against the drow in the Marching Mountains . Description .
description_long: Strohm III King Strohm III was a king of Tethyr . He was perhaps most famous for an epic battle he waged against the drow in the Marching Mountains . Description . Strohm III was rumored to have been a giant . In any case , he was peerless as a warrior , and many tales were told of his great prowess in combat . Relationships . Strohm III was the great - great - great - grandson of Strohm II , who was a half - elf and thus long - lived , which was why Strohm III succeeded his great - great - great - grandfather as king of Tethyr instead of his own father . Strohm III had at least three sons . History . Strohm III was born in the Year of the Hungry Jaws , 715 DR . He was crowned king at the age of twenty years in the Year of the Prophet ' s Child , 735 DR . Strohm III fought many wars during his reign as king , beginning in 737 DR , when he led Tethyr in battle against the last of Tathar . Five years later , he engaged the drow in a war that would encompass more than thirty battles , most of which took place in the Forest of Mir .

title: Strohm IV
description: Strohm IV King Strohm IV was a king of Tethyr . He was famous for winning the Battle of Brinniq Dell . Description .
description_long: Strohm IV King Strohm IV was a king of Tethyr . He was famous for winning the Battle of Brinniq Dell . Description . Strohm IV was a great warrior like his father , King Strohm III . Possessions . The king possessed two powerful magical swords known as the " Royal Masque Blades " . Relationships . Strohm IV was the third son of Strohm III . His second nephew was his only heir . Strohm IV was said to have been protected by a platinum dragon . History . Strohm IV was born in the Year of the Jeweled Aerie , 745 DR . He was crowned king in the Year of the Torm Cloak , 769 DR . In 771 DR , King Strohm IV defeated a goblin horde led by chieftain Delgern the Three - Tusked in the Battle of Brinniq Dell . Strohm IV ' s second nephew succeeded him upon his death in 802 DR and reigned as Strohm V . In 1264 DR , Strohm ' s tomb in the Fields of the Dead was among those desecrated by thieves , who stole several royal artifacts , including the " Royal Masque Blades " . One of the blades , the " Lion Blade " , eventually ended up in the hands of Fual yn Senaor al Barasth of Memnon .

title: Strongheart halfling
description: Strongheart halfling The strongheart halflings were , like the ghostwise and lightfoot hin , native to Luiren . They traced their ancestry back to the same long - lost days as the other subraces , but unlike their cousins , the stronghearts elected to remain in their homeland following the events of the Hin Ghostwar . The legacy of Chand , the strong - heart war chieftain who galvanized his tribe against the threat of the feral ghostwise , lived on in a nation that both reinforced and defied many of the expectations non - halflings had of this race .
description_long: Strongheart halfling The strongheart halflings were , like the ghostwise and lightfoot hin , native to Luiren . They traced their ancestry back to the same long - lost days as the other subraces , but unlike their cousins , the stronghearts elected to remain in their homeland following the events of the Hin Ghostwar . The legacy of Chand , the strong - heart war chieftain who galvanized his tribe against the threat of the feral ghostwise , lived on in a nation that both reinforced and defied many of the expectations non - halflings had of this race .

title: Stronghold of the Nine
description: Stronghold of the Nine The Stronghold of the Nine was an underground cavern complex on the banks of the Unicorn Run . History . Originally a dwarven hold , it was abandoned and fell into ruin until The Nine rediscovered and renovated it .
description_long: Stronghold of the Nine The Stronghold of the Nine was an underground cavern complex on the banks of the Unicorn Run . History . Originally a dwarven hold , it was abandoned and fell into ruin until The Nine rediscovered and renovated it . It was claimed that the citadel was guarded by naga s and golem s as well as The Nine themselves , all of whom were powerful adventurers . It was believed that most of the group ' s accumulated treasure was stored within . When The Nine finished their work restoring the place , several of them effectively retired there , going on less and less frequent adventures . When Laeral Silverhand brought the " Crown of Horns " back with her to the Stronghold in 1337 DR , her fellows were gripped with a desire to possess it and their secure home transformed into a battleground as The Nine and their followers battled each other . Four members of the group died and their outposts on the surface were abandoned as the battles became more concentrated underground . Many of the magical defenses in place failed as the last three living spellcasters concentrated on the infighting .

title: Stronk
description: Stronk Stronk was a fomorian living in the Wormwrithings during the Rage of Demons . Relationship . Stronk somehow formed a bond with the purple worm s .
description_long: Stronk Stronk was a fomorian living in the Wormwrithings during the Rage of Demons . Relationship . Stronk somehow formed a bond with the purple worm s . Activities . Stronk acted as a caretaker for the eggs of purple worms in the area . History . During the Rage of Demons , he was killed by an expedition led by some adventurers , hired by Bruenor Battlehammer to investigate the threat of the demon lords , who were in need of a purple worm egg for a rite to banish the demon lord s .

title: Stronmaus
description: Stronmaus Stronmaus ( " strawn " - mawz ) is the giant deity of the Sun , Sky , Weather , Seas , and Joy . His symbol is a forked lightning bolt descending from a cloud that partly obscures the sun . Description .
description_long: Stronmaus Stronmaus ( " strawn " - mawz ) is the giant deity of the Sun , Sky , Weather , Seas , and Joy . His symbol is a forked lightning bolt descending from a cloud that partly obscures the sun . Description . Stronmaus ' avatar appears as an enormous ( up to 80 ' tall ) giant with blue eyes and wavy flowing auburn - red hair , and wearing a simple gold - edged white robe . He is far more youthful and carefree than his father Annam . He is normally depicted smiling and reveling . He cannot help but smile , for the energy of life flows through him so strongly that it is hard not for him to express his continual exuberance . He revels in the storms he calls up and in the thunder that booms from his magical hammer . Stronmaus has inherited some of his father ' s fickle lusts , and may send avatars simply to woo and seduce beautiful female giants . Relationships . Stronmaus is the eldest son of Annam and thus the default leader of the giantish pantheon since Annam ' s withdrawal , though he does not covet his father ' s power . He will happily defer to Annam the moment the creator god returns .

title: Studded leather
description: Studded leather Studded leather armor ( also known as brigandine ) was a type of armor used on Toril . Description . Studded leather was made from tough but flexible leather .
description_long: Studded leather Studded leather armor ( also known as brigandine ) was a type of armor used on Toril . Description . Studded leather was made from tough but flexible leather . It was reinforced with numerous close - set rivets or spikes . Studded leather provided slightly more protection than regular leather armor . Each set was fitted with hundreds of rivets .

title: Student of the Seven
description: Student of the Seven A student of the Seven is a bard who has learned to embrace the versatility of his or her training , extending it further to a point where the bard is less a specialized arcane spellcaster and more a jack - of - all - trades . Students of the Seven , who take their inspiration from a semi - mythical band of seven known for their variety and lack of a confirmed identity , learn from all venues of life and consider no knowledge beyond them . In increasing their own versatility , a student of the Seven often learn to make others better at what they do as well .
description_long: Student of the Seven A student of the Seven is a bard who has learned to embrace the versatility of his or her training , extending it further to a point where the bard is less a specialized arcane spellcaster and more a jack - of - all - trades . Students of the Seven , who take their inspiration from a semi - mythical band of seven known for their variety and lack of a confirmed identity , learn from all venues of life and consider no knowledge beyond them . In increasing their own versatility , a student of the Seven often learn to make others better at what they do as well . Culture . The Seven are an archetype which can be found widely through many cultures . Sometimes , they are depicted as sisters , sometimes as brothers , but every time they are wondrous muses , individuals who , perhaps as exarch s or angel s , seek to feed the growth and flourishing of the arts . Some tales describe them as the inventors of the arts , others as simply patrons , while others pertain that they are agents of some higher power . No story of the Seven is exactly the same as the one before it and it is this versatility , this endless possibility , that students of the Seven hope to evoke .

title: Studious Mamluk Society
description: Studious Mamluk Society The Studious Mamluk Society , also known as the Studious , was a military organization in Zakhara . Activities . Contrary to most of the mamluk organizations in Zakhara , the Studious focused on espionage and communication .
description_long: Studious Mamluk Society The Studious Mamluk Society , also known as the Studious , was a military organization in Zakhara . Activities . Contrary to most of the mamluk organizations in Zakhara , the Studious focused on espionage and communication . Organization . The Studious were led by General Okin Abd al - Talib ' ilm . Base of Operations . Qudra was the base of operations for the Studious . They also operated in Huzuz , Wasat , and Utaqa .

title: Stump Bog
description: Stump Bog The Stump Bog was a swamp to the east of the hamlet of Rassalantar . Geography . The foul swamp was located just south of Goldenfields , and its waters were fed from the River Dessarin .
description_long: Stump Bog The Stump Bog was a swamp to the east of the hamlet of Rassalantar . Geography . The foul swamp was located just south of Goldenfields , and its waters were fed from the River Dessarin . This also made the bog a convenient body disposal site for killers , thieves , and dishonest Waterdhavians . Inhabitants . There were many rumors of buried treasure in its murky waters , but fortune hunters needed to beware the denizens who haunted the dark marsh . Like the sewerm , a large water snake , which hunted the foul waters of the Stump Bog . History . Stump Bog was named after the many rotting stumps rising out of the green algae covered waters .

title: Stumpet Rakingclaw
description: Stumpet Rakingclaw Stumpet Rakingclaw was a dwarven cleric from Mithral Hall . Description . She was a fiery dwarf with a short red beard .
description_long: Stumpet Rakingclaw Stumpet Rakingclaw was a dwarven cleric from Mithral Hall . Description . She was a fiery dwarf with a short red beard . Personality . Stumpet was an excellent brewer of dwarven holy water and Bruenor awarded her a nine out of ten for her brewing skills . Stumpet was a great spellcaster , but not known for her intellect , since she thought putting Harkle ' s eyes in her mouth would keep them moist . History . She was born in Citadel Adbar . Around 1358 DR , Stumpet auditioned before Bruenor Battlehammer to replace the fallen Cobble as Holy Cleric of the Hall . During the Time of Troubles , Harkle Harpell became separated from his eyes and Stumpet was given the duty of guarding his eyes until he could reach Mithral Hall . During the Battle of Keeper ' s Dale , Stumpet rallied five hundred dwarves to open the door of Mithral Hall and charge the drow horde lead by Berg ' inyon Baenre . She treated King Bruenor Battlehammer when he was struck by magic and put into a coma .

title: Stun dart
description: Stun dart A stun dart is a hollow dart that contains poison . When it impacts , it pierces and also releases a puff of poison gas that can stun an opponent for up to five minutes . Stun darts cost 40 gp each and weigh around 1 lb ( 450 g ) .
description_long: Stun dart A stun dart is a hollow dart that contains poison . When it impacts , it pierces and also releases a puff of poison gas that can stun an opponent for up to five minutes . Stun darts cost 40 gp each and weigh around 1 lb ( 450 g ) .

title: Stuyles
description: Stuyles Stuyles was a farmer who owned land near Luskan . However , he was driven off of his land by the policies of the High Captains of Luskan . Thus Stuyles and many of his fellows became bandits assaulting the caravans of Luskan .
description_long: Stuyles Stuyles was a farmer who owned land near Luskan . However , he was driven off of his land by the policies of the High Captains of Luskan . Thus Stuyles and many of his fellows became bandits assaulting the caravans of Luskan . In 1463 DR , their ambush was repelled by Dahlia Sin ' felle and Drizzt Do ' Urden . After Drizzt discovered the whole truth of their situation , he was shocked and offered some goods to Stuyles and his fellows .

title: Styx
description: Styx The river Styx ( frequently River Styx ) linked the topmost layers of the Lower Planes . The Styx did not extend into the Astral Plane but portals existed along its banks . The seven lower planes , as described by the Great Wheel cosmology model , were Acheron , the Nine Hells , Gehenna , Hades , Tarterus , the Abyss , and Pandemonium .
description_long: Styx The river Styx ( frequently River Styx ) linked the topmost layers of the Lower Planes . The Styx did not extend into the Astral Plane but portals existed along its banks . The seven lower planes , as described by the Great Wheel cosmology model , were Acheron , the Nine Hells , Gehenna , Hades , Tarterus , the Abyss , and Pandemonium . The Styx was also connected to the fifth level of the Nine Hells , Stygia , where it cut a channel through the great frozen sea . Some branches of the Styx flowed down holes in the first layer of the Abyss ( which were conduits to the various levels ) and some of these holes supplied water to the Styx in reverse waterfalls . When encountered , the river was a deep , swift , and unfordable torrent . Those who touched or drank from the Styx would forget their past lives completely for a while , sometimes permanently . Travelers were advised to use the boatman Charon or his servants ( the charonadaemon s ) to navigate the river . If nonnatives attempted to circumvent the river by flying or walking over it , there was a good chance of attracting hydrodaemon s or styx devil s .

title: Su ' un
description: Su ' un Su ' un was an island south of the large island of Saishu , off the coast of the Koryo Peninsula in northeast Kara - Tur . Description . It was a desert island , a bleak place of sand and jagged rocks with constant wind .
description_long: Su ' un Su ' un was an island south of the large island of Saishu , off the coast of the Koryo Peninsula in northeast Kara - Tur . Description . It was a desert island , a bleak place of sand and jagged rocks with constant wind . History . Seeking a suitable locale for his hermitage , the shukenja and holy man Chiquong had journeyed to the southern tip of Saishu , but had still found nothing to his liking . So instead he raised the island of Su ' un from the depths of the sea . There he dwelled , with the wind his only companion . The shukenja Pitalla was believed to have later visited Su ' un and left the " leaping fish " there . Legends . Rumors told that Chiquong still lived on Su ' un by 1350 DR , and that he could predict the future and hid great riches .

title: Su - monster
description: Su - monster Su - monsters were evil primate - like creatures with innate psionic abilities . They could be found in the Snowflake Mountains as of 1361 DR , and were prevalent on the Yadd al - Djinni islands of Zakhara ' s Crowded Sea in the same period . Description .
description_long: Su - monster Su - monsters were evil primate - like creatures with innate psionic abilities . They could be found in the Snowflake Mountains as of 1361 DR , and were prevalent on the Yadd al - Djinni islands of Zakhara ' s Crowded Sea in the same period . Description . Su - monsters had gorilla - like heads , attached to a canine physique , with broad chests and thin , tapered waists . Their four prehensile limbs were tipped with sharp nails , which alongside their prehensile tails made them adept climbers . They could suspend themselves upside - down , and often used this to their advantage when hunting for prey . The creatures had filthy gray fur , black faces , and blood - red paws . They were known to inhabit both underground areas as well as open - air wilderness , in a wide variety of different environments , and in both tropical and temperate climates . Personality . Evil and chaotic by nature , it was a matter of debate among druid s whether su - monsters were considered sentient or not . Beseeching his god , Silvanus , the druid Newander was able to determine the primates as self - aware , and thus fair game to kill . Combat .

title: Su - to
description: Su - to Su - to was a samurai ghost actor in the Fochu Peninsula in Wa . History . Around 1148 DR , Su - to was the greatest noh actor and dramatist of Wa .
description_long: Su - to Su - to was a samurai ghost actor in the Fochu Peninsula in Wa . History . Around 1148 DR , Su - to was the greatest noh actor and dramatist of Wa . Thanks to his popularity , he asked the shogun to built a theater for himself in Tsuta Island in Fochu Peninsula . The shogun granted this to Su - to and he gathered the best actors of Wa in Tsuta . However , a massive undersea earthquake caused the island to sink , killing Su - to and the entire company . Around 1248 DR , however , some of Su - to ' s admirers in the Celestial Bureaucracy caused the island to resurface with the theater intact and Su - to and his company of players got to live again as ghost s . From then on , Su - to performed monthly for the gods .

title: Su Po
description: Su Po Su Po was a member of the Society of the Purple Lotus in Shou Lung . History . As with all members of the Society of the Purple Lotus , Su Po wished to destroy the Mandarinate that ruled Shou Lung .
description_long: Su Po Su Po was a member of the Society of the Purple Lotus in Shou Lung . History . As with all members of the Society of the Purple Lotus , Su Po wished to destroy the Mandarinate that ruled Shou Lung . He was seized by the Emperor ' s agents for writing documents speaking out against the bureaucracy . He was found guilty of crimes against the state and sentenced to the Valley of Exiles . Only his distant blood relation to the Emperor saved him from harsher punishment . Before committing his crimes , Su Po was a popular poet and scholar . Since his exile , the Emperor ordered that all of his written documents were to be destroyed .

title: Substitution level
description: Substitution level Substitution levels are unusual talents developed by some people in Realmspace . Each is specific to a given character class . Often they are linked to a specific race , or a particular personal background .
description_long: Substitution level Substitution levels are unusual talents developed by some people in Realmspace . Each is specific to a given character class . Often they are linked to a specific race , or a particular personal background . In order to gain a substitution level , the character usually has to give up what would normally be a feature of their character class .

title: Succubus
description: Succubus Of the many demons that exist in the universe , Succubi are most often encountered in the mortal world . This is due to their extraordinary beauty and carnal desires ; traits that attract mortal spellcasters to summon the demoness forth to use for their own debased desire . Succubi delight in causing suffering by manipulating the desires of mortals and tempting them into depraved acts that they would normally avoid .
description_long: Succubus Of the many demons that exist in the universe , Succubi are most often encountered in the mortal world . This is due to their extraordinary beauty and carnal desires ; traits that attract mortal spellcasters to summon the demoness forth to use for their own debased desire . Succubi delight in causing suffering by manipulating the desires of mortals and tempting them into depraved acts that they would normally avoid . This strife often causes the destruction of long - term relationships and sows distrust between life - long friends and lovers . Succubi are not warriors . Their method of causing destruction is slow and manipulative when compared to other demons . These beautiful fiends will often go to great lengths to avoid battle , using their many demonic powers to assume mortal guises and manipulate others around them to fight in their stead . Many Succubi are under command of the demon lord Graz ' zt , but in the whole , they are ruled by their Queen , Malcanthet . The female child of a succubus and a human is traditionally called an Alu - fiend and the male child a Cambion .

title: Sudai Calin
description: Sudai Calin Sudai Calin lived within the Tower of Adnan al - Raqi in Huzuz , the City of Delights , in 1367 DR . Activities . Sudai was a dwarven sha ' ir and instructor for Adnan al - Raqi ' s students .
description_long: Sudai Calin Sudai Calin lived within the Tower of Adnan al - Raqi in Huzuz , the City of Delights , in 1367 DR . Activities . Sudai was a dwarven sha ' ir and instructor for Adnan al - Raqi ' s students . He also spent time learning the higher powers of the sha ' ir with Adnan and the other instructors .

title: Suelivain
description: Suelivain Suelivain was a male shade from Thultanthar . He was the leader of Demarch ' s Folly , an organization dedicated to learning shadow magic . Abilities .
description_long: Suelivain Suelivain was a male shade from Thultanthar . He was the leader of Demarch ' s Folly , an organization dedicated to learning shadow magic . Abilities . Suelivain was a wizard and shadowcaster , practicing both traditional arcane magic and shadow magic . He merged both in the path of the noctumancer . He was familiar with , but did not use , Shadow Weave magic . Possessions . Suelivain owned a number of magic item s . He wrote down his notes on shadow magic in the " tome of Suelivain " . History . Suelivain was dwelling in Thultanthar when a shadowstorm struck and he lost several of his possessions , including the " tome of Suelivain " . His things were spread across the Plane of Shadow . Unbeknownst to him , however , a rift to the plane later deposited his things in the Halls of Demarch in the city of Tantras in Faerûn . Members of Demarch ' s Folly found the " tome of Suelivain " and from it they learned the fundamentals of shadow magic . They tracked down Suelivain and returned his tome and other possessions in exchange for training in the ways of shadow magic . Suelivain accepted and joined Demarch ' s Folly in the role of mentor and leader .

title: Suggestion
description: Suggestion Suggestion was an enchantment spell used to compel a subject to follow the caster ' s orders , but only if they could understand the caster ' s spoken language . Effects . With this spell the caster influenced the subject through verbal suggestions .
description_long: Suggestion Suggestion was an enchantment spell used to compel a subject to follow the caster ' s orders , but only if they could understand the caster ' s spoken language . Effects . With this spell the caster influenced the subject through verbal suggestions . In order to work properly , the suggestion needed to be worded so the subject believed the suggestion was reasonable . For example , the spell would probably fail if the caster asked a fire elemental to dive into a body of water . However , if the caster could convince the fire elemental that the water was harmless , then the spell had a greater chance of succeeding . The caster could issue new suggestions for the duration of the spell . However , the spell ended when the subject completed any suggestion . The suggestion went unfulfilled if the spell ended and the subject had not completed their task . Components . This spell required a snake ' s tongue and either a small piece of honeycomb or a drop of sweet oil to cast .

title: Suha
description: Suha Suha was a noble dao and slave of the Unspeakable in Huzuz , the City of Delights , in 1367 DR . Activities . Suha remained at the Unspeakable ' s side at all times under a guise of " invisibility " while the yikarian was in control of Mu ' izzi al - Kamar ' s body .
description_long: Suha Suha was a noble dao and slave of the Unspeakable in Huzuz , the City of Delights , in 1367 DR . Activities . Suha remained at the Unspeakable ' s side at all times under a guise of " invisibility " while the yikarian was in control of Mu ' izzi al - Kamar ' s body . Like all dao enslaved to a yikarian , Suha despised her master and was constantly looking for ways to betray his presence to the natives of Huzuz . Since she could not directly betray the Unspeakable , she would often whisper cryptic hints into guests ear ' s when her master hosted a large party . History . Under direct orders from the Unspeakable , Suha hid special magical amulets within the masonry of each room of the Royal Harim of Huzuz . These amulets made it impossible for any female within the room to conceive a male child .

title: Suhail
description: Suhail Suhail was a female marid who served the notorious sha ' ir Adnan al - Raqi in 1367 DR . Activities . Suhail was tied to a " ring of genie summoning " owned by Adnan .
description_long: Suhail Suhail was a female marid who served the notorious sha ' ir Adnan al - Raqi in 1367 DR . Activities . Suhail was tied to a " ring of genie summoning " owned by Adnan . She was forced to obey Adnan ' s call whenever he activated the ring ' s magic .

title: Suhailah al - Hawai
description: Suhailah al - Hawai Suhailah al - Hawai was a minor member of the Corsair Council of Hawa . Description . Suhailah was sturdy like most dwarves and possessed blue eyes and brown hair .
description_long: Suhailah al - Hawai Suhailah al - Hawai was a minor member of the Corsair Council of Hawa . Description . Suhailah was sturdy like most dwarves and possessed blue eyes and brown hair . Personality . Her acidic tongue earned her fame , or infamy , throughout Hawa . She was happiest while on her ships and enjoyed working on them instead of sitting in on boring meetings . Abilities . A long career as a smuggler provided Suhailah with plenty of skills common to most rogues . She possessed a keen intellect , which translated well regarding ship improvements for speed and design . Activities . A minor member of the council , Suhailah was typically too busy to attend meetings .

title: Sulabra
description: Sulabra Sulabra was the Realms name for . Description . Sulabra was a soft , gray stone somewhere in between slate and shale in color and hardness .
description_long: Sulabra Sulabra was the Realms name for . Description . Sulabra was a soft , gray stone somewhere in between slate and shale in color and hardness . It easily cleaved in planes and was good for cheap carvings . It was of relatively low value due to its lack of color and durability . A typical price was 7 sp per pound ( 15 . 5 sp / kg ) . Powers . None known .

title: Sulasspryn
description: Sulasspryn Sulasspryn was a Moonsea city . History . In 974 DR ( Year of the Haunting Harpy ) , the Moonsea settlement that was built around the stronghold of retired half - elf adventurer Sulass Drowsbane is incorporated as the city of Sulasspryn .
description_long: Sulasspryn Sulasspryn was a Moonsea city . History . In 974 DR ( Year of the Haunting Harpy ) , the Moonsea settlement that was built around the stronghold of retired half - elf adventurer Sulass Drowsbane is incorporated as the city of Sulasspryn . The powers at Zhentil Keep meet with representatives of the other Moonsea cities in 1276 DR ( Year of the Crumbling Keep ) , and suggest that a joint force man the Citadel of the Raven . The cities of Hillsfar , Phlan , Mulmaster , Voonlar , Melvaunt , Thentia , Sulasspryn , Yûlash , and Zhentil Keep send forces to repair and occupy the citadel . Some of these cities use criminals , prisoners , and malcontents to make up their forces . The cities of Hulburg and Sulasspryn are defeated by Mulmaster in 1306 DR ( Year of Thunder ) during the Moonsea War . In 1307 DR ( Year of the Mace ) , Sulasspryn suddenly and inexplicably collapses in on itself , dropping into a large sinkhole . An entire city , and 7 , 500 people , are crushed in less than ten minutes . Sulasspryn is promptly abandoned for all time .

title: Sulbain
description: Sulbain Sulbain , also called Steeleye , was a pegasus who was stabled at Sarahin , the great fortress of the Everlasting . Activites . The Grandfather of the Everlasting trained Sulbain since birth , relying on harsh methods to bend the magical creature to his will .
description_long: Sulbain Sulbain , also called Steeleye , was a pegasus who was stabled at Sarahin , the great fortress of the Everlasting . Activites . The Grandfather of the Everlasting trained Sulbain since birth , relying on harsh methods to bend the magical creature to his will . The Grandfather was the only person allowed to ride Sulbain .

title: Suld
