title: Sun stone
description: Sun stone Sun stone was a spell unique to Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Effects . This spell turned a small stone into a magical incendiary missile .
description_long: Sun stone Sun stone was a spell unique to Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Effects . This spell turned a small stone into a magical incendiary missile . When held in the sunlight , a regular stone became so hot that it glowed with heat but did not harm the caster . The " sun stone " was aimed at a target like a " magic missile " . If the stone missed its target then it fell to the ground where it was still hot enough to damage anything touching it for several minutes . Wizards were capable of casting multiple " sun stones " at once depending on their magical might . Each " sun stone " had its own target . Components . This spell required a small stone to cast .

title: Sunbeam
description: Sunbeam Sunbeam , also known as sunray , was an evocation spell that allowed the caster to repeatedly fire destructive beams of sunlight . Effect . There were two known versions of this spell .
description_long: Sunbeam Sunbeam , also known as sunray , was an evocation spell that allowed the caster to repeatedly fire destructive beams of sunlight . Effect . There were two known versions of this spell . The newer version , " sunbeam " , had a range of 60 ft ( 18 . 3 m ) , gave a number of beams proportional to the experience of the druid , and harmed and possibly blinded all in its path . The older version , " sunray " , had fewer beams and could only blind normal creatures , but was particularly effective against undead , blasting out 10 ft ( 3 m ) wide beams with greater range that could do collateral damage to any undead within 20 ft ( 6 . 1 m ) of the central corridor of destruction . The caster could move between blasts , but any other action would end the spell . Otherwise , the spell lasted until the duration was up , or until the maximum number of beams had been fired , whichever came first . Creatures that did not shield their eyes in time were blinded for a few minutes , and those using some form of low - light vision were more severely affected . Creatures particularly vulnerable to sunlight could be permanently blinded and doubly harmed .

title: Sunbright Steelshanks
description: Sunbright Steelshanks Sunbright Steelshanks was a Rengarth barbarian who caught the eye of the Netherese wizard s Candlemas and Sysquemalyn . Description . The blond haired barbarian was slender and quick with corded muscles .
description_long: Sunbright Steelshanks Sunbright Steelshanks was a Rengarth barbarian who caught the eye of the Netherese wizard s Candlemas and Sysquemalyn . Description . The blond haired barbarian was slender and quick with corded muscles . With his bright hair and strong legs , the barbarian was given the name of " Sunbright Steelshanks " by his mother Monkberry on his name date . Possessions . When traveling , Sunbright dressed in a worn shirt , and iron studded boots , and a brown goatskin . Over his shoulders , he wore a longbow , a bedroll , and his sword Harvester of Blood . When hunting , Sunbright carried a knife for gutting deer . History . During the Shadowed Age , Steelshanks was born to Monkberry and Sevenhaunt . For many years , Sunbright lived with his parents in the Rengarth tribe called the Ravens until his father took ill and died . A year before the events of " Sword Play " , Sunbright killed his first Angardt enemy and was granted his father ' s greatsword " Harvester of Blood " by his mother . Envious , the Raven shaman Owldark prophesied Steelshanks would murder his people , so Sunbright fled in the night with the help of his mother .

title: Sunburst
description: Sunburst Sunburst was an arcane evocation and divine spell that blinded and damaged nearby enemies . Effects . There were a few different versions of this spell that developed over time .
description_long: Sunburst Sunburst was an arcane evocation and divine spell that blinded and damaged nearby enemies . Effects . There were a few different versions of this spell that developed over time . The earliest version was centered on the caster , and indeed the radiance was emitted from the caster ' s person out to a minimum radius of 160 ft ( 49 m ) ; even farther for more experienced casters . Later versions could be cast at a point far away and burst with a fixed size . The pre - Spellplague version had a range of at least 1 , 000 ft ( 305 m ) and an 80 ft ( 24 m ) radius of effect . The post - Second Sundering version could only be cast out to 150 ft ( 46 m ) and burst in a 60 ft ( 18 m ) radius . " Sunburst " caused a globe of searing heat and radiance to explode instantly and silently from the caster or the targeted point . All creatures in the globe had a chance to be blinded and damaged by the heat . Creatures that could see in darkness , or to whom sunlight was harmful ( such as vampire s ) or unnatural ( such as drow ) were affected more severely .

title: Sunburst ( prayer )
description: Sunburst ( prayer ) Sunburst was a cleric prayer in the post - Spellplague era that simultaneously burned enemies and healed allies . Effects . This prayer could be invoked at a distance of up to 50 ft ( 15 m ) away and created a 25 ft ( 7 .
description_long: Sunburst ( prayer ) Sunburst was a cleric prayer in the post - Spellplague era that simultaneously burned enemies and healed allies . Effects . This prayer could be invoked at a distance of up to 50 ft ( 15 m ) away and created a 25 ft ( 7 . 6 m ) square of light that could burn each enemy with divine radiance and at the same time heal the caster and all allies within the area of effect . This prayer require at least a few minutes rest between castings .

title: Sundabar
description: Sundabar Sundabar is a defensible , dwarven - built fortress that became a refuge for Prince Simberuel Astalmé of Ascalhorn and his collected survivors . As the years rolled on , the human s grew in number until emerging as the dominant race of a bastion city against the dangers of the North . Geography .
description_long: Sundabar Sundabar is a defensible , dwarven - built fortress that became a refuge for Prince Simberuel Astalmé of Ascalhorn and his collected survivors . As the years rolled on , the human s grew in number until emerging as the dominant race of a bastion city against the dangers of the North . Geography . Sundabar was located in Sundabar Vale on the western side of Silverymoon Pass , with the Nether Mountains making up the southern border of the valley . The Rauvin Mountains and Citadel Felbarr were upriver on the River Redrun . The nearest towns were Rauvincross downriver , Baraskur to the east , and Auvandell in the western Nether Mountains . Sundabar was directly connected to Citadel Adbar by the Dead Orc Pass , but only the most daring ( or foolish ) of travelers took that route . Beneath Sundabar was a volcano rift known as the Everfire . . Structure . The surface portion of the city was surrounded by two ring walls separated a moat ( called Tarnar ' s Moat ) , with four gates and bridges into the city : Swordsgate in the north , Eastgate in the northeast , Turnstone Gate in the southeast , and Rivergate in the west . Sundabar was described as " harsh [ and ] treeless .

title: Sundazzle
description: Sundazzle Sundazzle was a spell unique to Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Effects . If cast in full sunlight , or in the presence of spells that mimicked full sunlight , this spell caused small spheres of multicolored light to strike the target ' s eyes and blind them .
description_long: Sundazzle Sundazzle was a spell unique to Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Effects . If cast in full sunlight , or in the presence of spells that mimicked full sunlight , this spell caused small spheres of multicolored light to strike the target ' s eyes and blind them . Components . This spell required a small glob of sweet gum to cast .

title: Sune
description: Sune Sune ( pronounced " SOO - nee " ) , also known as Lady Firehair , was the deity of beauty , with governance also over love . Her dogma primarily concerned love based on outward beauty , with primary importance placed upon loving people who responded to the Sunite ' s appearance . Her symbol was that of a beautiful woman with red hair .
description_long: Sune Sune ( pronounced " SOO - nee " ) , also known as Lady Firehair , was the deity of beauty , with governance also over love . Her dogma primarily concerned love based on outward beauty , with primary importance placed upon loving people who responded to the Sunite ' s appearance . Her symbol was that of a beautiful woman with red hair . Description . When Sune appeared to the mortals of Faerûn she wore only a near - transparent gown . She was known for her lustrous red hair that draped down to the ground , her eyes of shining emerald s and ruby red plump lips . Worshipers . Sune ' s highest priest was known as the Heartwarder , usually being the most handsome / beautiful clergy member both inside and out . They were expected to keep their appearance as flattering as possible and shower others with sweet words at least five times a month . Sune ' s clerics sought to bring beauty to the world in many forms , all of which were pleasing to the senses . They created great works of art , became patrons for promising actors , and imported exotic luxuries like satin and fine wines . Her followers also enjoyed looking beautiful , and hearing tales of romance .

title: Sune ' s caress
description: Sune ' s caress Named for Lady Firehair , Sune ' s caress is an enchantment spell that fills a subject with intense feelings of love , which evildoers can ' t quite process . Effect . A caster ' s gentle touch fills the target with tremendous feelings of love and compassion , and has the power to unnerve and debilitate evil creatures .
description_long: Sune ' s caress Named for Lady Firehair , Sune ' s caress is an enchantment spell that fills a subject with intense feelings of love , which evildoers can ' t quite process . Effect . A caster ' s gentle touch fills the target with tremendous feelings of love and compassion , and has the power to unnerve and debilitate evil creatures . One must successfully touch the subject to affect the unwilling . It has no effect on a creature that one does not know is evil . An evil creature touched by the spell must wrestle with the pleasant feelings invoked by the spell . The spell has a ¼ chance each of making the subject cower , frightened , nauseated , or shaken . Instead of having the effect determined at random , the caster may elect to leave the creature shaken for the duration of the spell . Material Component . A peach seed . Origin . This spell originally appeared in the " Book of Exalted Deeds " as " Lastai ' s caress " , but the name was changed to fit FR canon .

title: Sunfire
description: Sunfire Sunfire was a spell unique to Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Effects . This spell harnessed the power of the sun to create an explosive ball of flame .
description_long: Sunfire Sunfire was a spell unique to Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Effects . This spell harnessed the power of the sun to create an explosive ball of flame . Most creatures killed by this spell were burned to ash . This spell was similar to a " fireball " spell with the exception that the caster , and all of his or her gear , were immune to the flames . Components . This spell required a ball of sticky gum to cast .

title: Sung
description: Sung Sung was a Prince of Shou Lung who earned the disfavor of the Emperor . History . Prince Sung was banished to the Valley of Exiles when he attempted to elope with one of the Emperor ' s concubines .
description_long: Sung Sung was a Prince of Shou Lung who earned the disfavor of the Emperor . History . Prince Sung was banished to the Valley of Exiles when he attempted to elope with one of the Emperor ' s concubines . Only the fact that the Emperor favored him spared Sung from certain execution for his brazen act . He spent his time in the Valley of Exiles learning what he could about the Emperor and his enemies with the vain hope to overthrow him one day .

title: Sunil al - Sahil
description: Sunil al - Sahil Sunil al - Sahil was a tasked administrator genie who inhabited Huzuz , the City of Delights , in 1367 DR . Personality . Sunil was prized by the Grand Caliph for her devotion to duty .
description_long: Sunil al - Sahil Sunil al - Sahil was a tasked administrator genie who inhabited Huzuz , the City of Delights , in 1367 DR . Personality . Sunil was prized by the Grand Caliph for her devotion to duty . Activities . Sunil represented the throne of Huzuz for the three major bureaucratic centers of power within in city . Bureaucrats from the North District , Affluent District , and Central District all answered to her . Relationships . Sunil was the sister of Sandara al - Sahil .

title: Sunlight after storm
description: Sunlight after storm Sunlight After Storm was a sutra that cleared illusion s from one ' s mind , enabling them to see things as they truly were . It could be activated with a sprinkle of kumiss . Realmslore .
description_long: Sunlight after storm Sunlight After Storm was a sutra that cleared illusion s from one ' s mind , enabling them to see things as they truly were . It could be activated with a sprinkle of kumiss . Realmslore . In the Year of the Helm , 1362 DR , the lama Koja of Khazari met a mysterious woman who ' d presented him with a magical feast and attempted to draw an oath from him . Fearing a trick , he uttered the Sunlight After Storm sutra and flicked kumiss at her . She revealed herself to be god Deneir .

title: Sunmaster
description: Sunmaster Sunmaster was a prestige class on Faerûn whose members were those faithful of Lathander who believed he is the reincarnation of the deity Amaunator . Although they worshiped the Morninglord ( while referring to him as Amaunator ) with the rest of his clergy , their heretical belief that Amaunator ' s re - ascension was close , caused a rift in the church of Lathander . Like the Morninglords of Lathander , Sunmasters represented the elite clergy , albeit on opposite sides of the disagreement .
description_long: Sunmaster Sunmaster was a prestige class on Faerûn whose members were those faithful of Lathander who believed he is the reincarnation of the deity Amaunator . Although they worshiped the Morninglord ( while referring to him as Amaunator ) with the rest of his clergy , their heretical belief that Amaunator ' s re - ascension was close , caused a rift in the church of Lathander . Like the Morninglords of Lathander , Sunmasters represented the elite clergy , albeit on opposite sides of the disagreement . It is worth noting that Sunmasters could cast prayer s , unlike the cleric s of god s who paid no heed to worshipers or who were truly dead . All Sunmasters were members of the Brotherhood of the Glorious Sun , an order within the church . Most Sunmasters were former Lathanderites , although a select few were simply paladin s and wizard / cleric s that strongly oppose dark and chaotic forces . With the coming of the Spellplague it was revealed that , ultimately , the Sunmasters were correct in believing Lathander and Amaunator to be one and the same .

title: Sunrise
description: Sunrise Sunrise was a pegasus who lived in the Moonwood with her twin brother Sunset . The pair were rescued from giant s by the moon elf Tarathiel a few years prior to 1370 DR , and after this , they served as winged mounts for him and his partner , Innovindil . Sunrise was so named because her mane was highlighted with a yellowish pink color .
description_long: Sunrise Sunrise was a pegasus who lived in the Moonwood with her twin brother Sunset . The pair were rescued from giant s by the moon elf Tarathiel a few years prior to 1370 DR , and after this , they served as winged mounts for him and his partner , Innovindil . Sunrise was so named because her mane was highlighted with a yellowish pink color . She was about sixteen hands high with strong muscles .

title: Sunrise Mountains
description: Sunrise Mountains The Sunrise Mountains was the name of a mountain range in Thay that formed much of that country ' s eastern border . Geography . The mountains marked the edge of Faerûn .
description_long: Sunrise Mountains The Sunrise Mountains was the name of a mountain range in Thay that formed much of that country ' s eastern border . Geography . The mountains marked the edge of Faerûn . The Sunrise Mountains were quite high , towering a good 15 , 000 feet above sea level and were full of old Raumathar ruins . Copper was mined in these mountains in 1359 DR .

title: Sunscorch ( Wizard version )
description: Sunscorch ( Wizard version ) Sunscorch was a spell unique to Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Effects . This spell caused an intense blast of heat to emanate from the caster ' s hand .
description_long: Sunscorch ( Wizard version ) Sunscorch was a spell unique to Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Effects . This spell caused an intense blast of heat to emanate from the caster ' s hand . This beam of heat curved around obstacles to unerringly strike the intended target . The heat from this spell caused more damage if the target was wearing or carrying any metal . Only living flesh was affected by this spell . This spell could not be cast underwater . Components . This spell did not require physical components to cast .

title: Sunset
description: Sunset Sunset was a pegasus who lived in the Moonwood with his twin sister Sunrise . Physical description . Sunset was so named because his mane had reddish tinges down the length of his body .
description_long: Sunset Sunset was a pegasus who lived in the Moonwood with his twin sister Sunrise . Physical description . Sunset was so named because his mane had reddish tinges down the length of his body . He was about sixteen hands high with strong muscles . History . The pair were rescued from giant s by the moon elf Tarathiel a few years prior to 1370 DR and after this , they served as winged mounts for him and his partner , Innovindil .

title: Sunset Mountains
description: Sunset Mountains The Sunset Mountains were a pair of mountain ranges separated by the Far Hills . Together with the Far Hills , they formed a high , almost impenetrable barrier between the Eastern and Western Heartlands , as well as forming the eastern edge of Sunset Vale . Inhabitants .
description_long: Sunset Mountains The Sunset Mountains were a pair of mountain ranges separated by the Far Hills . Together with the Far Hills , they formed a high , almost impenetrable barrier between the Eastern and Western Heartlands , as well as forming the eastern edge of Sunset Vale . Inhabitants . These mountains were home to a large number of evil tribes and savage humanoids . Several small dwarven clans also lived in this region . The dwarves were very secretive about the exact location of their homes . Most of these dwarves traded in the town of Easting . The other humanoids were the yeti , gnoll , ogre , and drow races . One white dragon had been recorded in Sunset Mountain history .

title: Sunset rose
description: Sunset rose The sunset rose was a flowering plant that grew in the Rose Garden of the Battle of Bones . Description . As the name implied , this plant ' s flowers were yellow , orange , and red .
description_long: Sunset rose The sunset rose was a flowering plant that grew in the Rose Garden of the Battle of Bones . Description . As the name implied , this plant ' s flowers were yellow , orange , and red . The flowers had dark stems and large thorns . The jagged - edged leaves made this plant dangerous as they could cut exposed flesh easily . Uses . The leaves of sunset roses were poisonous . A cut from one delivered a potent sleep poison that would knock a victim unconscious for hours . A high dosage could prevent the victim from breathing .

title: Sunsho Daji
description: Sunsho Daji Sunsho Daji was a samurai in Maeshi Province in 1360 DR . History . Daji was the youngest son of honorable Sunsho Anteki .
description_long: Sunsho Daji Sunsho Daji was a samurai in Maeshi Province in 1360 DR . History . Daji was the youngest son of honorable Sunsho Anteki . In 1360 Daji and his older brother Shunso Miharu went to Ito - Jo . Miharu entered in the caves deep the castle and Daji remained to wait outside but the brother never come back . After some time passing fishing he met an adventuring party hired by Michimori Uemon to recover the Seven Swords and decided to join them in order to find his brother . At last Daji discovered that Miharu was killed and eat by a wandering oni

title: Sunstone ( gem )
description: Sunstone ( gem ) Sunstone , also known as , was a gem closely related to moonstone . Description . The most common variety of this ornamental stone was soft and only able to be cut , but it did occur in a colorless or slightly greenish variety that was grade .
description_long: Sunstone ( gem ) Sunstone , also known as , was a gem closely related to moonstone . Description . The most common variety of this ornamental stone was soft and only able to be cut , but it did occur in a colorless or slightly greenish variety that was grade . Cabochons of sunstone were rarely more than three - quarters of an inch ( 2 cm ) in diameter and had glittering red or orange inclusions that were suspended in a nearly colorless matrix , giving the overall stone a warm golden or reddish brown hue . A typical stone had a base value of 10 gp . Sunstones were considered sacred by followers of Horus - Re , Labelas Enoreth , and Sehanine Moonbow — appropriate for sacrifice , or to be consecrated for use , or recognized as boons or omens when found . Powers . Sunstones could be made into talismans , usually in the form of jewelry , that acted on undead just like full sunlight . A sunstone talisman had to be charged by being left in full sun for at least one day ( about six hours of continuous exposure ) . Thereafter , the talisman could be worn and would remain dormant until the wearer was successfully attacked ( physically touched ) by an undead creature .

title: Sunstone ( lake )
description: Sunstone ( lake ) The Sunstone is a circular lake of liquid silver located in the Chical Hills in the House of Tezca desert in Maztica . The lake has mystical properties and can grant visions of the future to anyone who sits on the valley ' s rim at sunrise and stares into the lake .
description_long: Sunstone ( lake ) The Sunstone is a circular lake of liquid silver located in the Chical Hills in the House of Tezca desert in Maztica . The lake has mystical properties and can grant visions of the future to anyone who sits on the valley ' s rim at sunrise and stares into the lake .

title: Sunstone Commons
description: Sunstone Commons Sunstone Commons was a star - shaped open area in the city of Leuthilspar on the island of Evermeet . It was used as a meeting place , a place to deliver speeches , and a day and night market , particularly for trading in wine and food . A large statue of Corellon Larethian was located in the central area .
description_long: Sunstone Commons Sunstone Commons was a star - shaped open area in the city of Leuthilspar on the island of Evermeet . It was used as a meeting place , a place to deliver speeches , and a day and night market , particularly for trading in wine and food . A large statue of Corellon Larethian was located in the central area . At night , the area was lit by sunstone s .

title: Sunthrun Blackshoulder
description: Sunthrun Blackshoulder Sunthrun Blackshoulder was a high - ranking Zhentilar warrior in High Dale , known for his cruelty and his habit of butchering women and younglings if possible . History . In 1358 DR , Sunthrun was the second - in - command of Constable Heladar Longspear in the secret Zhent occupation army in High Dale .
description_long: Sunthrun Blackshoulder Sunthrun Blackshoulder was a high - ranking Zhentilar warrior in High Dale , known for his cruelty and his habit of butchering women and younglings if possible . History . In 1358 DR , Sunthrun was the second - in - command of Constable Heladar Longspear in the secret Zhent occupation army in High Dale . When an insurrection against the Zhents started , thanks to Elminster Aumar ' s and the Rangers Three ' s actions , Heladar was killed and Sunthrun became the acting Zhentilar commander . However , when the Dalesfolks led by Irreph Mulmar invaded the High Castle Sunthrun confronted the Harpers Itharr and Belkram inside but , with the timely arrival of Sharantyr , the Harpers managed to kill Sunthrun .

title: Suntunavick
description: Suntunavick Golden Gorger Suntunavick was a deep gnome cleric from Blingdenstone . He was head priest at the Ruby of the Rough temple to Segojan Earthcaller and was charged with the care of a number of cave badgers . History .
description_long: Suntunavick Golden Gorger Suntunavick was a deep gnome cleric from Blingdenstone . He was head priest at the Ruby of the Rough temple to Segojan Earthcaller and was charged with the care of a number of cave badgers . History . Around 1358 DR , Suntunavick and a few other svirfneblin priests opened a pathway from the Underdark to the surface to allow Belwar Dissengulp , Firble , and three hundred other svirfneblin soldiers to aid in the defense of Mithral Hall .

title: Sunwarp
description: Sunwarp Sunwarp was a spell unique to Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Effects . This was an impressive illusion spell that multiplied an image selected by the caster and filled an area with it .
description_long: Sunwarp Sunwarp was a spell unique to Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Effects . This was an impressive illusion spell that multiplied an image selected by the caster and filled an area with it . The caster could make one camel appear to be a herd , or one soldier appear as a band of mercenaries , etc . The caster viewed the selected object through a quartz crystal and focused on one item on the object that the caster has touched . When this focal point moved , the rest of the illusion moved with it . The illusion appeared to waver from the rising air heated by the sun . Components . This spell required a small quartz crystal to cast .

title: Sunwyrm
description: Sunwyrm A sunwyrm was a dangerous draconic predator that hunted from the skies above deserts and savannas . Description . A sunwyrm looked like a dragon with shining scales that visibly radiated heat , and wings that glowed with a brilliant light .
description_long: Sunwyrm A sunwyrm was a dangerous draconic predator that hunted from the skies above deserts and savannas . Description . A sunwyrm looked like a dragon with shining scales that visibly radiated heat , and wings that glowed with a brilliant light . It had a fanged mouth and large horns , and an almost - liquid light seemed to seep from its eyes . It had eight legs , and a long tale tipped with a pulsating sphere of energy . Combat . Since sunwyrms constantly emitted bright light , they positioned themselves between their prey and the sun , eliminating their shadows and waiting for the perfect moment to strike . Against more powerful foes , sunwyrms preferred to remain hidden until they had an opportunity to unleash their breath weapon : a line of blazing yellow energy that passed harmlessly through non - living matter , but which was devastating to living creatures . If forced into melee , a sunwyrm could turn its claws and teeth into pure energy to unleash devastating bite and claw attacks . A sunwyrm could convert its entire body into pure energy , becoming incorporeal but losing its ability to make physical attacks .

title: Suormpar
description: Suormpar Suormpar was the northernmost city in Ulgarth in southeast Faerûn . Description . Suormpar lay in the shadow of the Dustwall Mountains , on the eastern shore of Xontuil Bay and the Golden Water .
description_long: Suormpar Suormpar was the northernmost city in Ulgarth in southeast Faerûn . Description . Suormpar lay in the shadow of the Dustwall Mountains , on the eastern shore of Xontuil Bay and the Golden Water . Government . Around 1367 DR , Suormpar was led by Baron Redinald Rascalin , a descendent of Baron Maelin Rascalin . The Rascalins were the staunchest supporters of King Drasna Bluemantle . Trade . Trade dominated the local economy , as it did all around the Golden Water . Fiertallin , a popular cosmetic substance , was gathered from the river Xon some 20 miles ( 32 kilometers ) up the bay , and exported out of Suormpar . Defenses . Around 1367 DR , Suormpar was guarded by 500 footmen and 200 archers , led by the half - orc Hespal Nicort . History . The barony of Suormpar was granted by the king to Maelin Rascalin , a convicted bandit who rose to become the kingdom ' s greatest general , in reward for defending the realm against barbarians . By 1367 DR , warnings circulated that the gray orc s of the Dustwall Mountains were gathering in preparation for a major assault or raids into Ulgarth .

title: Supernal
description: Supernal Supernal was the language of the god s . It was a universal language , understandable by any sentient mind ( which heard the words as if they were spoken in its own languages ) . The gods shared their language with their servants , the angel s , and devil s spoke a version of it as well .
description_long: Supernal Supernal was the language of the god s . It was a universal language , understandable by any sentient mind ( which heard the words as if they were spoken in its own languages ) . The gods shared their language with their servants , the angel s , and devil s spoke a version of it as well . Mortals were unable to learn the language completely , so the words of creation lacked power , and they were unable to use Supernal to make themselves understood by those who speak only other languages . Supernal had its own hieroglyphic scipt .

title: Supreme Throne
description: Supreme Throne The Supreme Throne is the realm in which Cyric , the Prince of Lies , holds dominion . After the murder of the Goddess of Magic , Mystra , fellow gods Lathander , Tyr , and Sune imprisoned Cyric in this realm for 1000 years . Before Cyric took control of the Supreme Throne , it was a realm in the plane of Limbo .
description_long: Supreme Throne The Supreme Throne is the realm in which Cyric , the Prince of Lies , holds dominion . After the murder of the Goddess of Magic , Mystra , fellow gods Lathander , Tyr , and Sune imprisoned Cyric in this realm for 1000 years . Before Cyric took control of the Supreme Throne , it was a realm in the plane of Limbo . Description . The Supreme Throne is a barren realm where howling winds can drive mortals mad . Because Cyric is the enemy of all other faiths , the followers of any deity besides Cyric find their spells more difficult to cast on this plane . History . The Supreme Throne was established on the plane of Limbo by the batrachi in - 31500 DR . Inhabitants . The Supreme Throne is the home plane of the chaos beast s , demodand s , howler s , and slaad i . Notes . In 2nd edition , Cyric ' s realm was said to exist in Hades and then later in Pandemonium instead .

title: Suq Bay
description: Suq Bay Suq Bay was a vital body of water located in the heart of Zakhara . Geography . The bay was literally found in the center of the continent of Zakhara .
description_long: Suq Bay Suq Bay was a vital body of water located in the heart of Zakhara . Geography . The bay was literally found in the center of the continent of Zakhara . It was bordered to the south by the Golden Gulf , to the north by the Furrowed Mountains , to the east by the Haunted Lands , and to the west by the High Desert . Description . Suq Bay was divided into a North Quarter and South Quarter , with a narrow strait connecting the two . Rocky mountainous terrain or desert nearly encircled the entire bay .

title: Surbar
description: Surbar Surbar was a coastal city of Ulgarth in southeast Faerûn . Geography . Surbar was sheltered safely within the bay of the Golden Water .
description_long: Surbar Surbar was a coastal city of Ulgarth in southeast Faerûn . Geography . Surbar was sheltered safely within the bay of the Golden Water . It stood on the coast , southwest of the Galuil Mountains . Sunrise in springtime made the Mountains of Gold a beautiful sight . Government . Around 1367 DR , Surbar and its environs were governed by Baron Kasnchil . He was corrupt and greedy , yet the serfs thought he made the city prosper . Trade . Surbar received most of the gold and iron mined from the mountains . Metalworking , weapon - smithing , shipping , and spices were Surbar ' s primary industries . Baron Kasnchil ' s policy of accepting all kinds of trade through Surbar made it a popular port and a prosperous city , but this knew no limits : even Dambrath an pirates could dock there to resupply and refit . Inhabitants . Surbar was home to nearly 15 , 000 people , making it the second - largest city in Ulgarth . More than anywhere else in the kingdom , demihuman s were common here , thanks to the dwarven mining trade from the mountains .

title: Surbrin Valley
description: Surbrin Valley The Surbrin Valley is the rocky vale formed by the River Surbrin in the Interior of Northwest Faerûn in the Savage Frontier . It extends from the Spine of the World to the north , the Evermoors to the south ; and between the Moonwood to the east and the Frost Hills to the west . History .
description_long: Surbrin Valley The Surbrin Valley is the rocky vale formed by the River Surbrin in the Interior of Northwest Faerûn in the Savage Frontier . It extends from the Spine of the World to the north , the Evermoors to the south ; and between the Moonwood to the east and the Frost Hills to the west . History . As of 1371 DR the whole of the Surbrin Valley is taken up by the Kingdom of Many - Arrows .

title: Surefeet Trademasters
description: Surefeet Trademasters The Surefeet Trademasters was a merchant company in Faerûn . History . A council of merchants ran the operations of this merchant company .
description_long: Surefeet Trademasters The Surefeet Trademasters was a merchant company in Faerûn . History . A council of merchants ran the operations of this merchant company . Activities included providing expert guides , guards , and escorts for caravans . Their prices were steep , but experience combined with a great reputation made the price worthwhile for many . Base of Operations . The Surefeet Trademasters were based out of Scornubel .

title: Surelife
description: Surelife Surelife was a rare abjuration spell unique to those who worshiped deities within the repose domain . Effects . This spell allowed the caster to protect himself against a deadly condition .
description_long: Surelife Surelife was a rare abjuration spell unique to those who worshiped deities within the repose domain . Effects . This spell allowed the caster to protect himself against a deadly condition . Conditions varied but included being immersed in boiling oil , buried under an avalanche , etc . This spell only offered protection against natural conditions or occurrences . No protection was gained against conditions created by monsters or spells that mimicked natural conditions . The caster specified the condition from which they needed protection , and the spell would only protect against that condition . Should the caster be subjected to the specified condition during the duration of the spell , they felt no discomfort and took no damage from the condition . However , the spell did not protect items carried by the caster . At the end of the spell ' s duration , the condition had full normal effects on the caster if they were still subjected to it . Components . This spell required ointment of peach syrup and cinnabar to cast .

title: Suretmarch
description: Suretmarch The Duchy of Suretmarch was a region of southeast Tethyr bordering Calimshan . Geography . This contained a large portion of the Forest of Mir in its southern portions .
description_long: Suretmarch The Duchy of Suretmarch was a region of southeast Tethyr bordering Calimshan . Geography . This contained a large portion of the Forest of Mir in its southern portions . It was bordered by the Omlarandin Mountains in the east and the River Ith in the north . It neighbored County Monteshi of Ankaram to the west . The Ithal Road passed through the duchy . Suretmarch contained three counties : Alonmarch , Surkazar , and Mirkazar . Government . In 1370 DR , the Lord Just Chancellor , Duke Tardeth Llanistaph , former hero of the Company of Eight , controlled Suretmarch officially from his ducal seat at Veaddakar , but that manor was under reconstruction during that year , so the duke spent most of his time at Faerntarn or in Saradush .

title: Surface rothé
description: Surface rothé Surface rothé , also known as high rothé or brown rothé , were a variety of rothé that lived in surface lands . Description . Surface rothé had shaggy brown fur , cloven hooves , and two curving horns .
description_long: Surface rothé Surface rothé , also known as high rothé or brown rothé , were a variety of rothé that lived in surface lands . Description . Surface rothé had shaggy brown fur , cloven hooves , and two curving horns . Their fur was longer and shaggier and their legs were longer compared to their subterranean relatives . Combat . Surface rothé could fight with both their teeth and horns . They were skittish and prone to stampeding , which could be quite dangerous for anyone in their path . Locations . Rothé dwelt on the surface , in both cold and warm climates . They were commonly found in the mountains and glaciers of northwest Faerûn in the Moonsea . They occasionally wandered over onto the icy dunes of the Anauroch . The further south the rothé dwelt , the lighter the color and density of their fur . They were found throughout the Western Heartlands and south Faerûn . They could also be found in the Stonelands and were herded in the Shaar and Rashemen .

title: Surgol Velard
description: Surgol Velard Surgol Velard was a War Wizard of Cormyr from Suzail . History . Around 1479 DR , Surgol was sent to the troops that had just overrun the Stormserpent Towers .
description_long: Surgol Velard Surgol Velard was a War Wizard of Cormyr from Suzail . History . Around 1479 DR , Surgol was sent to the troops that had just overrun the Stormserpent Towers . He captured a flowing woman . Relationship . Surgol was disliked by his fellows Joreld Nerunnanthur and Welwyn Tracegar .

title: Surkazar
description: Surkazar Surkazar was a county in Tethyr located on the western foothills of the Omlarandin Mountains . Description . County Surkazar was known for its beautiful , pastoral landscapes as much as for its danger from monsters from the mountains .
description_long: Surkazar Surkazar was a county in Tethyr located on the western foothills of the Omlarandin Mountains . Description . County Surkazar was known for its beautiful , pastoral landscapes as much as for its danger from monsters from the mountains . The region contained Tethyr ' s largest population of sheep and had a large military presence . Geography . Located in the of Suretmarch , Surkazar neighbored counties Alonmarch and Mirkazar . The Omlarandins were its eastern border , and the River Ith flowed to the north . Government . Count Oon Santele , the Battalion Chancellor of Tethyr , ruled this county in 1370 DR . He was not a particularly talented organizer , but he had good councilors who helped him rule . The county seat was in Colbertann . Notable Location . The fortified city of Saradush was located in Surkazar .

title: Surkh
description: Surkh Surkh was a small city on the north shore of the Deepwash in the shadow of the Deepwing Mountains in the Vilhon Reach . The lizardfolk here keep to themselves , though they had good relations with the Emerald Enclave , Lachom , Nimpeth and Lheshayl . Government .
description_long: Surkh Surkh was a small city on the north shore of the Deepwash in the shadow of the Deepwing Mountains in the Vilhon Reach . The lizardfolk here keep to themselves , though they had good relations with the Emerald Enclave , Lachom , Nimpeth and Lheshayl . Government . Surkh was ruled by King Griss ' tok a lizardfolk barbarian . He seldom saw visitors and spoke only Draconic . He was well known for eating folks convicted of serious crimes . Description . Most of the lizardfolk lived in houses fashioned of baked mud bricks built around shades and communal pools . The Arena of Scales was a vast amphitheater in the heart of the city , fashioned to look like a circle of carved stone dinosaurs with their necks , limbs and tails intertwined . Gladiatoral events were held here once a tenday . The Shrine of the First Lizard was a large temple of Tiamat beneath the city streets . Trade Routes . There were no trade routes that passed through Surkh . Trivia . Folk throughout the Vilhon Reach feared this city and it ' s man - eating lizardfolk . A large , ancient dragon turtle , known as the Dragon of the Deeps lived in the Deepwash near the city .

title: Surruk
description: Surruk Surruk was an wild elven woodsman in Phlan during the Tyranny of Dragons . Possessions . When adventuring , Surruk wore dirty leather armor and fought with a purple - hued Morcant Burl longbow .
description_long: Surruk Surruk was an wild elven woodsman in Phlan during the Tyranny of Dragons . Possessions . When adventuring , Surruk wore dirty leather armor and fought with a purple - hued Morcant Burl longbow . To protect herself from harm , Surruk usually kept a " healing potion " in her backpack . Personality . The elf was not forthcoming and preferred the wilds of the Moonsea to speaking with others . History . In 1489 DR , Surruk patrolled the Quivering Forest hunting fey creatures . Later , she went to the Madame Freona ' s Tea Kettle and was briefly interrogated by adventurers hired by Buhrell Caah about a missing dangerous magic item .

title: Surthay
description: Surthay Surthay is the name of a region , or tharch , of Thay and the name this region ' s capital city . Surthay . The capital lies outside of the enchantments that manage the climate in central Thay so the weather is colder and rainier than in the central regions of Thay .
description_long: Surthay Surthay is the name of a region , or tharch , of Thay and the name this region ' s capital city . Surthay . The capital lies outside of the enchantments that manage the climate in central Thay so the weather is colder and rainier than in the central regions of Thay . The town is set at Lake Mulsantir . It is a very crude place with rutted dung - littered streets , simple wooden houses and thatch - roofed shacks . Government . The tharch Surthay is currently ruled by tharchion Homen Odesseiron .

title: Surtr
description: Surtr Surtr , also seen as Surtur , was the lord of the fire giants . His animal was the hell hound . His symbol was a flaming sword .
description_long: Surtr Surtr , also seen as Surtur , was the lord of the fire giants . His animal was the hell hound . His symbol was a flaming sword . Surtr looked like an immensely large fire giant with crackling flames for hair and eyebrows . He wore armor of blazingly hot iron and wielded a flaming iron sword 15 feet ( 4 . 6 m ) in length . Surtr , a son of Annam , was part of the second generation of giantish deities , born at about the same time as Skoraeus Stonebones and Thrym . While Surtr ' s cult was similar to that of Thrym ' s , fire and ice do not mix . Surtr ruled " Muspelheim " , an ever - burning realm on the fiery second layer of the plane of Ysgard ; the layer was also called Muspelheim , named for Surtr ' s realm . Surtr ' s domain contained portals to the City of Brass and to an efreeti outpost called the " Suhkteh Albarrana " where fire giants often hired themselves as mercenaries to the genies of flame . The realm of Muspelheim could also be reached through certain volcanic regions on the first layer of the plane . At the highest point in the earthberg upon which Surtr had built his realm was a range of mountains called the Serpent ' s Spine .

title: Susariel
description: Susariel Susariel was a cambion member of the Cult of the Dragon during the Tyranny of Dragons . History . In 1489 DR , during the Cult ' s coup in Phlan , Susariel was tasked with the command of the secret Black Fist prison inside Stojanow Gate , where Ector Brahms was imprisoned .
description_long: Susariel Susariel was a cambion member of the Cult of the Dragon during the Tyranny of Dragons . History . In 1489 DR , during the Cult ' s coup in Phlan , Susariel was tasked with the command of the secret Black Fist prison inside Stojanow Gate , where Ector Brahms was imprisoned . Eventually , an adventuring party aided by Black Fist loyalists led by Aleyd Burral assaulted the prison and defeated the cultists . Susariel was also killed in the fighting .

title: Suspended animation
description: Suspended animation Suspended animation was a necromancy spell that allowed one willing creature to enter a sleep - like state where bodily functions were so slow they became undetectable for extended periods of time . However , one or more priests of the same alignment had to maintain the spell , forgoing casting of all other spells and temporarily sapping their vitality . Effects .
description_long: Suspended animation Suspended animation was a necromancy spell that allowed one willing creature to enter a sleep - like state where bodily functions were so slow they became undetectable for extended periods of time . However , one or more priests of the same alignment had to maintain the spell , forgoing casting of all other spells and temporarily sapping their vitality . Effects . The state of " suspended animation " was very similar to a deep sleep wherein the body was limp and unresponsive with no measurable heart rate , breathing , or other processes of life . The subject did not require food or water but would die if deprived of oxygen . In addition , mental and physical illness were prevented from progressing and poison s , curses , lycanthropy , mummy rot and " geas " afflictions had no effect on the recipient while " suspended " so cures could be attempted . The subject also recovered an amount of health equivalent to a " cure minor wounds " for each month spent in " suspended animation " . However , the subject was completely helpless and could be killed by a single well - placed strike .

title: Suspension
description: Suspension Suspension was a stronger version of the " levitate " spell . It was believed to be involved in the unique magic that kept skyships afloat . This spell was jealously guarded by native wizard s of Halruaa .
description_long: Suspension Suspension was a stronger version of the " levitate " spell . It was believed to be involved in the unique magic that kept skyships afloat . This spell was jealously guarded by native wizard s of Halruaa . Effects . This spell could be cast on a person , an object , or any type of creature . Tons of material could fall under the influence of this spell if the caster was strong enough . The caster only needed to concentrate when raising or lowering the object of this spell , allowing for up to 120 ft . ( 36 . 6 m ) of movement within one minute . Components . This spell required a leather loop that hung from a bent golden wire to cast .

title: Susurrus
description: Susurrus The Susurrus was a monstrous spider of enormous proportions that ravaged Shadowdale ' s geographical backroads for millennia . Its maddening whispers and diseased bite turned all fey who encountered it into cannibalistic wendigo s . Appearance .
description_long: Susurrus The Susurrus was a monstrous spider of enormous proportions that ravaged Shadowdale ' s geographical backroads for millennia . Its maddening whispers and diseased bite turned all fey who encountered it into cannibalistic wendigo s . Appearance . Appearing as a gigantic arachnid covered in matted white fur and hateful glowing eyes , the Susurrus floated towards its prey with the charred bloody stumps of its legs outstretched . It bore the faint emblem of a spider on its brow . History . The Susurrus was unleashed upon the fey of Shadowdale in - 2549 DR by the drow of Maerimydra when they had created the Land Under Shadow amid the surrounding woodland . Eventually , the fey decided to make a pact in order to trap the horror and vowed never to use the region ' s crossroads while the Susurrus lived . This ensured the monster could never escape into the real world but also cut off many fey from Faerie , causing their numbers to dwindle over time . In 1375 , Azalar Falconhand lured the Susurrus back to the real world , where the monster was finally slain .

title: Susztam Mar - Shinn
description: Susztam Mar - Shinn Susztam Mar - Shinn was a male drow illusionist and shadow adept . He was the Head Student of the Inverted Tower and a user of the Shadow Weave in Szith Morcane in the 14th century . Description .
description_long: Susztam Mar - Shinn Susztam Mar - Shinn was a male drow illusionist and shadow adept . He was the Head Student of the Inverted Tower and a user of the Shadow Weave in Szith Morcane in the 14th century . Description . Uncommonly for a drow , Susztam appeared somewhat plump and seemed almost meek upon cursory inspection . He customarily wore dark shirts of grey and black trousers . Susztam wrapped himself in a spider - web pattern " cloak of arachnida " . Personality . Although appearing less hardened than others of his race , Susztam Mar - Shinn was just as malicious and ambitious as the rest of his kin . Testament to this was his dream of eventually surpassing and taking over from his master , Solom Ned ' razak , as archmage of the Inverted Tower . Abilities . Noted as Solom Ned ' razak ' s best student , Susztam was a skilled illusionist and also a practitioner of the Shadow Weave . Since delving into the secrets of the shadow weave , his illusion s were empowered by his understanding and noticeably harder to dispel . History . In 1354 DR , Susztam became the head student of the Inverted Tower under Solom Ned ' razak ' s tutelage .

title: Suth
description: Suth Suth , also called suthwood , was a type of tree found in the south of Faerûn . The name " suth " was thought to be a corruption of " south " . Description .
description_long: Suth Suth , also called suthwood , was a type of tree found in the south of Faerûn . The name " suth " was thought to be a corruption of " south " . Description . Suth trees had gray bark and olive - green leaves . The leaves of the suth tree were long , soft , and fluffy , but with a small spike at the end . Their growth was peculiar : the branches grew almost horizontally , extending out for a distance then changing angle and even doubling back . A few suth trees growing close together would become intertwined with one another and become impossibly tangled . This formed an impenetrable screen or wall , barring passage to all who could not fly overhead or crawl under the lowest branches . Usage . The wood of the suth tree ( called " suth - wood " ) was particularly hard and durable , making it difficult to carve without very fine tools . Even thin sheets of suthwood remained hard for decades , making it popular for use in book covers . It was also often used in the creation of shield s , as it never shattered or flew apart , only cracked under a devastating blow , and would not catch fire if soaked in water prior to battle . Locations .

title: Suzail
description: Suzail - - Olaurae , sage of Myth Drannor ( 855 DR ) Suzail was the capital of Cormyr and the seat of power . It was named after Suzara Obarskyr , the mother of the first king . It was originally the farm of Ondeth Obarskyr , the father of the first king .
description_long: Suzail - - Olaurae , sage of Myth Drannor ( 855 DR ) Suzail was the capital of Cormyr and the seat of power . It was named after Suzara Obarskyr , the mother of the first king . It was originally the farm of Ondeth Obarskyr , the father of the first king . Suzail was a large port city on the shores of lake Dragonmere . A person or item originating from Suzail was known as Suzailan . Government . Suzail was the capital of Cormyr and the home of the ruling Obarskyr family . King Foril Obarskyr delegated much of the day - to - day tasks of running Cormyr to his Lord Magister Edwin Morahan who was responsible for keeping the peace , maintaining city services and collecting taxes . The Lord Magister was assisted by a herald who handled the paperwork necessary to run the city . Military . The landward side of Suzail was protected by an 80 ft . ( 24 Meter ) wall . The city was further protected by the Citadel of the Purple Dragons as well as three gates which were essentially castles themselves . Two thousand Purple Dragons were garrisoned in the city and over one hundred War Wizards resided within the walls .

title: Suzale
description: Suzale Suzale , also known as Purple Dragon ale , was a fine - quality nutty ale . History . The ale was first brewed for King Azoun IV of Cormyr but over time it became sold across Faerûn .
description_long: Suzale Suzale , also known as Purple Dragon ale , was a fine - quality nutty ale . History . The ale was first brewed for King Azoun IV of Cormyr but over time it became sold across Faerûn . The name was a pun on the city of Suzail , the seat of power in Cormyr .

title: Suzara Obarskyr
description: Suzara Obarskyr Suzara Obarskyr was the wife of Ondeth Obarskyr and moved with him to the Forest Country to create a new life , and what would later become the nation of Cormyr . Its capital , Suzail , was named after her . Relatives .
description_long: Suzara Obarskyr Suzara Obarskyr was the wife of Ondeth Obarskyr and moved with him to the Forest Country to create a new life , and what would later become the nation of Cormyr . Its capital , Suzail , was named after her . Relatives . Suzara ' s husband was Ondeth Obarskyr . She had two sons , Rhiiman and Faerlthann Obarskyr , and a brother - in - law , Villiam Obarskyr . Background . Suzara did not like the lifestyle of the new settlement , preferring the company of other people in a larger town , and she had been vocal to Ondeth about this since the original move in 6 DR . She eventually left Ondeth and Faerlthann behind in 12 DR , taking Rhiiman with her and returning to Impiltur . . At some point she died and her body was placed under the roots of a fir tree . She was the first Ghazneth . Ghazneth . As a Ghazneth , Suzara had the power of fire manipulation and control . She could spray crimson fire from her fingertips and create pits of hellfire that would burst upward and incinerate any unfortunate creature caught within the radius . On her fir tree was engraved the typical Ghazneth poem , with her final line reading :

title: Suzildara Sharranen
description: Suzildara Sharranen Suzildara Sharranen was the High Whipmistress at the Resting Place of the Whip in Melvaunt . Activities . She watched over sixteen other priests and oversaw all the rituals of the temple .
description_long: Suzildara Sharranen Suzildara Sharranen was the High Whipmistress at the Resting Place of the Whip in Melvaunt . Activities . She watched over sixteen other priests and oversaw all the rituals of the temple . Appearance . A stunning beauty , Suzildara was slender with dark eyes and hair .

title: Swagdar
description: Swagdar The Swagdar , or the Outlaw Waste , was a large stretch of land located just northwest of Dambrath . Geography . This rolling grassland was filled with hidden valleys .
description_long: Swagdar The Swagdar , or the Outlaw Waste , was a large stretch of land located just northwest of Dambrath . Geography . This rolling grassland was filled with hidden valleys . The Swagdar covered a 150 square mile ( 390 km ) area . Inhabitants . This land comprised the only remaining free place for the Arkaiun . Small bands gathered together here to raid the countryside of Dambrath and the hated crinti . Sometimes they even ventured to nearby Halruaa . Arkaiun raiders were slain if caught , so battles with these people were fierce . If the bandits were able to capture children , they would raise them within their culture . As of 1367 DR , there were several thousand bandits living within the Swagdar , but a single strong leader was yet to arise to unite them .

title: Swamp cave ( Mere of Dead Men )
description: Swamp cave ( Mere of Dead Men ) The swamp cave was one of the caves in the Mere of Dead Men . Geography . The cave was located near West Harbor .
description_long: Swamp cave ( Mere of Dead Men ) The swamp cave was one of the caves in the Mere of Dead Men . Geography . The cave was located near West Harbor . Inhabitants . The cave itself was inhabited by lizardfolk , who stored goods from unlucky travelers they killed . History . This was one of the caves that the Harbormen knew was dangerous . For this reason , the Harbormen warned everyone to travel the roads , since straying from them would cause travelers to end up in places like this .

title: Swamp circle
description: Swamp circle The swamp circle was a druid circle associated with the fens , marshes , and wetlands filled with abundant life . Druids who took up the cause of nature in such a region had an affinity for this circle and the suite of spells that came to them without cost ( they could cast them at any time without having to prepare them in advance ) .
description_long: Swamp circle The swamp circle was a druid circle associated with the fens , marshes , and wetlands filled with abundant life . Druids who took up the cause of nature in such a region had an affinity for this circle and the suite of spells that came to them without cost ( they could cast them at any time without having to prepare them in advance ) .

title: Swamp ruins ( Mere of Dead Men )
description: Swamp ruins ( Mere of Dead Men ) The swamp ruins were part of the ruins of Illefarn in the Mere of Dead Men . Geography . The ruins were located near West Harbor .
description_long: Swamp ruins ( Mere of Dead Men ) The swamp ruins were part of the ruins of Illefarn in the Mere of Dead Men . Geography . The ruins were located near West Harbor . Inhabitants . Since the fall of Illefarn , lizardfolk have occupied the ruins . History . These swamp ruins were part of the Illefarn Empire , but time claimed them once the Illefarn Empire disappeared . Their magic was still in place , as one of the ruins contained a portal , which was linked with Arvahn , another Illefarn ruin . After the battle with the King of Shadows in West Harbor , Daeghun found a silver shard . Since he did not want to keep it nor to drop it , he hid it in the ruins to keep it safe . However , bladeling s and duergar attacked the village in 1374 DR , so Daeghun tasked the Kalach - Cha to retrieve it . The shard lay in the first ruin , and the Kalach - Cha could not open the second ruin . Bevil heard it could not be opened and that a wizard that tried to get in there never returned . The portal was activated once the Kalach - Cha completed the four rituals at Arvahn .

title: Swamplight lynx
description: Swamplight lynx A swamplight lynx was a magical cat found in swampy or marshy terrain . Description . Swamplight lynxes were between nine and ten feet long with large paws and short tails .
description_long: Swamplight lynx A swamplight lynx was a magical cat found in swampy or marshy terrain . Description . Swamplight lynxes were between nine and ten feet long with large paws and short tails . Their coloring ( usually a shade of yellow ) allowed them to camouflage themselves in their surroundings . Swamplight lynxes particularly liked the taste of elven flesh . Combat . Swamplight lynxes had several magical abilities , including " light " and " faerie fire " , which they used to confuse and distract their targets . They were able to " gather " Weave energy . Habitat . Swamplight lynxes dwelt in swamps and marshes . They could be found in the Flooded Forest in the Dragon Reach .

title: Swift Elyan
description: Swift Elyan Swift Elyan was a halfling adventurer in the Dalelands . History . Swift was an expert in traps and locks .
description_long: Swift Elyan Swift Elyan was a halfling adventurer in the Dalelands . History . Swift was an expert in traps and locks . She was a member of the adventuring party Byar ' s Seven until most of its members went missing during an adventure at Semberholme . In 1479 DR , Swift was with her friend Dorrin Brightaxe until they separated after an argument . She decided to accompany the caravan of Nyssa Seebenstern .

title: Swimstar Creek
description: Swimstar Creek Swimstar Creek was a tributary of the Shining Stream , which in turn was a tributary of Tethyr ' s River Ith . It began in the Kuldin Peaks and divided County Morninggold in half . It was fast - moving but shallow and contained a breed of luminescent fish .
description_long: Swimstar Creek Swimstar Creek was a tributary of the Shining Stream , which in turn was a tributary of Tethyr ' s River Ith . It began in the Kuldin Peaks and divided County Morninggold in half . It was fast - moving but shallow and contained a breed of luminescent fish .

title: Swipe
description: Swipe Swipe was the nickname of the rat - faced head of the Rogue ' s Guild in Hillsfar in 1367 DR . He and his guild acted as personal spies in the city for Lord Maalthiir but working too close with the Red Plumes prevented Swipe and his men from uncovering the true menace .
description_long: Swipe Swipe was the nickname of the rat - faced head of the Rogue ' s Guild in Hillsfar in 1367 DR . He and his guild acted as personal spies in the city for Lord Maalthiir but working too close with the Red Plumes prevented Swipe and his men from uncovering the true menace .

title: Swirling leaves of steel
description: Swirling leaves of steel Swirling leaves of steel was an exploit that allowed a ranger wielding two melee weapons to attack all adjacent enemies in a spinning dance of blades . Effects . Once per day , a ranger who learned this exploit could spin like a top with blades held out and strike all adjacent enemies that he or she could see in the immediate surrounding circle .
description_long: Swirling leaves of steel Swirling leaves of steel was an exploit that allowed a ranger wielding two melee weapons to attack all adjacent enemies in a spinning dance of blades . Effects . Once per day , a ranger who learned this exploit could spin like a top with blades held out and strike all adjacent enemies that he or she could see in the immediate surrounding circle .

title: Sword
description: Sword A sword is a melee weapon that in its simplest form consists of a blade and a hilt . This definition includes those weapons that fit the archetype of blade with the additional restriction of a minimum size . For game purposes , weapons are divided into three size / weight classes : light , one - handed , and two - handed .
description_long: Sword A sword is a melee weapon that in its simplest form consists of a blade and a hilt . This definition includes those weapons that fit the archetype of blade with the additional restriction of a minimum size . For game purposes , weapons are divided into three size / weight classes : light , one - handed , and two - handed . All swords are in either the one - handed or the two - handed class ( or both ) with the exception of the shortsword which is classified as a light weapon . It is included here mainly because of its widespread use and because it is used by smaller races in the same fashion as the other swords are used by larger races . Varieties . The sword is one of the most common weapons used in Faerûn . They are wielded by knights , soldiers , and creatures of many realms . Swords come in a great deal of varieties , some of the more common are : Famous swords . It is not uncommon for swords , especially enchanted ones , to have names , usually reflecting their origin or abilities . The most famous swords are those wielded by gods or heroes . These blades usually possess considerable magical power . Some examples include : Classes .

title: Sword Coast
description: Sword Coast The Sword Coast , not to be confused with the Sword Coast North , stretched along the Sea of Swords from Waterdeep down to the River Chionthar at Baldur ' s Gate in the south . The Sword Coast took its name from the white cliffs that rose up sharply for hundreds of miles along the coastline , from Baldur ' s Gate to the south and up to the River Dessarin in the north . Officially , the coast line north of Waterdeep up to Icewind Dale was not part of the Sword Coast , though most folk simply used the term Sword Coast for this otherwise unnamed stretch of coast line .
description_long: Sword Coast The Sword Coast , not to be confused with the Sword Coast North , stretched along the Sea of Swords from Waterdeep down to the River Chionthar at Baldur ' s Gate in the south . The Sword Coast took its name from the white cliffs that rose up sharply for hundreds of miles along the coastline , from Baldur ' s Gate to the south and up to the River Dessarin in the north . Officially , the coast line north of Waterdeep up to Icewind Dale was not part of the Sword Coast , though most folk simply used the term Sword Coast for this otherwise unnamed stretch of coast line . The Sword Coast region comprised the land from the coast to some distance inward , covering what were sometimes called the " Empty Lands " . This area stretched from Waterdeep to Amn in the south , and included the cities and towns of Baldur ' s Gate , Berdusk , Beregost , Daggerford , Elturel , Hill ' s Edge , Iriaebor , Nashkel , and Scornubel , as well as the Friendly Arm Inn and Candlekeep . It was a strategic location , encompassing the main caravan trade route to the Inner Sea . Volothamp Geddarm reported that the Sword Coast was named after the hazards one encountered there , both human and bestial .

title: Sword Coast Legends
description: Sword Coast Legends Sword Coast Legends is a role - playing video game developed by and , released on October 20th , 2015 . The game features tactical , party - based combat , as well as a " Dungeon Master " mode that emulates the group dynamic of tabletop Dungeons & Dragons . The game ' s main storyline is set in the Sword Coast region of Faerûn , around the time of Rage of Demons .
description_long: Sword Coast Legends Sword Coast Legends is a role - playing video game developed by and , released on October 20th , 2015 . The game features tactical , party - based combat , as well as a " Dungeon Master " mode that emulates the group dynamic of tabletop Dungeons & Dragons . The game ' s main storyline is set in the Sword Coast region of Faerûn , around the time of Rage of Demons . Similar to " Neverwinter " , " Sword Coast Legends " will receive content packs that coincide with " Forgotten Realms " tabletop storylines as they are released . After n - Space shut down on March 29th 2016 , Digital Extremes announced that it would continue to support " Sword Coast Legends " in regard to the development of downloadable content and porting the game to consoles . The first piece of DLC - " Rage of Demons " - was released on May 18th 2016 , including an expansion to the single player campaign ; playable tiefling characters ; the warlock class and several additions for Dungeon Masters . Plot . Legend says that after the Time of Troubles , the goddess Sehanine Moonbow wept for the dead .

title: Sword Coast North
description: Sword Coast North The Sword Coast North was a region on the northwestern coast of Faerûn . Geography . The region stretched from Waterdeep in the south to the Spine of the World in the north , and from the Sword Coast in the west to the Long Road in the east .
description_long: Sword Coast North The Sword Coast North was a region on the northwestern coast of Faerûn . Geography . The region stretched from Waterdeep in the south to the Spine of the World in the north , and from the Sword Coast in the west to the Long Road in the east . History . The first great realm to appear in the region known as the Sword Coast north was that of Illefarn . Existing thousands of years ago , the kingdom of Illefarn was a contemporary of Netheril , consisting of both dwarves and elves . Illefarn survived the Fall of Netheril , until the elves left for Evermeet . Northlander s and other human s began migrating into the region a few years before 1 DR .

title: Sword Dancer of Eilistraee
description: Sword Dancer of Eilistraee The Sword Dancers of Eilistraee were the speciality priests of the Dark Maiden . Organization . Only females elves , drow , half - drow and half elves could become Sword Dancers .
description_long: Sword Dancer of Eilistraee The Sword Dancers of Eilistraee were the speciality priests of the Dark Maiden . Organization . Only females elves , drow , half - drow and half elves could become Sword Dancers . Any priestess of Eilistraee who wished to become one had to spend at least one month on the surface , dancing each moonlit night for Eilistraee , and had to witness dawn at least once . They also had to be quick and agile , proficient in the arts of dance , song and acrobatics and skilled diplomats . Hierarchy . Like the rest of the clergy of the Dark Maiden , the Sword Dancers didn ' t have a rigid hierarchy or chain of command and recognized Qilué Veladorn as the spiritual guide of all followers of Eilistraee . Activities . As priestesses of Eilistraee , the Sword Dancers acted according to her teachings . They had the duty to lead and be on the frontline in missions to find , encourage , assist and protect any drow looking to return to the surface ( or that could be made to return ) and join a different life , far from Lolth .

title: Sword Dancers
description: Sword Dancers The Sword Dancers were a faction within the Everlasting in 1367 DR . Base of Operations . The Sword Dancers were based in the fortress of Sarahin located deep within the Haunted Lands .
description_long: Sword Dancers The Sword Dancers were a faction within the Everlasting in 1367 DR . Base of Operations . The Sword Dancers were based in the fortress of Sarahin located deep within the Haunted Lands . Activities . This young faction held beliefs that often clashed with the views of other holy slayer groups . The used fiery cleansing rituals , fasting , and ecstatic dancing to heighten their powers . History . The Court of Rhythm served as the origin of the Sword Dancers . The Unclean viewed the Sword Dancers as allies and the perfect complement to their sorcerous might . Members . The Sword Dancers were led by an efreeti named Farouk Abd al - Bazan . There were 43 members as of 1367 DR .

title: Sword Heralds
description: Sword Heralds The Sword Heralds were a group of mages that arrived unheralded in Cormyr several centuries prior to the 14th century . Before their abrupt departure , the Sword Heralds worked on a variety of projects that improved Cormyr , the most notable being the construction of extra - dimensional refuges ( otherwise known as hideaways ) that protected against the threat of foul weather , roaming brigands and monsters .
