Ground to a powder and placed on the tongue or in an open wound , tabasheer had a remarkable effect on the subject when " cure light wounds " was cast upon it : the recipient of this treatment gained a temporary health boost that lasted for 24 hours or until the health was lost due to subsequent injury , poison , or illness .

title: Tabaxi
description: Tabaxi Tabaxi ( also known as jaguar people or cat - men ) were a race of feline humanoids native to the jungles of Maztica . Description . Tabaxi were taller than most human s at six to seven feet .
description_long: Tabaxi Tabaxi ( also known as jaguar people or cat - men ) were a race of feline humanoids native to the jungles of Maztica . Description . Tabaxi were taller than most human s at six to seven feet . Their bodies were slender and covered in spotted and sometimes striped fur . Like most , Tabaxi had long tails and retractable claws . Tabaxi fur color ranged from light yellow to brownish red . Tabxi eyes were slit - pupilled and usually green or yellow . Tabaxi were competent swimmers and climbers as well as speedy runners . They had a good sense of balance and an acute sense of smell . Etymology . Depending on their region and fur coloration , tabaxi were known by different names . Tabaxi with solid spots were sometimes called leopard men and tabaxi with spots were called jaguar men . The way the tabaxi pronounced their own name also varied . Some pronounced it ta - - ee and others tah - - ee . Personality . Tabaxi were a reclusive people who often avoided interaction with other intelligent races .

title: Tabaxi ( tribe )
description: Tabaxi ( tribe ) The Tabaxi were the largest tribe of human s in Chult at the end of the 14th century DR . When most people referred to Chultans , they were speaking of members of this tribe , as the Tabaxi had absorbed most of the other Chultan tribes . History .
description_long: Tabaxi ( tribe ) The Tabaxi were the largest tribe of human s in Chult at the end of the 14th century DR . When most people referred to Chultans , they were speaking of members of this tribe , as the Tabaxi had absorbed most of the other Chultan tribes . History . The Tabaxi were one of a number of tribes that emigrated from the " Dark Continent " in - 2809 DR and later became the Chultan ethnic group . They fought the Eshowe ( the second - most - populous Chultan tribe ) across the territory of Chult in a bloody war that lasted from - 438 DR to - 122 DR . In - 137 DR , the Eshowe had conjured up a dreadful shadow - beast that attacked the Tabaxi city of Mezro . In vengeance , the Tabaxi protector Ras Nsi hunted and killed nearly all of the Eshowe tribesmen . Shortly after the end of the war , the remaining tribes were absorbed into the Tabaxi and became known collectively as Chultans . In addition to the Eshowe , the Tabaxi were enemies with the ptera - men . Confusion with the " Cat - Men " . " Tabaxi " was also a term given to a race of humanoid jaguars found in both Chult and Maztica . It has been suggested that this was an error in naming .

title: Tabl
description: Tabl The tabl ( TAB - leh ) was a double - sided Zakharan drum . Pearl divers from the Pearl Cities referred to these drums as " mirwas " . Description .
description_long: Tabl The tabl ( TAB - leh ) was a double - sided Zakharan drum . Pearl divers from the Pearl Cities referred to these drums as " mirwas " . Description . These small drums were covered with either horse or goat hides on both sides , though more exotic animal hides could be used as well . " Tabls " were beaten with the hands or cloth - covered sticks . History . The " tabl " was used throughout the Land of Fate .

title: Table dice
description: Table dice Table dice , or backgammon , was a board game played with dice . Description . The sets sold through Aurora ' s Emporium used polished stone markers , ivory dice , and a leather dice cup .
description_long: Table dice Table dice , or backgammon , was a board game played with dice . Description . The sets sold through Aurora ' s Emporium used polished stone markers , ivory dice , and a leather dice cup . The entire set could be transported in an ironwood case . Reputation . Table dice was commonly played as a tavern game in the Dalelands . As of 1359 DR , its popularity had begun to spread to the Western Heartlands and the North .

title: Tablets of Fate
description: Tablets of Fate The Tablets of Fate were stone slabs on which the official portfolios of every one of the deities of Abeir - Toril were written . Bane and Myrkul stole the tablets from Ao and hid them in Faerûn , suspecting that some of the Overgod ' s power was derived from these tablets . When Ao discovered the Tablets of Fate were missing he summoned all the deities and asked for those guilty to hand them over .
description_long: Tablets of Fate The Tablets of Fate were stone slabs on which the official portfolios of every one of the deities of Abeir - Toril were written . Bane and Myrkul stole the tablets from Ao and hid them in Faerûn , suspecting that some of the Overgod ' s power was derived from these tablets . When Ao discovered the Tablets of Fate were missing he summoned all the deities and asked for those guilty to hand them over . When no one stood forward to admit to stealing the Tablets , Ao cast down all the gods from the heavens , taking their divine power in the process . Ao tasked Lord Helm with guarding the Celestial Stairway s which would lead the deities back into their divine realms . For this he retained his divine powers . Before the Avatar Crisis ended , Bane and Myrkul were both slain , although Bane would return in 1372 DR . The suspicions of Bane and Myrkul that some of Ao ' s power lies in the tablets seems confirmed , as Ao appeared unable to recover the tablets himself . Ao suggests that the tablets had little power , serving only as reminders to the gods of their duties . However Ao himself destroyed the tablets , grinding them into powder . Appearance .

title: Tablets of Pharyssolnyth
description: Tablets of Pharyssolnyth The Tablets of Pharyssolnyth , or the Pharyssolnyth Tablets , were a collection of writings by the silver dragon Pharyssolnyth . They detailed the secrets of dragon magic . Description .
description_long: Tablets of Pharyssolnyth The Tablets of Pharyssolnyth , or the Pharyssolnyth Tablets , were a collection of writings by the silver dragon Pharyssolnyth . They detailed the secrets of dragon magic . Description . The Tablets consisted of thirty - seven large slates , obsidian black , with one side polished and the other rough . They seemed strange in appearance , and to feel . They were in fact the permanently enlarged scales of a black dragon . The polished sides were etched with minute , invisible etchings and scrawls , in a form of tactile writing unknown to any race that once inhabited Myth Drannor , and extremely difficult to notice and read regardless . On the raw sides , meanwhile , the elven examiners recorded their translations and theories in an ancient moon elven language . History . Pharyssolnyth dwelled in the elven city of Yrlaphon , among the eastern woodlands of Cormanthor , in its first century after its founding in −1535 DR ( prior to −1435 DR ) . There she recorded the Tablets of Pharyssolnyth . Following the fall of Yrlaphon in −722 DR , the Srinshee took the Tablets with her to Srinshinnar .

title: Tabot
description: Tabot Tabot was a mountainous state founded by monks and barbarians . The monks fled from oppression of Shou Lung to this mountainous terrain , which contained barbarians , monsters and merciless cold winds . The people of Tabot created their own special culture and customs , and many wise men spent their whole lives in the mountains to learn the truth .
description_long: Tabot Tabot was a mountainous state founded by monks and barbarians . The monks fled from oppression of Shou Lung to this mountainous terrain , which contained barbarians , monsters and merciless cold winds . The people of Tabot created their own special culture and customs , and many wise men spent their whole lives in the mountains to learn the truth . Geography . The land of Tabot was poor but workable . Shepherds grazed their herds of goats and sheep in the mountains . The lands of Bhutan were surrounded by thick bamboo forests , but other lowland parts of Tabot contained rough hills , grassy fields , and few trees . Tabot was a wild land known to experience avalanches and mud torrents . Fauna . The local draft animals , called yaks , were domesticated many millennia ago . Fluffy snow birds , monkey s and tiger s could be found throughout the country . Yeti were probably the most dangerous creatures found in the countryside . They constantly raided monasteries . Climate . Tabot ' s climate was harsh . The short growing season only lasted six to eight weeks , even in the lower river valleys . This region was dominated by harsh winds and snow storms .

title: Tabotan
description: Tabotan The Tabotans were an ethnicity of human s from the Kara - Tur an country of Tabot . Description . Tabotans were shorter than Shou and had coarse hair but shared the same yellow skin tones and flat features .
description_long: Tabotan The Tabotans were an ethnicity of human s from the Kara - Tur an country of Tabot . Description . Tabotans were shorter than Shou and had coarse hair but shared the same yellow skin tones and flat features . Personality . As a rule , Tabotans were emotionally strong and tough , but they also took pleasure in the small things of life . They tended to be very religious and patriotic and valued education . Language . Tabotans had their own language . History . The Tabotan people descendent from monk s who fled religious persecution in Shou Lung . They were also related to the nomads of the Plain of Horses . Appendix . Trivia . The Tabotans were inspired by the real - world .

title: Tabotan language
description: Tabotan language Tabotan was a language spoken by the Tabotan people of Tabot in Kara - Tur . Description . There was a common Tabotan tongue that held the nation together , but local accents were thick .
description_long: Tabotan language Tabotan was a language spoken by the Tabotan people of Tabot in Kara - Tur . Description . There was a common Tabotan tongue that held the nation together , but local accents were thick . Learning . Tabotan was quite a simple language and the common form was easily learned , but few outsiders knew it , and few Tabotans knew the Trade Tongue , only their native tongue . Fortunately , most cities and villages , especially those near the borders and along trade routes , had interpreters available . This in turn gave outsiders few incentives to learn Tabotan themselves .

title: Tabra
description: Tabra Tabra was the proprietor of a festhall in Bargewright Inn . Powers . Despite keeping her skill with magic a secret , Tabra always had a full complement of spell s available , most notably , the incredibly powerful Netherese spell " dragonshape " .
description_long: Tabra Tabra was the proprietor of a festhall in Bargewright Inn . Powers . Despite keeping her skill with magic a secret , Tabra always had a full complement of spell s available , most notably , the incredibly powerful Netherese spell " dragonshape " . She only used it when in intense personal danger or to defend her town of Bargewright Inn against powerful attackers . History . Tabra was once an apprentice of the wizard Ioulaum , one of the last remaining Netherese sorcerer - kings after the fall of Netheril . Though Ioulaum was slain in a spell battle with a cabal of a dozen alhoon , his greatest spell , " Ioulaum ' s longevity " was found by Tabra . She cast the spell on herself before destroying every last record of it . As the spell required the death of one mage for each year of life the caster desired to attain , she systematically exterminated a colony of over 2000 illithid s who were about to sacrifice her to some dark deity . In 1372 circa , however , Tabra was captured by the Shadovar and brought to the City of Shade . Tabra awoke from the stasis where the shadovar had put her on 1487 DR thanks to the death of Telamont Tanthul .

title: Tacal
description: Tacal Tacal was an Itza prince of history . History . During the Payit golden age , Tacal was a prince of Tulom - Itzi .
description_long: Tacal Tacal was an Itza prince of history . History . During the Payit golden age , Tacal was a prince of Tulom - Itzi . When rumors of the beauty of the Payit princess Aliah reached him , Tacal decided that she should be with him , but she was promised to her half - brother Xetl . So Tacal assembled his retinue and devised a plot to strike during the wedding day , where he was among the guests with his parents and most of the Itza nobles , and kidnap her . On the day of the wedding , Tacal and his warriors managed to kidnap Aliah but only with the deaths of most of his warriors . At last , in revenge , the Payit decided to slay the whole royal family of Tulom - Itzi . When Tacal , still surrounded by Ulatos ' s armies , saw at a distance the bodies of his family , he killed Aliah out of desperation . Soon after , Payit arrows killed Tacal . This act signaled the end of the Payit Golden Age .

title: Tace Blueshield
description: Tace Blueshield Tace Blueshield was a shield dwarf paladin of Ilmater at the Monastery of the Yellow Rose in the late 15th century DR . Personality . Tace was grim and disciplined and had a drill - sergeant attitude towards both her men and to the monks .
description_long: Tace Blueshield Tace Blueshield was a shield dwarf paladin of Ilmater at the Monastery of the Yellow Rose in the late 15th century DR . Personality . Tace was grim and disciplined and had a drill - sergeant attitude towards both her men and to the monks . She did not appreciate people telling her how to do her work . She hated speaking about her past . Tace believed that the monastery could only be in danger from external attacks , never believing in an internal threat . She acted only with solid proof , but with proof she would quickly arrest and interrogate anyone Activities . Tace ' s duty was to command the few military forces of the monastery .

title: Tad Staslep
description: Tad Staslep Tad Staslep was a grocer in Phlan in 1489 DR . Personality . Tad was a portly man with a big appetite .
description_long: Tad Staslep Tad Staslep was a grocer in Phlan in 1489 DR . Personality . Tad was a portly man with a big appetite . He was always chewing or about to chew something . He knew he was good in his work . Activities . Tad run the Cockburn ' s Grocery , just in front of Laughing Goblin Inn , for quite a while . Tad was the largest provider of provisions in the city .

title: Tadaz
description: Tadaz Tadaz was an inhabitant of the village of Toralth in Tethyr in 1370 DR . Description . Tadaz was a muscular man .
description_long: Tadaz Tadaz was an inhabitant of the village of Toralth in Tethyr in 1370 DR . Description . Tadaz was a muscular man . In his later years , he had gray hair and had lost most of his teeth . He had a strong tolerance for alcohol . History . On Uktar 10 , 1370 DR , he went to the Blue Badger Inn with his son Tural and his best friend Ondar in order to honor Tural ' s heading off to join Tethyr ' s new army at Riatavin . He was there when three dwarves , Bapar Ghalmrin , Odak Truesteel , and Soram Battlebellow , arrived , seeking the " Sondarr Scepter " .

title: Tae kwon do
description: Tae kwon do Tae kwon do , also known as Foot and Fist , was a martial art developed in the land of Koryo in Kara - Tur . Reputation . This martial art was widely practiced in Koryo in the 14th century DR .
description_long: Tae kwon do Tae kwon do , also known as Foot and Fist , was a martial art developed in the land of Koryo in Kara - Tur . Reputation . This martial art was widely practiced in Koryo in the 14th century DR . Indeed , all men and boys in this battle - ready society were trained in some form of tae kwon do to some degree . It was considered an honorable martial art , that is , unlike dishonorable ninja techniques . Training . There were ten " " in Koryo that taught honorable martial arts such as tae kwon do . One of the most prestigious was the Do Jang of Won Kwang in Pyong Do . Here , students spent their afternoons being instructed and supervised in tae kwon do and weapons use by school masters . At this time , students underwent testing to achieve new grades . As was common for practitioners of tae kwon do , students of the " do jang " wore training uniforms , or " " , consisting of white pants and a short white robe , tied with a belt whose color and tips denoted their grade , or " " . Beginners , known as neophytes , started at 10th " gup " and achieved lower " gup " s with higher grades , denoted as follows : These colors each bore special significance .

title: Taegan Nightwind
description: Taegan Nightwind Taegan Nightwind is an avariel , an elven subrace noted for their wings and the fact that they are nowadays extremely rare in Faerûn . Description . Taegan is a warrior , and more specifically a duelist and bladesinger , relying on his lightning reflexes , fencing skills , and arcane abilities rather than brute strength to win a fight .
description_long: Taegan Nightwind Taegan Nightwind is an avariel , an elven subrace noted for their wings and the fact that they are nowadays extremely rare in Faerûn . Description . Taegan is a warrior , and more specifically a duelist and bladesinger , relying on his lightning reflexes , fencing skills , and arcane abilities rather than brute strength to win a fight . He left his tribe when he was young in order to seek a more adventurous life than the one offered to him if he stayed with his fellow avariel . He regards members of his subrace as little more than uncivilized , though peaceful , nomads and he does not take pride in talking about them , or even the elven race in general ( although lately there have been signs that this may begin to change ) . History . Taegan was a resident of Lyrabar , the capital of the Kingdom of Impiltur , where he ran his own fencing academy . He ended up in Thentia , where he worked with the wizards of the city towards discovering a traitor under Sammaster ' s orders among them .

title: Taern Hornblade
description: Taern Hornblade Taern " Thunderspells " Hornblade was the High Mage of the city of Silverymoon < ref name = " N : GSF / Cities - p51 " > < / ref > , having succeeded Alustriel when she took the office of High Lady , and member of the Council of the Marches . < ref name = " N : GSF / Cities - p55 " > < / ref > Description . Taern was tall and gray - bearded , appearing grave and thoughtful most of the time .
description_long: Taern Hornblade Taern " Thunderspells " Hornblade was the High Mage of the city of Silverymoon < ref name = " N : GSF / Cities - p51 " > < / ref > , having succeeded Alustriel when she took the office of High Lady , and member of the Council of the Marches . < ref name = " N : GSF / Cities - p55 " > < / ref > Description . Taern was tall and gray - bearded , appearing grave and thoughtful most of the time . Personality . Although reckless in his youth , in his later years Taern prefers to avoid confrontations . By striving for consensus where possible and working hard at building friendships , Taern tended to reach decisions through alliance with others . Abilities . A powerful Evoker , Taern ' s nickname , " Thunderspell " , was earned during his early Magefair duels where his mastery of potent battle - spell s became known . During his tenure among the Spellguard he showed his prowess in defense of Silverymoon by facing off against a dracolich . Relationships . Taern has a deep and abiding love of Alustriel . History . Born in 1204 DR Taern earned his nickname , " Thunderspell " , early in his life from attending magefair duels and showcasing his deadly battle - spells .

title: Taerom Fuiruim
description: Taerom Fuiruim Taerom " Thunderhammer " Fuiruim is a renowned master armor er and weaponsmith , owning and running Thunderhammer Smithy in Beregost . Work . Taerom Fuiruim is considered one of the best smiths in Faerûn and has extensive knowledge of the use of rare and exotic ore s and magic in metalcrafting .
description_long: Taerom Fuiruim Taerom " Thunderhammer " Fuiruim is a renowned master armor er and weaponsmith , owning and running Thunderhammer Smithy in Beregost . Work . Taerom Fuiruim is considered one of the best smiths in Faerûn and has extensive knowledge of the use of rare and exotic ore s and magic in metalcrafting . He keeps over twelve apprentices in his smithy . Description . Taerom is a burly giant of a man standing seven feet tall and four feet wide at the shoulders , with chestnut hair and mutton - chop whiskers shot through with white . When called to fight , he uses a huge iron staff . It has been said he could kill an orc with a single blow . He is a quiet man , though he is also very respected in Beregost .

title: Taerymdoom
description: Taerymdoom Taerymdoom was a network of natural caves located in the southern borders of the Far Forest in the Savage Frontier . Description . Those who ventured into these caves said they stretched for several miles underground and were guarded by vargouille s .
description_long: Taerymdoom Taerymdoom was a network of natural caves located in the southern borders of the Far Forest in the Savage Frontier . Description . Those who ventured into these caves said they stretched for several miles underground and were guarded by vargouille s . History . Taerymdoom was named for an elf , Taerym , who was slain by a cloaker while trying to investigate the caves . Moreover , even a group of Zhentarim explorers and the Darkblades of Esmeltaran lost their lives to this evil place .

title: Tagar Lusos
description: Tagar Lusos Tagar Lusos was an aquatic elf dukar of the Order of Numos and a member of the Nantarn Council . Activities . Despite his irrational hatred of Morgan Ildacer , Tagar was an effective councilor and normally spoke in defense of the people of eastern Serôs ( locathah , shalarin , and Qatoris morkoth included ) .
description_long: Tagar Lusos Tagar Lusos was an aquatic elf dukar of the Order of Numos and a member of the Nantarn Council . Activities . Despite his irrational hatred of Morgan Ildacer , Tagar was an effective councilor and normally spoke in defense of the people of eastern Serôs ( locathah , shalarin , and Qatoris morkoth included ) .

title: Taglath
description: Taglath Taglath was a bizarre ghost in Skullport . History . In life , Taglath was a poet , explorer , and a romantic .
description_long: Taglath Taglath was a bizarre ghost in Skullport . History . In life , Taglath was a poet , explorer , and a romantic . He was known for courting the most beautiful women of the city , not caring for possible husbands . One day , after a tryst with the wife of a Calishite merchant , Taglath was assassinated in a Skullport street by an invisible creature . He would appear as a ghost in the place of his death .

title: Tagreth Cormaeril
description: Tagreth Cormaeril Lord Tagreth Cormaeril was the Grandfather of Assassins of the Fire Knives and tolerated no dissent within his organization . Description . Appearing as a frail and elderly man , Tagreth had unnatural vigor that came from magical sources .
description_long: Tagreth Cormaeril Lord Tagreth Cormaeril was the Grandfather of Assassins of the Fire Knives and tolerated no dissent within his organization . Description . Appearing as a frail and elderly man , Tagreth had unnatural vigor that came from magical sources . Using much of his wealth , he extended his lifespan and bolstered his health over many years .

title: Taharak
description: Taharak Taharak was once a powerful warrior among the drow of Maerimydra in life , before rising as a ghost after his death . Description . Taharak cut an impressive figure in his full plate armor , even more so when wearing his leering skull helm and astride his nightmare steed .
description_long: Taharak Taharak was once a powerful warrior among the drow of Maerimydra in life , before rising as a ghost after his death . Description . Taharak cut an impressive figure in his full plate armor , even more so when wearing his leering skull helm and astride his nightmare steed . In battle , Taharak wielded a spiked chain . History . Before his death , Taharak fought for Lolth . However , after dying he took up the cause of Kiaransalee , rising anew as a deadly ghostly champion . During Lolth ' s Silence in Maerimydra , the rising cult of Kiaransalee there put him to work as a scout , collecting the corpses of the fallen and bringing them back to Castle Maerimydra for reanimation by Irae T ' sarran ' s servants .

title: Tahlshara
description: Tahlshara Tahlshara is a magic two - handed sword sometimes considered to be the greatest elven weapon ever made . It drastically improves its wielder ' s armour and can only be wielded by elves ( except drow ) – death often being the result of a non - elf handling it . It has leaves and vines carved into its surface with knotwork on the hilt .
description_long: Tahlshara Tahlshara is a magic two - handed sword sometimes considered to be the greatest elven weapon ever made . It drastically improves its wielder ' s armour and can only be wielded by elves ( except drow ) – death often being the result of a non - elf handling it . It has leaves and vines carved into its surface with knotwork on the hilt . The name of the sword is present around the . The sword can be used to cast any high magic spell , or any of " teleport without error " , " spellstrike " , " sunburst " , " spelltrap " , " turnshadow " , or " teleport dead " . It is one of the three Great Treasures of Evermeet and is possessed by Queen Amlaruil Moonflower . History . The sword was the life ' s work of the elven armorer Kythaela Durothil . It is thought that its creation took over one hundred and fifty years and that Kythaela deliberately extended her life to complete it .

title: Tai Chai Ming
description: Tai Chai Ming Tai Chai Ming was the Minister of Magic of Shou Lung in 1358 DR . History . Tai Chai Ming was a talented wu jen .
description_long: Tai Chai Ming Tai Chai Ming was the Minister of Magic of Shou Lung in 1358 DR . History . Tai Chai Ming was a talented wu jen . One day , he met Governor Kawabi , who for asked his magical counsel , especially about immortality and the magical attributes of blood lines . Tai Chai Ming gained notoriety writing the report " A Study of the Principles of Thaumaturgic Research " . That report so impressed Emperor Kai Tsao Shou Chin and his wu jen Kao Shan Ten that they decided to make Tai Chai Ming the youngest minister of magic ever in order to revitalize the moribund ministry . Personality . He was a kind of playboy but with a keen mind about practice and theory of magic .

title: Taichi
description: Taichi Taichi was the magical advisor of the Funada clan in Nakamaru around 1357 DR . Activities . Taichi lived in the mountains surrounding Nakamaru and went to the city only if called by his lord , Funada Mitsuhide .
description_long: Taichi Taichi was the magical advisor of the Funada clan in Nakamaru around 1357 DR . Activities . Taichi lived in the mountains surrounding Nakamaru and went to the city only if called by his lord , Funada Mitsuhide . Taichi delighted in collecting and hoarding odd magics . Taichi had a habit of hopping gently on one foot if kept waiting or otherwise impatient . History . Taichi helped Kogi and Bupposo in their prank against Tsuyoi - no - kami monks , knowing they did not respect his lord . However , afterward , for reasons known only to him , he helped O - Shino in her bloodless vengeance against the Kogi and Bupposo . Personality . Taichi had no wisdom or patience , but a keen and perceptive brain . He initially like dthe prank of Kogi and Bupposo .

title: Taiku
description: Taiku Taiku was a settlement in the kingdom of Koryo in Kara - Tur . Geography . Taiku lay on the northern coast of the western peninsula , south of the Straits of Koryo .
description_long: Taiku Taiku was a settlement in the kingdom of Koryo in Kara - Tur . Geography . Taiku lay on the northern coast of the western peninsula , south of the Straits of Koryo . Locations . In the settlement stood Taiku Fountain , which bestowed invulnerability on anyone who bathed in it , lasting for a period of ten days . Needless to say , by 1350 DR , authorities closely guarded the pool to stop it being misused . It was said the bravest heroes of Koryoan history bathed in the fountain and even drank its waters before their biggest battles .

title: Tainted one
description: Tainted one Tainted ones were humans who had been turned into yuan - ti servitors by drinking a distillation of yuan - ti venom mixed with specific roots and herbs . Activities . Tainted ones primarily served as spies in human cities .
description_long: Tainted one Tainted ones were humans who had been turned into yuan - ti servitors by drinking a distillation of yuan - ti venom mixed with specific roots and herbs . Activities . Tainted ones primarily served as spies in human cities . They were also often employed by pureblood yuan - ti as bodyguards and stealthy strike forces within human settlements .

title: Tajar
description: Tajar Tajar was the most northerly of Zakhara ' s Pearl Cities . Geography . The city was located near the Golden Gulf on the banks of the Al - Adib River , at the nexus of different trade routes , making it the most important place to exchange all kinds goods in the whole Land of Fate apart from Golden Huzuz itself .
description_long: Tajar Tajar was the most northerly of Zakhara ' s Pearl Cities . Geography . The city was located near the Golden Gulf on the banks of the Al - Adib River , at the nexus of different trade routes , making it the most important place to exchange all kinds goods in the whole Land of Fate apart from Golden Huzuz itself . Tajar was therefore appropriately named the " City of Trade " . Inhabitants . Tajar was packed with merchants selling every manner of ware . It was said that " If it is not available in Tajar , it is not available . " Many of these merchants had no tolerance for amateurs . Clumsy haggling , providing inferior merchandise , and incompetence were often punished by confiscation , derision , and even imprisonment . Newcomers offering lower prices on the same items as established merchants were asked to raise their prices . If they ignored these requests they often disappeared . Disputes between merchants and customers were usually settled with blades . The city watch rarely interfered so long as permits were in order and taxes paid .

title: Tak
description: Tak Tak was a female doppelganger in the Moonsea . Activities . Posing as Doctor Jubal , she managed the wandering Doctor Jubal ' s Carnival of Curiosities .
description_long: Tak Tak was a female doppelganger in the Moonsea . Activities . Posing as Doctor Jubal , she managed the wandering Doctor Jubal ' s Carnival of Curiosities . History . At the start of the Rage of Demons , Tak — posing as a half - elf — was hired by Doctor Jubal with the promise of helping her against the Great Law of Humanity of Hillsfar . However , she found that Jubal did not truly care about it . Meanwhile , whispers in her dreams told Tak to replace all human s with crazed mirror duplicates . So Tak decided to act , subduing Jubal and taking his position . Afterward , she began kidnapping people and replacing them with mirror duplicates created by the carnival ' s mirror maze while the originals remained chained inside the maze and had their souls slowly consumed by the demon lord Graz ' zt . The duplicates spread madness like an infection while the originals , without their souls , became mutated beings , totally loyal to Tak . However at the village of Hillpicket , Tak was unveiled and killed by some adventurers . Personality . Tak truly hated Hillsfar ' s politics . She wanted to show everyone that nonhumans were not the monsters that the First Lord had made them out to be .

title: Takabbar
description: Takabbar Takabbar was a small town on the island of Jazirat al - Gawwar within the Nada al - Hazan archipelago . Rumors and Legends . It was rumored that the only way to get off of the island of Jazirat al - Gawwar was through the Tower of the Test , located in Takabbar .
description_long: Takabbar Takabbar was a small town on the island of Jazirat al - Gawwar within the Nada al - Hazan archipelago . Rumors and Legends . It was rumored that the only way to get off of the island of Jazirat al - Gawwar was through the Tower of the Test , located in Takabbar . Inhabitants . The Takabbari were kind people . There were no enemies on their island so they never carried weapons . They were isolated from the outside world and had no idea of events taking place beyond their small island .

title: Takae Suju
description: Takae Suju Takae Suju was a monk in Wa around 1357 DR . History . Suju was the military instructor at Uwaji and a close collaborator of Baiyosho Degi .
description_long: Takae Suju Takae Suju was a monk in Wa around 1357 DR . History . Suju was the military instructor at Uwaji and a close collaborator of Baiyosho Degi . Takae , however , advocated for a more proactive role for the samurai in the country ' s government , but this idea did not please the shogunate and he was reassigned to the isle of Huyusha to teach the prisoners at Ibhei . Suju continued his studies on government reform and wrote many unpublished books about it .

title: Takahashi Yamaguchi
description: Takahashi Yamaguchi Takahashi Yamaguchi was the leader of the ninja Yamaguchi clan in the town of Aru in Wa . Personality . Takahashi was a man of honor , never brooking an agreement .
description_long: Takahashi Yamaguchi Takahashi Yamaguchi was the leader of the ninja Yamaguchi clan in the town of Aru in Wa . Personality . Takahashi was a man of honor , never brooking an agreement . If anyone betrayed him Takahashi would do anything to have revenge . History . Takahashi trained in ninja arts inside the Warazama clan until that clan was destroyed by internal dissents . So Takahashi formed a own ninja clan , the Yamaguchi clan . One of first missions of Yamaguchi ninja was in 1358 DR spreading chaos in the town of Aru .

title: Takako Shimizu
description: Takako Shimizu Takako Shimizu was a samurai in the town of Aru in Wa . Personality . Takako was a model of a perfect female samurai , attractive and vivacious .
description_long: Takako Shimizu Takako Shimizu was a samurai in the town of Aru in Wa . Personality . Takako was a model of a perfect female samurai , attractive and vivacious . Relashionsip . Takako was the niece of the daimyo Benju Matsumoto and one of the members of his court .

title: Takamal
description: Takamal Takamal was the ruler of Kultaka in 1361 DR . History . Takamal originally was a great warrior that save Kultaka from the Nexalan armies led by Chalco , the nexalan ruler predecessor of Axalt , the father of Naltecona , around 1295 .
description_long: Takamal Takamal was the ruler of Kultaka in 1361 DR . History . Takamal originally was a great warrior that save Kultaka from the Nexalan armies led by Chalco , the nexalan ruler predecessor of Axalt , the father of Naltecona , around 1295 . When Takamal heard of Cordell ' s victories over the Payits , he pondered alone whether he should meet the Golden Legion in peace or in war , but at last he decided for war . Takamal developed a good strategy , using the characteristics of the terrain to the advantage of the Kultaka ns . During the furious battle , he directed his troops together with his advisor Naloc and quickly understood that his opponents were normal human s . However , in order to turn the tide of the conflict , the mage Darien levitate d to them and killed first Naloc and afterward Takamal .

title: Takari Moonsnow
description: Takari Moonsnow Takari Moonsnow was an Evereska n wood elf who served under Galaeron Nihmedu for many years as a desert border guard . Activities . She was estranged from Galaeron for a while and , during the later part of the Evereska – phaerimm war , she decided to bed Kuhl in order to get pregnant and thus be able to wield his family blade .
description_long: Takari Moonsnow Takari Moonsnow was an Evereska n wood elf who served under Galaeron Nihmedu for many years as a desert border guard . Activities . She was estranged from Galaeron for a while and , during the later part of the Evereska – phaerimm war , she decided to bed Kuhl in order to get pregnant and thus be able to wield his family blade . Following Kuhl ' s death , and the victory over the phaerimm , she traveled to Vaasa with Galaeron and Vala where they presumably lived for the remainder of their days .

title: Takegai Yodori
description: Takegai Yodori Takegai Yodori was a wandering shugenja in Kozakura in 1357 DR . Activities . Yodori acted as a courier for Takegai Uezami , the head of the council of state and a high - ranking member of the noble Takegai clan .
description_long: Takegai Yodori Takegai Yodori was a wandering shugenja in Kozakura in 1357 DR . Activities . Yodori acted as a courier for Takegai Uezami , the head of the council of state and a high - ranking member of the noble Takegai clan . Yodori traveled all Kozakura to deliver messages to Uezami ' s allies . Personality . Yodori was totally devoted to his clan . He was an ambitious , energetic , and serious individual .

title: Takenaka Okawa
description: Takenaka Okawa Takenaka Okawa was the shikken of Kozakura in 1357 DR . History . Okawa became shikken in 1349 DR after the conclusion of the Hojo War , where the Takenaka clan gained supremacy over the Hojo clan , putting a puppet shogun on the throne .
description_long: Takenaka Okawa Takenaka Okawa was the shikken of Kozakura in 1357 DR . History . Okawa became shikken in 1349 DR after the conclusion of the Hojo War , where the Takenaka clan gained supremacy over the Hojo clan , putting a puppet shogun on the throne . However , Takenaka Sugawara , the true military leader of the war , couldn ' t ascend to the shikken position because of his no blood ties to the shogun , a trait possessed instead by his half - brother , Okawa . Personality . Okawa was reserved and aloof , ambitious and very able in manipulate others . He was able in administrative works but not an inspired military leader or a good diplomat . Okawa considered Sugawara only a jealous man and was divided by the necessity to keep united his clan and frustration for Sugawara ' s actions against him

title: Takenaka Sugawara
description: Takenaka Sugawara Takenaka Sugawara was the hero of the Hojo War of Kozakura in 1357 DR . History . Sugawara led the Takenaka clan armies to victory in the Hojo War but after the end of the war in 1349 DR , he was unable to ascend to the position of shikken because of his lack of blood ties to the shogun , a trait possessed instead by his half - brother , Takenaka Okawa .
description_long: Takenaka Sugawara Takenaka Sugawara was the hero of the Hojo War of Kozakura in 1357 DR . History . Sugawara led the Takenaka clan armies to victory in the Hojo War but after the end of the war in 1349 DR , he was unable to ascend to the position of shikken because of his lack of blood ties to the shogun , a trait possessed instead by his half - brother , Takenaka Okawa . Sugawara retired to his estate in the Iwari province , plotting a way to undermine Okawa and claim his position of ruler . Until then , he waited , recruiting allies . Personality . Sugawara was slow to anger and never fought without a good reason , but when he had to act , he was swift and decisive . Sugawara was a great military leader , very popular among his subordinates .

title: Takht of the jann
description: Takht of the jann The takht of the jann was the collective term used when the five instruments of the jann were played together . Description . The " takht " consisted of a " qanun of the spirits " , a " riqq of the efreet " , a " rababah of the dao " , an " ' ud of the marids " , and a " nay of the djinn " .
description_long: Takht of the jann The takht of the jann was the collective term used when the five instruments of the jann were played together . Description . The " takht " consisted of a " qanun of the spirits " , a " riqq of the efreet " , a " rababah of the dao " , an " ' ud of the marids " , and a " nay of the djinn " . Powers . Though each single instrument of the jann was a powerful magic item , the true power of these instruments was unleashed when combined and played together . A group of bard s or " rawunin " playing these instruments under the direction of a skilled sha ' ir was capable of summoning an army of genie s . This army encompassed four genie units — one for each of the major genie races — each measuring 100 strong . Each of these units was under the command of a powerful noble genie . In order to summon the genie army , the musicians needed to play their instruments uninterrupted for a full hour . If the music was interrupted in any way , then the genies who had already arrived would not be under control . A successful summons granted the sha ' ir complete command of the genie army for 25 hours . The genies returned to their native planes when this time expired .

title: Tako
description: Tako Tako were a race of intelligence octopi . They lived mostly in temperate and tropical aquatic terrains and usually traveled in war parties of two to seven , or tribes of eight to twenty . They were usually neutral towards other races .
description_long: Tako Tako were a race of intelligence octopi . They lived mostly in temperate and tropical aquatic terrains and usually traveled in war parties of two to seven , or tribes of eight to twenty . They were usually neutral towards other races . They were creations of the batrachi .

title: Takshang
description: Takshang Takshang was a small hermitage located at the foot of Ghalyi Shan in the Hordelands . Description . The hermitage was located halfway up a cliff , tucked away in a cleft in the great mountain .
description_long: Takshang Takshang was a small hermitage located at the foot of Ghalyi Shan in the Hordelands . Description . The hermitage was located halfway up a cliff , tucked away in a cleft in the great mountain . No stairs or ladders led to Takshang . Ropes were typically used to move supplies or assist visitors in ascending the steep approach . A single , three - room building comprised the entire hermitage . Inhabitants . The only permanent resident of Takshang was Gyawa Zangpo , an oni serving out his imprisonment on Toril .

title: Takt Muren
description: Takt Muren The Takt Muren was a small river found in both the Hordelands and Shou Lung . Geography . The Takt Muren flowed slightly northeast from Nor Takt for several hundred miles within the far northern reaches of the Katakoro Plateau .
description_long: Takt Muren The Takt Muren was a small river found in both the Hordelands and Shou Lung . Geography . The Takt Muren flowed slightly northeast from Nor Takt for several hundred miles within the far northern reaches of the Katakoro Plateau . It cascaded over the Yellow Serpent Border Cliffs at the Yellow Thunder Falls . Description . The water filling the Takt Muren began as glacial runoff from the Katakoro Glacier , filling first Nor Zanskra and then Nor Takt before joining the river and ultimately combining with the Ch ' ing Tung River in Shou Lung .

title: Tal Sey Lo
description: Tal Sey Lo Tal Sey Lo was a member of the Black Leopard Cult in 1358 DR . History . Tal Sey Lo was a Black Leopard merchant in the city of Pe Nok in T ' u Lung .
description_long: Tal Sey Lo Tal Sey Lo was a member of the Black Leopard Cult in 1358 DR . History . Tal Sey Lo was a Black Leopard merchant in the city of Pe Nok in T ' u Lung . In 1358 DR , she was attacked by followers of Dragon Claw . Appendix . Gameplay . If players did not help her , she died .

title: Tala al - Sunim
description: Tala al - Sunim Tala al - Sunim was a tax collector who worked at the Gulf Gate in Huzuz in 1367 DR . Description . Though passed 60 years of age , Tala was as sharp as she was in her youth .
description_long: Tala al - Sunim Tala al - Sunim was a tax collector who worked at the Gulf Gate in Huzuz in 1367 DR . Description . Though passed 60 years of age , Tala was as sharp as she was in her youth . Personality . Tala had a positive reputation for fairness , except when dealing with sly caravan masters who tried to trick her simply because she was an old woman .

title: Tala bint Tufala
description: Tala bint Tufala Tala bint Tufala was a concubine of the Grand Caliph of Huzuz , Khalil al - Assad al - Zahir in 1367 DR . Description . Tala was beautiful , but where her appearance excelled her intelligence was lacking .
description_long: Tala bint Tufala Tala bint Tufala was a concubine of the Grand Caliph of Huzuz , Khalil al - Assad al - Zahir in 1367 DR . Description . Tala was beautiful , but where her appearance excelled her intelligence was lacking . Relationships . Khalil enjoyed Tala ' s passion but was aware that she would not make a good mother to his future children .

title: Talab
description: Talab The City of the Pantheon Talab lay on the source of the river Al - Muti . Situated at the crossroads between the League of the Pantheon , the Ruined Kingdoms and the Haunted Lands , visitors from very different cultures stopped here , while the inhabitants kept mainly to themselves . The so - called City of Questing was both home to a strong slave - trade and an important university specializing in Pantheist religion and medicine .
description_long: Talab The City of the Pantheon Talab lay on the source of the river Al - Muti . Situated at the crossroads between the League of the Pantheon , the Ruined Kingdoms and the Haunted Lands , visitors from very different cultures stopped here , while the inhabitants kept mainly to themselves . The so - called City of Questing was both home to a strong slave - trade and an important university specializing in Pantheist religion and medicine .

title: Talabrina Duskryn
description: Talabrina Duskryn Talabrina Duskryn was the main enemy of the deep gnome s re - settling Blingdenstone . Personality . Talabrina greatly hated the deep gnomes .
description_long: Talabrina Duskryn Talabrina Duskryn was the main enemy of the deep gnome s re - settling Blingdenstone . Personality . Talabrina greatly hated the deep gnomes . She was a treacherous and greedy individual like most drow but her hate for svirfneblin consumed her , driving her to commit unspeakable atrocities . In her mind , her actions were blessed by Lolth . On the surface , her objective was to sack the city of all its treasures . Relationship . Two unusual bugbear slaves served Talabrina with total loyalty : one was an albino , and the other was black as night . History . In 1479 DR , Talabrina tried to destroy the reborn deep gnome settlement in Blingdestone by any means . She first killed some scouts and afterward tried to sabotage all missions by an adventuring party hired by Kargien Dissengulp . In the end , she was defeated by the adventurers .

title: Talamic
description: Talamic Talamic was a bard of the 1360s DR . Talamic sang at the Griffin ' s Claw in the city of Procampur in the Vast in the Year of the Helm , 1362 DR . One of Talamic ' s songs was the " Lay of the Purple Dragons " .
description_long: Talamic Talamic was a bard of the 1360s DR . Talamic sang at the Griffin ' s Claw in the city of Procampur in the Vast in the Year of the Helm , 1362 DR . One of Talamic ' s songs was the " Lay of the Purple Dragons " .

title: Talana Taenfeather
description: Talana Taenfeather Talana Taenfeather was a member of the Waterdeep Guard , an elite unit of the city watch . She was a close friend of Araezra Hondyl , her commander . Talana was considered the fastest member of the guard and is usually the one who chased down suspects who fled .
description_long: Talana Taenfeather Talana Taenfeather was a member of the Waterdeep Guard , an elite unit of the city watch . She was a close friend of Araezra Hondyl , her commander . Talana was considered the fastest member of the guard and is usually the one who chased down suspects who fled . She flirted with the Open Lord Dagult Neverember although they were apparently not yet lovers . Equipment . Talana had a ring of featherfall given to her by the Open Lord after she was seriously injured in a fall from a rooftop . The ring allowed her to fall from a height at a slow rate . Appearance . Talana had bright red hair which she often wore in exotic hairstyles .

title: Talane
description: Talane Talane was a beholder - kin accomplice of Manshoon in Suzail . History . Manshoon polymorph ed Talane into a human and she posed as Lady Deleira of the Truesilver noble house , acting to advance Manshoon ' s goals among Cormyr ' s nobles .
description_long: Talane Talane was a beholder - kin accomplice of Manshoon in Suzail . History . Manshoon polymorph ed Talane into a human and she posed as Lady Deleira of the Truesilver noble house , acting to advance Manshoon ' s goals among Cormyr ' s nobles . Around 1479 DR , needing help , Manshoon awoke Talane in her true form , mentally instructing her to kill Elminster Aumar . Quickly Talane went to hunt for Elminster . During the battle at the house of Larak Dardulkyn , she was targeted by the death knight Targrael . She survived the battle and resumed her role as Lady Deleira but Targrael found her .

title: Talantra Bowgentle
description: Talantra Bowgentle Talantra Bowgentle was a bard based in Silverymoon and an active Harper . Description . Talantra stood 5 ft 6 in ( 168 cm ) , weighed 122 lb ( 55 kg ) , and had auburn hair and green eyes .
description_long: Talantra Bowgentle Talantra Bowgentle was a bard based in Silverymoon and an active Harper . Description . Talantra stood 5 ft 6 in ( 168 cm ) , weighed 122 lb ( 55 kg ) , and had auburn hair and green eyes . Personality . Talantra had a reputation of being a " dangerous lady " and it was wise not to trifle with her . She often wandered alone but once she discovered the Harpers she was often found in their company . She had no qualms about stealing from evil people and she championed any female , druid , ranger , or even outnumbered adventuring parties who were battling orc s , brigands , or evil creatures . Abilities . She was proficient in the use of the longsword , dagger , dart s , and club . She could swim , was skilled with a rope , could determine direction easily , and even fight in limited visibility situations . As a bard , she was also a superb singer . Possessions . Talantra wore a " ring of protection + 2 " , a " ring of regeneration " , a " cloak " and " boots of elvenkind " , and had one jar of " Keoghtom ' s ointment " . She kept a few bloodstone s in hollow heels attached to her boots . Activities .

title: Talbot Uskevren
description: Talbot Uskevren Talbot Uskevren was the youngest of three children from the noble Uskevren family of Selgaunt and an actor in Mistress Quickly ' s theater acts in the Wide Realms . A warrior of moderate skill , he preferred to play the swashbuckling type in his plays , using flashy and fancy acrobatic moves . History .
description_long: Talbot Uskevren Talbot Uskevren was the youngest of three children from the noble Uskevren family of Selgaunt and an actor in Mistress Quickly ' s theater acts in the Wide Realms . A warrior of moderate skill , he preferred to play the swashbuckling type in his plays , using flashy and fancy acrobatic moves . History . At age nineteen , Talbot was infected with lycanthropy while on a hunting trip with his closest friend , Chaney Foxmantle , and various other nobles . Chaney and others managed to escape , but Talbot was not so fortunate . He was found by Maleva and Feena , two priestess of Selûne , and was healed of the wounds suffered in the attack , but not the affliction , by Maleva . Relationships . Talbot was the youngest son of Thamalon and Shamur Uskevren , preceded by Tamlin and Thazienne . He was also the half - brother of Larajin and Leifander . Even before the revelation that he was related to Larajin — who was a family servant at the time — Tal always treated her more like a sister than a servant . When Tal turned six and they were no longer allowed to play together , they made a pact to always be friends , even if it was just in secret .

title: Taleb Abd al - Jari
description: Taleb Abd al - Jari Taleb Abd al - Jari was a dwarven sergeant stationed in the armory of Sarahin in 1367 DR . Activities . Taleb rotated his guard duty with two other dwarven farisan .
description_long: Taleb Abd al - Jari Taleb Abd al - Jari was a dwarven sergeant stationed in the armory of Sarahin in 1367 DR . Activities . Taleb rotated his guard duty with two other dwarven farisan . Possessions . Taleb carried a magic sword that benefited from a " continual light " spell .

title: Taleisin Starym
description: Taleisin Starym Taleisin Starym was a clan elder and Lord Protector of the Starym elven clan , uncle by marriage of Ysmyrl ' da Starym . He was a bladesinger and former member of the Akh ' Velahr as an " arykérym " cavalry . Taleisin , along with the clan heir Josidiah Starym were elves of great honour , and after the clan broke ties with the Coronal and most abandoned Myth Drannor , these two rebuilt the reputation of the family .
description_long: Taleisin Starym Taleisin Starym was a clan elder and Lord Protector of the Starym elven clan , uncle by marriage of Ysmyrl ' da Starym . He was a bladesinger and former member of the Akh ' Velahr as an " arykérym " cavalry . Taleisin , along with the clan heir Josidiah Starym were elves of great honour , and after the clan broke ties with the Coronal and most abandoned Myth Drannor , these two rebuilt the reputation of the family .

title: Talendar
description: Talendar The Talendars are the oldest , proudest noble family in Sembia . Among their enemies are the Uskevren family . Their family home , Old High Hall , is the biggest merchant - noble residence in Selgaunt .
description_long: Talendar The Talendars are the oldest , proudest noble family in Sembia . Among their enemies are the Uskevren family . Their family home , Old High Hall , is the biggest merchant - noble residence in Selgaunt . House Talendar deals in fine furniture and frequently ships to the kingdoms of the far south - Amn , Calimshan , and Tethyr , where the demand for Archendale walnut and Sembian mahogany seem infinite .

title: Talfir
description: Talfir The Talfir were an extinct race of human s who once dwelt in the lands that later became known as the Western Heartlands . They were known as practitioners of shadow magic . Description .
description_long: Talfir The Talfir were an extinct race of human s who once dwelt in the lands that later became known as the Western Heartlands . They were known as practitioners of shadow magic . Description . The Talfir were described by the elves who wrote about them as having fair skin and dark hair . They originated in the great forest of Shantel Othreier and may have shared lineage with the modern Tethyrian race . The original Ffolk of the Moonshae Isles were of Talfirian blood . Language . The Talfir spoke their own language of Talfiric , which derived from the Draconic language . Religion . Religious scholars suspected that the Talfir were responsible for introducing many of the gods of the Faerûnian pantheon to Toril , most notably the deity Tempus . History . The earliest historical mention of the Talfir was found in ancient elven writings dating from the Crown Wars . Like the early predecessors of the Tethyrians , these tribes were first observed in Shantel Othreier and later became the first humans to settle along the Chionthar . The Talfir invented a style of bard ic magic known as shadow magic , or " Talfirian magic " , ( not to be confused with Shadow Weave magic ) .

title: Tali al - Jasmini
description: Tali al - Jasmini Tali al - Jasmini was a janni inhabiting the Lost City of Ubar within the High Desert of Zakhara in 1367 DR . Description . Even among the widely attractive jann , Tali was considered to be quite beautiful .
description_long: Tali al - Jasmini Tali al - Jasmini was a janni inhabiting the Lost City of Ubar within the High Desert of Zakhara in 1367 DR . Description . Even among the widely attractive jann , Tali was considered to be quite beautiful . Personality . Tali was a goal - driven individual who was eager to please her supervisor , Farad al - Meisal , though he barely took notice of her . Activities . Tali assisted the Vizier of Ubar , Farad , in his duties .

title: Talia
description: Talia Talia was a monk at the Monastery of the Yellow Rose . Activities . Talia was an older monk in the Monastery of the Yellow Rose .
description_long: Talia Talia was a monk at the Monastery of the Yellow Rose . Activities . Talia was an older monk in the Monastery of the Yellow Rose . She was Keeper of the Crypt . Secretly , she was also a member of the Cult of Howling Hatred . Personality . Talia had been soured by her long years as caretaker of the crypts . She was an easy convert to the cult as she had lost belief in suffering so that others might not . She hoped to find freedom in the elemental node . Abandoned by her fellow cultists , Talia was consumed by thoughts of vengeance . History . Talia was easily converted by the cultists who had infiltrated the monastery in 1491 DR . She helped kidnap a number of monks in order to use them in a new plot to access the elemental node beneath the monastery . However , one of the chosen victims did not docilely accept his fate and stunned her . Talia ' s fellow cultists abandoned her and she was later found by other monks , who took her to the infirmary . Here , Talia was confronted by an adventuring party hired by Grandmaster Perrywinkle Shin to find the missing monks .

title: Talindra Amalith
description: Talindra Amalith Talindra Amalith was a wild elf and , as of 1374 DR , a member of the Vel ' Nikeryma , the guiding council of the Eldreth Veluuthra , who lived in the Methwood . She suffered due to the human adventurers in the area and led a cell of the Eldreth Veluuthra . She also recruited wild elves into the cell from the Chondalwood .
description_long: Talindra Amalith Talindra Amalith was a wild elf and , as of 1374 DR , a member of the Vel ' Nikeryma , the guiding council of the Eldreth Veluuthra , who lived in the Methwood . She suffered due to the human adventurers in the area and led a cell of the Eldreth Veluuthra . She also recruited wild elves into the cell from the Chondalwood .

title: Talis
description: Talis Talis was a card game popular in Faerûn , being considered " one of the four universal games " along with draughts , chess , and dice . Description . It involved a deck of 78 cards , including four regular ( " planar " ) suits ( flames , stones , waves , and winds ) and one trump suit of 22 cards , called the major arcana .
description_long: Talis Talis was a card game popular in Faerûn , being considered " one of the four universal games " along with draughts , chess , and dice . Description . It involved a deck of 78 cards , including four regular ( " planar " ) suits ( flames , stones , waves , and winds ) and one trump suit of 22 cards , called the major arcana . Major arcana cards included the Sun , Moon , Star , Comet , Throne , Key , and Night cards , among others . Many games could be played with a Talis deck . Common examples included : Decks . Most decks were made of lacquered parchment or paper and stored in a wooden case . A typical set might be purchased for 2 gold piece s , although bargain sets made in Candlekeep could be purchased for as little as three silver piece s from Aurora ' s Emporium . Other Uses . Some inhabitants of Faerûn used Talis decks for non - magical divination purposes . Appendix . Inspiration . A deck of Talis cards is described as similar to a deck of cards .

title: Talis Kasterel
description: Talis Kasterel Talis Kasterel was a high - ranking member of the reformed Cult of the Dragon under Severin Silrajin . History . Talis was raised by Galvan .
description_long: Talis Kasterel Talis Kasterel was a high - ranking member of the reformed Cult of the Dragon under Severin Silrajin . History . Talis was raised by Galvan . She joined the Cult very early and in time became one of their experts on white dragon , at the level of Severin ' s knowledge about red dragon s , once her namesake . Talis served as the leader of the Cult ' s hunting lodge in the Greypeak Mountains . Gameplay . Eventually , she was confronted by an adventuring party during the Tyranny of Dragons . Despite her loyalty to the Cult , the adventurers could potentially convince her to betray Severin with the right argument . Personality . Talis was a truly devoted follower of Tiamat . She believed that Severin ' s methods deviated too from their true objective and he just wanted glory for himself . She also greatly despised not being chosen as White Dragon Whisperer , which went instead to Varramzord , a dwarven friend of Severin .

title: Talking bird
description: Talking bird Talking birds were fascinating creatures found in Zakhara , the Land of Fate . These long - lived birds were highly intelligent , spending their years collecting information about their surroundings . They were even known to impart advice and wisdom to honorable people .
description_long: Talking bird Talking birds were fascinating creatures found in Zakhara , the Land of Fate . These long - lived birds were highly intelligent , spending their years collecting information about their surroundings . They were even known to impart advice and wisdom to honorable people . Talking birds were fluent in a large number of languages . Description . Talking birds looked like the offspring of a parrot and toucan . They stood 2 ft . ( 0 . 6 m ) tall with a wingspan of 4 ft . ( 1 . 2 m ) . Combat . These peaceful creatures avoided combat by flying away . If unable to flee , they would turn their sharp beaks on their attackers . Killing a talking bird was a sure way to incur Fate ’ s wrath . Habitat / Society . Zakharans believed that the very first talking bird was a gift from Fate , placed in the land to help those in need . Though extremely rare , talking birds could be found in any type of terrain . They did prefer forested areas above others . Talking birds answered questions for those lucky enough to stumble upon them . The number of questions they would answer varied from person to person , but talking birds never revealed what Fate had in store for someone .

title: Tall Trees
description: Tall Trees Tall Trees was a northeastern section of the High Forest in northwest Faerûn . It was believed to contain the oldest trees in the High Forest . The Tall Trees area was a remnant of the long - ago elven realm of Eaerlann , which fell when the elves retreated to Evermeet .
description_long: Tall Trees Tall Trees was a northeastern section of the High Forest in northwest Faerûn . It was believed to contain the oldest trees in the High Forest . The Tall Trees area was a remnant of the long - ago elven realm of Eaerlann , which fell when the elves retreated to Evermeet . Around 1358 DR , the region was held by the Druids of Tall Trees , who were devotees of Mielikki . Their aim was to protect the Tall Trees forest .

title: Tall mouther
description: Tall mouther Tall mouthers were aberration s found in the vicinity of halfling s . The halfling slang " They got mouthed " was a common way for halflings to explain that someone was killed by a tall mouther . Description .
description_long: Tall mouther Tall mouthers were aberration s found in the vicinity of halfling s . The halfling slang " They got mouthed " was a common way for halflings to explain that someone was killed by a tall mouther . Description . Tall mouthers were blue , furry , and had six legs . Their body was composed of merely a head , which was four feet long with big teeth and two big eyes . Locations . Tall mouthers dwelt primarily in the Lluirwood and on the borders Luiren . They also followed halflings throughout the Realms .

title: Tallus
description: Tallus Tallus was an archmage at the House of Wonder in Waterdeep . He was in service to the dark god Asmodeus and the evil angel Sathariel . He hoped to achieve immortality by helping Sathariel complete the ritual of the First Flensing which would open the gates of Hell in Waterdeep .
description_long: Tallus Tallus was an archmage at the House of Wonder in Waterdeep . He was in service to the dark god Asmodeus and the evil angel Sathariel . He hoped to achieve immortality by helping Sathariel complete the ritual of the First Flensing which would open the gates of Hell in Waterdeep . Instead , he was slain by the noblewoman Rilyanna Saerfynn who hoped to complete the ritual herself .

title: Talmost
description: Talmost Talmost was a Waterdhavian house that was known as one of the city ' s foremost clothiers and furriers . They managed widespread trapping and fur - trading operations in the North and operated prosperous silk trading and crafting businesses in Calimshan . They had close ties to the League of Skinners and Tanners and the Solemn Order of Recognized Furriers and Woolmen .
description_long: Talmost Talmost was a Waterdhavian house that was known as one of the city ' s foremost clothiers and furriers . They managed widespread trapping and fur - trading operations in the North and operated prosperous silk trading and crafting businesses in Calimshan . They had close ties to the League of Skinners and Tanners and the Solemn Order of Recognized Furriers and Woolmen . Thanks to recent events , they had a reciprocal emnity with House Melshimber . History . House Talmost first came to prominence during the reign of the Kingdom of Man .

title: Talon Everhale
description: Talon Everhale Talon Everhale was a young ranger in Icewind Dale , and a member of the Emerald Enclave during the Tyranny of Dragons of 1489 . History . Talon Everhale ' s mother died giving birth to her .
description_long: Talon Everhale Talon Everhale was a young ranger in Icewind Dale , and a member of the Emerald Enclave during the Tyranny of Dragons of 1489 . History . Talon Everhale ' s mother died giving birth to her . She was born with certain fiendish disfigurements . However , these deformities vanished after a mysterious person came to visit . The person left and with them went most people ' s memory of Talon ' s birth defects . Nevertheless , her father did not speak to her or anyone else since she was born . She grew into a beautiful young woman and skilled ranger . While on a hunt , she encountered the druid Delaan and his winter wolf . The druid offered her a place within the Emerald Enclave . He also informed her that she must guard herself against a dangerous chaos within herself . She was in fact the victim of a horrible curse that had been spawned in Ascalhorn , later known as Hellgate Keep . The curse passed from mother to child , it killed all male children , and was passed down the female line . The secret to ending this curse lay hidden in the ruins of Hellgate .

title: Talona
description: Talona Talona ( pronounced " tah - LOW - nah " ) , called the Lady of Poison , Mistress of Disease , and Mother of All Plagues , was the goddess of poison and disease . Talona was depicted as an old crone who brought misfortune and death . On the other hand , she could also be depicted as a beautiful and innocent woman .
description_long: Talona Talona ( pronounced " tah - LOW - nah " ) , called the Lady of Poison , Mistress of Disease , and Mother of All Plagues , was the goddess of poison and disease . Talona was depicted as an old crone who brought misfortune and death . On the other hand , she could also be depicted as a beautiful and innocent woman . History . The formula to the concoction known as the Chaos Curse was indirectly given to Aballister Bonaduce by an avatar of Talona . Relationships . Talona was allied with Loviatar and despised Chauntea , Mielikki , Kelemvor , and Tyr . She disliked Ilmater for the cures he found . Worshipers . Talona ' s followers scarred or tattooed themselves in horrible ways . They wore ragged gray - green robes and were expected to go about quietly and seek out new diseases . Her priests carried daggers dipped in poison . Orders . The Followers of Plague experienced pain as if it were pleasure . They believed death was more powerful than life , though they were equal in balance . They followed the dictum to work in her name and let their doings be subtle or spectacular . Temples . The House of Night ' s Embrace was Talona ' s largest church and was located in Tashluta .

title: Talons of Justice
description: Talons of Justice The Talons of Justice were an order of silver dragon paladin s dedicated to Xymor and who followed the " Ptarian Code " . Dogma . The " Ptarian Code " was originally an oath taken only by those who served the King of Justice , but eventually it was adopted by members of the gold and silver dragon species .
description_long: Talons of Justice The Talons of Justice were an order of silver dragon paladin s dedicated to Xymor and who followed the " Ptarian Code " . Dogma . The " Ptarian Code " was originally an oath taken only by those who served the King of Justice , but eventually it was adopted by members of the gold and silver dragon species . They took it as a knightly oath and followed it to the letter . It was expected that the Talons would be pure of heart and deed , would help each other and protect the " lesser races " , and would be able to convert their foes instead of killing them . Violence was used only as a last resort . Membership . No one knew exactly how many Talons there were , but the group probably numbered in the scores . Members were spread throughout Faerûn , many living in human and demihuman form in cities and towns , working in secrecy to further the cause of lawful good ness . The Talons were an elitist group , and rarely allowed for new members to bolster their numbers or accepted the help of their few allies . While originally consisting only of silver dragons , the Talons allowed Gold and silver half - dragon s to join their ranks after the last Rage of Dragons .

title: Talor Vurtalis
description: Talor Vurtalis Talor Vurtalis was one of the new aquatic elf high mages in Myth Nantar . History . In 1341 DR Talor was accepted as new student by the High Mages Taranath Reefglamor and Yrlimn Tidark together with Jhanra Merlistar and Keryth Adofaer .
description_long: Talor Vurtalis Talor Vurtalis was one of the new aquatic elf high mages in Myth Nantar . History . In 1341 DR Talor was accepted as new student by the High Mages Taranath Reefglamor and Yrlimn Tidark together with Jhanra Merlistar and Keryth Adofaer . Taranath placed three selu ' kiira upon their brows , sending the students into comas while the gems force - feed the knowledge of millennia into their brains . Talor and his fellow awaked only in tarskath 1 of 1369 DR in order to help in the Twelfth Serôs War . Talor and his fellow helped their masters in the war and in the great spell that sent Iakhovas to the Outer Planes . After Yrlimn and Taranath exhaust died and Keryth and Jhanra replaced them as new High Mages and also Talos was nominated High Mage . In ches of 1370 DR Talor evoked a Whirlpool Gate , no caring for people around , and disappeared . In nightal some dukar s discovered him in the Cliff City of Atin . Talor had renamed himself Atin taking control of the beast of the city . He injured the dukars that had discovered him Activiities . Talor vainly wear his selu ' kiira openly on his forehead in opposition to tradition to hid it .

title: Talos
description: Talos Talos ( pronounced " TAAHL - ose " ) , also known as The Storm Lord ( and long ago as Kozah ) , was the Faerûnian greater deity of storms and destruction . His dogma was self - serving , demanding utter obedience from his priests and instructing them to spread destruction where they might . His followers were known as Talassans .
description_long: Talos Talos ( pronounced " TAAHL - ose " ) , also known as The Storm Lord ( and long ago as Kozah ) , was the Faerûnian greater deity of storms and destruction . His dogma was self - serving , demanding utter obedience from his priests and instructing them to spread destruction where they might . His followers were known as Talassans . After the Spellplague , many came to believe that Talos was , in fact , an aspect of the orc ish god Gruumsh , but after the Second Sundering the two deities seemed more distinct . Description . Talos appeared as a broad shouldered , bearded man with one good eye . He wore half - plate armor over black leather , and black leather gloves . His empty eye socket was filled with whirling stars and covered with a dark eye patch . When he appeared in Calimshan , he often took the form of a dusky skinned , turbaned genie rising out of a sandstorm . Worshipers . The church of Talos was small by the standards of a greater deity , and his followers were fanatical in their love of destruction . The clergy had no formal hierarchy ; obedience was enforced through might .

title: Talryn
description: Talryn Talryn Heltharn was a prince of Impiltur . Relationships . Prince Talryn was the first son of King Imphras II and Lasheela of Dilpur .
description_long: Talryn Talryn Heltharn was a prince of Impiltur . Relationships . Prince Talryn was the first son of King Imphras II and Lasheela of Dilpur . He had a younger brother , Lashilmbrar , and four step - brothers — Kuskar , Velimbrar , Elphras , and Fylraun — from his father ' s second wife , Rebaera Osterhown . History . Talryn was born in 1188 DR . In 1204 DR , Talryn ' s father the king began showing signs that he was losing his mind . After four years , Talryn decided that his father needed to be removed from power . Since Talryn was the crown prince , this would have made him king , but his jealous brother Lashilmbrar , with the help of some nobles , found a way to have Talryn exiled for treason . Talryn took refuge among the pirates of the Inner Sea , but by Impilturan law , he remained the crown prince , and so Lashilmbrar was unable to take the throne . So Lashilmbrar attempted to kill Talryn by gathering a fleet and attacking the pirates of Urdogen , but by the chance of bad winds , Talryn ' s vessel was absent . Lashilmbrar tried to have his brother killed a second time in 1212 DR , and this time , he was successful .

title: Taluth
description: Taluth Taluth was a younger malaugrym , ( a . k . a .
description_long: Taluth Taluth was a younger malaugrym , ( a . k . a . shadowmaster ) living in Westgate as of the Year of the Banner , 1368 DR . Description . As a shapeshifter , Taluth could appear as any living thing , but usually appeared as a plain , ordinary , human female . Taluth was known to take more attractive male or female forms when it suited her needs . Personality . Taluth was a bold operator in Westgate , but cautious enough to redirect suspicion of her activities to the merchant - lords , making it look like her accomplishments were caused by their machinations . She was unpredictable , capricious , and merciless when it pleased her , toying with others for her own entertainment . Abilities . She was particularly adept at learning new magic spells . Activities . Taluth was constantly looking for ways to increase her pleasure , fill her coffers , or acquire new magic items and spells . She was a powerful player in Westgate , but chose to remain hidden and unsuspected . Relationships . She was particularly fond of humans and hired them as agents , dallied with them for pleasure , and used them as patsies and scapegoats . Adventuresome humans were her favorite playthings .

title: Talya Floshin
description: Talya Floshin Talya Floshin was one of the leaders of the daemonfey in the Year of the Tankard , 1370 DR . Relationships . Talya was the consort of Faersynd Floshin .
description_long: Talya Floshin Talya Floshin was one of the leaders of the daemonfey in the Year of the Tankard , 1370 DR . Relationships . Talya was the consort of Faersynd Floshin . Description . Talya resembled the goddess Hanali Celanil as shown in many depictions but with red eyes . Rumors said Talya was one of the daughters of the demon lord Graz ' zt . Activities . Talya valued potential informants and reported to Ryvvik Dlardrageth . Secretly , she plotted to kill her husband and replaced him with Baron Xhalth . History . In 1370 DR , Talya was pregnant with triplets and rumors said they were Xhalth ' s offspring . At one point , Talya gave birth to a daughter of Xhalth , Mogwyn , a fey ' ri marauder . Personality . Talya was the most manipulative of the fey ' ri . She wanted Xhalth as a new husband because he was more easily controlled by her .

title: Talzir
description: Talzir Talzir was a priest of Vhaeraun . History . In 1377 DR , Talzir was one of the six nightshadow s chosen for an assault led by Kâras on the main temple of Kiaransalee .
description_long: Talzir Talzir was a priest of Vhaeraun . History . In 1377 DR , Talzir was one of the six nightshadow s chosen for an assault led by Kâras on the main temple of Kiaransalee . Arriving near the temple , Kâras decided that he , Gindrol , and Talzir should polymorph into deep gnome s , allies of the Crones of Kiaransalee , and infiltrate the temple .

title: Tam Zawad
description: Tam Zawad Tam Zawad is a Harper and priest of Selûne living in the Sword Coast region of Faerûn . Description . Tam is described as a tall , thin middle aged man with brown skin and curly dark hair with some grey in it .
description_long: Tam Zawad Tam Zawad is a Harper and priest of Selûne living in the Sword Coast region of Faerûn . Description . Tam is described as a tall , thin middle aged man with brown skin and curly dark hair with some grey in it . History . Early life . Tam was born in Calimshan . As a young man while adventuring with friends , his entire group with the exception of Tam were slaughtered by Shadar - kai agents of Shade . From that moment onward Tam decided to dedicate himself to Selûne . Tam worked as a priest for a Harper cell on the Southern Sword Coast . He met a girl and they had a daughter Mira , Tam ' s only child . Later life . At some point , Tam began living in the Northern Sword Coast region . In 1478 DR he met a dragonborn bounty hunter named Mehen and his two adopted tiefling daughters Farideh and Havilar . Tam helped the group foil a plot by devils in Neverwinter . Later in 1478 DR , Tam was ordered by his Harper master to investigate antiquities in Waterdeep , presumably to keep them out of the hands of Shadovar .

title: Tamal
description: Tamal Tamal was the young prince of the dwarven Orothiar Clan in the Barony of Bloodstone in 1357 DR . Activities . Tamal was still immature .
description_long: Tamal Tamal was the young prince of the dwarven Orothiar Clan in the Barony of Bloodstone in 1357 DR . Activities . Tamal was still immature .
