He spoke constantly and a had a wacky sense of humor . History . In 1357 DR Tamal and his tribe met Gareth Dragonsbane ' s party and possibly he decided to join the party . In 1359 DR Tamal joined the Twilight Riders despite the concern of his father and did a great job .

title: Tamalin Zoar
description: Tamalin Zoar Tamalin Zoar was a member of the Zoar family and the ruler of Calling Horns sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . History . In the late 1480s or early 1490s DR , Tamalin bought the Calling Horn inn and retired to live there .
description_long: Tamalin Zoar Tamalin Zoar was a member of the Zoar family and the ruler of Calling Horns sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . History . In the late 1480s or early 1490s DR , Tamalin bought the Calling Horn inn and retired to live there . In time , thanks to her influence she gathered around it a small village of settlers . All villagers paid Tamalin for the " protection " guaranteed by her mercenaries .

title: Tamalynda
description: Tamalynda Tamalynda , or the Whisperer , was a High Lady of the marrash in 1367 DR . Personality . Tamalynda was a prideful marrashi who was not quick to trust others .
description_long: Tamalynda Tamalynda , or the Whisperer , was a High Lady of the marrash in 1367 DR . Personality . Tamalynda was a prideful marrashi who was not quick to trust others . She was a master of deceit . Activities . In addition to being the Lotus Emperor ' s invisible consort , Tamalynda also served as the Faceless God ' s lieutenant when the Emperor was unable . The soldiers under her command served a special enforcers for their god within the highest peaks of the Land of the Yak - Men .

title: Tamanokuni
description: Tamanokuni Tamanokuni was the largest city and the capital of Miyama Province in Kozakura in 1357 DR . In that year , there lived in the city more than 10 , 000 people divided into eight wards . Tamanokuni housed the residence of Niwa Hirotada and the most important shrines of Miyama .
description_long: Tamanokuni Tamanokuni was the largest city and the capital of Miyama Province in Kozakura in 1357 DR . In that year , there lived in the city more than 10 , 000 people divided into eight wards . Tamanokuni housed the residence of Niwa Hirotada and the most important shrines of Miyama .

title: Tamara
description: Tamara Tamara ( pronounced " Tuh - MAH - ruh " ) was the neutral good dragon goddess of life , light , mercy , and forgiveness . She was the consort of Lendys , and was commonly worshiped alongside him and Bahamut , who in some traditions was considered to be their son . Description .
description_long: Tamara Tamara ( pronounced " Tuh - MAH - ruh " ) was the neutral good dragon goddess of life , light , mercy , and forgiveness . She was the consort of Lendys , and was commonly worshiped alongside him and Bahamut , who in some traditions was considered to be their son . Description . In her natural form , Tamara was a huge , wingless platinum dragon with burnished scales , slightly smaller than Lendys . She radiated a comfortable aura of warmth and love , her eyes shining with the brightness of the sun itself . Realm . Tamara had a lair in the plane of Elysium . Personality . Tamara was the kindest and most benevolent of the draconic deities . Some mistook that for weakness , though such beings didn ' t survived to make that error twice . As consort of Lendys , she always strived to temper his hard - edged justice with a sense of forgiveness . Worshipers . Tamara was worshiped mostly by brass and copper dragon s , although many lawful good dragons of other species worshiped her as a consort of Lendys . Tamara ' s faith had a reputation of peaceful and merciful , but her worshipers didn ' t hesitated to stand against evil or tyranny if they needed to . Clergy .

title: Tamarand
description: Tamarand Tamarand was a gold great wyrm who was the King of Justice as of 1479 DR . Before that , he served as the second - in - comand to the former king , the gold dragon Lareth . Tamarand was also a chosen of Bahamut and a recurrent ally of the Talons of Justice .
description_long: Tamarand Tamarand was a gold great wyrm who was the King of Justice as of 1479 DR . Before that , he served as the second - in - comand to the former king , the gold dragon Lareth . Tamarand was also a chosen of Bahamut and a recurrent ally of the Talons of Justice . History . In 1373 DR , the former King of Justice , Lareth , was slain in battle by Tamarand who was Lareth ' s deputy and brother . Tamarand reluctantly challenged Lareth for leadership of all goodly dragons after Lareth ' s reasoning and judgment had been corrupted by the Dracorage . Lareth , teetering on the edge of madness as a result of the Rage , eagerly accepted , wrongly suspecting Tamarand was about to betray him . At first Tamarand tried to subdue Lareth , using only spells to disable him , but finally Tamarand was forced to deliver a fatal blow . As required by the protocols of the Ptarian Code , the gold dragon Larendrammagar and the silver dragon Havarlan bore witness to the battle . Tamarand was greatly grieved from killing his superior and brother , and initially did not accept the mantle of royalty .

title: Tamer Creed
description: Tamer Creed The Tamer Creed was one of the major illithid Creeds in the Realms . They were highly militaristic , and favored the use of martial might against other races . Oryndoll .
description_long: Tamer Creed The Tamer Creed was one of the major illithid Creeds in the Realms . They were highly militaristic , and favored the use of martial might against other races . Oryndoll . In Oryndoll , illithids in the Tamer Creed controlled most of the city ' s martial , non - psionic forces . Their influence in the city diminished after the Mindstalker Wars . They still however partnered closely with the Nourisher Creed to launch raids on the lizardfolk city of Surkh . The Nourishers turned the lizardfolk captured into tzakandi for the Tamers . They held influence over the branch of the military called the Errant Thoughts . They had control of the Armories of the city .

title: Tamiel
description: Tamiel Tamiel was a fallen angel in the Labyrinth during the Rage of Demons . History . The gods condemned Tamiel and seven other fallen angels to remain as stone statues in the depths of the Labyrinth for unknown crimes .
description_long: Tamiel Tamiel was a fallen angel in the Labyrinth during the Rage of Demons . History . The gods condemned Tamiel and seven other fallen angels to remain as stone statues in the depths of the Labyrinth for unknown crimes . Powers . Tamiel was mad and acted as an oracle .

title: Tammar
description: Tammar Tammar was a large town in Thesk . As of 1372 DR , it had a population of 3 , 594 . It was razed by the Tuigan Horde and subsequently besieged by bandits who took heavy tolls from passing caravans .
description_long: Tammar Tammar was a large town in Thesk . As of 1372 DR , it had a population of 3 , 594 . It was razed by the Tuigan Horde and subsequently besieged by bandits who took heavy tolls from passing caravans . The government of Thesk hired a hundred orc soldiers to rid the town of the bandits and these orcs were later hailed as heroes in Tammar . The town was since rebuilt .

title: Tammas Forkbeard
description: Tammas Forkbeard Tammas Forkbeard was a dwarf and the daughter of King Daurvos Frostbeard of the Ironstar clan . Relatives . Tammas ' s father was Daurvos Frostbeard , king of the Ironstar clan .
description_long: Tammas Forkbeard Tammas Forkbeard was a dwarf and the daughter of King Daurvos Frostbeard of the Ironstar clan . Relatives . Tammas ' s father was Daurvos Frostbeard , king of the Ironstar clan . Background . During the final days of the Ironstar clan , they had been driven out of their homes at Ironstar Mountain by orc s . With few survivors , they fled south along the west bank of the River Dessarin , pursued by the orcs and also troll s . While Daurvos led the fighting at the rear of the clan ' s group , along with his great grandchildren , Tammas led the wives and children south . Daurvos was felled while on the Stone Bridge , and the orcs trampled over him , leaving him to die . He shouted out to Moradin in an effort to aid his people , and then fell from the bridge into the water below , and died . His body was pulled from the water by a 6m - high ( 20ft ) avatar of Moradin , who cradled it and wept . The avatar was outlined in red flames and wielded a hammer that glowed red . Tammas turned to fight the orcs , who were being decimated by Moradin ' s avatar , and they were soon wiped out .

title: Tammith Iltazyarra
description: Tammith Iltazyarra Tammith Iltazyarra was a vampire and lover of the bard Bareris Anskuld . Tammith the human . Until 1375 DR , Tammith was a beautiful young woman and from the Rashemi underclass of Bezantur .
description_long: Tammith Iltazyarra Tammith Iltazyarra was a vampire and lover of the bard Bareris Anskuld . Tammith the human . Until 1375 DR , Tammith was a beautiful young woman and from the Rashemi underclass of Bezantur . She practically raised her younger brother Ral by herself after her mother ' s death rearing Ral . Her father couldn ' t overcome the death of his wife and , though being a good potter , started wasting his money gambling and drinking . Tammith was a good potter herself though she didn ' t work long enough as a potter to be accepted by the local potter guild . She loved Bareris Anskuld so much that she let him go six years ago to roam the world . In order to pay a gambling debt that her father Boravik had with the White Raven Gang of Bezantur , Tammith agreed to sell herself into slavery . Along with dozens of other slaves , she was bought by Red Wizards and lead to Delhumide to the undead manufactory of Xingax . But instead of giving her as fodder to his zombies , Xingax magically transformed her to a vampire . Tammith the vampire . Appearance .

title: Tamnaeuth
description: Tamnaeuth Tamnaeuth is an elf armourer who lives in Leuthilspar on the island of Evermeet where he operates an armoury . He creates sword s and mail and plate armour . Most of his pieces are enchanted .
description_long: Tamnaeuth Tamnaeuth is an elf armourer who lives in Leuthilspar on the island of Evermeet where he operates an armoury . He creates sword s and mail and plate armour . Most of his pieces are enchanted . He does not charge for his creations but chooses who to offer them to , often selecting nobility or other elves with influence , in an attempt to bolster his reputation . In exchange for this , the recipients of his items provide him with food and clothing .

title: Tamoko
description: Tamoko Tamoko was Sarevok ' s lover who did not wish for him to attempt to ascend to godhood , and for that reason ended up being abandoned by him in favor of Cythandria . Description . Tamoko was under 5 feet ( 1 .
description_long: Tamoko Tamoko was Sarevok ' s lover who did not wish for him to attempt to ascend to godhood , and for that reason ended up being abandoned by him in favor of Cythandria . Description . Tamoko was under 5 feet ( 1 . 52 meters ) tall with smooth skin and physical strength . History . Tamoko was a native of Kozakura . She could not read Common and had trouble with the Kozakuran language . She born in 1350 DR in the kozakuran isle of Mikedono . Her father sold her to the ninja Konishi clan . Tamoko was trained in the secret Konishi dojo in Chimotoge becoming a ninja of renown . However one day she was send to kill a high ranking wu jen but the wu jen was prepared to her arrive and managed to push Tamoko in a portal to Athkatla in Amn . In fear both of the powerful wu jen and of the Konishi ninja for failing her mission Tamoko remained in Faerun starting working as assassin until in Baldur ' s Gate she met Saverok .

title: Tamood al - Kasif
description: Tamood al - Kasif Tamood al - Kasif lived within the Tower of Adnan al - Raqi in Huzuz , the City of Delights , in 1367 DR . Activities . Tamood was a learned sha ' ir and instructor who worked with Adnan al - Raqi , learning the advanced skills of his order .
description_long: Tamood al - Kasif Tamood al - Kasif lived within the Tower of Adnan al - Raqi in Huzuz , the City of Delights , in 1367 DR . Activities . Tamood was a learned sha ' ir and instructor who worked with Adnan al - Raqi , learning the advanced skills of his order .

title: Tamper Tencoin
description: Tamper Tencoin Tamper Tencoin was a wayward Harper . Activities . Tamper was a wily adventurer who sometimes acted as a joker and other times patiently waited in order to enact vengeance .
description_long: Tamper Tencoin Tamper Tencoin was a wayward Harper . Activities . Tamper was a wily adventurer who sometimes acted as a joker and other times patiently waited in order to enact vengeance . History . For a time , Tamper was a member of the mercenary Flaming Fists until his commander Rivenhelm died on the battlefield , giving to him the magical sword " Namarra " , which was later stolen by a Zhentarim agent . For a while , Tamper acted as a caravan master between Amn and Westgate and sometimes Neverwinter . After he joined the Harpers , Tamper helped the Knights of Myth Drannor to defeat the Zhent mage Whisper . In his later career , he became a planewalker , often traveling Faerun with creatures from other planes , like the Nehwon ghoul Lacheera . In 1367 DR , he went alone to Daggerdale to help Randal Morn .

title: Tamr na - Fia
description: Tamr na - Fia Tamr na - Fia lived in the Tower of Adnan al - Raqi in Huzuz in 1367 DR . Relationships . Tamr was the favorite student of Adnan al - Raqi , who looked upon her as his own granddaughter .
description_long: Tamr na - Fia Tamr na - Fia lived in the Tower of Adnan al - Raqi in Huzuz in 1367 DR . Relationships . Tamr was the favorite student of Adnan al - Raqi , who looked upon her as his own granddaughter . < / ref > Activities . Tamr disappeared after she was sent to the court of one of the genie lords at the request of Adnan to find answers to the Grand Caliph ' s sterility . < / ref > He kept her private quarters ready for her in case she ever returned .

title: Tamura Tenryu
description: Tamura Tenryu Tamura Tenryu was a samurai of Fochu Peninsula in Wa around 1358 DR . Activities . Tamura Tenryu was the shoya of the village of Ayoi in Fochu Peninsula .
description_long: Tamura Tenryu Tamura Tenryu was a samurai of Fochu Peninsula in Wa around 1358 DR . Activities . Tamura Tenryu was the shoya of the village of Ayoi in Fochu Peninsula . Personality . Tenryu considered himself superior to the local villagers and had a desperate need for an intelligent conversation . He pressed all his guests to attend an incense ceremony before being welcomed in the village .

title: Tamura Umakai
description: Tamura Umakai Tamura Umakai was a wu jen of Fochu Peninsula in Wa . Activities . Tamura Umakai was the shoya of the village of Ikizawa in Fochu Peninsula .
description_long: Tamura Umakai Tamura Umakai was a wu jen of Fochu Peninsula in Wa . Activities . Tamura Umakai was the shoya of the village of Ikizawa in Fochu Peninsula . History . Umakai trained under the powerful wu jen Setsu Iki . In 1357 DR , after years of not seeing him , Setsu arrived in Ikizawa asking Umakai to take care of a page of the fabled Book of Hsi . Setsu explained that the evil Za - Jikku from the Qui demiplane wanted the book but it was safest being split in two , with a page in the far and isolated Ikizawa . However , in 1358 DR , the yellow - robed minions of Za - Jikku twice attacked the village , greatly scaring Umakai and his villagers . Later he met Osari Minhiro and a foreign adventuring party . After checking that they were good men , Umakai told them everything and gave them the page of the Book of Hsi .

title: Tanagyr ' s Stout
description: Tanagyr ' s Stout Tanagyr ' s Stout was a stout beer brewed in the Moonsea region . It was also sold through Aurora ' s Whole Realms Catalogue . Description .
description_long: Tanagyr ' s Stout Tanagyr ' s Stout was a stout beer brewed in the Moonsea region . It was also sold through Aurora ' s Whole Realms Catalogue . Description . This beer was a heavy black beverage with a malty flavor . It was on par with Evermead when considering its headiness . Trade . It was one of a scant few items exempted from trade embargoes against Zhentil Keep . Long confined to the Moonsea , it was traded to the south in the mid – 14th century DR , sold in unmarked barrels to escape the stigma of that area . Prices . title: Tanalasta Obarskyr
description: Tanalasta Obarskyr Tanalasta Obarskyr ( known informally as Tanny or Tana ) was the eldest daughter of King Azoun IV and Filfaeril Obarskyr . She was the heir of the throne of Cormyr until her death in 1371 . It was rumored that she was having a secret romance with Aunadar Bleth .
description_long: Tanalasta Obarskyr Tanalasta Obarskyr ( known informally as Tanny or Tana ) was the eldest daughter of King Azoun IV and Filfaeril Obarskyr . She was the heir of the throne of Cormyr until her death in 1371 . It was rumored that she was having a secret romance with Aunadar Bleth . She had conflicts with her parents about her belief in Chauntea . She mothered Azoun V . Appearance . Tanalasta had long dark brown hair and blue eyes . Possessions . Tanalasta has a hollow metal sphere that , upon spoken command , could transform into a key to unlock a secret vault in the depths of the royal palace . It is one of only five , the others possessed by the king , queen , Vangerdahast , and Tanalasta ' s sister , Alusair .

title: Tanar ' ri
description: Tanar ' ri The tanar ' ri were the dominant subcategory of demon s . Originally created by the obyrith s as slaves , they eventually revolted against their masters , killing most of them and taking over as the dominant race of demons in the Abyss . Most known demon lord s were tanar ' ri .
description_long: Tanar ' ri The tanar ' ri were the dominant subcategory of demon s . Originally created by the obyrith s as slaves , they eventually revolted against their masters , killing most of them and taking over as the dominant race of demons in the Abyss . Most known demon lord s were tanar ' ri . The tanar ' ri were essentially classic demons — those that arose as a result of faith and humanity and were reflections of cruelty , evil , and sin . They usually had a basic humanoid shape , although there were several exceptions . There were many known species of tanar ' ri . Varieties . title: Tanaroo Quinson
description: Tanaroo Quinson Tanaroo Quinson was a gnome illusionist in the Bloodstone Lands around 1357 DR and 1359 DR . Activities . Tanaroo was the assistant of Doctor Trundles in managing the Circus of Doctor Trundles , a collection of monsters .
description_long: Tanaroo Quinson Tanaroo Quinson was a gnome illusionist in the Bloodstone Lands around 1357 DR and 1359 DR . Activities . Tanaroo was the assistant of Doctor Trundles in managing the Circus of Doctor Trundles , a collection of monsters . History . In 1357 DR , Tanaroo went with Doctor Trundles and his circus to the Damara n city of Valls . However , a bulette freed itself and other monsters . Tanaroo hired some adventurers to capture the monsters before they killed someone . In 1359 DR , after capturing new monsters , Trundles went back for a new tour in Impiltur . Tanaroo acted as ringmaster with Trundles staying behind the scenes . Relationship . Tanaroo always traveled with Doctor Trundles .

title: Tanarukk
description: Tanarukk Tanarukks were orc s whose blood had been tainted by an evil outsider , in many cases a tanar ' ri demon . Physical Description . They appeared as short , stocky orcs with bristly hair , horns , or ridges along the sides of their heads .
description_long: Tanarukk Tanarukks were orc s whose blood had been tainted by an evil outsider , in many cases a tanar ' ri demon . Physical Description . They appeared as short , stocky orcs with bristly hair , horns , or ridges along the sides of their heads . Tanarukks also had the distinctive smell of brimstone about them and in fact had a limited ability to manipulate fire . History . The tanarukks originated as orc - demon crossbreeds in the region around Hellgate Keep . However , years of dwelling on Faerûn led to them being regarded as a separate species , rather than simply as a subrace . Psychology . They were nasty , brutish and not terribly intelligent ( despite being smarter than an average orc ) ; they were , however , extremely dangerous fighter s . In spite of their lack of personal magnetism , the tanarukks ' instinctive ability to control flame led many to become sorcerer s . More still could be found acting as muscle for cambion s and other fiend ish creatures .

title: Tanataskar Moonwind
description: Tanataskar Moonwind Tanataskar Moonwind was a curse d tavern owner in Yartar in 1370 DR . History . Once Tanataksar was an adventurer devotee of Tempus but offended the god for his pride and Tempus cursed him : whenever he draw blood in a fight he went berseker , also during this time a continuous rain of broken weapons pours from Tanataskar ' s body but with no consequence for him .
description_long: Tanataskar Moonwind Tanataskar Moonwind was a curse d tavern owner in Yartar in 1370 DR . History . Once Tanataksar was an adventurer devotee of Tempus but offended the god for his pride and Tempus cursed him : whenever he draw blood in a fight he went berseker , also during this time a continuous rain of broken weapons pours from Tanataskar ' s body but with no consequence for him . He had consulted many wizards and priests of Tempus in order to find a cure but with no avail . He also resorted to no went to adventure again in order to no risk endanger friends or fellow adventurers . He remained in his tavern to listened stories of adventures However in dreams Tempus said to him that a great task await him .

title: Tanathras
description: Tanathras Tanathras was a Netherese flying enclave . It was destroyed in −647 when the city ' s " mythallar " was disintegrate d by double agents working against Tanathras ' s ruler . Geography .
description_long: Tanathras Tanathras was a Netherese flying enclave . It was destroyed in −647 when the city ' s " mythallar " was disintegrate d by double agents working against Tanathras ' s ruler . Geography . Prior to its destruction , Tanathras was located above the city of Dagger ' s Point , a well - known haven for lawless individuals in Netheril . History . In −647 DR , the ruler of Tanathras , an archwizard named Falious , decided to relocate his flying enclave above Dagger ' s Point . Intending to use the relocated enclave as a summer retreat , Falious wanted to purge the city below of evil elements . He was approached by several former students of Trothas Helegaras , the ruler of Dagger ' s Point , who volunteered to aid Falious in taking control of the criminal city . However , these students turned out to be double agents in Helegaras ' s employ . They betrayed Falious , cast a powerful " disintegrate " spell on Tanathras ' s " mythallar " , and escaped using " contingency " . Tanathras plummeted into the side of the Dagger Mountains and was destroyed .

title: Tanetal
description: Tanetal Tanetal was a pit fiend and servant of Bane . History . Servant of the wizard .
description_long: Tanetal Tanetal was a pit fiend and servant of Bane . History . Servant of the wizard . Tanetal was ordered by Bane into the service of the Red Wizard Marcus in order to aid him in his task of bringing more power to the dark god by sacrificing human souls to the Pool of Darkness . Vastly more competent than his nominal master , Tanetal was used as a scapegoat by Marcus . Even though he brought power to the wizard and brought thousands of troops into his service , Tanetal was stymied by the inept wizard . Human form . Eventually , Tanetal assumed the form of the human bard " Latenat " in an effort to convince the people of Phlan to abandon the stolen city and leave the safety they enjoyed there . His plot almost succeeded until Marcus summoned him to his defense at a most inopportune moment . Evaine finally managed to banish him to the Nine Hells by figuring out his true name . Trivia . Tanetal showed a habit of saying Latenat at the beginning or end of his speech .

title: Tangled Trees
description: Tangled Trees The Tangled Trees was one of the four old elven communities of Cormanthyr ( the others were the Elven Court , Myth Drannor , and Semberholme ) in the great forest of Cormanthor . Hundreds of elves still occupied the area in the 14th century DR , but they were extremely hostile to outsiders and were likely to attack on sight . The elves of the Tangled Trees typically worshiped Rillifane Rallathil .
description_long: Tangled Trees The Tangled Trees was one of the four old elven communities of Cormanthyr ( the others were the Elven Court , Myth Drannor , and Semberholme ) in the great forest of Cormanthor . Hundreds of elves still occupied the area in the 14th century DR , but they were extremely hostile to outsiders and were likely to attack on sight . The elves of the Tangled Trees typically worshiped Rillifane Rallathil . The village itself as large by the standards set after the Retreat in 1344 DR , though many of its residents were on patrols or otherwise wandering among the Tangled Vale along its networks of twisted paths and webbed throughways from connected tree forts to other platforms high in the branches . Its population was largely comprised of youngsters , adventurers , and others who did not join the Retreat . The village was once called Faelorin , though it was destroyed by the dragon Venom after its mate was slain . The rebuilt village became known as Tangled Trees . Geography .

title: Tangled Webs
description: Tangled Webs Tangled Webs is the second book in the Starlight and Shadows trilogy by Elaine Cunningham . Summary . The novel opens with Liriel Baenre rescuing Hrolf the Unruly from prison in Skullport to his ship , the " Elfmaid " .
description_long: Tangled Webs Tangled Webs is the second book in the Starlight and Shadows trilogy by Elaine Cunningham . Summary . The novel opens with Liriel Baenre rescuing Hrolf the Unruly from prison in Skullport to his ship , the " Elfmaid " . With the help of Liriel ' s magic , the " Elfmaid " is able to pass through the magical portals of Skullport to the Sea of Swords , heading for Ruathym with a few stops on the side . Meanwhile , Caladorn Cassalanter , sailing with seal - hunters on the Cutter in the waters near Luskan , captures a ship and discovers it is filled with barrels of pickled sea elves . The barrels are marked with Ruathen symbols , indicating a plot to implicate Ruathym in the tragedy . The " Elfmaid " picks up the Cutter and strands its occupants without realizing they had not been the perpetrators . The surviving crew is saved by Xzorsh , the sea elf ranger . It turns out that the High Captains of Luskan are planning a war against Ruathym , using falsified atrocities to turn Waterdeep and other members of the Lords ' Alliance against the island .

title: Tanglehair
description: Tanglehair Tanglehair was a deep gnome in Zortagra during the late 1480s DR . History . She was captured with her fellows by duergar in the mid - 1480s DR and put to work in the recently conquered city of Zortagra .
description_long: Tanglehair Tanglehair was a deep gnome in Zortagra during the late 1480s DR . History . She was captured with her fellows by duergar in the mid - 1480s DR and put to work in the recently conquered city of Zortagra . Five years later , Tanglehair noticed the madness spreading among the duergar and led a group of captives to escape the chaos .

title: Tanis Keltronn
description: Tanis Keltronn Tanis Keltronn was a human male and the head of the Keltronn mercantile family in Eshpurta , which gave him a seat on the Shield Council as of early 1370 DR , the Year of the Tankard . . He was a distant cousin of the powerful Argrim family of Athkatla who made his reputation in the food and wine markets through ruthless negotiation .
description_long: Tanis Keltronn Tanis Keltronn was a human male and the head of the Keltronn mercantile family in Eshpurta , which gave him a seat on the Shield Council as of early 1370 DR , the Year of the Tankard . . He was a distant cousin of the powerful Argrim family of Athkatla who made his reputation in the food and wine markets through ruthless negotiation .

title: Tanistan
description: Tanistan Tanistan Barony was a part of the monarchy of Erlkazar encompassing the Plains of Pehrrifaal . Description . This barony was responsible for the defense of the country ' s southern borders .
description_long: Tanistan Tanistan Barony was a part of the monarchy of Erlkazar encompassing the Plains of Pehrrifaal . Description . This barony was responsible for the defense of the country ' s southern borders . It had four small human villages and also some non human ones in the mountains . In fact , the barony had an alliance with the Shieldbreaker Ogres in the region , in order to maintain peace with other monstrous races living in the High Peaks . Geography . Located in the southwest corner of Erlkazar , Tanistan was bordered by the Omlarandin Mountains on the west , the Kuldin Peaks on the north , and the High Peaks of the Cloven Mountains on the east . It shared borders with baronies Carrelath , Shalanar , and Ahlarkhem . The Plains of Pehrrifaal , named after a local warrior , took up most of the land of this region . Barley , millet , and grapes were grown here . The foothills of the Omlarandins and the High Peaks were lightly forested , and the scouts followed elven practices of using trees as lookout towers . Government . In 1370 DR , the barony was ruled by a half - elven woman named Laxaella Bronshield .

title: Tanjus
description: Tanjus Tanjus was a sea hag in the Doomvault dungeon in 1486 DR . Personality . She wanted to expand the territory that she controlled by any means , even if it meant helping adventurers .
description_long: Tanjus Tanjus was a sea hag in the Doomvault dungeon in 1486 DR . Personality . She wanted to expand the territory that she controlled by any means , even if it meant helping adventurers . History . Tanjus was a sea hag in the Doomvault . There , she commanded some merrow and other sea monsters but wanted to overthrow the spirit naga overseer Ihanvas . In 1486 DR , she met the heroes from Daggerford and offered them a truce in exchange for killing the spirit naga .

title: Tann
description: Tann Commander Tann was a human commander of Fort Locke near the Mere of Dead Men on the Sword Coast North . History . Tann was the commander of Fort Locke until he vanished on a patrol .
description_long: Tann Commander Tann was a human commander of Fort Locke near the Mere of Dead Men on the Sword Coast North . History . Tann was the commander of Fort Locke until he vanished on a patrol . A shadow priest captured him and his men Blaine , Bruneil , and Garret . When the Kalach - Cha arrived , Tann was held captive and needed to be rescued . Once done , the Kalach - Cha could ' ve searched for his men . However , upon returning coming to Fort Locke , Vallis would be displeased Tann had returned and would imprison him . The Kalach - Cha could ' ve fought Vallis or persuaded his men to put their weapons down .

title: Tannin
description: Tannin Tannin was a human bard and a member of the adventuring group , the Moor Runners . History . In 1364 DR , Tannin was killed by the red dragon Rylatar ' ralah ' tyma when she attacked the caravan he was with just outside of Hill ' s Edge .
description_long: Tannin Tannin was a human bard and a member of the adventuring group , the Moor Runners . History . In 1364 DR , Tannin was killed by the red dragon Rylatar ' ralah ' tyma when she attacked the caravan he was with just outside of Hill ' s Edge .

title: Tannivh Irithyl
description: Tannivh Irithyl Tannivh Irithyl was fifth Coronal of Cormanthyr , ruling from - 791 DR to - 223 DR . He is known for having successfully routed the drow form the Twisted Tower in - 331 DR , passing control of the tower to followers of Eilistraee . In gratitude to the reformed and surface - acclimatized drow who helped in the downfall of the tower , he granted them rights to settle remote woods east of Cormanthor .
description_long: Tannivh Irithyl Tannivh Irithyl was fifth Coronal of Cormanthyr , ruling from - 791 DR to - 223 DR . He is known for having successfully routed the drow form the Twisted Tower in - 331 DR , passing control of the tower to followers of Eilistraee . In gratitude to the reformed and surface - acclimatized drow who helped in the downfall of the tower , he granted them rights to settle remote woods east of Cormanthor . He died in - 223 DR , passing the rulership of the realm to his son , Eltargrim Irithyl .

title: Tannous al - Assad
description: Tannous al - Assad Prince Tannous was a member of the royal family of Huzuz in 1367 DR . Description . Tannous was lean from frequent exercise and appeared younger than he really was .
description_long: Tannous al - Assad Prince Tannous was a member of the royal family of Huzuz in 1367 DR . Description . Tannous was lean from frequent exercise and appeared younger than he really was . He was always armed and preferred wearing somber , plum - hued clothing that he imported from Muluk . Personality . Tannous was a serious and thoughtful man . He realized that power comes from knowledge . Possessions . Tannous possessed a " ring of protection + 2 " , " bracers of defense AC 4 " , " gauntlets of ogre power " , a " scimitar of speed + 2 " , a " dagger of venom " , and " slippers of soft movement " . Activities . Tannous feared that the Grand Caliph would die without leaving a male heir . He constantly invited Khalil to lavish parties , hoping to introduce him to potential wives to add to the Royal Harim . Tannous supplied Khalil with many of his magical item s , hoping to curry more favor with the Grand Caliph . He purchased these items from disreputable adventurer s who smuggled them from Afyal and the Ruined Kingdoms . He employed a team of elite alchemists to discover a formula for longevity potions . Relationships .

title: Tannuth Ormbyr
description: Tannuth Ormbyr Tannuth Ormbyr is the owner of The Net of Pearls , a curios store in Marsember , Cormyr . He has visible scars , and can find adventurers or mercenaries for a fee , or offer his services to retrieve people or items imprisoned or confiscated by the Crown . He knows a lot about Marsember , but will only talk about its history , refusing to talk about the present - day city .
description_long: Tannuth Ormbyr Tannuth Ormbyr is the owner of The Net of Pearls , a curios store in Marsember , Cormyr . He has visible scars , and can find adventurers or mercenaries for a fee , or offer his services to retrieve people or items imprisoned or confiscated by the Crown . He knows a lot about Marsember , but will only talk about its history , refusing to talk about the present - day city . He also has many contacts in Sembia .

title: Tanova
description: Tanova Tanova was transformed into a vampire by Bodhi , after Jon Irenicus met her in Baldur ' s Gate . Gorion ' s Ward fought her in the torture chamber in Bodhi ' s lair and defeated her . However , she was not fully slain .
description_long: Tanova Tanova was transformed into a vampire by Bodhi , after Jon Irenicus met her in Baldur ' s Gate . Gorion ' s Ward fought her in the torture chamber in Bodhi ' s lair and defeated her . However , she was not fully slain . She was later ordered to chase a Shadow Thief called Sansuki and again fought Gorion ' s Ward , but avoided defeat by transforming into mist .

title: Tanshiver Brynleaf
description: Tanshiver Brynleaf Tanshiver " the Bard " Brynleaf " was a human man living in Calaunt in the Vast around 1358 DR . Despite the nickname , Tanshiver was actually a sage who specialized in folklore of human cultures and music from around the Dragon Reach . He worked from his office , known as Tanshiver ' s Corner , on Turncobble Street .
description_long: Tanshiver Brynleaf Tanshiver " the Bard " Brynleaf " was a human man living in Calaunt in the Vast around 1358 DR . Despite the nickname , Tanshiver was actually a sage who specialized in folklore of human cultures and music from around the Dragon Reach . He worked from his office , known as Tanshiver ' s Corner , on Turncobble Street . He was also an active Harper agent .

title: Tanta Hagara
description: Tanta Hagara Tanta Hagara was an evil annis who worked her way into the Blue Bear tribe of the Uthgardt . A servant of Hellgate Keep and Grintharke , she corrupted the tribe with base rituals while posing as their shaman , to such an extant that the tribe were shunned by the rest of the Uthgardt . She sought the Grandfather Tree , an ancient embodiment of the forest , reputed to hold the Hall of Mists , a temple dating back to the creator races .
description_long: Tanta Hagara Tanta Hagara was an evil annis who worked her way into the Blue Bear tribe of the Uthgardt . A servant of Hellgate Keep and Grintharke , she corrupted the tribe with base rituals while posing as their shaman , to such an extant that the tribe were shunned by the rest of the Uthgardt . She sought the Grandfather Tree , an ancient embodiment of the forest , reputed to hold the Hall of Mists , a temple dating back to the creator races . Legend said that gate s to other worlds and the Abyss and the Negative Material Plane existed somewhere in the Hall .

title: Tantran Guild of Merchant Masters
description: Tantran Guild of Merchant Masters The Tantran Guild of Merchant Masters was a guild in the city of Tantras in the Vast , located in the north - east corner and active around 1358 DR . The guild was a private club for Tantran citizens who owned and operated merchant fleets , though anyone could become a member . The membership fees were 200 gp per year .
description_long: Tantran Guild of Merchant Masters The Tantran Guild of Merchant Masters was a guild in the city of Tantras in the Vast , located in the north - east corner and active around 1358 DR . The guild was a private club for Tantran citizens who owned and operated merchant fleets , though anyone could become a member . The membership fees were 200 gp per year .

title: Tantran finefish
description: Tantran finefish Tantran finefish was a type of fish prepared in the city of Tantras in the Vast . Those who didn ' t enjoy it disparaged it as silvermuck . The fish were caught locally , then spiced and pickled .
description_long: Tantran finefish Tantran finefish was a type of fish prepared in the city of Tantras in the Vast . Those who didn ' t enjoy it disparaged it as silvermuck . The fish were caught locally , then spiced and pickled . They were barreled in Tantras then exported across Faerûn , as one of the city ' s major products .

title: Tantras
description: Tantras Tantras was a city on the east coast of the Dragon Reach between Calaunt and Ravens Bluff . Etymology & Language . People and things from Tantras were called " Tantran " or " Tantrasan " .
description_long: Tantras Tantras was a city on the east coast of the Dragon Reach between Calaunt and Ravens Bluff . Etymology & Language . People and things from Tantras were called " Tantran " or " Tantrasan " . Its people spoke the Tantran dialect of the Easting language , which was related to the Damaran language . History . During the Vast ' s so - called Time of Glorious Fools ( from 649 DR onwards ) , Tantras was among those harbors that served as landing spots for immigrants and rest stops for pirates . These harbors were developed as trade ports for the trading vessels came from Aglarond , Impiltur , Sembia , and Westgate . Eventually , noble merchant families became established in Tantras , and they led the city for at least four generations by the mid – 14th century DR . In the Year of the Creeping Fang , 1305 DR , Thilana , the leader of the pirates of the Dragonisle , visited Tantras to check in on her extensive network of informants and spies . However , she was strangled to death one night by Laershala of the Emerald Eyes , one of her own pirate captains , who then seized control of the pirate fleet .

title: Tantras Trail
description: Tantras Trail The Tantras Trail , also called the Lion ' s Walk , was a trail that ran through the Vast , connecting the city of Tantras and the village of Highbank Forest . From west to east , it began at Tantras , ran through Orlimmin , and ended at Highbank Forest . On the way , it linked with the Cross Road , Coast Road , the Long Reach , and Feldar ' s Trail .
description_long: Tantras Trail The Tantras Trail , also called the Lion ' s Walk , was a trail that ran through the Vast , connecting the city of Tantras and the village of Highbank Forest . From west to east , it began at Tantras , ran through Orlimmin , and ended at Highbank Forest . On the way , it linked with the Cross Road , Coast Road , the Long Reach , and Feldar ' s Trail .

title: Tantuss Shieldsun
description: Tantuss Shieldsun Tantuss Shieldsun was an adventurer and guide who operated in the North . Description . Tantuss was a notably tall man , his face framed with black hair and a bushy beard .
description_long: Tantuss Shieldsun Tantuss Shieldsun was an adventurer and guide who operated in the North . Description . Tantuss was a notably tall man , his face framed with black hair and a bushy beard . Personality . While known to be shy around women , Tantuss was particularly bashful around priestesses of his own faith . He regularly bowed more often than necessary in order to hide his blushing cheeks . Relationships . While also an active Harper , Tantuss was known to tutor fellow ranger s for a nominal fee . He always donated what he did not need to live to the Church of Mielikki .

title: Tanya bint Perijan
description: Tanya bint Perijan Tanya bint Perijan was one of Grand Caliph Khalil al - Assad al - Zahir ' s favorite wives . Her dowry for her engagement to the Grand Caliph was a staggering 500 , 000 " dinar s " , instantly propelling her family to prominent status among the elite of Huzuz . Description .
description_long: Tanya bint Perijan Tanya bint Perijan was one of Grand Caliph Khalil al - Assad al - Zahir ' s favorite wives . Her dowry for her engagement to the Grand Caliph was a staggering 500 , 000 " dinar s " , instantly propelling her family to prominent status among the elite of Huzuz . Description . Still in her early 20s , Tanya was young and stunningly beautiful . She had rich sable hair and dark eyes that she accented further with kohl . Her favorite color was yellow , and she often wore garments and gold jewelry of this color . Her hands and feet were dyed with henna . Personality . Tanya was an opportunist and constantly thirsted for power , though she remained devoted to her husband . Possessions . Tanya had only but to ask to receive just about anything one could imagine , but she was known to always have in her possession a " ring of protection + 3 " , a " ring of invisibility " , a " scarab of deception " , a " dagger + 2 " , " oil of attractiveness " , and a " philter of love " . Activities . As Khalil ' s favored wife , Tanya ruled the other wives and concubines of the Royal Harim through friendship , bribery , or blackmail . Relationships .

title: Tanyl Evanara
description: Tanyl Evanara Tanyl Evanara was an elven chief war wizard of the Tower of the Sun on Evermeet . Description . Tanyl was tall and thin even by elven standards .
description_long: Tanyl Evanara Tanyl Evanara was an elven chief war wizard of the Tower of the Sun on Evermeet . Description . Tanyl was tall and thin even by elven standards . Personality . Dedicated to the defense of the island , Tanyl specialized in the development of new spells particularly of a military nature . Possessions . In battle , Tanyl wore enchanted mail and a helmet in the shape of a dragon . He wielded the sword " Tanduras " which had the ability to steal life from evil creatures and wore a " ring of spell turning " .

title: Tapann
description: Tapann Tapann was the patron deity of korred s . His symbol was a laughing mouth . Description .
description_long: Tapann Tapann was the patron deity of korred s . His symbol was a laughing mouth . Description . Tapann appeared as a six - foot - tall male korred , carrying a cudgel . He wore a rough tunic made from the hide of a bear or owlbear and a belt with pouches containing his own hair , a pair of silver shears , and vials of holy water . Relationships . Tapann was said in some myths to have fathered the goddess Shiallia , thanks to a brief dalliance with the dwarven goddess Sharindlar . Tapann brought dead korreds of unusual bravery to Limbo with him to be his personal servants . Some of this servants were named Jambul , Hrressek , Tishlun , and Bresk . All korreds obeyed Tapann or his servants without question . Realm . Tapann ' s realm on the plane of Limbo was a hill studded with standing stones . However , he spent most of his time on the Prime Material Plane . Worshipers . Tapann was worshiped by korreds . Tapann had no shamans or clerics , and did not grant spells to his followers . Rituals and holy days .

title: Tapestry of folded existence
description: Tapestry of folded existence Tapestries of folded existence were magical item s that could be found in Zakhara , the Land of Fate . They were only carried or used by holy slayer s . Description .
description_long: Tapestry of folded existence Tapestries of folded existence were magical item s that could be found in Zakhara , the Land of Fate . They were only carried or used by holy slayer s . Description . These tapestries always depicted an interior space . The threads of these tapestries depicted detailed accounts of everything brought into the room . They typically measured 6 feet by 10 feet ( 1 . 8 by 3 . 0 meters ) and were of the highest quality . These tapestries were heavy , requiring two people to carry . Powers . When hung on a wall or placed on the floor , the owner of one of these tapestries spoke a command word and was instantly transported to the room depicted on the thread . These items were perfect for use as treasuries , armories , and even prisons . Living creatures stored in these magical rooms did not require sustenance . Tapestries of folded existence were items of concealed wizardry , and " detect magic " spell s did not reveal their enchantment .

title: Tapeyzin
description: Tapeyzin Chief Tapeyzin was the founder of the Maztica n city of Michaca . He recognized that the abundance of gold in the area was causing men to become greedy and try to obtain personal wealth , and instead decided to use the gold to build a city that would serve as a tribute to the .
