He recognized that the abundance of gold in the area was causing men to become greedy and try to obtain personal wealth , and instead decided to use the gold to build a city that would serve as a tribute to the .

title: Tappeng
description: Tappeng Tappeng was a chieftain in Bawa in 1357 DR . Activities . Tappeng was the chieftain of the Kabundusil tribe , one of the most savage Bawani tribes .
description_long: Tappeng Tappeng was a chieftain in Bawa in 1357 DR . Activities . Tappeng was the chieftain of the Kabundusil tribe , one of the most savage Bawani tribes . Other tribes lived in fear of those times when Tappeng led a party on a headhunting raid or decided to pillage others ' rice fields and burn their dwellings . Tappeng was greatly concerned about the Bavanese and despised the subtle merchants who in his eyes truly ran the civilized kingdom . He promoted inter - tribal fighting because he believed it necessary to keep fit .

title: Tappy Foamstrap
description: Tappy Foamstrap Tappy Foamstrap was an innkeeper in Blingdenstone during the Rage of Demons . Personality . Tappy was very bored because nothing ever seemed to happen in his inn .
description_long: Tappy Foamstrap Tappy Foamstrap was an innkeeper in Blingdenstone during the Rage of Demons . Personality . Tappy was very bored because nothing ever seemed to happen in his inn . If new foreign guests arrived , he was very keen to serve them well . History . Tappy went to the reclaimed Blingdenstone and reopened the Foaming Mug inn , notorious in the days before the drow invasion of 1371 DR . However , during the Rage of Demons , because the city was not yet established ( and because of the arrival of the demon lord s ) , he had very few customers , and even spent months without seeing anyone .

title: Tar ' Ael Veluuthra
description: Tar ' Ael Veluuthra Tar ’ Ael Veluuthra , or Whetstone of the Blade or Whetstone of the Victorious Blade , was a spellbook containing some spell s designed for members of the Eldreth Veluuthra and also allowed crafting " humanbane " arrows for those with normally insufficient skill . Description . The entire book had a bend that looked as though it could and was carried around in a scroll tube .
description_long: Tar ' Ael Veluuthra Tar ’ Ael Veluuthra , or Whetstone of the Blade or Whetstone of the Victorious Blade , was a spellbook containing some spell s designed for members of the Eldreth Veluuthra and also allowed crafting " humanbane " arrows for those with normally insufficient skill . Description . The entire book had a bend that looked as though it could and was carried around in a scroll tube . The book ’ s cover was made from a single silverbark tree leaf folded in half along its central vine . The front cover spelled its name . The pages were made from beaten plant mush and were sewn together with vine . The book was written in delicate elven letters and started with the sentence : " May we drive the cursed vermin from our blessed land , may they despoil it no longer with their sweat , axes , and blood . " Contents . The book contained spells , that helped the spellcaster to navigate , spy , hide and relay information , namely : While the content was certainly useful , the book ’ s true value didn ’ t lie in the spells it contained but in its back cover . A spellcaster gained the ability to craft " humanbane arrows " after following through the following steps : 1 .

title: Tar Hurara
description: Tar Hurara Tar Hurara was a human fighter and the leader of the town of Priapurl on the Dragon Coast in 1372 DR . History . Hurara was descended from bandits but she sought to reach true nobility .
description_long: Tar Hurara Tar Hurara was a human fighter and the leader of the town of Priapurl on the Dragon Coast in 1372 DR . History . Hurara was descended from bandits but she sought to reach true nobility . She was known as a wastrel and spent most of her time at the court of Cormyr rather than in Priapurl .

title: Tara ' a
description: Tara ' a Tara ' a was a tasked artist genie working within the Palace of the Enlightened Throne in Huzuz , the City of Delights , in 1367 DR . Activities . Tara ' s artistic specialization revolved around cooking .
description_long: Tara ' a Tara ' a was a tasked artist genie working within the Palace of the Enlightened Throne in Huzuz , the City of Delights , in 1367 DR . Activities . Tara ' s artistic specialization revolved around cooking . She prepared many fine meals for the residents of the Royal Harim , including the Grand Caliph .

title: Tara el Viilam
description: Tara el Viilam Tara yr Meriel el Viilam , who became known as Tara of the Burning Mists , was the creator of the Bottlemist Plague , which killed thousands of people in Almraiven in the Year of the Tankard ( 1370 DR ) . Several other acts of terrorism were afterward attributed to her as well . Relationships .
description_long: Tara el Viilam Tara yr Meriel el Viilam , who became known as Tara of the Burning Mists , was the creator of the Bottlemist Plague , which killed thousands of people in Almraiven in the Year of the Tankard ( 1370 DR ) . Several other acts of terrorism were afterward attributed to her as well . Relationships . Tara was the second daughter of the " Veiled Caleph " of Almraiven , Lady Meriel yr Zahyra el Viilam , who ruled the Guild Arcane of Almraiven and its School of the Arcane Hands . History . Tara created the plague in the first month of 1370 in an attempt to assassinate the syl - pasha and his court when he visited her city the following month . Then , she hoped , Calimshan would be ruled by a magocracy again . Unfortunately , the plague was unleashed earlier than expected , and the city was crippled . An investigation by a cleric of Ilmater discovered that Tara was the one responsible , and he was found murdered soon after he revealed this information . Tara then fled the School of the Arcane Hands and became a fugitive , triggering a country - wide search . By the end of the year , she had still not been found . Rumors .

title: Taradril Aumraven
description: Taradril Aumraven Taradril Aumraven was a member of the Zhentarim in Darkhold in the Year of the Tankard , 1370 DR and a former Lord of Zhentil Keep . Personality . Taradril had a mercantile view of the Zhentarim and for this he supported Sememmon as the main Zhentarim leader .
description_long: Taradril Aumraven Taradril Aumraven was a member of the Zhentarim in Darkhold in the Year of the Tankard , 1370 DR and a former Lord of Zhentil Keep . Personality . Taradril had a mercantile view of the Zhentarim and for this he supported Sememmon as the main Zhentarim leader . He viewed Sememmon as a more stable and capable leader than Manshoon , whom Taradril thought too involved in secrets to have real perception of the liking of the Zhentish people . History . Taradril was a merchant wizard in Zhentil Keep and , thanks to his power , gained a seat on the Council of Lords . He often opposed Manshoon ' s proposal in the Council and tried to did the best for all Zhentil but Aumraven was sometimes double - crossed by Manshoon , as about the rebuilding of Citadel of the Raven . During the destruction of Zhentil Keep by Cyric ' s horde in 1368 DR , only the timely assistance of Sememmon saved Taradril ' s life . He was tasked with rebuilding the Zhentarim mercantile trade through Darkhold . For this , Taradril often clandestinely collaborated with Lady Alicia of the Citadel of the Raven for control the caravan trade in the Anauroch .

title: Tarag
description: Tarag Tarag was a merrow chieftain of Serôs in the 6th century DR . History . Tarag somehow came into the possession of the sword " Ilbratha " , the legendary lost sword of King Azoun I of Cormyr .
description_long: Tarag Tarag was a merrow chieftain of Serôs in the 6th century DR . History . Tarag somehow came into the possession of the sword " Ilbratha " , the legendary lost sword of King Azoun I of Cormyr . As a chieftain of the sea ogre s , Tarag used the powers of the sword and his own battle strategies to conquer the western frontiers of the merfolk realm of Hmurrath . There , in the Year of the Deep Wound , 582 DR , Tarag founded the two Axe Kingdoms of Khuur and Nmalk . " Ilbratha " remained among the merrow for seventy - three years .

title: Taragarth
description: Taragarth Taragarth , nicknamed the Bloodbrand , was a unique magic bastard sword or short sword . Description . The blade of " Taragarth " appeared as if it had been tarnished by fire , save for along its edges , which gleamed .
description_long: Taragarth Taragarth , nicknamed the Bloodbrand , was a unique magic bastard sword or short sword . Description . The blade of " Taragarth " appeared as if it had been tarnished by fire , save for along its edges , which gleamed . Just above the crossguard , a rune was etched into the metal of the blade — this was the maker ' s mark . Powers . Even if the blade was sheathed , the bearer of " Taragarth " would be protected from extrasensory perception and all detection spells . Once drawn , the bearer would also be protected from flames as if they were wearing a " ring of fire resistance " and if they were to fall more than ten feet , they would be affected by a feather fall spell . The sword had a knack for cutting through foes , allowing a wide swing to affect multiple surrounding opponents . History . Legend had it that " Taragarth " was forged by Elfgar of Silverymoon , who gave it to Aeroth . Aeroth wielded it against the troll s of the Evermoors during the Long Battle against them and earned it its nickname of " the Bloodbrand " .

title: Taraj Hurlymm
description: Taraj Hurlymm Taraj Hurlymm was a male wizard who was one of the magelord s of Athalantar and was killed by Elminster Aumar . Activities . Taraj ' s hobby was taking beast - shape and stalking men and women as if they were prey .
description_long: Taraj Hurlymm Taraj Hurlymm was a male wizard who was one of the magelord s of Athalantar and was killed by Elminster Aumar . Activities . Taraj ' s hobby was taking beast - shape and stalking men and women as if they were prey . History . He took over governance of outlying Dalniir for the magelords , pressing the elves . Thus they asked Elminster to kill Taraj . However , Taraj summoned his fellow magelord Kadeln Olothstar was eventually slain by Elminster .

title: Tarana Lyr
description: Tarana Lyr Tarana Lyr was a female human sorceress and a worshiper of Bane before and during the Time of Troubles in 1358 DR . History . Tarana was a crazy sorceress in the service of Bane during the god ' s assault on Tantras .
description_long: Tarana Lyr Tarana Lyr was a female human sorceress and a worshiper of Bane before and during the Time of Troubles in 1358 DR . History . Tarana was a crazy sorceress in the service of Bane during the god ' s assault on Tantras . Personality . The power of sorcery had long ago driven Tarana mad . She enjoyed the unpredictability of magic during the Time of Troubles and the sensation of playing with death .

title: Tarandor Delhame
description: Tarandor Delhame Tarandor Delhame was a powerful mage living in Iriaebor as of 1479 DR . He was the former apprentice of the apprentice of the arch mage Merithius who trapped Jack Ravenwild in the mythal beneath Ravens Bluff in 1367 DR . In 1479 DR the High House of Magic learned that Jack had escaped his confinement in the mythal and notified Tarandor who was obligated to his master to recapture Jack .
description_long: Tarandor Delhame Tarandor Delhame was a powerful mage living in Iriaebor as of 1479 DR . He was the former apprentice of the apprentice of the arch mage Merithius who trapped Jack Ravenwild in the mythal beneath Ravens Bluff in 1367 DR . In 1479 DR the High House of Magic learned that Jack had escaped his confinement in the mythal and notified Tarandor who was obligated to his master to recapture Jack . Tarandor tricked Jack into meeting him at a warehouse where he shrunk Jack and placed him into a bottle for easy transport to the mythal . Jack , however , was able to use a spell from the Sarkenaegal to escape his confinement . Later , Jack tricked Tarandor into purchasing a shadow simulacrum of Jack for 2 , 000 gold pieces . Thinking he had the real Jack , Tarandor imprisoned the simulacrum in the mythal stone .

title: Tarangu
description: Tarangu The Tarangu was a tribe of halfling s who inhabited an area of Jazayir al - Sartan in southwest Zakhara . Organization . The Tarangu did not build permanent structures on the ground .
description_long: Tarangu The Tarangu was a tribe of halfling s who inhabited an area of Jazayir al - Sartan in southwest Zakhara . Organization . The Tarangu did not build permanent structures on the ground . Instead they lived in special nests constructed in palm trees . Ropes hung between nests so the halflings could get around without touching the ground . Activities . These war - like halfings were rumored to be cannibalistic . Slavers often targeted the halflings since they did not follow the path of Enlightenment . Base of Operations . The Tarangu tribe inhabited the northern chain of Jazayir al - Alfar . Possessions . These people were semi - nomadic and only carried what they needed to travel between the islands . Members . The Tarangu were ruled by a halfling named Indeema , who was an obese matron . She was a priest of Kar ' r ' rga and supervised all sacrifices made to the savage god .

title: Tarask
description: Tarask Tarask was a fighter in Phlan in 1340 DR . History . Tarask had been in the service of Cadorna House since his youth .
description_long: Tarask Tarask was a fighter in Phlan in 1340 DR . History . Tarask had been in the service of Cadorna House since his youth . In 1340 DR , under the orders of Porphyrys Cadorna , he hired an adventuring party to clear monsters from the Cadorna Textile House . Tarask ' s true mission was to find the secret treasure hidden inside .

title: Tarathiel
description: Tarathiel Tarathiel was a moon elf from Moonvines in the Moonwood . Physical description . Tarathiel was not tall , and had an angular face with rich blue eyes and very pale skin .
description_long: Tarathiel Tarathiel was a moon elf from Moonvines in the Moonwood . Physical description . Tarathiel was not tall , and had an angular face with rich blue eyes and very pale skin . Like many moon elves , he had black hair . Equipment . In ranged combat , Tarathiel used the type of bow known as a longbow . In close combat , he used a slender sword , as well as a dirk . History . In 1357 DR , Tarathiel guided Drizzt from the Moonwood to Mooshie ' s Grove after the drow met the grown - up Ellifain . He then left Drizzt in front of cave from which the drow originally emerged from the Underdark . A few years prior to 1370 DR , Tarathiel rescued a pair of pegasi , Sunrise and Sunset , as foals from the Spine of the World after they were attacked by giant s and the rest of their group , including their mother , were killed . Years later , Tarathiel and his lover Innovindil left the Moonwood to search for Ellifain , an elf of their clan who wanted to kill Drizzt Do ' Urden . They followed Ellifain to the city of Luskan , where her trail went cold . In 1371 DR , Tarathiel was sliced in half by the orc king , Obould Many - Arrows .

title: Taraz
description: Taraz Taraz the Fair was an efreeti trapped in Xonthal ' s Tower by the wizard Xonthal circa 1380 DR . History . Xonthal disappeared and Taraz remained trapped in the tower .
description_long: Taraz Taraz the Fair was an efreeti trapped in Xonthal ' s Tower by the wizard Xonthal circa 1380 DR . History . Xonthal disappeared and Taraz remained trapped in the tower . Activities . During the Tyranny of Dragons , he tried to trick an adventurer ' s band that infiltrated the tower into free him .

title: Tarbaw Nighthill
description: Tarbaw Nighthill Tarbaw Nighthill was a human and the governor of the small town of Greenest , located in the Western Heartlands of west Faerûn . Description . Tarbaw was a noble , some sixty - odd winters old who usually dressed in a blue tunic .
description_long: Tarbaw Nighthill Tarbaw Nighthill was a human and the governor of the small town of Greenest , located in the Western Heartlands of west Faerûn . Description . Tarbaw was a noble , some sixty - odd winters old who usually dressed in a blue tunic . He had brown hair and a short beard . History . Around 1489 DR during a battle with the blue adult Lennithon and the Cult of the Dragon , Tarbaw was wounded but stayed in command in the keep with the Castellan Escobert the Red .

title: Tarchamus ' volcano
description: Tarchamus ' volcano Tarchamus ' volcano was an extremely powerful spell created by the legendary Netherese arcanist Tarchamus . The spell harnessed the power of Phlegethos to create a volcano capable of destroying cities . In approximately - 3500 DR , Tarchamus used the spell to destroy the floating Netherese city of Tenish .
description_long: Tarchamus ' volcano Tarchamus ' volcano was an extremely powerful spell created by the legendary Netherese arcanist Tarchamus . The spell harnessed the power of Phlegethos to create a volcano capable of destroying cities . In approximately - 3500 DR , Tarchamus used the spell to destroy the floating Netherese city of Tenish . The " Mavin ' s create volcano " spell may have been an attempt to recreate Tarchamus ' spell , although the two spells functioned differently . In 1478 DR , a group of adventurers including the tiefling Farideh and her sister Havilar used the spell to destroy Tarchamus ' s secret library . Whether or not the scroll containing the spell survived the cataclysm was unknown . Spell Level . The exact level and power of the spell were unknown . Given the spell ' s incredible power and the fact that many powerful Netherese arcanists spent years searching for the spell it was probable the spell was 10th level . However , with the fall of Karsus , Mystral revoked human access to 10th - level magic .

title: Tarchamus the Unyielding
description: Tarchamus the Unyielding Tarchamus the Unyielding was a legendary Netherese arcanist who lived approximately 5 , 000 years before 1478 DR . Tarchamus was so powerful he was able to directly harness the power of other planes to rain destruction on his enemies . History .
description_long: Tarchamus the Unyielding Tarchamus the Unyielding was a legendary Netherese arcanist who lived approximately 5 , 000 years before 1478 DR . Tarchamus was so powerful he was able to directly harness the power of other planes to rain destruction on his enemies . History . He didn ' t particularly care much for his fellow arcanists and frequently argued with them . One feud with the arcanist Arion grew so vicious that Tarchamus created a spell that opened a gate to Phlegethos to create a volcano that destroyed the floating city of Tenish . After the destruction of Tenish , the most powerful arcanists led by Tarchamus ' friend Emrys banded together and found a way to block Tarchamus ' access to the Weave . After his magical powers were revoked , Tarchamus built a huge library inside a mountain . Since he was unable to access the Weave , he was unable to achieve lichdom but was somehow able to transform himself into an extremely powerful mummy with the help of his apprentices . He was also able to transfer most of his consciousness into a magical book , the Book of Tarchamus .

title: Tardeth Llanistaph
description: Tardeth Llanistaph Lord Tardeth Llanistaph was Duke of Suretmarch , just chancellor of Tethyr , and one of the original members and a leader of the Company of Eight . He was greatly respected as a national hero across most of Tethyr . Description .
description_long: Tardeth Llanistaph Lord Tardeth Llanistaph was Duke of Suretmarch , just chancellor of Tethyr , and one of the original members and a leader of the Company of Eight . He was greatly respected as a national hero across most of Tethyr . Description . Tardeth was considered a handsome man , tall , with broad shoulders . He preferred to wear leathers , but if he knew that combat was evident , he would gear up in chainmail instead . Abilities . Tardeth specialized in the longsword and was also proficient in the use of the dagger , light crossbow , longbow , and spear . As a ranger he was dedicated to the tracking and pursuit of giant s and knew a great deal about animals and weather . Relationships . Tardeth had good relationships with all members of the Company of Eight and expected great things from Manfred Arbustle , who had been the youngest member . He considered all of them as his own family . Tardeth had an older brother named Alain , and they had adventured together , but the latter was killed early in the lifetime of the Company of Eight . Personality . Tardeth was honorable and just .

title: Tareen Kafour
description: Tareen Kafour Tareen Kafour ( pronounced " tuh - REEN KAY - fur " ) was a barkeeper in Mulmaster . History . Originally from Phlan , Tareen was forced to escape to Mulmaster after Vorgansharax ' s coup .
description_long: Tareen Kafour Tareen Kafour ( pronounced " tuh - REEN KAY - fur " ) was a barkeeper in Mulmaster . History . Originally from Phlan , Tareen was forced to escape to Mulmaster after Vorgansharax ' s coup . forced her to escape to , where she opened a pub , the . Around 1491 DR , Tareen ' s pub , the Hammer - Felled Tree , was a recruitment center for the army of Aleyd Burral . Personality . Tareen totally approved of the Liberators cause but knew nothing about the earth cultists inside it .

title: Tarek Wingspur
description: Tarek Wingspur Tarek is a wizard currently living in Zhentil Keep ( 1374 ) . He is a known shadow weave user . History .
description_long: Tarek Wingspur Tarek is a wizard currently living in Zhentil Keep ( 1374 ) . He is a known shadow weave user . History . Not much is known about the wizard known as Tarek Wingspur . The first bit of recorded history with his name appears in 1360 DR in a journal for the annual Mage Fair . At this mage fair , it was noted that a ' mysterious off - worlder demonstrated several necromantic spells and took second place in the category of Most Original New Divination ' . Tarek ' s fame grew from that point , but his origins remain shrouded in mystery . In 1369 , Tarek was part of an adventuring group who traveled to the Abyss in order to thwart the plans of the Demon Lord Baphomet .

title: Targ Keifer
description: Targ Keifer Targ Keifer was the chieftain of the Griffon Tribe in the 15th century DR . History . In 1484 DR , Targ discussed an alliance with Giselle Malcomb of Nesme , sensing the coming of the War of the Silver Marches .
description_long: Targ Keifer Targ Keifer was the chieftain of the Griffon Tribe in the 15th century DR . History . In 1484 DR , Targ discussed an alliance with Giselle Malcomb of Nesme , sensing the coming of the War of the Silver Marches . Later in the war , he met the Companions of the Hall and helped them .

title: Targaraene
description: Targaraene Targaraene is Scyllua Darkhope ' s nightmare , a fiendish servant that serves as her mount . Appearance . Targaraene looks like a large , powerful horse with a pale white coat .
description_long: Targaraene Targaraene is Scyllua Darkhope ' s nightmare , a fiendish servant that serves as her mount . Appearance . Targaraene looks like a large , powerful horse with a pale white coat . Flames wreathe its hooves and flare from its nostrils . Targaraene is stronger and heartier than an average Nightmare .

title: Targos
description: Targos Targos was the second - largest city of the Ten Towns of Icewind Dale . Geography . The city sits on the southernmost shore of the Maer Dualdon along a series of high cliff walls that shelter its port from the savage winter winds .
description_long: Targos Targos was the second - largest city of the Ten Towns of Icewind Dale . Geography . The city sits on the southernmost shore of the Maer Dualdon along a series of high cliff walls that shelter its port from the savage winter winds . The harbor ' s deep water allow the construction of vessels which were large for the area , and the sheltering cliffs permit construction to continue through much of the year . As a result the town isamongst the top towns of the region for dominance of the knucklehead trout industry . The city itself , and much of the harbor , is surrounded by a city wall . History . Ca . 1351 DR , the councilman of Targos was Kemp , who protected the town from a barbarian invasion in 1351 DR and the magical light beam sent by Akar Kessell in 1356 DR . Kemp was distrustful of outsiders and guarded his town ' s interests greedily . Trade . Like most of the Ten Towns , Targos specializes in trading knucklehead trout . Its hundred - boat fleet takes in a larger catch than the other three towns on Maer Dualdon combined . Notable locations .

title: Targrael
description: Targrael Targrael was a former High Knight of Cormyr who later became a death knight . In 1479 DR , Manshoon dominated her mind and compelled her to place the kingdom ' s two highest ranking war wizards into magical stasis and hide them in a crypt beneath the palace . She broke free of Manshoon ' s mind control and set about to protect Cormyr according to her own warped code of honor .
description_long: Targrael Targrael was a former High Knight of Cormyr who later became a death knight . In 1479 DR , Manshoon dominated her mind and compelled her to place the kingdom ' s two highest ranking war wizards into magical stasis and hide them in a crypt beneath the palace . She broke free of Manshoon ' s mind control and set about to protect Cormyr according to her own warped code of honor . Targrael fought Alusair ' s ghost and was defeated but not destroyed . She crawled deep into the haunted wing of the palace and used a blueflame relic to heal herself . Appearance . Targrael had white skin and sliver - white hair . She had a patch of mold growing on her face which didn ' t seem to bother her .

title: Tarik al Farid al Fuqani
description: Tarik al Farid al Fuqani Tarik al Farid al Fuqani was a Tethyr ian human from Myratma . Appearance . Tarik had dusky skin and straight jet - black hair in a short pony tail .
description_long: Tarik al Farid al Fuqani Tarik al Farid al Fuqani was a Tethyr ian human from Myratma . Appearance . Tarik had dusky skin and straight jet - black hair in a short pony tail . He had cobalt blue eyes . Relatives . Tarik ' s brother was Chaid al Farid al Fuqani . Personality . Tarik was very excitable and talkative , but also defiant and haughty . Background . Tarik resided at the Blackstaff Tower in Waterdeep from a young age . On 28 Uktar 1374 DR , when a nishruu attacked Blackstaff Tower , Tarik and his brother used floating disks to dump salt on it and defeat it . They had become familiar with nishruu from hearing bedtime stories .

title: Tarkas Thallavv
description: Tarkas Thallavv Tarkas Thallavv was the Gemayor of Keczulla in Amn in 1362 DR and secretly a Cowled Wizard . History . Tarkas once was an administrator for the Vinson family , but while their influence dwindled , Tarkas ' s powers grew .
description_long: Tarkas Thallavv Tarkas Thallavv was the Gemayor of Keczulla in Amn in 1362 DR and secretly a Cowled Wizard . History . Tarkas once was an administrator for the Vinson family , but while their influence dwindled , Tarkas ' s powers grew . In 1347 DR , he was the ruler of the city of the Keczulla , which he helped to grow with the aid of the Tanislove family . A decisive gain for the city were Pulth Tanislove ' s gem mines , discovered in 1355 DR .

title: Tarkhaldale
description: Tarkhaldale Tarkhaldale was considered one of the dales in the Dalelands , despite being located between Anauroch and the Dalelands . It was generally unmarked on maps , but was located west of Shadowdale . History .
description_long: Tarkhaldale Tarkhaldale was considered one of the dales in the Dalelands , despite being located between Anauroch and the Dalelands . It was generally unmarked on maps , but was located west of Shadowdale . History . In ancient times Tarkaldale flourished as a farming and mining community . When the Anauroch desert spread the region was abandoned to orc and goblin tribes . In 1360 DR a group of saurial s escaped from their imprisonment by the god Moander and made their home in the dale . Later the Netherese drove the saurials away and took over the dale .

title: Tarkos Ree
description: Tarkos Ree Tarkos Ree was a crime lord in Damara in 1359 DR . Activities . Tarkos was the head of the Tightpurse thieves guild , being probably the most powerful being in Heliogabalus .
description_long: Tarkos Ree Tarkos Ree was a crime lord in Damara in 1359 DR . Activities . Tarkos was the head of the Tightpurse thieves guild , being probably the most powerful being in Heliogabalus . He killed all people that crossed his way or guild ' s members that no followed Tarkos ' instructions . However he truly protected the city ' s merchants from unaffiliated thieves . Tarkos also truly protected from the shadows Dimian . Personality . Tarkos believed in logic , being purely pragmatical . He had decided to support his cousin ' s claim to the throne because the guild greatly expanded it sphere of influence in that case . Relationships . Tarkos was cousin of Dimian Ree , baron of Morov .

title: Tarl Desanea
description: Tarl Desanea Tarl Desanea was a blind , retired adventurer who lived in the city of Phlan with his wife Shal Desanea . History . Tarl was a cleric of Tyr from Vaasa who began his training in his order when he and his fellow brethren were tasked with transporting the Hammer of Tyr .
description_long: Tarl Desanea Tarl Desanea was a blind , retired adventurer who lived in the city of Phlan with his wife Shal Desanea . History . Tarl was a cleric of Tyr from Vaasa who began his training in his order when he and his fellow brethren were tasked with transporting the Hammer of Tyr . During a battle with undead , Tyr instinctively called the Hammer of Tyr to his hand while battling vampire s . Although he was forced to give the hammer over to the Master Vampire to save his friends , Tarl would later adventure with Ren o ' the Blade and Shal Bal to retrieve the holy relic , which was being subverted by the Master Vampire ' s evil . Soon afterwards , he married Shal . Ten years later , Tarl was among the defenders of Phlan when Bane transported the city to an underground cavern in order to subvert it . With Shal , Ren , and those accompanying Ren at the time , Tarl destroyed the Pool of Darkness empowering Phlan ' s captors by throwing the Hammer of Tyr into the pool . However , due to Bane ' s machinations , Tarl was unable to reclaim the artifact . It was during this that Tarl ' s son was born .

title: Tarmalune
description: Tarmalune The largest of the Windrise Ports , Tarmalune was a huge , cosmopolitan port city located in the southeastern shores of Returned Abeir , considered by its inhabitants to be the rival of Faerûn ian Waterdeep in wealth , tolerant outlook , entrepreneurial spirit , the ambition of its residents , and the sheer number of constantly unfolding opportunities that presented to the inhabitants of the city . The city bustled with activity and its streets were crowded day and night with merchants , traders , adventurers , nobles and commoners alike . History .
description_long: Tarmalune The largest of the Windrise Ports , Tarmalune was a huge , cosmopolitan port city located in the southeastern shores of Returned Abeir , considered by its inhabitants to be the rival of Faerûn ian Waterdeep in wealth , tolerant outlook , entrepreneurial spirit , the ambition of its residents , and the sheer number of constantly unfolding opportunities that presented to the inhabitants of the city . The city bustled with activity and its streets were crowded day and night with merchants , traders , adventurers , nobles and commoners alike . History . Tarmalune was originally named Tarmhaven , and like the other Windrise Ports , was part of the domains of the Dawn Titan Achazar . Eventually , however , Achazar fell into a deep sleep and the slaves declared themselves free . Dragon s shunned Tarmhaven out of fear of Achazar , who sleep in the form of giant pillar of fire amid the city , allowing Tarmhaven to grow in wealth and influence across Abeir . In time the city became known as Tarmalune Great Port , and later just as Tarmalune .

title: Tarman
description: Tarman Tarman the Old was the Emir of Phannaskul during the mid – 14th century DR . Activities . Sadly , Tarman spent most of his time reliving his glory days as a warrior instead of actually administering the city .
description_long: Tarman Tarman the Old was the Emir of Phannaskul during the mid – 14th century DR . Activities . Sadly , Tarman spent most of his time reliving his glory days as a warrior instead of actually administering the city . The various merchant guilds of the city made every important decision in his absence .

title: Tarmas
description: Tarmas Tarmas was a male human wizard of the village of West Harbor on the Sword Coast North in the 1370s DR . Desciption . Tarmas was balding and generally adopted a sour expression .
description_long: Tarmas Tarmas was a male human wizard of the village of West Harbor on the Sword Coast North in the 1370s DR . Desciption . Tarmas was balding and generally adopted a sour expression . He wore robes of dark brown and grey hues . Personality . Misanthropic and quick to deride his neighbours , Tarmas generally kept to himself . Though he maintained a quiet respect for the hardy folk of the Mere of Dead Men . Abilities . An adept wizard , Tarmas had developed a talent with altering the effects of certain spells and could extend their duration or empower them , as needed . Despite his surly demeanour , Tarmas was a capable tutor and had trained a number of apprentices in West Harbor . History . Early Life . Tarmas came to live in West Harbor after the First War of the Shadow , as the city life was unappealing to him . The villagers decided that he needed to train apprentices , so he took Amie Fern and adopted her , since her parents had died in the First War against the King of Shadows . During the Second Shadow War . During the Harvest Fair in 1374 DR , Tarmas planted the three feathers for the Knaves ' Challenge .

title: Tarmas ' home
description: Tarmas ' home Tarmas ' home was one of the houses in the village of West Harbor on the Sword Coast North . It belonged to Tarmas . Location .
description_long: Tarmas ' home Tarmas ' home was one of the houses in the village of West Harbor on the Sword Coast North . It belonged to Tarmas . Location . Located in the center of the village , Tarmas ' home was located between the Starling house and Pierson ' s home . Structure . Like the other houses in West Harbor , Tarmas ' home was wooden . Interior . The building was small . It was composed of a bedroom , a laboratory and a library . History . Tarmas and the Kalach - Cha ' s friend , Amie Fern , lived in this house . When duergar and bladeling s attacked the village in 1374 DR , Tarmas ordered the Kalach - Cha to retrieve some supplies from his house , which would aid them in the battle . The supplies were books , scrolls , potions and a magical mandolin .

title: Tarmel Drouth
description: Tarmel Drouth Tarmel Drouth was the bastard second son of Rancelair Illance of House Illance of Cormyr . His mother , Asla Drouth was a barmaid in the dockside district of Suzail . Personality .
description_long: Tarmel Drouth Tarmel Drouth was the bastard second son of Rancelair Illance of House Illance of Cormyr . His mother , Asla Drouth was a barmaid in the dockside district of Suzail . Personality . Tarmel had a fiery temper and appeared to be at least slightly mentally imbalanced as he enjoyed committing arson . He nursed a strong grudge against his father . History . Tarmel was raised with his legitimate brothers . As a youth , Tarmel engaged in thefts , arsons and brawls and was even rumored to have committed murders . His father , Rancelair soon grew tired of his antics and disowned him , stripping him of the right to use the family name . Penniless and nameless , Tarmel attempted unsuccessfully to burn down the family stables in Suszail . When this failed , he journeyed to Sembia where he lived for months as a bandit in Sembia ' s forests . He accumulated enough gold to purchase weapons and a wagon to conceal them in and he traveled to the Illance summer home at Stag Well in Cormyr . Tarmel attacked his father and the family guards and , although he killed many of the family ' s retainers , his father survived .

title: Tarna Calfi
description: Tarna Calfi Tarna Calfi was an inhabitant of Huzuz , the City of Delights , in 1367 DR . Activities . Tarna was the harbormaster of the Caliph ' s Harbor in Huzuz .
description_long: Tarna Calfi Tarna Calfi was an inhabitant of Huzuz , the City of Delights , in 1367 DR . Activities . Tarna was the harbormaster of the Caliph ' s Harbor in Huzuz . She answered to Keyfa al - Parid . She possessed a rare genius when it came to ship repair . History . Tarna began her career in Huzuz scraping barnacles off of the sides of ships . Through determination and her brilliant repair skills , she rose to serve as harbormaster .

title: Tarnheel Embuirhan
description: Tarnheel Embuirhan Tarnheel Embuirhan was the tyrant of Mintarn and was reputed to be one of the best swordsmen of the Realms . History . Tarnheel was intrigued when the " Sea Sprite " of Captain Deudermont arrived in Mintarn in search of information about the mythical isle of Caerwich because he knew that Drizzt Do ' Urden was onboard .
description_long: Tarnheel Embuirhan Tarnheel Embuirhan was the tyrant of Mintarn and was reputed to be one of the best swordsmen of the Realms . History . Tarnheel was intrigued when the " Sea Sprite " of Captain Deudermont arrived in Mintarn in search of information about the mythical isle of Caerwich because he knew that Drizzt Do ' Urden was onboard . Drizzt was considered by many the best swordsman in the Realms and Tarnheel wanted this title . He thought this was the perfect occasion to decide the matter . Thus Tarnheel sent his ambassador , Dunkin Tallmast , offering goods and information in exchange for a duel between Tarnheel and Drizzt . Drizzt accepted the offer and confronted Tarnheel in a secret fight . Nobody officially knew the result of the duel but when Drizzt later spoke with Catti - brie , he gave clues that he had easily won .

title: Tarnmark Lionmantle
description: Tarnmark Lionmantle Tarnmark Lionmantle was a War Wizard of Cormyr in 1487 DR . History . Tarnmark ' s mission involved spying on Lord Sardasper Halaunt .
description_long: Tarnmark Lionmantle Tarnmark Lionmantle was a War Wizard of Cormyr in 1487 DR . History . Tarnmark ' s mission involved spying on Lord Sardasper Halaunt . He witnessed the magic battle at the Dragon Rampant club between Manshoon , Shaan , and many other archmage s attempting to capture the lord .

title: Tarntar
description: Tarntar The Tarntar were a group of wealthy wizard s and merchants from Sembia that formed an illicit trading association that dabbled in slavery , smuggling , warehouse heists , and kidnapping of noble Sembian children and youths . It is unknown when this highly secretive cabal was formed , but it was known to be operating during the 1360s DR at least . History .
description_long: Tarntar The Tarntar were a group of wealthy wizard s and merchants from Sembia that formed an illicit trading association that dabbled in slavery , smuggling , warehouse heists , and kidnapping of noble Sembian children and youths . It is unknown when this highly secretive cabal was formed , but it was known to be operating during the 1360s DR at least . History . Some prominent members of the Tarntar and their entourage happened to be staying in Voonlar ' s Whistling Wizard inn when the Battle at the Bar broke out in the common room of the establishment . At least three members of the Tarntar lost their lives in the conflict . Members . Individual members of the Tarntar who were identified as being involved in the Battle at the Bar were :

title: Tarntassa
description: Tarntassa Tarntassa was a human woman of the city of Tantras in the Vast . She was a mage and adventurer . Home .
description_long: Tarntassa Tarntassa was a human woman of the city of Tantras in the Vast . She was a mage and adventurer . Home . Tarntassa was based at a tower known as Tarntassa ' s Tower , standing off Sandril ' s Lane in the western side of Tantras . Description . Tarntassa was easily recognized by her tall stature and very long ponytail of bronze - hued hair . History . During the Time of Troubles of 1358 DR , Tarntassa had apparently disappeared . In fact , she ' d travelled to Waterdeep and there became a friend and ally to Khelben Arunsun . She also became a secret ally of the Harpers . Afterward , she returned to Tantras . Relationships . Tarntassa was a friend to the Harpers . Harper agents were welcome at her tower , provided they came quietly under cover of dark .

title: Tarntassa ' s Tower
description: Tarntassa ' s Tower Tarntassa ' s Tower was a mage ' s tower in the city of Tantras in the Vast , standing off Sandril ' s Lane in the western side of the city . It was the home the adventurer - mage Tarntassa . Tarntassa was a friend to the Harpers .
description_long: Tarntassa ' s Tower Tarntassa ' s Tower was a mage ' s tower in the city of Tantras in the Vast , standing off Sandril ' s Lane in the western side of the city . It was the home the adventurer - mage Tarntassa . Tarntassa was a friend to the Harpers . Harper agents were welcome at her tower , provided they came quietly under cover of dark .

title: Taroo
description: Taroo Taroo the Farmhand was a farmer in Twilight Marsh near Phlan in 1489 DR . Personality . Taroo was an honest man .
description_long: Taroo Taroo the Farmhand was a farmer in Twilight Marsh near Phlan in 1489 DR . Personality . Taroo was an honest man . He was concerned with stayed safely employed . He greatly feared the lizardfolk of Twilight Marsh . He could be easily impressed by adventurers . History . In 1487 DR , he was employed at Renon Farm . In 1489 DR , he discovered that Renon had disappeared . With the help of Romsan Kal , he hired some adventurers to investigate the matter .

title: Tarr Burnig
description: Tarr Burnig Lord Tarr Burnig was a member of the Burnig Cormyr ean noble family . Description . Tarr was a large , musclebound man with a bushy red beard .
description_long: Tarr Burnig Lord Tarr Burnig was a member of the Burnig Cormyr ean noble family . Description . Tarr was a large , musclebound man with a bushy red beard . History . Tarr and five other noblemen were part of an informal group who secretly debated the Obarskyr succession and who they should support until they were killed by an unknown assassin in a seedy tavern in Suzail .

title: Tarrasque
description: Tarrasque The tarrasque was the most terrible creature known to inhabit the Prime Material Plane . A full fifty feet tall and seventy feet long quadruped with a long tail , reflective carapace , and two large horns on its head , the tarrasque was created by the primordial s as a weapon of destruction during the Dawn War , with the purpose of undoing the stability instilled in the world by the god s so that the primordials could remake it . Fortunately , the primordials created only one tarrasque , which slumbered within the world ' s core .
description_long: Tarrasque The tarrasque was the most terrible creature known to inhabit the Prime Material Plane . A full fifty feet tall and seventy feet long quadruped with a long tail , reflective carapace , and two large horns on its head , the tarrasque was created by the primordial s as a weapon of destruction during the Dawn War , with the purpose of undoing the stability instilled in the world by the god s so that the primordials could remake it . Fortunately , the primordials created only one tarrasque , which slumbered within the world ' s core . No one could predict when it would next awake . The tarrasque was irreversibly tied to the Prime by its nature . As a result , the most one could hope to do was put the creature to sleep within the core , holding it off for a while longer . However , ancient texts seemed to indicate that there might be a way to finally and ultimately deal with the creature , if one could somehow deceive it , luring it into another plane and sealing it there . Although the tarrasque was indisputably a force of pure destruction , it was not truly evil or even chaotic by nature , lacking the consciousness necessary for it to take a moral stance .

title: Tarsith
description: Tarsith Tarsith was a port city and a member of the confederation of the Dusk Ports in Returned Abeir . It was also one of the most important fishing cities in the region . Geography .
description_long: Tarsith Tarsith was a port city and a member of the confederation of the Dusk Ports in Returned Abeir . It was also one of the most important fishing cities in the region . Geography . Tarsith was located in the Esmur Flats , in the shore of the River Esmur near the mouth were the river flowed to the Dragon Sea . Background . Tarsith was the most calm and peaceful city of the Dusk Ports . However , this situation wasn ' t always the same , and usually the population had to endure hard times when the green dragon Orlarrakh invited a fellow from Melabrauth to eat . Aside from foodstuffs , Tarsith also boasted the finest ropes and sails in all Returned Abeir , although such products were not for sale . Government . Tarsith was ruled by a Tarsandar , a wizard who received his or her scepter from the Green Duchess herself . Economy . Due to its location in the River Esmur , Tarsith was known as the busiest fishing center of Returned Abeir . Most of the eels and clams were consumed locally , but the rock crab s and fish were Tarsith ' s major exports .

title: Tart
description: Tart Tarts were palm - sized pastry shells that were baked in Waterdeep . They were available for sale through " Aurora ' s Whole Realms Catalogue " . Description .
description_long: Tart Tarts were palm - sized pastry shells that were baked in Waterdeep . They were available for sale through " Aurora ' s Whole Realms Catalogue " . Description . The typical shape of a tart was curved at the edges so it could hold sweet or savory fillings such as jam , lemon curd or minced meat . Tarts purchased through " Aurora ' s " were shipped in wooden crates to prevent them from breaking during transport .

title: Tarterus
description: Tarterus Tarterus , also known as Carceri , was an Outer Plane in the Great Wheel cosmology model representing alignments between chaotic evil and neutral evil . Situated between Hades and the Abyss , Tarterus was a plane of contention between the warring demon s and daemon s but few of those interlopers would challenge the native demodand s . The Companions of the Hall entered Tarterus by means of the Taros Hoop in " The Halfling ' s Gem " .
description_long: Tarterus Tarterus , also known as Carceri , was an Outer Plane in the Great Wheel cosmology model representing alignments between chaotic evil and neutral evil . Situated between Hades and the Abyss , Tarterus was a plane of contention between the warring demon s and daemon s but few of those interlopers would challenge the native demodand s . The Companions of the Hall entered Tarterus by means of the Taros Hoop in " The Halfling ' s Gem " . Description . The six layers of Tarterus had a seemingly infinite number of worlds arranged like a string of pearls stretching into the air - filled void . In the top layer , Othrys , each orb was about the size of a Prime Material world and averaged about a hundred miles ( 160 km ) apart . In each successive lower layer the planetoids grew smaller and farther apart . There was no sun but the soil of each orb gave off heat and a dull reddish glow , similar to the phosphorescence of fire beetle s . The planets did not rotate and there was no day or night unless a greater deity wished it so in their realm .

title: Tartha
description: Tartha Tartha was a fire giant duchess sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . History . Tartha was one of the giant lords at the time of the shattering of the ordning .
description_long: Tartha Tartha was a fire giant duchess sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . History . Tartha was one of the giant lords at the time of the shattering of the ordning . In the late 1480s or early 1490s DR , Tartha was one of the giant lords who arrived in the Maelstrom citadel in search of news about Princess Serissa ' s plans for the future . Personality . Tartha hated dragon s above all .

title: Tarul Var
description: Tarul Var Tarul Var was a lich necromancer and Red Wizard of Thay in Daggerford in 1486 DR . History . Tarul was tasked with recreating the elemental portal nexus in Daggerford .
description_long: Tarul Var Tarul Var was a lich necromancer and Red Wizard of Thay in Daggerford in 1486 DR . History . Tarul was tasked with recreating the elemental portal nexus in Daggerford . He usually reside near the Bloodgate Gate , in the dungeon under Bloodgate Keep . In 1486 DR , a group of heroes from Daggerford , including Jekk Ironfist , Shalendra Floshin , Kelson Darktreader , and the rebel Red Wizard Mennek Ariz , among others , assaulted the Thayan Keep . In the fighting , the nexus was destroyed and Tarul killed but the heroes found themselves trapped in Thay . Defeated , Tarul recreated himself from his phylactery in the Doomvault dungeon in Thay . However , he was again killed by the same group of heroes who were investigating the dungeon , and they destroyed him for good along with his phylactery . Personality . Tarul was an arrogant and devious individual . He knew that his success depended on a favorable result from the Bloodgate mission , but he did not truly believe that he could fail . He believed that all living creatures were weaker than liches . He often berated his enemies and encouraged the cruelty of his underlings . Appendix . Behind the scenes .

title: Tash ' kla
description: Tash ' kla Tash ' kla was a priestess of Eilistraee . History . Tash ' kla was one of the Protectors of the Song in the Promenade of the Dark Maiden .
description_long: Tash ' kla Tash ' kla was a priestess of Eilistraee . History . Tash ' kla was one of the Protectors of the Song in the Promenade of the Dark Maiden . In 1377 DR , she was one of the six Protectors chosen for an assault led by Cavatina Xarann on the main temple of Kiaransalee . In 1379 DR Tash ' kla was killed by an ooze during the attack of the Ghaunadaur ' s followers to the Promenade but Cavatina hoped to resurrect her later .

title: Tasha ( monk )
description: Tasha ( monk ) Tasha was a monk at the Monastery of the Yellow Rose . History . Tasha was a thief in her youth , but in time she redeemed herself , becoming a monk at the monastery .
description_long: Tasha ( monk ) Tasha was a monk at the Monastery of the Yellow Rose . History . Tasha was a thief in her youth , but in time she redeemed herself , becoming a monk at the monastery . In 1491 DR , Tasha was one of the monks kidnapped by cultists of the Cult of the Howling Hatred , who planned to use them in a plot to access an elemental node . At the entrance room to the node complex under the monastery , she met an adventuring party hired by Grandmaster Perrywinkle Shin to find the missing monks . Tasha tested the adventurers , posing as a member of the Cult of the Black Earth , in order to see if they could be trusted to save her fellows . If they answered correctly , she disappeared .

title: Tashalan
description: Tashalan The Tashalans were a native human race of the Chultan Peninsula and the primary inhabitants of " the Tashalar " . Description . The Tashalans were generally considered a beautiful race by other human cultures .
description_long: Tashalan The Tashalans were a native human race of the Chultan Peninsula and the primary inhabitants of " the Tashalar " . Description . The Tashalans were generally considered a beautiful race by other human cultures . They had black hair and olive - colored skin . Tashalans were also known as swift runners . Language . Tashalan people spoke the Tashalan language , which made use of the Dethek script . Religion . Tashalans especially revered Savras and Talona among the other gods of the Faerûnian pantheon , but they were not limited in worship to those two gods . Some also maintained their historical worship of the yuan - ti deities . History . This people group originated on the Chultan Peninsula many thousands of years before the start of the Dale Reckoning . They were eventually enslaved by the sarrukh , the reptilian Creator race . When the sarrukh empire fell , many Tashalans continued to serve the yuan - ti . Others settled in lands all along the peninsula . Over time , those in the western part of the peninsula were driven out by the Chultan tribes . Those in the south and east were merged into the Halruaa n and Dambrath an cultures .

title: Tashalan language
description: Tashalan language The Tashalan language , called Akûrian , was a human language spoken in Tashalar and other parts of the Chultan Peninsula . Speakers . The Tashalan tongue was spoken in a region from Samarach in the west to the Mhair Jungle s in the east and from Narubel in the north to Mhairhetel in the south .
description_long: Tashalan language The Tashalan language , called Akûrian , was a human language spoken in Tashalar and other parts of the Chultan Peninsula . Speakers . The Tashalan tongue was spoken in a region from Samarach in the west to the Mhair Jungle s in the east and from Narubel in the north to Mhairhetel in the south . This included such places as Thindol , Tashluta , and the Black Jungle . It was also spoken in Calimshan , Chult , Halruaa , the Lake of Steam region , Lapaliiya , and the Shaar , and by some wild elves . Scholars counted at least three distinct dialects of Akûrian — Samarachian , Tashlutar , and Jungle Akûr . Script . Akûrian used the Dethek script of the dwarves . History . Akûrian was a member of the Akalaic languages , a subgroup of the Chessan languages group . As such , it was related to such languages as Eshowan , formerly spoken to the west in Chult , and Shaaran , spoken in the east . Examples . Female names in the Tashalan tongue might be Ayesha , Bhula , Lashela , Intingi , Mashai , Shevaya , Shesara , or Ushula . Common Akûrian male names were Angwe , Dumai , Gharbei , Indo , Masambe , Morife , Ngongwe , and Sepoto .

title: Tashalar
description: Tashalar Tashalar was a small , exotic country located on a strip of coast along the southern Shining Sea . It lay just east of the Chult peninsula , and west of the magic realm of Halruaa . It was famous for beautiful weather , beautiful people , excellent crossbows , and the richest wine - producing region in the world .
description_long: Tashalar Tashalar was a small , exotic country located on a strip of coast along the southern Shining Sea . It lay just east of the Chult peninsula , and west of the magic realm of Halruaa . It was famous for beautiful weather , beautiful people , excellent crossbows , and the richest wine - producing region in the world . Life and Society . The small city - states in Tashalar were home to various wealthy mercantile families who lived quite lavishly . In essence , they ruled the country through various merchant consortia . Commoners of the region typically made their living working in the fields , groves , or vineyards of these merchants ' estates . Failing this , they could commonly find work as sailors , shipwrights , sail makers , and provisioners , all contributing to the trade of the region ' s goods . Hunting was a popular sport in Tashalar , as there were many deadly creatures to be found in the jungles . The indigenous spicy foods were quite popular , as were strong wines and a tart fruit called yhaumarind .

title: Task
description: Task Task ( pronounced " TASK " ) was the chaotic evil dragon god of greed and selfishness . Description . Task usually manifested as a huge dragon whose hide was so studded with coins and gem s from snout to tail that it was impossible to determine the color of his scales .
description_long: Task Task ( pronounced " TASK " ) was the chaotic evil dragon god of greed and selfishness . Description . Task usually manifested as a huge dragon whose hide was so studded with coins and gem s from snout to tail that it was impossible to determine the color of his scales . Realm . Task ' s realm in the Dragon Eyrie was located in a region known as the Furnace because of it ' s volcanic activity . He dwelt in a rocky cave filled with a massive hoard , said to be the largest one of all , although followers of Astilabor disputed this . Red , gold and bronze dragon petitioners lived on his realm . It was also believed he had a lair in Pandemonium . Dogma . While Astilabor was the deity of acquisition with no stigma of greed attached , Task was greed personified . He wanted it all , and it didn ' t mattered to him what he had to do or what it cost to others to obtain what he wanted . His worshipers shared the same attitude . Task revered greed and selfishness , and sometimes rewarded followers who showed these traits in excess . One such gift he granted to his followers was to turn them into hoarder dragons on death so they could guard their treasure from opportunistic looters .

title: Taska Sonadora
description: Taska Sonadora Taska Sonadora was a sea captain in Waterdeep sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . Activities . Taska was an insane noble who wanted to use all her wealth on bold and foolish adventures .
description_long: Taska Sonadora Taska Sonadora was a sea captain in Waterdeep sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . Activities . Taska was an insane noble who wanted to use all her wealth on bold and foolish adventures . One of her crazy goals was to kill a white dragon . Her ship , the " Bobbin ' Flagon " , was stocked with the finest food and drink . History . In the late 1480s or early 1490s DR , Taska was possibly hired to accompany an adventuring party to Svardborg .

title: Tasked genie
description: Tasked genie Many tasked genies were once members of the four elemental realms . Over time they changed in appearance and form as a result of performing the specific tasks for which they were used . Tasked genies removed from their work suffered adverse effects including weakness , insanity , and even death .
description_long: Tasked genie Many tasked genies were once members of the four elemental realms . Over time they changed in appearance and form as a result of performing the specific tasks for which they were used . Tasked genies removed from their work suffered adverse effects including weakness , insanity , and even death . In the event that a tasked genie went insane , this triggered their transformation into a slayer genie . Habitat / Society . Unlike other genie s , some tasked genies consorted with humans on a regular and comfortable basis , dwelling with them in harmony . They were equally at home alone in the wilderness or surrounded by humanoid s in crowded cities . Their wilderness camps were often lavish mansions that could disappear into the sand if discovered . Some tasked genies tried to scare away intruders before resorting to violence . Tasked genies did not recognize the caste system of Zakhara like elemental genies did . They were just as content working for a pauper as they were for the sultan . Tasked genies were either bound by their profession to a specific location or kept inactive for long periods in between servitude .

title: Taskerleigh
description: Taskerleigh Taskerleigh was a village located not far from Waterdeep . Geography . Taskerleigh was located on the northern side of the convergence of the Unicorn Run and the River Delimbiyr .
description_long: Taskerleigh Taskerleigh was a village located not far from Waterdeep . Geography . Taskerleigh was located on the northern side of the convergence of the Unicorn Run and the River Delimbiyr . Presumably , it would have been located near Secomber . History . In or just prior to the year 1364 DR , the village was attacked and destroyed by the green dragon Grimnoshtadrano . There was only a single survivor : the elven bard Ingrival , who had carried the Morninglark harp . When others found him after the attack , he was quite mad and living as a hermit .

title: Tasloi
description: Tasloi Tasloi are humanoid jungle - dwellers whose race is thought to be thousands of years old . While very quick and nimble between the trees , tasloi are easily dazzled in bright sunlight , preferring to stay below the jungle canopy . Despite this , tasloi do possess low - light vision .
description_long: Tasloi Tasloi are humanoid jungle - dwellers whose race is thought to be thousands of years old . While very quick and nimble between the trees , tasloi are easily dazzled in bright sunlight , preferring to stay below the jungle canopy . Despite this , tasloi do possess low - light vision . They speak their own language of Tasloi but may also speak Common or Sylvan . Physical Description . Tasloi are 3 - feet tall with gold , cat - like eyes ; their green skin is thinly covered in coarse , black hair . They have a stooped , crouching posture and their knuckles drag on the ground when they walk . Society . Tasloi live in small groups consisting of several families . Their lairs are usually a series of large trees interconnected by vines and ropes , constructed on platforms high in the jungle canopy . On the ground below the platforms they sometimes raise dire rat s or spider eaters as beasts of burden and mounts . If the village does have any spider eaters , these beasts are reserved as steeds for the most powerful tasloi in the settlement . Combat . Tasloi normally attack from above , dropping from the treetops onto unwary opponents .

title: Taslythor Rocktapper
description: Taslythor Rocktapper Taslythor Rocktapper , who also went by the name Paerro , was a pickpocket and burglar within the city of Waterdeep in 1372 . Quickly falling into the life of a thief through necessity , Paerro eventually became quite skilled under the tutelage of Thear Chessar . It had been so long since he had been caught by the City Watch that they believed Paerro had left the City of Splendors .
description_long: Taslythor Rocktapper Taslythor Rocktapper , who also went by the name Paerro , was a pickpocket and burglar within the city of Waterdeep in 1372 . Quickly falling into the life of a thief through necessity , Paerro eventually became quite skilled under the tutelage of Thear Chessar . It had been so long since he had been caught by the City Watch that they believed Paerro had left the City of Splendors .

title: Tasseldale
description: Tasseldale Tasseldale was one of the dales in the Dalelands . Its capital was Tegal ' s Mark . In the 15th century DR the dale was controlled by Sembia .
description_long: Tasseldale Tasseldale was one of the dales in the Dalelands . Its capital was Tegal ' s Mark . In the 15th century DR the dale was controlled by Sembia . History . Once a free dale , at some point after the Spellplague Tasseldale was annexed by Sembia .

title: Tatak
description: Tatak Tatak was a desert dwarf from the House of Tezca desert in Maztica . History . After the Night of Wailing in 1361 DR , Tatak and his chieftain Luskag were checking a new water source when they were attacked by a Viperhands ogre .
description_long: Tatak Tatak was a desert dwarf from the House of Tezca desert in Maztica . History . After the Night of Wailing in 1361 DR , Tatak and his chieftain Luskag were checking a new water source when they were attacked by a Viperhands ogre . As Tatak died , an ancient hatred of goblinoid s rose up inside Luskag and he killed the ogre .

title: Tatalla
description: Tatalla Tatallas , meaning “ the eye ” , were tiny sinister creatures found in Zakhara , the Land of Fate . These creatures often found roles as spies or assassins . Description .
description_long: Tatalla Tatallas , meaning “ the eye ” , were tiny sinister creatures found in Zakhara , the Land of Fate . These creatures often found roles as spies or assassins . Description . Tatalla were small , standing around 2 feet ( 0 . 6m ) tall . They were humanoid in shape with a single large eye dominating their face . Many tatalla had tusks and large ears , making them appear like miniature ogre giant s . Combat . Tatalla were master trackers , possessing an unerring ability to hunt down their victims . These creatures possessed admirable thieving skills which they used to their advantage . A single bite of a tatalla caused nausea . Multiple bites caused adverse effects including loss of motor skills and even death if left untreated . Tatallas enjoyed biting sleeping victims , then returning each night for another bite until the victim died . The bites looked like regular spider bites . Though they generally avoided direct confrontations , tatalla were frenzied combatants if corned or forced to fight . Many even carried magical weapons . A pair of jambiya s or razors were their preferred melee weapons .

title: Tatigan Carrlock
description: Tatigan Carrlock Tatigan Carrlock was a human merchant living in the Shadowfell section of Ikemmu , a shadar - kai city . Activities . He specialized in providing the shadar - kai with exotic goods that stimulated their senses .
description_long: Tatigan Carrlock Tatigan Carrlock was a human merchant living in the Shadowfell section of Ikemmu , a shadar - kai city . Activities . He specialized in providing the shadar - kai with exotic goods that stimulated their senses . Tatigan regularly ran caravans between Ikemmu and the surface world . History . In 1480 DR , he pooled his resources with two other merchants to run a caravan to Rashemen . The witch Ilvani and the heroes Ashok , Skagi , and Cree journeyed with Tatigan on a quest to discover the source of the visions haunting Ilvani . Along the way it was discovered that one of Tatigan ' s partners , Thorm , was secretly working for bandits who attacked the caravan . The caravan was able to defeat the bandits , ice troll s , and other perils but when they arrived in Rashemen , they were unwelcome because of the restless spirits that were tormenting the land .

title: Tattoo of power
description: Tattoo of power Tattoo of power was a spell unique to Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Effects . Wizard s used this spell to store spells within special tattoos .
description_long: Tattoo of power Tattoo of power was a spell unique to Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Effects . Wizard s used this spell to store spells within special tattoos . Any spell could be stored in this manner , but the preparation time for stronger spells was greatly increased . Spells stored in this manner were permanent until cast , upon which time they would need to be stored again . The caster used this spell on others , but not themselves . The recipients did not need to be wizards . This spell needed to be cast in conjunction with the spell that was to be stored . The caster would then immediately tattoo the recipient . The spell stored within the tattoo could be released instantly by uttering a simple command , removing casting times altogether . The tattoo would fade away once the stored spell was cast . Spells cast in this manner acted as if the original caster were casting them . Thus , a weaker wizard could be walking around with the stored spell of an archmage that was ready for use at any time . Simple spells required a 2 - in . ( 5 . 1 - cm ) square of skin for the tattoo . Stronger spells required much more space .

title: Tau
description: Tau Tau was a member of the Cult of the Black Earth sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . History . In the late 1480s or early 1490s DR Tau and his fellow Shardra mounting two bulette went to One Stone spirit mound wanting claim the relic in the name of Ogrémoch .

title: Tauk Kodagai
description: Tauk Kodagai Tauk Kodagai was a korobokuru bushi adventurer in Shou Lung . Personality . Tauk liked wilderness , not being comfortable in huge cities and with more cultured people around her .
description_long: Tauk Kodagai Tauk Kodagai was a korobokuru bushi adventurer in Shou Lung . Personality . Tauk liked wilderness , not being comfortable in huge cities and with more cultured people around her . She had accepted to be the last of her family and no went back to her tribe . History . Born in Kuatan tribe Tauk , different from others women , decided to start a life as mercenary bushi . Meantime she was busy fighting rebel miners of Fukiow her family was destroyed by barbarians while saving the rest of the tribe . Tauk so decided to accept all works against barbarians around Dragonwall and into the Horse Plains . Tauk accomplished some great exploits : together with Iron Regiment stood against the cavalry charge at Lo Tu , recaptured Rendai Hills from barbarians and wild dogs of General Asu ' s , with the Haybat Imperial Archers defeated the horde of the ghostly Pin Mo Now , the Headtaker . She was also the standard bearer of General Hie Aie Shek during the cleaning of the Spice Road from bandits and severed the head of the barbarian chief , Asam Meneh in personal combat . In 1358 DR Tauk decided to go to the Komite Appendix . Behind the scenes .

title: Taulmaril
description: Taulmaril Taulmaril , also known as the Heartseeker , was Catti - brie ' s magic bow , which passed on to Drizzt after her death ( and remained with him even after her rebirth ) . Description . Longbow .
description_long: Taulmaril Taulmaril , also known as the Heartseeker , was Catti - brie ' s magic bow , which passed on to Drizzt after her death ( and remained with him even after her rebirth ) . Description . Longbow . Heartseeker was a beautifully crafted elven longbow + 3 made of polished wood . The elven craftsmen made the bow so strong even stone cannot scratch the marvelous wood , and the deep finish of its polish can be returned by a single brush of the hand . Quiver . The bow was also accompanied by the Quiver of Anariel , which contained twenty + 1 alchemical silver arrow s which never ran out . When an arrow was fired from Heartseeker , it became a whistling streak of silver light . Arrows launched from Taulmaril could easily bury themselves halfway into stone leaving a burned scorch mark . After a few minutes , arrows fired from Taulmaril magically dissolved , which caused a minor hissing sound . After the Spellplague , the arrows were depicted as having a lightning effect . Additionally , the arrows could be apparently be enchanted with light to create a torch . History .

title: Taunissik
description: Taunissik Taunissik was a small kuo - toa colony of Olleth located in Serôs . Geography . Taunissik was a deep atoll , with massive coral growths on a submerged mountain .
description_long: Taunissik Taunissik was a small kuo - toa colony of Olleth located in Serôs . Geography . Taunissik was a deep atoll , with massive coral growths on a submerged mountain . Goverment . Taunissik was founded by aggressive kuo - toans that wished to expand territory through conquest . History . In 1393 DR , several kuo - toa left Olleth and founded the colony of Taunissik . Shortly after its founding , the great kraken Gethshemeth enslaved the colony to its will .

title: Tauran
description: Tauran Tauran was an astral deva in service to Tyr until his faith was shaken in the events leading up to the death of Mystra . He was the mentor of the half - drow knight Kael . History .
description_long: Tauran Tauran was an astral deva in service to Tyr until his faith was shaken in the events leading up to the death of Mystra . He was the mentor of the half - drow knight Kael . History . In 1373 DR , Tauran was assigned to capture the alu - fiend Aliisza , whose unborn child ( Kael ) had cried out to Tyr for justice . Soon after , he and Micus captured Kashada the Nightwraith and imprisoned here in a sphere of eternal life . After Kael ' s birth , Tauran became his mentor . When the Cyric ist Zasian Menz infiltrated the House of the Triad , Tauran made an agreement with Kaanyr Vhok and Aliisza to hunt him down . However , they were unable to stop him from stealing Azuth ' s staff with the help of the freed Kashada / Shar and using it to kill Mystra . During this time , Tauran began doubting Tyr ' s judgement and his own faith in the gods , becoming a fallen angel . Not long after the death of Mystra , Tauran was protecting the Lifespring when he was killed by Vhok , who had betrayed the House of the Triad to a legion of demons . Appendix . Appearances . Novels . The Empyrean Odyssey :

title: Taurgosz Khosann
description: Taurgosz Khosann Taurgosz Khosann was the leader of the Blacktalons , a mercenary company based in Iriaebor . Description . He stood over 7 ft ( 2 .
description_long: Taurgosz Khosann Taurgosz Khosann was the leader of the Blacktalons , a mercenary company based in Iriaebor . Description . He stood over 7 ft ( 2 . 2 m ) tall , weighed about 350 lb ( 159 kg ) and had strength enough to wield some two - handed weapons in one hand . Personality . Tenhammer ruled with an iron fist and only listened to a few close and trusted allies . Possessions . His favorite weapon was his huge warhammer . He wore a magical suit of chain mail to battle . History . He earned his nickname , " Tenhammer , " by slaying 10 people with a single swing from his hammer while bidding to take over the leadership of the bandit group known as the Blacktalons . Appendix . Taurgosz Khosann ' s name is frequently misspelled . In his card in the 1992 series of the " AD & D Trading Cards " , his name is misspelled both as " Turgoz " , as well as " Turgosz " . In the computer game " Baldur ' s Gate " , it ' s spelled " Taugosz " , however this was corrected to " Taurgosz " in an update to " " .

title: Tavaray
description: Tavaray Tavaray ( or the Free City of Tavaray ) was a human settlement on the later site of the Lizard Marsh at the mouth of the River Delimbiyr . It was established in - 50 DR by settlers from Ruathym . This sparked a wave of settlement along the Sword Coast North .
description_long: Tavaray Tavaray ( or the Free City of Tavaray ) was a human settlement on the later site of the Lizard Marsh at the mouth of the River Delimbiyr . It was established in - 50 DR by settlers from Ruathym . This sparked a wave of settlement along the Sword Coast North . It was abandoned in 302 DR , prompting a wave of migration northward along the coast and eastward up the lower Delimibiyr Vale .

title: Tavern
description: Tavern A place where people go to eat and drink , some couple as inns as well . Usually there is one per town and there are many in large cities . Often in a city there are low - end taverns and high - end taverns , depending on where the tavern is located .
description_long: Tavern A place where people go to eat and drink , some couple as inns as well . Usually there is one per town and there are many in large cities . Often in a city there are low - end taverns and high - end taverns , depending on where the tavern is located . Low - end taverns are poorly made and offer cheap food and drink and are generally located around the shipping docks or slums of a city . They make great spots for thieves , beggars , ruffians , and the like . In these cheap hang - outs there are often fights an bar - brawls , as well as many pick - pocketings and robberies . High - end taverns are often found by the city halls , worshiping grounds , or palaces , these taverns are extremely well made and offer the finest food and drink money can buy . Those who frequent these places are rich or people of power . The tavern keepers hire multiple skilled bouncers to protect the place and stifle any fights that may break out .

title: Tavern of the Flagon Dragon
description: Tavern of the Flagon Dragon The Tavern of the Flagon Dragon was a tavern in the Castle Ward of Waterdeep , not far from Blackstaff Tower . Location . The two story tavern was located in the northern section of the Castle Ward on Darselune Street about a block from the Sleepy Slyph .
description_long: Tavern of the Flagon Dragon The Tavern of the Flagon Dragon was a tavern in the Castle Ward of Waterdeep , not far from Blackstaff Tower . Location . The two story tavern was located in the northern section of the Castle Ward on Darselune Street about a block from the Sleepy Slyph .

title: Tavilar
description: Tavilar Tavilar was a village in the Vast , located on the Hunt Trail between Ylraphon and Kurth , south of the Flooded Forest . The Pass Trail led to Blanaer . History .
description_long: Tavilar Tavilar was a village in the Vast , located on the Hunt Trail between Ylraphon and Kurth , south of the Flooded Forest . The Pass Trail led to Blanaer . History . The Turning Key , an adventuring company , once based themselves in Tavilar . After meeting with disaster and retiring , they never returned to Tavilar . A mage in Tavilar using a scrying spell was one of only two surviving witnesses to a rampage by a stag - horned lich in the Beluar ' s Hunt hills , around 1350 DR . The other witness was another scrying mage in Kurth . Description . The village lay beside the duskwood forests that formed the southern boundaries of the Flooded Forest . Locations . The House of the Key was once home to the Turning Key band . It was a rambling old place in need of continual maintenance when they inhabited it . It collapsed outright when they didn ' t return , well before 1370 DR . Rumors . Locals claimed that the Turning Key had been quite wealthy , and that their treasure must still be hidden somewhere in the area . Many times , adventurers poked through the ruins of the House of the Key , turning up nothing more than decayed furniture and finery .

title: Tawar Kroul
description: Tawar Kroul Tawar Kroul was the main representative of surface - dwellers in Mantol - Derith in 1479 DR . Activities . Tawar usually sold alcohol in exchange for art objects , poisons , and obsidian daggers .
description_long: Tawar Kroul Tawar Kroul was the main representative of surface - dwellers in Mantol - Derith in 1479 DR . Activities . Tawar usually sold alcohol in exchange for art objects , poisons , and obsidian daggers . Personality . Tawar had small degree of orc blood : her grandfather was a half - orc who mated with a human . She acted very aggressively .

title: Taxatl
description: Taxatl Taxatl was an exotic Maztican concubine of Grand Caliph Khalil al - Assad al - Zahir in Huzuz in 1367 DR . History . Taxatl was originally a plumaweaver from distant Maztica .
description_long: Taxatl Taxatl was an exotic Maztican concubine of Grand Caliph Khalil al - Assad al - Zahir in Huzuz in 1367 DR . History . Taxatl was originally a plumaweaver from distant Maztica . She joined her brother , Yax Cautli , on his voyage to see Faerûn , but was separated from him at sea when their ship was destroyed by a violent storm . Taxatly never learned what happened to her lost brother .

title: Tayanulchi
