Though outnumbered , the shukenja of the Red Mountain Sect met these attacks with fierce resistance . Were it not for the favor of Prince Ogandi , the temple and its followers would have surely been driven from Manass .

title: Temple of the Seldarine
description: Temple of the Seldarine The Temple of the Seldarine was a large temple complex located in Leuthilspar on the island of Evermeet . Description . Its main building was topped by a dome and was split into areas dedicated to the worship of the individual gods of the Seldarine , as well as a central chamber .
description_long: Temple of the Seldarine The Temple of the Seldarine was a large temple complex located in Leuthilspar on the island of Evermeet . Description . Its main building was topped by a dome and was split into areas dedicated to the worship of the individual gods of the Seldarine , as well as a central chamber . The temple was set in a parkland containing evergreen trees and poplar s . History . The Temple of the Seldarine was created by the sun elves . Angharradh was not represented here because the sun elves do not regard her as part of the Seldarine . This did not cause ill feelings amongst the other elves .

title: Temple of the Small Axe
description: Temple of the Small Axe The Temple of the Small Axe was a mosque dedicated to Kor in Liham , in 1367 DR . Description . The temple had a golden dome that dominated the city - scape of Liham .
description_long: Temple of the Small Axe The Temple of the Small Axe was a mosque dedicated to Kor in Liham , in 1367 DR . Description . The temple had a golden dome that dominated the city - scape of Liham . The main altar for the temple lay in the center of a beautiful garden . Location . The Temple of the Small Axe was situated across the street from the Palace of Sly Ravens . Inhabitants . The priests of Kor inhabiting the temple were all pragmatist s .

title: Temple of the Yellow Mountain
description: Temple of the Yellow Mountain The Temple of the Yellow Mountain was the seat of power for the Yellow Mountain Sect of Manass in Khazari in 1367 DR . Description . The temple was one of the larger structures found in Manass .
description_long: Temple of the Yellow Mountain The Temple of the Yellow Mountain was the seat of power for the Yellow Mountain Sect of Manass in Khazari in 1367 DR . Description . The temple was one of the larger structures found in Manass . It faced an open courtyard near the center of the city . Inhabitants . In all , 27 shukenja of the sect lived within the temple . The shukenja were aided by an additional 45 sohei . Dongzhei Nangpo was the ranking shukenja and effective leader of the temple . Activities . Most of the inhabitants of Manass followed the teachings of the Yellow Mountain Sect , though they usually only visited the temple on holy days or to honor dead relatives . The followers of the Yellow Mountain Sect often attacked the temple of their rival , the Red Mountain Sect .

title: Tempskya
description: Tempskya Tempskya is what was called in the Realms . Description . Specimens came in many colors , from black and white to red , yellow , brown , and sometimes pink .
description_long: Tempskya Tempskya is what was called in the Realms . Description . Specimens came in many colors , from black and white to red , yellow , brown , and sometimes pink . They could be as big as the original tree or plant was before it was buried , and they retained the tree ' s structure . Tempskya was sometimes difficult to polish because of inclusions of , opal , or chalcedony which fractured the surface and had different hardness than the substrate . Tempskya was usually cut in slabs , polished and used for inlays , but could be cut cabochon and used in jewelry . A typical price was 1 gp per pound ( 2 . 2 gp / kg ) . Powers . Tempskya was a substitute for the material component in all arcane magic spells dealing with petrification . It was also used as a component when enchanting items that concerned petrification .

title: Tempus
description: Tempus Tempus ( pronounced " TEM - pus " ) , also known as the Lord of Battles , was the god of war . His dogma was primarily concerned with honorable battle , forbidding cowardice and encouraging the use of force of arms to settle disputes . History .
description_long: Tempus Tempus ( pronounced " TEM - pus " ) , also known as the Lord of Battles , was the god of war . His dogma was primarily concerned with honorable battle , forbidding cowardice and encouraging the use of force of arms to settle disputes . History . Tempus was originally one of many potential war gods who emerged from the primordial clashes between Selûne and Shar . These gods fought constantly with each other , the victors absorbing the essence and power of the defeated . This continued until Tempus stood as the sole god of war in the Faerûnian pantheon , having defeated and absorbed all of his competitors ( with the notable exception of Garagos , whom he defeated but spared ) . The barbarians of Icewind Dale claimed that Tempus ' s original name was " Tempos " . The Time of Troubles . In the Time of Troubles of the Year of Shadows , 1358 DR , Tempus ' avatar appeared in a ruined castle in Battledale , just over five miles southwest of Essembra . Immediately following the Godswar , Eldan Ambrose , an Amn ian cleric of Tempus , saw Tempus during a battle in Swords Creek .

title: Tempus ' s Tears
description: Tempus ' s Tears Tempus ' s Tears sits at the intersection of the Skuldask Road and The Thundar ' s Ride at the heart of the Fields of the Dead . There is a large standing stone setup at the intersection with an inscription : The dwarf and gnome villagers live in burrow homes as the area of the village is covered in stone ruins . The villages say the stones are under the protections of Amaeraszantha , an Amethyst Dragon .
description_long: Tempus ' s Tears Tempus ' s Tears sits at the intersection of the Skuldask Road and The Thundar ' s Ride at the heart of the Fields of the Dead . There is a large standing stone setup at the intersection with an inscription : The dwarf and gnome villagers live in burrow homes as the area of the village is covered in stone ruins . The villages say the stones are under the protections of Amaeraszantha , an Amethyst Dragon . Located in the ruins is the Stone that Speaks . Scholars of Candlekeep have long sought that relic .

title: Tempus Blackthorne
description: Tempus Blackthorne Tempus Blackthorne was a male human wizard worshiper of Bane before and during the Time of Troubles . History . Tempus was a powerful wizard of Zhentil Keep and a member of the church of Bane .
description_long: Tempus Blackthorne Tempus Blackthorne was a male human wizard worshiper of Bane before and during the Time of Troubles . History . Tempus was a powerful wizard of Zhentil Keep and a member of the church of Bane . He was fiercely devoted to his god , aiding him in all matters of mortal life . In the end , Tempus died trying to perform a spell under the order of his god but the instability of the magic killed him . Strangely for him , Bane had a good memory of the mage after his demise . Tempus was also a childhood friend of Ronglath Knightsbridge and used all means of help his friend .

title: Ten Towns
description: Ten Towns The Ten Towns were a loose confederation of localized fishing villages in Icewind Dale , bordered individually by the lakes Lac Dinneshere , Maer Dualdon and Redwaters , and the mountain Kelvin ' s Cairn . Government . Official decisions for the towns were made by a council consisting of one influential member from each town .
description_long: Ten Towns The Ten Towns were a loose confederation of localized fishing villages in Icewind Dale , bordered individually by the lakes Lac Dinneshere , Maer Dualdon and Redwaters , and the mountain Kelvin ' s Cairn . Government . Official decisions for the towns were made by a council consisting of one influential member from each town . These council members met in the council building in Bryn Shander , which was unanimously recognized as the capital of Ten Towns , and of Icewind Dale itself , once a month during the summer season , and once every three in the winter . The definitive council in 1356 DR consisted of the following : The council list before the war with Akar Kessell : The list of the council following the war with Akar Kessell sits as thus : The Council as of 1485 DR was : Inhabitants . Its population is predominantly human , with very few half - elves and halflings . Surrounded by the unforgiving tundra of the dale , theirs is a life fraught with danger ; tundra yeti , barbarian , goblin and orc raids constantly threaten the towns , and only through their combined efforts and carefully honed defenses do they yet survive .

title: Tenblades
description: Tenblades The Tenblades was a small group of adventures active in Vaasa before much of the region had been explored or settled . History . The Tenblades used their own wealth to fund the construction of the fortress of Darmshall .
description_long: Tenblades The Tenblades was a small group of adventures active in Vaasa before much of the region had been explored or settled . History . The Tenblades used their own wealth to fund the construction of the fortress of Darmshall . Darmshall ' s construction was prompted by the leader of the Tenblades , Romas Thunderclap , after two of their members were murdered . Romas figured the presence of the fortress would deter future attacks in the region . Darmshall ' s defenses were well - constructed , as even Zhengyi could not conquer the keep .

title: Tenday
description: Tenday A tenday was a Faerûn ian unit of time . The Calendar of Harptos divided the thirty - day months into three blocks of ten days each , or simply put , " tendays " . The word was used interchangeably with the Earthly term " week " .
description_long: Tenday A tenday was a Faerûn ian unit of time . The Calendar of Harptos divided the thirty - day months into three blocks of ten days each , or simply put , " tendays " . The word was used interchangeably with the Earthly term " week " .

title: Tengu
description: Tengu The tengu was a winged avian humanoid creature found in Kara - Tur . There were two kinds of tengu : the crow tengu with a crow head and more avian characteristics ; and the humanoid tengu , with more humanoid characteristics . Description .
description_long: Tengu The tengu was a winged avian humanoid creature found in Kara - Tur . There were two kinds of tengu : the crow tengu with a crow head and more avian characteristics ; and the humanoid tengu , with more humanoid characteristics . Description . The more avian of the two , the crow tengu bore a bird - like head and beak , similar to that of a crow . Its body was covered in feathers ; these were brightly hued , often in shades of green , red , or yellow . Feathered wings emerged from between their shoulder blades , enabling flight . The crow tengu was short , standing only 2 – 3 feet ( 61 – 91 centimeters ) tall . The humanoid tengu , meanwhile , had a human - like head and face , but its nose was unusually long . They had no furthers , but their skin was blue or red . Approximately 70 % of humanoid tengu possessed wings like the crow tengu ; these were stunted but still permitted flight . Powers . Notably , both breeds of tengu could perfectly mimic any voice that they had heard , whether speech or animal noises . The crow and humanoid tengu could both cast the " polymorph " and " shout " spells , thrice a day .

title: Tenison
description: Tenison Tenison was a wizard in Daggerford around 1370 DR . Activities . Tenison had always been fascinated by fire , ever since he was a child .
description_long: Tenison Tenison was a wizard in Daggerford around 1370 DR . Activities . Tenison had always been fascinated by fire , ever since he was a child . At the age of three , he burned down his family ' s entire farm . Later he become an elementalist , specializing in the use of paraelemental s of smoke and magma and the quasi - elemental s of ash and radiance .

title: Tennora Hedare
description: Tennora Hedare Tennora Hedare is a young apprentice Wizard and a member of one of Waterdeep ' s minor noble houses . She currently works as a spy for Nazra Mrays , a masked Lord of Waterdeep . Description .
description_long: Tennora Hedare Tennora Hedare is a young apprentice Wizard and a member of one of Waterdeep ' s minor noble houses . She currently works as a spy for Nazra Mrays , a masked Lord of Waterdeep . Description . Tennora has blonde hair which she wears in a single braid . She prefers wearing her mother ' s leather armor to a mage robe . Abilities . Tennora has modest magical skills . She learned to pick locks from a rogue near the harbor and has been paying him for further instruction in roguish arts . History . Tennora ' s parents died during a Featherlung epidemic while she was still a child . Unknown to Tennora , her mother was an accomplished rogue before she married into the nobility . She was raised in North Ward by her father ' s brother and his wife . Tennora studied magic at the House of Wonders mage academy in Waterdeep but she was dismissed by Master Rhinzen Halnian because he didn ' t think she had much potential as a mage even though she was capable of casting moderately powerful magic such as the fireball spell . Tennora lived in an apartment at the God Catcher tenement .

title: Tenosh
description: Tenosh Tenosh was the Cloakmaster of Baldur ' s Gate for the Shadow Thieves around 1370 DR . Personality . Tenosh was a cruel woman .
description_long: Tenosh Tenosh was the Cloakmaster of Baldur ' s Gate for the Shadow Thieves around 1370 DR . Personality . Tenosh was a cruel woman . She rebuffed all romantic offers . Propriety . Tenosh possessed a " ring of human influence " that permitted all her contacts in the city to view her as friendly . Powers . It was not known how far Tenosh ' s tiefling powers extended . It was said that the skin on her belly was scaled , that she could generate cold from from her right hand , that she could climb all surfaces like an insect , and that she never slept . What was apparent was that her hair moved by itself when she was angered . Activities . In addition to her role as Cloakmaster , Tenosh was asked by her superiors to kill certain individuals passing through Baldur ' s Gate , and even a rogue agent of the Shadow Thieves .

title: Tenrax
description: Tenrax Tenrax was the seldom - seen leader of the Nugha tribes in T ' u Lung in 1357 DR . Activities . Tenrax was the kio ton mu ( witchdoctor ) leader of the horsemen of E ' sang Yi in the hill country south of Chunming in Ausa province .
description_long: Tenrax Tenrax was the seldom - seen leader of the Nugha tribes in T ' u Lung in 1357 DR . Activities . Tenrax was the kio ton mu ( witchdoctor ) leader of the horsemen of E ' sang Yi in the hill country south of Chunming in Ausa province . He performed ancient rites and possessed ancient and dangerous knowledge . Tenrax spoke for the Nugha at the court of Wai .

title: Tenser ' s transformation
description: Tenser ' s transformation Tenser ' s transformation was a spell that made the caster a virtual fighting machine — improving the caster ' s strength , dexterity , and physical constitution , as well as increasing the natural thickness of his or her skin . While granting those physical advantages , it prevented spellcasting and the ability to use any magical devices . To Zakhara n mages , always reluctant to acknowledge ajami names and accomplishments , the spell was known simply as transformation , and counted among the spells of the universal province .
description_long: Tenser ' s transformation Tenser ' s transformation was a spell that made the caster a virtual fighting machine — improving the caster ' s strength , dexterity , and physical constitution , as well as increasing the natural thickness of his or her skin . While granting those physical advantages , it prevented spellcasting and the ability to use any magical devices . To Zakhara n mages , always reluctant to acknowledge ajami names and accomplishments , the spell was known simply as transformation , and counted among the spells of the universal province .

title: Tentacle walls
description: Tentacle walls Tentacle walls was an enchantment spell that turned a room into a trap . Effects . The area of effect was a single room no bigger than a 50 ft ( 15 .
description_long: Tentacle walls Tentacle walls was an enchantment spell that turned a room into a trap . Effects . The area of effect was a single room no bigger than a 50 ft ( 15 . 3 m ) cube . The caster had to touch the inside of the room to cast this spell . Once the trap was set , any creature other than the caster larger than a typical rat ( 3 lb / 1 . 4 kg or 0 . 5 ft / 0 . 014 m ) would trigger the trap upon entering the room . When triggered , six large , black , leathery tentacles emerged from the walls , floor and ceiling , evenly spaced around the room and able to reach the opposite surface . The tentacles whipped wildly about the room , striking at random until all occupants either left the room , died , or all six tentacles were destroyed . If any tentacle was intact when the room no longer met the triggering conditions , the trap reset and six fresh tentacles would appear the next time a creature entered the room . When a tentacle was destroyed , it burst into a puff of black smoke . Components . In addition to a verbal component , the caster had to touch the inside of the room to be enchanted , and have a dried octopus tentacle .

title: Tephanis
description: Tephanis Tephanis is a quickling who has served many masters ; Ulgulu being one of them . Chance encounter . When a group of their gnoll s sent to retrieve a pair of farmers , the father and eldest son , from the Thistledown farm never returned , he and his brother sent Nathak to scout out what happened , he returned and told both Kempfana and Ulgulu that their raiding party of five gnoll s were dead .
description_long: Tephanis Tephanis is a quickling who has served many masters ; Ulgulu being one of them . Chance encounter . When a group of their gnoll s sent to retrieve a pair of farmers , the father and eldest son , from the Thistledown farm never returned , he and his brother sent Nathak to scout out what happened , he returned and told both Kempfana and Ulgulu that their raiding party of five gnoll s were dead . After that Ulgulu sent his quickling ally , Tephanis , to discover exactly what had happened . When Tephanis returned and told them that the newly - surfaced Drizzt Do ' Urden had slain the goblins , they had the quickling steal one of Drizzt ' s scimitars . Ulgulu used his shape - changing abilities to make himself appear as a drow , and with Drizzt ' s scimitar , attacked the Thistledown farm . After slaying the residents , he left the broken scimitar so as to make people believe that Drizzt had killed the family . When Drizzt learned what had happened , he and Guenhwyvar attacked the cave ' s inhabitants , destroying the two barghest s and many of their goblin allies . New Ally . Tephanis was not happy being uprooted and now had to find a new " ally " to help him .

title: Ter - soth
description: Ter - soth Ter - soth was a balor commander in the service of Orcus in the Abyss in 1357 DR . Activities . Ter - soth led a regiment of 100 glabrezu s guarding the conduit to the palace of Orcus .
description_long: Ter - soth Ter - soth was a balor commander in the service of Orcus in the Abyss in 1357 DR . Activities . Ter - soth led a regiment of 100 glabrezu s guarding the conduit to the palace of Orcus . If a powerful enemy attacked , he abandoned his men and fled to the palace asking for reinforcements .

title: Teraff
description: Teraff Teraff was a young Star elf firebrand of an orator who , in the early days of the creation of Sildëyuir preached against peaceful relations with any other nation , even with other elves . She led a group of renegade star elves on raids against coastal camps of human settlers who she suspected of spying on Yuireshanyaar . Her fears proved true when she and her group were captured by some of those coastal settlers .
description_long: Teraff Teraff was a young Star elf firebrand of an orator who , in the early days of the creation of Sildëyuir preached against peaceful relations with any other nation , even with other elves . She led a group of renegade star elves on raids against coastal camps of human settlers who she suspected of spying on Yuireshanyaar . Her fears proved true when she and her group were captured by some of those coastal settlers . Teraff was tortured to death for not revealing the locations of the " portal s " to Sildëyuir or how to activate them but some of her group managed to escape capture and return home . They told of her tale and she was forever remembered as a heroine and a symbol of inspiration to the star elf people .

title: Terazul
description: Terazul Terazul was a flowering plant found only in a few locations in the jungles south of Delzimmer . It was also the name of a somewhat addictive drug made from the leaves of the plant . Ecology .
description_long: Terazul Terazul was a flowering plant found only in a few locations in the jungles south of Delzimmer . It was also the name of a somewhat addictive drug made from the leaves of the plant . Ecology . When ground into a powder and snorted , the drug was a powerful stimulant , causing the user to remain awake for days at a time . When drunk as a potion it caused visions . Terazul was not without side effects , however , as children of terazul users were sometimes born with abnormalities such as tentacles . The plant ' s properties were thought to be due to its ability to tap into lingering pockets of spellplague . In reality , the plant ' s roots grew out of portals to the Far Realm , which had been opened by derro in the Underdark . History . The terazul trade was controlled by House Serrat of Delzimmer . In 1479 DR , a group led by Alaia Serrat and her adopted daughter Zaltys closed the portal to the Far Realm , destroying the terazul plants .

title: Teremon
description: Teremon Teremon was the king of the pixie s of Panjuis until his death in the early 14th century DR . Personality . Teremon was a disciplined ruler who maintained order within his special fortress .
description_long: Teremon Teremon was the king of the pixie s of Panjuis until his death in the early 14th century DR . Personality . Teremon was a disciplined ruler who maintained order within his special fortress . Activities . Panjuis fell into a state of disrepair after Teremon ' s death since his leadership was not present to keep the pixies in line .

title: Teresiel
description: Teresiel Teresiel was a prisoner at the Fane of the Eye under Tyar - Besil during the Elemental Evil crisis . History . In 1491 DR , Teresiel was chosen among many others to be part of a diplomatic delegation to Mirabar .
description_long: Teresiel Teresiel was a prisoner at the Fane of the Eye under Tyar - Besil during the Elemental Evil crisis . History . In 1491 DR , Teresiel was chosen among many others to be part of a diplomatic delegation to Mirabar . However , at Beliard in the Dessarin Valley , they were ambushed by the Cult of the Black Earth . Teresiel was captured and transported beyond the River Dessarin . There , in the Sumber Hills , they were attacked by the Cult of the Howling Hatred , but Teresiel remained in Black Earth ' s custody . Some time after being transported to the Fane , however , she was ceded to the Cult of the Eternal Flame , who put her in a jail in their section of the Fane until some adventurers infiltrated the temple and freed her .

title: Termalaine
description: Termalaine Termalaine was the second - northernmost settlement of Ten Towns , and the third largest in the region . Geography . Termalaine was located on the eastern shore of Maer Dualdon , due north of Bryn Shander .
description_long: Termalaine Termalaine was the second - northernmost settlement of Ten Towns , and the third largest in the region . Geography . Termalaine was located on the eastern shore of Maer Dualdon , due north of Bryn Shander . Historically , the area was been rich in tourmaline mining . History . The city got its name from tourmaline mining . Before being adopted by Bruenor Battlehammer , Catti - brie lived with her parents in Termalaine in the 1340s DR when they were killed by goblins . The city of Termalaine was taken over several times by barbarian forces . The infamous barbarian Heafstaag conquered it twice , but failed in his last try in 1351 DR when Heafstaag tried to conquer all of the Ten Towns in one massive attack . The attack by the Tribe of the Bear during the Battle of Icewind Dale forced more than half the townsfolk to take shelter in Bryn Shander , but the damage was quickly repaired . In 1356 DR , Regis captured the traitor DeBernezan in an alley in Termalaine . Government . A long standing councilman was Agorwal , owner of a tourmaline gem mine , who was injured and survived the orc invasion sent by Akar Kessell in 1356 DR .

title: Terondarg Del ' Armgo
description: Terondarg Del ' Armgo Terondarg Del ' Armgo was one of the most able scouts of House Barrison Del ' Armgo in 1486 DR . History . Terondarg was one of the best scouts of Menzoberranzan in 1486 .
description_long: Terondarg Del ' Armgo Terondarg Del ' Armgo was one of the most able scouts of House Barrison Del ' Armgo in 1486 DR . History . Terondarg was one of the best scouts of Menzoberranzan in 1486 . He went to check the situation after the attack of his House against the resurrected House Do ' Urden during the early stages of the Rage of Demons , making his report to the matron mother Mez ' Barris Armgo and high priestess Taayrul Armgo .

title: Terpenzi
description: Terpenzi Terpenzi was a ha - naga and the first ruler of Najara , taking this position in −361 DR . In 89 DR , Terpenzi foresaw its own death and ordered its servants to search for Netherese artifacts . In the meantime , it searched for a mate .
description_long: Terpenzi Terpenzi was a ha - naga and the first ruler of Najara , taking this position in −361 DR . In 89 DR , Terpenzi foresaw its own death and ordered its servants to search for Netherese artifacts . In the meantime , it searched for a mate . In the next year , it was indeed killed in battle with Verraketh the Shadowking . After being killed by the Shadowking , it returned more powerful than before in undeath , when one of its offspring , Jacinica , bound it to the " Marlspire of Najara " . Terpenzi continued to serve the kings who ruled after it , fighting the relic but still caring about Najara . It resided in the Snake Pit of Ss ' khanaja among the treasures of the kingdom .

title: Terran
description: Terran Terran was the language of creatures from the Elemental Plane of Earth or those otherwise related to the earth in some way . Many earthsoul genasi learned the language as well . When written , it used the Dethek script .
description_long: Terran Terran was the language of creatures from the Elemental Plane of Earth or those otherwise related to the earth in some way . Many earthsoul genasi learned the language as well . When written , it used the Dethek script . Description . Terran is a rumbling language with deep tones that reverberate through the listener .

title: Terrien Doucard
description: Terrien Doucard Terrien Doucard was a half - elven soldier of the Knights in Silver who replaced Besnell as leader during the Battle of Keeper ' s Dale . Description . Terrien had shining brown hair which shimmered even after the knight fought and killed on the battlefield .
description_long: Terrien Doucard Terrien Doucard was a half - elven soldier of the Knights in Silver who replaced Besnell as leader during the Battle of Keeper ' s Dale . Description . Terrien had shining brown hair which shimmered even after the knight fought and killed on the battlefield . Like many half - elves , Terrien was extremely slender . Personality . The knight was fiercely faithful to Lady Alustrial , Besnell , and the rest of the Knights in Silver . In fact , he was in love with Alustriel but was wise enough not to act on those feelings . Relationships . Terrien ' s father was an elf , a cousin of Besnell . His mother was the second daughter of one of Silverymoon ' s wealthiest families . History . In 1358 DR , Terrien followed Besnell and a hundred other Knights of Silver in the Battle of Keeper ' s Dale where they combined forces with Berkthgar ' s barbarians of Settlestone , the Longrider s of Longsaddle , and a few Riders of Nesmé to defend Mithral Hall against the drow horde of Menzoberranzan . During the battle , Besnell fell to a goblin spear and Terrien replaced him as the leader of the knights .

title: Terxyx
description: Terxyx Terxyx was a tome archon in service to Saint Sollars in 1357 DR . History . In 1357 , Terxyx led a company of sword archon s in the Astral Plane to save Gareth Dragonsbane and his party from pursuing demon s and to accompany them to meet his master Saint Sollars .
description_long: Terxyx Terxyx was a tome archon in service to Saint Sollars in 1357 DR . History . In 1357 , Terxyx led a company of sword archon s in the Astral Plane to save Gareth Dragonsbane and his party from pursuing demon s and to accompany them to meet his master Saint Sollars .

title: Teryani Ealoeth
description: Teryani Ealoeth Teryani Ealoeth was a female fey ' ri ranger and a daughter of Xhalth . She was the chief scout for the daemonfey . History .
description_long: Teryani Ealoeth Teryani Ealoeth was a female fey ' ri ranger and a daughter of Xhalth . She was the chief scout for the daemonfey . History . By 1374 DR , Teryani was primarily a spy and assassin , having infiltrated many Sembia n councils . Teryani assisted Sarya Dlardrageth in her dealings with Borstag Duncastle . Later Teryani was the principal liaison between Sembia and the daemonfey . Sarya ordered Teryani to kill Ilsevele Miritar , who was trying to make peace between Sembia and the Crusade . The assassination attempt failed thanks to Fflar Starbrow Melruth . Teryani was one of the few fey ' ri to survive their defeat in the Cormanthor War . Equipment . Teryani carried a " + 2 masterwork shortbow " . Personality . Teryani had a true talent for disguise and delighted in deceit .

title: Teshaurus
description: Teshaurus Teshaurus was a skull lord who was a member of the Dominion of Bone in 1479 DR . History . Teshaurus acted as the " ambassador " of Prince Nathur Hethkantan in Glaur , dealing with the genasi of the Dominion of the Burned , or with adventurers or treasure hunters who were exploring the fortress .
description_long: Teshaurus Teshaurus was a skull lord who was a member of the Dominion of Bone in 1479 DR . History . Teshaurus acted as the " ambassador " of Prince Nathur Hethkantan in Glaur , dealing with the genasi of the Dominion of the Burned , or with adventurers or treasure hunters who were exploring the fortress . Teshaurus invited those explorers who he deemed particularly interesting to meet Prince Nathur in the Dominion of Bone .

title: Teshburl
description: Teshburl Teshburl was the most isolated town of Calimshan . It was the secondary shipbuilding site for the Nallojal ; everything in the town revolved around the navy , and Teshburl served as the nation ' s headquarters and primary port for it . Geography and Layout .
description_long: Teshburl Teshburl was the most isolated town of Calimshan . It was the secondary shipbuilding site for the Nallojal ; everything in the town revolved around the navy , and Teshburl served as the nation ' s headquarters and primary port for it . Geography and Layout . Most cartographers and navigators considered Teshburl to mark the place where the Shining Sea and the Sea of Swords met . It was located at the southwestern tip of Calimshan and surrounded by the Calim Desert . The coast around Teshburl was rocky and consisted of many steep cliffs . Teshburl was divided into six sabban s of nineteen drudach s . Nallojal Sabban was the westernmost district of the town and included the majority of the docks and waterfront property . As its name implied , this was a military - controlled locale . Located next to it was Kadhatarna Sabban , another coastal sabban . As of 1370 DR , the navy was expanding its control and ownership into this area as well , and nearly every tavern and inn in this sabban was owned by retired sailors or naval officers . The northernmost sabban was named Qeldan Sabban . It included the sultan ' s estate .

title: Teshendale
description: Teshendale Situated along the valley of the River Tesh , Teshendale was a lost dale once occupied the territory spanning from Zhentil Keep to the Desertsmouth Mountains . Now , the area is covered in ruins , as in 1316 DR it was invaded by Zhent forces and orc s working for them ; the people were slain , ensalved or driven away , the valley was quarried and the granite used to build vast sections of the walls that protected Zhentil Keep . Although no longer part of the Dalelands , the cities of Teshwave and Snowmantle remained under control of Zhentil Keep until its destruction ; Teshwave , once the largest trading community in Teshendale , was a staging area for Zhent nonhuman troups and mercenaries .
description_long: Teshendale Situated along the valley of the River Tesh , Teshendale was a lost dale once occupied the territory spanning from Zhentil Keep to the Desertsmouth Mountains . Now , the area is covered in ruins , as in 1316 DR it was invaded by Zhent forces and orc s working for them ; the people were slain , ensalved or driven away , the valley was quarried and the granite used to build vast sections of the walls that protected Zhentil Keep . Although no longer part of the Dalelands , the cities of Teshwave and Snowmantle remained under control of Zhentil Keep until its destruction ; Teshwave , once the largest trading community in Teshendale , was a staging area for Zhent nonhuman troups and mercenaries . Snowmantle , located along the edge of the Border Forest , was a Zhent logging camp . . The Dales Council continues to keep an empty seat for Teshendale as a reminder of what happens when the Dales do not stick together .

title: Teshford Arms
description: Teshford Arms The Teshford Arms was run by Olavia Tsardruyn and was the only real inn in Dagger Falls . Rumors . The inn suffered from the fact that Olavia ' s mint wine was the only thing to recommend it .
description_long: Teshford Arms The Teshford Arms was run by Olavia Tsardruyn and was the only real inn in Dagger Falls . Rumors . The inn suffered from the fact that Olavia ' s mint wine was the only thing to recommend it . There were reports that it improved after the Zhent occupation in 1369 DR , but was rarely full .

title: Teshwave
description: Teshwave Teshwave was a small town in Teshendale in the Dalelands . Geography . The community was built along the River Tesh just south of the Dragonspine Mountains .
description_long: Teshwave Teshwave was a small town in Teshendale in the Dalelands . Geography . The community was built along the River Tesh just south of the Dragonspine Mountains . Trade . The town was the largest trading community in Teshendale and was controlled by the forces of Zhentil Keep . Defense . While Teshwave was protected by tribes of orc s , gnoll s and ogre s , Zhentil Keep had a reserve of two to three thousand troops to defend the town .

title: Teshyll
description: Teshyll The ancient city of Teshyll was a center for trade in the old Calim Empire . It was best known for the famous Harem Palace of Calim . Geography .
description_long: Teshyll The ancient city of Teshyll was a center for trade in the old Calim Empire . It was best known for the famous Harem Palace of Calim . Geography . The ruins of the city were found in the Calim Desert near the Trade Way about mid - way from Calimport to Memnon in the region known as the Teshyllal Wastes . Trade . In its day , before the Era of Skyfire , the city of Teshyll served as a central caravan stop for traders and a massive marketplace for the farmers from around the fertile plains of the Teshyllal Fields . The city important goods from the other territories within the genie empire and exported farm produce . History . The city of Teshyll was destroyed by the armies of Memnon sometime during the Era of Skyfire . By 1370 DR , only the corners of a few building remained intact . Notable Locations . The architectural marvel , the Harem Palace , was Calim ' s primary " jhasinnadah " , containing thousands of slaves .

title: Teshyllal Wastes
description: Teshyllal Wastes The Teshyllal Wastes were the desert wastelands surrounding the ruins of the ancient city of Teshyll . Geography . The Teshyllal Wastes were the central region of the Calim Desert .
description_long: Teshyllal Wastes The Teshyllal Wastes were the desert wastelands surrounding the ruins of the ancient city of Teshyll . Geography . The Teshyllal Wastes were the central region of the Calim Desert . Howling noises could often be heard over its barren lands , most likely the calls of the spirits of Calim and Memnon , who were defeated and imprisoned there . History . Once known as the Teshyllal Fields , the Teshyllal Wastes formerly contained lush and productive farms . The city of Teshyll was at its core , serving as a farmers ' market . After the imprisonment of Calim and Memnon in around - 6100 DR , the area grew barren and became one of the most dangerous regions of the Calim Desert . Notable inhabitants . The undead blue dragon Sapphiraktar laired below the Teshyllal Wastes .

title: Teskulladar
description: Teskulladar Teskulladar , also known as Manytalons , was a silver dragon . History . In 947 DR , Teskulladar killed the white dragon Cortulorrulagalargath in a battle above the realm of Calandor , indirectly causing the deaths of the Duke of Calandor and his retinue when the defeated Cortulorrulagalargath fell upon Delimbiyran .
description_long: Teskulladar Teskulladar , also known as Manytalons , was a silver dragon . History . In 947 DR , Teskulladar killed the white dragon Cortulorrulagalargath in a battle above the realm of Calandor , indirectly causing the deaths of the Duke of Calandor and his retinue when the defeated Cortulorrulagalargath fell upon Delimbiyran . In the 14th century DR , Teskulladar meet and fell in love with the song dragon Essembramaerytha . After they married , they traveled together across the Dalelands for many years until the day both disappeared without a trace . There were many legends about what fate befell the two dragons , but the truth was that they simply retired to live in Evermeet .

title: Tessaernil Deirr
description: Tessaernil Deirr Tessaernil Deirr was the star elf lord of House Deirr in the 1370s DR in Sildëyuir . History . In 1374 DR , Lord Tessaernil welcomed back his nephew Nesterin Deirr , who was accompanied by Jorin Kell Harthan and Araevin Teshurr ' s party .
description_long: Tessaernil Deirr Tessaernil Deirr was the star elf lord of House Deirr in the 1370s DR in Sildëyuir . History . In 1374 DR , Lord Tessaernil welcomed back his nephew Nesterin Deirr , who was accompanied by Jorin Kell Harthan and Araevin Teshurr ' s party . Nesterin said they ' d saved his life .

title: Tessalar Hulicorm
description: Tessalar Hulicorm Tessalar Hulicorm was an enterprising wizard in Waterdeep in 1372 DR . Personality . Tessalar was a vain man , with a liking for elaborate dress .
description_long: Tessalar Hulicorm Tessalar Hulicorm was an enterprising wizard in Waterdeep in 1372 DR . Personality . Tessalar was a vain man , with a liking for elaborate dress . He was unwilling to trust anyone , to the point of paranoia . Tessalar had ambitions to form his own noble house . Activities . When he wasn ' t attending parties , Tessalar stayed mostly in his magically fortified house . History . Tessalar was once a mercenary mage , tutoring and casting spells in exchange for treasure , which he spend to finance his magic research . One day , he came back from an expedition into Undermountain with so much treasure that he was richer than any man of his age . The truth was that he stole the hoard of the sleeping black dragon Vulharindauloth . Soon Tessalar established himself as a fixture of the parties in the Sea Ward of Waterdeep , often casting illusions and pyrotechnics for a sponsoring noble . As deduced by many , Tessalar wanted to use his noble connections in order to found his own noble house , but some family patriarchs knew the truth of his ambitions and easily used him to their own ends .

title: Tessaril Winter
description: Tessaril Winter Tessaril Winter , formerly known as Tessar the Mage , was a female human fighter and wizard . Previously an adventurer , she became the lord of the town of Eveningstar in Cormyr . She was beloved as an easy - going and attentive ruler , who used her magic to keep the peace .
description_long: Tessaril Winter Tessaril Winter , formerly known as Tessar the Mage , was a female human fighter and wizard . Previously an adventurer , she became the lord of the town of Eveningstar in Cormyr . She was beloved as an easy - going and attentive ruler , who used her magic to keep the peace . She was good friends and a one - time lover of King Azoun IV , and notably had a tressym familiar . History . Operating under the name " Tessar the Mage " , and disguised as a man , she was formerly a member of the King ' s Men adventuring band . She gained some local fame in this role . She was also once a lover of King Azoun IV of Cormyr , some time prior to his wedding . So she could better serve her beloved village and king , Tessaril retired from the adventuring career , and from the path of a mighty mage . She became Lord Tessaril Winter of the town of Eveningstar in Cormyr , holding this position by 1367 DR . In her time as lord , she was once warned about orc and bandit attacks by Deularla Ithruen . She also once used the Hidden House of the Sword Heralds .

title: Tessarin Alaurun
description: Tessarin Alaurun Tessarin " Longtresses " Alaurun was the witty and beautiful First Speaker of the council and ruler of the beleagured town of Nesmé . Among other things , she was renowned for her collection of magical items . Background .
description_long: Tessarin Alaurun Tessarin " Longtresses " Alaurun was the witty and beautiful First Speaker of the council and ruler of the beleagured town of Nesmé . Among other things , she was renowned for her collection of magical items . Background . Pre - leadership . Before the invasion of the Evermoors by the troll s she was a member of , but not leader of , the town council . Meetings often descended into heated arguments with the former First Speaker , Jygil Zelnathra , a cleric of Waukeen , about the role of religion in government . When Waukeen was captured by Graz ' zt just after the Time of Troubles , Jygil was weakened so much that Tessarin took over as First Speaker . Under Tessarin ' s leadership , she turned Nesmé into a magocracy and eventually took Jygil as her apprentice in the ways of The Art . She planned for Nesmé to rival the city of Silverymoon and to join the Lords ' Alliance . Troll invasions . Tessarin escaped the Troll Invasion of 1370 DR and struggled to rebuild after the damage her city had taken .

title: Tethgard
description: Tethgard Tethgard was an ancient , ruined city located in Hullack Forest . Description . The city was overgrown and mostly composed of isolated pillars , arches , half - arches , and stairs .
description_long: Tethgard Tethgard was an ancient , ruined city located in Hullack Forest . Description . The city was overgrown and mostly composed of isolated pillars , arches , half - arches , and stairs . Inhabitants . The watching spirit of Duskreene , Lady of Tethgard , resided there . She was an ancestress of Mirt . History . The city predated the realm of Cormyr . In the 1360s DR , stories circulated in Cormyr of the ruins of legendary Tethgard , hidden in the depths of the Hullack Forest . These became a draw for adventurers operating out of Thunderstone . In 1479 DR , the ruins of Tethgard were the site of a bloody battle as , after failing to take Elminster , Storm Silverhand , and the Simbul into custody , a group consisting of War Wizard s and Purple Dragon s unleashed their magics on the trio . Defending the three of them with a spell - shield that rebounded his opponents ' spells back at them , Elminster slew or maimed much of the group . The rest retreated .

title: Tethir
description: Tethir Tethir the Dragonslayer was an elven hero and the first elven dragonslayer . Relationships . Tethir was related to the elven hero Keltormir .
description_long: Tethir Tethir the Dragonslayer was an elven hero and the first elven dragonslayer . Relationships . Tethir was related to the elven hero Keltormir . History . Tethir sacrificed his own life to slay two ancient red dragon s living in the Ridge , allowing most of his tribe to escape to the southern reaches of the forest .

title: Tethtoril
description: Tethtoril Tethtoril was the First Reader of Candlekeep around 1367 DR . He is known to be wise and soft spoken . This tall , impressive , wise , and soft - spoken man is often mistaken for the Keeper of Tomes of Candlekeep .
description_long: Tethtoril Tethtoril was the First Reader of Candlekeep around 1367 DR . He is known to be wise and soft spoken . This tall , impressive , wise , and soft - spoken man is often mistaken for the Keeper of Tomes of Candlekeep . He is more intelligent , regal , and sensitive than his superior Ulraunt , by far ; and Ulraunt knows it . Yet Tethtoril is unfailingly loyal , thoughtful , and diligent in his duties , often anticipating troubles and preparing beforehand to spare Candlekeep troubles or Ulraunt any embarrassment . Most Holy Mystra often whispers to Tethoril in his dreams , bidding him to do this or that and in this way has led him to unearth key spells from forgotten tomes ; kept Elminster , Khelben , and the Harpers welcomed or at least , tolerated in Candlekeep ; and kept Ulraunt from being seduced by darker powers ( most recently , Cyric ) . Although he doesn ' t know it , Tethtoril is one of the safest people in all the Realms .

title: Tethyamar
description: Tethyamar The mines of Tethyamar were once home to one of the greatest dwarven communities in the North . Geography . The mines of Tethyamar were very deep , following the long vertical veins of ore that lay beneath the Desertsmouth Mountains .
description_long: Tethyamar The mines of Tethyamar were once home to one of the greatest dwarven communities in the North . Geography . The mines of Tethyamar were very deep , following the long vertical veins of ore that lay beneath the Desertsmouth Mountains . Along these descending ore - veins chains of chambers were constucted that made up the housing , forges , tombs and storage areas of the dwarves of Tethyamar . This design resulted in a far more widespread dwarf hold compared to others of its kind . Trade . Early trade in Tethyamar was primarily with its nearest neighbouring realms . These included Anauria , Asram , Avaeraether , Cormanthyr and Hlondath . After a few centuries its trading connections had expanded to include Cormyr , Hlontar , Myth Drannor , Merrydale , Northkeep and Teshar . With their forged goods , ore and riches , Tethyamar prospered from its ever - growing trade until the founding of Flostren ' s Hold in 747 DR . After Flostren ' s Hold under the sway of a consortium of wizards , known as the Zhentarim , fierce competition between the two mining nations erupted . Defences .

title: Tethyamar Trail
description: Tethyamar Trail The Tethyamar Trail was a trade road that ran the length of Daggerdale . Geography . The Tethyamar Trail started a few miles east of the southern point of Spiderhaunt Wood at the Northride .
description_long: Tethyamar Trail The Tethyamar Trail was a trade road that ran the length of Daggerdale . Geography . The Tethyamar Trail started a few miles east of the southern point of Spiderhaunt Wood at the Northride . It traveled north through the rolling hills of Daggerdale all the way to the town of Dagger Falls , where it joined the Tesh Trail . History . Before human s settled in Dagger Falls , the dwarves of Tethyamar used the Tethyamar Trail to ship metals between their southern and northern holdings .

title: Tethyr
description: Tethyr Tethyr recently emerged from a decades - long civil war ( 1347 - 1369 DR ) with two new monarchs . The strong rule of Queen - Monarch Zaranda Star Rhindaun and King Haedrak III ( who formerly served the great Elminster of Shadowdale as a scribe under the name of " Lhaeo " ) began to restore hope to a cynical , suspicious , war - torn land . Tethyr was a growing nation , establishing ties with hesitant neighbors , and driving monsters from its lands .
description_long: Tethyr Tethyr recently emerged from a decades - long civil war ( 1347 - 1369 DR ) with two new monarchs . The strong rule of Queen - Monarch Zaranda Star Rhindaun and King Haedrak III ( who formerly served the great Elminster of Shadowdale as a scribe under the name of " Lhaeo " ) began to restore hope to a cynical , suspicious , war - torn land . Tethyr was a growing nation , establishing ties with hesitant neighbors , and driving monsters from its lands . There continued to be much suspicion in the land , especially towards organizations that admitted to meddle in the affairs of others , such as the benevolent Harpers or sinister Zhentarim . Tethyr ' s large forests were home to a population of wood elves , who were ever wary of human rulers wishing to tame their forest with torch and axe . Tethyr was bordered to the north by Amn and to the south by Calimshan , while the pirates of the Nelanther Isles harried the kingdom ' s maritime commerce , such as trade vessels bound for far - off Maztica . As of 1479 DR , the rulers of Tethyr were Queen Cyriana and King Errilam . They had a daughter , the Princess Zandra , who was also one of the Court Vizeras , along with Mynda .

title: Tethyr Mills
description: Tethyr Mills The Tethyr Mills , located just outside the walls of Myratma along the River Ith , was one of the largest textile mills in all of Faerûn . It produced some of the best silks outside of Kara - Tur as well as popular waterproof canvases for tents and sails . The silks were the first choice for fine clothiers in Calimshan and Amn .
description_long: Tethyr Mills The Tethyr Mills , located just outside the walls of Myratma along the River Ith , was one of the largest textile mills in all of Faerûn . It produced some of the best silks outside of Kara - Tur as well as popular waterproof canvases for tents and sails . The silks were the first choice for fine clothiers in Calimshan and Amn .

title: Tethyrian Interregnum
description: Tethyrian Interregnum The Interregnum was a pivotal time in Tethyr ian history , when plots and assassinations and riots destabilized the entire country . History . A number of wizard s and their mercenary armies invaded Tethyr in 1333 DR attempting to create a new nation , which they would call Mulsparkh .
description_long: Tethyrian Interregnum The Interregnum was a pivotal time in Tethyr ian history , when plots and assassinations and riots destabilized the entire country . History . A number of wizard s and their mercenary armies invaded Tethyr in 1333 DR attempting to create a new nation , which they would call Mulsparkh . Unknown to them , they were sponsored by Calimshan ' s syl - pasha Rashid yn Yusef el Djenispool and king Alemander IV of Tethyr who were hoping to kill Alemander ' s brother , the paladin - prince Rythan . Unbeknownst to either ruler , they were both doing the dirty work of the Twisted Rune who wanted revenge against prince Rythan for killing Jhaniloth Puiral . Rythan led a small army to meet Mulsparkh ' s the next year but Mulsparkh ' s mercenary armies , consisting of humanoid s as well as men , destroyed Tethyr ' s force and killed Rythan in a battle known as the Battle of Nightflames . Objective complete , syl - pasha Rashid and the Rune ceased their covert support of Mulsparkh , whose armies quickly deserted , whereupon troops from Memnon annihilated any who remained , putting an end to the short - lived realm .

title: Teuveamanthaar
description: Teuveamanthaar Teuveamanthaar was the capital of Eaerlann . History . It was founded in −4550 DR among the ruins of Aryvandaar in the northern and eastern sections of the High Forest .
description_long: Teuveamanthaar Teuveamanthaar was the capital of Eaerlann . History . It was founded in −4550 DR among the ruins of Aryvandaar in the northern and eastern sections of the High Forest . It was built on a steep - sided ridge among tall oak trees . The dwellings were said to be constructed in the trees themselves among the hollows and branches . In the Year of the Curse , 882 DR , Eaerlann fell as a result of the fall of Hellgate Keep to demon s and this city was abandoned . However , followers of Mielikki , druid s , took refuge in a fraction of the city and secured it against orc s and demons . Later , the settlement was known as Tall Trees and the inhabitants were the Druids of Tall Trees .

title: Tevish Malacont
description: Tevish Malacont Tevish Malacont was a member of Cult of the Dragon in the Vast before 1489 DR . Personality . Tevish believed that Throstulgrael had killed him and he was being punished for his life of evil .
description_long: Tevish Malacont Tevish Malacont was a member of Cult of the Dragon in the Vast before 1489 DR . Personality . Tevish believed that Throstulgrael had killed him and he was being punished for his life of evil . History . Tevish was a cultist in the Flooded Forest where he was kidnapped by the black dragon Throstulgrael . He was transported to the dragon ' s new lair in Twilight Marsh and heavily tortured . There , totally insane , he was found by an adventuring party sent to recover some items from the dragon ' s lair .

title: Tewacha
description: Tewacha Tewacha was the fabled city of the gods located in the southern House of Tezca desert in Maztica . In approximately 350 DR , the gods desired a location for a battle they intended to fight so they commanded their human subjects to construct a great pyramid . The pyramid was over six hundred feet high and even in 1361 DR it remained in pristine condition .
description_long: Tewacha Tewacha was the fabled city of the gods located in the southern House of Tezca desert in Maztica . In approximately 350 DR , the gods desired a location for a battle they intended to fight so they commanded their human subjects to construct a great pyramid . The pyramid was over six hundred feet high and even in 1361 DR it remained in pristine condition . Although legend held that humans never dwelt in Tewacha , there was evidence of human habitation of the city , including tombs .

title: Texter
description: Texter Texter the Paladin was a Masked Lord of Waterdeep . Description . Texter had a powerful build , ruddy face , and a thick brown mustache .
description_long: Texter Texter the Paladin was a Masked Lord of Waterdeep . Description . Texter had a powerful build , ruddy face , and a thick brown mustache . Personality . Texter had little love for the city and spent much of his time in the wilderness battling monsters . He disliked intrigue and politics , especially among the clerics in the Hall of Justice . Residence . When in the city , Texter dwelt in the Guard Barracks . Relationships . Texter had a horse named Galadin .

title: Teyla Shan
description: Teyla Shan Teyla Shan , or the Godswatch Mountains , formed much of the border of eastern Semphar , essentially separating the country from the vast plains of the Hordelands . Geography . Teyla Shan ran roughly north to south from the River Estan in the north to the pass of Howling Gap in the south .
description_long: Teyla Shan Teyla Shan , or the Godswatch Mountains , formed much of the border of eastern Semphar , essentially separating the country from the vast plains of the Hordelands . Geography . Teyla Shan ran roughly north to south from the River Estan in the north to the pass of Howling Gap in the south . Description . One of the mountain range ' s most prominent peaks , Shan Karsha , was found in the southeast region overlooking the Silk Road .

title: Tezca
description: Tezca Tezca was the chaotic evil god of the sun and fire in Maztica . He was the live - giving force of heat and sunlight . Description .
description_long: Tezca Tezca was the chaotic evil god of the sun and fire in Maztica . He was the live - giving force of heat and sunlight . Description . He was pictured as a giant humanoid with orange skin and a face surrounded by flames . His hair was a mass of smoke that trailed behind him as he moved . Anything that touched him promptly burst into crackling flames . Worship . He was well - worshiped under the Kultaka ns and his influence there was even greater than Zaltec ' s . But he was important to all Mazticans , since he brought life and warmth to the world and , to a minor degree , the heat needed to cook meals . Tezca was ever - hungry and needed regular sacrifices . Like Zaltec , he preferred the fresh hearts of human s . His priests needed to make such a sacrifice at each sunset to assure that he came back the following day . His priests had major access to the spheres of Elemental , Sun , and Combat spheres of influence . During the sunlight hours they could also employ major access to the Weather sphere and they received minor access to the spheres of hishna , Animals , Divination and Guardian spells .

title: Teziir
description: Teziir Teziir is the largest free city on the coast of the Dragonmere . Teziir is an independent trade city , attempting to displace Westgate as the principal trade city for goods traveling from the Sword Coast to the Inner Sea . The city is still considered a frontier town by most people .
description_long: Teziir Teziir is the largest free city on the coast of the Dragonmere . Teziir is an independent trade city , attempting to displace Westgate as the principal trade city for goods traveling from the Sword Coast to the Inner Sea . The city is still considered a frontier town by most people . Its growth has been haphazard . Very few roads run straight for any considerable distance . There is also a considerable population that lives outside the town in shacks and tents . They provide many services , both legal and illegal , to the inhabitants of the city proper . Teziir has never been involved in an actual war , though it does suffer from brutal pirate raids . Government . Teziir is a trade city , run like a business by a council of merchants . This council ' s membership consists of many of the same men and women who founded the city and they run the city like it is their own personal property . These merchants have hired a variety of people to administer , guard , and otherwise service the city and they treat them like employees , dismissing them if they don ' t produce results . Religion .

title: Thaalis
description: Thaalis Thaalis was a lizardfolk cleric of Semuanya . She resided in the mines below Baeniff Tor in the Evermoors where she sacrificed victims to a giant crocodile , Kheshebik , who she and the Khoroshen tribe of lizardfolk believed to be an avatar of the deity Semuanya . Appearance .
description_long: Thaalis Thaalis was a lizardfolk cleric of Semuanya . She resided in the mines below Baeniff Tor in the Evermoors where she sacrificed victims to a giant crocodile , Kheshebik , who she and the Khoroshen tribe of lizardfolk believed to be an avatar of the deity Semuanya . Appearance . Thaalis ' scales were green and yellow . She had a large scar on her face and the end of her tail was missing . Possessions . Thaalis wore crocodile hide armor reinforced with parts of chain mail and plate mail . She wielded a club adorned with the vertebrae from crocodiles .

title: Thabort
description: Thabort Thabort ( THAH - bort ) was a dice game popular in the Dragon Reach region of Faerûn . It was a quick game that only required two six - sided dice and whatever coins players cared to wager . It was favored by guards and those in similar situations where there was not much to do until something happened that required immediate attention .
description_long: Thabort Thabort ( THAH - bort ) was a dice game popular in the Dragon Reach region of Faerûn . It was a quick game that only required two six - sided dice and whatever coins players cared to wager . It was favored by guards and those in similar situations where there was not much to do until something happened that required immediate attention . Rules . The object of the game was to roll a " spread " , meaning the numbers one through six , in six throws of the dice or fewer . The dice were counted separately , not added together . The ante , which all players had to put up before each round , was typically a few copper s . The person in possession of the dice made two throws , remembering what numbers showed , and then paused for the other players to place bets on how many more throws it would take to make a spread ( one to four rolls ) . If the dice roller achieved a spread in a total of six throws or fewer , he or she got half the pot . Betters who successfully guessed how many rolls it took to get the spread divided the other half of the pot .

title: Thaeron
description: Thaeron Thaeron ( also known later as Durthar Morgath ) was a swordmaster who was employed by Lord Elmaer Oraun of Harrowdale during his reign for around five years between 1175 and 1185 DR ( sources are not precise with dates ) . He died in the second inter - dale war in 1356 DR . History .
description_long: Thaeron Thaeron ( also known later as Durthar Morgath ) was a swordmaster who was employed by Lord Elmaer Oraun of Harrowdale during his reign for around five years between 1175 and 1185 DR ( sources are not precise with dates ) . He died in the second inter - dale war in 1356 DR . History . During the reign of Elmaer Oraun over Harrowdale , Thaeron was swordmaster . He disappeared , along with Elmaer and Elmaer ' s son Eramonn , during the Battle of Marak ' s Stile , in which Halvan the Dark seized control of Harrowdale , and it was rumoured that elven magic had prevented their deaths . Some fifty years later , traders reported seeing Thaeron along with Elmaer Oraun in Elventree , escorting an elven " great lady " , appearing not to have aged at all . In 1351 DR , " fey blue mage - fire " was seen above a farm on a hill in Harrowdale , owned by three brothers , Torstan , Ulbaern and Durthar Morgath from Sembia . The next morning , the wizard Arauntan of Selgaunt reports that despite the brothers walking and talking in the same way , their appearances had become those of Erammon Oraun , Elmaer Oraun , and Thaeron .

title: Thaerun Blackryn
description: Thaerun Blackryn Thaerun Blackryn was a member of Zhentil Keep ' s Council of Lords in 1368 DR . Personality . Thaerun look more like Lord Chess ; he was a cunning man but short - sight in his decisions , always fearing retribution from more ambitious and powerful Lords .
description_long: Thaerun Blackryn Thaerun Blackryn was a member of Zhentil Keep ' s Council of Lords in 1368 DR . Personality . Thaerun look more like Lord Chess ; he was a cunning man but short - sight in his decisions , always fearing retribution from more ambitious and powerful Lords . History . Thaerun was an able merchant , from one of the most ancient families in the Council ( his ancestor was a wizard companion of Zhentar ) . Thank to his Council ' s dealing he gained a consistent wealth . He usually vote with the majority .

title: Thagdal
description: Thagdal Thagdal was non - member of the Zhentarim who operated a small and local wizard ' s guild within the Tower of the Art in Zhentil Keep . He was a mousy , easily flustered individual who possessed a sharp mind and was always interested about the goings - on within the city . Despite this , he and his colleges within the wizard ' s guild tried to maintain a low profile , although Fzoul Chembryl always kept a close eye on them .
description_long: Thagdal Thagdal was non - member of the Zhentarim who operated a small and local wizard ' s guild within the Tower of the Art in Zhentil Keep . He was a mousy , easily flustered individual who possessed a sharp mind and was always interested about the goings - on within the city . Despite this , he and his colleges within the wizard ' s guild tried to maintain a low profile , although Fzoul Chembryl always kept a close eye on them . History . Thagdal started in magic career in the Zhentarim as apprentice of Sememmon and soon became a troubleshooter for Manshoon Somehow Thagdal managed to exit from the Zhentarim and started his mage guild . He was a loyal supporter of Orgauth until his death

title: Thaglar Xundorn
description: Thaglar Xundorn Thaglar Xundorn was a duergar smith in Skullport and Laird of Sargauthan Hold . Personality . Thaglar ' s title , bestowed on his father by the Deep King of Gracklstugh , granted him the loyalty of most of Skullport ' s duergar , especially those of Clan Xundorn .
description_long: Thaglar Xundorn Thaglar Xundorn was a duergar smith in Skullport and Laird of Sargauthan Hold . Personality . Thaglar ' s title , bestowed on his father by the Deep King of Gracklstugh , granted him the loyalty of most of Skullport ' s duergar , especially those of Clan Xundorn . History . Around 1370 DR , Thaglar was the proprietor of the only forge in the Port of Shadow and the lead authority among the duergar . One of their objectives was to check rumors of a mithral vein under Sargauth Enclave .

title: Thakorsil
description: Thakorsil Thakorsil was an archmage who seized power in the ancient kingdom of Yhalvia , which was part of the empire of Narfell ( −946 DR to −150 DR ) . History . Yhalvia had been ruled by the baatezu devil lord Orlex , and his reign was naturally cruel , depraved , and wicked .
description_long: Thakorsil Thakorsil was an archmage who seized power in the ancient kingdom of Yhalvia , which was part of the empire of Narfell ( −946 DR to −150 DR ) . History . Yhalvia had been ruled by the baatezu devil lord Orlex , and his reign was naturally cruel , depraved , and wicked . Thakorsil led a band of rebellious wizard s to depose Orlex . To do so , they created the throne known as " Thakorsil ' s Seat " to imprison and permanently bind and enslave the evil fiend . Unfortunately , although they had the best of intentions , the device demanded deeds of despicable evil to function . Thus , they devised the " ritual of twin burnings " , which involved the sacrifice of beings of good heart , believing this was for the greater good , that the ends justified the means . They went ahead with the horrific rites , and successfully bound and enslaved Orlex in the " Seat " , They then formed a council of wizards to govern Yhalvia . However , corrupted by the sacrifices and with Orlex as their slave , Thakorsil and the rest soon became as cruel , depraved , and wicked as the devil they had replaced .

title: Thakorsil ' s Seat
description: Thakorsil ' s Seat Thakorsil ' s Seat was a powerful minor artifact that had the power to completely bind and enslave those who sat upon it . Constructed in the ancient kingdom of Yhalvia in Narfell to yoke a devil lord , it found its way into the possession of Larloch , the Shadow King of Warlock ' s Crypt . He gave it to Szass Tam , Zulkir of Necromancy , for his plot to control the demon lord Eltab and take over Thay .
description_long: Thakorsil ' s Seat Thakorsil ' s Seat was a powerful minor artifact that had the power to completely bind and enslave those who sat upon it . Constructed in the ancient kingdom of Yhalvia in Narfell to yoke a devil lord , it found its way into the possession of Larloch , the Shadow King of Warlock ' s Crypt . He gave it to Szass Tam , Zulkir of Necromancy , for his plot to control the demon lord Eltab and take over Thay . However , use of the dread " Seat " had a terrible cost : it required mages of good heart to be sacrificed and destroyed body and soul in the " ritual of twin burnings " . Their essence fueled the creation of the runes of chaos and a nine - sided crystalline pyramid , which progressively eroded , bound the occupant of the " Seat " to the will of its owner . Operated by such rites , " Thakorsil ' s Seat " was a device of great evil and corrupting influence . Description . " Thakorsil ' s Seat " was a massive and elaborate throne carved of dark veined stone . It had a keyhole - carved back , its arms were in the form of the neck and head of snarling dragon s and each foot was a draconic claw clutching a sphere . Powers .

title: Thalaman Harthgroth
description: Thalaman Harthgroth Thalaman Harthgroth was the grizzled leader of the nomadic Harthgroth tribe and head of the tribal council that ruled over the land of Narfell . He viewed outsiders amiably , preferring to trade with them rather than pursuing endless fights . As such , his influence led the Harthgroth tribe to be far less hostile then the neighboring tribes .
description_long: Thalaman Harthgroth Thalaman Harthgroth was the grizzled leader of the nomadic Harthgroth tribe and head of the tribal council that ruled over the land of Narfell . He viewed outsiders amiably , preferring to trade with them rather than pursuing endless fights . As such , his influence led the Harthgroth tribe to be far less hostile then the neighboring tribes .

title: Thalantyr
description: Thalantyr Thalantyr was a wizard , specialized in conjuration , and a former adventurer who lived in his house called High Hedge , northwest of Beregost . Personality . Later retired , Thalantyr was more at home helping others through magic or advice for a fee .
description_long: Thalantyr Thalantyr was a wizard , specialized in conjuration , and a former adventurer who lived in his house called High Hedge , northwest of Beregost . Personality . Later retired , Thalantyr was more at home helping others through magic or advice for a fee . He appeared to never want to see his old adventuring partners again and enjoyed a quiet life . Most of the time , the wizard was happy walking outside alone , not welcoming visitors , nor accepting apprentices . Possessions . The noble archmage owned a long dark staff of power and took it on all his trips , whether it was to the town of Beregost or to a distant plane . History . Long ago , Thalantyr was an treasure hunter who quested for the lost magic of Netheril in desolate fortresses and keeps . On one such journey , the wizard appeared to have been captured by a horrid beast and only escaped through his quick thinking and the forgotten spells of Netheril . Appendix . Appearances . In the " Baldur ' s Gate computer game " , Thalantyr can be found in High Hedge where the player can purchase spell s and magic item s from him , or sell him skulls for money .

title: Thalart
description: Thalart Thalart was a malaugrym in 1358 DR . History . In 1358 DR , Thalart was plotting to usurp the position of the Shadowmaster Supreme Dhalgrave .
description_long: Thalart Thalart was a malaugrym in 1358 DR . History . In 1358 DR , Thalart was plotting to usurp the position of the Shadowmaster Supreme Dhalgrave . For this , he tried to kill Elminster Aumar in Shadowdale early in the Time of Troubles but was instead destroyed by El .

title: Thalder
description: Thalder Thalder was a member of the Cult of the Dragon in 1489 DR . History . Thalder was a Cult member of the traditionalist faction .
description_long: Thalder Thalder was a member of the Cult of the Dragon in 1489 DR . History . Thalder was a Cult member of the traditionalist faction . He was the main cultist delegate to the great dragon Claugiyliamatar of Kryptgarden Forest . He was killed during one of the skirmishes with an adventuring party hired to defeat Old Gnawbones .

title: Thaleste
description: Thaleste Thaleste was a female drow novice priestess of Eilistraee . History . Thaleste was born in Menzoberranzan as a member of a noble house .
description_long: Thaleste Thaleste was a female drow novice priestess of Eilistraee . History . Thaleste was born in Menzoberranzan as a member of a noble house . However , around 1373 DR , she angered her matron mother , who then poisoned Thaleste . She barely survived and escaped , going to Skullport in search of a cure . However , Thaleste took a wrong turn and blundered into the Promenade of the Dark Maiden . There she was healed and decided to join the Church of Eilistraee . In 1375 DR , she was with the Darksong Knight Cavatina Xarann in her first patrol duty on the eastern fringes of the promenade . During the patrol , while Cavatina was busy with a spellgaunt , Thaleste was attacked by an aranea cleric of Selvetarm . Cavatina however managed to arrive in time to save Thaleste ' s life . Later , Thaleste went back to check the place of the attack and found a secret passage . She followed it without telling this to anyone , and while inside she was attacked and killed by a carrion crawler .

title: Thalia
description: Thalia Thalia was a member of the Rogues of Tilverton in 1357 DR . History . In 1357 DR , the Guildmaster Artur Grossman ordered Thalia , disguised as a servant , to escort out of the Rogues ' hideout an adventuring party possessing the Azure Bonds .
description_long: Thalia Thalia was a member of the Rogues of Tilverton in 1357 DR . History . In 1357 DR , the Guildmaster Artur Grossman ordered Thalia , disguised as a servant , to escort out of the Rogues ' hideout an adventuring party possessing the Azure Bonds . In that moment , a group of mercenaries attacked them and Artus led his men in battle . Personality . Thalia was unhappy about Guildmaster Artur ' s sexism , but considered him a good guy .

title: Thallastam
description: Thallastam Thallastam was a Chondathan human man of the Vast of the 6th century DR . He was a famous expert in magical swords , a practitioner of the Sublime Way , and a Jade Phoenix mage . History .
description_long: Thallastam Thallastam was a Chondathan human man of the Vast of the 6th century DR . He was a famous expert in magical swords , a practitioner of the Sublime Way , and a Jade Phoenix mage . History . Thallastam hailed from the city of Procampur in the Vast . In his youth , he visited Kara - Tur and studied there for a while before returning to his homeland . There , he founded the Nine Swords Company , consisting of ten blade magic ians : four crusader s ; five warblades ; and himself , a swordsage . They adventured through the Vast , performing good deeds and slaying dangerous monsters . When they eventually disbanded , Thallastam concealed his companions ' nine sword s in Swords Pool using a spell he ' d cast , to protect and preserve them . He returned to Procampur and became a famous sage , specializing in magical swords and amassing a collection of blades . Therefore , a peddler from a neighboring town sold Thallastam a certain unidentified sword for 1500 gold piece s . In the Year of the Zealous , 550 DR , Thallastam set out and took the blade to a fellow sage and expert in swords , and the only person that he could trust with his find , Elminster of Shadowdale .

title: Thallos el Bhirax
description: Thallos el Bhirax Thallos yn Sarsor el Bhilax yi Almraiven was a Calishite weaponsmaster and a member of the Knights of the Shield in 1370 DR . History . Thallos inherited his position in the Knights from his grandfather , Tahir el Bhirax .
description_long: Thallos el Bhirax Thallos yn Sarsor el Bhilax yi Almraiven was a Calishite weaponsmaster and a member of the Knights of the Shield in 1370 DR . History . Thallos inherited his position in the Knights from his grandfather , Tahir el Bhirax . However , Tahir ' s son , Sarsor yn Tahir el Bhirax became a crazed cultist of Umberlee , losing all his money in devotion to the Sea Bitch . So Tahir transferred the Knights ' position to Sarsor ' s son , Thallos . Thallos fled his home city , and after a time as an adventurer , settled in Keltar , gaining a name as weaponsmaster for the Laamil clan . A series of good business deals made together with his employer and friend Amhir Rabi el Lammil gave Thallos for the first time the will to use his Knights ' connections for more lucrative business dealings .

title: Thalto Bresmer
description: Thalto Bresmer Thalto Bresmer was a traveling merchant based in Telflamm , Thesk . He covered in the Dragon Reach area , including the Moonsea and the Dalelands . Abilities .
description_long: Thalto Bresmer Thalto Bresmer was a traveling merchant based in Telflamm , Thesk . He covered in the Dragon Reach area , including the Moonsea and the Dalelands . Abilities . Thalto was an expert in fine furniture , ornate hardware for doors ( locks , handles , and hinges ) , and hardstones in quantity , used in wall decorations and wood furniture inlays . History . He was known to stay at the Whistling Wizard inn when passing through Voonlar . He called it " The most comfortable bad inn it has ever been my pleasure to stay in — quiet if shabby comfort , privacy if one desires it , and much entertainment if one does not . "

title: Thalynsar
description: Thalynsar Thalynsar was an illithilich wizard and was once a leader of the illithid city of Ch ' Chitl in the Northdark of the Underdark . History . Thalynsar was an ulitharid in Ch ' Chitl in the mid – 13th century DR when a raiding party of githyanki assaulted the city and mortally wounded the elder brain .
description_long: Thalynsar Thalynsar was an illithilich wizard and was once a leader of the illithid city of Ch ' Chitl in the Northdark of the Underdark . History . Thalynsar was an ulitharid in Ch ' Chitl in the mid – 13th century DR when a raiding party of githyanki assaulted the city and mortally wounded the elder brain . Taking desperate measures , Thalynsar transformed himself and several other illithid s into lich es so they could devour the elder brain , preserve its knowledge and powers , and take its place . Successful in their endeavor , the illithiliches formed a Conclave of Elders , with Thalynsar as the most powerful among them . He tried to retain much of the elder brain ' s knowledge for him , but the excessive information steadily turned him insane . Nevertheless , Thalynsar ruled Ch ' Chitl for over a hundred years . Finally , around 1370 DR , the other Elders united and were obligated to kill the insane Thalynsar . However , they struggled to lead in his place and divide the elder brain ' s lore .

title: Thamilas
description: Thamilas Throughout the High Desert of Zakhara , particularly north of the Range of the Marching Camels , travelers could encounter depressions in the sand called thamilas . These depressions often held yellowish water that was perfectly safe to drink despite its appearance . Boiling the water was recommended as per drinking any water found in the wild .
description_long: Thamilas Throughout the High Desert of Zakhara , particularly north of the Range of the Marching Camels , travelers could encounter depressions in the sand called thamilas .
