title: The Twilight Tomb
description: The Twilight Tomb The Twilight Tomb is an adventure module set in the " Forgotten Realms " for the 3 . 5 edition of " Dungeons & Dragons " . It was designed by Greg A .
description_long: The Twilight Tomb The Twilight Tomb is an adventure module set in the " Forgotten Realms " for the 3 . 5 edition of " Dungeons & Dragons " . It was designed by Greg A . Vaughan , based on a concept by Bruce R . Cordell , with cover art by Jon Foster and interior art by Marvin Mariano and Steve Prescott . It is designed for 3rd - level characters . Summary . The adventure sees the PCs on an expedition into the Yuirwood of Aglarond , where they discover a passage to the Night Realm , a demiplane splintered off the plane of Sildëyuir , realm of the star elves . Here , they venture into a citadel of glass and are caught between the mad schemes of a corrupted star elf named Mourel Duskwalker , a yochlol sorceress named Savera , and contend with armies of skeleton s and orc and hobgoblin mercenaries and much stranger monsters . The theme is one of weird horror , with bizarre undead and aberration s appearing . The storyline reveals some of the history and culture of the star elves first introduced in " Unapproachable East " , as well as their conflict with the nilshai .

title: The Two Swords
description: The Two Swords The Two Swords is the last book in The Hunter ' s Blades Trilogy by R . A . Salvatore .
description_long: The Two Swords The Two Swords is the last book in The Hunter ' s Blades Trilogy by R . A . Salvatore . Summary . Obould ' s horde has pressed the Companions of the Hall to the very gates of Mithral Hall , where Bruenor Battlehammer and his clan launch a desperate , last - ditch effort to push the orcs back . A desperate rescue attempt succeeds , with Drizzt and Innovindil rescuing the latter ' s pegasus , which Obould had captured and chained as a trophy , and Drizzt is unexpectedly reunited with the Companions that he long thought dead . Drizzt and the surface elf Innovindil bring their quest for the captured pegasus to a conclusion . A few more characters meet their demise in this novel .

title: The Vast
description: The Vast The Vast was a region in north Faerûn that rested along the north coast of the Sea of Fallen Stars , bounded by the Dragon Reach and River Lis in the west ; the Earthspur Mountains , the Gray Forest , and Impiltur in the east ; and the Moonsea and Damara in the north . It lay on both sides of the Earthfast Mountains that ran through it . Over its long history , it was home to the orc nation of Vastar for which it was named ; the ancient elf city of Ylraphon , an outpost of Cormanthyr ; the brief dwarf kingdom of Roldilar , the Realm of Glimmering Swords ; and a variety of human city - states — historic Procampur and Tsurlagol , and the newcomers Calaunt , Tantras , and Ravens Bluff , the Living City — some of which gathered into the nation of Vesperin .
description_long: The Vast The Vast was a region in north Faerûn that rested along the north coast of the Sea of Fallen Stars , bounded by the Dragon Reach and River Lis in the west ; the Earthspur Mountains , the Gray Forest , and Impiltur in the east ; and the Moonsea and Damara in the north . It lay on both sides of the Earthfast Mountains that ran through it . Over its long history , it was home to the orc nation of Vastar for which it was named ; the ancient elf city of Ylraphon , an outpost of Cormanthyr ; the brief dwarf kingdom of Roldilar , the Realm of Glimmering Swords ; and a variety of human city - states — historic Procampur and Tsurlagol , and the newcomers Calaunt , Tantras , and Ravens Bluff , the Living City — some of which gathered into the nation of Vesperin . Environment & Geography . The Vast was a land of great open spaces , sparsely settled but far from empty . Once , it was covered in dense forests , but the orcs of Vastar cut these down , leaving only grasslands and isolated woods . This left a green and temperate realm of hunting grounds and rolling farmlands , their fields used to grow all kinds of crops that suited the climate or for the grazing of herds .

title: The Wanderer
description: The Wanderer The Wanderer was an amnesiac kensai of Kozakura in 1358 DR . History . The Wanderer was at the Battle of Kiroshima .
description_long: The Wanderer The Wanderer was an amnesiac kensai of Kozakura in 1358 DR . History . The Wanderer was at the Battle of Kiroshima . He was one of the few survivors , along with Doin Sanehiro and Kuang , but without any memory of his past , not even his name or if he fought for the samurai or for Jinchin . However , he accepted Doin as his new master and always loyally served him after their meeting . In late 1358 the Wanderer was in Shou Lung province of Chu ' Yuan searching for his missing friend Okotampe Later The Wanderer search for Okotampe in Fochu Peninsula in Wa , the truth location where his friend was missing . Eventually the two met again thank to Osari Minhiro and a foreign adventuring party . Personality . The Wanderer seemed not to care for his past , probably because it was a terrible one . He only wanted to start a new life . He liked moving from place to place and doing things in order to not thinking about his past . If someone of his past appeared , then the Wanderer would surely try to escape .

title: The Warlock King
description: The Warlock King " The Warlock King " was a ballad known in Faerûn , about a warlock king . A few minstrels mistakenly called the ancient lich wizard Larloch " the Warlock " or " the Warlock King " , after the Warlock ' s Crypt where he dwelled , but Larloch apparently took umbrage at being called a warlock . Composers of ballads naming him as such were supposedly kidnapped by creatures in the night and carried away to be tortured and turned into some undead thing by Larloch .
description_long: The Warlock King " The Warlock King " was a ballad known in Faerûn , about a warlock king . A few minstrels mistakenly called the ancient lich wizard Larloch " the Warlock " or " the Warlock King " , after the Warlock ' s Crypt where he dwelled , but Larloch apparently took umbrage at being called a warlock . Composers of ballads naming him as such were supposedly kidnapped by creatures in the night and carried away to be tortured and turned into some undead thing by Larloch . Thus , singing the ballad " The Warlock King " anywhere in three days ' ride of the Troll Hills was not advised , lest Larloch overhear and be displeased .

title: The Way
description: The Way The Way was a faith dominant in Shou Lung , T ' u Lung , and other lands of Kara - Tur . It espoused a philosophy that there were no separate forces of good , evil , chaos , and law , but only interconnected and interrelated forces that followers of the Way could shape . Its followers were divided into a Dark Way and a Light Way .
description_long: The Way The Way was a faith dominant in Shou Lung , T ' u Lung , and other lands of Kara - Tur . It espoused a philosophy that there were no separate forces of good , evil , chaos , and law , but only interconnected and interrelated forces that followers of the Way could shape . Its followers were divided into a Dark Way and a Light Way . Dogma . Adherents of the Way held that all things in the universe were influenced by all other things , and in turn influenced all others . They maintained that there was no good or evil , no chaos or law as in western philosophy , that these were only labels applied by outsiders to fundamental forces of the universe . A follower of the Way endeavored to understand the best way to use and manipulate these forces . Theoretically , this meant the Way should be a wholly neutral faith , yet in practice it was split into two opposing sects : the Dark Way and the Light Way , who conflicted over the best way to use the power to shape these forces . The Dark Way asserted that a superior being was obligated to shape the universe for their own purposes .

title: The Way Inn
description: The Way Inn The Way Inn was a famous landmark on the Trade Way . It stood roughly 100 miles northwest of Dragonspear Castle . Ownership .
description_long: The Way Inn The Way Inn was a famous landmark on the Trade Way . It stood roughly 100 miles northwest of Dragonspear Castle . Ownership . The proprietor of the inn was Dauravyn Redbeard . . Description . It was a large walled compound on the western side of the Trade Way . There were three large gates with gatehouses . Each gatehouse was the size of a small keep . The inn was made of stone with a tile roof and topped with a lookout tower . There were many stone houses that were the residences for the staff and ancillary business of the inn . The inn had a standing guard of 21 warriors . . History . It was rebuilt after an ancient black dragon leveled the structure in 1363 DR . The rebuilding effort was sponsored by several merchant families based in Waterdeep .

title: The Widower
description: The Widower The Widower was a drow wizard who led a group belonging to Clan Auzkovyn . History . Nothing , including his name , was actually known about the Widower .
description_long: The Widower The Widower was a drow wizard who led a group belonging to Clan Auzkovyn . History . Nothing , including his name , was actually known about the Widower . It was suspected that he lived in a Lolth ite - ruled city as a consort to a matron mother , whom he strangled in her sleep . He had been inspired to the murder by Vhaeraun and committed it to leave his city and live among free drow , with whom he had a chance for a position of authority . He escaped with the help of his new patron and managed to hide his name through spells given to him by the Masked Lord ; since then , he called himself the Widower . In 1370 DR , he became the leader of one of the groups belonging to Clan Auzkovyn on the surface . The Widower successfully protected the group from enemies for two years , during which he had a good relationship of mutual support with Jezz the Lame from House Jaelre . During this time , he wrote at least two spellbook s in cooperation with a cleric of Vhaeraun , making both divine and arcane versions of both books . Among them was the " Obsul Ssussun " .

title: The Wight on a Waterdragon
description: The Wight on a Waterdragon The Wight on a Waterdragon was a restaurant in Marsember , Cormyr . It took its name from the sculpture on the roof , shaped into a wight riding a creature like a blue dragon but with fins instead of legs . It was carved in Marsember itself by Jathoom Berl .
description_long: The Wight on a Waterdragon The Wight on a Waterdragon was a restaurant in Marsember , Cormyr . It took its name from the sculpture on the roof , shaped into a wight riding a creature like a blue dragon but with fins instead of legs . It was carved in Marsember itself by Jathoom Berl . The building was formerly used for fish packing and thus still smelled of fish . It was filled with makeshift furniture but enjoyed good business nonetheless . It served Purple Dragon and Shadowdark ales , zzar , and a homebrew liquor known as Harbor Bottom . Food consisted of a choice of cheeses from across the Inner Sea , a seafood pie made with a variety of seafood and potatoes , a selection of sauces , pâté and a selection of roasts .

title: The Winking Wemic
description: The Winking Wemic The Winking Wemic was a gnome - run festhall in Skultan , Sembia , that was in existence in 1368 DR . It was staffed by attractive human females , and was home to underhanded dealings . A rumor existed that Purple Dragon s would permit these dealings to continue , accepting bribes in the form of discounted " services " .
description_long: The Winking Wemic The Winking Wemic was a gnome - run festhall in Skultan , Sembia , that was in existence in 1368 DR . It was staffed by attractive human females , and was home to underhanded dealings . A rumor existed that Purple Dragon s would permit these dealings to continue , accepting bribes in the form of discounted " services " .

title: The Worried Wyvern
description: The Worried Wyvern The Worried Wyvern , also known as the Worried Wyvern Inn or simply the Wyvern , and formerly known as The Wandering Wyvern , was a famous , high - quality inn found in the hamlet of Sevenecho in the Vast . Reputation . The Worried Wyvern was widely considered to be one of the finest inns in the Vast , ranked just behind The Wizard ' s Hand in Maskyr ' s Eye and competing with The Elf in Armor in High Haspur , and was among the best in all Faerûn .
description_long: The Worried Wyvern The Worried Wyvern , also known as the Worried Wyvern Inn or simply the Wyvern , and formerly known as The Wandering Wyvern , was a famous , high - quality inn found in the hamlet of Sevenecho in the Vast . Reputation . The Worried Wyvern was widely considered to be one of the finest inns in the Vast , ranked just behind The Wizard ' s Hand in Maskyr ' s Eye and competing with The Elf in Armor in High Haspur , and was among the best in all Faerûn . For this , it was well known to travelers , merchants , and adventurers of the Vast . History . The Wandering Wyvern , as it was known at the time , was built by the Sevenecho family in the Year of the Wanderer , 1338 DR . At the time , it was only a fairly modest inn , being a simple two - story lodge . It was later re - founded and expanded upon by proprietor and innkeeper Beliot Sevenecho in the Year of the Crown , 1351 DR . Its name became The Worried Wyvern . By 1367 DR , it was one of the finest inns in the Vast , and had grown into a much larger structure .

title: The Year of Rogue Dragons trilogy
description: The Year of Rogue Dragons trilogy The Year of Rogue Dragons is a trilogy by Richard Lee Byers . It covers the calamitous events of 1373 DR , the " Year of Rogue Dragons " . The Rage The Year of Rogue Dragons .
description_long: The Year of Rogue Dragons trilogy The Year of Rogue Dragons is a trilogy by Richard Lee Byers . It covers the calamitous events of 1373 DR , the " Year of Rogue Dragons " . The Rage The Year of Rogue Dragons . Book One Around – 25000 DR , at the dawn of history , both metallic and chromatic dragons ruled over the other races of the world until a circle of elven spellcasters performed an extraordinary work of high magic in their newly built citadel in the northernmost reaches of Toril . The elven magic created the Dracorage mythal : tied to the appearance of the King - Killer Star , the mythal incited the Rage of Dragons , a madness that drove all of dragonkind into mindless destruction as well as turned them against their own offspring . The frenzy caused the kingdoms of the wyrms to collapse and the dragons lost their absolute dominion over Faerûn , allowing the elves and the other races to establish their own independent realms . The powerful Dracorage mythal continued to afflict dragonkind with periodic bouts of madness in order to ensure that wyrms would never take over the world again .

title: The diary of Sarevok
description: The diary of Sarevok The diary of Sarevok told the story of Sarevok Anchev and the events he was involved in before the Iron Throne set the Iron crisis on the Sword Coast in motion and during the iron crisis itself until Gorion ' s Ward stopped the Iron Throne operations in the Cloakwood . The diary was in the possession of Cythandria in the Iron Throne headquarters in Baldur ' s Gate .
description_long: The diary of Sarevok The diary of Sarevok told the story of Sarevok Anchev and the events he was involved in before the Iron Throne set the Iron crisis on the Sword Coast in motion and during the iron crisis itself until Gorion ' s Ward stopped the Iron Throne operations in the Cloakwood . The diary was in the possession of Cythandria in the Iron Throne headquarters in Baldur ' s Gate .

title: The fist
description: The fist The fist is a magic + 1 chainmail gauntlet made from adamantine , created by dwarves . Description . It is covered with spikes and protects the wearer from " chill metal " and " heat metal " .
description_long: The fist The fist is a magic + 1 chainmail gauntlet made from adamantine , created by dwarves . Description . It is covered with spikes and protects the wearer from " chill metal " and " heat metal " . Once a day , the wearer can cause a powerful punch which knocks over opponents . It is worth around 23 , 000 gold pieces .

title: The flaming seas
description: The flaming seas Ganra ye - do , or " the flaming seas " was an area of sea lying south of the southwestern tip of the Koryo Peninsula in Koryo , Kara - Tur . The Muradi Lighthouse at the end of the peninsula was maintained to warn of ganra ye - do .
description_long: The flaming seas Ganra ye - do , or " the flaming seas " was an area of sea lying south of the southwestern tip of the Koryo Peninsula in Koryo , Kara - Tur . The Muradi Lighthouse at the end of the peninsula was maintained to warn of ganra ye - do .

title: The man in green
description: The man in green The man in green was a male human who visited the village of West Harbor on the Sword Coast North in the 1370s DR . History . The man in green was part of Knaves ' Challenge .
description_long: The man in green The man in green was a male human who visited the village of West Harbor on the Sword Coast North in the 1370s DR . History . The man in green was part of Knaves ' Challenge . He held a green feather that needed to be stolen from him .

title: The sun
description: The sun The sun of Realmspace , rarely also called Sol , was an enormous sphere of fire at the center of that crystal sphere , and the source of light and heat of the eight planets circling around it . In fact , the sun was so hot that any closer inspection was impossible for creatures not naturally immune to fire , even if magic al aid was employed . Features .
description_long: The sun The sun of Realmspace , rarely also called Sol , was an enormous sphere of fire at the center of that crystal sphere , and the source of light and heat of the eight planets circling around it . In fact , the sun was so hot that any closer inspection was impossible for creatures not naturally immune to fire , even if magic al aid was employed . Features . The sun ' s surface was made up of varying areas of molten earth and fluid flame , a distinction which only was useful for its fire - loving inhabitants . Some areas called sunspots were somewhat cooler than their surroundings and could be recognized by their darker color . At other places , pillars and loops of flame could violently spurt outward from the sun ' s surface for millions of miles . The surface also featured hundreds of portal s to the Elemental Plane of Fire , allowing access to the natives of that place . Another dreaded feature could be found 40 million miles away from the sun : like balls on the spokes of a wheel , twelve spherical dead - magic zone s with a diameter of 100 , 000 miles each orbited Realmspace ' s central body .

title: Thear Chessar
description: Thear Chessar Thear Chessar was a female shield dwarf rogue in Waterdeep in 1372 DR . Personality . Thear was very clever , using her image as a dwarf to avoid suspicion .
description_long: Thear Chessar Thear Chessar was a female shield dwarf rogue in Waterdeep in 1372 DR . Personality . Thear was very clever , using her image as a dwarf to avoid suspicion . She thieved mostly for the fun and danger of the situation . She kept her thieving under control in order to avoid being discovered . History . Thear was a dwarf of Clan Stoneshaft . Her appearance as a typical dwarf allowed her to be overlooked by pursuers . Relations . She became close to Paerro .

title: Theara Gravelthumb
description: Theara Gravelthumb Theara Gravelthumb was a duergar in the Deep Wastes . History . During the Rage of Demons of 1491 DR , Theara was traveling through the myconid settlement of Sporedome when she was attacked and captured by a group of githyanki servants of the rogue mind flayer warlock Xicvizt .
description_long: Theara Gravelthumb Theara Gravelthumb was a duergar in the Deep Wastes . History . During the Rage of Demons of 1491 DR , Theara was traveling through the myconid settlement of Sporedome when she was attacked and captured by a group of githyanki servants of the rogue mind flayer warlock Xicvizt . Xicvizt killed her and used her body to house one of its intellect devourer s in order to use her as a spy in the surrounding settlements . Personality . Theara ' s mind was no more . The intellect devourer inside her was fanatical loyal to Xicvizt .

title: Thearnytaar
description: Thearnytaar Thearnytaar was an ancient kingdom of green elves created during the First Flowering in - 21400 DR . History . Thearnytaar was drawn into the War of Three Leaves against Syòrpiir and Eiellûr by the actions of assassins and spies from Ilythiir in - 17100 DR .
description_long: Thearnytaar Thearnytaar was an ancient kingdom of green elves created during the First Flowering in - 21400 DR . History . Thearnytaar was drawn into the War of Three Leaves against Syòrpiir and Eiellûr by the actions of assassins and spies from Ilythiir in - 17100 DR . Thearnytaar entered the Crown Wars by allying with Eiellûr and declaring war against Ilythiir after Ilythiir destroyed Syòrpiir with fire in - 11600 DR . The Sable Wars , which began in - 11450 DR , were a series of battles during the Second Crown War . Aided by a few allies from Keltormir and Shantel Othreier , Eiellûr and Thearnytaar invaded Ilythiir , aiming to reform or conquer the dark elves before they destroyed any more realms . Over half their forces were wiped out by the dark elves ' corrupt magic . Around - 11200 DR , the kingdom was destroyed by the dark elf kingdom of Ilythiir during the Second Crown War . As the ages past , the ruins of Thearnytaar were taken over by the Thornwood .

title: Theebles Royuset
description: Theebles Royuset Theebles Royuset was a former merchant and a lieutenant of the Basadoni Cabal , a thieves ' guild in Calimport . He was also the mentor to the young Artemis Entreri until his untimely death . Royuset had bought his position in the thieves ' guild sheerly through money .
description_long: Theebles Royuset Theebles Royuset was a former merchant and a lieutenant of the Basadoni Cabal , a thieves ' guild in Calimport . He was also the mentor to the young Artemis Entreri until his untimely death . Royuset had bought his position in the thieves ' guild sheerly through money . He was physically unfit and gluttonous , but sharp of mind . He was the one who arranged Entreri to be tested and accepted into the guild . After he was appointed his personal mentor , the two quickly grew to hate each other . Ultimately Entreri challenged him to a game of " quarter table " , where each party had a chance of ingesting a lethal poison . Royuset was prepared for this and had taken antivenom , so he agreed . As a result , he died from eating a large amount of ground glass shortly afterwards , Entreri being far more cunning and deceptive than he had expected . The young man was subsequently given his position in the guild .

title: Thegger Grynn
description: Thegger Grynn Thegger Grynn was one of the Red Wizards of Thay at Bloodgate Keep around 1485 DR . History . In 1485 DR , Thegger decided to take control of the Phylund Lodge , with the aid of a tribe of gnoll s and the possessing pit fiend Baazka .
description_long: Thegger Grynn Thegger Grynn was one of the Red Wizards of Thay at Bloodgate Keep around 1485 DR . History . In 1485 DR , Thegger decided to take control of the Phylund Lodge , with the aid of a tribe of gnoll s and the possessing pit fiend Baazka . Quickly , he and his minions took control of the place , from where the gnolls started preying on caravans from Daggerford . Meanwhile , Thegger was busy in his necromantic researches . However , an adventuring party invaded the lodge to stop the gnolls ' raids and confronted and killed Thegger . Personality . Thegger was too scared to betray his masters . He preferred death .

title: Thelarr
description: Thelarr A thelarr was a simple wind instrument cut from a reed . It was considered a rustic longhorn . Description .
description_long: Thelarr A thelarr was a simple wind instrument cut from a reed . It was considered a rustic longhorn . Description . Thelarrs made a characteristic buzzing sound due to the dry fibers inside them . They were very simple instruments to construct , so that skilled bard s made them to give away to children . If purchased through " Aurora ' s Whole Realms Catalogue " , they could be obtained individually or as complete sets that could be played together to form melodies and chords .

title: Theldir Whitemoon
description: Theldir Whitemoon Theldir Whitemoon was a male sun elf psion shaper and an older member of the Kaliesh ' erai , an association of psionic elves in Evereska . Around 1374 DR , Theldir Whitemoon had emerged as the leader of a conservative contingent within the Kaliesh ' erai , older members who preferred seclusion and separation from the outer , non - elven world .
description_long: Theldir Whitemoon Theldir Whitemoon was a male sun elf psion shaper and an older member of the Kaliesh ' erai , an association of psionic elves in Evereska . Around 1374 DR , Theldir Whitemoon had emerged as the leader of a conservative contingent within the Kaliesh ' erai , older members who preferred seclusion and separation from the outer , non - elven world .

title: Theleda Rost
description: Theleda Rost Theleda Rost was a human and was a former member of the Company of the White Star . When the company disbanded , she settled in Waterdeep and used her treasures to run her own tavern , and provision caravans and merchant ships . She was an expert with traps and locks .
description_long: Theleda Rost Theleda Rost was a human and was a former member of the Company of the White Star . When the company disbanded , she settled in Waterdeep and used her treasures to run her own tavern , and provision caravans and merchant ships . She was an expert with traps and locks . Description . Theleda had a pointed chin and a heart - shaped face . Relationships . Theleda ' s daughter is Maresa Rost . History . Theleda was murdered by one of her business rivals in the summer of 1373 DR .

title: Thelgaar Ironhand
description: Thelgaar Ironhand Thelgaar Ironhand was the king of Oman ' s Isle , in the center of the Moonshae Isles . History . In 1345 DR , Grunnarch the Red brought his host of longship s to Thelgaar Ironhand ' s Iron Keep on Oman ' s Isle to prepare an attack on the southern Moonshae Isles .
description_long: Thelgaar Ironhand Thelgaar Ironhand was the king of Oman ' s Isle , in the center of the Moonshae Isles . History . In 1345 DR , Grunnarch the Red brought his host of longship s to Thelgaar Ironhand ' s Iron Keep on Oman ' s Isle to prepare an attack on the southern Moonshae Isles . In the first council of northern Kings and Captains , Thelgaar announced his intention of making long lasting peace with the Ffolk and start a prosperous trading relationship . Most of the warriors that were present did not agree and decided to continue with the plan of raiding and pillaging the cities of Caer Corwell and Caer Callidyrr and the rest of the Ffolk lands . The same night , Thelgar was slain by Kazgoroth who took the identity of the king and carried on with the plan to attack Caer Corwell .

title: Thelia Ondertos
description: Thelia Ondertos Thelia Ondertos was a human woman who owned the Leaping Hart Tavern as of 1479 DR . She lived in the city of Harglast , in the Windrise Ports of Returned Abeir . History .
description_long: Thelia Ondertos Thelia Ondertos was a human woman who owned the Leaping Hart Tavern as of 1479 DR . She lived in the city of Harglast , in the Windrise Ports of Returned Abeir . History . Thelia was an affable middle - aged woman who engaged in idle chit - chat for free , but required her patrons buy a round or two before she opened up to real gossip with strangers . She was good friends with Halagothra the Healer from Tarmalune .

title: Thelorn
description: Thelorn Thelorn was a human man and the proprietor of Thelorn ' s Safe Journeys in Red Larch . Thelorn was a former mercenary who became a skilled wheelwright . He had money invested in not only his business in Red Larch , but also in real estate in Waterdeep .
description_long: Thelorn Thelorn was a human man and the proprietor of Thelorn ' s Safe Journeys in Red Larch . Thelorn was a former mercenary who became a skilled wheelwright . He had money invested in not only his business in Red Larch , but also in real estate in Waterdeep . He was assisted by fifteen , very loyal , skilled carpenters who were all lesser fighters . Personality . Thelorn was grim , yet capable . Rumors . Red Larch locals thought Thelorn had hidden wealth beneath his fortified house . There were rumors that specifically named an undercellar that could only be reached through one of the three chimneys in Thelorn ' s home .

title: Thelorn ' s Safe Journeys
description: Thelorn ' s Safe Journeys Thelorn ' s Safe Journeys is a wagonworks shop owned by the ex - mercenary , Thelorn , in the town of Red Larch . Thelorn ' s Safe Journeys usually has at least a dozen high quality wagons in stock which cost about 150 gold pieces . These ready - made wagons are stored out of the weather under a large shed .
description_long: Thelorn ' s Safe Journeys Thelorn ' s Safe Journeys is a wagonworks shop owned by the ex - mercenary , Thelorn , in the town of Red Larch . Thelorn ' s Safe Journeys usually has at least a dozen high quality wagons in stock which cost about 150 gold pieces . These ready - made wagons are stored out of the weather under a large shed . The establishment will take custom orders , but requires a tenday to complete each special order . Notes . Thelorn ' s Safe Journeys once crafted a seaworthy sloop that also had wheels . It took a whole month to complete and Thelorn charged 4 , 500 gold pieces for it .

title: Thelossa
description: Thelossa Thelossa was a drow werebat who contracted the disease in 1352 DR . She left her home in Maerimydra and since then wandered the Underdark with her two dire bat animal companions . It is thought that she foolishly attacked the party of adventurers who went on to defeat Irae T ' sarran and paid for that foolishness with her life .
description_long: Thelossa Thelossa was a drow werebat who contracted the disease in 1352 DR . She left her home in Maerimydra and since then wandered the Underdark with her two dire bat animal companions . It is thought that she foolishly attacked the party of adventurers who went on to defeat Irae T ' sarran and paid for that foolishness with her life .

title: Thelve Baruinheld
description: Thelve Baruinheld Thelve Baruinheld was a merchant and member of the Six Coffers Market Priakos . Activities . Thelve was one of the original six founders of the merchant company .
description_long: Thelve Baruinheld Thelve Baruinheld was a merchant and member of the Six Coffers Market Priakos . Activities . Thelve was one of the original six founders of the merchant company . He served as their leader as of 1367 DR , working out of his base of operations in Berdusk .

title: Themberchaud
description: Themberchaud Themberchaud was a red dragon allied with the duergar of Gracklstugh in the Northdark of the Underdark in 1370 DR . Personality . Like most of his kind , Themberchaud was vain and proud .
description_long: Themberchaud Themberchaud was a red dragon allied with the duergar of Gracklstugh in the Northdark of the Underdark in 1370 DR . Personality . Like most of his kind , Themberchaud was vain and proud . He was pampered but also restless . He , at the time of Rage of Demons , started to consider conquering the whole city for himself . His ego was so big that he considered it impossible that someone would not agree with his orders . Activities . Like his predecessor , Themberchaud used his fire breath to temper the legendary steel blades of the city in exchange for contributions to his hoard . He was assisted by the Keepers of the Flame , a monastic order of duergar priest / psionicist s who catered to the dragon ' s every whim . History . Themberchaud for long years know that the Keepers were withholding things from him , but rather than demand disclosure he had waited and observed . At the time of Rage of Demons he tried to recruit his personal agents outside the Keepers . Themberchaud didn ' t know that , like other Wyrmsmiths before him , he was doomed to be slain before he grow too strong , replaced by a new red hatchling .

title: Thendara Spearsinger
description: Thendara Spearsinger Thendara Spearsinger was a shield dwarf of the dwarven city of Earthfast in the Earthfast Mountains of north Faerûn in the 14th century DR . She was a captain in the hearth guard , and said to be a fierce fighter . Thendara was the mate of Olam Chistlesmith and the mother of the bard Morgalla the Mirthful .
description_long: Thendara Spearsinger Thendara Spearsinger was a shield dwarf of the dwarven city of Earthfast in the Earthfast Mountains of north Faerûn in the 14th century DR . She was a captain in the hearth guard , and said to be a fierce fighter . Thendara was the mate of Olam Chistlesmith and the mother of the bard Morgalla the Mirthful . From a young age , she taught her to fight with a staff .

title: Thendarion
description: Thendarion Thendarion , also called the Wizard of the Boot , was a man from the city of Tsurlagol in the Vast . He was a wizard trapped in the form of a boot . History .
description_long: Thendarion Thendarion , also called the Wizard of the Boot , was a man from the city of Tsurlagol in the Vast . He was a wizard trapped in the form of a boot . History . Some time in the late 12th century DR ( around 80 years before 1370 DR ) , Thendarion was a wizard who engaged in a spell - duel with another mage . According to tales , his rival was still alive by 1370 DR , and was in fact a Zulkir of Thay , presumed to be Szass Tam himself . Thendarion lost and was cursed to be trapped in the form of a boot forever . In time , Thendarion was able to modify the spells he remembered to gain some freedom . However , sheer boredom had driven him insane . It was unknown how and when he came to Elgath ' s Provisions ( established in the late 1340s DR ) , but he took up residence there and always returned . Shoppers came to think the place was haunted . Volothamp Geddarm wrote of him in " Volo ' s Guide to the Dalelands " . He was still lurking amongst the merchandise in 1370 DR . Powers . A side - effect of Thendarion ' s curse was that he could never forget the spell s he ' d had in his mind when afflicted , but nor could he learn new spells .

title: Thendric
description: Thendric Thendric was a male human fighter and a temple guard at the new Temple of Mystra in Wheloon , Cormyr . Activities . Thendric stood guard in the outer courtyard of the temple , and had a bunk in the guard post outside .
description_long: Thendric Thendric was a male human fighter and a temple guard at the new Temple of Mystra in Wheloon , Cormyr . Activities . Thendric stood guard in the outer courtyard of the temple , and had a bunk in the guard post outside . In early Eleint of the Year of Lightning Storms , 1374 DR , Thendric was questioned by adventurers investigating the temple . Equipment . The temple guards wielded longbow and longsword , and wore scale mail armor .

title: Theod
description: Theod Theod was a female troglodyte barbarian who roamed the Deep Wastes on raids for her tribe . Description . Theod wore studded leather armor and gauntlets on her raids .
description_long: Theod Theod was a female troglodyte barbarian who roamed the Deep Wastes on raids for her tribe . Description . Theod wore studded leather armor and gauntlets on her raids . She typically wrapped herself in a cloak and wielded an oversized morningstar . Personality . She took great enjoyment in battle , especially close - quarters fighting . Theod ' s sojourns were often motivated by the allure of acquiring treasure from those she defeated . Abilities . A fine tracker , Theod was an experienced traveler in the Underdark and was quite good at listening to her quarry ' s movements . In battle , although not overly strong , she was a furious combatant who wielded an oversized morningstar with deadly effect . If needed , Theod could shift her attacks to smash an opponent ' s weapon or intersperse vicious swipes of her claw between her morningstar ' s blows . Despite her barbarian rages leaving her heedless to attacks , Theod could rely on her uncanny reflexes and troglodyte stench to see her through a fight . Possessions . On Theod ' s hunts , she was well - equipped with a number of magic al items .

title: Theoderus
description: Theoderus Theoderus was an eccentric and reclusive dwarven wizard who lived in a small , subterranean sanctum just outside the city of Melvaunt . He spent most of his time fashioning enchantments for items that are brought to him from various clientele . Background .
description_long: Theoderus Theoderus was an eccentric and reclusive dwarven wizard who lived in a small , subterranean sanctum just outside the city of Melvaunt . He spent most of his time fashioning enchantments for items that are brought to him from various clientele . Background . The mad dwarf known as Theoderus was once as Theoderus Stoneblood , a gifted young student at his clan ' s academy . While his clan was renowned for their stonework , Theoderus was lauded with praise for his talent with magic . Despite this , he was an awkward personality that had trouble relating to others . A Red Wizard spy within the academy took advantage of this weakness , luring him with the promising endeavor of new and exciting experiments . This turned out to be a trap , as these experiments , unbeknownst to Theoderus , ended up injuring and killing many dwarves within the community . While he was provided an alibi from the disguised Red Wizard agent , Theoderus chose to exile himself from his homeland . The Red Wizards demanded that he resettle in Melvaunt , acting as an observer of sorts in order that they might establish an enclave within the city .

title: Theodo Greataxe
description: Theodo Greataxe Theodo Greataxe was a dwarf and commander of a small group of other dwarves who made a valiant final stand upon Dead Dwarf Bridge . Activities . In order to give Almorel time to prepare against an invasion from Narfell , Theodo and seven other dwarves blocked their passage across Clearflow Bridge .
description_long: Theodo Greataxe Theodo Greataxe was a dwarf and commander of a small group of other dwarves who made a valiant final stand upon Dead Dwarf Bridge . Activities . In order to give Almorel time to prepare against an invasion from Narfell , Theodo and seven other dwarves blocked their passage across Clearflow Bridge . The bodies of the enemy piled high around the brave combatants , but all eventually succumbed to their injuries . In his final moments , Theodo shattered his magical weapon , Greataxeson , upon the bridge , cracking it in the center , before charging the enemy with only the handle of his weapon . All eight of the dwarves who perished upon the bridge returned as undead to stand guard there for all time .

title: Theodoric
description: Theodoric Theodoric was a cleric of Tempus in the Chondath in 1358 DR . History . Theodoric was the patriarch of Tempus in Chondath and a scholar of the old Chessentan Empire .
description_long: Theodoric Theodoric was a cleric of Tempus in the Chondath in 1358 DR . History . Theodoric was the patriarch of Tempus in Chondath and a scholar of the old Chessentan Empire . In 1358 DR the arcanaloth Yrkhetep manipulated him , making Theodoric insane . Totally mad Theodoric thank to the Staff of Skulls gave to him by the yugoloth rose an undead army and lead them to battle . Theodoric faced in battle the Company of the Singing Dawn , the Llandrydd ' s Steel and Enhanen ' s men . Personality . Theodoric suffered schizophrenia . He in order to use the staff had grew a second personality : an evil cleric from the time of the Chessentan Empire .

title: Theorists
description: Theorists The Theorists was an intellectual group in Mulmaster in 1491 DR . History . The Theorists were a group of friends who indulged in arguing about philosophy , literature , art , and politics .
description_long: Theorists The Theorists was an intellectual group in Mulmaster in 1491 DR . History . The Theorists were a group of friends who indulged in arguing about philosophy , literature , art , and politics . The core members of the group were Thibauld , Eugone , Archill , and Lucianne . They off lived money provided by other members of the group and noble scions : Elred Korsinchev , Orym Illustriana , and Liticia Gos .

title: Thepurl ' s Diamond
description: Thepurl ' s Diamond Thepurl ' s Diamond was a sailing ship on the Sea of Fallen Stars owned by the lich Ebonsoul . History . The ship was attacked and sunk by pirates around the time of the Spellplague .
description_long: Thepurl ' s Diamond Thepurl ' s Diamond was a sailing ship on the Sea of Fallen Stars owned by the lich Ebonsoul . History . The ship was attacked and sunk by pirates around the time of the Spellplague . It came to rest in around 200 feet ( 61 m ) of water . In 1481 DR , the wreck was discovered off the coast of Aglarond by Pericolo Topolino , the halfling guild master of a powerful Delthuntle criminal guild . The choicest treasures were plundered by Pericolo ' s expedition but they unwittingly released Ebonsoul from his imprisonment .

title: Theras
description: Theras Theras was a half - elf druid and the bastard child of a prince . Description . Clad in brown robes and a green cloak , Theras had lengthy brown hair , partially worked into a braid over his right ear .
description_long: Theras Theras was a half - elf druid and the bastard child of a prince . Description . Clad in brown robes and a green cloak , Theras had lengthy brown hair , partially worked into a braid over his right ear . Possessions . Theras owned a magical " hornblade " scimitar , in addition to an enchanted suit of leather armor and a mundane shield . History . Although he was a forest - dwelling druid , Theras was resented by his legitimate half - brother . When Theras ' s forest was burned down by his half - brother , he fled , only to return a decade later . Theras exacted revenge by strangling his brother with the foliage of the regrown forest .

title: Theremen Ulath
description: Theremen Ulath Theremen Ulath was the lord of Deepingdale in 1374 DR . Activities . Responsible for the Dale ' s defense , enforcing laws , and handling diplomatic matters , Theremen always used only the minimum authority necessary .
description_long: Theremen Ulath Theremen Ulath was the lord of Deepingdale in 1374 DR . Activities . Responsible for the Dale ' s defense , enforcing laws , and handling diplomatic matters , Theremen always used only the minimum authority necessary . History . Around 1349 DR , Theremen was awarded the post of lord by the dale ' s council . In 1374 DR , Theremen was contacted by Seiveril Miritar , who explained about his crusade against the daemonfey . Later , together with Haresk Malorn of Mistledale , Ilmeth of Battledale , and Storm Silverhand of Shadowdale , he formally met Seiveril for a high - ranking meeting .

title: Therescales
description: Therescales Therescales was the best wizard - hunter in Luthcheq in Chessenta in 1357 DR . Activities . Therescales was an agent of Jaerios Karanok .
description_long: Therescales Therescales was the best wizard - hunter in Luthcheq in Chessenta in 1357 DR . Activities . Therescales was an agent of Jaerios Karanok . He was a member of the Mage Society ; he always urged them to call foreign wizards to help them against House Karanok , but his true goal was to lead them into a trap . Personality . Therescales really enjoyed betraying people . At heart , however , he was a coward , who would confess anything if his life was threatened .

title: Theriheb
description: Theriheb Theriheb was a paladin of Osiris in Mulhorand in 1357 DR . History . In 1357 , Theriheb went to participate in the tournament held in Mourktar in Threskel to choose the new king .
description_long: Theriheb Theriheb was a paladin of Osiris in Mulhorand in 1357 DR . History . In 1357 , Theriheb went to participate in the tournament held in Mourktar in Threskel to choose the new king . He managed to finish among the tournament ' s finalists . Personality . Theriheb was an honorable man and a fierce warrior . Relationship . Theriheb was a cousin of the current incarnation of Osiris .

title: Therin
description: Therin Therin was the strongman of Pinch ' s thieves guild . Personality . Therin was ambitious and had tried unsuccessfully to become the boss of the gang instead of Pinch .
description_long: Therin Therin was the strongman of Pinch ' s thieves guild . Personality . Therin was ambitious and had tried unsuccessfully to become the boss of the gang instead of Pinch . Pinch would easily sacrifice him if the situation required . History . Therin was a Gur in Elturel . He was working as a " stooge for a fortune - teller " when Pinch recruited him . He suffered many scars from a hangman before the gang saved him . Therin was one of the thieves that followed his boss back to Ankhapur to regain his body . By 1370 DR , Therin had established his own thieves ' guild , the Bloody Scarves , within the city .

title: Therion Gers
description: Therion Gers Therion Gers ( later Therion the First of Gers ) was the human friend of Nether the Younger , one of the earliest rulers of Netheril . When the humans of Netheril began trading with the Earlanni elves , Therion became the first to learn the ways of magic , and after around a year of training , was able to cast the magic necessary to start a fire . Two years later , he had risen to the third most important position in Netheril , after Nether the Younger and the shaman Spiritsummoner .
description_long: Therion Gers Therion Gers ( later Therion the First of Gers ) was the human friend of Nether the Younger , one of the earliest rulers of Netheril . When the humans of Netheril began trading with the Earlanni elves , Therion became the first to learn the ways of magic , and after around a year of training , was able to cast the magic necessary to start a fire . Two years later , he had risen to the third most important position in Netheril , after Nether the Younger and the shaman Spiritsummoner .

title: Theris
description: Theris Theris was the dying king of Mourktar in Threskel in 1357 DR . History . In 1357 , Theris was on the verge of dying without an heir .
description_long: Theris Theris was the dying king of Mourktar in Threskel in 1357 DR . History . In 1357 , Theris was on the verge of dying without an heir . Under the inspiration of his god , he announced a great tournament to choose the new king . The tournament was opened to all men and woman , both human s and half - elves . Relationship . Theris was loved by his army .

title: Theron
description: Theron Theron was a cook in Neverwinter . Personality . Theron did not like human s because he thought they smelled .
description_long: Theron Theron was a cook in Neverwinter . Personality . Theron did not like human s because he thought they smelled . History . Around 1479 DR , Theron was the cook of the Moonstone Mask inn in the Protector ' s Enclave . He also supervised the inn ' s staff .

title: Therus
description: Therus Therus was a leader of the Cult of the Crushing Wave in Mulmaster in 1491 DR . History . Therus established a small chapter of the cult inside a former Zhent watchtower near Mulmaster .
description_long: Therus Therus was a leader of the Cult of the Crushing Wave in Mulmaster in 1491 DR . History . Therus established a small chapter of the cult inside a former Zhent watchtower near Mulmaster . There , in 1491 DR , he met and recruited the Cloak Drayson Fivestars . At last , an adventuring party hired by Salvar Brix , a fellow Cloak of Drayson , defeated him and his minions .

title: Therzt
description: Therzt Therzt , known simply as the Chosen of Ghaunadaur , was a male drow Chosen of Ghaunadaur in Neverwinter . History . In 1484 DR , he was responsible for the transformation of the Blacklake into sludge .
description_long: Therzt Therzt , known simply as the Chosen of Ghaunadaur , was a male drow Chosen of Ghaunadaur in Neverwinter . History . In 1484 DR , he was responsible for the transformation of the Blacklake into sludge . However , an adventurer tasked with purifying the lake discovered and defeated him . Therzt somehow reappeared as captive of the Red Wizards of Thay , in Doomvault . When freed by adventurers working for the Thayan Resurrection , he began babbling that he needed to die for his weakness and cast an Acid arrow spell on himself , dying as he proclaimed his devotion to Ghaunadaur .

title: Thesk
description: Thesk The nation of Thesk was an oligarchy of around 850 , 000 people , inhabited by human s , gnome s , and orc s . The majority of its inhabitants were either merchants or farmers . The Golden Way , the main trade route to Kara - Tur , ran through Thesk , exposing it to a wide variety of cultures and making its people more tolerant than most Faerûnians .
description_long: Thesk The nation of Thesk was an oligarchy of around 850 , 000 people , inhabited by human s , gnome s , and orc s . The majority of its inhabitants were either merchants or farmers . The Golden Way , the main trade route to Kara - Tur , ran through Thesk , exposing it to a wide variety of cultures and making its people more tolerant than most Faerûnians . History . In eons past , the lands of Thesk were once part of the empire of Narfell , but little survived the Great Conflagration that destroyed that empire in - 150 DR . Thesk remained largely empty until Windyn Balindre pioneered the Golden Way trade route to Kara - Tur in 970 DR and immigrants from Impiltur began to settle the land . Balindre and these settlers founded the city of Telflamm in 926 DR . In 1177 DR Princess Delile Balindre declared Telflamm ( and thus all of Thesk ) independent from Impiltur . In 1086 DR , Thay invaded and captured the two southernmost cities of Thesk , Nethjet and Nethentir . Twenty - five years later , in 1110 DR , Thay again invaded , marching on the city of Phent , but this time the combined forces of Impiltur and Thesk defeat the Red Wizards of Thay .

title: Thesk Mountains
description: Thesk Mountains The Thesk Mountains were bare , inhospitable mountains in Thesk that reached as high as 7 , 000 feet ( 2 , 100 meters ) . They featured extremely difficult terrain , and offered a limited amount of iron ore which was enough to supply the nation and provide extra for export .
description_long: Thesk Mountains The Thesk Mountains were bare , inhospitable mountains in Thesk that reached as high as 7 , 000 feet ( 2 , 100 meters ) . They featured extremely difficult terrain , and offered a limited amount of iron ore which was enough to supply the nation and provide extra for export .

title: Theskyn
description: Theskyn Theskyn was the court mage of Athalantar and an old friend and trusted servant of the Stag King Uthgrael Aumar . He tutored prince Cauln Aumar and many magelings sent to Hastarl by the outlying knights of the realm . He died soon after Uthgrael in 217 DR , poisoned by Belaur Aumar ' s agents .
description_long: Theskyn Theskyn was the court mage of Athalantar and an old friend and trusted servant of the Stag King Uthgrael Aumar . He tutored prince Cauln Aumar and many magelings sent to Hastarl by the outlying knights of the realm . He died soon after Uthgrael in 217 DR , poisoned by Belaur Aumar ' s agents .

title: Theskyn ' s hearty heave
description: Theskyn ' s hearty heave Theskyn ' s hearty heave was an evocation spell that created a blast of force . Effects . Casting this spell caused a blast of force to project from the caster , pushing away creatures that may have surrounded them .
description_long: Theskyn ' s hearty heave Theskyn ' s hearty heave was an evocation spell that created a blast of force . Effects . Casting this spell caused a blast of force to project from the caster , pushing away creatures that may have surrounded them . History . This spell was created by Theskyn , a court mage who served the Stag King of Athalantar .

title: Thesophul Wugg
description: Thesophul Wugg Thesophul Wugg was a shopkeeper and transmuter in Skullport . Activities . Thesophul managed a shop that provided adventurers who wanted to explore Undermountain with all they needed .
description_long: Thesophul Wugg Thesophul Wugg was a shopkeeper and transmuter in Skullport . Activities . Thesophul managed a shop that provided adventurers who wanted to explore Undermountain with all they needed . History . In 1370 DR , a great increase in returning , unsatisfied guests convinced Thesophul to hire a minotaur , S ' nogg Mudmane , as a guard , but unknown to Thesophul , he suffered from .

title: Thessaloni Canos
description: Thessaloni Canos Thessaloni Canos was the tharchion of the island tharch of Aloar in Thay . Description . Thessaloni was a tall woman even by Mulan standards .
description_long: Thessaloni Canos Thessaloni Canos was the tharchion of the island tharch of Aloar in Thay . Description . Thessaloni was a tall woman even by Mulan standards . She was quite handsome with a pleasant face , hooded green eyes , and weather - beaten skin . She usually wore scale armor and ornaments of coral , pearl , and scrimshaw . Her skin was also tattooed in an aquatic motif . Her favorite weapon was the trident . Reputation . Thessaloni was considered one of the most capable commanders in Thay . History . In 1385 DR , during the war of the zulkirs , Thessaloni and her men fled to the Wizard ' s Reach and secured both Escalant and Laothkund for the council of zulkirs .

title: Thessaly
description: Thessaly Thessaly was a succubus agent of the demon lord Graz ' zt in Hillsfar in 1491 DR . History . During the Rage of Demons in 1491 DR , Thessaly posed as the recently arrived sister of Davon Malaeda , the closest advisor of First Lord Torin Nomerthal ( in truth , Davon had been replaced by the incubus Ruexohn ) .
description_long: Thessaly Thessaly was a succubus agent of the demon lord Graz ' zt in Hillsfar in 1491 DR . History . During the Rage of Demons in 1491 DR , Thessaly posed as the recently arrived sister of Davon Malaeda , the closest advisor of First Lord Torin Nomerthal ( in truth , Davon had been replaced by the incubus Ruexohn ) . Thessaly seduced Nomerthal and Ruexohn convinced him that he needed to marry Thessaly . So the First Lord organized the First Lord ' s Midsummer Masquerade ballet in order to announce all the wealthiest citizens of Hillsfar of his marriage . As planned , at this point an elf assassin ( in truth , a fiendish doppelganger ) ruined the announcement of the marriage by attacking Thessaly . Ruexohn and Thessaly prepared to escape but an adventuring party hired by Elanil Elassidil to gather intelligence about Hillsfar unveiled them and fought and killed them .

title: Thessar
description: Thessar Thessar the Warrior was a famous former mercenary in 1370 . History . Thessar worked as a mercenary for a long time on the Dragon Coast , having many adventures .
description_long: Thessar Thessar the Warrior was a famous former mercenary in 1370 . History . Thessar worked as a mercenary for a long time on the Dragon Coast , having many adventures . Once retired in Westgate , he settled in a modest house where many young and old mercenaries gathered to listen to Thessar ' s stories . Secretly , he joined the Men of the Basilisk and thanks to his skills Thessar increased the society ' s power in the city . After the turmoil inside the Night Masks in 1368 DR , Thessar and his fellows gained more power but they remained cautious and did not openly challenge the guild .

title: Thestryl Mellardin
description: Thestryl Mellardin Thestryl Mellardin was a pale girl mage and a member of the Harpers in Waterdeep sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . Activities . Thestryl lived inside the City of the Dead cemetery .
description_long: Thestryl Mellardin Thestryl Mellardin was a pale girl mage and a member of the Harpers in Waterdeep sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . Activities . Thestryl lived inside the City of the Dead cemetery . Her duty was to protect one of " teleportation circle s " of Krowen Valharrow ' s network using a shield guardian .

title: Thezz Tlabbar
description: Thezz Tlabbar Thezz tlabbar was a drow warrior of House Faen Tlabbar in Menzoberranzan . Description . Thezz had a good look .
description_long: Thezz Tlabbar Thezz tlabbar was a drow warrior of House Faen Tlabbar in Menzoberranzan . Description . Thezz had a good look . Personality . Thezz always tried to bully people of Houses lowest than him ' s but reluctantly obeyed to those of higher Houses . History . Thezz in 1479 DR was among the people gathered to inspect the lost outpost of Sezz ' ia alongside priestesses Guannerrae Tlabbar , Myaral Tlabbar and Iyelle Tlabbar among others . However Iyelle turned traitor and attacked her fellows , included Thezz during a battle with some monsters . Thezz survived without injures unlike the priestesses so he become the spokesman of the group . He planned to went back to Menzoberranzan . Relationship . Thezz was a favorite of First Priestess Luafae Tlabbar .

title: Thibbledorf Pwent
description: Thibbledorf Pwent Thibbledorf Pwent was the dwarf leader of the Gutbusters of Mithral Hall . Description . Pwent was known for wearing vicious - looking spiked armor .
description_long: Thibbledorf Pwent Thibbledorf Pwent was the dwarf leader of the Gutbusters of Mithral Hall . Description . Pwent was known for wearing vicious - looking spiked armor . He was also known for having never taken a bath . He had an odor so foul that even other dwarves avoided standing too close to him . In one instance , Catti - brie rubbed his head in a fond manner and ended up with a film of stinking filth on her hand . Personality . Pwent was a dwarf of tremendous character ; held in high regards by many of his kin . In his initial arrival at Mithral Hall , Pwent was a thorn in the side of King Bruenor Battlehammer and many others . The berserker was loud , abrasive , and smelly ( because of his intense hatred for bathing ) . However , because of his deep love for King Bruenor and his steadfast loyalty to king and clan , Pwent earned his place as a member of Clan Battlehammer one battle at a time . Thibbledorf was known for his eagerness for and love of battle . He once begged the werewolf Bidderdoo Harpell to bite him so that he could also become a werewolf presumably making him even fiercer in combat and hairier to boot . Bidderdoo wisely refused the request . History .

title: Thief ' s lament
description: Thief ' s lament Thief ' s lament was an alteration spell that protected an area by making it difficult for thieves to practice their trade . Effects . Unless a thief was able to resist " theif ' s lament " , most of the abilities thieves were known for were made much more difficult by this spell .
description_long: Thief ' s lament Thief ' s lament was an alteration spell that protected an area by making it difficult for thieves to practice their trade . Effects . Unless a thief was able to resist " theif ' s lament " , most of the abilities thieves were known for were made much more difficult by this spell . Specifically , picking pockets , hiding in shadows , moving silently , finding and removing traps , climbing walls , opening locks , and even detecting noise were all adversely effected . Priests could protect an area equal to a cube whose sides were 5 ft ( 1 . 5 m ) times the level of the caster . Components . Verbal and somatic components were required to cast this spell , plus the priest ' s holy symbol and a silver key .

title: Thieraven
description: Thieraven Thieraven was a shadar - kai commander in the Lost Refuge in 1374 DR . History . Thieraven was sent by Esvele Greycastle to help Despayr organize his plot .
description_long: Thieraven Thieraven was a shadar - kai commander in the Lost Refuge in 1374 DR . History . Thieraven was sent by Esvele Greycastle to help Despayr organize his plot . He was in charge of the Lost Refuge , where worshipers of Mystra were sent to the Plane of Shadow to forcibly convert them to Shar . Eventually , the plot was ruined and Thieraven was killed by an adventuring party .

title: Thieves ' Patrol
description: Thieves ' Patrol The Thieves ' Patrol was the name given to the group of wandering ghost s that could be spotted in the Battle of Bones . Activities . The ghosts emerged from their resting place on the night of each new moon , only to be trampled again before dawn by the ghosts of those who acidentally killed them centuries ago .
description_long: Thieves ' Patrol The Thieves ' Patrol was the name given to the group of wandering ghost s that could be spotted in the Battle of Bones . Activities . The ghosts emerged from their resting place on the night of each new moon , only to be trampled again before dawn by the ghosts of those who acidentally killed them centuries ago . History . Before the Battle of Bones occurred , a group of men decided to wait out the battle in order to loot the corpses of the fallen . The men gave themselves superficial injuries and lay down to play dead in a natural depression to wait for the battle to end . As fate would have it , the battle raged furiously over the site they chose to hide in , being taken and retaken by both sides of the conflict . All of the hiding men were trampled to death in their pit .

title: Thieves ' cant
description: Thieves ' cant Thieves ' cant was the secret language of rogue s . Uses . This hidden language consisted more of and innuendos more than an actual language .
description_long: Thieves ' cant Thieves ' cant was the secret language of rogue s . Uses . This hidden language consisted more of and innuendos more than an actual language . The main use of thieves ' cant was to communicate rogue activities , such as banditry , burglary , finding marks , and discussing loot .

title: Thieves ' guild
description: Thieves ' guild A thieves ' guild was a guild of organized thieves and rogue s . Most major cities in Faerûn , and some smaller ones , had one or more thieves ' guilds . Some were powerful enough to hold significant political power , which they often obtained through bribery and intimidation .
description_long: Thieves ' guild A thieves ' guild was a guild of organized thieves and rogue s . Most major cities in Faerûn , and some smaller ones , had one or more thieves ' guilds . Some were powerful enough to hold significant political power , which they often obtained through bribery and intimidation . Most local guilds were short - lived groups that revolved around a particular individual . Members of thieves ' guild often served one of the following roles , which were dividied into divisions in larger guilds : assassins , beggars , bounty hunters , burglars , con artists and tricksters , cutpurses and pickpockets , enforcers and thugs , racketeers , scouts and spies , and fences , smugglers , and pirates . title: Thieves ' tools
description: Thieves ' tools Thieves ' tools encompassed a wide array of equipment that aided a prospective rogue during their illicit activities . Many of these items were hand - crafted by the individual who intended to use them , but some were available through local guilds or even from Aurora ' s Whole Realms Catalogue . Description .
description_long: Thieves ' tools Thieves ' tools encompassed a wide array of equipment that aided a prospective rogue during their illicit activities . Many of these items were hand - crafted by the individual who intended to use them , but some were available through local guilds or even from Aurora ' s Whole Realms Catalogue . Description . A typical set of thieves ' tools included a small file , a set of lockpicks , a small mirror , scissors , and pliers , which were meant to assist in picking locks and disarming traps . Possession of some thieve ' s tools was enough evidence for local authorities to invite the rogue for a stay in the dungeon .

title: Thieves Guild of Waterdeep
description: Thieves Guild of Waterdeep Several organizations attempted to claim this title over the many years Waterdeep existed . From 1255 DR , until it ' s near destruction and exile in 1298 DR , the Shadow Thieves were the closest claimant to the title . After 1298 DR , no organization could claim the title and the rise of the Red Sashes in 1311 DR put further pressure on stopping any would be claimant .
description_long: Thieves Guild of Waterdeep Several organizations attempted to claim this title over the many years Waterdeep existed . From 1255 DR , until it ' s near destruction and exile in 1298 DR , the Shadow Thieves were the closest claimant to the title . After 1298 DR , no organization could claim the title and the rise of the Red Sashes in 1311 DR put further pressure on stopping any would be claimant . In 1368 DR , the Xanathar Thieves ' Guild attempted to claim this title but the work of the Red Sashes has severely hampered the Xanathar Thieves ' Guild .

title: Thieving helmet
description: Thieving helmet Thieving helmets were special helmets worn by some rogues . Uses . One of the most important senses to a thief is his sense of hearing .
description_long: Thieving helmet Thieving helmets were special helmets worn by some rogues . Uses . One of the most important senses to a thief is his sense of hearing . Common helmets muffled the ability to hear lock mechanisms or approaching guards , among other things . A thief wanting to protect their head and still be able to hear had the option of wearing a thieving helmet . Thieving helmets were invented by a gnome from Waterdeep . They had special ear canals added to the structure of the helmet that amplified incoming sound to a thief ' s ear . These helmets sacrificed some structural protection in order to make way for the ear canals , but were better than nothing . Prices . A thieving helmet cost 10 gold piece s .

title: Thilren Sohj
description: Thilren Sohj Thilren Sohj was a Zhentarim spy inside the Cult of the Dragon in 1489 DR . History . In 1489 DR , Thilren managed to infiltrate the Cult under the orders of his Zhent masters .
description_long: Thilren Sohj Thilren Sohj was a Zhentarim spy inside the Cult of the Dragon in 1489 DR . History . In 1489 DR , Thilren managed to infiltrate the Cult under the orders of his Zhent masters . He passed to Welsea Parenthe information about the Cult ' s interest in Yarash ' s pyramid . When Welsea and the Lord Sage of Phlan sent adventurers to discover the secrets of the pyramid for them , she also asked the adventurers to extract Thilren if possible . They were too late , however , because Thilren ' s contingent of cultists were all slain in the Quivering Forest by an elven party .

title: Thimblewine
description: Thimblewine Thimblewine was the most notorious fence in Skullport . Activities . Thimblewine was famous for always identifying the real value of items people sold to him and paying only 10 % of it .
description_long: Thimblewine Thimblewine was the most notorious fence in Skullport . Activities . Thimblewine was famous for always identifying the real value of items people sold to him and paying only 10 % of it . His secret was that he used a " medallion of ESP " and a " ring of human influence " , with which he quietly and ruthlessly manipulated those who entered his shop .

title: Thindilar
description: Thindilar Thindilar was a town in the Vast in north Faerûn , located on the Cross Road between Blanaer and Hlintar , and on Blaern ' s Trail between Calaunt and Sendrin . History . Early in the Vast ' s history , before human rule and Thindilar , a flying cloud castle home to cloud giant s was defeated in some magical battle .
description_long: Thindilar Thindilar was a town in the Vast in north Faerûn , located on the Cross Road between Blanaer and Hlintar , and on Blaern ' s Trail between Calaunt and Sendrin . History . Early in the Vast ' s history , before human rule and Thindilar , a flying cloud castle home to cloud giant s was defeated in some magical battle . It crashed in the area and tumbled across the ground , steadily obliterated as it went , causing ground tremors and leaving a trail of destruction . Debris , bits of dead cloud giant , and giant treasures were left scattered across the countryside . Dwarves looted much of the treasure , reworking them into their own artworks . Description . By 1370 DR , Thindilar was a market town populated by artisans and craftspeople . Life there was busy and energetic , and people there had little time for wild tales of treasure and adventure in their vicinity . Rumors . Despite the attitude of the locals , there were stories that some of the cloud giant treasure still lay in the area by 1370 DR , whether buried deep or hovering high in the air , suspended by a lingering trace of the cloud castle ' s flight magic .

title: Thindol
description: Thindol Thindol was a little - known country on the southern coast of the Chultan Peninsula . It was full of grasslands and inhabited by Tashalan s and Chultans of the Thingugh tribe , known for their swift running . Gold dwarves , kuo - toa , and yuan - ti also inhabited the region .
description_long: Thindol Thindol was a little - known country on the southern coast of the Chultan Peninsula . It was full of grasslands and inhabited by Tashalan s and Chultans of the Thingugh tribe , known for their swift running . Gold dwarves , kuo - toa , and yuan - ti also inhabited the region . That latter two races were at war with the dwarves .

title: Thiotar Umbarton
description: Thiotar Umbarton Thiotar Umbarton was a male human cleric of Tempus , the Lord of Battle , in Tantras in the Vast around 1358 DR . Thiotar was High Battlemaster of the House of Glory temple to Tempus at the time . He led sixteen priests and twenty - two lay - followers .
description_long: Thiotar Umbarton Thiotar Umbarton was a male human cleric of Tempus , the Lord of Battle , in Tantras in the Vast around 1358 DR . Thiotar was High Battlemaster of the House of Glory temple to Tempus at the time . He led sixteen priests and twenty - two lay - followers .

title: Thirsty sand
description: Thirsty sand Thirsty sand was a magical sand originating in Zakhara , the Land of Fate , that possessed magical properties similar to " dust of dryness " . Powers . " Thirsty sand " drained water from nearby living creatures .
description_long: Thirsty sand Thirsty sand was a magical sand originating in Zakhara , the Land of Fate , that possessed magical properties similar to " dust of dryness " . Powers . " Thirsty sand " drained water from nearby living creatures . This sand caused excruciating pain from massive dehydration to a single target . The sand would fall into clumps around the victim ' s feet after draining water from them . Additional handfuls of this sand could be thrown at the same target , causing even more harm . A full gallon of water needed to be consumed to replenish the water stolen by the sand . " Thirsty sand " was especially deadly to any water - based creatures .

title: Thlorrog
description: Thlorrog Thlorrog was a mind flayer living in Gauntlgrym in the Underdark in 1484 DR . History . Thlorrog was the leader of a illithid sept that kidnapped many being in order to use as guinea - pigs for their experiment until the Underdark explorer Soren Ravaris send an adventurer to defeat them an to kill Thlorrog .
description_long: Thlorrog Thlorrog was a mind flayer living in Gauntlgrym in the Underdark in 1484 DR . History . Thlorrog was the leader of a illithid sept that kidnapped many being in order to use as guinea - pigs for their experiment until the Underdark explorer Soren Ravaris send an adventurer to defeat them an to kill Thlorrog .

title: Thogaf
description: Thogaf Thogaf was a human wizard who found himself imprisoned in the Fortress of the Five Vultures in Calaunt . Description . Thogaf was a tan - skinned man with long , brown hair , dressed in a green shirt .
description_long: Thogaf Thogaf was a human wizard who found himself imprisoned in the Fortress of the Five Vultures in Calaunt . Description . Thogaf was a tan - skinned man with long , brown hair , dressed in a green shirt . He had blue eyes , and slightly elongated ears . Possessions . Among Thogaf ' s possessions were two ioun stone s : one deep red that made him more dexterous , and one dusty rose that offered him slight protection . History . Whilst imprisoned in the dungeons of the Fortress of the Five Vultures , Thogaf befriended an ancient wizard named Yrlamar . Bereft of his spellbook , Yrlamar was unable to escape , but he was still able to school Thogaf in the field of magic .

title: Thogonia Grim
description: Thogonia Grim Thogonia Grim was a human woman and a priestess of Umberlee in the city of Tsurlagol in the Vast . By 1367 DR , Thogonia Grim was high priestess of Battering Wave temple of Umberlee in Tsurlagol , where she was served by six priests of fanatical beliefs . She was still in charge by 1370 DR .
description_long: Thogonia Grim Thogonia Grim was a human woman and a priestess of Umberlee in the city of Tsurlagol in the Vast . By 1367 DR , Thogonia Grim was high priestess of Battering Wave temple of Umberlee in Tsurlagol , where she was served by six priests of fanatical beliefs . She was still in charge by 1370 DR .

title: Thok Lian
description: Thok Lian Thok Lian was the monarch of Laothan in Malatra . Personality . Thok was more prone to speach than to action .
description_long: Thok Lian Thok Lian was the monarch of Laothan in Malatra . Personality . Thok was more prone to speach than to action . He could make very inspiring speeches but always dithered when the time for action arrived . Thok was totally oblivious in military matters . History . Around 1357 DR , Lian was the leading member of the Thok House , which hoped for a more centralized state . However , Lian ' s indecisiveness alienated to him a third of the Thok supporters .

title: Thokkor
description: Thokkor Thokkor of the Furrowed Mountains was in charge of Huzuz ' s mercenary units . Personality . Thokkor ' s strong sense of discipline snapped the unruly mercenaries serving Huzuz into shape after he assumed command .
description_long: Thokkor Thokkor of the Furrowed Mountains was in charge of Huzuz ' s mercenary units . Personality . Thokkor ' s strong sense of discipline snapped the unruly mercenaries serving Huzuz into shape after he assumed command . Under Thokkor ' s guidance , they became the bravest units in Huzuz ' s military . Activities . Thokkor spent all of his time training three mercenary units . Each had 700 men . He lived in an apartment within the Hall of Commanders in the Palace of the Enlightened Throne . History . Once a slave , Thokkor was bought and freed by Khalil al - Assad al - Zahir in the days before Khalil became the Grand Caliph . The two would often adventure together and grew quite close . Thokkor swore his allegiance to Khalil and offered to serve in the military , eventually rising to command Huzuz ' s mercenary forces .

title: Tholtz Daggerdark
description: Tholtz Daggerdark Tholtz Daggerdark was a sea - captain in Trackless Sea sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . Activities . Tholtz was one of the mad devotee thralls of Slarkrethel .
description_long: Tholtz Daggerdark Tholtz Daggerdark was a sea - captain in Trackless Sea sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . Activities . Tholtz was one of the mad devotee thralls of Slarkrethel . He commanded the Mokroth ship . He believed to be in constant telepathic link with the kraken but in truth he can only received rare and fragmented messages from his master . History . In the late 1480s or early 1490s DR the storm giant king Hekaton was captured by the Morkoth ' s crew posing as Lords ' Alliance agents and Slarkrethel ordered to Tholtz to remained on sea until the resolution of the matter . Behind the Scenes . After Khaspere Drylund ' s confession Slarkrethel decided to destroy the Morkoth with all onboard

title: Thom Reaverson
description: Thom Reaverson Thom Reaverson was a bard and historian of the 1360s DR . Reaverson was the author of " History of the Crusade " in the early 1360s DR , which gave a complete , accurate , and unbiased account of King Azoun IV ' s crusade against the Tuigan Horde in the Year of the Turret , 1360 DR . He also aided the lama Koja on his " Life among the Tuigan " , providing translation and guidance .
description_long: Thom Reaverson Thom Reaverson was a bard and historian of the 1360s DR . Reaverson was the author of " History of the Crusade " in the early 1360s DR , which gave a complete , accurate , and unbiased account of King Azoun IV ' s crusade against the Tuigan Horde in the Year of the Turret , 1360 DR . He also aided the lama Koja on his " Life among the Tuigan " , providing translation and guidance . Koja acknowledged that Reaverson put in an equal amount of work .

title: Thomas M . Costa
description: Thomas M . Costa Thomas M . Costa is a senior analyst with the Government Accountability Office , but in his spare time has written and contributed towards various written works for Wizards of the Coast , including " Demihuman Deities " and " Races of Faerûn " .
description_long: Thomas M . Costa Thomas M . Costa is a senior analyst with the Government Accountability Office , but in his spare time has written and contributed towards various written works for Wizards of the Coast , including " Demihuman Deities " and " Races of Faerûn " . Thomas is also the author of several articles in Dragon magazine .

title: Thomas Raphiel
description: Thomas Raphiel Thomas Raphiel was the Lord Regent of Ravens Bluff from 1345 DR - - ? Appearance . Thomas Raphiel stands 6 ' 2 " and weighs 195 pounds .
description_long: Thomas Raphiel Thomas Raphiel was the Lord Regent of Ravens Bluff from 1345 DR - - ? Appearance . Thomas Raphiel stands 6 ' 2 " and weighs 195 pounds . He looks much younger than his true age . He wears fine clothes and always carries a longsword . Personality . Lord Thomas has a noble bearing and is always charming and persuasive . He enjoys working with foreign dignitaries and can be calm and soothing or forceful and domineering as the need arises . He is very resistant to change and strives to uphold the traditions he was taught . He practices a chivalrous code of ethics and expects others to behave in similar fashion , but more and more frequently he is disappointed . His one weakness is his pride for his family name and he will not hear anyone slander the honor of the Raphiel clan or he is likely to challenge them to a duel . Background . Thomas was raised for a life of nobility and service , educated in history , literature , and warfare as well as the social graces . His family is an old one with deep - rooted traditions and he claims his ancestors once governed the lands Ravens Bluff now occupies .

title: Thomdor Ammaeth
