description: Thomdor Ammaeth Baron Thomdor Ammaeth was the cousin of Azoun IV and Warden of the Eastern Marches of Cormyr . He lived in Arabel . Appearance .
description_long: Thomdor Ammaeth Baron Thomdor Ammaeth was the cousin of Azoun IV and Warden of the Eastern Marches of Cormyr . He lived in Arabel . Appearance . Thomdor was a very large overweight man with a big belly . His hair was dark and messy , but streaked with grey . Background . In 1369 DR , Thomdor was on a hunt with King Azoun IV , Duke Bhereu and Aunadar Bleth when he was poisoned by a magical abraxus in the abraxus affair , putting him in a coma - like state . He eventually succumbed and died the same year . Relatives . Thomdor was the cousin of former King of Cormyr , Azoun IV , and was the brother of Duke Bhereu Ammaeth .

title: Thommar
description: Thommar Thommar was a location lying somewhere near Durpar , south of the Dustwall Mountains in southeast Faerûn . It lay south of Bralizzar , a town nestled in the Dustwall . The mountains shielded Thommar from the Raurin desert .
description_long: Thommar Thommar was a location lying somewhere near Durpar , south of the Dustwall Mountains in southeast Faerûn . It lay south of Bralizzar , a town nestled in the Dustwall . The mountains shielded Thommar from the Raurin desert . The noted astrologer and mage Aman Al - Raqib of Bralizzar in the 14th century DR hailed from Thommar .

title: Thondar
description: Thondar Thondar was an inhabitant of the city of Wheloon in Cormyr and a member of the Purple Dragons . History . Thondar held the position of Roadcaptain in the Purple Dragons and led road patrols around Wheloon in the 1350s DR .
description_long: Thondar Thondar was an inhabitant of the city of Wheloon in Cormyr and a member of the Purple Dragons . History . Thondar held the position of Roadcaptain in the Purple Dragons and led road patrols around Wheloon in the 1350s DR . During the Time of Troubles in the Year of Shadows , 1358 DR , Roadcaptain Thondar led a road patrol of fourteen Purple Dragons . They pursued Kelemvor Lyonsbane , Midnight , and Adon as they fled town on suspicion of murder , though they made a successful getaway . Possessions . As a Purple Dragon , Thondar wore chain mail . Unlike the rest of his patrol , he fought with a battleaxe and also had a wand of " magic missile " .

title: Thongi SamBhota
description: Thongi SamBhota Thongi SamBhota was the abbot of Lagiluri during the mid – 14th century DR . Appearance . Thongi wore an orange wool robe and a leopard pendant .
description_long: Thongi SamBhota Thongi SamBhota was the abbot of Lagiluri during the mid – 14th century DR . Appearance . Thongi wore an orange wool robe and a leopard pendant . Like all monks , his head was shaved . Activities . The abbot ran a small monastery within the village of Lagiluri . Abilities . Though he possessed a nice variety of clerical powers , during combat Thongi preferred to use " spiritual hammer " and " spell immunity " .

title: Thontoros
description: Thontoros Thontoros the Learned , also called the Sage of the Just Gods , was a sage . Thontoros made a study of the clergy , relics , and deeds of the followers of the deities of justice : Helm , Ilmater , Torm , and Tyr . Thontoros once wrote about how the Twelve Champions of Torm defended the citadel of Lothtia on the Shining Plains against orc s in the Year of the Blood Tusk Charge , 1158 .
description_long: Thontoros Thontoros the Learned , also called the Sage of the Just Gods , was a sage . Thontoros made a study of the clergy , relics , and deeds of the followers of the deities of justice : Helm , Ilmater , Torm , and Tyr . Thontoros once wrote about how the Twelve Champions of Torm defended the citadel of Lothtia on the Shining Plains against orc s in the Year of the Blood Tusk Charge , 1158 . Thontoros mentioned that the paladin Harondath carried the holy shield the " Veloghon of Vigilance " in battle and " bathed it in the blood of the orcs of Thoktor Ironfangs . " Thontoros was the author of a book entitled " Relics of the Righteous " , chronicling , amongst other things , the creation of the sword " Dornavver " .

title: Thoon
description: Thoon Thoon was perhaps a deity or some other entity which was venerated by a specific group of mind flayer s , or it could have been a guiding philosophy just as well . Worshipers . The mind flayers traveled the Underdark , where they spread the philosophy of Thoon .
description_long: Thoon Thoon was perhaps a deity or some other entity which was venerated by a specific group of mind flayer s , or it could have been a guiding philosophy just as well . Worshipers . The mind flayers traveled the Underdark , where they spread the philosophy of Thoon . Along the way , they search for a mysterious substance they call quintessence which could be found in creatures as well as in raw materials . Thoon disciples had access to the Evil domain , War domain and wielded heavy flail s . History . Not long after the last arrival of an avatar of Ilsensine in Oryndoll , some mind flayers of the Loretaker journeyed to the Cavern of Thought in the Deep Caverns . There was no record if they arrived there or went to some other place , such as the Far Realm . When they came back to Oryndoll , they proclaimed the belief in Thoon - a doctrine for which they were outcast by the clergy of Ilsensine .

title: Thoqqua
description: Thoqqua Thoqqua , also called rock worms , were worm - like elemental s native to the Elemental Plane of Fire . Description . A thoqqua ' s long body was hot enough to melt rock .
description_long: Thoqqua Thoqqua , also called rock worms , were worm - like elemental s native to the Elemental Plane of Fire . Description . A thoqqua ' s long body was hot enough to melt rock . Thoqqua had no internal organs , being made purely of the elements of fire and earth . Behavior . Thoqqua were foul - tempered . They spent most of their time burrowing underground in search of minerals to eat . Combat . Thoqqua used their bodies to slam their enemies . This was particularly effective because the touch of a thoqqua resulted in fire damage . Ecology . Thoqqua were natives of the Elemental Plane of Fire or , possibly , the Paraelemental Plane of Magma . However , they also dwelt on the Elemental Plane of Earth and in the Underdark on Toril .

title: Thoran
description: Thoran Thoran was a shadar - kai warrior in the ruin of Spellgard . History . Thoran was once the apprentice of a cabal of Shadowfell sages until he was exiled for stealing forbidden tomes .
description_long: Thoran Thoran was a shadar - kai warrior in the ruin of Spellgard . History . Thoran was once the apprentice of a cabal of Shadowfell sages until he was exiled for stealing forbidden tomes . In his exile , he started studying the secrets of Netheril , becoming an expert on Netherese spells to bind an arcane spirit . After reading " The Analects of Kuryon " , Thoran understood that his perfect victim would be Lady Saharel . In 1479 DR , Thoran and an army of minions took control of the central tower of Spellgard with the intent to find and enslave the Lady .

title: Thorass alphabet
description: Thorass alphabet Thorass was the name of the alphabet used by the large majority of human languages on Faerûn , including Common . The alphabet was first developed for use with the Thorass language by a scribe whose name has been lost to history and was spurred by interactions between the kingdoms of Jhaamdath and Calimshan . It was influenced by the runes of the Untheric language .
description_long: Thorass alphabet Thorass was the name of the alphabet used by the large majority of human languages on Faerûn , including Common . The alphabet was first developed for use with the Thorass language by a scribe whose name has been lost to history and was spurred by interactions between the kingdoms of Jhaamdath and Calimshan . It was influenced by the runes of the Untheric language . Thorass was the script used in Common , Alzhedo , Chessentan , Chondathan , Durpari , Illuskan , Midani ( in Anauroch only ) , Rasallesian , Tuigan , Turmic , and Uluik .

title: Thorass language
description: Thorass language Thorass , or Old ( Auld ) Common , was an old human language , the original trade language of Faerûn and the direct ancestor of Common . Description . Thorass was similar enough to modern Common that it could be directly translated into the latter language , though it would have an jarring form and archaic vocabulary .
description_long: Thorass language Thorass , or Old ( Auld ) Common , was an old human language , the original trade language of Faerûn and the direct ancestor of Common . Description . Thorass was similar enough to modern Common that it could be directly translated into the latter language , though it would have an jarring form and archaic vocabulary . It had a base 10 numbering system . Speakers . By the second half of the 14 century DR , few were literate in Thorass , with some exceptions in the southern parts of Faerûn . For example , in Amn , as late as 1370 DR , all official business was still conducted in this archaic language , and even its warriors were required to speak the language . The dialects of Common used in court in Tethyr and Erlkazar had stronger influences from Thorass than elsewhere , and the city of Zazesspur maintained its own variety of the language as well . Like in Amn , business in Durpar was often conducted in Thorass . Because the Shadovar who returned to Toril in 1372 DR were from an earlier time , some of them still spoke Thorass as a second language . Script . An unknown scribe eventually developed a written alphabet for Thorass .

title: Thorass languages
description: Thorass languages The Thorass languages composed a large linguistic grouping of languages spoken throughout Faerûn , including Thorass , Chondathan , and Common . Subgroups . The Thorass language group was broken down by scholars into five subgroups : Script .
description_long: Thorass languages The Thorass languages composed a large linguistic grouping of languages spoken throughout Faerûn , including Thorass , Chondathan , and Common . Subgroups . The Thorass language group was broken down by scholars into five subgroups : Script . Thorass languages shared the same script , with only a few exceptions . Appendix . Inspiration . Thorass languages are based on real - life languages such as , , and .

title: Thorlor ' s Well
description: Thorlor ' s Well Thorlor ' s Well was a well and campsite situated north of the western side of Ankhwood north of the Lake of Steam . History . At Thorlor ' s Well , " circa " 1342 DR , Sir Guth of Ormpetarr , a knight of Ilmater , confronted the mad Ilmatari priest Bloirt Waelarn over his crimes and challenged him to single combat .
description_long: Thorlor ' s Well Thorlor ' s Well was a well and campsite situated north of the western side of Ankhwood north of the Lake of Steam . History . At Thorlor ' s Well , " circa " 1342 DR , Sir Guth of Ormpetarr , a knight of Ilmater , confronted the mad Ilmatari priest Bloirt Waelarn over his crimes and challenged him to single combat . Waelarn accepted , and promptly used a " cairn " spell to bury Guth . Waelarn then dug Guth out with a pick , and used an axe to chop off any limb that was revealed . Guth was soon killed and Waelarn left . But the god Ilmater caused Sir Guth to rise from his grave as a zombie , which set off in relentless pursuit of the rogue priest .

title: Thorm
description: Thorm Thorm was a dwarven merchant who partnered with Tatigan Carrlock and another merchant in 1480 DR to form a caravan that journeyed to Rashemen . Unknown to Tatigan , Thorm was secretly working with bandits who attacked the caravan along the Golden Way . Throm was killed in a battle with his former comrades when the witch Ilvani and Daruk the bard used illusion magic to hide a crevasse into which Thorm fell .
description_long: Thorm Thorm was a dwarven merchant who partnered with Tatigan Carrlock and another merchant in 1480 DR to form a caravan that journeyed to Rashemen . Unknown to Tatigan , Thorm was secretly working with bandits who attacked the caravan along the Golden Way . Throm was killed in a battle with his former comrades when the witch Ilvani and Daruk the bard used illusion magic to hide a crevasse into which Thorm fell .

title: Thorm Sureblade
description: Thorm Sureblade Thorm Sureblade was the Guildmaster of the Independent Fighters ' Guild of Ravens Bluff from ? - - ? Appearance .
description_long: Thorm Sureblade Thorm Sureblade was the Guildmaster of the Independent Fighters ' Guild of Ravens Bluff from ? - - ? Appearance . Thorm Sureblade is 6 ' tall and weighs 200 pounds , very muscular for a half - elf . Rakishly handsome despite ( or perhaps because of ) the scar that descends from the black silk eye patch over his right eye to his jawline . In town he prefers to wear dark green or dark blue clothing . When traveling he wears black . His voice is a rumbling baritone . He is always armed with at least a dagger and never goes without his " bracers of defense " and " ring of protection " . Personality . Thorm is a friendly bear of a man with a hearty sense of humor . He is a self - confident , natural leader and makes quick decisions in the field . His training techniques emphasize quick thinking and winning by any means necessary , fair or foul . He enjoys good food and collects finely carved tobacco pipes . When he has a bad day at the guild he tends to start " friendly " brawls at the rowdiest inns and taverns in town . His brawling tends to exasperate his brother Tordon who often has to bail him out of jail .

title: Thorn
description: Thorn Thorn was a lythari fighter and adventuring companion of Liriel Baenre and Sharlarra Vendreth . She was a champion of Eilistraee and a Moonhunter , able to travel through moonbeams . Description .
description_long: Thorn Thorn was a lythari fighter and adventuring companion of Liriel Baenre and Sharlarra Vendreth . She was a champion of Eilistraee and a Moonhunter , able to travel through moonbeams . Description . Thorn was tall and lithe and appeared much like a moon elf , except for the feral light in her amber eyes . She had dark , raven - colored hair left unbound with a single streak of silver - colored hair , which was a mark of the favor of Eilistraee . She preferred to dress in all black colors , the same color of her pelt in wolf form . She often wore leathers and a chainmail vest . Personality . She was feral and enjoyed eating fresh meat . She was mostly stone - faced and calm , however , but acted very straightforward and blunt and could easily be considered rude . As a lone lythari , she had no interest in manners and etiquette ; and as an outcast follower of Selûne , she had neither patience nor mercy for her and the goddess ' s enemies . She also had a very high resistance to pain and torture , never compromising herself in the face of danger or agony .

title: Thorn ( fey )
description: Thorn ( fey ) Thorns were small fey warriors who acted as guardians of other fey creatures . They took their name from the longswords they carried , which were constructed from thorny plants . Most thorns in Faerûn lived in the Dalelands or Cormanthor .
description_long: Thorn ( fey ) Thorns were small fey warriors who acted as guardians of other fey creatures . They took their name from the longswords they carried , which were constructed from thorny plants . Most thorns in Faerûn lived in the Dalelands or Cormanthor . Combat . Thorns would attack anything that threatened other fey . They preferred to sneak up on opponents and carried sleep arrows , which caused adversaries to fall into a slumber . They also had the ability to launch a sneak attack .

title: Thorn Island
description: Thorn Island Thorn Island was located in the Moonsea , south of the civilized portion of the city of Phlan out in the Bay of Phlan . Geography . The island was shaped like a tear with Sokol Keep sitting on the western portion .
description_long: Thorn Island Thorn Island was located in the Moonsea , south of the civilized portion of the city of Phlan out in the Bay of Phlan . Geography . The island was shaped like a tear with Sokol Keep sitting on the western portion . It was said by many Phlanites the island was practically invisible in the pitch blackness of night . A ring of rocks protected the island where many ships had broken apart on in the past . However , rowboats could navigate through the rocky coast to reach the sandy shore as long as the sailors were patient . Structure . Sokol Keep covered most of the island and could be seen from the docks . The shoreline had a low slate sheer cliff that supported the keep above . History . In 1340 DR , Ren o ' the Blade , Shal Bal of Cormyr , and Tarl Desanea traveled to the island to seek the evil within Sokol Keep . In 1480 DR , Thorn Island and Sokol Keep were under the authority of House Sokol .

title: Thorn Tlassalune
description: Thorn Tlassalune Thorn Tlassalune was an innkeeper in Amphail . Activities . Thorn owned the Stone Stallion .
description_long: Thorn Tlassalune Thorn Tlassalune was an innkeeper in Amphail . Activities . Thorn owned the Stone Stallion . Personality . He pretended to be from Amn despite obviously being from Tethyr . History . In 1370 DR , his wife Khalarra died in childbirth and he started hearing the call of adventure . Thorn sponsored and fenced adventurers thanks to his contacts in Waterdeep .

title: Thorn Tree
description: Thorn Tree Thorn Tree was a local office of the Heralds of Faerûn , based in the city of Riatavin in Tethyr and performing Herald duties there . History . In the late 1360s DR , the office of Thorn Tree was occupied by a half - elf male .
description_long: Thorn Tree Thorn Tree was a local office of the Heralds of Faerûn , based in the city of Riatavin in Tethyr and performing Herald duties there . History . In the late 1360s DR , the office of Thorn Tree was occupied by a half - elf male . On the Feast of the Moon of the Year of the Tankard , 1370 DR , this Thorn Tree disappeared hours before he was to perform the Bloodsong . This triggered a storm of controversy . First , there were rumors that the High Heralds had plans to expel Thorn Tree for corruption . Second , the rebel government of Riatavin had hoped to use the Bloodsong to assert their authority over the city amidst their secession from Amn to Tethyr . Third , some claimed that Thorn Tree had been working for , variously , Amn , Tethyr , the Knights of the Shield , or another faction of Riatavin . Thus , Thorn Tree ' s disappearance was expected to be powerful political ammunition for all these factions , further disrupting the secession . In fact , Thorn Tree had actually been murdered by one of the Eldreth Veluuthra , and his body hidden so well it might never be found .

title: Thorndathus Ardenthyn
description: Thorndathus Ardenthyn Thorndathus Ardenthyn , better known as Father Thorn , was one of the founders of the Scions of Amber , and its leader in 1479 DR . Description . Father Thorn was a hulking dragonborn who wore a black patch over one eye at all times .
description_long: Thorndathus Ardenthyn Thorndathus Ardenthyn , better known as Father Thorn , was one of the founders of the Scions of Amber , and its leader in 1479 DR . Description . Father Thorn was a hulking dragonborn who wore a black patch over one eye at all times . Personality . Father Thorn was an optimistic fellow with an easy smile who was quick to laugh . He had a nearly religious faith in the Scions of Amber and their battle to topple the oppressive rule of the green dragon Orlarrakh in the Dusk Ports . History . Father Thorn was one of the original founders of the Scions of Amber , and the only surviving one in 1479 DR . He founded the organization after Orlarrakh killed his family . Father Thorn had no permanent house . He moved throughout all the cities of the Dusk Ports , helping people to rise against the dragon tyrants . In 1479 DR , Father Thorn and a group of adventurers saved Nandrel Gostur ' s son from a dragon attack . Since that day , the dragonborn earned the sympathy of the crime lord , who sent some of his agents to help Father Thorn .

title: Thornhold
description: Thornhold Thornhold was a fortress located off the southern edge of the Mere of Dead Men . Location . A short way from the top of a hill whose west side dropped off into a seaside cliff .
description_long: Thornhold Thornhold was a fortress located off the southern edge of the Mere of Dead Men . Location . A short way from the top of a hill whose west side dropped off into a seaside cliff . The hill itself was located to the west of the High Road and just beyond the southern border of the Mere . Structure . A plain gray stone fort with a central keep possessing two towers . Evenly - spaced arrow slits are the only things that broke up the stone . History . The earliest records said that Thornhold was the fortress of Brunyundar Margaster , a local warlord , until he was overthrown by Samular Carradoon shortly after the end of the Second Troll War . Samular had a deed of ownership written so that it would belong to his family but it actually functioned as a chapterhouse for the Knights of Samular until 1368 DR when it was briefly seized by the Zhentarim after Hronrulf Caradoon died . Recaptured by Hronrulf ' s daughter Bronwyn , she gifted the fortress to the dwarves of Clan Stoneshaft who transformed it into a caravan stop for traders about to brave the stretch of the High Road bordering the Mere .

title: Thornwood
description: Thornwood The Thornwood was a forest by the Lake of Steam . Geography . The River Minta flowed through it from Erlkazar to the Lake of Steam and out to the Shining Sea .
description_long: Thornwood The Thornwood was a forest by the Lake of Steam . Geography . The River Minta flowed through it from Erlkazar to the Lake of Steam and out to the Shining Sea . History . The Thornwood was once part of the elven nation of Thearnytar , which fell to the dark elves at the end of the Second Crown War . As of 1372 DR , it was inhabited by evil humanoid s and at least one beholder . By 1369 DR , the Twisted Rune had placed a magical gate in the forest to allow for instantaneous movement to other locations .

title: Thoth
description: Thoth Thoth ( pronounced " thoth " ) is the scribe and historian of the Mulhorandi pantheon . Also known by the names Tholaunt in Thay and Thalatos in Unther , Thoth is an intellectual deity known for academic debate and innovation . History .
description_long: Thoth Thoth ( pronounced " thoth " ) is the scribe and historian of the Mulhorandi pantheon . Also known by the names Tholaunt in Thay and Thalatos in Unther , Thoth is an intellectual deity known for academic debate and innovation . History . Thoth and Oghma are engaged in friendly competition to determine who can gain the most followers in the nation of Unther . Relationships . Thoth is an elder member of the Mulhorandi pantheon , and considers Horus - Re , Isis , and Osiris to be close allies . He has also forged favorable relationships with Azuth , Deneir , Gond , Oghma , Mystra , and Savras . Only Set and his followers are seen as true enemies of Thoth , though he is known to intervene in the actions of the Red Wizards of Thay as well . Avatar . Thoth usually appears as a slender Mulan male possessing the head of an ibis . He wears a linen skirt and gold breastplate , and often wears a wig . His quarterstaff is almost always close at hand . Powers and abilities . Thoth uses arcane and divine spells with equal ease , and always casts spells deftly and efficiently . Thoth ' s " Staff of Office " is both a powerful artifact and a repository of ancient magic Thoth can draw upon .

title: Thought sphere
description: Thought sphere The Thought sphere was a group of spells granted to monk s that followed deities of knowledge and learning . These spells treated thoughts as objects to be discovered and manipulated , even altering reality . Spells in normal text were listed in the Tome of Magic 2nd edition .
description_long: Thought sphere The Thought sphere was a group of spells granted to monk s that followed deities of knowledge and learning . These spells treated thoughts as objects to be discovered and manipulated , even altering reality . Spells in normal text were listed in the Tome of Magic 2nd edition . Spells in italics were added to the Thought Sphere in the sourcebook .

title: Thousand Maws
description: Thousand Maws The Thousand Maws were a group of one hundred caves located in the Nether Mountains and were the homes of the Thousand Fists orc tribe . Structure . Many of the caverns were huge , such as Arraggar , the home of around 60 orcs , and Oltho , where roughly 70 orcs lived .
description_long: Thousand Maws The Thousand Maws were a group of one hundred caves located in the Nether Mountains and were the homes of the Thousand Fists orc tribe . Structure . Many of the caverns were huge , such as Arraggar , the home of around 60 orcs , and Oltho , where roughly 70 orcs lived . The Thousand Maws were a spiderweb network of tunnels which wove throughout the mountains . Many trails spanned the outer edges of the Maws , where the orc tribes posts scouts to watch the enemies or prey . Interior . A few of the caverns were overgrown with and the Thousand Fists tribe would used slaves to collect and farm these locations . History . For years the orcs of the Thousand Fists tribe dwelt on the southern passes of the Nether Mountains and fought against the Ripped Gut orc tribe over control of Moon Pass . In 1372 DR , the Thousand Fists created an alliance with their rivals after the influence of a tanarukk emissary who was sent from Hellgate Keep . Inhabitants . The Blood of Morueme dragon s hunted the fringes of the Thousand Maws causing the Thousand Fists to move their livestock underground .

title: Thousand Sacred Sources of the Gaya
description: Thousand Sacred Sources of the Gaya The Thousand Sacred Sources of the Gaya was a collection of hundreds of rivers in the Hordelands and southeast Faerûn that fed the Gaya , also known as the River Xon , which flowed between Durpar and Ulgarth and Xontuil Bay and the Golden Water . Fed by the great Jumpa River , its many tributaries and sources lay throughout the Katakoro Shan and the A - Ling Shan ranges of the Yehimal and the facing plains . These rivers were considered sacred in the Padhran religion and were a path of pilgrimage for the faithful .
description_long: Thousand Sacred Sources of the Gaya The Thousand Sacred Sources of the Gaya was a collection of hundreds of rivers in the Hordelands and southeast Faerûn that fed the Gaya , also known as the River Xon , which flowed between Durpar and Ulgarth and Xontuil Bay and the Golden Water . Fed by the great Jumpa River , its many tributaries and sources lay throughout the Katakoro Shan and the A - Ling Shan ranges of the Yehimal and the facing plains . These rivers were considered sacred in the Padhran religion and were a path of pilgrimage for the faithful . They visited sacred sites along each river . The primary rivers of the Sacred Sources were : Other rivers that fed these and the Gaya included :

title: Thousand Year War
description: Thousand Year War The Thousand Year War was a conflict between dragonkind and the giant nation of Ostoria . It began in the Time of Dragons , c . - 26000 DR , and lasted until c .
description_long: Thousand Year War The Thousand Year War was a conflict between dragonkind and the giant nation of Ostoria . It began in the Time of Dragons , c . - 26000 DR , and lasted until c . - 25000 DR , after both races reached a truce . The war began when the dragon god Garyx sent an avatar to lead a flight of red dragon s to attack the giant nation . Soon afterward , all races of dragonkind were involved in the conflict . The giants also created a powerful colossus construct called Vonindod to help them in the fight against the dragons . The battles acquired such an epic scope that they became the source of inspiration for many dwarven , elven , and even giant classical ballads . One of the most renowned heroes of the war was the giant Hjurnur Wyrmrever , who killed many dragons single - handedly and was reputed to have challenged Tiamat in a contest of riddles . He lost that contest , however , and had to allow the Queen of Dragons devour his own child . Hjurnur died while killing a dragon king . His story was immortalized in the " Saga of the Dragon Queller " . After more than a thousand years of warfare , Ostoria finally reached a truce with dragonkind .

title: Thousandheads Trading Coster
description: Thousandheads Trading Coster The Thousandheads Trading Coster was a merchant company in Faerûn . History . Bharavan Bhaerkantos , a former adventurer , founded this merchant company .
description_long: Thousandheads Trading Coster The Thousandheads Trading Coster was a merchant company in Faerûn . History . Bharavan Bhaerkantos , a former adventurer , founded this merchant company . The Thousandheads Trading Coster only operated on trade routes from Waterdeep to Hillsfar via Scornubel , Berdusk , Iriaebor , Priapurl , Arabel , and Essembra . Base of Operations . Bharavan ' s personal stronghold , located just east of Riatavin , served as the base of operations for this company .

title: Thovantareth
description: Thovantareth Thovantareth , also known as the Finder of Lost Hoards , was a brown dragon who lived in Eskorn , Returned Abeir . History . In 1479 DR , Thovantareth was seeking lost treasures in the ruins of Firetrees when he met the adventuress Jada Marlserpent , who rightly claimed to be one of the fabled dragonheir s .
description_long: Thovantareth Thovantareth , also known as the Finder of Lost Hoards , was a brown dragon who lived in Eskorn , Returned Abeir . History . In 1479 DR , Thovantareth was seeking lost treasures in the ruins of Firetrees when he met the adventuress Jada Marlserpent , who rightly claimed to be one of the fabled dragonheir s . Fearing the possibility that she might one day come into her full abilities , Thovantareth tried to kill her , and when she fled he pursued her all the way to the only place she would be safe from him , the village of Wandering Stones , a sanctuary for escaped slaves , in hopes the Empress Dragon Gauwervyndhal would reward him for destroying the place . Although dragons feared Wandering Stones and usually avoided the place , Thovantareth ' s hatred for the dragonheirs was so strong that allowed him to surpass his fear and attack the village . When he was about to destroy Wandering Stones , the spirit of the primordial Arambar temporarily awakened from his ages - long slumber because of the attack and , recognizing the invader as a dragon , Arambar killed Thovantareth effortlessly .

title: Thoyana Jorgadaul
description: Thoyana Jorgadaul Thoyana Jorgadaul was the constable and served as village ruler of the town of Elmwood . Description . Thoyana was a calm dwarf woman with a gray braided beard who tolerated no troublemakers in her village .
description_long: Thoyana Jorgadaul Thoyana Jorgadaul was the constable and served as village ruler of the town of Elmwood . Description . Thoyana was a calm dwarf woman with a gray braided beard who tolerated no troublemakers in her village . Personality . The constable frequented the docks regularly keeping her eyes open and asking questions of all new strangers entering Elmwood . In her free time , she loved pipe - smoking and other recreations , such as chess . When not minding the affairs of the town , Thoyana could be found at the Still Waters , a two - story inn . Possessions . When she wandered the town , Thoyana wore no armor and carried only a club and a short sword tucked in her belt . Hidden in a small chest in her house , Thoyana owned " chainmail + 4 " and " gauntlets of ogre power " . Relationships . Elmwood had an informal town council consisting of Thoyana , Alamarayne Moonray , a cleric of Selûne ; and Ezril Treewarder , a druid of Eldath . The three were great friends and met once a week to discuss village business at the Still Waters . History .

title: Thradulf ' s Camp
description: Thradulf ' s Camp Thradulf ' s Camp was located in the southwestern region of the Cold Wood and was ruled by the cruel Thradulf Longfang , of the Red Tiger Tribe . History . Thradulf became leader of the Red Tiger tribe in 1368 DR succeeding Adalwulf Longfang , a wise leader who ruled his tribe long and well .
description_long: Thradulf ' s Camp Thradulf ' s Camp was located in the southwestern region of the Cold Wood and was ruled by the cruel Thradulf Longfang , of the Red Tiger Tribe . History . Thradulf became leader of the Red Tiger tribe in 1368 DR succeeding Adalwulf Longfang , a wise leader who ruled his tribe long and well . Before this time , the Red Tigers were a solitary tribe , but under Thradulf ' s rule , a darker side of the tribe was born . Inhabitants . Thradulf ' s camp was the largest gathering of Red Tigers . His followers hunted and gathered in the Cold Wood region during the wintertime and moved north to the Druarwood in the summer season .

title: Thraxata
description: Thraxata Thraxata is a red dragon . On Elesias 7 1373 DR , Thraxata set many fires in Battledale , consuming a large part of the woodland there . In 1370 DR , Thraxata was desribed as a " young red dragon " and was known to lair on Bloodhorn .
description_long: Thraxata Thraxata is a red dragon . On Elesias 7 1373 DR , Thraxata set many fires in Battledale , consuming a large part of the woodland there . In 1370 DR , Thraxata was desribed as a " young red dragon " and was known to lair on Bloodhorn .

title: Thraxxia
description: Thraxxia Thraxxia is a half - fiendish daughter of the demon lord Graz ' zt . Description . Though she has no known succubus blood , Thraxxia physically resembles an alu - fiend , with an attractive , feminine human form , upsloping eyebrows and small , batlike wings .
description_long: Thraxxia Thraxxia is a half - fiendish daughter of the demon lord Graz ' zt . Description . Though she has no known succubus blood , Thraxxia physically resembles an alu - fiend , with an attractive , feminine human form , upsloping eyebrows and small , batlike wings . She is , however , far more powerful , having gained the might and magical powers of a nalfeshnee through trickery and guile . History . Thraxxia is the daughter of Graz ' zt and a long - dead human monk . After killing three of her half - sisters to prove herself to her father , she has since served as Graz ' zt ' s personal assassin . During the imprisonment of Waukeen , Graz ' zt plotted to magically disguise Thraxxia as the goddess of wealth , counting on Lliira to transfer Waukeen ' s portfolio to Thraxxia in Waukeen ' s stead . This plot was thwarted by a band of adventurers in the course of the adventure " For Duty & Deity " .

title: Three - Faced Sun heresy
description: Three - Faced Sun heresy The Three - Faced Sun heresey states that the sun is a tripartite overdeity , with aspects of dawn , highsun ( solar noon ) , and dusk . Like a spinning prism viewed from the side , believers in this heresy teach that only two of the three aspects can be " seen " at any time . ( There are said to be brief instants in deific time when only one aspect is manifest .
description_long: Three - Faced Sun heresy The Three - Faced Sun heresey states that the sun is a tripartite overdeity , with aspects of dawn , highsun ( solar noon ) , and dusk . Like a spinning prism viewed from the side , believers in this heresy teach that only two of the three aspects can be " seen " at any time . ( There are said to be brief instants in deific time when only one aspect is manifest . ) According to this heresy , during the Age of Netheril , Amaunator ruled as the aspect of highsun , while Jergal ( then the Netherese deity of death ) held the portfolio of dusk . After Amaunator faded away , Lathander appeared as the aspect of dawn , and Myrkul inherited the aspect of dusk . The Time of Troubles marked the fall of Myrkul and Lathander ' s brief moment of unchallenged dominance . Now , believers in the Three - Faced Sun are heralding the rise of Amaunator . Some believers in this heresy suggest that Lathander will become the new aspect of highsun and another will take his place as the aspect of dawn , while others herald the rise of a new deity who is the aspect of highsun .

title: Three Elves
description: Three Elves The Three Elves was an inn located in Voonlar , known throughout the Moonsea for its homey atmosphere and good , cheap food . Location . The inn sat on the north side of Shind Road at the intersection with Dump Road .
description_long: Three Elves The Three Elves was an inn located in Voonlar , known throughout the Moonsea for its homey atmosphere and good , cheap food . Location . The inn sat on the north side of Shind Road at the intersection with Dump Road . A person standing on the front porch of the Three Elves looking outward would gaze southward down Dump Road past the House of Holy Light . Structure . The first floor was made from mortared fieldstone and had a large front door shaped in an oval with a hanging signboard that bore a heraldic design . The blazon for the Three Elves was an escutcheon filled with oak trees whose foliage formed a continuous field of green . Superimposed on this were three silver arrows flying in parallel diagonally downward to the sinister . There were two one - story lean - to additions , one on either side of the inn , that had tile roofs , which were cracked from age and from guests leaping from the upper - story windows . The second story was made of wood with a sloping , thatched roof from which many dormer windows protruded . Interior .

title: Three Gates Reef
description: Three Gates Reef Three Gates Reef was a large tiger coral reef bordering and forming part of the ecosystem of the underwater city of Myth Nantar . It was 30 m ( 100 ft ) tall and several kilometers wide , and encircled three sides of the city , providing three arches ( gates ) through which access to the city could be gained . Over the years , the reef was carved with scenes depicting battles and myths .
description_long: Three Gates Reef Three Gates Reef was a large tiger coral reef bordering and forming part of the ecosystem of the underwater city of Myth Nantar . It was 30 m ( 100 ft ) tall and several kilometers wide , and encircled three sides of the city , providing three arches ( gates ) through which access to the city could be gained . Over the years , the reef was carved with scenes depicting battles and myths . By 1369 DR , the reef had grown out of control and covered up much of the southern part of the city .

title: Three Old Kegs
description: Three Old Kegs The Three Old Kegs is a well - known inn in the city of Baldur ' s Gate . It is widely regarded as one of the best inns in all of Faerûn , and is known for its comfortable furnishings and its generally somnific atmosphere . The establishment is located along the east wall of the Ducal Palace .
description_long: Three Old Kegs The Three Old Kegs is a well - known inn in the city of Baldur ' s Gate . It is widely regarded as one of the best inns in all of Faerûn , and is known for its comfortable furnishings and its generally somnific atmosphere . The establishment is located along the east wall of the Ducal Palace . Its signboard consists of three old kegs hanging via chains from a roofpole above the door . Patronage . The Kegs ' clientele tends to be considerably tamer than that of most inns in Baldur ' s Gate . It caters towards relaxed , easygoing individuals who prefer to spend their days engaged in reading , napping , and low - stakes gambling . Architecture and Decor . While not huge , the Kegs is a large building , with four floors above ground and two levels of cellars below . The basements and the two lower floors are built of fieldstone , while the upper two floors are timber , all topped with a heavy slate roof . The ground floor is given over to the foyer and communal areas . The upper three floors consist almost entirely of bedrooms . The uppermost cellar contains the gaming rooms .

title: Three Roldons
description: Three Roldons The Three Roldons was an exclusive , expensive , and opulent tavern in Eshpurta in early 1370 DR , the Year of the Tankard . The proprietor was a halfling with impeccable taste who provided a quiet place for couples and small groups to gather and partake of good quality fare . The booths had heavy curtains and there were private rooms available for the utmost in discretion .
description_long: Three Roldons The Three Roldons was an exclusive , expensive , and opulent tavern in Eshpurta in early 1370 DR , the Year of the Tankard . The proprietor was a halfling with impeccable taste who provided a quiet place for couples and small groups to gather and partake of good quality fare . The booths had heavy curtains and there were private rooms available for the utmost in discretion . Only those with a name in good social standing in Eshpurta were allowed to enter .

title: Three Sisters
description: Three Sisters The Three Sisters were a series of volcanoes in the Ice Spires South . Description . The Three Sisters were semi - active volcanoes .
description_long: Three Sisters The Three Sisters were a series of volcanoes in the Ice Spires South . Description . The Three Sisters were semi - active volcanoes . They were connected to a complex of lava and steam vests leading deep into the depths of Toril . ( These same steam vents connected to the Dour Fissure , a deep gorge farther to the north . ) So much heat was in the ground of the foothills of the Three Sisters that the small dale adjacent to the hills was on average 25° warmer than the surrounding valley . This increased temperature allowed for limited agriculture , which provided much of the food for the kingdom of Hartsvale . Geography . The Three Sisters were considered a part of the Firecap Mountains , which were themselves a part of the Ice Spires .

title: Three Towers
description: Three Towers The Three Towers is a performance club in the Dock Ward of Waterdeep . It is known for hosting traveling minstrels , singers and storytellers , including Rymrick the Bawd , Dulchaesen and The Bell - Dwarves Three . On a night when no guest performer is available , a " Round of Ballades " is held by the staff , which is led by " Waterfall " Baerle Waszunn .
description_long: Three Towers The Three Towers is a performance club in the Dock Ward of Waterdeep . It is known for hosting traveling minstrels , singers and storytellers , including Rymrick the Bawd , Dulchaesen and The Bell - Dwarves Three . On a night when no guest performer is available , a " Round of Ballades " is held by the staff , which is led by " Waterfall " Baerle Waszunn . Location . The club is located on a corner in the Dock Ward , at a junction between Drawn Sword Alley , Leera ' s Alley and Watchrun Alley . Crying To My Harp . The club was the host of a notable performance of " Crying To My Harp " by the traveling minstrel Nymbrar " Nighteye " Shatterslee . It was extremely popular with the patrons and the venue was so full that the windows were propped open so that people could watch from the alleys outside . The performance caused so many coins to be thrown that the staff collected them in baskets normally used for bread .

title: Three Trees Pass
description: Three Trees Pass Three Trees Pass was a major pass between the Troll Mountains and the Giantspike Mountains in the Vast . The North Road ran through it to connect Kurth and King ' s Reach . Description .
description_long: Three Trees Pass Three Trees Pass was a major pass between the Troll Mountains and the Giantspike Mountains in the Vast . The North Road ran through it to connect Kurth and King ' s Reach . Description . The pass was a long cleft between the two mountain ranges . It was rocky , dangerous , and desolate . History . Three Trees Pass was named , obviously , for three great old pine s that were all that lived in the bleak landscape , and which marked the height of the pass . The name arose in conversation between two Sembia n merchants who ' d explored the dwarven - held lands of Vast ( during the time of Roldilar , 610 – 649 DR ) , as they sought a trade - route from the dwarven mines down to the River Vesper . To that end , the North Road was laid through Three Trees Pass , linking Kurth and King ' s Reach . Human s waged costly battles against the orc s of the mountains to control the pass , but were successful . The effort saved the last of the dwarves of Roldilar from being wiped out by the orcs at the fall of that kingdom . Conflicts continued to be fought through the pass as human prospectors moved into the surrounding mountains and clashed with the orcs . Usage .

title: Threldryn Imbranneth
description: Threldryn Imbranneth Threldryn Imbranneth was a knight and a noble of Cormyr who rode with Princess Alusair Obarskyr . History . In the Year of the Gauntlet , 1369 DR , Alusair and her knights were operating in the Stonelands , pursuing a bold orc band that had raided a caravan east of Eveningstar ; in six days of pursuit , they ' d killed a hydra , a " fire lizard " , and three chimera s .
description_long: Threldryn Imbranneth Threldryn Imbranneth was a knight and a noble of Cormyr who rode with Princess Alusair Obarskyr . History . In the Year of the Gauntlet , 1369 DR , Alusair and her knights were operating in the Stonelands , pursuing a bold orc band that had raided a caravan east of Eveningstar ; in six days of pursuit , they ' d killed a hydra , a " fire lizard " , and three chimera s . Beldred Truesilver sent Threldryn and Brace Skatterhawk to watch Alusair when she stepped aside to receive a private message . They returned to find Beldred and the knights had impetuously pursued the orcs into an ambush , and a few were killed . Alusair rallied her forces to defeat the orcs , before deducing they served a dark naga and the Zhentarim , who had been charming and transporting monsters into the area ; Threldryn struggled to catch up to her reasoning . He was one of those who volunteered to aid Alusair , and had a hand in slaying the naga .

title: Thri - kreen
description: Thri - kreen The thri - kreen were an insectoid monstrous humanoid race that primarily lived in the Shaar . The thri - kreen were a race of nomads and hunters . They were also known as mantis warriors and sometimes called " tri - kreen " .
description_long: Thri - kreen The thri - kreen were an insectoid monstrous humanoid race that primarily lived in the Shaar . The thri - kreen were a race of nomads and hunters . They were also known as mantis warriors and sometimes called " tri - kreen " . Description . A thri - kreen resembled a giant praying mantis , bipedal and standing 4 . 5 – 7 feet ( 1 . 4 – 2 . 1 meters ) high and weighing 100 – 375 pounds ( 45 – 170 kilograms ) ; a full - grown adult averaged at 6 feet ( 1 . 8 meters ) and 200 pounds ( 90 kilograms ) . They had exoskeletons over their entire bodies . They had six limbs protruding from their thorax : two for walking and four for use as arms , ending in four - fingered claw - like hands capable of tool - and weapon - use . Their insectoid heads had two black , multi - faceted compound eyes ; two small antennae sprouting from the top ; and a complex jaw structure with large sharp mandibles . It was extremely difficult to distinguish the males and females . The carapace of a thri - kreen was typically a sandy yellow in hue , but could vary from a sandy brown to a pale green color , as best suited the environment .

title: Throat
description: Throat The Throat was a water tower in Luskan . Location . The tower was located in the North Bank of Luskan near the Red Dragon Trading Post .
description_long: Throat The Throat was a water tower in Luskan . Location . The tower was located in the North Bank of Luskan near the Red Dragon Trading Post . The Throat could be reached by the long span of Harbor Cross from Blood Island . Structure . The Throat was a large water tower surrounded by pastures for tending sheep . Inhabitants . Anyone found in the vicinity of the tower was immediately apprehended to protect the city ' s main water supply . The city guards were armed with crossbow s with paralyzing quarrels . History . Around 1370 DR , the sheep raised in the field around the Throat were given to the five captains of Luskan : Baram , Kurth , Rethnor , Suljack , and Taerl . For a time , dwarves made it a rite of passage to paint the High Captains ' sheep different colors , but after a bloody feud with the city , the practice ceased . Rumors and Legends . Most Luskanites would tell all travelers to Luskan that the Throat and Whitesails Harbor were extremely dangerous places filled with kidnappers and killers .

title: Throleatha
description: Throleatha Throleatha is a sun elf sorceress and the proprietor of Throleatha ' s Public House in Leuthilspar on the island of Evermeet as of 1368 DR . She is sometimes called into the service of Queen Amlaruil Moonflower as a messenger between nobles or to agents in Faerûn .
description_long: Throleatha Throleatha is a sun elf sorceress and the proprietor of Throleatha ' s Public House in Leuthilspar on the island of Evermeet as of 1368 DR . She is sometimes called into the service of Queen Amlaruil Moonflower as a messenger between nobles or to agents in Faerûn .

title: Throleatha ' s Public House
description: Throleatha ' s Public House Throleatha ' s Public House is a quiet public house in Leuthilspar on the island of Evermeet . Its proprietor is Throleatha , an elven sorcerer . Most of its clientele are sun elves .
description_long: Throleatha ' s Public House Throleatha ' s Public House is a quiet public house in Leuthilspar on the island of Evermeet . Its proprietor is Throleatha , an elven sorcerer . Most of its clientele are sun elves . Nobles often meet to discuss their affairs since the establishment offers a range of private rooms and booths . moon elves , wood elves and wild elves are not forbidden , but visit infrequently , often finding it too quiet .

title: Throstulgrael
description: Throstulgrael Throstulgrael , or " Velvet " , was a young male black dragon who laired in the Flooded Forest in the lands of the Moonsea and the Vast in north Faerûn . History . By 1369 DR , Velvet was waging a feud with the much older green dragon Malachite , who lived in the forests south of Mulmaster .
description_long: Throstulgrael Throstulgrael , or " Velvet " , was a young male black dragon who laired in the Flooded Forest in the lands of the Moonsea and the Vast in north Faerûn . History . By 1369 DR , Velvet was waging a feud with the much older green dragon Malachite , who lived in the forests south of Mulmaster . Velvet sought to move in on Malachite ' s territory . Velvet still lived by 1374 DR . In 1489 DR , Throstulgrael tried to enslave the lizardfolk tribes of Twilight Marsh near Phlan , but his plot was ruined by some adventurers . Later that year , he was confronted by adventuring party sent to recover some items from the dragon ' s lair but when he seemed to have been killed , he mysteriously resurrected as a dracolich and flew away . Allies . In the 14th century , Velvet was supported by a Cult of the Dragon cell based near either Calaunt or Kurth . Though not particularly large or powerful , the cell was well organized and its members were close - knit . They feuded with Malachite ' s own Cult cell . Relationship . In Twilight Marsh , he had two half - dragon descendants : a son Graxxygak , and a daughter Nostilax .

title: Throwing
description: Throwing Throwing is a quality that can be applied to any melee weapon . A weapon with this property gains a range increment of 10 feet and can be thrown at enemies if the wielding creature is proficient with it . Creation .
description_long: Throwing Throwing is a quality that can be applied to any melee weapon . A weapon with this property gains a range increment of 10 feet and can be thrown at enemies if the wielding creature is proficient with it . Creation . To craft a " throwing " weapon , a spellcaster must have " magic stone " available .

title: Throwing axe
description: Throwing axe A throwing axe is a light , martial melee weapon of the axe family that can be used as a ranged weapon . Description . A throwing axe is similar to a handaxe but lighter and balanced for throwing .
description_long: Throwing axe A throwing axe is a light , martial melee weapon of the axe family that can be used as a ranged weapon . Description . A throwing axe is similar to a handaxe but lighter and balanced for throwing . The wooden haft is about one and a half feet ( 45cm ) long with a head like those shown here . The blade is single - edged with a plain back . An average throwing axe costs 8gp and weighs 2lbs ( 0 . 9kg ) . Weaponology . Classified as a light weapon , the throwing axe can be used while grappling . Some training is required to be able to hit a target with a throwing axe , therefore it is considered a martial weapon . Normal maximum range of a throwing axe is 50ft ( 15 . 2m ) . Realmslore . Gnome fighter s often use throwing axes for both melee and ranged attacks .

title: Thrym
description: Thrym Thrym was a titan , worshiped by the frost giant s as the giant god of cold and ice . He was the " de facto " leader of the frost giants as well . Thrym ruled the realm of Fimbulwinter in the Elemental Chaos , described as a large , desolate tundra accented by sparkling frozen waterfalls .
description_long: Thrym Thrym was a titan , worshiped by the frost giant s as the giant god of cold and ice . He was the " de facto " leader of the frost giants as well . Thrym ruled the realm of Fimbulwinter in the Elemental Chaos , described as a large , desolate tundra accented by sparkling frozen waterfalls . His stronghold and feast hall was called Nyfholl . In earlier cosmological models his realm was described as mountainous but still filled with snow , ice , frost , and glaciers . Description . Thrym appeared as an exceptionally large frost giant . He typically wore chainmail and a coat made of white fur . Personality . When not directly preparing for war , Thrym was known to be fairly aloof , wandering his realm restlessly . Abilities . Thrym could breathe a devastating " cone of cold " out to 100 ft ( 30 m ) and was completely immune to cold - or ice - based attacks . Only highly magical weapons could even touch him enough to injure him . He often granted frost giants the ability to use arcane magic equivalent to a 12th - level wizard . Possessions . His signature weapon was a large double - bladed greataxe . Relationships . Thrym was a son of Annam All - Father .

title: Thulbanian Games
description: Thulbanian Games The Thulbanian Games was a grand athletic competition that took place in Chessenta . Organization . They were held every two years on the Fields of Pryollus at the foot of Mount Thulbane in Threskel .
description_long: Thulbanian Games The Thulbanian Games was a grand athletic competition that took place in Chessenta . Organization . They were held every two years on the Fields of Pryollus at the foot of Mount Thulbane in Threskel . They lasted for one week and during this time , all wars in Chessenta were put on hold . Their purpose was to discover the very best athlete s of Chessenta . Winners were considered heroes in their home cities , and even slaves were treated like nobility if they did well . History . King Theris of Mourktar held his own games on the site in the Year of the Prince , 1357 DR in order to choose his successor . The attempt failed , however . After the dragon s Alasklerbanbastos and Jaxanaedegor took over Threskel in the Year of the Sword , 1365 DR , the Games remained on hold . By 1374 DR , organizers were considering relocating the games well out of Jaxanaedegor ' s domain . Events . In keeping with traditional Chessentan sports , all the competitions were individual events , not team sports .

title: Thulk
description: Thulk Thulk was a male bugbear barbarian slave from Szith Morcane . He ruled the slaves of Szith Morcane with an iron fist under the approval of his drow masters . Description .
description_long: Thulk Thulk was a male bugbear barbarian slave from Szith Morcane . He ruled the slaves of Szith Morcane with an iron fist under the approval of his drow masters . Description . Physically , Thulk appeared to be a very strong example of his kind . He customarily wore leather armor and kept a morningstar to hand . Personality . Not just physically imposing , Thulk was also renowned for his strong and imposing personality . Able to cow the rest of the goblinoid and even the stone giant slaves in Szith Morcane , his ability to keep the other slaves in check earned him the tentative backing of the drow . Thulk ' s cruelty could rival the drow when needed and he was intimidating enough to keep even giant s in order . Despite this , Thulk was not above negotiating with those he recognized as stronger than him , at least until he judged them weak enough to be killed off . Abilities . A forceful creature , Thulk was skilled at bullying others into doing what he wanted but smart enough to keep on good terms with his drow masters . In combat , Thulk could fly into a fierce rage , pummeling his foes with his morningstar or even smashing their weapons with his great strength . Possessions .

title: Thullen
description: Thullen Thullen was the benevolent brother of the cloud giant countess Sansuri sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . History . In the late 1480s or early 1490s DR He lived in Lyn Armaal with Sansuri ' s family .
description_long: Thullen Thullen was the benevolent brother of the cloud giant countess Sansuri sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . History . In the late 1480s or early 1490s DR He lived in Lyn Armaal with Sansuri ' s family . Usually Thullen acted as babysitter of the children of Sansuri . Personality . Thullen was in many ways the opposite of his sister , he disliked violence , was gentle and soft - spoken and no interested to gain power or influence . However he made a oath of protect Sansuri . The only thing that made him truly angry was tried to harm his nephews .

title: Thultanthar
description: Thultanthar Thultanthar ( " Shade " in the Loross language ) , also known as the Shade Enclave and the City of Shade , was a Netherese flying city situated in the middle of the Anauroch desert . Geography . On Toril , Thultanthar was located in the middle of the Anauroch desert among Bedine tribes along the Black Road trade route connecting the Silver Marches with Cormanthor .
description_long: Thultanthar Thultanthar ( " Shade " in the Loross language ) , also known as the Shade Enclave and the City of Shade , was a Netherese flying city situated in the middle of the Anauroch desert . Geography . On Toril , Thultanthar was located in the middle of the Anauroch desert among Bedine tribes along the Black Road trade route connecting the Silver Marches with Cormanthor . Near the city was the Shadow Sea , and the Scimitar Spires range surrounded both the lake and the city on three sides ( all except the north ) . Thultanthar ' s " twin " in the Shadowfell was known as Gloomwrought . History . Origins . Thultanthar was created in the year - 1471 DR , some 1 , 483 years after Ioulaum created the first such floating city . Thultanthar ' s high mage , known only as Lord Shadow , had been experimenting with the Plane of Shadow for some time and had successfully shifted the entire city into the Plane of Shadow mere days before Karsus cast " Karsus ' s Avatar " and temporarily destroyed the Weave in the Year of Sundered Webs , −339 DR . For some reason , however , Lord Shadow could not move the city back to the Prime Material Plane .

title: Thultyrl
description: Thultyrl Thultyrl was the name of the ruling family of the city of Procampur in the Vast . It was also the title that its rulers adopted . The Thultyrls served as hereditary overlords of the city .
description_long: Thultyrl Thultyrl was the name of the ruling family of the city of Procampur in the Vast . It was also the title that its rulers adopted . The Thultyrls served as hereditary overlords of the city . Appearance . The Thultyrls had a distinctive family resemblance of copper - colored hair , gray - green eyes , and a sharp chin . Title & Vows . The name " Thultyrl " was originally the family ' s surname until it was adopted as their title , leaving them with no practical surname . Instead , they bore the title " of the Royal Blood " . Every Thultyrl swore eternal vengeance on any pirate that dared raid Procampur ' s ships or attack its harbor . Assistants . The ruling thultyrls were assisted and supported by the Hamayarch , a special mage - adviser to the ruler . This post was traditionally taken by mage weaker than the Thultyrl , who was very loyal to their ruler and operated with their blessing . The Thultyrl was protected by the Forty , a troop of forty stern bodyguards and soldiers . The Thultyrl also had a personal secretary . History . Early history . The city of Procampur was formally founded in the Year of Trials Arcane , 523 DR .

title: Thuluna Maah
description: Thuluna Maah Thuluna Maah was a sea hag and a high - ranking member of the Cult of the Crushing Wave at the Temple of the Crushing Wave in Tyar - Besil during the Elemental Evil crisis . Personality . Thuluna Maah was the second - in - command of the temple , answering only to Gar Shatterkeel .
description_long: Thuluna Maah Thuluna Maah was a sea hag and a high - ranking member of the Cult of the Crushing Wave at the Temple of the Crushing Wave in Tyar - Besil during the Elemental Evil crisis . Personality . Thuluna Maah was the second - in - command of the temple , answering only to Gar Shatterkeel . She was a sly , calculating creature , quick to offer bargains and make deals that she could later turn to her advantage . Thuluna dreamed of purging the cult of its human members but only when the right opportunity came . Until then , she encouraged attacks against rival cults , hoping that the air or fire cultists would kill the Crushing Wave ' s human leadership for her . She hated beauty and always attacked the best - looking enemies first . History . In 1491 DR , Thuluna was in charge of all non - human members of the cult . She lived inside the temple with two ogre bodyguards and a retinue of lizardfolk . However , some adventurers infiltrated the temple and confronted and defeated her and her minions .

title: Thunder Blessing
description: Thunder Blessing The Thunder Blessing , also known as the Thundering , occurred in the Year of Thunder , 1306 DR , and was the dwarven god Moradin ' s gift to his people which dramatically increased the reproductive rate of dwarves . Moradin called a council of the dwarven pantheon to find a way to increase the number of dwarves . The council decided to split each existing soul into two when they were reincarnated .
description_long: Thunder Blessing The Thunder Blessing , also known as the Thundering , occurred in the Year of Thunder , 1306 DR , and was the dwarven god Moradin ' s gift to his people which dramatically increased the reproductive rate of dwarves . Moradin called a council of the dwarven pantheon to find a way to increase the number of dwarves . The council decided to split each existing soul into two when they were reincarnated . After the Thunder Blessing most dwarven births were twins .

title: Thunder Peaks
description: Thunder Peaks The Thunder Peaks were a range of mountains that ran in a north – south line , marking the eastern edge of Cormyr . The entire range was subject to extremely severe and sudden storms all year round . They were home to tribes of orc s and goblin s that launched raids in nearby Cormyr , Sembia , and the Dalelands , and were also home to the dracolich Aurgloroasa , the Sibilant Shade .
description_long: Thunder Peaks The Thunder Peaks were a range of mountains that ran in a north – south line , marking the eastern edge of Cormyr . The entire range was subject to extremely severe and sudden storms all year round . They were home to tribes of orc s and goblin s that launched raids in nearby Cormyr , Sembia , and the Dalelands , and were also home to the dracolich Aurgloroasa , the Sibilant Shade . The Thunder Peaks once hosted the dwarven settlement of Thunderholme . The Thunder River flowed west out of the Thunder Peaks to the Wyvernwater . In Elven , the Thunder Peaks were called " Airmbult " , or translated into common , Storm - Fangs .

title: Thunder slam
description: Thunder slam Thunder slam is a spell of the evocation school used by some sorcerer s early in their training . When cast , " thunder slam " causes a burst of sonic energy to burst from the sorcerer ' s implement , blowing a creature within fifty feet a distance of fifteen . " Thunder slam " is somewhat complex for its level of power and as such requires a rest of a few minutes before being cast again .

When cast , " thunder slam " causes a burst of sonic energy to burst from the sorcerer ' s implement , blowing a creature within fifty feet a distance of fifteen . title: Thunderbeast Tribe
description: Thunderbeast Tribe The Thunderbeast tribe was a group of Uthgardt . History . In 1370 DR , their chief was the charismatic Gundar Brontoskin , but he was replaced around 1372 DR by Sungar Wolfkiller .
description_long: Thunderbeast Tribe The Thunderbeast tribe was a group of Uthgardt . History . In 1370 DR , their chief was the charismatic Gundar Brontoskin , but he was replaced around 1372 DR by Sungar Wolfkiller . Late in the 15th century , the tribe arrived at Morgur ' s Mound for Runemeet to find it disinterred , missing the skeletons of the Thunderbeast and Morgur as well as the treasure buried within . Since they could no longer practice their traditions there , their current chieftain , Grandthur , decided that the Thunderbeast would meet the Elk tribe at Flintrock . He left a guard to wait for the Gray Wolf tribe to return to Neverwinter Wood and ask them what had happened . Organization . Their ritual enemies were wolves . They were known as the least barbaric of the Uthgardt , although they still did not practice agriculture . They guarded the secret that thunderbeast s still lived deep in the High Forest . Geography . The Thunderbeast ' s ancestor mound was Morgur ' s Mound , but they lived in the High Forest area .

title: Thunderbelly
description: Thunderbelly Thunderbelly , the Iron Arm of Dardath was a dwarf soldier who participated in the last Illefarn battle against the King of Shadows . Before the battle , he swore an oath to not rest before the King was dead , and so awoke to find himself trapped in the gem mines in the ruined city of Arvahn along with other spirits connected to the King . His spirit helped an adventurer uncover one of the statues needed for the Ritual of Purification , designed to weaken the King of Shadows .
description_long: Thunderbelly Thunderbelly , the Iron Arm of Dardath was a dwarf soldier who participated in the last Illefarn battle against the King of Shadows . Before the battle , he swore an oath to not rest before the King was dead , and so awoke to find himself trapped in the gem mines in the ruined city of Arvahn along with other spirits connected to the King . His spirit helped an adventurer uncover one of the statues needed for the Ritual of Purification , designed to weaken the King of Shadows . Thunderbelly got his name from his boisterous stomach ; during one particular battle , his gut would produce loud , hungry noises while he battled troll s ( he had missed breakfast that morning ) .

title: Thunderhide armor
description: Thunderhide armor Thunderhide armor was a type of armor used on Toril . Description . Thunderhide armor was made from layers of treated hides of dinosaur s ( called " thunderers " ) , or other large reptiles .
description_long: Thunderhide armor Thunderhide armor was a type of armor used on Toril . Description . Thunderhide armor was made from layers of treated hides of dinosaur s ( called " thunderers " ) , or other large reptiles . It was more supple than regular hide armor . Usage . Thunderhide armor was most commonly worn by druid s in Chult and in the Lizard Marsh and Serpent Hills .

title: Thunderholme
description: Thunderholme Thunderholme was a dwarven kingdom in the region known as the Thunder Peaks . Dwarven legends spoke of the city as favored by Dumathoin , the Keeper of Secrets Under the Mountain , and that it was home to the noblest miners and finest metalsmiths in the Realms . It was also said that its vaults were emptied in a day , when Dumathoin swept his chosen away to live in paradise with him .
description_long: Thunderholme Thunderholme was a dwarven kingdom in the region known as the Thunder Peaks . Dwarven legends spoke of the city as favored by Dumathoin , the Keeper of Secrets Under the Mountain , and that it was home to the noblest miners and finest metalsmiths in the Realms . It was also said that its vaults were emptied in a day , when Dumathoin swept his chosen away to live in paradise with him . The truth however was far more horrible and tragic . The realm fell into decline when its king and heir were assassinated , and then was finally conquered by Aurgloroasa , a powerful shadow dragon , in 1054 DR . History . In 616 DR , scouts from Thunderholme noted the arrival of a powerful and potentially dangerous dragon called Aurgloroasa in the region but the dwarves chose to do nothing about it . This choice would eventually lead to their doom . In 989 DR , miners from Thunderholme accidentally expanded their delves into the lair of Aurgloroasa , rousing her from her centuries - long sleep . She immediately despatched the miners and caved in their tunnel to make it appear as an accident . but the damage had been done .

title: Thundering
description: Thundering Thundering was a magical weapon quality . When a weapon of this type hit a creature in a vital area , it produced a loud sound like thunder . This sound was powerful enough to damage the creature hit , and that creature could be permanently deafened by the noise .
description_long: Thundering Thundering was a magical weapon quality . When a weapon of this type hit a creature in a vital area , it produced a loud sound like thunder . This sound was powerful enough to damage the creature hit , and that creature could be permanently deafened by the noise . The wielder of the thundering weapon was not affected . Creation . A spellcaster needed the " blindness / deafness " spell to create a weapon with this ability .

title: Thunderlance
description: Thunderlance Thunderlance was an arcane evocation spell that created a spear of force that could be used as a weapon and had the ability to dispel some defensive magics . One version also absorbed certain magic projectiles and added their damage to its own . Effects .
description_long: Thunderlance Thunderlance was an arcane evocation spell that created a spear of force that could be used as a weapon and had the ability to dispel some defensive magics . One version also absorbed certain magic projectiles and added their damage to its own . Effects . For one minute per level , the caster could wield a spear - like force that extended from his or her pointed finger . It was shimmering , faintly gray , could vary in length up to 20 ft ( 6 . 1 m ) , and was perfectly straight . No skill was required to wield " thunderlance " : an earlier version ignored all non - natural armor , and the later version struck as if the caster had great strength . The lance faded away at the will of the caster , if the caster lost consciousness or cast another spell , or when the spell expired . Some magical force protections were dispelled by the touch of a " thunderlance " . The later version could dispel " shield " , " mage armor " , and any other force - based spell of 3rd level or below . The earlier version could even dispel a " minor globe of invulnerability " and other abjuration spells of the same level or less .

title: Thunderspire Labyrinth
description: Thunderspire Labyrinth Thunderspire Labyrinth is an adventure module for the core setting of the 4th - edition ruleset of " Dungeons & Dragons " . Behind the scenes . While " Thunderspire Labyrinth " was designed initially for the " points of light " core setting of 4th edition , alterations to the adventure made in an article of " Dungeon " magazine made it possible to use it as a dungeon for characters in the " Forgotten Realms " .
description_long: Thunderspire Labyrinth Thunderspire Labyrinth is an adventure module for the core setting of the 4th - edition ruleset of " Dungeons & Dragons " . Behind the scenes . While " Thunderspire Labyrinth " was designed initially for the " points of light " core setting of 4th edition , alterations to the adventure made in an article of " Dungeon " magazine made it possible to use it as a dungeon for characters in the " Forgotten Realms " . These changes included changing the focus on Vecna to that of Cyric and relocating Thunderspire Mountain to a geographical location in Faerûn near Cormyr .

title: Thunderspire Mountain
description: Thunderspire Mountain Thunderspire Mountain was a mountain located in the Thunder Peaks , near Arabel and Winterhaven in Cormyr , and Highmoon in the Dalelands . Description . Thunderspire Mountain was one of the tallest mountains in the Thunder Peaks .
description_long: Thunderspire Mountain Thunderspire Mountain was a mountain located in the Thunder Peaks , near Arabel and Winterhaven in Cormyr , and Highmoon in the Dalelands . Description . Thunderspire Mountain was one of the tallest mountains in the Thunder Peaks . The mountain ' s pinnacle was usually wreathed in thunderstorm clouds , but on rare days it could be seen from a distance . From the East Way , a steep cobbled path turned north into the mountain , and then into the Seven - Pillared Hall through the Minotaur Gate . Notable Locations . Beneath Thunderspire Mountain was located the ancient minotaur city of Saruun Khel near an entrance to the Underdark . Appendix . Thunderspire Mountain was designed originally for the default setting of the 4th edition of Dungeons & Dragons , but was later adapted to the Forgotten Realms in Dungeon 155 .

title: Thunderstone
description: Thunderstone Thunderstone was a village or small town in northeastern Cormyr . It lay along the southern bank of the Thunder River , close to the southern side of Hullack Forest , north of the Vast Swamp , and near to the western slopes of the Thunder Peaks . The Thunderway began at Thunderstone , before running through High Dale and ending at Saerb in Sembia .
description_long: Thunderstone Thunderstone was a village or small town in northeastern Cormyr . It lay along the southern bank of the Thunder River , close to the southern side of Hullack Forest , north of the Vast Swamp , and near to the western slopes of the Thunder Peaks . The Thunderway began at Thunderstone , before running through High Dale and ending at Saerb in Sembia . The Hullack Trail began at Thunderstone , and ran west through southeast Cormyr . The town was named after the Thunder Peaks that rose nearby . History . Many years before the late 1360s DR , an ettin of the Thunder Peak assembled a band of orc s and goblin s and sent them on raids against Thunderstone and Hultail . The attacks were ultimately thwarted and the ettin slain . Thunderstone was one of a number of places captured by the Lost King Gondegal in the Year of the Dragon , 1352 DR . Like the others , his mercenary troops occupied and pillaged the town before being ousted by the Purple Dragons as Gondegal ' s eight - day kingdom fell . Desiring lumber and game to fuel the expansion of the realm , the Cormyrean crown sought to exploit the primeval Hullack Forest .

title: Thundertree
description: Thundertree Thundertree was a small village in the plains east of Neverwinter , in the time of 1365 DR . It was destroyed in 1451 DR . It was a source of wood and Zalantar .
description_long: Thundertree Thundertree was a small village in the plains east of Neverwinter , in the time of 1365 DR . It was destroyed in 1451 DR . It was a source of wood and Zalantar . Also it is known as the home of Aribeth de Tylmarande . Description . Thundertree , by the time of 1451 DR , was an overgrown wasteland . All the building have been destroyed and its interior open to the weathers . History . Thundertree was once a community that prospered on the edges of the Neverwinter Woods . However , when Mount Hotenow erupted in 1451 DR , it devastated the small town . In the wake of the disaster , zombies drove off any who survived the eruption . Sometime in the 1480 DR , the zombies have crumbled to dust , but strange magic had turned the local flora into twig blights . Inhabitants . By the time of 1451 DR , no one inhabited the ruins of Thundertree . There were two exceptions : Reidoth and Venomfang .

title: Thunderwave
description: Thunderwave Thunderwave is a spell of low complexity learned by many wizard s . An evocation spell , " thunderwave " creates a blast of sonic energy that can cause bodily harm to any enemies within an area of fifteen feet of the spell , in addition to pushing them backwards , away from the blast zone . The distance a creature caught in the blast is pushed depends upon the caster ' s degree of self - control and perception .
description_long: Thunderwave Thunderwave is a spell of low complexity learned by many wizard s . An evocation spell , " thunderwave " creates a blast of sonic energy that can cause bodily harm to any enemies within an area of fifteen feet of the spell , in addition to pushing them backwards , away from the blast zone . The distance a creature caught in the blast is pushed depends upon the caster ' s degree of self - control and perception . The spell dissipates almost instantaneously , but can be recast as many times as the wizard feels fit .

title: Thundrazi
description: Thundrazi Thundrazi was a Red Wizard of Thay and a Harper spy in Mulmaster . Personality . Thundrazi usually spoke only in brief and curt sentences .
description_long: Thundrazi Thundrazi was a Red Wizard of Thay and a Harper spy in Mulmaster . Personality . Thundrazi usually spoke only in brief and curt sentences . She had a soft side for the young of all species . She tried to maintain her cover , but in case of danger to children , she did not care if she was exposed . Relationships . Thundrazi worked with the Hawks , the secret police of Mulmaster , and infiltrated the local embassy of Thay . History . In 1491 DR , she was at Astrid Saj ' s estate during an uprising by Elemental Evil cultists , so Mistress Saj provided her with an adventuring party as an escort to return to the embassy .

title: Thungor Triblane
description: Thungor Triblane Thungor Triblane was an innkeeper in Tilverton in 1357 DR . Activities . Thungor , a former illusionist , managed The Windlord ' s Rest , an inn of good quality in the town .
description_long: Thungor Triblane Thungor Triblane was an innkeeper in Tilverton in 1357 DR . Activities .
