Thungor , a former illusionist , managed The Windlord ' s Rest , an inn of good quality in the town . History . In 1357 DR , news arrived in Suzail that runaway princess Alusair Obarskyr was seen near Tilverton . Rastafan was one of the many envoys sent by King Azoun Obarskyr IV to the Dalelands in order to recruit an adventuring party to find Alusair . Relationship . Thungor was a friend of the sage Filani .

title: Thunkers
description: Thunkers The Thunkers was a bandit organization in Damara in 1359 DR . History . The Thunkers originated in 1357 DR after the first defeat of the bandit army of the Grandfather of Assassins against Gareth Dragonsbane .
description_long: Thunkers The Thunkers was a bandit organization in Damara in 1359 DR . History . The Thunkers originated in 1357 DR after the first defeat of the bandit army of the Grandfather of Assassins against Gareth Dragonsbane . The stone giant s Rocktooth , Boulderhead , Bearcrusher deserted the bandit army together with some other humanoid s and went back to the Galena Mountains . After some time , however , bored by that life they went back to central Damara raiding small towns and adventuring parties . In time , many other humanoids joined the band . They all had a bounty over their heads for their crimes and were particularly hated by the dwarves of Ironspur , one of their favorite targets .

title: Thunkers of the Thunkers
description: Thunkers of the Thunkers The Thunkers of the Thunkers was an adventuring party in Damara in 1359 DR . Organization . The Thunkers of the Thunkers were three ranger s and a pair of twin brother dwarves who specialized in hunting giant s .
description_long: Thunkers of the Thunkers The Thunkers of the Thunkers was an adventuring party in Damara in 1359 DR . Organization . The Thunkers of the Thunkers were three ranger s and a pair of twin brother dwarves who specialized in hunting giant s . Their experience and strategy aided them tremendously when facing giants . History . The Thunkers of the Thunkers arrived on Toril from a different Prime Material Plane . Between 1353 DR to 1359 DR , they wandered the Sword Coast until deciding to settle in Damara in order to find more giants to kill . They allied with the dwarves of Clan Hillsafar .

title: Thunsroon Frostbryn
description: Thunsroon Frostbryn Thunsroon " Thunderhand " Frostbryn was a human wizard of Elversult on the Dragon Coast . Description . Thunsroon was a powerful and brash man .
description_long: Thunsroon Frostbryn Thunsroon " Thunderhand " Frostbryn was a human wizard of Elversult on the Dragon Coast . Description . Thunsroon was a powerful and brash man . Personality . Thunderhand often participated in magical duels and enjoyed publicly humiliating anyone who threatened or tricked him . He was also a known planewalker traveling to other worlds and planes .

title: Thuparlial
description: Thuparlial Thuparlial , also known as , was found in hardened lava as a lining to gas cavities in the rock , but rarely was this lining thick enough or an attractive color to warrant cutting it into gemstones . Description . Thuparlial was hard , resilient , and translucent gemstone which varied in color from deep green through pale greenish yellow and from yellow to brown .
description_long: Thuparlial Thuparlial , also known as , was found in hardened lava as a lining to gas cavities in the rock , but rarely was this lining thick enough or an attractive color to warrant cutting it into gemstones . Description . Thuparlial was hard , resilient , and translucent gemstone which varied in color from deep green through pale greenish yellow and from yellow to brown . Thuparlial was cut in if light - colored but otherwise made into s . It was considered an ornamental stone and a typical specimen had a base value of 10 gp . Powers . Powdered , this mineral was used in inks for creating the " pyrotechnics " and " heat metal " spells . Red wizard s who had access to large quantities of thuparlial experimented with using it as a substitute ingredient for many fire - and heat - based spells . It was unknown if they succeeded .

title: Thurauvyn Nathalanorn
description: Thurauvyn Nathalanorn Thuvauvyn Nathalanorn was a baelnorn lich in Myth Drannor . Activities . Thuvauvyn was the guardian of House Nathalanorn ' s crypt .
description_long: Thurauvyn Nathalanorn Thuvauvyn Nathalanorn was a baelnorn lich in Myth Drannor . Activities . Thuvauvyn was the guardian of House Nathalanorn ' s crypt . History . In 1487 DR , Thuvauvyn appeared to stop the shadovar agent Helgore Ulitarathulm . However , after a long and fierce battle , Helgore prevailed , destroying Thuvauvyn .

title: Thurbal
description: Thurbal Thurbal was a male human commander of the Twisted Tower ' s guards in Shadowdale before and during the Time of Troubles of 1358 DR . History . Thurbal in his role of leader of the guards of the Twisted Tower briefly met the young Shandril Shessair , the bearer of the " spellfire " , when she stayed in Shadowdale for a time .
description_long: Thurbal Thurbal was a male human commander of the Twisted Tower ' s guards in Shadowdale before and during the Time of Troubles of 1358 DR . History . Thurbal in his role of leader of the guards of the Twisted Tower briefly met the young Shandril Shessair , the bearer of the " spellfire " , when she stayed in Shadowdale for a time . Later , during the Time of Troubles , Lord Mourngrym Amcathra , fearing the threat of the god Bane in Zhentil Keep , ordered Thurbal to go and spy on the evil city . Thurbal discovered that Bane wanted to invade Shadowdale , but he was greatly injured in his escape from Zhentil Keep . He was trapped in a recuperative sleep throughout the Battle of Shadowdale . After the battle , he awoke cured . Thurbal was chosen by his lord to be the defendant of Adon and Midnight in a trial over the presumed death of Elminster Aumar . Thurbal was convinced of the innocence of Midnight and Adon , but the mob believed his judgement be twisted from his time in Zhentil Keep . In the end , Midnight and Adon were condemned to death .

title: Thurghom
description: Thurghom Thurghom was an outcast orc druid who guarded an ancient portal on the Sea of Moving Ice . Description . Thurghom dressed in magic rhino hide and carried a large magic shield of wood .
description_long: Thurghom Thurghom was an outcast orc druid who guarded an ancient portal on the Sea of Moving Ice . Description . Thurghom dressed in magic rhino hide and carried a large magic shield of wood . He often fought with a flame blade , which he created with his druidic magic . Abilities . Thurghom was a powerful druid , having the powers and abilities typical of such persons , including the ability to change his appearance and form . The most powerful spell he could cast was " sunbeam " . His strength and his wisdom were his greatest assets . Possessions . Thurghom had acquired a large selection of magical items , among them a " periapt of wisdom " , a " wilding clasp " , " boots of the winterlands " , and a " dusty rose ioun stone " . Activities . Thrughom guarded a sinkhole that he discovered as a youth , believing it to be a sacred site . He worshiped from a distance , never touching the stone pillars surrounding the hole . Occasionally , he would offer a living sacrifice to the " great spirit " within by tossing a creature into the pit . Relationships . Thurghom had befriended a dire polar bear , which he named Bahgkôm , who served as his faithful animal companion . History .

title: Thurgur
description: Thurgur Thurgurs were efreet military zones within the Elemental Plane of Fire . Geography . These zones were located all across the Elemental Plane of Fire , protecting the City of Brass and routing slaves back to the efreet capital .
description_long: Thurgur Thurgurs were efreet military zones within the Elemental Plane of Fire . Geography . These zones were located all across the Elemental Plane of Fire , protecting the City of Brass and routing slaves back to the efreet capital . Inhabitants . An efreet thurgur could contain as many as four large fortresses housing 40 efreet .

title: Thuria
description: Thuria Thuria was a Red Wizard of Thay in the Doomvault dungeon in 1486 DR . Personality . Thuria was a coward , not wanting to risk his life for the Red Wizards .
description_long: Thuria Thuria was a Red Wizard of Thay in the Doomvault dungeon in 1486 DR . Personality . Thuria was a coward , not wanting to risk his life for the Red Wizards . He was also bored in his work . History . Thuria was a wizard assigned to the secret complex of Doomvault under Thaymount . He was tasked with controlling the gardens that supported the Blood Pens . In 1486 DR , when the heroes of Daggerford arrived , Thuria and his minions readied to fight them . However , when defeated , he surrendered , pleading for his life and offering information about the dungeon in exchange and even helping them against his fellow Red Wizards . Relationship . Thuria had a black dragon wyrmling as his personal pet .

title: Thuriya al - Kadari
description: Thuriya al - Kadari Thuriya al - Kadari was an orc concubine of the Grand Caliph of Huzuz , Khalil al - Assad al - Zahir in 1367 DR . Description . Thuriya was not attractive by common standards but did offer Khalil genuine companionship .
description_long: Thuriya al - Kadari Thuriya al - Kadari was an orc concubine of the Grand Caliph of Huzuz , Khalil al - Assad al - Zahir in 1367 DR . Description . Thuriya was not attractive by common standards but did offer Khalil genuine companionship . History . Thuriya was an adventuring companion of Khalil ' s during his younger days . He later realized she would make a fine companion and invited her to live in the Royal Harim as his concubine . They often talked and reminisced about their adventuring days .

title: Thurl Merosska
description: Thurl Merosska Thurl Merosska was a high - ranking member of the Cult of the Howling Hatred and leader of Feathergale Knights during the Elemental Evil crisis . Personality . Thurl ' s main motivation and goal was power .
description_long: Thurl Merosska Thurl Merosska was a high - ranking member of the Cult of the Howling Hatred and leader of Feathergale Knights during the Elemental Evil crisis . Personality . Thurl ' s main motivation and goal was power . He thought that , thanks to Yan - C - Bin , he could rule Waterdeep . Thurl pledged loyalty to Aerisi Kalinoth but only reluctantly , believing that one day he would use her and her minions to conquer Waterdeep . History . Thurl was once a griffon rider in Waterdeep until a great storm nearly killed him . After that experience , he started to worship Yan - C - Bin . Soon , he gathered around him a group of like - minded wealthy folk of Waterdeep and founded the Feathergale Knights as a cover group of the Cult of the Howling Hatred .

title: Thurn Blackskull
description: Thurn Blackskull Thurn Blackskull was a male duergar fighter / psion or psychic warrior who worked as a fence in the subterranean city of Skullport in Undermountain around 1370 DR . Description . Thurn was an aged gray dwarf .
description_long: Thurn Blackskull Thurn Blackskull was a male duergar fighter / psion or psychic warrior who worked as a fence in the subterranean city of Skullport in Undermountain around 1370 DR . Description . Thurn was an aged gray dwarf . Activities . Thurn worked as a fence , specializing in the illicit trade of rare and enchanted weaponry . Most afternoons , Thurn could be found in the Broken Pike tavern , always with tankard in hand . Relationships . Thurn was a crony of Marks , proprietor of the Broken Pike , and an informal advisor to the prominent duergar Thaglar Xundorn . History . Thurn Blackskull hailed from the duergar city of Gracklstugh , before coming to Skullport . However , at some point by 1370 DR , Thurn ' s identity was stolen by the doppelganger Ptola , a local leader of the Unseen . Under the guise of Thurn Blackskull , Ptola carried on his life and trade , and his kin and cronies remained entirely aware of the substitution . This masquerade was maintained until at least 1372 DR .

title: Thurndan Tallwand
description: Thurndan Tallwand Thurndan Tallwand was one of the most powerful wizard s in Mulmaster and the leader of the Brotherhood of the Cloak in 1373 and 1491 DR . Activities . As the head of this magic - oriented organization in 1373 DR , it was Thurndan ' s responsibility to ensure the safety of High Blade Rassendyll Uoumdolphin .
description_long: Thurndan Tallwand Thurndan Tallwand was one of the most powerful wizard s in Mulmaster and the leader of the Brotherhood of the Cloak in 1373 and 1491 DR . Activities . As the head of this magic - oriented organization in 1373 DR , it was Thurndan ' s responsibility to ensure the safety of High Blade Rassendyll Uoumdolphin . Though he fulfilled this duty to the letter , it was his hope however to find Rassendyll ' s weakness and seize control of Mulmaster . History . In 1375 DR , Thurndan conspired with Rassendyll to usurp Selfaril Uoumdolphin ' s rule , thinking Rassendyll a more tractable ruler than his twin brother . Thurndan magically imprisoned Selfaril in a soulgem in the pommel of his sword . In time , Thurndan came to regret his deed and tried to made amends . In the years since , he became a lich and always remained as the head of the Cloak using various aliases . In 1491 DR , he was known as Rastol Shan . In that year , Thurndan and the Sword of Selfaril resurfaced in the Earthspur Mountains . He disliked the then - current High Blade Jaseen Drakehorn and decided to take the blade and finally free Selfaril .

title: Thurr Gargengrim
description: Thurr Gargengrim Thurr Gargengrim was a dwarf businessman in the Monastery of the Precipice in 1479 DR . Activities . The Gargengrim clan supplied the Monastery with all they needed in exchange for a percentage of the profits from distributing the monastery ' s whiskey .
description_long: Thurr Gargengrim Thurr Gargengrim was a dwarf businessman in the Monastery of the Precipice in 1479 DR . Activities . The Gargengrim clan supplied the Monastery with all they needed in exchange for a percentage of the profits from distributing the monastery ' s whiskey . Thurr was the clan delegate to lead the caravans to and from the monastery .

title: Thurrak
description: Thurrak Thurrak was a male stone giant sorcerer and an elder of his tribe who resided on the shores of the Lake of Shadows . Personality . Thurrak was slightly less reticent than others of his kind when dealing with others .
description_long: Thurrak Thurrak was a male stone giant sorcerer and an elder of his tribe who resided on the shores of the Lake of Shadows . Personality . Thurrak was slightly less reticent than others of his kind when dealing with others . He would try to examine how situations could be turned in the giants ' favor , albeit after much thought . Abilities . Smarter and less shy than other stone giants , Thurrak ' s station as an elder of his tribe granted him a degree of control over rock and stone . Additionally , Thurrak possessed some sorcerous powers and could use such magic to fire " magic missile ' s " at his foes or even strengthen his constitution with " endurance " spells . Possessions . An elder of his tribe , Thurrak held some of the few magical items among his kin . He wore a set of " bracers of armor + 3 " on his wrists and wielded an enormous enchanted greatclub . Relationships . He was the husband of Ghunda , a fellow elder of the tribe . However , they differed greatly in their outlooks and willingness to talk with strangers . History . At some point , Thurrak ' s tribe witnessed the construction of the Shrine of the Claw by the kuo - toa on the Lake of Shadows .

title: Thutai
description: Thutai Thutai was a Red Wizard of Thay overseer in the Doomvault dungeon in 1486 DR . Personality . Thutai cared little for his underlings .
description_long: Thutai Thutai was a Red Wizard of Thay overseer in the Doomvault dungeon in 1486 DR . Personality . Thutai cared little for his underlings . If a fight went bad for him , he always tried to escape . History . Thutai was a Red Wizard assigned to the secret complex of Doomvault under Thaymount . As one of the most loyal and fanatical followers of Szass Tam , he was tasked with the custody of the Chosen of Yurtrus Bandagh in the deepest levels of the dungeon . Heroes from Daggerford fought him in 1486 DR and Thutai tried to escape .

title: Thylius Caramitru
description: Thylius Caramitru Thylius Caramitru was a minor noble in Mulmaster . Personality . Thylius was extremely charismatic .
description_long: Thylius Caramitru Thylius Caramitru was a minor noble in Mulmaster . Personality . Thylius was extremely charismatic . His main joy was manipulating others to do his bidding . As a dilettante , he had studied a little of everything , but his favorite subject was herbalism . Powers . Like his father , Thylius had some psionic abilities . History . Thylius was the son of Julios Caramitru and Korona Caramitru , two minor nobles working in the city ' s bureaucracy . In 1491 DR , after a trip to the Monastery of the Yellow Rose , he said he had learned the new meditation technique of the Yellow Breath . Thylius soon had his first disciple in the young Riasa Yegorovna . They gave a demonstration during a party housed by Astrid Saj and Rosealine Culkin to honor Aleyd Burral , the Resurrected Hero of Phlan . In truth he kidnapped a monk , Ovon , that he had befriend at the monastery and forced him to teach to he the secret of Yellow Breath . Thylius want use this lore to create a cult to himself among young noble scions and rise the rank of the city ' s power . He gathered some young noble in the Yellow Breath Chapter House .

title: Thymari
description: Thymari Thymari , known to common people as Tymantherans , were the dragonborn ethnicity that made up the vast majority of the population of Tymanther . Description . Thymari dragonborn used piercings to shown their clan allegiances .
description_long: Thymari Thymari , known to common people as Tymantherans , were the dragonborn ethnicity that made up the vast majority of the population of Tymanther . Description . Thymari dragonborn used piercings to shown their clan allegiances . Those piercings were different for each one of the clans . Only Thymari of the highest rank could carry greatsword s , as a badge of their important status in Thymari society . Dragonborn of squire status or higher could carry broadsword s , while those without a rank could only carry either blunt weapons or weapons with a shorter cutting edge . Outlook . The vast majority of Thymari shared a common culture that was based on a sense of responsibility to their clans , encompassed in three key concepts : Likewise , Thymari weren ' t directly rude if they had something to say . When they wanted to criticize something , they arranged their compliments in such a way that the insult somehow was omited ( such as congratulating someone who had bad writing about their " good penmanship " , because talking about their swordsmanship was a waste of time ) . Thymari called that " sjashukri " .

title: Thyriellentha Snome
description: Thyriellentha Snome Thyriellentha Snome was the commander of the watch - wizard corps of the City Watch in Waterdeep in 1372 DR . Personality . Thyriellentha was a capable and friendly woman , but power - hungry , though only with legal methods and becoming petty and grasping .
description_long: Thyriellentha Snome Thyriellentha Snome was the commander of the watch - wizard corps of the City Watch in Waterdeep in 1372 DR . Personality . Thyriellentha was a capable and friendly woman , but power - hungry , though only with legal methods and becoming petty and grasping . She had very strict standards for her subordinates . Thyriellentha cut all dealings with her family when her grandfather chose her cousin over her as heir . History . Thyriellentha was born in the noble house of Snome . However , she distanced herself from the family when her grandfather Lord Arrabas Snome picked as his heir her cousin Dandobar Snome . Circa 1362 DR , she ascended to the position of leader of the watch - wizard contingent of the City Watch and commanded them efficiently . In the meantime , her cousin Dandobar chose her as his own heir , but this did not repair the fracture within her family .

title: Tiago Baenre
description: Tiago Baenre Tiago Baenre was the grandson of Dantrag Baenre and a noble of House Baenre in Menzoberranzan . Tiago and Ravel Xorlarrin were considered the most promising of Menzoberranzan ' s young males . Description .
description_long: Tiago Baenre Tiago Baenre was the grandson of Dantrag Baenre and a noble of House Baenre in Menzoberranzan . Tiago and Ravel Xorlarrin were considered the most promising of Menzoberranzan ' s young males . Description . Tiago was slender and had stylish short hair . He had an unusual " whisper " of a white mustache . He sometimes grew his hair out ; in 1484 DR , he had long white hair . Personality . Because of his position in House Baenre , Tiago was quite powerful — and he knew it . He was confident in his position and was not averse to using his influence to casually but seriously threaten others . He also used his influence to sleep with the priestesses of House Xorlarrin , Berellip and Saribel , although as priestesses he maintained they had the right to refuse . History . In 1463 DR , Tiago escorted Gol ' fanin on the Xorlarrin expedition to Gauntlgrym . Tiago also served as the expedition ' s emissary to House Baenre , keeping Ravel Xorlarrin and his sisters in line and reminding them that he was reporting to Matron Mother Quenthel Baenre .

title: Tiamat
description: Tiamat Tiamat ( pronounced " TEE - a - maht " ) , was the lawful evil dragon goddess of greed , queen of evil dragon s and , for a time , a reluctant servant of the greater gods Bane and later Asmodeus . Before entering the Faerûnian pantheon , she was a member of the Draconic pantheon , and for some time she was also a member of the Untheric pantheon . Tiamat was also the eternal rival of her brother Bahamut , ruler of the good metallic dragon s .
description_long: Tiamat Tiamat ( pronounced " TEE - a - maht " ) , was the lawful evil dragon goddess of greed , queen of evil dragon s and , for a time , a reluctant servant of the greater gods Bane and later Asmodeus . Before entering the Faerûnian pantheon , she was a member of the Draconic pantheon , and for some time she was also a member of the Untheric pantheon . Tiamat was also the eternal rival of her brother Bahamut , ruler of the good metallic dragon s . Appearance . Tiamat was a unique chromatic dragon , who had one head for each primary color of the most common species of chromatics ( black , blue , green , red , white ) . Each head was able to operate entirely independently of each other and had the powers of a member of the respective race of dragonkind . Her body also had traits in common with a wyvern , including a long tail tipped with a poisonous stinger . She also had three main avatars . " The Dark Lady " was a mulan female with long dark hair and completely black eyes . She always wore dark robes and frequently had a seductive smile on her face .

title: Tianna Skyflower
description: Tianna Skyflower Tianna Skyflower was a half - elf who led a band of raiders known only as the Half - Elven Renegades on the southern edge of the High Forest . History . She moved her home and raiding base from the Dire Wood to near the Shining Falls .
description_long: Tianna Skyflower Tianna Skyflower was a half - elf who led a band of raiders known only as the Half - Elven Renegades on the southern edge of the High Forest . History . She moved her home and raiding base from the Dire Wood to near the Shining Falls . She discovered the Cavern of Blooming Stone . Physical description . Tianna possessed a magic item known as the " Ring of Five Visages " , which altered her features with illusion magic , so few who met her ever likely saw her true appearance . She was most commonly described as a dusky - skinned and dark - haired half - moon elf but with a blaze of pure white through the crown . Personality . Tianna was said to have demanded to be addressed only as " Princess " .

title: Tiatha Hawksong
description: Tiatha Hawksong Tiatha Hawksong was the leader of the moon elf house Hawksong . History . Tiatha disappeared around 1357 DR , but members of her house believed her to be alive in 1367 DR .
description_long: Tiatha Hawksong Tiatha Hawksong was the leader of the moon elf house Hawksong . History . Tiatha disappeared around 1357 DR , but members of her house believed her to be alive in 1367 DR . Rumors and legends . It was rumored she possessed the " Gem of Clarata " .

title: Tiax
description: Tiax Tiax was a wandering cleric of Cyric . Not nearly as mad as his god , but insane nonetheless , Tiax claims that Cyric has granted him visions of world domination and he has made it his life ' s mission to fulfill those visions , attempting to create a worldwide theocracy in Cyric ' s name . He was not very successful in this endeavour , but it did not stop him from reminding everyone who he met of his goal .
description_long: Tiax Tiax was a wandering cleric of Cyric . Not nearly as mad as his god , but insane nonetheless , Tiax claims that Cyric has granted him visions of world domination and he has made it his life ' s mission to fulfill those visions , attempting to create a worldwide theocracy in Cyric ' s name . He was not very successful in this endeavour , but it did not stop him from reminding everyone who he met of his goal . Over and over again . He met with the Protagonist in Baldur ' s Gate before travelling south to Amn , where he was captured by the Cowled Wizards as a ' deviant ' and held in Spellhold . When the Protagonist arrived in Spellhold , Tiax and the other inmates were released ( he professed to only vaguely remember the Protagonist ) in order to help attack the more powerful Irenicus . Tiax was killed in the ensuing spell battle , his dying words claiming that death was but a minor inconvenience to his plans for ruling all . Player : " Tiax ! Aren ' t you supposed to be dead ? " Quotes . Baldurs Gate 2 . Tiax : " Tiax rules all from this throne room ! You are all servants of his majesty , even as you feign ignorance " Tiax : " The heavens move because he waves his hand !

title: Tibeem
description: Tibeem Tibeem was a member of the Cult of the Dragon in Phlan in 1489 DR . History . Tibeem and his fellow Spernik infiltrated Mantor ' s Library in Phlan in order to steal some books containing draconic lore .
description_long: Tibeem Tibeem was a member of the Cult of the Dragon in Phlan in 1489 DR . History . Tibeem and his fellow Spernik infiltrated Mantor ' s Library in Phlan in order to steal some books containing draconic lore . However , one day they were discovered and while Spernik managed to escape Tibeem was locked in combat with a summoned Knight of the Black Fist . He managed to kill the knight but was soon captured . Tibeem was brutally interrogated and died of his injuries .

title: Tidal wave
description: Tidal wave Tidal wave was an arcane alteration spell that created a huge destructive wave in a large body of water . In terms of damage and scope , it was one of the most powerful spells known in the Realms since Mystra ' s Ban in the Year of Sundered Webs , −339 DR . Effects .
description_long: Tidal wave Tidal wave was an arcane alteration spell that created a huge destructive wave in a large body of water . In terms of damage and scope , it was one of the most powerful spells known in the Realms since Mystra ' s Ban in the Year of Sundered Webs , −339 DR . Effects . This spell took thirty minutes to cast and was so taxing on the caster that he or she could not channel magical energy again for a few days afterward . When cast upon a large body of water , " tidal wave " created a single wave that was 75 ft ( 23 m ) high and at least 1 , 800 ft ( 550 m ) wide ( even wider for higher level casters ) that traveled in a chosen direction . The ponderous wave traveled at a pace slower than a walking gnome at 150 ft ( 46 m ) per minute , and could not be diverted once a direction was set . The spell lasted for over three hours ( again , even longer for more experienced casters ) or until the wave hit a shoreline . Swimming creatures near the surface of the water had a chance to move through the wave and come out the other side unscathed , but the unlucky were pummeled and crushed .

title: Tiefling
description: Tiefling Tieflings were human - based planetouched , native outsider s that were infused with the touch of the fiendish plane s , most often through descent from fiend s — demon s , Yugoloths , devil s , evil deities , and others who had bred with humans . Tieflings were known for their cunning and personal allure , which made them excellent deceivers as well as inspiring leaders when prejudices were laid aside . Although their evil ancestors could be many generations removed , the taint lingered .
description_long: Tiefling Tieflings were human - based planetouched , native outsider s that were infused with the touch of the fiendish plane s , most often through descent from fiend s — demon s , Yugoloths , devil s , evil deities , and others who had bred with humans . Tieflings were known for their cunning and personal allure , which made them excellent deceivers as well as inspiring leaders when prejudices were laid aside . Although their evil ancestors could be many generations removed , the taint lingered . Unlike half - fiend s , tieflings were not predisposed to evil alignments and varied in alignment nearly as widely as full humans , though tieflings were certainly devious . The celestial counterparts of tieflings were called aasimar . Similar races included fey ' ri , maeluth , tanarukk , and wispling s . Description . Tieflings tended to have an unsettling air about them , and most people were uncomfortable around them , whether they were aware of the tiefling ' s unsavory ancestry or not . While some looked like normal human s , most retained physical characteristics derived from their ancestor , with the most common such features being horns , prehensile tails , and pointed teeth .

title: Tiefling warfiend
description: Tiefling warfiend Tiefling warfiends are tiefling fighter s who use their fiend ish blood as a force for power . While many tiefling view their ancestry as a curse , tiefling warfiends learn to turn this dark " taint " into a source of brutal power , either for good or evil . These powerful warriors are deadly adversaries , consuming the energy of their foes and immersing their weapons in flame .
description_long: Tiefling warfiend Tiefling warfiends are tiefling fighter s who use their fiend ish blood as a force for power . While many tiefling view their ancestry as a curse , tiefling warfiends learn to turn this dark " taint " into a source of brutal power , either for good or evil . These powerful warriors are deadly adversaries , consuming the energy of their foes and immersing their weapons in flame . At their most basic levels , tiefling warfiends use their dark desires and emotions as well as their aptitude for flame to fuel lethal attacks . The diabolic bloodline of tieflings suits this methodology better , but all tieflings can take on the path of a tiefling warfiend and have throughout history . The first tiefling warfiends served Narfell as elite soldiers and some tiefling warfiends acquire their abilities through training by adherents to the empire ' s ancient traditions , but more than a few so without guidance . Whatever a warfiend ' s origin , it is up to the individual to use the powers of their path for good or evil , some choosing to use their abilities for sheer destruction while others mean only to channel their negative emotions into a more constructive purpose .

title: Tiega Gos
description: Tiega Gos Zora Tiega Gos ( pronounced ( ZORE - uh TEE - egg - uh GOSS ) was a noble in Mulmaster of the Gos family . History . In 1491 DR , for her birthday , Faltyn commissioned his nephew Andrik Gos to create a painting of her and hired Marim Tem as a musician , and hosted a party at the popular dance hall the Wave and Wink .
description_long: Tiega Gos Zora Tiega Gos ( pronounced ( ZORE - uh TEE - egg - uh GOSS ) was a noble in Mulmaster of the Gos family . History . In 1491 DR , for her birthday , Faltyn commissioned his nephew Andrik Gos to create a painting of her and hired Marim Tem as a musician , and hosted a party at the popular dance hall the Wave and Wink . However , during the party , Tiega was a victim of a mysterious arson attack by Kata Brizik , so Faltyn decided to hire an adventuring party to uncover the truth . Personality . Tiega was down to earth and friendly , in total opposition to her husband . She did not care for status . Tiega ' s interests were art , knowledge , and living life to its fullest , despite these not being typical characteristics of the Gos family . Relations . Tiega was the wife of Faltyn Gos , one of the members of the Blade s . Appendix . Gameplay . Only the very timely action of the players can save Tiega ' s life .

title: Tier Breche
description: Tier Breche Tier Breche was a cavern housing the Academy of Menzoberranzan , which consisted of Arach - Tinilith ( the clerical school ) , Sorcere ( the wizarding school ) , and Melee - Magthere ( the fighters ' school ) . Tier Breche was technically the name of the cavern where the Academy was located , but in common usage " Tier Breche " often referred to the Academy itself . Structure .
description_long: Tier Breche Tier Breche was a cavern housing the Academy of Menzoberranzan , which consisted of Arach - Tinilith ( the clerical school ) , Sorcere ( the wizarding school ) , and Melee - Magthere ( the fighters ' school ) . Tier Breche was technically the name of the cavern where the Academy was located , but in common usage " Tier Breche " often referred to the Academy itself . Structure . Tier Breche was a small side cavern off the main city cavern and consisted of the highest point in the city of Menzoberranzan . Additionally , two large spider statues could be animated to protect the Academy . It housed the three school complexes , which were carved from stalagmites and rock . Melee - Magthere , shaped like a pyramid , was located in the east . Sorcere , a many - spired tower , was located near the western wall . Arach - Tinilith , a spider - shaped complex and the largest of the three schools , both in terms of physical and numerical size , was located at the north of the cavern . A large staircase connected Tier Breche with the main city cavern . Two sentries , generally former students of Melee - Magthere , stood guard at the twin pillars .

title: Tierak Morcane
description: Tierak Morcane Tierak Morcane was a female drow priestess of Lolth and perhaps the sole surviving priestess from House Morcane after the Silence of Lolth . Description . Ever - scowling , Tierak Morcane was nevertheless a striking female and like many priestesses of Lolth , she had an almost palpable aura of authority about her .
description_long: Tierak Morcane Tierak Morcane was a female drow priestess of Lolth and perhaps the sole surviving priestess from House Morcane after the Silence of Lolth . Description . Ever - scowling , Tierak Morcane was nevertheless a striking female and like many priestesses of Lolth , she had an almost palpable aura of authority about her . Possessions . Tierak typically wore a shirt of fine mithral chain and a spider - shaped dagger at her belt . Whilst hiding in the Dordrien crypts she managed to bring a scroll of " invisibilty purge " and a wand of " searing light " with her . History . At the time of the Silence of Lolth in 1372 DR , Tierak was one of the many priestesses from House Morcane but she fled Szith Morcane when Kiaransaleean cultists overthrew the rulers of the settlement on Marpenoth 12th . After the fall of her House , Tierak found her way into the Dordrien crypts above Szith Morcane , along with a pair of skilled bodyguards and a Spellguard that were still loyal to her . Here they planned their reprisal against the followers of the White Banshee .

title: Tiger
description: Tiger Tigers were natural jungle cats that were native to both warm and cold forests of the world . They were distinguished from other great cats by their orange fur and black stripes . Also , unlike other great cats , tigers loved the water .
description_long: Tiger Tigers were natural jungle cats that were native to both warm and cold forests of the world . They were distinguished from other great cats by their orange fur and black stripes . Also , unlike other great cats , tigers loved the water . Their territories were often centered around or near a large body of water , such as a river or lake .

title: Tiger ' s Nest
description: Tiger ' s Nest The Tiger ' s Nest was an ancient monastery located in the Hordelands . History . Built in the age of the Imaskari Empire , the Tiger ' s Nest was originally an independent monastery of monks who fought against the evils of that empire , aiding the peasants of Imaskar against their rulers with powerful cleric spells .
description_long: Tiger ' s Nest The Tiger ' s Nest was an ancient monastery located in the Hordelands . History . Built in the age of the Imaskari Empire , the Tiger ' s Nest was originally an independent monastery of monks who fought against the evils of that empire , aiding the peasants of Imaskar against their rulers with powerful cleric spells . Their actions caused them to become known as the Invisible Tigers among the people , and their hidden fortress was nicknamed the Tiger ' s Nest . After the fall of the empire , most left the fortress , though the few that remained furthered their powers to the point they could survive on faith alone , without having to eat or even breathe . As of 1359 DR , only five monks remained at the Tiger ' s Nest , offering knowledge to those on the path of good . Their odd existence prevented them from fighting themselves , else they would vanish . The remaining Tigers viewed the Raja of Solon , Ambuchar Devayam , as their greatest enemy , though could do little against him due to his powers . Description . Built on the slopes of the A - Ling Shan , and across the Jumpa Chasm , the monastery was inaccessible beyond the use of magic . Appendix . Background .

title: Tiger ' s claws
description: Tiger ' s claws Tiger ' s claws were special weapon s in Zakhara . Description . Also called " bagh nakh " , these small weapons looked like brass knuckles that had spikes added so they stood out when the wearer made a fist .
description_long: Tiger ' s claws Tiger ' s claws were special weapon s in Zakhara . Description . Also called " bagh nakh " , these small weapons looked like brass knuckles that had spikes added so they stood out when the wearer made a fist . Uses . Since these weapons were small and easily concealed , they were favored by slayers and assassin s , who often coated the spikes with poison . Price . A pair of tiger ' s claws sold for 6 silver pieces .

title: Tiger eye agate
description: Tiger eye agate Tiger eye agate , also known as tiger ' s eye , was a member of the agate family . Description . This agate was a golden hue with dark brown stripes that exhibited a silky luster called .
description_long: Tiger eye agate Tiger eye agate , also known as tiger ' s eye , was a member of the agate family . Description . This agate was a golden hue with dark brown stripes that exhibited a silky luster called . This ornamental stone was named for its color and its stripes . A typical stone had a base value of 10 gp . Powers . Legends about this mineral said that it repelled undead and restless spirits , but had never been proven to be true . Regardless of this lack of evidence , the legend generated demand for tiger eye to be powdered and used in inks to mark caskets , sarcophagi , and tombs to prevent the dead from rising , and as an ingredient in " potions of undead control " .

title: Tigerworm
description: Tigerworm A tigerworm was a type of sea slug found in Kara - Tur . They were carnivorous and had black and orange stripes like the tiger , hence their name . By 1357 DR , tigerworms had infested E ' Tyon Bay north of Singye in Koryo .
description_long: Tigerworm A tigerworm was a type of sea slug found in Kara - Tur . They were carnivorous and had black and orange stripes like the tiger , hence their name . By 1357 DR , tigerworms had infested E ' Tyon Bay north of Singye in Koryo . They ' d sunk four fishing boats and a merchant ship . Singye authorities offered a reward to any who could eliminate the menace .

title: Tiglath
description: Tiglath Tiglath was the high priestess of Tiamat in Unther in 1357 DR and again in 1374 DR . History . Once Tiglath was a member of the Gilgeam ' s harem .
description_long: Tiglath Tiglath was the high priestess of Tiamat in Unther in 1357 DR and again in 1374 DR . History . Once Tiglath was a member of the Gilgeam ' s harem . In 1358 DR during the Godswar she helped Tiamat gained an other avatar and witnessed the battle between Gilgeam and her goddess but after Tilgath disappeared . At one point however she resurfaced in Messemprar and so after the Mulhorand ' s invasion Tiglath regained her position of high priestess and in 1374 Tiglath was the most powerful religious leader in the free Unther . Activities . Often she went in Eastern Shaar to coordinate with the bandit leader Furifax . Personality . Tiglath ' s goal was destroy Gilgeam and his church and Tiamat was only a means to an end . She was full with hatred and vengeance but was a no evil woman , a fact that concerned her goddess . After Godswar her new objective was create a united church of Tiamat . Relationship . Tiglath was a good friend with Furifax from many years .

title: Tilverton
description: Tilverton Tilverton was located on the Moonsea Ride in the Stonelands in Cormyr . Geography . Located at the strategic mouth of Tilver ' s Gap , between the Thunder Peaks and the Desertsmouth Mountains , Tilverton stood at the " T " intersection where the North Ride met the Moonsea Ride .
description_long: Tilverton Tilverton was located on the Moonsea Ride in the Stonelands in Cormyr . Geography . Located at the strategic mouth of Tilver ' s Gap , between the Thunder Peaks and the Desertsmouth Mountains , Tilverton stood at the " T " intersection where the North Ride met the Moonsea Ride . These roads led from the town to Arabel , via the Moonsea Ride and Shadowdale , via the North Ride . History . By 1357 DR , the city had come under complete Cormyrean occupation . In 1367 DR , the Rogues of Tilverton drove the agents of both the Zhentarim and the Dragon Cult out of Tilverton , to establish themselves as outlaw force to be reckoned with . Even a brief foray by the Fire Knives was repelled . Animal pelt traders from the Thunder Peaks and the Storm Horns did brisk business in Tilverton as of 1368 DR . The Destruction of Tilverton . On Mirtul 27 1372 DR , Tilverton was destroyed when it was attacked by the forces of Thultanthar . All that was left of the town was a dark , concave space filled with shadows and flitting regions of deeper darkness . Though Tilverton is now destroyed and desolate , the city ' s walls rise high above the flat plain on which it once stood .

title: Tilverton Scar
description: Tilverton Scar The Tilverton Scar is all that is left after the town of Tilverton was attacked by the forces of Thultanthar on Mirtul 27 1372 DR . As of 1479 DR , the Tilverton Scar is the only known area of plagueland in Cormyr . Surrounding Land .
description_long: Tilverton Scar The Tilverton Scar is all that is left after the town of Tilverton was attacked by the forces of Thultanthar on Mirtul 27 1372 DR . As of 1479 DR , the Tilverton Scar is the only known area of plagueland in Cormyr . Surrounding Land . A number of homes , most of them belonging to hardy herders and horse ranchers who refuse to be scared away , can be found around the former city ' s site . By 1479 DR a small keep had been erected within a few hundred yards of the pocket of plagueland . The curious could use this keep to examine the plagueland with some safety . Those who ventured too close were sometimes marked with a spellscar or worse . History . Destruction of Tilverton . On Mirtul 27 1372 DR , Tilverton was destroyed when it was attacked by the forces of Thultanthar . All that was left of the town was a dark , concave space filled with shadows and flitting regions of deeper darkness . Though Tilverton is now destroyed and desolate , the city ' s walls rise high above the flat plain on which it once stood . By 1479 DR , Tilverton had changed from shadows to a “ spiral of endless darkness and blue fire ” , said by some to be inhabited by something .

title: Time conduit
description: Time conduit Time conduit is an incredibly rare , powerful spell that allows the creation of a very short - lived portal backwards through time . It causes items that are anachronisms in the destination time to be removed , only restored into existence on the bearer ' s return to his or her own time . Pages from spellbooks or scrolls that refer to spells not yet in existence become blank , only being restored if the bearer travels forward in time again .
description_long: Time conduit Time conduit is an incredibly rare , powerful spell that allows the creation of a very short - lived portal backwards through time . It causes items that are anachronisms in the destination time to be removed , only restored into existence on the bearer ' s return to his or her own time . Pages from spellbooks or scrolls that refer to spells not yet in existence become blank , only being restored if the bearer travels forward in time again . It is possible for the caster to decide upon the destination time and culture , and this can potentially create the other end of the portal at any rough location the caster chooses . Drawbacks . The spell causes those traveling through the portal to age by one year , but their stay in the alternate time cannot last more than thirty days . The portal will always take the time travelers to the first day of the destination year , and will always return them on the last day of the original year . Beings cannot exist in two places at once on the timeline , so it is impossible to travel to the same destination time twice , and an attempt to do so will cause the spell to fail catastrophically . Materials .

title: Time gate
description: Time gate A time gate was a permanent physical portal through time . There were only a handful on Faerûn and their locations were unknown to all except certain elven High Mage s . The gates ' exact ages were unknown , but they predated even the coming of the dwarves .
description_long: Time gate A time gate was a permanent physical portal through time . There were only a handful on Faerûn and their locations were unknown to all except certain elven High Mage s . The gates ' exact ages were unknown , but they predated even the coming of the dwarves . The gates had the power to transport an individual to any point in the past , according to the wishes of the individual walking through . If no particular period in time was thought of , then the individual was transported to a random point in the past . The effect of walking through a gate was otherwise similar to the " time conduit " spell . An expedition to locate the lost time gates was launched in 404 DR . Locations . The only mentions of the locations of the gates were made in Mystryl ' s ancient texts . First gate . The first gate : Amaunator ' s belt was a constellation appearing in the summer over the Spine of the World . The gate was within a deep cave and was guarded by a vain and greedy white dragon , who demanded a hefty fee to allow anyone past . Second gate . The texts stated that the second gate was : Misken ' s Peak was since demolished by the Great Glacier and the portal buried beneath the ice .

title: Time of Dragons
description: Time of Dragons The Time of Dragons was a period in Faerûn ' s history that coincided with the Dawn Age , between - 30000 DR to - 24000 DR . The Time of Dragons began in - 30000 DR when the dragon s of Faerûn launched devastating attacks against the dominant Aearee Empires throughout the land , air , and underground , creating the first Flight of Dragons , destroying those nations completely . They also battled against giants over territory , forcing giantkind to yield their lands and flee to the north .
description_long: Time of Dragons The Time of Dragons was a period in Faerûn ' s history that coincided with the Dawn Age , between - 30000 DR to - 24000 DR . The Time of Dragons began in - 30000 DR when the dragon s of Faerûn launched devastating attacks against the dominant Aearee Empires throughout the land , air , and underground , creating the first Flight of Dragons , destroying those nations completely . They also battled against giants over territory , forcing giantkind to yield their lands and flee to the north . Individual dragons and dragon clans came to rule large swaths of territory and battled with their rivals not only for dominion of those lands , but also over matters of religious nature as the dragons of this age were devout followers of the Draconic pantheon . This period of devastating warfare among the dragons of Toril led the race to near extinction .

title: Time of Troubles
description: Time of Troubles The Time of Troubles , also known as the Arrival , the Godswar and the Avatar Crisis , was a cataclysmic time period in the chronology of Faerûn . Taking place during 1358 DR , the Year of Shadows , the Time of Troubles was a period during which the deities of Faerûn were forced to walk the earth in their mortal avatar forms . Several major deities died during the Time of Troubles ( see Deaths , Ascensions , and Resurrections ) and a handful of mortals rose to divinity .
description_long: Time of Troubles The Time of Troubles , also known as the Arrival , the Godswar and the Avatar Crisis , was a cataclysmic time period in the chronology of Faerûn . Taking place during 1358 DR , the Year of Shadows , the Time of Troubles was a period during which the deities of Faerûn were forced to walk the earth in their mortal avatar forms . Several major deities died during the Time of Troubles ( see Deaths , Ascensions , and Resurrections ) and a handful of mortals rose to divinity . Summary . The Time of Troubles was precipitated by an attempt by the gods Bane and Myrkul to steal the Tablets of Fate from the overdeity Ao . Angry at the gods for their habitual pursuit of power and negligence toward their mortal faithful , Lord Ao relegated every god ( except for the guardian god Helm , selected to protect the gates to the heavens ) to walk among their followers on the earth . The immediate effects of this edict were threefold . First , divine magic ( spells granted to clerics by their patron deities ) ceased to function altogether unless the cleric was within one mile of their deity ' s avatar .

title: Time sphere
description: Time sphere The Time sphere was a group of spells granted to monk s that allowed manipulation of the flow of time and the effects of time . Spells in normal text were listed in the Tome of Magic 2nd edition . Spells in italics were added to the Time Sphere in the sourcebook .
description_long: Time sphere The Time sphere was a group of spells granted to monk s that allowed manipulation of the flow of time and the effects of time . Spells in normal text were listed in the Tome of Magic 2nd edition . Spells in italics were added to the Time Sphere in the sourcebook .

title: Timmask
description: Timmask Timmask was a fungus that grew in the Underdark . It was known colloquially as " the devil ' s mushroom " . Description .
description_long: Timmask Timmask was a fungus that grew in the Underdark . It was known colloquially as " the devil ' s mushroom " . Description . Timmask was a squat toadstool that grew to a height of about two feet ( 60 centimeters ) . It had a beige - colored cap that was crossed with red and orange stripes . If it was heavily damaged or killed by uprooting , it spewed a cloud of spores out to a radius of 15 ft ( 4 . 6 m ) . All those within the cloud were poisoned for about a minute unless their constitution was sufficient to shake off the effects of the spores . Those who failed to resist acted like they were under the influence of a " confusion " spell until it wore off .

title: Timor
description: Timor Timor " the Scar " was a member of the Shields of the Highland adventuring company in Tethyr in 1370 DR . Description . Timor wore a sparse black beard .
description_long: Timor Timor " the Scar " was a member of the Shields of the Highland adventuring company in Tethyr in 1370 DR . Description . Timor wore a sparse black beard . He received his nickname from the nasty red scars that marked him from the corner of his right eye down his cheek and neck . Personality . Usually , Timor was friendly and exuberant . History . Timor hailed from a village near the Forest of Mir , like all his companions in the Shields . On Uktar 8 , 1370 DR , the Shields of the Highland lost two of their members , including Timor ' s own younger brother , Dumax , while guarding a caravan . Unexpected cold weather led to snow , and a band of fourteen gnoll s were able to track them and attack them , killing two of them during the ensuing battle . At dusk two days later , Timor and the other three survivors went to the Blue Badger Inn in the village of Toralth to grieve their loss . Timor was completely depressed from his loss and constantly murmured . They found a bard in the tavern , calling himself Fylson Tarasp , and demanded that he compose a dirge for their two fallen friends . They had no idea that this man was actually a secret agent of the sea elf Gantar Kraok .

title: Timoshenko
description: Timoshenko Timoshenko , as of 1372 DR , is the Grandfather of Assassins , the leader of the Citadel of Assassins in Damara . He rose to power after Kane defeated the last Grandfather . Backed by the archmage Knellict , Timoshenko surpassed Banak in power , a once mighty priest of Orcus , who was the other candidate for leader of the Citadel .
description_long: Timoshenko Timoshenko , as of 1372 DR , is the Grandfather of Assassins , the leader of the Citadel of Assassins in Damara . He rose to power after Kane defeated the last Grandfather . Backed by the archmage Knellict , Timoshenko surpassed Banak in power , a once mighty priest of Orcus , who was the other candidate for leader of the Citadel . Although Timoshenko is a mighty warrior he is thoughtful , conservative , and takes advice from Knellict often . In recent years , Timoshenko plays the political face of the organization . He lets his lieutenants carry out the dirty work . History . In 1357 DR Timoshenko was the commander of the bandit army when they attacked Bloodstone Village .

title: Timoth Eyesbright
description: Timoth Eyesbright Timoth Eyesbright was a male centaur adventurer who was known as a friend of Vajra Valmeyjar and Onyx the Invincible and as a hero of the Reclamation Wars . Personality . Timoth was quite loquacious .
description_long: Timoth Eyesbright Timoth Eyesbright was a male centaur adventurer who was known as a friend of Vajra Valmeyjar and Onyx the Invincible and as a hero of the Reclamation Wars . Personality . Timoth was quite loquacious . Sympathetic to a cause , he was quick to gallop to someone ' s aid and would tear up at their misfortunes . He was a good soul and perhaps too trusting . Possessions . In battle , Timoth wielded a longbow and a double - bladed sword . This distinctive weapon was extendable , the blades extending from the size of daggers to full - length swords . He would also use the bow to bludgeon foes . Later , he fought with a plain longsword . History . Timoth was originally from Chondath . By the late 1350s DR , Timoth had fallen in with a dwarven adventurer named Onyx the Invincible . Waterdeep . In the Year of the Prince , 1357 DR , Timoth was traveling with Onyx when they came across an elven maid being kidnapped by chasme . Quick to help , Timoth battled the winged creatures , and together they rescued Cybriana . Timoth volunteered himself and Onyx in escorting Cybriana to Waterdeep , though it was twenty leagues out of their way .

title: Timothy J . Kask
description: Timothy J . Kask Timothy J . Kask was a game designer for TSR , Inc .
description_long: Timothy J . Kask Timothy J . Kask was a game designer for TSR , Inc . and the first editor of " Dragon " magazine . Background . Tim Kask grew up in Moline , Illinois . He attended . He was one of the first play - testers of Gary Gygax ' s first edition of Dungeons & Dragons .

title: Ting Mei Wan
description: Ting Mei Wan Ting Mei Wan was the Minister of State Security of Shou Lung . Personality . Ting Mei Wan was a ruthless and ambitious woman who possessed great charm .
description_long: Ting Mei Wan Ting Mei Wan was the Minister of State Security of Shou Lung . Personality . Ting Mei Wan was a ruthless and ambitious woman who possessed great charm . She trusted no one , including her mentor Ju - Hai Chou . She was fanatical to the extreme in her job . In time she become power - hungry . History . Ting Mei Wan efficiently led the Secret Police Department , unveiling many rebels and traitors along the way . Around 1350 DR , the Minister of State , Ju - Hai Chou , appointed her as the new Minister of Security . In 1358 DR , Ting Mei Wan was completely caught off guard by events in Chu ' Yuan province . She executed many of her local officers and relieved many others of their duties . Her goal was to kill anyone involved in the matter . Ting Mei Wan was disappointed by the Emperor ' s idea to hire an adventuring party , sensing this as an insult and a lack of faith in her abilities . Ting Mei Wan later sent spies to watch the adventuring party and patrols with orders to arrest them based upon falsified accusations . In 1359 - 1360 during the Horde invasion Ting Mei Wan decided to secretly offered valuable information to the tuigan to gain political advantage .

title: Tintageer
description: Tintageer Tintageer was the capital of an ancient gold elven realm in the Faerie . It was an island that boasted one of the most wondrous and populous civilizations in all of Faerie . After some kind of war it was threatened by a tremendous flood created by magical powers .
description_long: Tintageer Tintageer was the capital of an ancient gold elven realm in the Faerie . It was an island that boasted one of the most wondrous and populous civilizations in all of Faerie . After some kind of war it was threatened by a tremendous flood created by magical powers . Many inhabitants of Tintageer were already dead , when the flood reached the shore . Only 100 survivors followed the last surviving heir to the throne , prince Durothil to the top of a nearby hill . There , Bonnalurie , the last priestess of Angharradh , helped to create a portal and sacrificed herself in the process of controlling the High Magic . Only fifty elves made it through the portal which led them to Faerûn . With them came prince Durothil and the moon elf Sharlario Moonflower , who became one of the ancestors of all moon elves and the founder of the Moonflower clan . The elves from Tintageer defeated the red wyrm Mahatnartorian , making themselves a realm in northern Faerûn .

title: Tirichik
description: Tirichik The tirichik was one of the most feared monsters of the Great Glacier , second only to white dragon s . Description . Tirichik were strange creatures that some described as a cross between a dragon and a centipede , but they had no true relation to either .
description_long: Tirichik The tirichik was one of the most feared monsters of the Great Glacier , second only to white dragon s . Description . Tirichik were strange creatures that some described as a cross between a dragon and a centipede , but they had no true relation to either . A tirichik had a long , white - scaled , tube - shaped body about 30 feet ( 9 meters ) in length , with a stumpy tail and a roughly dragon - shaped head . A bony ridge extended the whole length of the monster . It had two open , horn - shaped ear appendages , two pale pink eyes sunk deep in its skull , and two retractable , 20 - foot ( 6 - meter ) tentacles that extended from two holes on the top of its many - toothed jaw . A tirichik had four pairs of stubby legs that ended in broad , saucer - shaped and clawed feet , which gave it good maneuverability over ice and atop snow . Tirichik were completely immune to the hazards of cold , whether natural or magical . Tirichik were more intelligent than common animals but not by much . They could not speak and made no sounds . Combat . Tirichik preferred to ambush their prey , bursting out from under snow or popping up from out of a crevasse in the glacier .

title: Titan
description: Titan Titans are the largest of the giant race , standing even taller than cloud or storm giant s . Perchance they interact with other giants , they are ranked highest on the Ordning , above all other giants , giant - kin , and ogre s . They should not be mistaken with the Dawn Titans , or primordial s ( although the punishment for arrogance that lead to the creation of the Sea of Fallen Stars may very well be a confusion between the titans and the Dawn Titans ) .
description_long: Titan Titans are the largest of the giant race , standing even taller than cloud or storm giant s . Perchance they interact with other giants , they are ranked highest on the Ordning , above all other giants , giant - kin , and ogre s . They should not be mistaken with the Dawn Titans , or primordial s ( although the punishment for arrogance that lead to the creation of the Sea of Fallen Stars may very well be a confusion between the titans and the Dawn Titans ) . Combat . Titans typically wield a huge warhammer but also carry javelin s to throw . Although they aren ' t mages , Titans have numerous spell - like abilities such as holy smite , meteor swarm , and chain lightning . Subspecies . Death titan • Earth titan • Eldritch titan • Fire titan • Frost titan • Stone titan • Storm titan

title: Tithlin
description: Tithlin The Tithlin family was a noble merchant family of the city of Tantras in the Vast . The head of the family sat on the High Council that governed Tantras . In 1358 DR , shortly after the Time of Troubles , the Tithlins were allied with the Channath , Elovear , Laranadda , and Vandover families .
description_long: Tithlin The Tithlin family was a noble merchant family of the city of Tantras in the Vast . The head of the family sat on the High Council that governed Tantras . In 1358 DR , shortly after the Time of Troubles , the Tithlins were allied with the Channath , Elovear , Laranadda , and Vandover families .

title: Tiztor
description: Tiztor Tiztor the Great was a male human wizard from Mulmaster in the Moonsea area in the 14th century DR . Activities . Tiztor was obsessed with discovering the secret of the Thunder Stone , a monolith that stood at the center of the town of Thunderstone in Cormyr .
description_long: Tiztor Tiztor the Great was a male human wizard from Mulmaster in the Moonsea area in the 14th century DR . Activities . Tiztor was obsessed with discovering the secret of the Thunder Stone , a monolith that stood at the center of the town of Thunderstone in Cormyr . Although all spells of detection had reported it to bear no magic , and it exhibited no clear powers bar being said to be lucky , Tiztor was certain it was actually magical . He believed that if the correct command word was spoken , then the Stone ' s power would be activated , but he did not know the word could be . History . In the late 1360s DR , Tiztor made a brief visit to Thunderstone in order to study the eponymous stone . He had a few hypotheses about it to test out , following which he planned to teleport back to Mulmaster . He was willing to hire adventurers for a fact - finding mission in town , though such inquisitiveness was likely to aggravate the local Purple Dragons contingent . Personality . Tiztor the Great was ambitious and obsessive , but he was primarily a scholar . Equipment .

title: Tleobar T ' Enorgh
description: Tleobar T ' Enorgh Tleobar T ' Enorgh was a former drow adventuress from the Forest of Mir , the chosen guardian of the drow settlement of Dallnothax , and an agent of the Twisted Rune . Relationships . Tleobar was married to Raaghar T ' Enorgh , the ruler of Dallnothax and a priest of Vhaeraun .
description_long: Tleobar T ' Enorgh Tleobar T ' Enorgh was a former drow adventuress from the Forest of Mir , the chosen guardian of the drow settlement of Dallnothax , and an agent of the Twisted Rune . Relationships . Tleobar was married to Raaghar T ' Enorgh , the ruler of Dallnothax and a priest of Vhaeraun . Together , they worked as key agents for the Twisted Rune . She despised the Company of Eight and especially their leader Sylvanus Moondrop , and had taken a vow to slay each one of them . She planned to drop Sylvanus into the Spiders ' Maw , a deep rift below Dallnothax . History . Around 1343 DR , Sylvanus Moondrop led a band of elves from the Forest of Tethir and Shilmista to assault Allsihwann , the drow surface enclave where Tleobar lived and utterly destroyed it . In 1355 DR , Tleobar was an adventuress , and her party was questing in the Forest of Tethir with the intent to slay and rob the gold dragon Garlokantha when they were attacked by the Company of Eight . Garlokantha was saved and all of Tleobar ' s adventuring companions were killed ; she was the only survivor . It was then that she recognized Sylvanus Moondrop as the same elf who had led the attack on her former home .

title: Tlossarylathaunglar
description: Tlossarylathaunglar Tlossarylathaunglar was a dracolich in the Underdark . History . Tlossarylathaunglar was one of the oldest and most fell creations of the Cult of the Dragon .
description_long: Tlossarylathaunglar Tlossarylathaunglar was a dracolich in the Underdark . History . Tlossarylathaunglar was one of the oldest and most fell creations of the Cult of the Dragon . Once after , he had destroyed many deep gnome cities and many communities of drow , duergar , and dwarves by shattering lake basins in the bedrock above them , Elminster defeated and froze Tlossarylathaunglar in an Underdark lake . In 1487 DR , Elminster summoned him to Myth Drannor in order to create chaos among the Sembia n mercenaries and bound Tlossarylathaunglar to that city .

title: Tluth Melarn
description: Tluth Melarn Tluth Melarn was a drow and one of Houndaer Tuin ' Tarl and Syrzan ' s group in Menzoberranzan in 1372 . History . During the Silence of Lolth , Tluth joined Houndaer ' s group in order to start a slave revolt .
description_long: Tluth Melarn Tluth Melarn was a drow and one of Houndaer Tuin ' Tarl and Syrzan ' s group in Menzoberranzan in 1372 . History . During the Silence of Lolth , Tluth joined Houndaer ' s group in order to start a slave revolt . Tluth and Alton the Cobbler acted as bodyguards of the magical disguised Syrzan at one meeting of goblinoid slaves . He was eventually killed in the suppression of the revolt .

title: To ' Zon
description: To ' Zon To ' Zon was a korobokuru wu jen inhabiting the Rainbow Monastery in Ra - Khati during the mid 14th century DR . Appearance . To ' Zon stood 4 ft .
description_long: To ' Zon To ' Zon was a korobokuru wu jen inhabiting the Rainbow Monastery in Ra - Khati during the mid 14th century DR . Appearance . To ' Zon stood 4 ft . ( 1 . 2 m ) tall and had long shaggy hair . Personality . A strong temper and unpredictable nature often spelled trouble for To ' Zun . Activities . The Tuigan army forced To ' Zon into service when they passed through the region . However , he helped organized a desertion for some of the soldiers , eventually leading them to the Rainbow Monastery . His wu jen taboo was to never cut his hair or bathe . Abilities . To ' Zon could cast the following spells : " magic missile " , " invisibility " , " detect invisible " , " fire shuriken " , " haste " , " protection from normal missiles " , and " wall of fire " . He could also focus his " ki " , allowing him to execute sudden bursts of speed that usually caught his opponents off - guard . His " ki " could also be used to magnify the effects of his spells . Possessions . To ' Zon wore a pair of " bracers of defense " .

title: To Sever the Snake ' s Head
description: To Sever the Snake ' s Head With a massive attack against the city of Loudwater expected to come within a week and allies from Silverymoon being sparse , the party are asked to slip past enemy lines and kill the leaders of the Zhentarim and devil ish army . Loudwater ' s leaders hope that if the party cause enough deaths in the higher ranks of the coming force that they will be easier to defeat or , even better , the enemy will abandon the attack altogether . This was the final Tides of War adventure and also the final Legacy of the Green Regent module to be published before the campaign was abandoned .
description_long: To Sever the Snake ' s Head With a massive attack against the city of Loudwater expected to come within a week and allies from Silverymoon being sparse , the party are asked to slip past enemy lines and kill the leaders of the Zhentarim and devil ish army . Loudwater ' s leaders hope that if the party cause enough deaths in the higher ranks of the coming force that they will be easier to defeat or , even better , the enemy will abandon the attack altogether . This was the final Tides of War adventure and also the final Legacy of the Green Regent module to be published before the campaign was abandoned . It was hoped that the campaign would continue and one more module had already been planned but it was never written .

title: Toad
description: Toad A toad ( or frog — the terms were more or less interchangeable ) was any of a number of species of amphibians characterized by dry , leathery skin ( usually pink and orange - colored ) , short legs , and snout - like parotoid glands . Locations . Toads were found in the Calim Desert , the Great Swamp of Rethild , and at Toad Knoll in Shadowdale .
description_long: Toad A toad ( or frog — the terms were more or less interchangeable ) was any of a number of species of amphibians characterized by dry , leathery skin ( usually pink and orange - colored ) , short legs , and snout - like parotoid glands . Locations . Toads were found in the Calim Desert , the Great Swamp of Rethild , and at Toad Knoll in Shadowdale . Ecology . Toads could serve as familiar s to mage s . Frogs were eaten in many regional dishes , such as brassla . In culture . Geographical locations were sometimes named after toads , such as Toad Knoll and Toadsquat Mountains . History . The wizard Dhaerivus was once turned into a toad at a magefair . In 1358 DR , the wizard Regweld Harpell was experimenting with merging horses and frogs . He named his first " success " Puddlejumper .

title: Toad ( demon )
description: Toad ( demon ) Toad was a hezrou servant of the demon lord Graz ' zt . History . During the Rage of Demons , Graz ' zt sent Toad to serve the cambion siblings Gattash and Rashara , who had gained control of a kuo - toa tribe .
description_long: Toad ( demon ) Toad was a hezrou servant of the demon lord Graz ' zt . History . During the Rage of Demons , Graz ' zt sent Toad to serve the cambion siblings Gattash and Rashara , who had gained control of a kuo - toa tribe . Gattash and Rashara bullied Toad . He was ordered to remain in his lair until the cambions needed him . Personality . Toad was very stupid but believed himself smart . He knew that the cambions were bullying him and wanted to rebel but was alone and knew he needed allies first .

title: Toad Knoll
description: Toad Knoll Toad Knoll was found just north of the North Ride , less than a mile west of the bridge over the Ashaba in Shadowdale . Toad Knoll took its name from the bumper crop of frogs and toads that occurred in the spring months , living and breeding in the marshy ground at base of Toad Knoll , caused by the the upwelling of an intermittent natural spring .
description_long: Toad Knoll Toad Knoll was found just north of the North Ride , less than a mile west of the bridge over the Ashaba in Shadowdale . Toad Knoll took its name from the bumper crop of frogs and toads that occurred in the spring months , living and breeding in the marshy ground at base of Toad Knoll , caused by the the upwelling of an intermittent natural spring .

title: Toadsquat Mountains
description: Toadsquat Mountains The Toadsquat Mountains , or the Little Mountains , formed the northern border of Luiren in the Shining South in 1367 DR . Inhabitants . This mountain range was infested with ogres .
description_long: Toadsquat Mountains The Toadsquat Mountains , or the Little Mountains , formed the northern border of Luiren in the Shining South in 1367 DR . Inhabitants . This mountain range was infested with ogres . Attracted by the mountain ' s rich silver deposits , dwarves helped clear some of the ogre tribes in the east to gain access to mines . Post Spellplague . The Toadsquat Mountains were slumped alongside the Beastlands ' southern shore . Among their secrets , the fortress of Castle Al ' hanar , which resided on the west bank of Blood Lake .

title: Toal
description: Toal A toal was a Waterdhavian coin worth two gold pieces in the city , but outside Waterdeep , these coins were practically worthless . Description . The toal was a square brass coin with a hole in the center to allow it to be strung on a string .
description_long: Toal A toal was a Waterdhavian coin worth two gold pieces in the city , but outside Waterdeep , these coins were practically worthless . Description . The toal was a square brass coin with a hole in the center to allow it to be strung on a string .

title: Tobin
description: Tobin Tobin , also known as Tobin Tok Tor , was a goliath warrior and a member of Corvus Nightfeather ' s Circus of Wonders . Description . Like most goliaths , Tobin was much taller and heavier than a human .
description_long: Tobin Tobin , also known as Tobin Tok Tor , was a goliath warrior and a member of Corvus Nightfeather ' s Circus of Wonders . Description . Like most goliaths , Tobin was much taller and heavier than a human . Personality . Although Tobin formerly played the strongman role , he always wanted to play the clown , a role he was able to pursue when Cephas joined the circus . Possessions . Tobin used a great mattock in battle . History . Tobin was found by Corvus wandering in the mountains after he had been kicked out of his tribe for not being a fierce warrior . He participated in Corvus ' rescue of Cephas and traveled with Cephas to Almraiven , where he was attacked by renegade members of the Firestorm Cabal and magically teleported to Calimport . In Calimport , he was forced to fight in the arena , where he lost all six of his fights , though he survived . When his friends Cynda and Shan were about to fight each other in the arena , he used his clown routine to keep the crowd entertained long enough for Cephas to remove the magical stone that kept the Pasha ' s palace in the air .

title: Tocka
description: Tocka Tocka was a gnome holy slayer and member of the Gilded Palm in Zakhara in 1367 DR . History . Tocka once served as the personal attendant of the Sultana of Hiyal , Alurah bint Asrah .
description_long: Tocka Tocka was a gnome holy slayer and member of the Gilded Palm in Zakhara in 1367 DR . History . Tocka once served as the personal attendant of the Sultana of Hiyal , Alurah bint Asrah . Those who knew of Tocka ' s association with the Gilded Palm often pleaded to him about their problems to make them disappear .

title: Todd Gamble
description: Todd Gamble Todd Alan Gamble is an artist , illustrator , and cartographer , focusing on fantasy illustration . He has worked for Wizards of the Coast and several other gaming companies . He lives in .
description_long: Todd Gamble Todd Alan Gamble is an artist , illustrator , and cartographer , focusing on fantasy illustration . He has worked for Wizards of the Coast and several other gaming companies . He lives in . He works on three - dimensional scale models and dedicates much of his time to volunteer and educational projects . Education . Gamble has degrees in advertising design and fine arts with an emphasis on drawing and structure .

title: Todd Lockwood
description: Todd Lockwood Todd Lockwood was born in Boulder , Colorado and went on to graduate from the Colorado Institute of Art . He did freelance advertising work for fifteen years , managing to win several awards whilst also spending his free time playing " Dungeons & Dragons " . Inspired by artists such as Brom , Todd began doing artwork for sci - fi / fantasy magazines before going to work for Chaosium and Phil Foglio .
description_long: Todd Lockwood Todd Lockwood was born in Boulder , Colorado and went on to graduate from the Colorado Institute of Art . He did freelance advertising work for fifteen years , managing to win several awards whilst also spending his free time playing " Dungeons & Dragons " . Inspired by artists such as Brom , Todd began doing artwork for sci - fi / fantasy magazines before going to work for Chaosium and Phil Foglio . He was then referred to TSR , Inc . ' s art director at the time , Stephen Daniele in 1996 and has worked on TSR / Wizards of the Coast products ever since . In the " Forgotten Realms " , Todd is best known as the artist behind many of the " Legend of Drizzt " novel covers as well as the artwork for several sourcebooks .

title: Togar Ironseth
description: Togar Ironseth Togar Ironseth was a human blacksmith in Amnwater , Amn , around 1368 DR , and a member of the Ironseth family , owners of about half of the land around Amnwater . Description . The large dark skinned smith learned his trade from a dwarven blacksmith .
description_long: Togar Ironseth Togar Ironseth was a human blacksmith in Amnwater , Amn , around 1368 DR , and a member of the Ironseth family , owners of about half of the land around Amnwater . Description . The large dark skinned smith learned his trade from a dwarven blacksmith . Relationships . Togar ' s father was Lord Ghaark Ironseth . Togar was best friends with Lord Jhanos Yhliivast .

title: Tohkkal Burrwarden
description: Tohkkal Burrwarden Tohkkal Burrwarden was a shopkeeper in Skullport . Activities . Tohkkal , along with her twin brother Tykkyl Burrwarden , managed the shop Clockwork Wonders .
description_long: Tohkkal Burrwarden Tohkkal Burrwarden was a shopkeeper in Skullport . Activities . Tohkkal , along with her twin brother Tykkyl Burrwarden , managed the shop Clockwork Wonders . Personality . Tohkkal was the more practical of the Burrwarden twins . It was her organizational skills that kept the shop open . Tohkkal cared deeply for Tykkyl , but was concerned about his inspiration .

title: Tohrepur
description: Tohrepur Tohrepur was a ruined city in the Mere - That - Was region of Akanûl .
