The city formerly sat on the shores of the Akanamere but when the Spellplague dried up the lake , the waters receded and the city was left beyond the waters reach . The Abolethic Sovereignty destroyed Tohrepur in 1473 DR and turned its residents into aberrations .
description_long: Tohrepur Tohrepur was a ruined city in the Mere - That - Was region of Akanûl . The city formerly sat on the shores of the Akanamere but when the Spellplague dried up the lake , the waters receded and the city was left beyond the waters reach . The Abolethic Sovereignty destroyed Tohrepur in 1473 DR and turned its residents into aberrations . Tohrepur was then the home of a plaguechanged Sirine who was worshipped by a cult known as The Choir .

title: Toipeye
description: Toipeye Toipeye was a korobokuru bushi adventurer in Kozakura . History . Toipeye was aways be an outcast even among his tribe for his unattractive aspect and a bad temperament .
description_long: Toipeye Toipeye was a korobokuru bushi adventurer in Kozakura . History . Toipeye was aways be an outcast even among his tribe for his unattractive aspect and a bad temperament . He on contrary believed to be festinated to great exploits . He abandoned his family after batting a minstrel that showed in comical mode his last adventures . In 1357 DR , Toipeye was among the candidates values by Ko Mei Kho for the mission in Akari . In 1358 Toipeye ' s family finally took pride for his successes , forgiving him for his outrageous breach of etiquette . Toipeye however was still convinced that they only tolerated him , and was looking for greater actions to justify his abilities when was possibly approached by Ko Ho San Behind the scenes . Toipeye is a pre - generated PC for use in adventures in Akari . He was presented again upgraded for adventure in T ' u Lung .

title: Tokan
description: Tokan Tokan was the chieftain of the dwarven Orothiar Clan in Bloodstone Barony in 1357 DR . Activities . Tokan normally spoke of ancient events like they happened yesterday .
description_long: Tokan Tokan was the chieftain of the dwarven Orothiar Clan in Bloodstone Barony in 1357 DR . Activities . Tokan normally spoke of ancient events like they happened yesterday . History . In 1357 DR Tokan and his tribe met Gareth Dragonsbane ' s party . Later he joined the council that ruled the Barony . In 1359 DR Tokan and his people had joined the Alliance of Belt Watchers with local halfling s and centaur s .

title: Tokol
description: Tokol Tokol was a leader of Kultaka in 1361 DR . History . Tokol was one of the four sons of Takamal .
description_long: Tokol Tokol was a leader of Kultaka in 1361 DR . History . Tokol was one of the four sons of Takamal . After his father ' s defeat and death at the hands of the Golden Legion , he and his brothers submitted to Cordell . Cordell instead considered them as allies , gaining the absolute loyalty of Tokol . Later , he led troops at Palul , advising Cordell to be cautious . During the Night of Wailing he was with his troops in the central square of Nexal when the armies of the Viperhands attacked . He sensed he and his people dead when the legionaries reinforced them , permitting to Tokol and few of his men to escape . After the Night of Wailing Tokol became the most strenuous ally of Cordell As of 1362 DR Tokol was the ruler of Kultaka and still the most precious ally of Cordell .

title: Tola Vrass
description: Tola Vrass Tola Vrass was the beautiful and charasmatic leader of the Thay an enclave within Hillsfar . She served under the Zulkir of illusion , Mythrellan . Tola was involved in a bit of a courtship with Maalthiir , as the two were mutually attracted to one another both realized the power and benefits a successful alliance would garner for their power structures .
description_long: Tola Vrass Tola Vrass was the beautiful and charasmatic leader of the Thay an enclave within Hillsfar . She served under the Zulkir of illusion , Mythrellan . Tola was involved in a bit of a courtship with Maalthiir , as the two were mutually attracted to one another both realized the power and benefits a successful alliance would garner for their power structures .

title: Tolgar Anuvien
description: Tolgar Anuvien Tolgar Anuvien is the impressive and veteran member of the Company of Crazed Venturers along with being the founder of the Goldenfields . It is in this latter endeavor that he believes he is truly doing the work of Chauntea , the goddess whom he venerates . Becoming a very wealthy man after his many years of adventuring , Tolgar has gained great amounts of wealth which he has stored at his house in Waterdeep , the Dripping Dagger inn and with several friends including the palace of Piergeiron .
description_long: Tolgar Anuvien Tolgar Anuvien is the impressive and veteran member of the Company of Crazed Venturers along with being the founder of the Goldenfields . It is in this latter endeavor that he believes he is truly doing the work of Chauntea , the goddess whom he venerates . Becoming a very wealthy man after his many years of adventuring , Tolgar has gained great amounts of wealth which he has stored at his house in Waterdeep , the Dripping Dagger inn and with several friends including the palace of Piergeiron . Personality . Tolgar has a particularly quick wit and rather dry sense of humor . Relationships . Along with Piergeiron , Tolgar is counted among the friends of Malchor Harpell . He has some of his vast wealth guarded by the Harper in the Tower of Twilight , on the eastern side of the Neverwinter Wood . Possessions . Tolgar wields a + 3 mace , that he has dubbed Chauntea ' s Fire and Sword that possesses the ability to unleash " fireball s " and " blade barrier s " once per day . He also carries dual rings of spell storing .

title: Tollar Kieres
description: Tollar Kieres Tollar Kieres was a sailor of Baldur ' s Gate and a member of Merchant League . History . While searching for the sea charts needed by Mendas , Gorion ' s Ward met Tollar .
description_long: Tollar Kieres Tollar Kieres was a sailor of Baldur ' s Gate and a member of Merchant League . History . While searching for the sea charts needed by Mendas , Gorion ' s Ward met Tollar . When found , Tollar exchanged the charts for some of De ' Tranion ' s Baalor Ale from the Blushing Mermaid tavern .

title: Tolmara Hysstryn
description: Tolmara Hysstryn Tolmara Hysstryn was a deranged inhabitant of Triboar sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . Activities . Tolmara managed the Six Windows rooming house .
description_long: Tolmara Hysstryn Tolmara Hysstryn was a deranged inhabitant of Triboar sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . Activities . Tolmara managed the Six Windows rooming house . She normally spied on her customers . In a moment of madness , she accidentally caused the death of her husband , Mirak Hysstryn , but forgot about it and lived with his skeleton .

title: Tolodine ' s killing wind
description: Tolodine ' s killing wind Tolodine ' s killing wind was a spell of epic magic . History . This spell , was invented by the Netherese arcanist Tolodine in 1500 NY ( −2359 DR ) , one year before his death , as his crowning achievment .
description_long: Tolodine ' s killing wind Tolodine ' s killing wind was a spell of epic magic . History . This spell , was invented by the Netherese arcanist Tolodine in 1500 NY ( −2359 DR ) , one year before his death , as his crowning achievment . It had the distinction of being the first epic spell developed by the Netherese . It could no longer be cast after Mystra changed the rules governing magic after Karsus ' s Folly in - 339 DR , the Year of Sundered Webs .

title: Tom Baxa
description: Tom Baxa Tom Baxa is an artist who has illustrated various role - playing games . Education . Baxa was educated at , where he was taught by Mark Nelson , another artist who has illustrated Dungeons & Dragons material .
description_long: Tom Baxa Tom Baxa is an artist who has illustrated various role - playing games . Education . Baxa was educated at , where he was taught by Mark Nelson , another artist who has illustrated Dungeons & Dragons material . Works . In addition to many other projects , Nelson is known for his illustrations of many Dungeons & Dragons products , including many images for the Al - Qadim setting .

title: Tomar
description: Tomar Tomar , or Tomar of the Winds , was an elven inhabitant of the Pilgrims ' District of Huzuz in 1367 DR . Activities . Tomar ran a small school where he educated priests represented by every Zakharan god , though Tomar worshiped Haku .
description_long: Tomar Tomar , or Tomar of the Winds , was an elven inhabitant of the Pilgrims ' District of Huzuz in 1367 DR . Activities . Tomar ran a small school where he educated priests represented by every Zakharan god , though Tomar worshiped Haku . A small tent was used for his classroom . He taught anywhere between 3 — 15 students at a time over the course of 3 - week periods . The cost of tuition was 1 , 000 dinar s .

title: Tomas Siohcen
description: Tomas Siohcen Tomas Siohcen was a cleric of Cyric who joined the Unseen in Waterdeep by the Year of Wild Magic , 1372 DR . Personality . Tomas was a loyal devotee of Cyric .
description_long: Tomas Siohcen Tomas Siohcen was a cleric of Cyric who joined the Unseen in Waterdeep by the Year of Wild Magic , 1372 DR . Personality . Tomas was a loyal devotee of Cyric . He hated the goddess Talona and her followers for the suffering of his past . He believed that the Unseen incarnated the teachings of Cyric and enthusiastically supported their plots against the Lords of Waterdeep . History . Tomas was a slave of a Calishite follower of Talona in his past . When he arrived in Waterdeep , he decided to start a project to erect a cathedral to Cyric atop Mount Waterdeep . He joined the Unseen for this objective .

title: Tomb jade
description: Tomb jade Tomb Jade was the name for jade that had been buried for centuries and turned from green to red or brown . Description . Tomb jade was rare and commanded a high price in the Realms .
description_long: Tomb jade Tomb Jade was the name for jade that had been buried for centuries and turned from green to red or brown . Description . Tomb jade was rare and commanded a high price in the Realms . Normal jade was considered a fancy stone , but after being mined and possibly worked , then buried for great lengths of time , it changed color and was worth ten times as much . A typical specimen had a base value of 1 , 000 gp . Note that jade turned green if buried with items made of bronze which rendered it equivalent in value to normal jade . Powers . Powdered tomb jade was an ingredient in " potions of undead control " . It could also be used as a talisman for turning undead , granting a priest a second chance to turn an undead creature after a failed attempt .

title: Tomb of Chonis
description: Tomb of Chonis The Tomb of Chonis was the name given to a mysterious tomb in the Eastern Plains of Cormyr . Location . It was located north of the Way of the Manticore and west of the Vast Swamp .
description_long: Tomb of Chonis The Tomb of Chonis was the name given to a mysterious tomb in the Eastern Plains of Cormyr . Location . It was located north of the Way of the Manticore and west of the Vast Swamp . Coming from the west , from Wheloon , it lay approximately half a mile ( 800 meters ) beyond a ridge . History . It was an ancient structure and it had long been emptied of its contents . Over the long centuries , it had been used as a lair by countless creatures and as base for bandits and monsters out of the Vast Swamp to assault travelers on the road . Smugglers also made use of it . In the early 1370s DR , the smugglers Coobert Draftworth and Norry Waywocket made the Tomb of Chonis their favorite drop - site , storing their illicit goods here . Over three months in the Year of Lightning Storms , 1374 DR , they ' d accumulated a stash of stolen jewelry , bottles of utterdark wine , and royal attire . In early Eleint , they came to collect it but discovered others lurking in the tomb . A dark stalker and four dark creeper s had since taken up residence in the Tomb of Chonis .

title: Tomb of the Betrayers
description: Tomb of the Betrayers Tomb of the Betrayers was a crypt in Neverwinter on the Sword Coast . Location . The tomb was located in Neverwinter , near the Church of Tyr .
description_long: Tomb of the Betrayers Tomb of the Betrayers was a crypt in Neverwinter on the Sword Coast . Location . The tomb was located in Neverwinter , near the Church of Tyr . Structure . A stone tomb , composed of graves near the entrance . Interior . The tomb was composed of several halls and rooms , guarded by undead and having many traps . History . The tomb was built to symbolize fates of those that betrayed Neverwinter . When Judge Oleff Uskar sent Onan , a priest of Tyr , to investigate disturbances , the dead sealed the entrance , prohibiting Onan to escape . The Kalach - Cha could ' ve rescued him , if a ghost by the name Fenthick Moss would be defeated first .

title: Tomb tapper
description: Tomb tapper Thaalud , more commonly known as tomb tappers , were fifteen - foot tall intelligent construct s designed by the ancient Netherese empire to defend it against the depredations of the phaerimm . Their existence can be traced back to the very beginning of the Shadowed Age of Netheril ' s history , when a group of arcanist s created them to seek out the source of the magical drain that was beginning to reach across Netheril . Description .
description_long: Tomb tapper Thaalud , more commonly known as tomb tappers , were fifteen - foot tall intelligent construct s designed by the ancient Netherese empire to defend it against the depredations of the phaerimm . Their existence can be traced back to the very beginning of the Shadowed Age of Netheril ' s history , when a group of arcanist s created them to seek out the source of the magical drain that was beginning to reach across Netheril . Description . Tomb tappers were tall , naked , sexless , hairless humanoids with hard , smooth blue - gray skin , claws that could dig through solid rock , and great toothed mouths in their bellies . Their featureless heads earned them the nickname " the faceless . " Ecology . Tapper skin varied in porosity at will : through it , they took in needed water . Their jaws could crush rock to extract mineral sustenance . They could digest iron from blood and marrow if available , but they did not hunt to eat . Abilities . They communicated by means of a humming sound created by skin vibrations ( a language partially understood by mind flayer s ) and by 120 - ft - range " telepathy " .

title: Tombs of Deckon Thar
description: Tombs of Deckon Thar The Tombs of Deckon Thar were seven cairns loaded with bandit treasure within the Nether Mountains . Geography . The tombs were located on the western slope of the Nether Mountains in a secret canyon north of Silverymoon Pass .
description_long: Tombs of Deckon Thar The Tombs of Deckon Thar were seven cairns loaded with bandit treasure within the Nether Mountains . Geography . The tombs were located on the western slope of the Nether Mountains in a secret canyon north of Silverymoon Pass . History . Named for the first leader of the bandit group the Chieftains in Gold , the tombs were legendary . For years , Deckon Thar ' s raiders attacked merchants between Silverymoon and Sundabar . They grew rich hoarding their ill - gotten gains in a great keep and burying their leaders in dark caves filled with unplundered riches . Inhabitants . Around 1372 DR , the entombed began to stir and rose as wight s under the icy rule of Vinjarak the Mound King .

title: Tome of Battle
description: Tome of Battle Tome of Battle The Book of the Nine Swords is an optional rulebook designed for " Dungeons & Dragons " 3 . 5 edition , written by Richard Baker . Description .
description_long: Tome of Battle Tome of Battle The Book of the Nine Swords is an optional rulebook designed for " Dungeons & Dragons " 3 . 5 edition , written by Richard Baker . Description . " Tome of Battle " introduces a new combat subsystem for the D & D game . " Tome of Battle " adds new rules for players who want new combat options for their characters . The nine martial disciplines presented within allow a character to perform special combat maneuvers and magical effects . Three new martial classes are presented that allow a character to develop their discipline even further . Also included are new feats and prestige classes that build on the disciplines , new magic items and spells , and new monsters and organizations .

title: Tome of Suelivain
description: Tome of Suelivain The tome of Suelivain was a book written by Suelivain , a shade of Thultanthar . In it he included his notes of shadow magic . History .
description_long: Tome of Suelivain The tome of Suelivain was a book written by Suelivain , a shade of Thultanthar . In it he included his notes of shadow magic . History . Suelivain was dwelling in Thultanthar when a shadowstorm struck and he lost the " tome of Suelivain " and several other possessions . These were spread across the Plane of Shadow . Unbeknownst to him , however , a rift to the plane later deposited the tome and the rest of his things in the Halls of Demarch in the city of Tantras in Faerûn . Members of Demarch ' s Folly found the " tome of Suelivain " and from it they learned the fundamentals of shadow magic . They tracked down Suelivain and returned his tome and other possessions in exchange for training in the ways of shadow magic .

title: Tome of Torment
description: Tome of Torment The Tome of Torment was the most holy book of the Church of Ilmater , reputedly granted by the One Who Endures himself . It had a long and troubled history , being stolen and recovered numerous times and once the center of a holy war between rival temples to the Broken God , and ironically the focus of much suffering . Value .
description_long: Tome of Torment The Tome of Torment was the most holy book of the Church of Ilmater , reputedly granted by the One Who Endures himself . It had a long and troubled history , being stolen and recovered numerous times and once the center of a holy war between rival temples to the Broken God , and ironically the focus of much suffering . Value . The " Tome of Torment " was the holiest of all the sacred books of the church of Ilmater and the faithful were desperate to keep it within their possession . When stolen , the Ilmatari made vigorous and probing searches all across Faerûn , no matter who they angered in the process . Anyone who was known to possess it was quickly harassed by a number of Ilmatari , who politely , firmly , and repeatedly made offers to buy or trade for the " Tome " . If the owner attempted to damage it , lock it away , or sell it to a non - believer , then the Ilmatari would attack with overwhelming magic al force . Although perhaps priceless , the " Tome " was sold for 20 , 000 gold pieces as stolen property , and a reward of 40 , 000 gp was offered by the church for its safe return . Description .

title: Tome of Universal Harmony
description: Tome of Universal Harmony The Tome of Universal Harmony is the most holy book of the god Deneir , studied and memorized by his disciples . A large tome in thick black bindings , containing nearly two thousand pages . The book is worth to be read more than once during one ' s life because as the perceptions of the world change while the words in the book remain the same , the meaning of those words will change as well .
description_long: Tome of Universal Harmony The Tome of Universal Harmony is the most holy book of the god Deneir , studied and memorized by his disciples . A large tome in thick black bindings , containing nearly two thousand pages . The book is worth to be read more than once during one ' s life because as the perceptions of the world change while the words in the book remain the same , the meaning of those words will change as well . Song of Universal Harmony . Thoroughly reading and letting oneself get into the book will lead to hearing the " song " of the book in one ' s mind - the special meaning behind simple words singing in one ' s mind , a melody along with ancient voices . The reader can get lost in that song though , the song draining one ' s strength quickly . Several of higher ranking Deneirian preists have been found dead , lying across the book . They tried to hear the song of Deneir , the song of universal mysteries , but were not strong enough to control the effects of that strange and beautiful music .

title: Tome of mystical equations
description: Tome of mystical equations A tome of mystical equations is a magical tome that contains charts and equations that relate to the numbers sphere of magic , and can be used as the material component for the following spells , halving their casting time and making them harder to save against :

title: Tome of the Unicorn
description: Tome of the Unicorn The Tome of the Unicorn is a large book . It is 2 feet broad , 3 feet high and more than 4 inches thick . The pages of the Tome are polished plates of electrum and a casual observer might think that they are blank .
description_long: Tome of the Unicorn The Tome of the Unicorn is a large book . It is 2 feet broad , 3 feet high and more than 4 inches thick . The pages of the Tome are polished plates of electrum and a casual observer might think that they are blank . If the observer concentrates on the Tome , the contents will show , written in Thorass and they will be visible for some time . History of the Tome . Legends claim that the Tome of the Unicorn was once made by the mage - king of Iltkazar . His Majesty , the most - Mighty Emperor Shoon VII of the Shoon Empire created the book . It is also said that the book contains many unique spells , including means to create a permanent gate between planes of existence , the means to construct golem armies , and necromantic spells that could animate and control whole graveyards of undead soldiers . It gained its name from its gruel construction . To finish it and preserve its final enchantments , Shoon bathed the metal book plates in the blood of 12 slaughtered unicorn s in the Year of Mourning Horns . He had to destroy an elven tribe , who guarded the unicorns , so that both evil acts brought him the eternal enmity of elves and druids across Faerûn .

title: Tomi Sabero
description: Tomi Sabero Tomi Saburo was an explorer from the city of Shou ' Kuan in Ch ' ing Tung province in Shou Lung . History . In 1358 DR , he went to explore Chu ' Yuan province .
description_long: Tomi Sabero Tomi Saburo was an explorer from the city of Shou ' Kuan in Ch ' ing Tung province in Shou Lung . History . In 1358 DR , he went to explore Chu ' Yuan province . There , Tomi Saburo was bitten by mosquito s that infected him with the Nyamuk Plague and died from the illness .

title: Tomi Undergallows
description: Tomi Undergallows Tomi Undergallows , or " Grin , " as he was often known , was a male halfling rogue from the land of Calimshan . An escaped prisoner from the Neverwinter Peninusula District Prison , he was wanted for a number of crimes , including " deflowering " a pasha ' s daughter and pickpocketing . Carefree and mischievous , Tomi rarely seemed to take things seriously .
description_long: Tomi Undergallows Tomi Undergallows , or " Grin , " as he was often known , was a male halfling rogue from the land of Calimshan . An escaped prisoner from the Neverwinter Peninusula District Prison , he was wanted for a number of crimes , including " deflowering " a pasha ' s daughter and pickpocketing . Carefree and mischievous , Tomi rarely seemed to take things seriously . Appendix . Tomi Undergallows is an optional companion character in both " Neverwinter Nights " , as well as in " " .

title: Tomphael Arkenrret
description: Tomphael Arkenrret Tomphael Arkenrret was a mature adult drow - dragon ( " draa ' zekyl " ) , who held the tile of Patron Father of Eryndlyn among the Jaezred Chaulssin . After the Silence of Lolth , he became the direct superior of Nimor Imphraezl . Description .
description_long: Tomphael Arkenrret Tomphael Arkenrret was a mature adult drow - dragon ( " draa ' zekyl " ) , who held the tile of Patron Father of Eryndlyn among the Jaezred Chaulssin . After the Silence of Lolth , he became the direct superior of Nimor Imphraezl . Description . In his drow form , his appearance was that of a slender drow in wizard robes , which looked rakish . In his dragon - form , he was a mature adult shadow dragon . Personality . He was first and foremost a cautious pragmatist . He preferred steadily pooling his strength , so he could conduct decisive strikes at the right opportunity , over taking risky actions . In the eyes of Nimor Imphraezl , Tomphael ' s cautiousness bordered on cowardice , and the older dragon was aware of the young one ' s evaluation of him . History . Tomphael was the Patron Father of the major fosterage in Eryndlyn , which was constructed around the time of 1136 DR . Under him , the Jaezred Chaulssin managed to bring the drow of the church of Vhaeraun and those from Ghaunadaur ' s under a single banner during the Silence of Lolth , so they were able to destroy the power of Lolth in their city . They succeeded .

title: Tomyris
description: Tomyris Tomyris , the Meeting Ground , was one of the most important places for the Issacortae tribe . This was a high bald hill circled by monoliths and surrounded by many tribal dwellings . Usually , the high king or queen lived far from Tomyris with their people , but the great shaman lived there all year and looked after the site .
description_long: Tomyris Tomyris , the Meeting Ground , was one of the most important places for the Issacortae tribe . This was a high bald hill circled by monoliths and surrounded by many tribal dwellings . Usually , the high king or queen lived far from Tomyris with their people , but the great shaman lived there all year and looked after the site . Each year , the leaders of all the Issacortae tribes gathered here to listen to the predictions of the shaman and to discuss important matters . Tomyris was also a place for negotiations during extremely important situations , whether natural disasters , an enemy invasion , or the death of a king , queen , or shaman . The tribal chieftains chose their new king or queen , while the shaman chose their own successor with the chieftains officiating .

title: Tongue of madness
description: Tongue of madness Tongue of madness was a fungus that grew in the Underdark . When mature , it resembled a large human tongue and was edible but somewhat poisonous . When consumed , any creature with the power of speech who did not have sufficient constitution to resist the mind - altering effects was compelled to speak his or her every thought for the next hour .
description_long: Tongue of madness Tongue of madness was a fungus that grew in the Underdark . When mature , it resembled a large human tongue and was edible but somewhat poisonous . When consumed , any creature with the power of speech who did not have sufficient constitution to resist the mind - altering effects was compelled to speak his or her every thought for the next hour . This compulsion could be cured by a " lesser restoration " or similar spell .

title: Tongues
description: Tongues Tongues was a divination or alteration spell that allowed the caster or a touched creature to speak and understand additional languages . The alteration version was reversible , called babble , and could confuse all verbal communication in an area . Effects .
description_long: Tongues Tongues was a divination or alteration spell that allowed the caster or a touched creature to speak and understand additional languages . The alteration version was reversible , called babble , and could confuse all verbal communication in an area . Effects . The divination version of " tongues " was much improved over the alteration version because it could be bestowed on another creature , had greater range , and lasted 10 minutes per level of the caster , but it was not reversible . The alteration version had a divine and an arcane variation that differed only in duration : the divine variation lasted 10 minutes whereas the arcane variation lasted one minute per level of the caster . The area of effect for the alteration version was a circle of 30 ft ( 9 . 1 m ) radius centered on the caster , whereas the divination spell allowed the subject to communicate as far as his or her voice could carry . The subject of " tongues " could only speak one language at a time but could understand other languages , therefore the subject could act as an interpreter but could not address a diverse crowd and be understood by all .

title: Tonorak Winthrax
description: Tonorak Winthrax Tonorak Winthrax was a high priest of Helm in the Vilhon Reach in 1370 DR . History . Tonorak gained renown when , around 1361 DR , he spoke against sending missionaries to Maztica , saying the duty of true followers of Helm was to guard and protect , no to go and fight in far lands .
description_long: Tonorak Winthrax Tonorak Winthrax was a high priest of Helm in the Vilhon Reach in 1370 DR . History . Tonorak gained renown when , around 1361 DR , he spoke against sending missionaries to Maztica , saying the duty of true followers of Helm was to guard and protect , no to go and fight in far lands . In later years , Tonorak gained prominence inside the church of Helm in the Vilhon Reach , despite not being the regional leader .

title: Tooktook
description: Tooktook Tooktook was a duergar living in Mithral Hall during the reign of Haerinvureem . Relationships . While Mithral Hall was controlled by Clan Bukbukken , Tooktook was from Clan Trilk .
description_long: Tooktook Tooktook was a duergar living in Mithral Hall during the reign of Haerinvureem . Relationships . While Mithral Hall was controlled by Clan Bukbukken , Tooktook was from Clan Trilk . History . After the death of the shadow dragon , Tooktook was killed by Bruenor Battlehammer in the outer tunnels . Later , Bruenor used Tooktook ' s name to deceive two gray dwarves from Clan McUduck .

title: Tooman Thendrik
description: Tooman Thendrik Tooman Thendrik was a male drow cleric of Ghaunadaur from Szith Morcane that secretly led a cult of Ghaunadar worshipers . Description . Tooman maintained an unassuming appearance to hide his true allegiance .
description_long: Tooman Thendrik Tooman Thendrik was a male drow cleric of Ghaunadaur from Szith Morcane that secretly led a cult of Ghaunadar worshipers . Description . Tooman maintained an unassuming appearance to hide his true allegiance . He dressed as a simple drow warrior . Personality . As the leader of the outlawed cult of Ghaunadaur , Tooman Thendrik was loathe to bring attention to himself unless drow society was under grave threat . Abilities . An experienced cleric of Ghaundaur , Tooman had a strong command of divine magic and was able to cast spells like " Evard ' s black tentacles " and " forbiddance " in defense of his deity . In addition to this , his proficiency with martial weapons was such that he could pass himself off as a drow warrior if need be . Activities . Utilizing an abandoned merchant warehouse as a shrine to Ghaunadaur , Tooman led both humanoid and non - humanoid members of his cult in worship of That Which Lurks . Possessions . Tooman carried magic studded leather armor , shield , and warhammer with him at all times and wore a " periapt of wisdom " that gave him great insight . History .

title: Toothed tentacle
description: Toothed tentacle Toothed tentacle was an evocation spell that caused a shadowy tentacle of energy to spring from your hand . Effects . This spell created a tentacle of energy , starting at your hand and extending outward before splitting into three slimmer tentacles tipped by toothed gaping mouths .
description_long: Toothed tentacle Toothed tentacle was an evocation spell that caused a shadowy tentacle of energy to spring from your hand . Effects . This spell created a tentacle of energy , starting at your hand and extending outward before splitting into three slimmer tentacles tipped by toothed gaping mouths . These mouths then struck at the caster ' s target . Realmslore . This spell was originally created by the Phaerimm of Myth Drannor . The spell was often found in spell trigger ed traps in phaerimm lairs .

title: Toover Unn
description: Toover Unn Toover Unn was a wererat and a member of the Dead Rats gang in Neverwinter . History . Toover was a wererat merchant of the Dead Rats , living in the sewers of the Protector ' s Enclave .
description_long: Toover Unn Toover Unn was a wererat and a member of the Dead Rats gang in Neverwinter . History . Toover was a wererat merchant of the Dead Rats , living in the sewers of the Protector ' s Enclave . An adventurer met him during a mission and asked why he was not hostile like his fellows . Toover explained that he was a well - known coward . Instead , he offered to do business with the adventurer .

title: Topaz
description: Topaz Topaz was a precious stone that occurred in granite deposits , sometimes yielding large , gem - quality crystals . Description . Topaz was a very hard , clear gemstone that was usually golden yellow but could be found in shades from yellow to brown .
description_long: Topaz Topaz was a precious stone that occurred in granite deposits , sometimes yielding large , gem - quality crystals . Description . Topaz was a very hard , clear gemstone that was usually golden yellow but could be found in shades from yellow to brown . Topaz turned pink or light blue if subjected to high temperatures . A typical specimen had a base value of 500 gp . Topaz stones were considered sacred by followers of Deneir , Horus - Re , and Gaerdal Ironhand — appropriate for sacrifice , or to be consecrated for use , or recognized as boons or omens when found . The blue variety of topaz was sacred to followers of Eldath . Powers . Topaz was often used to create items that conferred protection from magical effects because this stone protected the item itself from trauma due to force , acid , fire , petrification , and disintegration . It was the preferred component when making a gem of brightness because topaz took on the hardness of mithral when so enchanted . Topaz gems naturally stored healing magic .

title: Topaz dragon
description: Topaz dragon Topaz dragons were selfish and had an erratic personality which made them dangerous to deal with . Topaz dragons were most commonly found in the Elemental Chaos but sometimes live in lairs on secluded beaches on the Prime Material Plane . Combat .
description_long: Topaz dragon Topaz dragons were selfish and had an erratic personality which made them dangerous to deal with . Topaz dragons were most commonly found in the Elemental Chaos but sometimes live in lairs on secluded beaches on the Prime Material Plane . Combat . Topaz dragons breathed a cone of dehydration .

title: Topiary guardian
description: Topiary guardian A Topiary guardian is a plant that has been sculpted into the shape of a creature and then animated with magic . Even though they are the same dimensions as the creature they resemble , they weigh much less because they ' re constructed from twigs and branches . Topiary guardians often guard druid rings or shrines to druidic deities such as Mielikki or Chauntea .
description_long: Topiary guardian A Topiary guardian is a plant that has been sculpted into the shape of a creature and then animated with magic . Even though they are the same dimensions as the creature they resemble , they weigh much less because they ' re constructed from twigs and branches . Topiary guardians often guard druid rings or shrines to druidic deities such as Mielikki or Chauntea . They may also be found in the gardens of the wealthy . A Topiary guardian will follow the orders of its creator if they are nearby . Otherwise they follow the last instructions they received . Combat . A Topiary guardian ' s attacks are similar to those used by the creature it resembles . For example , a topiary guardian shaped like a lion can pounce on an opponent and rake it with his claws .

title: Topsy
description: Topsy Topsy was a deep gnome wererat living in the Underdark with his twin Turvy during the Rage of Demons . Personality . The gnome was very close to his twin Turvy .
description_long: Topsy Topsy was a deep gnome wererat living in the Underdark with his twin Turvy during the Rage of Demons . Personality . The gnome was very close to his twin Turvy . He was the more sociable of the duo . They feared that someone would discover that they were novice wererats who couldn ' t easily control their instincts . History . Topsy and Turvy lived in Blingdenstone . During the Rage of Demons , they were infected with lycanthropy . Later , during a trip to collect some mushrooms , he and his twin were captured by drow slavers of Velkynvelve .

title: Tor Millows
description: Tor Millows Tor Millows was a male human on the Sword Coast North in the 1370s DR . He was a priest of Ilmater . History .
description_long: Tor Millows Tor Millows was a male human on the Sword Coast North in the 1370s DR . He was a priest of Ilmater . History . In 1374 DR , Tor went to Fort Locke to heal people who were robbed by bandits . However , he was robbed and his symbol of Ilmater was taken away . He managed to get to the fort , but requested the Kalach - Cha to find and bring the symbol back . The symbol was located inside the bandit ' s camp . If retrieved , Tor would comment on the Kalach - Cha ' s approach on dealing with the bandit leader . Rgardless , Torn was able to heal the Kalach - Cha and their companions .

title: Toragawa
description: Toragawa Toragawa was a head sohei in Kozakura in 1357 DR . Activities . Toragawa was the head sohei at the Kanchai Temple of Miyama and also the overseer of the local shoen .
description_long: Toragawa Toragawa was a head sohei in Kozakura in 1357 DR . Activities . Toragawa was the head sohei at the Kanchai Temple of Miyama and also the overseer of the local shoen . He constantly drilled 500 sohei to keep them sharp for the defense of the temple . Personality . Toragawa preferred to work with his men than manage the estate , so he deferred the administrative work of the shoen to his lieutenants .

title: Toram Gyvvalstorm
description: Toram Gyvvalstorm Toram Gyvvalstorm was a paladin of Helm who led the Tethyrian Helmite knightly order of the Champions Vigilant , which during the Tethyrian Interregnum defended many poor people from the bandits and corrupt barons . Toram led them as late as 1374 DR , from Chevangard in Survale Ford .
description_long: Toram Gyvvalstorm Toram Gyvvalstorm was a paladin of Helm who led the Tethyrian Helmite knightly order of the Champions Vigilant , which during the Tethyrian Interregnum defended many poor people from the bandits and corrupt barons . title: Toranu Ganppo
description: Toranu Ganppo Toranu Ganppo , also transliterated as Toranu Gang - po , was a fortress in Koryo . Its location was lost by the 14th century DR . The fortress was said to hold many treasures , among them the magical chalice called the " dancing hart " .
description_long: Toranu Ganppo Toranu Ganppo , also transliterated as Toranu Gang - po , was a fortress in Koryo . Its location was lost by the 14th century DR . The fortress was said to hold many treasures , among them the magical chalice called the " dancing hart " . In 1357 DR , a band of adventurers headed by Glei Yuindo returned to Pan and it was rumored they had discovered the lost fortress . However , before they could tell their story , they died of a mysterious sickness .

title: Torchstalk
description: Torchstalk Torchstalk was a fungus that grew in the Underdark . Description . The torchstalk mushroom grew to a height of one to two feet ( 30 to 60 centimeters ) and had a flammable cap .
description_long: Torchstalk Torchstalk was a fungus that grew in the Underdark . Description . The torchstalk mushroom grew to a height of one to two feet ( 30 to 60 centimeters ) and had a flammable cap . Unfortunately , about one in six of these fungi exploded when lit , sending out flaming spores in a ten foot ( three meter ) radius , pelting all within range . Those that didn ' t burst ignited like a torch and could be used as such for 24 hours .

title: Tordon Sureblade
description: Tordon Sureblade Tordon Sureblade was the Lord Chancellor of Ravens Bluff from ? - - ? Appearance .
description_long: Tordon Sureblade Tordon Sureblade was the Lord Chancellor of Ravens Bluff from ? - - ? Appearance . Tordon Sureblade is short and muscular at 5 ' 5 " and 175 pounds . He is meticulous about his appearance , always dressing neatly in conservative colors , especially grays and browns . Personality . Tordon is a man of few words , very solemn and dedicated to Torm and his duties as Lord Chancellor of the city ' s legal system . His main goal is to promote justice by creating a comprehensive system of laws . This requires much paperwork and he worries that the demands of his job is making him stale as a fighter of evil . He rarely shows his feelings but occasionally reveals he has a dry wit . He tolerates non - evil faiths and tries to be as fair as possible in dealing with them . He gives 40 percent of his income to the temple to help the poor . He dearly loves his half - brother Thorm but despairs at his impulsive nature , which frequently leads him into brawls . Background . Tordon grew up in Ravens Bluff and saw first hand the corruption and lawlessness that plagued the city before Charles Oliver O ' Kane became the Lord Mayor .

title: Toren
description: Toren Toren was a half - orc fighter and a member of the Zhentarim . He was a high - ranking member of the Zhent occupation army in Daggerdale in 1369 DR . History .
description_long: Toren Toren was a half - orc fighter and a member of the Zhentarim . He was a high - ranking member of the Zhent occupation army in Daggerdale in 1369 DR . History . Toren was a brutal half - orc fighter in command of part of the Zhent army in Dagger Falls . During the kidnapping of Randal Morn , he had many skirmished with the adventures recruited to free the dale ' s rightful heir . At last , in the final battle against the resistance fighters , Toren and some of his men refused to accept defeat and retreated into a tavern . , There they fought to the last man against Morn ' s forces .

title: Torg mac Cei
description: Torg mac Cei Torg mac Cei was a shield dwarf man of the dwarven city of Earthfast of the Earthfast Mountains of north Faerûn , in the Earthroot region of the Underdark He was the Ironlord or King of Earthfast . History . Torg was the son of Cei and the hereditary ruler of Earthfast , succeeding to the position of ironlord .
description_long: Torg mac Cei Torg mac Cei was a shield dwarf man of the dwarven city of Earthfast of the Earthfast Mountains of north Faerûn , in the Earthroot region of the Underdark He was the Ironlord or King of Earthfast . History . Torg was the son of Cei and the hereditary ruler of Earthfast , succeeding to the position of ironlord . Earthfast was besieged by an alliance of goblin s and orc s determined to annihilate the dwarves . Torg ' s queen died in battle around 1345 DR , and his son was also slain . Torg and the remaining dwarves stayed to defend , but Earthfast appeared doomed . They received some surprising aid in mid - autumn of the Year of the Serpent , 1359 DR , when Alusair Obarskyr , the renegade princess of Cormyr , came to Earthfast . Alusair lent her aid and knowledge of strategy to the struggle . In particular , she introduced Torg to the use of polearm s , particularly a treatise written by her father King Azoun IV of Cormyr . Torg began training his soldiers in their use and together they routed the orcs and saved Earthfast . The Horde Wars .

title: Torgan Minerson
description: Torgan Minerson Torgan Minerson was a human male , and the proprietor of The Roots of the Earth tavern in Eshpurta , Amn , in early 1370 DR , the Year of the Tankard . Torgan was once trapped in a mine cave - in and claimed he saw visions during the traumatic experience . He subsequently retired from mining and opened his tavern , which also housed a shrine to Grumbar , the King of the Land Below the Roots .
description_long: Torgan Minerson Torgan Minerson was a human male , and the proprietor of The Roots of the Earth tavern in Eshpurta , Amn , in early 1370 DR , the Year of the Tankard . Torgan was once trapped in a mine cave - in and claimed he saw visions during the traumatic experience . He subsequently retired from mining and opened his tavern , which also housed a shrine to Grumbar , the King of the Land Below the Roots . Torgan retold the story of his entrapment and revelations to any who would listen .

title: Torgar Hammerstriker
description: Torgar Hammerstriker Torgar Delzoun Hammerstriker is a tough - looking dwarf with many scars and a long black beard . He is the commander of the Axe of Mirabar , the militia of Mirabar . He has served the marchion of Mirabar for as long as anyone can remember , claiming it to be three hundred years .
description_long: Torgar Hammerstriker Torgar Delzoun Hammerstriker is a tough - looking dwarf with many scars and a long black beard . He is the commander of the Axe of Mirabar , the militia of Mirabar . He has served the marchion of Mirabar for as long as anyone can remember , claiming it to be three hundred years . Torgar is the last member of Clan Hammerstriker . Equipment . Torgar possesses a suit of fine plate armor . Background . Loyalties . Torgar ' s loyalty to Mirabar was called into question by the Marchion Elastul Raurym after Bruenor Battlehammer and his party of dwarves visited the city and Torgar was openly consorting with them . Torgar was torn between his long - standing loyalty to Mirabar on the one hand and his loyalty to the dwarven race on the other . This prompted Torgar to consider leaving Mirabar . His decision to leave for Mithral Hall was sealed when he was , in his view , poorly treated by the Marchion and Agrathan Hardhammer . Not long after departing Mirabar , he was captured by the Hammers and imprisoned on the grounds that he would have given up the city ' s secrets to Mithral Hall .

title: Torgoja P ' a
description: Torgoja P ' a Torgoja P ' a was a high lama on the Plain of Horses in 1357 DR . History . Torgoja ' s early life was shrouded in mystery .
description_long: Torgoja P ' a Torgoja P ' a was a high lama on the Plain of Horses in 1357 DR . History . Torgoja ' s early life was shrouded in mystery . He appeared around 1343 DR in Alamaqu , where he convinced the T ' aghur to stop their plot against the triumvirate . Later , in Peqqir , he helped design an irrigation project that made the fortunes of the Guychiang . P ' a eventually settled on Mount OrGhash , where he served as high lama , although he preferred the company of his two camels to the company of other lamas . Reputed to be a great sage , many farmers and nobles asked his counsel and he welcomed all .

title: Torgrave Needlebaum
description: Torgrave Needlebaum Torgrave Needlebaum was the seneschal of Hillsfar in 1491 DR . Activities . Torgrave was the city ' s seneschal and Head of Household .
description_long: Torgrave Needlebaum Torgrave Needlebaum was the seneschal of Hillsfar in 1491 DR . Activities . Torgrave was the city ' s seneschal and Head of Household . He also kept the cleanest house of the city . Torgrave knew all gossip in the city and was often consulted for this knowledge . Unkown to many Torgrave was also the Spy Master of the Red Plumes . History . During the Rage of Demons in 1491 DR , Torgrave attended the First Lord ' s Midsummer Masquerade ballet . He possibly hired as servers an adventuring party ( who had been hired by Elanil Elassidil to infiltrate the masquerade without Torgrave ' s knowledge ) . During the visit of the court to Yulash the Harpers discovered his true work and possibly ordered to Harpers - affiliated adventurers to capture him alive . Personality . Torgrave was proud of his clean house . He was friendly and outgoing , living his dream . Torgrave always took care of others ' problems .

title: Torhild Flametongue
description: Torhild Flametongue Torhild Flametongue was a dwarf who founded the realm of Besilmer in −4420 DR . Background . Torhild believed that the dwarven race would remain in a beleaguered state if they continued to live underground in mines , so he set out to create an overground farming realm , where dwarves could act as builders , inventors , and repairers .
description_long: Torhild Flametongue Torhild Flametongue was a dwarf who founded the realm of Besilmer in −4420 DR . Background . Torhild believed that the dwarven race would remain in a beleaguered state if they continued to live underground in mines , so he set out to create an overground farming realm , where dwarves could act as builders , inventors , and repairers . His realm came under constant attack from giant s , troll s from the Evermoors and wolves , but initially managed to fight them back . When fighting a hill giant in one - on - one combat at the Stone Bridge , Torhild was killed , which ultimately led to the downfall of Besilmer , and the fleeing of its inhabitants to the Fallen Kingdom .

title: Toril
description: Toril Toril , occasionally known as Abeir - Toril was the name of a planet in Realmspace . The name " Abeir - Toril " was archaic , meaning " cradle of life " in an extinct and forgotten language . It consisted of various continents and islands , including Faerûn , Kara - Tur , and Zakhara in the central super - continent and , throughout most of its history , Anchorome , Maztica , and Katashaka in the western super - continent .
description_long: Toril Toril , occasionally known as Abeir - Toril was the name of a planet in Realmspace . The name " Abeir - Toril " was archaic , meaning " cradle of life " in an extinct and forgotten language . It consisted of various continents and islands , including Faerûn , Kara - Tur , and Zakhara in the central super - continent and , throughout most of its history , Anchorome , Maztica , and Katashaka in the western super - continent . Following the Spellplague , however , Maztica ( and likely Anchorome as well ) was replaced by the continent of Returned Abeir . There was also one large and very mysterious continent east of Kara - Tur called Osse whose nature and inhabitants were all but unknown . Toril ' s crystal sphere was called Realmspace . It was orbited by one moon named Selûne , and by a cluster of asteroids , known as the Tears of Selûne . Throughout most of its history , Toril was known less commonly as Abeir - Toril . Since the Spellplague and the revelation of the existence of a planetary sibling known as Abeir , and the fact that both Abeir and Toril were once united , the latter name came to mean specifically the formerly united worlds of Abeir and Toril . Appendix .

Some devil s collected sets of warlocks , and a Toril thirteen was considered one of the most difficult collections to acquire because one of the warlocks named Bryseis Kakistos had very few living heirs . Original Thirteen .

title: Torin Nomerthal
description: Torin Nomerthal Torin Nomerthal , a First Lord of Hillsfar , was a human who reasserted the Great Laws of Trade and Humanity in Hillsfar in 1487 DR . He was head of a powerful family , known to be outwardly friendly , but secretly shrewd and cunning . Relationships .
description_long: Torin Nomerthal Torin Nomerthal , a First Lord of Hillsfar , was a human who reasserted the Great Laws of Trade and Humanity in Hillsfar in 1487 DR . He was head of a powerful family , known to be outwardly friendly , but secretly shrewd and cunning . Relationships . Torin had the following colleagues : Torin was formerly betrothed to Davon ' s twin sister , Thessaly Malaeda , but she turned out to be a shapechanged succubus . History . Torin was once a commander of the Red Plumes . After Maalthiir ' s death , Torin formed an alliance made up of Red Plumes , the Hillsfar Mages ' Guild , mercenaries , and disloyal Netherese soldiers called the Tower Guard . After Thultanthar fell onto Myth Drannor in 1487 , Torin renamed the Tower Guard to the Red Plumes and reenacted Maalthiir ' s Great Laws .

title: Torio Claven
description: Torio Claven Torio Claven was Luskan ' s ambassador to Neverwinter and an agent of Black Garius during the Shadow War . History . Torio was born in Luskan and wandered the streets of the city earning coppers singing and performing in Luskan alehouses until Black Garius noted her and her talents .
description_long: Torio Claven Torio Claven was Luskan ' s ambassador to Neverwinter and an agent of Black Garius during the Shadow War . History . Torio was born in Luskan and wandered the streets of the city earning coppers singing and performing in Luskan alehouses until Black Garius noted her and her talents . Garius used her to spy on his fellow mages of the Hosttower when they went into the streets . As Garius ' prestige grew , Torio became an effective weapon , serving as his eyes and ears . Eventually , she was given the position of ambassador to Neverwinter . Here , Torio was involved in Garius ' plan regarding the King of Shadows and the Kalach - Cha . Garius ordered her and Lorne Starling to concoct a plan to have the Kalach - Cha extradited to Luskan and sentence them to low justice in order to prevent further interference . They framed the Kalach - Cha for the massacre of Ember , which was in Luskan territory , and tried to play it as some sort of hate crime . However , the Kalach - Cha unveiled the plot and Torio was captured and disavowed by Luskan as being a member of a rogue faction . She was condemned to death .

title: Torixileos
description: Torixileos Torixileos was a white dragon apparently living with its treasure inside a glacier near Silverymoon Pass . The dragon abducted Lynaelle Dawnmantle as Lynaelle traversed the pass during a blizzard . Taken back to the dragon ' s lair , Lynaelle was frightened into assisting Torixileos in plundering a young silver dragon named Starglimmer ' s hoard .
description_long: Torixileos Torixileos was a white dragon apparently living with its treasure inside a glacier near Silverymoon Pass . The dragon abducted Lynaelle Dawnmantle as Lynaelle traversed the pass during a blizzard . Taken back to the dragon ' s lair , Lynaelle was frightened into assisting Torixileos in plundering a young silver dragon named Starglimmer ' s hoard . Lynaelle discovered the deception in time to rescue Starglimmer and herself as a larger silver dragon arrived . The larger silver , Symarra Brightmoon , killed Torixileos , thereby rescuing both her son and Lynaella .

title: Torlin Silvershield
description: Torlin Silvershield Torlin Silvershield was one of Grand Duke s of Baldur ' s Gate in 1479 DR . Personality . Torlin was a consummate actor with a great control over his voice .
description_long: Torlin Silvershield Torlin Silvershield was one of Grand Duke s of Baldur ' s Gate in 1479 DR . Personality . Torlin was a consummate actor with a great control over his voice . His main concern was the best interests of the city , even over the will of the church of Gond . Torlin had no interest in money or status , but thought that the end always justified the means . History . Torlin was the leader of the greatest noble family of Baldur ' s Gate and the high priest of the grandest temple . He helped defend the city from Valarken ' s coup and helped to establish the Parliament of Peers . In 1479 DR , Torlin was involved in the crisis the culminated in the resurrection of Bhaal . Eventually he become the Chosen of the resurrected Bhaal Torlin was later captured by the Red Wizards of Thay , who transported him to Doomvault for experimentation and transformed him a Wight .

title: Torlyn Wands
description: Torlyn Wands Torlyn Wands was a human noble and book collector in Waterdeep . Description . Torlyn was young ( 1479 DR ) and had mahogany hair and a full beard , as well as a hairy chest .
description_long: Torlyn Wands Torlyn Wands was a human noble and book collector in Waterdeep . Description . Torlyn was young ( 1479 DR ) and had mahogany hair and a full beard , as well as a hairy chest . Personality . Torlyn liked functional clothes . History . As one of Renaer Neverember ' s closest friends , Torlyn was present at the Nightal 20 , 1479 DR , meeting at Roarke House to reform a group similar to the Moonstars . He was willing to support the group , but only in secret . Possessions . Torlyn owned a full set of mundane books written by the Seven Sisters . The book he purchased that completed the purchase was " Lifelong with Regrets " by Laeral Silverhand . Relationships . Torlyn had a sister named Nharaen Wands .

title: Torm
description: Torm Torm ( pronounced " TORM " ) , known as The True and The Loyal Fury , was the god whose portfolio consisted of duty , loyalty , and righteousness . His symbol was a right - hand gauntlet held upright with palm forward . History .
description_long: Torm Torm ( pronounced " TORM " ) , known as The True and The Loyal Fury , was the god whose portfolio consisted of duty , loyalty , and righteousness . His symbol was a right - hand gauntlet held upright with palm forward . History . Prior to the Time of Troubles Torm was a minor demipower . Torm gained considerable attention and praise during the Godswar when his faithful helped keep one of the missing Tablets of Fate safe , and his own avatar battled and completely destroyed the avatar of Bane outside Tantras on Eleasis 13 , seemingly killing the god who had already been weakened by Mystra and her servant Elminster . Torm knew he did not have enough power to do this , so he chose to absorb the souls of his worshipers in Tantras , knowing that they would be instantly killed . The transferring of souls was done voluntarily and took thousands of lives , but Torm chose to spare children aged 14 and below . These individuals became known as the Martyr ' s Progeny . Torm died in the conflict too , but because of his loyalty to his portfolio was resurrected by the overdeity Ao at the end of the Time of Troubles , with his power greatly increased .

title: Torm ( adventurer )
description: Torm ( adventurer ) Torm was a human rogue and a member of the Knights of Myth Drannor . He born in Westgate from prostitute Netha and a unknown man , heavily presumed be Dathguld , most powerful lord of the city . For this lineage he was targeted by Night Masks ( guild ) Description .
description_long: Torm ( adventurer ) Torm was a human rogue and a member of the Knights of Myth Drannor . He born in Westgate from prostitute Netha and a unknown man , heavily presumed be Dathguld , most powerful lord of the city . For this lineage he was targeted by Night Masks ( guild ) Description . He wore a thin mustache and a slim longsword . Relationships . He loved to tease Rathan Thentraver .

title: Torment domain
description: Torment domain The once whom hold domain over the tainted domain of torment are the lord of nessus Asmodeus and the whiling whip Loviatar . The Supreme ruler of the nine hells torments the damned in his hells , with torture he breaks adversaries and impose his will upon them , or as a punishment for enemies whom are captured by his minions . The twisted torment met at the hands of the maiden of pain and followers carers with it a small sliver of kindness or tricks of desire .
description_long: Torment domain The once whom hold domain over the tainted domain of torment are the lord of nessus Asmodeus and the whiling whip Loviatar . The Supreme ruler of the nine hells torments the damned in his hells , with torture he breaks adversaries and impose his will upon them , or as a punishment for enemies whom are captured by his minions . The twisted torment met at the hands of the maiden of pain and followers carers with it a small sliver of kindness or tricks of desire . They find this brings in the full embodiment of pain , Loviatar brings tormented pain trough ice , fire and of course the whip . Power of torment domain . Any divine caster who worships a god of the torment domain may use it to channel the power of the deity . As a Divine caster choses the domain she will become more intimidating also , when they use a power of the domain that will hit a target , as it hits the target it will become a easier target to strike for the next attacking ally . The powers of the domain are : < br > Ardent strike < br > Astral seal < br > Overwhelming strike < br > Mantle of the infidel < br > Perfect torment divinity .

title: Torment toadstool
description: Torment toadstool Torment toadstools are blue mushrooms found in swamps that release spores when stepped on . The spores can cause nausea and vomiting , although a spore cloud released from a torment toadstool will only last around a minute before dissipation . The toadstools have been known to be used in making ale .
description_long: Torment toadstool Torment toadstools are blue mushrooms found in swamps that release spores when stepped on . The spores can cause nausea and vomiting , although a spore cloud released from a torment toadstool will only last around a minute before dissipation . The toadstools have been known to be used in making ale .

title: Tormstar
description: Tormstar Tormstar the Scarred was an assassin of the Night Masks in 1370 DR and a deep - cover Harper spy . History . Tormstar was a ranger living peacefully in Battledale , in the Dalelands , with his wife until a werewolf started terrorizing the dale .
description_long: Tormstar Tormstar the Scarred was an assassin of the Night Masks in 1370 DR and a deep - cover Harper spy . History . Tormstar was a ranger living peacefully in Battledale , in the Dalelands , with his wife until a werewolf started terrorizing the dale . Tormstar pursued and tracked the beast and , after a furious fight , destroyed the werewolf , only to discover that the beast was in fact his wife . Scarred both in mind and body , he abandoned his ranger career and volunteered to join the Night Masks as a deep - cover spy for the Harpers , a suicide mission . He joined the Masks but , to everyone ' s surprise , he not only survived but also rose through the ranks , finding himself to be a very good assassin . His superiors in Those Who Harp wondered if Tormstar might not enjoy his life in Westgate too much , although he infrequently sent reports to them .

title: Tornskulls
description: Tornskulls The Tornskulls were an orc tribe lead , in 1372 DR , by the trio of Koront , Naurorin and Baerzel . Its territory was located in the Dead Orc Pass . Description .
description_long: Tornskulls The Tornskulls were an orc tribe lead , in 1372 DR , by the trio of Koront , Naurorin and Baerzel . Its territory was located in the Dead Orc Pass . Description . The Tornskulls used the tactic of strike first and strike hard . They were much more numerous than neighboring tribes . The main strategy of the Tornskulls was to conquer Citadel Felbarr and Sundabar . The Tornskulls didn ' t want to risk their army so they tried by every means to convince the Red Fangs and the Heart Takers orc tribes to besiege these strongholds . The leaders of the Tornskulls were aware that if they had goaded neighboring tribes against the Silver Marches the situation would have been turned in their favor . Their plan was to conquer the citadels by killing rival orcs eventually tired of fighting . During 1372 DR they were still not able to find a way to convince the neighboring tribes to join their war . Organization . The warleaders trio led almost five thousand well - equipped experienced orcs . Their units were divided into " claws " . Each " Claw " was formed by eighty orcs led by a veteran leader .

title: Toroth
description: Toroth Toroth was a noble family in Zhentil Keep . Around 1258 DR , Manshoon requested the help of this family in order to avenge the death of Harlshoon , his father . This resulted in the destruction of a Toroth villa , although Manshoon was pulled from the rubble and saved by his soon - to - be apprentice Sememmon ( known as Malatar Wingstarl at that time ) .
description_long: Toroth Toroth was a noble family in Zhentil Keep . Around 1258 DR , Manshoon requested the help of this family in order to avenge the death of Harlshoon , his father . This resulted in the destruction of a Toroth villa , although Manshoon was pulled from the rubble and saved by his soon - to - be apprentice Sememmon ( known as Malatar Wingstarl at that time ) .

title: Torque of faith
description: Torque of faith The torque of faith was a magical item holy to the church of Tymora . History . Around Kythorn of the Year of the Gauntlet , 1369 DR , the " torque of faith " was to be transported to The Lady ' s Favor , a newly built temple of Tymora in the hamlet of Sevenecho in the Vast .
description_long: Torque of faith The torque of faith was a magical item holy to the church of Tymora . History . Around Kythorn of the Year of the Gauntlet , 1369 DR , the " torque of faith " was to be transported to The Lady ' s Favor , a newly built temple of Tymora in the hamlet of Sevenecho in the Vast . This was done in secret so as not to attract thieves . However , the Vipers bandits attacked the convoy anyway , massacred its guardians , and looted its wealth , including the torque . This was carried back to their hideout , the Vipers ' Nest , and stored along with the rest of their loot . The Tymoran superiors at the temple in the city of Procampur were outraged at the theft . They granted Randolph dul Umast , high priest of The Lady ' s Favor , permission to recover the " torque of faith " at all costs . To this end , Randolph hired the ranger Dura Gerathu to locate the Vipers ' Nest . When , on the 1st Eleint , one of the hamlet ' s wells was poisoned , Randolph was guided by Tymora to link the poisoning to the Vipers . He sought adventurers to seek the poison ingredients or a cure , and return the " torque of faith " if they found it . Description .

title: Torrin Ironstar
description: Torrin Ironstar Torrin Ironstar , or Daffyd Raltin , was a male human rogue and member of the Order of Delvers from Eartheart . History . Early Life .
description_long: Torrin Ironstar Torrin Ironstar , or Daffyd Raltin , was a male human rogue and member of the Order of Delvers from Eartheart . History . Early Life . Torrin was born Daffyd Raltin to human shopkeepers in the town of Hammergate just outside Eartheart . As a young boy , Torrin helped around his parents ' shop . When Torrin was seven , the shop was robbed and Torrin picked up a magical dwarven mace , activated the magic and killed the robber , something that only a dwarf was supposedly able to do . Even though his father consulted a loremaster who claimed that non - dwarves could use magical dwarven weapons , Torrin ' s use of the mace lead to his lifelong belief that he was really a reincarnated dwarf of the now extinct Ironstar clan . At some point , Torrin left his parents and moved into Eartheart proper where he was adopted by the Thunsonn clan . Stoneplague . In 1480 DR , Torrin traveled into the Underdark to purchase a teleportation rune from a shady dwarf . The dwarf had a strange condition that made his skin look like dried mud and his eyes like white marbles .

title: Torst Evenhand
description: Torst Evenhand Torst Evenhand ( 244 – 286 DR ) was a human from Westgate and a member of the Evenhand family . He married Besmra Obarskyr who would later become Queen of Cormyr , and was therefore ennobled within Cormyr . Relatives .
description_long: Torst Evenhand Torst Evenhand ( 244 – 286 DR ) was a human from Westgate and a member of the Evenhand family . He married Besmra Obarskyr who would later become Queen of Cormyr , and was therefore ennobled within Cormyr . Relatives . Torst ' s wife was Besmra Obarskyr . He had three sons : Torst , Gordroun , and Keldroun Obarskyr , all of whom became King of Cormyr .

title: Torstan Holbrar
description: Torstan Holbrar Torstan Holbrar was a wheelwright from the hamlet of Sarbreenar in the Vast , in business around 1370 DR . Torstan worked at the Sarbreenar wagonworks , and made top - quality wheels , among the best around the Inner Sea . Torstan also kept a large stock of spares available to wagon - drivers who ' d suffered breakdowns on the rough High Trail , though at exorbitant prices .
description_long: Torstan Holbrar Torstan Holbrar was a wheelwright from the hamlet of Sarbreenar in the Vast , in business around 1370 DR . Torstan worked at the Sarbreenar wagonworks , and made top - quality wheels , among the best around the Inner Sea . Torstan also kept a large stock of spares available to wagon - drivers who ' d suffered breakdowns on the rough High Trail , though at exorbitant prices .

title: Torstan Ulzimmer
description: Torstan Ulzimmer Torstan Ulzimmer was a human man of the city of Procampur in the Vast , who lived " circa " 1358 DR . He owned a fleet of merchant ships that operated on the Inner Sea , and paid highly for the best crews and equipment . His ships were sleek and fast , and the best manned and equipped around .
description_long: Torstan Ulzimmer Torstan Ulzimmer was a human man of the city of Procampur in the Vast , who lived " circa " 1358 DR . He owned a fleet of merchant ships that operated on the Inner Sea , and paid highly for the best crews and equipment . His ships were sleek and fast , and the best manned and equipped around . Ulzimmer aimed for reliability and speed , an approach that brought him great profits and him one of the most well - known Procampans of his day .

title: Tortilla
description: Tortilla Tortilla was a flat bread made of coarse - grained mayz . It was traditionally baked in Maztica and was available for purchase through " Aurora ' s Whole Realms Catalogue " . Description .
description_long: Tortilla Tortilla was a flat bread made of coarse - grained mayz . It was traditionally baked in Maztica and was available for purchase through " Aurora ' s Whole Realms Catalogue " . Description . Tortillas were baked on hot stone griddles and could be consumed plain , with spices , wrapping meat or beans , baked with cheese or fried in oil . Tortillas purchased through " Aurora ' s " were shipped from the Temple of Helm at Ulatos . Part of the profits was donated to the temple in order to assist the natives with medical care and education .

title: Tortoise shield
description: Tortoise shield Tortoise shields were magical shields that could be found in Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Description . Tortoise shields were small buckler - style shields known as daraq s in Zakhara .
description_long: Tortoise shield Tortoise shields were magical shields that could be found in Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Description . Tortoise shields were small buckler - style shields known as daraq s in Zakhara . Powers . Though they appeared as small shields , these unique items created a powerful invisible force field around the body of the shield that protected the wielder as a full body shield . Tortoise shields were especially effective at blocking missile attacks .

title: Tortured Land
description: Tortured Land The Tortured Land was an area of land in the Moonsea region which was formed by ancient lava flows that were then carved by flowing ice . Giant stone pillars , like teeth , smoothed by the wind jutted out from the landscape . Strange monsters chased small animals but the only other inhabitants seemed to be the bats that laired in the few caves of the area .
description_long: Tortured Land The Tortured Land was an area of land in the Moonsea region which was formed by ancient lava flows that were then carved by flowing ice . Giant stone pillars , like teeth , smoothed by the wind jutted out from the landscape . Strange monsters chased small animals but the only other inhabitants seemed to be the bats that laired in the few caves of the area . 3000 years before the Era of Upheaval , dwarves mined the metal deposits that were to be found but they were exiled to the Novularond . Only four members of the clan survived and they went on to found the Innugaakalikurit clan . During the Era of Upheaval the majority of the Tortured Land was occupied by flind - led gnoll tribes . The ruins of a forgotten city known as Frozen Flindyke to bard s , could have once been a bastion of civilization for these gnolls in times past or could have been the home of a settlement of humans , surrounded by the gnolls . The truth was lost to the sands of time but the shamans of Yeenoghu who ruled over the gnolls and flinds were said to have been descended from those who summoned the Trio Nefarious that aided in the fall of Myth Drannor .

title: Torynnar Rhaevaern
description: Torynnar Rhaevaern Torynnar Rhaevaern was a sun elf baelnorn and one of the founders of the Eldreth Veluuthra . As of 1374 DR , he was still amongst its ranks , as a member of the Vel ' Nikeryma , and a source of great wisdom . He suspected that the organization was suffering from an outside influence in Cormanthor , and he last felt an influence of this power during the Fall of Myth Drannor .
description_long: Torynnar Rhaevaern Torynnar Rhaevaern was a sun elf baelnorn and one of the founders of the Eldreth Veluuthra .
