He suspected that the organization was suffering from an outside influence in Cormanthor , and he last felt an influence of this power during the Fall of Myth Drannor .

title: Tos ' un Armgo
description: Tos ' un Armgo Tos ' un Armgo was the son of Mez ' Barris Armgo and later part of a band of four renegade drow that advised Obould Many - Arrows . Personality . Tos ' un was somewhat uncomfortable with violence .
description_long: Tos ' un Armgo Tos ' un Armgo was the son of Mez ' Barris Armgo and later part of a band of four renegade drow that advised Obould Many - Arrows . Personality . Tos ' un was somewhat uncomfortable with violence . That is perhaps one of the reasons he left Menzoberranzan in the first place , but his sentient sword " Khazid ' hea " often prompted him to take the more violent course of action . History . Early life . In his youth , Tos ' un fought for his house against rival house . During that battle , he was riding a riding lizard when hit a patch of magically slickened floor . The lizard scrabbled and ended up flipping him forwards over its head . He recalled this incident shortly before his death . Renegade . In 1358 DR , Tos ' un participated in Menzoberranzan ' s failed siege of Mithral Hall . In the chaos , he managed to flee to the surface , where he met the drow Ad ' non Kareese , Donnia Soldou , and Kaer ' lic Suun Wett . He joined with them and helped them to aid and advise Obould Many - Arrows in his plan to create the Kingdom of Many - Arrows . All three of his companions were slain ( one by Obould himself and two by Drizzt Do ' Urden ) and Tos ' un was left by himself .

title: Toshikazu Wada
description: Toshikazu Wada Toshikazu Wada was a samurai commander in the town of Aru in Wa . Personality . Toshikazu was a easy - going individual , always friendly and outgoing .
description_long: Toshikazu Wada Toshikazu Wada was a samurai commander in the town of Aru in Wa . Personality . Toshikazu was a easy - going individual , always friendly and outgoing . However he knew when times need he to be serious . He had a very good dealing with his daimyo . Activities . Toshizaku was the commander of the Home Guard of Aru and the direct subordinate of Yuji Takaesu . Often he went to hunt with his daimyo Benju Matsumoto . History . Around 1358 DR , his daimyo Benju hired an adventuring party in order to unveil a menace against pilgrims . During a courtesy meeting with the adventurers Toshizaku was targeted by a yakuza assassin .

title: Tosker Nightsword
description: Tosker Nightsword Tosker Nightsword was the owner and proprietor of the Calling Horns inn . The inn was given to him by an adventuring group known as the Bored Swords . As a retired guide and hunter , Tosker was as familiar with the Evermoors and the western region of the High Forest as well as anyone else in Faerûn .
description_long: Tosker Nightsword Tosker Nightsword was the owner and proprietor of the Calling Horns inn . The inn was given to him by an adventuring group known as the Bored Swords . As a retired guide and hunter , Tosker was as familiar with the Evermoors and the western region of the High Forest as well as anyone else in Faerûn .

title: Toss the Dagger
description: Toss the Dagger Toss the Dagger was a betting game played in Cormyr . Set - Up . The game was played indoors over a " throwing area " of moist sand .
description_long: Toss the Dagger Toss the Dagger was a betting game played in Cormyr . Set - Up . The game was played indoors over a " throwing area " of moist sand . It also required that an assortment of metal objects — often old armor or broken weapons — be hung from the ceiling over the throwing area . Rules . While its rules differed depending on where it was played , a common variation had the following rules . A blindfolded woman would hold two dagger s , and players would bet on whether one , both , or none of the daggers would land in the sand blade down after thrown . After bets were placed , the woman would toss the daggers into the air simultaneously and step quickly back out of harm ' s way . A valid toss must involve each dagger striking at least one of the hanging metal items . The game was played until no one else could place any more bets or after an agreed upon series of six , seven , nine , or twelve bets . History . This game was especially popular in Cormyr at the Lucky Dragon gambling house in Jester ' s Green .

title: Tosvin
description: Tosvin The ice devil Tosvin was one of the Icy Claws of Iyraclea and the guardian of the portal to Jhothûn within the ruins of Gharreil . Description . Tosvin looked something akin to tall , humanoid insect .
description_long: Tosvin The ice devil Tosvin was one of the Icy Claws of Iyraclea and the guardian of the portal to Jhothûn within the ruins of Gharreil . Description . Tosvin looked something akin to tall , humanoid insect . He had claws on his hands and feet , mandibles for a mouth , and a long , thick , spiked tail . While Tosvin was sworn to serve Iyraclea , he had dual alliances . He had also taken an oath to defend the portal found within the ruins of Gharreil . Tosvin was the most intelligent of the three portal guardians of the provincial capitals of the Jhothûn empire . Of the three , he alone understood that he was guarding a portal at all . He even knew that the portal was a part of a network of portals in the old empire and that the one he was guarding led directly to the capital . He also suspected that an ancient , powerful , and intelligent sentience existed on the other side of the portal and believed ( rightly ) that this being was sacred to his goddess Auril . He kept these secrets from Iyraclea , even though he knew she was actively seeking the powers of lost Jhothûn . Personality .

title: Totem
description: Totem Totems are small animal carvings made of great wood that are given to children of a primal tribe at birth to determine their future personality . For example , Bear means affectionate , caring but is quick tempered and can turn into a savage beast when angered . Lion means courageous and strong , also working especially well in a group .
description_long: Totem Totems are small animal carvings made of great wood that are given to children of a primal tribe at birth to determine their future personality . For example , Bear means affectionate , caring but is quick tempered and can turn into a savage beast when angered . Lion means courageous and strong , also working especially well in a group .

title: Touch of Blibdoolpoolp
description: Touch of Blibdoolpoolp Touch of Blibdoolpoolp is a cleric and druid spell in the transmutation school . It is granted to the faithful of the kuo - toa n deity Blibdoolpoolp . The hand of the caster of the spell turns into a large claw , resembling a lobster .
description_long: Touch of Blibdoolpoolp Touch of Blibdoolpoolp is a cleric and druid spell in the transmutation school . It is granted to the faithful of the kuo - toa n deity Blibdoolpoolp . The hand of the caster of the spell turns into a large claw , resembling a lobster .

title: Touch of Opening
description: Touch of Opening The Touch of Opening was a ritual used by sha ' ir s on their gen to grant their familiar s the ability to open any item locked by mundane means . Preparation . In order for this ritual to succeed the sha ' ir needed to acquire a set of pure golden lockpicks worth at least 2 , 000 dinar s .
description_long: Touch of Opening The Touch of Opening was a ritual used by sha ' ir s on their gen to grant their familiar s the ability to open any item locked by mundane means . Preparation . In order for this ritual to succeed the sha ' ir needed to acquire a set of pure golden lockpicks worth at least 2 , 000 dinar s . In addition to the monetary demand of this requirement , it was often exceedingly difficult to find a craftsman skilled enough to complete such a task . The Touch of Opening ritual lasted for 30 hours . If successful , the ritual granted the gen the ability to open any lock unless it was barred by magic . The gen needed only to touch the locked item in question for the lock to open . It should be noted that sha ' irs who performed this ritual on their gen were distrusted by other sha ' irs , causing a negative effect upon their station in Zakhara .

title: Touchsickle
description: Touchsickle Touchsickle was a divine magic spell available to druid s , specialty priest s , and allies of Eldath , the Green Goddess . It transformed the caster ' s hand into a magical sickle . Effects .
description_long: Touchsickle Touchsickle was a divine magic spell available to druid s , specialty priest s , and allies of Eldath , the Green Goddess . It transformed the caster ' s hand into a magical sickle . Effects . Similar to " flame blade " and " ice blade " , this spell caused one of the caster ' s hands to become a magical weapon . For six minutes ( longer for more experienced casters ) , the chosen hand was transformed into a magically sharp wooden sickle that , for comparison purposes , was equivalent to a " + 2 " weapon . " Touchsickle " did not improve combat skill by any means , but the merest touch of this implement caused a wound identical to being slashed by a non - magical sickle . Components . Only verbal and somatic components were required to cast this spell . Users . Peacemen and peacewomen of Eldath could only use this spell for non - aggressive purposes or self - defense . For druids , the " touchsickle " was equivalent to a gold en or silver sickle for the purpose of harvesting mistletoe at its greatest potency .

title: Tour of Duty
description: Tour of Duty As Waterdeep ' s city guard is crippled by illness , volunteers are needed to relieve a northern outpost . At the same time , ranger s from the same outpost discover a dragon ' s hoard and help themselves to some choice items , much to the anger of the dragon .
description_long: Tour of Duty As Waterdeep ' s city guard is crippled by illness , volunteers are needed to relieve a northern outpost . At the same time , ranger s from the same outpost discover a dragon ' s hoard and help themselves to some choice items , much to the anger of the dragon .

title: Tourmaline
description: Tourmaline Tourmaline was a long - crystalled mineral that came in many colors and was considered a fancy stone . Description . Tourmaline could be found in a wide variety of colors , the more common being pale shades of blue , brown , gold , green , pink , red , and silver pearl .
description_long: Tourmaline Tourmaline was a long - crystalled mineral that came in many colors and was considered a fancy stone . Description . Tourmaline could be found in a wide variety of colors , the more common being pale shades of blue , brown , gold , green , pink , red , and silver pearl . White or colorless tourmaline was called waterstar . If multiple colors occurred in the same crystal , it was known as rainbow tourmaline and was priced in the higher precious stone range . Black tourmaline was called ravenar and was considered a gem stone . A typical monochromatic specimen had a base value of 100 gp . Tourmalines were considered sacred by followers of Deneir — appropriate for sacrifice , or to be consecrated for use , or recognized as boons or omens when found . The rainbow variety of tourmaline was sacred to followers of Mystra . Powers . All tourmalines could absorb any spell cast upon it and immediately convert it into three " lightning bolt s " that blasted outward in straight lines from the crystal facets in directions chosen by the caster . This act consumed the gem in the process .

title: Tower Chûmavhraele
description: Tower Chûmavhraele Tower Chûmahraele was a drow - controlled castle located in the Underdark approximately 2 , 500 feet ( 760 meters ) beneath the city of Ravens Bluff . The castle was home to the drow clan House Chûmavh , ruled by the Marquise Dresimil Chûmavh . The castle was constructed some time between 1367 DR and 1479 DR .
description_long: Tower Chûmavhraele Tower Chûmahraele was a drow - controlled castle located in the Underdark approximately 2 , 500 feet ( 760 meters ) beneath the city of Ravens Bluff . The castle was home to the drow clan House Chûmavh , ruled by the Marquise Dresimil Chûmavh . The castle was constructed some time between 1367 DR and 1479 DR . Description . The castle was an imposing structure in a huge cavern that also contained an ancient drow - built mythal . The castle was surrounded by forests of huge mushrooms the size of trees as well as paddocks where rothe were raised . The interior of the castle had the typical chambers one would expect to find in a castle , such as dungeon cells and a kitchen . It also had a huge throne room with a spider - shaped throne . Inhabitants . In addition to the dark elves , Castle Chûmavhraele was home to slave s of many races .

title: Tower Reilloch
description: Tower Reilloch Tower Reilloch was a tower on the northern coast of the island of Evermeet and home to Araevin Teshurr and the Circle of Reilloch Domayr . Defenses . It was guarded by the Queen ' s Guards since the attack on the island in 1371 DR .
description_long: Tower Reilloch Tower Reilloch was a tower on the northern coast of the island of Evermeet and home to Araevin Teshurr and the Circle of Reilloch Domayr . Defenses . It was guarded by the Queen ' s Guards since the attack on the island in 1371 DR . The tower was of stone construction with battlements and was surrounded by fir and spruce trees .

title: Tower Tranquil
description: Tower Tranquil Tower Tranquil stood just north of Oversember Vale . Location . The Tower Tranquil stood atop the gateway to the cavern of the dracolich Rauglothgor .
description_long: Tower Tranquil Tower Tranquil stood just north of Oversember Vale . Location . The Tower Tranquil stood atop the gateway to the cavern of the dracolich Rauglothgor . A " gate " once linked the tower to a cavern in Myth Drannor . History . Tower Tranquil was built by the mage Jhavanter of Highmoon Shandril Shessair destroyed the tower in 1356 DR with " spellfire " .

title: Tower of Adnan al - Raqi
description: Tower of Adnan al - Raqi The Tower of Adnan al - Raqi was located in Huzuz in 1367 DR . Location . The Tower of Adnan al - Raqi could be found in the Pilgrims ' District of the City of Delights .
description_long: Tower of Adnan al - Raqi The Tower of Adnan al - Raqi was located in Huzuz in 1367 DR . Location . The Tower of Adnan al - Raqi could be found in the Pilgrims ' District of the City of Delights . Structure . This three - leveled tower was built for strength as well as education . The first level held a reception area and interview room where Adnan al - Raqi could talk with prospective students . A study room and the dormitory were also located here . The second level housed the library , a lounge , a special conjuring room , and quarters for advanced students . The third level of the tower held Adnan ' s personal library , conjuring room , enchanting room , bedroom , and treasure room . Defenses . The tower walls were enchanted so creatures who traveled the ethereal plane could not pass through . The walls also barred any teleportation attempt . The only places to magically travel into or out of the tower were the conjuring rooms , and these were closely watched by dangerous guardian genie s . Inhabitants .

title: Tower of Al - Kalb
description: Tower of Al - Kalb The Tower of Al - Kalb , or Tower of the Dog , was located within the great fortress of Sarahin in the Haunted Lands . Description . Grey stucco covered the outside of the tower .
description_long: Tower of Al - Kalb The Tower of Al - Kalb , or Tower of the Dog , was located within the great fortress of Sarahin in the Haunted Lands . Description . Grey stucco covered the outside of the tower . Inhabitants . This tower was given to Akim al - Kalaas when he joined the Everlasting . His servants , genie s and apprentices lived in the tower with him .

title: Tower of Harmony
description: Tower of Harmony The Tower of Harmony was located atop Mount Kus in the Hordelands near Kushk . Description . The Tower was constructed on the site where the six roads leading up from the Holy Mountain of Kus converged .
description_long: Tower of Harmony The Tower of Harmony was located atop Mount Kus in the Hordelands near Kushk . Description . The Tower was constructed on the site where the six roads leading up from the Holy Mountain of Kus converged . Each road actually led to a different floor of the Tower . Though it was a simple structure made from red stone , the Tower of Harmony was considered to be a place of perfect enlightenment . Inhabitants . The High Lama of Bimasara lived within the Tower of Harmony . He met with priests who were wise enough to master the dangerous tests within the Holy Mountain below .

title: Tower of Martyrs
description: Tower of Martyrs The Tower of Martyrs was an outpost of the great fortress of Sarahin . Location . The Tower of Martyrs was located deep within the Haunted Lands of Zakhara .
description_long: Tower of Martyrs The Tower of Martyrs was an outpost of the great fortress of Sarahin . Location . The Tower of Martyrs was located deep within the Haunted Lands of Zakhara . Description . Made entirely of mud bricks , this tower was decorated with carved statues and mosaic designs . The base of the Tower of Martyrs measured 40 ft . ( 12m ) wide and the tower stood 200 ft . ( 60m ) tall . The entire tower was solid and had a lone spiral stairway leading to the top . Inhabitants . Saluqi greyhounds were kept in a kennel at the base of the tower . Messenger pigeons were housed in an aviary located at the top . A trio of wind walker s were bound to the tower , allowing only members of the Everlasting or worshipers of Hajama to reach the top safely . All others climbing the stair were allowed to reach the halfway point before being blown from the tower to plummet to their deaths . The wind walkers also carried holy slayer s away from Sarahin on important missions , usually toward the Free Cities of Zakhara . History . The Tower of Martyrs was used by the Everlasting as a lookout point as it offered clear views of the surrounding desert for many miles .

title: Tower of Mystery
description: Tower of Mystery The Tower of Mystery or Tower of Mysteries was a temple to Mystra , the Lady of Mysteries , in Saerloon in Sembia . Leadership . Around 1370 DR , the temple was led by Mage Arcane Tanthala , who was assisted by Lord of Mystery Telornym .
description_long: Tower of Mystery The Tower of Mystery or Tower of Mysteries was a temple to Mystra , the Lady of Mysteries , in Saerloon in Sembia . Leadership . Around 1370 DR , the temple was led by Mage Arcane Tanthala , who was assisted by Lord of Mystery Telornym . History . In Eleint of the Year of Lightning Storms , 1374 DR , Tunaster Dranik , an itinerant cleric of Mystra , journeyed to the Tower of Mystery in search of an explanation or assistance regarding the mysterious Temple of Mystra in Wheloon in neighboring Cormyr . He believed someone there would be able to teleport him back to Wheloon if needed .

title: Tower of Pain Exalted
description: Tower of Pain Exalted The Tower of Pain Exalted was found in Zhentil Keep in 1358 DR . This temple was dedicated to the worship of Loviatar , the Maiden of Pain . Inhabitants .
description_long: Tower of Pain Exalted The Tower of Pain Exalted was found in Zhentil Keep in 1358 DR . This temple was dedicated to the worship of Loviatar , the Maiden of Pain . Inhabitants . Ulamyth Quantor served as the High Priest , or High Torturelord , of the temple . He and his 14 fellow priests preached the word of Loviatar to a congregation of 26 believers .

title: Tower of Stars
description: Tower of Stars The Tower of Stars was a wizard ' s tower on Traitor ' s Isle on the Sea of Fallen Stars . History . It was constructed and used by Jorunhast , a former Royal Wizard of Cormyr .
description_long: Tower of Stars The Tower of Stars was a wizard ' s tower on Traitor ' s Isle on the Sea of Fallen Stars . History . It was constructed and used by Jorunhast , a former Royal Wizard of Cormyr . It was given its name because its walls were adorned with star mosaics .

title: Tower of Twilight
description: Tower of Twilight The Tower of Twilight was home to Malchor Harpell and was located on the eastern edge of the Neverwinter Wood , a day ' s ride west of Longsaddle . Structure . Exterior .
description_long: Tower of Twilight The Tower of Twilight was home to Malchor Harpell and was located on the eastern edge of the Neverwinter Wood , a day ' s ride west of Longsaddle . Structure . Exterior . The enchanted emerald tower with two twisted spires rested on an island within a small lake which drained into the woods to the west . It was invisible in the sunlight , but in starlight , the twisting spires twinkled and an emerald - green bridge appeared spanning the water to the island . The tower was reached by an invisible ( although it could glow green , if needed ) bridge . Interior . Upon entering , visitors discovered a wide , round chamber lined with stalls for steeds along one wall . A corridor from the chamber gradually turned upward along the tower ' s inner circumference , growing steeper , and tightening as it wound to the top . The second level housed the dining room and above that was Malchor ' s study , which occupied the whole upper level , its door opened directly from the spiraling corridor . The passageway continued past the study to serve the turret chambers . Malchor ' s museum .

title: Tower of the Dawn
description: Tower of the Dawn The Tower of the Dawn was an important religious site for the great fortress of Sarahin . Location . The Tower of Martyrs was located deep within the Haunted Lands of Zakhara in Sarahin .
description_long: Tower of the Dawn The Tower of the Dawn was an important religious site for the great fortress of Sarahin . Location . The Tower of Martyrs was located deep within the Haunted Lands of Zakhara in Sarahin . Description . A sacred flame , called the Lamp of Devotion , was tended so it burned bright at all hours . History . Holy slayer s of the Everlasting used this location for many purposes . The call to prayer was issued here every morning , noon , and evening . New holy slayers were inducted into the Everlasting here after taking their vow of secrecy . The Tower also served as a site to punish criminals where they were branded , hanged , or thrown from the top of the tower , depending on their crimes .

title: Tower of the Eye
description: Tower of the Eye The Tower of the Eye was a temple of Helm in the Temple District of the city of Procampur in the Vast . By 1357 DR until 1367 DR and after , it was led by High Guardian Endra " Watchever " Mathlyn , with 18 subordinate priests and 24 lay - followers . History .
description_long: Tower of the Eye The Tower of the Eye was a temple of Helm in the Temple District of the city of Procampur in the Vast . By 1357 DR until 1367 DR and after , it was led by High Guardian Endra " Watchever " Mathlyn , with 18 subordinate priests and 24 lay - followers . History . In the Year of the Wandering Wyrm , 1317 DR , the High Guardian of the time wrote about the Plague of Dragons and the dragon that spread the diseases around the Inner Sea , telling of theories surrounding them and events in other lands . The current Thultyrl recruited the temple corps to help defend the city . The High Guardian ' s writings were kept in the Tower ' s ecclesiastic archives . In Marpenoth of the Year of the Shield , 1367 DR , when Procampur was struck by the featherlung plague , clerics of Helm treated the sick within the Temple District .

title: Tower of the Faceless God
description: Tower of the Faceless God The Tower of the Faceless God was a large structure within the Yikarian Empire dedicated to the Faceless God in 1367 DR . Location . The Tower was found in the capital city of Nathong , specifically within the Emperor ' s Quarters .
description_long: Tower of the Faceless God The Tower of the Faceless God was a large structure within the Yikarian Empire dedicated to the Faceless God in 1367 DR . Location . The Tower was found in the capital city of Nathong , specifically within the Emperor ' s Quarters . Description . Easily the tallest structure within Nathong , the Tower soared high above the rest of the city . A massive bronze bell decorated the top of the Tower . The bell was believed to weigh at least two tons .

title: Tower of the Masked Mage
description: Tower of the Masked Mage The Tower of the Masked Mage was a temple to Vhaeraun in Sshamath . Description . Sshamath was a drow city in an Underdark cavern , with the temple hanging from the cavern ' s roof .
description_long: Tower of the Masked Mage The Tower of the Masked Mage was a temple to Vhaeraun in Sshamath . Description . Sshamath was a drow city in an Underdark cavern , with the temple hanging from the cavern ' s roof . It was situated in the Darkwoods district , which was Sshamath ' s slum . Membership . The city was unique among drow cities in that it wasn ' t ruled by a clergy but by mages . Vhaeraun , under the alias Masked Mage or Lord of Shadow , was primarily worshiped in his role as the drow patron of shadow magic and spellfilchers . Religion and divine magic weren ' t viewed highly in the city and the same applied to this temple ' s faith . Due to this reason , they didn ' t have many cleric s and the majority were rogue s and spellfilchers , as well as arcane caster who used the Shadow Weave . The head priest of this temple was Shadow Sorcerer Pharaun Lhalabar who , despite his title , didn ' t possess any arcane capabilities . History . The School of the Shadow Weave was an attempt to get a seat in Sshamath ' s ruling body . During the Silence of Lolth , Lolth ' s priesthood lost their powers and Vhaeraun ' s clerics took the official positions formerly held by Lolth ' s clergy .

title: Tower of the Talon
description: Tower of the Talon The Tower of the Talon was a fortress inhabited by a cell of the Cult of the Dragon and named in honor of Anabraxis the Black Talon . The tower was shaped to look like a huge dragon fang with two tips . There were numerous balconies in the tower for the convenience of dragons .
description_long: Tower of the Talon The Tower of the Talon was a fortress inhabited by a cell of the Cult of the Dragon and named in honor of Anabraxis the Black Talon . The tower was shaped to look like a huge dragon fang with two tips . There were numerous balconies in the tower for the convenience of dragons . The tower was organized as a military organization and had a large armory and barracks .

title: Tower of the Test
description: Tower of the Test The Tower of the Test was a structure located on the island of Jazirat al - Gawwar in the Crowded Sea in 1367 DR . Location . The tower could be found in the town of Takabbar .
description_long: Tower of the Test The Tower of the Test was a structure located on the island of Jazirat al - Gawwar in the Crowded Sea in 1367 DR . Location . The tower could be found in the town of Takabbar . Structure . The tower was surrounded by a stone wall . Within the wall was a garden encircling the base of the tower that filled the air with sweet scents . The tower had four doors at its base , one on each side . Interior . A single circular stairway wound upward from the bottom floor . A small windowless chamber was located at the top of the stairway . An intricate pattern lined the floor of this room . Rumors and Legends . The pattern lining the floor on the tower ' s highest level was rumored to be magical , capable of instantly transporting anyone who stood upon it to whichever location they pictured in their mind . Inhabitants . Four guardian genie s stood before the doorways on the bottom floor of the tower , preventing anyone from ascending the stairway unless they correctly answered a question . The genies reacted aggressively to any visitor who did not immediately leave the tower if they failed to answer the question .

title: Towerfall
description: Towerfall Towerfall was a powerful arcane spell that could knock over stone towers and walls . Effects . " Towerfall " , quite simply , lifted and knocked over huge stone structures , like castle towers , bridges , and city walls .
description_long: Towerfall Towerfall was a powerful arcane spell that could knock over stone towers and walls . Effects . " Towerfall " , quite simply , lifted and knocked over huge stone structures , like castle towers , bridges , and city walls . A variant of " towerfall " was " stone fountain " . History . Inhil " Hurler - of - Stars " Lauthdryn , the Magister from 154 to 1294 DR , had a special love of blowing up castles , hence his creation of " towerfall " . He particularly enjoyed the spell , but he took its secrets to his grave in the Year of Deep Moon , 1294 DR .

title: Towers of Good Fortune
description: Towers of Good Fortune The Towers of Good Fortune was a large and extremely wealthy temple in Suzail dedicated to the goddess of luck Tymora . The temple was considered the most prominent in Suzail and was home to over a dozen priest s who were assisted by several hundred laymen . Description .
description_long: Towers of Good Fortune The Towers of Good Fortune was a large and extremely wealthy temple in Suzail dedicated to the goddess of luck Tymora . The temple was considered the most prominent in Suzail and was home to over a dozen priest s who were assisted by several hundred laymen . Description . The temple contained an elaborate wishing well in its courtyard constructed shortly prior to 1479 DR .

title: Towers of Willful Suffering
description: Towers of Willful Suffering The Towers of Willful Suffering was a temple and abbey complex located in Eshpurta , Amn . In the Year of the Shield , 1367 DR , it was a quiet , contemplative place with a staff of 16 priests and a community of 48 followers , led by the Revered Mother of the House Heldatha Dhussta . The grounds and architecture were understated and plain , but its mere presence in Amn made it stand out more than opulence and grandeur ever could .
description_long: Towers of Willful Suffering The Towers of Willful Suffering was a temple and abbey complex located in Eshpurta , Amn . In the Year of the Shield , 1367 DR , it was a quiet , contemplative place with a staff of 16 priests and a community of 48 followers , led by the Revered Mother of the House Heldatha Dhussta . The grounds and architecture were understated and plain , but its mere presence in Amn made it stand out more than opulence and grandeur ever could .

title: Towers of the Vengeful Hand
description: Towers of the Vengeful Hand The Towers of the Vengeful Hand was a temple complex devoted to Tempus and located in the center of Eshpurta in the Year of the Shield , 1367 DR through at least early 1370 DR , the Year of the Tankard . As of 1367 DR , there were 10 underpriests serving about 150 adherents and a large number of worshipers among the 28 , 000 garrisoned troops , instructors , trainees , and support personnel . As of 1370 DR , Jak Errins was getting on in years and two of his underpriests , Peris Whallnsor , and Niskam Tresdaap , were vying for the powerful leadership position .
description_long: Towers of the Vengeful Hand The Towers of the Vengeful Hand was a temple complex devoted to Tempus and located in the center of Eshpurta in the Year of the Shield , 1367 DR through at least early 1370 DR , the Year of the Tankard . As of 1367 DR , there were 10 underpriests serving about 150 adherents and a large number of worshipers among the 28 , 000 garrisoned troops , instructors , trainees , and support personnel . As of 1370 DR , Jak Errins was getting on in years and two of his underpriests , Peris Whallnsor , and Niskam Tresdaap , were vying for the powerful leadership position .

title: Toyo Otomoto
description: Toyo Otomoto Toyo Otomoto was a sea captain in Kozakura in 1357 DR . History . Otomoto was a very experienced captain in service of Shou Ko clan for a long time commanding the " Joyful Spring " ship .
description_long: Toyo Otomoto Toyo Otomoto was a sea captain in Kozakura in 1357 DR . History . Otomoto was a very experienced captain in service of Shou Ko clan for a long time commanding the " Joyful Spring " ship . He made numerous travels between Kozakura and far Akari island , where Shou Lung was constructing a colony . In 1357 Otomoto transported an adventuring party hired by Ko Mei Kho to stop the Ochimo .

title: Toyo Shidiro
description: Toyo Shidiro Toyo Shidiro was a sailor in 1358 DR . Activities . Toyo Shidiro was a Kozakuran sailor in service to the mercantile Ko clan , acting as second - in - command of the " Victorious Morning " ship under Captain Hu .
description_long: Toyo Shidiro Toyo Shidiro was a sailor in 1358 DR . Activities . Toyo Shidiro was a Kozakuran sailor in service to the mercantile Ko clan , acting as second - in - command of the " Victorious Morning " ship under Captain Hu . History . In 1358 DR , he was ordered to take Ko La Ko and an adventuring party hired by Ko Ho San to H ' sin - to , at the mouth of the Fenghsintzu River in T ' u Lung . Eventually , he started a mutiny but was defeated by the adventurers . Personality . Toyo Shidiro had a bad treatment from the Ko clan and secretly wanted revenge against them .

title: Toyoaki
description: Toyoaki Toyoaki was a monk in Shou Lung in 1358 DR . Activities . Toyoaki was a monk devoted to Nung Chiang , one of the Nine Immortals of the Celestial Empire , and to the Way .
description_long: Toyoaki Toyoaki was a monk in Shou Lung in 1358 DR . Activities . Toyoaki was a monk devoted to Nung Chiang , one of the Nine Immortals of the Celestial Empire , and to the Way . He lived in the monastery of Chu ' tung , a city in Chu ' Yuan province . History . In 1358 DR , his masters tasked Toyoaki with the mission of building a new shrine to Nung Chiang among the people living in the Shao Mountains . Eventually , with the help of an adventuring party , he managed to finish building the shrine in time for the next holy day .

title: Toytere
description: Toytere Toytere was a halfling man and the leader of the Dead Rats gang of Luskan and the biological twin brother of Kalen Dren ' s adopted sister Cellica . Like many of the Rats , Toytere had some wererat blood although he never demonstrated any ability to shape shift until his death when his body took the form of a wererat . Description .
description_long: Toytere Toytere was a halfling man and the leader of the Dead Rats gang of Luskan and the biological twin brother of Kalen Dren ' s adopted sister Cellica . Like many of the Rats , Toytere had some wererat blood although he never demonstrated any ability to shape shift until his death when his body took the form of a wererat . Description . Toytere had a weasel - like face , a red beard , and sharpened teeth . He carried a cane topped by a gold rat . Abilities . Toytere had the Sight , which allowed him to see the future when in a trance . Relationships . Toytere hated Kalen whom he blamed for taking her sister to Waterdeep although he forgave Kalen before he died . History . In 1480 DR , Toytere ordered the capture of the powerful spellscared wizard Myrin Darkdance with the intent of turning her over to the Coin Spinners gang for payment . Realizing they couldn ' t hold a mage as powerful of Myrin , they led her to believe she was the new leader of the gang . Toytere was bitten by a rat infected with the Fury plague and slowly began to develop symptoms of the disease , becoming increasingly aggressive and irrational .

title: Traceless travel
description: Traceless travel Traceless travel was a spell unique to Zakhara , the Land of Fate . This spell was only usable by wizard s . Effects .
description_long: Traceless travel Traceless travel was a spell unique to Zakhara , the Land of Fate . This spell was only usable by wizard s . Effects . This spell allowed the target to move over sand with out leaving a visible trail . Components . This spell required a handful of sand and a tear from the caster to cast .

title: Tracker scent
description: Tracker scent The tracker scent ritual was used by sha ' ir s to enhance the sense of smell of their gen . Preparation . A concoction of rare herbs costing 600 dinar s was needed to complete the tracker scent ritual .
description_long: Tracker scent The tracker scent ritual was used by sha ' ir s to enhance the sense of smell of their gen . Preparation . A concoction of rare herbs costing 600 dinar s was needed to complete the tracker scent ritual . This ritual took 16 hours to complete . Gens with tracker scent were able to track any creature by their scent providing the creature traveled by land .

title: Trackless Sea
description: Trackless Sea The Trackless Sea was the name of the ocean due west of the continent of Faerûn . Geography . The Trackless Sea ran from the Sea of Swords in the west to Maztica , where it was known as Taylola , the Eastern Ocean , and Anchorome in the east .
description_long: Trackless Sea The Trackless Sea was the name of the ocean due west of the continent of Faerûn . Geography . The Trackless Sea ran from the Sea of Swords in the west to Maztica , where it was known as Taylola , the Eastern Ocean , and Anchorome in the east . The sea also spanded north to the Sea of Moving Ice and south to the peninsula of Chult .

title: Trade Harbor
description: Trade Harbor The Trade Harbor was located in Huzuz , the City of Delights , along the banks of Al - Sarif River . Description . This large harbor had enough docks to support 40 galley s or dromond s with an additional 75 cog s .
description_long: Trade Harbor The Trade Harbor was located in Huzuz , the City of Delights , along the banks of Al - Sarif River . Description . This large harbor had enough docks to support 40 galley s or dromond s with an additional 75 cog s . All of the docks were well - maintained to accommodate the constant influx of vessels . Activities . A constant bustle of activity permeated every available space of the Trade Harbor . This section of Huzuz acted like a small city , with many of the thousands of workers never even leaving the area during their lifetimes . Each incoming ship had their wares assessed by a tax collector to determine the tax to be paid . After paying the tax , the ship was assigned a dock where they could unload their merchandise . Since the Trade Harbor was crammed at times , marid s were often used to pull ships to their docks . Inhabitants . Many of the wealthy merchant families employed genie s , ogre s , and giant s to facilitate the movement of trade goods . Several platoons of the Dauntless Mamluk Society were always present around the docks to maintain security and apprehend thieves for justice .

title: Trade Tongue
description: Trade Tongue Trade Tongue was the name given to the common trade language amongst the inhabitants of Kara - Tur . Due to its purpose , it had only a limited vocabulary , consisting largely of terms for the exchange of goods and currency . It was therefore mostly used by merchants and traders , as well as sailors .
description_long: Trade Tongue Trade Tongue was the name given to the common trade language amongst the inhabitants of Kara - Tur . Due to its purpose , it had only a limited vocabulary , consisting largely of terms for the exchange of goods and currency . It was therefore mostly used by merchants and traders , as well as sailors . However , in the 14th century DR , an increasing number of diplomats preferred it for negotiation , for the sake of neutrality and impartiality . However , people of Tabot did not know the Trade Tongue .

title: Trade Way
description: Trade Way The Trade Way was a long , well traveled trade road along the west coast of Faerûn . Geography . The Trade Way started at Calimport in the south and traveled along the coast line all the way north to Waterdeep .
description_long: Trade Way The Trade Way was a long , well traveled trade road along the west coast of Faerûn . Geography . The Trade Way started at Calimport in the south and traveled along the coast line all the way north to Waterdeep . The section of road between Baldur ' s Gate and Tethyr was also known as the Coast Way on some maps . History . After the Spellplague , traffic to Luskan and Calimport was nearly non - existent but the Trade Way remained in use from Waterdeep to the southern edges of Tethyr . The Trade Way was no longer considered safe and paladin s from Elturgard guarded the crossing at the Winding Water River . Caravan guards were considered a necessity and were in constant demand .

title: Trade bar
description: Trade bar Trade bars are a form of hard currency made of various precious metals that are accepted as currency throughout virtually all of Faerûn . They are typically marked with the seal or symbol of the mercantile group or nation that minted them . Merchants , trade costers and anyone else who is trading in large quantities typically prefer to use trade bars for their wide acceptance and ease - of - use .
description_long: Trade bar Trade bars are a form of hard currency made of various precious metals that are accepted as currency throughout virtually all of Faerûn . They are typically marked with the seal or symbol of the mercantile group or nation that minted them . Merchants , trade costers and anyone else who is trading in large quantities typically prefer to use trade bars for their wide acceptance and ease - of - use . Varieties . Ranging in sizes from 1 , 2 , 5 and 10 lbs , trade bars are usually minted in silver , or more rarely , gold . Silver trade bars are worth 5 gp per lb , with the gold variety being worth 50 gp per lb . Mirabar is known to issue spindle - shaped black iron bars weighing 2 lbs , that are worth 10 gp within the city and only 5 gp elsewhere . While most trade bars are around six inches long . Calishite trade bars are an inch longer with tapered sides .

title: Trademeet
description: Trademeet Trademeet , also known as the City of Merchant ' s Peace , was a settlement in Amn and the smallest of the region ' s caravan stops . Due to the Merchant ' s Peace , all commerce in Trademeet was bound to be carried out honestly and fairly . Geography .
description_long: Trademeet Trademeet , also known as the City of Merchant ' s Peace , was a settlement in Amn and the smallest of the region ' s caravan stops . Due to the Merchant ' s Peace , all commerce in Trademeet was bound to be carried out honestly and fairly . Geography . Trademeet was located between the Forest of Tethir / Wealdath to the south and the Small Teeth mountains to the north . It was generally considered part of the Small Teeth region of Amn . Trade . Trademeet was primarily a caravan stop , with a few agricultural products produced by the estates surrounding the town . The Trade Way passed north - south through Trademeet , connecting it to Imnescar and eventually Baldur ' s Gate in the north and Mosstone and eventually Zazesspur in the south . The Tethir Road led west to Murann on the coast and east to Riatavin and the Snowflake Mountains . Description . Trademeet was a small town centered around Waukeen ' s Circle , a prehistoric circle of seven upright stone slabs . History . In 223 DR , Trademeet was established as the caravan mustering point for Amn and Tethyr . In 661 DR , ogre s from the Cloud Peaks and Small Teeth ransacked Trademeet and neighboring Imnescar .

title: Trader ' s Road
description: Trader ' s Road The Trader ' s Road was a road traveling from the Sunset Vale through the Dragon Coast . Geography . The road ran from the town of Easting in the Sunset Vale , across the Dragon Reach through Elversult , across the Horse Prairie , to the town of Teziir , then turns south and goes through the town of Smuggler ' s Bank and Reddansyr , then crosses the river Reddan and ends at the city of Starmantle on the Sea of Fallen Stars .
description_long: Trader ' s Road The Trader ' s Road was a road traveling from the Sunset Vale through the Dragon Coast . Geography . The road ran from the town of Easting in the Sunset Vale , across the Dragon Reach through Elversult , across the Horse Prairie , to the town of Teziir , then turns south and goes through the town of Smuggler ' s Bank and Reddansyr , then crosses the river Reddan and ends at the city of Starmantle on the Sea of Fallen Stars .

title: Trader Bob
description: Trader Bob Trader Bob was a human adventurer - turned - merchant . His shops were notable for being more expensive than the norm . Description .
description_long: Trader Bob Trader Bob was a human adventurer - turned - merchant . His shops were notable for being more expensive than the norm . Description . Bob had long , brown hair , light skin , and wore a purple tunic with green pants . Possessions . On his person , Trader Bob carried three pieces of magical equipment : a suit of plate mail , a shield , and a battleaxe . History . Trader Bob began his career as an adventurer at a young age , and decided to retire early as well . He went into business as an equipment merchant , and his shops could be found all over Toril , even far from civilization .

title: Trades Ward of Waterdeep
description: Trades Ward of Waterdeep Trades Ward was one of the seven wards of the city of Waterdeep . Geography . The ward was bounded in the south by South Ward , in the west by Castle Ward , in the north by North Ward and the City of the Dead and in the east by the Trollwall .
description_long: Trades Ward of Waterdeep Trades Ward was one of the seven wards of the city of Waterdeep . Geography . The ward was bounded in the south by South Ward , in the west by Castle Ward , in the north by North Ward and the City of the Dead and in the east by the Trollwall .

title: Traevyn Illance
description: Traevyn Illance Traevyn Illance was an old noble in Cormyr and lord of the Illance noble house . History . Around 1479 DR , Traevyn visited Broryn Windstag and his friend to check on their situation and to try to recruit all the gathered nobles to his cabal .
description_long: Traevyn Illance Traevyn Illance was an old noble in Cormyr and lord of the Illance noble house . History . Around 1479 DR , Traevyn visited Broryn Windstag and his friend to check on their situation and to try to recruit all the gathered nobles to his cabal . Later he arranged a meeting with Rauligus Helderstone using as intermediate the wizard - for - hire Morligul Downdagger , but in truth was a trap in order to kill Helderstone for broking an agreement between the two . However at the meeting arrived instead Elminster Aumar disguised as Morligul and Mirt disguised as Helderstone and thank also to Storm Silverhand they defeated the Illance ' s bodyguards and subdued him .

title: Trahern
description: Trahern Trahern of Oakvale was an old druid in charge of the Oakvale , a small forest in the Myrloch Vale . Personality . He was proud of his caretaker - ship of the Oakvale .
description_long: Trahern Trahern of Oakvale was an old druid in charge of the Oakvale , a small forest in the Myrloch Vale . Personality . He was proud of his caretaker - ship of the Oakvale . History . In 1345 DR , Trahern was corrupted by Kazgoroth in the disguise of a Dryad so he could show Grunnarch the Red and his army a safe and fast passage through Myrloch Vale .

title: Trail Lords
description: Trail Lords The Trail Lords was a merchant company in Faerûn . History . This mysterious merchant group was known to hire half - orcs , and other unsavory races , as caravan guards .
description_long: Trail Lords The Trail Lords was a merchant company in Faerûn . History . This mysterious merchant group was known to hire half - orcs , and other unsavory races , as caravan guards . The group was rumored to be comprised of wealthy merchant - kings who fell under the control of Thay .

title: Trail between Everlund and Sundabar
description: Trail between Everlund and Sundabar The Everlund to Sundabar trail was a pathway within the Silver Marches . Geography . The trail began in Everlund at the Upriver Gate and followed the north bank of the River Rauvin to Lhuvenhead .
description_long: Trail between Everlund and Sundabar The Everlund to Sundabar trail was a pathway within the Silver Marches . Geography . The trail began in Everlund at the Upriver Gate and followed the north bank of the River Rauvin to Lhuvenhead . From Lhuvenhead the trail continued along the north bank of the River Rauvin to Jalanthar . Between Lhuvenhead and Jalanthar , there was a branch trail which lead to Hilltop . From Jalanthar , the trail stayed on the north side of the River Rauvin as it traveled through the Moon Pass until it reached Rauvincross . At Rauvincross , the trail crossed the River Rauvin then ended in Sundabar .

title: Trailsend
description: Trailsend Trailsend was a large city in Damara . A large center of trade for the surrounding region , the city appealed to adventuring parties who often went to explore the ruins of Rawlinswood or the Giantspire Mountains . The city was often used by travelers on the long road to Rashemen .
description_long: Trailsend Trailsend was a large city in Damara . A large center of trade for the surrounding region , the city appealed to adventuring parties who often went to explore the ruins of Rawlinswood or the Giantspire Mountains . The city was often used by travelers on the long road to Rashemen .

title: Traitor ' s Heads
description: Traitor ' s Heads Traitor ' s Heads was a betting dice game played in Cormyr . Set - Up . The game required a large cloak or velvet cloth ; a set of five six - sided dice ; and two skulls , one of which had had the top sawed off .
description_long: Traitor ' s Heads Traitor ' s Heads was a betting dice game played in Cormyr . Set - Up . The game required a large cloak or velvet cloth ; a set of five six - sided dice ; and two skulls , one of which had had the top sawed off . The intact skull was placed on the center of the cloak or cloth . Rules . A target number ( most often 36 ) was agreed upon by the players . They would then take bets on who would reach the target number first , and sometimes these bets were modified if the target was reached by a certain number of rolls . The game was played in turns . On his or her turn , each player would shake the dice within the skull with a sawed - off top and pour them onto the top of the remaining skull . All dice must hit the skull and land on the cloth . If they did not , they had to be shaken and poured again . After a valid roll , the value of the dice was added to the players running total . If the player rolled doubles , he or she could instead reroll one or both of the dice . If triples or quadruples were rolled , he or she could instead roll all three or four of the dice , respectively . If all five dice showed the same number , that player won the game instantly .

title: Traitor ' s Isle
description: Traitor ' s Isle Traitor ' s Isle was an unoccupied island that formed one of the two islands of Prespur in the Sea of Fallen Stars . The only site of interest was the Tower of Stars , created and used by Jorunhast , former Royal Wizard of Cormyr . The island ' s coastline was jagged and rocky , making travel there by boat extremely difficult and hazardous .
description_long: Traitor ' s Isle Traitor ' s Isle was an unoccupied island that formed one of the two islands of Prespur in the Sea of Fallen Stars . The only site of interest was the Tower of Stars , created and used by Jorunhast , former Royal Wizard of Cormyr . The island ' s coastline was jagged and rocky , making travel there by boat extremely difficult and hazardous .

title: Traj
description: Traj Traj was a desert dwarf chieftain in Maztica . History . Traj ruled over a village near Sunhome .
description_long: Traj Traj was a desert dwarf chieftain in Maztica . History . Traj ruled over a village near Sunhome . In 1361 DR , after the Night of Wailing , he was one of the chieftains gathered by Luskag to discuss the matter of the goblinoid armies from Nexal .

title: Tralia Falrith
description: Tralia Falrith Tralia Falrith was a crinti living in Ammathtar in northeast Dambrath during the 14th century DR . Relationships . She was a third cousin of Queen Yenandra .
description_long: Tralia Falrith Tralia Falrith was a crinti living in Ammathtar in northeast Dambrath during the 14th century DR . Relationships . She was a third cousin of Queen Yenandra . Activities . Tralia served as Duchess of the North for Dambrath . Though she was sixth in the line of succession , Tralia still had designs on the throne , including assassination attempts on the other duchesses . The most recent of these attempts was on Duchess Merial Luenath , where Tralia arranged for a group of young males to kill Merial in her bedchambers during one of her marathon " pleasure and pain " exercises . The attempt failed and Tralia remained blameless .

title: Tranph
description: Tranph Sergeant - Major Tranph was an officer in the Golden Legion . History . Tranph was a veteran of the Legion .
description_long: Tranph Sergeant - Major Tranph was an officer in the Golden Legion . History . Tranph was a veteran of the Legion . In 1361 DR , after the victory at Ulatos , Cordell assigned Tranph to oversee Helmsport ' s garrison whent he went to Nexal with most of the Legion . After the arrival of Don Vaez , Tranph and his men were put in prison .

title: Transitions
description: Transitions Transitions is a series by R . A . Salvatore that follows The Hunter ' s Blades trilogy .
description_long: Transitions Transitions is a series by R . A . Salvatore that follows The Hunter ' s Blades trilogy . Transitions . The Transitions Series is a series of fantasy novels by R . A . Salvatore , the famous science fiction and fantasy author , consisting of three novels : " The Orc King " , " The Pirate King " , and " The Ghost King " . " The Orc King " was published in September 2007 , " The Pirate King " in October 2008 , and " The Ghost King " in October 2009 . This series will be Salvatore ' s latest work in the long saga of the companions of Mithril Hall . It continues the tale of the famous renegade drow ( dark elf ) Drizzt Do ' Urden and his friends . This series is a follow up to The Hunter ' s Blades Trilogy . Like the rest of the saga , it is set in the Forgotten Realms , a popular Dungeons & Dragons role - playing setting . The Orc King . The story begins a century in the future . Drizzt Do ' Urden still wields Twinkle and Icingdeath and he now wields Taulmaril , Catti - Brie ' s magical bow . Drizzt defeats a group of bandits calling themselves Casin Cu Calas , a group that wears black and travels through the Orcish Kingdom of Many - Arrows and slays Orcs in their sleep .

title: Transitive Planes
description: Transitive Planes Transitive Planes is a collective term used to describe those planes of existence that connected other planes together , or could be used as a means of travel between points on a single plane . The various cosmology models each described them differently and ascribed them slightly different traits , but all were accessed by either magic spells , spell - like abilities , or portals . The known Transitive Planes were : Each had their own unique structure and means of travel , and each connected a different set of planes together .

title: Transmutation
description: Transmutation The transmutation school of magic consisted of spell s that changed the physical properties of some creature , thing , or condition . The school was previously known as alteration . A wizard who specialized in transmutation was known as a transmuter .
description_long: Transmutation The transmutation school of magic consisted of spell s that changed the physical properties of some creature , thing , or condition . The school was previously known as alteration . A wizard who specialized in transmutation was known as a transmuter . Transmutation spells included " bull ' s strength " , " eagle ' s splendor " , and the various polymorph spells .

title: Transmute metal to wood
description: Transmute metal to wood Transmute metal to wood was a transmutation spell that permanently transformed any metal within a 40 foot ( 12 m ) radius into wood . Older versions of this spell only operated on a single object . Effects .
description_long: Transmute metal to wood Transmute metal to wood was a transmutation spell that permanently transformed any metal within a 40 foot ( 12 m ) radius into wood . Older versions of this spell only operated on a single object . Effects . All objects made of metal were affected . Magical items had a chance to resist being transformed . Wooden weapons and armor were less effective and had a chance to splinter and break . The effect was permanent unless a " limited wish " or the equivalent was used to transform items back to their original state . When this spell was used only on a single object , it took a full " wish " to return it to metallic form again . Components . Verbal and somatic components , as well as the caster ' s holy symbol or divine focus were required to cast this spell .

title: Transmute rock to mud
description: Transmute rock to mud Transmute rock to mud was a transmutation or alteration spell that transformed natural stone into an equivalent volume of viscous mud . The reverse of this spell , " transmute mud to rock " , caused normal mud or quicksand to become a solid but brittle quantity of stone ( like alabaster , pipestone , or sandstone ) of equal volume . Effects .
description_long: Transmute rock to mud Transmute rock to mud was a transmutation or alteration spell that transformed natural stone into an equivalent volume of viscous mud . The reverse of this spell , " transmute mud to rock " , caused normal mud or quicksand to become a solid but brittle quantity of stone ( like alabaster , pipestone , or sandstone ) of equal volume . Effects . This spell only worked on uncut , un - worked rock . Any shaping , polishing , or other alterations by non - natural processes prevented the transformation . The maximum depth of stone that could be changed was 10 ft ( slightly over 3 m ) . Upon transformation , gravity caused the mud to fall , slide , ooze , subside , or pour to the lowest level possible . Any creatures or objects that were using the rock for support rapidly sank partway into the mud unless they were able to climb , fly , levitate , or use other means to escape . Falling mud was likely to damage to any beneath the affected area . If cast on the ceiling of a cavern , structural integrity could possibly be compromised , causing further damage and destruction .

title: Transport via plants
description: Transport via plants Transport via plants was a transmutation or alteration spell that allowed the caster to enter any sufficiently large plant and jump any distance to another plant of the same species . Effects . The plants in question had to be alive and Medium sized or larger to accommodate the caster and any baggage ( up to the caster ' s carrying capacity ) .
description_long: Transport via plants Transport via plants was a transmutation or alteration spell that allowed the caster to enter any sufficiently large plant and jump any distance to another plant of the same species . Effects . The plants in question had to be alive and Medium sized or larger to accommodate the caster and any baggage ( up to the caster ' s carrying capacity ) . The transmutation version of this spell also allowed other willing creatures and their baggage to be transported as long as they were touching the caster either directly or by daisy chain when he or she entered the plant . The number and size of creatures that could be transported increased with the experience of the caster . The alteration version of this spell did not allow passengers but the caster could take refuge inside either the source or the destination plant for up to 24 hours . The caster did not have to pick a specific plant , he or she could specify a direction and a distance and the spell would transport the subject ( s ) as close as possible to the location . The alteration version of " transport via plants " was a little error - prone for less experienced druids .

title: Transposing lunge
description: Transposing lunge Transposing lunge is a spell used by several swordmage s , particularly those of the shielding style . When " transposing lunge " is cast it allows a swordmage to teleport a creature struck their weapon in melee combat to a nearby location . Shielding swordmages have the added capacity to teleport in such a way creatures who would normally beyond the reach of the spell , so long as they are also currently under the affect of the " aegis of shielding " spell .
description_long: Transposing lunge Transposing lunge is a spell used by several swordmage s , particularly those of the shielding style . When " transposing lunge " is cast it allows a swordmage to teleport a creature struck their weapon in melee combat to a nearby location . Shielding swordmages have the added capacity to teleport in such a way creatures who would normally beyond the reach of the spell , so long as they are also currently under the affect of the " aegis of shielding " spell . " Transposing lunge " can be recharged after a short rest of a few minutes , at which point it can be cast again .

title: Transtra
description: Transtra Transtra was one of the leaders of the Iron Ring and a slaver of Skullport around 1370 DR . History . Transtra was a powerful crime lord and slaver in Skullport who associated herself with the Iron Ring Consortium .
description_long: Transtra Transtra was one of the leaders of the Iron Ring and a slaver of Skullport around 1370 DR . History . Transtra was a powerful crime lord and slaver in Skullport who associated herself with the Iron Ring Consortium . Very few knew about her true nature as a lamia noble , as she used many disguises and illusions . Very secretly — and under a " geas " effect — she was being tutored in the magical arts by Halaster himself . Relationship . Transtra ' s only companion was her pet behir Uliss , that she had charmed to obey her .

title: Tranth
description: Tranth Tranth was the baron of the Barony of Bloodstone in 1357 DR . History . Tranth inherited the barony from his father around 1332 DR , just before the kingdom started to fall .
description_long: Tranth Tranth was the baron of the Barony of Bloodstone in 1357 DR . History . Tranth inherited the barony from his father around 1332 DR , just before the kingdom started to fall . After the Grandfather of Assassins built the local bandits in a powerful army he accepted to pay tributes to the bandit army in order to spare the villagers ' lives . However when in 1356 DR the bandits also took away as slaves some youths from the village Tranth decided he need to fight back . So in 1357 he sent Garlen and Garvin in search of some adventurers to help them . After Gareth Dragonsbane ' s party destroyed the bandit army Tranth granted his daughter in marriage to Gareth . In 1359 DR Tranth proposed the creation of the Bloodstone Kingdom , comprising both Vaasa and Damara . Relationship . Tranth was related to King Virdin

title: Trap the soul
description: Trap the soul Trap the soul is a sorcerer and wizard spell that allows the caster to trap the life force and material body ( if any ) of a creature inside a gem . The creature can only be released if the gem is broken . The caster can complete the spell normally , or by creating a trigger object .
description_long: Trap the soul Trap the soul is a sorcerer and wizard spell that allows the caster to trap the life force and material body ( if any ) of a creature inside a gem . The creature can only be released if the gem is broken . The caster can complete the spell normally , or by creating a trigger object . If a trigger object is used , the creature becomes trapped in the gem as soon as it touches the object . The more powerful the creature being trapped , the more valuable the gem must be . If the gem is not of a high enough value compared with the power of the creature , the gem will shatter instead of functioning properly . Some of the inhabitants of Esh Alakar in Maztica are trapped in gems beneath the ruins of the site , after falling victim to this spell .

title: Traskar Selarn
description: Traskar Selarn Traskar Selarn , the Lord of Secomber , is a tall , regal and good - natured man . He has agreed to keep watch over the city for the Lords ' Alliance by intervening in it ' s affairs when necessary , but otherwise leaving it ' s inhabitants to themselves . He often sends adventurers to ruins he knows holds promise in that they have not yet been looted .
description_long: Traskar Selarn Traskar Selarn , the Lord of Secomber , is a tall , regal and good - natured man . He has agreed to keep watch over the city for the Lords ' Alliance by intervening in it ' s affairs when necessary , but otherwise leaving it ' s inhabitants to themselves . He often sends adventurers to ruins he knows holds promise in that they have not yet been looted .

title: Travel domain
description: Travel domain The Travel domain is a deity domain that grants divine spellcasters traveling spell powers . They gain the ability to move freely for brief periods regardless of magical effects impeding their movement . The ability is automatic and lasts until it runs out or is no longer needed .
description_long: Travel domain The Travel domain is a deity domain that grants divine spellcasters traveling spell powers . They gain the ability to move freely for brief periods regardless of magical effects impeding their movement . The ability is automatic and lasts until it runs out or is no longer needed . Also , their understanding of the wilderness improves .

title: Traveler ' s Cloak Inn
description: Traveler ' s Cloak Inn Traveler ' s Cloak Inn was an inn in Mulmaster on the Moonsea . Structure . The inn was a welcoming establishment where each room had a fireplace .
description_long: Traveler ' s Cloak Inn Traveler ' s Cloak Inn was an inn in Mulmaster on the Moonsea . Structure . The inn was a welcoming establishment where each room had a fireplace . Staff . The Traveler ' s Cloak was run by Dela and Vesvur Alder . Activities . Vesvur was a Harper agent who reported to Chesslyn Onaubra .

title: Traveler ' s dust
description: Traveler ' s dust Traveler ' s dust was a deadly , addictive drug . Those that used traveler ' s dust were said to be " walking the crimson road " . Appearance .
description_long: Traveler ' s dust Traveler ' s dust was a deadly , addictive drug . Those that used traveler ' s dust were said to be " walking the crimson road " . Appearance . Traveler ' s dust was transported and sold in the form of tiny roseate crystals , each a bit bigger than a grain of salt . Use . Traveler ' s dust was used by dropping a single grain of the drug onto the eye and letting it dissolve . Symptoms . Anyone using traveler ' s dust showed these telltale signs : trembling hands , sometimes slurred speech , and — most telling — eyes the color of blood . All who used the drug eventually died . History . Traveler ' s dust appeared a couple of years after the Spellplague . Realmslore . Traveler ' s dust was illegal in most civilized places .

title: Traveler ' s pearl
description: Traveler ' s pearl Traveler ' s pearls were magic item s created by marid and given to mortals . Description . This item appeared as a large pearl with rosy coloration .
description_long: Traveler ' s pearl Traveler ' s pearls were magic item s created by marid and given to mortals . Description . This item appeared as a large pearl with rosy coloration . It gave of a slight hint of alteration magic . Powers . If given as a gift , the previous owner of the " traveler ' s pearl " could speak a command word and " teleport " themselves and a companion to the pearl ' s current location , often resulting in the old owner being transported directly into the new owner ' s treasury . They pearl was destroyed once the previous owner uttered the command word .

title: Traven Blackdagger
description: Traven Blackdagger Traven Blackdagger was the older and more powerful of the Blackdagger Bandits who , together with his brother Malus Blackdagger , raided the High Road . History . Malus and Traven were two penniless brothers from Luskan .
description_long: Traven Blackdagger Traven Blackdagger was the older and more powerful of the Blackdagger Bandits who , together with his brother Malus Blackdagger , raided the High Road . History . Malus and Traven were two penniless brothers from Luskan . In the years just after the Spellplague of 1385 DR , they began their bandit careers with only a handful of men , but their ruthlessness and keen eye for opportunity earned them great success . The Blackdagger Bandits , as they were now called , gained some measure of fame , and criminals flocked to join them . With the rebuilding of Neverwinter and the subsequent increase in trade , the Blackdagger Bandits saw an even greater increase both to their income and to their ranks . After Neverwinter put a bounty or their heads , the two brothers disappeared for a time and started rumors that they had been killed and someone else led the Blackdagger Bandits . The truth was more nefarious ; the Red Wizard necromancer Kallos Tam had transformed them into undead in order to use them and their forces to attack the city of Neverwinter . However , Traven did not trust Kallos at all and decided to remain close to him to control his movements .

title: Treahugh Greiko
description: Treahugh Greiko Treahugh Greiko was an ex - ranger in the village of Conyberry around 1370 DR . History . Treahugh was a famed ranger expert in tracking large monsters .
description_long: Treahugh Greiko Treahugh Greiko was an ex - ranger in the village of Conyberry around 1370 DR . History . Treahugh was a famed ranger expert in tracking large monsters . Usually he accompanied wealthy city - dwellers who wanted to demonstrate their physical prowess by killing dangerous creatures . However , one time , a merchant of Mirabar hired him to track the fabled Mielikkar in the High Forest . Treahugh had never before heard about this monster but agreed , thanks to the very good pay . But just after the merchant killed the Mielikkar , Trehugh realized he had helped kill an animal sacred to Mielikki . He lost all his ranger abilities and retreated to Conyberry . There he opened a store where he healed injured animals .

title: Treant
description: Treant A treant was a huge intelligent plant . Biology . Although a treant ' s wood appeared to be solid like stone , it was filled with tubes that carried water from its roots to the areas where it was needed .
description_long: Treant A treant was a huge intelligent plant . Biology . Although a treant ' s wood appeared to be solid like stone , it was filled with tubes that carried water from its roots to the areas where it was needed . Diseases such as tube wilt could affect these tubes and therefore the health of the treant . Species . Cormanthor . The treants in the forest of Cormanthor became hosts for rot grub s , which lived off rotting wood . If a treant was affected by tube wilt , it would open up a small crack and let the grubs in . The grubs would eat through all the rotten wood , eating the fungi causing the disease , and usually remain for good and tackle subsequent rot . This relationship did not harm either party , and older , larger treants might contain up to a hundred of these grubs . In order to ward off predators such as woodchuck s or wood - eating horse s , the Cormanthor treants surrounded their roots with up to six Cormanthor violet fungi , whose roots tapped into the treant itself , using its sap as sustenance , and they would attempt to rot the flesh of any would - be predators .

title: Treatise Against Blood - Metal
description: Treatise Against Blood - Metal Treatise Against Blood - Metal was a book written by the sage Fairin Icemantle in the 7th century DR . In this treatise , Fairin expressed his reservations about orcslayer blades whose steel was poisonous to orc s . He feared that they would lead to the development of other alloys toxic to many races , and spread death and destruction .
description_long: Treatise Against Blood - Metal Treatise Against Blood - Metal was a book written by the sage Fairin Icemantle in the 7th century DR . In this treatise , Fairin expressed his reservations about orcslayer blades whose steel was poisonous to orc s . He feared that they would lead to the development of other alloys toxic to many races , and spread death and destruction . It also discussed the dwarven attack on the orc kingdom of Vastar in the Year of the Spellfire , 610 DR , in which the dwarves wielded the new orcslayer blades . This provided the only first - hand account of the conflict to later generations . Fairin described the dwarven slaughter of the orcs , saying that they had " run in waist - high riot across the land " . Copies of the " Treatise Against Blood - Metal " remained in libraries in Cormyr , Sembia and Waterdeep by 1370 DR , and possibly within the ruins of Myth Drannor . A copy could be found in the War Library of the Abbey of the Sword , a temple to Tempus in Battledale , around 1372 DR .

title: Treatise Historical of the Dragon Tyrants
description: Treatise Historical of the Dragon Tyrants The Treatise Historical of the Dragon Tyrants was an ancient text penned by Reverent Dreamer Rhistel Laelithar . It was recovered from the ruins of Myth Drannor in 1374 DR . The book discussed the history of the Time of Dragons , including the creation of the kobold , urd , and gnome races , and the origin of the deities Kurtulmak and Kuraulyek .
description_long: Treatise Historical of the Dragon Tyrants The Treatise Historical of the Dragon Tyrants was an ancient text penned by Reverent Dreamer Rhistel Laelithar . It was recovered from the ruins of Myth Drannor in 1374 DR . The book discussed the history of the Time of Dragons , including the creation of the kobold , urd , and gnome races , and the origin of the deities Kurtulmak and Kuraulyek .

title: Treaty of Garumn ' s Gorge
description: Treaty of Garumn ' s Gorge The Treaty of Garumn ' s Gorge was a treaty signed in 1372 DR by both Bruenor Battlehammer and Obould Many - Arrows . It ended the fierce war between the newly recovered dwarvern kingdom and the beginnings of the orc realm known as the Kingdom of Many - Arrows . As of 1409 the two kingdoms are still at peace , although Bruenor has expressed sincere regret on numerous occasions .
description_long: Treaty of Garumn ' s Gorge The Treaty of Garumn ' s Gorge was a treaty signed in 1372 DR by both Bruenor Battlehammer and Obould Many - Arrows . It ended the fierce war between the newly recovered dwarvern kingdom and the beginnings of the orc realm known as the Kingdom of Many - Arrows . As of 1409 the two kingdoms are still at peace , although Bruenor has expressed sincere regret on numerous occasions . The two Kings that originally signed the document have now passed away .

title: Trebbe
description: Trebbe Trebbe was an archwizard and one of the most prolific spell creators in Netheril . Abilities . He was a specialist in magic that protected arcanists , enabling spell duels to last much longer .
description_long: Trebbe Trebbe was an archwizard and one of the most prolific spell creators in Netheril . Abilities . He was a specialist in magic that protected arcanists , enabling spell duels to last much longer . History . Trebbe was born in - 2292 DR . He established Shadowtop Borough , a Netherese enclave for magical research in - 2267 DR . It was here he created the " Crown of Horns " , an evil artifact . Death . In - 2237 DR , a spellcasting accident triggered while Trebbe was working on the crown led to his death .

title: Tred McKnuckles
description: Tred McKnuckles Tred McKnuckles was a stout dwarf with a yellow beard . He wore a throwing hammer on the back of each shoulder . He was a skilled blacksmith and farrier , and was often called upon by King Emerus Warcrown to shoe horses .
description_long: Tred McKnuckles Tred McKnuckles was a stout dwarf with a yellow beard . He wore a throwing hammer on the back of each shoulder . He was a skilled blacksmith and farrier , and was often called upon by King Emerus Warcrown to shoe horses . Relatives . Tred had a brother called Duggan McKnuckles who was killed in 1370 DR . Equipment . Tred used a single - bladed axe with a point at its tip , and also a double - bladed axe . Background . During late winter 1370 DR , Tred was travelling to Shallows by caravan , with his brother Duggan , Nikwillig , Bokkum and Stokkum , when it was attacked by a band of orc s and boulder - hurling frost giant s . Tred was injured during this attack , and only he and Nikwillig survived . They stumbled across the hamlet of Clicking Heels where they were given food and healing , before continuing their journey , encountering Bruenor Battlehammer ' s caravan , and joining up with them .

title: Tree - Gem of Bloodstone
description: Tree - Gem of Bloodstone The Tree - Gem of Bloodstone was a 30 ft tall white tree with golden leaves growing in the courtyard of Palace Dragonsbane in Bloodstone Village . History . In 1359 DR , Gareth Dragonsbane and his companions traveled to the Abyss and stole the Wand of Orcus using advice from Saint Sollars .
description_long: Tree - Gem of Bloodstone The Tree - Gem of Bloodstone was a 30 ft tall white tree with golden leaves growing in the courtyard of Palace Dragonsbane in Bloodstone Village . History . In 1359 DR , Gareth Dragonsbane and his companions traveled to the Abyss and stole the Wand of Orcus using advice from Saint Sollars . The Platinum dragon Bahamut then directed them to the only method of its destruction , which was to immerse the wand in the black blood of the heart of an avatar of Tiamat . After they destroyed the wand , its heart was left behind in the form of a small white gem . Bahamut gave it to Gareth as a sign of his covenant with him to protect Damara from demon attacks . The gem was planted in the courtyard of Palace Dragonsbane in Bloodstone Village and grew into a tall white tree with golden leaves . The Tree - Gem brought renewed interest of non - dragons in the worship of Bahamut as a god . Powers . So long as the rulers of Bloodstone aligned with good , the Tree - Gem prevented demons from entering the Kingdom of Bloodstone . Occasionally , the Tree - Gem dropped a branch that could be fashioned into powerful weapons or magical items for those deemed worthy .

title: Tree Ghost Tribe
description: Tree Ghost Tribe The Tree Ghost Tribe were a Uthgardt barbarian band that seperated from the Blue Bear tribe in 1313 DR . History . In 1372 DR , the Tree Ghost ancestral mound was the Grandfather Tree .
description_long: Tree Ghost Tribe The Tree Ghost Tribe were a Uthgardt barbarian band that seperated from the Blue Bear tribe in 1313 DR . History . In 1372 DR , the Tree Ghost ancestral mound was the Grandfather Tree . Religion . They considered the Grandfather Tree sacred and maintained a camp nearby .

title: Tree of Souls
