description: Tree of Souls The Tree of Souls was a sapling planted on the newly formed Evermeet by the elven gods Angharradh and Corellon Larethian and given into the protection of the high mage Starleaf after the completion of the magic which created Evermeet in the First Sundering . History . The Tree of Souls remained in Evermeet and in the protection of the elves there but , after the failed conquest by Kymil Nimesin , the Queen , Amlaruil Moonflower , gave her son , Lamruil Moonflower , a bud of the tree .
description_long: Tree of Souls The Tree of Souls was a sapling planted on the newly formed Evermeet by the elven gods Angharradh and Corellon Larethian and given into the protection of the high mage Starleaf after the completion of the magic which created Evermeet in the First Sundering . History . The Tree of Souls remained in Evermeet and in the protection of the elves there but , after the failed conquest by Kymil Nimesin , the Queen , Amlaruil Moonflower , gave her son , Lamruil Moonflower , a bud of the tree . The Queen imparted to Lamruil that the time to plant the Tree on the mainland had come . Lamruil took the seed , and traveled to the most northern reaches of Faerûn , and there established the elven settlement of Auseriel . There he planted the tree , creating a haven for elves on the mainland . In 1373 DR , Auseriel was abandoned and Lamruil retreated with the Tree to Evermeet to prevent its destruction . The tree was returned to Queen Amlaruil for safe keeping . In 1377 DR , Amlaruil brought the Tree back to the mainland and presented it to Ilsevele Miritar , seventh Coronal of the recently recaptured Myth Drannor .

title: Tree python
description: Tree python Often mistaken for normal , non - magical , tree - hunting constrictor snakes , tree pythons are found native to the Serpent Hills . Physical description . The tree python is an intelligent creature , that lies patiently in wait for its prey safely tangled up on a branch from a tree .
description_long: Tree python Often mistaken for normal , non - magical , tree - hunting constrictor snakes , tree pythons are found native to the Serpent Hills . Physical description . The tree python is an intelligent creature , that lies patiently in wait for its prey safely tangled up on a branch from a tree . Its natural skin tone is a dull , greenish - brown , resembling the bark of a tree . Due to its chameleon like abilities it can alter its skin color to match its surrounding , making it hard to discern among the trees and leaves of its natural habitat . This magical snake can even shift its colours as it moves through the forest to stalk its unsuspecting prey . Combat . Learning from experiences , the tree python has developed a genuine hunting technique . It chooses isolated targets , usually the last creature in a group passing by beneath the tree the snake has coiled itself upon . Tree pythons are night creatures , therefore hunting by night making themselves almost invisible when blending in with the moonlit environment . They sleep by day , but can forego sleep for a long period of time to hunt down tirelessly prey and attack it when it dozes of to slumber .

title: Tree seat
description: Tree seat Tree seats were handy items used by ranger s and others who spent time travelling through the wilds of Faerûn . Uses . With a tree seat , a ranger could turn any sturdy tree into his own fortress or watchtower .
description_long: Tree seat Tree seats were handy items used by ranger s and others who spent time travelling through the wilds of Faerûn . Uses . With a tree seat , a ranger could turn any sturdy tree into his own fortress or watchtower . Using a tree seat almost always guaranteed that the user was not surprised by an enemy . These items were made from duskwood and had steel claws that never slipped . DISLCAIMER : Use of this item on treant s voided the manufacturer ' s warranty . Prices . A tree seat cost 15 gold piece s .

title: Tree shape
description: Tree shape Tree shape , also called just tree , was a transmutation or alteration spell that allowed the caster to take the form of a large tree or shrub for a few hours . Effects . When cast , the caster and all the caster ' s clothing and accouterments changed into a live tree or shrub , or a dead trunk with only a few dead limbs .
description_long: Tree shape Tree shape , also called just tree , was a transmutation or alteration spell that allowed the caster to take the form of a large tree or shrub for a few hours . Effects . When cast , the caster and all the caster ' s clothing and accouterments changed into a live tree or shrub , or a dead trunk with only a few dead limbs . While in tree form the caster could not move , but could see and hear all that took place in the immediate environment , just as if the caster were standing there normally . The transformation passed all mundane tests and the closest scrutiny , but " detect magic " registered faint transmutation magic . " Tree shape " could be dismissed instantly by the caster before the spell expired , with no recovery time or lingering detrimental effects . While in tree form , the transmutation version of this spell conferred additional natural armor to the caster and made it impossible for a single blow to do critical damage . Components . The newer version of " tree shape " required the use of the caster ' s holy symbol or divine focus as well as the usual verbal and somatic components . The older alteration version also required a twig from a tree .

title: Tree steed
description: Tree steed Tree steed was an alteration / enchantment spell that changed a piece of wood into a walking ( I won ' t say lumbering ) beast of burden . Effects . Any kind of wood could be used for a " tree steed " as long as it was at least 3 in ( 7 .
description_long: Tree steed Tree steed was an alteration / enchantment spell that changed a piece of wood into a walking ( I won ' t say lumbering ) beast of burden . Effects . Any kind of wood could be used for a " tree steed " as long as it was at least 3 in ( 7 . 6 cm ) thick , 1 ft ( 30 cm ) wide , and between 3 and 10 ft ( 0 . 91 and 3 m ) long . Upon casting this spell , the log or plank grew four wooden , horse - like legs and could be ridden or used to carry gear and equipment . The maximum load the " tree steed " could carry was 600 lb ( 272 kg ) before breaking . The " tree steed " would obey simple movement commands ( forward , stop , speed up , slow down , turn , etc . ) and could move at a normal human walking pace on land or paddle on water at half that rate . The caster had to stay within 10 yd ( 9 . 1 m ) of the " steed " or it would stop and wait for the caster to come back within range . The " tree steed " remained animated for one hour per experience level of the caster . If the " steed " broke for any reason , the enchantment ended . It would not fight or do anything other than follow movement commands within its limitations .

title: Tree stride
description: Tree stride Tree stride , also known as pass plant , was a conjuration or alteration spell that allowed the caster to enter a tree and then teleport to a distant tree of the same type , and repeat for the duration of the spell . Effects . This spell was an improvement on the " plant door " spell , allowing the caster to not only step inside a tree , but also jump to other similar trees within range .
description_long: Tree stride Tree stride , also known as pass plant , was a conjuration or alteration spell that allowed the caster to enter a tree and then teleport to a distant tree of the same type , and repeat for the duration of the spell . Effects . This spell was an improvement on the " plant door " spell , allowing the caster to not only step inside a tree , but also jump to other similar trees within range . Upon entering the first tree , the caster immediately knew the location of all other acceptable trees within the range of the spell . They had to be alive , of the same type ( oak , maple , pine , etc . ) , and big enough to contain the caster in all dimensions . The caster then had the choice of teleporting to one of the candidate trees , staying hidden inside the first tree , or stepping back out . If a jump was made , then the process could be repeated , from tree to tree , as many times as the caster had experience levels .

title: Trek bell
description: Trek bell A " Trek Bell " is a magical item of transportation . Description . A trek bell is an immense dull iron sphere , large enough to hold four or five people .
description_long: Trek bell A " Trek Bell " is a magical item of transportation . Description . A trek bell is an immense dull iron sphere , large enough to hold four or five people . Runes cover the outside of the sphere . The entire bottom is open and is called a moon well . Powers . A trek bell can protect those within from nearly any medium or environment . It can move through earth , stone and water .

title: Tremair
description: Tremair Tremair , also known as hexagonite or pink tremolite , was a very small but valuable fancy stone . Description . In raw ore , tremair was found as small , pink , clear to translucent crystals .
description_long: Tremair Tremair , also known as hexagonite or pink tremolite , was a very small but valuable fancy stone . Description . In raw ore , tremair was found as small , pink , clear to translucent crystals . These could be cut into even smaller faceted gems . In Waterdeep , Chessenta , and Sembia , these small gemstones were sewn or woven into gowns that debutantes wore at social occasions , signifying eligibility for marriage . A typical specimen had a base value of 100 gp . Powers . If worn next to the skin , tremair gems bestowed an immunity to magical curses on the wearer .

title: Tren Noemfor
description: Tren Noemfor Tren Noemfor was a fighter and the Zhent - appointed constable of Dagger Falls from 1353 DR until around 1368 DR . History . Tren was an ex - adventurer of Daggerdale whom the Zhentarim appointed as constable of Dagger Falls in order to maintain the facade of a free and legitimate government in the dale .
description_long: Tren Noemfor Tren Noemfor was a fighter and the Zhent - appointed constable of Dagger Falls from 1353 DR until around 1368 DR . History . Tren was an ex - adventurer of Daggerdale whom the Zhentarim appointed as constable of Dagger Falls in order to maintain the facade of a free and legitimate government in the dale . Tren was a cruel but not stupid governor of the city . He fought the Freedom Riders and all the partisans supporting Randal Morn but did not often authorize raids against innocent people not involved in the war . His downfall probably began in 1367 DR when the cleric of Cyric Eragyn resurrected Colderan Morn . In order to rule the dale himself , Colderan spread a magical illness that affected everyone , both Zhents and those loyal to Randal , in the same manner . Finally , an adventuring band resolved the situation but Tren ' s actions were not appreciated in Zhentil Keep . In 1368 DR , there was another constable in town , Guthbert Golthammer . Some rumors said that Tren was demoted and transferred to a far and isolated Zhent outpost .

title: Tren Saykatt
description: Tren Saykatt Tren Saykatt was the Cloakmaster of Murann for the Shadow Thieves around 1370 DR . Personality . The crime lord was totally devoted to the Shadow Thieves , whom she rightly saw as saving her from retaliation for the actions of her crazed goddess .
description_long: Tren Saykatt Tren Saykatt was the Cloakmaster of Murann for the Shadow Thieves around 1370 DR . Personality . The crime lord was totally devoted to the Shadow Thieves , whom she rightly saw as saving her from retaliation for the actions of her crazed goddess . She was afraid that if she remained in the sea for too long , then Umberlee would seize her . She did not care about the Cloakmasters of the other three districts of Murann . History . Tren joined the church of Umberlee but left when she discovered she could more wealthy without such a volatile mistress . However , the Bitch Queen curse d her : every day , she had to immerse herself in salt water or suffer an overall decline in physical and mental traits . Tren found sanctuary when she joined the Shadow Thieves , who protected her from enraged sailors after a vessel — supposedly protected by Umberlee and her priests — sank to the bottom of the sea . In 1370 DR , when Murann was besieged during the Sothillisian War , she and her underlings went into hiding .

title: Trent Oster
description: Trent Oster Trent Oster is one of the founders of BioWare and the founder of , a downloading service , and IdeaSpark Labs . Education and Career . Oster studied computer science at the University of Saskatchewan before co - founding Bioware in 1995 .
description_long: Trent Oster Trent Oster is one of the founders of BioWare and the founder of , a downloading service , and IdeaSpark Labs . Education and Career . Oster studied computer science at the University of Saskatchewan before co - founding Bioware in 1995 . He worked on the Baldur ' s Gate game and directed the production of Neverwinter Nights and its expansions He left BioWare in 2009 .

title: Trent Vendall
description: Trent Vendall Trent Vendall was a visitor of Neverwinter in the 1370s DR . History . Trent came from Cormyr and went to Neverwinter , despite bandits attacking the caravans .
description_long: Trent Vendall Trent Vendall was a visitor of Neverwinter in the 1370s DR . History . Trent came from Cormyr and went to Neverwinter , despite bandits attacking the caravans . He managed to arrive to Neverwinter . He offered Kalach - Cha some alcohol , if worked with the Watchman .

title: Trenton Bartlowes
description: Trenton Bartlowes Trenton Bartlowes was a businessmanin Skullport . History . Trenton was a rich man of Arabel that decided to settle in Skullport .
description_long: Trenton Bartlowes Trenton Bartlowes was a businessmanin Skullport . History . Trenton was a rich man of Arabel that decided to settle in Skullport . In 1370 DR he managed a gambling hall and also owned the nearest festhall , that recently was connected to the other building with a walkway .

title: Tresendar
description: Tresendar The Tresendar Family was a royal family that used to live in a manor in Phandalin before the orc raids of Uruth Ukrypt wiped out the town and laid waste to the settlement in 951 DR . The manor , along with the whole town was abandoned during that time . Most of the members of the Tresendar Family were buried in the crypt below the manor .
description_long: Tresendar The Tresendar Family was a royal family that used to live in a manor in Phandalin before the orc raids of Uruth Ukrypt wiped out the town and laid waste to the settlement in 951 DR . The manor , along with the whole town was abandoned during that time . Most of the members of the Tresendar Family were buried in the crypt below the manor . Sometime after the Spellplague , some members of the family had risen as undead defending the cellars of Tresendar Manor . Notable Members . One notable member of the Tresendar Family was Aldith Tresendar , who was also known as the " Black Hawk " . Sir Aldith was a great knight who died fighting the orcs of Uruth Ukrypt during their rampages on the town in 951 DR . The orcs found the hidden caverns under Tresendar Manor , and Sir Aldith fought them there . Aldith carried with him a magical blade in a silver - chased scabbard that was inscribed with the name " Talon " . The hilt of the blade was shaped into a majestic bird with its wings stretched out wide . Talon was lost in the caverns under the manor until a nothic found the blade .

title: Tresk Mulander
description: Tresk Mulander Tresk Mulander was a necromantic Red Wizard and a member of the Researcher faction who was imprisoned , brought to Mantol - Derith in the Underdark by Hadrogh Prohl , and sold to Xandra Shobalar in 1348 where he was kept by her in captivity in Menzoberranzan for two years . During his time in captivity , he learned a great deal about the magic of the Underdark . Appearance .
description_long: Tresk Mulander Tresk Mulander was a necromantic Red Wizard and a member of the Researcher faction who was imprisoned , brought to Mantol - Derith in the Underdark by Hadrogh Prohl , and sold to Xandra Shobalar in 1348 where he was kept by her in captivity in Menzoberranzan for two years . During his time in captivity , he learned a great deal about the magic of the Underdark . Appearance . Tresk was muscled , tall and had a sallow complexion . He had green eyes and a narrow nose . He was bald except for a long thick grey beard and has tattoos on his head that served as magical runes . He was sixty years old in 1348 Relatives . Tresk ' s father ' s father was from Rashemen . His mother was a Mulan . Background . Tresk came to be sold into slavery when he was betrayed by his apprentice . Tresk had also previously betrayed his master .

title: Trespin
description: Trespin Trespin was a four - armed troll , a demon - worshiper , and a member of the reformed Cult of the Dragon under Severin Silrajin . History . Trespin acted as one of the lead custodians of the Cult ' s hunting lodge in the Greypeak Mountains .
description_long: Trespin Trespin was a four - armed troll , a demon - worshiper , and a member of the reformed Cult of the Dragon under Severin Silrajin . History . Trespin acted as one of the lead custodians of the Cult ' s hunting lodge in the Greypeak Mountains . Personality . Trespin love hunting , whether animals or sentient beings . He liked to give the blood and bones of his prey to his ambush drake s and he loved to see the terror in the eyes of more intelligent prey . Trespin concerned himself only with combat and mayhem and believed that serving the Cult would provide him with more opportunities for combat and mayhem . He was also very devoted to Talis the White .

title: Tressym
description: Tressym A tressym was a magical beast resembling a small winged cat . They could be found across the warm and temperate lands of Faerûn , and were most common in northern Cormyr , particularly in the village of Eveningstar where they were seen as good luck charms and mascots and praised for keeping down rodents . They were also popular as familiars for good wizard s .
description_long: Tressym A tressym was a magical beast resembling a small winged cat . They could be found across the warm and temperate lands of Faerûn , and were most common in northern Cormyr , particularly in the village of Eveningstar where they were seen as good luck charms and mascots and praised for keeping down rodents . They were also popular as familiars for good wizard s . Description . A tressym resembled a small cat , roughly the size of a common housecat , and growing up to 2 feet ( 61 centimeters ) long from nose to tail . Their primary feature was of course their wings . Extending from their well - muscled shoulders , these wings were formed like a bat ' s , being divided into arc - segments by hollow elongated " finger " bones . However , the leathery membranes between these bones were covered in feathers . These wings had a maximum wingspan of 3 feet ( 0 . 9 meters ) . Tressym were fluffy and their coat varied in color and length as much as regular cats . The majority were short - haired , with black , gray , or tabby fur . Some tressym had owl - like faces with tufts of fur at the points of their ears .

title: Trett
description: Trett Trett was a merchant during the Tyranny of Dragons . History . Trett , during one of his travels in 1489 DR , acquired a necklace made from a blue dragon tooth .
description_long: Trett Trett was a merchant during the Tyranny of Dragons . History . Trett , during one of his travels in 1489 DR , acquired a necklace made from a blue dragon tooth . She decided to sell it to the Ironhanded , Phlan ' s Ironworkers ' Guild . He met Yanna Hammerbound , a high - ranking member of Ironhanded , at the Madame Freona ' s Tea Kettle for an exchange . However , a " lightning bolt " spell from inside the item hit Trett . The situation was resolved by adventurers hired by Buhrell Caah , who wanted the item in order to neutralize it . Trett presumably survived .

title: Triadic knight
description: Triadic knight Triadic Knight is a prestige class whose members worship the Triad , the union of Ilmater , Torm and Tyr . They believe that to fully embody the virtues of a paladin , they must draw on the strengths of all three of these deities . Through courage and perseverance , Triadic knights seek justice for all .
description_long: Triadic knight Triadic Knight is a prestige class whose members worship the Triad , the union of Ilmater , Torm and Tyr . They believe that to fully embody the virtues of a paladin , they must draw on the strengths of all three of these deities . Through courage and perseverance , Triadic knights seek justice for all . Triadic knights trace their history back to 729 DR , when the churches of the Triad united to engage in the Triad Crusade during the Fiend Wars of Impiltur . They are found throughout western and central Faerûn in churches and religious orders that embrace the worship of the three gods of the Triad . The largest concentrations of Triadic knights are found in Impiltur , in Tethyr , and in Calimshan , where they venerate Anachtyr in lieu of Tyr . Paladins , cleric / paladins , and clerics most commonly become Triadic knights , although many multiclass combinations including clerics and paladins are represented or have served in the past among the ranks of the Triad ' s holy warriors . Culture . Triadic knights are brave , persevering , and honorable at all times , embodying the traits of all three members of the Triad .

title: Tribe of the Elk ( Icewind Dale )
description: Tribe of the Elk ( Icewind Dale ) The Tribe of the Elk was a nomadic group of Reghedman barbarians living in the tundra that comprised Icewind Dale . History . After the Battle of Icewind Dale in 1351 DR , few tribe members were left , forcing women to scavenge for food on the tundra .
description_long: Tribe of the Elk ( Icewind Dale ) The Tribe of the Elk was a nomadic group of Reghedman barbarians living in the tundra that comprised Icewind Dale . History . After the Battle of Icewind Dale in 1351 DR , few tribe members were left , forcing women to scavenge for food on the tundra . Drizzt Do ' Urden occasionally left slain reindeer where the tribe could find them . Wulfgar assumed control of the tribes after being released form the servitude of Bruenor Battlehammer and extensive training by Drizzt . He convinced his tribe to join forces with the men of Ten - Towns against the army of Akar Kessel , wielder at the time of Crenshinibon . With the help of the barbarians they were successful . Thinking of what might be best for his people , he split the tribe into two groups . One remained in Icewind Dale , led by Revjak , the other followed him to the south where his adoptive father Bruenor Battlehammer had reclaimed his childhood home Mithral Hall . They lived in a town called Settlestone . Originally a Dwarven town they rebuilt it after two hundred years of its vacancy . They lived a prosperous life working as traders and merchants for the dwarves .

title: Triboar
description: Triboar Triboar is on the junction of the Long Road and Evermoor Way , due west of Yartar , its traditional rival . It is a large town with a population of around 2500 . Over the centuries it has been the assembly point for human armies in response to the orc hordes from the mountains in the north along the Surbrin .
description_long: Triboar Triboar is on the junction of the Long Road and Evermoor Way , due west of Yartar , its traditional rival . It is a large town with a population of around 2500 . Over the centuries it has been the assembly point for human armies in response to the orc hordes from the mountains in the north along the Surbrin . Its name is thought to reflect a traveler ' s tale of killing three boar s on the same day . The lord protector ' s banner consists of three black boars on a red background . Government . The town is ruled by a democratically elected lord protector . His or her task is to command the town ' s militia and to settle disputes . The town ' s legal system is called " The Lord ' s Decree " and the lord protector has the power to amend this system at will . The previous ruler , Faurael Blackhammer , was killed in 1369 DR fighting the Tanar ' ri forces from Hellgate Keep . Militia . The town operates a defense force called " The Twelve " which consists of this many mounted patrols that rotate in a tenday cycle . If necessary , the town can rally together a well - armed militia of fifty rapidly and three hundred in a day . Goods and services .

title: Triboar Trail ( region )
description: Triboar Trail ( region ) The Triboar Trail was a stretch of foothills and rolling , sparsely wooded plains extending between the Sword Mountains to the south and the Neverwinter Wood s to the north . The area got its name from the trail of the same name . The Triboar Trail was also sometimes referred to as the Triboar Cutoff or named after the town of Conyberry as the Cony Gap .
description_long: Triboar Trail ( region ) The Triboar Trail was a stretch of foothills and rolling , sparsely wooded plains extending between the Sword Mountains to the south and the Neverwinter Wood s to the north . The area got its name from the trail of the same name . The Triboar Trail was also sometimes referred to as the Triboar Cutoff or named after the town of Conyberry as the Cony Gap .

title: Triceratops
description: Triceratops A triceratops ( ytepka in the Chultan language ) was a gargantuan , herbivorous , herd dinosaur . Description . These massive dinosaurs had a bony plate on their six - foot - long skull for defense , with two long horns on the top and a shorter horn at the nose .
description_long: Triceratops A triceratops ( ytepka in the Chultan language ) was a gargantuan , herbivorous , herd dinosaur . Description . These massive dinosaurs had a bony plate on their six - foot - long skull for defense , with two long horns on the top and a shorter horn at the nose . Their bodies extended for about 25 feet ( 7 . 6 kilometers ) , and they weighed around ten tons ( nine metric tons ) . Behavior . Triceratops had especially short tempers for herbivores , and would charge , trample , and skewer any creature invading their territory . When defending their young , they were intelligent enough to form a circle around them , horns facing outwards . Combat . A triceratops could trample creatures smaller than it ; it would gore anything else . Reputation . In Chult , where these dinosaurs were common , there was a secret society , the Triceratops Society , named after them , known for leaving iron triceratops figurines as signs of warning .

title: Triceratops Society
description: Triceratops Society The Triceratops Society ( or Ytepka , Chultan for " triceratops " ) was a secret society dedicated to the protection of Chult from foreigners . Organization . There were 99 degrees of membership in the society .
description_long: Triceratops Society The Triceratops Society ( or Ytepka , Chultan for " triceratops " ) was a secret society dedicated to the protection of Chult from foreigners . Organization . There were 99 degrees of membership in the society . The oldest Tabaxi were of the highest degree and led the group . It was rumored that one of the " bara e " headed the society , but there was no evidence to support this claim . Activities . The " Ytepka " carefully monitored all happenings in Chult . Their task was to ensure that the natural and social order of Chult was not upset . If the Society noticed a potential problem , they would leave an iron triceratops figurine at the home or abode of the individual about to commit the wrong . If the marked person ignored the symbolic warning , the Triceratops Society would take punitive action . This punishment was most often a fine of some sort , but physical punishment or even death might also be enacted if the crime were severe enough . Members . The group consisted mainly of warriors . Two or three members were likely to be found in every port and village around the country , and they maintained an efficient communication network with each other .

title: Trickery domain
description: Trickery domain The Trickery domain was a suite of spells that were granted by deities whose portfolios included pranks , deception , and larceny . Priests who worshiped one of these deities could choose which aspects of their god or goddess they wished to focus on , and if they chose this domain , their repertoire of spells was expanded to include the ones listed below . Trickery Domain Spells .
description_long: Trickery domain The Trickery domain was a suite of spells that were granted by deities whose portfolios included pranks , deception , and larceny . Priests who worshiped one of these deities could choose which aspects of their god or goddess they wished to focus on , and if they chose this domain , their repertoire of spells was expanded to include the ones listed below . Trickery Domain Spells . During the latter part of the Era of Upheaval , priests who chose this domain had access to the following spells as they advanced in level . After the Second Sundering , clerics who chose this domain were granted free access to these spells ( they could cast them at any time without having to prepare them in advance ) .

title: Trident
description: Trident A trident was a three - pronged martial piercing weapon . Usage . A trident could be thrown , but it was not as well - balanced as a spear .
description_long: Trident A trident was a three - pronged martial piercing weapon . Usage . A trident could be thrown , but it was not as well - balanced as a spear . It also was effective in defending against charges . Reputation . The trident was often associated with the ocean . It was commonly used by undersea races such as sahuagin It was the favored weapon of the ocean deities Umberlee , Deep Sashelas , Persana , and Sekolah . Notable Owners . Thessaloni Canos , tharchion of Aloar in Thay , wielded a trident . A trident was the preferred weapon of the drow weapon master Uthegentel Del ' Armgo .

title: Triel
description: Triel Triel was a small village in the Fields of the Dead located at the intersection of the Trade Way and the Dusk Road , south of Boareskyr Bridge . The city of Elturel was located to the southeast and the Trielta Hills were located to the northeast . The original ruler of Triel was Elvar the Grainlord .
description_long: Triel Triel was a small village in the Fields of the Dead located at the intersection of the Trade Way and the Dusk Road , south of Boareskyr Bridge . The city of Elturel was located to the southeast and the Trielta Hills were located to the northeast . The original ruler of Triel was Elvar the Grainlord . However , by 1479 DR , Triel was part of Elturgard . Defense . Triel had a log - and - boulder stockade and locked its gates at night . Most travelers were unwelcome after dark . Imports . Triel had few farms in the area and had to import everything it needed , especially food . Much of the room behind the stockade was used to store grain and dry vegetables for the winter months when merchant visits were few and far between .

title: Triel Baenre
description: Triel Baenre Triel Baenre was a drow priestess and the matron mother of House Baenre , first house of Menzoberranzan until 1383 DR . As the matron mother of the first house , Triel was the most influential drow in the city , and as such could be seen as the unofficial leader of Menzoberranzan ; however , due to the nature of the drow , no other matron mother would ever willingly accept her dominance publicly - - they were a far too envious and power hungry of a race to concede power to a single figurehead . As a powerful matron mother , Triel was addressed by a number of titles .
description_long: Triel Baenre Triel Baenre was a drow priestess and the matron mother of House Baenre , first house of Menzoberranzan until 1383 DR . As the matron mother of the first house , Triel was the most influential drow in the city , and as such could be seen as the unofficial leader of Menzoberranzan ; however , due to the nature of the drow , no other matron mother would ever willingly accept her dominance publicly - - they were a far too envious and power hungry of a race to concede power to a single figurehead . As a powerful matron mother , Triel was addressed by a number of titles . Some of them were " Exalted Mother " and " Sacred Mother . " Description . Triel was less than 5 feet tall , short - - even by drow standards - - but broad and strong . She was not particularly attractive compared to many other drow elves , either , but made up for this with her ferocity and ambition ( which are often seen as attractive traits in drow society ) . She typically wore her white hair braided in a crown around her head . Triel often wore a tunic with five black spiders embroiled in silver to proclaim her rank . Personality .

title: Trielta Hills
description: Trielta Hills The Trielta Hills lay to the north - east of Triel and north - west of Hardbuckler in the Western Heartlands . They were home to many communities of gnome s and a few halfling s . Periodically , miners found silver and gold deposits in the hills .
description_long: Trielta Hills The Trielta Hills lay to the north - east of Triel and north - west of Hardbuckler in the Western Heartlands . They were home to many communities of gnome s and a few halfling s . Periodically , miners found silver and gold deposits in the hills . This led to inevitable small gold rushes , but the strikes didn ' t last long . Rumors . There were no rumors of lost kingdoms , wizards towers , ruined holds or any such thing about the Trielta Hills , making them almost unique for their normality .

title: Trifin Creek
description: Trifin Creek Trifin Creek was a swiftly flowing small river with steep banks . Its source was near the Snakewood , and it flowed mainly southward until it merged with the River Rimril and then joined the Amstel River past Eshpurta . There were a few places where the current slowed enough to allow fishing .
description_long: Trifin Creek Trifin Creek was a swiftly flowing small river with steep banks . Its source was near the Snakewood , and it flowed mainly southward until it merged with the River Rimril and then joined the Amstel River past Eshpurta . There were a few places where the current slowed enough to allow fishing .

title: Trill
description: Trill Trill was the pet wyvern of Mattias Farseer . Mattias found Trill as a fledgling after he had killed her mother . He adopted the little wyvern and the two travelled together for many years .
description_long: Trill Trill was the pet wyvern of Mattias Farseer . Mattias found Trill as a fledgling after he had killed her mother . He adopted the little wyvern and the two travelled together for many years . They found that due to Trill ' s nature as a wyvern , they had to continually move farther south , away from the more settled regions of northern Faerûn . Mattias and Trill joined Corvus Nightfeather ' s Circus of Wonders and were a featured act . Trill died in 1479 DR at the side of his master , fighting together against a demon in the Plain of Stone Spiders . Trill was well behaved for a wyvern and didn ' t attack humans or other creatures without provocation .

title: Trillimac
description: Trillimac Trillimac was a fungus that grew in the Underdark . Description . Trillimac stalks reached a height of 4 – 5 ft ( 1 .
description_long: Trillimac Trillimac was a fungus that grew in the Underdark . Description . Trillimac stalks reached a height of 4 – 5 ft ( 1 . 2 – 1 . 5 m ) and were a light gray color capped with a wide , flat gray - green hood . Uses . The stems of the trillimac made a bread - like food once they were cleaned off , soaked in water for one hour , and then allowed to dry . A single stalk prepared this way yielded about 7 to 10 pounds ( 2 . 3 to 4 . 5 kilograms ) of food . The cap had a leathery texture that held inks and dyes well . After it was cut and cleaned , the cap of a trillimac could be used to make a map or a scroll . It was also just tough and flexible enough to be made into a hat , but was not appropriate for things that would suffer wear and tear .

title: Trimia ' s catalogue of Outer Plane artifacts
description: Trimia ' s catalogue of Outer Plane artifacts Trimia ' s catalogue of Outer Plane artifacts is an unmarked large book bound in heavy wood . The title of the book and a list of contents can be found on the first page . Operation .
description_long: Trimia ' s catalogue of Outer Plane artifacts Trimia ' s catalogue of Outer Plane artifacts is an unmarked large book bound in heavy wood . The title of the book and a list of contents can be found on the first page . Operation . On selecting a page , there is a 25 % chance it will be blank or 75 % chance it will describe a magical device which can provide a way of getting to the appropriate Outer Plane , along with a price from 1 , 000 to 20 , 000 gp . In order to manifest the device in question , the coin must be laid upon the open book page and have a " vanish " spell cast upon it . The device ' s command word is the name of the plane of its destination , and it will transport users to a different location on the destination plane each time it is used . The device can be used up to once per day , and offers the user a return journey from the destination plane to the point of origin on the Prime Material Plane . Each time the device is used , there is a 5 % chance it will disappear once it has finished transporting its users to the destination plane .

title: Trio Nefarious
description: Trio Nefarious The Trio Nefarious or Khov ' Anilessa in elven , were three greater Nycaloth s summoned by the netherese archwizard Aldlas Sodhese who had heard that the Nether Scrolls lay somewhere in Cormanthor . His plan was to use the Yugoloths to wreak havoc among the elves as a distraction while searching for the scrolls . History .
description_long: Trio Nefarious The Trio Nefarious or Khov ' Anilessa in elven , were three greater Nycaloth s summoned by the netherese archwizard Aldlas Sodhese who had heard that the Nether Scrolls lay somewhere in Cormanthor . His plan was to use the Yugoloths to wreak havoc among the elves as a distraction while searching for the scrolls . History . Aulmpiter was a master strategist , Malimshaer a stealthy warrior and Gaulguth a terrible berserker . While in the Blood Rift , they all served under the fallen Solar Malkizid but the trio would argue and compete against each other almost constantly . Conversely , in destroying the Elven villages they were single - minded and , under the direction of Aulmpiter , wiped out whole tribes of satyrs and centaurs and at least two green dragon s . Aldlas believed that he had complete control over all three of them , though he was actually being manipulated into that belief by Aulmpiter . The four together were unstoppable until they came within a few hundred yards of Cormanthyr where the Elves had arrayed an organized army .

title: Trip
description: Trip Trip was an enchantment spell that caused an object placed on the ground to rise up and attempt to make anyone crossing over it stumble and fall . Effects . Typically a long , thin object like a rope , vine , rod , stick , board , or staff was the target of this spell .
description_long: Trip Trip was an enchantment spell that caused an object placed on the ground to rise up and attempt to make anyone crossing over it stumble and fall . Effects . Typically a long , thin object like a rope , vine , rod , stick , board , or staff was the target of this spell . When laid on the ground or floor , for the duration of the spell , the object would float upward at the opportune moment to trip anyone trying to walk or run across it . The victim of this prank had a chance to resist the magic of this spell , and once aware of its presence the chance of avoiding it rose significantly . The trap was difficult to detect without magical assistance . Common sense guidelines : falling while running caused more damage than while walking , and falling on stone hurt more than falling on turf . A tripped victim was likely stunned for a short while . This spell was ignored by huge creatures and did not function under water . Components . Verbal and somatic components were used to cast this spell on an object that was suitable for making a trip trap .

title: Triple Legion
description: Triple Legion The Triple Legion was a mercenary organization within the Sevenfold Mazework of the Great Dismal Delve . Organization . The Triple Legion was made - up of 800 xorn mercenaries .
description_long: Triple Legion The Triple Legion was a mercenary organization within the Sevenfold Mazework of the Great Dismal Delve . Organization . The Triple Legion was made - up of 800 xorn mercenaries . Activities . This mercenary group was used by the dao for scouting and spy missions . They were well - paid but not trusted . The dao kept them far from the palace of the Great Khan . Base of Operations . The Sevenfold Mazework within the Great Dismal Delve served as base of all dao military organizations .

title: Trishina
description: Trishina Trishina was the goddess of the dolphins and consort of Deep Sashelas . She was the reason why aquatic elves had such a bond with dolphins . Her clergy were pacifists but devoted themselves utterly to protecting the young of any race they encountered and saving as many lives as they could .
description_long: Trishina Trishina was the goddess of the dolphins and consort of Deep Sashelas . She was the reason why aquatic elves had such a bond with dolphins . Her clergy were pacifists but devoted themselves utterly to protecting the young of any race they encountered and saving as many lives as they could . She was seen by many as the mother goddess of the Shalarin , who , when compared to most humanoid depictions of her , looked remarkably similar to a Shalarin . Since the shalarin were a transplanted culture , they adopted her as their main deity , naming her as Ri ' da ' trisha .

title: Tristan Kendrick
description: Tristan Kendrick Tristan Kendrick was a member of the Kendrick family and the prince of Corwell . Description . Tristan was a dashing man with a thick beard and dark brown hair .
description_long: Tristan Kendrick Tristan Kendrick was a member of the Kendrick family and the prince of Corwell . Description . Tristan was a dashing man with a thick beard and dark brown hair . Possessions . In public , Tristan wore a heavy wool over his leather and dark leather boots . For protection , Tristan carried a large hunting knife . While on a mission to rescue Keren Donnell , he accidentaly found the Sword of Cymrych Hugh hidden in a treasure chamber within a Firbolg stronghold . Keren recognized it for what it was and told Tristan that the weapon had chosen him to be the wielder . Relationships . The halfling Pawldo was a long time friend and sold Tristan his moorhound , Canthus . He married the druid Robyn who was one of his companions during the conflict and they resided in Caer Callidyrr with their daughters ( one of which was Alicia Kendrick ) . History . Tristan was born a prince in 1328 DR to King Bryon Kendrick and his wife . He was instrumental in stopping the evil forces from taking over the ffolk ' s parts of the Moonshae Isles during the conflict known as the Darkwalker War .

title: Tristopher Chettlebell
description: Tristopher Chettlebell Tristopher Chettlebell was a historian of Neverwinter in around 1480 DR . History . As a sage , Tristopher tried to record the history of Neverwinter .
description_long: Tristopher Chettlebell Tristopher Chettlebell was a historian of Neverwinter in around 1480 DR . History . As a sage , Tristopher tried to record the history of Neverwinter . He became obsessed with reconstructing the story of the dracolich Azharzel buried somewhere in the city , and recruited an adventurer to help his research .

title: Triton
description: Triton Tritons originate from the Elemental Plane of Water , but have migrated to the Material Plane for some unknown purpose . They are sea dwellers , preferring warm waters but able to tolerate colder depths . Physical description .
description_long: Triton Tritons originate from the Elemental Plane of Water , but have migrated to the Material Plane for some unknown purpose . They are sea dwellers , preferring warm waters but able to tolerate colder depths . Physical description . A triton is about the same size and weight as a human and has silvery skin that fades into silver - blue scales on the lower half of its body . A triton ' s hair is deep blue or blue - green . Society . Tritons form communities , either in great undersea castles built of rock , coral and other natural materials or in finely - sculpted caverns . A hunter - gatherer people , tritons take from the sea ' s vast bounty only what they need to survive . Tritons had good relations with giant sea horse s , hippocampi , and sea lion s , such that these creatures would hark to a summons by the sounding of a conch shell horn . Relations with other races . They are naturally suspicious of surface dwellers and prefer not to deal with them if possible .

title: Triumvirate
description: Triumvirate The Triumvirate were a group of three phaerimm who managed to escape Anauroch through a breach in the Sharn Wall . They conquered the beholder city of Ooltul in the Northdark . Activities .
description_long: Triumvirate The Triumvirate were a group of three phaerimm who managed to escape Anauroch through a breach in the Sharn Wall . They conquered the beholder city of Ooltul in the Northdark . Activities . In their continuing war against the beholders , the Triumvirate learned from the still - trapped phaerimm their ancient methods for creating a beholderkin known as a gouger . They also created miniature , mutated beholderkin known as eyeball s . However , the Triumvirate allowed their mutant creatures to stray out and across the Underdark . By 1372 DR , they plotted to release the other phaerimm still trapped in Anauroch .

title: Trobriand
description: Trobriand Trobriand was a wizard and former student of Halaster who lived in Undermountain . He specialized in magical metal creations , and whenever one of his creations failed , he used " Trobriand ' s wand of rejection " to send it to Trobriand ' s Graveyard . He thought of his creations as being superior to other creatures .
description_long: Trobriand Trobriand was a wizard and former student of Halaster who lived in Undermountain . He specialized in magical metal creations , and whenever one of his creations failed , he used " Trobriand ' s wand of rejection " to send it to Trobriand ' s Graveyard . He thought of his creations as being superior to other creatures . Graveyard . Trobriand was most renowned for Trobriand ' s Graveyard , which was an area of Undermountain he originally used to discard his broken or failed creations . He noticed that some of the creations he had discarded showed signs of activity , and began to monitor them . They eventually created a society of their own , and Trobriand was careful to provide them with everything they needed to survive . Description . Trobriand was tall and very thin . He had long grey hair and was clean - shaven . He appeared to be frail but despite this , his magic kept his physical condition good . History . Trobriand was an ex - student of Halaster Blackcloak . Although he was a powerful mage in his own right , Trobiand did not pose a threat to Halaster himself .

title: Trobriand ' s Graveyard
description: Trobriand ' s Graveyard Trobriand ' s Graveyard was an area of Undermountain used as a scrap heap by the mage Trobriand . History . Each time he needed to dispose of a failed creation , Trobriand used his " wand of rejecting " to send it to the graveyard .
description_long: Trobriand ' s Graveyard Trobriand ' s Graveyard was an area of Undermountain used as a scrap heap by the mage Trobriand . History . Each time he needed to dispose of a failed creation , Trobriand used his " wand of rejecting " to send it to the graveyard . He assumed that everything sent there was inactive , but later discovered that this was not the case , and became fascinated with the interactions between his failed creations . He then set about supplying the mechanical inhabitants of the graveyard with what they needed , and experimenting with their reactions . The name " Trobriand ' s Graveyard " was coined by Halaster , Trobriand ' s ex - master , after he showed it to him . As of 1368 DR , it was led by a scaladar known as Squch and populated with ten silversann s , twelve thanatar s , and up to thirty ferragan s , as well as many more generic mechanical creatures . Entrance . The entrance to the graveyard was a gate that appears like a will - o ' - wisp . It traveled Faerûn autonomously , although it was more likely to appear in areas where there had been recent heavy magic use or where there were large collections of magical items .

title: Troglodyte
description: Troglodyte Troglodytes were reptilian humanoids , shorter than a human , with spindly but muscular arms and squat legs . They also had long , slender tails . The stench of an angry or frightened troglodyte was so foul that it sickened all living creatures nearby , even after the troglodyte died .
description_long: Troglodyte Troglodytes were reptilian humanoids , shorter than a human , with spindly but muscular arms and squat legs . They also had long , slender tails . The stench of an angry or frightened troglodyte was so foul that it sickened all living creatures nearby , even after the troglodyte died . History . Troglodytes were created by the sarrukh of Mhairshaulk . Religion . The god of the troglodytes was Laogzed .

title: Troken ' ther Vandree
description: Troken ' ther Vandree Troken ' ther Vandree was the matron mother of House Vandree in Menzoberranzan around 1358 DR . Personality . The drow elf matron was known for being inefficient in challenging other houses , such as House Barrison Del ' Armgo .
description_long: Troken ' ther Vandree Troken ' ther Vandree was the matron mother of House Vandree in Menzoberranzan around 1358 DR . Personality . The drow elf matron was known for being inefficient in challenging other houses , such as House Barrison Del ' Armgo . History . Troken ' ther was killed by her daughter Fiirnel ' ther Vandree in 1388 DR .

title: Troll
description: Troll Trolls are massive , predatory species of giant - kin , they are considered " stupid bastards " by other species of giants except for ogre s , who are treated the same way . The most distinctive feature of trolls is their ability to regenerate . If any part of a troll ' s body is cut off , it will grow back after a while and the felled limb has a chance to evolve into an entirely new troll .
description_long: Troll Trolls are massive , predatory species of giant - kin , they are considered " stupid bastards " by other species of giants except for ogre s , who are treated the same way . The most distinctive feature of trolls is their ability to regenerate . If any part of a troll ' s body is cut off , it will grow back after a while and the felled limb has a chance to evolve into an entirely new troll . The only things that can stop this are fire and acid , both of which trolls fear greatly . Physical description . The average troll stands 9 ft ( 2 . 7 m ) high and weighs roughly 500 lbs ( 227 kg ) , though females tend to be a bit larger than males . The hide of trolls is rubbery , and usually either moss green , putrid gray , or mottled gray and green . Their coarse hair is typically iron gray , or greenish - black . Trolls initially seem to be somewhat shorter , due to their sagging shoulders and tendency to hunch forward . They walk with an uneven gait , and their arms dangle and drag the ground when running . Despite this apparent awkwardness , trolls are quite agile . Ecology . Trolls are most often found in cold , mountainous regions , but can be encountered nearly anywhere .

title: Troll Hills
description: Troll Hills The Troll Hills are a series of hills found along the coastal area of the Western Heartlands . . Features .
description_long: Troll Hills The Troll Hills are a series of hills found along the coastal area of the Western Heartlands . . Features . Live oak trees predominate the area and the rounded peaks are topped with thick patches of razorgrass . Inhabitants . Trolls are found in numbers here . . Several competing troll kingdoms can be found here .

title: Troll Mountains ( Amn )
description: Troll Mountains ( Amn ) The Troll Mountains were a range of low mountains in Amn , so named for the rather intelligent troll s that inhabited their peaks . They were considered the " gateway to the northeast " . Geography .
description_long: Troll Mountains ( Amn ) The Troll Mountains were a range of low mountains in Amn , so named for the rather intelligent troll s that inhabited their peaks . They were considered the " gateway to the northeast " . Geography . The Troll Mountains formed part of the northern border of Amn , along with the Cloud Peaks to the west . Between the Troll Mountains and Snowflake and Giant ' s Run Mountains farther to the east lay great open plains . The average peak height within the range was about 11 , 000 feet ( 3 , 400 meters ) above sea level . They were less humid than the Cloud Peaks and were only covered with snow during the winter months . One of the rivers composing the Esmelflow ran down from the Troll Mountains , and the Khalleshyr river began here as well . The mountains were notable for their large deposits of gem s , nickel , and iron . History . Centuries before human s settled the lands of Amn , the Troll Mountains were home to an actual civilization of trolls . The humans eventually slaughtered the trolls nearly to extinction , but they were unsuccessful in wiping them out entirely .

title: Troll Mountains ( the Vast )
description: Troll Mountains ( the Vast ) The Troll Mountains , also called the Trollcrag Mountains , was a small mountain range in the Vast in north Faerûn , running north of the River Vesper from the Dragon Reach in the west to the Earthspur Mountains in the east . Geographical features . The Troll Mountains were an arm of the greater Earthspur Mountains .
description_long: Troll Mountains ( the Vast ) The Troll Mountains , also called the Trollcrag Mountains , was a small mountain range in the Vast in north Faerûn , running north of the River Vesper from the Dragon Reach in the west to the Earthspur Mountains in the east . Geographical features . The Troll Mountains were an arm of the greater Earthspur Mountains . They held two major passes , Viperstongue and Three Trees Pass . Viperstongue in the east was a low saddle valley through which ran the Cross Road . In the west , Three Trees Pass was a long cleft between the Troll Mountains and the Earthspur or Giantspike Mountains , along which the North Road ran . The mountains were riddled with old dwarven mine tunnels . Inhabitants . As the name said , trolls once hunted the slopes and valleys of the range , but they were nearly wiped out by the dwarves , leaving few trolls by 1370 DR . The dwarves made their homes in mines in high mountains by Three Trees Pass . History . The dwarven mines of the Troll Mountains were at one time rich in iron and copper , but these were thoroughly worked out by 1370 DR , producing very little of metal . The disused passages were overrun by monsters .

title: Trollblood ioun stone
description: Trollblood ioun stone The Trollblood ioun stone was a unique " ioun stone " giving martial prowess against troll s and the ability to regenerate wounds . Description . The stone was a gleaming dark green , resembling a sphere of hardened troll blood , bearing deep cracks .
description_long: Trollblood ioun stone The Trollblood ioun stone was a unique " ioun stone " giving martial prowess against troll s and the ability to regenerate wounds . Description . The stone was a gleaming dark green , resembling a sphere of hardened troll blood , bearing deep cracks . Powers . When attuned , the " Trollblood ioun stone " granted its bearer great skill in slaying trolls in combat and conferred a weaker form of a troll ' s ability to regenerate wounds . History . According to legend , seven trolls had once been captured and , over seven nights , used in experiments in magic . From the blood of each of the seven trolls , the " Trollblood ioun stone " was created . The stone came into the possession of the vampire Tsolak . When in the forest by the Coast Way on the Sword Coast in 1368 DR , Tsolak would give the stone in reward to any who killed the vampire hunters Ikros and Isabella .

title: Trollbridge
description: Trollbridge Trollbridge was a small village near the High Forest . North of it lay the Evermoor Way and the Dessarin with the Dead Horse Ford . Less than two days ' march from it lay the Drygully Tunnel , an entrance to the Underdark .
description_long: Trollbridge Trollbridge was a small village near the High Forest . North of it lay the Evermoor Way and the Dessarin with the Dead Horse Ford . Less than two days ' march from it lay the Drygully Tunnel , an entrance to the Underdark . Through this raiding parties of drow came to the World Above to threaten the inhabitants of the small village . Structure . A wooden palisade surrounded the village to protect it from raiders . History . In 1361 DR , Fyodor and Liriel Baenre passed through the village to obtain supplies after emerging from the Underdark . In the same year , the village was said to have been attacked by a drow female who had ensorcelled a swordsman . If the story was true , it may have been Quenthel Baenre in her pursuit of Liriel Baenre . Notable locations . The only inn of Trollbridge was the Steaming Kettle , run by Saida in 1361 DR . The inn itself resembled a barn with stone walls and narrow windows . The inn served meals of dark ale and steamed grain porridge .

title: Trollclaw Ford
description: Trollclaw Ford The Trollclaw Ford is ruined hamlet located on the Winding Water , and is part of the Coast Way , connecting Baldur ' s Gate to Waterdeep . It would appear to be named after the Troll Claw , a group of hills to the immediate east of the ford .
description_long: Trollclaw Ford The Trollclaw Ford is ruined hamlet located on the Winding Water , and is part of the Coast Way , connecting Baldur ' s Gate to Waterdeep . It would appear to be named after the Troll Claw , a group of hills to the immediate east of the ford .

title: Trollstooth Run
description: Trollstooth Run Trollstooth Run was one of the watercourses of the Esmelflow in Amn . Description . This stream was named for the large amount of teeth and bones from troll s and other creatures that are found within its waters , resulting from many battles that took place in the area .
description_long: Trollstooth Run Trollstooth Run was one of the watercourses of the Esmelflow in Amn . Description . This stream was named for the large amount of teeth and bones from troll s and other creatures that are found within its waters , resulting from many battles that took place in the area . These sharp teeth and bones make the stream dangerous for wading in without footwear . Geography . This creek began in the Qadim Hills and served as the eastern branch of upper river Khalleshyr .

title: Trolltide
description: Trolltide Trolltide was a lesser Waterdhavian feast day celebrated mostly by children at the start of Kythorn . It commemorated the end of the Second Trollwar . Children ran through the city acting like troll s , banging on doors and growling , from highsun till dusk .
description_long: Trolltide Trolltide was a lesser Waterdhavian feast day celebrated mostly by children at the start of Kythorn . It commemorated the end of the Second Trollwar . Children ran through the city acting like troll s , banging on doors and growling , from highsun till dusk . Home and shop owners were expected to give the children candy , fruits , or small items . If no treat was given , it was highly likely that they would be the target of a trick at sundown .

title: Trollwars
description: Trollwars The Trollwars were two wars fought between the human s of Waterdeep and the troll s of the nearby Trollmoors . First Trollwar . The First Trollwar occurred in 932 DR , when a large population of trolls had been displaced from the Sword Mountains by orc s after they were united under the Brotherhood of the Scarlet Scourge .
description_long: Trollwars The Trollwars were two wars fought between the human s of Waterdeep and the troll s of the nearby Trollmoors . First Trollwar . The First Trollwar occurred in 932 DR , when a large population of trolls had been displaced from the Sword Mountains by orc s after they were united under the Brotherhood of the Scarlet Scourge . The trolls attacked the city that would become known as Waterdeep and were met with retaliation by forces led by Nimoar the Reaver . The retaliatory forces burned large parts of the Evermoors , purging it of all trolls . Second Trollwar . The Second Trollwar began in 940 DR and lasted until 952 DR . It was fought between the human s of Waterdeep , allied with cities of the North , and the troll s of the Evermoors . First , the Waterdhavian defenders drove the trolls back from their walls . The human realms then united under Aeroth , War Captain of Silverymoon ; Ahghairon of Waterdeep ; and Samular Caradoon of Tyr , and together they eradicated trolls across the Evermoors . Ahghairon the mage used his magical prowess to turn the war against the trolls . Third assault .

title: Trommen
description: Trommen Trommen was an ex - adventurer in Daggerford around 1370 DR . History . Although extremely lazy , Trommen was an adventurer with 32 years of adventuring experience .
description_long: Trommen Trommen was an ex - adventurer in Daggerford around 1370 DR . History . Although extremely lazy , Trommen was an adventurer with 32 years of adventuring experience . His life included a collection of interesting experiences , including studying for five years the priesthood of the lizardfolk in Silverymoon , serving as the mayor of a tiny hamlet in the Neverwinter Wood for three years , and being imprisoned by the drow for fifteen years with two of his companions . In 1370 , with the treasures recovered from the drow , all Trommen wanted was to live in peace .

title: Trout
description: Trout The trout was a common fish of Faerûn . Species . Szorp .
description_long: Trout The trout was a common fish of Faerûn . Species . Szorp . Szorp were a troutlike fish found in the Delimbiyr . Usually brown in color , their white flesh was very tasty and was a favored delicacy in the more opulent taverns of Waterdeep . Knucklehead . The knucklehead trout was a fish unique to Icewind Dale ' s three lakes . Its ivory was the only real export of the region and was in great demand by the rich over the length and breadth of Faerûn . The ivory itself isn ' t what was most important because in skilled hands it could be carved into magnificent sculptures . The craft , called scrimshaw , was widely in practice in the valleys of the region . The main exporters of the craft were : Notable scrimshanders included Regis .

title: Troy Denning
description: Troy Denning Troy Denning ( b . 1958 ) is a fantasy and science fiction author of the New York Times bestselling novel Waterdeep ( 1989 ) , which he wrote with Scott Ciencin under the pseudonym Richard Awlinson . Other notable works are " Dragonwall " , " Pages of Pain " , and " The Parched Sea " .
description_long: Troy Denning Troy Denning ( b . 1958 ) is a fantasy and science fiction author of the New York Times bestselling novel Waterdeep ( 1989 ) , which he wrote with Scott Ciencin under the pseudonym Richard Awlinson . Other notable works are " Dragonwall " , " Pages of Pain " , and " The Parched Sea " . He is also known for his work on the epilogue to the Avatar trilogy , " " . A former editor and game designer , one of his more notable games is the AD & D game Dark Sun , which he also wrote about in the Prism Pentad , a series of five novels . He is also the author of a number of Star Wars Legends novels . He enjoys outdoor activities , practices martial arts , and currently lives in Wisconsin .

title: True Ghost Knight Faithful
description: True Ghost Knight Faithful The True Ghost Knight Faithful was a cult that venerated the Ghost Knight of Galardoun as an incarnation of the dead god Helm . The group met in the upstairs rooms of the Ten Trolls Fallen tavern in Waterdeep ' s Trade Ward . The cult often quested to find the apparition which wandered the Heartlands .
description_long: True Ghost Knight Faithful The True Ghost Knight Faithful was a cult that venerated the Ghost Knight of Galardoun as an incarnation of the dead god Helm . The group met in the upstairs rooms of the Ten Trolls Fallen tavern in Waterdeep ' s Trade Ward . The cult often quested to find the apparition which wandered the Heartlands .

title: True bearing
description: True bearing True bearing was a spell unique to Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Effects . This spell was a favorite of mariners who used it to determine the direction of a landmark .
description_long: True bearing True bearing was a spell unique to Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Effects . This spell was a favorite of mariners who used it to determine the direction of a landmark . This could only be used to find the direction of places previously visited by the caster . Locations hidden by magic caused the spell to fail . This spell only worked on fixed objects and never living things . A wizard casting this spell needed to have 10 feet ( 3 meters ) of water beneath their feet . Components . This spell required a pinch of iron filings to cast .

title: True name
description: True name A creature ' s true name is its hidden name that , rather just acting as a label , metaphysically truly belongs to that creature . All beings have true names , though most of these are unknown , especially to mere mortals . Knowing a creature ' s true name can grant power over it .
description_long: True name A creature ' s true name is its hidden name that , rather just acting as a label , metaphysically truly belongs to that creature . All beings have true names , though most of these are unknown , especially to mere mortals . Knowing a creature ' s true name can grant power over it . There are several different accounts of true names and how they function in this sense . 2nd Edition . True names were given to all creatures by an agreement between the powers in an effort to control them . They were supposed to be kept secret , but some were leaked out by one or more powers . When a creature ' s true name is known , a non - chaotic spellcaster may use it to cast spells such as " true name " , " cacofiend " , " ensnarement " and " spirit wrack " , which harm , bind or control the creature . It can also be used to bind a summoned fiend to make a pact it will be compelled to keep . The powers themselves apparently do not have true names . 3rd Edition . Each creature has a unique true name among the Words of Creation , a language so primal even speaking a word of it has a powerful effect .

title: True seeing
description: True seeing True seeing , also known as true sight , was a divination spell that allowed the subject see things in their true form or location . A divine version of this spell was reversible , called false seeing , and masked the true form of things , generally making them appear the opposite of their true nature . Effects .
description_long: True seeing True seeing , also known as true sight , was a divination spell that allowed the subject see things in their true form or location . A divine version of this spell was reversible , called false seeing , and masked the true form of things , generally making them appear the opposite of their true nature . Effects . The caster had to successfully touch the recipient of this spell and , for a number of minutes equal to the caster ' s experience level , the subject ' s vision was greatly enhanced out to a range of 120 ft ( 36 m ) . ( The older arcane version of this spell had half this range . ) Normal and magical " darkness " were no longer a barrier , illusion s became transparent , magically concealed doors became obvious , invisible things became visible , " blur red " things became sharp , " mirror image s " didn ' t fool the subject , and " displaced " and out of phase things were seen in their true location . Polymorphed or transmuted things could be seen in their original form , e . g . , an elf that was really a polymorphed dragon appeared to have a life - sized spectral dragon superimposed on it .

title: True strike
description: True strike True strike was a divination spell that allowed the caster to look a few seconds into the future and gain a great advantage to hit a target . Effects . This spell allowed the caster to look one move ahead and strike at the right place at the right time , with almost guaranteed success .
description_long: True strike True strike was a divination spell that allowed the caster to look a few seconds into the future and gain a great advantage to hit a target . Effects . This spell allowed the caster to look one move ahead and strike at the right place at the right time , with almost guaranteed success . This knowledge even negated the concealment of targets . The divination only revealed a few seconds into the future , so any hesitation to act on this knowledge was a lost opportunity . Components . This spell required a verbal component and a small wooden disk with concentric circles on it , resembling an archery target .

title: Trueblades
description: Trueblades The Trueblades were an order of crusader s devoted to the god Torm the True , based in the city of Tantras in the Vast . Base . They were based in a sword - temple in the city of Tantras .
description_long: Trueblades The Trueblades were an order of crusader s devoted to the god Torm the True , based in the city of Tantras in the Vast . Base . They were based in a sword - temple in the city of Tantras . Activities . The Trueblades fought for justice and order in the name of Torm . In particular , they performed damage control during warfare and disasters . History . In 1358 DR , during the Time of Troubles , the Trueblades worked to perform damage control after the cataclysmic battle between the gods Torm and Bane in Tantras that destroyed large sections of the city . The Trueblades were still active in 1374 DR , commanded by Phindrake Korlaunt .

title: Truent Tyranon
description: Truent Tyranon Truent Tyranon was a seasoned Cormyr ian warrior in Scardale in 1368 DR . Activities . Truent led the Cormyrean garrison in the city .
description_long: Truent Tyranon Truent Tyranon was a seasoned Cormyr ian warrior in Scardale in 1368 DR . Activities . Truent led the Cormyrean garrison in the city . He found himself trusted in delicate diplomatic matters . The Cormyrean government was starting to consider a retreat but did not want to favor the Zhent s by any means .

title: Trueshield Trading Priakos
description: Trueshield Trading Priakos The Trueshield Trading Priakos was a merchant company in Faerûn . History . This merchant group built its own wagons and even trained and equipped their guards .
description_long: Trueshield Trading Priakos The Trueshield Trading Priakos was a merchant company in Faerûn . History . This merchant group built its own wagons and even trained and equipped their guards . No expense was spared , resulting in fine caravan guards that few bandits dared tangle with . Base of Operations . The Trueshield Trading Priakos was based out of Telpir along the south west coast of the Sea of Fallen Stars .

title: Truesilver
description: Truesilver House Truesilver was a noble house of Cormyr , whose estate was situated beyond the Royal Gardens in Suzail . The family was known for its militarism and pushed to expand the Imperial Navy ' s influence in the late 15th century DR . The Truesilvers and Dauntinghorn s shared similar views on Cormyr ' s military might .
description_long: Truesilver House Truesilver was a noble house of Cormyr , whose estate was situated beyond the Royal Gardens in Suzail . The family was known for its militarism and pushed to expand the Imperial Navy ' s influence in the late 15th century DR . The Truesilvers and Dauntinghorn s shared similar views on Cormyr ' s military might .

title: Trumpet archon
description: Trumpet archon Trumpet archons were a celestial beings that lived primarily on the slopes of Celestia . Physical description . A trumpet archon appeared as a beautiful humanoid being with pale skin , white hair and feathered wings , with eyes the color of gleaming pearls .
description_long: Trumpet archon Trumpet archons were a celestial beings that lived primarily on the slopes of Celestia . Physical description . A trumpet archon appeared as a beautiful humanoid being with pale skin , white hair and feathered wings , with eyes the color of gleaming pearls . Combat . They cast divine magic spells and could access the Air , Destruction , Good , Law , and War domain s , in addition to any others granted by their sovereign deity . Equipment . Each trumpet archon carried a gleaming silver trumpet about 6 ft . ( 1 . 83 m ) long , often adorned with the symbol of their patron deity . This trumpet could transform into a magical greatsword at the whim of its bearer . Ecology . Trumpet archons served as the messengers of the gods of good and the heralds of the heavenly armies . When the gods of the heavenly realms required mortals to know their will , they sent forth a trumpet archon to deliver the message .

title: Trunalor
description: Trunalor The Trunalor , or star people , were a tribe of wild elves who lived within the Forest of Amtar in northern Dambrath . History . The star people despised the drow and crinti who dominated the country of Dambrath .
description_long: Trunalor The Trunalor , or star people , were a tribe of wild elves who lived within the Forest of Amtar in northern Dambrath . History . The star people despised the drow and crinti who dominated the country of Dambrath . Logging excursions into the Forest of Dambrath for prized bluewood often resulted in bloodshed between the wild elves and the loggers of Dambrath . Organization . For 300 years the Trunalor were led by Ferla Treeclimber . Their numbers hovered around 500 wild elves , causing them to chose their battles carefully to avoid unnecessary risk . Raiding parties of Trunalor would not attack an outside group found within the Forest of Amtar if that group had a full - blooded elf with them .

title: Trundles
description: Trundles LL . McV . Trundles or Doctor Trundles was a businessman in the Bloodstone Lands around 1357 DR and 1359 DR .
description_long: Trundles LL . McV . Trundles or Doctor Trundles was a businessman in the Bloodstone Lands around 1357 DR and 1359 DR . Activities . Doctor Trundles managed the Circus of Doctor Trundles , a collection of monsters . History . In 1357 DR , Doctor Trundles took his circus to the Damara n city of Valls with his loyal assistant Tanaroo Quinson . However , a bulette freed itself and other monsters , and Trundles fainted in shock . Tanaroo hired some adventurers to capture the monsters before they killed someone . In 1359 DR , after capturing new monsters , Trundles went back for a new tour in Impiltur with more security measures . Tanaroo acted as ringmaster with Trundles staying behind the scenes . Relationships . Trundles always traveled with his loyal assistant Tanaroo Quinson .

title: Truth candle
description: Truth candle A truth candle was a special magic item made by mystic s in the Realms . It caused individuals to enter a state of torpor and forced them to answer questions truthfully . Description .
description_long: Truth candle A truth candle was a special magic item made by mystic s in the Realms . It caused individuals to enter a state of torpor and forced them to answer questions truthfully . Description . " Truth candles " were purple in color and intended to be burnt in ten - minute intervals . The longest - lasting candle that could be made burned for ninety minutes . This was the third type of candle mystics learned to make when studying candle magic . Powers . After burning for the desired amount of time and then being extinguished ( either by blowing , snuffing , dousing , or reaching the end of its wick ) , the victims had one chance to resist the candle magic . Those that succeeded in resisting felt nothing and were not affected . Those that failed fell into a stupor and would answer truthfully to questions posed to them . They were forced to answer two questions for every ten minutes the victims were exposed to the " truth candle " . While in this state of torpor , subjects could only defend themselves — they could not take any offensive action and they could move at only half their normal pace .

title: Trythos
description: Trythos Trythos was one of the leaders of New Waterdeep in 1370 DR . History . Trythos simply went to Maztica in order to find a new land .
description_long: Trythos Trythos was one of the leaders of New Waterdeep in 1370 DR . History . Trythos simply went to Maztica in order to find a new land . He led a group who settled the small colony of Trythosford inside the New Waterdeep territory . As the most honorable man among the leaders of New Waterdeep , Trythos was chosen as Open Lord of all settlements .

title: Tsabanor Oblodra
description: Tsabanor Oblodra Tsabanor Oblodra was the house patron of House Oblodra and the mate of Matron Mother K ' yorl Odran circa 1358 DR . Personality . Tsabanor was a pathetic figure in his house , and lived only with K ' yorl ' s permission .
description_long: Tsabanor Oblodra Tsabanor Oblodra was the house patron of House Oblodra and the mate of Matron Mother K ' yorl Odran circa 1358 DR . Personality . Tsabanor was a pathetic figure in his house , and lived only with K ' yorl ' s permission . She taunted and tormented him constantly . He often considered hurling himself into the Clawrift to end his suffering . History . Tsabanor was chosen by Matron Mother K ' yorl as patron for his latent psionic powers . He was once a skilled speaker , but K ' yorl cut his tongue out because he had spoken to her too often . From that point on he lived a pathetic life . Powers . He had latent psionic powers .

title: Tsabrak
description: Tsabrak Tsabrak was a drider and one of Houndaer Tuin ' Tarl and Syrzan ' s group in Menzoberranzan in 1372 . History . Tsabrak was part of a drider colony living in tunnels near Menzoberranzan .
description_long: Tsabrak Tsabrak was a drider and one of Houndaer Tuin ' Tarl and Syrzan ' s group in Menzoberranzan in 1372 . History . Tsabrak was part of a drider colony living in tunnels near Menzoberranzan . During the Silence of Lolth , Tsabrak and others driders joined Houndaer ' s group in order to start a slave revolt hoping for a better future for their fellows .
