He was eventually killed in the suppression of the revolt .

title: Tsabrak Xorlarrin
description: Tsabrak Xorlarrin Tsabrak Xorlarrin was the Archmage of Q ' Xorlarrin . History . Tsabrak served as master of Sorcere academy of Menzoberranzan .
description_long: Tsabrak Xorlarrin Tsabrak Xorlarrin was the Archmage of Q ' Xorlarrin . History . Tsabrak served as master of Sorcere academy of Menzoberranzan . He was the house wizard of House Xorlarrin before becoming Archmage of Q ' Xorlarrin . In 1484 DR , Tsabrak was tasked by Matron Mother Quenthel Baenre to prepare to be the conduit of Lolth in a spell known as the Darkening , which was intended to prepare battlefield of the North for Quenthel ' s takeover . The knowledge for the spell was given to him by the illithid Methil El - Viddenvelp . Later Tsabrak went to Eryndlyn in order to raise the Demon Weave for Lolth but was stopped at the last moment by some adventurers . Relationships . House Xorlarrin . Tsabrak was cousin to Berellip Xorlarrin . Tsabrak and Ravel Xorlarrin , the house wizard , were bitter rivals .

title: Tsabrak of the Blood
description: Tsabrak of the Blood Tsabrak of the Blood was the head of the College of Necromancy and one of the members of the Conclave of Sshamath in the city of Sshamath in the year 1372 DR . History . In 1377 DR , Q ' arlynd Melarn told the priestess of Eilistraee Miverra that everyone knew that Master Tsabrak was a vampire .
description_long: Tsabrak of the Blood Tsabrak of the Blood was the head of the College of Necromancy and one of the members of the Conclave of Sshamath in the city of Sshamath in the year 1372 DR . History . In 1377 DR , Q ' arlynd Melarn told the priestess of Eilistraee Miverra that everyone knew that Master Tsabrak was a vampire . In 1379 DR Tsabrak acted as moderator in the debate about elevate the College of Ancient Arcana or the College of Bae ' qeshel Magic as new eleven official college of the city . Later Tsabrak unfrozen Q ' arlynd Melarn permitting him to spoke in front of the Conclave , despite the breaking of the protocol .

title: Tsagoth
description: Tsagoth Tsagoth is an undead creature , a blood fiend . Appearance . Tsagoth is huge with a purple - black scaly hide .
description_long: Tsagoth Tsagoth is an undead creature , a blood fiend . Appearance . Tsagoth is huge with a purple - black scaly hide . His has a lupine muzzle with great fangs and red eyes . He has four clawed hands . As a blood fiend he feeds on blood , preferably of other fiends . Skills . Most wounds inflicted on him will heal in mere moments . Tsagoth can dissolve into vapor . In this form he can float along walls and ceiling , being not quite invisible but fairly inconspicuous while making not a sound or pass through cracks in the wall . He can also transform into a gigantic bat . He is able to control one ' s mind . As vampires prey on humans , so do blood fiends prey on demons and like vampires , Tsagoth can also transform other creatures into their likes , as he demonstrated on Mari Agneh . History . In 1375 DR , Tsagoth was summoned by Szass Tam into Thay to find Mari Agneh . She was to be used to kill Aznar Thrul . < br > The blood fiend was further used as soldier of Szass Tam ' s undead army during the following war of Thay in 1385 DR .

title: Tsampo
description: Tsampo Tsampo was a staple food stuff of Khazari , made from roasted flour . It could be prepared as a . History .
description_long: Tsampo Tsampo was a staple food stuff of Khazari , made from roasted flour . It could be prepared as a . History . The lama Koja thought of tsampo porridge when he remembered his homeland . He was later presented with a magical feast that included tsampo porridge .

title: Tsao Ho
description: Tsao Ho Tsao Ho was a sohei adventurer in Shou Lung . History . Tsao Ho born as son of a noble of the Sheng Ti province of Shou Lung and made a quickly career in the army , leading many bushi .
description_long: Tsao Ho Tsao Ho was a sohei adventurer in Shou Lung . History . Tsao Ho born as son of a noble of the Sheng Ti province of Shou Lung and made a quickly career in the army , leading many bushi . However Ho ' s father started plotting against the Emperor and Tsao , divide between loyalty to his family and to his country , decided to sought refuge in the Sheng - Ti monastery known as " The Sanctuary " in the city of Hsi - Feng . There he joined the sohei ' s ranks , his family was so shocked to stop their rebellious plans . After that episode Ho was considered a loyal follower of the Emperor . He was chosen to accompany Deng Tse Chin in his two - year voyage . In 1358 DR , Deng decided to attent the Komite . Appendix . Behind the scenes . Tsao Ho was a pre - generated PC for use in adventures in Shou Lung . In the plot of the adventure he was the second choice as relative of the Emperor .

title: Tsaparang Fortress
description: Tsaparang Fortress Tsaparang Fortress , or Tsa Parang , was an ancient fortress located in the Endless Wastes . History . Tsaparang Fortress was an old fortress built sometime during the age of the Kingdom of Guge by a race of half - elves known as the Maviddi in order to combat the growing power of that kingdom .
description_long: Tsaparang Fortress Tsaparang Fortress , or Tsa Parang , was an ancient fortress located in the Endless Wastes . History . Tsaparang Fortress was an old fortress built sometime during the age of the Kingdom of Guge by a race of half - elves known as the Maviddi in order to combat the growing power of that kingdom . While the Maviddi were unable to defeat Guge outright , Guge was unable to take the fortress for some time . Eventually however , the warriors of Guge breached the fortress , slaughtering all the defenders inside except a few children , and leaving the bodies of the slain left to rot unburied . Those who fled the fortress were scattered across the Katakoro Plateau . Afterwards , Guge looted the fortress , taking all its treasures and even chiseling out the better stonework . Since then , the ruins were haunted by the ghosts of the fallen defenders , who attacked anyone without Maviddi blood who tried to enter the ruins . Because of this , most people outright avoided the ruins , while those that did enter didn ' t stay long . Description .

title: Tsarra Chaadren
description: Tsarra Chaadren Tsarra Chaadren ( known by the alias Autumnfire ) was a half - elf sorceress and the second Blackstaff of Waterdeep . Appearance . Tsarra had long , curly auburn hair Her eyes were hazel .
description_long: Tsarra Chaadren Tsarra Chaadren ( known by the alias Autumnfire ) was a half - elf sorceress and the second Blackstaff of Waterdeep . Appearance . Tsarra had long , curly auburn hair Her eyes were hazel . As of 28 Uktar 1374 DR , Khelben " Blackstaff " Arunsun had attached a " kiira " to Tsarra ' s forehead , which consisted of an intricate tattoo with a green gem at its center . Personality . Tsarra was a patient teacher , although she did have a temper , which flared up when hearing lies , or when people treated children or animals poorly . She was stubborn when she believed herself to be right . She preferred to spend time in the than in cities , but preferred cities at night . She gained from her mother a knowledge of woodland herbs and their use in healing applications . Possessions . Tsarra inherited Mhaornathil , a magical Rillifane Rallathil - blessed scimitar that could harm ghost s , from her mother , and she held a deep affection for it . Tsarra was given the Shield Belt of Storms to wear on 28 Uktar 1374 DR , through which she bore the majority of the spirit of her friend Danthra . As an arcane archer , Tsarra usually possessed a bow . Relationships .

title: Tsathree ' s Comforts
description: Tsathree ' s Comforts Tsathree ' s Comforts was a boutique owned by Jhamanthra Tsathree . Location . Tsathree ' s Comforts was located on Golden Serpent Street in the North Ward of Waterdeep circa the Year of Lightning Storms , 1374 DR .
description_long: Tsathree ' s Comforts Tsathree ' s Comforts was a boutique owned by Jhamanthra Tsathree . Location . Tsathree ' s Comforts was located on Golden Serpent Street in the North Ward of Waterdeep circa the Year of Lightning Storms , 1374 DR . History . This shop gained brief notoriety when Jhamanthra began selling a new scented facial wash she called Waterfall Kiss . It was quickly discovered that skin treated with this product suddenly began to glow a vivid green color a few hours after applying certain cosmetic products to the treated area . The glow lasted for a few hours and then faded , apparently harmlessly . For a time , Waterfall Kiss was in great demand as the Waterdhavian youth with disposable income experimented with the humorous and glamorous application of making other body parts glow .

title: Tsenya Bhrokiti
description: Tsenya Bhrokiti Princess Tsenya Bhrokiti was the royal heir of Ra - Khati during the mid – 14th century DR . Personality . Many believed that Tsenya had many qualities that were ill - suited to a future ruler .
description_long: Tsenya Bhrokiti Princess Tsenya Bhrokiti was the royal heir of Ra - Khati during the mid – 14th century DR . Personality . Many believed that Tsenya had many qualities that were ill - suited to a future ruler . She was willful , impetuous , and self - centered . However , she was also goodhearted and possessed an innate sense of decency . Her adventurous spirit left her despising the general sense of xenophobia that dominated the entire society of Ra - Khati . Activities . Princess Bhrokitit was forbidden from leaving the Potala by her father until she assumed control of the regency . As a practicing wu jen , Tsenya was required to adhere to a particular taboo or lose her powers . As a result , she could never sleep in the same room with another person . History . Tsenya cared little for the spiritual aspects that controlled much of society within Ra - Khati . Much of this arose from the fact that her mother died during her birth , leaving her to be raised by the palace staff , who often over - indulged her to the point of spoiling the young princess . Abilities . Tsenya had a degree of training in the martial arts and the use of magic .

title: Tsenya Garbo
description: Tsenya Garbo Tsenya Garbo was the Holy Leader of Ra - Khati , also called the Dalai Lama , during the mid – 14th century DR . Appearance . Though he was well over one hundred years old , Tsenya appeared to be in his 50 ' s .
description_long: Tsenya Garbo Tsenya Garbo was the Holy Leader of Ra - Khati , also called the Dalai Lama , during the mid – 14th century DR . Appearance . Though he was well over one hundred years old , Tsenya appeared to be in his 50 ' s . Personality . Tsenya was a good - hearted , fearless man who placed Ra - Khati ' s safety above all else . This also made him a bit shortsighted . He disliked magic - users who caused harm to others . Activities . Tsenya Garbo served as the Dalai Lama for over a century , acting as Ra - Khati ' s ruler and spiritual guide . Abilities . As an advanced cleric and monk , Tsenya knew a wide variety of spells . He was well - trained in the martial arts . Tsenya could focus his ki into powers including resisting magic , preventing himself from getting hurt if falling from great distances , and even reading minds . Relationships . Princess Bhrokiti was the daughter of the Dalai Lama .

title: Tsien Chiang
description: Tsien Chiang Tsien Chiang was a wu jen sorceress who formerly lived in Kara - Tur and later became the Lord of I ' Cath in the Demiplane of Dread . History . Tsien was born as the daughter of one of the princes of I ' Cath .
description_long: Tsien Chiang Tsien Chiang was a wu jen sorceress who formerly lived in Kara - Tur and later became the Lord of I ' Cath in the Demiplane of Dread . History . Tsien was born as the daughter of one of the princes of I ' Cath . From a young age , despite her father ' s objection that women were only needed to make children , she mastered the talents of both the military and wu jen necromancy , and also learning poison craft . In response to her father ' s belittling of her , she became a determined misandrist and eventually murdered her father , then used her wu jen powers to turn her mother and three brothers into imbeciles . Tsien Chiang was acclaimed the ruler of I ' Cath by the local elders , who would rather see her as lord than one of her idiot family members . She quickly became a notorious tyrant and , in time , one of the most powerful individuals in all of Kara - Tur . Despite binding oaths of loyalty to the Emperor of Shou Lung that she reluctantly swore , Tsien was feared even by him .

title: Tsu - tsu
description: Tsu - tsu The Tsu - tsu ( or " Tsu - Tsu " ) were a tribe of the Plain of Horses in the Hordelands . They were one of the three major tribes of the plain , alongside the Fankiang and the Kashghun . Language .
description_long: Tsu - tsu The Tsu - tsu ( or " Tsu - Tsu " ) were a tribe of the Plain of Horses in the Hordelands . They were one of the three major tribes of the plain , alongside the Fankiang and the Kashghun . Language . As one of the major tribes of the Plain of Horses , the Tsu - tsu spoke their own dialect of Chuchian , called " Tsu - tsu " . Territory . Tsu - tsu territory stretched from the base of the Chigidi Mountains in the north , to the Shou Lung province of Chukei in the east , and to the Kashghun territory in the west . Its southern tip met the northern end of the Dragonwall . Society . The Tsu - tsu tribe were semi - nomadic , spending most of their year on the steppes , where they herded sheep and cattle , before returning to their villages or the city of Jugicha . Thus , each Tsu - tsu family had two homes : tents in the summer and brick houses in the winter . They were considered to be among the top hunters and fishermen of the Plain of Horses , as well as superb herders and producers of livestock . They were proficient in breeding horse s , and were the only tribe in the area to breed pigs .

title: Tsu Gonsuke
description: Tsu Gonsuke Tsu Gonsuke was the head of the noble Tsu family and the provincial governor of Miyama Province in Kozakura in 1357 DR . History . The retired emperor Gokammu gave the governorship of Miyama to the Tsu family , one of the noble families that supported him , and Gonsuke , as head of the house , was chosen as governor .
description_long: Tsu Gonsuke Tsu Gonsuke was the head of the noble Tsu family and the provincial governor of Miyama Province in Kozakura in 1357 DR . History . The retired emperor Gokammu gave the governorship of Miyama to the Tsu family , one of the noble families that supported him , and Gonsuke , as head of the house , was chosen as governor . Thank to the income from the province , the Tsu clan prospered . However , Gonsuke never actually ruled Miyama , as he lived most of his life in the capital and the actual governing of the province was handled by the mokudai . Personality . Gonsuke was a gruff man , greatly suffering from arthritis .

title: Tsu family
description: Tsu family The Tsu family was a declining noble house related to the Igi clan in Miyama Province in Kozakura in 1357 DR . They still controlled the kokushu position but little more than that . In the past , the Igi were considered vassals of the Tsu but around 1357 DR , the Igi dominated the Tsu .
description_long: Tsu family The Tsu family was a declining noble house related to the Igi clan in Miyama Province in Kozakura in 1357 DR . They still controlled the kokushu position but little more than that . In the past , the Igi were considered vassals of the Tsu but around 1357 DR , the Igi dominated the Tsu .

title: Tsuga Mosuke
description: Tsuga Mosuke Tsuga Mosuke was a Hengeyokai retainer of the Funada clan in Nakamaru around 1357 DR . Activities . He had several little birdlike mannerisms that marked his heritage .
description_long: Tsuga Mosuke Tsuga Mosuke was a Hengeyokai retainer of the Funada clan in Nakamaru around 1357 DR . Activities . He had several little birdlike mannerisms that marked his heritage . History . Mosuke was adopted by Tsuga clan as a child ( in honor of services rendered by his real family ) . He become the pillar of the Tsuga family . In 1357 Ueda Teishi , a supported of Goshukara clan in verge to being exiled from Nakamaru , became convicted that Mosuke was the head of his enemies that had caused his misfortunes . So with help of Kidera Takeshi , that was in life - debt with his dead father , Teishi targeted Mosuke for death Personality . Mosuke was a concentrate of qualities . He was a model of filial piety and all of his action were directed towards increasing the honor of his family . He was a strong supporter of Funada Toyoo

title: Tsukishima
description: Tsukishima Tsukishima was the main isle of Wa . It was the largest and most densely populated . The terrain was composed by many extinct volcanoes bordered by fertile lowlands .
description_long: Tsukishima Tsukishima was the main isle of Wa . It was the largest and most densely populated . The terrain was composed by many extinct volcanoes bordered by fertile lowlands . The capital of Wa Uwaji was located on the east coast , like most of the major cities .

title: Tsukku
description: Tsukku Tsukku was a young samurai retainer of Benju Matsumoto in the town of Aru in Wa . Personality . Tsukku was a young but proud and loyal samurai .
description_long: Tsukku Tsukku was a young samurai retainer of Benju Matsumoto in the town of Aru in Wa . Personality . Tsukku was a young but proud and loyal samurai . He took very seriously any kind of offense to his honor . History . Around 1358 DR , his daimyo Benju ordered Tsukku to find and escort to his presence an adventuring party that was spending a night at the Waiting Stone , a local ryokan .

title: Tsurlagol
description: Tsurlagol Tsurlagol , formerly known as Chessagol , was the southernmost city - state of the Vast , lying at the end of Stormcrest Trail from Sevenecho , on the north coast of the Sea of Fallen Stars . It was a prosperous port city , the last on the Inner Sea before Impiltur . To merchants , it was " The Gateway to the Unapproachable East " ; to pirates it was " Pirate ' s Haven " .
description_long: Tsurlagol Tsurlagol , formerly known as Chessagol , was the southernmost city - state of the Vast , lying at the end of Stormcrest Trail from Sevenecho , on the north coast of the Sea of Fallen Stars . It was a prosperous port city , the last on the Inner Sea before Impiltur . To merchants , it was " The Gateway to the Unapproachable East " ; to pirates it was " Pirate ' s Haven " . It had the unenviable record of being raided , destroyed , and rebuilt more often than any other city in the surrounding lands , such that to the local dwarves , " Tsurlagol " was a byword for " job available " . Etymology & Language . When founded , the city was known as " Chessagol " , but this later evolved into its modern name , " Tsurlagol " . The name " Tsurlagol " was pronounced as " Tsss - SIR - lah - gel " or " TSIR - lah - gol " , and its people were called " Tsurlagoli " . Its people spoke the Easting language , which was related to the Damaran language . History . Early history . Tsurlagol was almost as old as its sister - city Procampur , and shared a common origin , having also been founded by human settlers from fallen Jhaamdath ( what is now Chondath ) .

title: Tsurlanej
description: Tsurlanej Tsurlanej was an illithilich sorcerer and the first elder of the Concord of Elders that governed the illithid city of Ch ' Chitl in the Northdark of the Underdark in the mid – 14th century DR . History . In the mid – 13th century DR , the githyanki assaulted the city and mortally wounded the elder brain .
description_long: Tsurlanej Tsurlanej was an illithilich sorcerer and the first elder of the Concord of Elders that governed the illithid city of Ch ' Chitl in the Northdark of the Underdark in the mid – 14th century DR . History . In the mid – 13th century DR , the githyanki assaulted the city and mortally wounded the elder brain . Taking desperate measures , the ulitharid Thalynsar transformed himself and several other illithid s , including Tsurlanej , into lich es so they could devour the elder brain , preserve its knowledge and powers , and take its place . Successful in their endeavor , the illithiliches formed a Conclave of Elders , with Thalynsar as the most powerful among them . He tried to retain much of the elder brain ' s knowledge for himself , but the excessive information steadily turned him insane . Nevertheless , Thalynsar ruled Ch ' Chitl for over a hundred years . Finally , around 1370 DR , Tsurlanej and the other Elders united and were obligated to kill the insane Thalynsar . However , they struggled to lead in his place and divide the elder brain ' s lore . Tsurlanej rose to become the new leader of the Conclave .

title: Tsushima
description: Tsushima Tsushima was a samurai retainer of the Korimori clan in Maeshi Province in 1360 DR . History . Tsushima was ordered to lead a cavalry squadron to stop by any means an adventuring party hired by Michimori Uemon to retrieve the Seven Swords for Uemon .
description_long: Tsushima Tsushima was a samurai retainer of the Korimori clan in Maeshi Province in 1360 DR . History . Tsushima was ordered to lead a cavalry squadron to stop by any means an adventuring party hired by Michimori Uemon to retrieve the Seven Swords for Uemon . He attacked them but was defeated and killed . Personality . Tsushima was a brutal man , who acted without mercy and fondness . He considered himself and his troop to be the best .

title: Tu ' ara ' thal
description: Tu ' ara ' thal Tu ' ara ' thal was a shalarin cleric of Oghma in Myth Nantar . History . Born into the shalarin ' s Seeker Caste , Tu ' ara ' thal followed the call of Oghma and joined the Faiths Caste .
description_long: Tu ' ara ' thal Tu ' ara ' thal was a shalarin cleric of Oghma in Myth Nantar . History . Born into the shalarin ' s Seeker Caste , Tu ' ara ' thal followed the call of Oghma and joined the Faiths Caste . Around 1349 DR , Tu ' ara ' thal , with the unborn Ka ' ioa ' Tara still inside her , led her husband Po ' ioa ' nam to penetrate the Great Barrier after fleeing a group of merrow that had killed all his companions . Qos accepted Po ' ioa ' nam and his wife and permitted them to settle in the city .

title: Tu ' ola ' sara
description: Tu ' ola ' sara Tu ' ola ' sara was a dukar of the Order of Maliirn and a member of the Nantarn Council . History . Hailing from Ys ' bhol Tu ' ola ' sara was a shalarin of Wandered Caste .
description_long: Tu ' ola ' sara Tu ' ola ' sara was a dukar of the Order of Maliirn and a member of the Nantarn Council . History . Hailing from Ys ' bhol Tu ' ola ' sara was a shalarin of Wandered Caste . During a trip a rogue current sent her against the Great Barrier . She was saved by the dukar and soon Tu ' ola ' sara joined them . She was sent back to Es ' rath as secret dukar agent in the area culling as much lore as possible . After the Twelfth Serôs War and the reveal of the dukar orders Tu ' olaìsara was granted a place in the council .

title: Tu ' uua ' col
description: Tu ' uua ' col Tu ' uua ' col was a dukar of the Order of Kupav . History . Born in 1313 DR Tu ' uua ' col was trained as dukar by Qos and others in Qatoris and sent as secret agent in merfolk territories .
description_long: Tu ' uua ' col Tu ' uua ' col was a dukar of the Order of Kupav . History . Born in 1313 DR Tu ' uua ' col was trained as dukar by Qos and others in Qatoris and sent as secret agent in merfolk territories . There around 1349 DR he managed to save the life of Vhaemas against a pod of shark s and sahuagin . Despite objection of the king Ator IX and of the court Vhaemas and Tu ' uua ' col became blood brothers and the shalarin acted as advisor for Vhaemas and wizard tutor for the many royal princelings . During the Twelfth Serôs War Tu ' uua ' col was one of the key player in the forging of the Nantarn Alliance in marpenoth of 1369 DR finally revealing his allegiance to the considered lost dukars . Personality . Tu ' uua ' col was a man of word , he considered above all the vows he had forged with Vhaemas and with his dukar leader Gayar . He truly wanted that merfoks can finally use wizard magic . Col always kept an eye to Arina , that he stated consider to be the Chosen Star , as Qos prophesied and a key component in restoring the lost Order of Jhimari . Relationship . Truly Col considered Vhaemas his best friend .

title: Tu - shun
description: Tu - shun Tu - shun was a sohei and also a zussho in Kozakura in 1357 DR . Activities . Tu - shun administrated a shoen of the Konjo school near the Itsuki village .
description_long: Tu - shun Tu - shun was a sohei and also a zussho in Kozakura in 1357 DR . Activities . Tu - shun administrated a shoen of the Konjo school near the Itsuki village . He led 77 sohei and was at the time in a dispute over ownership of the village with the samurai Sakai Kazuhiko . Tu - shun had captured the eastern end of Itsuki .

title: Tualo
description: Tualo Tualo , usually known as Tualo the Bright , was a wizard living in Neverwinter in 1484 DR . He was interested in studying the effects of the Spellplague . Tualo met and befriended an elven wizard , Rhazzad , who had the same interest .
description_long: Tualo Tualo , usually known as Tualo the Bright , was a wizard living in Neverwinter in 1484 DR . He was interested in studying the effects of the Spellplague . Tualo met and befriended an elven wizard , Rhazzad , who had the same interest . Unfortunately , Rhazzad had a vicious plan in mind and used Tualo as a pawn . Rhazzad gave Tualo a magic scroll but tricked the human , and when Tualo read it out loud the spell opened a " portal " to the Far Realm . The entities of that dimension killed Tualo and escaped . The " portal " was closed only when an adventurer sent by Sergeant Knox arrived at Tualo ' s house in order to question him about Rhazzad , who had come under the Watch ' s scrutiny for his suspect actions . Thank to Tualo ' s assistant and some letters , the adventurer discovered the dealings between Rhazzad and Tualo .

title: Tube wilt
description: Tube wilt Tube wilt was a disease affecting treant s . It was carried by tiny spores in the soil that could get into the trunk . Once inside the treant , they grew into a fungus that fed on the heartwood , the most tube - rich area of the treant , and caused rotting to occur .
description_long: Tube wilt Tube wilt was a disease affecting treant s . It was carried by tiny spores in the soil that could get into the trunk . Once inside the treant , they grew into a fungus that fed on the heartwood , the most tube - rich area of the treant , and caused rotting to occur . This was very painful for the treant and would cause death in a few months , when the trunk became too weak to support the weight of the branches .

title: Tuern
description: Tuern Tuern ( pronounced " TOORN " ) was an island in the Frozenfar in the Trackless Sea , far to the west of Faerûn . It was a rocky island of black beaches and fuming volcanoes , but was very fertile . Climate .
description_long: Tuern Tuern ( pronounced " TOORN " ) was an island in the Frozenfar in the Trackless Sea , far to the west of Faerûn . It was a rocky island of black beaches and fuming volcanoes , but was very fertile . Climate . Although classed as a subarctic climate , Tuern was somewhat warmed by the coastal current . People & Culture . Tuern was inhabited largely by Northmen . The people of the island were known as " Tuernish " . Though they worshiped no gods ( and often denied their existence ) , they held great reverence for the red dragon s that dwelt in the mountains . Their longships were big enough to house giants ( and frequently did ) , and were decorated with figureheads depicting fierce warriors . A typical Tuernish crew consisted of over a hundred warriors . The Tuernish despised magic , and its usage was punishable by death . Clerics were treated with disdain , and even Northman shamans found little respect among the Tuernish . Other non - Northmen and non - humans only received respect if their skill in battle was obvious . The volcanic conditions also made Tuern an ideal home for both fire giant s and red dragons .

title: Tufala min - Jarmik
description: Tufala min - Jarmik Tufala min - Jarmik was a half - elven ethoist priest of Jarmik in 1367 DR . Activities . Tufala supervised the ten priests of the Mosque of the Thirsty Jann along the Pilgrims ' Route .
description_long: Tufala min - Jarmik Tufala min - Jarmik was a half - elven ethoist priest of Jarmik in 1367 DR . Activities . Tufala supervised the ten priests of the Mosque of the Thirsty Jann along the Pilgrims ' Route . All of the priests of the mosque helped passing travelers and pilgrims by offering food and a drink from their special well .

title: Tufenk
description: Tufenk Tufenks were special weapons originating in Zakhara . Description . These weapons looked like elongated blowpipe s .
description_long: Tufenk Tufenks were special weapons originating in Zakhara . Description . These weapons looked like elongated blowpipe s . Uses . Tufenks were used to project over short distances . The Zakharan term for Greek fire was " oil of liquid star " or simply " liquid star . " This weapon required the use of both hands to operate safely . Price . Tufenks cost 21 gp .

title: Tuigan
description: Tuigan The Tuigan were humans from Taan , also known as the Endless Wastes , the vast steppes that stretched between Faerûn and Kara - Tur . Territory . The original tribal lands of the Tuigan were in the central Wastes .
description_long: Tuigan The Tuigan were humans from Taan , also known as the Endless Wastes , the vast steppes that stretched between Faerûn and Kara - Tur . Territory . The original tribal lands of the Tuigan were in the central Wastes . Their lands bordered those of the Dalat , Naican , Khassidi , Zamogedi , Quirish , and Oigur tribes . History . In 1358 DR , the Tuigan tribes united under Horselord Yamun Khahan . The first tribe to join with them were the Naican , who at one time had shared pastures with the Tuigan . When the Tuigan campaigned against the Zamogedi , the Gur quickly joined them . Next , the Oigur were forced to join . By the end of Yamun Khahan ' s campaign , only the Fankiang still actively rebelled against him , though he had technically conquered them too . Under Yamun Khahan ' s banner , the Grand Army of the Tuigan invaded the nations of Semphar , Khazari , Shou Lung , Thay , Rashemen , and Thesk . They were defeated at Phsant in 1360 DR by King Azoun IV of Cormyr leading an alliance of nations throughout Faerûn . Description . Tuigans had yellowish - bronze skin with black hair and broad , flat features .

title: Tuigan language
description: Tuigan language Tuigan was the language of the Tuigan tribe of the Hordelands . Description . Tuigan had harsh consonant sounds , and the sound of L was heavily aspirated .
description_long: Tuigan language Tuigan was the language of the Tuigan tribe of the Hordelands . Description . Tuigan had harsh consonant sounds , and the sound of L was heavily aspirated . Its grammar had a subject – object – verb order . Speakers . This tongue was spoken primarily by the nomadic Tuigan tribe . Script . While most of the Tuigan did not remember it , Tuigan originally used the Imaskari alphabet . By 1372 DR , some of the tribesmembers had taken to using the Thorass alphabet instead , which had been introduced by traders passing through the Hordelands on the Golden Way toward Kara - Tur . History . Scholars classified Tuigan as one of the Southern Imaskari languages , which evolved from the Roushoum language . It was strongly influenced by the Muhjuri language .

title: Tuir Stonebeard
description: Tuir Stonebeard Tuir " Stonebeard " , Blood of Helban was a dwarf man and Deep King of the dwarven kingdom of Roldilar in the Vast in north Faerûn in the 7th century DR . History . Tuir was a descendent of Helban , whom he honored in his name .
description_long: Tuir Stonebeard Tuir " Stonebeard " , Blood of Helban was a dwarf man and Deep King of the dwarven kingdom of Roldilar in the Vast in north Faerûn in the 7th century DR . History . Tuir was a descendent of Helban , whom he honored in his name . When the orc nation of Vastar , in the lands later known as the Vast , fell into civil war in the Year of Writhing Darkness , 572 DR , dwarves began to encroach from the west , spreading underground and applying increasing pressure on the orcs . Among these dwarves was Lord Tuir Stonebeard , who was determined to destroy Vastar and found his own kingdom . Working with human s and elves , the dwarves secretly developed " orcslayer " , a steel toxic to orcs . Lord Tuir Stonebeard requested over a thousand orcslayer weapons and Master Smith Fyrfar Smokebeard and High Old One Turbaern , together with the human mage Beldossan and the elven sorceress Aleratha Ilnatar worked hard over several years to forge and enchant them . Among these was the short sword " Sarghathuld " , forged in the Year of the Many Serpents , 605 DR , and given to the dwarven warrior Ulnorn .

title: Tukan
description: Tukan Tukan was a relatively new city in Maztica that sat on a peninsula . It was constructed by refugees from Nexal and was inhabited by human s of different origins . Most of them were Nexalans , others from Azatl or Tezat .
description_long: Tukan Tukan was a relatively new city in Maztica that sat on a peninsula . It was constructed by refugees from Nexal and was inhabited by human s of different origins . Most of them were Nexalans , others from Azatl or Tezat . There were even some legionnaires from the Newcomers of Faerûn . The land around the city was fertile and good farmland . The most famous inhabitants in the 1360s DR were the heroes Erixitl and the legionnaire Halloran , together with Poshtli , the leader of the Eagle Knights .

title: Tukulti
description: Tukulti Tukulti was the ruler of Firetrees in Unther in 1357 DR . Activities . Tukulti was a supporter of Gilgeam .
description_long: Tukulti Tukulti was the ruler of Firetrees in Unther in 1357 DR . Activities . Tukulti was a supporter of Gilgeam . He wanted to become the right hand of the king but he had no chance . Personality . Tukulti was an idiot who believed that the current rebellion was a minor problem . He envied his fellow Great Lords with good reasons .

title: Tula Duadil
description: Tula Duadil Tula Duadil was an aquatic elf thief in Myth Nantar . History . Tula , a cousin of the ruler of Naramyr , went to the city in order to become a dukar but was rejected for her power - hungry attitude .
description_long: Tula Duadil Tula Duadil was an aquatic elf thief in Myth Nantar . History . Tula , a cousin of the ruler of Naramyr , went to the city in order to become a dukar but was rejected for her power - hungry attitude . Tula wanted revenge , so attempted to insinuate herself into the circles surrounding the Nantarn Council . Personality . Tula was a spoiled girl who ruthlessly searched for power .

title: Tulmene
description: Tulmene Tulmene was a small settlement on the south coast of the Tethyr Peninsula . Tulmene was known for being the largest fishing village in the region . The village also occasionally traded goods with merchants .
description_long: Tulmene Tulmene was a small settlement on the south coast of the Tethyr Peninsula . Tulmene was known for being the largest fishing village in the region . The village also occasionally traded goods with merchants . History . By 1357 DR , Tulmene was one of the few settlements on the Tethyr Peninsula that had escaped attack by the Nelanther pirates . This was due to a secret agreement with the pirates . In exchange for immunity from the pirates , Tulmene regularly provided them with information on the movements of merchant ships in The Race . In order to gather such intelligence , the Tulmene fishing fleet effectively acted as a vast scouting network . In 1358 DR , an inhabitant of Tulmene named Boltborm witnessed the Red Knight defending Tethyr . When Queen Zaranda visited Tulmene in Eleasias of 1367 DR , she quickly discovered the pirates operating there . After confronting the mayor and battling the pirates at the docks in a chaotic skirmish , Zaranda appointed the honest guard Jos Knightson as the new mayor . With the pirates gone , law and order was restored . Without the prosperous trade from the pirates , Tulmere saw a drop in wealth and quality of life .

title: Tulmon
description: Tulmon Tulmon is a settlement in the Lake of Steam area . In 1372 DR , its population was around 25 , 000 and was ruled by the sorcerer Arkanuirr Tchallem . Most of the buildings in the city were constructed of stone .
description_long: Tulmon Tulmon is a settlement in the Lake of Steam area . In 1372 DR , its population was around 25 , 000 and was ruled by the sorcerer Arkanuirr Tchallem . Most of the buildings in the city were constructed of stone . Crypt City , part of the original city of Tulmon , is located nearby , and in 1372 DR was used by the criminal underworld , despite being inhabited by undead . The inhabitants of the city distrust foreign wizards and sorcerers .

title: Tulom - Itzi
description: Tulom - Itzi Tulom - Itzi was a city in Far Payit in Maztica . The city was once a thriving metropolis but by the mid – 14th century was inhabited by only a fraction of the people who once lived there . The inhabitants , the Itza s , lived in wooden huts and had allowed the jungle to reclaim many of the great stone buildings .
description_long: Tulom - Itzi Tulom - Itzi was a city in Far Payit in Maztica . The city was once a thriving metropolis but by the mid – 14th century was inhabited by only a fraction of the people who once lived there . The inhabitants , the Itza s , lived in wooden huts and had allowed the jungle to reclaim many of the great stone buildings . In 1362 DR , the city was overrun by Darien ' s army of giant ants and the inhabitants were forced to flee the city . Tulom - Itzi was ruled by Zochimaloc until he sacrificed himself to stop Darien .

title: Tulrun
description: Tulrun Tulrun of the Tent ( pronounced " TULL - run " ) was an uthgardt weretiger archmage who was , for a time , cursed into the form of a tiefling . Description . When Tulrun was a weretiger , he was tall and powerfully built , with pale skin that was covered in fine red and white hairs , striped like a tiger ' s .
description_long: Tulrun Tulrun of the Tent ( pronounced " TULL - run " ) was an uthgardt weretiger archmage who was , for a time , cursed into the form of a tiefling . Description . When Tulrun was a weretiger , he was tall and powerfully built , with pale skin that was covered in fine red and white hairs , striped like a tiger ' s . He had bright blue eyes , and wore his red hair long and unkempt with a red goatee beard that stretched beyond his chest . When he was a tiefling , Tulrun was instead a short , slender man with fine features , red scaly skin and short white hair . His hands had turned into talons . He tended to wear a thick , wolfskin jacket and bearskin leggings along with a woollen kilt . He was most often seen bearing a roughly hewn ironwood staff shaped like a large cat , a necklace of totems and a pair of mithral bracers in the shape of tiger ' s heads with sapphire s for eyes . Personality . Tulrun was bad tempered , argumentative and uncooperative but had occasional bouts of friendliness and cheerfulness . He avoided people when he could , never truly having escaped the distrust of civilisation inherent to his ancestors .

title: Tulrun ' s Tent
description: Tulrun ' s Tent Tulrun ' s Tent was a magical dwelling found in the Cold Wood . Structure . From the outside , it looked like a colorful silk tent perched on top a plain wooden platform held on five thin wooden legs about 30 ft ( 9 .
description_long: Tulrun ' s Tent Tulrun ' s Tent was a magical dwelling found in the Cold Wood . Structure . From the outside , it looked like a colorful silk tent perched on top a plain wooden platform held on five thin wooden legs about 30 ft ( 9 . 14 m ) up . While it could walk , the tent often flew when requested by Tulrun . Description . Wanderers entering the tent became lost in an extradimensional labyrinth of stairs , rooms and corridors composed of glowing white mist . Tulrun was using several detection spells to understand the real intentions of the intruders . Inhabitants . Tulrun preferred to stay alone to create new spell s , but occasionally intervened in aid of needy adventurers . He was an expert in creating construct s , including three beautiful servants which had beautiful female likenesses , but really were realistic constructs . Caere , Elsara and Tionele . Despite they were similar to flesh golem , they hadn ' t the same tendency to go berserk during fights . Tulrun planned a system to establish a means to link all three of his creations to himself as if they were familiar s .

title: Tumblestone River
description: Tumblestone River The Tumblestone River was a narrow river that originated in the hills north of the village of Arnglar in the Border Kingdoms and flowed roughly northeast through the realms of Middle Mukshar and Nether Mukshar until it reached the shores of the Lake of Steam , a total course of approximately 60 miles .
description_long: Tumblestone River The Tumblestone River was a narrow river that originated in the hills north of the village of Arnglar in the Border Kingdoms and flowed roughly northeast through the realms of Middle Mukshar and Nether Mukshar until it reached the shores of the Lake of Steam , a total course of approximately 60 miles .

title: Tumen River
description: Tumen River The Tumen River was a river in the kingdom of Koryo in Kara - Tur . Geography . Beginning with two tributaries in the Vorkani Mountains , the Tumen River ran between the mountains and the Naktong Moors , and flowing into the Sea of Kozakura near Konang Pen .
description_long: Tumen River The Tumen River was a river in the kingdom of Koryo in Kara - Tur . Geography . Beginning with two tributaries in the Vorkani Mountains , the Tumen River ran between the mountains and the Naktong Moors , and flowing into the Sea of Kozakura near Konang Pen . It formed the border between the Koryoan kingdoms of Silla in the north and Koguryo in the south . History . In 1357 DR , villages along the Tumen River were being attacked and even destroyed by giant snake s . The villagers grew desperate for aid .

title: Tun Hayal
description: Tun Hayal Tun Hayal was the owner of the Merchant ' s Home in Huzuz in 1367 DR . Activities . Though he owned the most splendid in all of the City of Delights , Tun was rarely found within his establishment .
description_long: Tun Hayal Tun Hayal was the owner of the Merchant ' s Home in Huzuz in 1367 DR . Activities . Though he owned the most splendid in all of the City of Delights , Tun was rarely found within his establishment . He preferred to leave the operation of his business into the hands of trusted servants .

title: Tun Marshes
description: Tun Marshes The Tun Marshes , also called the Marsh of Tun , was a swamp lying in the Tunlands between the Sunset Mountains and the Stormhorns east of Cormyr in interior Faerûn . Geography . Originating in the Farsea Marshes , the Tun River flowed south with few bends .
description_long: Tun Marshes The Tun Marshes , also called the Marsh of Tun , was a swamp lying in the Tunlands between the Sunset Mountains and the Stormhorns east of Cormyr in interior Faerûn . Geography . Originating in the Farsea Marshes , the Tun River flowed south with few bends . The middle portion of the Tun River bogged down into the low and densely vegetated Tun Marshes . Inhabitants . The region was home to many creatures both magical and mundane . But unlike the northern Farsea Marshes , the Tun Marshes were not populated by the same races of sentient beings . Instead , it was home to the black dragon s who laired there and the various lizardfolk tribes . Few reputable humans called it home . Those who did were the Tun Bandits . The Tun Marshes held a substantial bandit population in the mid – 14th century DR , last recorded at or around 1000 bandits . The bandits , mostly human in racial identity , were outlawed refugees fleeing the justice of Cormyr .

title: Tunaster Dranik
description: Tunaster Dranik Tunaster Dranik was a male Chondathan human cleric of Mystra who wandered Cormyr in 1374 DR . History . Tunaster was an itinerant cleric of Mystra who journeyed in search of old magic .
description_long: Tunaster Dranik Tunaster Dranik was a male Chondathan human cleric of Mystra who wandered Cormyr in 1374 DR . History . Tunaster was an itinerant cleric of Mystra who journeyed in search of old magic . On his travels , he set foot in dusty tombs and perilous ruins . Once he even came across the lair of a lich , but went around it . He ' d been an Mystran priest for a long time , stayed in regular contact , and was in good standing . In the month of Eleint in the Year of Lightning Storms , 1374 DR , he stopped at the town of Wheloon in Cormyr , where a new temple to the Lady of Mysteries had just opened . Tunaster was astonished : there were no other temples to Mystra in the realm , and he ' d heard nothing about it from fellow priests , nor of the Lady of Mystery Naedaenya Arthas who managed it . Delighted nonetheless , he went to visit and ask about it . However , the local clerics gave him a frosty reception , barring him from the inner areas and keeping him waiting for an hour for an audience with Arthas . In the end , he was met by Starweaver Deinyn Fembrys . Something about him looked so strange and off to his eyes that Tunaster turned and fled from the temple .

title: Tunfer
description: Tunfer Tunfer the Stout was a male human cleric who resided in Dagger Falls and advised Lord Randal Morn . Abilities . As an experienced cleric , Tunfer could pray for spell s capable of raising the dead , if needed .
description_long: Tunfer Tunfer the Stout was a male human cleric who resided in Dagger Falls and advised Lord Randal Morn . Abilities . As an experienced cleric , Tunfer could pray for spell s capable of raising the dead , if needed . Activities . Besides his duties as a priest of Tyr at the Temple of Tyr in Dagger Falls , Tunfer would also counsel Lord Randal Morn . During the occupation of Daggerdale by the Zhent s , Tunfer displayed talent with the healing arts and would regularly tend to wounded soldiers . History . By 1368 DR , Tunfer the Stout was a firm ally of Randal Morn and worked as a trusted advisor to the Lord . The priest of Tyr would help the wounded freedom fighters of Daggerdale that still fought against the dale ' s Zhent rulership . After Randal Morn had reclaimed Dagger Falls and assumed his place as its ruler once again , Tunfer the Stout eventually became a resident of the town . In 1372 DR , Tunfer was arguably the most experienced cleric in Dagger Falls and was still one of Randal Morn ' s closest counselors .

title: Tunlands
description: Tunlands The Tunlands was an appellation given by many Cormytes to the area between the Storm Horns and the Sunset Mountains . Claimed as part of Cormyr due to its proximity to that nation , the region was more accurately owned by various tribes of human s and humanoid s . Dominated by the Farsea Marshes and the Tun Marshes , the Tunlands were wet and humid with very few settlements of any significant size .
description_long: Tunlands The Tunlands was an appellation given by many Cormytes to the area between the Storm Horns and the Sunset Mountains . Claimed as part of Cormyr due to its proximity to that nation , the region was more accurately owned by various tribes of human s and humanoid s . Dominated by the Farsea Marshes and the Tun Marshes , the Tunlands were wet and humid with very few settlements of any significant size . The Tunlands were once part of the massive forest of " Arcorar " , in particular the area was known by the elves as the Gods ' Theater due the shape of the surrounding mountains . It was the site of one of the bloodiest battles of all the Crown wars - the Battle of the Gods ' Theater wherein over 70 , 000 elves were killed when the forces of Aryvandaar and Shantel Othreier were both attacked by a massive orc horde . After the fall of Shanatar , the Tunlands ( or at least the tunnels underneath it ) were the location of the relatively short - lived dwarven realm of Oghrann . Evidence exists of an ancient civilization / civilizations that predates elven recorded history in the area .

title: Tural
description: Tural Tural was a young inhabitant of the village of Toralth in Tethyr in 1370 DR . Description . Tural looked almost exactly like a younger version of his father Tadaz .
description_long: Tural Tural was a young inhabitant of the village of Toralth in Tethyr in 1370 DR . Description . Tural looked almost exactly like a younger version of his father Tadaz . He was left - handed . Possessions . Tural was given his grandfather ' s sword as a gift from his father . History . In 1370 DR , he decided to head off to join Tethyr ' s new army at Riatavin . On Uktar 10 , the morning before he was to leave , his father Tadaz went with Tural and Tadaz ' s best friend Ondar to the Blue Badger Inn in order to send him off . Tural , however , was more interested in the barmaid , Skie . That night , three dwarves , Bapar Ghalmrin , Odak Truesteel , and Soram Battlebellow , entered the tavern seeking the " Sondarr Scepter " . When Bramas Thorntree accused some of the other patrons of stealing it , this triggered a tavern brawl . Tural was one of the ones who tried to separate and calm the brawlers .

title: Turam min Kor
description: Turam min Kor Turam min Kor was a priest of the Golden Mosque in Huzuz , the City of Delights , in 1367 DR . Activities . Though Imam Renn min Zann held the title of Keeper of the Mosques , Turam shared much of the workload .
description_long: Turam min Kor Turam min Kor was a priest of the Golden Mosque in Huzuz , the City of Delights , in 1367 DR . Activities . Though Imam Renn min Zann held the title of Keeper of the Mosques , Turam shared much of the workload . He selected who would be allowed to preach within the Golden Mosque on a daily basis . He tried to be fair in his selections and anyone who was turned down six days in a row would be allowed to preach on the seventh day should they return .

title: Turami
description: Turami The Turami were an ethnic group of humans who made up the primary population of Turmish . Description . Turami had flat faces with mahogany skin tones .
description_long: Turami The Turami were an ethnic group of humans who made up the primary population of Turmish . Description . Turami had flat faces with mahogany skin tones . Their hair was curly , and they tended towards muscular and tall builds . Language . Turmic was the language of the Turami . They employed the Thorass alphabet in their writings , which they learned from trade with the Calishite s and Chondathan s . History . The Turami were native to the region around the Alamber Sea , but they were displaced by the migrating Mulan tribes after the fall of Imaskar in −2488 DR . They came to settle in the area around Alaghôn and founded the nation of Turmish in −37 DR . Rumors & Legends . The Methwood was said to contain the ruins of a city of the Turami from the time of Imaskar .

title: Turbaern
description: Turbaern Turbaern was one of the dwarves who would found the kingdom of Roldilar in the Vast in north Faerûn in the 7th century DR . Turbaern was a priest of Clangeddin Silverbeard , holding the highest position of the faith , High Old One , and the personal title " Blood Axe of Clangeddin " . In the early 7th century , Turbaern enchanted over a thousand weapons forged from orcslayer metal by Master Smith Fyrfar Smokebeard over several years at the order of Deep King Tuir Stonebeard , in their mission to destroy the orc realm of Vastar .
description_long: Turbaern Turbaern was one of the dwarves who would found the kingdom of Roldilar in the Vast in north Faerûn in the 7th century DR . Turbaern was a priest of Clangeddin Silverbeard , holding the highest position of the faith , High Old One , and the personal title " Blood Axe of Clangeddin " . In the early 7th century , Turbaern enchanted over a thousand weapons forged from orcslayer metal by Master Smith Fyrfar Smokebeard over several years at the order of Deep King Tuir Stonebeard , in their mission to destroy the orc realm of Vastar . Turbaern was assisted by the human mage Beldossan the Short and the elven sorceress Aleratha Ilnatar . Among these was the short sword " Sarghathuld " in the Year of the Many Serpents , 605 DR .

title: Turban of multiplication
description: Turban of multiplication Turbans of multiplication were magical items that could be found in Zakhara , the Land of Fate . They were only carried or used by holy slayer s . Description .
description_long: Turban of multiplication Turbans of multiplication were magical items that could be found in Zakhara , the Land of Fate . They were only carried or used by holy slayer s . Description . These turbans were available in a wide variety of colors and cloths . Powers . Once per day , the wearer of this turban could create " mirror image " s of himself or herself as if cast by a moderately powerful mage .

title: Turban of silence
description: Turban of silence Turbans of silence were magical item s that could be found in Zakhara , the Land of Fate . They were only used by holy slayer s . Powers .
description_long: Turban of silence Turbans of silence were magical item s that could be found in Zakhara , the Land of Fate . They were only used by holy slayer s . Powers . Three times per day the wearer of this turban could create a spherical region of silence exactly like the wizard spell " silence , 15 ' radius " . The silence could be dispelled at any time from a mental command by the wearer .

title: Turcassan
description: Turcassan Turcassan was a former noble house of Cormyr . It was situated beyond the Royal Gardens in Suzail , Cormyr . The house betrayed the Crown when Melineth Turcassan , in the king ' s absence , sold the city of Suzail to pirate s , although Jotor Turcassan remained loyal to the crown .
description_long: Turcassan Turcassan was a former noble house of Cormyr . It was situated beyond the Royal Gardens in Suzail , Cormyr . The house betrayed the Crown when Melineth Turcassan , in the king ' s absence , sold the city of Suzail to pirate s , although Jotor Turcassan remained loyal to the crown .

title: Turelve
description: Turelve Turelve was a large city in Durpar in the Shining Lands in 1367 DR . Geography . Situated at the mouth of the River Ssarren on the west end of the Golden Water , Turelve was a major launching point for caravans heading north or west out of Durpar .
description_long: Turelve Turelve was a large city in Durpar in the Shining Lands in 1367 DR . Geography . Situated at the mouth of the River Ssarren on the west end of the Golden Water , Turelve was a major launching point for caravans heading north or west out of Durpar . Its close proximity to Veldorn made this a dangerous place to live . Description . Turelve was home to 30 , 000 residents , making it one of the larger cities within the Shining Lands . Defenses . In order to guard against threats from Veldorn , Turelve maintained a force of 2 , 000 horsemen — the largest standing force for any city in Durpar . In addition to the horsemen , many halfling slingers manned the city walls . Caravans taxes were used to pay for many of these soldiers in return for a guarded escort well beyond the city . Though many grumbled about the tax , most caravan masters saw the wisdom of paying it .

title: Turg Zhuroth
description: Turg Zhuroth Turg Zhuroth was a member of the Xanathar Thieves ' Guild in Waterdeep around 1370 DR . Activities . Turg was a member of a party of Hands that wandered Waterdeep in search of possible slaves to kidnap .
description_long: Turg Zhuroth Turg Zhuroth was a member of the Xanathar Thieves ' Guild in Waterdeep around 1370 DR . Activities . Turg was a member of a party of Hands that wandered Waterdeep in search of possible slaves to kidnap . Usually , Turg and his fellows neutralized the victims with their sleep - poisoned weapons and transported them via Waterdeep ' s sewers to a secret entrance to Undermountain .

title: Turik Dumark
description: Turik Dumark Turik Dumark was a mage and bloodforge commander in the Utter East during the time of the Bloodforge Wars ( 648 – 657 DR ) . A dangerous mage , Turik Dumark attempted to ambush the Legendary Campaign forces on the road by Old Stone Keep . However , one of Dumark ' s scouts was captured , and the trap was revealed .
description_long: Turik Dumark Turik Dumark was a mage and bloodforge commander in the Utter East during the time of the Bloodforge Wars ( 648 – 657 DR ) . A dangerous mage , Turik Dumark attempted to ambush the Legendary Campaign forces on the road by Old Stone Keep . However , one of Dumark ' s scouts was captured , and the trap was revealed . The commander of the Legendary Campaign quickly tried to hunt down out Dumark .

title: Turlang
description: Turlang Turlang was a treant in the High Forest . With his companions , he oversaw the security of the ruins of Hellgate Keep by refusing to let anyone in or out , but he was aware that evil was still present , sealed beneath the ruins , and was wary of its escape .
description_long: Turlang Turlang was a treant in the High Forest . With his companions , he oversaw the security of the ruins of Hellgate Keep by refusing to let anyone in or out , but he was aware that evil was still present , sealed beneath the ruins , and was wary of its escape .

title: Turmic
description: Turmic Turmish was the language of the Turami people and the official tongue of Turmish . Speakers . Besides in the nation of Turmish , Turmic was spoken by folk living in Chessenta , Cormyr , Impiltur , Sembia , Thesk , the Vast , the Vilhon Reach , the Western Heartlands , and along the Dragon Coast .
description_long: Turmic Turmish was the language of the Turami people and the official tongue of Turmish . Speakers . Besides in the nation of Turmish , Turmic was spoken by folk living in Chessenta , Cormyr , Impiltur , Sembia , Thesk , the Vast , the Vilhon Reach , the Western Heartlands , and along the Dragon Coast . Script . Turmic employed the Thorass alphabet , which the Turami learned from trade with the Chondathan s and Calishite s . History . Turmic was a lone branch of the Thorass language family . Examples . Common Turmic names for women included Balama , Dona , Faila , Jalana , Luisa , Marta , Quara , Selise , and Vonda . Turmic names for males included Anton , Diero , Marcon , Pieron , Rimardo , Romero , Salazar , and Umbero . Common Turmic surnames were Agosto , Astorio , Calabra , Domine , Falone , Marivaldi , Pisacar , and Ramondo .

title: Turmish
description: Turmish Turmish is a republic with the capital of Alaghôn , and is located in the north of the Vilhon Reach . The approximately 1 , 700 , 000 inhabitants are mainly humans , most of whom are Turami , but dwarves are common as well , along side minorities of halflings , elves , gnomes , half - elves and half - orcs . Turmish is known throughout the Sea of Fallen Stars as the " heartland of the Reach " due to its peaceful nature and concentration on commerce over warfare .
description_long: Turmish Turmish is a republic with the capital of Alaghôn , and is located in the north of the Vilhon Reach . The approximately 1 , 700 , 000 inhabitants are mainly humans , most of whom are Turami , but dwarves are common as well , along side minorities of halflings , elves , gnomes , half - elves and half - orcs . Turmish is known throughout the Sea of Fallen Stars as the " heartland of the Reach " due to its peaceful nature and concentration on commerce over warfare . Its capital , Alaghôn , serves as the most popular port - of - call along the southern fringes of the Inner Sea . Politics . Officially , Turmish is ruled by the Assembly of Stars , a group of freely elected men and women chosen from the everyday population of the region . Each serves a term of three years before another election brings a fresh group of Turmishans into political life . This keeps " professional politicians " to a bare minimum , since the decision to run for office is not a personal choice to make , but rather the decision of one ' s peers . ( That is not to say that the decision to elect someone to public office cannot be political . ) The job of an assemblyman is not easy .

title: Turmish Brick
description: Turmish Brick Turmish Brick was a cheese crafted in Turmish . It was also sold through Aurora ' s Whole Realms Catalogue . Description .
description_long: Turmish Brick Turmish Brick was a cheese crafted in Turmish . It was also sold through Aurora ' s Whole Realms Catalogue . Description . Heavy red wine lent this crumbly cheese its color . Unlike the wine used to make it , this cheese traveled well and was popular as far away as Neverwinter . Prices . Turmish Brick could be purchased in the following sizes :

title: Turn bin Trevor
description: Turn bin Trevor Turn bin Trevor , formerly known as Turon Daysender was a male human fighter from Waterdeep who came to Zakhara . He was Jayani al - Jasir ' s consort as of 1367 DR . Description .
description_long: Turn bin Trevor Turn bin Trevor , formerly known as Turon Daysender was a male human fighter from Waterdeep who came to Zakhara . He was Jayani al - Jasir ' s consort as of 1367 DR . Description . Turn was a handsome young outlander in Zakhara . Relationships . Turn gained the attentions and affections of Jayani al - Jasir and enjoyed life as her romantic consort . History . Turn was originally from Waterdeep where he was called Turon Daysender . Turn sailed all across the coastlines of the Realms , eventually settling in the Corsair Domains of Zakhara . Jayani planned to use him to help extend her holdings beyond the Land of Fate .

title: Turn undead
description: Turn undead Turn undead is a " channel divinity " prayer cast by nearly all cleric s . When a cleric casts " turn undead " he or she pushes any undead within a nearby area of five feet in radius back at least fifteen feet , perhaps further depending on the cleric ' s strength of personality . Undead caught in the blast are momentarily paralyzed or , at the very least , seared by the severe light of the prayer .
description_long: Turn undead Turn undead is a " channel divinity " prayer cast by nearly all cleric s . When a cleric casts " turn undead " he or she pushes any undead within a nearby area of five feet in radius back at least fifteen feet , perhaps further depending on the cleric ' s strength of personality . Undead caught in the blast are momentarily paralyzed or , at the very least , seared by the severe light of the prayer .

title: Turning Key
description: Turning Key The Turning Key was an adventuring company . Description . The Turning Key consisted entirely of female thieves and bard s .
description_long: Turning Key The Turning Key was an adventuring company . Description . The Turning Key consisted entirely of female thieves and bard s . They were always joking and playing pranks , and generally merry . Base . The women of the Key made their happy home at the House of the Key in Tavilar in the Vast . It was a rambling old place in need of continual maintenance when they inhabited it . History . The ladies of the Turning Key went adventuring on some far plane but suffered disaster , losing several of their number . After that , the few survivors chose to retire , but rather than return together to the House of the Key where they ' d been happy together , they went their separate ways , to Berdusk , Neverwinter and Waterdeep . They never returned to Tavilar or the House of the Key , and the old building collapsed . Locals of Tavilar claimed that the Turning Key had been quite wealthy , and that their treasure must still be hidden somewhere in the area . Many times , other adventurers poked through the ruins of the House of the Key , turning up nothing more than decayed furniture and finery . The last survivor was Satcheera Moonfist .

title: Turnshadow
description: Turnshadow Turnshadow was an arcane abjuration spell that could cause fear in illusory shadow monsters . It could also be used to take control of one such creature away from its summoner . Effects .
description_long: Turnshadow Turnshadow was an arcane abjuration spell that could cause fear in illusory shadow monsters . It could also be used to take control of one such creature away from its summoner . Effects . This spell was effective against quasi - real illusions created by the " shadow monsters " , " demi - shadow monsters " , and " shades " spells . When cast on a 40 - ft ( 12 - m ) square area up to 60 yd ( 55 m ) away , all such creatures fled in panic as quickly as they were able for a number of minutes related to the caster ' s level . Once the spell wore off , they could return if they were able . When " turnshadow " was directed at a single shadow monster , it had one chance to resist the magic of this spell . If it succeeded , then nothing happened , but if it failed it came under the control of the caster . The caster was then free to pick a new target for its attack , including the mage who originally summoned the monster . Once " turnshadow " expired , the controlled shadow monster was banished back to the Plane of Shadow . Components . Only verbal and somatic components were required to cast this spell . History .

title: Turnstone Pass
description: Turnstone Pass Turnstone Pass was a valley in the Nether Mountains . Description . The region had a bad reputation .
description_long: Turnstone Pass Turnstone Pass was a valley in the Nether Mountains . Description . The region had a bad reputation . According to some rumors , the area was infested by daemonfey , Fey ' ri and half - fiend s of House Dlardrageth . History . Around 872 DR , the road from Sundabar to Ascalhorn wound its way through the pass . By 1372 DR , the valley was mostly wilderness .

title: Turquoise
description: Turquoise Turquoise was generally found in the more arid locations around Toril . Description . This ornamental stone was an opaque blue to greenish - blue , and usually occurred with blotches of darker hues in the mix .
description_long: Turquoise Turquoise was generally found in the more arid locations around Toril . Description . This ornamental stone was an opaque blue to greenish - blue , and usually occurred with blotches of darker hues in the mix . A typical stone had a base value of 10 gp . Turquoise stones were considered sacred by followers of Aerdrie Faenya and Erevan Ilesere — appropriate for sacrifice , or to be consecrated for use , or recognized as boons or omens when found . Powers . Elves valued the pure color stones ( without the darker mottling ) for casting sky - related magic and mage s used turquoise in the creation of items related to flight . It was also used as a good luck charm by horsemen who would put a small shard of turquoise in their horse ' s harness to ward off misstep or trail hazards . Turquoise had a slight gleam when it came near gold and was therefore associated with prosperity . Foredawn was the best time of day to apply an immersion containing turquoise .

title: Turritella
description: Turritella Turritella was an agate made up of many small fossilized shell s . Description . The shells were spiral and cone - shaped , less than an inch ( two and a half centimeters ) long .
description_long: Turritella Turritella was an agate made up of many small fossilized shell s . Description . The shells were spiral and cone - shaped , less than an inch ( two and a half centimeters ) long . The rock substrate was a dark brown . It was quarried in slabs and could be used instead of marble for facings or it was cut for inlay work . A typical price was 8 sp per pound ( 18 sp / kg ) . Powers . It was believed this hardstone had magical properties , but it is unknown if they were ever discovered .

title: Turvy
description: Turvy Turvy was a deep gnome wererat living in the Underdark with his twin Topsy during the Rage of Demons . Personality . The gnome was very close to his twin Topsy .
description_long: Turvy Turvy was a deep gnome wererat living in the Underdark with his twin Topsy during the Rage of Demons . Personality . The gnome was very close to his twin Topsy . He was constantly blabbering and muttering darkly and his brother translated for him . They feared that someone would discover that they were novice wererat s who couldn ' t easily control their instincts . History . Topsy and Turvy lived in Blingdenstone . During the Rage of Demons , they were infected with lycanthropy . Later , during a trip to collect some mushrooms , he and his twin were captured by drow slavers of Velkynvelve .

title: Tusk
description: Tusk Tusk was a fiendish elephant and the favorite pet of Kurgoth Hellspawn during the invasion of Maerimydra in 1372 DR . Description . Typically outfitted in chainmail barding and metal blades along its tusks , it was an enormous war elephant .
description_long: Tusk Tusk was a fiendish elephant and the favorite pet of Kurgoth Hellspawn during the invasion of Maerimydra in 1372 DR . Description . Typically outfitted in chainmail barding and metal blades along its tusks , it was an enormous war elephant . Larger than other elephants , Tusk was covered in an unusual scaly hide . Personality . Fearsome and battle - hardened , Tusk could strike fear into even ogre s when it was roused to battle . Abilities . Immensely strong and with fiendish resistances to ordinary weapons , the elements , and even magic , Tusk was not easily overpowered . In addition , its heritage gave Tusk intellect far surpassing others of its kind , which enabled it to ably serve its master . Possessions . When outfitted for war , Tusk wore chainmail barding and had wicked blades affixed to its tusks . Relationships . Tusk was the companion and pet of Kugoth Hellspawn . Although Kurgoth took great pleasure in watching Tusk fight he never hesitated to leap to Tusk ' s defense should the elephant be outmatched . History . In 1372 DR , Tusk was part of Kurgoth Hellspawn ' s invasion force when the half - fiend fire giant attacked the drow city of Maerimydra .

title: Tuth
description: Tuth Tuth was a member of the Shield Council of the Knights of the Shield in 1370 DR . History . Tuth in his early days was an adventurer on the Sword Coast , sacking temples at the bidding of enemy churches .
description_long: Tuth Tuth was a member of the Shield Council of the Knights of the Shield in 1370 DR . History . Tuth in his early days was an adventurer on the Sword Coast , sacking temples at the bidding of enemy churches . At last , Tuth managed to kill a green dragon and seized its hoard ( although he only poisoned the dragon in its sleep ) . Tuth invested the hoard in business and gained even more money , enough to join the Knights of the Shield . However , he heavily invested in the colony of Fort Flame in Maztica , losing a great deal of money as a result . It was only with the Knights ' support that he avoided bankruptcy . Tuth was invited to join the Shield Council , but for an evil purpose . Hhune and Ghauntz intended to use Tuth as a scapegoat before the council , blaming him for any major and noticeable deeds ordered by the Hidden Lord

title: Tutugnik
description: Tutugnik Tutugnik was a bugbear king living in Gauntlgrym in 1463 DR . History . Tutugnik was the king of a tribe of bugbears , orc s , and goblin s living in Gauntlgrym in 1463 DR when an army of House Xorlarrin arrived .
description_long: Tutugnik Tutugnik was a bugbear king living in Gauntlgrym in 1463 DR . History . Tutugnik was the king of a tribe of bugbears , orc s , and goblin s living in Gauntlgrym in 1463 DR when an army of House Xorlarrin arrived . After brief fighting , Tutugnik and most of the goblinoids were captured by the drow . Ravel Xorlarrin offered Tutugnik the chance to remain leader of his tribe under the drow ' s authority , but the bugbear understood that they would all only be slaves and refused . Ravel quickly killed Tutugnik and decided to purge all of Tutugnik ' s loyalists while the others would live as slaves .

title: Twelfth Serôs War
description: Twelfth Serôs War The Twelfth Serôs War was the major event in the Sea of Fallen Stars of the 1 , 439 year of Timesong ( 1369 DR ) . It involved the destruction brought by Iakhovas the Ravager , a great shark . History .
description_long: Twelfth Serôs War The Twelfth Serôs War was the major event in the Sea of Fallen Stars of the 1 , 439 year of Timesong ( 1369 DR ) . It involved the destruction brought by Iakhovas the Ravager , a great shark . History . The war officially began on Eldasong 21 when Iakhovas and his sahuagin demolished a large portion of the Sharksbane Wall and destroyed Akhanmyr . Iakhovas soon allied with the morkoth of Olleth , the merfolk of Thurindru , and the koalinth of the Sea Hulks tribe . They attacked the Xedran Reefs . In response , morkoth from Qatoris allied with shalarin from Es ' rath , triton s from Vuuvax , and merfolk from Voalidru . Sahuagin caused the death of over 1 , 000 unhatched shalarin in Es ' rath , which enraged all the shalarin of As ' arem and brought them into the war as well . Iakhovas next used magic to turn the entire population of the Whamite Isles into zombies to fight for him . Avina , Lacuan , and Voalidru soon fell . In revenge , ixitxachitl s from the Xedran Reefs annihilated three - quarters of the koalinth army . The allied good races , known as the Nantarn Alliance rallied at Xadea and Myth Nantar .

title: Twelvefold
description: Twelvefold The Twelvefold were a coalition of noble families who had great renown and influence in Gontal . The common folk considered the families of the Twelvefold to be the true rulers of Gontal , although this wasn ' t actually true . Background .
description_long: Twelvefold The Twelvefold were a coalition of noble families who had great renown and influence in Gontal . The common folk considered the families of the Twelvefold to be the true rulers of Gontal , although this wasn ' t actually true . Background . The families of the Twelvefold were the twelve most richest noble families of Gontal . It included the Clargannuth , Elkannath , Garrandar , Imrilsar , Keldorn , and Morlith families , among others . They held great political influence in Gontal , specially in Gontal City , were common folk believed the Twelvefold families held incontable treasures in their manors and vaults , and were the true power behind the throne . They controlled most of the commerce in Gontal , as well as many illegal activities . However , they actually didn ' t had the political influence people believed they had . Although the families of the Twelvefold were supposed to be allied , they also plotted against each other and vied for power , making it impossible for any family to really influence Queen Imreera Hethkantan .

title: Twice as Nice
description: Twice as Nice Twice as Nice was a shop in the Sea Ward of Waterdeep . Structure . Located off the Street of Lances , the building was in a constant state of disrepair .
description_long: Twice as Nice Twice as Nice was a shop in the Sea Ward of Waterdeep . Structure . Located off the Street of Lances , the building was in a constant state of disrepair . In the basement , there was a wooden door leading to a gate to Wyllowwood in Undermountain .

title: Twilight Falling
description: Twilight Falling Twilight Falling is the first book in the The Erevis Cale Trilogy by Paul S . Kemp . Erevis Cale Origins .
description_long: Twilight Falling Twilight Falling is the first book in the The Erevis Cale Trilogy by Paul S . Kemp . Erevis Cale Origins . Resurrection ( short story ) . Part of the book The Halls of Stormweather , it introduces Erevis Cale . Shadow ' s Witness . Second book of the series , continuing the story of Erevis Cale , started in " Resurrection " . Soulbound ( short story ) . Part of the anthology Realms of the Dragons , it has been collected in the Erevis Cale trilogy Omnibus .

title: Twilight Knight
description: Twilight Knight The Twilight Knight was a vampire and the most mysterious member of the Night Masters , the cabal of vampires who led the Night Masks . Description . The Twilight Knight always wore a mask modeled after a skull and no one except for Orbakh knew his true appearance .
description_long: Twilight Knight The Twilight Knight was a vampire and the most mysterious member of the Night Masters , the cabal of vampires who led the Night Masks . Description . The Twilight Knight always wore a mask modeled after a skull and no one except for Orbakh knew his true appearance . History . The Twilight Knight was supposed by Phultan Hammerwand to be a former paladin of Lathander who lost his faith during the Time of Troubles , his lust for power causing the order to banish him . All of this was only conjecture and Hammerwand never did confirm the story and so spoke to no one until he could provide clear proof . Despite his mysterious history , the Twilight Knight proved himself very competent as leader of the guild ' s enforcers and was also responsible for blackmail and extortion operations . He also dealt with all cases of treason inside the guild and had never failed to discover traitors .

title: Twilight Riders
description: Twilight Riders The Twilight Riders were a recently formed vigilante organization in Damara in 1359 DR . Organization . The Riders were a group of heroes gathered by the wizard Emelyn the Gray .
description_long: Twilight Riders The Twilight Riders were a recently formed vigilante organization in Damara in 1359 DR . Organization . The Riders were a group of heroes gathered by the wizard Emelyn the Gray . They used seven magical steeds created using the last light of day by the former Red Wizard Myrddin Viligoth . They went around south Damara in search of wrongs needing righting and acted as emissaries of King Gareth Dragonsbane , spreading the idea of the new Bloodstone Kingdom . The Riders concerned themselves with both little deeds and great exploits . Despite this , all the Riders worked very well together . Members . The members of the group were : History . Emelyn , with the help of Myrddin Viligoth , started the Twilight Riders in only 1359 DR . However , in a few weeks , they proved very efficient in helping the common people of Damara in their problems . Emelyn decided to head for the town of Tellerth , hoping to learn more about Rawlinswood ' s druids and centaur s .

title: Twilight Traders
description: Twilight Traders The Twilight Traders were a coalition of merchants who did business with the people of the Underdark . Their business was secretive and membership was closely guarded , there being only six members . New members were approved by the existing members and also the denizens of the Underdark .
