description_long: Twilight Traders The Twilight Traders were a coalition of merchants who did business with the people of the Underdark . Their business was secretive and membership was closely guarded , there being only six members . New members were approved by the existing members and also the denizens of the Underdark . They operated from the underground city of Mantol - Derith .

title: Twilight Vale
description: Twilight Vale The Twilight Vale was a mystical valley far to the north of Faerûn that only existed when the shadow of Othea Tor fell upon it . It was the location of the citadel of Voninheim , one of the last strongholds of the great Ostoria n Empire . Description .
description_long: Twilight Vale The Twilight Vale was a mystical valley far to the north of Faerûn that only existed when the shadow of Othea Tor fell upon it . It was the location of the citadel of Voninheim , one of the last strongholds of the great Ostoria n Empire . Description . The Twilight Vale was a barren valley located on the northern edge of the Ice Spires , within the Bleak Plain . It was a deep fissure full of purple gloom . Its borders were precisely in the shape of the shadow of Othea Tor . The walls of the fissure were black like slate and were well over a hundred feet in height . The burial drumlins of the fathers of the giants — Vilmos , Nicias , Obadai , Ottar , Masud , and Ruk — were found around the Vale . Since the valley only came into existence when the sun fell behind Othea Tor , it was perpetually in twilight . When not in the shadow of Othea Tor , only a dagger - wide rift appeared on the ground . Strange omens and apparitions were often seen in or near the valley , which had been known to drive some people mad . Defenses . The giants living in the Ice Spires North would defend the valley against intruders . History .

title: Twin Paradises
description: Twin Paradises The Twin Paradises of Bytopia were two layers that formed one of the Outer Planes in the Great Wheel cosmology model representing alignments between lawful good and neutral good . Some characteristics of this plane were ascribed to the World Tree cosmology planes of Golden Hills and the House of the Triad when that cosmology became popular . The Golden Hills became part of Arvandor after the Spellplague and the House of the Triad became known as Celestia as described by the World Axis cosmology .
description_long: Twin Paradises The Twin Paradises of Bytopia were two layers that formed one of the Outer Planes in the Great Wheel cosmology model representing alignments between lawful good and neutral good . Some characteristics of this plane were ascribed to the World Tree cosmology planes of Golden Hills and the House of the Triad when that cosmology became popular . The Golden Hills became part of Arvandor after the Spellplague and the House of the Triad became known as Celestia as described by the World Axis cosmology . Description . The two layers of this plane were joined at one barrier which happened to span the entire sky at about 10 miles ( 16km ) above sea level . Gravity for each layer was normal for that layer but switched direction as soon as one crossed the barrier . The inhabitants of one layer could look up and see the other layer hanging upside down high overhead . Several mountains reached the crossover point and a few met mountains rising up from the other side , allowing careful climbers a way to reach the other layer . Also the space between layers was filled with air , allowing flight from one side to the other . Each layer glowed with a golden - white light . Dothion .

title: Twin Towers of the Eternal Eclipse
description: Twin Towers of the Eternal Eclipse The Twin Towers of the Eternal Eclipse were a pair of towers hidden high in the Small Teeth mountains , one on each side of the Trade Way . Location . The towers were about 5 mi ( 8 km ) apart , deep in the highest peaks of the Small Teeth Mountains between Amn and Muranndin .
description_long: Twin Towers of the Eternal Eclipse The Twin Towers of the Eternal Eclipse were a pair of towers hidden high in the Small Teeth mountains , one on each side of the Trade Way . Location . The towers were about 5 mi ( 8 km ) apart , deep in the highest peaks of the Small Teeth Mountains between Amn and Muranndin . The towers were almost completely obscured from view , even from above . Structure . Each tower was five stories tall and they were connected by a twisting underground passage . Inhabitants . As of 1370 DR , Blackwill Haarken Akhmelere was in charge of the church of Cyric congregation . History . Originally temples dedicated to Bane , cyricists conquered the towers in 1362 DR and rededicated them to the worship of Cyric . In 1373 DR The Sojourner destroyed the western tower to get at the magical granite it was made out of .

title: Twin Visages
description: Twin Visages The Twin Visages are a site at the northern coast of Payit and a landmark for the people from Faerûn which shows them that they will soon arrive at the safe harbor of Helmsport . It consists of two faces looking to the east and cut into a high cliff . One shows a woman , the other a man and it is said that they were built to look for the return of the god Qotal who left the True World for the east a long time ago .
description_long: Twin Visages The Twin Visages are a site at the northern coast of Payit and a landmark for the people from Faerûn which shows them that they will soon arrive at the safe harbor of Helmsport . It consists of two faces looking to the east and cut into a high cliff . One shows a woman , the other a man and it is said that they were built to look for the return of the god Qotal who left the True World for the east a long time ago . On top of the cliff stands also the ruin of a stone pyramid where only the altar is still in a good shape .

title: Twinkle
description: Twinkle Twinkle was Drizzt Do ' Urden ' s left - handed defensive scimitar forged by the elves of old . Description . Like all magical weapons , this " + 2 defending scimitar " had an enchantment that made the blade sharper and the weapon more likely to strike true .
description_long: Twinkle Twinkle was Drizzt Do ' Urden ' s left - handed defensive scimitar forged by the elves of old . Description . Like all magical weapons , this " + 2 defending scimitar " had an enchantment that made the blade sharper and the weapon more likely to strike true . This enchantment could be diverted in order to make the wielder better at parrying an opponent ' s blow . Twinkle had a star - cut azure sapphire on its pommel and when it detected danger nearby it softly glowed blue . It was partially empathic and could impart weak , base emotions upon its wielder . History . The blade was given to Drizzt by Malchor Harpell in 1356 DR , when the Companions of the Hall were chasing Artemis Entreri after he had kidnapped Regis . In Archmage , the sword is broken , and then repaired , but without the strong magic it formerly had . Later on , Catti - brie would combine the blade with another sword by using the Great Forge of Gauntlgrym . With the help of the Primordial guiding her , the act not only restored much of blade ' s former ability but also greatly improve its cutting edge and defensive power as well .

title: Twisted Rune
description: Twisted Rune The Twisted Rune was a highly secret cabal of lich es and other powerful undead spellcasters . The inner circle was highly secretive , and employed agents to do their bidding , most of whom were unaware that they worked for the Rune . By 1018 DR ( the Year of the Dracorage ) , the Rune had become the most powerful organization in southwestern Faerûn , with agents in every country south of the High Moor and west of the Storm Horn Mountains .
description_long: Twisted Rune The Twisted Rune was a highly secret cabal of lich es and other powerful undead spellcasters . The inner circle was highly secretive , and employed agents to do their bidding , most of whom were unaware that they worked for the Rune . By 1018 DR ( the Year of the Dracorage ) , the Rune had become the most powerful organization in southwestern Faerûn , with agents in every country south of the High Moor and west of the Storm Horn Mountains . The Rune secretly controlled nearly half the powerful families of Calimshan . However they rarely acted directly to achieve their goals , instead preferring to let time work for them since they were , in effect , immortal . The seven known Runemasters are : Jymahna , Kartak Spellseer , Priamon " Frostrune " Rakesk , Rhangaun , Sapphiraktar the Blue , Shangalar the Black , and Shyressa . The eighth Runemaster was Jhaniloth Puiral . Hierarchy . The original hierarchy of the organisation was a loose consortium of liches who each had their own networks of agents to do their bidding . This was unwieldy as the organisation grew , so the hierarchy was tightened .

title: Twisted Tower of Ashaba
description: Twisted Tower of Ashaba The Twisted Tower of Ashaba was the home and seat of power of the lord and lady of Shadowdale . The tower , originally known simply as the Twisted Tower , took its name from the first human lord of the dale , the water wizard Ashaba . History .
description_long: Twisted Tower of Ashaba The Twisted Tower of Ashaba was the home and seat of power of the lord and lady of Shadowdale . The tower , originally known simply as the Twisted Tower , took its name from the first human lord of the dale , the water wizard Ashaba . History . Drow began construction of the Twisted Tower drow in - 2600 DR , and was completed in - 2549 DR . It was retained by the drow , and expanded twice in the decades following - 750 DR . In - 331 DR , coronals Connak and Tannivh Irithyl broke through the Twisted Tower ' s defenses with their elf armies , and destroyed the drow within , although the drow captured the " Soldier ' s Blade " in the process . The tower was handed over to good dark elves , and became a temple to Eilistraee within a hundred years . This period lasted until 194 DR , when drow , rising from the Underdark , again took the Tower and restored it to a military garrison . Josidiah Starym , in his quest to reclaim the " Soldier ' s Blade " , caused the Tower to fall temporarily in 500 DR .

title: Two - Form Glacier
description: Two - Form Glacier The Two - Form Glacier was a large glacier locked within the peaks of an unknown mountain range near the monastery of Fatula Chupa in what was once the Kingdom of Guge . Geography . The glacier covered roughly 900 square miles ( 1450 sq .
description_long: Two - Form Glacier The Two - Form Glacier was a large glacier locked within the peaks of an unknown mountain range near the monastery of Fatula Chupa in what was once the Kingdom of Guge . Geography . The glacier covered roughly 900 square miles ( 1450 sq . km ) within the mountain range . Several small tributaries fed by glacial runoff flowed onto the plains from the north and northeastern portions of the glacier .

title: Two - bladed sword
description: Two - bladed sword A two - bladed sword , or double - sword , was an exotic , two - handed melee weapon that could be used as a double weapon . Description . The two - bladed sword was approximately the same length as a greatsword or a quarterstaff but had two short sword - sized blades at each end .
description_long: Two - bladed sword A two - bladed sword , or double - sword , was an exotic , two - handed melee weapon that could be used as a double weapon . Description . The two - bladed sword was approximately the same length as a greatsword or a quarterstaff but had two short sword - sized blades at each end . A typical two - bladed sword weighed 10 lbs . ( 4 . 5 kg ) . Cost & availability . An average two - bladed sword cost 100 gp . Weaponology . It took special training to wield a two - bladed sword effectively , and therefore it was viewed as an exotic weapon . The two - bladed sword was a double weapon that could be used as if fighting with two separate weapons and was wielded two - handed if used so . Notable two - bladed swords . A double - sword was wielded by the centaur hero Timoth Eyesbright around 1357 DR . Notably , this distinctive weapon was also extendable , the blades extending from the size of daggers to full - length swords when the weapon was whirled around .

title: Two Rocks
description: Two Rocks Two Rocks was a small rocky island in the harbor of Harrowdale Town ( later New Velar ) . As of 1368 DR , it was believed to be the location of hidden treasure , stored by pirates such as Urthag the Knife and the Masked Marquis , although up until that time , no treasure had been found there . As of 1368 DR , the Council of Seven Burghers , the ruling council of Harrowdale , were considering building a sea tower on the island to provide further defenses for the port , against the " one or two privateer night raids per season " that were endured at that time .
description_long: Two Rocks Two Rocks was a small rocky island in the harbor of Harrowdale Town ( later New Velar ) . As of 1368 DR , it was believed to be the location of hidden treasure , stored by pirates such as Urthag the Knife and the Masked Marquis , although up until that time , no treasure had been found there . As of 1368 DR , the Council of Seven Burghers , the ruling council of Harrowdale , were considering building a sea tower on the island to provide further defenses for the port , against the " one or two privateer night raids per season " that were endured at that time . It would have seen a bridge constructed from the island to the rocks known as the Shoulder . Although in 1368 DR , the idea of constructing a defensive tower was generally seen as good , it was notably opposed by the newest Burgher , the wizard Erethun Rivenstave , based on its proposed cost .

title: Tyaa Tymmyr
description: Tyaa Tymmyr Tyaa Tymmyr was an assassin of the Night Masks in 1370 DR . History . Tyaa was born in Daerlun as a scion of a merchant family and lived in wealth and privilege until a business partner of her father slaughtered all her family .
description_long: Tyaa Tymmyr Tyaa Tymmyr was an assassin of the Night Masks in 1370 DR . History . Tyaa was born in Daerlun as a scion of a merchant family and lived in wealth and privilege until a business partner of her father slaughtered all her family . Only Tyaay survived and she escaped to Westgate , where she joined the church of Leira . By 1358 DR , she had risen through the ranks of the church , but the death of her goddess during the Time of Troubles forced Tyaa to go into hiding again . She decided to join the Night Masks and become an assassin . With the death of Victor Dhostar , no - one in the Night Masks still sought missing worshipers of Leira , and Tyaa discovered she enjoyed her new life . She commanded an elite assassin team specializing in killing hard - target merchants both in Westgate and Sembia . Tyaa greatly enjoyed killing old rivals of the father .

title: Tyar - Besil
description: Tyar - Besil Tyar - Besil was the ancient fortress - city of the shield dwarf kingdom of Besilmer , built under the Sumber Hills in the Dessarin Valley . It was eventually overrun by hordes of orc s , troll s , and giant s . The fortress - city was later used as a base for the Cult of Elemental Evil in 1491 DR .
description_long: Tyar - Besil Tyar - Besil was the ancient fortress - city of the shield dwarf kingdom of Besilmer , built under the Sumber Hills in the Dessarin Valley . It was eventually overrun by hordes of orc s , troll s , and giant s . The fortress - city was later used as a base for the Cult of Elemental Evil in 1491 DR . After the cult ' s defeat , dwarves began to reclaim the ancient site .

title: Tyche
description: Tyche Tyche ( pronounced " TIE - key " ) was the original goddess of fortune . An ancient goddess , she was split into Tymora ( goddess of good luck ) and Beshaba ( goddess of misfortune ) before the rising of the Standing Stone ( 1 DR ) .
description_long: Tyche Tyche ( pronounced " TIE - key " ) was the original goddess of fortune . An ancient goddess , she was split into Tymora ( goddess of good luck ) and Beshaba ( goddess of misfortune ) before the rising of the Standing Stone ( 1 DR ) .

title: Tyche ' s touch
description: Tyche ' s touch Named for the ancient goddess of luck who was split into Tymora and Beshaba , Tyche ' s touch was a divine abjuration spell that granted either a protection or a curse to the target . Effects . The protection or curse from this spell lasted a day and either aided or harmed the target of the spell as circumstances affected them .
description_long: Tyche ' s touch Named for the ancient goddess of luck who was split into Tymora and Beshaba , Tyche ' s touch was a divine abjuration spell that granted either a protection or a curse to the target . Effects . The protection or curse from this spell lasted a day and either aided or harmed the target of the spell as circumstances affected them . History . Presumably this spell was first granted to clerics of Tyche , but in later years divine spell casters of both Beshaba and Tymora were granted the spell .

title: Tying Place
description: Tying Place The Tying Place was the name of a courtyard in Manass primarily used to stable horses and other pack animals . Uses . This courtyard was surrounded by stables and corrals .
description_long: Tying Place The Tying Place was the name of a courtyard in Manass primarily used to stable horses and other pack animals . Uses . This courtyard was surrounded by stables and corrals . Many visitors to Manass commonly left their animals in this location while they explored the city . The Tying Place was also used for the site of a livestock market on a monthly basis . As one would expect for any area housing a large collection of animals , the stench emanating from the square was often overbearing to those not accustomed to it .

title: Tyjit Skesh
description: Tyjit Skesh Tyjit Skesh was a guard on the Sword Coast just before the Tyranny of Dragons . Personality . Tyjit was quick to anger and quicker to use her two blades , but was also honest to a fault .
description_long: Tyjit Skesh Tyjit Skesh was a guard on the Sword Coast just before the Tyranny of Dragons . Personality . Tyjit was quick to anger and quicker to use her two blades , but was also honest to a fault . She did not tolerate bullying , and always explained the cause of her anger in the hopes that people ' s attitude would change . History . At the start of the Tyranny of Dragons in 1489 DR Tyjit acted as a guard for a great caravan that , unbeknownst to her , was full of agents of the Cult of the Dragon transporting treasures for the Hoard of the Dragon Queen .

title: Tykkyl Burrwarden
description: Tykkyl Burrwarden Tykkyl Burrwarden was a shopkeeper in Skullport . Activities . Tykkyl , with his twin sister Tohkkal Burrwarden , managed the shop Clockwork Wonders .
description_long: Tykkyl Burrwarden Tykkyl Burrwarden was a shopkeeper in Skullport . Activities . Tykkyl , with his twin sister Tohkkal Burrwarden , managed the shop Clockwork Wonders . Personality . Tykkyl was the dreamer of the Burrwarden twins . He was prone to bouts of inspirational ranting and activity . He dropped whatever he was doing and began sketching out a newly formulated idea on any nearby piece of paper , napkin , or tablecloth . Often his ideas were of no application , but sometimes he devised a truly new development . Tykkyl was a pacifist at heart , and so unable to to harm someone

title: Tyllaetha Silverspear
description: Tyllaetha Silverspear Tyllaetha Silverspear is a moon elf warrior and wizard , and as of 1368 DR , the matriarch of House Silverspear . Tyllaetha was an adventurer , and possesses the moonblade Thoerl , considered a symbol of the house . Tyllaetha keeps the heads of certain creatures she has slain in her study in the house ' s estate in Leuthilspar .
description_long: Tyllaetha Silverspear Tyllaetha Silverspear is a moon elf warrior and wizard , and as of 1368 DR , the matriarch of House Silverspear . Tyllaetha was an adventurer , and possesses the moonblade Thoerl , considered a symbol of the house . Tyllaetha keeps the heads of certain creatures she has slain in her study in the house ' s estate in Leuthilspar . One of these is the pit - fiend Foulheart .

title: Tym Waterdeep Limited
description: Tym Waterdeep Limited Tym Waterdeep Limited was a large publishing business located in the city of Waterdeep . Structure . The publishing company was a large , converted warehouse .
description_long: Tym Waterdeep Limited Tym Waterdeep Limited was a large publishing business located in the city of Waterdeep . Structure . The publishing company was a large , converted warehouse . The building was four floors high . Inhabitants . The building was owned and run by Justin Tym History . Tym Waterdeep Limited was famous throughout the " Realms " as the publisher of all of the works of Volothamp Geddarm , including all his famous guide books .

title: Tymanchebar
description: Tymanchebar Tymanchebar was once a province ruled by rebel dragonborn in Abeir . It was destroyed during the Spellplague . History .
description_long: Tymanchebar Tymanchebar was once a province ruled by rebel dragonborn in Abeir . It was destroyed during the Spellplague . History . Around the final decades of the 13th century DR , in the world of Abeir , after the Battle of the Crippled Mountain rebellious clans of dragonborn slaves managed to seize a province of the empire of Skelkor and free themselves from the rule of the Empress Dragon Gauwervyndhal . Renaming that province Tymanchebar , they fought bravely against flights of dragons to maintain their freedom . < ref name = " AotT / Hardcover - p291 " > < / ref > The dragonborn created many " djeradi " ( " clanholds " , in Draconic ) , settlements for each one of the clans . The most important of those was the one that eventually will be called Djerad Thymar , that became the capital of Tymanchebar . Among the rebel dragonborn clans of Abeir , Tymanchebar dragonborn were the most successful as they were able to create a state that ruled itself . In the wake of the Spellplague , however , Skelkor , along with a great Abeiran landmass later known as Returned Abeir , was transported to Toril .

title: Tymanther
description: Tymanther Tymanther was a displaced section of the Abeir an , militaristic dragonborn - ruled state of Tymanchebar . Tymanther was located in the " Old Empires " region that was once southern Unther . The bulk of the dragonborn population resided in its capital , the citadel - city of Djerad Thymar .
description_long: Tymanther Tymanther was a displaced section of the Abeir an , militaristic dragonborn - ruled state of Tymanchebar . Tymanther was located in the " Old Empires " region that was once southern Unther . The bulk of the dragonborn population resided in its capital , the citadel - city of Djerad Thymar . Geography . Despite having been ripped from the world of Abeir , Tymanther was a relatively calm region of forests , mountains , and plains . Tymanchebar was literally dropped onto the Unther region , rather than being transposed like Akanûl to the north . The impact resulted in a desolate region full of Untheran ruins . Aside from a sizeable population of kobold s and the local fauna native to East Faerûn , some creatures native to Abeir inhabited the region , such as the scathebeast s . After the Second Sundering , Tymantheran territory was reduced to the lands near the Smoking Mountains and south of the River Alamber . < ref name = " TDYK / Hardcover - p483 - 484 " > < / ref > Government and military . Djerad Thymar was the seat of power for a highly militant dragonborn kingdom , struggling to make a name for themselves in the lands of Faerûn .

title: Tymantheran ( dialect )
description: Tymantheran ( dialect ) Tymantheran was a regional Draconic dialect spoken by the dragonborn of Tymanther . Tymantheran words sounded softer than normal Draconic , a little more nasal and with words that had elongated syllables . Tymantheran dialect was based on the Draconic language from Abeir rather than from its Toril ian variant .
description_long: Tymantheran ( dialect ) Tymantheran was a regional Draconic dialect spoken by the dragonborn of Tymanther . Tymantheran words sounded softer than normal Draconic , a little more nasal and with words that had elongated syllables . Tymantheran dialect was based on the Draconic language from Abeir rather than from its Toril ian variant .

title: Tymofarrar
description: Tymofarrar Tymofarrar was a young white dragon who led the kobold tribes in the Nether Mountains . He sent the kobolds to attack Drogan Droganson and his pupils in 1372 DR . He held a mask artifact and wanted Drogan ' s apprentice to kill J ' Nah , who commanded the gnoll s in the High Forest .
description_long: Tymofarrar Tymofarrar was a young white dragon who led the kobold tribes in the Nether Mountains . He sent the kobolds to attack Drogan Droganson and his pupils in 1372 DR . He held a mask artifact and wanted Drogan ' s apprentice to kill J ' Nah , who commanded the gnoll s in the High Forest . He had some magic powder to use against J ' Nah . Tymofarrar was also the master of Deekin Scalesinger , a kobold bard , who sought help from Drogan Droganson ' s apprentice . The pupil had the choice to either kill Tymofarrar or make a deal with him to release Deekin . If the apprentice chose to kill J ' Nah , then they could either kill or threaten Tymofarrar with an item they obtained from J ' Nah .

title: Tymora
description: Tymora Tymora ( pronounced " tie - MORE - ah " ) , or more commonly Lady Luck , was the goddess of good fortune . She shone upon those who took risks and blessed those who dealt harshly with the followers of Beshaba . Should someone flee from her sisters ' mischievous followers or defile the dead , their fate would be decided with a roll of Tymora ' s dice .
description_long: Tymora Tymora ( pronounced " tie - MORE - ah " ) , or more commonly Lady Luck , was the goddess of good fortune . She shone upon those who took risks and blessed those who dealt harshly with the followers of Beshaba . Should someone flee from her sisters ' mischievous followers or defile the dead , their fate would be decided with a roll of Tymora ' s dice . Realm . Tymora resided in the Gates of the Moon , allied to but independent of that realm ' s twin mistresses . Her realm was the Great Wheel , seven earthmote s connected by lofty bridges , where games of chance , tests of luck , and gambling abounded . Relationships . Tymora was a known ally of the demipower Finder Wyvernspur . She also had a relationship with Brandobaris of the halfling pantheon . History . Tymora was a sister to Beshaba , the goddess of misfortune , having been created when Tyche , the former deity of luck , was infected by Moander ' s evil essence and split apart by Selûne . Worshipers . Commonly consisting of adventurers and others who relied on a mixture of luck and skill to achieve their goals , the Tymoran clergy encouraged folk to pursue their dreams .

title: Tymora ' s Fancy
description: Tymora ' s Fancy Tymora ' s Fancy was a high coin gambling establishment in the North Ward of the city of Waterdeep . Activities . The gambling den offered a fair and level field of play : no spell s , no magic items , no exceptions .
description_long: Tymora ' s Fancy Tymora ' s Fancy was a high coin gambling establishment in the North Ward of the city of Waterdeep . Activities . The gambling den offered a fair and level field of play : no spell s , no magic items , no exceptions . Should any magic be used to effect a game , no winners would be declared as it was magic tainted . Defenses . The public was told that all clandestine magical items were disintegrate d , though this was a lie as all such items were teleport ed to a locked box in the back office . Inhabitants . Its proprietor was Elaith Craulnober .

title: Tymora ' s coin
description: Tymora ' s coin Tymora ' s coin was a divine spell , or Channel Divinity prayer , given to worshipers of Tymora that , after an incident of extreme luck ( either good or bad ) granted the caster a double chance at an attack or to avoid harm within a brief window of time .
description_long: Tymora ' s coin Tymora ' s coin was a divine spell , or Channel Divinity prayer , given to worshipers of Tymora that , after an incident of extreme luck ( either good or bad ) granted the caster a double chance at an attack or to avoid harm within a brief window of time .

title: Tyr
description: Tyr Tyr ( pronounced " TEER " ) , also known as The Maimed God , was a lawful good greater deity of law and justice and part of The Triad . His dogma was primarily concerned with the punishment of wrong - doers , and the general furthering of law and good in the world . Not coincidentally , these values are among those held by most paladin s , many of whom were more than likely to follow The Triad , as the patron of paladins Torm is one - third of the coalition .
description_long: Tyr Tyr ( pronounced " TEER " ) , also known as The Maimed God , was a lawful good greater deity of law and justice and part of The Triad . His dogma was primarily concerned with the punishment of wrong - doers , and the general furthering of law and good in the world . Not coincidentally , these values are among those held by most paladin s , many of whom were more than likely to follow The Triad , as the patron of paladins Torm is one - third of the coalition . History . Tyr was a power before the time of Jhaamdath and over the millennia , was known by a multitude of different names such as Achanatyr , Anachtyr , Arrtyr Judge Of All , Iltyr the Blind but All - Seeing Eye , The Sword of Justice , and several others . He was a member of the Jhaamdathi Pantheon and sponsored cults as well as priests . His followers were known to have slain the great wyrm Rivenaurlgoth the Darkly Pious in the Marching Mountains in - 284 DR . Tyr first made a major historical impact on Toril in a campaign to pacify the remnants of the fallen empire of Jhaamdath in the Year of the Striking Lance , −247 DR .

title: Tyra
description: Tyra Tyra was a female young adult black dragon who dwelled in the Vast Swamp in the mid – 14th century DR . Relationships . Tyra was the spawn of Skurge , the great dragon of the Tun Marshes , and the clutchmate of Despayr .
description_long: Tyra Tyra was a female young adult black dragon who dwelled in the Vast Swamp in the mid – 14th century DR . Relationships . Tyra was the spawn of Skurge , the great dragon of the Tun Marshes , and the clutchmate of Despayr . Through Skurge , both Tyra and Despayr were direct descendants of the mighty Thauglorimorgorus , the Black Doom , who once ruled the entire land of Cormyr . Tyra ' s father was unknown , but was reputed to be a black dragon living in the jungles of Chult . Lair . Tyra and Despayr dwelled within the Vast Swamp . They typically hunted for prey within its confines , but by 1367 DR they had started raiding into the settled lands of Cormyr beyond . History . When Despayr hatched from his egg , revealing glowing runes across his scales , Tyra and her mother were shocked by the sight . When it became clear he could not breathe acid or wield magic like a typical black dragon , they spurned him and treated him unfairly . Nevertheless , both Tyra and Despayr made their lairs in the Vast Swamp .

title: Tyran
description: Tyran Tyran the Outlaw was a bandit leader in Teshendale in 1368 DR . History . Tyran was a descendant of an old Teshwave family .
description_long: Tyran Tyran the Outlaw was a bandit leader in Teshendale in 1368 DR . History . Tyran was a descendant of an old Teshwave family . Around 1368 DR , he gathered a small army and started to attack Zhentarim caravans with the ultimate goal of freeing his dale . The Zhent s put a bounty on his head .

title: Tyrangal
description: Tyrangal Tyrangal was a copper dragon who lived in a large , heavily warded mansion in an abandoned section of Ormpetarr , in the guise of a human female . Tyrangal was the friend and mentor of the rogue Duvan . History .
description_long: Tyrangal Tyrangal was a copper dragon who lived in a large , heavily warded mansion in an abandoned section of Ormpetarr , in the guise of a human female . Tyrangal was the friend and mentor of the rogue Duvan . History . Tyrangal was known as Gaulauntyr prior to the Spellplague . She was affected by the Rage and went into self - imposed exile . At some point after the Spellplague she moved to Ormpetarr and established herself as one of the powers in the city . In 1479 DR she became entangled in a scheme by the Order of Blue Flame to enlarge the area of the Plaguewrought Land and was seriously injured in a fight to stop the order from carrying out their plan .

title: Tyranny
description: Tyranny High Lord Kalahar Twohands orders the party to immediately return to the Fortress of the Eternal Despot from which they have only recently arrived back . New research suggests that a powerful artifact of evil lies underneath the structure and must be retrieved before Bane ' s clergy gets their hands on it .

title: Tyranny of Dragons
description: Tyranny of Dragons The Tyranny of Dragons was a Dungeons & Dragons storyline that began in August 2014 . A number of Dungeons & Dragons adventures were published under the Tyranny of Dragons storyline . The storyline also extended to the fourth and fifth Neverwinter modules , Tyranny of Dragons and Rise of Tiamat .

title: Tyranny of Dragons ( comic )
description: Tyranny of Dragons ( comic ) Tyranny of Dragons was a 10 - paneled comic released online to coincide with the Tyranny of Dragons event . Summary . The people of Icewind Dale are being besieged by dragon s , which are protecting a group of the Cult of the Dragon as they search for powerful Dragon Mask s .
description_long: Tyranny of Dragons ( comic ) Tyranny of Dragons was a 10 - paneled comic released online to coincide with the Tyranny of Dragons event . Summary . The people of Icewind Dale are being besieged by dragon s , which are protecting a group of the Cult of the Dragon as they search for powerful Dragon Mask s . Lord Lord Neverember in Neverwinter summons the heroes Alaeros , Barrowin , and Nymmestra to investigate . Meanwhile , the cultists have failed to fine the Red Dragon Mask , but have located a " portal " , but before they can activate it , they are beset upon by the heroes , who are joined by Ratshadow ( of the Zhentarim ) and Talon ( of the Emerald Enclave ) . They agree to work together to try to find the Dragon Masks before the Cult of the Dragon can . The heroes travel through the portal to the island of Tuern , where they find themselves at the heart of the island ' s volcano . They are attacked by one of the three dragon overlords , a red dragon that they manage to slay . Upon learning the news , the other dragon overlords fly about setting the island on fire .

title: Tyrantfog
description: Tyrantfog The Tyrantfog was a magical ritual , empowered by Iyachtu Xvim , that Fzoul Chembryl devised to save his own life . The ritual ' s effects affected much of the Western Heartlands , western Sea of Fallen Stars and south - eastern Tethyr . History .
description_long: Tyrantfog The Tyrantfog was a magical ritual , empowered by Iyachtu Xvim , that Fzoul Chembryl devised to save his own life . The ritual ' s effects affected much of the Western Heartlands , western Sea of Fallen Stars and south - eastern Tethyr . History . In Alturiak of 1370 DR , the banelich Faram Khaldan decided to put into action his plan to assassinate Fzoul Chembryl . Using information given to him by Manshoon , Faram managed to get inside the underground temple of Xvim beneath Zhentil Keep where he encountered Fzoul . Fzoul , armed with the Scepter of the Sorcerer - Kings , plunged it into Faram ' s chest , which broke the artifact into five separate pieces that were then flung into the planes . Faram was destroyed but the magic released both destroyed the temple and filled Fzoul ' s body with a massive amount of magical energy . Fzoul knew that the energy his body now contained would soon kill him so he began work on a ritual to expunge it . On Mirtul 3 , from an altar in the ruined northern section of Zhentil Keep , Fzoul sacrificed many captured Cyricists and Zhents loyal to Manshoon to fuel his ritual .

title: Tyranthraxus
description: Tyranthraxus Tyranthraxus , also called the " Possessing Spirit " and the " Flamed One " , was a malign entity who stole control over the bodies of others to further its wicked goals . He was said to have been one of the Seven Lost Gods forced long ago to bow before Bane . Some sages have identified him as a type of yugoloth , though spells normally effective against such fiends have been shown to have no effect on him .
description_long: Tyranthraxus Tyranthraxus , also called the " Possessing Spirit " and the " Flamed One " , was a malign entity who stole control over the bodies of others to further its wicked goals . He was said to have been one of the Seven Lost Gods forced long ago to bow before Bane . Some sages have identified him as a type of yugoloth , though spells normally effective against such fiends have been shown to have no effect on him . All that is truly known is that Tyranthraxus was an extraplanar entity of unknown origin but apparently ( according to the creature ' s own diary ) , a very weak example of his kind . History . Some sages have said that Tyranthraxus ruled over a large swathe of land consisting of the Moonsea region and northern Cormanthor in an unknown time before the Dalelands were settled by human s . He had 3 lairs during this time : One in the Dragonspine Mountains , one in what is now Yûlash and one in what is now Phlan . He came into frequent conflict with the elves of Cormanthor and was also known by the ogre s of Thar .

title: Tyrda Q ' Helvor
description: Tyrda Q ' Helvor Tyrda Q ' Helvor was Pommarch on the Council of Six in Amn from 1362 DR , the Lady of House Q ' Helvor from 1359 DR , and the first woman on the council . History . She was only the head of a moderately successful family of pottery merchants from Esmeltaran before being chosen by the Iltarch for an empty position in the council .
description_long: Tyrda Q ' Helvor Tyrda Q ' Helvor was Pommarch on the Council of Six in Amn from 1362 DR , the Lady of House Q ' Helvor from 1359 DR , and the first woman on the council . History . She was only the head of a moderately successful family of pottery merchants from Esmeltaran before being chosen by the Iltarch for an empty position in the council . Relationships . Very secretly , Tyrda was an able wizard and Rhinnom Dannihyr , having discovered her secret through the Shadow Thieves , planned to use Tyrda as a secret weapon against the Cowled Wizards in a time of need . She eventually agreed with Dannihyr ' s plan only because her position in the council greatly advantaged her businesses . Personality . Tyrda was trained by her father to trust only herself and moneys and suspected of everything .

title: Tyrluk
description: Tyrluk Tyrluk was a small village at the base of the Storm Horn Mountains in Cormyr . History . In 1368 DR , Tyrluk , along with Espar , Eveningstar , and Waymoot , was plagued by rogue dragon s .
description_long: Tyrluk Tyrluk was a small village at the base of the Storm Horn Mountains in Cormyr . History . In 1368 DR , Tyrluk , along with Espar , Eveningstar , and Waymoot , was plagued by rogue dragon s . In Tarsakh 1370 DR , Tyrluk was sacked at the beginning of the Goblin War . By the end of the war all that was left was the smithy and the Old Man ' s Face inn , and they were both left in poor condition .

title: Tystarn Dauntinghorn
description: Tystarn Dauntinghorn Tystarn Dauntinghorn was an unwitting spy for the Night Masks in 1370 DR . History . Tystarn was an expatriate Cormyrean noble who closely resembled Manshoon .
description_long: Tystarn Dauntinghorn Tystarn Dauntinghorn was an unwitting spy for the Night Masks in 1370 DR . History . Tystarn was an expatriate Cormyrean noble who closely resembled Manshoon . He arrived in Westgate in 1368 DR to represent his family interests in the area , but when Manshoon saw the resemblance to himself , he immediately " charmed " Tystarn and usurped his position . Manshoon used Tystarn ' s guise to approach and seduce Thistle Thalavar . When Tystarn was in possession of his senses , he worked as a spy for the Night Masks , reporting all useful information he gained in his business and noble life . However , Tystarn had no idea about his true masters , believing instead he worked for the Men of the Basilisk Possessions . Tystarn was given a " ring of swimming " ostensibly by the Men of the Basilisk , but in reality it was a " shoonring of swimming " from Manshoon . In addition to granting aquatic abilities , it also prevented the detection or dispelling of " charms " on him , thus giving Manshoon extra insurance against anyone discovering his duplicitous ploy .

title: Tyvollus Aluviirsan
description: Tyvollus Aluviirsan Tyvollus Aluviirsan was a elf High Mage who was born during the time of the height of Cormanthyr . He transformed the stolen sets of the " Nether Scrolls " into the Quess ' Ar ' Teranthvar , the " Golden Grove of Hidden Knowledge " . It was said that , for centuries after , he still watched over the Quess ' Ar ' Teranthvar , his body in stasis and his mind locked in " reverie " .
description_long: Tyvollus Aluviirsan Tyvollus Aluviirsan was a elf High Mage who was born during the time of the height of Cormanthyr . He transformed the stolen sets of the " Nether Scrolls " into the Quess ' Ar ' Teranthvar , the " Golden Grove of Hidden Knowledge " . It was said that , for centuries after , he still watched over the Quess ' Ar ' Teranthvar , his body in stasis and his mind locked in " reverie " . Should he be separated from the tree it would collapse into molten metal . After 20 years or less , the metal would once again reform itself into the shape of the metal scrolls that the Netherese were familiar with .

title: Tyzack
description: Tyzack Tyzack was a male human commander of the Zhentilar Company of the Scorpions during the Time of Troubles . History . When he was young , Tyzack tried to rebel against the Zhentarim and killed a young cleric of Bane in a little temple north of Zhentil Keep .
description_long: Tyzack Tyzack was a male human commander of the Zhentilar Company of the Scorpions during the Time of Troubles . History . When he was young , Tyzack tried to rebel against the Zhentarim and killed a young cleric of Bane in a little temple north of Zhentil Keep . From then on , Tyzack lived in fear that someone would discover his secret . Later , Tyzack joined the Zhentilar army and soon become the leader of the Company of the Scorpions . Furing the Time of Troubles , he and his men met the mortal Cyric , by that time starting his career in evil , and soon Cyric become the second - in - command of the company . All the previous bearers of the title had been killed by Tyzack ' s personal assassin Ren for discovering the captain ' s secret . In the end , during a rain of metal blades , a manifestation of the crazy magic of that time , Tyzack died , probably killed by Ren who considered Cyric a better commander .

title: Tzakand
description: Tzakand Tzakand were the result of illithid tadpoles being inserted into lizardfolk . The tzakandi were used as personal guards and slave laborers . They were a race specific to the city of Oryndoll and were all made from the lizardfolk of Surkh by the Nourisher Creed .
description_long: Tzakand Tzakand were the result of illithid tadpoles being inserted into lizardfolk . The tzakandi were used as personal guards and slave laborers . They were a race specific to the city of Oryndoll and were all made from the lizardfolk of Surkh by the Nourisher Creed . Description . Tzakandi , even after ceremorphosis , resembled lizardfolk . They had more intelligence in their eyes and also had two long , writhing tentacles that emerged from the back of their heads . Their skin was a deeper tone of green and their heads were also longer than those of regular lizardfolk . Psychology . The larvae chosen for implementation tended to be more aggressive and less intelligent according to illithid standards . These tadpoles would otherwise be consumed by the elder brain . As soon as tzakand were created from lizardfolk , they attached themselves to the first illithid they saw . They were fanatically loyal to that illithid and would serve that illithid without question . Tzakandi were always on edge , looking for the next fight their masters would send them to . They were highly valued by the illithids because of their ferocity . However , they were still treated as inferiors .

title: Tzar - Su
description: Tzar - Su Tzar - Su was a malicious spirit in Shou Lung in 1358 DR . History . In 1358 DR , Tzar - Su unleashed a gorgon he had created from the Qui Ren family ' s plowing ox inside the House of Qui Ren .
description_long: Tzar - Su Tzar - Su was a malicious spirit in Shou Lung in 1358 DR . History . In 1358 DR , Tzar - Su unleashed a gorgon he had created from the Qui Ren family ' s plowing ox inside the House of Qui Ren . He unleashed the monster because he was offended he not personally been invited to the inn ( he was a spirit who took offense at all manner of slights , real and imagined ) . However , some adventurers and the wu jen Ko Ho San were on hand to deal with the gorgon and Tzar - Su .

title: Tzindylspar
description: Tzindylspar Tzindylspar , the City of Rubies , was founded in - 1715 DR by dwarves of Delzoun and human s of Netheril . Geography . The mountain that marked the location of the city was unremarkable , one of many in the western Nether Mountains northeast of Silverymoon .
description_long: Tzindylspar Tzindylspar , the City of Rubies , was founded in - 1715 DR by dwarves of Delzoun and human s of Netheril . Geography . The mountain that marked the location of the city was unremarkable , one of many in the western Nether Mountains northeast of Silverymoon . Inhabitants . Halfling s also dwelt here . History . A rich corundum vein gave the city its name and brief prestige . A portal was created connecting Tzindylspar with Calimshan , and a thriving trade in rubies commenced , lasting until the fall of the Cajaan dynasty in - 1428 DR . Ynamalik Nadim came through the portal with an army of monsters and conquered Tzindylspar in - 1427 DR . Between - 665 DR and 620 DR , three powerful earthquakes collapsed the tunnels leading to the surface , opened passages into the Fardrimm , and killed various forces occupying the city .

title: Tzirik Jaelre
description: Tzirik Jaelre Tzirik Jaelre was a high priest of Vhaeraun and member of House Jaelre . Description . He was short , stocky , and - - unusual for a drow - - bald .
description_long: Tzirik Jaelre Tzirik Jaelre was a high priest of Vhaeraun and member of House Jaelre . Description . He was short , stocky , and - - unusual for a drow - - bald . He wore black mithral plate with demonic figures and gold filigree and a a ceremonial veil of black silk . He had a spiked mace and masked helm shaped like a demon ' s skull . History . In 1372 DR , Tzirik was approached by a group of drow led by Quenthel Baenre with an old acquaintance , Valas Hune , in tow . The group was investigating the Silence of Lolth and sought a cleric of another god to inquire about their goddess . Tzirik agreed to do this service for them if they retrieved the " Geildirion of Cimbar " from a beholder lair in Myth Drannor . They did so and Tzirik reveled that Lolth had sealed herself away in the Demonweb Pits . The group decided to use astral projection to visit the Demonweb Pits and supplicate the goddess themselves . Tzirik escorted them . Once in front of Lolth ' s temple , Tzirik gated in Vhaeraun , who began attacking the face of Lolth .

title: Ualair
description: Ualair Ualair the Silent was the last High Mage of Myth Drannor . History . Ualair , in the last years of Myth Drannor , was the High Mage of the city and also the Master of the N ' Vaelahr , the shadow army of Myth Drannor .
description_long: Ualair Ualair the Silent was the last High Mage of Myth Drannor . History . Ualair , in the last years of Myth Drannor , was the High Mage of the city and also the Master of the N ' Vaelahr , the shadow army of Myth Drannor . At the start of the Weeping War he used a high magic spell to polymorph the gnome Rhymallos into a Mezzoloth so he could infiltrate the Army of Darkness as spy . The gnome sent invaluable information back to Ualair . He was also one of the main proponents of the Spiders ' Truce between the elves of Cormanthyr and the drow of House Dhuurniv . Tragedy hit Ualair when thank to Rhymallos ' informations Malimshaer discovered the Vaults of Uvaeren , a deposit of important elven artifacts . Aulumpiter personally directed Rhymallos ' regiment to went to Uvaeren to take the artifacts away . Immediately Rhymallos informed Ualair but can ' t gathered reinforcements in fear to unveil Rhymallos ' cover . Rhymallos and Ualair fought the Army of Darkness ' troops alone at Uvaeren until they decided to destroy access to the vault , dying in the process .

title: Ubar
description: Ubar Ubar , also called the Lost City of Ubar , was a unique city found in Zakhara , the Land of Fate , in 1367 DR . Ubar was the given name of the city in Jannti , the common genie tongue , but the desert giant s referred to the location as Dayya in their own language . Geography .
description_long: Ubar Ubar , also called the Lost City of Ubar , was a unique city found in Zakhara , the Land of Fate , in 1367 DR . Ubar was the given name of the city in Jannti , the common genie tongue , but the desert giant s referred to the location as Dayya in their own language . Geography . This mystical city was said to rise from the sands of the Genies ' Anvil of the High Desert whenever the genies commanded . Other travelers said it was a permanent fixture of the desert . Description . Ubar was ringed with strong stone walls and iron gates . Eight octagonal - shaped towers provided splendid views of the surrounding terrain . Ubar ' s central market was built around a deep well . All of the buildings in Ubar were large enough to accommodate giant s , prompting the logical conclusion that it was originally constructed by desert giants . Because of the Amir ' s poor health , and lack of leadership to direct routine maintenance , many of the buildings in Ubar were in need of repair . The Amir ' s palace , the Red Tower of Dayya , was located in the center of the city . Mosques to Hajama , Najm , and Haku could be found within Ubar . Activities .

title: Ubriien Orlyn
description: Ubriien Orlyn Ubriien Orlyn was one of the most powerful magelord s of the kingdom of Athalantar . History . Ubriien was the first leader of the magelords , before Neldryn Hawklyn , and the first Royal Mage of Belaur Aumar , as which he dominated the nation .
description_long: Ubriien Orlyn Ubriien Orlyn was one of the most powerful magelord s of the kingdom of Athalantar . History . Ubriien was the first leader of the magelords , before Neldryn Hawklyn , and the first Royal Mage of Belaur Aumar , as which he dominated the nation . He loved to travel the country in disguise to spy on people . However , in 222 DR , disguising as an elf , he tried to cast a spell on an alert dwarven axelord at a feast , but the dwarf killed him .

title: Ubtao
description: Ubtao Ubtao ( pronounced " oob - TAY - oh " ) is the patron deity of Chult . He is also known as The Father of the Dinosaurs , Creator of Chult , Founder of Mezro , and The Deceiver . He stays distant from both mortals and other deities , and he seems to be above the daily doings of the world and his followers .
description_long: Ubtao Ubtao ( pronounced " oob - TAY - oh " ) is the patron deity of Chult . He is also known as The Father of the Dinosaurs , Creator of Chult , Founder of Mezro , and The Deceiver . He stays distant from both mortals and other deities , and he seems to be above the daily doings of the world and his followers . This may be partly due to his origin as a primordial , and in fact it ' s not fully known if he is a deity in the traditional sense . Only since the Time of Troubles has he begun to show interest in his followers again . The many jungle spirits worshiped in Chult are all aspects of Ubtao . But due to this he only has power in and around the jungles of Chult . Worshipers . The Church of Ubtao is split among three wholly independent sects , all based in the jungles of Chult among the various clans of the humans . Many of the church multiclass as rangers . Mazewalkers are found only in the city of Mezro . They take care of the general spiritual welfare of the clan , and try to prepare the faithful for their trek through the maze of life . They teach history and lore of Chult to both children and adults .

title: Udhask
description: Udhask Udhask was a deep gnome ghost in Blingdenstone during the Rage of Demons . History . When the drow attacked Blingdenstone in 1371 DR , he tried to reach for his loot when he died of a heart attack .
description_long: Udhask Udhask was a deep gnome ghost in Blingdenstone during the Rage of Demons . History . When the drow attacked Blingdenstone in 1371 DR , he tried to reach for his loot when he died of a heart attack . For unknown reasons , he rose as a ghost . Thereafter , every time someone approached his remains he relived his death in a loop , attacking and scaring people . If someone recovered his remains and put it in the catacombs , he would find peace .

title: Udi
description: Udi Udi was a wandering wu jen in Bawa in 1357 DR . Activities . Udi wandered the wilderness of Bawa , trying to help the local tribes .
description_long: Udi Udi was a wandering wu jen in Bawa in 1357 DR . Activities . Udi wandered the wilderness of Bawa , trying to help the local tribes . She acted as healer and mediator between different tribes . She did not care about the Bavanese laws , customs , and property however . For this , Udi was greatly respected among the Bawani people and no chief refused her counsel , but she was declared an outlaw by the Bavanese , risking her freedom every time she went into town .

title: Ueda Teishi
description: Ueda Teishi Ueda Teishi was a retainer of the Goshukara clan in Nakamaru around 1357 DR . Activities . Teishi was a supporter of Goshukara with a bad fortune .
description_long: Ueda Teishi Ueda Teishi was a retainer of the Goshukara clan in Nakamaru around 1357 DR . Activities . Teishi was a supporter of Goshukara with a bad fortune . History . Teishi was lost after the death of his valorous and wise father Ueda Umaki . In 1357 Teishi was framed and in verge to being exiled from Nakamaru but he thought that was a plot of his enemies , especially Tsuga Mosuke , a strong supporter of Funada Toyoo . So he asked the help of Kidera Takeshi , that was in life - debt with Umaki , to kill Mosuke before too late Personality . Teishi was a headstrong and foolish man , not ready for live in the world . He believed that all his misfortunes were all due to the plots and envies of others . He was obsessed with the idea that powerful enemies were seeking his destruction .

title: Uhlsrysn Xorlarrin
description: Uhlsrysn Xorlarrin Uhlsrysn Xorlarrin was a member of House Xorlarrin and a master of Sorcere in 1479 DR . Personality . The drow had a prickly pride , always feeling himself inferior to his brother and he was easily provoked .
description_long: Uhlsrysn Xorlarrin Uhlsrysn Xorlarrin was a member of House Xorlarrin and a master of Sorcere in 1479 DR . Personality . The drow had a prickly pride , always feeling himself inferior to his brother and he was easily provoked . Abilities . Uhlsrysn was a talented transmuter , known especially for his transmutations of goblin slaves into terrible monsters . History . Uhlsrysn was the second boy of House Xorlarrin , but because the elder boy was a more talented wizard , Uhlsrysn was chosen to remain as an instructor at Sorcere .

title: Uhndek
description: Uhndek Uhndek was the lizardfolk leader of the Khoroshen tribe , based in the marshland of the Evermoors . Uhndek had a crocodile companion named Dross . Appearance .
description_long: Uhndek Uhndek was the lizardfolk leader of the Khoroshen tribe , based in the marshland of the Evermoors . Uhndek had a crocodile companion named Dross . Appearance . Uhndek was short and stocky . Possessions . Uhndek owned a suit of well - made crocodile - hide armor and carried a spear , " Semuanya ' s Fang " , that had been adorned with human finger bones and carved runes . He also owned a crocodile - tooth necklace . Background . In 1374 DR , Uhndek and the tribe were hired by First Speaker Tessarin Alaurun in defense of Nesmé , but Uhndek betrayed the city and made an agreement with the troll s to work together in attacking Nesmé ; the lizardfolk would gain the city and the trolls the surrounding moors . The meeting to agree to this plan was interrupted by Alaurun ' s aide , Chaver Tegarech , who was captured and taken to mines below Baeniff Tor .

title: Uiss
description: Uiss Uiss was the leader of the Order of the Snake in Fochu Peninsula in Wa . History . Around 1158 DR , the yuan - ti infiltrated the Order of the Snake .
description_long: Uiss Uiss was the leader of the Order of the Snake in Fochu Peninsula in Wa . History . Around 1158 DR , the yuan - ti infiltrated the Order of the Snake . In 1358 DR , the yuan - ti abomination Uiss was the leader of the clan . That year , the Snakes ordered a hunt against some people of the foreign adventuring party that accompanied Osari Minhiro , as the adventurers housed the souls of members of the Order of the Mouse . At last , the adventurers confronted Uiss and his minions in their lair and defeated them .

title: Ukharim Grimshackle
description: Ukharim Grimshackle Ukharim Grimshackle was a halfling jailer at Grimshackle Jail in Phlan in 1489 DR . Personality . Ukharim and his brother were only interested in money .
description_long: Ukharim Grimshackle Ukharim Grimshackle was a halfling jailer at Grimshackle Jail in Phlan in 1489 DR . Personality . Ukharim and his brother were only interested in money . He was filthy and bedraggled like his brother . Activities . Ukharim and his brother Bhevek Grimshackle opened Grimshackle Jail , where they took criminals whom they ransomed to the highest bidder . History . In 1489 DR , Ukharim permitted , for some money , an adventuring party to interrogate Gray Patriots ' s member Rathene Fel . Afterward , however , in an attempted prison break , the corrupt jailer Iorg Brokenjaw took him hostage , but the adventurers resolved the situation .

title: Ukolo
description: Ukolo Ukolo was a hamlet of Azuposi humans in the Pasocada Basin in Maztica . It was the center of the Azuposi ' s turquoise - mining operation . Raw turquoise was exported from Ukolo to other settlements such as Michaca or Opallinoc , where it was refined into jewellery and other valuable items .
description_long: Ukolo Ukolo was a hamlet of Azuposi humans in the Pasocada Basin in Maztica . It was the center of the Azuposi ' s turquoise - mining operation . Raw turquoise was exported from Ukolo to other settlements such as Michaca or Opallinoc , where it was refined into jewellery and other valuable items .

title: Ukulsid
description: Ukulsid Ukulsid was an undead male gnoll and the military commander of the city of Surcross in Thay in 1480 DR . He received his orders from Szass Tam himself . Ukulsid permitted Valindra Shadowmantle to use his city as her headquarters but only because this was the will of his master and Szass usually paid no attention to the elven lich .
description_long: Ukulsid Ukulsid was an undead male gnoll and the military commander of the city of Surcross in Thay in 1480 DR . He received his orders from Szass Tam himself . Ukulsid permitted Valindra Shadowmantle to use his city as her headquarters but only because this was the will of his master and Szass usually paid no attention to the elven lich .

title: Ulala
description: Ulala Ulala was a dustdigger and pet of the famed smith Jogaoh , protecting his home in the Sword Coast lands . When Vajra Valmeyjar , Cybriana , Timoth Eyesbright , Onyx the Invincible , and Priam Agrivar sought out the smith in the Year of the Prince , 1357 DR , they sighted a pool of sparkling fresh water and rushed into it . They were soon ensnared by the dustdigger , which dropped the illusion and tried to devour them .
description_long: Ulala Ulala was a dustdigger and pet of the famed smith Jogaoh , protecting his home in the Sword Coast lands . When Vajra Valmeyjar , Cybriana , Timoth Eyesbright , Onyx the Invincible , and Priam Agrivar sought out the smith in the Year of the Prince , 1357 DR , they sighted a pool of sparkling fresh water and rushed into it . They were soon ensnared by the dustdigger , which dropped the illusion and tried to devour them . Fortunately , Jogaoh called off his pet .

title: Ulamyth Quantor
description: Ulamyth Quantor Ulamyth Quantor served as the High Priest , or High Torturelord , of Loviatar within the Tower of Pain Exalted in Zhentil Keep in 1358 DR . Activities . High Torturelord Quantor supervised 14 fellow priests of the Maiden of Pain .
description_long: Ulamyth Quantor Ulamyth Quantor served as the High Priest , or High Torturelord , of Loviatar within the Tower of Pain Exalted in Zhentil Keep in 1358 DR . Activities . High Torturelord Quantor supervised 14 fellow priests of the Maiden of Pain . He preached to a congregation of 26 followers .

title: Ulark
description: Ulark Ulark was one of the river ports along the coast of the Sword River in the Sword Lands , Returned Abeir . Background . As of 1479 DR , the town was renowned as the merriest place in the Sword Lands , as well as for its brothels and swindlers .
description_long: Ulark Ulark was one of the river ports along the coast of the Sword River in the Sword Lands , Returned Abeir . Background . As of 1479 DR , the town was renowned as the merriest place in the Sword Lands , as well as for its brothels and swindlers .

title: Ulatha Mesavir
description: Ulatha Mesavir Ulatha Mesavir was an aquatic elf prince in the Moonsea in 1491 DR . History . Ulatha was captured by the marel Shelavassa of the Cult of the Crushing Wave , who planned to use him as a sacrifice .
description_long: Ulatha Mesavir Ulatha Mesavir was an aquatic elf prince in the Moonsea in 1491 DR . History . Ulatha was captured by the marel Shelavassa of the Cult of the Crushing Wave , who planned to use him as a sacrifice . A patrol led by Musanna went to rescue him . However , Shelavassa was confronted and defeated by an adventuring party hired to destroy the cultist group for their bandit activities near River Lis and Ulatha was freed .

title: Ulatos
description: Ulatos Ulatos was the only city of any size in Payit on the continent of Maztica . History . It was conquered by Cordell and the Golden Legion in 1361 DR .
description_long: Ulatos Ulatos was the only city of any size in Payit on the continent of Maztica . History . It was conquered by Cordell and the Golden Legion in 1361 DR . Government . The Revered Counselor Caxal was allowed by the Amn nians to remain the figurehead ruler of Ulatos . The Mazticans were allowed to settle disputes among themselves but disputes involving Faerûn ians were adjudicated by a tribunal composed of representatives of the Council of Six and the Church of Helm . Locations . The city was dominated by a huge pyramid temple of Qotal in the center of the city . The pyramid had lush hanging gardens and a magical spring on top . The Grand Market occupied the former site of the pyramid of Zaltec . Goods of both Faerûnian and Maztican origin could be found here . Caxal ' s Palace was a modest twelve - room palace that faced the plaza of the pyramids . Religion . The Amnnians banished worship of the evil Maztican gods but tolerated worship of the more benign gods . The pyramid of Zaltec was torn down and its stones were used to construct the fort in Helmsport . The grand market of Ulatos was erected on the former site of the pyramid .

title: Ulblyn Blackalbuck
description: Ulblyn Blackalbuck Ulblyn Blackalbuck was the proprietor of Blackalbuck ' s Swap Shop within the city of Melvaunt . Activities . Along with trading equipment and goods , Ulblyn was always looking for information and tips for which to trade .
description_long: Ulblyn Blackalbuck Ulblyn Blackalbuck was the proprietor of Blackalbuck ' s Swap Shop within the city of Melvaunt . Activities . Along with trading equipment and goods , Ulblyn was always looking for information and tips for which to trade . The information Ulblyn gained could often be put to good use as he was the head operative for the Harpers within the city . He often got others to work for him with their goals in mind , particularly if he could strike a blow against the slave trade of the Moonsea .

title: Ulbrec Dinnesmore
description: Ulbrec Dinnesmore Lord Ulbrec Dinnesmore was a man from Neverwinter who became the lord of Targos in Icewind Dale . Personality . Ulbrec is known for his short temper .
description_long: Ulbrec Dinnesmore Lord Ulbrec Dinnesmore was a man from Neverwinter who became the lord of Targos in Icewind Dale . Personality . Ulbrec is known for his short temper . History . Ulbrec was a Neverwinter guard who met Elytharra when he was about 20 . They married , and when he retired , the couple moved to Targos where he took a seat in the ruling council of the Ten Towns . He received the title " Lord " in 1299 DR .

title: Ulbror
description: Ulbror Ulbror was an orc chieftain of the orc kingdom of Vastar in the 6th century DR . In the Year of the Wyvernfall , 512 DR , Ulbror led an orcish horde out of Vastar and marched them east through many small passes over the Earthspur Mountains . They invaded the uplands of Impiltur , where they were met by a small army led by King Sharaun Mirandor .
description_long: Ulbror Ulbror was an orc chieftain of the orc kingdom of Vastar in the 6th century DR . In the Year of the Wyvernfall , 512 DR , Ulbror led an orcish horde out of Vastar and marched them east through many small passes over the Earthspur Mountains . They invaded the uplands of Impiltur , where they were met by a small army led by King Sharaun Mirandor . The orcs destroyed the Impilturan army , killing Sharaun and his three sons in battle and thus ending the Mirandor dynasty . Later that year , Duke Harandil Durlaven had mustered another army and met Ulbror ' s horde in the Battle of Bloody Reeds . This time , the orcs were routed and Harandil was crowned king .

title: Ulburto
description: Ulburto Ulburto was a man who lived in a small village on an isle near Phlan in the Moonsea region in 1489 DR . Activities . He ran the village ' s smokehouse .
description_long: Ulburto Ulburto was a man who lived in a small village on an isle near Phlan in the Moonsea region in 1489 DR . Activities . He ran the village ' s smokehouse . He knew the village ' s dark secret . Personality . Ulburto was a violent and dangerous man , waiting for time when he could use violence . He was suspicious of all strangers but liked the stories of the village ' s crones .

title: Ulcaster
description: Ulcaster Ulcaster was a conjurer of note , who founded a school of wizardry in the small farming village of Beregost in the mid – 11th century DR . Roughly eighty years after the school was founded , Calishite mages came to fear the school ' s power and popularity . The school was destroyed in a massive spell battle and Ulcaster disappeared and was not seen since .
description_long: Ulcaster Ulcaster was a conjurer of note , who founded a school of wizardry in the small farming village of Beregost in the mid – 11th century DR . Roughly eighty years after the school was founded , Calishite mages came to fear the school ' s power and popularity . The school was destroyed in a massive spell battle and Ulcaster disappeared and was not seen since . The ruins of the school lay on a hill to the east of Beregost and were said to be haunted . The local cleric s of Lathander grazed their sheep near the ruins to keep an eye on things in the area . Gorion ' s Ward eventually met Ulcaster ' s ghost haunting his school .

title: Ulder Ravengard
description: Ulder Ravengard Ulder Ravengard was the marshal of the Flaming Fists and the Baldur ' s Gate leading delegate at the Council of Waterdeep during the Tyranny of Dragons . History . Ulder was a fighter , rising the ranks of the Faming Fists with the might of his blade and the sharpness of his wits .
description_long: Ulder Ravengard Ulder Ravengard was the marshal of the Flaming Fists and the Baldur ' s Gate leading delegate at the Council of Waterdeep during the Tyranny of Dragons . History . Ulder was a fighter , rising the ranks of the Faming Fists with the might of his blade and the sharpness of his wits . Although his city and his soldiers need reconstruction after the resurrection of Bhaal inside Baldur ' s Gate Ulder dream the glory of crush the Cult of the Dragon forces leading his soldiers By 1488 DR he was also one of the Gand Dukes . Personality . Ulder was a warrior at heart , with a very great martial acume ; he sometimes lack sophistication and tact but possesses an unwavering commitment to the law . More comfortable with soldiers , Ulder think in term of orders given and obeyed . He sense also a great duty to his city and want the best to regain the lost Baldur ' s Gate ' s pride ; he think the glory in defeat Tiamat was a good opportunity , if the others gave the right stature to the greatest city in Faerûn .

title: Uldreiyn Starym
description: Uldreiyn Starym Uldreiyn Starym was a male elf and a former archmage of the Starym House of Cormanthyr who attempted to corrupt the raising of the " mythal " in 261 DR . He also slew Aulathar Orbryn in the rebellion . History .
description_long: Uldreiyn Starym Uldreiyn Starym was a male elf and a former archmage of the Starym House of Cormanthyr who attempted to corrupt the raising of the " mythal " in 261 DR . He also slew Aulathar Orbryn in the rebellion . History . Uldreiyn was an Elder of Starym House and a former archmage at the Coronal ' s court . He was also one of the most influential members of his house , using his experience to guide his fellows in difficult times . Like all in his house , Uldreiyn was hotly against the Opening promised by Coronal Eltargrim but knew that direct opposition was futile . When the Lord Speaker of the Starym , Llombaerth Starym , died trying to stop the raising of the " mythal " , Uldreiyn recommended caution and to surrender to the coronal ' s will . But in secret he had other plans , and with his ethereal body Uldreiyn observed the raising of the " mythal " and soon conceived a plan to corrupt it , to cause it to kill all non - pure - blooded elves inside Myth Drannor . To do this , he secretly killed and replaced Aulathar Orbryn in the " mythal " ' s circle .

title: Ulf
description: Ulf Ulf was a shaman of Ruathym in 1361 DR . Activities . Ulf was a shaman and religious leader of the Northlander s .
description_long: Ulf Ulf was a shaman of Ruathym in 1361 DR . Activities . Ulf was a shaman and religious leader of the Northlander s . History . Ulf grew up with his cousin Hrolf , being sons of twin - born brothers . The night that Ulf ' s twin daughters Dagmar and Ygraine were born , an omen said that Ygraine would bring back the ancient magic of the Shapechange and thus it was decided she must marry Wedigar , the only man gifted with that power . In 1360 DR , however , Ygraine was lost in a sudden squall . In 1361 DR , the renegade drow wizard Liriel Baenre went to met Ulf in order to learn rune magic to carve inside the Yggdrasil ' s Child with the windwalker . However , Ulf disagreed with Liriel and refused to help her . At that time , Ivar informed Ulf that some hunters who had gone to hunt with First Axe Aumark Lithyl were slaughtered and only the Axe came back injured . Ulf went to heal Aumark but the wounds were too deep so Liriel arrived and saved Aumark with Lolth ' s clerical powers , impressing Ulf . Despite this , however , Ulf still refused to teach Liriel .

title: Ulgar
description: Ulgar Ulgar the Undying was a vampire who lived on Ulgar ' s Isle in the Pirate Isles . He became a vampire in Unther over 2 , 000 years ago ( as of 1370 DR ) , was banished to the island , and was later released by pirates . A lack of blood turned him insane .
description_long: Ulgar Ulgar the Undying was a vampire who lived on Ulgar ' s Isle in the Pirate Isles . He became a vampire in Unther over 2 , 000 years ago ( as of 1370 DR ) , was banished to the island , and was later released by pirates . A lack of blood turned him insane . As of 1370 DR , he prowled the island with his vampiric minions , preying on anyone who traveled there . His vampiric minions were magically bound to the island and were unable to leave . Ulgar was approached by members of the Twisted Rune who sought to become his ally . They fed him a steady supply of slaves in an attempt to restore his sanity . The Twisted Rune offered a way for Ulgar to leave the island in exchange for all of his accrued knowledge . Ulgar intended to rule Chessenta when he was able to do this .

title: Ulgar ' s Isle
description: Ulgar ' s Isle Ulgar ' s Isle , or Ulgar Isle , was an island in the Pirate Isles in the Sea of Fallen Stars . It was inhabited by the Chessenta n vampire Ulgar and his undead minions . History .
description_long: Ulgar ' s Isle Ulgar ' s Isle , or Ulgar Isle , was an island in the Pirate Isles in the Sea of Fallen Stars . It was inhabited by the Chessenta n vampire Ulgar and his undead minions . History . In an attempt to ally with Ulgar , the Twisted Rune sent shiploads of slaves to the isle for the vampire to feast upon . The organization hoped that satiating Ulgar ' s bloodlust would stabilize him enough for them to learn his secrets .

title: Ulgarth
description: Ulgarth Ulgarth was a feudal kingdom located in southeast Faerûn , east of Durpar and the Golden Water . Environment & Geography . Ulgarth occupied an area along the eastern shore of the Golden Water and north of the Great Sea , just before the barbarian - inhabited plains of the Utter East began .
description_long: Ulgarth Ulgarth was a feudal kingdom located in southeast Faerûn , east of Durpar and the Golden Water . Environment & Geography . Ulgarth occupied an area along the eastern shore of the Golden Water and north of the Great Sea , just before the barbarian - inhabited plains of the Utter East began . It was bordered by the Dustwall Mountains in the north , the Silaviul Mountains in the south , and the A - Ling Shan range in the east . Although a part of the Golden Water region , it was not part of the Shining Lands of Durpar and Var the Golden which lay to the west . It was a geographically bounded and isolated land . Ulgarth derived a great deal of its prosperity from the bay of the Golden Water . The small range of the Galuil Mountains stood in the northern part of the realm , beside the Golden Water . By 1367 DR , many Ulgarthan citizens had settled in the hills and lower slopes of the mountains . They worked in the gold and iron mines , and cultivated fruit and lumber that grew better at the cooler heights of the mountains . Many mingari farms lay in the fertile lands in the eastern part of the country , particularly around Kaspar .

title: Ulgoth ' s Beard
description: Ulgoth ' s Beard Ulgoth ' s Beard was a hamlet on the north bank of the river Chionthar , within sight of the Sea of Swords . It was home mostly to poor shepherds and fishermen . The purpose of the settlement was to warn Baldur ' s Gate of pending attacks or pirate raids .
description_long: Ulgoth ' s Beard Ulgoth ' s Beard was a hamlet on the north bank of the river Chionthar , within sight of the Sea of Swords . It was home mostly to poor shepherds and fishermen . The purpose of the settlement was to warn Baldur ' s Gate of pending attacks or pirate raids . The beacon was located on the cliffs at the mouth of the river . Ulgoth ' s Beard was named because the beacon was said to metaphorically singe the beard of a pirate named Ulgoth , whose attack was robbed of surprise by the beacon . To travel to Ulgoth ' s Beard , one was required to navigate rolling grassy hills or arrive by boat as there was no road . Ulgoth ' s Beard also had no tavern or inn . The closest thing to a tavern was a local who sold poor quality home - made ale . There were few notable inhabitants of the hamlet except for an eccentric mage by the name Shandalar . The wizard lived in a floating house just east of the settlement , made from a converted Halruaan skyship . Shandalar was known in Baldur ' s Gate for both the quality and variety of the mushrooms his three daughters sold at the market . Appendix . Appearances .

title: Ulgrym
description: Ulgrym Lord General Ulgrym was the commander - in - chief of the Zhentilar and a member of the Zhentarim in 1370 DR . Relationships . Ulgrym was a member of the Council of lords of Zhentil Keep and the leader of the Zhentilar .
description_long: Ulgrym Lord General Ulgrym was the commander - in - chief of the Zhentilar and a member of the Zhentarim in 1370 DR . Relationships . Ulgrym was a member of the Council of lords of Zhentil Keep and the leader of the Zhentilar . History . At the onset of the Time of Troubles Ulgrym was a captain of the Zhentilar . After the Cyric ' s crusade in 1368 DR Ulgrym entered in the Zhentarim . In circa 1372 DR , he was replaced by Scyllua Darkhope .

title: Ulgulu
description: Ulgulu Ulgulu was a barghest whelp from the planes of Gehenna . Description . Ulgulu was a huge purple - skinned goblin - like creature with glowing orange eyes .
description_long: Ulgulu Ulgulu was a barghest whelp from the planes of Gehenna . Description . Ulgulu was a huge purple - skinned goblin - like creature with glowing orange eyes . History . Sent to the Material Plane to eat and grow , Ulgulu and his brother Kempfana made their home in the cave of a hill giant , Lagerbottoms , where they could safely mature before returning to their home plane . Around 1340 DR , the barghests sent their main force of gnoll s to capture a human man and his eldest son from the Thistledown farm , but the raiders never returned . Ulgulu and his brother sent Nathak to scout out what happened , and he returned reporting their raiding party of five gnolls were dead . After that , Ulgulu sent his quickling ally , Tephanis , to discover exactly what had happened . When Tephanis returned , he told them a newly surfaced drow , Drizzt Do ' Urden , had slain the monsters . In rage , Ulgulu asked the quickling steal one of Drizzt ' s scimitar s . After receiving the blade , Ulgulu used his shape - changing abilities to make himself appear as a drow , and attacked the Thistledown farmstead .

title: Ulhro Luruth
