The fortress was originally constructed by King Brindor Olósynne and named Emmech . It was intended to protect against raiders from Thesk . In 1194 DR , it launched forces to repel the invasion of the Red Wizards from Thay , in the Battle of the Singing Sands , in which King Elthond Olósynne is killed during the battle . Settlement . By 1368 DR , the number of troops in Emmech had increased to 2500 , which was a large proportion of the total army . There was also a village around the fortress , with five hundred inhabitants , who kept the harbour and provided services to the troops . By 1374 DR , the troops stationed here , known as the Army of the Lion , and now led by Lord Gante Demelin , had been reduced to 1500 in number , but the total population ( including these troops ) had swelled to 7600 .

title: Undying Temple
description: Undying Temple The Undying Temple was a living temple dedicated to Kiaransalee in Castle Maerimydra . It was summoned by Irae T ' sarran during the Silence of Lolth . Location .
description_long: Undying Temple The Undying Temple was a living temple dedicated to Kiaransalee in Castle Maerimydra . It was summoned by Irae T ' sarran during the Silence of Lolth . Location . Located inside an enormous stalactite just beside the southern column of Castle Maerimydra in Maerimydra , the Undying Temple was reached via a small bridge in the top level of the Castle ' s Lesser Tower . Structure . Exterior . The Undying Temple appeared as a tower of ribbed black stone that curved gracefully up to a point . The structure curved around an enormous floating orb of negative energy that absorbed all light around it . Another identical spiraling tower mirrored the first , albeit on the ethereal plane , and hung upside down so that both towers cradled the gigantic sphere . Interior . Inside the Undying Temple , the temple was formed of numerous chambers , each laced with an almost imperceptible magic al circuitry that allowed the consciousness of the temple to manifest and see inside those rooms . In addition , all the doors blended almost completely with the surrounding stonework , making them difficult to locate for those unfamiliar with the layout .

title: Undying patron
description: Undying patron An Undying patron was one possible sponsor for a warlock . If a bargain was made between a warlock and a mortal being who had conquered death in some fashion , the warlock ' s patron gave them access to certain powers , including a suite of spells that expanded the choices to fill their spell slots . Starting at 1st level , you learn the " spare the dying " cantrip , which counts as a warlock cantrip for you .
description_long: Undying patron An Undying patron was one possible sponsor for a warlock . If a bargain was made between a warlock and a mortal being who had conquered death in some fashion , the warlock ' s patron gave them access to certain powers , including a suite of spells that expanded the choices to fill their spell slots . Starting at 1st level , you learn the " spare the dying " cantrip , which counts as a warlock cantrip for you . You also have advantage on saving throws against any disease . Undying patron features . Additionally , undead have difficulty harming you . If an undead targets you directly with an attack or a harmful spell , that creature must make a Wisdom saving throw against your spell save DC ( an undead needn ' t make the save when it includes you in an area effect , such as the explosion of " fireball " ) . On a failed save , the creature must choose a new target or forfeit targeting someone instead of you , potentially wasting the attack or spell . On a successful save , the creature is immune to this effect for 24 hours . An undead is also immune to this effect for 24 hours if you target it with an attack or a harmful spell .

title: Undylyl Tessran
description: Undylyl Tessran Undylyl Tessran was a human woman of the city of Procampur in the Vast . She was a wizard and an ambitious young adventuress . Around 1358 DR , she was looking for adventuring bands to join or hire her .
description_long: Undylyl Tessran Undylyl Tessran was a human woman of the city of Procampur in the Vast . She was a wizard and an ambitious young adventuress . Around 1358 DR , she was looking for adventuring bands to join or hire her . She was one of the more notable Procampan mages of the time .

title: Unearthly choir
description: Unearthly choir Unearthly choir was an evocation spell cast cooperatively by three or more priests in which they sing a dissonant chord for possibly devastating effect . Effects . Three or more priests were required to cast this spell simultaneously and they had to be within 10 ft ( 3 m ) of each other at the time of casting .
description_long: Unearthly choir Unearthly choir was an evocation spell cast cooperatively by three or more priests in which they sing a dissonant chord for possibly devastating effect . Effects . Three or more priests were required to cast this spell simultaneously and they had to be within 10 ft ( 3 m ) of each other at the time of casting . " Unearthly choir " took only half a minute to cast and at the conclusion all the priests involved each sang a purposefully discordant note that combined into a cone of sonic power aimed at their enemies . The more casters added their voice to this spell , the greater the effect . Components . This spell only required a verbal component to cast , albeit from at least three casters .

title: Unfailing endurance
description: Unfailing endurance Unfailing endurance was a necromancy spell that granted one or more creatures almost complete immunity from fatigue . Effects . The caster could bestow this boon on as many creatures as he or she had experience levels , but was required to touch them during the casting .
description_long: Unfailing endurance Unfailing endurance was a necromancy spell that granted one or more creatures almost complete immunity from fatigue . Effects . The caster could bestow this boon on as many creatures as he or she had experience levels , but was required to touch them during the casting . Each recipient was immune to fatigue and exhaustion for one day per level of the caster . This allowed affected creatures to do intensely physical labor for 12 hours , or force march for 12 hours and not get tired . In addition , each subject had a greatly increased chance of overcoming tests of strength , constitution , stamina , or overall fitness , including resisting magical attacks such as " weakness " , " fatigue " , or " enfeeblement " . Components . Only verbal and somatic components were required to cast this spell .

title: Unferth
description: Unferth Unferth was a member of the Kraken Society during the Elemental Evil crisis . Activities . The priest and his partner Ghald were the Kraken Society ' s top operatives in this part of the North , specialized in advancing the agenda of the society through theft , intimidation , and assassination .
description_long: Unferth Unferth was a member of the Kraken Society during the Elemental Evil crisis . Activities . The priest and his partner Ghald were the Kraken Society ' s top operatives in this part of the North , specialized in advancing the agenda of the society through theft , intimidation , and assassination . He was usually the spokesman but Ghald was in command . History . In 1491 DR , a patrol of the Twelve near Triboar had defeated some cultists of the Cult of the Eternal Flame and recovered a " devastation orb " . They went back to Yartar with the orb , but just after they put it in the city ' s vaults , Naaren Dhest stole it . After examining it , the Hands of Yartar decided to sell it in an auction at the Wink and Kiss tavern . Hearing this news , Ghald and Unferth decided that the Society needed the orb , so they formed a partnership with Haliyra Ravenfast to obtain it . Ghald , Unferth , and some minions waited in a tomb near the tavern but the intervention of some adventurers ruined their plan and Ghald and Unferth were defeated .

title: Unger Farshal
description: Unger Farshal Unger Farshal was the proprietor of the Grinning Lion tavern in the North Ward of Waterdeep . He secretly worked for the Two - Cities Consortium , operating the drug markets weekly between Waterdeep and Skullport . He had been known to obtain bloodroot for Orlpar Husteem , a Waterdhavian noble .
description_long: Unger Farshal Unger Farshal was the proprietor of the Grinning Lion tavern in the North Ward of Waterdeep . He secretly worked for the Two - Cities Consortium , operating the drug markets weekly between Waterdeep and Skullport . He had been known to obtain bloodroot for Orlpar Husteem , a Waterdhavian noble . Description . Unger was bald .

title: Ungo - Ti
description: Ungo - Ti Ungo - Ti was a member of the Order of the Snake in Fochu Peninsula in Wa . Activities . Ungo - Ti wandered the peninsula searching for clues about a reemergence of the Order of the Mouse and promising candidates to join the Snakes .
description_long: Ungo - Ti Ungo - Ti was a member of the Order of the Snake in Fochu Peninsula in Wa . Activities . Ungo - Ti wandered the peninsula searching for clues about a reemergence of the Order of the Mouse and promising candidates to join the Snakes . History . In 1358 DR , Ungo - Ti was discovered in the village of Awajiga in Fochu Peninsula . He posed as one of the workers on the canal that the local shoya Ginoyo Yashishira had ordered built . He sensed that some people of the foreign adventuring party that accompanied Osari Minhiro housed the souls of the Mouses . So he devised a trap for them in Awajiga , by sending a dream to the non - Mouse adventurers , plotting to destroy the people housing the Mouses and recruiting the others . His plan backfired because the party was too united and he escaped from Awajiga in order to find Snake reinforcements .

title: Ungu Yakana
description: Ungu Yakana Ungu Yakana was an evil Wu jen in Ito - Jo in 1360 DR . History . Yakana entered in service of Ito family but secretly he worked for clan ' s enemies that payed him well .
description_long: Ungu Yakana Ungu Yakana was an evil Wu jen in Ito - Jo in 1360 DR . History . Yakana entered in service of Ito family but secretly he worked for clan ' s enemies that payed him well . Discovered was imprisoned in the caves deep the castle and was unavailable in 647 DR . The " ancient curse " placed him under the service of the krakentua responsible for Ito fall . He supplied it with its favorite cherry incense , assisted by three ju ju zombie s . In 1360 DR an adventuring party hired by Michimori Uemon to recover the Seven Swords fought and destroyed him .

title: Unholy aura
description: Unholy aura Unholy aura is an abjuration spell that grants protection against . It is the counterpart to the good spell " holy aura " . Effect .
description_long: Unholy aura Unholy aura is an abjuration spell that grants protection against . It is the counterpart to the good spell " holy aura " . Effect . A malevolent darkness surrounds the subjects , protecting them from attacks , granting them resistance to spells cast by good creatures , and weakening good creatures when they strike the subjects . This abjuration has four effects : First , the warded creatures gain a + 4 deflection bonus to AC and a + 4 resistance bonus to saves . Unlike the effect of protection from good , this benefit applies against all attacks , not just against attacks by good creatures . Second , the warded creatures gain SR 25 against good spells and spells cast by good creatures . Third , the abjuration blocks possession and mental influence , just as " protection from good " does . Finally , if a good creature succeeds at a melee attack against a warded creature , the offending attacker takes 1d6 points of temporary Strength damage ( Fortitude save negates ) . Focus . A tiny reliquary containing some sacred relic , such as a piece of parchment from an unholy text . The reliquary costs at least 500 gp .

title: Unholy blight
description: Unholy blight Unholy blight was a divine evocation spell unique to the evil domain that damaged good - aligned creatures . Effects . Upon casting , a cloying miasma of cold and greasy darkness spread around a point determined by the caster in a radius of 20 feet ( 6 .
description_long: Unholy blight Unholy blight was a divine evocation spell unique to the evil domain that damaged good - aligned creatures . Effects . Upon casting , a cloying miasma of cold and greasy darkness spread around a point determined by the caster in a radius of 20 feet ( 6 . 1 meters ) . The point of origin was determined by the caster and could be anywhere within 100 feet or more depending on the caster ' s skill . This darkness caused harm to any creature depending on its philosophical orientation : the full effect to those of good , no effect on evil creatures , and only partially effective on those in between . First , physical damage was suffered . This damage was about doubly more dangerous to good creatures than neutral ones and when it came down to good outsider s , the lethality was double that of normal good creatures . Furthermore , good creatures suffered a sickening effect for a time , that made follow - up attacks more dangerous to them . The damage could be softened and good creatures could also protect themselves against the debilitating effect when they showed a strong will . Components . This spell required only verbal and somatic components .

title: Unicorn
description: Unicorn A unicorn was a mysterious and majestic magical beast resembling a horse with a horn protruding from its forehead . Description . A unicorn resembled a horse with a white coat , mane , and tail .
description_long: Unicorn A unicorn was a mysterious and majestic magical beast resembling a horse with a horn protruding from its forehead . Description . A unicorn resembled a horse with a white coat , mane , and tail . However , it had a number of traits that distinguished it from a horse , including cloven hooves and a long ivory - colored horn that protruded from its forehead head . Males had a white beard . Unicorns were not subject to poison , death magic , or " charm " spells . Society . Unicorns dwelt deep within their forests and shunned most creatures , only conferring with fey such as pixie s , dryad s , and sprite s . They usually showed themselves only in defense of their forests . They scratched glyphs into the bark of trees in the areas under their protection . Unicorns mated for life . Unicorns that rested at the Place of the Unicorn , sacred to the unicorn goddess Lurue , in the Sword Mountains were healed of all injury and disease . Combat . Unicorns were able to sense evil nearby and radiate an aura which protected them from most evil spells . A touch of the unicorn ' s horn could both heal wounds and cure poison . Unicorns could fey step ( " teleport " ) to a nearby location .

title: Unicorn ' s Bane
description: Unicorn ' s Bane Unicorn ' s Bane was the name eventually given to one of the " Qysari Rings " belonging to the wicked Shoon VII of the Shoon Imperium . It allowed the wearer to short - range " teleport " to within a few yards ( meters ) of a named individual , a member of a chosen race , or a specimen of a selected species . Description .
description_long: Unicorn ' s Bane Unicorn ' s Bane was the name eventually given to one of the " Qysari Rings " belonging to the wicked Shoon VII of the Shoon Imperium . It allowed the wearer to short - range " teleport " to within a few yards ( meters ) of a named individual , a member of a chosen race , or a specimen of a selected species . Description . Magic rings made during the sixth age of Calimshan ( 27 – 450 DR ) , were constructed of twisted bands of two different metals and were known as " shoonring s " . What distinguished the " Qysari Rings " from ordinary " shoonrings " was that they changed appearance depending on the nature of the person wearing them . When placed on the finger of a cleric , druid , or other priest , the direction of the metal weave turned at right angles to the circumference of the ring . If donned by warrior s or rogue s , the raised weave pattern became smooth to the touch but still visible . Wizard s saw no change in the design when it was placed on their finger . Powers .

title: Unicorn ( Herald )
description: Unicorn ( Herald ) In the Heralds of Faerûn , the office of Unicorn was one of the High Heralds and the oldest and most revered . The holder of this office could set policy and his or her judgement took precedence in debates over Herald business , which could only be overruled by a unanimous vote from a quorum of the other High Heralds . By tradition , Unicorn had the first right to cry and judge all contests of honor , whether ceremonial , ritual , or personal single combat , except for those involving great cats or horses , mules and other creatures related to horses .
description_long: Unicorn ( Herald ) In the Heralds of Faerûn , the office of Unicorn was one of the High Heralds and the oldest and most revered . The holder of this office could set policy and his or her judgement took precedence in debates over Herald business , which could only be overruled by a unanimous vote from a quorum of the other High Heralds . By tradition , Unicorn had the first right to cry and judge all contests of honor , whether ceremonial , ritual , or personal single combat , except for those involving great cats or horses , mules and other creatures related to horses . Unicorn was allowed to live in the opulent mansion known as Herald ' s Hall , deep under Mount Sklagarra on lake Swordsmere . Possessions . The badge of office for Unicorn was a rod of ebony with a unicorn horn mounted on one end . It was a " + 1 " weapon that was enchanted with a permanent " continual light " . The holder of this office was also entrusted with the famous Rod of the Heralds , a simple black " rod of rulership " with other enhancements known only to the High Heralds .

title: Unicorn Run
description: Unicorn Run The Unicorn Run was a river that started somewhere in the Star Mounts and joined the river Delimbiyr near Secomber . Bard s and sages passed down the tale that the headwaters of the Unicorn Run were , in truth , the Font of Life , and a cradle of fecundity . Each natural race was said to have emerged from the womb of Chauntea onto Toril at the river ' s source , and then traveled down the Unicorn Run to the outside world .
description_long: Unicorn Run The Unicorn Run was a river that started somewhere in the Star Mounts and joined the river Delimbiyr near Secomber . Bard s and sages passed down the tale that the headwaters of the Unicorn Run were , in truth , the Font of Life , and a cradle of fecundity . Each natural race was said to have emerged from the womb of Chauntea onto Toril at the river ' s source , and then traveled down the Unicorn Run to the outside world . Some said that a daughter of Chauntea resided at the river ' s source to usher the newborns into the world , while others claimed that Shiallia midwifed the process . Regardless of the truth , the elves , korreds , and halflings all agreed that the Unicorn Run was sacred to life and a site of incredible purity . As a result , all three races had strong taboos about extended trips up the run , for if the river was ever fouled , then no new races would ever be born on Toril again .

title: Unicorn pendant
description: Unicorn pendant Unicorn pendants were magical amulets embossed with the holy symbol of the deity Lurue . Description . Bearing the head of unicorn , a " unicorn pendant " could be made of silver or sculpted of marble with a gold horn .
description_long: Unicorn pendant Unicorn pendants were magical amulets embossed with the holy symbol of the deity Lurue . Description . Bearing the head of unicorn , a " unicorn pendant " could be made of silver or sculpted of marble with a gold horn . Powers . The wearer of the pendant gained the ability to cast " cure moderate wounds " and " neutralize poison " once each per day . Paladin s who wore this pendant had their " lay on hands " healing ability enhanced .

title: Unidentified duergar fiddler
description: Unidentified duergar fiddler An unidentified duergar fiddler of Zortagra was in Elventree during the late 1480s DR . History . A duergar fiddler was afflicted by the demon lord ' s madness in the late 1480s DR .
description_long: Unidentified duergar fiddler An unidentified duergar fiddler of Zortagra was in Elventree during the late 1480s DR . History . A duergar fiddler was afflicted by the demon lord ' s madness in the late 1480s DR . For unknown reasons , she went to the village of Elventree in Cormanthor and there started to play a madness - spreading melody during a celebration in honor of Mielikki . Thanks to some adventurers , she was stopped before too much damage was done . Later , Elanil Elassidil hired the adventurers that had stopped her to investigate the matter in the Underdark . Behind the scenes . The fiddler was very probably killed by the players , as this was the most simple method to stop her , as she would not listen to speech .

title: Universal ( province )
description: Universal ( province ) In the Zakhara n view of magic , the universal province encompassed a number of spells that were not specific to the four elemental provinces of sand , sea , wind , and flame . Universal spells could be learned by all Zakharan sorcerers and elemental mage s , no matter their specialization . The universal province is not to be confused with the much narrower range of universal spell s that were not considered part of any of the nine ( or eight ) schools of magic distinguished by Faerûn ian magic - users .
description_long: Universal ( province ) In the Zakhara n view of magic , the universal province encompassed a number of spells that were not specific to the four elemental provinces of sand , sea , wind , and flame . Universal spells could be learned by all Zakharan sorcerers and elemental mage s , no matter their specialization . title: Universal spell
description: Universal spell Universal spells were spells not associated with any school , though they were sometimes collectively called the school of universal magic . Only a small number of spells fit this description , including " permanency " , " prestidigitation " , and " wish " . They could be learned by all wizards , no matter their specialization .
description_long: Universal spell Universal spells were spells not associated with any school , though they were sometimes collectively called the school of universal magic . Only a small number of spells fit this description , including " permanency " , " prestidigitation " , and " wish " . They could be learned by all wizards , no matter their specialization . Universal province . Universal spells were distinct from the much larger number of spells belonging to the universal province in the Zakhara n system of dividing spells into elemental provinces rather than the eight commonly recognized schools .

title: Unknown Shrine
description: Unknown Shrine The Unknown Shrine was the name given to a ruined structure in the Eastern Plains of Cormyr . Location . The Unknown Shrine stood atop a steep - sided hill situated some 10 miles ( 16 kilometers ) east of the city of Wheloon and a few miles to the north of the Way of the Manticore .
description_long: Unknown Shrine The Unknown Shrine was the name given to a ruined structure in the Eastern Plains of Cormyr . Location . The Unknown Shrine stood atop a steep - sided hill situated some 10 miles ( 16 kilometers ) east of the city of Wheloon and a few miles to the north of the Way of the Manticore . It was visible from the road on a clear day , so local folk and travelers knew it as a landmark on the way to Wheloon . Description . Built all of white marble , it consisted of a thick circular wall approximately 60 feet ( 18 meters ) in diameter , broken in places amidst piles of rubble , but with two apparent passages built through . Within were arrays of columns , up to 20 feet tall ( 6 meters ) ; some remaining standing , but others had fallen or were broken . There was a ring of eight sturdy columns , 5 feet ( 1 . 5 meters ) thick . Interspersed among these were a number of slender columns , only 1 . 5 feet ( 0 . 45 meters ) thick , which could be pushed or pulled by a strong arm or beast . The structure appeared to have never had a roof , and the floor was flagged with white stone slabs . At the center was a low dais .

title: Unleash monolith
description: Unleash monolith Unleash monolith was a spell unique to Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Effects . This was an elemental summoning spell that brought an elemental creature to the Prime Material Plane .
description_long: Unleash monolith Unleash monolith was a spell unique to Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Effects . This was an elemental summoning spell that brought an elemental creature to the Prime Material Plane . The monolith was barely sentient and composed of one of the four elements depending on the components supplied . These monoliths were much stronger than regular elementals and were capable of destroying nearly anything in their path . In order to open the interplanar gate to summon these creatures , the wizard needed to spend a full day carefully meditating and chanting . The wizard could not be interrupted by anything during this time , nor could they stop to eat , sleep , or drink . The stress of casting this spell sometimes overwhelmed wizards with weaker constitution , resulting in their collapse of even death . Once summoned , an elemental monolith was uncontrollable . Spells that banished or controlled regular elementals had no effect on them . They sought to destroy as much of their surroundings as possible for the duration of the spell . Components . This spell required different components to cast depending on the type of monolith summoned .

title: Unluck
description: Unluck Unluck was a wild magic spell that allowed the caster to affect the forces of chance around the target , giving it a stroke of bad luck for the duration of the spell . Components . Proper casting of this spell required verbal and somatic component s and the shard of a broken mirror , which was tossed in the direction of the target and vanished .
description_long: Unluck Unluck was a wild magic spell that allowed the caster to affect the forces of chance around the target , giving it a stroke of bad luck for the duration of the spell . Components . Proper casting of this spell required verbal and somatic component s and the shard of a broken mirror , which was tossed in the direction of the target and vanished . Users . As a wild magic spell , " unluck " was especially common among wild mage s . Oathbinder genie s had the innate ability to use this spell three times per day .

title: Unnamed Dungeons & Dragons movie
description: Unnamed Dungeons & Dragons movie An unnamed " Dungeons & Dragons " movie is currently in planning and expected to be set in the " Forgotten Realms " . It is rumored to be titled Dungeons & Dragons : The Hand of Chaos . Production .
description_long: Unnamed Dungeons & Dragons movie An unnamed " Dungeons & Dragons " movie is currently in planning and expected to be set in the " Forgotten Realms " . It is rumored to be titled Dungeons & Dragons : The Hand of Chaos . Production . Following a lawsuit over the rights to a D & D movie and months of negotiation between ' s , , and Sweet Pea Entertainment , it was announced on August 3 , 2015 , that plans were underway to make another movie based on the " Dungeons & Dragons " franchise . Furthermore , it is to be set in the popular and long - running " Forgotten Realms " campaign setting . According to Greg Silverman , president of creative development and worldwide production at Warner Bros . , " We are so excited about bringing the world of Dungeons & Dragons to life on the big screen . This is far and away the most well - known brand in fantasy , which is the genre that drives the most passionate film followings . D & D has endless creative possibilities , giving our filmmakers immense opportunities to delight and thrill both fans and moviegoers new to the property . " It had a screenplay written by ( " " , " " ) .

title: Unnamed Grandfather of Assassins
description: Unnamed Grandfather of Assassins A unnamed old man was the leader of the Assassins Guild of the Galenas until 1357 DR . History . The Grandfather allied with the lich - King of Vaasa Zhengyi and conspired with him to kill King Virdin of Damara .
description_long: Unnamed Grandfather of Assassins A unnamed old man was the leader of the Assassins Guild of the Galenas until 1357 DR . History . The Grandfather allied with the lich - King of Vaasa Zhengyi and conspired with him to kill King Virdin of Damara . After the death of Virdin he and his assassins slaughtered the most loyal and powerful nobles of Damara in a single night . After the fall of the kingdom of Damara the Grandfather saw a perfect opportunity to gain direct power . So he gathered all the deserters , refugees , bullies , and other scum forging them in a bandit army . with this army he subjugated the Barony of Bloodstone until 1357 . When baron Tranth rebelled the Grandfather sent all his army , because was crucial for him the control of the Bloodstone Pass . He was planning to occupy next Arcata . In 1357 DR he was the leader of the main army that went to attack the Bloodstone Village . After being defeated in that battle he searched vengeance sending his best henchman , the Fist , and a squad of assassins to kill the Gareth Dragonsbane ' s party .

title: Unnamed bandit leader
description: Unnamed bandit leader This unnamed bandit leader was a human bandit in the bandit camp near the Mere of Dead Men on the Sword Coast North . History . When the Kalach - Cha came to the bandit leader , the leader was calm , as his plans had been foiled and had no power to resist .
description_long: Unnamed bandit leader This unnamed bandit leader was a human bandit in the bandit camp near the Mere of Dead Men on the Sword Coast North . History . When the Kalach - Cha came to the bandit leader , the leader was calm , as his plans had been foiled and had no power to resist . The Kalach - Cha had three choices for dealing with the leader : leave him in peace , kill him , or persuade him to join the Greycloaks ( the last idea sounding quite insane to him ) .

title: Unnamed bandit sergeant
description: Unnamed bandit sergeant This unnamed bandit sergeant was a half - orc ish bandit in the bandit camp near the Mere of Dead Men on the Sword Coast North in 1374 DR . History . When the Kalach - Cha came to the building in the bandit camp , the Kalach - Cha could ' ve encountered this sergeant , who was not pleased and attacked .
description_long: Unnamed bandit sergeant This unnamed bandit sergeant was a half - orc ish bandit in the bandit camp near the Mere of Dead Men on the Sword Coast North in 1374 DR . History . When the Kalach - Cha came to the building in the bandit camp , the Kalach - Cha could ' ve encountered this sergeant , who was not pleased and attacked .

title: Unnamed craftmaster
description: Unnamed craftmaster This unnamed craftmaster was a human in Fort Locke near the Mere of Dead Men on the Sword Coast North . History . In 1374 DR , the craftmaster was able to give the Kalach - Cha the many wonders and secrets of weapons , traps , alchemy , armor , and magical item crafting .
description_long: Unnamed craftmaster This unnamed craftmaster was a human in Fort Locke near the Mere of Dead Men on the Sword Coast North . History . In 1374 DR , the craftmaster was able to give the Kalach - Cha the many wonders and secrets of weapons , traps , alchemy , armor , and magical item crafting .

title: Unnamed lizardling shaman
description: Unnamed lizardling shaman This unnamed lizardling shaman was an inhabitant near the village of West Harbor on the Sword Coast North in the 1370s DR . History . The lizardling shaman was preaching to the followers of the Stone God when the Kalach - Cha and Bevil Starling entered the room .
description_long: Unnamed lizardling shaman This unnamed lizardling shaman was an inhabitant near the village of West Harbor on the Sword Coast North in the 1370s DR . History . The lizardling shaman was preaching to the followers of the Stone God when the Kalach - Cha and Bevil Starling entered the room . The shaman was offended , so the Kalach - Cha could ' ve persuaded , or lied , to the shaman to leave the room . Otherwise , the shaman would have attacked them .

title: Unnamed minstrels ( NWN2 )
description: Unnamed minstrels ( NWN2 ) These unnamed minstrels were human s who visited West Harbor on the Sword Coast North in the 1370s DR . History . The minstrels came to West Harbor to entertain people .
description_long: Unnamed minstrels ( NWN2 ) These unnamed minstrels were human s who visited West Harbor on the Sword Coast North in the 1370s DR . History . The minstrels came to West Harbor to entertain people . Once the winner of the Harvest Fair was announced , they disappeared .

title: Unnamed refugee leader
description: Unnamed refugee leader This refugee leader was a human captive in the bandit camp near the Mere of Dead Men on the Sword Coast North . History . The refugee leader was one of the bandits ' captives , who were held for ransom .
description_long: Unnamed refugee leader This refugee leader was a human captive in the bandit camp near the Mere of Dead Men on the Sword Coast North . History . The refugee leader was one of the bandits ' captives , who were held for ransom . The Kalach - Cha had the option to rescue them at Liza ' s demand . However , the Kalach - Cha needed to fight the bandits first . After the rescue , the leader thanked the Kalach - Cha and went on to Fort Locke with the other refugees .

title: Unnamed shadow priest
description: Unnamed shadow priest This unnamed shadow priest was an antagonist of the unnamed graveyard near the Mere of Dead Men on the Sword Coast North . History . This shadow priest was located in the unnamed graveyard .
description_long: Unnamed shadow priest This unnamed shadow priest was an antagonist of the unnamed graveyard near the Mere of Dead Men on the Sword Coast North . History . This shadow priest was located in the unnamed graveyard . He raised zombies and skeletons to boost Black Garius ' army . He also captured Tann and his men . However , the Kalach - Cha was employed to investigate and defeat the shadow priest .

title: Unnamed wizard ( Bandit camp )
description: Unnamed wizard ( Bandit camp ) These unnamed wizards were human spellcasters in the bandit camp near the Mere of Dead Men on the Sword Coast North . History . These wizards were employed by the bandit leader .
description_long: Unnamed wizard ( Bandit camp ) These unnamed wizards were human spellcasters in the bandit camp near the Mere of Dead Men on the Sword Coast North . History . These wizards were employed by the bandit leader . The female wizard would attack on sight , while the male was waiting for the leader ' s orders .

title: Unquenchable
description: Unquenchable The Unquenchable , or abd Multahib , was an efreet organization within the City of Brass on the Elemental Plane of Fire . Organization . The Unquenchable were composed of 3 , 000 efreet who were fanatically loyal to their Sultan .
description_long: Unquenchable The Unquenchable , or abd Multahib , was an efreet organization within the City of Brass on the Elemental Plane of Fire . Organization . The Unquenchable were composed of 3 , 000 efreet who were fanatically loyal to their Sultan . They wore white robes and black turbans to distinguish themselves . Activities . Members of this organization served as the palace guard , protecting the Sultan from any threat . Base of Operations . The City of Brass served as the base of the Unquenchable .

title: Unseen
description: Unseen The Unseen were a group of shapechangers , illusionists , assassins , thieves and evil creatures based out of Waterdeep . They were led by a greater doppelganger known as Hlaavin , who masqueraded as the Masked Lord , Nindil Jalbuck . History .
description_long: Unseen The Unseen were a group of shapechangers , illusionists , assassins , thieves and evil creatures based out of Waterdeep . They were led by a greater doppelganger known as Hlaavin , who masqueraded as the Masked Lord , Nindil Jalbuck . History . Originally a band of dopplegangers controlled by illithid s , known by that species as a " druuth " . They were tasked with spying on Waterdeep for the Underdark city Ch ' Chitl but when the elder brain of that city died , control of the " druuth " was lost . One of the dopplegangers was secretly half - illithid so this creature , called Hlaavin , took control . Originally based in the Rat Hills , the Rat Hills Conflagration forced the group wholly into the city . They set themselves up in the Hanging Lantern , a high - class brothel that catered to the nobility and the wealthy where they used their abilities to glean secrets from their clientele until the famous writer Volothamp Geddarm revealed their ruse . The group spread out after that , creating several bases and outposts in Waterdeep ' s sewers and Skullport as well as one in the Dungeon of the Crypt .

title: Unseen ( Zakhara )
description: Unseen ( Zakhara ) The Unseen referred to any elemental mage in Zakhara who wished to conceal the true nature of his or her power . The common factor driving most elemental mages to choose this way of life was the desire to remain hidden , and safe , from the Brotherhood of the True Flame . Activities .
description_long: Unseen ( Zakhara ) The Unseen referred to any elemental mage in Zakhara who wished to conceal the true nature of his or her power . The common factor driving most elemental mages to choose this way of life was the desire to remain hidden , and safe , from the Brotherhood of the True Flame . Activities . Elemental mages counted as Unseen usually traveled in disguise , often choosing to mimic the dress and behavior of non - spellcasters including anything from mamluk s to holy slayer s . The Unseen were less skilled spellcasters compared to pure elemental mages . However , because of the time spent perfecting their disguises and false roles , they were quite skilled in other areas that elemental mages could not dream of practicing , but were still pure amateurs compared to the true practitioners of their chosen disguise . Examples of these skills included weapons training , stealth skills , etc . Regardless of the disguise they chose , any Unseen who cast spells while disguised risked instantly revealing their true nature to any onlookers . True practitioners of the Unseen ' s chosen disguise viewed them as complete amateurs .

title: Unseen aid
description: Unseen aid Unseen aid is a spell used by many sorcerer s early in their training . Using " unseen aid " grants arcane assistance to the caster , allowing them to perform a number of tasks with greater proficiency than they would otherwise be able to . " Unseen aid " is not particularly difficult to cast , taking only an instant to use and a rest of a few minutes or more to recharge .

title: Unseen servant
description: Unseen servant An unseen servant was a conjuration spell that performed simple tasks at its user ' s orders . History . This spell was created by the Arcanist Carbury in - 880 DR .
description_long: Unseen servant An unseen servant was a conjuration spell that performed simple tasks at its user ' s orders . History . This spell was created by the Arcanist Carbury in - 880 DR . " Unseen servant " was an uncommon spell in the Realms . Magic Items . Drow House insignia token s typically contained this spell .

title: Unspeakable
description: Unspeakable The Unspeakable , or He Whose Name Must Not Be Spoken , was a yak - man who possessed the body of Mu ' izzi al - Kamar , in 1367 DR . Other yikarians referred to him as " Revered Master , " which is their term for a High Priest . Activities .
description_long: Unspeakable The Unspeakable , or He Whose Name Must Not Be Spoken , was a yak - man who possessed the body of Mu ' izzi al - Kamar , in 1367 DR . Other yikarians referred to him as " Revered Master , " which is their term for a High Priest . Activities . The emperor of the yikarians tasked the Unspeakable with gaining ultimate control of the Court of Enlightenment . The Unspeakable first encountered Mu ' izzi al - Kamar during the 1340s DR when some of his earthservant s grabbed him after a sandstorm struck his caravan . After entering his mind and realizing that Mu ' izzi was the head of one of the richest merchant families in Huzuz , the Unspeakable instantly recognized the opportunity to wreak havoc upon the Grand Caliph by possessing Mu ' izzi ' s body . Within a year of his " return " to Huzuz in Mu ' izzi ' s body , the Unspeakable had utterly " charmed " every member of the House of Al - Kamari to protect his disguise . The Unspeakable ' s first task to harm the Grand Caliph was to ensure he never fathered an heir . He accomplished this feat by forcing his Suha , his noble dao slave , to bury magical amulets within the masonry of each room of the royal harim .

title: Unstrarr Troon
description: Unstrarr Troon Unstrarr Troon was a veteran member of the Purple Dragons in Suzail , Cormyr . History . Around 1479 DR , Troon and other five Dragons acted as an escort for the War Wizard of Cormyr Ellard Gauntur in his pursuit of the renegade Rorskryn Mreldrake to Marsember .
description_long: Unstrarr Troon Unstrarr Troon was a veteran member of the Purple Dragons in Suzail , Cormyr . History . Around 1479 DR , Troon and other five Dragons acted as an escort for the War Wizard of Cormyr Ellard Gauntur in his pursuit of the renegade Rorskryn Mreldrake to Marsember . However , Troon was killed by the death knight Targrael , who was acting under the orders of Manshoon .

title: Unther
description: Unther Unther was one of the Old Empires in eastern Faerûn . The Untherite were brought to Toril from Earth by the Imaskar Empire looking for some manpower . After countless praises , the gods of the Untheric pantheon were able to manifest into Toril by sending physical avatars .
description_long: Unther Unther was one of the Old Empires in eastern Faerûn . The Untherite were brought to Toril from Earth by the Imaskar Empire looking for some manpower . After countless praises , the gods of the Untheric pantheon were able to manifest into Toril by sending physical avatars . With the help of their deities , the former slaves freed themselves and settled that lands that later became Unther . Ironically , their rival in the millennia to come was another human tribe captured by the Imaskari and freed at the same time , which founded the empire of Mulhorand . Government . After the foundation of the First Untheric Empire , the god - kings of the Untheric pantheon ruled the land without opposition . After Enlil left the Realms in - 734 DR , Gilgeam became the inmortal ruler of Unther until his death in 1358 DR . In the chaotic period before Gilgeam ' s death , Mulhorand conquered most of Unther , and a group of spellcaster s known Northern Wizards were able to maintain the north free of the presence of the occupation force .

title: Untheric languages
description: Untheric languages The Untheric languages group was one of the two major branches of the Rauric languages family and included languages spoken in both Faerûn and Zakhara . Subgroups . The Untheric languages included the Untheric language spoken in Unther and also those of the two language subgroups of the Midani and Alzho languages .
description_long: Untheric languages The Untheric languages group was one of the two major branches of the Rauric languages family and included languages spoken in both Faerûn and Zakhara . Subgroups . The Untheric languages included the Untheric language spoken in Unther and also those of the two language subgroups of the Midani and Alzho languages . Untheric was strongly influenced by Imaskari slave argot , while the Midani and Alzho languages were shaped by the languages of genie s . Appendix . Inspiration . The grouping of the Untheric languages was inspired by the real - life languages , such as and .

title: Untheric pantheon
description: Untheric pantheon The Untheric pantheon , originally housed on the plane of Zigguraxus . Brought over from another world by slaves imported into Faerûn by Imaskar . Like the Mulhorandi pantheon , the Untheric gods were initially barred from contact with their followers by a planar barrier erected by the Imaskari , however also like the Mulhorandi gods , they bypassed this problem by sending physical manifestations of themselves to Toril via the Astral Plane .
description_long: Untheric pantheon The Untheric pantheon , originally housed on the plane of Zigguraxus . Brought over from another world by slaves imported into Faerûn by Imaskar . Like the Mulhorandi pantheon , the Untheric gods were initially barred from contact with their followers by a planar barrier erected by the Imaskari , however also like the Mulhorandi gods , they bypassed this problem by sending physical manifestations of themselves to Toril via the Astral Plane . With their divine power backing them , their followers were able to overthrow the Imaskari and build a civilisation for themselves . The pantheon made few friends among the other gods , but many enemies then , during the Orcgate Wars , the pantheon was devastated by the loss of seven of its members at the hands of the Orc deities while another , Tiamat , was banished to the Nine Hells . Gilgeam became more and more despotic over time and grew to be hated by the people of Unther . When the last of Tiamat ' s cultists summoned an aspect of her , she began to forment plans to overthrow the God - king and she regained her status as a god with the resulting swell of worshipers who shared her goal .

title: Unworthy of Ilsensine
description: Unworthy of Ilsensine The Unworthy of Ilsensine is a new organization , based underneath the Giant ' s Run mountains on the Dragon Coast . It is a cult dedicated to the worship of Ilsensine and is led by an Illithid cleric named Qooql . History .
description_long: Unworthy of Ilsensine The Unworthy of Ilsensine is a new organization , based underneath the Giant ' s Run mountains on the Dragon Coast . It is a cult dedicated to the worship of Ilsensine and is led by an Illithid cleric named Qooql . History . Qooql was a pilgrim who went to the Illithid city of Oryndoll in 1370 DR where Ilsensine had appeared twice before . For reasons known only to itself , the Elder Brain of the city turned Qooql away at the gates . Qooql thought he was being tested so waited just outside of the city before trying to enter again . This time he was forced away by a group of thrall s . Qooql believed he was being rejected by a sect of renegade priests and decided to travel to the surface instead , whereupon he met a band of Stone giants . He " charmed " the leader of the group and asked to be brought before the tribe ' s chieftain , whom he thought he could manipulate . He didn ' t reckon on the chieftain to be the Dodkong himself , who ordered Qooql ' s destruction for " charming " one of his best hunters . Qooql convinced his " charmed " giant that the Dodkong had gone insane and meant to kill them both . The giant aided in the pair ' s escape .

title: Uplift
description: Uplift Uplift was a cooperative spell that allowed one priest to boost the spellcasting ability of another , temporarily granting higher level spells . Effects . Both priests had to be able to cast this spell , which took 12 hours to complete .
description_long: Uplift Uplift was a cooperative spell that allowed one priest to boost the spellcasting ability of another , temporarily granting higher level spells . Effects . Both priests had to be able to cast this spell , which took 12 hours to complete . At the end of this long ritual , the higher level priest was granted two ( or more , depending on the level of the assisting priest ) experience levels for the purpose of spellcasting only , i . e . , no benefits other than receiving extra spells and the ability to cast them at the temporary level . During the casting of " uplift " , the priests decided which new spells of all levels they desired and supplicated their deity or deities for them . Upon successful completion of this spell , the priests touched palms and the superior priest immediately gained the additional spells and had 10 minutes in which to cast them . At the end of this time , the priest that received the " uplift " took mental exhaustion damage that could only be healed after eight hours of bedrest . Components . The only somatic component of this spell was the touching of palms at the very end . Verbal components included naming the bonus spell or spells desired .

title: Upper planes
description: Upper planes The upper planes ( sometimes Upper Planes ) is a collective term used in the Great Wheel cosmology model to represent the Outer planes of Good alignment , located across the top of the Great Wheel . These are Arcadia , the Seven Heavens , the Twin Paradises , Elysium , Happy Hunting Grounds / Beastlands , Olympus / Arvandor , and Gladsheim . The World Tree cosmology model rearranged , renamed , and reorganized the upper planes into the Celestial planes but some people still use the older term to describe the good - aligned planes .

title: Upsen Downs
description: Upsen Downs Upsen Downs was a dwarven song and the name of the subject of the song : a mythical dwarven utopian town in a deep mine . Once the many formal verses had been sung , it was customary to improvise further verses , where each singer would take a turn to state their own wants from the imaginary town .

Once the many formal verses had been sung , it was customary to improvise further verses , where each singer would take a turn to state their own wants from the imaginary town .

title: Upsetting onslaught
description: Upsetting onslaught Upsetting onslaught , also sometimes known as binding blast , is a spell used by some warlock s , particularly those of the dark pact . When " upsetting onslaught " is cast , the warlock casts a bolt of pure arcane power at a target of his or her choice within fifty feet . If the target fails to resist the bolt ' s effects upon their minds , they dazed into a stupor for a brief moment or take even greater injury .
description_long: Upsetting onslaught Upsetting onslaught , also sometimes known as binding blast , is a spell used by some warlock s , particularly those of the dark pact . When " upsetting onslaught " is cast , the warlock casts a bolt of pure arcane power at a target of his or her choice within fifty feet . If the target fails to resist the bolt ' s effects upon their minds , they dazed into a stupor for a brief moment or take even greater injury . While the spell , which uses the warlock ' s charisma to fuel its power , usually attacks the mind of the opponent , dark pact warlocks can choose instead to attack the body , if they view it to be more vulnerable . " Upsetting onslaught " can be cast with relative ease and reacquired after its casting through a rest of a few minutes or more . Prior to the Spellplague , " upsetting onslaught " was known more commonly as " binding blast " and was able to be cast at - will , rather than once every so often . In virtually all other ways , however , the spell was identical .

title: Upstream Span
description: Upstream Span The Upstream Span was a bridge across the River Mirar in the city of Luskan . History . As of 1370 DR , Baliver ' s House of Horses was situated at the south end of this bridge , and at the north end was the North Gate , the northern entrance to the walled city .
description_long: Upstream Span The Upstream Span was a bridge across the River Mirar in the city of Luskan . History . As of 1370 DR , Baliver ' s House of Horses was situated at the south end of this bridge , and at the north end was the North Gate , the northern entrance to the walled city .

title: Upvale
description: Upvale Upvale is the name of the area between Tall Trees and the Far Forest . This region , along the Delimbiyr ( River Shining ) , used to be an area with many farms and pastures settled by humans , but subject to frequent raids by orcs . It eventually fell under the control of Hellgate Keep until that location was laid to ruins .
description_long: Upvale Upvale is the name of the area between Tall Trees and the Far Forest . This region , along the Delimbiyr ( River Shining ) , used to be an area with many farms and pastures settled by humans , but subject to frequent raids by orcs . It eventually fell under the control of Hellgate Keep until that location was laid to ruins . It is part of a larger region known as the Delimbiyr Vale .

title: Ur - priest
description: Ur - priest While the vast majority of divine spellcasters gain their powers from a deity , there are some who despise the gods . The ur - priests have learned to siphon off the divine or unholy energies granted by gods to their divine spellcasters , using it for their own needs without giving even lip - service to any god . Background .
description_long: Ur - priest While the vast majority of divine spellcasters gain their powers from a deity , there are some who despise the gods . The ur - priests have learned to siphon off the divine or unholy energies granted by gods to their divine spellcasters , using it for their own needs without giving even lip - service to any god . Background . Ur - priests , while rare , come from all walks of life , as there is no spellcasting requirement for this class . Some of the deadliest , however , are ex - cleric s who , for whatever reason , have decided to forswear their deity to gain earthly power . Whereas clerics , paladin s , and the like pray for their spells each day at a chosen time , ur - priests go into a meditative state not unlike the elven resting trance . In this state , they mentally steal the power gods channel to their spellcasters . Of necessity they are cunning and stealthy , never stealing too much from any single deity , but instead slipping in , drawing out power , and slipping back out . They become highly resilient to divine spells and creative with the energies they steal .

title: Urathyl
description: Urathyl Urathyl was the Councilor of Zhentil Keep ' s Council of Lords in 1368 DR . Personality . Urathyl was loyal to Manshoon and the Zhent but if he can support also the Church of Bane .
description_long: Urathyl Urathyl was the Councilor of Zhentil Keep ' s Council of Lords in 1368 DR . Personality . Urathyl was loyal to Manshoon and the Zhent but if he can support also the Church of Bane . History . Urathyl ' s family profited from festhall and vine trade ; he was appointed at the Council under Manshoon input but proved very capable in his role . Urathyl did all the amministrative works of the Council , paying attention to have the support of all members . Usually the High Hall ' s staff were full of relatives and friends of all lords ( including Urathyl ' s ) . Urathyl used seldom " creative solution " to resolve troubles , like create false Council ' s papers . He supported always Zhentarim . Urathyl supervised all the Council ' s meetings .

title: Urbone
description: Urbone Urbone was a lizardfolk chieftain in Cormanthor . Activities . Urbone was the leader of a lizardfolk tribe that venerated Dretchroyaster .
description_long: Urbone Urbone was a lizardfolk chieftain in Cormanthor . Activities . Urbone was the leader of a lizardfolk tribe that venerated Dretchroyaster . History . In 1479 DR , Urbone was ready to destroy the heretical Cult of the Dragon cell led by Silakul when some adventurers infiltrated the lair of Dretchroyaster and they defeated Urbone . Personality . Urbone and his tribe truly worshiped Dretchroyaster like a true god . Thus he greatly disliked Silakul and his fellows , who saw the the dracolich only as an instrument of power . He ruled with cunning and patience .

title: Urd
description: Urd Urds were distant relatives of kobold s , with the power of flight , due to a pair of bat - like wings . They were frail , around 3 ' ( 90 cm ) tall with yellow to red scales and a pair of horns . Although they could live over a hundred years , life expectancy was only around fifty .
description_long: Urd Urds were distant relatives of kobold s , with the power of flight , due to a pair of bat - like wings . They were frail , around 3 ' ( 90 cm ) tall with yellow to red scales and a pair of horns . Although they could live over a hundred years , life expectancy was only around fifty . They possessed darkvision . In combat , urds preferred to attack under the cover of darkness by dropping sharp stones from above . Religion . Urds worshiped their patron god , Kuraulyek . Some revered the kobold deity Kurtulmak instead , and Kuraulyek ' s priests made it their primary duty to wipe out incidences of Kurtulmak - worship from their flocks . Regions . Urds were found in the Starspire Mountains in County Starspur of Tethyr . History . The " Treatise Historical of the Dragon Tyrants " recounted that in circa - 24500 DR , early members of the kobold race mated with chromatic dragon s to produce the first dragonwrought kobold s . These dragonwrought kobolds came to work in teams known as wings , or " urds " in the Draconic language . The leader of the urds in those days was a blue dragonwrought kobold named Kuraulyek .

title: Urdlen
description: Urdlen Urdlen , also known as the Crawler Below , was a chaotic evil gnome deity . It took the form of a white mole , blind , hairless , sexless , but with claws of steel . A mindless force of evil and destruction , Urdlen was the only evil gnome deity .
description_long: Urdlen Urdlen , also known as the Crawler Below , was a chaotic evil gnome deity . It took the form of a white mole , blind , hairless , sexless , but with claws of steel . A mindless force of evil and destruction , Urdlen was the only evil gnome deity . It was allowed to remain part of that pantheon by its leader Garl Glittergold as a reminder to all gnomes of the dangers of greed and bloodlust . Worshipers . Worship of Urdlen was limited to either secretive cults or a lurking threat on the margins of society . Its cleric s waged war on the clergy of other gnome deities , or spent their time stealing works of art and other objects of great value and destroying or defacing them . Relationships . Urdlen hated all the other gnomish deities , and they had no particular love for him as well . Its actions also earned the wrath of the gods of halflings , dwarves , and kobolds , as well as Grumbar . Dogma . Urdlen insisted that all living things had to be killed , and that all things created by the living had to be destroyed . It exhorted its followers to hate , covet , ruin , and destroy ; to succumb to bloodlust ; to revel in orgies of destruction and exult in killing .

title: Urdogen
description: Urdogen Urdogen was a pirate lord of history residing in Ravenloft . History . Urdogen was the successor of Immurk as lord of the Pirate Isles in 1204 DR .
description_long: Urdogen Urdogen was a pirate lord of history residing in Ravenloft . History . Urdogen was the successor of Immurk as lord of the Pirate Isles in 1204 DR . His raids inflicted so great damages that in Eleint 11 of 1209 DR Cormyr , Sembia , Impiltur , and the Vilhon Reach joined together to assault him and the Dragonisle . When Urdogen saw all his ships destroyed he flew in his last ship proclaiming his stern vengeance to the Inner Sea but soon was surrounded by strange mists and found himself in Raveloft . There quickly he become a specter and cursed all his crew with unlife . In time he become one of the powerful Ravenloft lord but never forgot his vengeance . In moonless nights when the fog was high Urdogen went back to Faerûn and preyed upon all ships he found but at dawn was driven back to Ravenloft .

title: Urdun Brizik
description: Urdun Brizik Urdun Brizik was a half - elf businessman and dancer in Mulmaster . Personality . The half - elf considered himself very lucky that Mulmaster ' s current situation permitted him to join his two interests into a profitable venture .
description_long: Urdun Brizik Urdun Brizik was a half - elf businessman and dancer in Mulmaster . Personality . The half - elf considered himself very lucky that Mulmaster ' s current situation permitted him to join his two interests into a profitable venture . However , he was always in fear of a misstep that could cost him his business and social standing . Urdun liked to flirt with female patrons . Relationships . Urdun was a dancer who at one point opened the festhall the Wave and Wink with his wife Kata Brizik . Soon it became one of the most popular festhalls in the city . History . In 1491 DR , however , during a party for the birthday of Zora Tiega Gos , his wife inexplicably burned Tiega . He agreed with Zor Faltyn Gos to hire an adventuring party to uncover the truth .

title: Urdunnir
description: Urdunnir The Urdunnirin ( singular : urdunnir ) were a long - forgotten offshoot of the dwarves . Their name meant " orecutter " in the urdunnir dialect of Dwarvish . History .
description_long: Urdunnir The Urdunnirin ( singular : urdunnir ) were a long - forgotten offshoot of the dwarves . Their name meant " orecutter " in the urdunnir dialect of Dwarvish . History . Urdunnirin were created by Dumathoin from the shield dwarves that lived in Shanatar . After their creation , the urdunnirin went into the depths of the Underdark and became creatures of legend . Physical description . Urdunnirin looked much like gold dwarves . Their skin and hair , however , were stone gray and their eyes were silver . Males groomed their gray beards carefully , while females did not have facial hair . Abilities . All urdunnirin had the ability to walk through solid earth and stone at will , moving through these normally solid materials as if they were air . They could move up to twice their body weight with them in this manner . They also had an innate ability to shape stone and metal as if they were wet clay , the materials remaining solid after they were done with them . Ecology . Urdunnirin did not eat normal foods . Instead , they fed on gem s as xorn did . The god Dumathoin provided each urdunnir settlement with a self - replenishing gem supply so that his people did not starve .

title: Urduthar
description: Urduthar Urduthar was a shadowslain cleric of Shar involved in the Zhent invasion of Shadowdale in the Year of Risen Elfkin , 1375 DR . History . Urduthar was a cleric of Shar that chose to become undead to rise in rank within the Church of Shar ; and so he become the second - in - command of Esvele Greycastle .
description_long: Urduthar Urduthar was a shadowslain cleric of Shar involved in the Zhent invasion of Shadowdale in the Year of Risen Elfkin , 1375 DR . History . Urduthar was a cleric of Shar that chose to become undead to rise in rank within the Church of Shar ; and so he become the second - in - command of Esvele Greycastle . He was in the lair of the ally lich Alokkair in 1375 DR , performing shadow rituals to destroy the Weave in the Shadowdale area .

title: Urgala Meltimer
description: Urgala Meltimer Urgala Meltimer was an innkeeper in Triboar sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . Description . Urgala was a female human of Turami descent , with dark brown skin and black hair .
description_long: Urgala Meltimer Urgala Meltimer was an innkeeper in Triboar sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . Description . Urgala was a female human of Turami descent , with dark brown skin and black hair . She kept herself fit and could be quite intimidating . Personality . Urgala was a former adventurer and because of her previous experiences she held a deep mistrust for all adventurers . She liked retirement and was very protective of her home , the Northshield House inn , and was willing to fight to preserve it . All guests in the inn bearing weapons were admonished to keep them sheathed . She treated bullies just like monsters , curbing their behavior with a sharp word and a firm hand , or driving them out with violence if necessary . Abilities . She was skilled with a morningstar and a shortbow , especially against giant s . She spoke both common and the language of giants . Possessions . Urgala was the owner and proprietor of the Norhtshield House , an inn located in Triboar . She also had three masiff s which she used for hunting . Activities . Urgala kept the Northshield House clean and quiet , earning it a good reputation in the region . History .

title: Urgrosh
description: Urgrosh An urgrosh , also known as a spear - axe , was an exotic two - handed melee weapon . Description . The urgrosh was much like the dwarven waraxe but with a longer haft , longer even than a greataxe but not so long as to be considered a pole arm .
description_long: Urgrosh An urgrosh , also known as a spear - axe , was an exotic two - handed melee weapon . Description . The urgrosh was much like the dwarven waraxe but with a longer haft , longer even than a greataxe but not so long as to be considered a pole arm . The gripping end of the haft was mounted with a spearhead . An average urgrosh cost 50 gp and weighed 12 lbs ( 5 . 5 kg ) . Use . Because of the two heads , the urgrosh could deal either slashing or piercing damage . The urgrosh was considered a double weapon that could be used as if fighting with two separate weapons provided it was wielded two - handed . If used one - handed , it was treated as either a shortspear or a battleaxe . Dwarves favored this weapon , because for them it was a martial weapon ; for everyone else , it was exotic . Realmslore . The dwarven warrior Khouryn Skulldark wielded an urgrosh .

title: Urgutha Forka
description: Urgutha Forka Urgutha Forka was a vicious demon that once spread a virulent plague in ancient times before the ancestors of the drow fled to the Underdark . The surface elves denied the existence of Urgutha Forka , preferring to blame the drow . The drow , when realizing they were immune to the lethal plague , enlisted Urgutha as an ally .
description_long: Urgutha Forka Urgutha Forka was a vicious demon that once spread a virulent plague in ancient times before the ancestors of the drow fled to the Underdark . The surface elves denied the existence of Urgutha Forka , preferring to blame the drow . The drow , when realizing they were immune to the lethal plague , enlisted Urgutha as an ally . The saying " been yet not been " was a line from a longer drow tale insulting the surface elves who had lost thousands to a demon they refused to admit existed .

title: Urhur Hahpet
description: Urhur Hahpet Urhur Hahpet was a Red Wizard practitioner of necromancy and a follower of the lich Szass Tam . History . Urhur was one of the necromancers tasked by Tam with creating and commanding the marauding undead who had attacked eastern Thay in order to create fear .
description_long: Urhur Hahpet Urhur Hahpet was a Red Wizard practitioner of necromancy and a follower of the lich Szass Tam . History . Urhur was one of the necromancers tasked by Tam with creating and commanding the marauding undead who had attacked eastern Thay in order to create fear . Aoth Fezim , Bareris Anskuld , Chathi Oandem , and Mirror , already suspecting the truth , ambushed Urhur ' s party , and after he was subdued he confirmed their suspicions . However , he was killed by Szass Tam ' s binding enchantment before he could reveal the necromancer ' s orders concerning the imminent fight against the undead host . .

title: Uridezu
description: Uridezu A uridezu was a craven , intelligent demon of the Abyss . Appearance . It appeared as a hairless rat - like fiend that walked upright with a long flexible tail and feral claws .
description_long: Uridezu A uridezu was a craven , intelligent demon of the Abyss . Appearance . It appeared as a hairless rat - like fiend that walked upright with a long flexible tail and feral claws . They were often in the employ of more powerful demons , but could command regular rats when on the Material Plane .

title: Urkamond Thond
description: Urkamond Thond Urkamond Thond was a wealthy aristocrat from Saerloon , Sembia , who made his fortune in the textile trade . Abilities . Urkamond was a sharp - witted fellow that made shrewd business deals in textiles .
description_long: Urkamond Thond Urkamond Thond was a wealthy aristocrat from Saerloon , Sembia , who made his fortune in the textile trade . Abilities . Urkamond was a sharp - witted fellow that made shrewd business deals in textiles . History . Even though he could easily afford better , he was known to stay at the Whistling Wizard inn when he passed through Voonlar . He was of the opinion that it was " Far better than I ' d been led to believe . If all one demands is fair food and a place to sleep unmolested , it serves quite adequately . "

title: Url
description: Url Url was a dwarven blacksmith and merchant in Mantol - Derith . Activities . Url usually sold weapons .
description_long: Url Url was a dwarven blacksmith and merchant in Mantol - Derith . Activities . Url usually sold weapons . Personality . Url disliked drow and duergar . He deeply regretted how his life was ruined by the evil Red Wizard . History . Around 1479 DR , Url and his lover were captured by a Red Wizard of Thay . With the life of his lover in the wizard ' s hands , the wizard commanded Url to go to Mantol - Derith to sell weapons and collect information .

title: Urlgen Threefist
description: Urlgen Threefist Urlgen Threefist is a male orc and son of King Obould Many - Arrows . Background . Urlgen led some of his fathers forces agains the Shallows , which was ultimately levelled by the attack .
description_long: Urlgen Threefist Urlgen Threefist is a male orc and son of King Obould Many - Arrows . Background . Urlgen led some of his fathers forces agains the Shallows , which was ultimately levelled by the attack . The attack was from the orcs fighting from the south and some of Dame Gerti Orelsdottr ' s giant s throwing stones from across a ravine to the north . The attack though successful , ultimately allowed for the companions rescue as Regis , having become much braver , though still frightened , escapes with the help of a worg and the orc rider using his ruby pendant to entrance the rider . Bruenor is in dire trouble , barely alive as the Shallow s falls around them . Bruenor having gone over the wall into the orcs causing them a great deal of trouble , but ultimately he fell and was seemingly in a coma for a while . Urlgen though , had eradicated the town , even ultimately causing the death of Withegroo Seian ' Doo the wizard . Urlgen is approached during the campaign by Gerti , seeking in her own way to diminish his fathers standing , lending aid to him of a number of giants . These frost giant s start building giant catapults to help crush the dwarves standing against him .

title: Urlingwood
description: Urlingwood The Urlingwood was a wood in north Rashemen . Inhabitants . The forest was the meeting place of the Witches of Rashemen .
description_long: Urlingwood The Urlingwood was a wood in north Rashemen . Inhabitants . The forest was the meeting place of the Witches of Rashemen . Anyone not of their order was killed for entering the woods . Patrols of Rashemi solders marched around the border to warn off the ignorant or lost . History . As of 1374 DR , the easternmost cell of the Eldreth Veluuthra operated here , being made up of those who committed crimes within the organization not serious enough to be deemed worthy of execution . The cell was tasked with ridding the wood of witches .

title: Urlryn
description: Urlryn Urlryn was a drow and one of Houndaer Tuin ' Tarl and Syrzan ' s group in Menzoberranzan in 1372 DR . History . Urlryn once trained at Melee - Magthere under Ryld Argith and was proficient enough that Ryld remembered his name many years later .
description_long: Urlryn Urlryn was a drow and one of Houndaer Tuin ' Tarl and Syrzan ' s group in Menzoberranzan in 1372 DR . History . Urlryn once trained at Melee - Magthere under Ryld Argith and was proficient enough that Ryld remembered his name many years later . During the Silence of Lolth , Urlryn joined Houndaer ' s group in order to start a slave revolt . The plot was discovered by Ryld Argith and Pharaun Mizzrym . When they escaped from the conspirators ' building , Urlryn and his fellows hunted them , but Urlryn was killed by his former master .

title: Urlryn Khalazza
description: Urlryn Khalazza Urlryn Khalazza was the head of the College of Conjuration and one of the members of the Conclave of Sshamath in the city of Sshamath in the year 1372 DR . History . In 1377 DR , Q ' arlynd Melarn told the priestess of Eilistraee Miverra that Urlryn had risen through the ranks by poisoning all his rivals .
description_long: Urlryn Khalazza Urlryn Khalazza was the head of the College of Conjuration and one of the members of the Conclave of Sshamath in the city of Sshamath in the year 1372 DR . History . In 1377 DR , Q ' arlynd Melarn told the priestess of Eilistraee Miverra that Urlryn had risen through the ranks by poisoning all his rivals . After spoking with Miverra the Master of Divination Seldszar Elpragh informed Master Urlryn of his discoveries about the faerzress ' s problems and Urlryn said he received the same information from a cleric of Vhaeraun from Skullport . In 1379 DR Urlryn agreed with Seldszar ' s proposal to the Conclave to elevate Q ' arlynd as new member , Master of the Ancient Arcana . Later he met with Masters Seldszar Elpragh , Masoj Dhuunyl and Q ' arlynd Melarn and they involved also Masoj in their plan to strip the faerzress from the drow . Together with Q ' arlynd ' s apprentices and the Masters Seldszar Elpragh and Masoj Dhuunyl he helped Q ' arlynd when he engineered ( with the aid of Eilistraee ) the ritual that transformed all drow not tainted by Wendonai ' s blood into brown - skinned dark elves . Afterward they all relocated to Rhymanthiin .

title: Urmas
description: Urmas Urmas was the busiest of the librarians living in Gravenhollow during the Rage of Demons . Activities . Urmas regularly kept in touch with all giant s community in Underdark using a vast network of magically augmented subterranean beasts used as messengers .
description_long: Urmas Urmas was the busiest of the librarians living in Gravenhollow during the Rage of Demons . Activities . Urmas regularly kept in touch with all giant s community in Underdark using a vast network of magically augmented subterranean beasts used as messengers . One of his most frequent questioned was Stonekeeper Hgraam in Gracklstugh . He was also in constant contact with all stone giants mystic and some xorn and galeb duhr servants Personality . Urmas was a patient and polite individual on surface . However he dislike people or things that disturb his work

title: Urml
description: Urml Urml was a community of grippli at the far eastern end of the Wetwoods in the Shining Plains . Government . Urml ' s leader was the tribe mother Oluusious , a grippli aged nearly four hundred years old .
description_long: Urml Urml was a community of grippli at the far eastern end of the Wetwoods in the Shining Plains . Government . Urml ' s leader was the tribe mother Oluusious , a grippli aged nearly four hundred years old . She was afraid of humanoid expeditions into the Wetwoods , worrying that human expansion would mean their small village being added to human lands . Notable locations . A shrine to Silvanus was found in Urml . History . Over a number of years , the grippli gathered at this location to build a small village of 200 omnivorous grippli . They tried to stay out of the affairs of the other humanoid s as much as they could . In the Year of the Spur , 1348 DR , an excavation outside Urml turned up a magically preserved " rieldoxia " , a word crystal of the fallen empire of Jhaamdath . It apparently contained the thought images of Exarch Thelasand IV of Jhaamdath , from the very beginning of the Procession of Justice in the Year of the Striking Lance , – 247 DR , mentioning his flight to the Wetwoods and captivity among the grippli .

title: Urmlaspyr
description: Urmlaspyr Urmlaspyr was a city in southern Sembia that was notable mostly for its poor treatment at the hands of the shadovar . The city was supported by Cormyr and a significant amount of trade from that country flowed through its port . Urmlaspyr was blanketed by a layer of dark magical clouds conjured by a Netherese arch mage that was impossible to dispel .
description_long: Urmlaspyr Urmlaspyr was a city in southern Sembia that was notable mostly for its poor treatment at the hands of the shadovar . The city was supported by Cormyr and a significant amount of trade from that country flowed through its port . Urmlaspyr was blanketed by a layer of dark magical clouds conjured by a Netherese arch mage that was impossible to dispel . Military . Cormyr loaned the city a company of Purple Dragon knights to aid in its defense . History . Urmlaspyr was formerly known as the city of temples . When the shadovar outlawed the worship of any deity other than Shar the people of Urmlaspyr resisted and the city was nearly razed and many of the citizens enslaved . The city threw out the shadovar after the Spellplague and was an independent city in 1479 DR .

title: Urn of the Blue Vishap
description: Urn of the Blue Vishap The Urn of the Blue Vishap was a unique Zakhara n magical item commanding a powerful creature . Description . This item was aptly named , being an urn richly adorned in gold and blue with themes from the sea with a vishap ' s head decorating its lid .
description_long: Urn of the Blue Vishap The Urn of the Blue Vishap was a unique Zakhara n magical item commanding a powerful creature . Description . This item was aptly named , being an urn richly adorned in gold and blue with themes from the sea with a vishap ' s head decorating its lid . It could change in height from one to four feet . Powers . The " Urn " held the blue dragon Saluuknir in bounds . The holder of the urn could ask the mighty dragon to perform three tasks . Saluuknir was not only forced to fulfil these wishes , but also prevented from attacking the possessor of the urn or anyone else , except in defense of himself or his prison . The " Urn of the Blue Vishap " also granted its prisoner some magic abilities beyond its great natural powers . History . The " Urn " was originally created as a " genie prison " by accomplished sha ' ir Shalik ibn Shakuffar , who used it to trap the evil marid Merifa of the Pearl Lagoons . The item was then sent outside of Zakhara , where Merifa managed to escape its power by tricking Saluuknir into exchange places . The blue dragon had been seeking for ways to escape the urn and take revenge on the marid ever since .

title: Urnalithorgathla
description: Urnalithorgathla Urnalithorgathla was a female wyrm green dragon that once laired in Spiderhaunt Wood in the Dalelands . History . Around the 1270s DR , Urnalithorgathla slew the Grimblades adventuring company in her lair , and left their bones amidst her treasure .
