description_long: Urnalithorgathla Urnalithorgathla was a female wyrm green dragon that once laired in Spiderhaunt Wood in the Dalelands . History . Around the 1270s DR , Urnalithorgathla slew the Grimblades adventuring company in her lair , and left their bones amidst her treasure . She took the sword " Sarghathuld " , wielded by their leader Kesten Orthalin , for her hoard , and it lay there for over ninety years . Finally , Urnalithorgathla was slain by a force of dwarves led by Borlin , who claimed " Sarghathuld " , prior to 1364 DR .

title: Urogalan
description: Urogalan Urogalan was the halfling deity of earth and death . His symbol was the silhouette of a dog ' s head . Urogalan was a gentle deity for a god of death , respected and revered by his chosen race but never feared .
description_long: Urogalan Urogalan was the halfling deity of earth and death . His symbol was the silhouette of a dog ' s head . Urogalan was a gentle deity for a god of death , respected and revered by his chosen race but never feared . He was seen as a protector of the dead . Because halfling dead were usually buried in the earth , he was also the guardian of the earth itself ( as opposed to the green plants that grow in the earth , which were the dominion of other halfling deities ) . Urogalan rarely spoke or showed emotion . His voice , rarely heard , was tinged with loss . In appearance , Urogalan was a slim , dusky - skinned halfling dressed in brown or pure white , representing his two primary aspects of earth and death . Realm . Urogalan ' s realm , " Soulearth " , was found on the plane of Elysium . This realm was a cavern beneath the surface of Eronia , Elysium ' s second layer . The souls of halflings went to Urogalan ' s realm before being assigned their proper places in the afterlife . Worshipers . Few halflings actually worshiped Urogalan , but most honored and propitiated him . Clergy . Though he was propitiated by many halflings , Urogalan ' s priesthood was small .

title: Urophion
description: Urophion An urophion was created by inserting an illithid tadpole into a roper , resulting in these miserable creatures . They were used as guards and sentries . Description .
description_long: Urophion An urophion was created by inserting an illithid tadpole into a roper , resulting in these miserable creatures . They were used as guards and sentries . Description . An urophion was a truly unique creature , and was evidence of the willingness of the illithid to attempt to create ceremorphs even from the most unlikely organisms . What was truly unique about the urophion was that it was the only known case of ceremorphosis working on a cold - blooded creature . An urophion was nearly identical in every regard to a roper in appearance . Society . Urophions acted as guardians and sentinels in illithid cities . They were similar to ropers in behaviour , predominately soltary , sedentary and stationary . Urophions were just as intelligent as regular illithid with psionic abilities that were nearly as powerful . Even though in almost every regard they were equally powerful to illithid , they were still considered lesser by their illithid overlords and were forced into dreary servitude . Their only honour was that when they died they would be fed to the elder brain . Most remain loyal to the illithid yet some do tend to become independent and wander off on their own .

title: Urthag
description: Urthag Urthag the Knife was a infamous pirate who preyed on the Dragon Reach in north Faerûn around the early 7th century DR . History . Urthag somehow got his hands on Galathos , a magic sword forged during the ancient empire of Raumathar and lost many centuries before .
description_long: Urthag Urthag the Knife was a infamous pirate who preyed on the Dragon Reach in north Faerûn around the early 7th century DR . History . Urthag somehow got his hands on Galathos , a magic sword forged during the ancient empire of Raumathar and lost many centuries before . He spent some time in the city of Chessagol in the Vast , and boldly caroused for several hours at the Bloated Gargoyle Inn . Finally , the Royal Constabulary discovered him and tried to arrest him . Urthag fled across the rooftops of Chessagol , but was forced to drop Galathos . Urthag escaped and his sword was given to King Lamoth . Legend had it that Urthag the Knife buried his treasure on the island of Two Rocks in the harbor of Harrowdale Town in the Dalelands . However , not a trace of this hoard was found by the mid – 14th century DR .

title: Uruma
description: Uruma Uruma was the oyabun of the Worthless Flower yakuza gang in Nakamaru around 1357 DR . Activities . Uruma directed all the operations of his gang from his veranda .
description_long: Uruma Uruma was the oyabun of the Worthless Flower yakuza gang in Nakamaru around 1357 DR . Activities . Uruma directed all the operations of his gang from his veranda . Thanks to his prized " cap of telepathy " , his underlings never knew when he saw inside their minds and what operations were underway , so they depended heavily on Uruma . History . Uruma was targeted by the tigbanua buso Getsu as the perfect vessel to spread his infection . Personality . Uruma ' s shrewd brain compensated for the weakness of his old body . However , he was still capable of fighting .

title: Uruth Ukrypt
description: Uruth Ukrypt Uruth Ukrypt was the king of the orc s of the Sword Mountains and led the orc invasion of Nimoar ' s Hold ( which later became Waterdeep ) in the Orcfastings War in 936 DR . Appearance . Uruth was a massive tusker .
description_long: Uruth Ukrypt Uruth Ukrypt was the king of the orc s of the Sword Mountains and led the orc invasion of Nimoar ' s Hold ( which later became Waterdeep ) in the Orcfastings War in 936 DR . Appearance . Uruth was a massive tusker . Background . Uruth was an orc chieftain until 927 DR , when the shaman Wund crowned him king . His orcs instigated the Orcfastings War in 936 DR and he led them to victory in the Battle of Whirling Blades , the Battle of Sarcrag and the Battle of Withered Fields . He held Nimoar ' s Hold ( which later became Waterdeep ) under siege until it was broken at the Battle of Burning Cliffs . In 951 DR , Uruth and his orcs laid waste to the human village of Phandalin . Subsequently , Uruth was killed in the Battle of the Westwood .

title: Uruthkurt
description: Uruthkurt The Uruthkurt family was a noble merchant family of the city of Tantras in the Vast . The head of the family sat on the High Council that governed Tantras . In 1358 DR , shortly after the Time of Troubles , the Uruthkurts were allied with the Aldimer and Mathlin families .
description_long: Uruthkurt The Uruthkurt family was a noble merchant family of the city of Tantras in the Vast . The head of the family sat on the High Council that governed Tantras . In 1358 DR , shortly after the Time of Troubles , the Uruthkurts were allied with the Aldimer and Mathlin families .

title: Uryuga
description: Uryuga Uryuga was an orc shaman in the Kingdom of Many - Arrows in 1484 DR . History . Uryuga was the high shaman of Gruumsh among the Many - Arrows orcs .
description_long: Uryuga Uryuga was an orc shaman in the Kingdom of Many - Arrows in 1484 DR . History . Uryuga was the high shaman of Gruumsh among the Many - Arrows orcs . He was convinced by Tiago Baenre , Tos ' un Armgo , and Ravel Xorlarrin to support the new war against the Silver Marches , giving it the blessing of Gruumsh .

title: Urz Jaelre
description: Urz Jaelre Urz Jaerle was a drow priest of Vhaeraun in 1375 DR . History . Urz was a priest from House Jaelre who joined Malvag ' s plot .
description_long: Urz Jaelre Urz Jaerle was a drow priest of Vhaeraun in 1375 DR . History . Urz was a priest from House Jaelre who joined Malvag ' s plot . Urz attacked Eilistraee ' s shrine in the Gray Forest , claiming the soul of a priestess . Later , he went to Malvag in a designated location to cast a spell that allowed Vhaeraun to enter Eilistraee ' s domain undetected . He was later killed by his fellow Szorak ( in truth , Q ' arlynd Melarn in disguise ) . Malvag managed to resurrect him after the casting of the spell but the returned Urz explained that it was Eilistraee who had killed Vhaeraun and claimed his portfolio . Afterward , he descended into madness .

title: Usamah
description: Usamah Usamah was a human corsair living on the various lands of the Great Sea in 1367 DR . Activities . Usamah was both the nakhuda and rubban of his sailing vessel .
description_long: Usamah Usamah was a human corsair living on the various lands of the Great Sea in 1367 DR . Activities . Usamah was both the nakhuda and rubban of his sailing vessel . This was a source of great pride for him . Possessions . Usamah owned " leather armor + 2 " , a " figurine of wondrous power ( marble elephant ) " , and a " scroll of protection from fire " .

title: Usilie Rostik
description: Usilie Rostik Usilie Rostik was a shopkeeper in Mulmaster in 1491 DR . Personality . Usilie was a very greedy person , always looking for some way to make a profit .
description_long: Usilie Rostik Usilie Rostik was a shopkeeper in Mulmaster in 1491 DR . Personality . Usilie was a very greedy person , always looking for some way to make a profit . He had pride in his very wide selection of imported products . For select clients , he also procured even rarer items of an illegal nature , such as silkroot . Activities . Usilie ran Usilie Rostik ' s Smoke Shoppe , a very popular shop in the city . History . in 1491 Usilie was interrogated by an adventuring party hired to found some missing noble scions . He admitted that most of them were clients of his shop . Possibly under input of Order of the Gauntlet the adventurers discovered his role in silkroot ' s traffic and arrested him

title: Uskevren
description: Uskevren The Uskevren ( meaning " too bold to hide " in some forgotten tongue ) were a noble family of Selgaunt who lived primarily in Stormweather Towers . Their house badge was a gold horse - head - and - fouled - anchor . Their money originally stockpiled through piracy , the family was nearly destroyed in the 1330s DR by rival families who discovered their illicit means of money - making .
description_long: Uskevren The Uskevren ( meaning " too bold to hide " in some forgotten tongue ) were a noble family of Selgaunt who lived primarily in Stormweather Towers . Their house badge was a gold horse - head - and - fouled - anchor . Their money originally stockpiled through piracy , the family was nearly destroyed in the 1330s DR by rival families who discovered their illicit means of money - making . The only surviving family member , Thamalon Uskevren , rebuilt the family fortune by buying and selling land , and then began sponsoring common folk . The people of Selgaunt began to trust the Uskevren name again Enemies . Primary among the Uskevren ' s enemies were those that helped nearly destroy them : the Soargyl , Talendar , Baerodreemer , Ithivisk , and Malveen . Properties . In addition to Stormweather Towers , the Uskevrens had a tallhouse near the Way of the Manticore and another on Lurvin Street . They also owned a smaller home outside of the city , named Storl Oak . Magical Items . Throughout the years , when there was doubt if someone was truly an Uskevren , the family used a magical cup called the " Quaff of the Uskevren " .

title: Ust Natha
description: Ust Natha Ust Natha is a drow city in the Underdark under northwestern Tethyr in Old Shanatar . It is maintained by the drow as a symbol , marking the location of a nearby temple on the surface where the first drow descended underground ; its name means " the first " . The temple and city are fought over regularly by the drow and surface elves ( including at least those from Suldanessellar ) , though the silver dragon Adalon guards the area and tries to govern the hostilities , often succesfully .
description_long: Ust Natha Ust Natha is a drow city in the Underdark under northwestern Tethyr in Old Shanatar . It is maintained by the drow as a symbol , marking the location of a nearby temple on the surface where the first drow descended underground ; its name means " the first " . The temple and city are fought over regularly by the drow and surface elves ( including at least those from Suldanessellar ) , though the silver dragon Adalon guards the area and tries to govern the hostilities , often succesfully . The entrance to her lair is located near that of Ust Natha , but the drow are incapable of entering it due to a wall of magical , impenetrable darkness blocking the passage . Other neighbours of Ust Natha include outposts of kuo - toa , illithid , and beholder s , all of whom are regarded as rivals by the drow ; and a svirfneblin town that is independent but plays a subservient role to the drow . At the other end of the same main cavern from which all of these settlements are accessed , there is also a hole leading upwards all the way into City - of - Caverns , a sahuagin settlement .

title: Ust sreen
description: Ust sreen Ust sreen , meaning " first danger " , was a fighting style taught among drow . It put importance on fast reactions when danger was first sighted . Description .
description_long: Ust sreen Ust sreen , meaning " first danger " , was a fighting style taught among drow . It put importance on fast reactions when danger was first sighted . Description . As the name " first danger " suggested , the fighting style was about fast reactions to the first appearance of an enemy and be the first danger to the same . The majority of drow combat groups , especially scouting groups , had at least one user of this style among them . That individual ' s role was to react fast and shoot a poisoned bolt to incapacitate an enemy before combat really began . Training . The style gave fast reactions and was certainly useful at the start of combat but , due to being almost useless in prolonged combat , users also tended to learn other styles to give themselves other offensive abilities . Reputation . Drow society was one in which vigilance was paramount , and thus the basics of this style were part of the standard curriculum of every drow fighting academy . Appendix . Background . This style is based on the Improved Initiative and Quick Draw feats of 3rd - edition " Dungeons & Dragons " .

title: Ustann
description: Ustann Ustaan was a small fishing village on the edge of Gbor Nor in Murghom . Description . Sitting on the coast of Gbor Nor , the small fishing village of Ustann was most famous for the Myrthard Clan of fishermen who lived there .
description_long: Ustann Ustaan was a small fishing village on the edge of Gbor Nor in Murghom . Description . Sitting on the coast of Gbor Nor , the small fishing village of Ustann was most famous for the Myrthard Clan of fishermen who lived there . Inhabitants . The Myrthard clan were famous for being the only people on Gbor Nor who were able to catch the giant sturgeon of the lake . Having spent decades refining their trade , they fanatically guarded the secrets to catching these massive fish , and often sabotaged rivals , or hired thugs to chase them out of town . While their secrecy was considered extreme by outsiders , the reason behind it all was the rarity of the fish , with only five or so being caught every year . These fish were highly prized in the courts of Semphar and Murghom , and a single one could fetch enough money for a year ' s worth of needs for an entire family .

title: Ustilagor
description: Ustilagor Ustilagors were the larval stage of the development of intellect devourer s . They were considered a delicacy by the mind flayer s of Oryndoll . The Thrall Market sold ustilagors to visitors for high prices in several varieties such as raw , pickled or seasoned with fungi .
description_long: Ustilagor Ustilagors were the larval stage of the development of intellect devourer s . They were considered a delicacy by the mind flayer s of Oryndoll . The Thrall Market sold ustilagors to visitors for high prices in several varieties such as raw , pickled or seasoned with fungi .

title: Ustova
description: Ustova Ustova was the most reserved of the librarians living in Gravenhollow during the Rage of Demons . Activities . Ustova spent all her time in meditation , sensing visions of the future that she transcribed on stone tablets .
description_long: Ustova Ustova was the most reserved of the librarians living in Gravenhollow during the Rage of Demons . Activities . Ustova spent all her time in meditation , sensing visions of the future that she transcribed on stone tablets . She kept a special eye on the futures of all giant communities in the Underdark , hoping to maybe see a clue to rebuilding the once - great giant civilization .

title: Ususi Manaallin
description: Ususi Manaallin Empress Ususi Manaallin was an Imaskari human wizard and the ruler of High Imaskar in 1479 DR . Appearance . As of 1479 DR , Empress Ususi was a frail and weak old woman .
description_long: Ususi Manaallin Empress Ususi Manaallin was an Imaskari human wizard and the ruler of High Imaskar in 1479 DR . Appearance . As of 1479 DR , Empress Ususi was a frail and weak old woman . Despite her age , she was warm and benevolent . History . Ususi was a wizard of Deep Imaskar . In 1374 DR , Ususi Manaallin with the help of the star elf Kiril Duskmourn and the vengeance - taker Iahn Qoyllor managed to keep the body and mind of the Elder Evil Pandorym imprisoned in the Celestial Nadir and the Palace of the Purple Emperor . When the threat had been dealt with , many of the younger Imaskari of Deep Imaskar left with Ususi to support the growth of High Imaskar . After the Spellplague , the wizard Ususi relocated the old Palace of the Purple Emperor to the barren Mulhorand i lands and founded the city of Skyclave and the nation of High Imaskar . She was crowned empress and her first mandate was to renounce the slavery of her ancestors , outlawing slave ownership on pain of death . She also set up the Body of Artificers , Planners , and Apprehenders , whose power was equal to and balanced hers .

title: Utaqa
description: Utaqa Utaqa , located at the mouth of Al - Zulma River , was the northernmost of Zakhara ' s Free Cities . Laying almost 200 miles ( 322 km ) from its nearest neighbor , Hafayah , Utaqa ' s citizens felt on the edge of civilization , and took pride in their independence from authority .
description_long: Utaqa Utaqa , located at the mouth of Al - Zulma River , was the northernmost of Zakhara ' s Free Cities . Laying almost 200 miles ( 322 km ) from its nearest neighbor , Hafayah , Utaqa ' s citizens felt on the edge of civilization , and took pride in their independence from authority .

title: Uth I
description: Uth I King Uth I ( full name Uth Myrmoran ) was a human who constructed Uthtower and became self - proclaimed king of a small port settlement on the Sword Coast North that would later become Myrmoran . Relatives . Uth ' s eldest son was Ornoth Myrmoran .
description_long: Uth I King Uth I ( full name Uth Myrmoran ) was a human who constructed Uthtower and became self - proclaimed king of a small port settlement on the Sword Coast North that would later become Myrmoran . Relatives . Uth ' s eldest son was Ornoth Myrmoran . Biography . Uth was a Lord of Tavaray until he was exiled . He moved to a small port settlement nearby and , in 146 DR , he built Uthtower on a rocky hill nearby . He brought a company of Shoon mercenaries with him , and proclaimed himself king , intending to build a great realm from this first settlement . He had brought with him a great deal of personal wealth from Tavaray and used this to pay off anyone who was opposed to him seizing power . He named his new settlement after himself , naming it Myrmoran . Uth began to feel the effects of age around 158 DR , when his eldest son Ornoth Myrmoran began to run the government , and died a decade later in 168 DR .

title: Uthagrimnoshaarl
description: Uthagrimnoshaarl Uthagrimnoshaarl , also known as the Dire Dragon , was an shadow dracolich who acted as the guardian of the Well of Dragons in Skull Gorge . Description . Uthagrimnoshaarl was a special kind of undead , a dracolich .
description_long: Uthagrimnoshaarl Uthagrimnoshaarl , also known as the Dire Dragon , was an shadow dracolich who acted as the guardian of the Well of Dragons in Skull Gorge . Description . Uthagrimnoshaarl was a special kind of undead , a dracolich . History . Around 1370 DR , the Cult of the Dragon approached him with a proposal of an alliance : The Cult ' s wizard s would release the Dire Dragon from his role of guardian if , in exchange , he would permit the Cult to build a fortress inside the Well .

title: Uthalion
description: Uthalion Uthalion was a human fighter and former mercenary who lived in the Spur Forest with his killoren friend Vaasurri . Uth was something of a naturalist and enjoyed sketching plants in a notebook . He was best known for destroying The Choir cult .
description_long: Uthalion Uthalion was a human fighter and former mercenary who lived in the Spur Forest with his killoren friend Vaasurri . Uth was something of a naturalist and enjoyed sketching plants in a notebook . He was best known for destroying The Choir cult . History . Uthalion was a mercenary who had retired to Airspur in Akanûl with his wife and child . He left his family in 1473 DR to fight for the Keepers of the Cerulean Sign in their campaign against the Aboleth Sovereignty . Uth ' s company was wiped out by the aboleth s at the village of Caidris . After the battle , Uth moved to the Spur Forest , where he lived in a grove with a killoren named Vaasurri . In 1479 DR , an old half - elf friend from his military days named Brindani sought Uthalion ' s aid as a guide through the Mere - That - Was region of Akanûl on a mission to rescue a genasi from The Choir . Uthalion and Vaasurri traveled with Brindani and the genasi ' s twin sister , Ghaelya , to Tohrepur where they confronted The Choir ' s leader , Lord Khault and slew him . Ghaelya ' s twin was so corrupted by a plaguechanged sirine that she slew her sister to end her suffering . Equipment .

title: Uthegentel Del ' Armgo
description: Uthegentel Del ' Armgo Uthegentel Del ' Armgo was the drow house weapons master of Barrison Del ' Armgo . Description . It was often said Uthegentel was the largest drow ever since he stood at over 6 ft ( 1 .
description_long: Uthegentel Del ' Armgo Uthegentel Del ' Armgo was the drow house weapons master of Barrison Del ' Armgo . Description . It was often said Uthegentel was the largest drow ever since he stood at over 6 ft ( 1 . 83 m ) tall and weighed around 200 lb ( 90 . 72 kg ) . Uthegentel had short spiky white hair which was gelled with cooked rothe udders . Through his nose was a mithril ring and he had gold pins stuck through his cheeks . Most think Uthegental was never full blooded , because of his height and abnormally large build for a drow elf . Uthegental was a rival to Dantrag Baenre , weapon master to House Baenre until his death at the hands of Drizzt Do ' Urden . At this time , Uthegentel was considered the greatest drow warrior in all of Menzoberranzan . Possessions . His weapon of choice was a black trident and he also used a magical net of entrapment . When battling foes , Uthegentel wore a suit of black plate mail and often let them strike first just to prove that they could not harm him . Personality . In battle , Uthegentel was wild and would wipe red and yellow dye on his face , which could be seen with or without darkvision .

title: Uther
description: Uther Uther was a dye found in the city of Qadib in Zakhara . Uses . The city of Qadib was well known for its dyemakers .
description_long: Uther Uther was a dye found in the city of Qadib in Zakhara . Uses . The city of Qadib was well known for its dyemakers . Uther was a crimson yellow - orange dye used in coloring many fabrics , including . The merchants of Qadib exported Uther throughout Zakhara . History . Around 1367 DR , many of the citizens throughout the City of Wands were identified by the uther colored clothing , such as their yellow robes or gold .

title: Uther ( individual )
description: Uther ( individual ) Uther was the butler of the Society of Stalwart Adventurers in Suzail in the 1360s DR . Thanks to an irreversible spell cast by Danilo Thann , Uther looked like an Abyss al denizen . The Thann family payed him a large amount of money for the damage .
description_long: Uther ( individual ) Uther was the butler of the Society of Stalwart Adventurers in Suzail in the 1360s DR . Thanks to an irreversible spell cast by Danilo Thann , Uther looked like an Abyss al denizen . The Thann family payed him a large amount of money for the damage . Secretly , Uther liked his new look , because it attracted some of the more adventurous female members of the circle and made it easy for him stop a brawl with a single look .

title: Uthgang Jyarl
description: Uthgang Jyarl Uthgang Jyarl was the head of the Tall Trees druidic order and the reputed Great Druid of the North . Not much was known of the goals of the druidic other than their desire to protect that portion of the woods that was once part of Earlann . Very few were allowed access to the Tall Trees enclave save a few allied Harpers , and notable figures of good , with whom they had some mutual alliance .
description_long: Uthgang Jyarl Uthgang Jyarl was the head of the Tall Trees druidic order and the reputed Great Druid of the North . Not much was known of the goals of the druidic other than their desire to protect that portion of the woods that was once part of Earlann . Very few were allowed access to the Tall Trees enclave save a few allied Harpers , and notable figures of good , with whom they had some mutual alliance . Like most nature faiths , they also sought to keep a balance between wild lands and civilization . The Deep Glade , the key grove of Silvanus was to be found in Tall Trees .

title: Uthgar
description: Uthgar Uthgar ( pronounced " UHTH - gar " ) , the Battle Father , is the god of the Uthgardt and physical strength as well as , by 1479 DR , an exarch of Tempus . Worshipers . Uthgar ' s followers consist of many human tribes collectively termed as the Uthgardt barbarians .
description_long: Uthgar Uthgar ( pronounced " UHTH - gar " ) , the Battle Father , is the god of the Uthgardt and physical strength as well as , by 1479 DR , an exarch of Tempus . Worshipers . Uthgar ' s followers consist of many human tribes collectively termed as the Uthgardt barbarians . His clerics often multi - class as barbarians , druids or rangers . Tribes and alignments . The dogma of the Uthgardt religion varies slightly from tribe to tribe as each beast cult emphasizes different barbaric virtues . The clerics of these tribes , along with those who take Uthgar as a patron deity , must abide by the somewhat broader alignment guidelines of the beast totems who mediate between Uthgar and his people . Any alignment that fits the guideline for a beast totem is suitable for a cleric of Uthgar of that totem . The names of these tribes , along with their corresponding totems and alignments , are as follows : Relationships . Uthgar ' s superior is the Lord of Battles , Tempus . History . Born Uthgar Gardolfsson , the son of Gardolf Beorunna , Thane of Ruathym .

title: Uthgardt
description: Uthgardt The Uthgardt is a collective term used to refer to various human barbarian tribes who worship the deity Uthgar . Each tribe is named after a beast totem of Uthgar who mediates between the deity and his people . The Uthgardt are humans , often with black hair and blue eyes .
description_long: Uthgardt The Uthgardt is a collective term used to refer to various human barbarian tribes who worship the deity Uthgar . Each tribe is named after a beast totem of Uthgar who mediates between the deity and his people . The Uthgardt are humans , often with black hair and blue eyes . They speak a dialect of Illuskan and are believed to be related to the Northlander s of Ruathym . No Uthgardt will willingly cut down a living tree . History . The Uthgardt originally consisted of Northman raiders from Ruathym , Netherese Runlatha n refugees , and various others who swore fealty to Uthgar Gardolfsson . They became the Uthgardt after their leader ' s death from wounds suffered in battle with Gurt , lord of the pale giants , in 123 DR . Individuals took up worship of the thirteen beast spirits that Uthgar had claimed to have tamed , and formed into tribes along this religious divide . Uthgardt Alliance . In 705 DR the mages of The Covenant used their magic to create an alliance between the disparate tribes of Uthgardt in order for them to stand united against coming orc and goblinoid hordes .

title: Uthgrael Aumar
description: Uthgrael Aumar Uthgrael Aumar , also known as the Stag King , was the founder and ruler of the kingdom of Athalantar until his death in 216 DR . Relationships . He was married to Niluembra and fathered seven sons , who became known as " the warring princes " , and was the grandfather of Elminster Aumar .
description_long: Uthgrael Aumar Uthgrael Aumar , also known as the Stag King , was the founder and ruler of the kingdom of Athalantar until his death in 216 DR . Relationships . He was married to Niluembra and fathered seven sons , who became known as " the warring princes " , and was the grandfather of Elminster Aumar .

title: Uthor
description: Uthor Uthor was very high - ranking storm giant sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . History . Uthor was the brother of king Hekaton at the time of the shattering of the ordning .
description_long: Uthor Uthor was very high - ranking storm giant sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . History . Uthor was the brother of king Hekaton at the time of the shattering of the ordning . In the late 1480s or early 1490s DR was Uthor that found the dead body of Queen Neri and soon went to his niece Serissa for counsel . Serissa managed to calm her father ' s rightful rage . For this Hekaton decided to appoint Serissa as his heir . After her father ' s disappearance , Serissa reluctantly ascended to the Wyrmskull Throne as a regent , with Uthor as advisor . Uthor was near Serissa on the throne room . Personality . Uthor deeply cared for her youngest niece . , however he no trusted the small folks .

title: Uthorn
description: Uthorn Uthorn was a doppelganger and a baron of the city of Calaunt in the Vast in 1358 DR . Activities . Together with Wenszrin , a fellow baron and doppelganger , Uthorn commanded the city ' s standing army , The Teeth of Calaunt , with all warcaptains reporting to the two barons .
description_long: Uthorn Uthorn was a doppelganger and a baron of the city of Calaunt in the Vast in 1358 DR . Activities . Together with Wenszrin , a fellow baron and doppelganger , Uthorn commanded the city ' s standing army , The Teeth of Calaunt , with all warcaptains reporting to the two barons . The pair also commanded all mercenary forces the city hired to supplement its military . Uthorn and Wenszrin also served as spies and scouts for the Merchant Duke s of Calaunt . However , they were under the magical control of Duke Iritar the Dark . Possessions . Uthorn was supplied with a variety of magical item s for protection . Description . Uthorn normally adopted the appearance of a plain , veteran warrior .

title: Uthraki
description: Uthraki Uthraki were malevolent forest spirits in Rashemen . Description . The natural form of an uthraki was apelike , hairy , and gray - white .
description_long: Uthraki Uthraki were malevolent forest spirits in Rashemen . Description . The natural form of an uthraki was apelike , hairy , and gray - white . Its small face was humanlike , but a dozen black eyes went all the way around the creature ' s head . The uthraki was able to shapechange at will to any creature of about the same size or somewhat smaller . At night , an uthraki was able to heal exceptionally fast . Uthraki were known for taking the form of human children and seeking aid from other humans before devouring them . They were also known for taking the form of rabbit s ; such forms were indistinguishable from normal rabbits except by magic . Combat . An uthraki used its tough , sharp claws to cut and rend its opponent . Those claws remained sharp and tough even while the uthraki was shapechanged . Habitat . Uthraki dwelt either in pairs or alone in the wooded and hilly areas of Rashemen , far from the hathran that killed them on sight .

title: Utter East
description: Utter East The Utter East was a land in the extreme southeast of Faerûn , bordering the continents of both Kara - Tur and Zakhara . It was home to the Five Kingdoms . Geography .
description_long: Utter East The Utter East was a land in the extreme southeast of Faerûn , bordering the continents of both Kara - Tur and Zakhara . It was home to the Five Kingdoms . Geography . The Utter East lay on the isthmus joining the great continents of Faerûn and Kara - Tur in the north to Zakhara in the south . The Wu Pi Te Shao Mountains , the southern arm of the massive Yehimal Mountains , ran down the center of the isthmus like a spine . The Utter East lay on the western side , between the mountains the sea , in a narrow landscape less than 100 miles wide ( 160 kilometers ) . It was the only easily traversable land - bridge between the continents ; the Sempadan Forest on the eastern side was much too dense . The coastline was dry and rugged . It was lashed by the Great Sea , which in its wake formed whirlpools and maelstroms . Vast and uncharted plains lay in the north , which bordered the eastern side of Ulgarth . Society . The Utter East was dominated by the Five Kingdoms , which were ruled by the Ffolk and by the Northmen . They included : They ruled over the indigenous Mar tribes .

title: Utterdark
description: Utterdark Utterdark was a wine made and sold in the town of Bogbrook in Cormyr in the 14th century DR . Description . It was black and had a salty taste .
description_long: Utterdark Utterdark was a wine made and sold in the town of Bogbrook in Cormyr in the 14th century DR . Description . It was black and had a salty taste . Cost . A bottle of utterdark was worth 2 gp in Sembia . History . In the Year of Lightning Storms , 1374 DR , the smugglers Norry Waywocket and Coobert Draftworth had twenty bottles of stolen utterdark minted in 1370 DR . They stored in their secret stash in the Tomb of Chonis in Cormyr .

title: Utterdark ( wine )
description: Utterdark ( wine ) Utterdark was a wine made in the town of Bogbrook in Cormyr . Utterdark , or " black Bogbrook water " as it was known colloquially , was described as a black wine rather than a red due to its incredibly dark colouration . Made using a secret process , it tasted salty with a fiery undertone .
description_long: Utterdark ( wine ) Utterdark was a wine made in the town of Bogbrook in Cormyr . Utterdark , or " black Bogbrook water " as it was known colloquially , was described as a black wine rather than a red due to its incredibly dark colouration . Made using a secret process , it tasted salty with a fiery undertone . It was not a popular wine amongst many , though those who enjoyed it did so immensely , leading to it being sold in ports throughout the Inner Sea as well as in Amn and Waterdeep . It was often used as a marinade to hide the taste of spoiled food . Various spices were often added to the drink during its creation by individual Bogbrook families in an attempt to make it better and the concoctions made by three of those families , the Jhalonsons , Ittreers and especially the Athantals were generally more popular than the norm . It was a common trade commodity for traders heading west out of Cormyr as it was worth 6 gold pieces in Waterdeep compared to the 1 gold piece it was sold at per jar in Bogbrook . Bottles of 1370 utterdark were worth two gold pieces each in Sembia in 1374 DR .

title: Utu
description: Utu Utu was the Untheric god of the sun . His manifestation on Toril was killed during the Orcgate Wars . His symbol was a sun disc .
description_long: Utu Utu was the Untheric god of the sun . His manifestation on Toril was killed during the Orcgate Wars . His symbol was a sun disc . Description . Utu manifested as a human male bathed in dazzling golden light that destroyed undead . Any non - indestructible object that touched his body would melt . Contact with any heat above 100 degrees Fahrenheit would instantly heal all of his wounds . He had the power to transform living matter into soil . In battle , he flung bits of the sun at his opponents , up to two miles away . History . Utu presumably came to Toril with the other Untheric deities aboard the " Galley of the Gods " . He was killed by one of the orcish gods in - 1071 DR , and his body was laid to rest in a God - Tomb in Unther .

title: Uwaji
description: Uwaji Uwaji was the shogunate capital of Wa , where the shogun lived and meet . It was one of the most largest and important cities of Kara - Tur . It was in Tsukishima , bordered on the west by the Ikuyu Mountains .
description_long: Uwaji Uwaji was the shogunate capital of Wa , where the shogun lived and meet . It was one of the most largest and important cities of Kara - Tur . It was in Tsukishima , bordered on the west by the Ikuyu Mountains . The busy Tawata Road linked Uwaji with Rukimbaru .

title: Uwan
description: Uwan Uwan has served as the leader of the Shadar - kai city of Ikemmu in the Shadowfell for twenty years . He is a mighty warrior and strong leader . Uwan has an extremely strong sense of justice and adheres rigorously to the law of Ikemmu .
description_long: Uwan Uwan has served as the leader of the Shadar - kai city of Ikemmu in the Shadowfell for twenty years . He is a mighty warrior and strong leader . Uwan has an extremely strong sense of justice and adheres rigorously to the law of Ikemmu . Uwan is a devout follwer of Tempus and was a close confidant of Tempus ' high priest in Ikemmu ( Natan ) prior to his murder by Vedoran . Uwan took a young Shadar - kai named Ashok into the city and had him trained with Ikemmu ' s warriors . Uwan later sent Ashok on a mission to find a missing Ikemmu expedition in the Shadowfell . Ashok was successful in rescuing the witch Ilvani who was held captive by his home enclave but was framed by Vedoran as a traitor to Ikemmu . Because of the evidence against Ashok , Uwan was forced to find him guilty and sentenced Ashok to ten days of solitary confinement . During Ashok ' s imprisonment , Uwan went to visit Ashok in his cell but was ambushed by Vedoran who intended to kill both Uwan and Ashok with the intent of starting a revolt in Ikemmu . Uwan was gravely injured during the fight but Ashok managed to kill Vedoran . Equipment . Uwan carries a greatsword and wears shadow armor .

title: Uxma
description: Uxma Uxma the Sorcerer was a wise elder in Maztica in 1362 DR . Activities . Uxma was a sage specializing in the fields of Maztican art and architecture , astronomy , Maztican history and folklore , and music .
description_long: Uxma Uxma the Sorcerer was a wise elder in Maztica in 1362 DR . Activities . Uxma was a sage specializing in the fields of Maztican art and architecture , astronomy , Maztican history and folklore , and music . Uxma lived as a hermit in the Payit region . Usually , people of nearby villages consulted him about their most troubling problems in exchange for gifts . Near his house lived a dragonne , Chalocka . Uxma allowed it to stay in the area to discourage visitors . Personality . Uxma was a benevolent individual , especially liking artists . However , he was very terse with people he considered fools . He enjoyed his image as a powerful and mysterious sorcerer .

title: Uyun al - Sartan
description: Uyun al - Sartan Uyun al - Sartan , also known as the Eyes of the Crab , was an island in Jazayir al - Sartan . Geography . The island served as a hatchery for giant crab s infesting the lagoon .
description_long: Uyun al - Sartan Uyun al - Sartan , also known as the Eyes of the Crab , was an island in Jazayir al - Sartan . Geography . The island served as a hatchery for giant crab s infesting the lagoon . Landing on the island was a dangerous venture because the crabs were voracious carnivores that would swarm anything setting foot on the island .

title: Uzbeg
description: Uzbeg Uzbeg was a village near the Lake of Mists in the Hordelands between Kara - Tur and Faerûn . Geography . The village was located along the Golden Way which connected the continents of Kara - Tur and Faerûn .
description_long: Uzbeg Uzbeg was a village near the Lake of Mists in the Hordelands between Kara - Tur and Faerûn . Geography . The village was located along the Golden Way which connected the continents of Kara - Tur and Faerûn . Uzbeg was the only residential in stop in the Hordelands . Inhabitants . In 1479 DR , the population of Uzbeg was five hundred human s who made a living fishing in the Lake of Mists and trading goods . History . During the Spellplague , Uzbeg was settled by Raumviran s with aid from merchants from Thesk to be a trade route along the Golden Way . Notable locations . Uzbeg had four , which were like inns but under the sway of eastern and migrant cultures . These caravanserais included stables , inns , shops , warehouses , and were like a small trade city .

title: Uzurr
description: Uzurr Uzurr , also called the The City of Toiling Monks , was a city in Lapaliiya , which lay sprawling across three hilltops west of the Lapal Way , between Abreon and Lhazantal . Uzurr was a member of the Lapal League and one of the Cities of the Seabreeze . It was devoted to Ilmater , the Crying God .
description_long: Uzurr Uzurr , also called the The City of Toiling Monks , was a city in Lapaliiya , which lay sprawling across three hilltops west of the Lapal Way , between Abreon and Lhazantal . Uzurr was a member of the Lapal League and one of the Cities of the Seabreeze . It was devoted to Ilmater , the Crying God . History . During the time of the Shoon Imperium ( 27 – 450 DR ) , Ilmatari missionaries of the Order of St . Uzurr from Calimshan traveled to Lapaliiya and founded a walled monastery called the Cloister of St . Uzurr . In the following centuries , a city grew up around the monastery , known simply as " Uzurr " . Yuan - ti purebloods began infiltrating Uzurr on Eleasias 1 , the Year of Rogue Dragons , 1373 DR with the aim of assassinating Abbot Kadar al Ilmater and stopping his research into curing tainted one s and broodguard s . Society . The city was dominated by the Order , and ruled by the Abbot of St . Uzurr ; this was Kadar al Ilmater " circa " 1372 DR . Like in other cities of Lapaliiya , Uzurr ' s civic deity was Ilmater and the people discouraged other faiths . Uzurr ' s relations with the other cities of Lapaliiya mimicked those of Ilmater with their respective deities .

title: V ' elddrinnsshar
description: V ' elddrinnsshar V ' elddrinnsshar was a drow city located on a mile wide island in the centre of the Moondeep Sea . The city ' s name seems to be composed of two drow words that have been given translation ( Veldrin and shar meaning concealment and mind respectively ) and thus the name could mean Concealed Mind or some variation there upon . Like most drow cities , it was dominated by the clergy of Lolth , but even her divine magic couldn ' t protect her subjects from the Ascomoid Plague .
description_long: V ' elddrinnsshar V ' elddrinnsshar was a drow city located on a mile wide island in the centre of the Moondeep Sea . The city ' s name seems to be composed of two drow words that have been given translation ( Veldrin and shar meaning concealment and mind respectively ) and thus the name could mean Concealed Mind or some variation there upon . Like most drow cities , it was dominated by the clergy of Lolth , but even her divine magic couldn ' t protect her subjects from the Ascomoid Plague . The last inhabitant died in 1278 DR and nothing was heard of the place until ten years later when duergar looted whatever remained . In 1337 DR a priestess of Kiaransalee named Larynda Telenna brought with her a group of acolytes who aided her in constructing the Acropolis of Thanatos in the ruins of the city . The black marble temple attracted a thousand more of the faithful and since then , it has been used as a base from which to launch attacks on the cults of Orcus that inhabited Vaasa above them . Little do the drow know , but without them , Gareth Dragonsbane may not have been able to defeat Zhengyi as readily as he did .

title: Vaal
description: Vaal Vaal was a cloud giant count sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . History . Vaal was one of the giant lords at the time of the shattering of the ordning .
description_long: Vaal Vaal was a cloud giant count sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . History . Vaal was one of the giant lords at the time of the shattering of the ordning . In the late 1480s or early 1490s DR Vaal was one of the giant lords arrived in Maelstrom citadel in search of news about princess Serissa ' s plans for the future . Personality . Vaal was susceptible to brides

title: Vaalrik Redreef
description: Vaalrik Redreef Vaalrik Redreef was a sea captain in Luskan sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . Activities . Vaalrik a captain in the employ of the High Captains of Luskan .
description_long: Vaalrik Redreef Vaalrik Redreef was a sea captain in Luskan sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . Activities . Vaalrik a captain in the employ of the High Captains of Luskan . History . In the late 1480s or early 1490s DR , Vaalrik was hired to accompany an adventuring party to Svardborg .

title: Vaasa
description: Vaasa Vaasa was an untamed wasteland of frozen moors and tundra located in the Cold Lands of northeast Faerûn . Geography . It was a relatively empty land with sporadic farms and the occasional wandering monster .
description_long: Vaasa Vaasa was an untamed wasteland of frozen moors and tundra located in the Cold Lands of northeast Faerûn . Geography . It was a relatively empty land with sporadic farms and the occasional wandering monster . As much of the land was unclaimed , there were many prospectors who came to Vaasa looking for natural treasures , of which it had many . The lands were rich in precious metals and gems , particularly bloodstone . The Great Glacier was a retreating glacier that once covered the lands of Vaasa and Damara . It lay to the north of both of these lands . Bloodstone Pass allowed trade access through the Galena Mountains to Damara in the east . Notable locations . Castle Perilous was the former home of Zhengyi the Witch - King , located on the shore of the Lake of Tears . Darmshall was a small fortress - village that was founded by the Tenblades adventuring company , and Palischuk was a once - destroyed city that had since been rebuilt and occupied by half - orc s .

title: Vaasurri
description: Vaasurri Vaasurri was a killoren who lived with his human friend Uthalion in a secluded grove in the Spur Forest . Like most killoren , he was highly attuned to the natural world . In 1479 DR , one of Uthalion ' s old friends , who was on a mission to rescue a young genasi from a cult , sought their aid as guides to the ruined city of Tohrepur .
description_long: Vaasurri Vaasurri was a killoren who lived with his human friend Uthalion in a secluded grove in the Spur Forest . Like most killoren , he was highly attuned to the natural world . In 1479 DR , one of Uthalion ' s old friends , who was on a mission to rescue a young genasi from a cult , sought their aid as guides to the ruined city of Tohrepur . In Tohrepur , Vaasurri and friends killed Lord Khault , the leader of the cult , but were forced to kill the captive genasi . Equipment . Vaasurri carried a bone sword . Appearances . Vaasurri had green skin . His hair and eye color changed depending on the aspect of nature he was currently manifesting .

title: Vadalma Tlabbar
description: Vadalma Tlabbar Vadalma Tlabbar was the drow matron mother of House Faen Tlabbar , the fourth house of Menzoberranzan in 1372 DR and and 1484 DR . Personality . During the Rage of Demons , she was fanatically devoted to Lolth .
description_long: Vadalma Tlabbar Vadalma Tlabbar was the drow matron mother of House Faen Tlabbar , the fourth house of Menzoberranzan in 1372 DR and and 1484 DR . Personality . During the Rage of Demons , she was fanatically devoted to Lolth . History . Vadalma ascended to the position of matron mother in 1372 DR . In that year , Nimor Imphraezl of the Jaezred Chaulssin killed both matron mother Ghenni Tlabbar and her favorite daughter , Sil ' zet Tlabbar . Vadalma was the fifth daughter of Ghenni ( or maybe Ghenni ' tiroth Tlabbar ) and ascended to matron mother position . She was still in charge in 1484 DR .

title: Vaelis
description: Vaelis Vaelis was a young human paladin and Kalen Dren ' s first apprentice . History . At some point in 1479 DR , Kalen took Vaelis on as his apprentice with the intent of training him to be the heir to the Shadowbane title .
description_long: Vaelis Vaelis was a young human paladin and Kalen Dren ' s first apprentice . History . At some point in 1479 DR , Kalen took Vaelis on as his apprentice with the intent of training him to be the heir to the Shadowbane title . Kalen believed he had accidentally killed Vaelis in the underground of Waterdeep . However , either Vaelis never died or was resurrected by someone for , in 1480 DR , he began crusading in Westgate as Shadowbane . Vaelis became a servant of the vampire Kirenkirsalai and aided him in a plot that apparently revolved around capturing Myrin Darkdance . Vaelis believed that the god of vengeance , Hoar , was the true third god of the Threefold God trinity and he incorporated Hoar ' s belief in vengeance into his crusading . Vaelis confronted Kalen in Westgate and was defeated , losing an arm in the fight . Near death , Vaelis returned to Kirenkirsalai ' s lair and was turned into a vampire .

title: Vaelish Gant
description: Vaelish Gant Vaelish Gant was a wizard of the Arcane Brotherhood in Icewind Dale in 1485 DR . Personality . With his plot , Vaelish hoped to elevate his master Jendrick to the position of Archmage Arcane so he could replace him as Master of the North Tower .
description_long: Vaelish Gant Vaelish Gant was a wizard of the Arcane Brotherhood in Icewind Dale in 1485 DR . Personality . With his plot , Vaelish hoped to elevate his master Jendrick to the position of Archmage Arcane so he could replace him as Master of the North Tower . History . Vaelish was born in Athkatla in Amn . At a young age , he discovered his magical powers and joined the reformed Arcane Brotherhood in Luskan . Here , Vaelish soon rose through the ranks until he became an apprentice of Jendrick the Blue , Overwizard of the North Tower . In 1484 DR , Vaelish , together with his apprentice Pallidor and some thugs of Ship Rethnor , settled in Bryn Shander and started a plot to conquer the dale . To all in the Ten Towns , he was just a merchant who served as an aide to the Speaker of Bryn Shander , Duvessa Shane . At the news of several threats to the dale ( some secretly instigated by himself ) , he proposed a no - confidence vote to replace Duvessa . Appendix . Gameplay . In order to fight Akar Kessell and Hedrun Arnsfirth , the adventurers may need to allow Vaelish to succeed in his plan .

title: Vaeren Dragonskorn
description: Vaeren Dragonskorn Vaeren Dragonskorn was a sky pirate . Activities . Vaeren had managed to repair an old Halruaan skyship that he used for his business .
description_long: Vaeren Dragonskorn Vaeren Dragonskorn was a sky pirate . Activities . Vaeren had managed to repair an old Halruaan skyship that he used for his business . History . In 1480 DR , Simbul went to Dragonskorn ' s sky ship asking for a blueflame item . He instead ordered his crew to kill her but in the end the Simbul killed Dragonskorn . Personality . Vaeren considered himself not a pirate but a " sky ' s adventurer " .

title: Vaeril Rhuidhen
description: Vaeril Rhuidhen Vaeril Rhuidhen was a sun elf and a member of the Council of Elders in Everlund as of 1372 DR and also sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . Activities . Vaeril acted as voice of moderation and reason inside the council .
description_long: Vaeril Rhuidhen Vaeril Rhuidhen was a sun elf and a member of the Council of Elders in Everlund as of 1372 DR and also sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . Activities . Vaeril acted as voice of moderation and reason inside the council . He was also the liaison with the Lords ' Alliance .

title: Vaerluth
description: Vaerluth Vaerluth was the easternmost goblin realm in the Rauvin Mountains in Luruar . Geography . Malauth was located in the caverns and foothills of the eastern Rauvin Mountains .
description_long: Vaerluth Vaerluth was the easternmost goblin realm in the Rauvin Mountains in Luruar . Geography . Malauth was located in the caverns and foothills of the eastern Rauvin Mountains . Government . Vaerluth was ruled by a succession of kings named Vaerluth ; in 1372 DR , the realm was on its 36th King Vaerluth . Succession of each king came through the murder of his predecessor . Inhabitants . The goblins of Vaerluth were considered the poorest of the goblins in the Rauvin Mountains . They dwelt in huge - spider - infested caverns and foothills , which gave them immunity to the spider venom . The goblins boiled the spider webs to make soup .

title: Vaerndoun
description: Vaerndoun Vaerndoun was a network of interconnected caves in the Underdark . Geography . Vaerndoun stretched for over 100 miles ( 160 kilometers ) northeast to southwest with the center point directly under the city of Torsch in southeastern Sespech .
description_long: Vaerndoun Vaerndoun was a network of interconnected caves in the Underdark . Geography . Vaerndoun stretched for over 100 miles ( 160 kilometers ) northeast to southwest with the center point directly under the city of Torsch in southeastern Sespech . Many , but not all , of the caves were filled with water , forming lakes . Activties . Vaerndoun was the site of a two - week trade fair at the beginning of Alturiak every year . It was hosted by mind flayer s who referred to themselves as , and claimed to be from , a hidden realm called " the Asglyth " . The fair , called the " Eleave " in the drow tongue , was visited by agents from all over the Underdark as long as they provided the admission price of slaves for the illithid to feed on . History . The traveling merchant Rebrum of Sheirtalar wrote in the " Life of Rebrum " ( written " circa " 1210 DR ) of an appearance of the " Chanting Chain " , a holy relic of Talos the Destroyer , at the Eleave . A group of drow traders , sent by their matrons , attempted to barter the " Chain " to another group of drow from a distant city . However , the " Chain " likely fell into the hands of one of the Asglyth mind flayers .

title: Vahn
description: Vahn Vahn was a human arcane archer and one of a trio of adventurer s who arrived in Baldur ' s Gate as the Dark Alliance was rising to threaten the city . Abilities . As an arcane archer , Vahn combined the arts of archery and arcane magic .
description_long: Vahn Vahn was a human arcane archer and one of a trio of adventurer s who arrived in Baldur ' s Gate as the Dark Alliance was rising to threaten the city . Abilities . As an arcane archer , Vahn combined the arts of archery and arcane magic . His abilities included attacking with numerous kinds of magical arrow s and other things that aided his profession , such as a " repulsion " spell to keep enemies at range and having the means to reduce the weight of arrows he carried . Overall , Vahn constituted a balance between Adrianna ' s focus on spells and Kromlech ' s focus on arms and armor . History . Vahn grew up as an adventurer who fought against many powers of evil . He had fought with many dwarves , elves , halfling s , and other human s . He met Dorn Redbear for the first time while helping the barbarian ' s tribe . Since he never gained any fame from his work , Vahn traveled to Baldur ' s Gate . Once at the Black Dragon Gate , Vahn and his future company were attacked by thieves . War against the thieves . After being attacked by the thief Karne , Vahn paired up with Kromlech , a shield dwarf fighter , and Adrianna a moon elf sorceress to get his gold back .

title: Vahtov
description: Vahtov Vahtov was once one of the greatest cities of the High Desert of Zakhara . Inhabitant . During the mid 900s DR a motley group composed of dwarf nomads from the Mountains of the Lizard ' s Tongue and human refugees from the House of Nasr joined together to excavate rumored gem and gold deposits beneath the Pit of the Ghuls .
description_long: Vahtov Vahtov was once one of the greatest cities of the High Desert of Zakhara . Inhabitant . During the mid 900s DR a motley group composed of dwarf nomads from the Mountains of the Lizard ' s Tongue and human refugees from the House of Nasr joined together to excavate rumored gem and gold deposits beneath the Pit of the Ghuls . The settlement they founded became known as Vahtov , or " fated fortune " in the dwarven tongue . As of 1367 DR , Vahtov ' s leader was a centaur named Akidya , and she maintained strict law enforcement . Akidya served as judge and jury for all crimes committed in Vahtov . Centaurs also served as the local militia . Description . The early enterprise succeeded , producing a mountain of emeralds and turquoise and tons of gold . Much of this new - found wealth was invested into improving the rapidly growing settlement . Palatial homes , streets of onyx , and silver watch towers soon dotted the cityscape . History . Eventually the dwarf / human relationship soured — the dwarves grew tired of doing all of the hard work , and the humans grew weary of protecting the dwarves all of the time .

title: Vainrence
description: Vainrence Vainrence was the second - in - command of the War Wizards of Cormyr in 1479 DR . History . In 1479 DR , Vainrence , together with the Royal Mage Ganrahast Aeiulvana , was imprisoned by one of Manshoon ' s servants in magical stasis in a crypt beneath the Royal Palace in Suzail .
description_long: Vainrence Vainrence was the second - in - command of the War Wizards of Cormyr in 1479 DR . History . In 1479 DR , Vainrence , together with the Royal Mage Ganrahast Aeiulvana , was imprisoned by one of Manshoon ' s servants in magical stasis in a crypt beneath the Royal Palace in Suzail . Elminster and Vangerdahast ' s shade rescued Vainrence and Ganrahast . Later , he and Glathra Barcantle explored the crypt .

title: Vairshekellabex
description: Vairshekellabex Vairshekellabex was a gray dragon who lived on an earthmote above Old Man ' s Head mountain in the Akanapeaks . He was allied with Tchazzar and with the help of Tiamat ' s clergy , he made it appear that dragonborn were attacking villages and caravans in Akanûl . This was part of Tchazzar ' s plot to convince Akanûl to join him in an invasion of Tymanther .
description_long: Vairshekellabex Vairshekellabex was a gray dragon who lived on an earthmote above Old Man ' s Head mountain in the Akanapeaks . He was allied with Tchazzar and with the help of Tiamat ' s clergy , he made it appear that dragonborn were attacking villages and caravans in Akanûl . This was part of Tchazzar ' s plot to convince Akanûl to join him in an invasion of Tymanther . Aoth Fezim led an expedition composed of members of the Brotherhood of the Griffon and genasi to the Akanapeaks where they attacked and killed Vairshekellabex .

title: Vajal
description: Vajal Vajal the Dark was a member of the Shields of the Highland adventuring company in Tethyr in 1370 DR . Description . Vajal was a Calishite man with dark , long hair and a well - trimmed bear .
description_long: Vajal Vajal the Dark was a member of the Shields of the Highland adventuring company in Tethyr in 1370 DR . Description . Vajal was a Calishite man with dark , long hair and a well - trimmed bear . History . Vajal hailed from a village near the Forest of Mir like all his companions . On Uktar 8 , 1370 DR , the Shields of the Highland lost two of their members while guarding a caravan . Unexpected cold weather led to snow , and a band of fourteen gnoll s were able to track them and attack them , killing two of them during the ensuing battle . At dusk two days later , Vajal and the other three survivors went to the Blue Badger Inn in the village of Toralth to grieve their loss . Vajal , despite complaints from the barkeep , constantly carved strange symbols into the wooden tabletops with his knife . They found a bard in the tavern , calling himself Fylson Tarasp , and demanded that he compose a dirge for their two fallen friends . They had no idea that this man was actually a secret agent of the sea elf Gantar Kraok .

title: Vajra Safahr
description: Vajra Safahr Vajra Safahr was the seventh Blackstaff of Waterdeep , a title she ascended to in 1479 DR when her mentor and lover , Samark Dhanzscul , was killed . Description . Vajra was diminutive , with olive skin , and short black hair , and indigo blue eyes .
description_long: Vajra Safahr Vajra Safahr was the seventh Blackstaff of Waterdeep , a title she ascended to in 1479 DR when her mentor and lover , Samark Dhanzscul , was killed . Description . Vajra was diminutive , with olive skin , and short black hair , and indigo blue eyes . She was young when she became the Blackstaff ( 1479 DR ) . Possessions . Vajra wielded a fabled Blackstaff , which was silver shod and several feet taller than her . History . Early years . Vajra was born in Tethyr to paladin Tamik al Tamik al Safahr and Parama yr Manshaka . She had several older siblings , but she was the only one born with sorcery . She grew up at Sheshyr House in Tethyr , the family home . When Vajra was fourteen , her father and her aunt died in defense of Darromar , which was attacked by assassins . She turned away from sorcery and towards wizardry , since it was what was able to save Queen Cyriana and King Errilam . She was apprenticed to Mynda Gyrfalcon - Thann and Princess Zandra , Court Vizeras of her homeland . She came to Waterdeep in order to learn foreign magic for a brief time ( a requirement for her course of study ) around 1476 DR .

title: Vajra Valmeyjar
description: Vajra Valmeyjar Vajra Valmeyjar was a female human fighter and a slave - warrior of the Arena of Blood in Manshaka in the 1350s DR . She famously escaped and went on to become an adventuress in Waterdeep and later even a duchess of the Kingdom of Tethyr . Description .
description_long: Vajra Valmeyjar Vajra Valmeyjar was a female human fighter and a slave - warrior of the Arena of Blood in Manshaka in the 1350s DR . She famously escaped and went on to become an adventuress in Waterdeep and later even a duchess of the Kingdom of Tethyr . Description . Vajra , a Tethyrian by birth , was a tall and powerfully built warrior , standing 6 ' 1 " ( 1 . 85 m ) high and being exceptionally muscular . She had pale - green eyes , brown skin , and blue - black hair . She kept her hair short , except for a long braid falling down to the small of her back , though she later grew her hair longer . However , as a starving child , she was rake - thin and small . She still wore her gladiator ' s manacles from the Arena of Blood , which proved useful in scaring any who would try to pick a fight with her . Even when she had become a noble of Tethyr , she changed her style of dress little , despite this bothering her courtiers substantially . Personality . Vajra was exceedingly stubborn , which served her well on the battlefield but also irked some of her courtiers . She found it humorous that she ended up a duchess . She always strongly opposed injustice , especially slavery .

title: Valan Jaelre
description: Valan Jaelre Valan Jaelre was a leader of House Jaelre and the Jaezred Chaulssin . Physical Description . Valan wore fine robes and a house insignia of a sunburst with two dagger s pointing downward from it .
description_long: Valan Jaelre Valan Jaelre was a leader of House Jaelre and the Jaezred Chaulssin . Physical Description . Valan wore fine robes and a house insignia of a sunburst with two dagger s pointing downward from it . He wielded a twisted staff that looked like it was made of filaments of shadow . Personality . He was overconfident and would rant about how he would defeat his opponents and bring down Menzoberranzan even when fighting a losing battle . History . In the late 15th century DR , Valan put a simulacrum of himself in charge of a House Jaelre attack on Shadowdale to steal the " Pendant of Ashaba " . The real Valan infiltrated the Braeryn in his ancestors ' home of Menzoberranzan , hoping to cause civil war . He sent a Jaezred Chaulssin assassin named Merinid Dalael to instigate a fight between the Council of Spiders and adventurers hired by the houses . The assassins ' involvement was discovered , and the adventurers were dispatched to Stenchstreets to eliminate Valan .

title: Valantha Moonbreeze
description: Valantha Moonbreeze Valantha Moonbreeze was a merchant in Elventree during the late 1480s DR . History . Valantha sold finger foods at a celebration for Mielikki at the Hall of the Unicorn in Elventree .
description_long: Valantha Moonbreeze Valantha Moonbreeze was a merchant in Elventree during the late 1480s DR . History . Valantha sold finger foods at a celebration for Mielikki at the Hall of the Unicorn in Elventree . Personality . Valantha had a terrible sense of humor . However , she often only asked for a joke or a funny story as payment .

title: Valas Belaem del Pharm
description: Valas Belaem del Pharm Valas Belaem Del Pharm ( Valas , slave of Pharm ) the Black Raven was a half - drow slave of house Leun in Rilauven , he was lost in a bet to house Pharm who kept him despite the slave ' s considerable strength just to spite Leun . Pharm made Valas fight in the city arenas , where the latter developed his fighting style and became the city ' s greatest arena champion . Valas freed himself and fought his way through the Underdark with only his bare hands and the chains holding them .
description_long: Valas Belaem del Pharm Valas Belaem Del Pharm ( Valas , slave of Pharm ) the Black Raven was a half - drow slave of house Leun in Rilauven , he was lost in a bet to house Pharm who kept him despite the slave ' s considerable strength just to spite Leun . Pharm made Valas fight in the city arenas , where the latter developed his fighting style and became the city ' s greatest arena champion . Valas freed himself and fought his way through the Underdark with only his bare hands and the chains holding them . When he reached the surface at the Black Raven River ' s source he encountered a group of Black Raven barbarians who eagerly attacked him but were easily defeated . Seeing his great prowess and in awe of his peculiar appearance ( he had jet black skin and fiery red eyes ) the simple barbarians considered him to be a warrior spirit and bestowed upon him the honorific of " Black Raven " which he kept until his death . Later Valas left the barbarians and went travailing across the land freeing slaves , fighting imprisonment and collecting many loyal followers . In 1181 DR he eventually returned to where he first surfaced to erect the Black Raven Monastery where he is now buried .

title: Valas Hune
description: Valas Hune Valas Hune was a pragmatic drow scout and member of Bregan D ' aerthe . He was an accomplished guide of the Underdark . He became involved in a quest to solve the mystery of the Silence of Lolth .
description_long: Valas Hune Valas Hune was a pragmatic drow scout and member of Bregan D ' aerthe . He was an accomplished guide of the Underdark . He became involved in a quest to solve the mystery of the Silence of Lolth . Description . Valas was described as small and wiry . Valas had amber eyes and a square jaw . He often appeared tense . His skin was scarred , particularly on his hands ( although he noted that after being polymorph ed , his scars were in different locations ) . He generally wore a simple vest of chain mail over a spider - silk shirt and dark breeches . Over that he wore a vest with numerous magical badges and tokens ( see Equipment below ) . Personality . He seemed to know a little about everything , including constellation s ( such as one that resembled a crown ) . He was well traveled and had been to Ched Nasad a number of times , as well as many locations on the surface and even beyond to the Shadow Fringe and Shadow Deep . He was quiet and capable . He wanted to stay out of trouble with priestess es whenever possible . He was also referred to as " dutiful . " Valas was also humble .

title: Valas Jaelre
description: Valas Jaelre Valas Jaelre was a drow wizard who held the position of senior mage in an outpost of House Jaelre in Cormanthor . Duties . Valas was the senior mage in an outpost of House Jaelre , which served as a launching point for attacks against the Dalelands and followers of Lolth .
description_long: Valas Jaelre Valas Jaelre was a drow wizard who held the position of senior mage in an outpost of House Jaelre in Cormanthor . Duties . Valas was the senior mage in an outpost of House Jaelre , which served as a launching point for attacks against the Dalelands and followers of Lolth . His role was that of the primary spellcaster . Other duties of his were to supply his fellows with alchemical goods like flasks of acid , alchemist ' s fire , smokestick s , tanglefoot bag s and thunderstones , but also with magical drugs like kammarth and ziran , which were distributed by the outpost ' s leaders . He had an own laboratory , which had resting quarters just for him , for this purpose . His role in regards to defending the outpost was to assist the defensive efforts with his spells . But he was also given the right to judge an attack as too strong for the drow at his own discretion and to change his course of action to ensure the safety of his fellows . This was done by him opening a " portal " created by him after ensuring that the drow were close enough to escape safely with him . Relationship . He was the second cousin to Jezz the Lame .

title: Valashar ' s Bane
description: Valashar ' s Bane Valashar ' s Bane was a ship in Cormyr ' s navy in the 4th century DR , sailing on the Sea of Fallen Stars . It was the flagship of the fleet and carried Crown Prince Azoun I , until it was wrecked and a sunk in a storm in 389 DR , taking with it many great treasures . Description .
description_long: Valashar ' s Bane Valashar ' s Bane was a ship in Cormyr ' s navy in the 4th century DR , sailing on the Sea of Fallen Stars . It was the flagship of the fleet and carried Crown Prince Azoun I , until it was wrecked and a sunk in a storm in 389 DR , taking with it many great treasures . Description . It was a fast - running cog , swift enough to overtake pirate vessels on the Inner Sea along the Dragon Coast , though it was not heavily armed . As a wreck by the mid – 14th century DR , the ship ' s wooden timbers had all rotted away and the copper fittings had rusted away . The only remains were coins , nails , and cutlasses , scattered about and buried under some 10 inches ( 25 centimeters ) of mud , which protected from corrosion . History . The ship was named in honor of Prince Azoun ' s victories over the realm of Valashar in the Year of the Leaping Hare , 376 DR . It became the prince ' s pride and joy . In the Year of the Wooded Altar , 389 DR , Azoun sailed " Valashar ' s Bane " to the Vilhon Reach , on a trade mission to Arrabar .

title: Valashar ( county )
description: Valashar ( county ) County Valashar , or Lathmarch , was known as the " Gate to the Highlands " of Tethyr . Located roughly in the southern reaches of the historic kingdom of the same name , Valashar had a large population of monsters . Geography .
description_long: Valashar ( county ) County Valashar , or Lathmarch , was known as the " Gate to the Highlands " of Tethyr . Located roughly in the southern reaches of the historic kingdom of the same name , Valashar had a large population of monsters . Geography . Valashar was one of the Golden Marches . Being the northeasternmost area of Tethyr , it bordered the kingdom of Amn in the north and the Snowflake Mountains in the east . The Shining Stream marked its southeastern border . Its sister counties of Hazamarch and Morninggold were to the south , and County Spellshire was to the west . The county rose high above sea level , over 2 , 000 feet ( 600 meteres ) , and was at the highest elevation of any other region of Tethyr . The Tethir Road passed through its lands . Government . In 1370 DR , the Siegelord of Tethyr ' s armies , Count Holver Roaringhorn ruled Valashar from the manor of Tannithall . History . After the defection of Riatavin from Amn to Tethyr in 1370 DR , the county grew in size . It also grew in unrest , as the queen ordered many of her troops into that county in case war with Amn could not be averted .

title: Valashar ( kingdom )
description: Valashar ( kingdom ) Valashar was a short - lived kingdom within the Shoon Empire . Geography . At its founding , Valashar extended from the highlands near the start of the Sulduskoon River north to the headwaters of the Amstel River .
description_long: Valashar ( kingdom ) Valashar was a short - lived kingdom within the Shoon Empire . Geography . At its founding , Valashar extended from the highlands near the start of the Sulduskoon River north to the headwaters of the Amstel River . On the west , it bordered the halfling kingdom of Meiritin and the Tejarn Hills . At its height , the country extended north to the Troll Mountains and far beyond into even the High Moor , pushing east even toward the western borders of Cormyr and west to the Sword Coast . Government . Valashar ' s only ruler was its founder , King Ashar Tornamn , though he was only considered a " nazir " by the Shoon Imperium . Defenses . A wooden fortress , later named Fort Ilbratha , defended the northernmost region of Valashar . It was located in the eastern foothills of the Troll Mountains . History . Valashar was founded in 361 DR by Lord Ashar Tornamn , a prince and the fourth nephew of King Karaj Tiiraklar II of Tethyr . As only fourth in line to the throne of Tethyr , Ashar sought another means to power . Over fifteen years , he slowly built up an army and continuously spread the territory under his control , all in the name of the Shoon Empire .

title: Valdar Jaelre
description: Valdar Jaelre Valdar Jaelre was a drow priest of Vhaeraun in 1375 DR . History . Valdar was a priest from House Jaelre born when his house was still in Menzoberranzan .
description_long: Valdar Jaelre Valdar Jaelre was a drow priest of Vhaeraun in 1375 DR . History . Valdar was a priest from House Jaelre born when his house was still in Menzoberranzan . Valdar was one of the nightshadow s who joined Malvag ' s plot . Valdar attacked a Eilistraee ' s shrine , claiming a soul of a priestess . Later he went to Malvag in the designed location to cast the spell to allowed Vhaeraun to enter in the Eilistraee ' s domain undetected . After Malvag summoned his loyal Szorak , Urz and Valdar to the designed place to cast the spell but instead of Szorak arrived Q ' arlynd Melarn in disguise that managed to kill Urz before to be killed , ruining the rite that needed three spellcasters to act . Resurrecting and forcing Q ' arlynd to cooperate Malvag and Valdar casted the spell successfully . However just after he with his great surprise can cast moonfine . Thank to the resurrection of Urz they had the answer : Eilistraee killed Vhaeraun and claimed his portfolio . Valdar was devastated by the news and fled . Valdar in 1376 DR refuged in Guallidurth in Underdark , and come to believe that Vhaeraun succeeded in his plan but deceived all claiming to be instead defeated .

title: Valdenar Octi
description: Valdenar Octi Valdenar Octi was a dragonborn paladin of Bahamut and a platinum knight . Description . Valdenar had gold scales .
description_long: Valdenar Octi Valdenar Octi was a dragonborn paladin of Bahamut and a platinum knight . Description . Valdenar had gold scales . History . Before he underwent the " Rite of Rebirth " , Valdenar was a Chondathan human . After his transformation , he became an ally of the Sisterhood of Essembra .

title: Vale of Lost Voices
description: Vale of Lost Voices The Vale of Lost Voices is a sacred burial place for honored elf warriors . Created on the spot where Venom ambushed and killed those who had killed his mate , the Vale of Lost Voices is now guarded by baelnorn s from the sylvan elf clan Audark . Over time this place has been used by other elves to bury their honored dead .
description_long: Vale of Lost Voices The Vale of Lost Voices is a sacred burial place for honored elf warriors . Created on the spot where Venom ambushed and killed those who had killed his mate , the Vale of Lost Voices is now guarded by baelnorn s from the sylvan elf clan Audark . Over time this place has been used by other elves to bury their honored dead . Rauthauvyr ' s Road passes though the middle of the vale and while travelers are not disturbed if they stick to the road , any attempt to interfere with the tombs and mausoleums usually ends poorly for the adventurer . Cormanthor drow give this place a wide berth . The Eldreth Veluuthra consider the vale a sacred place .

title: Vale of Shadows
description: Vale of Shadows The Vale of Shadows was a valley in Icewind Dale , lying a few hours ' journey northeast of Kuldahar . History . Tombs were built in the Vale of Shadows by the barbarian king Kresselack , the Black Wolf .
description_long: Vale of Shadows The Vale of Shadows was a valley in Icewind Dale , lying a few hours ' journey northeast of Kuldahar . History . Tombs were built in the Vale of Shadows by the barbarian king Kresselack , the Black Wolf . When the construction of the primary tomb was complete , he slew the workers and buried them outside in minor tombs . Afterwards , he sacrificed his followers to become the guardians of the primary tomb built for himself . Then he sacrificed himself to rule beside Myrkul , the lord of the dead , for all eternity , but instead he became a spirit forced to forever haunt his tomb . Centuries later , the inhabitants of the nearby settlement of Kuldahar buried their dead in family tombs inside the Vale . Description . The Vale was an area of high bluffs and deep chasms with small pathways , with tombs lying through it . It remained shadowed even in the middle of a bright day at highsun . Some of these were undead shadow s bearing hunger and hate . All were warned away from this place .

title: Valen
description: Valen Valen was a vampire and a mistress of Bodhi . She and two other vampires attacked Gorion ' s Ward just as they arrived in Brynnlaw , but were defeated . Not fully slain , however , she again fought Gorion ' s Ward in Bodhi ' s lair and was ultimately destroyed .
