description_long: Valen Valen was a vampire and a mistress of Bodhi . She and two other vampires attacked Gorion ' s Ward just as they arrived in Brynnlaw , but were defeated . Not fully slain , however , she again fought Gorion ' s Ward in Bodhi ' s lair and was ultimately destroyed .

title: Valen Shadowbreath
description: Valen Shadowbreath Valen Shadowbreath was a tiefling fighter and weapon master . He was in the rebel drow encampment of Lith My ' athar in 1372 DR . Although distrustful of others , Valen made his services available to an adventurer .
description_long: Valen Shadowbreath Valen Shadowbreath was a tiefling fighter and weapon master . He was in the rebel drow encampment of Lith My ' athar in 1372 DR . Although distrustful of others , Valen made his services available to an adventurer . As a tiefling , he was often tormented by the violent nature of his infernal blood and his dark past .

title: Valerios Theokillos
description: Valerios Theokillos Valerios Theokillos was the Tharchion of Pyarados in Thay and a retired adventurer in 1357 DR . History . Valerios was a success adventurer in his youth ; it ' s said that he slew also an avatar of one of the Mulhorand god - king ; now Valerios was retired and appointed tharchion .
description_long: Valerios Theokillos Valerios Theokillos was the Tharchion of Pyarados in Thay and a retired adventurer in 1357 DR . History . Valerios was a success adventurer in his youth ; it ' s said that he slew also an avatar of one of the Mulhorand god - king ; now Valerios was retired and appointed tharchion . Valerios as tharchion had participation in all outfitting shop in the city and thank to it he had a close eye to strangers and adventurers in his city . Usually he taxed the adventures back in city with a big treasure of some of the most prized objects but many Red Wizard s knowing his hobby arrived to reclaim for themselves the objects .

title: Valero Brokengulf
description: Valero Brokengulf Valero Brokengulf was a member of House Brokengulf in 1489 DR . Personality . Valero had a deeply hatred of Claugiyliamatar .
description_long: Valero Brokengulf Valero Brokengulf was a member of House Brokengulf in 1489 DR . Personality . Valero had a deeply hatred of Claugiyliamatar . History . Valero always wanted to destroy his old family ' s enemy , Claugiyliamatar . In 1489 DR , rumors arose that the Cult of the Dragon wanted to transform her into a dracolich at last . With the support of House Silmerhelve , Valero hired an adventuring party to defeat the great dragon .

title: Valiant Mamluk Society
description: Valiant Mamluk Society The Valiant Mamluk Society , also known as the Valiant , was a military organization in Zakhara . Activities . This mamluk organization specialized in engaging enemies with quick lightning strikes .
description_long: Valiant Mamluk Society The Valiant Mamluk Society , also known as the Valiant , was a military organization in Zakhara . Activities . This mamluk organization specialized in engaging enemies with quick lightning strikes . Several platoons of the Valiant were stationed within the Chamber of Judges to guard the " qadi " and scribes working their and to maintain order . The Valiant maintained a large contingent in the North Center of Huzuz to aid in security and monitor the caravans entering the city through that ward . Organization . The Valiant were led by General Kalin Abd al - Bas . Base of Operations . Qudra served as the main base for this group , though they maintained units within Huzuz and Utaqa as well .

title: Valin Geldencross
description: Valin Geldencross Valin Geldencross was a diviner from Bryn Shander . Activities . Valin was hired by Elytharra Dinnesmore of Targos to locate a goblin headquarters when The Legion of the Chimera attacked in 1312 DR .
description_long: Valin Geldencross Valin Geldencross was a diviner from Bryn Shander . Activities . Valin was hired by Elytharra Dinnesmore of Targos to locate a goblin headquarters when The Legion of the Chimera attacked in 1312 DR . He fell ill when he hit a scrying barrier made by Isair and his orc shamans . Valin was revived of his visions when given a dose of Braegh . Though his visions , he was able to warn adventurers of the danger near the Western Pass .

title: Valindra Shadowmantle
description: Valindra Shadowmantle Valindra Shadowmantle was an Overwizard of the Host Tower of the Arcane and Master of the North Tower responsible for the Brotherhoods operations in the northern quadrant of Faerûn . Later , she became an important player in the politics of rebuilt Neverwinter . Personality .
description_long: Valindra Shadowmantle Valindra Shadowmantle was an Overwizard of the Host Tower of the Arcane and Master of the North Tower responsible for the Brotherhoods operations in the northern quadrant of Faerûn . Later , she became an important player in the politics of rebuilt Neverwinter . Personality . Valindra never felt the same respect for community that other moon elves shared . She grew into a self - absorbed individual who cared little for anything that wasn ' t connected to her own interests or goals . Valindra prided herself on her intellect and would rather talk her way out of a fight than blast an opponent with magic . That said , she wouldn ' t hesitate to kill or maim an enemy if the situation demanded it . History . Born in 1225 DR in the High Forest , where she trained as a wizard . Frustrated with the slow pace of her education , she left her homeland in 1322 DR to pursue her own goals . Valindra made her way to Mirabar where she found little trouble persuading a trusting old wizard to take her on as an apprentice . After a year working with her mentor she murdered him and appropriated his spellbooks and magic items .

title: Valkur
description: Valkur Valkur ( pronounced " val - KURR " ) , the Captain of the Waves , was an exarch of Tempus , patron of sailors , ships , favorable winds , and naval combat . Worshipers . Clergy .
description_long: Valkur Valkur ( pronounced " val - KURR " ) , the Captain of the Waves , was an exarch of Tempus , patron of sailors , ships , favorable winds , and naval combat . Worshipers . Clergy . The church of Valkur was loosely organized . Many cleric s served as captains or sailors aboard ships and they usually met each other only if they happened to serve on the same ship or be in the same port . The clergy was known for helping sailors who were down on their luck . Holy Days . Valkur ' s church celebrated only one holy day known as the Shattering . The exact date of the festival varied but it was always celebrated in the spring . The purpose of the festival was to celebrate the breaking up of ice floes in the north which marked the beginning of the sailing season . Relationships . Valkur ' s philosophy often put him in conflict with the capricious ocean - goddess Umberlee and he was a sworn enemy of the Deities of Fury . He was friendly with Selûne who guided sailors across the sea . History . It was believed that Valkur may have once been a mortal sailor who challenged Umberlee and won .

title: Valley of Dog - Men
description: Valley of Dog - Men The Valley of Dog - Men was nestled deep within the Kun - Yen Shan mountain range in the Hordelands . Inhabitants . A large colony of gnolls claimed this valley .
description_long: Valley of Dog - Men The Valley of Dog - Men was nestled deep within the Kun - Yen Shan mountain range in the Hordelands . Inhabitants . A large colony of gnolls claimed this valley . The gnolls were originally summoned to serve a powerful wizard , but stayed around and thrived after the wizard ' s death . As of 1359 DR their numbers hovered around 400 . Their presence in the isolated valley gave rise to many legends about savage dog - faced men who abducted beautiful women . A group of the gnolls clashed with inhabitants of the Valley of Exiles while they were out exploring for new territory .

title: Valley of Exiles
description: Valley of Exiles The Valley of Exiles was nestled within the Kun - Yen Shan mountain range in the Hordelands . Description . Compared to the other hidden valleys of the Kun - Yen Shan range , the Valley of Exiles is relatively easy to locate , though its exact location was kept secret .
description_long: Valley of Exiles The Valley of Exiles was nestled within the Kun - Yen Shan mountain range in the Hordelands . Description . Compared to the other hidden valleys of the Kun - Yen Shan range , the Valley of Exiles is relatively easy to locate , though its exact location was kept secret . Defenses . The main entrance to the valley is guarded by a pair of stone fortresses . Each of these fortresses held 100 samurai warriors who were members of the Imperial Guard of Shou Lung . The guards ensured that no one entered or left they valley without their permission . Inhabitants . As the name implied , the Valley of Exiles housed enemies of the Emperor of Shou Lung , mainly political prisoners . Once sentenced to the Valley an exile was never allowed to leave . The exiles lived as they wished within the valley , but contact with the outside world was forbidden .

title: Valley of Khedrun
description: Valley of Khedrun The Valley of Khedrun was a valley through which the River Mirar flowed from east to west , joined by the River Khedrun from the north , with the Spine of the World to the north and the Lurkwood to the south . It was filled with tall grass and dandelion s . Its eastern edge was about a hundred miles east of Mirabar .
description_long: Valley of Khedrun The Valley of Khedrun was a valley through which the River Mirar flowed from east to west , joined by the River Khedrun from the north , with the Spine of the World to the north and the Lurkwood to the south . It was filled with tall grass and dandelion s . Its eastern edge was about a hundred miles east of Mirabar . It was ( falsely ) thought by some to be the location of Gauntlgrym . History . According to legend , Khedrun , a dwarf prospector , discovered the " greatest cache of gems the world has ever seen " and then built a home for himself and his fellows using only his axe .

title: Valley of Nanayok
description: Valley of Nanayok The Valley of Nanayok was a valley in the eastern end of the Koryaz Mountains of the Northern Wastes of Kara - Tur . By 1357 DR , the valley was filled with ruins , though mostly no more than heaps of crumbling stones shrouded in vegetation . It was believed to have been a center of Maraloi culture and politics .
description_long: Valley of Nanayok The Valley of Nanayok was a valley in the eastern end of the Koryaz Mountains of the Northern Wastes of Kara - Tur . By 1357 DR , the valley was filled with ruins , though mostly no more than heaps of crumbling stones shrouded in vegetation . It was believed to have been a center of Maraloi culture and politics . It was whispered that places beneath the ground here still contained the secrets of the " Ancient Lords . " Strict taboos existed among the Pazruki tribes about visiting the ruins or accepting items taken from them . Only a few intrepid Pazruki wu jen dared investigate the site ; those who returned did not speak of what they might have found .

title: Valley of Nexal
description: Valley of Nexal The Valley of Nexal was once the center of the mighty maztican empire and more than one million humans inhabited the cities and the center city Nexal on the island of the central lake itself . After the Night of Wailing the valley became a wasteland full with monsters and evil humans . The mount Zatal still errupted smoke and ash which coated the valley and made it impossible to farm the land .
description_long: Valley of Nexal The Valley of Nexal was once the center of the mighty maztican empire and more than one million humans inhabited the cities and the center city Nexal on the island of the central lake itself . After the Night of Wailing the valley became a wasteland full with monsters and evil humans . The mount Zatal still errupted smoke and ash which coated the valley and made it impossible to farm the land . Sometimes the vulcano also errupted lava from his peak or out of his western flank . Inhabitants . The monsters were once humans but then were corrupted into becoming orc s , oger and troll s . Some of them were unique beings and the leaders . Once those more powerfull monsters have been the priests of Zaltec . The most mightiest of all beings after the destruction was still the patriarch of the evil god Zaltec . Hoxitl was corrupted into a being of the lower planes but could still use all of his clerical might and spells . He was the leader of the monster army and ruled still as the highest priest of Zaltec from his temple - pyramid in the center of the destroyed city Nexal .

title: Valley of the Dogs
description: Valley of the Dogs The Valley of the Dogs is a forested valley between Harkwood and Weathercote Wood , in the Fallen Lands , inhabited by two hobgoblin tribes called the Spittlemaws and Fistclenches . The two tribes are in a perpetual war over the area , though neither side can explain or remember why the valley is so important to them .
description_long: Valley of the Dogs The Valley of the Dogs is a forested valley between Harkwood and Weathercote Wood , in the Fallen Lands , inhabited by two hobgoblin tribes called the Spittlemaws and Fistclenches . The two tribes are in a perpetual war over the area , though neither side can explain or remember why the valley is so important to them .

title: Valley of the Shan Sao
description: Valley of the Shan Sao The Valley of the Shan Sao was isolated deep within the Kun - Yen Shan mountain range in the Hordelands . Description . Heavy forests permeated this small valley .
description_long: Valley of the Shan Sao The Valley of the Shan Sao was isolated deep within the Kun - Yen Shan mountain range in the Hordelands . Description . Heavy forests permeated this small valley . Unlike some of the other valleys of Kun - Yen Shan , the Valley of the Shan Sao was completely isolated . Inhabitants . This valley was home to the mysterious shan sao . Nearly 300 of the creatures were spread over 15 different settlements throughout the valley . Though not aggressive , they would pester any travelers passing through their land . The shan sao were allied with tiger s that also lived in the valley . Tiger pelts taken from the Valley of the Shan Sao typically sold for five to ten times their normal price . Only a few families of hunters knew of the entrances to the valley and they kept their secret closely guarded .

title: Valls
description: Valls Valls was a town in Damara and the capital of the duchy of Arcata . It was situated in the southern part of the duchy at a tributary to the Beaumaris River at the north end of the King ' s Road . History .
description_long: Valls Valls was a town in Damara and the capital of the duchy of Arcata . It was situated in the southern part of the duchy at a tributary to the Beaumaris River at the north end of the King ' s Road . History . After the death of King Virdin at the Battle of Goliad in 1357 DR , Valls was overrun by refugees moving south to escape the invaders of Vaasa . There was little wealth and treasure left in the small town and , in response , the merchants and traders of Valls increased their prices . At the same time , the town was visited by the Circus of Doctor Trundles . At the parade through the town , a bulette escaped and tore up the cages of the other circus monsters . After a tumult , where a few people were killed , all monsters except the bulette , were recaptured . Defense . The town was surrounded by a wall with three gates and twelve towers . It was defended by the Ducal Guard . Location . The town had ten inns and a tavern .

title: Valmiki
description: Valmiki Valmiki was a poet in Daggerford around 1370 DR . Activities . Valmiki was a mediocre poet , that usually copied her poems from more famous artists .
description_long: Valmiki Valmiki was a poet in Daggerford around 1370 DR . Activities . Valmiki was a mediocre poet , that usually copied her poems from more famous artists . She hoped that the company of an adventuring group would help her creativity . Appendix . Notes . is an extremely important poet in .

title: Valon
description: Valon Valon was the commander of the centaur s in Bloodstone Barony in 1357 DR . History . In 1357 DR , Valon and his fellows met Gareth Dragonsbane ' s party .
description_long: Valon Valon was the commander of the centaur s in Bloodstone Barony in 1357 DR . History . In 1357 DR , Valon and his fellows met Gareth Dragonsbane ' s party . In 1359 DR , Valon was a key member of the Alliance of Belt Watchers with local halfling s and dwarves . He was the most able commander . Personality . Valon was known for this raw but precise intelligent with a cold and logical mind , making him perfect for the military .

title: Valostar
description: Valostar The Valostar was an award bestowed by the city of Waterdeep for acts of service to the city . It was more of a lifetime achievement award rather than one given for single acts of service . The award was never given to members of the clergy as they were expected to serve without the expectation of reward .
description_long: Valostar The Valostar was an award bestowed by the city of Waterdeep for acts of service to the city . It was more of a lifetime achievement award rather than one given for single acts of service . The award was never given to members of the clergy as they were expected to serve without the expectation of reward . Description . Made of adamantine , the beautiful medallion was a pin set with a sapphire .

title: Valsharess
description: Valsharess " For the word as a generic term , see Drow dictionary . " The Valsharess ( meaning " queen " or " empress " ) was the name adopted by a female drow who gained great power and influence after the binding of Mephistopheles , one of the Archdukes of Hell , and using the devil in her service . She was originally just another matron mother , and it is not known how she managed to bind Mephistopheles .
description_long: Valsharess " For the word as a generic term , see Drow dictionary . " The Valsharess ( meaning " queen " or " empress " ) was the name adopted by a female drow who gained great power and influence after the binding of Mephistopheles , one of the Archdukes of Hell , and using the devil in her service . She was originally just another matron mother , and it is not known how she managed to bind Mephistopheles . With the help of the devil , she managed to conquer much of the Underdark during the Silence of Lolth . After this , she even went on to imprison Halaster Blackcloak and start attacking Waterdeep through Undermountain . Meanwhile , Mephistopheles planned to get free by using a famous adventurer , a student of Drogan Droganson , who had acquired an artifact of Mephistopheles . The adventurer did not know the nature of the artifact , but it was in fact meant for the leader of a cult of Mephistopheles , and bound its carrier to the archdevil . When the adventurer came to Waterdeep to help stop the drow attacks , the Valsharess was led to believe - likely by Mephistopheles - that they would be her doom if she did not act in time .

title: Valygar Corthala
description: Valygar Corthala Valygar Corthala was a specialised ranger ( stalker ) living in Amn with a particular dislike for magic . His parents had come to a tragic end after being corrupted by the power of magic , and his whole line family was cursed because of his infamous ancestor Lavok . Determined to leave no heir and to have nothing to do with arcane magic , Valygar was nevertheless forced to face both in 1369 DR when Lavok returned from the Planes to Toril in search of his last descendant .
description_long: Valygar Corthala Valygar Corthala was a specialised ranger ( stalker ) living in Amn with a particular dislike for magic . His parents had come to a tragic end after being corrupted by the power of magic , and his whole line family was cursed because of his infamous ancestor Lavok . Determined to leave no heir and to have nothing to do with arcane magic , Valygar was nevertheless forced to face both in 1369 DR when Lavok returned from the Planes to Toril in search of his last descendant . Lavok ' s Planar Sphere was of great interest to the Cowled Wizards of Amn and , once they learned of Valygar ' s connection to it , put a significant bounty on the recovery of his body as Valygar ' s blood was the only thing that would open the sphere ' s doors . Valygar was accosted by Cowled Wizards at his family estate , but escaped when they became violent . The cowled wizards approached the protagonist ' s party who then sought him out at his cabin in the Umar Hills . They persuaded him to come back to Athkatla and enter the sphere . Once inside though , the sphere plane - shifted and needed to be refuelled with demon hearts .

title: Vamar Isahn
description: Vamar Isahn Vamar Isahn was a lich living in Serôs in Vamar ' s Tower . History . Born in 1247 DR , Vamar was a wizard in Starmantle .
description_long: Vamar Isahn Vamar Isahn was a lich living in Serôs in Vamar ' s Tower . History . Born in 1247 DR , Vamar was a wizard in Starmantle . In 1308 DR , after becoming a lich , he relocated himself and his tower to Serôs . There , Vamar remained secluded , working on his studies of aquatic magic . In 1369 DR , his tower was attacked three times by sahuagin and morkoth during the Twelfth Serôs War but Vamar destroyed all invaders . Personality . Vamas was a quite paranoid but not so evil individual . He only wanted to not be disturbed .

title: Vampire
description: Vampire Vampires were one of the most feared and powerful undead creatures in Toril . Description . A vampire is an undead creature .
description_long: Vampire Vampires were one of the most feared and powerful undead creatures in Toril . Description . A vampire is an undead creature . A humanoid or monstrous humanoid can become a vampire , and looks as it did in life , but with paler skin , haunting red eyes , and a feral cast to its features . A new vampire is created when another vampire drains the life out of a living creature , or when a living creature is killed by its Energy Drain . Vampires are drawn to feed on the blood of the living , and can only survive on blood ( normal food and drink do nothing for it and cause it to forcefully vomit it up within moments ) , obtaining it in any way they possibly can . They do not cast shadows , nor do they possess a reflection . A vampire can be of any evil alignment , and if its alignment was not evil in life , it becomes so in undeath . A vampire retains all the abilities it had in life , and also becomes super - humanly strong , fast , and durable plus it gains the ability to drain blood and life energy , and to dominate other creatures with its gaze . Vampires gain the ability to shapeshift into a Dire Wolf , Wolf , Bat , Dire Bat , and a Gaseous Form .

title: Vampire spawn
description: Vampire spawn Vampire spawn were undead created by vampire s . Description . Vampire spawn appeared as they did in life , though their features were hardened and appeared predatory .
description_long: Vampire spawn Vampire spawn were undead created by vampire s . Description . Vampire spawn appeared as they did in life , though their features were hardened and appeared predatory . They lived their lives in darkness and believe they were better than other living or undead creatures . Even though they did not possess all of the standard vampire powers , they still had the affections of all their traditional weaknesses and vulnerabilities . Personality . When it came to a life of adventuring , vampire spawn would seek vengeance on their creators , or penance for their new damnation . If these monsters could overcome their ravenous emotions , they might seek out knowledge , glory , or power . Pride was the true driver of the vampire spawn , since they believed themselves better than others . Combat . Vampire spawn were the masters of stealth and charismatic cunning , easily standing their ground against any foe in combat . For them , battle was simple , because if they couldn ' t win through sheer force , they coulkd vanish using abilities like " gaseous form " or " spider climb ing " .

title: Vampiric ( weapon quality )
description: Vampiric ( weapon quality ) Vampiric was a quality that could be applied to weapons . When the weapon struck an opponent , there was a chance that some of the opponent ' s life energy was drained and transferred to the wielder . The effects on the wielder disappeared after about an hour .
description_long: Vampiric ( weapon quality ) Vampiric was a quality that could be applied to weapons . When the weapon struck an opponent , there was a chance that some of the opponent ' s life energy was drained and transferred to the wielder . The effects on the wielder disappeared after about an hour .

title: Vampiric dragon
description: Vampiric dragon A vampiric dragon was a type of undead dragon with vampirism . It was created when another vampiric dragon fully drained the life energy from a living dragon . They desired only evil and death , and were fond of spreading tales of their treasure to lure unwitting adventurers to feed upon .
description_long: Vampiric dragon A vampiric dragon was a type of undead dragon with vampirism . It was created when another vampiric dragon fully drained the life energy from a living dragon . They desired only evil and death , and were fond of spreading tales of their treasure to lure unwitting adventurers to feed upon . Vampiric dragons were also capable of creating vampire spawn from the victims of their blood drain or energy Drain abilities . if the victim was an adult dragon , it rose as another vampiric dragon within a matter of days , while younger dragons instead rose as mindless zombie dragons . Vampiric dragons shared many traits with non - draconic vampire s : they sustained themselves by feeding on the blood of living creatures , they cast neither shadows nor reflections , and they could turn themselves to mist . While normal vampires were anchored to their coffins , a vampiric dragon was anchored to its hoard . Like other vampires , vampiric dragons had a weakness to sunlight .

title: Vampiric embrace
description: Vampiric embrace Vampiric embrace is a simple but deadly spell used most often by infernal pact warlock s , though other warlocks may also learn it . When cast " vampiric embrace " allows its caster to extend a strand of necrotic energy into the life force of a creature within twenty - five feet , sapping its vitality to temporarily fuel the warlock ' s own . The potency of the spell is largely determined by the warlock ' s regular health , and those of the infernal pact use an even deadlier version of the spell .
description_long: Vampiric embrace Vampiric embrace is a simple but deadly spell used most often by infernal pact warlock s , though other warlocks may also learn it . When cast " vampiric embrace " allows its caster to extend a strand of necrotic energy into the life force of a creature within twenty - five feet , sapping its vitality to temporarily fuel the warlock ' s own . The potency of the spell is largely determined by the warlock ' s regular health , and those of the infernal pact use an even deadlier version of the spell . The spell does not come easily , however , and a warlock must rest for a few minutes after using it if he or she wishes to cast it again . " Vampiric embrace " is similar , but not identical , to the " devour magic " spell .

title: Vandathra Paleme
description: Vandathra Paleme Vandathra Paleme was a cleric from Neverwinter . History . Vandathra originated from a Neverwintan family with elven blood .
description_long: Vandathra Paleme Vandathra Paleme was a cleric from Neverwinter . History . Vandathra originated from a Neverwintan family with elven blood . Always a chaotic individual , from a very early age she started wandering Faerûn and even the planes with few companions . The last time Vandathra was seen was in Aglarond , saying she was planning to go to Rashemen and Thay in hopes of finding magic that would allow her to travel closer to the plane where the goddess Tymora resided . Her luck was always good , so she probably succeeded .

title: Vander
description: Vander Vander was a firbolg , once an assassin of the Night Masks and later a companion of Cadderly Bonaduce and his friends . Description . Vander had red hair and beard , was about twelve feet tall and weighed over 800 pounds , being thick - muscled and bearing scars of many battles .
description_long: Vander Vander was a firbolg , once an assassin of the Night Masks and later a companion of Cadderly Bonaduce and his friends . Description . Vander had red hair and beard , was about twelve feet tall and weighed over 800 pounds , being thick - muscled and bearing scars of many battles . He had dark eyes under bushy brows . Vander wore wide studded bracers , glittering with dozens of small jewels , on his wrists and a white bearskin cloak , and had a giant - sized sword belted at his side . History . He was born and raised in a firbolg community in the Spine of the World mountains . Somehow , the assassin Ghost got a hold on him and since then used Vander ' s body through the powers of his Ghearufu to perform his gruesome craft . Once Vander fled from the assassin and got almost all the way back to the Spine of the World Mountains . But Ghost found him . Merely to humiliate Vander even more , Ghost forced a body switch and mercilessly slaughtered several of Vander ' s fellow firbolgs , including his brother . Ghost reversed the body switch , leaving Vander holding his eldest son ' s left arm in his hands . Cadderly Bonaduce finally freed Vander from his predicament . Abilities .

title: Vander Stillhawk
description: Vander Stillhawk Vander Stillhawk is a human ranger and a major character in the realm of Tethyr . He was a companion to Queen Zaranda Star before her ascension to the crown . Vander is tall and spare with long muscles that seem to have been carved of oak and then weathered dark .
description_long: Vander Stillhawk Vander Stillhawk is a human ranger and a major character in the realm of Tethyr . He was a companion to Queen Zaranda Star before her ascension to the crown . Vander is tall and spare with long muscles that seem to have been carved of oak and then weathered dark . He is handsome in a heavy - browed brooding way , with long black hair , a broad jaw and ever - present stubble . The fighter was raised by elves and carries a magical elven long bow . The elves not only trained him in use of the bow , but also in elven hand signals . Vander does not speak , as he lost his tongue to orc ish raiders when he was a boy , but rather he communicates through these hand signals . Like most rangers , Stillhawk despises missions requiring him to enter a city , preferring to remain in nature . Vander has attained high position in the court of Tethyr which grants him many titles : Monarch ' s Champion , Regent of Prince Coran Rhindaun , and leader of the Warriors of the Star . The former title places him in charge of the monarchs ' safety as the Warriors are the personal guard of Queen Zaranda Star and King Haedrak III . Vander has an innate magical ability .

title: Vandover
description: Vandover The Vandover family was a noble merchant family of the city of Tantras in the Vast . The head of the family sat on the High Council that governed Tantras . In 1358 DR , shortly after the Time of Troubles , the Vandovers were allied with the Channath , Elovear , Laranadda , and Tithlin families .
description_long: Vandover The Vandover family was a noble merchant family of the city of Tantras in the Vast . The head of the family sat on the High Council that governed Tantras . In 1358 DR , shortly after the Time of Troubles , the Vandovers were allied with the Channath , Elovear , Laranadda , and Tithlin families .

title: Vane
description: Vane Vane was a member in the Golden Legion and a companion of the officer Alvarro . History . Vane took part in the Maztica n expedition as one of the cavalry .
description_long: Vane Vane was a member in the Golden Legion and a companion of the officer Alvarro . History . Vane took part in the Maztica n expedition as one of the cavalry . He was at his superior ' s side during the battle at Palul and was taking care of the horses when Alvarro tried to rape Erixitl . Vane was killed from behind by the furious Halloran , who went to save his lover .

title: Vanesci Hamlet
description: Vanesci Hamlet Vanesci Hamlet , or simply Vanesci , was a town in Konigheim in the Utter East of southeast Faerûn . It lay outside the Phantom Pass , which connected it to the Kingdom of Nix on the Forbidden Plateau . Description .
description_long: Vanesci Hamlet Vanesci Hamlet , or simply Vanesci , was a town in Konigheim in the Utter East of southeast Faerûn . It lay outside the Phantom Pass , which connected it to the Kingdom of Nix on the Forbidden Plateau . Description . Vanesci Hamlet was built upon a bed of gravel or stones , with cottages with light beige walls , arched or half - circle windows with flower boxes , and peaked turquoise - tiled roofs with chimneys ; the ruined settlement in the Phantom Pass was of the same architectural style . There were granaries on the outskirts of town and a fountain in the middle . The land around the settlement was mostly brown dirt with patches of green grassland and trees . To the east was a farm of some green plant . North of the town , a canal ran west to east , with sides supported by logs . Beyond it were fields of wheat and pumpkins . To the north , the land grew rocky , with cliffs rising upwards . History . Harvest of Horrors . During the time of the Bloodforge Wars ( 648 – 657 DR ) , the monstrous Redfang , ruler of the Kingdom of Nix , developed a taste for human flesh and instituted a reign of terror upon neighboring Vanesci Hamlet .

title: Vangerdahast Aeiulvana
description: Vangerdahast Aeiulvana Vangerdahast Aeiulvana was the former Royal Court Wizard of Cormyr who was responsible for the awakening of Nalavarauthatoryl and the returning of the goblin s of Grodd . Vangerdahast was perhaps the greatest mage to have ever taken up the mantle of Mage Royal . For decades he controlled the Kingdom of Cormyr , in fact if not in title .
description_long: Vangerdahast Aeiulvana Vangerdahast Aeiulvana was the former Royal Court Wizard of Cormyr who was responsible for the awakening of Nalavarauthatoryl and the returning of the goblin s of Grodd . Vangerdahast was perhaps the greatest mage to have ever taken up the mantle of Mage Royal . For decades he controlled the Kingdom of Cormyr , in fact if not in title . While the king would fight the wars and sit on the throne , Vangerdahast would keep the court in order and keep control of the various factions who wished to dethrone the King . He was the overall leader of the defenses of Cormyr and only the king could command him . His title of Mage Royal allowed him control over the two main military factions of Cormyr , the knights known as the Purple Dragons and the mages and wizards of the War Wizards . He could also to a large extent control the Harpers who resided in the kingdom . He was trained by Elminster and therefore knew spells and magic s far beyond the average wizard . He was called " Vangey " for short by some . Description . Vangerdahast usually wore reddish brown robes . He was average height and slightly overweight , with dark brown eyes that became red when he was angry .

title: Vanifer
description: Vanifer Vanifer is the Prophet of Fire and leader of the Cult of the Eternal Flame . She is extremely manipulative , gathering allies as she needs them and discarding them as soon as they lose their usefulness . Though she puts on the airs of a rich noble , she she despises those born into wealth .
description_long: Vanifer Vanifer is the Prophet of Fire and leader of the Cult of the Eternal Flame . She is extremely manipulative , gathering allies as she needs them and discarding them as soon as they lose their usefulness . Though she puts on the airs of a rich noble , she she despises those born into wealth . She wields a magical dagger known as " Tinderstrike " . Vanifer was born in the poorest quarter of Calimport , surviving only with her cunning wits . She learned to dance for coin , slowly working her way up to the bedchambers of the city ' s nobles and learning fire magic to distinguish herself from others . She eventually became a pasha ' s concubine , but hated him despite his lavish affections . She robbed him of a small fortune and left , setting his palace ablaze as she fled . She fled first to Zazesspur , but when the pasha ' s agents found her she continued to Baldur ' s Gate . She opened a school for dancers , and when her talent with fire attracted other sorts of students she turned them into a cult of fire worshipers . She led the cult for several years before she began to receive visions that compelled her to seek out a lost temple beneath the Sumber Hills .

title: Vanilla
description: Vanilla Vanilla was a delicate spice from Maztica . It was available for purchase through " Aurora ' s Whole Realms Catalogue " . Description .
description_long: Vanilla Vanilla was a delicate spice from Maztica . It was available for purchase through " Aurora ' s Whole Realms Catalogue " . Description . Vanilla was a bean harvested from an exotic type of orchid in the Maztican jungles . To preserve its delicate flavors , vanilla beans purchased through " Aurora ' s " were individually sealed in vial s .

title: Vanish
description: Vanish Vanish is a wizard spell that causes an object to vanish and optionally reappear in another location . It cannot be used on creatures or magical forces . The more powerful the caster , the larger and heavier an object can be made to vanish , but if the caster attempts an object beyond his or her power , the spell fails .
description_long: Vanish Vanish is a wizard spell that causes an object to vanish and optionally reappear in another location . It cannot be used on creatures or magical forces . The more powerful the caster , the larger and heavier an object can be made to vanish , but if the caster attempts an object beyond his or her power , the spell fails . If desired , the object can be put on the Ethereal Plane instead , in which case the object ' s point of origin will remain faintly magical . If a " dispel magic " spell is cast upon the point of origin , the object will reappear . Each time an item is vanished there is a 1 % chance it will disintegrate and be lost , and a 1 % chance that a creature from the Ethereal Plane can gain access to the Prime Material Plane at the point of origin of the object .

title: Vankila Slab
description: Vankila Slab The Vankila Slab is prison in the sky . Built by a joint effort of the Houses of Amn , it had been constructed on a barren mote , a massive slab of earth floating above Murandinn . The ogres who were charged with running the prison were given enough gold and slave labor to construct four sky - scraping round towers connected by raised walkways .
description_long: Vankila Slab The Vankila Slab is prison in the sky . Built by a joint effort of the Houses of Amn , it had been constructed on a barren mote , a massive slab of earth floating above Murandinn . The ogres who were charged with running the prison were given enough gold and slave labor to construct four sky - scraping round towers connected by raised walkways . Without anything except the sky to offer perspective , the towers looked taller than they were . Originally , the Vankila Slab housed spellcasters who had defied Amn ' s ban on using magic or members of well - connected families who had fallen out of favor with Amn ' s ruling houses . But within ten years of building the prison , the political sensibilities in Amn shifted , and the Vankila Slab fell into the hands of a single faction that had its fingers deep in the murky politics of both Amn and Tethyr . Soon the prison became a mercenary operation that took the most dangerous criminals off the hands of the law and political prisoners off anyone who would pay .

title: Vannak
description: Vannak Vannak ran a camp near Spellgard . History . Vannak was a dragonborn of a prominent clan .
description_long: Vannak Vannak ran a camp near Spellgard . History . Vannak was a dragonborn of a prominent clan . He traveled with his retinue to Spellgard seeking Lady Saharel ' s counsel in order to find the strongest mate ever . He established a private camp near the ruin . In 1479 DR , his warriors had captured a woman , Hanna Blenn , who claimed to have met the Lady .

title: Vanquisher
description: Vanquisher Vanquisher was a title used by a dragonborn ruler of Tymanther , equivalent to both a monarch and a general . The Vanquisher were also the leaders of the Adjudicators . < ref name = " AotT / Hardcover - p61 , 145 " > < / ref > A Vanquisher governed for a period of ten years , after which a new Vanquisher was elected .
description_long: Vanquisher Vanquisher was a title used by a dragonborn ruler of Tymanther , equivalent to both a monarch and a general . The Vanquisher were also the leaders of the Adjudicators . < ref name = " AotT / Hardcover - p61 , 145 " > < / ref > A Vanquisher governed for a period of ten years , after which a new Vanquisher was elected . The Vanquisher was always a dragonborn who had been determined to be fit to rule by rising in rank over a period of twenty years in the military forces . Dragonborn who became the patriarchs or matriarchs of a clan lose their right to be elegible as the Vanquisher . < ref name = " AotT / Hardcover - p300 " > < / ref > Although Thymari rarely chose to became spellcaster s , the Vanquisher had a few dragonborn spellcasters under his or her direct command . Vanquishers used piercings different to those of the clans of Thymari society . Theirs were square bits of gold under their eyes like teardrops . History . Tarhun was the Vanquisher of Tymanther in 1479 DR , and until his death in 1486 DR . < ref name = " AotT / Hardcover - p437 , 464 " > < / ref > Before him , Ophinshtalajiir Shaushka held the position of Vanquisher .

title: Vanquo
description: Vanquo Vanquo was a mind flayer in the Vast region . Personality . Its main goal was to acquire artifacts from the Elemental Plane of Earth .
description_long: Vanquo Vanquo was a mind flayer in the Vast region . Personality . Its main goal was to acquire artifacts from the Elemental Plane of Earth . History . One day , Vanquo discovered that the Turning Key adventuring party had found one of the artifacts it needed . In a case of destiny , Adera Moonfist , a descendant of a member of the Turning Key , also dreamed of rediscovering that treasure . In 1491 DR , Adera agreed to meet Vanquo but he quickly subdued her and absorbed all the information from her , replacing her brain with an intellect devourer . Later , Vanquo sent the new " Adera Moonfist " to the Flooded Forest to find the treasure . His plan was ruined , however , by an adventuring party hired to clear the area of bandits , which were secretly led by " Adera " . The adventurers confronted and killed the intellect devourer .

title: Vansi Bloodscar
description: Vansi Bloodscar Vansi Bloodscar was the female leader of the Many - Arrows contingent in Neverwinter . History . Vansi , a powerful spellscar red orc warrior , was chosen by King Obould XVII to guide the Many - Arrows contingent in Neverwinter following the rebuilding of the city after the Spellplague .
description_long: Vansi Bloodscar Vansi Bloodscar was the female leader of the Many - Arrows contingent in Neverwinter . History . Vansi , a powerful spellscar red orc warrior , was chosen by King Obould XVII to guide the Many - Arrows contingent in Neverwinter following the rebuilding of the city after the Spellplague . However , Vansi was a warmonger and soon went rogue with all her army . She also allied herself with the Abolethic Sovereignty , beginning to harass Neverwinter ' s citizens and occupying the Tower District of the city . Many adventurers were recruited to weaken and defeat the orc horde . Finally , it was likely that an adventurer infiltrated the Cloak Tower and fought and killed Vansi .

title: Vaprak
description: Vaprak Vaprak was a lesser deity and the patron deity of ogre s . Othea , mother of giant s , had an affair with him , which led to the birth of the ogre race . Vaprak was located in the Abyss on the layer of Shatterstone .
description_long: Vaprak Vaprak was a lesser deity and the patron deity of ogre s . Othea , mother of giant s , had an affair with him , which led to the birth of the ogre race . Vaprak was located in the Abyss on the layer of Shatterstone . Description . Vaprak appeared to be the unholy fusion of both troll and ogre , combining the worst characteristics of both races . He had mottled greenish brown skin . Worshipers . Ogre s and troll s worshiped Vaprak .

title: Var ( tribe )
description: Var ( tribe ) The Var were a strong dangerous tribe of Nar found in western Narfell and Damara . They measured 2 , 400 strong in 1357 DR . Activities .
description_long: Var ( tribe ) The Var were a strong dangerous tribe of Nar found in western Narfell and Damara . They measured 2 , 400 strong in 1357 DR . Activities . The Var expressed interest in mining gems from the Giantspire Mountains . Base of Operations . The Var ranged along the base of the Giantspire Mountains in western Narfell .

title: Var the Drowned
description: Var the Drowned Var the Drowned was an area once known as Var the Golden . This land was drowned in 1385 DR . Geography .
description_long: Var the Drowned Var the Drowned was an area once known as Var the Golden . This land was drowned in 1385 DR . Geography . This land was once known for its vast wheat fields , however in 1385 DR the Spellplague came , and Var the Golden sank beneath the waves . By 1479 DR , this area was a drowned land of silt covered fields and ruined towns and villages .

title: Var the Golden
description: Var the Golden Var the Golden , or simply Var , was a peninsula in the far south - eastern region of Faerûn . In front of it sat Ulgarth . Its name came from huge quantities of wheat fields found throughout the land .
description_long: Var the Golden Var the Golden , or simply Var , was a peninsula in the far south - eastern region of Faerûn . In front of it sat Ulgarth . Its name came from huge quantities of wheat fields found throughout the land . Like Durpar , Var the Golden followed the teachings of Satama . With Estagund , they constituted the Shining Lands . The city of Vaelen hosted a Shou Town .

title: Varden
description: Varden Varden was a male human thief living in Scardale during the Time of Troubles . History . Varden was a successful thief in Scardale Town until in 1358 the god Bane , after the Battle of Shadowdale , ordered the Zhentilar armies to conquer Scardale in order to then threaten Tantras .
description_long: Varden Varden was a male human thief living in Scardale during the Time of Troubles . History . Varden was a successful thief in Scardale Town until in 1358 the god Bane , after the Battle of Shadowdale , ordered the Zhentilar armies to conquer Scardale in order to then threaten Tantras . Varden was conscripted into the Sembian Resistance , composed of all forces in the dale fighting the Zhent forces . During a mission , they met the heroes Midnight and Adon . Understanding the importance of their mission , Varden helped them in many ways until they reunited with Kelemvor Lyonsbane and boarded a warship to Tantras to fulfill their mission . Varden went with them but when attacked by Bane ' s assassins on the sea , Varden was killed .

title: Varen Malavhan
description: Varen Malavhan Varen Malavhan was a mercenary recruiter in Westgate . Activities . Varen was the chief recruiting and propaganda officer and treasurer of the Mercenaries ' Guild of Westgate .
description_long: Varen Malavhan Varen Malavhan was a mercenary recruiter in Westgate . Activities . Varen was the chief recruiting and propaganda officer and treasurer of the Mercenaries ' Guild of Westgate . He always accompanied the troops in the field . The good reputation of the Guild was mostly due to Varen ' s work . He had a networks of bards , fighters , and priests to help him recruit , who received a bounty for each recruit . History . Once , a ballad he wrote , " The Battle of the Yellow Eye Orcs " , was a triumph of propaganda but it also annoyed the Urdo family , whose symbol was a yellow eye .

title: Vargo Kent
description: Vargo Kent Vargo Kent was a member of the Cult of the Dragon who had devoted his life to dragon s , specifically black dragon s . History . He was tasked with the construction of their citadel at the Well of Dragons .
description_long: Vargo Kent Vargo Kent was a member of the Cult of the Dragon who had devoted his life to dragon s , specifically black dragon s . History . He was tasked with the construction of their citadel at the Well of Dragons . By 1479 DR , Vargo had become a lich and the co - ruler of the Well of Dragons . Relationships . Vargo had a cohort , Amnemis , a female black dragon , as well as a black wyrmling familiar , Enixtryx .

title: Vargouille
description: Vargouille Vargouilles were denizens of the lower planes , some of which were trapped in Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Lands . Summoned to Zakhara during ages past for an unknown purpose , these creatures were usually found within the Haunted Lands or Ruined Kingdoms .
description_long: Vargouille Vargouilles were denizens of the lower planes , some of which were trapped in Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Lands . Summoned to Zakhara during ages past for an unknown purpose , these creatures were usually found within the Haunted Lands or Ruined Kingdoms . They could also be found in underground locations such as sewers or catacombs . Description . Vargouilles appeared as a human head sprouting bat wings . Their mouths were filled with sharp fangs and a ring of tentacles enveloped their face . Their eyes glowed with a constant eerie green light . While they could speak Infernal , Vargouilles did not speak mortal languages , but screamed during attacks . Combat . The simple sight of a pack of vargouilles was enough to send many brave warriors running , especially when they heard its terrifying scream . Some who heard the scream were frozen with fear , vulnerable to the vargouille ' s poisoned bite . A vargouille ’ s bite injected the victim with a debilitating poison that would not heal unless treated with magic . Vargouilles sometimes chose to kiss their victims , which began the victim ' s transformation into a new vargouille .

title: Variance Amatick
description: Variance Amatick Variance Amatick was a shade cleric of Shar at the Fane of Shar in Thultanthar . Description . She had gray black skin and black hair .
description_long: Variance Amatick Variance Amatick was a shade cleric of Shar at the Fane of Shar in Thultanthar . Description . She had gray black skin and black hair . She wore a black mantle over black clothing embroidered in dark purple . Equipment . Variance used a chakram in battle .

title: Variath
description: Variath Variath was a powerful druid in the Chondalwood in 1358 DR . Activities . Variath governed a section of Chondalwood .
description_long: Variath Variath was a powerful druid in the Chondalwood in 1358 DR . Activities . Variath governed a section of Chondalwood . History . Variath born and raised in Chondalwood , went in outside world only one time . Variath in 1358 found ten members of the Sailors of the Crimson Sea mercenary company inside his forest after they had killed a deer , a terrible crime at Variath ' s eyes . He captured them and put them to trial . Personality . Variath believed that all outside Chondalwood was evil and men were evil . He hated what he had seen in Faerûn . In truth Variath was full of petty hatred and wanted to vent his ire on someone .

title: Variscite
description: Variscite Variscite , also known as lucinite and peganite , was an ornamental stone found in nodules or in rock seams . Description . This stone was translucent and came in deep to pale shades of yellowish green .
description_long: Variscite Variscite , also known as lucinite and peganite , was an ornamental stone found in nodules or in rock seams . Description . This stone was translucent and came in deep to pale shades of yellowish green . When cut and polished they occasionally displayed gray and yellow bands or rings ( " eyes " ) . A typical stone had a base value of 10 gp . Powers . Variscite was poisonous to lycanthrope s and , if delivered into the bloodstream on the tip of a weapon , caused triple the normal damage for that strike . Once a lycanthrope was infected with variscite , further exposure did no additional harm until the subject recovered — a process that took a full 24 hours . Infection could also be accomplished if a variscite stone , say mounted in a ring or other jewelry , were pressed into an open wound on a lycanthrope , or touched to the creature ' s tongue .

title: Varorn Irrymgalis
description: Varorn Irrymgalis Varorn Irrymgalis was an elf steward in Myth Drannor . Activities . Varorn was the Steward of the Southern Gate of the city .
description_long: Varorn Irrymgalis Varorn Irrymgalis was an elf steward in Myth Drannor . Activities . Varorn was the Steward of the Southern Gate of the city . History . In 1487 DR , Storm Silverhand , Arclath Delcastle , and Amarune Whitewave were conducted in front of Varorn in order to decide if they could enter in the city . Storm tried to argue with him . In the end , it was Fflar Starbrow Melruth himself who decided to admit them . Relationship . Varorn was the son of Orblyn Irrymgalis .

title: Varramzord
description: Varramzord Varramzord , also known as Varram the White , was a male gold dwarf and the White Dragon Wrymspeaker in the reformed Cult of the Dragon under Severin Silrajin . Personality . Owing to his past experience , Varram hated the Red Wizards of Thay and despised the fact that Severin had allied with them .
description_long: Varramzord Varramzord , also known as Varram the White , was a male gold dwarf and the White Dragon Wrymspeaker in the reformed Cult of the Dragon under Severin Silrajin . Personality . Owing to his past experience , Varram hated the Red Wizards of Thay and despised the fact that Severin had allied with them . Varram was one of Severin ' s best friends , but had a weak personality and greatly feared the wrath of Severin . He could be easily convinced to betray the Cult in exchange for his personal protection . History . Varram was captured by pirates during a trip across the Sea of Fallen Stars and sold as a slave to the Red Wizards of Thay . He managed to escape but retained a great hate for the Thay an wizards . During the Tyranny of Dragons , a very competent Zhentarim thief stole Varram ' s " white dragon mask " and in fear of punishment from Severin he secretly traveled from the Cult ' s stronghold of the Well of Dragons to the Tomb of Diderius — the site of a powerful divination pool — in order to find the mask ' s location . However , in the Serpent Hills , Varram was captured by a yuan - ti clan .

title: Varrdig
description: Varrdig Varrdigs , or fluid brutes , were grue native to the Elemental Plane of Water . Description . These creatures assumed multiple forms depending on the situation .
description_long: Varrdig Varrdigs , or fluid brutes , were grue native to the Elemental Plane of Water . Description . These creatures assumed multiple forms depending on the situation . They could appear as a small pool of water , a fountain , or simply as part of a larger body of water . Their greenish tint made them noticeable to careful observers . A varrdig ' s true form was that of a globular translucent mass . Small clawed legs and tube - like appendages radiated outward from its central section . Varrdigs moved about while in water by shooting water through the tube appendages . Combat . Varrdigs could attack opponents out of the water by jetting water at them with impressive force . These streams of water could easily blind a target or even knock them unconscious . Any target falling unconscious was easily drowned by the varrdig . When encountered within water , varrdigs were capable of a swift ramming attack that often surprised their target because of the varrdigs ungainly appearance . Varrdigs were completely immune to all cold and water - based magic . Their mere presence within 30 feet of such magic automatically dispelled it , including permanent spells .

title: Varriel
description: Varriel Varriel was a Red Wizard of Thay in Waterdeep in 1479 DR . History . In 1479 DR , Varriel discovered notes about a necromancer ' s laboratory inside Undermountain .
description_long: Varriel Varriel was a Red Wizard of Thay in Waterdeep in 1479 DR . History . In 1479 DR , Varriel discovered notes about a necromancer ' s laboratory inside Undermountain . Not suited for adventure , she hired Aizel Treemaine , a female elf wizard , to explore on her behalf . However , Aizel joined the doomed Rutherford Urmbrusk ' s party and disappeared . Soon after , some undead with a symbol associated with the laboratory started wandering the dungeon . So Varriel decided to hire a second adventuring party in order to uncover the matter . Behind the Scenes . The adventure did not specify if Varriel was a Red Wizard exile with good intentions or an evil minion of Szass Tam .

title: Varscona
description: Varscona Varscona was an enchanted longsword . It was of a type of sword used by Sharran priests during the sacrificial rites conducted during Feast of the Moon ceremonies . Accoriding to legend , this sword was placed within the chest of its ritually mummified owner , who was to be exhumed and born again in some new form .
description_long: Varscona Varscona was an enchanted longsword . It was of a type of sword used by Sharran priests during the sacrificial rites conducted during Feast of the Moon ceremonies . Accoriding to legend , this sword was placed within the chest of its ritually mummified owner , who was to be exhumed and born again in some new form . The tomb was forgotten , however , and she was never let out of it , leaving her to develop a rage that bordered on insanity , imbuing the sword with enhanced deadliness in combat and an ability to deal cold damage . When the tomb was later discovered , only the sword was found within . The sword was carried by the bounty hunter Greywolf .

title: Vartain
description: Vartain Vartain was a widely traveled riddlemaster originally from Calimport . Description . Vartain was bald .
description_long: Vartain Vartain was a widely traveled riddlemaster originally from Calimport . Description . Vartain was bald . History . Vartain grew up on the streets of Calimport . He later became a respected riddlemaster and language scholar . He was trained in Mulhorand tradition . In 1364 DR , Vartain was hired by Elaith Craulnober to help him seek out the Morninglark harp . They were joined by Harpers Danilo Thann and company and traveled to the High Forest , where Vartain was posed a conundrum by the riddle - loving dragon Grimnoshtadrano . Vartain overthought the riddle and answered incorrectly . His anguish at answering incorrectly later led him to go behind Danilo ' s back and pose Iriador Wintermist the same conundrum ; she also failed to answer correctly . Possessions . Vartain carried and was skilled with a blowpipe ( dart s ) .

title: Vartha Do ' Urden
description: Vartha Do ' Urden Vartha Do ' Urden was the mother and predecessor of Malice Do ' Urden , matron mother of House Do ' Urden . History . Vartha Do ' Urden was the matron mother of House Do ' Urden when she suffered a sudden death in the tenth century DR .
description_long: Vartha Do ' Urden Vartha Do ' Urden was the mother and predecessor of Malice Do ' Urden , matron mother of House Do ' Urden . History . Vartha Do ' Urden was the matron mother of House Do ' Urden when she suffered a sudden death in the tenth century DR . Her daughter Malice subsequently became matron mother , even though she was less than 100 years old at the time . Relationships . Vartha was the mother of Malice Do ' Urden and thus the grandmother of Malice ' s children : Briza , Nalfein , Dinen , Vierna , Maya Do ' Urden , and Drizzt Do ' Urden .

title: Varyth
description: Varyth County Varyth was a region of lush farmland in Tethyr but also struggled with an elevated monster population . Geography . Varyth was a member of the Crown Lands .
description_long: Varyth County Varyth was a region of lush farmland in Tethyr but also struggled with an elevated monster population . Geography . Varyth was a member of the Crown Lands . It was between the River Ith and the Sulduskoon River and bordered County Rivershire and County Hazamarch in the Golden Marches . Trade . County Varyth produced large barley crops , as well as wines and pipeweed . Government . County Varyth was ruled by a pair of mages , Count Dancon Riiklass and his wife Iimvara Riiklass . Dancon held the official power , but the Countess - Consort ran the everyday business of the county for him , as he was more often involved with his mutual role as Duties Chancellor of Tethyr . Their home was in the keep Tor Arcana on the River Ith . History . As of 1370 DR , the county struggled with a relatively large population of monsters ; as elves from the eastern portions of the Forest of Tethir drove the monsters out of their woods , they tended to cross the Sulduskoon and enter Varyth .

title: Varytha Gheldieg
description: Varytha Gheldieg Varytha Gheldieg was a member of the Gheldieg family and lived on an estate in Eshpurta as of early 1370 DR , the Year of the Tankard . . She was also a necromancer and a member of the Cowled Wizards .
description_long: Varytha Gheldieg Varytha Gheldieg was a member of the Gheldieg family and lived on an estate in Eshpurta as of early 1370 DR , the Year of the Tankard . . She was also a necromancer and a member of the Cowled Wizards . Varytha Gheldeig was actively trying to get a spy in a position near the Council of Six and was also looking for influence over her fellow Cowled Wizards . Her apprentice , Zallanora Argentresses , was strongly encouraged to apply her elven beauty and charm to gaining favor and knowledge from others who wore the Cowl and to report back to Varytha . Little did she know that the lovely Zallanora had her own plans for gaining power and influence . Varytha discreetly took delivery of the bodies of any person who died in Eshpurta alone and too destitute to afford a proper burial . What she did with those corpses was known to very few .

title: Vasen Cale
description: Vasen Cale Vasen Cale was the son of Erevis Cale and Varra . History . Vasen Cale was conceived in 1374 DR , to Varra and the shade assassin , Erevis Cale .
description_long: Vasen Cale Vasen Cale was the son of Erevis Cale and Varra . History . Vasen Cale was conceived in 1374 DR , to Varra and the shade assassin , Erevis Cale . When Shar ' s servants loosed the Shadowstorm across Sembia , Vasen ' s pregnant mother took transport in a caravan fleeing the darkness for the Dales . But she was never to reach her destination . Thousands of undead prowled the Shadowstorm — wraiths , specters , unliving shadows — and dozens of them attacked the fleeing caravan . To save the others , Varra led the undead into a nearby wood . There , she encountered an avatar of the god Mask , who touched her pregnant form and changed Vasen in the womb . Still fleeing the terrors of the Shadowstorm , Varra stumbled into a magical meadow where she hid herself and wished desperately to be somewhere else , somewhere safe . The magic of the meadow granted her that wish . She and Vasen , possibly due to the machinations of Mask , were pushed forward in time almost seventy years .

title: Vast Swamp
description: Vast Swamp The Vast Swamp was an area of swampland in interior Faerûn that lay between Cormyr to its west and Sembia to its east . It was widely thought of as the most dangerous stretch of wilderness in the land . Ignored by surrounding nations , it had no proper name ; " vast swamp " appears to be a nickname that stuck .
description_long: Vast Swamp The Vast Swamp was an area of swampland in interior Faerûn that lay between Cormyr to its west and Sembia to its east . It was widely thought of as the most dangerous stretch of wilderness in the land . Ignored by surrounding nations , it had no proper name ; " vast swamp " appears to be a nickname that stuck . Geography . It was flanked to the north and east by the Thunder Peaks mountains , to the west by the Eastern Plains of Cormyr , and to the south by the Dragonmere , a body of water that poured into the Sea of Fallen Stars . Between the swamp and the coast ran the Way of the Manticore , the only overland route between Cormyr and Sembia . The Vast Swamp was largely marshland covered with forest of middling density , making it appear more like a flooded forest than an actual swamp . One could rarely see far for the forest . The terrain was dominated by undergrowth and bogs with precious little clear , dry land to be found anywhere within its borders . The ground underfoot was soft and spongy , largely comprising thick peat . What paths there were to be found winding through the swamp were little more than muddy trails .

title: Vast Swamp geyser
description: Vast Swamp geyser There was an unnamed geyser in the Vast Swamp of Cormyr where the Sharptooth lizardfolk tribe made their encampment . Geography . The geyser lay in a somewhat drier part of the western swamp , where the marshy ground gave way to an area of wet gravel , mud , and even bare rock .
description_long: Vast Swamp geyser There was an unnamed geyser in the Vast Swamp of Cormyr where the Sharptooth lizardfolk tribe made their encampment . Geography . The geyser lay in a somewhat drier part of the western swamp , where the marshy ground gave way to an area of wet gravel , mud , and even bare rock . It wasn ' t far from the Skull Staff marker . Description . The center of the area was a great geyser , its mouth some 30 feet ( 9 meters ) across . Preceded by ground shaking and an explosive burst , the geyser periodically unleashed a great gout of boiling water and steam roughly every 12 – 24 seconds , rising to a height of 100 feet ( 30 meters ) and showering all in the immediately vicinity . Here and there , the bare rock was pockmarked by pools of water fed by hot springs . These were boiling hot and produced steam . Between steam and chthonic vapors , the area was blanketed in a hazy mist that limited visibility to 60 feet ( 18 meters ) . The air was muggy , humid and warm , and smelled of sulfur . History .

title: Vastar
description: Vastar Vastar was an orc kingdom that occupied the lands later known as the Vast , between Cormanthyr and Impiltur in north Faerûn . It was founded " circa " −700 DR and fell in 610 DR . History .
description_long: Vastar Vastar was an orc kingdom that occupied the lands later known as the Vast , between Cormanthyr and Impiltur in north Faerûn . It was founded " circa " −700 DR and fell in 610 DR . History . The rise of Vastar . Orc hordes overwhelmed the elven community of Yrlaphon in the north of the land in the summer of −722 DR . It became a ruin held as an orcish stronghold and ruled by an orc chieftain . The orc kingdom of Vastar rose " circa " −700 DR . It was in place across the land by −626 DR . From time to time , the orcs of Vastar clashed with the minotaur s of the kingdom of Grong - Haap ( −981 to −350 DR ) , which encroached upon the northern highlands of the Vast . Following the fall of Grong - Haap , every ten years or so , entire tribes of orcs would vanish in the night , abducted by shadowy creatures that appeared suddenly and took them unawares . In time , rumors pointed to Ironfang Keep , the old capital of Grong - Haap , held to be the lair of cultists that experimented on beasts and people alike . The words of the few surviving witnesses passed into orc folklore . The hordes of Vastar .

title: Vataqatal
description: Vataqatal Vataqatal was the Zakhara n war god . He wanted his followers to grow by testing their strength of body and will and preached the importance of duty . He was a local god worshiped mainly in the northern parts of the Land of Fate that bordered on foreign lands .
description_long: Vataqatal Vataqatal was the Zakhara n war god . He wanted his followers to grow by testing their strength of body and will and preached the importance of duty . He was a local god worshiped mainly in the northern parts of the Land of Fate that bordered on foreign lands . Vataqal ' s symbol was a red - bladed scimitar . The Warrior - Slave had been described as a muscular , veiled warrior with glowing red eyes who wore robes and battle - worn lamellar armor and bore a great scimitar . < br > He was worshiped by warriors , especially mamluk s and farisans who valued duty and dedication to one ' s service .

title: Vattick Tanthul
description: Vattick Tanthul Prince Vattick Tanthul was a male shade human of Thultanthar , the City of Shade . Relationships . He was the twin brother of Prince Mattick Tanthul .
description_long: Vattick Tanthul Prince Vattick Tanthul was a male shade human of Thultanthar , the City of Shade . Relationships . He was the twin brother of Prince Mattick Tanthul . He was 2 minutes younger than his brother . Both had black hairs and eyes and were perfect replicas of one another — only their parents could distinguish one from the other . Mattick and Vattick used this to perpetrate innumerable conspiracies and jokes , some benign and others much less so , on the royal household since their early childhood . They were inseparable and were rarely found at great distance from one another . Mattick and Vattick divided their time between research at the academy of alchemy and helping Brennus Tanthul seek out clues to the locations of old Netherese sites . History . In 1487 DR , Vattick was killed by Dove Falconhand . Personality . Mattick and Vattick sided with Brennus and Hadrhune in supporting the swift destruction of all threats to Shade ' s rule . Prince Vattick ' s personal sigil was a pair of interlocking silver rings , outlined in purple on a charcoal gray field .

title: Vault of Cloaked Midnight
description: Vault of Cloaked Midnight The Vault of Cloaked Midnight was a temple of Vhaeraun in Ultoksamrin around which a settlement of followers of the same deity did grow . It was led by Vokkrzyr Rualfren , a cleric of Vhaeraun . Structure .
description_long: Vault of Cloaked Midnight The Vault of Cloaked Midnight was a temple of Vhaeraun in Ultoksamrin around which a settlement of followers of the same deity did grow . It was led by Vokkrzyr Rualfren , a cleric of Vhaeraun . Structure . The Vault of Cloaked Midnight was situated in the ruling cavern of Ultoksamrin , a 1000ft . high grotto , a mile beneath Mount Sarengard . The temple occupied about half of the cavern and the drow who weren ’ t living there lived in the old dwarven clanholds for defensive reasons . Development . The drow in Ultoksamrin were escapees from the city of Guallidurth . They were followers of Vhaeraun and fled from religious persecution at the hand of Lolth ’ s matriarchy . They fled and built settlements in the Ultoksamrin and Forest of Mir . One of the settlements in the Forest of Mir was Allsihwann , alongside Dallnothax , Holldaybim and Iskasshyoll . When Allsihwann was destroyed by the combined forces of Tethyr and surface elves , the drow fled to Ultoksamrin . Despite this development , the settlement ’ s leader Vokkrzyr Rualfren tried to invite surface elves to bolster the cathedral city ’ s numbers , with the goal to hurt Guallidurth .

title: Vault of the Word of the Loregiver
description: Vault of the Word of the Loregiver The Vault of the Word of the Loregiver was part of the complex of the Palace of the Enlightened Throne in Huzuz in 1367 DR . Activities . Contained within this vault was the oldest known recorded copy of the Word of the Loregiver , created by the first Grand Caliph .
description_long: Vault of the Word of the Loregiver The Vault of the Word of the Loregiver was part of the complex of the Palace of the Enlightened Throne in Huzuz in 1367 DR . Activities . Contained within this vault was the oldest known recorded copy of the Word of the Loregiver , created by the first Grand Caliph . These precious scrolls were displayed for all to see , but kept safely behind " walls of force " . Defenses . In addition to the " walls of force " protecting the vault , many magical protective measures were used to guard the ancient scrolls . A tasked slayer genie lay hidden within the base of the stand holding the scrolls , ready to spring out and destroy any intruder or thief with unbridled fury .

title: Vaustal Urle
description: Vaustal Urle Vaustal Urle was a female human cleric of Helm who resided in Hillsfar and would occasionally help adventurers . Abilities . As a highly experienced cleric of Helm , Vaustal could request some of the most powerful divine spell s from her deity .
description_long: Vaustal Urle Vaustal Urle was a female human cleric of Helm who resided in Hillsfar and would occasionally help adventurers . Abilities . As a highly experienced cleric of Helm , Vaustal could request some of the most powerful divine spell s from her deity . Activities . Vaustal Urle was occasionally known to lend help to adventurers in need of her aid . However , this help was generally only given out to followers of deities similarly aligned to Helm . History . In 1372 DR , Vaustal Urle resided in Hillsfar , where she would aid adventurers who also worshiped deities of law , like Helm .

title: Vaxall
description: Vaxall Vaxall , also known as Vaxall of the Dying Gaze and as Xavlal to the Zhentarim , was one of the oldest beholder s in Faerûn . Relationships . Vaxall was a lesser agent of the Twisted Rune .
description_long: Vaxall Vaxall , also known as Vaxall of the Dying Gaze and as Xavlal to the Zhentarim , was one of the oldest beholder s in Faerûn . Relationships . Vaxall was a lesser agent of the Twisted Rune . Vaxall had many minions , among them its elite servants were the battle horror Gauntlet , the flameskull Skullpyr and the Doom Brigade , a company of ten Helmed horror s . History . Vaxall was the most powerful beholder of the Alimir Hive outlander community , which was based out of the beholder city of Zokir . Its desire was to create a beholder nation on the surface consisting of the Arnaden region , Calimshan , eastern Tethyr and Erlkazar . In 1230 DR , Vaxall forged an alliance with Jhaniloth Puiral and , while becoming an elder orb , learned the secrets of magic from her . Since Jhaniloth ' s destruction in 1330 DR , Vaxall began work on a plan to make his desires come true . It began by unifying some of the fractious eye tyrants of the Alimir Hive then , in the wake of the Time of Troubles , approached Teldorn Darkhope , " polymorph ed " into the guise of a much younger beholder calling itself Xavlal .

title: Vedoran
description: Vedoran Vedoran was an accomplished Shadar - kai warrior from Ikemmu in the Shadowfell . Although most inhabitants of Ikemmu worhip Tempus , Vedoran didn ' t have strong faith in any god . He utilized Beshaba ' s temple for healing and schemed with Traedis , Beshaba ' s priest , to start an uprising in the city .
description_long: Vedoran Vedoran was an accomplished Shadar - kai warrior from Ikemmu in the Shadowfell . Although most inhabitants of Ikemmu worhip Tempus , Vedoran didn ' t have strong faith in any god . He utilized Beshaba ' s temple for healing and schemed with Traedis , Beshaba ' s priest , to start an uprising in the city . In 1479 DR , Uwan appointed Vedoran the leader of an expedition to investigate the disappearance of a scouting party lead by the witch Ilvani . He was accompanied by several young Shadar - kai warriors including Ashok , who had been found near death in the Shadowfell several months previous . The group found the Shadar - kai enclave in which Ilvani was held prisoner and during the rescue mission , Vedoran correctly guessed that the enclave belonged to Ashok ' s clan . Vedoran took the information to Traedis who encouraged him to frame Ashok as a traitor to Ikemmu . Vedoran took an oath to Beshaba with the intent of starting a revolt in Ikemmu . Vedoran later had a heated argument with Tempus ' high priest Natan and killed the cleric .

title: Veera Wavecrest
description: Veera Wavecrest Veera Wavecrest was a female Chondathan human rogue sorceress and a pirate from the Vilhon Reach in the 14th century DR . History . Veera was a pirate captain of the Vilhon Reach who venerated both Umberlee and Mystra , thanks to her sorcerous powers .
description_long: Veera Wavecrest Veera Wavecrest was a female Chondathan human rogue sorceress and a pirate from the Vilhon Reach in the 14th century DR . History . Veera was a pirate captain of the Vilhon Reach who venerated both Umberlee and Mystra , thanks to her sorcerous powers . In the Year of Lightning Storms , 1374 DR , she sailed to Wheloon in Cormyr in need of repairs to her ship , far from the waters where she normally operated . There she visited the Temple of Mystra to pay homage to her goddess , and partook in the three - day ritual of Mystra ' s Sacred Trust . But then she was " dominated " with the " Starry Gnosis " and abducted by Shar ran clerics posing as Mystran clerics . Fortunately for her , there was no room on Mhair ' s boat to the Lost Refuge , and she was kept in a cage beneath the temple . Eventually , she was freed by some adventurers recruited to investigate the strange behavior of these false Mystran clerics .

title: Vees
description: Vees Vees was a firesoul genasi guard in Neverwinter . History . Vees was always in the employ of Sala Nidris and followed her and her son Zan Nidris to Neverwinter .
description_long: Vees Vees was a firesoul genasi guard in Neverwinter . History . Vees was always in the employ of Sala Nidris and followed her and her son Zan Nidris to Neverwinter . In 1479 DR , however , a gang of kidnappers attacked the Nidrises ' house and kidnapped Zan , despite Vees ' resistance . Vees survived with only a few injuries and told about the attack to the adventurers Sala hired to to find her son .

title: Veesh Restoon
description: Veesh Restoon Veesh Restoon was a member of the Xanathar Thieves ' Guild in Waterdeep around 1370 DR . Activities . Veesh ' s role on her team was as sneak attack specialist .
description_long: Veesh Restoon Veesh Restoon was a member of the Xanathar Thieves ' Guild in Waterdeep around 1370 DR . Activities . Veesh ' s role on her team was as sneak attack specialist . She would wait in a pre - established place where the victims were funneled and would strike with a poisoned dagger . She was obsessive about cleaning and avoided entering sewers whenever possible .

title: Vegepygmy
