description: Vegepygmy Vegepygmies , also known as moldies , mold folk or mold men , were fungus creatures that lived in dark forests or underground , hunting for sustenance and spreading the spores from which they reproduced . They were spawned from dead humanoid s or giant s that were killed by a type of mold commonly known as russet mold . Society .
description_long: Vegepygmy Vegepygmies , also known as moldies , mold folk or mold men , were fungus creatures that lived in dark forests or underground , hunting for sustenance and spreading the spores from which they reproduced . They were spawned from dead humanoid s or giant s that were killed by a type of mold commonly known as russet mold . Society . Vegepygmies were organized in simple tribal units , led by their elders , whom outsiders referred to as " chiefs " . Chiefs bore spores which they could use to infect creatures the same way russet mold did . If a beast died infected by russet mold or a chief ' s spores , then a bestial moldie , known as a " thorny " , would sprout instead . Vegepygmy tribes had good relations with myconid s , shrieker s , and violet fungi . History . The origin of vegepygmies was ultimately unknown . It was speculated that vegepygmies originated outside of Toril , and were brought there by a falling star infested with russet mold .

title: Vehlarr
description: Vehlarr Vehlarr was a natural werewolf and accomplished sorcerer who was favoured by Malar and Sehanine . With their help , he organized the packs of werewolves in the Wood of Sharp Teeth and formed the city of Vehlarr within the forest . Myth Lharast .
description_long: Vehlarr Vehlarr was a natural werewolf and accomplished sorcerer who was favoured by Malar and Sehanine . With their help , he organized the packs of werewolves in the Wood of Sharp Teeth and formed the city of Vehlarr within the forest . Myth Lharast . Syri Mhaal had placed a magic lure on the city of Myth Lharast which was causing Vehlarr ' s werewolves to fall victim to it . This action annoyed Vehlarr , and displeased Sehanine , because she felt that Syri had corrupted a city built at least partly in her honour . Sehanine helped Vehlarr construct the Circle of Vehlarr , a magical gate into Myth Lharast , upon which work began in 712 DR . The attack on Myth Lharast was conducted in 720 DR but the defenders proved too strong . Selûne , to whom Myth Lharast was also partly dedicated , and who had become annoyed by the battle , completely destroyed the city . Some of this magical destruction fed back through the gate into the city of Vehlarr , destroying it too . Rumours . A myth exists that Vehlarr is still alive and he and the city of Myth Lharast were magically transported to another plane .

title: Vehlarr ( city )
description: Vehlarr ( city ) Vehlarr was a city named after its creator , the werewolf Vehlarr , who united the werewolf packs of the Wood of Sharp Teeth into a single nation . The city was the site of the Circle of Vehlarr , a magic portal into the city of Myth Lharast , until the deity Selûne destroyed both cities in 720 DR , after being angered by the warfare between them . Rumours .
description_long: Vehlarr ( city ) Vehlarr was a city named after its creator , the werewolf Vehlarr , who united the werewolf packs of the Wood of Sharp Teeth into a single nation . The city was the site of the Circle of Vehlarr , a magic portal into the city of Myth Lharast , until the deity Selûne destroyed both cities in 720 DR , after being angered by the warfare between them . Rumours . It is rumoured that Vehlarr was not destroyed and still exists on another ageless plane . On nights of a full moon , the city is supposed to return to Abeir - Toril and it supposedly accessible through the Circle of Vehlarr . The rumour has never been substantiated .

title: Vekkak
description: Vekkak Vekkak was an Iulutiun village on the shore of Lake Risuak . Its claim to fame was that its " iquemelum " ( council of elders ) was particularly adept at predicting the weather . Geography .
description_long: Vekkak Vekkak was an Iulutiun village on the shore of Lake Risuak . Its claim to fame was that its " iquemelum " ( council of elders ) was particularly adept at predicting the weather . Geography . Vekkak was found in Alpuk , northwest of the Lugalpgotak Sea and north of the village of Gotokok .

title: Vel ' Nikeryma
description: Vel ' Nikeryma The Vel ' Nikeryma ( or Blade Lords ) was the organization that acted as the guiding council for the Eldreth Veluuthra . Its purpose was to gather information from across Faerûn in order to dictate the direction of the Eldreth Veluuthra but , in general , they avoided intervention in individual cells ' matters . Organization .
description_long: Vel ' Nikeryma The Vel ' Nikeryma ( or Blade Lords ) was the organization that acted as the guiding council for the Eldreth Veluuthra . Its purpose was to gather information from across Faerûn in order to dictate the direction of the Eldreth Veluuthra but , in general , they avoided intervention in individual cells ' matters . Organization . Although the organization was originally led by members of its five founding families , as of 1374 DR , this was no longer the case , and the leadership was determined by voting amongst its most powerful members . Recruitment . Recruitment into the Vel ' Nikeryma was through the Eldreth Veluuthra . An established member could apply to become an agent and be granted a sort of free - roaming status in Faerûn . An agent would be expected to gather information and pay a portion of his or her treasure to superiors , in exchange for knowledge of the organization ' s passcodes , handshakes and symbols . An agent would be able to seek supplies and shelter from a cell of the Eldreth Veluuthra , and only if the agent ' s stay exceeded a tenday or demands were very high could the cell ' s leader demand a task be carried out . Activities .

title: Veladar ' s vambrace
description: Veladar ' s vambrace Veladar ' s vambrace was an alteration spell that repaired , preserved , and strengthened inorganic materials . Effects . One item no bigger than the caster ' s body could be enchanted by this spell .
description_long: Veladar ' s vambrace Veladar ' s vambrace was an alteration spell that repaired , preserved , and strengthened inorganic materials . Effects . One item no bigger than the caster ' s body could be enchanted by this spell . The caster had to touch the object while casting . When the spell took effect , all minor flaws , fractures , weaknesses , and blemishes were eliminated , making the object look like new . Fragile materials were strengthened and tough materials were made tougher , giving the object much greater resistance to acid , cold , crushing blows , disintegration , falls , non - magical fire , and rot . Organic substances like glue could be present in the object , but if they made up more than ten percent of the total volume , the spell failed . Components . Verbal and somatic components were required to cast this spell as well as a diamond of at least 2 , 000 gp value , a piece of ironwood at least as big as the diamond , a similar - sized shard of chitin from a beholder , ankheg , or bulette , and a drop of giant slug spittle .

title: Velandilmur
description: Velandilmur Velandilmur was a port town of the kingdom of Gontal . Government . As of 1479 DR , the Docklord Lantra Orhond administered the town on behalf of Queen Imreera Hethkantan .
description_long: Velandilmur Velandilmur was a port town of the kingdom of Gontal . Government . As of 1479 DR , the Docklord Lantra Orhond administered the town on behalf of Queen Imreera Hethkantan . Background . Velandilmur was known for being a dangerous place for strangers . It was inhabited mostly by infirms , outcasts and outlaws .

title: Velantha Waerdar
description: Velantha Waerdar Velantha Waerdar was a cleric of Tymora in Yartar in 1370 DR . Activities . Velantha was the high priestess of the temple of Tymora in the city .
description_long: Velantha Waerdar Velantha Waerdar was a cleric of Tymora in Yartar in 1370 DR . Activities . Velantha was the high priestess of the temple of Tymora in the city . She was an amicable individual but secretly delighted in stirring up chaos , forcing others to trust in their luck , take chances , and otherwise unwittingly follow the way of the Lady . Velantha had many friends among adventurers .

title: Velarswood
description: Velarswood Velarswood ( also known as Velarwood ) was a wood near the centre of Harrowdale . Geography . The north of the wood contained a temple to Eilistraee , which was guarded by a number of drow .
description_long: Velarswood Velarswood ( also known as Velarwood ) was a wood near the centre of Harrowdale . Geography . The north of the wood contained a temple to Eilistraee , which was guarded by a number of drow . Inhabitants . In 1372 DR it was inhabited by bonebat s , cloaker s , stirge s , and troll s , as well as more formidable creatures . More than fifty Eilistraeeans lived and worshiped in Velarswood , both drow and other elves , in the Shadowtop Glade shrine . They often gathered in evensong in gratitude . They were creating a surface home there and generally had good relations with local humans , whom they aided when ill . There was also a number of werewolves in the area . Followers of Eilistraee often joined the moon - worshipping lycanthropes , and celebrate sacred hunts in honor of Eilistraee and Selûne alongside them . However , some of the Eilistraeeans were known to frequently hunt those lycanthropes that they considered to be abominations and dangerous for the inhabitants of the area . In fact , those Eilistraeeans hung the lycanthrope heads on a trophy tree .

title: Velartree
description: Velartree Velartree was a hamlet in Harrowdale , and marked the start of the Halfaxe Trail to the north west , and the Harrow Ride to the south east . As of 1374 DR , it consisted of a market paddock , an inn - and - tavern , a mill , a smith , and a small number of residences , including boarding for seasonal farm hands .
description_long: Velartree Velartree was a hamlet in Harrowdale , and marked the start of the Halfaxe Trail to the north west , and the Harrow Ride to the south east . As of 1374 DR , it consisted of a market paddock , an inn - and - tavern , a mill , a smith , and a small number of residences , including boarding for seasonal farm hands .

title: Velasta T ' sarran
description: Velasta T ' sarran Velasta T ' sarran was a female drow cleric of Kiaransalee and one of the twin nieces of Dorina T ' sarran . Description . A strongly built female drow , Velasta had a rounder face than most other drow .
description_long: Velasta T ' sarran Velasta T ' sarran was a female drow cleric of Kiaransalee and one of the twin nieces of Dorina T ' sarran . Description . A strongly built female drow , Velasta had a rounder face than most other drow . She wore darkened drow chainmail and wrapped herself in a large black cloak . A prominent symbol of Kiaransalee was often displayed around her neck . Velasta appeared identical in practically every way to her sister , Velina . Personality . Velasta T ' sarran was a drow of erratic moods , alternating between haughty and charming when dealing with others . However , she harbored nothing but contempt for her twin sister . Abilities . An experienced drow cleric and the niece of Dorina T ' sarran , Velasta had a solid command of divine magic and was able to cast spells like " flame strike " and " slay living " in defense of her deity . In addition to this , she could craft both magic al arms and armor , and magic wand s . Velasta , like her sister , was an adaptive combatant and could adjust her tactics effectively when given the opportunity or when prepared . Possessions .

title: Velathalar Muirdraevrel
description: Velathalar Muirdraevrel Velathalar Muirdraevrel was an elf warrior in Myth Drannor . History . In 1487 DR , during heavy fighting against Sembia n mercenaries , Velathalar met again Storm Silverhand , together with Arclath Delcastle and Amarune Whitewave .
description_long: Velathalar Muirdraevrel Velathalar Muirdraevrel was an elf warrior in Myth Drannor . History . In 1487 DR , during heavy fighting against Sembia n mercenaries , Velathalar met again Storm Silverhand , together with Arclath Delcastle and Amarune Whitewave . Storm and Velathalar started considering a retreat from the city . Soon after , the mercenaries managed to break the wall , killing most of the defenders . Relationship . Velathalar was an acquaintance of Storm Silverhand .

title: Velcuthimmorhar
description: Velcuthimmorhar Velcuthimmorhar ( also known as Hephaestus ) was a red wyrm living in the mountains west of Mirabar , where he has resided for longer than even the dwarves can remember . The name " Hephaestus " was given to the dragon in reference to some obscure god of blacksmiths . He earned his considerable pay by melting ores for merchants .
description_long: Velcuthimmorhar Velcuthimmorhar ( also known as Hephaestus ) was a red wyrm living in the mountains west of Mirabar , where he has resided for longer than even the dwarves can remember . The name " Hephaestus " was given to the dragon in reference to some obscure god of blacksmiths . He earned his considerable pay by melting ores for merchants . The dragon was lazy , somewhat stupid and was overly proud . He describes himself as Destroyer of Cockleby , Devourer of Ten Thousand Cattle , He Who Crushed Anga Lander the Stupid Silver . He was able to speak the common tongue , but was not very perceptive when presented with duplicity . Drizzt Do ' Urden once passed by Hephaestus claiming to be Mergandevinasander of Chult ( an old black dragon known to Hephaestus ) and claimed that his lavender eyes , a trait shared between the two , proved it .

title: Veldyskar
description: Veldyskar Veldyskar was an intelligent basilisk living in Gravenhollow during the Rage of Demons . History . A stone giant visitor to Gravenhollow donated Veldyskar to the keepers of the library to act as a guardian and general - purpose helper untold years before .
description_long: Veldyskar Veldyskar was an intelligent basilisk living in Gravenhollow during the Rage of Demons . History . A stone giant visitor to Gravenhollow donated Veldyskar to the keepers of the library to act as a guardian and general - purpose helper untold years before . During the Rage of Demons , the basilisk met an expedition led by some adventurers , hired by Bruenor Battlehammer to investigate the threat of a demon lord , at the gate of Gravenhollow . Personality . Veldyskar ' s philosophy during fights was to petrify first and ask questions later . To avoid problems , the keepers taught him how to cast a " greater restoration " spell .

title: Velen
description: Velen Velen was a coastal city near Tethyr . It was a naval outpost , protecting against the Nelanther pirates . In addition , owing to its coastal location , it was also home to a large seafaring and fishing community .
description_long: Velen Velen was a coastal city near Tethyr . It was a naval outpost , protecting against the Nelanther pirates . In addition , owing to its coastal location , it was also home to a large seafaring and fishing community . Prior to 1424 DR , Velen was part of Tethyr but it broke away to become an independent duchy . It was rumored that ghost s haunted the city but the people appeared to be largely ignorant or uncaring concerning the hauntings .

title: Velgor Zolond
description: Velgor Zolond Velgor Zolond was a drow mage in Menzoberranzan during the Rage of Demons . History . During the Rage of Demons , Velgor was the second - in - command of Ryzliir Symryvvin in leading a drow battalion to intercept an expedition led by some adventurers hired by Bruenor Battlehammer to investigate the threat of a demon lord , but she and her troops were defeated .
description_long: Velgor Zolond Velgor Zolond was a drow mage in Menzoberranzan during the Rage of Demons . History . During the Rage of Demons , Velgor was the second - in - command of Ryzliir Symryvvin in leading a drow battalion to intercept an expedition led by some adventurers hired by Bruenor Battlehammer to investigate the threat of a demon lord , but she and her troops were defeated . Relationship . Velgor was the husband and the second - in - command of Ryzliir Symryvvin .

title: Velina T ' sarran
description: Velina T ' sarran Velina T ' sarran was a female drow cleric of Kiaransalee and one of the twin nieces of Dorina T ' sarran . Description . A strongly built female drow , Velina had a rounder face than most other drow .
description_long: Velina T ' sarran Velina T ' sarran was a female drow cleric of Kiaransalee and one of the twin nieces of Dorina T ' sarran . Description . A strongly built female drow , Velina had a rounder face than most other drow . She wore darkened drow chainmail and wrapped herself in a large black cloak . A prominent symbol of Kiaransalee was often displayed around her neck . Velina appeared identical in practically every way to her sister , Velasta . Personality . Velina T ' sarran was a drow of erratic moods , alternating between haughty and charming when dealing with others . However , she harbored nothing but contempt for her twin sister . Abilities . An experienced drow cleric and the niece of Dorina T ' sarran , Velina had a solid command of divine magic and was able to cast spells like " flame strike " and " slay living " in defense of her deity . In addition to this , she could craft both magic al arms and armor , and magic wand s . Velina , like her sister , was an adaptive combatant and could adjust her tactics effectively when effectively when given the opportunity or when prepared . Possessions .

title: Velkryst
description: Velkryst Velkryst was the house patron of House Baenre and the mate of matron mother Quenthel Baenre circa 1484 DR . History . The drow wizard was a former member of House Xorlarrin .
description_long: Velkryst Velkryst was the house patron of House Baenre and the mate of matron mother Quenthel Baenre circa 1484 DR . History . The drow wizard was a former member of House Xorlarrin . Circa 1400 DR , Quenthel chose him as her patron despite his family ' s objections . Over the years , they had five daughters and two sons but around 1484 DR , Velkryst feared for his life as Quenthel grew bored of his affections .

title: Velkynvelve
description: Velkynvelve Velkynvelve ( drow for " unseen knife " ) was a small drow outpost of the great city of Menzoberranzan , specifically used to collect slaves captured in various raids before taking them to the city as workers or sacrifices to Lolth . History . During the Rage of Demons , the commander of the outpost was Ilvara Mizzrym of House Mizzrym and her senior officials were Shoor Vandree and Asha Vandree of House Vandree and Jorlan Duskryn of House Duskryn .
description_long: Velkynvelve Velkynvelve ( drow for " unseen knife " ) was a small drow outpost of the great city of Menzoberranzan , specifically used to collect slaves captured in various raids before taking them to the city as workers or sacrifices to Lolth . History . During the Rage of Demons , the commander of the outpost was Ilvara Mizzrym of House Mizzrym and her senior officials were Shoor Vandree and Asha Vandree of House Vandree and Jorlan Duskryn of House Duskryn . At that time , there was a great escape of prisoners . Some months after the command was given to the wizard Servan Llarabbar

title: Velsharoon
description: Velsharoon Velsharoon ( pronounced " VEL - shah - roon " ) , the Archmage of Necromancy , was a god of necromancy . History . Velsharoon was once a lich wizard who , with the sponsorship of the deity Talos , managed to ascend to godhood .
description_long: Velsharoon Velsharoon ( pronounced " VEL - shah - roon " ) , the Archmage of Necromancy , was a god of necromancy . History . Velsharoon was once a lich wizard who , with the sponsorship of the deity Talos , managed to ascend to godhood . In 1425 DR , Velsharoon was engulfed in flames and died ; his corpse was eventually secured by the Aglarond ans . The Simbul was also believed to have died in the flames , but in fact survived and moved to the Dalelands . Relationships . Although he nominally served Azuth ( and through him , Mystra ) , Velsharoon re - established a secret alliance with Talos and a flirtatious relationship with Shar .

title: Veltalar
description: Veltalar Veltalar ( formerly Velprintalar ) was a settlement in Aglarond and the nation ' s primary port in 1479 DR , with a population of around seventy thousand . It was founded by human colonists from Chessenta in 756 DR . The population of Veltalar rose from around 35 , 000 in 1368 DR , to around 66 , 000 in 1374 DR , then around 70 , 000 by 1479 DR .
description_long: Veltalar Veltalar ( formerly Velprintalar ) was a settlement in Aglarond and the nation ' s primary port in 1479 DR , with a population of around seventy thousand . It was founded by human colonists from Chessenta in 756 DR . The population of Veltalar rose from around 35 , 000 in 1368 DR , to around 66 , 000 in 1374 DR , then around 70 , 000 by 1479 DR . The city did not have defensive walls . Port . As of 1368 DR , the city docks were equipped with cargo cranes and a limited drydock . The waterfront featured numerous small warehouses for this cargo . Nytus the Shipwright was a sailor who retired and made a name as a shipwright . In 1374 DR , Velprintalar was the only major port in Aglarond , with a large naval yard . It received trade via ship from Impiltur and Sembia . After peace had been established with Thay , Aglarond prospered , boosting trade in the city . Old Velprintalar . As of 1479 DR , the city moved towards the receded shoreline in relation to its previous location . The old city was renamed Old Velprintalar and became a slum . The settled land furthest away from the shore was on a steep slope , and the buildings were placed close together as a result .

title: Velvet Hands
description: Velvet Hands The Velvet Hands were a thieves ' guild in Hastarl in the ancient kingdom of Athalantar , formed by the thief Farl and his best friend , the young Elminster Aumar . History . In the years between 224 DR and 229 DR , Elminster , under the alias " Eladar the Dark " , and Farl were two of the most notorious thieves of Hastarl .
description_long: Velvet Hands The Velvet Hands were a thieves ' guild in Hastarl in the ancient kingdom of Athalantar , formed by the thief Farl and his best friend , the young Elminster Aumar . History . In the years between 224 DR and 229 DR , Elminster , under the alias " Eladar the Dark " , and Farl were two of the most notorious thieves of Hastarl . In 229 DR , however , a powerful thieves ' guild , called the Moonclaw , emerged . In response , Farl and El with some others , Jhardin , Rheagar , Chasarla , Tarth , Naneetha , and Tassabra , formed the gang dubbed the Velvet Hands in opposition . The name was inspired by the velvet hands of Naneetha . Soon after , however , El decided to leave the kingdom to fulfill his destiny and said goodbye to Farl . In the years after , the Velvet Hands prospered under the guidance of Farl , together with Tassabra . They also destroyed the Moonclaw , who were discovered to be servants of the magelord s . In 240 DR , the members of the Velvet Hands under Farl helped in Elminster ' s insurrection against the magelords .

title: Ven
description: Ven The Ven was the title of the ruler of the city of Tsurlagol in the Vast . The Ven was elected by the members of the Council , consisting of Tsurlagol ' s highest noble s and leading merchant lords , from among their number . Each Ven served for a 10 - year term , in which their word was law , though unpopular Ven tended to die prematurely .
description_long: Ven The Ven was the title of the ruler of the city of Tsurlagol in the Vast . The Ven was elected by the members of the Council , consisting of Tsurlagol ' s highest noble s and leading merchant lords , from among their number . Each Ven served for a 10 - year term , in which their word was law , though unpopular Ven tended to die prematurely . Strangely , the true identity of the Ven was kept secret throughout their reign ; it was an odd arrangement but apparently worked well for Tsurlagol . The spokesperson of the Ven was the Ven ' s Voice , who served as their chief advisor and announced the Ven ' s decrees to the people of Tsurlagol . However , the Voice was often more powerful than the Ven .

title: Ven ' s Voice
description: Ven ' s Voice The Ven ' s Voice was the title of the chief advisor and spokesperson of the city of Tsurlagol in the Vast . The Ven ' s Voice was elected by the members of the Council , consisting of Tsurlagol ' s highest noble s and leading merchant lords , from among their number . The Voice served as a spokesperson both for the Council and for the Ven , the secret ruler of the city .
description_long: Ven ' s Voice The Ven ' s Voice was the title of the chief advisor and spokesperson of the city of Tsurlagol in the Vast . The Ven ' s Voice was elected by the members of the Council , consisting of Tsurlagol ' s highest noble s and leading merchant lords , from among their number . The Voice served as a spokesperson both for the Council and for the Ven , the secret ruler of the city . The Voice was also chief advisor to the Ven and announced the Ven ' s decrees to the people of Tsurlagol . As such , in many ways , the Voice could often be more powerful than the Ven themself . This position was not a secret one . By 1367 DR until 1370 DR and after , the Ven ' s Voice was the ambitious Conoptora Billon .

title: Venali Starym
description: Venali Starym Lord Venali Starym was clan heir of the Starym clan , holding the post while the proper heir , Josidiah Starym had left on a quest to find the lost Warblade of Cormanthyr ( Josidiah was gone from 500 DR until 674 DR ) . He later served on the Council of Twelve as a House Lord of the clan . Venali was the first son of Illitran Starym , who made a pact with Moander in order to fool the family Moonblade in 523 DR .
description_long: Venali Starym Lord Venali Starym was clan heir of the Starym clan , holding the post while the proper heir , Josidiah Starym had left on a quest to find the lost Warblade of Cormanthyr ( Josidiah was gone from 500 DR until 674 DR ) . He later served on the Council of Twelve as a House Lord of the clan . Venali was the first son of Illitran Starym , who made a pact with Moander in order to fool the family Moonblade in 523 DR . When Illitran passed and Venali became House Lord , he took up the Moonblade , and wielded it for many years . During the Weeping War , he used the blade to teleport to safety when he was discovered by fiends in his family crypt , protecting his wealth . His cowardice and self - preservation abilities were imbued in the Moonblade . After the war , Venali removed to the Hullack Forest with his kin , where he died of a strange wasting disease , passing on the blade to his niece , Seldanna . Referential Discrepencies . Venali ' s level is described as Fighter 13 in , while in the The Fall of Myth Drannor ( sourcebook ) , he is Fighter 11 . It could be possible that he somehow lost his levels , though how is not specified .

title: Vendariiq Memtyn
description: Vendariiq Memtyn Vendariiq Memtyn was a leading member of the derro Council of Savants and the " high priest " of Diirinka in Gracklstugh in 1370 DR . Personality . Despite his role as the main caretaker of the worship of Diirinka , Vendariiq had little interest in preaching .
description_long: Vendariiq Memtyn Vendariiq Memtyn was a leading member of the derro Council of Savants and the " high priest " of Diirinka in Gracklstugh in 1370 DR . Personality . Despite his role as the main caretaker of the worship of Diirinka , Vendariiq had little interest in preaching . He preferred to scheme with his fellow savants . His areas of expertise were the magical legacies of the elves of the High Forest , the human s of Ascalhorn , and the legendary wyrm s of the North . History . Vendariiq was a prominent member of the faction of savants , and he led the derro in the worship of Diirinka by tending the god ' s shrine . He was interested in the fall of Hellgate Keep and the opportunity that this provided , sending many expeditions to scavenge its catacombs .

title: Vendes Baenre
description: Vendes Baenre Vendes Baenre , also named Duk - Tak , a name meaning " Unholy Executioner " , was one of Yvonnel Baenre ' s daughters and also a priestess of Lolth . She was master tormentress of the Baenre compound ; her nickname was because of this " job " . History .
description_long: Vendes Baenre Vendes Baenre , also named Duk - Tak , a name meaning " Unholy Executioner " , was one of Yvonnel Baenre ' s daughters and also a priestess of Lolth . She was master tormentress of the Baenre compound ; her nickname was because of this " job " . History . Vendes Baenre tortured Drizzt when he returned to Menzoberranzan and was captured by House Baenre . Later , she was killed by Drizzt when Cattie - brie and Artemis Entreri rescued him from the Baenre compound in 1357 DR . Personality & Activities . Vendes was so uncontrollably volatile that Matron Baenre did not gave her a room in the highest tier of the Baenre stalagmite . However , the old Matron Baenre had some use for her daughter . If there was a problem with a lower ranking drow , she sent Vendes to mete out her punishment . Vendes wielded a seven - headed " whip of fangs " that transformed the skin of the victims into ebony . The old Matron deposited the resulting statues in a room for future sale . She let her daughter also punish priestesses in Arach - Tinilith . If a would - be priestess was seen , or even thought to be , deviating from the Way of Lolth , Vendes came into action .

title: Venerator Creed
description: Venerator Creed The Venerator Creed was one of the major illithid Creed s in the Realms . They were the priests of Ilsensine . Bases .
description_long: Venerator Creed The Venerator Creed was one of the major illithid Creed s in the Realms . They were the priests of Ilsensine . Bases . The Venerators had temples called the Shrines of the Great Brain in Oryndoll . In the city , the tenets of the Venerator Creed and the Loretaker Creed dominated every aspect of life . Dissent was tolerated though rarely shown . This Creed believed that the Flowstone Tapestry was a manifestation of Ilsensine ' s thought processes . They were closely aligned with the Abysmal Creed . History . The Venerator Creed in Oryndoll was founded soon after the duergar uprising in - 4000 DR . This happened as a result of Ilsensine appearing to restore order to the city . Ilsensine allowed Venerators to join with the Elder Brain in death , so the Creed flourished . By 1370 DR , the Venerators were the most powerful Creed in Oryndoll , with the Loretaker Creed close behind them . The Creedmaster of the Venerators , Cephalossk , had assumed a prominent position on the Elder Concord , even above the Encephalithid .

title: Vengeance domain
description: Vengeance domain The Fiery force that is vengeance fuels a lot different individuals , and the deities of the vengeance domain both love to use it . vengeance is worthwhile if it is given in equal or greater suffering in reciprocation and it should be the only response according to Loviatar . Even the slightest insult against the spiteful queen of dragons Tiamat , her vain and pride will bring down the fury and wrath of her devoted worshipers .
description_long: Vengeance domain The Fiery force that is vengeance fuels a lot different individuals , and the deities of the vengeance domain both love to use it . vengeance is worthwhile if it is given in equal or greater suffering in reciprocation and it should be the only response according to Loviatar . Even the slightest insult against the spiteful queen of dragons Tiamat , her vain and pride will bring down the fury and wrath of her devoted worshipers . Power of Vengeance Domain . Any divine caster that worships a deity who claims the vengeance domain may choose to channel the deities powers within the domain , and when the caster choses the domain she will become more intimidating . When a power that uses the vengeance domain is hit on an enemy , his next strike against the caster or any of her allies will damage the enemy . And as her power increases so does the damage that the enemy will inflict on him self . < br > The Powers of the change Domain are : < br > Astral seal < br > Avenging light < br > Holy strike < br > Radiant vengeance < br > Small vengeance divinity .

title: Vengeance knight
description: Vengeance knight The Vengeance Knights are an elite group of fighters who have pledged to serve the Knights of the Shield , a group of politicians and merchants with considerable influence in many governments along the Sword Coast . The Knight ' s purpose is to force the organizations enemies into compliance . Vengeance Knights prefer to wear heavy plated armor .
description_long: Vengeance knight The Vengeance Knights are an elite group of fighters who have pledged to serve the Knights of the Shield , a group of politicians and merchants with considerable influence in many governments along the Sword Coast . The Knight ' s purpose is to force the organizations enemies into compliance . Vengeance Knights prefer to wear heavy plated armor . They usually also wear a full helm or just cover their armor with symbols . Fighters , Blackguard s , and ex - Paladins ( with their heavy armor ) , are usually recruited to become Vengeance Knights .

title: Vengeance of the Iron Dwarf
description: Vengeance of the Iron Dwarf Vengeance of the Iron Dwarf is the third and final book of the Companions Codex series by R . A . Salvatore .
description_long: Vengeance of the Iron Dwarf Vengeance of the Iron Dwarf is the third and final book of the Companions Codex series by R . A . Salvatore . Summary . The story of the War of the Silver Marches continues with the three dwarven strongholds — Mithral Hall , Citadel Felbarr , and Citadel Adbar — under siege and the cities of Nesmé and Sundabar ( renamed " Hartusk Keep " ) already captured by the forces of the Many - Arrows , aided by frost giants and a number of drow from Menzoberranzan and Q ' Xorlarrin . King Connerad Brawnanvil of Mithral Hall , along with Drizzt Do ' Urden , Bruenor Battlehammer , Catti - brie , and Athrogate have arrived at Citadel Felbarr to discuss the dwarven kingdoms ' next steps . Bruenor , known to the other dwarves as Reginald Roundshield , reveals himself to be the once - king of Mithral Hall reborn . The dwarves and their guests celebrate Bruenor ' s return before the remaining Companions of the Hall and Athrogate return to Mithral Hall . In the Underdark , Regis and Wulfgar , who were separated from their friends at the underground gates of Mithral Hall , are surviving but unable to return to their friends due to the hordes of orcs every which way .

title: Ventriloquism
description: Ventriloquism Ventriloquism ( originally called Dace ' s ventriloquism ) was an illusion spell from the subschool that allowed one to throw his or her voice . Some creatures , such as slayer genie s and dazzles could innately create this magical effect . Effects .
description_long: Ventriloquism Ventriloquism ( originally called Dace ' s ventriloquism ) was an illusion spell from the subschool that allowed one to throw his or her voice . Some creatures , such as slayer genie s and dazzles could innately create this magical effect . Effects . By speaking into a cone made from rolled - up parchment , the caster could throw his or her voice within a relatively close range , making it sound as if it had come from someone or somewhere else . Notable Users . The Zakharan potion merchant Bahija Jalin was able to brew a mixture imbued with the power of the " ventriloquism " spell , yet she rarely sold it . Components . To cast this spell required a verbal component in addition the parchment used as its focus . History . The spell was invented by the Netherese arcanist Dace in −1859 DR .

title: Venzentilax
description: Venzentilax Venzentilax was a blue dragon living in Threskel . She was a loyal servant of Alasklerbanbastos . Description .
description_long: Venzentilax Venzentilax was a blue dragon living in Threskel . She was a loyal servant of Alasklerbanbastos . Description . Venzentilax had an unusually long beard of bladelike scales beneath her chin , and her horn lacked a secondary point . History . Venzentilax took part on Alasklerbanbastos ' s invasion to Soolabax . She faced Tchazzar , who killed her effortlessly .

title: Veperyd
description: Veperyd Veperyd was one of the fire giant lieutenants of Queen Hledh Hellspawn , who ruled the city of Maerimydra in the Deep Wastes . History . During the Rage of Demons , Veperyd was in charge of the security of Coliseum with four bar - lgura guards until an adventuring party hired by Solom Ned ' razak to collect samples of fiendish fire giant bloods confronted and defeated him and his minions .
description_long: Veperyd Veperyd was one of the fire giant lieutenants of Queen Hledh Hellspawn , who ruled the city of Maerimydra in the Deep Wastes . History . During the Rage of Demons , Veperyd was in charge of the security of Coliseum with four bar - lgura guards until an adventuring party hired by Solom Ned ' razak to collect samples of fiendish fire giant bloods confronted and defeated him and his minions . Personality . Veperyd enjoyed the power of his position and did anything to keep control of the fighting in the Coliseum .

title: Verbal component
description: Verbal component The verbal component was a basic part of spellcasting . Most spells required the caster to complete a spoken incantation in a clear , powerful voice . Being gagged or magically silence d prevent one from casting such a spell .
description_long: Verbal component The verbal component was a basic part of spellcasting . Most spells required the caster to complete a spoken incantation in a clear , powerful voice . Being gagged or magically silence d prevent one from casting such a spell . The spoken words of arcane spells somehow affected the Weave directly , while those spoken by divine magic casters were expressions of faith in their deities .

title: Verbeeg
description: Verbeeg Verbeegs were giant - kin and were also sometimes known as human behemoths because they resembled human s more than any other giant race . Verbeeg were accomplished spear fighters . Personality .
description_long: Verbeeg Verbeegs were giant - kin and were also sometimes known as human behemoths because they resembled human s more than any other giant race . Verbeeg were accomplished spear fighters . Personality . A verbeeg was usually chaotic neutral or chaotic evil . They were typically smarter than most other types of giants , and were often found leading or bullying hill giant s and ogre s . They used their extreme cunning to their advantage where possible . Society . The treacherous nature of verbeegs made such treachery the primary skill where the ordning was concerned . To advance in ranks , a verbeeg had to discredit or defeat a superior , by violence or any other means . Verbeegs had no concept of ownership and believed that everything was owned by everyone , so they took whatever they wanted without pause to think about it . Religion . Verbeeg primarily worshiped the god Karontor . History . The verbeeg race was created when Othea , wife of the giant deity Annam All - Father , had an affair with Ulutiu .

title: Verblen
description: Verblen Verblen was the Slave Lord of Zhentil Keep and an important member of the Zhentarim . History . Verblen grew up on the streets of Zhentil Keep , always in fear of the slavers that wandered the keep at nights .
description_long: Verblen Verblen was the Slave Lord of Zhentil Keep and an important member of the Zhentarim . History . Verblen grew up on the streets of Zhentil Keep , always in fear of the slavers that wandered the keep at nights . Soon , Verblen decided that the best option for him was to join the slavers and quickly rose through the ranks . He was , by 1370 DR , one of the most trusted agents of the previous Slave Lord , Marsh Belwintle Afterward , he replaced Marsh as Slave Lord . Personality . Verblen loved his work and was a loyal supporter of Fzoul Chembryl . However , although he was devoted to Bane like all in the modern Zhentarim , he also worshiped Loviatar . The goddess was more suited to his depraved and vicious nature . He sometimes wished his job was less administrative .

title: Verdant lord
description: Verdant lord Verdant Lord is a special class on Faerûn . Its members are people who have dedicated their lives to the understanding and well - being of all plant life . Being skilled in herbalism and wilderness lore , most verdant lords live apart from civilization , often within very lush groves .
description_long: Verdant lord Verdant Lord is a special class on Faerûn . Its members are people who have dedicated their lives to the understanding and well - being of all plant life . Being skilled in herbalism and wilderness lore , most verdant lords live apart from civilization , often within very lush groves . Verdant lords are generally patient and retiring in nature ; however , if somebody threatens plants or carelessly waves fire around they become enraged very quickly . of them travel , but those who do , tend to do so in the company of treant s . Verdant lords are almost always elven or half - elven druid s , as their long lifespan allows them to appreciate the trees and forests they care for . Occasionally , a druid of another race or a ranger may follow this calling , along with cleric s of either of one of the nature deities . Other people tend to lack the knowledge of plant life and commitment to nature required of a verdant lord . See Also . The Order of the Verdant Grove is an association of druids and verdant lords who share information about nature with each other .

title: Veren Drakewell
description: Veren Drakewell Veren Drakewell was a member of the Brotherhood of the Cloak in Mulmaster and secretly a member of the Cult of the Howling Hatred . Activities . Veren was a low - ranking Cloak who also ran a shop in the city .
description_long: Veren Drakewell Veren Drakewell was a member of the Brotherhood of the Cloak in Mulmaster and secretly a member of the Cult of the Howling Hatred . Activities . Veren was a low - ranking Cloak who also ran a shop in the city . Secretly , however , he spied on the Cloaks under the orders of his cultist masters . History . In 1491 DR , Zel Tregarthen ' s section discovered his true loyalties and raided his shop .

title: Vergadain
description: Vergadain Vergadain , also known as The Laughing Dwarf by non - dwarves , is the neutral dwarven deity of luck , trickery , negotiation and wealth and an exarch of Moradin . While it seems that Vergadain represents the dwarves ' well - known dedication to the mercantile art of bargaining , those who know better are aware that he has an aspect that fills even the more legal - minded dwarves with pride . As such Vergadain also watches over those dwarves who use less - than - legal means to gain wealth .
description_long: Vergadain Vergadain , also known as The Laughing Dwarf by non - dwarves , is the neutral dwarven deity of luck , trickery , negotiation and wealth and an exarch of Moradin . While it seems that Vergadain represents the dwarves ' well - known dedication to the mercantile art of bargaining , those who know better are aware that he has an aspect that fills even the more legal - minded dwarves with pride . As such Vergadain also watches over those dwarves who use less - than - legal means to gain wealth . Regardless of how he is viewed , Vergadain delights in the art of the deal , no matter what it is , so long as it turns a profit . Worshipers . Few admit to following Vergadain in knowledgeable society , but those who do are known as Hurndor or " those who trade " . The Hurndor are dedicated to furthering dwarven commerce , traveling Faerûn farther than the priests of any member of the Morndinsamman with the exception of Marthammor Duin . Cleric s of Vergadain are expected to be personally wealthy , while also ensuring that some of their wealth is dedicated to keeping the local temple filled with treasure .

title: Veridon
description: Veridon Veridon was a Netherese man and an arcanist . He was the ruler of the enclave of Lathery . History .
description_long: Veridon Veridon was a Netherese man and an arcanist . He was the ruler of the enclave of Lathery . History . Veridon elevated the city of Lathery to enclave status in 3357 NY ( −502 DR ) . Lathery fished the Narrow Sea by using its mythallar to " teleport " fish ( and anything else ) that passed under the enclave into special cold storage chambers . By 3400 NY ( −459 DR ) , Veridon had improved upon Lathery ' s fishing mythallar such that it could distinguish between certain creatures and send some to different holding tanks . In 3415 NY ( −444 DR ) , Veridon developed the spell " Veridon ' s storm " , which was then used to refrigerate the storage chambers . In 3426 NY ( −433 DR ) , the ancient white dragon Wintercloak flew under the city and found itself teleported into one of the cold storage chambers . It tore itself free and broke out into the city streets , but was confronted by Veridon and the city ' s arcanist s . Veridon and a dozen others were killed by the dragon ' s icy breath , before it was slain by the survivors . Powers . Veridon was a mage who developed a number of spells based around cold and fog .

title: Verik
description: Verik Verik was a member of the Cult of the Dragon in the Moonsea in 1489 DR . Personality . Verik was a very good liar and spy .
description_long: Verik Verik was a member of the Cult of the Dragon in the Moonsea in 1489 DR . Personality . Verik was a very good liar and spy . History . Verik was part of a Cult traditionalist faction under the wizard Ixan . In 1489 DR , he was sent to a small village on a isle not too far from Phlan , where a great fiend ish power was hidden . He infiltrated the village while acting as a madman . He also befriended Elisande . When an adventuring party arrived in the village , to investigate rumors of dracolich es and ghost ships , they may have discovered and killed him .

title: Veris
description: Veris Veris was a Cyric - worshiping pirate on the Moonsea in 1367 DR . Description . Veris was a one - eyed , bald , and scarred man .
description_long: Veris Veris was a Cyric - worshiping pirate on the Moonsea in 1367 DR . Description . Veris was a one - eyed , bald , and scarred man . Personality . Veris was a cruel man ; he enjoyed playing deadly jokes on his victims . His favorite joke was to take all crew and passengers from a captured vessel while his men looted it , before allowing them to board again and leave . However , once they were back on board , Veris ordered his men to shoot the ship with flaming arrows and then pick the people off as they escaped the burning ship . Needless to say , they were skilled archers . History . Veris was a devotee of Cyric who remained loyal to Zhentil Keep . At some point , he went into piracy and became quite notorious for his actions . His ship was the " Purple Star " .

title: Vermin keeper
description: Vermin keeper A Vermin Keeper is a prestige class of the Underdark . Whether formerly from the Realms of Above ( as the lands of Faerûn are called in the Underdark ) or life long denizens of the dark places , Vermin Keepers have mastered the control of vermin creatures . Insects , spiders , scorpions , worms all are subject to the orders of the Vermin Keeper .
description_long: Vermin keeper A Vermin Keeper is a prestige class of the Underdark . Whether formerly from the Realms of Above ( as the lands of Faerûn are called in the Underdark ) or life long denizens of the dark places , Vermin Keepers have mastered the control of vermin creatures . Insects , spiders , scorpions , worms all are subject to the orders of the Vermin Keeper . Unlike the Arachnomancer , Vermin Keepers do not necessarily worship or even enjoy the presence of vermin ; mastery of what one fears drives a number of these druidic spellcasters to this discipline .

title: Verner
description: Verner Verner was a halfling youth from the Moonsea . History . Verner lived with nine other non - human children in Madame Delilah ' s Home for Orphaned Children in Hillsfar until First Lord Torin Nomerthal proclaimed again the Great Law of Humanity , expelling all non - humans .
description_long: Verner Verner was a halfling youth from the Moonsea . History . Verner lived with nine other non - human children in Madame Delilah ' s Home for Orphaned Children in Hillsfar until First Lord Torin Nomerthal proclaimed again the Great Law of Humanity , expelling all non - humans . Luckily , Verner and the others were housed by Ebenz Farbough and Bea Farbough , two farmers without children , in a farmhouse near the city . Verner lived there for two years until the Rage of Demons , developing a bond with the goat Jovee . At that time , Jovee was in an unusual state . Some adventurers who happened to near the farmhouse were asked to help but Jovee give birth to demon ic goats .

title: Veron Angalen
description: Veron Angalen Veron Angalen is a half - orc bounty hunter , originally from Silverymoon . Unlike many half - orcs who are the result of a non - consensual union between a human female and a male orc , Veron ' s orcish mother and human father were married and loved each other . In 1478 DR , Veron accepted a commision to track down a supposedly mad woman named Clytemorrenestrix ( Nestrix ) who had killed a wizard in Cormyr .
description_long: Veron Angalen Veron Angalen is a half - orc bounty hunter , originally from Silverymoon . Unlike many half - orcs who are the result of a non - consensual union between a human female and a male orc , Veron ' s orcish mother and human father were married and loved each other . In 1478 DR , Veron accepted a commision to track down a supposedly mad woman named Clytemorrenestrix ( Nestrix ) who had killed a wizard in Cormyr . He tracked her to Waterdeep and while atttempting to apprehend her , became caught up in a plot by a Green dragon ( Andareunarthex ) to steal magic items that would allow him to bypass Waterdeep ' s dragon ward . Veron helped rescue Nestrix , who was really a Blue dragon plaguechanged into a human woman , from Andareunarthex . Later , he helped to defeat the green and drive him from Waterdeep .

title: Verthandantalynx
description: Verthandantalynx Verthandantalynx was a green dragon living in the forest of Cormanthor , to the west of the ruins of Myth Drannor . Also called Verdant Cloud , this green wyrm lived 80 miles due west of Myth Drannor , and was worshipped by the population of Trenahess , a nearby village of human s on the east bank of the River Ashaba . The villagers offered up visitors and valuables to " Little Verthie " , who defended them from monsters and other communities .
description_long: Verthandantalynx Verthandantalynx was a green dragon living in the forest of Cormanthor , to the west of the ruins of Myth Drannor . Also called Verdant Cloud , this green wyrm lived 80 miles due west of Myth Drannor , and was worshipped by the population of Trenahess , a nearby village of human s on the east bank of the River Ashaba . The villagers offered up visitors and valuables to " Little Verthie " , who defended them from monsters and other communities . On Uktar 13 , 1373 DR , Verthandantalynx fell victim to the Rage of Dragons and attacked and laid to waste the village of Trenahess .

title: Verthisathurgiesh Anala
description: Verthisathurgiesh Anala Verthisathurgiesh Anala was the dragonborn matriarch of Clan Verthisathurgiesh in 1486 DR . Description . Anala was lithe and loose - limbed , with damp brick - colored scales and black plumes hanging neatly to her shoulders .
description_long: Verthisathurgiesh Anala Verthisathurgiesh Anala was the dragonborn matriarch of Clan Verthisathurgiesh in 1486 DR . Description . Anala was lithe and loose - limbed , with damp brick - colored scales and black plumes hanging neatly to her shoulders . History . In 1486 DR , Anala invited her nephew Mehen to Djerad Thymar in hopes to convince him to rejoining the clan . However , her third son , Baruz , was found dead the same day Mehen reached the city . Anala hired Mehen to help her uncover the assassin of her son .

title: Vesarius
description: Vesarius Vesarius was a cornugon lieutenant in Dragonspear Castle circa 1363 DR . History . In the past , Vesarius made a bargain with the ancient black dragon Maelestor Rex .
description_long: Vesarius Vesarius was a cornugon lieutenant in Dragonspear Castle circa 1363 DR . History . In the past , Vesarius made a bargain with the ancient black dragon Maelestor Rex . In 1363 DR , Vesarius led one of the Hordes of Dragonspear , specifically the Storm , a group composed of 100 bugbear s and 100 ogre s , plus Maelestor Rex . Personality . Vesarius was a very brutal commander and believed Vooka and Vrag to be worthless inferiors .

title: Vescaras Ammakyl
description: Vescaras Ammakyl Vescaras Ammakyl was a half - elf Harper agent . Activities . Vescaras was a noble of Waterdeep .
description_long: Vescaras Ammakyl Vescaras Ammakyl was a half - elf Harper agent . Activities . Vescaras was a noble of Waterdeep . He used his position in House Ammakyl ' s business to run a network of spies . History . In 1486 DR , Vescaras discovered from one of his spies a smuggling ring trafficking gems , weapons , and people from Vaasa to Sembia . He and his fellow Khochen went on a mission to Westgate to collect clues about it . During the mission , they destroyed a caravan of shadovar trading with drow in the Dalelands . Afterward , they went to Waterdeep to make a report to Dahl Peredur and Tam Zawad . Later he and Khochen were choose to help , and survey , Mehen in the research of the missing Farideh , that Vescaras believed to be a shadovar agent . Relationships . Vescaras had a secret sexual affair with Khochen . He disliked Dahl for flirting with his sister Jadzia Ammakyl .

title: Veserab
description: Veserab A veserab was a large , worm - like creature with bat wings and a large leech - like maw lined with teeth . Combat . They could also and spew a highly corrosive acid in battle .
description_long: Veserab A veserab was a large , worm - like creature with bat wings and a large leech - like maw lined with teeth . Combat . They could also and spew a highly corrosive acid in battle . Ecology . The monster was used as a mount by shadovar soldiers . They bonded to a rider and were fiercely loyal to that rider , as long as they lived . These creatures could travel long distances hunting and feeding on the wing .

title: Vesilde Gaerth
description: Vesilde Gaerth Vesilde Gaerth is a sun elf Knight - Commander of the Golden Star . He personally led over 500 elves in aid of Seiveril Miritar ' s cause against the daemonfey threat to the elves of Faerûn in early 1374 DR . Description .
description_long: Vesilde Gaerth Vesilde Gaerth is a sun elf Knight - Commander of the Golden Star . He personally led over 500 elves in aid of Seiveril Miritar ' s cause against the daemonfey threat to the elves of Faerûn in early 1374 DR . Description . Vesilde is short and wiry . Possessions . In combat , Vesilde wears golden plate armor with a helmet .

title: Vesperin
description: Vesperin Vesperin was a human country in the land of the Vast in the 15th century , comprising the cities of Calaunt , Ravens Bluff , and Tantras . History . In 1370 DR , Ravens Bluff proposed the formation of a regional government in the Vast .
description_long: Vesperin Vesperin was a human country in the land of the Vast in the 15th century , comprising the cities of Calaunt , Ravens Bluff , and Tantras . History . In 1370 DR , Ravens Bluff proposed the formation of a regional government in the Vast . It started by taking neighboring settlements under its control , such as Mossbridges and New Hope , and thus turned Ravens Bluff into a city - state . Procampur remained neutral on the plan , preferring to wait - and - see , while Tantras strongly rejected the proposal . Local lords were unwilling to place themselves under civic authority , while others disliked being annexed , but merchants and many ordinary folk felt it would only improve prosperity of the Vast . Vesperin was founded when the formerly independent city - states of Calaunt , Ravens Bluff , and Tantras united to form a single state . When the second Netheril took over Sembia around 1400 DR , many Sembian merchants migrated to Vesperin . The majority of them settled in Ravens Bluff , making it the largest city in the nation . The Netherese rulers eventually cracked down on Sembian migration , killing would - be refugees who tried to cross to the Vast .

title: Vesryn Aelorothi
description: Vesryn Aelorothi Vesryn Aelorothi was a male fey ' ri sorcerer of House Aelorothi and a member of the daemonfey . Equipment . Vesryn carried a magical " + 1 longsword " , " + 1 elven chain " , 2 " potion s of cure moderate wounds " , a " potion of neutralize poison " , a " scroll of flashburst " , a " scroll of lesser ironguard " , a " ring of counterspells " ( " magic missile " ) , a " wand of Melf ' s acid arrow " , 2 waterstar s ( 500 gp each ) , and a leather scroll case containing a hand - drawn map of the North .
description_long: Vesryn Aelorothi Vesryn Aelorothi was a male fey ' ri sorcerer of House Aelorothi and a member of the daemonfey . Equipment . Vesryn carried a magical " + 1 longsword " , " + 1 elven chain " , 2 " potion s of cure moderate wounds " , a " potion of neutralize poison " , a " scroll of flashburst " , a " scroll of lesser ironguard " , a " ring of counterspells " ( " magic missile " ) , a " wand of Melf ' s acid arrow " , 2 waterstar s ( 500 gp each ) , and a leather scroll case containing a hand - drawn map of the North . History . After the death of Nurthel Floshin in 1374 DR , the daemonfey leader Sarya Dlardrageth promoted Vesryn as her new spymaster , thanks to his knowledge about modern Faerun . After losing the Cormanthor War , he , alongside most of the remaining fey ' ri , tried to escape inside the Waymeet but at last was killed in the fighting . Personality . Vesryn possessed gracious and courteous manners but also exquisite cruelties .

title: Vestress
description: Vestress Vestress was a rogue illithid serving as the Regent of Ascarle in 1361 DR . Description . Vestress dressed elegantly , with amethyst rings , lavender robes , and a silver circlet on her head .
description_long: Vestress Vestress was a rogue illithid serving as the Regent of Ascarle in 1361 DR . Description . Vestress dressed elegantly , with amethyst rings , lavender robes , and a silver circlet on her head . Her greatest hobby was weaving , and she could capture a person ' s soul and weave it into a tapestry , which she did to a number of sea elves . Allies . Vestress was part of the Kraken Society . She had an army with a core of 100 merrow under her command . History . Vestress was a mind flayer living in Gauntlgrym in 1278 DR when agents of the Kraken Society discovered the dwarven city and the illithid community living there . While trying to loot the city , they damaged the elder brain and escaped with Vestress as a captive . The Society later managed to brainwash Vestress into working for them . In 1361 DR , Vestress served as the nominal Regent of Ascarle , claiming to rule on behalf of a kraken . Vestress was a rogue illithid who had taken the city from the hands of a drow banshee , whom she banished to Inthar on Ruathym via a portal . She desired to conquer Ruathym , but the banshee made that impossible , so she plotted to have the banshee destroyed by Liriel Baenre .

title: Vesvur Alder
description: Vesvur Alder Vesvur Alder was an agent of the Harpers who operated out of Mulmaster . Activities . The bard frequently reported his findings within the city to Chesslyn Onaubra Relationships .
description_long: Vesvur Alder Vesvur Alder was an agent of the Harpers who operated out of Mulmaster . Activities . The bard frequently reported his findings within the city to Chesslyn Onaubra Relationships . Alder ' s wife was Dela , the owner of the Traveler ' s Cloak Inn which they ran together . She had no knowledge of his second life as one of " Those Who Harp " .

title: Veteran Guild of Ravens Bluff
description: Veteran Guild of Ravens Bluff The Veteran Guild of Ravens Bluff was a mercenary company based in Ravens Bluff and also active in the Sea of Fallen Stars and the Vast around 1358 DR . Organization . As well as infantry , cavalry , archers , and wizards , they also had a unit of priests and even a musical unit composed of ten bards to improve morale .
description_long: Veteran Guild of Ravens Bluff The Veteran Guild of Ravens Bluff was a mercenary company based in Ravens Bluff and also active in the Sea of Fallen Stars and the Vast around 1358 DR . Organization . As well as infantry , cavalry , archers , and wizards , they also had a unit of priests and even a musical unit composed of ten bards to improve morale . Contracts . They preferred work for governments or merchants , usually defeating pirates . They charged 1 gold piece per day for each member for their services . History . The Society had by 1358 DR been recently founded by Giovanni the Drake , who ' d gathered many veterans of the Horde Wars living around Ravens Bluff .

title: Vhaemas
description: Vhaemas Vhaemas was the merfolk king of Eadraal in Myth Nantar . History . Born in 1302 DR , Vhaemas ruled for 35 years of peace until the start of the Twelfth Serôs War when Prince Vhaemas the Bastard allied with Iakhovas .
description_long: Vhaemas Vhaemas was the merfolk king of Eadraal in Myth Nantar . History . Born in 1302 DR , Vhaemas ruled for 35 years of peace until the start of the Twelfth Serôs War when Prince Vhaemas the Bastard allied with Iakhovas . However , Iakhovas at last attacked Eadraal and King Vhaemas was forced to meet his son Vhaemas the Bastard in the battle . However , the two merfolk reconciled and together attacked Iakhovas , also helped by Princess Jian . They managed to destroy Iakhovas ' s trident but the monster killed the two younger merfolk and injured King Vhaemas . Vhaemas remained conscious long enough to order his people to retreat toward Myth Nantar and after choosing his son Mirol as heir ordered him to join the Nantarn Alliance and stop Iakhovas . After arriving in Myth Nantar , he slipped into a coma and remained unconscious with few signs of awakening .

title: Vhaemas the Bastard
description: Vhaemas the Bastard Vhaemas the Bastard was a renegade merfolk king during the Twelfth Serôs War . History . Vhaemas was born in 1320 DR to King Vhaemas and a merwoman of the outcast Kamaar clan .
description_long: Vhaemas the Bastard Vhaemas the Bastard was a renegade merfolk king during the Twelfth Serôs War . History . Vhaemas was born in 1320 DR to King Vhaemas and a merwoman of the outcast Kamaar clan . Abandoned by his father , he came to hate him . In Thuridru , he married twice , producing five children ready to fight against those merfolk who banished them . At the start of the Twelfth Serôs War , Vhaemas the Bastard allied with Iakhovas in order to conquer the ixitxachitl of the Xedran Reefs . However , Iakhovas attacked Eadraal and Vhaemas the Bastard was forced to meet King Vhaemas in battle . However , the two merfolk reconciled and attacked Iakhovas together , also helped by Princess Jian . They managed to destroy Iakhovas ' s trident but the monster killed the two younger merfolk and injured king Vhaemas . Personality . Vhaemas was always filled with hate . He grew into an angry and bitter individual .

title: Vhaerath
description: Vhaerath A vhaerath was a creature created by Vhaeraun from one of his petitioners . They were used by the deity as servants on Toril . Description .
description_long: Vhaerath A vhaerath was a creature created by Vhaeraun from one of his petitioners . They were used by the deity as servants on Toril . Description . A vhaerath always looked like a drow , with the difference of having a completely black body and equipment . A common vhaerath had basic skills with weapons . Abilities . Petitioners of any deity lost all of their memories and skills in life and even some of their innate abilities , like the drow ' s innate magical abilities . Vhaeraths were different . While they didn ' t have the standard qualities of a petitioner of the Demonweb Pits , what they had were their memories of their lives , skills aquired over their lives and their innate abilities as drow . They also had some added abilities in stealth from Vhaeraun . They were good at hiding and sneaking , and their abilities to hide increased when they were in shadow . Magic . A vhaerath could be intentionally called with the " summon monster II " spell by a person who was a divine caster of Vhaeraun who had read the notes about vhaeraths in the " Obsul Ssussun " .

title: Vhaeraun
description: Vhaeraun Vhaeraun ( Vay - " rawn " ) , also called the Masked Lord , the Masked God of Night , The Shadow , less frequently , the Masked Mage and the Lord of Shadow was the drow god of drow males , thievery , territory , shadow magic , spellfilcher s and evil activities on the surface , aimed to further drow goals , interests and power there . Vhaeraun was the son of Araushnee and Corellon Larethian . He held the unique view among drow that males and females were equally valuable , and was primarily prayed to by those drow males who sought a better life than slavery under Lolth ’ s matriarchy , and that opposed it .
description_long: Vhaeraun Vhaeraun ( Vay - " rawn " ) , also called the Masked Lord , the Masked God of Night , The Shadow , less frequently , the Masked Mage and the Lord of Shadow was the drow god of drow males , thievery , territory , shadow magic , spellfilcher s and evil activities on the surface , aimed to further drow goals , interests and power there . Vhaeraun was the son of Araushnee and Corellon Larethian . He held the unique view among drow that males and females were equally valuable , and was primarily prayed to by those drow males who sought a better life than slavery under Lolth ’ s matriarchy , and that opposed it . Description . As an avatar , Vhaeraun appeared either as a normal male drow . or as a handsome male drow , with a slim , graceful , and toned physique . He never used armor , but always wore a black ( or purple ) mask , and a long cloak of the same hue . His eyes and / or hair could change color to reflect his emotions ( red for anger , gold for triumph , blue for amusement , green for puzzlement and curiosity ) .

title: Vhaeraun ' s nightshield
description: Vhaeraun ' s nightshield Vhaeraun ' s nightshield was an abjuration spell contained in the " Obsul Ssussun " and associated with the drow god Vhaeraun . Effects . The spell created a protective aura that enhanced the physical resilience , reflexes , and willpower of the caster , and protected them from the " magic missile " spell in a manner similar to a " brooch of shielding ] " .
description_long: Vhaeraun ' s nightshield Vhaeraun ' s nightshield was an abjuration spell contained in the " Obsul Ssussun " and associated with the drow god Vhaeraun . Effects . The spell created a protective aura that enhanced the physical resilience , reflexes , and willpower of the caster , and protected them from the " magic missile " spell in a manner similar to a " brooch of shielding ] " . Components . " Vhaeraun ' s nightshield " used verbal and somatic components , and the divine version also required a divine focus like a holy symbol .

title: Vhaidra Uoswiir
description: Vhaidra Uoswiir Vhaidra was a drow monk who excelled in both armed and unarmed combat . History . Vhaidra is the first in line to the noble Uoswiir household .
description_long: Vhaidra Uoswiir Vhaidra was a drow monk who excelled in both armed and unarmed combat . History . Vhaidra is the first in line to the noble Uoswiir household . However , she was forced to flee Menzoberranzan when much of her family was slaughtered by rival houses . Since then , she has been adventuring while secretly planning the return of her household and the downfall of those who were responsible for attacking it . To this end she has allied with her half - sister , Ulua , who conducts operations to regroup the Uoswiir household and to eliminate its rivals . Vhaidra is proud , ruthless and often dismissive of those who are neither an expedient nor a threat to her purposes . In the introduction to the game her motivation for travelling to Baldur ' s Gate in search of adventure is said to be ' power . ' Adventuring career . Playing as Vhaidra pits her not only against the schemes of Mordoc SeLanmere but also opens up the optional sidequest of furthering the cause of her noble house .

title: Vharem Kuthcutter
description: Vharem Kuthcutter Vharem Kuthcutter was a friend of Renaer Neverember . Description . Vharem had an unkempt blond beard .
description_long: Vharem Kuthcutter Vharem Kuthcutter was a friend of Renaer Neverember . Description . Vharem had an unkempt blond beard . History . Vharem was recruited by his friend Renaer Neverember in 1479 DR to investigate the torture of Vajra Safahr , the seventh Blackstaff , in the cellars of Waterdeep . Vharem joined Renaer , Vajra , Laraelra Harsard , and Meloon Wardragon at Varadras , where they nursed Vajra , and was " teleport " ed with them to the Pellamcopse . When the group arrived in Waterdeep on Nightal 11 , 1479 DR , Vharem died when he threw himself between enemies and Renaer in a successful attempt to save Renaer ' s life . Vharem was granted the posthumous honor of being a member of the ( unnamed ) group of heroes that Renaer decided to form at Roarke House to serve a similar function to that of the Moonstars . Skills . Vharem wielded a short sword , which he borrowed from Neverember Manor .

title: Vhissilka
description: Vhissilka Vhissilka was a marilith commander serving the balor lord Axithar . Description . Vhissilka wore her hair in dull gray - brown braids .
description_long: Vhissilka Vhissilka was a marilith commander serving the balor lord Axithar . Description . Vhissilka wore her hair in dull gray - brown braids . She wore a bronze cuirass and wielded two scimitars . History . Vhissilka was a demon commander who claimed to have once been in command of 10 , 000 soldiers . In 1385 DR , she and her minions were engaged in the Blood War against devil s in the Blood Rift . When Mystra was killed and the multiverse went awry , a " chunk " of the Blood Rift was ripped away from the main plane , trapping Vhissilka and soldiers from both sides . After Tauran , Aliisza , Kael , Kaanyr Vhok , and Zasian Menz accidentally arrived in that remnant , Vhok abandoned them and joined up with Vhissilka . Vhok and Vhissilka escaped and returned to the balor Axithar , who invaded the House of the Triad with the intelligence provided by Vhok . Appendix . Appearances . Novels . The Empyrean Odyssey :

title: Vhondryl
description: Vhondryl Vhondryl was a female human psion living in Skullport in the 1360s and 1370s DR . One of the most powerful psionicist s in the city , she was also one of the top two dealers in poisons and potions , the alleged proprietor of The Deepfires inn , and leader of the Hall of Mental Splendor group of mercenary psychic spies . Description .
description_long: Vhondryl Vhondryl was a female human psion living in Skullport in the 1360s and 1370s DR . One of the most powerful psionicist s in the city , she was also one of the top two dealers in poisons and potions , the alleged proprietor of The Deepfires inn , and leader of the Hall of Mental Splendor group of mercenary psychic spies . Description . Plain featured and thin framed , Vhondryl had an odd appearance that some described as alien or fey in aspect . Her skin was white as chalk and her eyes were yellow like straw , while she grew her blonde hair down to her knees . Few would consider her beautiful , but her appearance gave her an air of mystery . Personality . Vhondryl was quiet to the point of being taciturn and she could be cryptic , and these traits added to her mystique . Her approach to business was distinctly mercenary , and she was not one to cross , cheat , or threaten , lest she retaliate . Evil - minded but lawful , she was wise and charismatic . She was a passionate worshiper of Loviatar , the Maiden of Pain . Abilities . Known to have magical powers , Vhondryl was in fact a formidable psionicist , commanding great powers of the mind she termed " the Invisible Art " .

title: Vhostym
description: Vhostym Vhostym , also called the Sojourner , is a member of the sparsely populated but powerful offshoots of the Gith sundering , the Githvyrik . Vhostym is an ancient and extremely powerful being who has both arcane and psionic powers to call upon . Vhostym worships no god or goddess , as he sees the gods as nothing compared to the utter randomness and enormity of the universe .
description_long: Vhostym Vhostym , also called the Sojourner , is a member of the sparsely populated but powerful offshoots of the Gith sundering , the Githvyrik . Vhostym is an ancient and extremely powerful being who has both arcane and psionic powers to call upon . Vhostym worships no god or goddess , as he sees the gods as nothing compared to the utter randomness and enormity of the universe . The only order and predictability that the universe has to offer him is its perfect Mathematics , which he uses to bolster his spellcraft , making him near unrivaled by any but the gods themselves . He resolved through his increase in power that the only law in the universe was that those who are weak should suffer the will of the powerful , and that morality , whether good or evil , is a fiction created by sentient beings to bring purpose to meaninglessness . Vhostym went on in his youth to build and use his strength for his own desires , destroying entire worlds , slaughtering flights of dragons and thousands , perhaps millions of creatures . Vhostym takes no pleasure from the suffering of others , while not hesitating to wipe out civilizations and worlds for his whims .

title: Vhyridaan the Mad
description: Vhyridaan the Mad Vhyridaan the Mad was a male half - elf mage who had his soul trapped inside a stone . History . Exiled from Myth Drannor , Vhyridaan was self - taught in the ways of High Magic .
description_long: Vhyridaan the Mad Vhyridaan the Mad was a male half - elf mage who had his soul trapped inside a stone . History . Exiled from Myth Drannor , Vhyridaan was self - taught in the ways of High Magic . He tried to store his knowledge in a " kiira " , but failed — the stone absorbed not only his knowledge but his body and soul completely , as well as the one magic item he had with him , a " ring of spell turning " . His soul remained trapped inside the stone thereafter , becoming the " mantle stone of Vhyridaan " , a unique " ioun stone " . After several owners , the " mantle stone " fell into the clutches of Aulmpiter , the nycaloth commander of the Army of Darkness during the Weeping War . At the Fall of Myth Drannor in 714 DR , during the Bane ' s Duel , Aulmpiter and Captain Fflar Starbrow Melruth dueled to the death . Vhyridaan and the " mantle stone " were presumed destroyed , either sundered by Fflar or in the explosion that annihilated both combatants . Powers . Vhyridaan lived on as a sentient magical item in the " mantle stone " . He could communicate mind - to - mind when in contact with the stone ' s owner . He had no ego and no power to possess the owner , however .

title: Vi ' oontu
description: Vi ' oontu The Vi ' oontu were a ninja clan based in the town of Manchar in Koryo . Their name meant " evening swallow that calls death " . Around 1357 DR , the Vi ' oontu waged an ongoing war with the Panthers of Xi , who dominated the Vorkani Mountains to the north .
description_long: Vi ' oontu The Vi ' oontu were a ninja clan based in the town of Manchar in Koryo . Their name meant " evening swallow that calls death " . Around 1357 DR , the Vi ' oontu waged an ongoing war with the Panthers of Xi , who dominated the Vorkani Mountains to the north .

title: Vial
description: Vial Vials were small glass containers that were used to hold liquids and powders . They could be used in laboratories to conduct experiments or to transport these substances . Description .
description_long: Vial Vials were small glass containers that were used to hold liquids and powders . They could be used in laboratories to conduct experiments or to transport these substances . Description . A typical vial could hold up to 4 oz ( 118 ml ) of liquid . Outside of the laboratory , vials were most commonly used to store and transport acid s , antitoxin s , perfume s , poison s , and potion s . Vials were essential in laboratories , and were also integral components of herbalism kit s and poisoner ' s kit s . A variety of vials was available for sale through " Aurora ' s Whole Realms Catalogue " , along with matching corks and other laboratory glass containers produced in Urmlaspyr by the glass - blowers guild .

title: Vichorn Vrockwing
description: Vichorn Vrockwing Vichorn Vrockwing was a tiefling who frequented the Driftwood Tavern in Neverwinter around 1484 DR . Activities . Vichorn wanted to recruit a tiefling adventurer , claiming there was a bargain between his master and the adventurer ' s ancestors , to sabotage the Ashmadai .
description_long: Vichorn Vrockwing Vichorn Vrockwing was a tiefling who frequented the Driftwood Tavern in Neverwinter around 1484 DR . Activities . Vichorn wanted to recruit a tiefling adventurer , claiming there was a bargain between his master and the adventurer ' s ancestors , to sabotage the Ashmadai . Behind the Scenes . Vichorn only appears to players of the tiefling race . His master is unknown but some clues point to Baalzebul .

title: Viconia DeVir
description: Viconia DeVir History . Viconia left her house and trappings as a priestess of Lolth after she failed to slay a baby in Lolth ' s name . A rival killed the child in her stead and House DeVir fell out of favour with the Drow ' s fell deity .
description_long: Viconia DeVir History . Viconia left her house and trappings as a priestess of Lolth after she failed to slay a baby in Lolth ' s name . A rival killed the child in her stead and House DeVir fell out of favour with the Drow ' s fell deity . Sacrifices of wealth and servants were no use , it seemed Lolth only wanted one thing from them : Viconia herself . Matron DeVir was desperate for Viconia to prostrate herself in front of Lolth , especially after a lesser house failed to destroy them after learning of their newfound weakness , but Viconia refused , sick of Lolth ' s ways , somehow believing that she would still survive with her station intact .
