Her mother had her taken away to be sacrificed to the Spider Queen but her brother Valas , a powerful wizard , saved her and killed their enraged mother . For his actions , he was turned into a Drider by Lolth . Viconia was stripped of her clerical powers and fled to the surface while finding renewed faith in Shar . She was saved from a goblin attack by a Calishite caravan only to be used as a pleasure slave by its rotund owner . She quickly bent him to her will and bade the caravan go wherever she wished .

title: Victor Dhostar
description: Victor Dhostar Victor Dhostar was the second Faceless of the Night Mask until 1367 DR . Description . Victor was a tall and handsome man with brown hair and blue eyes .
description_long: Victor Dhostar Victor Dhostar was the second Faceless of the Night Mask until 1367 DR . Description . Victor was a tall and handsome man with brown hair and blue eyes . He dress good but without particular elegance . As the Faceless he dress an all - black costume with a helm of disguise that he thieved from the temple of Leira during the Time of Troubles . Personality . The primary motivation of Victor was greed ; he did all it ' s necessary in order to achieve his goals . He too kill and frame his own father for his crimes and tried to seduce Alias . History . Victor was born in Westgate as son of the noble family of the Dhostar ; his family was so important that his father Luer Dhostar was elected Croamarkh , the informal leader of the city . But Victor want more ; first he understand that he can gain more moneys with illegal means and so he entered in the Night Mask , the true power of Westgate . His avarice permitted to him to rise the ranks quickly and in the end he replaced the Faceless as leader of the guild .

title: Vidrinath
description: Vidrinath Vidrinath ( or Lullaby ) was a sword belonging to Tiago Baenre . Description . Like " Orbbcress " , the sword was made of translucent glassteel imbued with diamond s .
description_long: Vidrinath Vidrinath ( or Lullaby ) was a sword belonging to Tiago Baenre . Description . Like " Orbbcress " , the sword was made of translucent glassteel imbued with diamond s . The hilt was a black metal formed like a spider web . Its pommel looked like a spider ' s head , with two dull emerald s for its eyes . Abilities . The sword was imbued with magic by a djinni . It could defeat some magical energy . It was also imbued with drow sleeping poison . History . The legendary weaponsmith Gol ' fanin forged " Vidrinath " in Gauntlgrym for Tiago in 1463 DR .

title: Vierna Do ' Urden
description: Vierna Do ' Urden Vierna Do ' Urden was a drow priestess of Lolth of House Do ' Urden in Menzoberranzan . She raised her younger brother , Drizzt Do ' Urden , in his early years . Personality .
description_long: Vierna Do ' Urden Vierna Do ' Urden was a drow priestess of Lolth of House Do ' Urden in Menzoberranzan . She raised her younger brother , Drizzt Do ' Urden , in his early years . Personality . Because of the drow acceptance of harsh practices , Vierna used violence as part of her motivation in teaching her brother Drizzt his part as a male in drow society . However , she also used violence very sparingly and only when Drizzt did something wrong , whereas her sisters used violence for their own enjoyment . She tried to instill in him the mindset of unquestioning respect and obedience to and reverence of their Matron Mother . Vierna showed sadness when her father , Zaknafein , was sacrificed to Lolth , and showed genuine interest when Drizzt ' s whereabouts in the Underdark were reported . It was speculated that she embraced Lloth ' s teachings because she had nothing else , and perhaps if she had gone with Drizzt earlier in life , she might have turned out differently . History . House Do ' Urden . Born in 1213 DR , Vierna was the second daughter of Matron Malice , sired by Zaknafein Do ' Urden and the full - blooded sister of Drizzt .

title: Vigdas Miller
description: Vigdas Miller Vigdas Miller was a widow miller living near Hillsfar . History . Vigdas lived with her husband , a miller , until he died two years before the Rage .
description_long: Vigdas Miller Vigdas Miller was a widow miller living near Hillsfar . History . Vigdas lived with her husband , a miller , until he died two years before the Rage . During the Rage of Demons , she saw Red Plumes in the Tinfellow Farm one night the day after the halfling family had disappeared . Relationship . Vigdas was friends with her neighbors the Tinfellow family .

title: Vigilent Order
description: Vigilent Order The Vigilent Order was a loosely organized society in Waterdeep dedicated to furthering the ends of the evil god Asmodeus . In the years prior to 1480 DR , the Vigilent Order was nearly destroyed by the deva Jinnaoth Ir ' Gadohn who ruthlessly hunted down members of the Order . Until the late 15th century DR , most members of the Order were poor , desperate people who hoped to improve their situation through Asmodeus ' power .
description_long: Vigilent Order The Vigilent Order was a loosely organized society in Waterdeep dedicated to furthering the ends of the evil god Asmodeus . In the years prior to 1480 DR , the Vigilent Order was nearly destroyed by the deva Jinnaoth Ir ' Gadohn who ruthlessly hunted down members of the Order . Until the late 15th century DR , most members of the Order were poor , desperate people who hoped to improve their situation through Asmodeus ' power . The Order began recruiting members of Waterdeep ' s nobility who wanted more wealth and power . The Order was one of the groups attempting to complete the ritual of the First Flensing which would have created a gateway for Asmodeus to the Prime Material Plane .

title: Viis Dyrr
description: Viis Dyrr Viis Dyrr was a member of House Agrach Dyrr of Menzoberranzan in 1373 DR . History . Viis graduated from Sorcere at unknown time .
description_long: Viis Dyrr Viis Dyrr was a member of House Agrach Dyrr of Menzoberranzan in 1373 DR . History . Viis graduated from Sorcere at unknown time . During the siege of Dyrr ' s compound for their betrayal of Menzoberranzan during the Siege of Menzoberranzan , Viis was called back to his house together with all Dyrr ' s other wizards to help raise magical defenses .

title: Vikos
description: Vikos Vikos was one of the centaur s in the Barony of Bloodstone in 1357 DR . Activities . Vikos was a historian and a good writer .
description_long: Vikos Vikos was one of the centaur s in the Barony of Bloodstone in 1357 DR . Activities . Vikos was a historian and a good writer . History . In 1357 DR , Vikos broke one of his legs but was saved by Gareth Dragonsbane ' s party . Some months later , Vikos and his fellows met Gareth Dragonsbane ' s party . Personality . Vikos was very modest about his talents . Powers . Vikos had some of the ancestral wildness of the centaur race .

title: Vil ' Kenna
description: Vil ' Kenna Vil ' Kenna was a female barbarian from the Sky Pony tribe of Uthgardt barbarians . In 1374 DR she travelled to Nesmé on the edge of the Evermoors to join others from her tribe who had been hired by First Speaker Tessarin Alaurin to defend the city against troll and giant attack .
description_long: Vil ' Kenna Vil ' Kenna was a female barbarian from the Sky Pony tribe of Uthgardt barbarians . In 1374 DR she travelled to Nesmé on the edge of the Evermoors to join others from her tribe who had been hired by First Speaker Tessarin Alaurin to defend the city against troll and giant attack .

title: Vilcuum
description: Vilcuum Vilcuum was a mind flayer in Ryxyg . History . During the Rage of Demons of 1491 DR , Vilcuum was one of the mind flayers that joined the allied attack on Maerimydra .
description_long: Vilcuum Vilcuum was a mind flayer in Ryxyg . History . During the Rage of Demons of 1491 DR , Vilcuum was one of the mind flayers that joined the allied attack on Maerimydra . With the support of an adventuring party , Vilcuum fought an aboleth and his orc minions inside the Lake of Blood .

title: Vilheim
description: Vilheim Vilheim Baltson was a native of Chessenta . He was a paladin of Torm when during the Time of Troubles he lost sign of his god ( when he was killed by Bane in Tantras . Feeling abandoned he retreated in the Great Glacier living as hermit .
description_long: Vilheim Vilheim Baltson was a native of Chessenta . He was a paladin of Torm when during the Time of Troubles he lost sign of his god ( when he was killed by Bane in Tantras . Feeling abandoned he retreated in the Great Glacier living as hermit . However in 1366 he accepted to help the Harper Martine in fighting the Ice devil Vreesar

title: Vilhiard
description: Vilhiard Vilhiard was a human man from the city of Procampur in the Vast . He was a renowned scholar and monk of Deneir , famous for his book " A Discovery of the World " . History .
description_long: Vilhiard Vilhiard was a human man from the city of Procampur in the Vast . He was a renowned scholar and monk of Deneir , famous for his book " A Discovery of the World " . History . On the orders of his Hierarch ( who was in turned thought to have received commands from the Thultyrl of Procampur ) , Vilhiard set out on a number of lengthy and hazardous journeys into the East . Though he later wrote of his travels , Vilhiard remained quiet about the actual purposes of these missions . The Thultyrl granted him a supply of wealth for expenses . At one point , Vilhiard explored the Hordelands and met a people called " Taangan " , later commonly known as the Tuigan . After seeing an envoy from the Zulkir s of Thay made to suffer starvation and various irritations for failing to present gifts to the Tuigan leaders , Vilhiard was forced to give them a large part of his Thultyrl - granted funds . Afterwards , he tried explaining the laws of Procampur and the Thultyrl to the Tuigan , in comparison to their own , but they only laughed and ignored them . Vilhiard wrote of all that he saw and discovered on his journeys in " A Discovery of the World " , including Tuigan customs .

title: Vilhon Cider
description: Vilhon Cider Vilhon Cider was a cider crafted in Nimpeth . It was also sold through Aurora ' s Whole Realms Catalogue . Description .
description_long: Vilhon Cider Vilhon Cider was a cider crafted in Nimpeth . It was also sold through Aurora ' s Whole Realms Catalogue . Description . The strong fruity flavors of this heady cider made it quite exquisite . Vilhon Cider was best served hot with cinnamon or cloves . Prices . title: Vilhon Mercenary Corps
description: Vilhon Mercenary Corps The Vilhon Mercenary Corps were a renowned group that traveled around the " Forgotten Realms " completing various contracts for noble lords and city - states . History . In 1479 DR , it was rumored Lord Caleb Randol of Kovel Mansion commissioned the group to undermine Black Fist operations north of Phlan .
description_long: Vilhon Mercenary Corps The Vilhon Mercenary Corps were a renowned group that traveled around the " Forgotten Realms " completing various contracts for noble lords and city - states . History . In 1479 DR , it was rumored Lord Caleb Randol of Kovel Mansion commissioned the group to undermine Black Fist operations north of Phlan .

title: Vilhon Reach
description: Vilhon Reach The Vilhon Reach was a region named after a body of water called the Vilhon Reach , a part of the Sea of Fallen Stars . Geography . Through its many port cities , the Vilhon Reach was established as an essential trade center between the cities of the southern bodies of water , the Lake of Steam , the Shining Sea , and the many kingdoms and city - states around the inner sea of the continent , the Sea of Fallen Stars .
description_long: Vilhon Reach The Vilhon Reach was a region named after a body of water called the Vilhon Reach , a part of the Sea of Fallen Stars . Geography . Through its many port cities , the Vilhon Reach was established as an essential trade center between the cities of the southern bodies of water , the Lake of Steam , the Shining Sea , and the many kingdoms and city - states around the inner sea of the continent , the Sea of Fallen Stars . Defences . The coastal areas of the Vilhon Reach are subject to attacks from koalinth and merrows . History . After the Spellplague the great body of water known as the Vilhon Reach was no more and had splintered into several small lakes .

title: Vilhon blanc
description: Vilhon blanc Vilhon Blanc was a cheese from Sembia . Geography . The cheese was rarely found outside the Sea of Fallen Stars .
description_long: Vilhon blanc Vilhon Blanc was a cheese from Sembia . Geography . The cheese was rarely found outside the Sea of Fallen Stars . Description . It was made by mixing in wine during straining , which gave it a light reddish colour and a delicate taste , more so than Turmish Brick , which was made using similar processes but a heavier wine . Prices . As of 1368 DR , Vilhon Blanc was supplied by the Thousand - Heads Trading Coster . It was around six silver pieces for a 450 g ( 1 lb ) " loaf " .

title: Vilirij
description: Vilirij A vilirij was a bizarre parasite found in Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Description . Vilirij were small , flat creatures that looked exactly like a patch of human or demihuman skin .
description_long: Vilirij A vilirij was a bizarre parasite found in Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Description . Vilirij were small , flat creatures that looked exactly like a patch of human or demihuman skin . Ecology . Vilirij were mostly active during the night , flying around in search for victims . They also hid over doorways or on ceilings and dropped onto victims who passed underneath . When a victim was found , the vilirij would grasp onto the victim ' s skin , usually an unseen area of the body , and inject a venom that anesthetized the area of contact and began to affect the victim ' s mind . This made it extremely difficult for the victim to take notice of the parasite . If viewed by others on an area of exposed skin , the vilirij would simply appear as a patch of discolored skin . Vilirij fed of off the blood of their victims , taking a small amount each day while attached . However , they consumed more blood than their host could produce during a day , so death for the host was a possibility if the vilirij was attached for too long .

title: Vilksmaarg
description: Vilksmaarg Vilksmaarg was an herbed goat cheese made in Vilkstead . Description . Vilksmaarg was pungent and salty , and was popular in taverns along the Sword Coast .
description_long: Vilksmaarg Vilksmaarg was an herbed goat cheese made in Vilkstead . Description . Vilksmaarg was pungent and salty , and was popular in taverns along the Sword Coast . Despite the success of Vilksmaarg and pickled fish as the village ' s main exports , the ransom paid by Vilkstead to Trisk to avoid conquest and slavery to Slarkrethel prevented the villagers from ever escaping poverty .

title: Villonah Leadstopper
description: Villonah Leadstopper Villonah Leadstopper was a gnome in Phlan during the Tyranny of Dragons . History . Villonah from a young age had trouble with the law , usually being saved by her father Rillo Leadstopper , who paid for the damage she did .
description_long: Villonah Leadstopper Villonah Leadstopper was a gnome in Phlan during the Tyranny of Dragons . History . Villonah from a young age had trouble with the law , usually being saved by her father Rillo Leadstopper , who paid for the damage she did . In truth , she had joined secretly the Order of the Gauntlet and worked for them . One day in 1489 DR , Villonah and her fellow Yllivia allowed themselves to be captured by Knights of the Black Fist in order to find a map that showed a secret white dragon lair . However , they were transported to a secret prison where corrupt Black Fists tortured prisoners for sport . Villonah was saved by adventurers hired by her father .

title: Villynaty
description: Villynaty Villynaty was a sahuagin prince in the Sea of Swords . History . Villynaty lived in the City of Caverns .
description_long: Villynaty Villynaty was a sahuagin prince in the Sea of Swords . History . Villynaty lived in the City of Caverns . At one point , he started a civil war in order to dethrone King Ixilthetocal . Eventually Gorion ' s Ward arrived in the City of Caverns and Villynaty met them , asking them to kill Ixilthetocal .

title: Viln Tirin
description: Viln Tirin Viln Tirin was a gang leader and cultist in Menzoberranzan during the Rage of Demons . Activities . The elf led the Bandersnatches , a gang of young demon - worshiping drow in West Wall district .
description_long: Viln Tirin Viln Tirin was a gang leader and cultist in Menzoberranzan during the Rage of Demons . Activities . The elf led the Bandersnatches , a gang of young demon - worshiping drow in West Wall district . They hoped to spread more chaos in the city in the wake of Demogorgon ' s rampage . Relationship . Viln and her gangsters had a quasit advisor .

title: Vimal Craumerdaun
description: Vimal Craumerdaun Vimal Craumerdaun was a human male and the head accountant for the Craumerdaun family in Eshpurta , Amn , in early 1370 DR , the Year of the Tankard . Due to the treatment of arcane spellcaster s in Amn , Vimal kept his wizard ly skills a closely guarded secret .
description_long: Vimal Craumerdaun Vimal Craumerdaun was a human male and the head accountant for the Craumerdaun family in Eshpurta , Amn , in early 1370 DR , the Year of the Tankard . Due to the treatment of arcane spellcaster s in Amn , Vimal kept his wizard ly skills a closely guarded secret .

title: Vindala Chalanther
description: Vindala Chalanther Vindala Chalanther was a retired adventurer and illusionist who lived in Marsember , Cormyr . She tutored apprentice magicians but would accept hire as a spellcaster , and enjoyed relaxing at the Drowning Flagon inn . She was petite with black hair and dark eyes , although she often disguised herself .
description_long: Vindala Chalanther Vindala Chalanther was a retired adventurer and illusionist who lived in Marsember , Cormyr . She tutored apprentice magicians but would accept hire as a spellcaster , and enjoyed relaxing at the Drowning Flagon inn . She was petite with black hair and dark eyes , although she often disguised herself . She liked to pull pranks .

title: Vindicator
description: Vindicator Vindicator was Helm ' s bastard sword . Description . The sword glowed with silver y flame and had the symbol of Helm on its hilt .
description_long: Vindicator Vindicator was Helm ' s bastard sword . Description . The sword glowed with silver y flame and had the symbol of Helm on its hilt . Anyone unworthy of wielding the sword felt a burning sensation when they grasped it . History . Vindicator was given to Gedrin Shadowbane after he had a vision of Helm ' s death at the hand of Tyr . Many years later , Gedrin gave the sword to Kalen Dren who carried the sword as of 1479 DR . In 1480 DR , Kalen no longer felt worthy of the sword and gave it to a young paladin named Rhetegast Hawkwinter ( Rhett ) although the two passed the sword back and forth . In 1480 DR Rhett took Vindicator to Westgate but the sword was returned to Kalen in pieces by Lilten although Kalen was able to reassemble the sword using divine power . Fearing Rhett dead , Kalen journeyed to Westgate to find answers . In Westgate Kalen found a third wielder , his first apprentice Vaelis , whom Kalen had thought dead .

title: Vine Vale
description: Vine Vale The Vine Vale is an area surrounding Evereska dedicated to agriculture for orchards and vineyards . It is a vast staircase of lush vineyards and black soiled winter fields , descending toward Evereska ' s walls in a series of smokethorn tree and spiny soapleaf covered terraces .
description_long: Vine Vale The Vine Vale is an area surrounding Evereska dedicated to agriculture for orchards and vineyards . It is a vast staircase of lush vineyards and black soiled winter fields , descending toward Evereska ' s walls in a series of smokethorn tree and spiny soapleaf covered terraces .

title: Vineshade
description: Vineshade The town of Vineshade was the largest settlement in the Purple Hills in Tethyr and thought by most to be the wine capital of the entire Sword Coast . It was primarily a halfling town . Geography and Layout .
description_long: Vineshade The town of Vineshade was the largest settlement in the Purple Hills in Tethyr and thought by most to be the wine capital of the entire Sword Coast . It was primarily a halfling town . Geography and Layout . Vineshade was located in the Purple Hills of County Vintor in the Purple Marches , along the Hillstrail . This town was arranged in quarters . The western quarter contained the wineries and drying shacks for the pipeweed . The northern section contained most of the human houses and buildings . The other two quarters were filled with halfling - style abodes . The center of the town was where the largest building in town stood , the Vintners ' Guildhouse . Architecture . Every building in the town showed the same quality of workmanship present in the wines the city produced . The halfling homes consisted of clusters of subterranean burrows in the hills or hollowed - out large trees . Defenses . No wall surrounded this town ; however , the halfling militia have a series of underground tunnels leading from secret armories to locations outside the town perimeter . Thus , the town guards can often flank troublemakers trying to escape capture .

title: Vintor
description: Vintor Vintor was a county on the western coast of Tethyr famous for its wines . Geography . Vintor was one of the counties of the Purple Marches .
description_long: Vintor Vintor was a county on the western coast of Tethyr famous for its wines . Geography . Vintor was one of the counties of the Purple Marches . It lay west of counties Elemetar and Bardshyr on the other side of the Red River and south of the of Kamlann on the other side of the Sulduskoon River . A large portion of the county was a region called the Purple Hills , a land known for its cider , pipeweed , and wine . Its two largest settlements were Barrowsmorn and Vineshade . Population . County Vintor included a high percentage of halfling s among its populace , since they admired the hilly landscape of the region . Government . In 1370 DR , Vintor was governed by Count Krimmon Amethystall , who was also the Fleet Chancellor of Tethyr . The official county seat was Amethyst Hall .

title: Viol
description: Viol A viol was a six - string instrument similar to a violin . Description . Viols had a deeply resonant sound that conveyed melancholy themes very well .
description_long: Viol A viol was a six - string instrument similar to a violin . Description . Viols had a deeply resonant sound that conveyed melancholy themes very well . They could be played on their own or as part of larger ensembles . Viols were particularly favored by dwarves , owing to their deep and dark sounds . Viols were available for purchase through " Aurora ' s Whole Realms Catalogue " , produced by the same craftsmen from Waterdeep and Selgaunt who produced the violins sold through the catalogue .

title: Violet fungus
description: Violet fungus A violet fungus was a type of subterranean fungus creature that could be dangerous to adventurers . Description . Violet fungi were human - sized mushrooms supported by a mass of root - like feelers that allowed them to move slowly to more favorable feeding spots .
description_long: Violet fungus A violet fungus was a type of subterranean fungus creature that could be dangerous to adventurers . Description . Violet fungi were human - sized mushrooms supported by a mass of root - like feelers that allowed them to move slowly to more favorable feeding spots . They could range in color from deep purple to dull gray , or they could be violet and covered in purple spots . They also contained four leafy tendrils . These " tentacles " could apply a secreted poison that caused weakening . Behavior . Violet fungi could sense nearby motion and would flail their appendages at creatures nearby . They would feed on decaying matter , often from the bodies of creatures that came too close and had succumbed to their poison . Violet fungi had a symbiotic relationship with shrieker s , another closely related fungus species , and often grew interspersed with them in patches . The shriekers ' noise would benefit a violet fungus by drawing curious creatures near enough for the violet fungus to poison . Variants . Cormanthor ian violet fungi grew only to around 3 feet ( 0 . 9 meters ) high .

title: Violet slime
description: Violet slime Violet slime was a slime found on the surface of standing water in swampy environments . It clung to creatures and caused acid burns , although these did not affect metals . It could be washed off with water , or burned with fire or bright light .
description_long: Violet slime Violet slime was a slime found on the surface of standing water in swampy environments . It clung to creatures and caused acid burns , although these did not affect metals . It could be washed off with water , or burned with fire or bright light .

title: Violin
description: Violin Violins were musical instruments greatly favored by elves . Description . Music from violins was mellow and their sound was particularly loved by elves .
description_long: Violin Violins were musical instruments greatly favored by elves . Description . Music from violins was mellow and their sound was particularly loved by elves . The cities of Waterdeep and Selgaunt harbored craftsmen , many of whom were elven , capable of making high - quality violins . They could be ordered from " Aurora ' s Whole Realms Catalogue " , from which master - quality violins were also available for special orders and custom prices .

title: Violine
description: Violine Violine gems were purple and volcanic in nature . Description . Found in deposits mixed with other minerals and occasionally of exceptional ( up to human fist ) size , this ornamental stone was usually cut and polished , or baguette style .
description_long: Violine Violine gems were purple and volcanic in nature . Description . Found in deposits mixed with other minerals and occasionally of exceptional ( up to human fist ) size , this ornamental stone was usually cut and polished , or baguette style . A typical stone had a base value of 10 gp . Violine stones were considered sacred by followers of Ghaunadaur — appropriate for sacrifice , or to be consecrated for use , or recognized as boons or omens when found . Powers . This gem was proof against mummy rot . A creature with mummy rot only had to touch a violine crystal and the mummy rot was removed . The violine was completely consumed by this process . If this stone came into contact with an actual mummy , it burst and damaged the mummy . If a mummy was destroyed by contact with violine , the resulting mummy dust was inert and could not be used as a spell component or for other magical purposes .

title: Viper ' s Kiss
description: Viper ' s Kiss Viper ' s Kiss by Lisa Smedman is the second book in the House of Serpents Trilogy . Summary . This novel explores the political intrigues of the yuan - ti race , the details of which have been little explored in previous Forgotten Realms products .
description_long: Viper ' s Kiss Viper ' s Kiss by Lisa Smedman is the second book in the House of Serpents Trilogy . Summary . This novel explores the political intrigues of the yuan - ti race , the details of which have been little explored in previous Forgotten Realms products .

title: Viper tree
description: Viper tree Viper trees were a strange mixture of demon , plant and reptile found in the Lower Planes . As of 1370 DR there were reports that several Red Wizard zulkir s had brought specimens from the Abyss and planted them in Thay . Description .
description_long: Viper tree Viper trees were a strange mixture of demon , plant and reptile found in the Lower Planes . As of 1370 DR there were reports that several Red Wizard zulkir s had brought specimens from the Abyss and planted them in Thay . Description . In the larval stage , viper trees were fully mobile and appeared to be three - headed snakes ( all heads at the same end ) with the middle head smaller than the other two . After they planted themselves , they could be mistaken for beech trees or other similar trees with light - colored , smooth bark , at a distance . Up close , the reptilian nature was easily noticeable with scaly white skin and a snake head at the end of each branch . A mature viper tree had dozens of branches . Behavior . After hatching , viper tree larvae were insatiably hungry with only animal intelligence , feeding on small prey such as cranium rat s . For the first month or so , the middle head was dormant until at some point it awakened and became the guiding intelligence of the creature , seeking out a good place to put down roots .

title: Vipers
description: Vipers The Vipers were a bandit company active in the Vast in the 1360s DR . They were based out of the Vipers ' Nest in Brynwood . History .
description_long: Vipers The Vipers were a bandit company active in the Vast in the 1360s DR . They were based out of the Vipers ' Nest in Brynwood . History . In the Year of the Banner , 1368 DR , two Red Brigade scouts reported a dead - magic zone in Brynwood Forest in the Vast . Captain Cedric Ravajar kept the find a secret and the two scouts disappeared shortly afterwards . Late that year , Cedric announced his retirement and disbanded the Red Brigade . The group split up and most went their separate ways . A trusted few , however , departed with Cedric and secretly returned to the dead - magic zone , where they reformed into the Vipers , a bandit group . They built their base , the Vipers ' Nest , within the dead - magic zone , and began raiding merchant caravans going through the Glorming Pass by the close of the year . By the beginning of the Year of the Gauntlet , 1369 DR , they ' d made a fearful reputation for themselves , for their ruthlessness , organization , and efficiency .

title: Vipers ' Nest
description: Vipers ' Nest The Vipers ' Nest was a secret base of the Vipers bandits , located in the Brynwood forest in the Vast . History . In the Year of the Banner , 1368 DR , two Red Brigade scouts reported a dead - magic zone in Brynwood in the Vast to their captain , Cedric Ravajar .
description_long: Vipers ' Nest The Vipers ' Nest was a secret base of the Vipers bandits , located in the Brynwood forest in the Vast . History . In the Year of the Banner , 1368 DR , two Red Brigade scouts reported a dead - magic zone in Brynwood in the Vast to their captain , Cedric Ravajar . He later disbanded the Red Brigade and reformed with a trusted few into the Vipers , a bandit gang . They returned to the dead - magic zone and began construction of their base , as an underground hideout protected by the magic - dead area . Dwarven engineers , formerly of the Red Brigade , designed and built the structure , with the aid of low - ranking bandits . It was nicknamed " the Vipers ' Nest " . They were in operation by the end of the year . There were frequent attempts by rangers , bounty hunters , constables , and other groups to locate their hideout but all failed , largely due to the dead - magic environment and the Vipers concealing their tracks . Calispar Delgorth , a priest of Talona and member of the Vipers , discovered that plant - based toxins grown within the dead - magic zone were unaffected by magic . He used the find to develop poison s immune to magic .

title: Viperstongue Ford
description: Viperstongue Ford Viperstongue Ford was a ford where the Cross Road , between Thindilar and Blanaer , went over the River Vesper in the Vast . It coincided with the valley of Viperstongue , a low saddle in the Troll Mountains that served as a major pass through the range . History .
description_long: Viperstongue Ford Viperstongue Ford was a ford where the Cross Road , between Thindilar and Blanaer , went over the River Vesper in the Vast . It coincided with the valley of Viperstongue , a low saddle in the Troll Mountains that served as a major pass through the range . History . Viperstongue Ford was a strategic location , making it the site of several battles . No buildings or settlements survived there very long . When Deep King Tuir Stonebeard of Roldilar led the dwarven armies against those of orcs and goblins in the Year of the Bloody Crown , 649 DR , they were defeated at Viperstongue Ford . Roldilar ' s defenses were broken , and the dwarves retreated to Mount Grimmerfang . The Roldilarren dwarves were saved from total extinction by their human and elven allies . The elven warrior Beluar and his forces routed the orcs at Viperstongue Ford , then pursued them through the hills later known as Beluar ' s Hunt and into the village of Maskyr ' s Eye to slay the last orc . Locations . By 1370 DR , The Stag and Viper inn stood at the ford . It was once the base of the Mistdown Marauders , who were later buried amongst some trees north - east of the ford .

title: Virdin
description: Virdin King Virdin was the king of Damara in 1357 DR . History . King Virdin led the Damaran armies against those of Zhengyi the Witch - King , but was defeated at the Ford of Goliad when he was tricked into believing that a magic wand would enable his army to cross the Goliad River .
description_long: Virdin King Virdin was the king of Damara in 1357 DR . History . King Virdin led the Damaran armies against those of Zhengyi the Witch - King , but was defeated at the Ford of Goliad when he was tricked into believing that a magic wand would enable his army to cross the Goliad River . It is widely believed in Damara that he was betrayed by Felix , his own chief lieutenant , but Zhengyi was waiting for Virdin to make this mistake , and inflicted a thorough defeat upon the Damaran army while they were helpless in the river . Virdin was on a nearby hill watching these events unfold when he was assassinated by a dagger . It is believed that Felix was also responsible for this act .

title: Virus charm
description: Virus charm Virus charm was an arcane enchantment spell , similar to " mass charm " , that could spread from a single creature to other individuals by touch . Effects . When casting this spell , it was important that the first target be a creature less robust than the caster for the virus to take hold — a child or a commoner , for example .
description_long: Virus charm Virus charm was an arcane enchantment spell , similar to " mass charm " , that could spread from a single creature to other individuals by touch . Effects . When casting this spell , it was important that the first target be a creature less robust than the caster for the virus to take hold — a child or a commoner , for example . If the first target was not less healthy or weaker than the caster , then this spell functioned like a simple " charm person " or " charm monster " and had no viral capability . If they failed to resist the spell , they became charmed and regarded the caster as a trusted friend and ally . They could pass the " charm " on by touching other persons or creatures , each of which had one chance to resist ( again , more robust individuals had a better chance to resist ) or become an ally of the caster and able to infect others , and so on . " Virus charm " could infect over fifty creatures ( more for higher level casters ) and they remained charmed for a period of one day to weeks and even months depending on their intelligence .

title: Viryn
description: Viryn Viryn was a solar in service to Tyr in 1385 DR . History . Viryn was a solar in service to Tyr in Mount Celestia .
description_long: Viryn Viryn was a solar in service to Tyr in 1385 DR . History . Viryn was a solar in service to Tyr in Mount Celestia . He was in charge of the escort that bought the diviner deva Eirwyn to prison . After the Spellplague , Viryn was ordered to free Eirwyn and take her to a council . Later , Viryn fought against the fiend armies that tried to invade Celestia , profiting off the chaos . The Empyrean Odyssey :

title: Vishap
description: Vishap Vishap were flightless dragon s that lived in Zakhara . Compared to other dragons they were cowardly , choosing to prey on the weak . Stealth and deceit were their chosen methods of attack .
description_long: Vishap Vishap were flightless dragon s that lived in Zakhara . Compared to other dragons they were cowardly , choosing to prey on the weak . Stealth and deceit were their chosen methods of attack . Despite being large creatures , vishap were surprising athletic , being able to run , jump and climb with graceful agility . Vishap scales provided natural camouflage with their surroundings . Vishap were especially aware of their surroundings and could even detect nearby invisible creatures . These dragons did not have a breath weapon and they could not cast spell s , nor did they exude dragon fear . Description . Most vishap were an average of 25 ft ( 7 . 6 m ) in length , but could grow to 174 ft ( 53 m ) . Combat . A vishap studied potential opponents for days at a time before engaging in combat . After this time the vishap would approach weak targets to speak and then attack when in range . Victims who flattered a vishap were sometimes spared if they yielded all treasure or served as slaves . Aggressive targets were left alone until they could be ambushed . During physical combat , a vishap could attack with its teeth , claws and tail .

title: Vishap ' s Teeth
description: Vishap ' s Teeth The Vishap ' s Teeth was a landmark located in the High Desert of Zakhara . Description . It was surely a striking feature .
description_long: Vishap ' s Teeth The Vishap ' s Teeth was a landmark located in the High Desert of Zakhara . Description . It was surely a striking feature . Four immense pyramids of dark granite composed the structure . Rumors and Legends . Most believed the Vishap ' s Teeth to be a natural landmark , but there were those who thought they were actually the teeth of a sleeping wingless dragon or " vishap " .

title: Vishnan VII
description: Vishnan VII Vishnan VII was the priest - king of Kuong Kingdom in Malatra around 1357 DR . Personality . Vishnan was a strong leader with a regal authority .
description_long: Vishnan VII Vishnan VII was the priest - king of Kuong Kingdom in Malatra around 1357 DR . Personality . Vishnan was a strong leader with a regal authority . Only his mother could change his mind after he had made a decision . He preferred temple ceremonies to military business , despite being an able fighter .

title: Vishva
description: Vishva Vishva was a dragonborn member of the Platinum Cadre , who became the leader of the order after the death of Patrin in 1479 DR . Due to her faith in a dragon god , Vishva was a " thrikominaki " ( clanless dragonborn ) . Description .
description_long: Vishva Vishva was a dragonborn member of the Platinum Cadre , who became the leader of the order after the death of Patrin in 1479 DR . Due to her faith in a dragon god , Vishva was a " thrikominaki " ( clanless dragonborn ) . Description . Vishva had brown scales , and scars were she once wore her clan ' s piercings . History . Due to her faith in a dragon god , Vishva had been casted out of her clan . In 1479 DR , Vishva became the leader of the Platinum Cadre after the death of the previous leader , the paladin Patrin . Although other dragonborn shunned them , Vishva led the remaining members of the Cadre who still wanted to serve her country . She convinced Medrash to help the members of the Cadre by cleansing them of the power they had gained from Tiamat . When Khouryn Skulldark returned to Tymanther and warned them about Tchazzar plan ' s to invade the dragonborn nation , Vanquisher Tarhun assigned to the Platinum Cadre the mission to destroy Gestaniius and liberate High Imaskar from her forces , so the Imaskari would lend their aid to the thymari . Vishva took part in this operation as one of the high - ranking officials of the Cadre .

title: Visil ' Taphenos Meadswimmer
description: Visil ' Taphenos Meadswimmer Visil ' Taphenos Meadswimmer was a renegade aboleth savant from Llurth Dreir living in Sloopdilmonpolop in 1370 DR . History . Born in Llurth Dreir , Visil ' Taphenos descended from a line of aboleths specializing in dwarven lore .
description_long: Visil ' Taphenos Meadswimmer Visil ' Taphenos Meadswimmer was a renegade aboleth savant from Llurth Dreir living in Sloopdilmonpolop in 1370 DR . History . Born in Llurth Dreir , Visil ' Taphenos descended from a line of aboleths specializing in dwarven lore . Very early on , it displayed the exceptional mental skills needed to become an aboleth savant . As a savant , it became interested in the idea of combining complex aboleth symbols with dwarven rune lore . Thus it sought out and consumed one of the few remaining dwarven runemaster s , a High Old One of Dumathoin . Visil ' Taphenos absorbed the knowledge , but also acquired many aspects of the victims ' personality into itself . Understanding that it couldn ' t go back to its home , it chose to live as an exile in Sloopdilmonpolop . There , it became one of the most preeminent sages of the Underdark . Activities . Visil ' Taphenos , ignored by the kuo - toa , exchanged its knowledge for dwarven lore or artifacts with individuals of all races . Its fields of expertise included dwarven architecture , genealogy , and languages and dialects , the history of Shanatar , and geology and mycology .

title: Vision
description: Vision Vision was a divination spell that granted the caster knowledge of tales about a given person , place , or thing . Effects . This spell worked in the same manner as " legend lore " , except that " vision " worked more quickly and produced greater strain on the caster .
description_long: Vision Vision was a divination spell that granted the caster knowledge of tales about a given person , place , or thing . Effects . This spell worked in the same manner as " legend lore " , except that " vision " worked more quickly and produced greater strain on the caster . The caster would pose a question about some person , place , or object , and then cast the spell . If the person or object was at hand or if the caster was in the place in question , he or she might received a vision about it , depending on how well - known the information in question was . XP Cost . 100 XP

title: Viticun
description: Viticun Viticun was a sage and Red Wizard in Eltabbar in 1358 DR . His area of expertise was the understanding of magic and its relationship to the Inner Planes and Outer Planes and nobody knew more than him about this . He worked only for fellow Red Wizards .
description_long: Viticun Viticun was a sage and Red Wizard in Eltabbar in 1358 DR . His area of expertise was the understanding of magic and its relationship to the Inner Planes and Outer Planes and nobody knew more than him about this . He worked only for fellow Red Wizards . A story told that the Simbul visited him in magical disguise and stole a great secret . Personality . Viticun did not care for politics and conquest .

title: Viv
description: Viv Viv was a halfling trickster in Waterdeep in 1479 DR . History . In 1479 DR , Viv joined Enda Yate in her treasure hunt into Undermountain .
description_long: Viv Viv was a halfling trickster in Waterdeep in 1479 DR . History . In 1479 DR , Viv joined Enda Yate in her treasure hunt into Undermountain . When they ventured into Undermountain , Viv remained at the base , not moving at all from her bedroom . She listened to her companions slaughtering some Downshadow folks that arrived nearby . Personality . Viv was a coward , sneaky and self - serving . She was also a good actress .

title: Vix ' thra
description: Vix ' thra Vix ' thra was a dracolich who allied with the Valsharess during her campaign to conquer the Underdark . Vix ' thra established a cult devoted to his worship , under the leadership of a vampire priest named Sodalis . This cult was based in an Underdark village called Drearing ' s Deep , where freed slaves came to seek refuge .
description_long: Vix ' thra Vix ' thra was a dracolich who allied with the Valsharess during her campaign to conquer the Underdark . Vix ' thra established a cult devoted to his worship , under the leadership of a vampire priest named Sodalis . This cult was based in an Underdark village called Drearing ' s Deep , where freed slaves came to seek refuge . In exchange for the cult ' s protection , the villagers were required to offer members of their community to the cult as sacrifices . Sodalis and his vampire cultists would then feast on the flesh and blood of the sacrificial victim , while the bones would be delivered to Vix ' thra to be reanimated as an undead servant . During the Silence of Lolth , the Valsharess began a campaign to declare herself the supreme ruler of the Underdark . Vix ' thra entered into an alliance with her , sending undead and bone golems to bolster her army . A great adventurer , seeking ways to weaken Valsharess , travelled to Drearing ' s Deep and infiltrated the cult .

title: Vizeran DeVir
description: Vizeran DeVir Vizeran DeVir was an exiled drow archmage during the Rage of Demons . History . A scion of House DeVir , Vizeran studied the arcane arts at the same time as Gromph Baenre .
description_long: Vizeran DeVir Vizeran DeVir was an exiled drow archmage during the Rage of Demons . History . A scion of House DeVir , Vizeran studied the arcane arts at the same time as Gromph Baenre . Gromph discovered Vizeran ' s true devotion to the Elder Elemental Eye and engineered his disgrace and exile as an unbeliever of Lolth . Ironically , this spared Vizeran from the downfall of House DeVir at the hands of House Do ' Urden . In his exile , he became a great archmage , building his tower of Araj and plotting his revenge . Centuries before the late 15th century DR , Vizeran DeVir crafted the weapons " Ironfang " , " Drown " , " Windvane " , and " Tinderstike " for the Elemental Evil cults in the Fane of the Eye of Tyar - Besil . From afar , Vizeran acted as the shadowy patron of the Council of Spiders and from their number he gained the assistance of Grin Ousstyl . During the Rage of Demons , Vizeran correctly deduced what had truly happened : Lolth had manipulated Gromph as a pawn to unleash the demon lord s throughout the Underdark in order to gain absolute power in the Abyss . The demon lords in the Realms used faerzress to spread their madness .

title: Vizier ' s turban
description: Vizier ' s turban Vizier ' s turbans were symbiotic creatures in Zakhara that attached themselves to wizard s . Abilities . Bonded to a wizard , they would greatly increase any wizard ' s ability to cast spells in exchange for a small portion of the wizard ' s life force .
description_long: Vizier ' s turban Vizier ' s turbans were symbiotic creatures in Zakhara that attached themselves to wizard s . Abilities . Bonded to a wizard , they would greatly increase any wizard ' s ability to cast spells in exchange for a small portion of the wizard ' s life force . If enough life force was given , the wizard would even gain a degree of magic resistance . Vizier ' s turbans were able to bond with all types of wizards in Zakhara except sha ' ir s . They communicated telepathically with their host . Description . As their name implied , these creatures looked just like a regular turban , though they were able to reshape themselves into veils and other Zakharan headdresses . Two bright jewels located toward the center of the turban served as the creature ' s eyes . They could change color at any time to match the wizard ' s clothing . Combat . A vizier ' s turban did not attack or cause damage in any way . They were connected to their host as a single life form . A vizier ' s turban possessed the problem - solving abilities of a genius , and could impart helpful information to its host .

title: Vlaakith CLVII
description: Vlaakith CLVII Vlaakith CLVII , also known as the Lich Queen , is the current ruler of the githyanki race . Vlaakith is the name of several rulers of the githyanki race after the disappearance of Gith , the rebel leader that united them against the illithid . The original holder , Vlaakith I helped seal the pact between the red dragons and the githyanki .
description_long: Vlaakith CLVII Vlaakith CLVII , also known as the Lich Queen , is the current ruler of the githyanki race . Vlaakith is the name of several rulers of the githyanki race after the disappearance of Gith , the rebel leader that united them against the illithid . The original holder , Vlaakith I helped seal the pact between the red dragons and the githyanki . All subsequent queens of the githyanki have been named after her . The last queen of the githyanki , Vlaakith CLVII , died after ascending the throne without giving birth to an heir , but returned as a lich . Vlaakith has ruled the githyanki for over a thousand years . Her home , the Castle Susurrus , is in the githyanki capital city , Tu ' narath , which is built on the god - isle of a deceased power known only as " The One in the Void " .

title: Vlashiri
description: Vlashiri Vlashiri was a drow priestess of Eilistraee in the Misty Forest . History . Vlashiri was one of the priestesses in the Misty Forest .
description_long: Vlashiri Vlashiri was a drow priestess of Eilistraee in the Misty Forest . History . Vlashiri was one of the priestesses in the Misty Forest . She was talented in breaking curse s . In 1375 DR , Vlashiri was killed during an attack by a large group of drider s .

title: Vlotho
description: Vlotho Vlotho the Blue was a half - elf gambler who lived in the city of Harglast , in the Windrise Ports of Returned Abeir , as of 1479 DR . Background . Vlotho was a known gambler and gossiper in Harglast , and he usually dealt with more obscure information as well .
description_long: Vlotho Vlotho the Blue was a half - elf gambler who lived in the city of Harglast , in the Windrise Ports of Returned Abeir , as of 1479 DR . Background . Vlotho was a known gambler and gossiper in Harglast , and he usually dealt with more obscure information as well . He was also a skilled player of Liar ' s Dice , a popular dice game in Harglast . Vlotho was a regular customer of the Leaping Hart Tavern .

title: Voadkyn
description: Voadkyn The voadkyn were a kind of giant - kin sometimes also known as wood giants . A large population lived with the wood elves and the treant s in the Cold Wood . Abilities .
description_long: Voadkyn The voadkyn were a kind of giant - kin sometimes also known as wood giants . A large population lived with the wood elves and the treant s in the Cold Wood . Abilities . They had the ability to magically disguise themselves as a generic specimen of any humanoid creature 3 to 15 ft ( 1 to 4 . 6 m ) in height . Personality . A voadkyn was usually chaotic good in alignment . Homelands . Voadkyn lived in temperate and warm forests . As of 1368 DR , voadkyn inhabited the Chondalwood . Society . Voadkyn believed themselves to be superior to the other giants and giant - kin , and believed that they were unfairly placed near to the bottom of the ordning in terms of racial status . They disliked jovial behavior and preferred brooding and silence . Voadkyn respected their forest environment and took it upon themselves to tend to it , creating vast landscaped gardens and large labyrinths . Myths and legends . In the Ice Spires there were stories that there were huge voadkyn mazes in the Forgotten Forest that contained treasures at their centers . Religion . Voadkyn primarily worshiped the goddess Hiatea . History .

title: Voaraghamanthar
description: Voaraghamanthar Voaraghamanthar , known as the Black Death , was one of the most famous black dragon s . Personality . Voaraghamanthar shared an unusually powerful empathic link with his twin Waervaerendor .
description_long: Voaraghamanthar Voaraghamanthar , known as the Black Death , was one of the most famous black dragon s . Personality . Voaraghamanthar shared an unusually powerful empathic link with his twin Waervaerendor . They truly acted as one soul in two bodies and their greatest fear was that someone would discover their secret . From a young age , Voaraghamanthar and his twin desired immortality but they were not interested in normal dracolich transformation . However , they believed that Chardansearavitriol ' s condition was somehow different and tried to replicate it . Both were able sorcerers , Voaraghamanthar preferred to study ancient tomes . They saw most other creatures only as food or annoyances to be quickly disposed of . The exceptions were adventurers and other dragons . They avoided other dragons , not out of fear but in order to avoid being discovered as twinss . Adventurers , on the other hand , they viewed as tools too useful to be killed and the Black Brothers needed to recover too many artifacts to not use adventurers that agreed to work for them . Activities . The Black Brothers patrolled their domain efficiently .

title: Vocalize
description: Vocalize Vocalize was an alteration spell that allowed a spell - caster to cast spells without uttering a sound . Effects . For five minutes , this spell granted the ability to cast spells silently .
description_long: Vocalize Vocalize was an alteration spell that allowed a spell - caster to cast spells without uttering a sound . Effects . For five minutes , this spell granted the ability to cast spells silently . The caster of " vocalize " had to touch the recipient to confer this ability on someone else . For the duration of " vocalize " , the spell - casting creature did not need to speak as part of casting a spell , as long as the casting was finished within the five minute time limit of " vocalize " . Thus , the recipient could cast spells within the bounds of a " silence " spell , or when stealth was important , for example . Somatic and material components are not affected by " vocalize " , only the verbal requirement is deleted from the spell ( s ) being cast . Components . No verbal component was necessary to cast this spell , only somatic and a material component in the form of a bell with no clapper .

title: Vodos
description: Vodos Vodos was the great triton architect who planned the Sharksbane Wall . History . Vodos was a very ancient triton born possibly in - 11000 DR .
description_long: Vodos Vodos was the great triton architect who planned the Sharksbane Wall . History . Vodos was a very ancient triton born possibly in - 11000 DR . He was old at the time of the rise of Aryselmalyr . A devout priest of Persana , under his goddess ' s inspiration , he erected the early garrisons of the Sharksteeth Mounts and planned and possibly built the Sharksbane Wall . Vodos ' s death was surrounded by mystery . In - 10400 DR , when very old , he went into the Trench of Lopok and nobody saw him again . Many believed he had chosen Lopok as his resting place but this was only speculation .

title: Voice of the great lion
description: Voice of the great lion The Voice of the Great Lion was a magical item that could be found in Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Description . This item looked like a crinkled old scroll bound with a faded golden cord .
description_long: Voice of the great lion The Voice of the Great Lion was a magical item that could be found in Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Description . This item looked like a crinkled old scroll bound with a faded golden cord . Anyone unrolling the scroll without caution risked destroying it . The surface of the scroll was covered with intricate script written in an ancient dialect of Midani . The first few lines of the scroll read : " " Let be known to all the decision of the Great Lion , Worthy of the Gods , Confidant of Genies , He who sits on the Enlightened Throne , for he decrees Krak al - _ _ _ and the lands accorded it by custom be awarded to the bearer . Let he of the court who contests this judgment read and hear the proof of the Great Lion from our master ' s own lips " . " Powers . When the magical script was read aloud , an image of the First Caliph appeared and repeated the judgement written above . After reading , the image remained for one hour and behaved just like the real First Caliph . The fortress was a stronghold on the al - Sabaya river that flowed to Gana . The size of the stronghold and surrounding land was left vague .

title: Voice of thunder
description: Voice of thunder A voice of thunder is a variety of bard trained to enhance their voice with arcane magic through ancient traditions . To the properly trained voice of thunder , the sound of their voice is a weapon in of itself , a source of power that can harm and heal alike . From the sound of music to the rumbling roll of thunder , a voice of thunder ' s vocal range is impressive and filled with deadly power , with even its echoes full of supernatural qualities .
description_long: Voice of thunder A voice of thunder is a variety of bard trained to enhance their voice with arcane magic through ancient traditions . To the properly trained voice of thunder , the sound of their voice is a weapon in of itself , a source of power that can harm and heal alike . From the sound of music to the rumbling roll of thunder , a voice of thunder ' s vocal range is impressive and filled with deadly power , with even its echoes full of supernatural qualities . Culture . Voice of thunders do not come from any one tradition or culture and each race interprets the way of a voice of thunder slightly differently . While an eladrin voice of thunder might evoke seasonal themes in their magic , dwarves or goliath s might instead rumble with the power of stone . Other examples include drow , who often use harsh yet beautiful music for their magic or tiefling s , who use the abilities of a voice of thunder to enhance their already commanding voices . Regardless , all voices of thunders share similar threads that can be found throughout many bardic traditions .

title: Voidstone
description: Voidstone Voidstone was a solid substance that originated on the Negative Energy Plane and destroyed anything it touched . Properties . Completely black and featureless , voidstone was nearly unmeasurable by any known means .
description_long: Voidstone Voidstone was a solid substance that originated on the Negative Energy Plane and destroyed anything it touched . Properties . Completely black and featureless , voidstone was nearly unmeasurable by any known means . Rough estimates of size could be made by the black hole it formed in any region of illumination . Size could range from a few inches / centimeters to dozens of feet / many meters in any dimension . Any material touching it , other than another voidstone , was quickly destroyed in a matter of seconds — a being with great fortitude might have lasted a little longer . " Telekinesis " or other forms of mental control did not work on voidstones , but perhaps divine or other magical powers could be used to manipulate them . Some voidstones were attracted to life ; the medium - sized chunks would move in the direction of the nearest living creature while the very small and very large pieces remained motionless . Voidstones showed no reaction to undead . Fabrication . No means of creating voidstone were known .

title: Vok Dorrg
description: Vok Dorrg Vok Dorrg was the vendicative reigning king of Ruathym sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . Activities . Vok ruled from the Hall of the Black Waves .
description_long: Vok Dorrg Vok Dorrg was the vendicative reigning king of Ruathym sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . Activities . Vok ruled from the Hall of the Black Waves . He was too old and blind to lead his troops but he was supported by his many sons , daughters and grandchildren to captain his ship .

title: Vokkrzyr Rualfren
description: Vokkrzyr Rualfren Vokkrzyr Rualfren was a cleric of Vhaeraun . Activities . He was the leader of the drow settlement in Ultoksamrin , which made him the leader of the Vault of Cloaked Midnight .
description_long: Vokkrzyr Rualfren Vokkrzyr Rualfren was a cleric of Vhaeraun . Activities . He was the leader of the drow settlement in Ultoksamrin , which made him the leader of the Vault of Cloaked Midnight . Originally , the temple was built by drow escapees from the drow city of Guallidurth . The settlement experienced an influx of drow refugees when the surface city of Allsihwann was destroyed by the combined forces of surface elves and Tethyr . Despite this background , Vokkrzyr Rualfren advocated cooperation with surface elves in their fight against Lolth and her priestesses , in this case against the temple city of Guallidurth . While his invitation and willingness for such cooperation was widely known , it wasn ' t known how much success he had with recruitment efforts .

title: Volahk
description: Volahk Volahk was a senior priest in Neverwinter in 1484 DR . Relationships . As a member of the Eternal Order of Kelemvor , his mission was the clean the city ' s graveyard of undead .
description_long: Volahk Volahk was a senior priest in Neverwinter in 1484 DR . Relationships . As a member of the Eternal Order of Kelemvor , his mission was the clean the city ' s graveyard of undead . History . During the Tyranny of Dragons , Volahk recruited an adventurer for missions in the graveyard .

title: Volar
description: Volar Volar was a storm giant hero of history in Serôs . History . Born in 780 DR , Volar emerged as a great storm giant chieftain living among the mountains that were renamed in his honor , and all people in Seros knew about his battles against the sahuagin king Kromes and Xisar the Blue Kraken .
description_long: Volar Volar was a storm giant hero of history in Serôs . History . Born in 780 DR , Volar emerged as a great storm giant chieftain living among the mountains that were renamed in his honor , and all people in Seros knew about his battles against the sahuagin king Kromes and Xisar the Blue Kraken . At one point , he met Elminster Aumar during a trip to meet the Simbul , and El was impressed by the giant . In 1304 DR , Volar confronted the kraken Xisar for the last time . Both were never seen again and Volar was presumed dead . Personality . Volar cared for the small folks of Serôs as an uncle looked upon by favored nephews , helping them to mature but never guiding them . He protected them against all the darkest menaces . Relationship . Volar considered all people that he met in peace to be his friends . He was a great friend of Hmur .

title: Volkumburgh
description: Volkumburgh Volkumburgh is a tiny village nestled in the foothills of the Thunder Peaks , south of Thunder Gap . The village was originally a noble ' s villa , but strangely , the location of the village only appears on maps of Cormyr dated from before 1160 DR . King Proster ordered the College of Shaping Magics located in Volkumburgh to build something known as an awtawmatawn but this information can only be found in a single obscure government document in Suzail .
description_long: Volkumburgh Volkumburgh is a tiny village nestled in the foothills of the Thunder Peaks , south of Thunder Gap . The village was originally a noble ' s villa , but strangely , the location of the village only appears on maps of Cormyr dated from before 1160 DR . King Proster ordered the College of Shaping Magics located in Volkumburgh to build something known as an awtawmatawn but this information can only be found in a single obscure government document in Suzail .

title: Volo ' s Guide to All Things Magical ( in - universe )
description: Volo ' s Guide to All Things Magical ( in - universe ) Volo ' s Guide to All Things Magical was a vellum pamphlet written by Volothamp Geddarm in late 1359 DR and published by Tym Waterdeep Limited Description . description_long: Volo ' s Guide to All Things Magical ( in - universe ) Volo ' s Guide to All Things Magical was a vellum pamphlet written by Volothamp Geddarm in late 1359 DR and published by Tym Waterdeep Limited Description . The guide was full of long - forgotten spells and a grab bag full of odds and ends about magic . History . Controversy . Several powerful mages , including Elminster would have preferred the spells and secrets in the guide remained unknown to the general public . All copies were hunted down and destroyed . Re - Release . In 1367 DR , a second pamphlet of the same name was released . This version , now named " Volo ' s Guide to all Things Magical , the Revised , Authorized & Expanded Edition " was extensively rewritten and edited by Elminster .

description: Volo ' s Guide to the Sword Coast This book is the third in the celebrated series of travel guides by Volothamp Geddarm . This book details settlements and attractions large and small , up and down the sword coast . It is written in Volo ' s trademark colorful and ( unintentionally ) humorous style .

title: Volo ' s rating system
description: Volo ' s rating system Volo ' s Ratings System was the means by which Volothamp Geddarm ranked taverns , inns , shops , alleyways , and so forth in his well - known guidebooks . The categories were as follows : Pipes . Used to rate the quality of inns , which were defined as any establishment that rented beds to travelers .
description_long: Volo ' s rating system Volo ' s Ratings System was the means by which Volothamp Geddarm ranked taverns , inns , shops , alleyways , and so forth in his well - known guidebooks . The categories were as follows : Pipes . Used to rate the quality of inns , which were defined as any establishment that rented beds to travelers . The rating took into account such things as decor , comfort , service , food , et cetera . The criteria did not include pricing . An inn received a number of pipes from being the lowest quality to being the highest quality . Tankards . Used to rate the quality of taverns , defined as any public establishment that serves alcoholic beverages . The rating took into account such things as atmosphere , watering of the drinks , service , decor , food ( if any ) , et cetera . The criteria did not include pricing . A tavern received a number of tankards from being the lowest quality to being the highest quality . Coins . Used to rate the pricing of all businesses . The rating compared the general prices of goods or services against the average for the city / country / region in which the business operated .

title: Volo ( familiar )
description: Volo ( familiar ) Volo was a bat living in West Harbor on the Sword Coast North in the 1370s DR . History . Volo was Amie ' s familiar .
description_long: Volo ( familiar ) Volo was a bat living in West Harbor on the Sword Coast North in the 1370s DR . History . Volo was Amie ' s familiar . She would ' ve summoned it in aid when it was necessary . Appendix . Trivia . Volo was named after Volothamp Geddarm , whose books were read by Amie .

title: Volodni
description: Volodni Volodni were sentient plant creature s native to the cold forests of Northeast Faerûn . History . Circa - 150 DR , a group of Nar refugees fled from the effects of the Great Conflagration into a nearby ancient forest .
description_long: Volodni Volodni were sentient plant creature s native to the cold forests of Northeast Faerûn . History . Circa - 150 DR , a group of Nar refugees fled from the effects of the Great Conflagration into a nearby ancient forest . Inside they were met by a powerful entity associated with that forest - an elder treant or perhaps , Silvanus himself - who gave them an ultimatum . They would forever have to give up their demon - binding ways and accept the blood of the forest as their own or they would be ejected from the wood . The Nar lord leading those men and women agreed immediately , fearing what would happen should they be forced back into the open and so he and his followers were transformed into the first volodni , walking humanoid pine trees . Since then though they were doomed to watch the erosion of their forest homes due to humanoid woodcutters . Some of these plant men became very hostile towards their flesh and blood cousins as a result .

title: Volothamp Geddarm
description: Volothamp Geddarm Volothamp Geddarm , or Volo for short , was a legendary traveler and storyteller , and was most famous for his guidebook published by Tym Waterdeep Limited . Personality . He was oft portrayed as the quintessential " go - to guy " of the Realms even if his information was , at best , half - accurate .
description_long: Volothamp Geddarm Volothamp Geddarm , or Volo for short , was a legendary traveler and storyteller , and was most famous for his guidebook published by Tym Waterdeep Limited . Personality . He was oft portrayed as the quintessential " go - to guy " of the Realms even if his information was , at best , half - accurate . He was too curious for his own good . Activities . As travelling scholar and minor wizard , Volo was always on the lookout for an exposé . He all too frequently was at odds with Elminster , who preferred some things to be kept in the dark . While Volo ' s reputation was well - earned and well - kept , there were others who tended to profit from it , the most well - known being Marco Volo , as he styled himself when it suits him , also known as Marcus Wands , of the famous Wands family of wizards . A trouble - making bard , Wands gained Volothamp ' s moniker after he stole an artifact from a powerful wizard , and laid the blame on the far more infamous scapegoat of the real Volo .

title: Volshur
description: Volshur Volshur the Crooked was a priest of Ilmater , of the 3rd century DR , who held the title " Exalted Servant " and helped create the legendary sword " Dornavver " , the " Demonbane " . History . To counter the growing spread of evil under the Shoon Imperium and a plethora of evil artifacts fashioned at the time , the Church of Ilmater sought a weapon to combat such evil .
description_long: Volshur Volshur the Crooked was a priest of Ilmater , of the 3rd century DR , who held the title " Exalted Servant " and helped create the legendary sword " Dornavver " , the " Demonbane " . History . To counter the growing spread of evil under the Shoon Imperium and a plethora of evil artifacts fashioned at the time , the Church of Ilmater sought a weapon to combat such evil . To this end , the sword " Dornavver " was completed in the Year of the Wrath Sword , 275 DR . On the night of the Feast of the Moon that same year , Volshur , along with Archsufferer Irmakul " Bloodthews " , Revered Brother Filithan and other senior clergy of Ilmater , took the sword and gathered at Allyn ' s Anvil in the Alimir Mountains east of Calimshan . There they conducted a holy ritual in which their impassioned prayers and howls of suffering enchanted the sword . These events were documented in the tome " Relics of the Righteous " .

title: Volzakaris
description: Volzakaris Volzakaris was a green dragon living near the Well of Dragons . History . When the Cult of the Dragon attempted to summon Tiamat into the world at the Well of Dragons , Volzakaris was one of the chromatic dragon heralds sent to ensure the coming of the Dragon Queen .
