title: Vongoethe
description: Vongoethe Vongoethe was a lich from Calimshan encountered in Amkethran in " " . He had come to the town in pursuit of a man called Marlowe and set up a lair in the cave used as a graveyard for the town . The player is likely to first hear about Vongoethe from Marlowe , who asks for their help and will tell that the lich was after his daughter Malla and has now stolen her soul .
description_long: Vongoethe Vongoethe was a lich from Calimshan encountered in Amkethran in " " . He had come to the town in pursuit of a man called Marlowe and set up a lair in the cave used as a graveyard for the town . The player is likely to first hear about Vongoethe from Marlowe , who asks for their help and will tell that the lich was after his daughter Malla and has now stolen her soul . He can also arrange access to the cave through the magical barrier Balthazar ' s monks have set up around the cave to keep Vongoethe from escaping . Once encountered , however , Vongoethe — who recognizes the player character as a " godling " and a fatal threat even to a lich — is willing to talk and reveal that it is Marlowe ' s soul he is after . He needs a soul given willingly , and Marlowe had bargained for his earlier on in exchange for worldly wealth and good fortune , but then escaped when payment was due . The lich will also destroy the stone containing Malla ' s soul if directly attacked . Otherwise , he ' s willing to hand it over in return for Marlowe being brought to him and made to willingly relinquish his own soul .

title: Voninheim
description: Voninheim Voninheim , ( which means " Titanhome " in Jotun , ) known also as the Bleak Palace , was a citadel in the Ice Spires . History . It was built by Lanaxis and formed the capital of the giant kingdom of Ostoria for over a thousand years .
description_long: Voninheim Voninheim , ( which means " Titanhome " in Jotun , ) known also as the Bleak Palace , was a citadel in the Ice Spires . History . It was built by Lanaxis and formed the capital of the giant kingdom of Ostoria for over a thousand years . When Ulutiu died and his amulet began to freeze the northernmost part of Faerûn , Voninheim was placed under threat by the advancing ice , but Othea , Lanaxis ' s mother , forbade him from intervening . Lanaxis attempted to defy Othea , but Voninheim was destroyed by the ice .

title: Vooka
description: Vooka Vooka was the most intelligent cornugon lieutenant in Dragonspear Castle circa 1363 DR . History . Vooka led one of the Hordes of Dragonspear , specifically the Blood Guard , a group composed of 300 orc s and 200 hobgoblin s .
description_long: Vooka Vooka was the most intelligent cornugon lieutenant in Dragonspear Castle circa 1363 DR . History . Vooka led one of the Hordes of Dragonspear , specifically the Blood Guard , a group composed of 300 orc s and 200 hobgoblin s . They were the main army of the hordes . Personality . Vooka wanted to impress Baazka with his cunning and intelligence . He was a master strategist and often advised his master during military campaigns .

title: Voonlar
description: Voonlar Voonlar was a small farming town located between the Dalelands and the Moonsea . It was more urbanized than most farming communities because it was located at an intersection of trade routes . The town was Shadowdale ' s main rival in many ways .
description_long: Voonlar Voonlar was a small farming town located between the Dalelands and the Moonsea . It was more urbanized than most farming communities because it was located at an intersection of trade routes . The town was Shadowdale ' s main rival in many ways . Geography . Voonlar was a crossroads town located on the North Ride between Shadowdale and Teshwave where the Shind Road split off toward Yûlash . Most of the town ' s important buildings were found at the " Y " created where the two trails met , known as " the Throat . " The town was on the edge of the northwestern arm of the Cormanthor forest , known locally as " Greentree . " The surrounding non - wooded area was dotted with farms , some quite large and prosperous . Government & Politics . Ostensibly , Voonlar was an independent town with a democratically elected sheriff called the Bron ( possibly a corruption of " baron " ) who performed the duties of judge and enforcer . The Bron had six full - time deputies who kept the peace . They wore the symbol of Voonlar , five white coins in a circle , emblazoned on the back and over the breast of dark green jerkins .

title: Voor
description: Voor Ecology . Voors have ravenous appetites for flesh and even greater appetites for blood ; the legacy of cruelty and murder they leave behind makes this obvious to those who have witnessed their rampages . Periodically a voor may spawn broods : it takes five years for a juvenile voor to reach maturity , after which it is ready for guard duty .
description_long: Voor Ecology . Voors have ravenous appetites for flesh and even greater appetites for blood ; the legacy of cruelty and murder they leave behind makes this obvious to those who have witnessed their rampages . Periodically a voor may spawn broods : it takes five years for a juvenile voor to reach maturity , after which it is ready for guard duty . For a long time the voor will stick close to the voor that spawned it , learning techniques for guarding an area and capturing prey . Society . Voors serve more powerful fiends because they ' re tough and dangerous enough to be effective , yet dim - witted enough to take orders without question . The voor is incredibility patient , as it can be content to sit and guard an area for weeks , waiting patiently for the opportunity to cause destruction and havoc . Due to its simple intellect , a voor can only comprehend simple commands like " Guard this area " or " Permit only humans who say ' Orcus ' to pass " — anything more complicated is simply lost to them . Unless told otherwise , the voor will pursue and destroy lesser fiends who enter the area it guards .

title: Vorasaegha
description: Vorasaegha Vorasaegha was an ancient guardian dragon living in Gray Forest in Impiltur during the Rage of Dragons of 1373 DR . History . Vorasaegha was a female bronze dragon in past ages prior to her death .
description_long: Vorasaegha Vorasaegha was an ancient guardian dragon living in Gray Forest in Impiltur during the Rage of Dragons of 1373 DR . History . Vorasaegha was a female bronze dragon in past ages prior to her death . Her spirit however continued to wander the forest she loved . In 1373 DR , in a desperate effort to destroy a Cult of the Dragon hideout hidden in the Gray Forest , the avariel Taegan Nightwind , leader of the remaining Impiltur an troops , and the faerie dragon Jivex evoked Vorasaegha , who incarnated herself in a bronze dragon . In that form , she attacked the cultists and entered into combat with the green dragon dracolich leader . The dracolich eventually found a way to expel the guardian spirit . However , the significant damage that the bronze dragon had inflicted allowed Taegan , Jivex , and the Impilturans to destroy the evil creature .

title: Vorbyx
description: Vorbyx Vorbyx is said , by the orc s and ogre s of Thar , to have been the " First King of Thar " . By 1373 DR no one remembers who Vorbyx was , or even what race Vorbyx was . What is known is Vorbyx united the orc and ogre tribes of Thar .
description_long: Vorbyx Vorbyx is said , by the orc s and ogre s of Thar , to have been the " First King of Thar " . By 1373 DR no one remembers who Vorbyx was , or even what race Vorbyx was . What is known is Vorbyx united the orc and ogre tribes of Thar . However , the time , Vorbyx took to do this was longer than the life span of an ogre or orc , thus part of the discusion of sages about his " true race " . Vorbyx ' s Hammer is a ledgendry weapon believed to have been used by Vorbyx .

title: Vordrorn Forest
description: Vordrorn Forest The Vordrorn Forest was a small forest at the base of the Ice Mountains , north of the fork . It was sometimes referred to as the Ghostwood , owing to the large number of incorporeal undead that seemed bound to it . Nearby areas of interest included Adbar Road , Ascore , and Fork Road .
description_long: Vordrorn Forest The Vordrorn Forest was a small forest at the base of the Ice Mountains , north of the fork . It was sometimes referred to as the Ghostwood , owing to the large number of incorporeal undead that seemed bound to it . Nearby areas of interest included Adbar Road , Ascore , and Fork Road . Description . As of around 1372 DR , the forest was seldom explored , and it was usually shrouded in chilly mist . The forest lay on top of caverns and dungeons dating back to ancient Illusk . At one time , a cult of sorcerer s , death - priests , and warriors practiced evil rituals in the forest , leaving behind black stone towers and crypts , protected by curses and magical wards . As of 1372 DR , at least one doomsphere ( a ghostly beholder ) was known to inhabit this area . It was also inhabited by ghost s , spectre s , and wraith s . Flora . The Vordrorn Forest was mainly pine trees and .

title: Vorgansharax
description: Vorgansharax Vorgansharax was an adult green dragon during the time of Tyranny of Dragons . Description . Vorgansharax was a massive dragon whose ego surpassed his size .
description_long: Vorgansharax Vorgansharax was an adult green dragon during the time of Tyranny of Dragons . Description . Vorgansharax was a massive dragon whose ego surpassed his size . Despite an old injury , Vorgansharax was an imposing figure . He was stronger and larger than other dragons of his age . Because of the injury , Vorgansharax was not a graceful flyer but compensensated for this by being a terrible adversary on ground . History . Vorgansharax was the offspring of the ancient green dragon Claugiyliamatar , who ruled Kryptgarden Forest far to the west . When he was a wyrmling he was greatly injured in a fight with a bronze dragon , resulting in a tattered and maimed right wing . During the Tyranny of Dragons , Claugiyliamatar , angered by intermissions in her forest , lent Vorgansharax ' s aid to the Cult of the Dragon . In 1489 DR , the Cult sent him in to Phlan to secure the Pool of Radiance and return it to its former power in exchange for Vorgansharax ' s rule . He managed to conquer the city killing most of the city ' s leaders at the Valjevo Castle He ruled until 1492 DR . However he had be subtly possess by Tyranthraxus .

title: Vorja
description: Vorja Vorja was a Red Wizard of Thay in the Doomvault dungeon in 1486 DR . Personality . Vorja had very little loyalty to the Red Wizards .
description_long: Vorja Vorja was a Red Wizard of Thay in the Doomvault dungeon in 1486 DR . Personality . Vorja had very little loyalty to the Red Wizards . History . Vorja was a Red Wizard assigned to the secret complex of Doomvault under Thaymount . However , in 1486 DR , he was found to be disloyal to his masters and was sentence to execution and placed in a cell guarded by some gargoyle s . Luckily for him , the heroes of Daggerford arrived and eventually freed him . Vorja easily betrayed his fellow Red Wizards , giving information about the dungeon to his liberators . Afterward , he might have joined Syranna and her cell of the Thayan Resurrection .

title: Vorkani Mountains
description: Vorkani Mountains The Vorkani Mountains were a mountain range that arced across the land of Koryo in northeastern Kara - Tur , lying at the end of the great Koryo Peninsula . They were also known as the Sillan Mountains . Geography .
description_long: Vorkani Mountains The Vorkani Mountains were a mountain range that arced across the land of Koryo in northeastern Kara - Tur , lying at the end of the great Koryo Peninsula . They were also known as the Sillan Mountains . Geography . The headwaters of the Malu River lay high in the Sillan Mountains . Locations . The Vorkani Mountains defined much of Koryo as a rough mountainous country . The towns of Manchar and Xi lay in or close beside the Vorkani Mountains , and the village of Mu Tong stood near the source of the Malu River . The mountains separated the settlements of T ' o na ' Chee and Xi from the rest of Koryo . One could view the mountains from Xai Chung . Inhabitants . The Panthers of Xi ninja controlled the northern mountains between Xi and the Malu River in the east . Somewhere , high in the mountains , likely near the town of Pan in the west , the yakuza wu jen No Ziar claimed a keep , in which he stored his hidden wealth . A handsome breed of " birdmen " ruled the tallest peaks of the mountains . They were enigmatic to the folk of Koryo . The monstrous Krestung lurked in the depths of the Vorkani Mountains .

title: Voronica Whitney - Robinson
description: Voronica Whitney - Robinson Voronica Whitney - Robinson is the author of several " Forgotten Realms " works , including two novels . She has also written novels in the " Ravenloft " and " Star Wars " settings . She resides in Seattle , USA , and works as a marine biologist .

title: Vorpal
description: Vorpal Vorpal was a magical enhancement for slashing weapons that increased the chance of the weapon severing an opponent ' s head . Creation . A powerful spellcaster needed the spells " keen edge " and " circle of death " to add this magic quality to a weapon .
description_long: Vorpal Vorpal was a magical enhancement for slashing weapons that increased the chance of the weapon severing an opponent ' s head . Creation . A powerful spellcaster needed the spells " keen edge " and " circle of death " to add this magic quality to a weapon .

title: Vosh
description: Vosh Vosh the White was a miller in the village of Toralth in Tethyr in 1370 DR . Description . Very few in Toralth knew that Vosh was a half - orc , thanks to his long beard .
description_long: Vosh Vosh the White was a miller in the village of Toralth in Tethyr in 1370 DR . Description . Very few in Toralth knew that Vosh was a half - orc , thanks to his long beard . The only orcish traits he inherited were a pug nose and features that he could hide underneath a thick beard . Activities . He often went to the Blue Badger Inn , being an old friend of the owner Jorid . History . On Uktar 10 , 1370 DR , three dwarves , Bapar Ghalmrin , Odak Truesteel , and Soram Battlebellow , entered the Blue Badger Inn , seeking the " Sondarr Scepter " . When Bramas Thorntree accused some of the other patrons of stealing it , this triggered a tavern brawl . Vosh was one of the ones who tried to separate and calm the brawlers .

title: Vourdakeq
description: Vourdakeq Vourdakeq was an ixzan teacher and a member of the Xendreth , the ruling council of of Malydren in 1370 DR . Personality . Vourdakeq was a severe disciplinarian .
description_long: Vourdakeq Vourdakeq was an ixzan teacher and a member of the Xendreth , the ruling council of of Malydren in 1370 DR . Personality . Vourdakeq was a severe disciplinarian . One of the reasons for her moniker were the brutal tail - lashings she administered to aspiring ixzan wizards . Activities . Vourdakeq was tasked with identifying and nurturing beginning ixzan wizard s selected from the younger ixzan .

title: Vournoth
description: Vournoth Vournoth was a lich that laired in a stagnant intersection in the Deep Wastes that became known as Vournoth ' s Mire . Personality . Vournoth had become well - known enough in the vicinity of Maerimydra that the lich ' s name was attributed to the mire it resided in .
description_long: Vournoth Vournoth was a lich that laired in a stagnant intersection in the Deep Wastes that became known as Vournoth ' s Mire . Personality . Vournoth had become well - known enough in the vicinity of Maerimydra that the lich ' s name was attributed to the mire it resided in . Abilities . The powers and abilities of a lich , like Vournoth , meant the creature was highly resistant to ordinary attacks and could paralyze foes with but a touch . Vournoth was considered dangerous enough by the drow of Maerimydra that they sent a champion out to face the lich . Possessions . A notable lich , Vournoth at one time had a phylactery that allowed the lich to reform after defeat . History . At some point , Vournoth managed to master the necromantic art of lich dom and took up residence in a mire roughly 40 miles ( 64 . 3 km ) from the drow city of Maerimydra in the Deep Wastes . Although many creatures had laired in the mire over the years , Vournoth ' s reputation eventually spread to such a degree that the fetid intersection became known as Vournoth ' s Mire .

title: Vournoth ' s Mire
description: Vournoth ' s Mire Vournoth ' s Mire was an area in the Deep Wastes between Szith Morcane and Maerimydra that had been the lair for numerous creatures over the years . Geography . Situated along the natural tunnels that connect the city of Maerimydra with the outpost of Szith Morcane , it was 40 miles north from Maerimydra itself and 50 miles from the Wailing Cliff .
description_long: Vournoth ' s Mire Vournoth ' s Mire was an area in the Deep Wastes between Szith Morcane and Maerimydra that had been the lair for numerous creatures over the years . Geography . Situated along the natural tunnels that connect the city of Maerimydra with the outpost of Szith Morcane , it was 40 miles north from Maerimydra itself and 50 miles from the Wailing Cliff . The mire was distinguished by an underground river that formed a narrow gully through the cavern and , over the years , had formed two stagnant lakes within the caves . This river eventually fed into the enormous Lake of Shadows to the west . History . Although many creatures had laired in the mire , the area earned its name from a lich called Vournoth who was perhaps its most notable inhabitant . In 800 DR , a drow champion from the city of Maerimydra eventually tracked down Vournoth and allowed for the establishment of a drow outpost of Szith Morcane in 804 DR . Over the next 100 years the drow used Vournoth ' s Mire as a well - patrolled campsite .

title: Vrag
description: Vrag Vrag was a cornugon lieutenant in Dragonspear Castle circa 1363 DR . History . Vrag led one of the Hordes of Dragonspear , specifically the Marauders , a group composed of one unit of 500 kobold s and one unit of 500 goblin s led by the able chieftain Pruj .
description_long: Vrag Vrag was a cornugon lieutenant in Dragonspear Castle circa 1363 DR . History . Vrag led one of the Hordes of Dragonspear , specifically the Marauders , a group composed of one unit of 500 kobold s and one unit of 500 goblin s led by the able chieftain Pruj . Personality . Vrag disliked his current position , believing he led the weakest army . In order to impress Baazka , he ordered his warriors to make very dangerous assaults .

title: Vragni Moonsmith
description: Vragni Moonsmith Vragni Moonsmith was a dwarf mummy in the Deep Wastes . History . During the Rage of Demons of 1491 DR , Vragni and his retinue were ambushed and killed by drow from Szith Morcane .
description_long: Vragni Moonsmith Vragni Moonsmith was a dwarf mummy in the Deep Wastes . History . During the Rage of Demons of 1491 DR , Vragni and his retinue were ambushed and killed by drow from Szith Morcane . However , Vragni rose as mummy and with a now - undead retinue slaughtered all living beings in the cavern where they were killed . Vragni was eventually confronted by an adventuring party supported by a priestess of Eilistraee . Personality . Vragni inflicted his vengeance upon all drow .

title: Vraith
description: Vraith Vraith was a wood elf female and a commander in the Order of Blue Flame located in the city of Ormpetarr . She held the rank of Accordant . She possessed a spellscar .
description_long: Vraith Vraith was a wood elf female and a commander in the Order of Blue Flame located in the city of Ormpetarr . She held the rank of Accordant . She possessed a spellscar . Vraith was inspired through visions sent by the Sharn to attempt to enlarge the Plaguewrought Land around Ormpetarr through the Ritual of the Border . She was convinced that she would be able to join with the Sharn if she pleased them by unleashing the spellplague . History . She was born in 1345 DR in the Chondalwood . In 1385 DR , the Spellplague appeared in her dormitory room at the wizard academy and touched her , forming the spellscar on her chest . Vraith devised a ritual to extend the border of the Plaguewrought Land . She convinced Brother Gregor that she intended to find a way to capture rogue areas of spellplague that remained in Faerûn and enlisted Gregor to create a potion that partially blocked the effects of the spellplague , which would allow pilgrim volunteers to survive long enough to complete the ritual . When Vraith learned that Duvan was immune to the spellplague , she ordered him captured and experimented on . Duvan later escaped with the help of Slanya .

title: Vrakk
description: Vrakk Vrakk was a Zhentilar general , and noted war hero in Zhentil Keep . He was bodyguard and co - conspirator with Fzoul Chembryl in the creation of " The True Life of Cyric " in 1368 DR History . In 1360 Vrakk led the orc army that the Zhent send to joined the allied armies led by Azoun Obarskyr IV in fighting against the Grand Army of the Tuigan in Thesk .
description_long: Vrakk Vrakk was a Zhentilar general , and noted war hero in Zhentil Keep . He was bodyguard and co - conspirator with Fzoul Chembryl in the creation of " The True Life of Cyric " in 1368 DR History . In 1360 Vrakk led the orc army that the Zhent send to joined the allied armies led by Azoun Obarskyr IV in fighting against the Grand Army of the Tuigan in Thesk . In 1370 DR , Vrakk was the second - in - command of the Zhentarim army in Zhentil .

title: Vreesar
description: Vreesar Vreesar was an ice devil who tried to conquer Faerûn . Description . Vreesar was a large , insectoid creature as were all gelugons .
description_long: Vreesar Vreesar was an ice devil who tried to conquer Faerûn . Description . Vreesar was a large , insectoid creature as were all gelugons . He had massive clawed hands and feet , sharp mandibles , compound eyes , and a thick tail with razored spikes . Abilities . Vressar could see in the dark , was telepathic , and had several spell - like abilities , such as the ability to magically fly or create a wall of ice . He could regenerate damage and emitted an aura of fear . If one were struck by Vreesar ' s tail , he or she would become frozen in place with extreme , magical cold . History . In 1366 DR , thanks to a planar rift from the Paraelemental Plane of Ice , Vreesar managed to enter Toril , in the Samek Valley near the Great Glacier north of Damara . Soon he took control of the gnoll Burnt Fur tribe after slaying its chieftain and planned to bring more of his fellow baatezu through the rift — preferably ones that could conquer the warmer lands of Faerûn . He hoped Toril would serve as a staging ground in the baatezu ' s fight against the tanar ' ri .

title: Vremyonni
description: Vremyonni The vremyonni or " Old Ones " were an arcane brotherhood in Rashemen . Organization . Men that were arcane spellcasters in Rashemen had two choices , exile or to join the vremyonni .
description_long: Vremyonni The vremyonni or " Old Ones " were an arcane brotherhood in Rashemen . Organization . Men that were arcane spellcasters in Rashemen had two choices , exile or to join the vremyonni . Many vremyonni were kept alive for eons by longevity magic . Activities . Vremyonni were expert weaponsmiths and magic item creators . On very rare occasions , vremyonni would fight in the defense of Rashemen . Tactics . Vremyonni used secrets of magic that even the Witches of Rashemen did not use , destructive spells forbidden among the wilds of Rashemen , in case such magic was needed . Base of Operations . The Running Rocks harbored secret strongholds of the vremyonni . Possessions . All vremyonni wore masks .

title: Vriild Denvenar
description: Vriild Denvenar Vriild Denvenar was a leading member of the derro Council of Savants in Gracklstugh in 1370 DR . Personality . Vriild ' s main concern was the new nation of Luruar , which Vriild saw as a successor of Ascalhorn , Myth Drannor , and Phalorm , and a menace to the derros ' ambitions on the surface .
description_long: Vriild Denvenar Vriild Denvenar was a leading member of the derro Council of Savants in Gracklstugh in 1370 DR . Personality . Vriild ' s main concern was the new nation of Luruar , which Vriild saw as a successor of Ascalhorn , Myth Drannor , and Phalorm , and a menace to the derros ' ambitions on the surface . His areas of expertise were the human history of northwest Faerûn , cartography , and prominent human wizards . History . Vriild was the leader of a faction of savants whose main field of study was the Realms Above . Over 1369 – 1370 DR , Vriild made close contacts with the Kraken Society in Yartar . Vriild offered to the Krakenar magical aid to infiltrate Luruar in exchange for sharing information .

title: Vrock
description: Vrock Vrocks , also known as Type I demons , were minor tanar ' ri demon s . Description . Vrocks appeared as a large cross between a vulture and a human .
description_long: Vrock Vrocks , also known as Type I demons , were minor tanar ' ri demon s . Description . Vrocks appeared as a large cross between a vulture and a human . They stood 8 feet tall and weighed 500 pounds . They had long arms , legs , and wings , and their bodies were covered with small gray feathers . They had the head of a vulture . Personality . Vrocks were considered quite stupid . They embodied the worst traits of the demonic race : betrayal , rage , and hatred . They delighted in slowly slaying mortal creatures and feasting on their warm entrails while the still - living victim watched in horror . They were very fond of humanoid flesh . Society . Vrocks served more powerful demons as guards and assault troops . They were carefully watched for disloyalty , however , as they were likely to switch sides without any notice . Vrocks and chasme hated each other . Combat . Vrocks were vicious fighters who like to fly down onto the enemy and claw them to cause as much damage as possible . The sound of their screech could paralyze foes , and they had the ability to emit poisonous spores upon contact .

title: Vrr ' maal
description: Vrr ' maal Vrr ' maal was a balor prince who dwelled in the Infinite Layers of the Abyss . He was known for keeping a great forge . One proposed method for destroying the dread artifact known as " Thakorsil ' s Seat " was to take it to the Abyss and drop into Vrr ' maal ' s forge .
description_long: Vrr ' maal Vrr ' maal was a balor prince who dwelled in the Infinite Layers of the Abyss . He was known for keeping a great forge . One proposed method for destroying the dread artifact known as " Thakorsil ' s Seat " was to take it to the Abyss and drop into Vrr ' maal ' s forge .

title: Vryloka
description: Vryloka Vryloka were a race of vampire - like nobles . History . The elders of their race made a deal with an entity known as the Red Witch .
description_long: Vryloka Vryloka were a race of vampire - like nobles . History . The elders of their race made a deal with an entity known as the Red Witch . They were proud and despised other undead . They considered themselves to be superior to the living . Physical description . Vyloka stood between 5 ' 4 " and 6 ' 2 " ( 1 . 5 — 1 . 8m ) and could easily pass for human s . Their extremely pale skin , which was often chalk white , was their most telling feature . Many had red hair but ebony black hair was found on occasion . Vryloka canine teeth were slightly more pronounced compared to humans . However , they did not have true fangs like vampires .

title: Vualdia
description: Vualdia Vualdia was a dukar of the Order of Maliirn and the morkoth member of the Nantarn Council . Personality . Vualdia was a strict conservative individual , believing that her opinion being facts .
description_long: Vualdia Vualdia was a dukar of the Order of Maliirn and the morkoth member of the Nantarn Council . Personality . Vualdia was a strict conservative individual , believing that her opinion being facts . Vualdia was arrogant and argumentative , often citing pieces of forgotten lore that herself only knew . She had no sense for compromise but despite all some councilors were swayed by her arguments .

title: Vuddar
description: Vuddar Vuddor ( singular vuddar ) were the specialty priest s of Thard Harr , the patron of the wild dwarves . Etymology . The word " vuddar " means " of the jungle " in the Authalan dialect .
description_long: Vuddar Vuddor ( singular vuddar ) were the specialty priest s of Thard Harr , the patron of the wild dwarves . Etymology . The word " vuddar " means " of the jungle " in the Authalan dialect . Reputation . The vuddor were held in high esteem by " dur Authalar " , who considered Thard Harr to be the only dwarven god . Organization . While the vast majority of vuddor were wild dwarves , Thard Harr ' s clergy did in fact include members of other dwarven subraces as members as well . About half of Thard Harr ' s clergy were vuddor . By 1370 DR about 40 % of the vuddor were male , a much higher percentage than in other dwarven clerical orders . Titles . Like all priests of Thard Harr , upon initiation into the order , a vuddar would be granted a special title from his or her god through a dream in the middle of the night . This title was usually the name of a great jungle beast . Activities . Along with the regular cleric s ( called " shamans " ) of Thard Harr , the vuddor led their fellow dwarves on hunts or into war and also served as the spokespeople for their tribes . They always prayed for their spells in the mornings . Abilities .

title: Vudlur
description: Vudlur The Vudlur was one of the watercourses of the Esmelflow in Amn . Geography . This creek began at a spring in the western Snakewood .
description_long: Vudlur The Vudlur was one of the watercourses of the Esmelflow in Amn . Geography . This creek began at a spring in the western Snakewood . It joined with the Golden Creek before flowing into the Splendarrllur . The Axe Bridge spanned its waters . History . The creek was named by the dwarves ; " vudlur " means " woods stream " in Dwarvish .

title: Vuhm Yestral
description: Vuhm Yestral Vuhm Yestral was a commander of Hillsfar ' s Red Plumes . Personality . Vuhm , despite being loud and opinionated , was kind and very devoted to the citizens of Hillsfar .
description_long: Vuhm Yestral Vuhm Yestral was a commander of Hillsfar ' s Red Plumes . Personality . Vuhm , despite being loud and opinionated , was kind and very devoted to the citizens of Hillsfar . He had no problems with nonhumans going to the city to trade . History . Vuhm was the Red Plumes ' leader in Hillsfar . During the Rage of Demons of 1491 DR , after many drow raids near the city , he led a Red Plume contingent to the Waydown , a recently formed sinkhole that the drow emerged from , in order to secure the location and stop the raids . He noted that the drow attacked in sunlight and were desperate individuals . Later for his few zeal in enforcing the Great Law of Humanity Vuhm was relocated to Yûlash . Later First Lord Torin Nomerthal and his court made a visit to Yulash , with the objective to deal with Damara ' s representatives ; Vhum showed to the Lord the situation in the city . After the successful revolution against Torin Vuhm Yestral became the new First Lord . He lead a Red Plumes contingent in Sporedome to join the assault to Maerimydra . Relationship . Vuhm was a member of the Lords ' Alliance .

title: Vulpomyscan
description: Vulpomyscan Vulpomyscan was a brown dragon who dwelt in the Citadel of Black Ash in Unther . History . Around −3000 DR , a clan of dwarves from the Brightstar Lake region began digging into the cliffs along the edge of the Black Ash Plain when they awakened Vulpomyscan , who ate their leaders and enslaved the remaining dwarves .
description_long: Vulpomyscan Vulpomyscan was a brown dragon who dwelt in the Citadel of Black Ash in Unther . History . Around −3000 DR , a clan of dwarves from the Brightstar Lake region began digging into the cliffs along the edge of the Black Ash Plain when they awakened Vulpomyscan , who ate their leaders and enslaved the remaining dwarves . He put them to work excavating and mining , and over the centuries , the dwarves and their descendents began worshiping him in the Citadel of Black Ash . Sometime after - 2087 DR , the human city of Unthalass began encroaching on Vulpomyscan ' s territory . He flew out and ransacked the human empire , thus angering the Untheric pantheon . They challenged Vulpomyscan , and Marduk fought him in the skies over the Black Ash Plain , eventually slaying him .

title: Vulture drake
description: Vulture drake A vulture drake , also known as a deathwing , was a type of drake that had been corrupted by the Shadowfell . Description . The drakes were large , menacing reptiles that could be used as mounts .
description_long: Vulture drake A vulture drake , also known as a deathwing , was a type of drake that had been corrupted by the Shadowfell . Description . The drakes were large , menacing reptiles that could be used as mounts . The vulture drake was a gaunt winged creature with taut skin and a skeletal physique . It had long and unwieldy wings . Combat . A vulture drake would prefer to focus on a single target , swooping in and allowing itself to sustain a hit , since this would enable it to use its death shriek . Once a target was eliminated , the vulture drake would take off again in order to repeat the process . Ecology . The vulture drake could commonly be found in the Shadowfell .

title: Vurgrom
description: Vurgrom Vurgrom the Mighty was an evil pirate in 1359 DR . History . Vurgrom rose the rank killing his captain .
description_long: Vurgrom Vurgrom the Mighty was an evil pirate in 1359 DR . History . Vurgrom rose the rank killing his captain . Vurgrom was an able pirate captain but a more able vendor of himself , always exaggerating his exploits at audience . In truth his secret was his ally the enchanter Zensil of Westgate how charm ed small schools of vicious sea - creatures to aid Vurgrom in his raids . He was challenged many times but always resulted victor . His main goal was become te new pirate lord but was opposed by Teldar . In 1359 Vurgrom was in feud also against the master of intrigue Crammar . He was a legend among younger pirates but many however feared that Vurgrom secretly may worked for Zhentil Keep . His main competitor in 1359 was Gasteban . In 1359 DR under payment from Westgate Vurgrom lead a raid against Teziir . In 1363 DR Vurgrom managed to defeat Teldar becoming the pirate lord . In 1369 DR he allied with Iakhovas during the Twelfth Seros War but suffered the defeat Vurgrom too

title: Vuzlyn Freth
description: Vuzlyn Freth Vuzlyn Freth was a drow and one of Houndaer Tuin ' Tarl and Syrzan ' s group in Menzoberranzan in 1372 DR . History . During the Silence of Lolth , Vuzlyn joined Houndaer ' s group in order to start a slave revolt .
description_long: Vuzlyn Freth Vuzlyn Freth was a drow and one of Houndaer Tuin ' Tarl and Syrzan ' s group in Menzoberranzan in 1372 DR . History . During the Silence of Lolth , Vuzlyn joined Houndaer ' s group in order to start a slave revolt . Vuzlyn and Alton Vandree were , among others , summoned to Pharaun Mizzrym and Ryld Argith , as might be some of the males they needed to find . Vuzlyn was eventually killed in the suppression of the revolt .

title: Vyaalis
description: Vyaalis Vyaalis was from the Coral Kingdom , a sea elven kingdom in the Trackless Sea near Evermeet . History . For a time , he lived in Memnon , learning the art of longsword fighting from Shieldlord Hastor el Khafar .
description_long: Vyaalis Vyaalis was from the Coral Kingdom , a sea elven kingdom in the Trackless Sea near Evermeet . History . For a time , he lived in Memnon , learning the art of longsword fighting from Shieldlord Hastor el Khafar . Something of a wanderer , Vyaalis ' s curiosity led him to explore the surface world in Calimshan and Tethyr . His interest in the longsword stemmed from his discovery of one among the wreckage of the " Pasha ' s Palace " , a sunken Calishite vessel .

title: Vyqinak
description: Vyqinak Vyqinak was an ixitxachitl vampire known as the Count of the Depths in the court of the Night King in Westgate as of the Year of the Tankard , 1370 DR . Activities . As Count of the Depths , Vyqinak was the junior Night Master in charge of all smuggling in the Westgate harbor .
description_long: Vyqinak Vyqinak was an ixitxachitl vampire known as the Count of the Depths in the court of the Night King in Westgate as of the Year of the Tankard , 1370 DR . Activities . As Count of the Depths , Vyqinak was the junior Night Master in charge of all smuggling in the Westgate harbor . He was also responsible for reports on shipping activity on the Dragon Coast . He was tasked by the Night King to seek out the wreck of the " Sapphire of Enki " , an Untheric sailing vessel believed to have been carrying a powerful magic tome titled " Songs of Sea Serpents " , written by Nezram " Worldwalker " . Vyqinak concentrated his search on the area between Westgate and Sembia , a sea bed covered in thick silt known as the Haunted Plains . Relationships . Vyqinak answered to the Duke of Shadows , Tebryn Dhialael , whose portfolio included all smuggling and thieving activity perpetrated by the Night Masks . In turn , Vyqinak ' s servents included a pack of lesser seawolves that worked on the docks and as hands on ships that regularly returned to Westgate . Vyqinak recruited Hrarnok Sharkchum as an assassin after discovering he was a seawolf whose shapechanging ability made an excellent cover .

title: Vyrlo Trath
description: Vyrlo Trath Vyrlo Trath was a member of the Cult of the Crushing Wave in Mulmaster . Relationships . Trath was a warrior affiliated with the Cult of the Crushing Wave .
description_long: Vyrlo Trath Vyrlo Trath was a member of the Cult of the Crushing Wave in Mulmaster . Relationships . Trath was a warrior affiliated with the Cult of the Crushing Wave . History . In 1491 DR , he was chosen to lead an expedition into Mulmaster ' s sewers , joined by Xaxan Thavish of the Cult of the Eternal Flame , to find the tomb of an ancient kuo - toa mystic devoted to Olhydra and Bwimb . However , a band of troglodyte s surprise - attacked their camp , killing Vyrlo .

title: Vyzzstek Nhynssoth
description: Vyzzstek Nhynssoth Vyzzstek Nhynssoth was the Arcane Brotherhood representative in Skullport . History . Around 1370 DR , Vyzzstek posed as a loyal lieutenant of Zstulkk Ssarmn but in truth was the eyes and ears of the Arcane Brotherhood under his master , the South Overwizard Deltagar Zelhund .
description_long: Vyzzstek Nhynssoth Vyzzstek Nhynssoth was the Arcane Brotherhood representative in Skullport . History . Around 1370 DR , Vyzzstek posed as a loyal lieutenant of Zstulkk Ssarmn but in truth was the eyes and ears of the Arcane Brotherhood under his master , the South Overwizard Deltagar Zelhund . His position permitted him to subtly aid the Host Tower of the Arcane ' s interests and , at the same time , he kept under surveillance the Harpers , the Kraken Society , and the Lords of Waterdeep .

title: Wa
description: Wa Wa is an island nation made up of several islands . Geography . The largest island and most populated island of Wa is known as Tsukishima composed of towering but extinct volcanoes and fertile lowlands .
description_long: Wa Wa is an island nation made up of several islands . Geography . The largest island and most populated island of Wa is known as Tsukishima composed of towering but extinct volcanoes and fertile lowlands . Uwaji the capital , is located on the east coast . The second largest island is knows as Shidekima . Shidekima is dominated by vast dry plains , making it mostly unsuitable for farming . To the north of Tsukishima lie the islands of Paikai and Machukara , and like Shidekima are sparsely populated . Paikai comprises of a cluster of islands covered with rugged mountains and stretches of volcanic ash . Machukara is a land of dense unchartered forests and is the northern most region of Wa . The rest of Wa is known as the Outer Isles comprising dozens of charted and hundreds of uncharted islands . Charted islands include The Isle of Devils , The Isle of One Thousand Pines , The Isle of the Gloomy Temple , The Isle of the Black Tree , The Isle of No Mosquitoes , The Isle of Immortality , The Isle of the Long Legged and Long Armed , The Isle of Gargantuas , The Isle of Poison and the Isle of Pearls . Society .

title: Wa - an
description: Wa - an Wa - an , or the Wa language , was a language spoken by the Wanese , inhabitants of Wa in Kara - Tur . Wa - an descended from the ancient Han language , as did Koryo and Kozakuran , and possibly others . Wa - an and Kozakuran were closely related ; some considered them only different dialects of the same language .
description_long: Wa - an Wa - an , or the Wa language , was a language spoken by the Wanese , inhabitants of Wa in Kara - Tur . Wa - an descended from the ancient Han language , as did Koryo and Kozakuran , and possibly others . Wa - an and Kozakuran were closely related ; some considered them only different dialects of the same language . There was perhaps 65 % comprehension between the two . Wa - an was abundant with polite expressional and flowery terminology . Etiquette rather than grammar regulated the proper usage of many phrases . Wa - an was divided up into a number of dialects for each of the Wanese social classes , each with vocabulary most often employed by folk of that class and not necessarily used by others . For example , the farmers and fishermen of the No class spoke No Wa - an , which featured a great deal of agricultural terminology that was not to be found in , say , Lords Wa - an .

title: Wadi ' a bint Sali
description: Wadi ' a bint Sali Wadi ' a bint Sali was an gnome sha ' ir within the Palace of the Enlightened Throne in Huzuz , the City of Delights , in 1367 DR . Activities . Wadi ' a was an assistant of the Grand Vizier , Alyana al - Azzazi .
description_long: Wadi ' a bint Sali Wadi ' a bint Sali was an gnome sha ' ir within the Palace of the Enlightened Throne in Huzuz , the City of Delights , in 1367 DR . Activities . Wadi ' a was an assistant of the Grand Vizier , Alyana al - Azzazi . Relationships . Her familiar was a fire gen named Ladok .

title: Wadsworth
description: Wadsworth Wadsworth was a Helm ite priest in Maztica in 1362 DR . Activities . Together with his fellows Delian and Elkhound , Wadsorth was a missionary in the village of Maju on the plains between the Chuapli Forest and the Narabatun Jungle .
description_long: Wadsworth Wadsworth was a Helm ite priest in Maztica in 1362 DR . Activities . Together with his fellows Delian and Elkhound , Wadsorth was a missionary in the village of Maju on the plains between the Chuapli Forest and the Narabatun Jungle . He acted as spokesman . History . In 1362 DR , he told an adventuring party hired by Bishop Devane about the missing priestess Mirandos . Wadsworth believed she ' d fallen from grace while Delian believed her to have been kidnapped by savages and Elkhound believed her under a curse .

title: Waelan
description: Waelan Waelan was the native language of the Ffolk . Speakers . Waelan was spoken by the Ffolk of the southern Moonshaes , although by 1372 DR the majority of Ffolk in the Isles spoke the Illuskan language of the Northlander s who had invaded their native home .
description_long: Waelan Waelan was the native language of the Ffolk . Speakers . Waelan was spoken by the Ffolk of the southern Moonshaes , although by 1372 DR the majority of Ffolk in the Isles spoke the Illuskan language of the Northlander s who had invaded their native home . The Ffolk who had migrated to the Five Kingdoms of the Utter East also spoke Waelan . Dialects . There were two major dialects of Waelan , Proper ( spoken in the Moonshaes ) and Five Kingdoms ( spoken in the Utter East ) . The two dialects were substantially different from each other as a result of their separation . Five Kingdoms Waelan was comparatively isolated by the Utter East ' s mountainous borders , yet also influenced by the Northmen settlers who ' d accompanied the Ffolk and by corsairs and merchants from across south Faerûn and north Zakhara . Related Languages . The term " Waelan " also referred to the group of languages including Waelan and Cosh , a little - known tongue spoken in the Nelanther Isles . The two secret druid ic languages , Drueidan and Daelic , were derived from Waelan . Script . Waelan and Cosh used the Thorass alphabet ; the druidic languages had their own secret script . Appendix .

title: Waerva Baenre
description: Waerva Baenre Waerva Baenre was a drow priestess of Lolth in Menzoberranzan and a member of House Baenre in 1372 DR . History . During the Silence of Lolth in 1372 DR , Waerva sought to increase her power by framing the ambassador of Ched Nasad , Faeryl Zauvirr , with plotting against Matron Mother Triel Baenre .
description_long: Waerva Baenre Waerva Baenre was a drow priestess of Lolth in Menzoberranzan and a member of House Baenre in 1372 DR . History . During the Silence of Lolth in 1372 DR , Waerva sought to increase her power by framing the ambassador of Ched Nasad , Faeryl Zauvirr , with plotting against Matron Mother Triel Baenre . However , Faeryl managed to survive an assassination attempt ordered by Waerva , thanks to the aid of Bregan D ' aerthe , who ' d been recruited by Triel to investigate the matter . Faeryl spoke to Triel , telling her that to end the Silence of Lolth they needed to ally Menzoberranzan and Ched Nasad . Triel agreed with Faeryl and vowed to find the person responsible for the false accusation against Faeryl . When Waerva discovered this , she tried to escape from Menzoberranzan , fearing the wrath of the matron mother . However , she was ambushed and presumably killed by some kobold s , former slaves who had escaped after Syrzan ' s failed insurrection .

title: Waervaerendor
description: Waervaerendor Waervaerendor , nicknamed by himself the Rapacious Raider , was the shadow of one of the most famous black dragon s in Faerûn . Personality . Waervaerendor shared an unusually powerful empathic link with his twin Voaraghamanthar .
description_long: Waervaerendor Waervaerendor , nicknamed by himself the Rapacious Raider , was the shadow of one of the most famous black dragon s in Faerûn . Personality . Waervaerendor shared an unusually powerful empathic link with his twin Voaraghamanthar . They truly acted as one soul in two bodies and their greatest fear was that someone would discover their secret . From a young age , Voaraghamanthar and his twin desired immortality but they were not interested in the normal dracolich transformation . However , they believed that Chardansearavitriol ' s condition was somehow different and tried to replicate it . Both dragons were able sorcerers . Waervaerendor liked face - to - face discussions with others . They saw most other creatures only as food or annoyances to be quickly disposed of . The exceptions were adventurers and other dragons . They avoided other dragons , not out of fear but in order to avoid being discovered as twins . Adventurers , on the other hand , they viewed as tools too useful to be killed and the Black Brothers needed to recover too many artifacts to not use adventurers that agreed to work for them . Activities .

title: Wah - ree
description: Wah - ree Wah - ree was an ancient abstract strategy board game in Faerûn , popular among giant s and played even by some of the gods . History . Legends stated that the game of " wah - ree " was invented by the gods themselves .
description_long: Wah - ree Wah - ree was an ancient abstract strategy board game in Faerûn , popular among giant s and played even by some of the gods . History . Legends stated that the game of " wah - ree " was invented by the gods themselves . The myths of the giants state that early in the history of the world , after thousands of years of war between the giants and the dragon s , the god of giants , Annam All - Father , made a truce with the god Garyx by agreeing with the dragon god to settle the war with a game of " wah - ree " . So skilled were the two opponents , that game ended in a stalemate , and the war came to an end . Another giant legend tells of two verbeeg s who played a single game of " wah - ree " over a 40 year period ! Appendix . Inspiration . It has been speculated that " wah - ree " was inspired by the real - life game of , a game in the family . However , the illustration of the game on p . 8 of " Giantcraft " does not look anything at all like mancala and instead appears to be similar to a board combined with three circles .

title: Wai Chi
description: Wai Chi Wai Chi was a Shou scribe on Akari in 1357 DR . History . Wai Chi was the scribe of Governor Ko Lei Kho .
description_long: Wai Chi Wai Chi was a Shou scribe on Akari in 1357 DR . History . Wai Chi was the scribe of Governor Ko Lei Kho . In 1357 DR , he guided Tai Ko town an adventuring party hired by Ko Mei Kho to stop the ochimo . Later that night , the ochimo appeared in the town and Wai Chi gave him a scroll with information about the adventurers . Despite this , the ochimo killed him and absorbed his soul .

title: Wai Gada Shinzu
description: Wai Gada Shinzu Wai Gada Shinzu was the emperor of T ' u Lung in 1357 DR . History . Wai Gada Shinzu ascended to become the Eighth Emperor of the Lui Dynasty in 1308 DR and soon after his cousin and regent Wai Yeh Yin disappeared .
description_long: Wai Gada Shinzu Wai Gada Shinzu was the emperor of T ' u Lung in 1357 DR . History . Wai Gada Shinzu ascended to become the Eighth Emperor of the Lui Dynasty in 1308 DR and soon after his cousin and regent Wai Yeh Yin disappeared . Wai Gada opened diplomatic relations with Shou Lung , defining the border between the two and halting large - scale military incursions . In 1357 DR , Wai Gada Shinzu argued with his brother Wai Gada Mo , governor of To ' an District , and soon after Wai Gada Mo was summoned by the Emperor in Wai , arrested , and put in Dakarazu Palace ' s dungeon . Activities . Wai Gada Shinzu , was always protected by his bodyguard army known as the Silent Tigers , led by the mercenary Ye ' ahn Joshu , believed by many to be a ninja . He usually lived in Dakarazu Palace in Wai and saw people from the outside only one day a week when he received court to review and judge civil disturbances and captured criminals . Personality . Wai Gada liked to collect caged birds ; he put one in almost every room of the palace . When he had too many , Wai Gada released some that he did not like any more while his companion Ye ' ahn practiced his archery skills on them .

title: Wai Locunni Eio
description: Wai Locunni Eio Wai Locunni Eio was the mother of the emperor of T ' u Lung . Personality . At 72 years of age , Wai Locunni had iron gray hair yet still had a straight back .
description_long: Wai Locunni Eio Wai Locunni Eio was the mother of the emperor of T ' u Lung . Personality . At 72 years of age , Wai Locunni had iron gray hair yet still had a straight back . She was sophisticated , strict , and prim and proper in her ways , and ruthless in dealing with those who failed her or stood against her . Activities . Wai Locuuni Eio was secluded in Dakarazu Palace in Wai . She remained close to the imperial court and quietly influenced affairs , insisting that all procedures and ceremonies be conducted in the proper ways . Locunni was the only person able to made demands of the Emperor and see them met . Rumors said that she always carried a dagger dipped in the poison of the yankara root , which could inflict instant fiery pains , to use against her opponents . History . In her youth , Locunni Eio was very beautiful . One day , Ku He Long prophesied that Locunni Eio would live until her son had lived for 60 summers . By 1357 DR , she still had many years to go before this prophecy could be fulfilled .

title: Wail of the banshee
description: Wail of the banshee Wail of the banshee was a necromancy spell that killed several creatures . Effects . The caster emitted a terrible scream that killed creatures who heard it , except for the caster .
description_long: Wail of the banshee Wail of the banshee was a necromancy spell that killed several creatures . Effects . The caster emitted a terrible scream that killed creatures who heard it , except for the caster . The more powerful the caster , the more creatures that could be effected by the wail . History . This spell was not Netherese in origin , nor was it created by Sammaster as many necromancy spells were during his dark days . Its history was otherwise unknown . Realmslore . " Wail of the banshee " was a very rare spell in the Realms . Szass Tam likely knew this spell .

title: Wailing Cliff
description: Wailing Cliff The Wailing Cliff was a 300 - ft - high ( 91 . 4 m ) cliff in the Deep Wastes that interrupted the tunnel between the Lake of Shadows and Maerimydra . Geography .
description_long: Wailing Cliff The Wailing Cliff was a 300 - ft - high ( 91 . 4 m ) cliff in the Deep Wastes that interrupted the tunnel between the Lake of Shadows and Maerimydra . Geography . Situated 18 miles ( 28 . 9 km ) east of the Lake of Shadows and 50 miles ( 80 . 4 km ) northwest of Vournoth ' s Mire , the Wailing Cliff was a 300 - ft - tall ( 91 . 4 m ) cliff that disrupted that passage . The cliff itself was pock - marked by three caverns of varying sizes , two smaller near the base and one much larger about half - way up . In addition to the geological disturbance , the Wailing Cliff had an unusual planar one too . Everything within ½ mile ( 0 . 8 km ) of the Wailing Cliff was subject to a convergence of the Plane of Shadow and the Material Plane . This phenomenon severely disrupted spell s like " shadow walk " , making it impossible to maintain . Despite this , within the area surrounding the Wailing Cliff , any spells that used shadow magic were greatly enhanced , whilst spells that utilized light or fire were much more difficult to cast . Two great iron chimes were placed at the top and bottom of the cliff .

title: Wailing Death
description: Wailing Death The Wailing Death was a magical disease that ravaged the city of Neverwinter in Tarsakh and Mirtul of 1372 DR . Most of the citizens of the city were dead or dying within a tenday of the first reported case . Neverwinter did not fully recover from the effects of the disease for an entire decade and it left the city vulnerable to Netherese infiltration .
description_long: Wailing Death The Wailing Death was a magical disease that ravaged the city of Neverwinter in Tarsakh and Mirtul of 1372 DR . Most of the citizens of the city were dead or dying within a tenday of the first reported case . Neverwinter did not fully recover from the effects of the disease for an entire decade and it left the city vulnerable to Netherese infiltration . History . The disease started in a region of the city known as the Beggar ' s Nest , one of the poorer districts . Clerics and healers were dumbfounded at the disease ' s resilience to both mundane and magical healing and hundreds were dead within days . The city was quickly quarantined to prevent the spread of the disease and a call was put out to brave persons to receive free training in order to create a taskforce of adventurers loyal to the city ( or at least to gold ) especially meant to combat the plague any way they could . At the same time , Lord Nasher Alagondar petitioned Khelben " Blackstaff " Arunsun to come up with an arcane cure .

title: Wailing Dwarf
description: Wailing Dwarf The Wailing Dwarf was a 4 , 000 ft ( 1 , 220 m ) stone sculpture of a dwarf named for the sound made by wind passing over and through the cavernous ears , eyes , and mouth . Geography . The Wailing Dwarf was located in the Troll Mountains of western Amn , carved from the easternmost peak , Mount Batyr .
description_long: Wailing Dwarf The Wailing Dwarf was a 4 , 000 ft ( 1 , 220 m ) stone sculpture of a dwarf named for the sound made by wind passing over and through the cavernous ears , eyes , and mouth . Geography . The Wailing Dwarf was located in the Troll Mountains of western Amn , carved from the easternmost peak , Mount Batyr . The monument faced eastward toward Breakback Pass in the Giant ' s Run Mountains . The southern slope of the mountain presented a rough climb to the shoulder of the massive structure . There , a 5 ft ( 1 . 5 m ) wide path cut out of natural rock skirted across the front of the edifice , ran between the twisting stone columns that made up his braided beard , and eventually reached his mouth . Defenses . The first challenge to gaining entry was the exposed climb up Mount Batyr and along the narrow path to the statue ' s mouth . The breezes in and out of the eyes and mouth were erratic ; from light zephyrs to gale - force winds . At their strongest , objects and creatures not securely fastened to stone were either blown out to plummet nearly 4 , 000 ft ( 1 , 220 m ) or sucked down the 100 ft ( 30 m ) throat to land unceremoniously in the First Antechamber .

title: Wailing Years
description: Wailing Years The Wailing Years , also known as the Plague Years , was a cataclysmic time period in the chronology of Toril and Abeir . Taking place between 1385 DR , the Year of Blue Fire , and 1395 DR , the Year of Silent Death , the Wailing Years was a period of ten years during which the effects of the Spellplague were at their worst . Summary .
description_long: Wailing Years The Wailing Years , also known as the Plague Years , was a cataclysmic time period in the chronology of Toril and Abeir . Taking place between 1385 DR , the Year of Blue Fire , and 1395 DR , the Year of Silent Death , the Wailing Years was a period of ten years during which the effects of the Spellplague were at their worst . Summary . After the death of Mystra , assassinated by Shar and Cyric in 1385 DR , the Weave collapsed triggering the Spellplague , a cataclysm of multiversal proportions that unraveled and reshaped flesh , stone , magic , and even space and time in its wake . A storm of virulent blue flames swept across the face of Toril and into the planes , until it reached the world of Abeir , where its devastating effects also changed that world . In the following decade , the effects of the Spellplague destroyed or reshaped entire regions , killed or mutated thousands of people , and even the gods and reality itself were forever changed .

title: Wailing wind
description: Wailing wind Wailing wind was a divine magic spell available to druid s of Eldath , the Mother Guardian of Groves . It warned the caster of any intrusion on a designated space and carried the sound of the intruder to the caster . Effects .
description_long: Wailing wind Wailing wind was a divine magic spell available to druid s of Eldath , the Mother Guardian of Groves . It warned the caster of any intrusion on a designated space and carried the sound of the intruder to the caster . Effects . A beginning caster could alarm a volume of space up to the equivalent of a 10 ft ( 3 m ) cube up to 15 ft ( 4 . 6 m ) away . This maximum volume increased dramatically for higher level casters while the range increased at a more moderate , linear rate . The area of effect was described verbally in the casting of the spell and could conform to a room , a passageway , a doorway , a cave mouth , a cavern , " etc . " When any creature larger than a common honeybee entered the designated area , the " wailing wind " whistled from the intruder ' s location toward the caster , carrying any speech or noises with it for one minute , but fading out after 100 yd ( 91 m ) . Again , higher level casters could extend this duration and range . The " wailing wind " had a unique tone and could be heard by anything with ears .

title: Wak Rathar
description: Wak Rathar Wak Rathar was a wizard living in Hillsfar in 1367 DR . As an old friend of Lord Maalthiir , he was permitted to do all he wished . Personality .
description_long: Wak Rathar Wak Rathar was a wizard living in Hillsfar in 1367 DR . As an old friend of Lord Maalthiir , he was permitted to do all he wished . Personality . Wak had a sick sense of humor . He enjoyed sending people into the Arena for only the sport of it .

title: Walaxyrvaan
description: Walaxyrvaan Walaxyrvaan ( preferred name Lynx ) was an elf from the Elmanesse tribe in the Wealdath who earned an apprenticeship at Blackstaff Tower . The name translates as Lynx of the Approaching Dusk . Appearance .
description_long: Walaxyrvaan Walaxyrvaan ( preferred name Lynx ) was an elf from the Elmanesse tribe in the Wealdath who earned an apprenticeship at Blackstaff Tower . The name translates as Lynx of the Approaching Dusk . Appearance . Walaxyrvaan had copper - coloured skin . Background . Walaxyrvaan , originally from the Elmanesse tribe of the Wealdath , was recommended by Arilyn Moonblade and Danilo Thann for apprenticeship at Blackstaff Tower . She was an apprentice there in 1374 DR , when she was not quite an adolescent .

title: Waleed ibn - Keram
description: Waleed ibn - Keram Waleed ibn - Keram was a gnome tax collector who worked at the Gate of the Ghost in Huzuz in 1367 DR . Activities . Waleed had an impeccable eye for spotting smugglers .
description_long: Waleed ibn - Keram Waleed ibn - Keram was a gnome tax collector who worked at the Gate of the Ghost in Huzuz in 1367 DR . Activities . Waleed had an impeccable eye for spotting smugglers . Her slight stature made her a natural fit for testing wagons for false bottoms . History . Smuggling was Waleed ' s trade for more than a decade in her youth . When caught , she was given a chance to redeem her name and pay her debt to society by helping catch other smugglers .

title: Walharrow
description: Walharrow Captain Walharrow was a minotaur pirate and inmate of Grimshackle Jail in Phlan . History . Walharrow was a feared pirate captain .
description_long: Walharrow Captain Walharrow was a minotaur pirate and inmate of Grimshackle Jail in Phlan . History . Walharrow was a feared pirate captain . At one point , however , he was captured and jailed at Grimshackle Jail . In 1489 DR , the corrupt jailer Iorg Brokenjaw , in order to free Rathene Fel , let Walharrow break free to use him as diversion . The minotaur pirate rampaged through the jail until an adventuring party there to interrogate Rathene confronted and defeated him .

title: Walking Statue
description: Walking Statue The Walking Statue was a 90 ft ( 27 m ) stone golem positioned on Gull Leap at the western end of Julthoon Street in Waterdeep by Khelben " Blackstaff " Arunsun to help defend the city . It was one of a set of eight such golems .
description_long: Walking Statue The Walking Statue was a 90 ft ( 27 m ) stone golem positioned on Gull Leap at the western end of Julthoon Street in Waterdeep by Khelben " Blackstaff " Arunsun to help defend the city . It was one of a set of eight such golems .

title: Walking Statue of Waterdeep
description: Walking Statue of Waterdeep Walking statues were mighty construct s built for the defense of holy temples , ancient vaults and the most important cities , castles and fortresses of Waterdeep . They often served as ethereal guardians that could attack other ethereal creatures approaching its guarded area . They were unswervingly loyal to their instructions or orders , carrying them out to the best of their abilities .
description_long: Walking Statue of Waterdeep Walking statues were mighty construct s built for the defense of holy temples , ancient vaults and the most important cities , castles and fortresses of Waterdeep . They often served as ethereal guardians that could attack other ethereal creatures approaching its guarded area . They were unswervingly loyal to their instructions or orders , carrying them out to the best of their abilities . Unlike most constructs , walking statues were free - willed , thinking creatures who could reason , learn and remember . They were able to stand still for centuries at a time , remaining endlessly vigilant , but all the while they would be deep in thought . Walking statues were capable of understanding Common and Draconic , but would speak only if they were commanded to do so by their creator or by any whom they recognized as an authority .

title: Wall against noise
description: Wall against noise Wall against noise was a spell unique to Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Effects . This spell created a wall of air that prevented sound from passing through .
description_long: Wall against noise Wall against noise was a spell unique to Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Effects . This spell created a wall of air that prevented sound from passing through . The wall blocked any sound - based attacks , such as a harpy ' s cry or a banshee ' s wail . Components . This spell required a white feather to cast .

title: Wall of fire
description: Wall of fire Wall of fire was an evocation or conjuration spell that raised a one - sided opaque curtain of flames in the form of a segmented wall or a circle . After the Spellplague , the wall was two - sided . Effects .
description_long: Wall of fire Wall of fire was an evocation or conjuration spell that raised a one - sided opaque curtain of flames in the form of a segmented wall or a circle . After the Spellplague , the wall was two - sided . Effects . The wall was oriented vertically with respect to the caster and did not move once created . The shape and the flaming side of the wall was determined by the caster and the maximum size of the wall was determined by the caster ' s level . The sheet of flame lasted for as long as the caster maintained concentration , or for a minimum time if the caster became distracted . The opaque curtain appeared up to 20 ft ( 6 . 1 m ) high and reddish - blue to violet in color if created by arcane magic or greenish - yellow to amber if created by divine magic . After the Spellplague , a " wall of fire " was limited to 40 ft ( 12 m ) in length , made up of 5 ft ( 1 . 5 m ) orthogonal segments , and only lasted a few seconds . The range of this spell was 50 ft ( 15 . 2 m ) . Any creature near the flaming side of the wall was subject to harm from the heat , although the farther away , the less intense the heat .

title: Wall of force
description: Wall of force Wall of force ( originally called Shan ' s forcewall ) was an evocation spell used by arcane casters to create and invisible force field . Some cleric s of were also granted this spell . Oathbinder genie s , a type of tasked genie , could create a wall of force effect innately .
description_long: Wall of force Wall of force ( originally called Shan ' s forcewall ) was an evocation spell used by arcane casters to create and invisible force field . Some cleric s of were also granted this spell . Oathbinder genie s , a type of tasked genie , could create a wall of force effect innately . Effects . The spellcaster could choose the shape of the wall , provided it remained in a plane . He or she could place the wall within close range , and it would last upwards from about minute in duration or until breached . The wall of force created by this spell was impervious to most forms of damage and to magic , but it was known to be weak to the " disintegrate " and " mage ' s disjunction " spells and to " rods of cancellation " and " spheres of annihilation " . The wall blocked creatures within the ethereal plane as well . Components . In addition to verbal and somatic component s , the caster required a pinch of powder ground from a clear gem ( such as rusteen ) to cast this spell , which vanished . History . The spell was invented by the Netherese arcanist Shan in −624 DR — his final recorded spell .

title: Wall of ice
description: Wall of ice Wall of ice , formerly known as Veridon ' s ice wall , was an evocation spell that created a thick , opaque , sheet or dome of ice . After the Spellplague , only the wall form was available . " Wall of ice " could be cast by sorcerer s , wizard s , and cleric s who commanded the cold or ocean domain s .
description_long: Wall of ice Wall of ice , formerly known as Veridon ' s ice wall , was an evocation spell that created a thick , opaque , sheet or dome of ice . After the Spellplague , only the wall form was available . " Wall of ice " could be cast by sorcerer s , wizard s , and cleric s who commanded the cold or ocean domain s . In the time of Netheril , it could be cast by arcanist s of the Inventive or Variation specializations . Effects . All versions of this spell created a smooth , unbroken feature of ice , but they varied in size , shape , and support requirements . Older versions of this spell did not require the ice sheet to be anchored to anything , thus allowing a caster to cause it to fall upon opponents , creating an effect similar to " ice storm " . Another form that could be created before the Spellplague was a dome of at least 10 ft ( 3 . 1 m ) radius . Walls and domes both required a solid anchor . Vertical walls were anchored to the floor , while slanted or horizontal walls required two anchoring surfaces . After the Spellplague , the wall was made up of contiguous 5 ft ( 1 . 5 m ) square orthogonal segments anchored to the floor .

title: Wall of iron
description: Wall of iron Wall of iron is a conjuration spell that creates a dense iron barrier . Effect . You cause a flat , vertical iron wall to spring into being .
description_long: Wall of iron Wall of iron is a conjuration spell that creates a dense iron barrier . Effect . You cause a flat , vertical iron wall to spring into being . This wall can be used to seal off a passage or close a breach , for the wall inserts itself into any surrounding nonliving material if its area is sufficient to do so . The wall cannot be conjured so that it occupies the same space as a creature or another object . It must always be a flat plane , though you can shape its edges to fit the available space . The wall of iron is 1 inch thick per four caster levels . You can double the wall ’ s area by halving its thickness . Each 5 - foot square of the wall has 30 hit points per inch of thickness . Creatures can hit the wall automatically , but it is so hard that the first 10 points of damage from each blow are ignored . ( For example , a blow of 17 points of damage deals only 7 to the wall . ) A section of wall whose hit points drop to 0 is breached . If a creature tries to break through the wall with a single attack , the DC for the Strength check is 25 + 2 per inch of thickness .

title: Wall of sand
description: Wall of sand Wall of sand was an arcane evocation spell that created a temporary wall made of spinning sand . Effects . This spell could create a wall up to 12 ft ( 3 .
description_long: Wall of sand Wall of sand was an arcane evocation spell that created a temporary wall made of spinning sand . Effects . This spell could create a wall up to 12 ft ( 3 . 7 m ) high . The thickness and length of the wall were limited by the level of the caster . The largest wall that could be created by a wizard meeting the minimum requirements for this spell was 7 ft ( 2 . 1 m ) thick and 28 ft ( 8 . 5 m ) long . The wall required a solid footing and once its dimensions were set they could not be altered . The wall did not require further concentration by the caster and lasted for one minute per level of the caster , or until the caster dispelled it , whichever came first . The wall was a swirling mass of sand that was completely opaque but not solid . Open flames engulfed by the wall were immediately extinguished . Movement through the wall was possible at half speed , but while encased in sand , normal creatures could not see , breathe , speak , or cast spells . Creatures requiring respiration began to suffocate after one minute within the wall . Because of the impairment to movement and perception , those emerging from the wall were much easier targets for attack .

title: Wall of stone
description: Wall of stone Wall of stone is a conjuration or evocation spell that summons a mutable stone wall . Effect . This spell creates a wall of rock that merges into adjoining rock surfaces .
description_long: Wall of stone Wall of stone is a conjuration or evocation spell that summons a mutable stone wall . Effect . This spell creates a wall of rock that merges into adjoining rock surfaces . It is typically employed to close passages , portals , and breaches against opponents . The " wall of stone " is 1 inch thick per four caster levels and composed of up to one 5 - foot square per level . You can double the wall ’ s area by halving its thickness . The wall cannot be conjured so that it occupies the same space as a creature or another object . Unlike a " wall of iron " , you can create a " wall of stone " in almost any shape you desire . The wall created need not be vertical , nor rest upon any firm foundation ; however , it must merge with and be solidly supported by existing stone . It can be used to bridge a chasm , for instance , or as a ramp . For this use , if the span is more than 20 feet , the wall must be arched and buttressed . This requirement reduces the spell ’ s area by half . Thus , a 20th - level caster can create a span with a surface area of ten 5 - foot squares .

title: Wall of the Faithless
description: Wall of the Faithless The Wall of the Faithless is the wall surrounding the City of Judgment on the Fugue Plane . It was erected by Myrkul to punish the souls of beings who claimed no patron god . When a faithful mortal dies , it can then petition their respective gods for entry to their plane of influence .
description_long: Wall of the Faithless The Wall of the Faithless is the wall surrounding the City of Judgment on the Fugue Plane . It was erected by Myrkul to punish the souls of beings who claimed no patron god . When a faithful mortal dies , it can then petition their respective gods for entry to their plane of influence . The faithless were absorbed into the wall of souls and wholly become a part of it . Those who examine the Wall of the Faithless can see the faces and skulls of the countless souls absorbed into the very fabric of the wall . Initially , the faithless are cemented into the wall with a green , supernatural mold .

title: Wall of thorns
description: Wall of thorns Wall of thorns was a conjuration spell that called a dense , thorny thicket into existence . Effects . A tangled mass of wiry scrub with needle - like thorns as long as a human finger was temporarily created by this spell .
description_long: Wall of thorns Wall of thorns was a conjuration spell that called a dense , thorny thicket into existence . Effects . A tangled mass of wiry scrub with needle - like thorns as long as a human finger was temporarily created by this spell . The size of the thicket was one 10 ft ( 3 . 1 m ) cube per level of the caster and could be shaped in any contiguous path or structure up to the maximum volume the caster could summon . Optionally , the caster could make twice as many wall segments of only 5 ft ( 1 . 5 m ) thickness . The barrier could be dismissed by the caster at any time . Impacting or moving through these prickly shrubs subjected the unfortunate being to slashing damage from the thorns . Only creatures with the ability to move through overgrown terrain unhindered could pass " wall of thorns " at normal speed undamaged . The better the armor worn by the victim , the less harm was incurred . Sufficient armor coverage could result in no damage whatsoever . If a creature was caught in the area of effect as the matrix of thorns appeared , they were considered to have impacted the wall and took damage accordingly .

title: Walls of Halruaa
description: Walls of Halruaa The Walls were a crescent - shaped mountain range that towered up to 20 , 000 feet ( 6 , 100 meters ) over Halruaa , surrounding the country on three sides . Geography . Prior to the Spellplague the mountains formed a natural defense for the realm .
description_long: Walls of Halruaa The Walls were a crescent - shaped mountain range that towered up to 20 , 000 feet ( 6 , 100 meters ) over Halruaa , surrounding the country on three sides . Geography . Prior to the Spellplague the mountains formed a natural defense for the realm . The three sections of the mountain range – the Nathaghal , Lhairghal , and Muaraghal Mountains – formed a stout border . Unfortunately , the range ' s height made it difficult for Halruaans to escape the effects of the Spellplague . Three passes connected the remnants of Halruaa to the rest of Faerûn . The Azhal Pass and Talath Pass were difficult for a large group to travel . Only the wider High Aluar pass offered a secure route for any sizable group .

title: Wan - yen Ch ' eng - shih
description: Wan - yen Ch ' eng - shih Wan - yen Ch ' eng - shih was the Shou magistrate of Kwachow in 1359 DR . Personality . Wan - yen was a lazy ruler who was disinterested in his post .
description_long: Wan - yen Ch ' eng - shih Wan - yen Ch ' eng - shih was the Shou magistrate of Kwachow in 1359 DR . Personality . Wan - yen was a lazy ruler who was disinterested in his post . Activities . Wan - yen cared little for his subjects , preferring to tax them heavily to fund his extravagant luxuries and desires . He allowed the guards to bully the population of Kwachow .

title: Wan Tu Ma
description: Wan Tu Ma Wan Tu Ma was a barbarian in Shou Lung . History . Hailing from Ma ' Yuan , Wan worked as a weapon - smith , horseman , and bodyguard for his sometime romantic interest Mei Li Mao .
description_long: Wan Tu Ma Wan Tu Ma was a barbarian in Shou Lung . History . Hailing from Ma ' Yuan , Wan worked as a weapon - smith , horseman , and bodyguard for his sometime romantic interest Mei Li Mao . Around , 1357 DR , he was usually found at the Imperial Phoenix restaurant in Kuo Te ' Lung .

title: Wanang Sun
description: Wanang Sun Wanang Sun was a male human samurai and the warlord and king of Koryo in Kara - Tur , ruling from the capital city of Xi Hulang . He was the first of the Wanang dynasty . History .
description_long: Wanang Sun Wanang Sun was a male human samurai and the warlord and king of Koryo in Kara - Tur , ruling from the capital city of Xi Hulang . He was the first of the Wanang dynasty . History . Wanang Sun was born around 1299 DR . As a young man , he trained at the Do Jang of Won Kwang in Pyong Do , learning the arts of war and other skills . In time , he became a general in service to the king of Silla . In the early 14th century DR , Silla was at war with the kingdoms of Koguryo and Saishu . General Wanang Sun was instrumental in Silla ' s campaign , aiding the king of Silla in overcoming the other kingdoms . However , he plotted to become king himself one day and laid the foundation for a more secure and prosperous realm . In the 1330s DR , with Sun ' s aid , the king of Silla conquered Koguryo and Saishu , unifying the whole land of Choson into the Sillan Empire and defending against all threats . However , the Sillan king proved to be a tyrant , inflicting crippling taxes and martial law on Saishu , occupying it with Sillan troops .

title: Wand
