description_long: Wunturn Radest Wunturn Radest was the high priest of the temple of Tempus within the city of Mulmaster . Relationships . Radest and the rest of the clergy served the army of Mulmaster as the majority of its forces shared in the worship of the Lord of Battles . A veteran of many battles in just as many campaigns , Wunturn inspired countless soldiers to raise arms against the enemies of Mulmaster .

title: Wurlitzer
description: Wurlitzer Wurlitzer was a tavern owner and cook in Skullport . Relationship . Wurlitzer hated the halfling Smallfry .
description_long: Wurlitzer Wurlitzer was a tavern owner and cook in Skullport . Relationship . Wurlitzer hated the halfling Smallfry . He also had bad dealings with Gyudd , who would no longer supply him with beer . Wurlitzer was assisted by the morose Oslo . History . Around 1370 DR , the rivalry between Wurlitzer and the halfling Smallfry had become legend in the city . Wurlitzer tried every means at his disposal , including illegal ones , to understand why his opponent enjoyed more success than him . All his work was for naught .

title: Wurt Dumire
description: Wurt Dumire Wurt Dumire was a tyrant ruling the goblin realm of the Kingdom of Nix in the Utter East during the time of the Bloodforge Wars ( 648 – 657 DR ) . In the aftermath of Redfang the Reaper ' s reign , Wurt Dumire came to enslave the goblins of Nix , putting them to work in a far - off mine . The commander of the Legendary Campaign felt unexpected sympathy for the goblins ' plight and was compelled to try to bring an end to Wurt ' s operation in a bloodforge battle in Nix itself .
description_long: Wurt Dumire Wurt Dumire was a tyrant ruling the goblin realm of the Kingdom of Nix in the Utter East during the time of the Bloodforge Wars ( 648 – 657 DR ) . In the aftermath of Redfang the Reaper ' s reign , Wurt Dumire came to enslave the goblins of Nix , putting them to work in a far - off mine . The commander of the Legendary Campaign felt unexpected sympathy for the goblins ' plight and was compelled to try to bring an end to Wurt ' s operation in a bloodforge battle in Nix itself .

title: Wydda
description: Wydda Wydda was the monk sacristan of the Monastery of the Yellow Rose . History . Wydda was a monk of vaguely elven ancestry from Aglarond who went to the Monastery of the Yellow Rose , where she became the high cleric .
description_long: Wydda Wydda was the monk sacristan of the Monastery of the Yellow Rose . History . Wydda was a monk of vaguely elven ancestry from Aglarond who went to the Monastery of the Yellow Rose , where she became the high cleric . Personality . Wydda was patient , wise , and caring . However , she spent more time praying than among her flock . She was impressed by people showing compassion , endurance , or theological knowledge . Activities . Wydda was the sacristan of the Temple of Ilmater inside the Monastery of the Yellow Rose . Her duty was praying and offering guidance to her fellow monks .

title: Wykarr
description: Wykarr Wykarr was a fence and a member of the Shadow Thieves in Port Kir around 1370 DR . Personality . Wykarr had a keen eye for details .
description_long: Wykarr Wykarr was a fence and a member of the Shadow Thieves in Port Kir around 1370 DR . Personality . Wykarr had a keen eye for details . He had a pleasant manner , but would not put up with rudeness . Many times he ejected greedy thieves or adventurers ( whom he saw as much the same ) from his store . Activities . Wykarr worked as a tinsmith as a cover for his fencing activities . The upper floor of the store was a gambling hangout run by the Shadow Thieves and they often appeared to help Wykarr in case of problems .

title: Wyl Mossfeld
description: Wyl Mossfeld Wyl Mossfeld was a male human of the village of West Harbor on the Sword Coast North in the 1370s DR . Activities . Wyl , like his brothers , was the member of West Harbor militia .
description_long: Wyl Mossfeld Wyl Mossfeld was a male human of the village of West Harbor on the Sword Coast North in the 1370s DR . Activities . Wyl , like his brothers , was the member of West Harbor militia . History . Wyl was the bully of the West Harbor , who would tease Kalach - Cha , Bevil Starling and Amie Fern . They were the champions of the Harvest Fair several years . During the Harvest Fair , Wyl and his brothers were the winners of the Harvest Brawl . The Kalach - Cha , after defeating the Lannon siblings , would ' ve faced him and his brothers , Ward and Webb . If the Kalach - Cha , Amie and Bevil were defeated , they could ' ve asked Merring for a rematch or submit that Mossfelds won . During the attack of bladeling s and duergar , the Kalach - Cha could ' ve encountered Wyl , who would ask for their help . The Kalach - Cha could ' ve healed him ( either through magic or getting Merring ' s herbs ) and get to the field , or simply slay him due to " his wounds being too thick to be healed " . When the Kalach - Cha returns to the village to craft the Sword of Gith , he / she encountered Wyl and his brothers . However , it was an ambush , as they were shadows .

title: Wylan Burral
description: Wylan Burral Wylan Burral was a high - ranking member of the Cult of the Black Earth in Mulmaster . Personality . On the surface , Wylan was a jovial and friendly individual , wanting to enjoy the finer things in life .
description_long: Wylan Burral Wylan Burral was a high - ranking member of the Cult of the Black Earth in Mulmaster . Personality . On the surface , Wylan was a jovial and friendly individual , wanting to enjoy the finer things in life . He was quick to offer a drink , a joke , or ( more commonly ) both . However , it was all a facade : in truth , he was full of determined malice and passion for his cause . He usually encouraged bold actions as a sign of his ( false ) devotion to Tymora . History . Wylan was a high - ranking member of the Cult of Black Earth who was disguised a low - ranking member of the temple of Tymora in Mulmaster . Around 1490 DR , he resurrected his sister , Aleyd Burral , after her corpse was taken from Phlan . In 1491 , Wylan was one of the chief supporters of Selfaril Uoumdolphin in his return to power , hoping to destroy the Church of Bane that had stopped the earth cultists ' expansion in the city . Later , Wylan supported his sister in creating an army in order to retake Phlan but used this opportunity to corrupt her into advancing the earth cult ' s cause .

title: Wyllowwood
description: Wyllowwood Wyllowwood is an area of Undermountain . Access . There are numerous ways to enter Wyllowwood , although none are immediately apparent .
description_long: Wyllowwood Wyllowwood is an area of Undermountain . Access . There are numerous ways to enter Wyllowwood , although none are immediately apparent . Malar . Many of the inhabitants of Wyllowwood worship the Beast Lord Malar . The area is well - suited to Malarites because it is near a large forest , yet underground and quite private . Most of the High Hunt s that are conducted by Wyllowwood ' s Malarite inhabitants are conducted in this forest . The hunt ' s winner is determined by the person who has collected the most shields and skulls in a one - month period , and Malar grants this person more powerful spells .

title: Wyn Ashgrove
description: Wyn Ashgrove Wyn Ashgrove was an elven bard and spellsinger . Description . Wyn was graceful , with golden skin , short curly black hair , and green eyes .
description_long: Wyn Ashgrove Wyn Ashgrove was an elven bard and spellsinger . Description . Wyn was graceful , with golden skin , short curly black hair , and green eyes . He had a serious mien and was about five and a half feet tall . History . Wyn had been apprenticed to Kerigan the Bold , a skald from the Moonshaes . In 1364 DR at the Spring Faire in Silverymoon , Wyn noticed that old songs passed on through the ages had inexplicably changed , yet not even the singers seemed to notice . He reported his findings to Khelben " Blackstaff " Arunsun in Waterdeep , who sent him to travel with Danilo Thann and the dwarf Morgalla to determine the cause . They determined that Iriador Wintermist was using the Morninglark harp to place a curse upon the Harpers and the people of Waterdeep . Wyn traveled with the group to the High Forest and back and aided in the retrieval of the Morninglark . Wyn was last seen traveling with Morgalla to her people in the Earthfast Mountains . Possessions . Wyn carried a deep green crystal flute and a silver " lyre of changing " , which upon command could change into any instrument of its size of smaller .

title: Wyndra Syrylstone
description: Wyndra Syrylstone Wyndra Syrylstone was a human woman of the city of Calaunt in the Vast . She was a priestess of Selûne . She was the High Priestess , or " Moon Mistress " , of the Moonsilver House temple by 1358 DR , a position which she still held by 1370 DR .
description_long: Wyndra Syrylstone Wyndra Syrylstone was a human woman of the city of Calaunt in the Vast . She was a priestess of Selûne . She was the High Priestess , or " Moon Mistress " , of the Moonsilver House temple by 1358 DR , a position which she still held by 1370 DR . She had twenty - two subordinate priests and 229 lay - followers .

title: Wynn Castle
description: Wynn Castle Wynn Castle was the keep of Earl Radborne Wynn of Hartsvale . Location . Wynn Castle was located east of the Clear Whirl River , south of where its tributary , the Wyrm River , joined it .
description_long: Wynn Castle Wynn Castle was the keep of Earl Radborne Wynn of Hartsvale . Location . Wynn Castle was located east of the Clear Whirl River , south of where its tributary , the Wyrm River , joined it . Its location permitted it to serve as a defensive point for the southern passes that led to the rest of the civilized regions of Faerûn . Structure . The castle was the second - strongest castle in Hartsvale ; only Castle Hartwick was better fortified . It was circled by a moat and had two curtain walls surrounding and inner keep . This inner keep ( Wynn Keep ) had four towers at its corners , which rose higher than the inner curtain wall , and a drawbridge . The towers were named and included the red tower , the flag tower , and the queen ' s tower . History . Throughout its history , Wynn Castle had withstood attacks from fire giant s . After the battle with fire giant s in the Gorge of the Silver Wyrm in 1369 DR , Queen Brianna , her newborn child , Avner , Tavis Burdun , and Basil retreated to this castle . The castle quickly fell under siege from an alliance of giant - kin , including firbolg s , verbeeg s , and even fomorian s .

title: Wynne Cromm
description: Wynne Cromm Wynne Cromm was a commander in the Lizard Marsh sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . Activities . Wynne ruled over Cromm Hold , a keep that watched over the Marsh in order to detect all signs of lizardfolk activities .
description_long: Wynne Cromm Wynne Cromm was a commander in the Lizard Marsh sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . Activities . Wynne ruled over Cromm Hold , a keep that watched over the Marsh in order to detect all signs of lizardfolk activities . History . In the late 1480s or early 1490s DR , Wynne conspired with the succubus Pencheska to capture the Duchess of Daggerford Morwen Daggerford .

title: Wynter
description: Wynter Wynter was a centaur and an agent of the Harpers . Personality . Wynter was a kind of pacifist , fighting only if he really had no other options .
description_long: Wynter Wynter was a centaur and an agent of the Harpers . Personality . Wynter was a kind of pacifist , fighting only if he really had no other options . He preferred to avoid confrontations by using words . This was also because he was very confident about his fighting skills . Wynter greatly disliked the Red Wizards of Thay . History . Wynter was born in Thay . His father treated his slaves very harshly , and Wynter grew disgusted by this practice and abandoned his home . After some outlaws robbed him , he met Galvin , who helped him to recover his goods and afterward inducted him into the Harpers . In 1362 DR , he and Galvin were instructed by Brenna Graycloak to infiltrate Thay to uncover some plots . During the mission , Wynter posed as a buyer and managed to free a group of slaves . They discovered the evil plans of the Zulkir Maligor and , thanks also to the help of the lich Zulkir Szass Tam , defeated him .

title: Wyrekka Kusell
description: Wyrekka Kusell Wyrekka Kusell was a bard famous in the eastern Sea of Fallen Stars and the regional agent of the Moonstars for Thesk , Impiltur , Narfell and Great Dale in the Year of the Tankard , 1370 DR . History . Wyrekka made her home in Telflamm when she wasn ' t wandering Thesk , Impiltur , and the Great Dale .
description_long: Wyrekka Kusell Wyrekka Kusell was a bard famous in the eastern Sea of Fallen Stars and the regional agent of the Moonstars for Thesk , Impiltur , Narfell and Great Dale in the Year of the Tankard , 1370 DR . History . Wyrekka made her home in Telflamm when she wasn ' t wandering Thesk , Impiltur , and the Great Dale .

title: Wyrm River
description: Wyrm River Wyrm River in Hartsvale was a tributary of the Clear Whirl River . Description . Wyrm River froze solid in the winter months .
description_long: Wyrm River Wyrm River in Hartsvale was a tributary of the Clear Whirl River . Description . Wyrm River froze solid in the winter months . Geography . The river flowed from the Ice Spires South , flowed through the Gorge of the Silver Wyrm , and fed the Clear Whirl .

title: Wyrmcrown
description: Wyrmcrown The Wyrmcrown was a powerful dragon artifact . Abilities . The Wyrmcrown allowed its bearer to magically poison any dragon who was blood - related to it , or a dragon whose blood the bearer had tasted .
description_long: Wyrmcrown The Wyrmcrown was a powerful dragon artifact . Abilities . The Wyrmcrown allowed its bearer to magically poison any dragon who was blood - related to it , or a dragon whose blood the bearer had tasted . The Wyrmcrown could affect any dragon within the continent of Returned Abeir . History . As of 1479 DR , the Wyrmcrown was in the possession of the Empress Dragon Gauwervyndhal .

title: Wyrmheart Mine
description: Wyrmheart Mine Wyrmheart Mine was a dwarven mine in the Kobold Mountains , renowned in Chult for its vast collection of diamonds and emeralds . The clan leader , Kyer Wyrmheart , was an old and hateful dwarf . He placed ballista e and dimetrodon s at the entrance to the mine to defend against raiders .
description_long: Wyrmheart Mine Wyrmheart Mine was a dwarven mine in the Kobold Mountains , renowned in Chult for its vast collection of diamonds and emeralds . The clan leader , Kyer Wyrmheart , was an old and hateful dwarf . He placed ballista e and dimetrodon s at the entrance to the mine to defend against raiders .

title: Wyrmskull Throne
description: Wyrmskull Throne Wyrmskull Throne is a throne made from the skulls of four blue dragons slain by Taark Shanat around - 12 , 000 DR to bring the Cloaker Wars to a victorious end for his dwarves . It is believed that the throne was forged by Dumathoin ' s hand . History .
description_long: Wyrmskull Throne Wyrmskull Throne is a throne made from the skulls of four blue dragons slain by Taark Shanat around - 12 , 000 DR to bring the Cloaker Wars to a victorious end for his dwarves . It is believed that the throne was forged by Dumathoin ' s hand . History . The throne originally resided in Brightaxe Hall ( originally the Rift of Dhalnadar ) , in the lair of the blue dragons . When Brightaxe Hall was abandoned during the Third Spider War around - 6150 DR , the dwarves took the throne with them . The Throne resurfaced around 1370 DR in possession of the aquatic elf tyrant Gantar Kraok After an adventuring party took it away from the Gantar Kraok they sold it to storm giant queen Neri for a considerable fortune . She magically enlarged it and gave it as gift to her husband king Hekaton

title: Wyrran Alastrarra
description: Wyrran Alastrarra Wyrran Alastrarra was the mate of Countess Sarya Dlardrageth in the Year of the Tankard , 1370 DR . Relationships . Wyrran was the most recent mate of Sarya .
description_long: Wyrran Alastrarra Wyrran Alastrarra was the mate of Countess Sarya Dlardrageth in the Year of the Tankard , 1370 DR . Relationships . Wyrran was the most recent mate of Sarya . History . Wyrran hailed from Evermeet but was exiled for trafficking with fiend s a century before . He went to Luskan and joined the Arcane Brotherhood . Wyrran was then captured by the daemonfey together with some members of the Company of the Jaded Heart . Interesting in the breeding experiments conducted by Sarya Dlardrageth , Wyrran plotted to be formally adopted into House Dlardrageth and become Sarya ' s consort .

title: Wyrruth
description: Wyrruth Wyrruth was a male human shade and an enchanter who operated as an ambassador between the city of Shade and Maerimydra . Description . A dark grey complexion complemented his equally dark eyes and his black hair was kept pulled back in a long ponytail .
description_long: Wyrruth Wyrruth was a male human shade and an enchanter who operated as an ambassador between the city of Shade and Maerimydra . Description . A dark grey complexion complemented his equally dark eyes and his black hair was kept pulled back in a long ponytail . Wyrruth was tall but gaunt for a human and sported a black goatee . Wyrruth ' s clothing appeared relatively old - fashioned ; he wore a burgundy and black tunic with many layers and gold thread trim along the collar and sleeves . Over this was a weighty mantle of black with a burgundy lining . Personality . An eloquent shade of stately comportment , Wyrruth was completely loyal to Thultanthar and would rather die than betray his people . As an ambassador , Wyrruth was very careful to avoid conflicts in most cases and maintained a diplomatic air throughout his conversations . Abilities . Wyrruth was an adept negotiator and considered , by the leaders of Thultanthar , to be capable enough to serve as the ambassador to Maerimydra where he would need to deal with the dangerous politics of drow society . As a powerful enchanter , his diplomatic skills were complemented by the numerous enchantment spells he had prepared .

title: Wyvern
description: Wyvern A wyvern was a large winged lizard with a stinging tail and sharp teeth . They had dark brown or grey bodies , around 15 ' ( 4 . 6 m ) in length , weighing around a ton .
description_long: Wyvern A wyvern was a large winged lizard with a stinging tail and sharp teeth . They had dark brown or grey bodies , around 15 ' ( 4 . 6 m ) in length , weighing around a ton . They were not greatly intelligent although they did speak Draconic fluently . They were not averse to attacking anything less powerful than themselves . Their sleek , strong legs proved very useful for attack . History . Wyverns were created by the aearee of Viakoo in −30 , 700 DR . Uses . Wyverns were used as mounts by various races and cultures , including Zhentarim skymage s and the extradimensional marauder Imgig Zu . Wvyern hide was used in bookbindings . The wyvern ' s poisonous barbed tail could be used for poison darts .

title: Wyvern Ferry Route
description: Wyvern Ferry Route The Wyvern Ferry Route , or simply the Wyvern Ferry , was a ferry across the Wyvernflow River in the city of Wheloon in Cormyr . It linked the Way of the Manticore over the river . 1374 DR Wheloon was originally a small thorp that lived off the trade of river crossings on the Wyvern Ferry .
description_long: Wyvern Ferry Route The Wyvern Ferry Route , or simply the Wyvern Ferry , was a ferry across the Wyvernflow River in the city of Wheloon in Cormyr . It linked the Way of the Manticore over the river . 1374 DR Wheloon was originally a small thorp that lived off the trade of river crossings on the Wyvern Ferry . It slowly developed as trade along the Way of the Manticore increased and grew into a town based around the ferry . With heavy traffic and many Whelunians owning boats , fares remained cheap . For a one - way trip , the fare was 1 copper piece per person , mount or pack animal , cart or wagon , and baggage that could not be carried in hand . The ferries ran day and night .

title: Wyvern Tor
description: Wyvern Tor Wyvern Tor was a crag in the hills northeast of the Sword Mountains , and was easily seen by any on the Triboar Trail near the vicinity of Conyberry . History . Wyvern Tor was formerly inhabited by a vicious nest of wyverns , but they were slain by bold adventurers .
description_long: Wyvern Tor Wyvern Tor was a crag in the hills northeast of the Sword Mountains , and was easily seen by any on the Triboar Trail near the vicinity of Conyberry . History . Wyvern Tor was formerly inhabited by a vicious nest of wyverns , but they were slain by bold adventurers . By the time of approximately 1480 DR , the place was abandoned by the wyvern nest . Many creatures laid here from time to time , the most prominent of which was a group of orcs and one ogre . In 1480 DR , the place became the lair of orc scouts of the Many Arrows tribe . The stories of Phandalin being resettled in this time renewed traffic on the Triboar Trail and attracted the orcs to the area . Inhabitants . Wyvern Tor was originally inhabited by a nest of wyverns , but after they were driven out , many creatures used the place as their lair . By 1480 DR , a group of six orcs led by the leader of the scouting party , Brughor Axe - Biter , inhabited the crag . They also allied themselves with a nasty ogre named Gog .

title: Wyvern Watch Inn
description: Wyvern Watch Inn The Wyvern Watch Inn was an inn located in the city of Wheloon in Cormyr . It was owned by the Mhaerkoon family : Buldegas Mhaerkoon and later his daughters Asanta & Baerill . History .
description_long: Wyvern Watch Inn The Wyvern Watch Inn was an inn located in the city of Wheloon in Cormyr . It was owned by the Mhaerkoon family : Buldegas Mhaerkoon and later his daughters Asanta & Baerill . History . The Wyvern Watch Inn was in business by 1358 DR and still in business in 1369 DR , under the long - term ownership of Buldegas Mhaerkoon . However , not long before 1374 DR , Buldegas chose to build a new inn in Arabel , taking away his money and some of his best employees . He left the Wyvern in the care of his daughters , Asanta and Baerill , who increased its popularity . In early Eleint , the Year of Lightning Storms , 1374 DR , Tunaster Dranik based himself at the Wyvern Watch Inn while recruiting adventurers to investigate the new Temple of Mystra . Location . The Wyvern Watch Inn lay at the western end of the Wyvern Ferry over the Wyvernflow River , opposite its rival , the Lantern Inn and Boathouse on the other bank . It stood right next to the ferry slip , and close to the center of town , with the Wheloon Watch House nearby . Services . The Wyvern Watch Inn was the biggest and best - looking inn in Wheloon , as well as the most popular and successful .

title: Wyvern watch
description: Wyvern watch Wyvern watch was an evocation spell of the guardian sphere that created a field of temporary paralysis to guard an area against intrusion . Effects . This spell lasted for eight hours or until it was triggered , which ever came first .
description_long: Wyvern watch Wyvern watch was an evocation spell of the guardian sphere that created a field of temporary paralysis to guard an area against intrusion . Effects . This spell lasted for eight hours or until it was triggered , which ever came first . Any creature entering the area of effect had to resist the spell or be paralyzed for a few minutes ( the more experienced the caster , the longer the paralysis ) . " Wyvern watch " was not removed if an intruder managed to resist the spell . It remained in place until it successfully paralyzed a victim ; either another creature entering the area , or even the same creature exiting and re - entering . A victim could be freed before the expiration time by the will of the caster , a successful " dispel magic " , or a " remove paralysis " spell . This spell was called " wyvern watch " due to a hazy , vaguely wyvern - shaped mist that indicated the presence of this spell . This haze could be detected before entering the area of effect if it was illuminated . The brighter the illumination , the easier it was to see the " wyvern " . Darkness made it impossible to detect .

title: Wyvernstones of Hullack
description: Wyvernstones of Hullack The Wyvernstones of Hullack are a sacred site of Eldath and a legend of the Hullack Forest in northeastern Cormyr . Each menhir is twelve feet high and six wide and the twelve of them create a circle some 60 feet in diameter . The north , east , and west facing stones are crossed by a table stone forming an arch over each pair with the south arch , lying cracked and broken at the base of the menhirs .
description_long: Wyvernstones of Hullack The Wyvernstones of Hullack are a sacred site of Eldath and a legend of the Hullack Forest in northeastern Cormyr . Each menhir is twelve feet high and six wide and the twelve of them create a circle some 60 feet in diameter . The north , east , and west facing stones are crossed by a table stone forming an arch over each pair with the south arch , lying cracked and broken at the base of the menhirs . Hidden under thick moss on the inward facing surface of each stone are druidic runes . If cleared and deciphered they form several spells often employed by druid s of Eldath . The outer surface of each stone is entirely devoid of moss or lichen , leaving several intricate carvings of ancient wyverns visible to anyone who should discover the fabled Wyvernstones of Hullack . A small , clear , 30 ' diameter pool lies in the center of the circle and despite the bloody sacrifices and rituals tainting its waters nightly , upon the morning it becomes pure again with the first rays of dawn . They once marked the burial glen for the elves of House Amaratharr until their eventual retreat and were later used by druids of the Wyvernwater Circle .

title: Wyverntongue Chalice
description: Wyverntongue Chalice The Wyverntongue Chalice was one of the relics of The Nine . It contained the spirit of Treth Halonter who could be called forth by the chalice ' s owner . Treth ' s spirit was forced to obey the commands of the owner .
description_long: Wyverntongue Chalice The Wyverntongue Chalice was one of the relics of The Nine . It contained the spirit of Treth Halonter who could be called forth by the chalice ' s owner . Treth ' s spirit was forced to obey the commands of the owner . The chalice was displayed in the royal palace in Suzail for many years but was stolen as a drunken prank by Nethglas Stormserpent sometime in the 1470s DR . When the chalice ' s theft stirred the war wizard s into a frenzy , Nethglas became worried and stashed the chalice in the Chamber of Wyrms Ascending in the palace . In 1479 DR , his younger brother , Marlin , retrieved the chalice from the palace . Marlin called forth Treth and Relve Langral ' s spirit from the Flying Blade and sent them on a killing spree through Suzail . Elminster sought the chalice and the other relics to feed to Alassra Silverhand to restore her sanity .

title: Wyvernwater
description: Wyvernwater The Wyvernwater was a star - shaped freshwater lake more or less centrally positioned in Cormyr . It had abundant crab , eel , and fish stocks . Each morning , the lake was covered in a thick mist , and those who fished it early in the morning were therefore known as " mistfishers " .
description_long: Wyvernwater The Wyvernwater was a star - shaped freshwater lake more or less centrally positioned in Cormyr . It had abundant crab , eel , and fish stocks . Each morning , the lake was covered in a thick mist , and those who fished it early in the morning were therefore known as " mistfishers " . The lake was fed by the Sword River to the north , and the Thunder River to the east , and it flowed into the Dragonmere to the south , via the Wyvernflow .

title: Xai Chung
description: Xai Chung Xai Chung was a settlement in the kingdom of Koryo in Kara - Tur around 1357 DR . Geography . It lay on the western side of Kang Bay near the foot of the Vorkani Mountains , which one could view from a balcony in Xai Chung .
description_long: Xai Chung Xai Chung was a settlement in the kingdom of Koryo in Kara - Tur around 1357 DR . Geography . It lay on the western side of Kang Bay near the foot of the Vorkani Mountains , which one could view from a balcony in Xai Chung . Government . Xai Chung was governed by Meo Yungdo , who also advisor to King Wanang Sun . Description . It was a rather sedate place , compared to Tu Pe , at least . One road there was Lu Chan Street . The ancestral mansion of the Meo family stood in Xai Chung . The Nikanii bazaar was a market in Xai Chung . On display here in the mid – 14th century DR was the skeleton of one of the birdmen of the Vorkani Mountains ; a Koryoan adventurer discovered the bones in the nest of a giant spider he had slain . History . The bodies of three members of Koryo ' s " night brotherhoods " were once found in Lu Chan Street " circa " 1347 DR , apparently having slain each other for dark secrets . Around 1350 DR , the king of Silla ordered " nameless ones " of one of these brotherhoods to kidnap Meo Li , the teenage daughter of Meo Yungdo . They swung down from the rooftops , used magic sleep powder on her , and whisked her away from her guards .

title: Xalith Masq ' il ' yr
description: Xalith Masq ' il ' yr Xalith Masq ' il ' yr was a drow trader living in Gracklstugh during the Rage of Demons . Activities . Xalith was a trader in Gracklstugh and an ally of House Mizzrym of Menzoberranzan .
description_long: Xalith Masq ' il ' yr Xalith Masq ' il ' yr was a drow trader living in Gracklstugh during the Rage of Demons . Activities . Xalith was a trader in Gracklstugh and an ally of House Mizzrym of Menzoberranzan . History . During the Rage of Demons , Xalith was contacted by Ilvara Mizzrym and ordered to search for an adventuring party that had escaped Velkynvelve .

title: Xalliana
description: Xalliana Xalliana was a tiefling member of the Harpers who infiltrated the Blackdagger Bandits . History . Xalliana was a Harper agent who infiltrated the Blackdagger Bandits as a spy .
description_long: Xalliana Xalliana was a tiefling member of the Harpers who infiltrated the Blackdagger Bandits . History . Xalliana was a Harper agent who infiltrated the Blackdagger Bandits as a spy . Thanks to her information , the Harpers could direct Neverwinter ' s troops to stop the bandits ' raids . Later , she guided an adventurer recruited by the Harpers to the stronghold of the bandits in order to kill the bandits ' leaders : Malus and Traven Blackdagger and the Red Wizard necromancer Kallos Tam .

title: Xalyth
description: Xalyth Xalyth , also known as Nal , was a female drow trader and fencer of gems and spell components in Menzoberranzan in 1370 DR . History . Her fortune came from her relations with nine suppliers , from Ammryyr of Skullport , a male drow worshiper of Vhaeraun , to Ubelein Shubelith , a duergar of Underspires nicknamed " Fatreek " .
description_long: Xalyth Xalyth , also known as Nal , was a female drow trader and fencer of gems and spell components in Menzoberranzan in 1370 DR . History . Her fortune came from her relations with nine suppliers , from Ammryyr of Skullport , a male drow worshiper of Vhaeraun , to Ubelein Shubelith , a duergar of Underspires nicknamed " Fatreek " . Personality . Xalyth was fearless and fairly trustworthy . She had a sharp tongue , but was slow to anger . Her nickname was formed from the initials of " Not A Lady " .

title: Xamlyn Margaster
description: Xamlyn Margaster Xamlyn Margaster was a wizard of the Margaster family in Silverymoon sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . Activities . Xamlyn resided in a tower in Silverymoon .
description_long: Xamlyn Margaster Xamlyn Margaster was a wizard of the Margaster family in Silverymoon sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . Activities . Xamlyn resided in a tower in Silverymoon . Her duty for the family was to keep a watch on a nearby secret stash of magic items .

title: Xamus
description: Xamus Xamus was an efreeti inhabiting Rog ' osto in east Zakhara in 1367 DR . Relationships . Xamus served the sha ' ir Othmar bin Kaloth as his loyal genie companion .
description_long: Xamus Xamus was an efreeti inhabiting Rog ' osto in east Zakhara in 1367 DR . Relationships . Xamus served the sha ' ir Othmar bin Kaloth as his loyal genie companion . Activities . Xamus possessed a shrewd eye for judging a person ' s character and true intentions , a skill that served his master well . A favorite pastime of Xamus ' was collecting magical items from those whom his master had imprisoned . Xamus hoped to gather enough powerful items to impress a beautiful female noble efreeta back home in his native City of Brass .

title: Xan
description: Xan Xan was an elf who appeared in both the Baldur ' s Gate computer game and novelization . The Novel . Xan was an elf with a sense of humor as well as a good streak of luck who befriended Abdel Adrian , Khalid , and Jaheira .
description_long: Xan Xan was an elf who appeared in both the Baldur ' s Gate computer game and novelization . The Novel . Xan was an elf with a sense of humor as well as a good streak of luck who befriended Abdel Adrian , Khalid , and Jaheira . He was found in a smelly place below the mines of Nashkel by Abdel . His caretaker for his time there was a disgusting half - orc . He got in a fight with Khalid after Abdel punched Jaheira in the face by accident , thinking it was Khalid ' s doing and calling him " breed " . Xan followed Korak into a spider den and was decapitated by a large spider . The Game . Xan was one of up to twelve NPC s ( non - playing characters ) in the computer game version of Baldur ' s Gate . In the game he was a pessimistic elven wizard from Evereska who the Bhaalspawn finds in the Nashkel mines after he ' d been captured by Mulahey ' s kobolds . Xan had his own flaming Moonblade and belonged to an organization called the Greycloaks . In the game " Icewind Dale " it is discovered that he also has a cousin named Erevain who died while adventuring . Xan also appears in " " , but only in the tutorial .

title: Xanathar
description: Xanathar The Xanathar was one of most infamous beholder s of the Realms and the crime lord of the Xanathar Thieves ' Guild in Skullport . History . The Eye , as he was originally known , was an ancient , wrinkled , and paranoid beholder of the Graypeaks Hive .
description_long: Xanathar The Xanathar was one of most infamous beholder s of the Realms and the crime lord of the Xanathar Thieves ' Guild in Skullport . History . The Eye , as he was originally known , was an ancient , wrinkled , and paranoid beholder of the Graypeaks Hive . The Eye arrived in Skullport in 1205 DR , already a slaver in search of a greater market . In time , his business and his organization grew . At one point , he re - organized his organization into a semi - autonomous model and retreated into the background , spreading rumors about his demise or retirement . Soon , most people forgot about the beholder slaver and in 1304 DR the Agents of the Eye were simply a large slaving ring in Skullport with no association with beholders . Meanwhile , the Eye investigated the Xanathar Thieves ' Guild , a powerful thieves guild , and in time discovered that they were also led by a beholder , a beholder of a different hive . Thus the Eye decided to take control , by killing and taking the position of Xanathar . The Eye discovered all Xanathar ' s secrets and at the same time manipulated another Skullport beholder , Uthh , into wanting to kill Xanathar .

title: Xanathar ' s Thieves ' Guild
description: Xanathar ' s Thieves ' Guild Xanathar ' s Thieves ' Guild was run by a paranoid elder beholder . Geography . This slaver network was the most powerful on the Sword Coast and often acted as a buffer against other evil organizations unintentionally .
description_long: Xanathar ' s Thieves ' Guild Xanathar ' s Thieves ' Guild was run by a paranoid elder beholder . Geography . This slaver network was the most powerful on the Sword Coast and often acted as a buffer against other evil organizations unintentionally . They operated out of Skullport . Membership . Members of the guild were trained in stealth , discretion , and tactics with fighter s , rogue s , sorcerer s , wizard s , and expert s which comprised most of its numbers . An ever - growing organization , it utilized multiple mouthpieces to protect and conceal the identity of the Xanathar . To join a member had to prove their ruthlessness and obedience in a test of loyalty , which usually involved killing or selling a friend or family member into slavery , as well as paying 300 gp . The typical agent earned dues of 60 gp a month .

title: Xanathar ( original )
description: Xanathar ( original ) Xanathar was one of most infamous beholder s of the Realms and the crime lord of the Xanathar Thieves ' Guild in Skullport . History . Xanathar was originally a follower of Xantriph of Zhentil Keep .
description_long: Xanathar ( original ) Xanathar was one of most infamous beholder s of the Realms and the crime lord of the Xanathar Thieves ' Guild in Skullport . History . Xanathar was originally a follower of Xantriph of Zhentil Keep . He was sent by the Zhentarim to Waterdeep to destroy the Lords of Waterdeep and establish a ruler allied to the Zhent s . However , he soon started to act independently , establishing a new thieves ' guild and disappearing . He later led a great thieves ' guild and only his four lieutenants — Slan Thurbel , Slink Monteskor , Ott Steeltoes , and Shindia Darkeyes — knew his true nature and aspirations . His ruin came circa 1370 DR with the Eye , who manipulated another Skullport beholder , Uthh , into killing Xanathar and afterwards secretly replaced him . Personality . Xanathar greatly enjoyed been a crime lord just under the nose of the Waterdeep ' s Lords . Xanathar very liked finely prepared foods , scented oils , and spiced southern tobaccos and herbs .

title: Xandra Shobalar
description: Xandra Shobalar Xandra Shobalar was a drow of House Shobalar and the third daughter of Hinkutes ' nat Alar Shobalar . She was the house ' s Mistress of Magic , tasked with training others in the house about wizardry . She trained the young Liriel Baenre .
description_long: Xandra Shobalar Xandra Shobalar was a drow of House Shobalar and the third daughter of Hinkutes ' nat Alar Shobalar . She was the house ' s Mistress of Magic , tasked with training others in the house about wizardry . She trained the young Liriel Baenre . Relatives . Xandra ' s mother was Hinkutes ' nat Alar Shobalar and she had ten sisters . Five of these sisters were wizard s . Her daughter was Bythnara . History . Xandra became deeply envious of Liriel ' s magical ability and plotted to kill her , travelling to Mantol - Derith in order to buy an enslaved wizard , Tresk Mulander , to pit against her in the Blooding .

title: Xanos Messarmos
description: Xanos Messarmos Xanos Messarmos was a half - orc sorcerer and barbarian , and a former student of Drogan Droganson . Description . A large half - orc man with black hair and mustache .
description_long: Xanos Messarmos Xanos Messarmos was a half - orc sorcerer and barbarian , and a former student of Drogan Droganson . Description . A large half - orc man with black hair and mustache . His main weapons were daggers and arcane magic . Personality . Xanos was not of greater than average intelligence among such races as human s , and occasionally stumbled intellectually in his arrogance , but he had studied and learnt from history and had grand and not very naive plans for improving himself before becoming a great leader . He was adamant of his future and destiny to one day hold great power and would have gone to the extremes to get this . It also made him a very determined and ambitious worker . Xanos was eager to prove a point wherever possible , as well as having a sharp and sometimes offensive sense of humour , especially towards his fellow apprentices . Possessions . Drogan ' s apprentices all possessed a ring which allowed them to teleport themselves to Drogan ' s location at the cost of focus crystals . Relationships . Was deeply competitive towards Dorna Trapspringer and often teased her .

title: Xantam
description: Xantam Xantam was the guild master of Xantam ' s Thieves Guild , an emergent criminal organization in Baldur ' s Gate , with the secret backing of Eldrith . His primary agent was Karne , in truth a Zhentarim agent . His guild was destroyed and Xantam was killed by the heroes Vahn , Adrianna , and Kromlech Bruenghor .
description_long: Xantam Xantam was the guild master of Xantam ' s Thieves Guild , an emergent criminal organization in Baldur ' s Gate , with the secret backing of Eldrith . His primary agent was Karne , in truth a Zhentarim agent . His guild was destroyed and Xantam was killed by the heroes Vahn , Adrianna , and Kromlech Bruenghor .

title: Xanther Srildar
description: Xanther Srildar Xanther Srildar was a saturnine merchant in High Dale . History . Xanther was a merchant of Sembia n rarities and collectibles in High Dale .
description_long: Xanther Srildar Xanther Srildar was a saturnine merchant in High Dale . History . Xanther was a merchant of Sembia n rarities and collectibles in High Dale . When in 1358 DR a secret Zhent occupation army occupied the dale , Xanther was a member of the Council of the High Dale . Constable Heladar Longspear believed him to be obviously a spy . In truth Xanther was a very deeply - cover Zhentarim spy , tasked by Manshoon himself to spy upon fellow Zhent . After told to Manshoon the involvement of Elminster in ruining the Zhent plot , Xanther left the dale . He went to Spellgard hoping to help in kill Elminster but instead Xanther was killed .

title: Xanthon Cormaeril
description: Xanthon Cormaeril Xanthon Cormaeril was a member of the Cormaeril noble family . His traitorous cousin , Gaspar Cormaeril , was the cause of their noble house being stripped of land and title . Xanthon then somehow turned into a ghazneth , unleashing the buried scourges to destroy Cormyr .
description_long: Xanthon Cormaeril Xanthon Cormaeril was a member of the Cormaeril noble family . His traitorous cousin , Gaspar Cormaeril , was the cause of their noble house being stripped of land and title . Xanthon then somehow turned into a ghazneth , unleashing the buried scourges to destroy Cormyr . History . Xanthon was one of House Cormaeril ' s more adventurous youths . He traveled the Heartlands in search of wealth and excitement , and in the process often irritated a foreign merchant or monarch to the point that his family needed to use its influence to free him from foreign justice . When Gaspar Cormaeril ' s failed coup caused the family to lose its influence , Xanthon and his fellow Cormaeril nobles were subjected to the full consequences of their actions , resulting in several of his relatives being imprisoned or put to death . Xanthon was able to escape and somehow became the sixth ghazneth . Ghazneth powers . As a ghazneth , Xanthon had surprising speed and power , which allowed him to overwhelm and kill Emperel Ruousk , along with many other victims . Xanthon had the power to control swarms of poisonous creatures , from wasps and scorpions to even large snakes .

title: Xantriph
description: Xantriph Xantriph was a beholder member of the Zhentarim and one of the closest ally of Manshoon . History . Xantriph was a beholder living in the Temple in the Sky , a strange flying hollow rock over Teshendale .
description_long: Xantriph Xantriph was a beholder member of the Zhentarim and one of the closest ally of Manshoon . History . Xantriph was a beholder living in the Temple in the Sky , a strange flying hollow rock over Teshendale . Informed by his spies of the strange place , Manshoon investigated personally , hoping to find powerful magic . Instead , he discovered the beholder Xantriph . The two canny individuals joined forces , claiming the rock was a conduit to the gods . Banite priests flocked to the place where Xantriph instructed them all to do as Manshoon commanded , joining the Zhentarim and leading them away from the decadent High Imperceptor of the church . However , in order to do this , Manshoon and his magelings had to pledge fealty to Bane , promising to lead the faith to even greater heights of power than the weakening High Imperceptor had . Furthermore , Manshoon promised control of the priesthood and Zhentil Keep to the beholders , or so it seemed . The plot was ruined when , in 1350 DR , the adventurers known as the Knights of Myth Drannor discovered the Temple and in exploring it they found Xantriph . The Knights soon fought the evil monster and killed Xantriph .

title: Xaos
description: Xaos The Xaos was a chaos beast lurking at Telkoun ' s Tower in High Thorog in the Silver Marches . It was twice the normal size of a chaos beast . History .
description_long: Xaos The Xaos was a chaos beast lurking at Telkoun ' s Tower in High Thorog in the Silver Marches . It was twice the normal size of a chaos beast . History . In 1372 DR , the Xaos had recently been released from the " stasis sphere " by the evil sorcerer Telkoun Adranther in his tower . Telkoun cast the spell " charm monster " on the beast , gaining control of the creature and ordered it to drive intruders away from his tower .

title: Xara Tantlor
description: Xara Tantlor Xara Tantlor was a wizard and shopkeeper in Silverymoon in 1370 DR . Activities . Xara worked as a wizard - for - hire but also managed a potion shop .
description_long: Xara Tantlor Xara Tantlor was a wizard and shopkeeper in Silverymoon in 1370 DR . Activities . Xara worked as a wizard - for - hire but also managed a potion shop . All this was to fund her explorations of ruins and tombs in interior Faerûn . Relationship . Xara lived with a faerie dragon companion named Villynk , who considered herself the true owner of the shop .

title: Xarlandralath
description: Xarlandralath Xarlandralath , spawn of Xorlughra , was one of the beholder s in the service of Manshoon in Suzail . History . Around 1479 DR , Manshoon sent Xarlandralath and many other beholders to the house of Larak Dardulkyn to ensure the death of Elminster Aumar .
description_long: Xarlandralath Xarlandralath , spawn of Xorlughra , was one of the beholder s in the service of Manshoon in Suzail . History . Around 1479 DR , Manshoon sent Xarlandralath and many other beholders to the house of Larak Dardulkyn to ensure the death of Elminster Aumar . In the chaotic battle that arose , Xarlandralath was hit by a spell and fell from the sky to his death .

title: Xaros Tenseal
description: Xaros Tenseal Xaros Tenseal , known as the " Amlak Arcane " , was an elf who actually held a position of respect in the city of Keltar . He was the commander of the " amlakkar " , the city guard in Keltar , as well as a competent mage . He actually cared about upholding the law and protecting the citizens and refused to except bribes from the powerful cattle lords in the city .
description_long: Xaros Tenseal Xaros Tenseal , known as the " Amlak Arcane " , was an elf who actually held a position of respect in the city of Keltar . He was the commander of the " amlakkar " , the city guard in Keltar , as well as a competent mage . He actually cared about upholding the law and protecting the citizens and refused to except bribes from the powerful cattle lords in the city .

title: Xatli
description: Xatli Xatli was a priest of Qotal in Nexal . History . In 1361 DR , he was one of the survivors after the Night of Wailing .
description_long: Xatli Xatli was a priest of Qotal in Nexal . History . In 1361 DR , he was one of the survivors after the Night of Wailing . Xatli was the eldest of the surviving priests and became their unofficial leader . He acted as advisor to Erixitl during the march .

title: Xavarathimius
description: Xavarathimius Xavarathimius , also known as the Everlasting Wyrm , was a male great wyrm green dragon dracolich bound by the witches of Rashemen to guard the demon lord Eltab ' s prison in the Sharawood . History . Even after Eltab was gone , the Everlasting Wyrm remained .
description_long: Xavarathimius Xavarathimius , also known as the Everlasting Wyrm , was a male great wyrm green dragon dracolich bound by the witches of Rashemen to guard the demon lord Eltab ' s prison in the Sharawood . History . Even after Eltab was gone , the Everlasting Wyrm remained .

title: Xaven Tanor ' this
description: Xaven Tanor ' this Xaven Tanor ' this was an alchemist of Szith Morcane . History . Xaven was an alchemist in Maerimydra ' s Shattered Tower and later in Szith Morcane .
description_long: Xaven Tanor ' this Xaven Tanor ' this was an alchemist of Szith Morcane . History . Xaven was an alchemist in Maerimydra ' s Shattered Tower and later in Szith Morcane . When , early in the Rage of Demons , the fire giant s of Maerimydra started a war against Szith Morcane , he worked with archmage Solom Ned ' razak , the ruler of the outpost , to create a means of purging the giants of the demonic blood that powered them . However , before Xaven completed the research , Szith Morcane fell to the giants and Xaven was captured . Xaven was sold to the yugoloth collector Maram il Vass and Solom Ned ' razak , who eventually escaped , hired an adventuring party to find and free him . At last , the adventurers managed to free Xaven from the yugoloth and took him to Sporedome to meet with Solom . Xaven and Solom restarted their research , but to complete the experiment they sent the adventurers to Maerimydra to obtain some samples of fiendish blood . The adventurers returned with a fiendish fire giant prisoner and with this subject Xaven and Solom successfully completed their research .

title: Xax Chung
description: Xax Chung Xax Chung was a male hengeyokai ( hare ) bushi and the defender of the city of Koje in Koryo in the mid – 14th century DR . History . Xax was found wounded in the form of a hare by a wandering shukenja .
description_long: Xax Chung Xax Chung was a male hengeyokai ( hare ) bushi and the defender of the city of Koje in Koryo in the mid – 14th century DR . History . Xax was found wounded in the form of a hare by a wandering shukenja . However , after healing him , the shukenja placed a " geas " on Xax , commanding that he must look after and protect the people of the city of Koje until Jisziat ' s tower , a prominent local landmark , was " cast to the ground " . Xax could not be free until this was done . In this duty , Xax saved Koje from the threat of giant dragon turtle and slew the tengu Kwi ' asp . For his efforts , he was feted as the " hero of Koje " . He also " tamed " the witch Zartalla , whom he later married . By 1357 DR , Xax and Zartalla had settled at a ranch and raised a family , but his " geas " remained unfulfilled . Personality . In the fulfilment of his " geas " , Xax had to maintain the pretense of being a human to the people of Koje , though would prefer to get away into the woods to be with other hare hengeyokai . He never ate meat , a habit that was noticed but not questioned . Description . In human form , Xax was of medium build and had wide brown eyes as befitted a hare .

title: Xaxan Thavish
description: Xaxan Thavish Xaxan Thavish was a member of the Cult of the Eternal Flame in Mulmaster . Personality . The priest was a vain and fastidious sociopath .
description_long: Xaxan Thavish Xaxan Thavish was a member of the Cult of the Eternal Flame in Mulmaster . Personality . The priest was a vain and fastidious sociopath . He tried to keep himself always immaculately clean . While Xaxan presented a friendly facade , he was full of envy and resentment . He greatly disliked water cultists . He was a notorious womanizer . Relationships . Xaxan was a cleric affiliated with the Cult of the Eternal Flame . He had a sexual relationship with the wife of his superior until the latter found out . Possessions . The cultist wielded a quarterstaff in battle . History . In 1491 DR , after being discovered having sex with his superior ' s wife , Xaxan ' s superior offered him two options — become a flameskull or join an expedition into Mulmaster ' s sewers sponsored by the Cult of the Crushing Wave . Xaxan chose the latter and was sent to find the tomb of an ancient kuo - toa mystic devoted to Olhydra and Bwimb . However , a band of troglodyte s attacked their camp , killing the leader of expedition , a warrior named Vyrlo Trath , and this left Xaxan as the highest - ranking member present .

title: Xazax
description: Xazax Xazax the Eyemonger was a beholder in the Underdark during the Rage of Demons . History . Xazax was an unusual beholder who , with the help of his servant and surgeon Peebles the deep gnome , grafted onto himself the eyestalks of other beholders after killing them .
description_long: Xazax Xazax the Eyemonger was a beholder in the Underdark during the Rage of Demons . History . Xazax was an unusual beholder who , with the help of his servant and surgeon Peebles the deep gnome , grafted onto himself the eyestalks of other beholders after killing them . During the Rage of Demons , it sent Peebles to Mantol - Derith to search for more beholders from which to take new eyestalks . Relationship . Xazax had a trusted attendant : the deep gnome Peebles . Abilities . During the Rage of Demons , Xazax had eighteen eyestalks but couldn ' t fire rays from the grafted eyes .

title: Xehil Yldin
description: Xehil Yldin Xehil Yldin was a lich inhabiting the Battle of Bones in 1367 DR . Personality . Xehil possessed an uncanny ability to work with others to further his own goals .
description_long: Xehil Yldin Xehil Yldin was a lich inhabiting the Battle of Bones in 1367 DR . Personality . Xehil possessed an uncanny ability to work with others to further his own goals . He was known to associate with drow and the Zhentarim on occasion . Abilities . A wide array of magical spell s was at Xehil ' s disposal . Possessions . Xehil carried a ring of " spell storing " ( containting " teleport without error " , " delayed blast fireball " , and " hold monster " ) , " wand of enfeeblement " , " cloak of the manta ray " , and a dagger covered with drow poison . Activities . Xehil was rumored to collect many of the wandering undead of the Battle of Bones and to add them to his personal army . History . At one point , Xehil worked with the drow occupying the Twisted Tower of Ashaba in Shadowdale . He disappeared from those lands long before the rise of the Lords of Shadowdale .

title: Xendreth
description: Xendreth The Xendreth was the ruling council of Malydren , composed of both the preeminent wizards and clerics of the ixzan city . Unlike most ixzan communities , mutant ixzan were allowed to join the clergy and become wizards , so they could also join the council . For many centuries , the council was in fact strongly influenced by the two vampiric ixzan Zekaqux and Phiaqiv .
description_long: Xendreth The Xendreth was the ruling council of Malydren , composed of both the preeminent wizards and clerics of the ixzan city . Unlike most ixzan communities , mutant ixzan were allowed to join the clergy and become wizards , so they could also join the council . For many centuries , the council was in fact strongly influenced by the two vampiric ixzan Zekaqux and Phiaqiv .

title: Xenix
description: Xenix Xenix the Occluded was an elderly beholder eye tyrant of Ooltul and an innkeeper in 1370 DR . Personality . Xenix , like its fellow beholders , hated non - beholder strangers .
description_long: Xenix Xenix the Occluded was an elderly beholder eye tyrant of Ooltul and an innkeeper in 1370 DR . Personality . Xenix , like its fellow beholders , hated non - beholder strangers . Only the orders of the Triumvirate forced Xenix to deal with visitors . Usually , Xenix followed the most rapid and violent resolutions to problems and left much of the care of guests to its goblin slaves . Activities . Aged and rheumy - eyed , having lost the use of most or all of his powers , Xenix adapted to act as an innkeeper . Its inn , the Severed Stalk , was a relativity good place for sojourn in Ooltul , although it was recommended that guests erect their own personal magical wards before going to sleep .

title: Xeno Mirrormane
description: Xeno Mirrormane Xeno Mirrormane was a cleric of Cyric . Appearance . Xeno ' s face was covered with wrinkles and he had curly silver - white hair .
description_long: Xeno Mirrormane Xeno Mirrormane was a cleric of Cyric . Appearance . Xeno ' s face was covered with wrinkles and he had curly silver - white hair . He wore long purple robes and a death ' s - head ring on one finger . History . Xeno murdered his brother Maskul Mirrormane . Xeno turned 60 in 1368 DR . Possessions . Xeno kept a dirk in the sleeve of his robe .

title: Xephras
description: Xephras Xephras ( pronounced " ZEF - frus " ) was the " stormazîn " of the " Jotunbrud " in 1366 DR . Description . Xephras was a short cloud giant .
description_long: Xephras Xephras ( pronounced " ZEF - frus " ) was the " stormazîn " of the " Jotunbrud " in 1366 DR . Description . Xephras was a short cloud giant . He was several hundred years old and had a stooped figure with long white hair and a beard . Personality . Xephras firmly disbelieved in the Twilight Spirit as a representative of the will of Annam , although he did not offer any alternatives to the Spirit ' s identity . Activities . As the Great Priest of Annam All - Father , Xephras was the highest religious figure in giant society . In his old age , because of his sickly physical condition , he was unable to attend as many rituals and ceremonies as he would have liked in order to fulfill his duties as " stormazîn " . He would step down when he had found a successor . Xephras resided with two stone giant disciples with the grand temple of Annam within the Ice Spires .

title: Xern
description: Xern Xern was a monk at the Monastery of the Yellow Rose . Activities . Xern was a member of the Order of the Chisel of the Disciples of St .
description_long: Xern Xern was a monk at the Monastery of the Yellow Rose . Activities . Xern was a member of the Order of the Chisel of the Disciples of St . Sollars the Twice - Martyred . His duty was to act as wine master and cook for the monastery and occasionally also for the Guest House . Secretly , he was also a member of the Cult of Howling Hatred . History . Xern was one of the cultists who infiltrated the monastery in 1491 DR . He brewed the cordial that cultists used to keep Mother Savahn unconscious . Relationships . Xern was one of the few to know fellow monk Nym personally . He also was a good friend of Ovon .

title: Xetzirbor
description: Xetzirbor Xetzirbor was a mind flayer during or after the Rage of Demons . History . During the Rage of Demons , the elder brain of Cyrog , also named Cyrog , died and was raised as an undead creature by the demon lord Orcus .
description_long: Xetzirbor Xetzirbor was a mind flayer during or after the Rage of Demons . History . During the Rage of Demons , the elder brain of Cyrog , also named Cyrog , died and was raised as an undead creature by the demon lord Orcus . During this event , Xetzirbor went to Gravenhollow to find a means of saving the dying elder brain .

title: Xhalph Dlardrageth
description: Xhalph Dlardrageth Xhalph Dlardrageth was a daemonfey and the son of Sarya Dlardrageth . Appearance . Xhalph inherited the four arms of his father , and stands taller with a stronger build than any human .
description_long: Xhalph Dlardrageth Xhalph Dlardrageth was a daemonfey and the son of Sarya Dlardrageth . Appearance . Xhalph inherited the four arms of his father , and stands taller with a stronger build than any human . Relatives . Xhalph ' s mother was Sarya Dlardrageth and his father was a glabrezu . History . After killing Seiveril Miritar in Myth Drannor in the last battle of the Cormanthor War he alongside most of the remaining fey ' ri tried to escape inside the Waymeet but at last was killed fighting Fflar Starbrow Melruth .

title: Xhalth
description: Xhalth Baron Xhalth was a half - fiend member of the daemonfey and the nephew of Sarya Dlardrageth . Appeareance . Xhalth was physically the most fearsome of the tanar ' ri half - breeds .
description_long: Xhalth Baron Xhalth was a half - fiend member of the daemonfey and the nephew of Sarya Dlardrageth . Appeareance . Xhalth was physically the most fearsome of the tanar ' ri half - breeds . His skin had an olive - green tone and parts of it appeared to be heavily scaled . His darkly scaled ears stood out prominently due to his bald head . Xhalth had six arms . He disdained from covering his heavily muscled body , believing his form was far more intimidating to his foes when exposed . Personality . By his aunt ' s testimony , " Xhalth has little patience for anything aside from battle , and his longing for true challenges leads him into foolish exercises of berserker rage and wasteful combat . In truth , his father ' s blood made him more akin to a wrathful balor than the scheming marilith his mother was . " Temperamental and rash , Xhalth was his aunt ' s enforcer , though he got annoyed when he was denied a chance for battle . While held in check from his desire for direct and immediate conquest by his aunt ' s will and her plans , he would much rather take command of those of Kaanyr Vhok ' s tanarukk forces . Xhalth once reveled in the jealousies of his cousins .

title: Xharva Deem
description: Xharva Deem Xharva Deem was a dao in service to the Cult of the Black Earth at the Temple of the Black Earth in Tyar - Besil during the Elemental Evil crisis . History . In 1491 DR , Marlos Urnrayle made a pact with Xharva Deem in order to use the dao ' s abilities to manage the forge for the Black Earth .
description_long: Xharva Deem Xharva Deem was a dao in service to the Cult of the Black Earth at the Temple of the Black Earth in Tyar - Besil during the Elemental Evil crisis . History . In 1491 DR , Marlos Urnrayle made a pact with Xharva Deem in order to use the dao ' s abilities to manage the forge for the Black Earth . She respected the pact and worked at the forge with two duergar assistants .

title: Xi
description: Xi Xi was a town in the kingdom of Koryo in Kara - Tur , lying in the northern Vorkani Mountains . The mountains separated Xi from the rest of Koryo . Around 1357 DR , the town was the base of the ninja clan known as the Panthers of Xi .
description_long: Xi Xi was a town in the kingdom of Koryo in Kara - Tur , lying in the northern Vorkani Mountains . The mountains separated Xi from the rest of Koryo . Around 1357 DR , the town was the base of the ninja clan known as the Panthers of Xi .

title: Xi - Chu
description: Xi - Chu Xi - Chu was a vampire who ruled over the Taring village of Gigit in Kutuk Valley in Shou Lung in 1358 DR . History . In 1358 DR , Xi - Chu was attacked in the jungle by some hunters from the village of Tebing , who struck him with a wooden stake and then threw the body into the Ular River .
description_long: Xi - Chu Xi - Chu was a vampire who ruled over the Taring village of Gigit in Kutuk Valley in Shou Lung in 1358 DR . History . In 1358 DR , Xi - Chu was attacked in the jungle by some hunters from the village of Tebing , who struck him with a wooden stake and then threw the body into the Ular River . Some time later , Xi - Chu washed ashore and two hunters who found the body removed the stake . Immediately , he drained them of all blood , managing to recover . He planned to regain control of Gigit , which during his absence was ruled by the monk Awang Sophir . He met an adventuring party , hired by the Emperor to find General Goyat Nagumo , and asked for their help in the reconquest of the village , offering safe passage through the area if they agreed and indiscriminately killing them if they refused . Somehow , Xi - Chu managed to return to Gigit , where Awang quickly escaped using his " ring of teleportation " to avoid a confrontation . Xi - Chu thus regained his rule .

title: Xi Hulang
description: Xi Hulang Xi Hulang was the capital city of the kingdom of Koryo in Kara - Tur around 1357 DR . It lay at the mouth of the Hoparatu River on Kang Bay . The city was the home of King Wanang Sun , ruler of Koryo .
description_long: Xi Hulang Xi Hulang was the capital city of the kingdom of Koryo in Kara - Tur around 1357 DR . It lay at the mouth of the Hoparatu River on Kang Bay . The city was the home of King Wanang Sun , ruler of Koryo . An ex - general , he ran the city , like his kingdom , like an army , always building and upgrading defenses and establishing reliable lines of supply , but also putting in place strict laws and regulations , including curfews , licenses , and annual censuses . However , twice or thrice a year , he went out among the people of the city and listened carefully to their views and received their complaints , before correcting their misconceptions and explaining why he would not alter his rules . The settled workers of the city respected and admired him for this . Also living in Xi Hulang was Merquam Pang , one of the most prosperous merchants of Koryo . He lived with his Shou wife , Mai Lan , in their mansion .

title: Xiang Do
description: Xiang Do Xiang Do is the art of fighting without fighting . Only few truly know it , but those that do are some of the best martial artists in the realms . Although the origin of this fighting style is unknown , there are rumors that suggest the creator of this art was a Shou monk .
description_long: Xiang Do Xiang Do is the art of fighting without fighting . Only few truly know it , but those that do are some of the best martial artists in the realms . Although the origin of this fighting style is unknown , there are rumors that suggest the creator of this art was a Shou monk . Still , there are other rumors that suggest this " monk " was in fact the patriarch of an ancient and secret ninja clan whose members no longer live .

title: Xiang Temple
description: Xiang Temple Xiang Temple was a monastery for monk s in the city of Telflamm in the nation of Thesk . Appearance . The Xiang Temple was brightly painted on the outside , while the inside was covered with incense smoke .
description_long: Xiang Temple Xiang Temple was a monastery for monk s in the city of Telflamm in the nation of Thesk . Appearance . The Xiang Temple was brightly painted on the outside , while the inside was covered with incense smoke . Services . The temple was a sanctuary for the common person . The martial art known as Xiang Do was taught here .

title: Xicvizt
description: Xicvizt Xicvizt was a rogue mind flayer from Ryxyg . History . During the Rage of Demons of 1491 DR , Xicvizt sensed a strange presence in the Underdark .
description_long: Xicvizt Xicvizt was a rogue mind flayer from Ryxyg . History . During the Rage of Demons of 1491 DR , Xicvizt sensed a strange presence in the Underdark . Investigating , he found the demon lord Graz ' zt . Soon he disconnected from the illithid hive - mind and went rogue , starting to worship Graz ' zt and becoming a warlock . He retreated into a lair and allied with a group of githyanki . The mind flayer Glorghakt , however , hired an Order of the Gauntlet – affiliated adventuring party to deal with Xicvizt . The adventurers found and killed him . Personality . Xicvzt fully devoted himself to Graz ' zt . Relationship . Xicvizt and Glorghakt were born from the same pool .

title: Xinaya
description: Xinaya Xinaya was a drow scout of Velkynvelve during the Rage of Demons . History . Xinaya was a young scout and acolyte of Lolth in Velkynvelve .
description_long: Xinaya Xinaya was a drow scout of Velkynvelve during the Rage of Demons . History . Xinaya was a young scout and acolyte of Lolth in Velkynvelve . During the Rage of Demons , she was leading a patrol when an adventuring party escaped from the drow outpost . She was telepathically contacted by her superiors near Neverlight Grove and ordered to search and see if the escaping group was inside the Grove . However , meeting the myconids there , Xinaya accepted the hospitality of Phylo , who gave her and her minions to Yestabrod to be food and sacrifices to Zuggtmoy . At last , the adventuring party she was ordered to search found Xinaya just before her death , and she asked them to warn Menzoberranzan of the danger of Zuggtmoy .

title: Xingax
description: Xingax Xingax was a mighty , undead creature from the Abyss . Appearance . Xingax looked like an oversized , freakishly deformed stillborn or aborted fetus - the pure ugliness with asymmetrical features .
description_long: Xingax Xingax was a mighty , undead creature from the Abyss . Appearance . Xingax looked like an oversized , freakishly deformed stillborn or aborted fetus - the pure ugliness with asymmetrical features . He had small rotting fingers at twisted stubby arms . A frayed , greasy length of umbilicus dangled from his belly . Xingax was shortsighted - an array of lenses poised on swiveling steel arms moved in front of his eye enhanced his sight mechanically . He emanated an aura of malign energy , which lead people not shielding themselves from it to vomiting , blinding headaches and collapsing in convulsions . Xingax was carried around by a giant zombie though he could move about quite adequately on his own . He just liked others to think of him as physically helpless . When necessary , he could just float in the air . He was injured during a fight with the bard Bareris Anskuld but repaired that damage with the oversized shadow - black hand and an eye from the body of the fallen Nighthaunt Ysval . He learned to wield their innate magical abilities such as summoning darkness to shut out the daylight . Personality .

title: Xinlenal
description: Xinlenal Xinlenal was the first of the flying Netherese enclaves . History . It was created in - 2954 DR by the archwizard Ioulaum , sixty years after he had invented the mythallar .
description_long: Xinlenal Xinlenal was the first of the flying Netherese enclaves . History . It was created in - 2954 DR by the archwizard Ioulaum , sixty years after he had invented the mythallar . The creation of Xinlenal led many other powerful mages of Netheril to create flying enclaves of their own , in effect splitting the nation into two , High and Low Netheril . In - 339 DR , the Year of Sundered Webs , Ioulaum suddenly and mysteriously abandoned his enclave for his lair in the Northdark . The sudden disappearance of their great champion caused wide - spread panic in Netheril , leading to the casting of " Karsus ' Avatar " and the end of the Empire of Magic .

title: Xinlenal Enclave
description: Xinlenal Enclave Xinlenal Enclave was the first floating city of Netheril ( known then as Ioulaum ) . The city was established in - 2954 DR as a magrocacy ruled by Ioulaum until - 1205 DR when day - to - day control over the city itself was given to a variety of archwizards who resided in Ioulaum ' s city . The First Floating City .
description_long: Xinlenal Enclave Xinlenal Enclave was the first floating city of Netheril ( known then as Ioulaum ) . The city was established in - 2954 DR as a magrocacy ruled by Ioulaum until - 1205 DR when day - to - day control over the city itself was given to a variety of archwizards who resided in Ioulaum ' s city . The First Floating City . When Ioulaum had created the first floating city in - 2954 DR , the Netherese flocked to his city to live high above those they deemed lesser than themselves ; because of this , Xinlenal was overpopulated . Law and Order . As the first floating city , Xinlenal had been used as a model for all other floating cities . Each flying enclave was given laws by its archwizard , and as the first , Xinlenal ' s laws were the outline for those of the other flying enclaves .

title: Xiousing
description: Xiousing Xiousing ( pronounced " yow - sing " ) was a small , cramped district in northern Marsember in Cormyr inhabited primarily by Shou . History . Xiousing was built on land exposed after the level of the Sea of Fallen Stars dropped in the years following the Spellplague .
description_long: Xiousing Xiousing ( pronounced " yow - sing " ) was a small , cramped district in northern Marsember in Cormyr inhabited primarily by Shou . History . Xiousing was built on land exposed after the level of the Sea of Fallen Stars dropped in the years following the Spellplague . The original Shou squatters on the new land were ruled by Burgher Xarod . In 1419 DR , a Shou noble named Duc - Sum Li and his son were traveling through Cormyr . Crown Prince Foril I was very ill and no Cormyrean healers could heal him . King Azoun Obarskyr V summoned Duc - Sum to court and the Shou was able to heal the prince . In gratitude , King Azoun knighted Duc - Sum and granted him control over a small parcel of land in Marsember inhabited by Shou squatters . As of 1479 DR , Xiousing was a bustling community inhabited mostly by Shou .

title: Xisar
description: Xisar Xisar , or simply the Blue Kraken , was a powerful kraken of history in Serôs . History . A very unusual sapphire - blue - tinged kraken Xisar attacked multiple times Es ' purr and the Hills of Eralis , trying to enslave the eastern locathah tribes .
description_long: Xisar Xisar , or simply the Blue Kraken , was a powerful kraken of history in Serôs . History . A very unusual sapphire - blue - tinged kraken Xisar attacked multiple times Es ' purr and the Hills of Eralis , trying to enslave the eastern locathah tribes . Usually it was awake for six years of every twenty - four . In 1297 DR Xisar started it last terror ' s campaign . In 1304 DR the storm giant hero Volar confronted the Blue Kraken at the Bymmal Trench . Neither hero nor villain had been seen since . In 1370 DR most being considered Xisar a creature of legend

title: Xivros
description: Xivros Emissary Xivros was one of the many Red Wizards of Thay serving under Valindra Shadowmantle in Neverwinter in 1484 DR . History . The emissary Xivros decided to raise the powerful ancient ogre warrior Arleon the Unforgiven as an undead to guide Valindra ' s undead army in the conquest of the city .
description_long: Xivros Emissary Xivros was one of the many Red Wizards of Thay serving under Valindra Shadowmantle in Neverwinter in 1484 DR . History . The emissary Xivros decided to raise the powerful ancient ogre warrior Arleon the Unforgiven as an undead to guide Valindra ' s undead army in the conquest of the city . Xivros succeeded in his ritual and Arleon the Unforgiven became a wight . However , soon after , an adventurer sent by Sergeant Knox to stop the plot arrived and fought and defeated the ogre wight and likely killed Xivros as well .

title: Xol
description: Xol Xol was a flumph living in the Underdark beneath the Earthspur Mountains near Mulmaster . Personality . Xol greatly disliked evil and did all in his ability to stop it .
description_long: Xol Xol was a flumph living in the Underdark beneath the Earthspur Mountains near Mulmaster . Personality . Xol greatly disliked evil and did all in his ability to stop it . He was adamantine in his crusade and often persuaded his mate to join him . Relationships . Xol was in love with Laal . History . In 1491 DR , Xol noticed a group of troglodyte s moving into Mulmaster ' s sewers . He convinced Laal to follow them in order to warn others about this menace . Following the troglodytes , Xol located the mind of a particularly evil human . Xol tried to follow this man but was killed in an ambush . His body fell into the sewers and ended up on surface where it was discovered by some children .

title: Xolkin Alassandar
description: Xolkin Alassandar Xolkin Alassandar was the leader of the Seven Snakes sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . Activities . Xolkin and his six men usually did " dirty works " for the Zhentarim , in particular Nelkin Danniker .
description_long: Xolkin Alassandar Xolkin Alassandar was the leader of the Seven Snakes sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . Activities . Xolkin and his six men usually did " dirty works " for the Zhentarim , in particular Nelkin Danniker . History . In the late 1480s or early 1490s DR , Xolkin plotted with Kella Darkhope to occupy the village of Nightstone . However , a cloud giant bombardment ruined Kella ' s plan . Xolkin and his men arrived in a ruined settlement infested by goblin s . Relationship . Xolkin was in love with the Zhent Kella Darkhope .

title: Xonthal ' s Tower
description: Xonthal ' s Tower Xonthal ' s Tower was a tower in the Western Heartlands that housed the wizard Xonthal after 1361 DR . History . The tower became famous in the Realms for its unusual magical defenses , including the magical hedge maze that surrounded it .
description_long: Xonthal ' s Tower Xonthal ' s Tower was a tower in the Western Heartlands that housed the wizard Xonthal after 1361 DR . History . The tower became famous in the Realms for its unusual magical defenses , including the magical hedge maze that surrounded it . In 1365 – 1366 DR , a group of Zhentarim under Hansibal Droun , a shopkeeper of the village near the tower , tried to conquer it for its strategic commercial value . However , Xonthal always defeated them . Just before the Tyranny of Dragons , the Cult of the Dragon managed to acquire the tower . Inhabitants . During the Tyranny , the Cult ' s leaders based at the Tower were the dracolich traditionalists Jorgen Pawl and his lieutenant Iskander .

title: Xontuil Bay
description: Xontuil Bay Xontuil Bay was a bay in the Golden Water , lying between Durpar and Ulgarth in southeast Faerûn . It was fed by the river Xon . It was also known as Xonaluir Bay and the Narrow Seas .
description_long: Xontuil Bay Xontuil Bay was a bay in the Golden Water , lying between Durpar and Ulgarth in southeast Faerûn . It was fed by the river Xon . It was also known as Xonaluir Bay and the Narrow Seas . Politics . The heavily defended and fortified border between Durpar and Ulgarth lay in Xontuil Bay and along the river Xon . Locations . The settlements of Suormpar and Ravvan lay on the Ulgarthan side of the bay .

title: Xoraulkyr
description: Xoraulkyr Xoraulkyr was a beholder in Waterdeep . Personality . The beholder believed himself above all other minds until Elminster defeated and froze Xoraulkyr in a Waterdeep prison .
description_long: Xoraulkyr Xoraulkyr was a beholder in Waterdeep . Personality . The beholder believed himself above all other minds until Elminster defeated and froze Xoraulkyr in a Waterdeep prison . History . In 1487 DR , Elminster summoned it to Myth Drannor in order to create chaos among the Sembia n mercenaries and then bound Xoraulkyr to that city .

title: Xorhun
description: Xorhun Xorhun , also known as Corellon ' s Cradle and Lifeblood Falls , is a special city in the Turmish area , on the edge of the Halondar Valley .
