Xorhun serves primarily as a stopping point along the Halondar , the road that connects Hlondeth to the south and Alaghôn to the north . It is populated primarily by craftsmen and merchants .
description_long: Xorhun Xorhun , also known as Corellon ' s Cradle and Lifeblood Falls , is a special city in the Turmish area , on the edge of the Halondar Valley . Xorhun serves primarily as a stopping point along the Halondar , the road that connects Hlondeth to the south and Alaghôn to the north . It is populated primarily by craftsmen and merchants . Xorhun also serves as the garden spot of the non - human population , especially elves , having an unusual effect on elves and gnomes , increasing their fertility rate . Children are born at a rate two to three times the norm for their race . One must live in the area for five years before the fertility effects begin to show .

title: Xorla Djannas
description: Xorla Djannas Xorla Djannas was fervent champion of the deity Cyric who resided in Waterdeep in 1372 DR . Biography . A native of the southern region of Tethyr , Xorla moved to Waterdeep with her master Selphar Thynn .
description_long: Xorla Djannas Xorla Djannas was fervent champion of the deity Cyric who resided in Waterdeep in 1372 DR . Biography . A native of the southern region of Tethyr , Xorla moved to Waterdeep with her master Selphar Thynn . When Thynn died in a tavern brawl , Xorla was left alone in the city . It was not too long after this that she found her true calling . During the Time of Troubles she was witness to the ascension of Cyric into godhood . It was then that she devoted her life to the Dark Sun and became an agent of his church .

title: Xorn
description: Xorn Xorns ( alternative plural " xorn " ) were strange elemental creatures from the Plane of Earth . Reputation . Grumbar , the lord of elemental earth , naturally favored xorns .
description_long: Xorn Xorns ( alternative plural " xorn " ) were strange elemental creatures from the Plane of Earth . Reputation . Grumbar , the lord of elemental earth , naturally favored xorns . They were sacred to the gnome deities Callarduran Smoothhands and Flandal Steelskin and the Mulhorand i god Geb as well . These powers would sometimes send xorns to aid their followers . The dao would often hunt xorn for sport or keep them as slaves . Xorn maintained good relations with the yak folk found on the planes . Description . Xorns were very odd - looking creatures . They had radially symmetrical bodies with their large mouth at the top and surrounded by three long arms interspersed with their three eyes . Their wide , pebbly , and rocky bodies rested upon three stumpy legs . They had talons at the end of their arms . Smaller xorns were about three feet tall , but the oldest specimens could reach eight feet in height and width and weigh as much as 9 , 000 pounds ( 4080 kilograms ) . Xorns were immune to the effects of fire and cold and resistant to electricity . The stony flesh of xorns was a required component in the creation of " daggers of defiance " . Variations .

title: Xorthaul Barriath
description: Xorthaul Barriath Xorthaul Barriath was a drow - dragon who held the position of the Patron Father of Jhachalkhyn . Description . Xorthaul Barriath was a drow - dragon cleric of Vhaeraun .
description_long: Xorthaul Barriath Xorthaul Barriath was a drow - dragon who held the position of the Patron Father of Jhachalkhyn . Description . Xorthaul Barriath was a drow - dragon cleric of Vhaeraun . He learned minor skills of a rogue and an assassin , as it was common among clerics of his faith , having some capabilities in these was also an entry requirement for the Jaezred Chaulssin . In his drow form he wore black mail of a priest of his faith and in his dragon form , he was a mature adult shadow dragon . Position . He was a Patron Father , a member of the Jaezred Chaulssin ’ s leading council , to be more precise the one responsible for the major fosterage in Jhachalkhyn . He and his fosterage organised a series of assassinations during the Silence of Lolth , that shifted the power balance in Jhachalkhyn from Lolth ' s matriarchy to the city ' s merchant class , who became their opportunity giver ' s sponsors . After the Spellplague , he and his fosterage gained control over the city . He represented the church of Vhaeraun in the assassins ’ guild , inside of which members of the church held positions of influence .

title: Xorvintaal
description: Xorvintaal Xorvintaal , sometimes referred to as " The Great Game " or just " The Game " , was a game dragon s used as a proxy for open warfare . Rules . Dragons who played " xorvintaal " were called " taaldarax " .
description_long: Xorvintaal Xorvintaal , sometimes referred to as " The Great Game " or just " The Game " , was a game dragon s used as a proxy for open warfare . Rules . Dragons who played " xorvintaal " were called " taaldarax " . A dragon ' s head servant was known as his or her " lovac " , and his or her other servants were known as " dokaal " . " Xorvintaal " was like a chess game , as players had to defeat their opponents with strategy instead of combat . There were hundreds of rules , called Precepts . Brimstone said that to read the entire codex of rules would take a few years , and even Alasklerbanbastos admitted he didn ' t fully understand all the rules . The most important rule was that " to gain , first you must lose " ; thus all " taaldarax " lost what magic they had in order to play the game . Another rule forbade players from acting against each other directly ; instead they must use their servants against their opponents . The rules did not forbid combat in all circumstances , however ; if a challenge for combat was issued and both players agreed , the " taaldarax " could battle one another , and their servants were bound to fight as well .

title: Xothaerin
description: Xothaerin Xothaerin was a subkingdom of Deep Shanatar with Sharindlar as its patron deity . Geography . It was located below western Amn and known as the Adamant Kingdom .
description_long: Xothaerin Xothaerin was a subkingdom of Deep Shanatar with Sharindlar as its patron deity . Geography . It was located below western Amn and known as the Adamant Kingdom . Inhabitants . The ruling shield dwarves belonged to Clan Azerkyn , which had some azer blood . = References =

title: Xualahuu
description: Xualahuu Xualahuu was a Zhentarim beholder in Anauroch . History . By 1358 DR , it had been seriously injured and lost the use of some of its eyestalks .
description_long: Xualahuu Xualahuu was a Zhentarim beholder in Anauroch . History . By 1358 DR , it had been seriously injured and lost the use of some of its eyestalks . Xualahuu retreated to the Zhent oasis of Olomaa to regather strength . Relationships . Xualahuu was deeply loyal to Manshoon and tried to profit off all occasions to advance the Black Network ' s plots .

title: Xulla
description: Xulla Xulla was a beholder member of the Zhentarim . Relationships . Xulla was the longest and most loyal beholder ally of Fzoul Chembryl .
description_long: Xulla Xulla was a beholder member of the Zhentarim . Relationships . Xulla was the longest and most loyal beholder ally of Fzoul Chembryl . History . It was one of the many beholder exiled from Ootlul The beholder was chosen as a replacement for Xantriph as Voice of Bane in the Temple in the Sky but was not so efficient . In later years , Xulla was nominated as Caravan Leader of the Zhentarim and responsible for the mercantile part of the organization .

title: Xullrae Dhuurniv
description: Xullrae Dhuurniv Xullrae Dhuurniv was the youngest of the Matron Sisters of House Dhuurniv involved in the Zhent invasion of Shadowdale in the Year of Risen Elfkin , 1375 DR . History . Although Xullrae allied together with her sisters with the Zhentarim the Matron Sisters had plots in minds different from the objective of the Zhent and the Shar rans ; the true plan of Xullrae was recreate a swarm of spiderfire , an ancient kind of spider , and unleash them in the Cormanthor forest to burn it down .
description_long: Xullrae Dhuurniv Xullrae Dhuurniv was the youngest of the Matron Sisters of House Dhuurniv involved in the Zhent invasion of Shadowdale in the Year of Risen Elfkin , 1375 DR . History . Although Xullrae allied together with her sisters with the Zhentarim the Matron Sisters had plots in minds different from the objective of the Zhent and the Shar rans ; the true plan of Xullrae was recreate a swarm of spiderfire , an ancient kind of spider , and unleash them in the Cormanthor forest to burn it down .

title: Xvart
description: Xvart Xvarts ( also known as Xivorts or Svarts ) were a race of small blue humanoid s . Description . Xvarts were relatively small , standing at around 3 feet ( 0 .
description_long: Xvart Xvarts ( also known as Xivorts or Svarts ) were a race of small blue humanoid s . Description . Xvarts were relatively small , standing at around 3 feet ( 0 . 9m ) . They had blue skin and large yellow eyes . Xvarts often wore simple cloth doublets , preferring greens and blues . Some xvarts had dark patches of hair , often receding . Personality . Xvarts were cowardly and easily intimidated . They were of average intelligence . Xvarts were generally hateful creatures . Their short , miserable lives led them to despise most creatures and take out their angst on anyone and anything they could ; but they particularly enjoyed tormenting larger creatures , in particular goliaths and half - orcs . However they enjoyed somewhat better relationships with gnomes and halflings , having been frequently recruited as spies and minions by evil members of those races . Combat . Xvarts were weak as individuals , so they often attacked in large groups . Ambush tactics were the xvarts preferred form of attack . They would often attack sleeping opponents if given the opportunity . Xvart raiding parties sometimes took prisoners to torture or hold for ransom .

title: Xxiphu
description: Xxiphu Xxiphu , also known as the Soaring City , was an ancient mobile aboleth city from the Far Realm that had existed on Abeir - Toril since prehistoric times . Description . Xxiphu was a glyph - scribed obelisk with tentacles sprawling from its walls , wrapped in an eternal storm that soared over the surface of the world .
description_long: Xxiphu Xxiphu , also known as the Soaring City , was an ancient mobile aboleth city from the Far Realm that had existed on Abeir - Toril since prehistoric times . Description . Xxiphu was a glyph - scribed obelisk with tentacles sprawling from its walls , wrapped in an eternal storm that soared over the surface of the world . The inscriptions on the surface of the obelisk depicted thousands of interconnected images , that were constantly changing . The full meaning of the evolving inscription was too alien for mortal minds to comprehend and remain sane . Reality was altered around Xxiphu ' s vicinity , periodically spawning aberrations from the Far Realm onto the world . History . The ancient city of Xxiphu originally came to Abeir - Toril from the Far Realm when the world was young . Xxiphu plummeted to the world and settled deep below what is now the Sea of Fallen Stars . When Abeir - Toril was sundered into two twin planets , Abeir and Toril , the city of Xxiphu remained on Abeir . During the Spellplague , Xxiphu was transported to Faerûn during the Wailing Years . The monolith city was first raised over the Sea of Fallen Stars near Cormyr in 1389 DR .

title: Xylopal
description: Xylopal Xylopal was a form of petrified wood with a more lustrous beauty . Description . Xylopal was similar to tempskya ( petrified wood ) except the wood fiber was replaced by opal instead of .
description_long: Xylopal Xylopal was a form of petrified wood with a more lustrous beauty . Description . Xylopal was similar to tempskya ( petrified wood ) except the wood fiber was replaced by opal instead of . Sometimes called opalized wood or lithoxyle , it was highly prized for its beauty ( it made good bookends ) . Especially detailed pieces could be used as inlays , statuettes , or for jewelry . A typical price was 22sp per pound ( 49 sp / kg ) . Powers . This hardstone was able to substitute for the material components of the " reverse gravity " , specifically the iron filings and the lodestone . It required a hand - sized amount , either in a single stone or a bag of fragments .

title: Xynicynct
description: Xynicynct Xynicynct was the jailor of Vorgansharax in 1489 DR . History . After Vorgansharax ' s coup Xynicynct lead a squad of Tears of Virulence in trying to stop the escape from the city of Madame Freona , the Lord Sage of Phlan and Jhessail Greycastle but was killed by a adventuring party hired by the resistance
description_long: Xynicynct Xynicynct was the jailor of Vorgansharax in 1489 DR . History . After Vorgansharax ' s coup Xynicynct lead a squad of Tears of Virulence in trying to stop the escape from the city of Madame Freona , the Lord Sage of Phlan and Jhessail Greycastle but was killed by a adventuring party hired by the resistance

title: Xzar
description: Xzar Xzar was an insane wizard and a member of the Zhentarim . He was quite unbalanced and would randomly spout gibberish at unpredictable moments . He was sent to the Baldur ' s Gate area during the iron crisis with his " colleague " Montaron .
description_long: Xzar Xzar was an insane wizard and a member of the Zhentarim . He was quite unbalanced and would randomly spout gibberish at unpredictable moments . He was sent to the Baldur ' s Gate area during the iron crisis with his " colleague " Montaron . In the Novel . In the " Baldur ' s Gate " novelization , Xzar saved Abdel Adrian from a horde of gibberling s with an odd magical device or spell of his making . He and Montaron both accompanied Adrian to the " Friendly Arms " inn and from there on to the Nashkel mines . Xzar repeatedly stated that Adrian was a Bhaalspawn , but that was put down to his insanity and no - one listened to him . He and his companion were killed by Sarevok after the group had cleared the mines . In the Games . In " Baldur ' s Gate " , Xzar ( together with Montaron , whom he calls " Monty " ) is likely to be amongst the very first party NPCs encountered . The two are lurking along the Way of the Lion east of Candlekeep , not far from the place where Gorion is killed . Xzar will offer the player character potions of healing as a supposed token of good will , and then try to shame them into accompanying him and Montaron to Nashkel in return for the favour .

title: Xzorsh
description: Xzorsh Xzorsh ( pronounced with a click followed by " zzorshhh " ) was a sea elf ranger dwelling in the Trackless Sea . Personality . Xzorsh was a ranger who was quite curious and relatively open - minded .
description_long: Xzorsh Xzorsh ( pronounced with a click followed by " zzorshhh " ) was a sea elf ranger dwelling in the Trackless Sea . Personality . Xzorsh was a ranger who was quite curious and relatively open - minded . He always had an interest in the arcane arts , but because of his background was never able to develop that interest . History . Hrolf , captain of the " Elfmaid " , saved Xzorsh ' s life when he was a child . From that point forward , Xzorsh pledged to protect the " Elfmaid " and all of her crew to the best of his ability . He was particularly involved in this promise in 1361 DR , when the " Elfmaid " was being pursued by the Kraken Society of Ascarle and by Rethnor of Luskan . Xzorsh was killed in 1361 DR by a drow group seeking Liriel Baenre . Xzorsh went with them willingly , believing they were wizard tutors Liriel had found for them . Relationships . Sittl . Sittl , another sea elf , was Xzorsh ' s partner and close friend . He turned out to be a malenti ( a mutated sahuagin appearing as a sea elf ) working for Ascarle . Liriel Baenre .

title: Xûl - Jarak
description: Xûl - Jarak Xûl - Jarak , also called The Gray Citadel because of its gray ashen walls , is a fortress that has long been in disrepair . It is situated two days ride north of Melvaunt along the road to Glister , in the realm of Thar . It sits atop a 20ft ( 7 .
description_long: Xûl - Jarak Xûl - Jarak , also called The Gray Citadel because of its gray ashen walls , is a fortress that has long been in disrepair . It is situated two days ride north of Melvaunt along the road to Glister , in the realm of Thar . It sits atop a 20ft ( 7 . 1 m ) high barren crag , and raises another two stories of fortifactions . The four levels of dungeons beneath the fortress has an entrance to the Underdark . Within the dungeons is King Kursk One - Tusk the Merciless ' crypt .

title: Y ' chak
description: Y ' chak Y ' chak , " " The Violet Flame " " , is an Elder Evil who is actively interested in the destruction of life and an inspiration for all that is destructive and ruinous within civilizations . The Aboleth s believe that the gods of evil came to be as a result of Y ' chak ' s whisperings and Y ' chak encourages the worship of those deities . Y ' chak appears to those it contacts as a member of the same race , but its true form is said to be a brilliant pillar of violet flames that conceal an inner form which is to horrifying to see .
description_long: Y ' chak Y ' chak , " " The Violet Flame " " , is an Elder Evil who is actively interested in the destruction of life and an inspiration for all that is destructive and ruinous within civilizations . The Aboleth s believe that the gods of evil came to be as a result of Y ' chak ' s whisperings and Y ' chak encourages the worship of those deities . Y ' chak appears to those it contacts as a member of the same race , but its true form is said to be a brilliant pillar of violet flames that conceal an inner form which is to horrifying to see . To honor Y ' chak , the aboleths build massive pillars of violet flame that burn underwater . Perhaps Y ' chak is just another name for the Outer God Nyarlathotep , which is known from the writings of H . P . Lovecraft .

title: Y ' lara
description: Y ' lara " Y ' lara " was a yochlol trapped in Menzoberranzan during the Rage of Demons . History . A yochlol was sent by Lolth to help Archmage of Menzoberranzan Gromph Baenre in a demon lord summoning ritual in late 1486 DR .
description_long: Y ' lara " Y ' lara " was a yochlol trapped in Menzoberranzan during the Rage of Demons . History . A yochlol was sent by Lolth to help Archmage of Menzoberranzan Gromph Baenre in a demon lord summoning ritual in late 1486 DR . The yochlol knew the true plot behind the spell . However , after the summoning , Gromph also understood the true meaning of what he did , and he magically trapped the yochlol in his private sanctuary before it escaped the city . Posing as a drow priestess called " Y ' lara " , the yochlol tried to obtain someone ' s help in order to escape .

title: Yaaz Gut - Breaker
description: Yaaz Gut - Breaker Yaaz Gut - Breaker was an ogre mage living on Jazirat al - Sadaf in the Crowded Sea in 1367 DR . He ruled a mixed tribe of ogres and ogre magi called the Gurum . Description .
description_long: Yaaz Gut - Breaker Yaaz Gut - Breaker was an ogre mage living on Jazirat al - Sadaf in the Crowded Sea in 1367 DR . He ruled a mixed tribe of ogres and ogre magi called the Gurum . Description . Yaaz was powerfully built and had a temper to match his strength . He had fiery red eyes and azure skin . Activities . Yaaz ruled the Gurum with an iron fist . Anyone speaking out against him is met with a brutal death . Most of the ogre magi families secretly plotted against him .

title: Yadd al - Djinni
description: Yadd al - Djinni Yadd al - Djinni , or the Hand of the Djinni , were rocky jungle islands of the Djinni ' s Claws southwest of mainland Zakhara . Geography . The islands of Yadd al - Djinni were very slender and covered with dense jungle .
description_long: Yadd al - Djinni Yadd al - Djinni , or the Hand of the Djinni , were rocky jungle islands of the Djinni ' s Claws southwest of mainland Zakhara . Geography . The islands of Yadd al - Djinni were very slender and covered with dense jungle . Inhabitants . Civilized people stayed far away from these islands since they were inhabited by a variety of monsters and undead , including the rare su - monster .

title: Yaemon
description: Yaemon Yaemon was a monk of Bishamon at the Shining Temple of Bishamon in the town of Aru in Wa . Personality . Yaemon was a good man but too often jumped too quickly to conclusions and reacted violently .
description_long: Yaemon Yaemon was a monk of Bishamon at the Shining Temple of Bishamon in the town of Aru in Wa . Personality . Yaemon was a good man but too often jumped too quickly to conclusions and reacted violently . If people explained to him his errors , however , he soon asked forgiveness . History . Around 1358 DR , Yaemon arrived in town to attend the Ceremony of the Three Thousand Steps . Hearing about menaces to the pilgrims , he decided to become their defender . Yaemon argued with Buntaro Ostato , who was working with an adventuring party hired by the daimyo Benju Matsumoto , about the deaths of some pilgrims . Later , he saw some pilgrims killed by some people resembling the adventuring party . Yaemon soon after attacked the real adventuring party in order to avenge the deaths of the pilgrims . Somehow , the adventurers managed to stop him and convinced him of their innocence .

title: Yaereene Ilbaereth
description: Yaereene Ilbaereth Yaereene Ilbaereth was an elf of House Ilbaereth and the proprietor of the Elfstone Tavern , a tavern aimed at elves and half - elves in the Castle Ward of Waterdeep . She usually had a blue - green faerie dragon familiar named Pyrith on her shoulder . Appearance .
description_long: Yaereene Ilbaereth Yaereene Ilbaereth was an elf of House Ilbaereth and the proprietor of the Elfstone Tavern , a tavern aimed at elves and half - elves in the Castle Ward of Waterdeep . She usually had a blue - green faerie dragon familiar named Pyrith on her shoulder . Appearance . Yaereene was tall with silvery eyes , and pale copper skin . Relatives . Malruthiia Chaadren was Yaereene ' s illegitimate half - sister . After Malruthiia ' s death , Yaereene sorely missed her , despite her family ' s general view on the matter .

title: Yaga - Shura
description: Yaga - Shura Yaga - Shura was a fire giant Bhaalspawn and one of the Five . He commanded an army of fire giants and humans in an attempt to destroy other Bhaalspawn , advancing greatly in that objective when he laid siege to and finally sacked Saradush . He had acquired invulnerability to all attacks by having his heart removed and keeping it burning with magical fire .
description_long: Yaga - Shura Yaga - Shura was a fire giant Bhaalspawn and one of the Five . He commanded an army of fire giants and humans in an attempt to destroy other Bhaalspawn , advancing greatly in that objective when he laid siege to and finally sacked Saradush . He had acquired invulnerability to all attacks by having his heart removed and keeping it burning with magical fire . Nevertheless , he was the second one of the Five to be killed , right after his destroying Saradush . Yaga - Shura was raised by a human witch called Nyalee , who also helped him achieve invulnerability by setting the fire to his heart . He did not ultimately show much gratitude , taking her magically removed heart with him as well to keep her from being able to undo the magic . Subsequently he took control of at least some of the fire giants in the Marching Mountains , recruiting many in his army and leaving others to guard the temple that housed his heart . Near the beginning of , the player character arrives in Saradush . The city is under siege by Yaga - Shura ' s forces and constant random bombing by catapults .

title: Yaghi - Siyan
description: Yaghi - Siyan Emir Yaghi - Siyan was the ruler of Delbyl during the mid 14th century DR . Activities . The position of Emir of Delbyl was typically given to incompetent individuals , or as punishment from the bey .
description_long: Yaghi - Siyan Emir Yaghi - Siyan was the ruler of Delbyl during the mid 14th century DR . Activities . The position of Emir of Delbyl was typically given to incompetent individuals , or as punishment from the bey . Yaghi - Siyan controlled all activity in the small backwater town of Delbyl . He was assisted by a civil watch comprised of twelve " maliks " , or chiefs , and the men under their command .

title: Yagoth
description: Yagoth Yagoth was an ogre chieftain of Thar during the Rage of Dragons of 1373 DR . History . Yagoth was both chieftain of his tribe and a shaman of the god Vaprak .
description_long: Yagoth Yagoth was an ogre chieftain of Thar during the Rage of Dragons of 1373 DR . History . Yagoth was both chieftain of his tribe and a shaman of the god Vaprak . In 1373 DR , Yagoth ' s tribe was attacked by a blue dragon maddened by the Rage but thanks to the timely help of the dragonslayers Will Turnstone and Pavel Shemov , they killed the mad dragon . Will and Pavel were in Thar searching for old ruins containing lore about the Dracorage and Yagoth offered his tribe ' s help . However , once they discovered the ruins , Yagoth betrayed the two dragonslayers , hoping to use the lore for his god ' s glory . Will managed to escape but Pavel was captured . Later , Will directed four enraged green dragon s against the ogres and in the chaos managed to free Pavel . Yagoth tried to subdue the two men but was instead killed .

title: Yak ' s Horn
description: Yak ' s Horn The Yak ' s Horn was a southwestern province of the Yikarian Empire in 1367 DR . Geography . This province was split into equal parts of rocky terrain from the World Pillar Mountains on the northeastern side , and a portion of the desert wasteland known as the Haunted Lands in the southwest .
description_long: Yak ' s Horn The Yak ' s Horn was a southwestern province of the Yikarian Empire in 1367 DR . Geography . This province was split into equal parts of rocky terrain from the World Pillar Mountains on the northeastern side , and a portion of the desert wasteland known as the Haunted Lands in the southwest . The Yak ' s Horn was easily the driest province of the Yikarian Empire . Inhabitants . Mother Millstone served as governor of the Yak ' s Horn .

title: Yak butter
description: Yak butter Yak butter was a soft cream cheese made from the of a yak . It was made in the Spine of the World , Khazari , the Hordelands and the Land of the Yak - Men . Description .
description_long: Yak butter Yak butter was a soft cream cheese made from the of a yak . It was made in the Spine of the World , Khazari , the Hordelands and the Land of the Yak - Men . Description . It was a mild and delicate cheese but had a more characterful flavor than a typical cream cheese . The best yak butter was made in the spring after the first major thaw . Uses . Yak butter was also an ingredient in butter tea . Prices . As of 1368 DR , a 450 g ( 1 lb ) tub was available for around four silver pieces , whereas a 45 kg ( 100 lb ) tub was about 35 gold pieces .

title: Yak folk
description: Yak folk Yak - folk were a race inhabiting the remote mountains of northern Zakhara . They referred to themselves as the yikaria , which translated as " Lucky Chosen " in their language . Yak - men was another common name for them among the natives of the Land of Fate .
description_long: Yak folk Yak - folk were a race inhabiting the remote mountains of northern Zakhara . They referred to themselves as the yikaria , which translated as " Lucky Chosen " in their language . Yak - men was another common name for them among the natives of the Land of Fate . Description . Yak - folk were ogre - sized humanoid s . Their heads resembled those of a and their bodies were covered in coarse fur . They preferred to wear robes and wield staves , some of which were magical . The only distinguishing feature between females and males was that the females were only slightly smaller . Their feet were hoofed but their arms possessed hands with five digits . Combat . Yak - folk were deadly opponents to face in combat . Many of them had access to an impressive array of magical items . Yak - folk leaders were always spellcasters who had access to both arcane and priestly magic . All yak - folk had the innate ability to summon and command dao . These dao were utterly helpless slaves under the control of their summoner . Angered by their situation , these dao vented their frustration on the closest available target : the yak - folk ' s enemies .

title: Yal Tengri
description: Yal Tengri Yal Tengri , also known as the Great Ice Sea , was an arm of the ocean that covered the north pole of Toril . All sorts of cold - loving creatures were found in its waters . The sea was open for about six months of the year .
description_long: Yal Tengri Yal Tengri , also known as the Great Ice Sea , was an arm of the ocean that covered the north pole of Toril . All sorts of cold - loving creatures were found in its waters . The sea was open for about six months of the year . Fall brought rapidly dropping temperatures and the water gradually froze over . In the winter Yal Tengri was basically a sheet of ice , broken only by a few dangerous shifting ribbons of open water . As spring dawned , icebergs calve off the permanent ice cap and the melting began .

title: Yalathanil Symbaern
description: Yalathanil Symbaern Yalathanil Symbaern was a reclusive sun elf wizard . Activities . As of 1368 DR , he was the patriarch of House Symbaern and was at least 1000 years old .
description_long: Yalathanil Symbaern Yalathanil Symbaern was a reclusive sun elf wizard . Activities . As of 1368 DR , he was the patriarch of House Symbaern and was at least 1000 years old . Possessions . Yalathanil once possessed a magical staff that was rumoured to have been able to send its wielder back in time by a few minutes in order to change the outcome of unfavourable events . It was not known whether he still possessed the staff , nor whether accounts of the staff ' s powers are accurate .

title: Yalek Snurd
description: Yalek Snurd Yalek Snurd was a spy of the Zhentarim in 1489 DR . History . Yalek infiltrated the new faction of the Cult of the Dragon led by Severin Silrajin .
description_long: Yalek Snurd Yalek Snurd was a spy of the Zhentarim in 1489 DR . History . Yalek infiltrated the new faction of the Cult of the Dragon led by Severin Silrajin . In 1489 DR , he was among a Cult contingent sent to establish an alliance with the great dragon Claugiyliamatar of Kryptgarden Forest . He reported to his Zhent masters all that happened and they gave the information to an adventuring party hired to defeat Old Gnawbones . The adventurers ambushed some stolen cargo guarded by some cultists , one of which was Yalek . They probably identified him thanks to his V - shaped scar and spared him . After the skirmish , he would reveal that the cultists were in search of a magic item , the Green Dragon ' s Mask , which was in possession of the hobgoblin warlord Garbul . Appendix . Appearances . " Corruption in Kryptgarden "

title: Yamun Khahan
description: Yamun Khahan Yamun Khahan lived in the Hordelands during the mid – 14th century DR . Personality . Though he came from humble beginnings , Yamun Khahan was a natural leader who possessed both charisma and strong ambition .
description_long: Yamun Khahan Yamun Khahan lived in the Hordelands during the mid – 14th century DR . Personality . Though he came from humble beginnings , Yamun Khahan was a natural leader who possessed both charisma and strong ambition . He was a cunning , brilliant military commander . Relationships . Yamun killed his father in 1334 DR , becoming khan of the Hoekun . Activities . Once he became khan of the Hoekun , Yamun organized the tribe into a small but efficient fighting force . Through sheer force , and aided allies — the Basymit s — Yamun was able to subvert the Jamaqua , Dalat , and several other tribes of the Tuigan , increasing the size of his army along the way . Yamun was eventually elected as the Khahan of the Tuigan . He then proceeded to conquer the Naican , Commani , and Oigur clans . Yamun chose to invite clans to join him with the hopes of preventing future blood feuds and wasting valuable lives that could be used to swell his expanding army . The remaining tribes of the Hordelands either joined Yamun Khahan or were crushed by his armies in battle until all the tribes of the Endless Wastes were united under a single banner called the Grand Army of the Tuigan .

title: Yan - C - Bin
description: Yan - C - Bin Yan - C - Bin , also known as the Prince of Evil Air , was a powerful archomental from the Elemental Plane of Air . Description . Yan - C - Bin commonly appeared to his followers as a tall , thin , elderly humanoid with long hair flowing in the wind .
description_long: Yan - C - Bin Yan - C - Bin , also known as the Prince of Evil Air , was a powerful archomental from the Elemental Plane of Air . Description . Yan - C - Bin commonly appeared to his followers as a tall , thin , elderly humanoid with long hair flowing in the wind . His true form was akin to a tornado . Personality . Yan - C - Bin was a being of great wisdom and pure malice . His plans began at the forging of the world . The most subtle of the Princes , he operated unseen and studied his foes from afar , attacking swiftly and vanishing before they could strike back . He cared nothing for those that worshiped him as a god or offered him prayer and sacrifice . All he cared about was seeing realm after realm torn apart by winds . Relationships . Yan - C - Bin and those that served him had a strong dislike of the servants of Ogrémoch and the Prince of Evil Earth himself . However , he recognized the Elder Elemental Eye as their father .

title: Yanitsava
description: Yanitsava The Yanitsava was a holy book within the Red Mountain Sect of the Path of Enlightenment . In it , it was said that all things had their balance . The lama Koja of Khazari used this to explain to Foxe that kumiss warmed the blood , despite the taste , and that Faerûn ian roast meats unbalanced the weak and strong animus — meaning that Foxe was overweight .
description_long: Yanitsava The Yanitsava was a holy book within the Red Mountain Sect of the Path of Enlightenment . In it , it was said that all things had their balance . The lama Koja of Khazari used this to explain to Foxe that kumiss warmed the blood , despite the taste , and that Faerûn ian roast meats unbalanced the weak and strong animus — meaning that Foxe was overweight . In his book , " A History of the Tuigan " , Koja wished to quote a verse of the " Yanitsava " to invoke Furo ' s blessing .

title: Yanna Hammerbound
description: Yanna Hammerbound Yanna Hammerbound was a dwarf and a high - ranking member of the Ironhanded in Phlan during the Tyranny of Dragons . History . Yanna worked as high - ranking member of Phlan ' s Ironworkers ' Guild .
description_long: Yanna Hammerbound Yanna Hammerbound was a dwarf and a high - ranking member of the Ironhanded in Phlan during the Tyranny of Dragons . History . Yanna worked as high - ranking member of Phlan ' s Ironworkers ' Guild . One day in 1489 DR , she went to the Madame Freona ' s Tea Kettle to meet a merchant named Trett in order to buy a powerful magic item . When a " lightning " spell from inside the item hit Trett , Yanna tried to escape with the magic item but was captured by adventurers hired by Buhrell Caah .

title: Yannik Johastra
description: Yannik Johastra Yannik Johastra was a minor noble in the Monastery of the Precipice in 1479 DR . Activities . Yannik traveled to Spellgard in 1478 DR seeking Lady Saharel ' s counsel regarding a feud between his sons .
description_long: Yannik Johastra Yannik Johastra was a minor noble in the Monastery of the Precipice in 1479 DR . Activities . Yannik traveled to Spellgard in 1478 DR seeking Lady Saharel ' s counsel regarding a feud between his sons . He believed that the key to have the Lady back was reconstructing the mansion .

title: Yanseldara
description: Yanseldara Lady Yanseldara is the , human , ruler of the city of Elversult . She killed the black dragon Cypress . When he was resurrected as a dracolich by the Cult of the Dragon , he became fixated on her believing himself to be in love with his killer .
description_long: Yanseldara Lady Yanseldara is the , human , ruler of the city of Elversult . She killed the black dragon Cypress . When he was resurrected as a dracolich by the Cult of the Dragon , he became fixated on her believing himself to be in love with his killer .

title: Yantha Coaxrock
description: Yantha Coaxrock Yantha Coaxrock was the leader of of the Stoneheart Enclave in Blingdenstone during the Rage of Demons . History . Yantha was a young wizard who became the leader of the Stoneheart Enclave in Blingdenstone .
description_long: Yantha Coaxrock Yantha Coaxrock was the leader of of the Stoneheart Enclave in Blingdenstone during the Rage of Demons . History . Yantha was a young wizard who became the leader of the Stoneheart Enclave in Blingdenstone . She split her time and energy between conducting magical research in her city , helping the svirfneblin enclave in Mantol — Derith , and working with the rest of the Stoneheart Enclave . During the Rage of Demons , Yantha was in Mantol - Derith , where the duergar merchant Krimgol Muzgardt hired her to set a gem in an item of jewelry . However , the gem was in fact a magical gem that caused madness — the work of the demon lord Fraz - Urb ' luu — and Yantha succumbed to the gem ' s influence and lied to Krimgol about its value . Suspecting treachery , the duergar demanded the gem back , but it was secretly stolen by Flink Thunderbonk , Yantha ' s apprentice . Krimgol did not believe Yantha ' s story and , with the support of Ghuldur Flagonfist , the duergar representative , attacked the deep gnome section of the city and kidnapped the wizard , starting a civil war in the trading post .

title: Yaphyll
description: Yaphyll Yaphyll was the Zulkir of divination in the Red Wizards of Thay who was a strong supporter of Druxus Rhym and Szass Tam . She often used her magic to keep an eye on the other Zulkirs and various Thay an enclaves throughout Faerûn . History .
description_long: Yaphyll Yaphyll was the Zulkir of divination in the Red Wizards of Thay who was a strong supporter of Druxus Rhym and Szass Tam . She often used her magic to keep an eye on the other Zulkirs and various Thay an enclaves throughout Faerûn . History . Yaphyll was once an imperialist and ally of Zulkir Lauzoril . Together with the other zulkirs she tried to stand against Szass Tam ' s aspirations to become sole ruler of Thay . In the years 1375 - 1385 DR , when it became apparent that the war that erupted turned into a stalemate with neither side gaining an advantage , Yaphyll switched sides and joined Szass . By then she was ready to do anything to shift the balance of power , break the stalemate , and end the war before it would destroy Thay completely . But the stalemate continued and over the years Yaphyll decided to rather stand with the living than with the undead , thus switching sides again in favor of the council of zulkirs . . As a result Szass took her prisoner in 1385 DR , binding her with powerful items of domination .

title: Yapoza
description: Yapoza Yapoza was an Azuposi human settlement of 1 , 200 people on the banks of the Pasocada River in Maztica . History . A myth surrounded the city ' s history .
description_long: Yapoza Yapoza was an Azuposi human settlement of 1 , 200 people on the banks of the Pasocada River in Maztica . History . A myth surrounded the city ' s history . It was alleged that when Matsailema , one of the War Twins , went on a rampage across the land , he became tired and chose to rest on the banks of the Pasocada River . While he was resting , a man and woman provided him with food and drink , and in exchange for their kindness , Matsailema pledged to provide the Azuposi people with prosperity , but introduced a matrilineal society to ensure that he kept some control over them . The site at which he took his rest was the site where the city was founded .

title: Yaraella
description: Yaraella Yarealla was a powerful Rashemi witch who had an extremely strong connection to the spirit world . In 1480 DR she was driven mad and apparently committed suicide , leaving her young daughter behind . In reality , Yarealla was murdered by the Wychlaren Sree because of Yarealla ' s refusal to join the Wychlaren and because Sree wanted to raise Yarealla ' s child as a Wychlaren .
description_long: Yaraella Yarealla was a powerful Rashemi witch who had an extremely strong connection to the spirit world . In 1480 DR she was driven mad and apparently committed suicide , leaving her young daughter behind . In reality , Yarealla was murdered by the Wychlaren Sree because of Yarealla ' s refusal to join the Wychlaren and because Sree wanted to raise Yarealla ' s child as a Wychlaren . Yarealla didn ' t go quietly to the grave . Her spirit began haunting her village , casuing crops to fail and agitating the native spirits of Rashemen . Yarealla ' s spirit reached out to the Shadar - kai witch Ilvani who also had a strong connection to the spirit world . Yarealla began haunting Ilvani ' s dreams which caused the creatures of the Shadowfell to go mad whenever Ilvani was near . In 1480 DR , Ilvani set out with a caravan to Rashemen to seek out the Wychlaren and the source of her haunting . The witches were able to perform a ritual which put Yarealla ' s spirit at rest .

title: Yarash
description: Yarash Yarash was a wizard living near Phlan in 1340 DR . Activities . Yarash was a wizard and alchemist who busied himself with creating new species in his pyramid near Phlan in order to dominate the Moonsea .
description_long: Yarash Yarash was a wizard living near Phlan in 1340 DR . Activities . Yarash was a wizard and alchemist who busied himself with creating new species in his pyramid near Phlan in order to dominate the Moonsea . He created many mutants that lived in rooms of the pyramid . History . Yarash was busy for 30 years in trying to create a race of freshwater sahuagin , despite never seeing a true sahuagin in his life . At last , in 1340 DR , an adventuring party killed him .

title: Yarbro
description: Yarbro Yarbro was a male human soldier living in Shadowdale during the Time of Troubles of 1358 DR . History . He was guarding the gates of the city when the company of Midnight and Kelemvor Lyonsbane arrived before Bane ' s assault .
description_long: Yarbro Yarbro was a male human soldier living in Shadowdale during the Time of Troubles of 1358 DR . History . He was guarding the gates of the city when the company of Midnight and Kelemvor Lyonsbane arrived before Bane ' s assault . He had a great antipathy for the four adventurers . He survived the Battle of Shadowdale . When Midnight and Adon , accused of killing Elminster Aumar , escaped with the aid of Cyric , the Lord of Shadowdale chose Yarbro and Kelemvor to lead an expedition to recapture them . The company managed to recapture the fugitives but at that point Kelemvor fell victim to his curse and killed most of the men . Yarbro escaped with some other men and found Cyric . Yarbro ' s bad mood convinced Cyric of his decision , and he manipulated the Dalesmen into believing that he was only a victim of Adon and Midnight . Later , the Company of the Scorpions met and killed most of the surviving Dalesmen . Only Yarbro and Cyric remained ; Cyric revealed his evil deeds and killed Yarbro in cold blood .

title: Yarin Frostmantle
description: Yarin Frostmantle Yarin Frostmantle was the king of the Bloodstone Lands . History . Yarin Frostmantle was born a noble in the Bloodstone Lands .
description_long: Yarin Frostmantle Yarin Frostmantle was the king of the Bloodstone Lands . History . Yarin Frostmantle was born a noble in the Bloodstone Lands . He bought lots of land and became the richest man in the land ; it was said that was how he became king circa 1464 DR . It was also rumored that Frostmantle had murdered the previous king , Murtil Dragonsbane , thus ending the line of Dragonsbane . As king , he was very paranoid and operated multiple spy networks . By 1484 DR , Frostmantle had no heirs and was on his seventh wife , Queen Concettina , whom he married three years previously . Frostmantle had divorced his first four wives because of claims of barrenness . The fifth and sixth wives had been executed by guillotine in the palace gardens : the fifth wife for treason ( it was claimed she had taken substances to prevent pregnancy ) and the sixth for murder ( it was rumored she had given birth to a son whom she murdered in bed ) . Statues of each of the wives were located in the palace gardens ; the statues of the fifth and sixth wives were headless . Relationships . King Frostmantle was seen as a tyrant king .

title: Yarjack Blamreld
description: Yarjack Blamreld Yarjack Blamreld was a veteran War Wizard of Cormyr in Arabel . History . Around 1479 DR , Blamreld was one of the leading War Wizards sent to besiege the Stormserpent Towers near Suzail .
description_long: Yarjack Blamreld Yarjack Blamreld was a veteran War Wizard of Cormyr in Arabel . History . Around 1479 DR , Blamreld was one of the leading War Wizards sent to besiege the Stormserpent Towers near Suzail . On this occasion , he checked young wizard Caldor Raventree ' s personality .

title: Yarkul
description: Yarkul Yarkul was a member of the Zhentarim in Darkhold in the Year of the Tankard , 1370 DR . Description . Yarkul was a black - haired female wizard .
description_long: Yarkul Yarkul was a member of the Zhentarim in Darkhold in the Year of the Tankard , 1370 DR . Description . Yarkul was a black - haired female wizard . Personality . Her ambition was to become the lover and second - in - command of Sememmon but her plot was easily detecting by the others . Relationships . The wizard was the best student of Ashemmi but she was said to be tutored also by Khelben Arunsun . History . As trusted member of the Sememmon ' s faction , Yarkul was peripherally involved in the hunt for Shandril Shessair

title: Yarlhang La
description: Yarlhang La Yarlhang La , or the Trying Pass , was a prominent mountain pass located the Hordelands . Based upon maps of the region , Yarlhang La was the general location where the A - Ling Shan and Katakoro Shan mountain ranges converged . Geography .
description_long: Yarlhang La Yarlhang La , or the Trying Pass , was a prominent mountain pass located the Hordelands . Based upon maps of the region , Yarlhang La was the general location where the A - Ling Shan and Katakoro Shan mountain ranges converged . Geography . Located on the northwestern side of the mountain range , Yarlhang La was the only pass through the steep rock surfaces . The Old Caravan Road wound through the pass on the way toward Kushk .

title: Yarno
description: Yarno Yarno was a young werewolf living in Velarswood . Description . He had dark hair and was dirty .
description_long: Yarno Yarno was a young werewolf living in Velarswood . Description . He had dark hair and was dirty . He appeared to be about 12 years old . History . Yarno ' s parents were killed by a drow hunt the year he was born . Hed lived with his grandfather , also a werewolf . His grandfather had been a former slave of the drow but escaped . They lived together in a hut in the forest , hiding from Eilistraee ans , who hated them and hunted them . In 1373 DR , Yarno came across the drow Ryld Argith in the forest and bit him . Ryld was bitten by Yarno and given belladonna to ward off lycanthropy . Yarno took him to his grandfather , who had injured his leg . Ryld helped his grandfather tend to his leg and in return was given belladonna to ward off the lycanthropic infection . Ryld passed out in the woods , where Yarno found him once again and nursed him back to health . Yarno reminded Ryld of himself as a young child .

title: Yarrat
description: Yarrat Yarrat was a small dwarven village within the High Desert of Zakhara . Description . Yarrat was located near the southern tip of the Genies ' Anvil .
description_long: Yarrat Yarrat was a small dwarven village within the High Desert of Zakhara . Description . Yarrat was located near the southern tip of the Genies ' Anvil . The dwarves dug pits into the sand that were shaded by ironwood trees . Each family had their own pit . Inhabitants . Yarrat was populated by hearty dwarves whose ability to survive and find water was legendary . It was rumored that they had over a hundred secret water caches scattered throughout the Genies ' Anvil . Other desert tribes would often hire the dwarves as guides in their travels . The females practiced " sahar " , a special form of magic that used colored stones taken from the Genie ' s Anvil . Each stone needed to have a smooth side and a rough side to be suitable . The stone ' s color symbolized different aspects : black for land , blue for sea , white for woman , red for man , brown for camel . The " evil eye " could be cast by crushing a white or red stone while saying a person ' name . Many other effects could be produced by combining different stones and uttering appropriate phrases . Casting the stone like dice allowed the practitioner to read the future .

title: Yarsha
description: Yarsha Yarsha was a high - ranking member of the Cult of the Black Earth at the Temple of the Black Earth in Tyar - Besil during the Elemental Evil crisis . Personality . Yarsha was a murderous individual , plotting to kill and replace Miraj Vizann .
description_long: Yarsha Yarsha was a high - ranking member of the Cult of the Black Earth at the Temple of the Black Earth in Tyar - Besil during the Elemental Evil crisis . Personality . Yarsha was a murderous individual , plotting to kill and replace Miraj Vizann . History . In 1491 DR , Yarsha and her two bodyguards controlled the guardroom of the temple .

title: Yartar
description: Yartar Yartar was a fortified city standing on the east bank of the River Dessarin . It was connected by a fortified bridge to a citadel on the west bank where the Evermoor Way ( linking Triboar and Silverymoon crossed the Dessarin . It was a crossroads trading town , so it was always bustling with caravans entering and leaving its walls .
description_long: Yartar Yartar was a fortified city standing on the east bank of the River Dessarin . It was connected by a fortified bridge to a citadel on the west bank where the Evermoor Way ( linking Triboar and Silverymoon crossed the Dessarin . It was a crossroads trading town , so it was always bustling with caravans entering and leaving its walls . History . In 1361 DR , Baron Alahar Khaumfros attempted to further a plot to provoke the Lords ' Alliance ( particularly Waterdeep ) to war against Ruathym on behalf of the Kraken Society and Luskan . He was foiled in his attempt when Liriel Baenre , Fyodor , and Caladorn Cassalanter discovered the plot . Government . The ruler of Yartar , the " Waterbaron " , was elected for life . The Waterbaron in 1366 DR was Belleethe Kheldorna . This position was previously held by Alahar Khaumfros , who had inherited the position from his father and who was later revealed to be the leader of the Kraken Society . Khaufros employed the doppelganger Semmonemily to do his dirty work and had an elderly steward was named Cladence . Alliances . Yartar was a member of the Lords ' Alliance .

title: Yarth
description: Yarth Yarth of Berun was a gnome businessman in Daggerford around 1370 DR . Activities . Yarth managed a series of vaults , considered the safest places to store items in all the North .
description_long: Yarth Yarth of Berun was a gnome businessman in Daggerford around 1370 DR . Activities . Yarth managed a series of vaults , considered the safest places to store items in all the North . He claimed that no one could enter one of his vaults without authorization . His vaults were also protected by a ward that stopped evil actions , even those made for good reasons .

title: Yarting
description: Yarting A yarting was a stringed instrument , similar to a , common to Amn and Calimshan . Description . Yartings were widespread among bard s across Faerûn and many variations of the instrument existed .
description_long: Yarting A yarting was a stringed instrument , similar to a , common to Amn and Calimshan . Description . Yartings were widespread among bard s across Faerûn and many variations of the instrument existed . Various sizes of yartings were available for purchase through " Aurora ' s Whole Realms Catalogue " .

title: Yashar
description: Yashar Yashar was a male medusa that guarded the Undying Temple during the Silence of Lolth . Description . He was only 5 ft ( 1 .
description_long: Yashar Yashar was a male medusa that guarded the Undying Temple during the Silence of Lolth . Description . He was only 5 ft ( 1 . 5 m ) tall and sported a supple but tough body . Personality . Yashar was an intensely striking individual , whose presence could draw the eye of even casual observers , albeit to their detriment . Abilities . As a medusa , Yashar employed the abilities famed by his kind to petrify those who met his gaze . This ability was augmented by the " ring of ethereal sight " that he wore , which enabled his petrifying glare to affect even creatures on the ethereal plane . Yashar had also cultivated fairly potent sorcerous powers , with an emphasis on manipulating force energy , owing to its effectiveness against incorporeal creatures . He could create an impenetrable " wall of force " or conjure a deadly " thunderlance " to help him in battle , among many other spells . Additionally , Yashar was an adroit archer and could fire his arrows accurately even when outnumbered or in close - quarters . If pressed , the numerous snakes that formed his hair could still keep an enemy occupied . Possessions . Yashar a wielded a " + 2 shortbow " in battle .

title: Yasir
description: Yasir Yasir was a bandit and member of the Desert Wind during the mid – 14th century DR . Activities . Yasir served as one of Sheik Ar - Rabi ' s lieutenants .
description_long: Yasir Yasir was a bandit and member of the Desert Wind during the mid – 14th century DR . Activities . Yasir served as one of Sheik Ar - Rabi ' s lieutenants . He commanded fellow bandits , raiding local tribes on the Plains of Purple Dust and southern Murghôm . Relationships . Though he was loyal to Ar - Rabi , Yasir harbored personal ambitions as well .

title: Yasmi al - Datma
description: Yasmi al - Datma Yasmi al - Datma was one of many wives of the Grand Caliph Khalil al - Assad al - Zahir in Huzuz . Description . Yasmi was a slim , elven woman with wide , sky blue eyes .
description_long: Yasmi al - Datma Yasmi al - Datma was one of many wives of the Grand Caliph Khalil al - Assad al - Zahir in Huzuz . Description . Yasmi was a slim , elven woman with wide , sky blue eyes . Personality . Yasmi was quiet but intelligent . Abilities . She possessed skills in sorcery and had the ability to play the dulcimer . Activities . When Khalil was occupied at night with his other wives , Yasmi and Tanya would often escape the palace by using Tanya ' s " teleport " spell . Relationships . Yasmi was married to the Grand Caliph in 1362 DR . Yasmi was quickly befriended by Tanya bint Perijan who realized the importance of having a sorcerer in the harem . History . Before she married the Grand Caliph , Yasmi was a respected member of the Grand Vizier ' s palace security force .

title: Yasraena Dyrr
description: Yasraena Dyrr Yasraena Dyrr was the matron mother of House Agrach Dyrr of Menzoberranzan until 1373 DR . History . Yasraena was the granddaughter of the Lichdrow and sister of Auro ' pol Dyrr , who was matron mother until 1358 DR .
description_long: Yasraena Dyrr Yasraena Dyrr was the matron mother of House Agrach Dyrr of Menzoberranzan until 1373 DR . History . Yasraena was the granddaughter of the Lichdrow and sister of Auro ' pol Dyrr , who was matron mother until 1358 DR . After Auro ' pol ' s death , Yasraena was chosen by the Lichdrow to be matron mother . In 1372 DR , during the Silence of Lolth , House Agrach Dyrr entered into a secret alliance with the Jaezred Chaulssin , which had chosen that house because of its de facto male ruler , the ( Lichdrow Dyrr ) . In exchange for the assassination of Matron Mother Ghenni Tlabbar , they worked with Nimor Imphraezl to betray Menzoberranzan ' s Army of the Black Spider to the armies of Gracklstugh and Kaanyr Vhok . Nimor posed as Captain " Zhayemd " of House Agrach Dyrr in order to complete the deception . After the house ' s betrayal was revealed , the house compound was besieged by House Xorlarrin and its allies . Gromph Baenre battled Lord Dyrr , destroying his corporeal form . Thus the defense of the house was for the first time truly in the hands of Yasraena and her daughters . However , Gromph infiltrated their compound in order to destroy the lich ' s phylactery .

title: Yastera Menano
description: Yastera Menano Yastera " Blackhands " Menano was a Proven Thief of the Shadowmasters of Telflamm in 1370 DR with a unique power . Description . Yastera was slender and fairly short , with wispy red hair and freckles on her nose .
description_long: Yastera Menano Yastera " Blackhands " Menano was a Proven Thief of the Shadowmasters of Telflamm in 1370 DR with a unique power . Description . Yastera was slender and fairly short , with wispy red hair and freckles on her nose . Personality . Yastera was happy that she got special attention from the guild for her unique ability . The praise and consideration she received kept her loyal to the Shadowmasters . Abilities . Like many of the members of the Shadowmasters , she underwent the " Ritual of Shadow Walking " and gained the ability to " shadow walk " at the cost of some of her overall health and a slight reduction in the sharpness of her skills . Strangely , Yastera acquired the ability to carry one other person while " shadow walking " , making her extremely valuable for kidnapping operations where the target was difficult to reach or heavily guarded . When she used this ability , her hands gave off an unusual nimbus of black radiance , and this earned her the nickname , " Blackhands " . Possessions . The guild gave her a " cloak of elvenkind " to aid her in her missions .

title: Yataghan
description: Yataghan The yataghan was a type of one - handed sword , closely related to the sabre . Description . It featured a broad blade with one edge , slightly curved inward .
description_long: Yataghan The yataghan was a type of one - handed sword , closely related to the sabre . Description . It featured a broad blade with one edge , slightly curved inward . Weaponology . It was made in a way that emphasized the natural movement in a slashing attack , while the weight of its somewhat broader front half made downward cuts especially effective . It could be wielded about as fast as a bastard sword when used one - handed . Use . The yataghan was in use in the lands of Kara - Tur and Zakhara . Appendix . Notes . This weapon is based on the that was used in .

title: Yathaghera
description: Yathaghera Yathaghera , the Winged Queen , is a pegasus demigoddess bound to Toril and the Prime Material Plane . She dwells on the Island of Evermeet . Appearance .
description_long: Yathaghera Yathaghera , the Winged Queen , is a pegasus demigoddess bound to Toril and the Prime Material Plane . She dwells on the Island of Evermeet . Appearance . Yathaghera appears as a magnificent pegasus with a silver mane and rainbow - colored wings . Relationships . Yathaghera is the daughter of the winged unicorn god Eachthighern , and the younger sister of Lurue . Worshipers . Yathaghera is queen of the pegasi and unicorn s of Evermeet , but her subjects actually worship her father , Eachthighern , rather than her . The chaotic unicorns rarely even pay attention to her .

title: Yathchol webrider
description: Yathchol webrider A Yathchol webrider was a prestige class of the Underdark . Yathchol webriders were generally members of the chitine race of spiderkind , though anyone who possessed the capacity to create a web through natural or magical means might elect to become a webrider . A stealthy disposition meant that rogues were a natural fit for this class .
description_long: Yathchol webrider A Yathchol webrider was a prestige class of the Underdark . Yathchol webriders were generally members of the chitine race of spiderkind , though anyone who possessed the capacity to create a web through natural or magical means might elect to become a webrider . A stealthy disposition meant that rogues were a natural fit for this class . Yathchol webriders believed in a mystical construct called the " Overweb " , a web that connected all of the Underdark together and allowed those who possessed the knowledge of it to travel along it . Because of this knowledge , Yathchol webriders were capable of moving at great speeds , ignoring barriers of rock that would force others to make detours . Yathchol webriders were a very close community and generally very tightly integrated into chitine society , though non - chitines might create their own communities or even walk the infinite paths of the Overweb alone . Their dispositions and alignments varied just like most other groups , although communities of Yathchol webriders typically shared the same views .

title: Yather Indaglol
description: Yather Indaglol Yather Indaglol was the proprietor of the Helm at Highsun in Red Larch . Personality . Yather Indaglol was a reclusive mage who stays in a locked , warded room in the back of his tavern .
description_long: Yather Indaglol Yather Indaglol was the proprietor of the Helm at Highsun in Red Larch . Personality . Yather Indaglol was a reclusive mage who stays in a locked , warded room in the back of his tavern . History . Yather was once an adventurer , and made visits to other planes . Activities . He ran the Helm with the aid of his helmed horror named Araldyk , " wizard eye " spells , speaking tubes , and a staff of a dozen workers . Yather was trying to perfect a mobile , invisible " wardmist " spell that was centered on himself at all times . He wanted the spell to never fail and constantly sustain him so he didn ' t have to eat , sleep , age , or die . He only managed to create a semi - permanent , mobile magical field around himself that duplicated the effects of a " light " spell at will . It also allowed Yather to regenerate a small amount of health . Strangely , this spell was fed by the soul of an older wizard that existed as a floating , undead skull that could not be turned . The skull could not harm anyone except by talking ceaselessly — which it did to Yather — constantly distracting him from his research . Resources . Yather was very rich .

title: Yathla Oloryn
description: Yathla Oloryn Yathla " Shimmerstar " Oloryn " was a human woman living in Calaunt in the Vast around 1358 DR . She was an expert make - up artist and cosmetic surgeon , skilled with all kinds of human disguises . She was also a talented actor .
description_long: Yathla Oloryn Yathla " Shimmerstar " Oloryn " was a human woman living in Calaunt in the Vast around 1358 DR . She was an expert make - up artist and cosmetic surgeon , skilled with all kinds of human disguises . She was also a talented actor . Yathla ' s services could be hired by adventurer s .

title: Yathrinshee
description: Yathrinshee Mistresses of undead , the yathrinshee used arcane magic along with their clerical powers to further the aims of Kiaransalee . Culture . Yathrinshees were leaders among the church of Kiaransalee and were often the instigators of many of the church ' s plots .
description_long: Yathrinshee Mistresses of undead , the yathrinshee used arcane magic along with their clerical powers to further the aims of Kiaransalee . Culture . Yathrinshees were leaders among the church of Kiaransalee and were often the instigators of many of the church ' s plots . Considered the elite of the worshipers of Kiaransalee , only drow females were generally admitted into their ranks . Besides a good degree of skill in both arcane and divine magic necromantic magic , other vile acts were required for those wishing to join . Most notably was that each yathrinshee must have engaged in perverted sexual acts with some form of undead . Abilities . As yathrinshees became more experienced , they developed their arcane and divine powers simultaneously , as well as gaining mastery over necromantic magic . Relationships . As part of their initiation into the ranks of the yathrinshee , each member must become perform numerous sex acts with some form of undead .

title: Yaulazna
description: Yaulazna Yaulazna was an earthmote used as a fortress by the Five Companies . History . Yaulazna was originally a pirate enclave on Halruaa ' s coast .
description_long: Yaulazna Yaulazna was an earthmote used as a fortress by the Five Companies . History . Yaulazna was originally a pirate enclave on Halruaa ' s coast . Sometime before the Year of Blue Fire , 1385 DR , the lizardfolk of Rethild were given three skyship s by the Halruaan merchant houses with which to harry the pirates of the Great Sea and the Crinti of Dambrath . However , Yaulazna broke off and became an earthmote during the Spellplague of 1385 DR , which also devastated the town and destroyed its protective wards . Following Halruaa ' s destruction , wizards fleeing the destruction found the earthmote and the pirates and lizardfolk that inhabited it . Following a brief clash , the Halruaans made an accord with the remaining pirates before seizing the lizardfolk ' s skyships . In the end , the Yaulaznans found themselves with five working skyships and formed the Yaulazna Pact to protect each other ; this pact eventually evolved into the Five Companies . Geography . There was but one village on Yaulazna . At its heart was a central keep with five towers — one for each of the Five Companies , with the central keep for House Jordain .

title: Yauln
description: Yauln Yauln was the leader of a stone giant clan in the ancient past . History . Yauln led his clan until the duergar of Gracklstugh offered an alliance .
description_long: Yauln Yauln was the leader of a stone giant clan in the ancient past . History . Yauln led his clan until the duergar of Gracklstugh offered an alliance . He went to the mystic library of Gravenhollow asking for counsel . It was known that a stone giant clan became a longtime ally of Gracklstugh ' s kings .

title: Yavendel
description: Yavendel Yavendel was a druid of the Emerald Enclave in Mulmaster . History . In 1491 DR , Yavendel found some of her burrowing mammal friends acting strange .
description_long: Yavendel Yavendel was a druid of the Emerald Enclave in Mulmaster . History . In 1491 DR , Yavendel found some of her burrowing mammal friends acting strange . Investigating , she discovered that they had escaped into a tunnel inside the city . Following them inside , Yavendel exited in the Oxpit Tavern , where she met an adventuring party hired to locate some vandals . Activities . In 1491 DR , Yavendel patrolled just outside the city at the behest of the Emerald Enclave .

title: Yawning Portal
description: Yawning Portal The Yawning Portal inn , built in 1306 DR by the later Lord of Waterdeep Durnan on the ruins of Halaster Blackcloak ' s old tower , gained most of its renown for being the primary open route to the Undermountain . A well within its walls led down into the first dungeon of Undermountain . Location .
description_long: Yawning Portal The Yawning Portal inn , built in 1306 DR by the later Lord of Waterdeep Durnan on the ruins of Halaster Blackcloak ' s old tower , gained most of its renown for being the primary open route to the Undermountain . A well within its walls led down into the first dungeon of Undermountain . Location . The Yawning Portal was located on Rainrun Street in Waterdeep ' s Castle Ward between Waterdeep Castle and Snail Street . Patronage . The clientele consisted mostly of adventurers eager to enter the depths of Undermountain . The Called , as they were sometimes known , listened to Waterdhavian s , who were only too keen on sharing rumors and stories about the dungeon . As Durnan , despite his old age , was still a brawny man , who kept his old greatsword among the racks and " asked " any troublemakers to leave the inn , the Yawning Portal remained safe from toughs and brawlers . Architecture and decor . A stone building with a slate roof , the Yawning Portal offered guest rooms on the three upper floors . Well - worn boards covered the floor , but the main impression was of comfort .

title: Yder Tanthul
description: Yder Tanthul Prince Yder Tanthul was a male shade and the right hand of his older brother Prince Rivalen Tanthul , whilst being respected and feared as a warrior . Personality . Unlike his elder brother , Rivalen , Yder has no quarrel with Telamont ' s hand , Hadrhune .
description_long: Yder Tanthul Prince Yder Tanthul was a male shade and the right hand of his older brother Prince Rivalen Tanthul , whilst being respected and feared as a warrior . Personality . Unlike his elder brother , Rivalen , Yder has no quarrel with Telamont ' s hand , Hadrhune . He would simply like the will of his deity guide the Shadovar rather than Hadrhune ' s . Possessions . Yder ' s personal Sigil is a stylized silver greatsword on a gray field . The pommel of this sword is a replica of the symbold of shar ( a black disk with a deep purple border ) . History . Like the rest of his brothers , Yder was born before the Karsus ' s Folly in Netheril at some point . Initially trained as a soldier among the Shadovar army , Yder reached the rank of captain before he joined Shar ' s service as Rivalen ' s right hand man . After - 339 DR , spent much of his life on the Plane of Shadow where he was transformed into a Shade like many of his kin . By 1372 DR , when Telamont Tanthul returned Thultanthar to Faerûn , Yder was a divine champion dedicated to Shar and commanded the guards of the Hall of Shadow .

title: Yeenoghu
description: Yeenoghu Yeenoghu was the demon prince and lord of savagery , and the chief being worshiped by gnoll s . Relationships . Yeenoghu was the patron of all gnolls and commanded the servitude of ghoul s through the subjugation of the demonic King of Ghouls , Doresain , a former ally of Orcus , who failed to strike back at Yeenoghu for the acquisition of one of his subjects .
description_long: Yeenoghu Yeenoghu was the demon prince and lord of savagery , and the chief being worshiped by gnoll s . Relationships . Yeenoghu was the patron of all gnolls and commanded the servitude of ghoul s through the subjugation of the demonic King of Ghouls , Doresain , a former ally of Orcus , who failed to strike back at Yeenoghu for the acquisition of one of his subjects . Yeenoghu had a continuous feud with Baphomet , and both demon s pulled no punches when dealing with one another . The fight lasted so long that neither demon lord could remember what originally started the battle . Along with Baphomet , Yeenoghu loathes Malcanthet , the queen of the succubus , because the Queen destroyed of a number of Yeenoghu ' s material plane cultists , the Maure Family . Worshipers . The tanar ' ri lord ' s only known worshipers were gnoll s and flind s . Clerics of Yeenoghu had access to the domains of Chaos , Demonic , Evil , and Strength . Equipment . Yennoghu wielded a three headed " flail + 3 " in battle .

title: Yegar
description: Yegar Lord Yegar was the ruler of Citadel Rashemar during the mid 14th century DR . Activities . Lord Yegar dispatched patrols to monitor the Sunrise Mountains .
description_long: Yegar Lord Yegar was the ruler of Citadel Rashemar during the mid 14th century DR . Activities . Lord Yegar dispatched patrols to monitor the Sunrise Mountains . He spent most of his time pressing Rashemen ' s rights to the copper mines located in Murghôm . He claimed this because of ancient borders and not present day alignment .

title: Yegor
description: Yegor Yegor was the leader of a cell of the Cult of the Black Earth in the Moonsea . History . Yegor led an earth cultist cell in the Moonsea ; they acted as minor pirates until 1491 DR .
description_long: Yegor Yegor was the leader of a cell of the Cult of the Black Earth in the Moonsea . History . Yegor led an earth cultist cell in the Moonsea ; they acted as minor pirates until 1491 DR . That year , they were tasked with taking the elemental codex from Furgis Boltsmelter . Yegor ' s minions tried many times to take it but were always defeated . At last , Yegor himself led a last group of cultists against Furgis and / or his adventuring party bodyguards , who were talking with the drow wizard Murssvayas Dhuurniv , but they were defeated and Yegor killed .

title: Yehimal Mountains
description: Yehimal Mountains The Yehimal , a name meaning " Rock - Snow " , or the Mountains of Snow , and sometimes called the Yehimal Mountains or simply the Yehimals , was an immense mountain range that formed the primary barrier between the three continents of Zakhara , Faerûn , and Kara - Tur , and between them the Hordelands . They were famed as the largest , highest , most extensive , and indeed greatest mountain range in all the known lands of Toril . Geography .
description_long: Yehimal Mountains The Yehimal , a name meaning " Rock - Snow " , or the Mountains of Snow , and sometimes called the Yehimal Mountains or simply the Yehimals , was an immense mountain range that formed the primary barrier between the three continents of Zakhara , Faerûn , and Kara - Tur , and between them the Hordelands . They were famed as the largest , highest , most extensive , and indeed greatest mountain range in all the known lands of Toril . Geography . The Yehimal was undoubtedly the most majestic natural wonder in all the Hordelands , thanks to its soaring , glacier - topped peaks . These ranged in height from 15 , 000 feet ( 4570 meters ) to astonishing 30 , 000 feet ( 9140 meters ) above sea level , marking them as the tallest in the world . The mountains were formed from folded and upthrust granite , with jagged profiles . The mountains sprawled southwest of Shou Lung in Kara - Tur and lay south and east of the Jumpa River Gorge , which delineated the mountains from the steppes of the Hordelands . The Yehimal effectively dominated and separated the steppes from the southern kingdoms .

title: Yellow Sea
description: Yellow Sea The Yellow Sea washed the northern shores of Kara - Tur and the haunted island of Talmaruk , as well as the west coast of Koryo . Geography . Some in Shou Lung considered the Yellow Sea to be the same as the Celestial Sea , which lay in the south .
description_long: Yellow Sea The Yellow Sea washed the northern shores of Kara - Tur and the haunted island of Talmaruk , as well as the west coast of Koryo . Geography . Some in Shou Lung considered the Yellow Sea to be the same as the Celestial Sea , which lay in the south . Inhabitants . Many tribal settlements dotted the shores of the Yellow Sea . These were inhabited by Wu - haltai , who believed in the Lord of the Sea . Legends . The Koryoans knew the Yellow Sea as a home to sea serpents and strange magical phenomena , such as a green mist that transformed people into fish and a blue ice so cold it burned flesh , yet sizzled and smoked when immersed in water . The Wu - Haltai told that the worst winter storms were breathed out by the evil spirits of the isle of Talmaruk .

title: Yellow Serpent Border Cliffs
description: Yellow Serpent Border Cliffs The Yellow Serpent Border Cliffs was a long stretch of sheer rock that served as a natural boundary between part of the eastern Hordelands and western Shou Lung , specifically the provinces of Mai Yuan and Ch ' ing Tung . Geography . The cliffs ran for hundreds of miles from the northernmost region of the Yehimal mountains near Nas Trango Shan to the peak of Shan Trango in the south .
description_long: Yellow Serpent Border Cliffs The Yellow Serpent Border Cliffs was a long stretch of sheer rock that served as a natural boundary between part of the eastern Hordelands and western Shou Lung , specifically the provinces of Mai Yuan and Ch ' ing Tung . Geography . The cliffs ran for hundreds of miles from the northernmost region of the Yehimal mountains near Nas Trango Shan to the peak of Shan Trango in the south . Description . Much of the cliff face was a sheer drop , including a dizzying 2 , 000 ft . plunge at the Yellow Thunder Falls .

title: Yellow Thunder Falls
description: Yellow Thunder Falls The Yellow Thunder Falls were a large series of waterfalls in the Endless Wastes region . Description . Falling over the Yellow Serpent Border Cliffs in the Katakoro Plateau , the Takt Muren river dropped over 2 , 000 feet ( 610 meters ) to form this large waterfall .
description_long: Yellow Thunder Falls The Yellow Thunder Falls were a large series of waterfalls in the Endless Wastes region . Description . Falling over the Yellow Serpent Border Cliffs in the Katakoro Plateau , the Takt Muren river dropped over 2 , 000 feet ( 610 meters ) to form this large waterfall . The name of the falls came from the sulfurous deposits in the nearby cliffs . The misty water caught the various shades of the rock , giving the falls a golden , fiery color . The falls were known to appear suddenly , offering little warning to travelers on the water . That , when combined with the strong current of the river , made avoiding them difficult and dangerous . A small , steep , path crisscrossed the cliffs in switchbacks from the top to its base . Windblown mist was known to cover the path , making it very dangerous . It took most of a day to climb the path .

title: Yemere
description: Yemere Yemere was a steel dragon who lived in the disguise of a young windsoul genasi in Akanûl . He was a participant in the draconic game of Xorvintaal and was allied with the gray dragon Vairshekellabex . Yemere travelled with Aoth Fezim ' s expedition into the Akanapeaks to kill Vairshekellabex .
description_long: Yemere Yemere was a steel dragon who lived in the disguise of a young windsoul genasi in Akanûl . He was a participant in the draconic game of Xorvintaal and was allied with the gray dragon Vairshekellabex . Yemere travelled with Aoth Fezim ' s expedition into the Akanapeaks to kill Vairshekellabex . He charmed a young stormsoul genasi named Son - liin and forced her to take actions to harm the expedition . One night , Gaedynn Ulraes remained awake all night and followed Son - liin to her rendezvous with Yemere where he attacked the dragon . Yemere nearly defeated Gaedynn but Aoth heard the fighting and brought his genasi allies and together they killed Yemere .

title: Yenandra
description: Yenandra Yenandra , the Pirate Queen , was a Queen of Dambrath from the latter 13th century to the mid – 14th century DR . Relationships . Yenandra was the daughter of Queen Ausitil .
description_long: Yenandra Yenandra , the Pirate Queen , was a Queen of Dambrath from the latter 13th century to the mid – 14th century DR . Relationships .
