Yenandra was the daughter of Queen Ausitil . She had four daughters : Luatharyn ; Meltruil ; Hasafir ; and Catharyn , the eldest . Activities . Yenandra enjoyed sailing and piracy , traveling and raiding as far as Zakhara . She was a popular ruler as Dambrath enjoyed increased prosperity under her reign . Queen Yenandra ruled Dambrath for 81 years and just began to show signs of age in her last decade . Sometime during this period , she contracted a disease or finally succumbed to one that confounded the clerics , and when it became clear that her days were numbered she voluntarily underwent the process of becoming a spectral guardian . Her daughter Hasafir performed the ritual along with several other drow sorcerer s and then Hasafir assumed the throne in 1356 DR . Yenandra ' s favorite horse was also transformed into a nightmare and thereafter the people of Dambrath would see her at night , riding silently through the land , her eyes giving off an eerie red glow .

title: Yench ' eng Tzu Yu
description: Yench ' eng Tzu Yu Yench ' eng Tzu Yu was a wu jen member of the Many - Hued Peacock Society in Nakamaru around 1357 DR . History . Yench ' eng Tzu Yu may have an ulterior motive behind his affiliation with the Many - Hued Peacock .
description_long: Yench ' eng Tzu Yu Yench ' eng Tzu Yu was a wu jen member of the Many - Hued Peacock Society in Nakamaru around 1357 DR . History . Yench ' eng Tzu Yu may have an ulterior motive behind his affiliation with the Many - Hued Peacock . After the party for the birth of Goshukara Sadamoto ' s third son , Lui - hsia Chih sent Nan - kuo and Yench ' eng Tzu Yu to read the aura of Yin - kung T ' o . Personality . Yench ' eng Tzu Yu appeared to be a frail man but had a true unholy vigor . He behaved in all things like a man possessed and driven to some secret end . He was a fatalistic individual , believing that all the fantastic risks and seemingly foolish gambles that he did were decided by destiny .

title: Yenisha
description: Yenisha Yenisha was a clown in the Pasocada Basin in Maztica . History . Yenisha was always a troublemaker , having become disenchanted with her people .
description_long: Yenisha Yenisha was a clown in the Pasocada Basin in Maztica . History . Yenisha was always a troublemaker , having become disenchanted with her people . So she decided to travel to see the Metahel , the Dog People , the Short Ones , and the Poscadari Elves . In 1362 DR , Yenisha observed from afar Sozarro ' s expedition and decided that they were the right people to save her people . In exchange , she promised to guide them to Michaca . Personality . Yenisha was a very active person . She quickly became disenchanted with her people and from her meeting with other peoples , Yenisha came to feel that her people were stagnant .

title: Yeoman ' s fiddle
description: Yeoman ' s fiddle A yeoman ' s fiddle was a mechanical musical instrument invented by the gnome artist Nadul DaRoni . It was available for purchase through " Aurora ' s Whole Realms Catalogue " . Description .
description_long: Yeoman ' s fiddle A yeoman ' s fiddle was a mechanical musical instrument invented by the gnome artist Nadul DaRoni . It was available for purchase through " Aurora ' s Whole Realms Catalogue " . Description . The instrument had either a crank or a spring that turned a rosin - covered wheel against the strings to produce sound , while a set of keys connected to gears pressed the strings . It could include different wheels for different songs . When played , a yeoman ' s fiddle attracted much attention , but due to its complex nature and delicate construction it also had a small chance of malfunctioning .

title: Yerrininae
description: Yerrininae Yerrininae was the leader of the drider s in service to the drow House Xorlarrin . History . In Menzoberranzan , Yerrininae served Gromph Baenre , who frequently ordered him to guard Ravel Xorlarrin while the younger drow collected spell components .
description_long: Yerrininae Yerrininae was the leader of the drider s in service to the drow House Xorlarrin . History . In Menzoberranzan , Yerrininae served Gromph Baenre , who frequently ordered him to guard Ravel Xorlarrin while the younger drow collected spell components . In 1463 DR , Yerrininae led a group of driders alongside members of House Xorlarrin when they captured Gauntlgrym in preparation for the settlement of Q ' Xorlarrin in 1484 DR . In 1484 DR , when Ambergris was captured , Yerrininae took her mace , " Skullcrusher " . Yerrininae was killed after a battle with Wulfgar . Relationships . Yerrininae ' s consort was Flavvar , who was killed by Dahlia Sin ' felle in 1484 DR .

title: Yeshpek
description: Yeshpek Yeshpek is a large fortified city in the Lake of Steam area of Faerûn . As of 1372 DR , its population was around 23 , 000 . Its inhabitants are known for becoming mercenaries , often reckless ones who oppose authority , and for being critical of others , despite displaying pride over their own goods .
description_long: Yeshpek Yeshpek is a large fortified city in the Lake of Steam area of Faerûn . As of 1372 DR , its population was around 23 , 000 . Its inhabitants are known for becoming mercenaries , often reckless ones who oppose authority , and for being critical of others , despite displaying pride over their own goods . The city exports chains of various sizes .

title: Yeslick Orothiar
description: Yeslick Orothiar Yeslick Orothiar is a laid - back , good - natured dwarven cleric of Moradin and Clangeddin Silverbeard . He was once a blacksmith of the Iron Throne , but was betrayed when he casually mentioned the location of his clan ' s long abandoned ore mine to them . Now he is one of the Iron Throne ' s prisoners / slave laborers held in the Cloak Wood mines .
description_long: Yeslick Orothiar Yeslick Orothiar is a laid - back , good - natured dwarven cleric of Moradin and Clangeddin Silverbeard . He was once a blacksmith of the Iron Throne , but was betrayed when he casually mentioned the location of his clan ' s long abandoned ore mine to them . Now he is one of the Iron Throne ' s prisoners / slave laborers held in the Cloak Wood mines . Behind the scenes . In the Baldur ' s Gate video game , Yeslick is voiced by .

title: Yestabrod
description: Yestabrod Yestabrod was an aberrant myconid leader of a Circle in Neverlight Grove during the Rage of Demons . History . In Neverlight Grove , Yestabrod was created as the leader of the new Circle of Masters , formed by Phylo only from myconids corrupted by Zuggtmoy .
description_long: Yestabrod Yestabrod was an aberrant myconid leader of a Circle in Neverlight Grove during the Rage of Demons . History . In Neverlight Grove , Yestabrod was created as the leader of the new Circle of Masters , formed by Phylo only from myconids corrupted by Zuggtmoy . It was so corrupted by the demon lord that it looked more like an aberration than a myconid . It acted as a priest of Zuggtmoy in the wedding preparation ceremony between the demon lord and Araumycos , but was defeated before the ritual was completed by an adventuring party that had escaped the drow of Velkynvelve .

title: Yeth hound
description: Yeth hound A yeth hound was an intelligent outsider that hunted during night . Description . A yeth hound looked like a big grey hound with glowing cherry - red eyes .
description_long: Yeth hound A yeth hound was an intelligent outsider that hunted during night . Description . A yeth hound looked like a big grey hound with glowing cherry - red eyes . When not found alone or in a pair , they organized themselves in small packs consisting of several to a dozen members . Phobia . As mentioned above , yeth hounds hunted at night . Despite suffering no ill effects , they suffered from an irrational fear of the sun and never went under sunlight . " Never " was meant literally ; if they had a choice between going out under the sun and surviving , or staying out of sunlight and dying , they chose the latter . Abilities . Yeth hounds had good senses , sight , and hearing but their sense of smell was especially good . They were better at tracking prey by smell than other indicators . They could run faster than humans and were good flyers who could fly even faster , despite having no wings . They glided a bit above ground to hunt and could stop and resume flying with ease . Their most special ability however was their voice . When a yeth hound barked or howled , those who weren ' t evil outsider s in a 300 ft . ( 91 .

title: Yeti
description: Yeti Yeti , also known as tundra yeti , were large , white - furred creatures that could be found in arctic climates . They were the cold - climate version of the dire ape . Description .
description_long: Yeti Yeti , also known as tundra yeti , were large , white - furred creatures that could be found in arctic climates . They were the cold - climate version of the dire ape . Description . Yeti appeared as a cross between a human and a bear and walked upright . Although they were usually white , their fur turned brown in the short summers of the north . Yeti had an extra , translucent eyelid that allowed them to see clearly in a snowstorm . Behavior . Yeti were hard to find , although one could find evidence of their passing . In the summer , they hid in long grass ; in the winter , they hid in the snow . They were always hungry and apt to attack anything that moved . Yeti could be tamed by the most dedicated ( or fearsome ) of keepers . < ref name = " Dra127 - p60 " >

title: Yeva
description: Yeva Appearance . Yeva ' s skin is the color of desert sand with dark mottling . Her hair is long and brown colored , layered into braids .
description_long: Yeva Appearance . Yeva ' s skin is the color of desert sand with dark mottling . Her hair is long and brown colored , layered into braids . Her features are sharp and she has pointed ears . She wore silvery plate armor . History . Yeva is not native to Toril , and is most likely a githyanki based on her swearing by " the Fires of Tu ' narath , " and her referencing of her people invading Toril . Abilities . Yeva can summon a psionic " storm lance " that takes the form of a lightning bolt . Appearances . Yeva appears in the last two novels of the " Abolethic Sovereignty " trilogy , " City of Torment " and " Key of Stars " .

title: Yezeed
description: Yezeed Qadi Yezeed was a dwarf priest living in Sams Bandar on Jazirat al - Qraidis in the Crowded Sea in 1367 DR . Description . Yezeed spoke so slowly that it often infuriated others .
description_long: Yezeed Qadi Yezeed was a dwarf priest living in Sams Bandar on Jazirat al - Qraidis in the Crowded Sea in 1367 DR . Description . Yezeed spoke so slowly that it often infuriated others . Activities . Yezeed was aware of every single bloodline and feud that went on in the village of Sams Bandar . He attended court meetings to share in the latest gossip .

title: Yggdrasil
description: Yggdrasil Yggdrasil , also known as the World Ash , was a cosmic plane - spanning tree that linked the Prime Material Plane through the Astral Plane to the Outer Planes that were important to the Norse mythos . The tree ' s roots were in Niflheim ( the second layer of Hades ) , and its crown was in Asgard ( the first layer of Gladsheim ) as described by the Great Wheel cosmology model . Other roots and branches penetrated the Prime planes where the Norse pantheon was recognized , allowing travelers to climb the tree until they reached a " color pool " and step through to their destination .
description_long: Yggdrasil Yggdrasil , also known as the World Ash , was a cosmic plane - spanning tree that linked the Prime Material Plane through the Astral Plane to the Outer Planes that were important to the Norse mythos . The tree ' s roots were in Niflheim ( the second layer of Hades ) , and its crown was in Asgard ( the first layer of Gladsheim ) as described by the Great Wheel cosmology model . Other roots and branches penetrated the Prime planes where the Norse pantheon was recognized , allowing travelers to climb the tree until they reached a " color pool " and step through to their destination . The entry point into Niflheim was guarded by a gargantuan , very ancient red dragon , named Nidhogg , and her countless children . The World Ash and the dragon were perpetually in conflict as Nidhogg tried to sever the inter - planar link to Gladsheim by chewing through the roots . Yggdrasil responded by putting down new roots as fast as the dragon could eat them . All this took place in sight of the feast hall of Hel , Norse goddess and guardian of the dead . At the other end of Yggdrasil was Asgard on the plane of Gladsheim , the home of the rest of the Norse pantheon .

title: Yggdrasil ' s Child
description: Yggdrasil ' s Child Yggdrasil ' s Child was a tree of great power grown from a seed of the World Ash Yggdrasil . The tree stood in a remote grove on the island of Ruathym north of the Moonshae Isles . Before the destruction of the World Tree in the Spellplague Yggdrasil ' s Child could be used as a portal .
description_long: Yggdrasil ' s Child Yggdrasil ' s Child was a tree of great power grown from a seed of the World Ash Yggdrasil . The tree stood in a remote grove on the island of Ruathym north of the Moonshae Isles . Before the destruction of the World Tree in the Spellplague Yggdrasil ' s Child could be used as a portal . The tree retained enormous power and anyone carving their name in the tree would grow in power as the tree grew . The tree protected itself with forest creatures it had enhanced with magic . Liriel Baenre visited the tree in 1361 DR to inscribe a rune on the tree in order to gain the power of the Windwalker amulet . She was led to it and somewhat instructed in regards to it by Ulf the Shaman of Ruathym town . She described the tree as a magical , huge ancient oak with dozens of complex runes carved into the tree . She also explained that it was the " symbol of life . "

title: Ygorl
description: Ygorl Ygorl was the slaad Lord of Entropy . He was the second - oldest slaad lord , after Ssendam , and was considered the " de facto " ruler of the Outer Plane of Limbo . He was said to have created the Spawning Stone that was the focus of the slaad race , forcing them to take frog - like forms rather than their original , purely chaotic shapes .
description_long: Ygorl Ygorl was the slaad Lord of Entropy . He was the second - oldest slaad lord , after Ssendam , and was considered the " de facto " ruler of the Outer Plane of Limbo . He was said to have created the Spawning Stone that was the focus of the slaad race , forcing them to take frog - like forms rather than their original , purely chaotic shapes . Description . Ygorl appeared as a blackened , bat - winged , skeletal hulk , wielding a large sickle made from adamantine . He rode a great brass wyrm named Shkiv . As one of the exemplars of the chaotic neutral alignment , Ygorl was not truly evil , but still very dangerous , unpredictable , and self - serving . He believed in bringing death , decay , and disorganization to the multiverse , and thought this was best done by the slaadi , the truest agents of Chaos . He carried a 8 ' sickle with the slaad word for " death " inscribed on it and he could murder opponents instantly with it . Relationships . Ygorl considered the slaadi to be his living pawns . They did not serve him in any organized fashion , but most would obey his orders rather than allow him to devour them .

title: Yhalvia
description: Yhalvia Yhalvia was an ancient kingdom that was part of the empire of Narfell ( −946 DR to −150 DR ) . History . The baatezu devil lord Orlex ruled Yhalvia with an iron fist .
description_long: Yhalvia Yhalvia was an ancient kingdom that was part of the empire of Narfell ( −946 DR to −150 DR ) . History . The baatezu devil lord Orlex ruled Yhalvia with an iron fist . His reign was naturally cruel , depraved , and wicked . In time , a band of rebellious wizard s arose to depose Orlex . Led by the archmage Thakorsil , they created the throne known as " Thakorsil ' s Seat " to imprison and permanently bind and enslave the evil fiend . Unfortunately , although they had the best of intentions , the device demanded deeds of despicable evil to function . Thus , they devised the " ritual of twin burnings " , which involved the sacrifice of beings of good heart , believing this was for the greater good , that the ends justified the means . They went ahead with the horrific rites , and successfully bound and enslaved Orlex in the " Seat " . Afterward , they formed a council of wizards that governed Yhalvia . However , corrupted by the sacrifices and with Orlex as their slave , they soon became as cruel , depraved , and wicked as the devil they had replaced .

title: Yharaskrik
description: Yharaskrik Yharaskrik was an illithid . Description . As an illithid , Yharaskrik had a truly horrible appearance .
description_long: Yharaskrik Yharaskrik was an illithid . Description . As an illithid , Yharaskrik had a truly horrible appearance . The humanoid creature had a bulbous head that resembled a huge brain , with several tentacles protruding from the part of its face where a nose , mouth , and chin should have been . Like other illithids , the Yharaskrik was a powerful psionic energy user , easily defeating any enemy with stunning blasts of mental energies . The illithid has a bubbling , watery voice that was described by Artemis Entreri as like the sound made by a very old man with too much phlegm in his throat . History . Yharaskrik and Bregan D ' aerthe . Yharaskrik came to Calimport to study the sword Charon ' s Claw . The creature lived in the deep tunnels below Kohrin Soulez ' s throne room in Dallabad Oasis after pretending to be defeated by Kohrin Soulez . After Jarlaxle and Bregan D ' aerthe successfully attacked Dallabad Oasis , Yharaskrik allied himself with Kimmuriel Oblodra . The creature taught Kimmuriel how to prevent Crenshinibon from controlling him , thereby making Kimmuriel an ally of necessity .

title: Yhaunn
description: Yhaunn Yhaunn was a coastal city of Sembia built on an old quarry site . History . The city was built on the site of an ancient quarry .
description_long: Yhaunn Yhaunn was a coastal city of Sembia built on an old quarry site . History . The city was built on the site of an ancient quarry . Many great buildings in Selgaunt , Saerloon , Westgate , Alaghôn , Cimbar , and Velprintalar were built with Yhauntan stone . In 1385 DR , during the Spellplague . the cliffs that surrounded the city broke away and became earthmote s , in the process killing tens of thousands of inhabitants . The shadovar masters of Sembia helped the city recover and by 1479 DR it had even more residents than before the Spellplague .

title: Yhekal
description: Yhekal Yhekal was a Zhent wizard in Anauroch . History . Yhekal was a Zhentarim wizard who in 1360 DR plotted an attack in order to enslave the Bedine .
description_long: Yhekal Yhekal was a Zhent wizard in Anauroch . History . Yhekal was a Zhentarim wizard who in 1360 DR plotted an attack in order to enslave the Bedine . He disguised himself as the assistant of the Zhentilar warrior El Zarud to better plot . However , thanks to the witch Ruha and the Harper Lander , his army was destroyed and El Zarud was killed .

title: Yhliivast
description: Yhliivast The Yhliivast family was a human family residing in Amnwater , Amn around 1368 DR . It was a family of horse breeders and trainers , wheel wrights , and various other caravan trades . As of 1368 DR the head of the family was Lord Jhanos Yhliivast .
description_long: Yhliivast The Yhliivast family was a human family residing in Amnwater , Amn around 1368 DR . It was a family of horse breeders and trainers , wheel wrights , and various other caravan trades . As of 1368 DR the head of the family was Lord Jhanos Yhliivast .

title: Yi Woo
description: Yi Woo Yi Woo was a Shou healer who operated a clinic in the Xiousing district of Marsember . In his youth , he studied the arcane as well as the martial arts . Later in life he moved to Xiousing and opened a healing clinic that served both Shou and native Marsembens .
description_long: Yi Woo Yi Woo was a Shou healer who operated a clinic in the Xiousing district of Marsember . In his youth , he studied the arcane as well as the martial arts . Later in life he moved to Xiousing and opened a healing clinic that served both Shou and native Marsembens . He would heal anyone regardless of their ability to pay . Woo became frustrated with the Purple Dragons ' inability to fight crime so he became a secret vigilante , operating under the cover of darkness .

title: Yi Wu ' s Clinic
description: Yi Wu ' s Clinic Yi Wu ' s Clinic was a healing center located in the Xiousing district in Marsember . It was run by the Shou healer known as Yi Wu . The clinic would treat anyone , Shou or Cormyrean , regardless of ability to pay .
description_long: Yi Wu ' s Clinic Yi Wu ' s Clinic was a healing center located in the Xiousing district in Marsember . It was run by the Shou healer known as Yi Wu . The clinic would treat anyone , Shou or Cormyrean , regardless of ability to pay .

title: Yiccardaria
description: Yiccardaria Yiccardaria is one of many handmaidens of Lloth . This type of creature is principally a mediate , a messenger between the priestesses of Menzoberranzan ( more commonly Matron Mothers ) and Lloth . In this case , Yiccardaria seems to be appointed to the reborn Yvonnel the Eternal because she is now the Chosen of Lloth .
description_long: Yiccardaria Yiccardaria is one of many handmaidens of Lloth . This type of creature is principally a mediate , a messenger between the priestesses of Menzoberranzan ( more commonly Matron Mothers ) and Lloth . In this case , Yiccardaria seems to be appointed to the reborn Yvonnel the Eternal because she is now the Chosen of Lloth . Yiccardaria monitors , protects and serves as emissary for Yvonnel . Short , Yiccardaria acts as a direct line with the goddess Lloth .

description: Yikarian ( language ) Yikarian was the native tongue of the mysterious yak folk of Northeast Zakhara . Given their horrific reputation and their distrust of outsiders , little was known about the language outside of the Yikarian Empire . Yikarian dictionary .

title: Yikarian Empire
description: Yikarian Empire The Yikarian Empire was an ancient empire in the northern corner of Zakhara that was home to the malicious yak - folk . The terrain covered by the Yikarian Empire was known as the Land of the Yak - Men . Geography .
description_long: Yikarian Empire The Yikarian Empire was an ancient empire in the northern corner of Zakhara that was home to the malicious yak - folk . The terrain covered by the Yikarian Empire was known as the Land of the Yak - Men . Geography . Most of the Empire ' s terrain was dominated by the World Pillar Mountains of northeast Zakhara . The rest of the Empire extended into the terrain surrounding the mountains , including the fringes of the Jungle of Monsters in the east , the desert wastelands of the northeastern portion of the Haunted Lands , and the hill country and plains bordering Konigheim and the Utter East in the north . The River Ruin was used to transport goods and slaves , both by boat during the rainy season and with caravans on the dry riverbed at other times , from the Great Sea to the various provinces of the Empire . From east to west the Yikarian Empire stretched from the jungles of Sempadan all the way to the cool waters of Bahr al - Kibar . Description . Each of the eight provinces of the Yikarian Empire were classified as either Strongholds — areas without a temple to the Faceless God — or Safeholds — areas that possessed a temple to the Faceless God .

title: Yin - kung T ' o
description: Yin - kung T ' o Yin - kung T ' o was the cell leader of the Royal Vagabonds in Nakamaru around 1357 DR . History . At the celebration of the birth of Goshukara Sadamoto ' s third son , the Gorath disguised himself as Yin - king T ' o to impress Lui - hsia Chih .
description_long: Yin - kung T ' o Yin - kung T ' o was the cell leader of the Royal Vagabonds in Nakamaru around 1357 DR . History . At the celebration of the birth of Goshukara Sadamoto ' s third son , the Gorath disguised himself as Yin - king T ' o to impress Lui - hsia Chih . After the party , Lui sent Nan - kuo and Yench ' eng Tzu Yu to read the aura of the real Yin - kung T ' o , finding nothing strange . That night , Yin - kung and the Gorath led an attack on the Many - Hued Peacock Society ' s headquarters in Nakamaru . Activities . Yin - kung T ' o posed as a foreign merchant in the city , having all the mannerisms of a man not able to live outside of his country , always wearing Shou dress and speaking with a strong accent , but this was only a cover for his true work as a Royal Vagabond . He led the ten - member cell in Nakamaru but received direct orders from the Gorath . Personality . Yin - kung T ' o prided himself on how he had resisted the " barbaric " ways of Wa .

title: Yio Dufong
description: Yio Dufong The Yio Dufong , nicknamed " bears " , were a powerful yakuza clan based in the town of T ' o na ' Chee in Koryo . For many years , the Yio Dufong possessed the " standing bear " , a potent magical chalice that granted those who drank from it the strength of a bear . All the Yio Dufong would imbibe before a fight , and for this reason they were called the " bears " .
description_long: Yio Dufong The Yio Dufong , nicknamed " bears " , were a powerful yakuza clan based in the town of T ' o na ' Chee in Koryo . For many years , the Yio Dufong possessed the " standing bear " , a potent magical chalice that granted those who drank from it the strength of a bear . All the Yio Dufong would imbibe before a fight , and for this reason they were called the " bears " . However , the " standing bear " was later stolen and by 1357 DR had not turned up .

title: Yip
description: Yip Yip was a madman in Phlan in 1489 DR . History . Yip used to live in a village near Phlan .
description_long: Yip Yip was a madman in Phlan in 1489 DR . History . Yip used to live in a village near Phlan . One day in 1489 DR a disaster hit his village and he was the only survivor . He arrived in the city blabbering incoherent words about a dracolich . Aleyd Burral of the Knights of the Black Fist noticed him and somehow managed to take him to the temple of Kelemvor , where the priests took care of him . Later , the high priest Yovir Glandon hired an adventuring party to investigate the matter .

title: Yipyak
description: Yipyak Yipyak was the language spoken by kobold s . It was a variation of the Draconic language that sounded like the yapping of a dog . Origins .
description_long: Yipyak Yipyak was the language spoken by kobold s . It was a variation of the Draconic language that sounded like the yapping of a dog . Origins . Kobolds originally learned the Draconic language directly from true dragon s . The earliest kobolds were instructed to speak Draconic in a variety of accents and dialects , and when they became independent of their dragon masters , they took their language with them , dispersing it among their various clans and tribes . As these independent kobolds interacted with one another , their inherited Draconic dialects mingled , creating Yipyak , the common kobold tongue . Kobold sorcerers also knew how to speak true Draconic , which required more exacting pronunciation than Yipyak . Script . It was believed by elven scholars that Iokharic , the runic script of Draconic , was originally developed by kobolds , as dragons had little need to write . It originated with cave paintings used to record kobold history . Those paintings developed into pictograms , and eventually into the Iokharic script .

title: Yitriq Rukku
description: Yitriq Rukku Yitriq Rukku was a barbarian ruler inhabiting the Plain of Horses in 1357 DR . Activities . Yririq was the Fankiang ruler of Haxkhun and a notorious coward .
description_long: Yitriq Rukku Yitriq Rukku was a barbarian ruler inhabiting the Plain of Horses in 1357 DR . Activities . Yririq was the Fankiang ruler of Haxkhun and a notorious coward . He was subordinate to the rulers of Li - Raz but with no enthusiasm . Rukku staged weekly horse - wrestling contests in Haxkhun ' s central district , where he challenged opponents . Obviously the game was devised to make Rukku always be the victor and anyone who refused to play saw his family massacred . If anyone lost , he was executed .

title: Yklwa
description: Yklwa An yklwa was a Chult an short spear . Description . A typical yklwa was four feet long , with about 40 % of the length taken up by its sword - like , bladed point .
description_long: Yklwa An yklwa was a Chult an short spear . Description . A typical yklwa was four feet long , with about 40 % of the length taken up by its sword - like , bladed point . It was primarily used as a thrusting spear in melee combat and was not well - balanced for throwing . It dealt more damage than a normal short spear but could only be thrown accurately with half a short spear ' s range . Yklwas could be wielded with two hands , but Tabaxi warriors typically used them in conjunction with oval hide shields called " hlang " . The name " yklwa " supposedly mimicked the sucking sound heard when pulling the weapon from the heart of a slain dinosaur .

title: Ylarell
description: Ylarell Ylarell was a member of the City Guard of Waterdeep during the Time of Troubles in 1358 DR . Activities . He collaborated with Khelben Arunsun .
description_long: Ylarell Ylarell was a member of the City Guard of Waterdeep during the Time of Troubles in 1358 DR . Activities . He collaborated with Khelben Arunsun . When Kelemvor Lyonsbane arrived in Waterdeep , Ylarell led him to Blackstaff Tower . Later , he accompanied the heroes in their expedition to Undermountain . Back at his post , he commanded a platoon against the undead commanded by Myrkul . However , in the fighting Ylarell and all his men , bar one , were killed .

title: Yllivia
description: Yllivia Yllivia was a scout and member of the Order of the Gauntlet in Phlan during the Tyranny of Dragons . History . In 1489 DR , Yllivia asked for the help of her fellow Villonah Leadstopper to find a map showing a secret white dragon lair .
description_long: Yllivia Yllivia was a scout and member of the Order of the Gauntlet in Phlan during the Tyranny of Dragons . History . In 1489 DR , Yllivia asked for the help of her fellow Villonah Leadstopper to find a map showing a secret white dragon lair . The map was in the possession of the Knights of the Black Fist . During the investigation , they were captured by some corrupt members of the Black Fist , who imprisoned them in a secret prison where Black Fists tortured prisoners for sport . They were rescued by some adventurers hired by Rillo Leadstopper , the father of Villonah .

title: Ylraphon
description: Ylraphon Ylraphon , also known as Yrlaphon , was a town in the Vast , lying on the eastern shore of the northern end of the Dragon Reach , at the eastern end of the Hunt Trail . Etymology . The name " Ylraphon " was variously pronounced as either " Ee - ul - RAFF - on " , " Ee - IL - ra - FON " or " Ee - yil - ra - fon " .
description_long: Ylraphon Ylraphon , also known as Yrlaphon , was a town in the Vast , lying on the eastern shore of the northern end of the Dragon Reach , at the eastern end of the Hunt Trail . Etymology . The name " Ylraphon " was variously pronounced as either " Ee - ul - RAFF - on " , " Ee - IL - ra - FON " or " Ee - yil - ra - fon " . It could be spelled as either " Ylraphon " or " Yrlaphon " . History . Elven habitation . Elves from Cormanthor went beyond the River Lis to found Yrlaphon among the eastern woodlands in −1535 DR . The elven community there built it into a city . In the city ' s first century ( prior to −1435 DR ) , the silver dragon Pharyssolnyth dwelled in Yrlaphon . There she wrote the Tablets of Pharyssolnyth , which detailed how dragon s learned and handled magic . The famous Srinshee also once made her home at Yrlaphon . As this was one of the few confirmed facts about her history , it proved her to be one of the longest - lived elves in the world . Drow raided Yrlaphon in the winter of −722 DR and weakened its defenses . The city fell to overwhelming orc hordes in the summer . For her efforts , the Srinshee became known as the " savior of Yrlaphon ' s Survivors " .

title: Ylsa Henstak
description: Ylsa Henstak Ylsa Henstak was a duergar merchant in Gracklstugh during the Rage of Demons . Activities . Ylsa was a rich merchant in Gracklstugh , notorious for leading caravans that always arrived on schedule .
description_long: Ylsa Henstak Ylsa Henstak was a duergar merchant in Gracklstugh during the Rage of Demons . Activities . Ylsa was a rich merchant in Gracklstugh , notorious for leading caravans that always arrived on schedule . She was a member of the Merchant Council . History . During the Rage of Demons , Ylsa was intrigued by how the local derro gained so much surface currency and jewelry .

title: Ylveraasahlisar
description: Ylveraasahlisar Ylveraasahlisar , also known as the Rose Dragon , was an infamous red dragon that ruled Calimshan for more than a century . History . Ylveraasahlisar was a great wyrm that laired somewhere in or near Calimshan in past ages .
description_long: Ylveraasahlisar Ylveraasahlisar , also known as the Rose Dragon , was an infamous red dragon that ruled Calimshan for more than a century . History . Ylveraasahlisar was a great wyrm that laired somewhere in or near Calimshan in past ages . In - 1838 DR , a group of Calishite adventurers crept into her lair to steal some of her treasure hoard , killing one of her brood in the process . After this incident , an enraged Ylveraasahlisar attacked Calimport , destroying two - thirds of the city including the Caleph ' s Court and the Raor Bakkal , along with most of Calimshan ' s army . After the bloodbath she seized the throne and her first edict was to reconstruct all she had destroyed . In a hurry to comply , her terrified subjects merely leveled the rubble enough to support new construction and began anew , thus creating much of the Muzad . Ylveraasahlisar ruled until - 1726 DR when Rafak el Cajaan organized her demise . He gathered a group of dragonslayers , including a bronze dragon named Cadasalmpar , that attacked the Rose Dragon by surprise in her court . After a fierce battle , she escaped from Calimport gravely wounded .

title: Ymmeline
description: Ymmeline Ymmeline was a Zhentarim agent in the Moonsea . Activities . Ymmeline resided at the inn and tavern called the Plodding Plow , in the village of The Stop .
description_long: Ymmeline Ymmeline was a Zhentarim agent in the Moonsea . Activities . Ymmeline resided at the inn and tavern called the Plodding Plow , in the village of The Stop . History . During the Rage of Demons in 1491 DR , Ymmeline possibly ordered some adventurers affiliated the Zhentarim to recover some rust monster s alive that had mysteriously disappeared in the area .

title: Yngukulub
description: Yngukulub Yngukulub the Devourer was an aboleth ally of Gar Shatterkeel at the Fane of the Eye under Tyar - Besil during the Elemental Evil crisis . Personality . Yngukulub obeyed Gar because it believed that in the new era of Olhydra the aboleth would rule the world .
description_long: Yngukulub Yngukulub the Devourer was an aboleth ally of Gar Shatterkeel at the Fane of the Eye under Tyar - Besil during the Elemental Evil crisis . Personality . Yngukulub obeyed Gar because it believed that in the new era of Olhydra the aboleth would rule the world . History . In 1491 DR , Yngukulub stayed at the Fane , served by a retinue of deranged kuo - toa , until some adventurers infiltrated the temple and killed it .

title: Yntar Shieldblazon
description: Yntar Shieldblazon Yntar Shieldblazon was a bard . History . Around 1370 DR , Yntar was a local member of the Heralds of Faerûn , holding the title of Flailchains .
description_long: Yntar Shieldblazon Yntar Shieldblazon was a bard . History . Around 1370 DR , Yntar was a local member of the Heralds of Faerûn , holding the title of Flailchains . He was an authority on the history of Westgate . Once the role of Flailchains had been a public one , but after the death of the last king , Verovan , it became an independent agent but with strong ties to the rulers of the city .

title: Yochlol
description: Yochlol A yochlol was a type of lesser tanar ' ri demon that served as " handmaidens " to Lolth , the drow goddess of chaos . Description . Yochlols had four forms available to them : humanoid , spider , ooze , and gaseous .
description_long: Yochlol A yochlol was a type of lesser tanar ' ri demon that served as " handmaidens " to Lolth , the drow goddess of chaos . Description . Yochlols had four forms available to them : humanoid , spider , ooze , and gaseous . In their natural form they appeared as a six - foot - tall , eight - tentacled blob of melted wax that continually emitted a foul stench . They also had the power to change their shape — usually to a comely drow female ( although other elves and human s were also possible ) or to a large spider . They could also change into a gaseous form , allowing their unknowing victims to inhale them , and then suffocate . All forms were immune to poison and electricity . Personality . Like all tanar ' ri , yochlols were chaotic evil creatures . They relished dominating other creatures . They were cruel and enjoyed a good battle . Summoned yochlols were compelled to faithfully serve one deed to their summoner , but they took special delight in escaping the control of those who summoned them and wandering about free about the Prime Material Plane , causing chaos .

title: Yola
description: Yola Imam Yola min Zann was a gnome " qadi " living in Huzuz , the City of Delights , in 1367 DR . Activities . Yola was the " qadi " for the entire Grand Bazaar and surrounding area , which also happened to be the part of Huzuz with the greatest amount of crime .
description_long: Yola Imam Yola min Zann was a gnome " qadi " living in Huzuz , the City of Delights , in 1367 DR . Activities . Yola was the " qadi " for the entire Grand Bazaar and surrounding area , which also happened to be the part of Huzuz with the greatest amount of crime . Though initially ridiculed for her short stature , Yola quickly earned a reputation for being a hard judge who treated truthful criminals with more fairness that those who lied . Several attempts were made on her life because of this , but she was able to thwart them all . Yola desired marriage but had yet to find a suitable gnome husband . She secretely fantasized about being swept off her feet by a gnomish desert rider for wild romance in the deep deserts of Zakhara . Possessions . Yola owned a valuable ruby brooch , a blow gun , a " ring of protection " , a " rod of smiting " , and a flask of " oil of great devotion " .

title: Yolanda Shamat
description: Yolanda Shamat Yolanda Shamat was a cleric of Loviatar in Waterdeep in 1372 DR . Description . Yolanda always stood rigidly erect and had an icy stare .
description_long: Yolanda Shamat Yolanda Shamat was a cleric of Loviatar in Waterdeep in 1372 DR . Description . Yolanda always stood rigidly erect and had an icy stare . History . Yolanda was a slave until she was bought and freed by Lady Ellandra Tolbert , who was the primary source of funds for the church of Loviatar in Waterdeep . Yolanda then served as her chamberlain .

title: Yondalla
description: Yondalla Yondalla ( pronounced yon - " dah " - lah ) was the creator of the halfling race and matriarch of not only the halfling pantheon , but the whole race itself . With her charming personality and friendly demeanor she was an example to all halflings ; who almost all shared her curiosity , loyalty and sense of mischief . Yondalla was not , in fact , a true goddess but rather a divine aspect of the goddess Chauntea .
description_long: Yondalla Yondalla ( pronounced yon - " dah " - lah ) was the creator of the halfling race and matriarch of not only the halfling pantheon , but the whole race itself . With her charming personality and friendly demeanor she was an example to all halflings ; who almost all shared her curiosity , loyalty and sense of mischief . Yondalla was not , in fact , a true goddess but rather a divine aspect of the goddess Chauntea . Worshipers . Despite her widespread worship among halflings and her central role in their society ; her temples were unusually rare , those that did exist were designed to look like a well - hidden halfling burrow - home and were filled with weapons and food so that the communities that surrounded them could hold out against possible invaders . Her clergy were afforded a lot of respect by the followers of other gods for their defensive capabilities in spite of their small stature . Relationships . Yondalla had close bonds with Garl Glittergold , Corellon Larethian and Moradin .

title: Yondalla ' s Children
description: Yondalla ' s Children Yondalla ' s Children was the collective name for the halfling pantheon , which was led by the greater deity Yondalla , known as the Protector and Provider , the Nurturing Matriarch , and the Blessed One . The members of the pantheon were : According to the Great Wheel cosmology model , Yondalla ' s Children resided in Venya , the third layer of the Seven Heavens , which they named the Green Fields . When the World Tree cosmology model became popular , Green Fields became its own plane connected to the World Tree .
description_long: Yondalla ' s Children Yondalla ' s Children was the collective name for the halfling pantheon , which was led by the greater deity Yondalla , known as the Protector and Provider , the Nurturing Matriarch , and the Blessed One . The members of the pantheon were : According to the Great Wheel cosmology model , Yondalla ' s Children resided in Venya , the third layer of the Seven Heavens , which they named the Green Fields . When the World Tree cosmology model became popular , Green Fields became its own plane connected to the World Tree . Green Fields survived the Spellplague to float in the Astral Sea as described by the World Axis cosmology model .

title: Yondral Horn
description: Yondral Horn Yondarl Horn was an innkeeper in Rassalantar sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . Activities . Yondarl managed the Sleeping Dragon inn .
description_long: Yondral Horn Yondarl Horn was an innkeeper in Rassalantar sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . Activities . Yondarl managed the Sleeping Dragon inn . Secretly he was also a spy under the payroll of the Zhentarim , especially interested about City Watch ( Waterdeep ) ' s and Lords ' Alliance ' s agents . History . In the late 1480s or early 1490s DR once Yondarl was an adventurer payed by the Zhent . After retired he become the innkeeper of the Sleeping Dragon .

title: Yonin
description: Yonin Yonin was a head ninja and also a zussho in Kozakura in 1357 DR . Activities . Yonin led the ninja village of Susa .
description_long: Yonin Yonin was a head ninja and also a zussho in Kozakura in 1357 DR . Activities . Yonin led the ninja village of Susa . He was also the zussho of the local shoen . Personality . Yonin , like all ninja of Susa , was very loyal to the Niwa clan . Relationship . Yonin married a daughter of Niwa Hirotada .

title: Yorel
description: Yorel Yorel was a veteran Zhentilar commander in Zhentil Keep in 1358 DR . Personality . Yorel was a cautious individual well - suited to his job .
description_long: Yorel Yorel was a veteran Zhentilar commander in Zhentil Keep in 1358 DR . Personality . Yorel was a cautious individual well - suited to his job . Activities . Because of his experience , Yorel was often selected to lead select patrols , bodyguard units , reconnaissance missions , and attacks near the city .

title: Yosh al - Nasr
description: Yosh al - Nasr Yosh al - Nasr , or the Eagle , was a Maztican Eagle Knight living in Huzuz , the City of Delights , in 1367 DR . His real name was Yax Cautli . History .
description_long: Yosh al - Nasr Yosh al - Nasr , or the Eagle , was a Maztican Eagle Knight living in Huzuz , the City of Delights , in 1367 DR . His real name was Yax Cautli . History . While living in Maztica with his sister , Yosh sailed across the Trackless Sea with the hopes of seeing Faerûn . His ship was blown off course and wrecked during a violent storm , yet he and his sister were able to survive by clinging to a piece of flotsam , though they were separated at sea . Yosh was eventually rescued by sailors who transported him to Qudra on the shores of Zakhara . He was able to narrowly avoid becoming a slave . Activities . Yosh wanted to discover the fate of his sister , Taxatl , who was in fact a member of the Royal Harim of Huzuz . He used his unique skills to earn work as an elite bodyguard while he searched for his sister . Possessions . Yosh owned some bizarre , at least by Zakharan standards , equipment including a " maca " and a matching set of feathered armor and headpiece .

title: Yoshiie
description: Yoshiie Yoshiie was a bandit leader in Kozakura in 1357 DR . Activities . Yoshiie led a bandit gang with more than 200 members , including korobokuru , with a kensai second - in - command and sometimes a wu jen in his service .
description_long: Yoshiie Yoshiie was a bandit leader in Kozakura in 1357 DR . Activities . Yoshiie led a bandit gang with more than 200 members , including korobokuru , with a kensai second - in - command and sometimes a wu jen in his service . They were based in a secluded valley . Personality . Yoshiie achieved his position through the use of fear , force , and brainpower . His men were like his children to him , but he was a stern " father " as the gang knew him . Yoshiie was protective and kind to his gang members , but had a harsh and unforgiving discipline . He received help from Kate Kenkichi , but knew that one day his gang would split .

title: Yoshimo
description: Yoshimo Yoshimo was a rogueish male human from Kara - Tur . He died in Faerûn during Jon Irenicus ' attempt to destroy Suldanessellar with the help of the hidden divine power he brought forth from the souls of Imoen and another Bhaalspawn . The Game .
description_long: Yoshimo Yoshimo was a rogueish male human from Kara - Tur . He died in Faerûn during Jon Irenicus ' attempt to destroy Suldanessellar with the help of the hidden divine power he brought forth from the souls of Imoen and another Bhaalspawn . The Game . Yoshimo was a bounty hunter , a rogue specialized in hunting people and setting traps . He had come from Kara - Tur to Amn and ended up working for Irenicus , not knowing what he was getting into but being bound to obey by a geas . Biography . Yoshimo is first encountered near the beginning of " " , on the second level ( counting from the " bottom " where the party starts out ) of Irenicus ' s dungeon . He says that he , too , has been imprisoned , but he gives no idea why this might have been done and still has all his equipment on him . These include his personal katana + 1 that only he can use . He will seek to accompany the player character , in reality by Irenicus ' s order . He may certainly become friends with the party along the way , but is nevertheless compelled to obey Irenicus .

title: Yosten
description: Yosten Yosten was a sage from the city of Procampur in the Vast . Yosten made a study of the mysterious gigantic stone carvings on the island of Paldir in the Sea of Fallen Stars . As they showed no hand - or foot - holds for their construction , Yosten speculated that the workers began at the top and worked their way down , carving away signs of their work as they went .

As they showed no hand - or foot - holds for their construction , Yosten speculated that the workers began at the top and worked their way down , carving away signs of their work as they went .

title: Yostur Ulhmond
description: Yostur Ulhmond Yostur Ulhmond was a fighter from the villages of the Snow People of Thar in the 1350s DR . In the Year of the Worm , 1356 DR , Yostur was a member of a band of adventurers that rediscovered the fabled Barroch ' s Hold in the Glacier of the White Worm . However , they soon ran into a number of strange creatures , and were separated or killed .
description_long: Yostur Ulhmond Yostur Ulhmond was a fighter from the villages of the Snow People of Thar in the 1350s DR . In the Year of the Worm , 1356 DR , Yostur was a member of a band of adventurers that rediscovered the fabled Barroch ' s Hold in the Glacier of the White Worm . However , they soon ran into a number of strange creatures , and were separated or killed . Yostur , together with Feenoch the Five - Fingered , made it to Orm to tell their story , though they would not be drawn on the matter of treasure . By the end of the year , it was said in Hillsfar they were trying to muster a larger group of adventurers , bearing sledges , perhaps intending to return . At the time , Yostur was young , with blond hair and described as strong as an ox .

title: Youmans
description: Youmans Youmans was an ex - adventurer in Daggerford around 1370 DR . History . Youmans had a tragic story : she was once part of an adventuring party who fought some rust monster s and a tribe of orc / gnoll hybrids , and all save Youmans and one other died .
description_long: Youmans Youmans was an ex - adventurer in Daggerford around 1370 DR . History . Youmans had a tragic story : she was once part of an adventuring party who fought some rust monster s and a tribe of orc / gnoll hybrids , and all save Youmans and one other died . Later , the other adventurer died from an infection and Youmans went back to Daggerford totally devastated in her mind and missing half her leg . She was often drunk and Baergon Bluesword believed she was haunted by the memories . When Youmans was sober , she carted water for the Watermen ' s Guild .

title: Your delicious weakness
description: Your delicious weakness Your delicious weakness , is a spell used by some warlock s , particularly those who forge pacts with demon ic powers of the Abyss . When " your delicious weakness " is cast , the warlock strikes into the mind of a creature within fifty feet , uncovering their weaknesses and using those weaknesses against them . The spell is normally charged by a warlock ' s strength of personality but warlocks of the dark pact are able to enhance the deadliness of the spell through concentrating their intellect .
description_long: Your delicious weakness Your delicious weakness , is a spell used by some warlock s , particularly those who forge pacts with demon ic powers of the Abyss . When " your delicious weakness " is cast , the warlock strikes into the mind of a creature within fifty feet , uncovering their weaknesses and using those weaknesses against them . The spell is normally charged by a warlock ' s strength of personality but warlocks of the dark pact are able to enhance the deadliness of the spell through concentrating their intellect . " Your delicious weakness " can be cast with relative ease and reacquired after its casting through a rest of a few minutes or more .

title: Your glorious sacrifice
description: Your glorious sacrifice Your glorious sacrifice is a moderately powerful warlock invocation learned by young or inexperienced warlock s , particularly those who forge pacts with the powers of the Abyss . " Your glorious sacrifice " is , in many ways , a relatively weak spell , injuring a creature within fifty feet through necrotic power enhanced by the warlock ' s strength of personality . However , if the warlock chooses , he may target a nearby ally as well with the power , dealing damage to them as well to increase their chances of successfully attacking their primary target .
description_long: Your glorious sacrifice Your glorious sacrifice is a moderately powerful warlock invocation learned by young or inexperienced warlock s , particularly those who forge pacts with the powers of the Abyss . " Your glorious sacrifice " is , in many ways , a relatively weak spell , injuring a creature within fifty feet through necrotic power enhanced by the warlock ' s strength of personality . However , if the warlock chooses , he may target a nearby ally as well with the power , dealing damage to them as well to increase their chances of successfully attacking their primary target . Additionally , this " sacrifice " allows the warlock to infect their foe with a mild poison , in addition to other attacks and even if " your glorious sacrifice " fails to fully affect the target it still can strike into their life force , sapping it . Dark pact warlocks may also find that their intellect can help to make the poison more deadly . Like any spell of its power to complexity ratio , " your glorious sacrifice " can only be cast once per day .

title: Yovir Glandon
description: Yovir Glandon Yovir Glandon was the high priest of Kelemvor in Phlan in 1489 DR . Personality . Yovir was a reserved man , speaking as little as possible .
description_long: Yovir Glandon Yovir Glandon was the high priest of Kelemvor in Phlan in 1489 DR . Personality . Yovir was a reserved man , speaking as little as possible . He had no interest in the city ' s politics but hoped for the best for his people . History . Yovir served as a priest of Kelemvor and caretaker of Valhingen Graveyard for 40 years . He was also a member of the Order of the Silent Shround . In 1489 DR , with rumors of dracolich es and ghost ships wandering the Moonsea on the rise , a madman arrived in the city speaking about a ghost ship . This convinced Yovier to hire an adventuring party to investigate the matter . Some time later a growing increase of undead activities in Valhingen Graveyard inducted him to hire an adventuring party , possibly the same of before , to investigate also this matter , helped by acolyte Cassyt During the coup instigated by Dragon Cultists , he was nowhere to be found . It was discovered that he died during the coup . Around 1492 DR somehow , likely with the help of the Dark Powers of Ravenloft , he was risen as vampire and fought against the army that tried to reclaim the city but at last some adventurers destroyed him for good .

title: Yozumian Dudui Yinochek
description: Yozumian Dudui Yinochek Yozumian Dudui Yinochek was the high priest of the Protector ' s House , a Selûnian temple in Memnon . Activities . On the surface Yozumian ' s clerics helped the poor people of Memnon , but in truth the high members of the church , starting with Yozumian , were corrupt , living in very comfortable room with precious goods and indulging in the company of women .
description_long: Yozumian Dudui Yinochek Yozumian Dudui Yinochek was the high priest of the Protector ' s House , a Selûnian temple in Memnon . Activities . On the surface Yozumian ' s clerics helped the poor people of Memnon , but in truth the high members of the church , starting with Yozumian , were corrupt , living in very comfortable room with precious goods and indulging in the company of women . Yozumian especially enjoyed the company of women , sometimes pretending to perform special rituals on them . One of his victims was the young mother of young Artemis Entreri who was subservient to Yozumian even before Entreri ' s birth . In 1368 Entreri remembered that part of his past and returned to Memnon to confront his family and Yozumian . Yozumian used all his resources to avoid a confrontation with the assassin , but Entreri , aided by Jarlaxle , defeated the Protector ' s House ' s defense and confronted Yozumian . He denied mistreating Enteri ' s mother , murmuring about gods ' designs . Entreri rebuffed this claim and killed the man .

title: Yrberop
description: Yrberop Yrberop was a myconid leader of a Circle in Neverlight Grove during the Rage of Demons . Personality . Yrberop always listened to a music that only it could hear , but because of Zuggtmoy , people could hear a faint echo of its internal cacophony .
description_long: Yrberop Yrberop was a myconid leader of a Circle in Neverlight Grove during the Rage of Demons . Personality . Yrberop always listened to a music that only it could hear , but because of Zuggtmoy , people could hear a faint echo of its internal cacophony . Yrberop was enthusiastic about Phylo ' s plans to spread the will of Zuggtmoy throughout the Underdark . Due to its madness , Yrberop forgot all conversations after they ended . History . Yrberop was the leader of the Circle of Sporers in Neverlight Grove . Yrberop was easily seduced during the Rage of Demons when Zuggtmoy ' s will twisted most of the Circle . It began creating more and more myconid sprouts .

title: Yrjixtilex Kallan
description: Yrjixtilex Kallan Yrjixtilex Kallan was a dragonborn mercenary member of Clan Yrjixtilex , and the interim Vanquisher of Tymanther in 1487 DR . Description . Kallan was a handsome dragonborn , even by human standards , with dark - gray scales and silver eyes .
description_long: Yrjixtilex Kallan Yrjixtilex Kallan was a dragonborn mercenary member of Clan Yrjixtilex , and the interim Vanquisher of Tymanther in 1487 DR . Description . Kallan was a handsome dragonborn , even by human standards , with dark - gray scales and silver eyes . Before he was elected Vanquisher , he didn ' t have any clan piercings . History . Kallan was raised in the homesteads of Tymanther . Since culture was less demanding in the homesteads than in Djerad Thymar , Kallan was never asked to use clan piercings or to marry by his clan elders . < ref name = " AotT / Hardcover - p199 " > < / ref > In 1486 DR , Kallan was working as a mercenary in Cormyr . Kallan ' s mercenary group was hired to protect Aubrin Crownsilver during the siege of Suzail . During this time , Kallan and Clanless Mehen became close , but Mehen ' s insecurities didn ' t allow their relationship to blossom . After the hostilities , Kallan and a fellow wizard were hired by the Ilstan Nyaril , Chosen of Azuth , to accompany him to Djerad Thymar . < ref name = " AotT / Hardcover - p84 " > < / ref > Kallan didn ' t know Ilstan ' s reasons to be in Djerad Thymar were to kill Farideh , foster daughter of Mehen .

title: Yrlamar
description: Yrlamar Yrlamar was a wizard who , in his old age , found himself imprisoned in the dungeons underneath the Fortress of the Five Vultures in Calaunt . Deprived of his spellbook , he was unable to escape . Yrlamar was chained next to the wizard Thogaf , and spent a lot of time training his much younger colleague in the art of magic .
