title: Yrudis Gregan
description: Yrudis Gregan Yrudis Gregan was a wealthy businessman in Sundabar in 1373 DR . Description . Yrudis was an obese man .
description_long: Yrudis Gregan Yrudis Gregan was a wealthy businessman in Sundabar in 1373 DR . Description . Yrudis was an obese man . History . In 1373 DR , Yrudis was searching for a dress for a present to his daughter . While disguised , Aliisza saw that he harshly treated a girl in Velsin ' s employ . The Empyrean Odyssey :

title: Ysele
description: Ysele Ysele the Cat was a businesswoman and wizard in Skullport . Personality . Ysele was a persuasive and manipulative woman .
description_long: Ysele Ysele the Cat was a businesswoman and wizard in Skullport . Personality . Ysele was a persuasive and manipulative woman . She was secretive , duplicitous , vicious , and utterly without scruples or remorse . Ysele was ready to use any means to get what she wanted : even lying , cheating , stealing , or killing . History . Ysele hailed from Tethyr , where her human father taught her magic . In adolescence , she grew bored of her father ' s caution and convinced him to hire a more talented wizard as her instructor , but soon after , the tutor expelled Ysele for stealing some scrolls . After that , Ysele contacted a lower planes creature and organized her father ' s assassination . After her father ' s death , she sold all his holdings to a rival of her father in a prearranged deal and left the country . In Skullport , she hired some thugs to attack her in order to attract the attention of Aurin and Chantos Graybeard , who offered her a position inside the Hired Horrors business . However , Ysele grew frustrated that she could not manipulate Aurin and Chantos because of their mutual friendship .

title: Ysgarda
description: Ysgarda Ysgarda was a page of Candlemas , the of Delia , in the Netherese Empire . Description . The girl had deep blue eyes and short black hair .
description_long: Ysgarda Ysgarda was a page of Candlemas , the of Delia , in the Netherese Empire . Description . The girl had deep blue eyes and short black hair . Personality . Ysgarda acted very flighty and nervous around powerful figures , such as Candlemas . Possessions . When working for the High Steward , Ysgarda wore a white and black outfit . Relationships . Her father managed the in Delia for Lady Polaris . History . During the Shadowed Age , the nine - year - old page informed Candlemas that members of the Beneficent Traders ' Guild of Dalekeva , also known as Oberon ' s Hold , wished to speak to him about a growing problem . The traders begged the Netherese to protect them from the orc and human army of the One King who destroyed their neighboring city of Tinnainen .

title: Yshiggol
description: Yshiggol Yshiggol was a mind flayer elder brain living in the Dread Vault in Gauntlgrym . In the past , Yshiggol was responsible for the corruption of the dwarven Clan Duergar into the subrace of duergar . When the duergar rose against their masters , Yshiggol was thought by all to have been killed by the rebellious slaves .
description_long: Yshiggol Yshiggol was a mind flayer elder brain living in the Dread Vault in Gauntlgrym . In the past , Yshiggol was responsible for the corruption of the dwarven Clan Duergar into the subrace of duergar . When the duergar rose against their masters , Yshiggol was thought by all to have been killed by the rebellious slaves . In truth , the brain was trapped in a magic prison by duergar magic powered by devil s . Circa 1480 DR , the mind flayers discovered the truth of the situation and worked to free their master . In the end , Yshiggol was freed from the prison by the mind flayers , but soon after was killed by some adventurers .

title: Ysmyrl ' da Starym
description: Ysmyrl ' da Starym Ysmyrl ' da Starym was a clan archmage of the elven Starym clan , one of the twelve founding houses of Cormanthyr , and mother of the house ' s famous missing heir , Josidiah Starym . She was niece by marriage to Taleisin Starym , one of the clan elders . She was a moon elf , a minority in the clan .
description_long: Ysmyrl ' da Starym Ysmyrl ' da Starym was a clan archmage of the elven Starym clan , one of the twelve founding houses of Cormanthyr , and mother of the house ' s famous missing heir , Josidiah Starym . She was niece by marriage to Taleisin Starym , one of the clan elders . She was a moon elf , a minority in the clan .

title: Ysolde Veladorn
description: Ysolde Veladorn Ysolde Veladorn was the daughter of Qilué Veladorn . History . Ysolde was born to the Chosen of Eilistraee Qilué Veladorn and her companion Elkantar Iluim in the Promenade of the Dark Maiden in Skullport .
description_long: Ysolde Veladorn Ysolde Veladorn was the daughter of Qilué Veladorn . History . Ysolde was born to the Chosen of Eilistraee Qilué Veladorn and her companion Elkantar Iluim in the Promenade of the Dark Maiden in Skullport . In time , Ysolde too became a priestess of Eilistraee in the Promenade . In 1361 DR , Qiluè agreed to help Liriel Baenre against the Vhaeraun - worshiping Dragon ' s Hoard , sending her warriors to attack their headquarters . However , during the fighting , despite their victory , Gorlist killed Elkantar . Later , Gorlist led the remaining Dragon ' s Hoard against the Promenade in revenge and in the fighting Ysolde too was killed .

title: Ysuran Auondril
description: Ysuran Auondril Ysuran Auondril is a moon elf necromancer and one of five starting playable characters in . He has access to more magical specializations than the other characters and he carries a black tome at all times during the game . Biography .
description_long: Ysuran Auondril Ysuran Auondril is a moon elf necromancer and one of five starting playable characters in . He has access to more magical specializations than the other characters and he carries a black tome at all times during the game . Biography . Backstory . Ysuran lived in the Moon elf city of Evereska . He was a noble there and was related to the ruling family of Evereska . He was exiled from the city for his deeds . Adrianna also came from Evereska but Ysuran lived there about two hundred years before her . Ysuran joined Eldreth Veluuthra and tried to commit genocide against any human . This gave him the motivation to learn Necromancy and he traveled to Zarad ' s Clock Tower to do so , there he learned Necromancy from Zarad Duskmarrow . However , after Zarad learned Ysuran ' s intentions against humans , he wiped the Moon elf ' s memory . This caused Ysuran to wander the Western Heartlands to find his past . Through this he stumbled across his companions that he would travel with to fight Mordoc SeLanmere . War Against the Vampires . As Ysuran learned tidbits of his memory , he grew more increasingly powerful in the necromantic arts .

title: Ysval
description: Ysval Ysval was a nighthaunt ; a sentient undead being from the Plane of Shadow - an avatar of darkness . Appearance . Ysval somewhat resembled a gargoyle with bat wings , talons , curling horns and a whipping serpentine tail .
description_long: Ysval Ysval was a nighthaunt ; a sentient undead being from the Plane of Shadow - an avatar of darkness . Appearance . Ysval somewhat resembled a gargoyle with bat wings , talons , curling horns and a whipping serpentine tail . His body looked as if made of the shadow - stuff of the night itself . He had no face , just a flat triangular space set with a pair of pale eyes , blank and round as pearls . Abilities . Unlike many other undead creatures , Ysval could bear the touch of sunlight without actual harm , though it makes him feel uncomfortable . He had the mystical strength to darken the day to a point where it seemed almost as dark as during the night . When conversing with his underlings , Ysval used a psychic bond for communication without words . History . In 1375 DR , Ysval led an army of undead to conquer Thay . He felt kindred spirit Shex , one of his commanders . He was slain by the combined attacks of Bareris Anskuld , Mirror , Aoth Fezim , Milsantos Daramos , and Nymia Focar at the fight of Thazar Keep . There is evidence that he was ultimately destroyed .

title: Ythazz Buvaar
description: Ythazz Buvaar Ythazz Buvaar was a Red Wizard of Thay demilich in 1368 DR and one of the fonder of modern Thay . History . Ythazz was one of the members of the original group of Red Wizard when Thay was still a province of the empire of Mulhorand .
description_long: Ythazz Buvaar Ythazz Buvaar was a Red Wizard of Thay demilich in 1368 DR and one of the fonder of modern Thay . History . Ythazz was one of the members of the original group of Red Wizard when Thay was still a province of the empire of Mulhorand . He in 922 DR guided his fellow in revolt . They sack and destroy Delhumide , the provincial capital . At the Battle of Thazalhar , a conjurer named Jorgmacdon summons the demon lord Eltab to the Red Wizards ' aid , and the Mulhorandi army is routed . So driven out the Mulhorandi Ythazz and the others pose the basis for modern Thay , they established the zulkir , one from each magic school , as supreme authorities of the land . Among that original group Ythazz was considered the leader and many called him the First Zulkirs In time however Ythazz grew bored of political business , preferred use his time in magic research . So he transformed himself in lich and settled in deep catacombs under Bezantur .

title: Yuan - ti
description: Yuan - ti Yuan - ti are a species of monstrous humanoid snake - men and are usually of an evil alignment . Yuan - ti have their own language , and they can also speak Common , Draconic , and Abyssal . Society .
description_long: Yuan - ti Yuan - ti are a species of monstrous humanoid snake - men and are usually of an evil alignment . Yuan - ti have their own language , and they can also speak Common , Draconic , and Abyssal . Society . Yuan - ti call themselves vrael olo ( which means " favored ones " ) . Daily use typically uses the shortened " vrael " , and can be modified to " auvrael " ( meaning friendly or known yuan - ti ) and duthrael ( unfriendly or unfamiliar yuan - ti ) . In general , the more serpentine features a yuan - ti possesses the higher its status in yuan - ti society . Abominations are at the top of their society , followed by halfblood , and finally purebloods . Within their subraces , yuan - ti are ranked by achievements and the demonstrated favor of Sseth . Most yuan - ti worship Sseth , with other serpentine deities that some have worshipped over the years either being masks worn by Sseth or a false deity of the Scaleless Ones . All yuan - ti must act in accordance with the Sacred Way of Sseth - that is , subtly . Whenever possible , yuan - ti choose manipulation over open confrontation , the whisper over the fang .

title: Yuan - ti abomination
description: Yuan - ti abomination Yuan - ti abominations were monstrous serpent - like creatures , almost completely snakelike except for a roughly humanoid torso . They formed the highest caste of yuan - ti society . Description .
description_long: Yuan - ti abomination Yuan - ti abominations were monstrous serpent - like creatures , almost completely snakelike except for a roughly humanoid torso . They formed the highest caste of yuan - ti society . Description . With their almost completely serpentine form and vaguely humanoid arms able to use weapons and tools , abominations were the form of yuan - ti that most closely resembled the originally intended appearance of the yuan - ti race as envisioned by the serpent gods . Society . Since they were the most prestigious caste within yuan - ti society , abominations were almost always the leaders of their cities , except if a yuan - ti anathema were present .

title: Yuan - ti anathema
description: Yuan - ti anathema Yuan - ti anathemas were the result of a ritual that transformed a yuan - ti abomination into a larger , more powerful and more aggressive creature . They were considered by their followers to be the pinnacle of the yuan - ti race . Description .
description_long: Yuan - ti anathema Yuan - ti anathemas were the result of a ritual that transformed a yuan - ti abomination into a larger , more powerful and more aggressive creature . They were considered by their followers to be the pinnacle of the yuan - ti race . Description . Anathemas were immortal and considerably larger than abominations , with claw - like hands and six snake heads . The ritual that transformed an abomination into an anathema was cruel and painful , involving the sacrifice of hundreds of snakes and requiring the abomination to bathe in the blood of its enemies . Some yuan - ti disliked the idea of creating a new anathema , because they were far more aggressive and brutal leaders than abominations .

title: Yuan - ti halfblood
description: Yuan - ti halfblood < / ref > Halfbloods , also known as malisons , were a subrace of the yuan - ti , a psionic race of serpent - men . Halfblood was not a precise category but generally referred to a yuan - ti with half human - like and half snake - like features , which shared certain common abilities . Description .
description_long: Yuan - ti halfblood < / ref > Halfbloods , also known as malisons , were a subrace of the yuan - ti , a psionic race of serpent - men . Halfblood was not a precise category but generally referred to a yuan - ti with half human - like and half snake - like features , which shared certain common abilities . Description . There was great variety among the yuan - ti halfbloods . Not only did they come in several general body types , but they also tended to show variations in scale patterns and colors , much like natural snakes . Four in ten halfbloods had the body of an agile , sharp - featured human but with a serpent head and scales . Some varieties had hoods like cobras , such as those halfbloods who were members of House Hss ' tafi . The remaining 60 % of halfbloods fell into three remaining variations . Some had the lower body of a snake instead of legs , others had a snake - like tail , and still others had snake - like arms in place of normal arms . Halfbloods tended to have body masses and sizes in the same range as human s . Abilities . Like all true yuan - ti , halfbloods had psionic powers .

title: Yuan - ti pit master
description: Yuan - ti pit master Yuan - ti pit masters were the most conservative of yuan - ti malison priests . They had a pact with the god Merrshaulk and pledged to sacrifice humanoids to him in order to raise him . Advocates of caution and always opposed to reckless behavior , pit masters were the most deeply concerned with the yuan - ti ' s plans of world domination .
description_long: Yuan - ti pit master Yuan - ti pit masters were the most conservative of yuan - ti malison priests . They had a pact with the god Merrshaulk and pledged to sacrifice humanoids to him in order to raise him . Advocates of caution and always opposed to reckless behavior , pit masters were the most deeply concerned with the yuan - ti ' s plans of world domination . Description . Pit masters had a humanoid body and several snakes for arms .

title: Yuan - ti pureblood
description: Yuan - ti pureblood Purebloods were the most human - seeming of all true yuan - ti and one of three main breeds — the other two being the halfbloods and the abominations . Description . Purebloods were described as human - like but with minor reptilian features , such as snake - like eyes , a forked tongue , and patches of scales on their skin .
description_long: Yuan - ti pureblood Purebloods were the most human - seeming of all true yuan - ti and one of three main breeds — the other two being the halfbloods and the abominations . Description . Purebloods were described as human - like but with minor reptilian features , such as snake - like eyes , a forked tongue , and patches of scales on their skin . Purebloods had weights and heights in the same range as human s . Abilities . While not as powerful as other yuan - ti forms , purebloods still had psionic powers . Like all yuan - ti , they could morph their bodies into the form of any viper by force of will alone and could sense the presence of any poison nearby . They were also innately resistant to magic . They were not as intelligent as halfbloods , yet they still took pride in being more intelligent on average than humans . The psionic powers of purebloods included the ability to charm other humanoids , to entrance animals , to cause fear , to create darkness , and to command plants to entangle opponents . Purebloods were very adept at impersonating humans , and often entered human settlements in disguise as spies . Life Cycle .

title: Yuchimo Ein
description: Yuchimo Ein Yuchimo Ein was a monk of Bishamon at the Shining Temple of Bishamon in the town of Aru in Wa around 1357 DR . Activities . He was a high - ranking monk of Bishamon , based permanently at the Shining Temple .
description_long: Yuchimo Ein Yuchimo Ein was a monk of Bishamon at the Shining Temple of Bishamon in the town of Aru in Wa around 1357 DR . Activities . He was a high - ranking monk of Bishamon , based permanently at the Shining Temple . His duties included supervising acolytes , instructing others in spiritual matters , and the organizing special services for visiting dignitaries and important pilgrims . However , he had two hidden vices . For one , he was a ceaseless gossip ; he would usually exaggerating truthful matters to make them seem more interesting . For the second , he was a compulsive gambler , ready to bet on anything , including local cricket races and how many visitors wore kimonos of a certain pattern . He wasn ' t even any good , so he had to borrow money from seedy lenders . Personality . Ein was amiable , pleasant - natured , and good at heart , and also very chatty . He truly loved his work at the temple , and found his gossiping and gambling habits intensely shameful . He was afraid he would be found out and forced to resign ; he would do anything to stop this happening . History .

title: Yuf Bawrax
description: Yuf Bawrax Yuf Bawrax was a man living in the settlement of Bejung in Koryo around 1358 DR , described as an " old northern barbarian " . He could often be found at The Sharpening House , a local tavern . Yuf had discovered an entrance into the ruins of the city of Old Bejung .
description_long: Yuf Bawrax Yuf Bawrax was a man living in the settlement of Bejung in Koryo around 1358 DR , described as an " old northern barbarian " . He could often be found at The Sharpening House , a local tavern . Yuf had discovered an entrance into the ruins of the city of Old Bejung . He declined to step foot inside , but would show it to others .

title: Yugoloth
description: Yugoloth Yugoloths ( also often called daemons or nicknamed loths ) are neutral evil fiend ish natives of the Blood Rift who are neutral to the affairs of the other fiendish races , interfering only when they see a situation that may be profitable or a potential for the advancement of their own schemes . The yugoloths are manipulative , secretive , and mercenary by nature , often acting as soldiers for in their own private wars , or even at times aiding both sides of the Blood War . Physical description .
description_long: Yugoloth Yugoloths ( also often called daemons or nicknamed loths ) are neutral evil fiend ish natives of the Blood Rift who are neutral to the affairs of the other fiendish races , interfering only when they see a situation that may be profitable or a potential for the advancement of their own schemes . The yugoloths are manipulative , secretive , and mercenary by nature , often acting as soldiers for in their own private wars , or even at times aiding both sides of the Blood War . Physical description . The yugoloths present themselves as simply greedy mercenaries , willing to sell their services to both sides , while behind that public face , the members of their highest castes view the entire course of the conflict as their own thing to control and manipulate until they decide to end it , unify the Fiendish Planes , and turn their attention to the planes of Good . Like the tanar ' ri and baatezu , the yugoloths have their rulers : the baernoloth s , who are their progenitors . Below the baernoloths is the ruler of Khin - Oin , who is given the title of Oinoloth .

title: Yui Min Li
description: Yui Min Li Yui Min Li was the Minister of Faith of Shou Lung in 1358 DR . History . Yui Min Li was originally a sohei of the Dragon Order but also an Imperial Guard .
description_long: Yui Min Li Yui Min Li was the Minister of Faith of Shou Lung in 1358 DR . History . Yui Min Li was originally a sohei of the Dragon Order but also an Imperial Guard . After being promoted to minister , she faced a very hard task : her duty was to decide which among the thousands of different branches of the Path of Enlightenment could be sanctioned by the Imperial government , and be considered among the approximately 200 approved sects of the Path ' s Shou - ling Tao , or Receivers of Guidance . She also had to avoid battle between Shou - ling Tao sects , both between sanctioned sects and against non - sanctioned sects . Yui Min Li had a delicate truce with the Path ' s High Priest , Kung Pu Mok , whom she knew had ties to the Black Chun Tao . She secretly had an ally in the Minister of Magic .

title: Yuir
description: Yuir The Yuir elves were a proud race of wild elves who inhabited the Yuirwood in what is now known as Aglarond . They possessed powerful magic and held ceremonies in circles of stone menhirs . The Yuir fell into decline , pressured by outside forces such as a human presence , and eventually ceased to exist , although their ancestry remains in some of the half - elves of modern Aglarond .
description_long: Yuir The Yuir elves were a proud race of wild elves who inhabited the Yuirwood in what is now known as Aglarond . They possessed powerful magic and held ceremonies in circles of stone menhirs . The Yuir fell into decline , pressured by outside forces such as a human presence , and eventually ceased to exist , although their ancestry remains in some of the half - elves of modern Aglarond . History . The Yuir elves came under pressure from attacks by the drow and mountain troll s and were also forced deeper into the Yuirwood by the arrival of human colonists from Chessenta in 756 DR , who settled the coastal areas . The population of elves dwindled further and further until by 880 DR , they had been reduced to a few villages . The elves were diseased and in heavy decline at this stage , but the humans joined their fight against the drow and mountain troll threats , helping to eradicate them and make the Yuirwood safe . Breeding between the humans and the Yuir elves created a half - elf race proud of its elven ancestry . Eventually , the elves died off and were succeeded by their half - elven descendants . Religion .

title: Yuir pantheon
description: Yuir pantheon The Yuir pantheon was the pantheon of ten deities once worshiped by the primitive tribes of indigenous human s living in the forests of what became Aglarond , the Great Dale , Impiltur and Narfell . These humans eventually moved on , with the last cohesive remnants of their tribes becoming the Nar s , who turned from the pantheon in favour of Abyssal powers . These gods came to be associated with the Yuir elves when they established homes within those woodlands after the Crown Wars in - 9800 DR .
description_long: Yuir pantheon The Yuir pantheon was the pantheon of ten deities once worshiped by the primitive tribes of indigenous human s living in the forests of what became Aglarond , the Great Dale , Impiltur and Narfell . These humans eventually moved on , with the last cohesive remnants of their tribes becoming the Nar s , who turned from the pantheon in favour of Abyssal powers . These gods came to be associated with the Yuir elves when they established homes within those woodlands after the Crown Wars in - 9800 DR . After the formation of the Kingdom of Aglarond , the half - elven descendants of the Yuir elves had abandoned these gods in favor of more common human or elvish gods and it was assumed that without worshipers , the deities in this pantheon had ceased to exist . Half of these deities however had long ago been subsumed by various members of the Seldarine . Rumors spread during the Era of Upheaval that half - elves proud of their ancient elven roots had begun to venerate some of these gods once more . Deities . Sages speculate that the other four gods of the pantheon had the portfolios of sky & weather ; hearth & home ; tribal / familial life ; and evil & darkness respectively .

title: Yuirwood
description: Yuirwood Once home to a powerful nation of elves , in 1372 DR , the Yuirwood is the site of ancient ruins of unknown power and origin . It is located in the center of the nation of Aglarond , and is populated by elves and half elves . Sildëyuir is a plane of finite size that is conterminous with the Yuirwood in Faerûn , perhaps two to three hundred miles from end to end , and is home to the Star Elves , a subrace of elves that left Faerûn in antiquity .
description_long: Yuirwood Once home to a powerful nation of elves , in 1372 DR , the Yuirwood is the site of ancient ruins of unknown power and origin . It is located in the center of the nation of Aglarond , and is populated by elves and half elves . Sildëyuir is a plane of finite size that is conterminous with the Yuirwood in Faerûn , perhaps two to three hundred miles from end to end , and is home to the Star Elves , a subrace of elves that left Faerûn in antiquity . The ruins in the Yuirwood are the remnants of their original society . History . In −9800 DR , the Yuirwood was settled by green elves in the aftermath of the Crown Wars . In −6950 DR , the star elves began leaving other elven nations and gathering in the Yuirwood . In −6600 DR , the star and green elves founded the realm of Yuireshanyaar in the Yuirwood . The human empire of Unther battled Yuireshanyaar in −1250 DR for control of the southern Aglarondan coast , and the Yuir were driven back into the woods . From −1076 to −1069 DR , the Orcgate Wars occurred after an Imaskari wizard opened up a gate in Mulhorand to the orc ' s home world , and Yuireshanyaar was pressed hard by the orcs .

title: Yuji Takaesu
description: Yuji Takaesu Yuji Takaesu was a samurai in the town of Aru in Wa . Personality . Yuji was totally loyal to his daimyo .
description_long: Yuji Takaesu Yuji Takaesu was a samurai in the town of Aru in Wa . Personality . Yuji was totally loyal to his daimyo . He loved music and outside his government dutieshe was an introspective and intellectual individual . Activities . Yuji was the right - hand man of the daimyo Benju Matsumoto . His hobbies were acting in noh plays with Benju and playing go . History . Yuji met Benju Matsumoto when he was a simple samurai general . From that day , Yuji was his closest advisor and best friend .

title: Yuk Yuk
description: Yuk Yuk Yuk Yuk was a goblin living in the Silken Paths during the Rage of Demons . Personality . He was a thrill - seeking individual .
description_long: Yuk Yuk Yuk Yuk was a goblin living in the Silken Paths during the Rage of Demons . Personality . He was a thrill - seeking individual . Yuk Yuk was a relatively sociable denizen of the Underdark . Relationship . Yuk Yuk was the inseparable friend and partner of Spiderbait . They called themselves the Web Runners . Activities . For a suitable fee , he offered to help and guide strangers through the Underdark .

title: Yukio
description: Yukio Yukio the Rice Merchant was one of the most powerful merchant in Miyama Province in Kozakura in 1357 DR . Activities . Yukio operated by a large fortified house with all confort in the Castle District of Tamanokuni .
description_long: Yukio Yukio the Rice Merchant was one of the most powerful merchant in Miyama Province in Kozakura in 1357 DR . Activities . Yukio operated by a large fortified house with all confort in the Castle District of Tamanokuni . His house housed 20 members of his family , 30 servants , six business clerks and an overseer and for protection 250 bushi led by 10 ronin . Plus he sponsored the school of the kensai Oshio and his five students , which was located on the grounds .

title: Yulis
description: Yulis Yulis the Fortune Teller was a human woman who had the ability to divine the future . As of 1479 DR , she lived in the city of Harglast , in the Windrise Ports of Returned Abeir . Abilities .
description_long: Yulis Yulis the Fortune Teller was a human woman who had the ability to divine the future . As of 1479 DR , she lived in the city of Harglast , in the Windrise Ports of Returned Abeir . Abilities . Yulis had the ability to accurately foresee the future by using a pool that emanated magic al vapor , that was located in a cave below her house in Harglast . She had to study many years to master this ability . Yulis had also the ability to alter the destiny of certain individuals by manipulating the Weave , although she was also aware of the risks of using the Weave in such way . Background . Yulis was well - known in Harglast due to her abilities , and was respected by the citizens . Yulis was also an acquittance of Queen Imreera Hethkantan of Gontal , and helped her when the Queen required it .

title: Yumbu Shan
description: Yumbu Shan Yumbu Shan was a large mountain peak found in the nation of Khazari in the Hordelands . Geography . Yumbu Shan was found in the southwest corner of Khazari where an arm of Katakoro Shan encircled the country from the south .
description_long: Yumbu Shan Yumbu Shan was a large mountain peak found in the nation of Khazari in the Hordelands . Geography . Yumbu Shan was found in the southwest corner of Khazari where an arm of Katakoro Shan encircled the country from the south . Description . The peak rose to an elevation of 16 , 041 feet or 4 , 890 meters . Yumbu Citadel was built atop Yumbu Shan .

title: Yuminoi Bowida
description: Yuminoi Bowida Yuminoi Bowida was a Roju representative in Fochu in Wa around 1357 DR . Activities . Yuminoi was sent from Uwaji by the Roju in Fochu to survey possible activity of followers of Chauntea in the area since daimyo Bokika Hokio was known to sympathized for them .
description_long: Yuminoi Bowida Yuminoi Bowida was a Roju representative in Fochu in Wa around 1357 DR . Activities . Yuminoi was sent from Uwaji by the Roju in Fochu to survey possible activity of followers of Chauntea in the area since daimyo Bokika Hokio was known to sympathized for them . Bowida love his job , especially possibility to execute suspect peasants taking advantage of his kirsute gome privilege . Often he manufactured evidence against people . All in the area hated Yuminoi and his men .

title: Yunik al - Zanil
description: Yunik al - Zanil Yunik al - Zanil ran a small shop specializing in flying tours within the Grand Bazaar of Huzuz in 1367 DR . Activities . Yunik ’ s rates were pricey , but worth it .
description_long: Yunik al - Zanil Yunik al - Zanil ran a small shop specializing in flying tours within the Grand Bazaar of Huzuz in 1367 DR . Activities . Yunik ’ s rates were pricey , but worth it . For 20 dinar s customers received a 30 minute aerial tour of Golden Huzuz aboad a " flying carpet " . The tours were customized based upon what the customer wished to view . Yunik had several apprentices who paid for their training by taking customers on tours , though Yunik stepped in to conduct tours for elite customers . Flying above the Golden Mosque or the Palace of the Enlightened Throne was prohibited . Customers who had the permission of the Grand Vizier or Grand Caliph were allowed to purchase flying carpets from Yunik . Large carpets sold for 10 , 000 dinar , and smaller ones for 5 , 000 . The waiting time to receive a carpet was six months . If customers were not willing to wait that long , Yunik sometimes sold the carpets he used on tours .

title: Yurian
description: Yurian The yurians , also known as crabmen , aldani , or lobster men , were a race of crustacean beings that inhabited the seas and rivers of Faerûn . Description . An aldani resembled a the size of a human being , walking on two humanoid legs but they could swim like lobsters .
description_long: Yurian The yurians , also known as crabmen , aldani , or lobster men , were a race of crustacean beings that inhabited the seas and rivers of Faerûn . Description . An aldani resembled a the size of a human being , walking on two humanoid legs but they could swim like lobsters . Its face was also similar to that of a human , though encased in chitinous armor and with eyes on stalks . Society . Despite a heavily armored appearance , aldani were quite intelligent and very civilized , with a society . Disputes between them were resolved with courtly tournaments , though these were usually to the death . However , outsiders who fell afoul of the aldani were rarely offered the option of a tournament battle . History . During the Second Serôs War in −8298 DR , the sea elf empire , Aryselmalyr , used crabmen , merfolk , and locathah forces to destroy the Kuo - Toan Consortiums . The war ended in −8282 with a massacre of the kuo - toa in the Sea of Fallen Stars . Around 1363 DR , Mainu of Mezro , a " bara " , dwelt in the Olung river with a dozen aldani guards in her throne room . Settlements .

title: Yurtrus
description: Yurtrus Yurtrus was an orc god of death and disease . Where Shargaas symbolized the fear of what lurked in the bowels of the earth , Yurtrus embodied the constant threat of death and plagues with which the orc s lived every day . Description .
description_long: Yurtrus Yurtrus was an orc god of death and disease . Where Shargaas symbolized the fear of what lurked in the bowels of the earth , Yurtrus embodied the constant threat of death and plagues with which the orc s lived every day . Description . The Lord of Maggots did not speak or communicate , but sometimes was receptive to prayers and sacrifices to save an individual or a tribe from the ravages of disease . He was depicted as an orc whose body was covered in sores , excepting his hands , which were white and unblemished . History and Relationships . By his very nature , Yurtrus had little relationship with anyone . He offered silent support to Shargaas when he tried to counteract the influence of the three orcish gods of war . Yurtrus certainly maintained links with other gods of death and disease , such as Talona , but perhaps it was more a rivalry than a real alliance . Like the rest of the orc pantheon , Yurtrus hated dwarves , elves , and goblin s , and he opposed them when the opportunity arose . Worshipers . Priesthoods . Apart from some monastic orders , Yurtrus ' s church was not organized and its clergy was dispersed among numerous tribes and clans .

title: Yusendre
description: Yusendre Yusendre was one of the Nimbral Lords . She was an impish fun - loving figure and one of the leading Elders . History .
description_long: Yusendre Yusendre was one of the Nimbral Lords . She was an impish fun - loving figure and one of the leading Elders . History . Yusendre was forced to help her fellow Elder Skouloun to sell many rival wizards to the shadovar . Yusendre escaped from the Spellplague using a gate to an other plane . There she entered in stasis using the Phezult ' s sleep of ages spell . Yusendre awoke around 1487 DR and competed with her fellow Elder Skouloun and other archmages for possession of the Lost Spell during a spellstorm . She however was killed by Tabra for her dealing with the shadovar .

title: Yusten Karas
description: Yusten Karas Yusten Karas was a drow assassin and sword master in the Moonsea in 1489 DR . History . At one point , he was captured in Phlan and put in prison .
description_long: Yusten Karas Yusten Karas was a drow assassin and sword master in the Moonsea in 1489 DR . History . At one point , he was captured in Phlan and put in prison . With Vorgansharax ' s coup in 1489 DR , he managed to escape . However , soon after , near Twilight Marsh , he was again captured by the black dragon Throstulgrael and brainwashed to work for him . The Order of the Gauntlet desperately wanted him back alive , so eventually he was subdued by an adventuring party sent to recover some items from the dragon ' s lair .

title: Yusuf bin Ayyub
description: Yusuf bin Ayyub Yusuf bin Ayyub was the leader of the Loyalists within the fortress of Sarahin in 1367 DR . Personality . Paranoid that everyone was jealous of his position within Sarahin , Yusuf was accompanied by three werelion bodyguards at all times .
description_long: Yusuf bin Ayyub Yusuf bin Ayyub was the leader of the Loyalists within the fortress of Sarahin in 1367 DR . Personality . Paranoid that everyone was jealous of his position within Sarahin , Yusuf was accompanied by three werelion bodyguards at all times . His lack of confidence prompted him to be curt with others . Activities . Yusuf made careful plans and preparations to assume power when the Shadow Caliph died . Relationships . It was rumored that Yusuf had become intimate with Jamila al - Zahab , one of his werelion bodyguards . Possessions . Yusuf owned a magical scimitar , a " ring of protection " , and a " ring of invisibility " .

title: Yusuke T ' ing
description: Yusuke T ' ing Yusuke T ' ing was an inhabitant of Fochu Peninsula in Wa . History . Yusuke lived in the village of Sokijan in Fochu Peninsula .
description_long: Yusuke T ' ing Yusuke T ' ing was an inhabitant of Fochu Peninsula in Wa . History . Yusuke lived in the village of Sokijan in Fochu Peninsula . In 1358 DR , his pet sparrow died and he went in search of a new one in the surrounding area . He first met a group of Blue Kumi Bandits and later Osari Minhiro and a foreign adventuring party . He asked them to accompany him back to his home .

title: Yuvaraj
description: Yuvaraj Yuvaraj was the last " Lord Artificer " ( Emperor ) of Imaskar . He fell in battle with the deity Horus at the palace of Inupras in - 2488 DR . The battle , in which he rode his copper dragon mount and wore the " First Imaskarcana " , was the final confrontation between the Imaskari and the Mulan and their deities .
description_long: Yuvaraj Yuvaraj was the last " Lord Artificer " ( Emperor ) of Imaskar . He fell in battle with the deity Horus at the palace of Inupras in - 2488 DR . The battle , in which he rode his copper dragon mount and wore the " First Imaskarcana " , was the final confrontation between the Imaskari and the Mulan and their deities .

title: Yvonnel Baenre
description: Yvonnel Baenre Yvonnel Baenre , often known only as Matron Baenre or simply Baenre , was the matron mother of House Baenre in the city of Menzoberranzan . She led her house and the city itself with an uncanny strength bred from deceitful ambition . Description .
description_long: Yvonnel Baenre Yvonnel Baenre , often known only as Matron Baenre or simply Baenre , was the matron mother of House Baenre in the city of Menzoberranzan . She led her house and the city itself with an uncanny strength bred from deceitful ambition . Description . Matron Baenre had lost much of the beauty she possessed while young to a combination of factors , including several uses of zin - carla . At the end of her life she looked haggard , with a patchwork of wrinkles across her face . Possessing an unusual vibrancy , she was capable of pregnancy till her late 1900s . History . Yvonnel Baenre was born in - 685 DR . She was the younger of twinborn drow priestesses , though not much was known of her youth . Some time in the past , she encountered Gandalug Battlehammer and his bodyguard Crowmower Pwent . During this confrontation her twin sister was slain by the first king of Mithral Hall amongst others ( mainly by the king ' s bodyguard ) . She managed to entrap Gandalug ' s soul in one of his teeth that had been knocked loose .

title: Yxunomei
description: Yxunomei Yxunomei was a marilith demon who threatened Icewind Dale . History . Yxunomei wished to precipitate an ages - old vendetta against the baatezu Belhifet while also returning Icewind Dale to its ancient jungle - like state , wherein her serpentine followers could thrive .
description_long: Yxunomei Yxunomei was a marilith demon who threatened Icewind Dale . History . Yxunomei wished to precipitate an ages - old vendetta against the baatezu Belhifet while also returning Icewind Dale to its ancient jungle - like state , wherein her serpentine followers could thrive . Yxunomei arrived on the Prime Material Plane sometime after Belhifet , often simply referred to as " The Old Enemy " , was banished from Baator . In 1281 DR , Arundel , the archdruid of Kuldahar , sent a messenger to the village of Easthaven asking for help in determining what evil plagued the Kuldahar pass . Aid came in the form of a group of adventurers who eventually made their way to the demon ' s lair , known as Dragon ' s Eye . Once inside , they destroyed the marilith ' s army , including the necromancer Presio , before encountering the demon herself , disguised as an odd little girl . Yxunomei refused to give up the Heartstone Gem , an ancient artifact Arundel wished returned to Kuldahar , and was eventually slain by the adventurers . Later , it was found that the women of Kuldahar had been impregnated by Yxunomei ' s yuan - ti .

title: Yûlash
description: Yûlash Yûlash was a fortress town positioned between the two cities of Zhentil Keep and Hillsfar . The ongoing conflict between these two cities meant that Yûlash spent much of its history in ruin and occupied by soldiers . Geography .
description_long: Yûlash Yûlash was a fortress town positioned between the two cities of Zhentil Keep and Hillsfar . The ongoing conflict between these two cities meant that Yûlash spent much of its history in ruin and occupied by soldiers . Geography . Yûlash sat atop a large plateau giving it a considerable tactical advantage over all the nearby settlements . Government . For most of its history , Yûlash was ruled by a lord but in in 1337 DR , after years of political disputes between the nobles houses , Yûlash began to be ruled by a council of leaders . Having been controlled by Zhentil Keep for much of its history , the city ' s culture and politics was easily influenced by the will of the Zhentarim . History . During 171 DR the elves of Cormanthor destroyed the last remaining temple of Moander . Moander went into hiding deep under the ruins of its temple . Centuries later the town of Yûlash would be unknowingly built on the site of the temple ruins . In 1275 DR Zhentil Keep granted Yûlash independence . Despite this official status little changed and Yûlash was still heavily influenced by the will of Zhentil Keep .

title: Z ' har thalack
description: Z ' har thalack Z ' har thalack , meaning " riding war " , was a fighting style taught among drow for those who fought on mounts . Description . As the name " riding war " suggested , users fought while riding , and the style addressed the benefits and drawbacks of this as for any mounted warrior .
description_long: Z ' har thalack Z ' har thalack , meaning " riding war " , was a fighting style taught among drow for those who fought on mounts . Description . As the name " riding war " suggested , users fought while riding , and the style addressed the benefits and drawbacks of this as for any mounted warrior . What made this style unique was that it was a three - dimensional style — drow primarily used riding lizards as combat mounts , which had the ability to walk on walls . This gave lizard - mounted warriors added advantages against foot - soldiers . Training . The style was developed for mounted patrols . As the name " riding war " suggested , users needed to learn how to fight while mounted , enhancing that knowledge with various mounted tactics . Reputation . House Baenre had lizard riders that were organized under Berg ' inyon Baenre , who made good use of his " death lance " with this style . Appendix . Background . The style was based on the Mounted Combat feat chain in 3 . 0 - edition " Dungeons & Dragons " .

title: Z ' ress a ' thalak
description: Z ' ress a ' thalak Z ' ress athalak , meaning " force of war " , was a fighting style taught among drow . It was unusual for drow as it revolved around the users ' physical strength . Description .
description_long: Z ' ress a ' thalak Z ' ress athalak , meaning " force of war " , was a fighting style taught among drow . It was unusual for drow as it revolved around the users ' physical strength . Description . As the name " force of war " suggested , force was paramount for this style . Users made use of heavier weapons such as longsword s , hammer s , and axe s , instead of the lighter ones favored by most drow and were ready to sacrifice accuracy for additional strength behind their attacks , enough to cleave through one enemy and into the next and to destroy their weapons . Users of this style often cooperated with users of the " bautha z ' hin " style for the latter could easily use the former as a good anchor point for flanking maneuvers . Training . As the name suggested , would - be users needed physical strength , something most drow lacked , which made this style a rarity . Users of the " z ' ress athalak " style were noted to fight in similar ways as the users of the " phindar streeaka " " style " . While both were similar in putting emphasis on strength , the former the result of purposeful training , whereas the latter simply applied mindless brute force . Reputation .

title: Za - Jikku
description: Za - Jikku Za - Jikku was a powerful wu jen of Fochu Peninsula in Wa . History . Originally Za - Jikku was a pan lung member of the Celestial Bureaucracy .
description_long: Za - Jikku Za - Jikku was a powerful wu jen of Fochu Peninsula in Wa . History . Originally Za - Jikku was a pan lung member of the Celestial Bureaucracy . He was one of the officers of the Qui sub - committee that governed the affairs of the animal population of the Fochu Peninsula under orders of the Ministry of Animal Affairs of the Celestial Bureaucracy oversewing about the scaly animals of the land . However Za - Jikku was always a wild card with a enorme ego : one time he tricked the inhabitants of the Jufosu Range to venerate him as god , an other time a duel of Za - Jikku caused a series of earthquakes . In the end around 886 DR following an indiscretion that results in the destruction of a vast area of the Momoben Forest the high echelon of the Bureaucracy decided to act : Za - Jikku was strip of his duty and expel from Qui , punished to live as human in Fochu Peninsula while his former dragon body transformed in a jade statue . Za - Jikku installed himself in a fortes surrounded by legions of juju zombie dressed in gold but his obsession was become again immortal . In time thank to his discoveries Za - Jikku continued to live but was still far to immortality .

title: Zabbas Thuul
description: Zabbas Thuul Zabbas Thuul was a rogue and all - around ne ' er - do - well who operated out of Waterdeep and Skullport . He made his living either as a thief , using his magical powers to augment his chances of success , or as an agent for several devious organizations who operated out of the Port of Shadows . Among those he worked for were the Iron Ring slavers and the Red Wizards of Thay through Consul Orgin Ulmokina in their enclave in Skullport .
description_long: Zabbas Thuul Zabbas Thuul was a rogue and all - around ne ' er - do - well who operated out of Waterdeep and Skullport . He made his living either as a thief , using his magical powers to augment his chances of success , or as an agent for several devious organizations who operated out of the Port of Shadows . Among those he worked for were the Iron Ring slavers and the Red Wizards of Thay through Consul Orgin Ulmokina in their enclave in Skullport . Thuul could usually be found in one of the rooms he continuously rented at the Blushing Nymph festhall in Waterdeep , or the Burning Troll if conducting business in Skullport .

title: Zachan
description: Zachan Zachan was a villager of Highcliff on the Sword Coast North in the 1370s DR . History . Zachan was in Weeping Willow Inn when he was attacked by bladeling s and duergar .
description_long: Zachan Zachan was a villager of Highcliff on the Sword Coast North in the 1370s DR . History . Zachan was in Weeping Willow Inn when he was attacked by bladeling s and duergar . Gera , his wife , asked the Kalach - Cha to rescue him . Once Zachan was rescued , both of them headed for Highcliff . In Highcliff , he and his wife worried about their lost sons , Alex and Andrew . If the Kalach - Cha saved the boys from wolves at Highcliff Castle , Zachan admitted he told his sons stories to give them more confidence . Nevertheless , he would reward the Kalach - Cha . Finally , the the Kalach - Cha encountered Zachan again on the way to Highcliff after the King of Shadows launched his attack . Zachan and Gera would thank the Kalach - Cha and explain what was going on in Highcliff .

title: Zagum
description: Zagum Zagum was a vassal of Asmodeus . Personality . He was noted for cold - blooded ambition .
description_long: Zagum Zagum was a vassal of Asmodeus . Personality . He was noted for cold - blooded ambition . However , he considered cruelty self - indulgent and wasteful of time . Instead , he used humor to build alliances with fellow devils , devising stunts which were amusing and harmless .

title: Zahara ' s Krakens
description: Zahara ' s Krakens Zahara ' s Krakens were a mercenary company based in the Sword Coast around 1358 DR . They had a lucrative business of protecting shipping . Tactics .
description_long: Zahara ' s Krakens Zahara ' s Krakens were a mercenary company based in the Sword Coast around 1358 DR . They had a lucrative business of protecting shipping . Tactics . In the attacks to a port they tried to kept destruction to a minimum and they did only if this served a noble cause , like deposing an evil lord . Organization . The Krakens had five small ships . Each ship had onboard 15 crew members , 30 marines , five spellcasters . One of the ship had , unknown to general public , a spelljamming helm that permitted them to fly in desperate occasion . Contracts . The Krakens took 500 gold piece for a week or any portion thereof , half in advance . They asked terrestrial support to attack a port .

title: Zaheb al - Zidq
description: Zaheb al - Zidq Zaheb al - Zidq was a noble dao inhabiting Ajayib in Zakhara in 1367 DR . Activities . Despite being a mighty noble among the dao , Zaheb was madly in love with the Calipha of Ajayib , Halima al - Wahsi .
description_long: Zaheb al - Zidq Zaheb al - Zidq was a noble dao inhabiting Ajayib in Zakhara in 1367 DR . Activities . Despite being a mighty noble among the dao , Zaheb was madly in love with the Calipha of Ajayib , Halima al - Wahsi . He spent most of his time at Halima ' s side , hoping to win her affections . Relationships . It seemed that all of Zaheb ' s efforts were wasted since the Calipha viewed him as a favorite pet and nothing else .

title: Zaid bin Ziyad
description: Zaid bin Ziyad Zaid bin Ziyad was a cook in Zakhara in 1367 DR . Description . Zaid was a large man .
description_long: Zaid bin Ziyad Zaid bin Ziyad was a cook in Zakhara in 1367 DR . Description . Zaid was a large man . Personality . Zaid had a friendly personality and loved to ask food - related questions of travelers . Activities . Zaid was a professonial cook . He sometimes accompanied Bahramiyah al - Musafir when her caravans traveled from Hiyal to Qudra .

title: Zairtail
description: Zairtail Zairtails are small aggressive lizards found across Returned Abeir . Description . These reptile s have bodies around the size of a human hand and tails which are about twice this length .
description_long: Zairtail Zairtails are small aggressive lizards found across Returned Abeir . Description . These reptile s have bodies around the size of a human hand and tails which are about twice this length . Ecology . Zairtails live in swarms usually riding on the back of scathebeast s . They feed by plucking flies from the air , and will jump onto passing enemies and rip into them . Zairtails lay clutches of around 5 rubbery eggs covered in a foul smelling oil . The eggs are buried in loose dirt , and the young are left to fend for themselves . Subraces . Various sub - species of Zairtail can be found across Returned Abeir , each with a different brightly colored skin tone . Firetongue . These rich crimson colored Zairtails are known for its burning hot skin . Firetongues are about the size of a small dog . Unlike other varieties , Firetongues stay with their eggs in order to keep them warm . Gazer . Gazers have large suckers on their toes and big eyes . They use these hypnotic eyes to distract prey whilst the rest of the swarm closes in . Their large eyes also give them better vision than any other subspecies of Zairtail . Cutter .

title: Zakhara
description: Zakhara Zakhara , also known as the Land of Fate , was a giant peninsula of the same super - continent that hosted Faerûn and Kara - Tur on the planet Abeir - Toril . The land was located south and east of Faerûn , beyond the region of the Utter East , with the closest Faerûnian lands to Zakhara being Dambrath and Var the Golden ( by sea ) and Ulgarth or arguably Konigheim ( by land ) . Zakhara was mostly isolated from the rest of the world , as the peninsula was separated from the main mass by the treacherous World Pillar Mountains .
description_long: Zakhara Zakhara , also known as the Land of Fate , was a giant peninsula of the same super - continent that hosted Faerûn and Kara - Tur on the planet Abeir - Toril . The land was located south and east of Faerûn , beyond the region of the Utter East , with the closest Faerûnian lands to Zakhara being Dambrath and Var the Golden ( by sea ) and Ulgarth or arguably Konigheim ( by land ) . Zakhara was mostly isolated from the rest of the world , as the peninsula was separated from the main mass by the treacherous World Pillar Mountains . The Land of Fate was home to a diversity of non - human inhabitants , but the majority was comprised of human Zakharans with brown skin , dark hair and relatively small height . They usually all spoke the common language of Midani and shared in the common culture of Enlightenment , racial values were much less prominent than elsewhere . Only few Zakharans ventured outside their homeland , usually as traders , and could then be found especially in the very south of Faerûn .

title: Zakharan ( ethnicity )
description: Zakharan ( ethnicity ) Zakharans were the human ethnicity that made up the vast majority of the population of Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Description . Zakharans tended to be shorter than those of other human groups on average .
description_long: Zakharan ( ethnicity ) Zakharans were the human ethnicity that made up the vast majority of the population of Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Description . Zakharans tended to be shorter than those of other human groups on average . Adult males ranged between 4 ' 11 " ( 150 cm ) and 7 ' 3 " ( 220 cm ) tall . Females were between 4 ' 6 " ( 140 cm ) and 6 ' 10 " ( 210 cm ) . Men weighed between 119 and 275 pounds ( 54 . 0 – 125 kg ) , while women weighed in the range of 84 to 240 pounds ( 38 – 110 kg ) . They had brown skin and dark hair . A variety of robelike garments ( " aba s " , " caftan s " , " dolman s " , or " jellaba s " ) were the usual clothing of Zakharans , while tunics ( " dishdashah " ) or the combination of shirt and trousers were worn by the lower classes . Most Zakharans wore some kind of headdress , a " keffiyeh " , a " fez " , or a turban for men and a shawl for women . In general , the richness of clothing reflected the status of the individual . More traditionally - minded Zakharans wore veils , though for men they were only common in the Cities of the Pantheon . There , women were often seen wearing a " chador " , a garment covering them from head to foot .

title: Zakharan Holidays
description: Zakharan Holidays The people of Zakhara celebrated a wide range of holidays , holy days , and festivals throughout the year . High Holy Days . The five High Holy Days — Ahad , Atnen , Salas , Arba , and Yasad — occurred between the months of Qawafil and Safa .
description_long: Zakharan Holidays The people of Zakhara celebrated a wide range of holidays , holy days , and festivals throughout the year . High Holy Days . The five High Holy Days — Ahad , Atnen , Salas , Arba , and Yasad — occurred between the months of Qawafil and Safa . Large festivals honored the Enlightened gods and pilgrims swelled Golden Huzuz to bursting during this time . The entire month of Safa was used to recover from the festivals of the High Holy Days . Though it was a High Holy Day , Yasad was also Ascension Day — the date when the first Grand Caliph took the throne . Historically , it was the date that every Grand Caliph since then also assumed power . The Grand Caliph would address his people at the Golden Mosque and worship publicly on this day .

title: Zakharan ogre
description: Zakharan ogre Zakharan ogre s were found throughout the Land of Fate . Personality . In Zakhara , these ogres interacted with the world in many of the same ways that human s , elves , or dwarves did , though they did not have superior crafting skills .
description_long: Zakharan ogre Zakharan ogre s were found throughout the Land of Fate . Personality . In Zakhara , these ogres interacted with the world in many of the same ways that human s , elves , or dwarves did , though they did not have superior crafting skills . Society . Zakharan ogres disliked magic and saw ogre mages as secretive and sneaky . In their society , only pure breed ogres were seen as civilized , those with purple - skin or mixed blood , like the ogrima , were shunned . Zakharan ogres tended to distance themselves from the sinister reputation of the ogrima .

title: Zakharan pantheon
description: Zakharan pantheon The Zakharan pantheon greatly influenced the culture on the continent of Zakhara , which was shaped by the Law of the Loregiver — a set of common values including honor , hospitality and the importance of one ' s family that date back to the teachings of a person called the Loregiver . Altogether this is called Enlightenment . Accordingly the commonly worshiped deities of Zakhara were seen as enlightened and differed from other deities worshiped on Al - Toril because they did not have a precise portfolio .
description_long: Zakharan pantheon The Zakharan pantheon greatly influenced the culture on the continent of Zakhara , which was shaped by the Law of the Loregiver — a set of common values including honor , hospitality and the importance of one ' s family that date back to the teachings of a person called the Loregiver . Altogether this is called Enlightenment . Accordingly the commonly worshiped deities of Zakhara were seen as enlightened and differed from other deities worshiped on Al - Toril because they did not have a precise portfolio . Instead , each exemplified a single characteristic or trait important to Enlightenment . They stood above the classifications of alignment , as these traits could be found in good and evil folk alike . Other gods were seen as either savage ( opposed to Enlightenment ) or " ajami " ( coming from outside ) , or perhaps both . The enlightened deities were grouped into major or Great Gods , worshiped throughout Zakhara , and local or common gods , worshiped only in a certain region , sometimes just a single town .

title: Zakharan roc
description: Zakharan roc Zakharan rocs were monstrous raptors found in the Land of Fate . They were even larger versions of their northern cousins . Three variations of Zakharan rocs existed : the common roc , great roc , and two - headed roc .
description_long: Zakharan roc Zakharan rocs were monstrous raptors found in the Land of Fate . They were even larger versions of their northern cousins . Three variations of Zakharan rocs existed : the common roc , great roc , and two - headed roc . The great roc and two - headed roc spoke Midani as well as their own language . Description . Zakharan rocs were beautiful creatures decorated with colorful plumage . Wings were usually a shade of green or gold . Females had a brilliantly white breast . Their massive beaks ranged in color from ivory to bronze . The color of a Zakharan roc ' s wing tip feathers was used to differentiate between the three roc species , aside from noting the obvious extra head that two - headed rocs possessed . Common rocs had crimson - colored wing tip feathers , azure feathers indicated a great roc , and two - headed rocs had jet black wing tip feathers . Furthermore , the color of the crest on males of all Zakharan roc species matched their wing tip feathers . Tales existed of adventurers having witnessed pure white , black , and red rocs . If these creatures existed then they were certainly rare .

title: Zakharan seas
description: Zakharan seas The continent of Zakhara was renowned for its burning deserts and lush jungles , but the seas surrounding its varied coastlines allowed much travel and trade hindered by its harsh interior . Surrounding seas . The Land of Fate was surrounded by three major seas : < br > Together , these interior bodies of water separated the west of Zakhara almost completely from its central and eastern portion , with only a relatively narrow strip of land between Qudra and Liham connecting the regions of the High Desert and the Haunted Lands .

title: Zaknafein Do ' Urden
description: Zaknafein Do ' Urden Zaknafein Do ' Urden was the famed weapons master of House Daermon N ' a ' shezbaernon more commonly known as House Do ' Urden . He was also Drizzt Do ' Urden ' s father , his mentor and his dearest friend . It was he who gave Drizzt the courage to leave Menzoberranzan and trained him to become an excellent warrior .
description_long: Zaknafein Do ' Urden Zaknafein Do ' Urden was the famed weapons master of House Daermon N ' a ' shezbaernon more commonly known as House Do ' Urden . He was also Drizzt Do ' Urden ' s father , his mentor and his dearest friend . It was he who gave Drizzt the courage to leave Menzoberranzan and trained him to become an excellent warrior . Zaknafein also played a great part in shaping his personality , protecting his son from the truth of Menzoberranzan for as long as he could . Description . The drow weapon master was strong with thick white hair . Personality . Zak delighted in killing the priests of Lolth . He hated the passionless evil they represented , and saw chances to kill them as a way of fighting against it . He had a strong and willful personality , in contrast to the status quo submissiveness that was seen in other drow males . Matron Malice took note of it , but often said nothing because it was that quality that made him even more desireable to her . He also believed in honor and hated the idea of killing children . He was proud when he found out that Drizzt didn ' t kill a moon elf child . Relationships .

title: Zal ' therra Baenre
description: Zal ' therra Baenre Zal ' therra Baenre was a cousin of Triel Baenre and commander of the rearguard of the Army of the Black Spider in 1372 DR . She was the most promising of Triel ' s cousins . Description .
description_long: Zal ' therra Baenre Zal ' therra Baenre was a cousin of Triel Baenre and commander of the rearguard of the Army of the Black Spider in 1372 DR . She was the most promising of Triel ' s cousins . Description . She was a foot taller than Triel and was a good 30 pounds heavier . History . Zal ' therra was one of the most promising attendants of Triel . During the Silence of Lolth , when enemy armies marched to Menzoberranzan , Zal ' therra was chosen as one of the commanders of the Army of the Black Spider , put in control of the rearguard . She was the highest - ranking House Baenre member of the army and Triel usually interacted with Zal ' therra instead of the titular commander Mez ' Barris Armgo . In the battle against the armies of Gracklstugh at the Pillars of Woe , the army was betrayed by the plans of Nimor Imphraezl and House Agrach Dyrr sided with the invaders , causing the defeat of the drow . Very disappointed with Zal ' therra for not acknowledging the enemy ' s plan , Triel ordered her to block the enemy ' s path with her troops , gaining time for the majority of the army to retreat .

title: Zalantar
description: Zalantar Zalantar , also called blackwood or darkwood , was a subtropical tree that was usually found in southern Faerûn . Description . Zalantars grew oddly in the sense that one plant was composed of several tree trunks that stemmed from a central root system .
description_long: Zalantar Zalantar , also called blackwood or darkwood , was a subtropical tree that was usually found in southern Faerûn . Description . Zalantars grew oddly in the sense that one plant was composed of several tree trunks that stemmed from a central root system . Their leaves were usually white or another light color . The pure black wood from a zalantar tree was called " darkwood " , or " blackwood " in the North . The wood was as hard as normal wood but half as heavy . Usage . Items made from zalantar weighed half as much as normal wooden items of the same type . Darkwood weapons and shields were thus very light and made to high quality but also more costly . Darkwood was extensively in the South in buildings , wagons , and wheels , and almost exclusively for rod s , staff s , and wand s .

title: Zalaren
description: Zalaren Zalaren was a priest of Waukeen and an agent of the Lords ' Alliance in 1489 DR . Personality . Zalaren was a dour individual .
description_long: Zalaren Zalaren was a priest of Waukeen and an agent of the Lords ' Alliance in 1489 DR . Personality . Zalaren was a dour individual . His main concern was economic stagnation . History . In 1489 DR , he was the Alliance delegate sent to help a hired adventuring party to defeat the great dragon Claugiyliamatar of Kryptgarden Forest . The Alliance ' s main objectives were to destroy siege weapons and to recover stolen cargo .

title: Zalarth Bloodbrow
description: Zalarth Bloodbrow Zalarth Bloodbrow was a Zhentarim wizard and a trusted agent of Manshoon . History . In 1358 DR , after Elminster Aumar had foiled a Zhentarim plot to conquer High Dale , Manshoon decided to send the young Avaerl to track and kill the Old Mage .
description_long: Zalarth Bloodbrow Zalarth Bloodbrow was a Zhentarim wizard and a trusted agent of Manshoon . History . In 1358 DR , after Elminster Aumar had foiled a Zhentarim plot to conquer High Dale , Manshoon decided to send the young Avaerl to track and kill the Old Mage . In truth , the High Lord of the Zhentarim was skeptical of Avaerl ' s chances and sent also Zalarth Bloodbrow to follow Avaerl and intervene if needed . Zalarth gathered a team of Zhent s and started the mission . Avaerl found Elminster and Sharantyr at Spellgard , always with Zalarth and his team following . He managed to survive a meeting with Lady Saharel and spied upon the duel between the Old Mage and Avaerl , waiting for the right occasion but at last was killed by the timely arrival of the Harpers Itharr and Belkram .

title: Zalathorm Kirkson
description: Zalathorm Kirkson Zalathorm Kirkson was the Netyarch ( wizard - king ) of the nation of Halruaa . Activities . As of 1367 DR , Zalathorm served as the leader of Halruaa and head of the Council of Elders .
description_long: Zalathorm Kirkson Zalathorm Kirkson was the Netyarch ( wizard - king ) of the nation of Halruaa . Activities . As of 1367 DR , Zalathorm served as the leader of Halruaa and head of the Council of Elders . Zalathorm ' s tower in Halarahh served as the seat of his rulership . When meeting with the Council , he would use a magical crystal orb that allowed him to contact all 400 Elders of the Council if needed . Possessions . Among Zalathorm ' s vast collection of magical items was a special carriage that radiated a " globe of invulnerability " upon command . This wondrous carriage was a true rarity in the arcane world since a globe of invulnerability was stationary when cast . Zalathorm never parted with the secret by which he was able to accomplish the magical feat of a mobile globe of invulnerability .

title: Zalaznar Crinios
description: Zalaznar Crinios Zalaznar Crinios was the ruler of Cedarsproke in the Gulthmere Forest in 1370 DR . Activities . Zalaznar was a totally independent leader , not affiliated with the Emerald Enclave .
description_long: Zalaznar Crinios Zalaznar Crinios was the ruler of Cedarsproke in the Gulthmere Forest in 1370 DR . Activities . Zalaznar was a totally independent leader , not affiliated with the Emerald Enclave . He sometimes disagreed with the Enclave ' s politics but remained neutral instead , showing dissent without weakening the religion . History . In 1391 DR Zalaznar transformed into a mighty treant for his service to nature , takes hold of the druid circle in Cedarspoke .

title: Zalazuu
description: Zalazuu Zalazuu ( also seen as Zalasuu ) was a city located in southeast Halruaa nestled in the Bay of Azuth . Description . Zalasuu was a small city with a population of 5 , 000 .
description_long: Zalazuu Zalazuu ( also seen as Zalasuu ) was a city located in southeast Halruaa nestled in the Bay of Azuth . Description . Zalasuu was a small city with a population of 5 , 000 . An additional 2 , 000 soldiers and sailors were stationed in a nearby fort . Inhabitants . Zalasuu was ruled by the cleric Lailuu . History . This city served as one of two naval bases for Halruaa ' s mighty navy .

title: Zaldar Floshin
description: Zaldar Floshin Zaldar Floshin was a sea - captain in Waterdeep sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . Activities . Zaldar was the captain of the " Kelpie ' s Kiss " .
description_long: Zaldar Floshin Zaldar Floshin was a sea - captain in Waterdeep sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . Activities . Zaldar was the captain of the " Kelpie ' s Kiss " . He had a sprite as first mate and a Harper agent as ship ' s bosun . History . In the late 1480s or early 1490s DR eventually Zaldar was hired by the Harpers to travel in search of the " Morkoth

title: Zallanora Argentresses
description: Zallanora Argentresses Zallanora Argentresses was a young elf and only 105 years old , when she met the demilich , known as Shoon VII . She appeared to be still a young , short elf woman with bobbed silver and curly hair . Her coppery skin and hazel eyes showed her sylvan - elf heritage .
description_long: Zallanora Argentresses Zallanora Argentresses was a young elf and only 105 years old , when she met the demilich , known as Shoon VII . She appeared to be still a young , short elf woman with bobbed silver and curly hair . Her coppery skin and hazel eyes showed her sylvan - elf heritage . When she got angry , her eyes darkened to mahogany . Description . Zallanora appeared as a female elf wizard . But in truth she was a neutral - evil male human necromancer . He could tap the full magical potential that he built up over time , despite the limitations that normally bound elven wizards , and he still gained all the innate physical abilities of elves . Shoon ’ s Zallanora facade was that of a a light - hearted elf with a dry sense of humor , a fabulous knowledge of ancient history , and a talent for magic . But behind this mask was the most ruthless , evil dictator - mage who ever stalked the Realms . If he revealed more knowledge or power than his facade as a 3rd - level wizard should have , Shoon would slay all observers and eradicate evidence that might implicate him . History .

title: Zallara
description: Zallara Zallara was a drow priestess of Eilistraee . Description . Zallara had black skin and very long , flowing white hair .
description_long: Zallara Zallara was a drow priestess of Eilistraee . Description . Zallara had black skin and very long , flowing white hair . Personality . Like other followers of Eilistraee , Zallara was good - natured and wanted to aid her race in peacefully returning to the surface of Toril . Possessions . Zallara owned a blessed magical scimitar . Activities . She participated in moonlit rituals such as High Hunt and Circle of Song .

title: Zaltec
description: Zaltec Zaltec was the chaotic evil god of war in Maztica . He was also known as Bringer of War and the Eater of Hearts . The latter title says what he demanded of his followers .
description_long: Zaltec Zaltec was the chaotic evil god of war in Maztica . He was also known as Bringer of War and the Eater of Hearts . The latter title says what he demanded of his followers . Worship . The cult of Zaltec was brought to extremes by the Nexal an people . He was their patron deity and they thanked him consequently for their victorious conquests of Maztica . His priests had to give him human sacrifices in high quantities . The highest sacrifice was a fresh heart presented on an altar of a holy pyramid . But he also loved those sacrifices who were given to him during a battle . His worshipers believed that he favored them if they made war in his name . Ironically the Nexalan used the so called " feathered wars " ( named after the peaceful brother of Zaltec , the god Qotal ) and waged them in Zaltec ' s name to procure sufficient sacrifices during times of peace . The priests of Zaltec were clothed in black , soiled robes and used the blood of their victims as coloration for their hair . They also arranged the hair into spikes sprouting out into all directions . The priests had minor access to the spheres of hishna , sun , combat and charm but major access to influence .

title: Zaltember
description: Zaltember Zaltember was a fire giant and the sadistic son of Duke Zalto in Ironslag sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . History . In the late 1480s or early 1490s DR , Zaltember was overseeing four ogre s in the upper level of Ironslag ' s foundry .
description_long: Zaltember Zaltember was a fire giant and the sadistic son of Duke Zalto in Ironslag sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . History . In the late 1480s or early 1490s DR , Zaltember was overseeing four ogre s in the upper level of Ironslag ' s foundry . He entertained himself torturing a shield dwarf slave . Personality . Zaltember was at heart a bully and a coward . If injured , he quickly escaped to his mother . He also tried to impress enemies by declaring himself to be the son of Zalto .

title: Zalto
description: Zalto Duke Zalto was the ruler of the fire giant s sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . History . Zalto was one of the giant lords at time of the shattering of the ordning .
description_long: Zalto Duke Zalto was the ruler of the fire giant s sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . History . Zalto was one of the giant lords at time of the shattering of the ordning . In the late 1480s or early 1490s DR after the disappearance of storm giant king Hekaton all giant lords started their path to reshape the ordning . Zalto first led his minions to reclaim Ironslag in the North Faerûn , the greatest forge of ancient Ostoria , with the plan to reconstruct the ancient colossus construct Vonindon , a relic of the Thousand Year War , and unlashed it upon the hated dragon s . However Zalto understood to need a more powerful flame than Ironslag ' s ones so forged an alliance with the drow of House Xorlarrin in order to gain the primordial Maegera . He managed to also forge a non aggression pact with the nearby yak folk Usually Zalto was in the assembly hall playing with his two hell hound s Narthor and Zerebor . Personality . Zalto was always a warmonger , dreaming to led giants in war for the glory of Surtr and Annam . He would sacrifice his family with regret if need for achieve his goal

title: Zaltys Serrat
description: Zaltys Serrat Zaltys Serrat was a yuan - ti pureblood ranger and the adopted daughter of Alaia Serrat , one of the three leaders of the merchant clan House Serrat . Until she was seventeen , she believed she was human . Zaltys spent much of her time with the Travelers of House Serrat who harvested terazul in the jungles south of Delzimmer .
description_long: Zaltys Serrat Zaltys Serrat was a yuan - ti pureblood ranger and the adopted daughter of Alaia Serrat , one of the three leaders of the merchant clan House Serrat . Until she was seventeen , she believed she was human . Zaltys spent much of her time with the Travelers of House Serrat who harvested terazul in the jungles south of Delzimmer . She was a capable ranger and was promoted to lead the Serrat scouts . Description . Although she was yuan - ti , because she was a pureblood she appeared human in nearly all respects . The only hint of her yuan - ti blood was a patch of scales that grew on her lower back . She had large green eyes and was considered attractive . Possessions . Zaltys had many magical arrows which had been given to her by her mother . At her coming of age party in 1479 DR she was given a magical compound short bow by Krailash which was made from a tree in a place touched by the Shadowfell . The bow could shoot through or around obstacles . At the same party Glory gave her a psychic ring that allowed her to periodically send a short mental message to another person and Quelamia gave her magical leather armor made from a shadow snake skin . Relationships .

title: Zaluski
description: Zaluski Zaluski was a fishmonger in Daggerford around 1370 DR . History . Zaluski was a fishmonger west of Mirabar but was forced to abandon the area because of the growing pressure from Luskan .
description_long: Zaluski Zaluski was a fishmonger in Daggerford around 1370 DR . History . Zaluski was a fishmonger west of Mirabar but was forced to abandon the area because of the growing pressure from Luskan . She resettled in Daggerford where she married and later gave birth to three children .

title: Zamanyeh bint Salman al - Kahn
description: Zamanyeh bint Salman al - Kahn Zamanyeh bint Salman al - Kahn was a mamluk who lived in Liham in 1367 DR . Activities . Captain Zamanyeh was in charge of guarding from Liham .
description_long: Zamanyeh bint Salman al - Kahn Zamanyeh bint Salman al - Kahn was a mamluk who lived in Liham in 1367 DR . Activities . Captain Zamanyeh was in charge of guarding from Liham . Those guards under her command were all female mamluks . Possessions . Zamanyeh owned a khopesh . short sword , and short bow . She wore lamellar armor .

title: Zammzt Everharn
description: Zammzt Everharn Zammzt Everharn was a drow - dragon ( " draa ' zekylyn " ) and one of the eight patron fathers of the Jaezred Chaulssin . Specifically , he was the Patron Father of Ched Nasad . Description .
description_long: Zammzt Everharn Zammzt Everharn was a drow - dragon ( " draa ' zekylyn " ) and one of the eight patron fathers of the Jaezred Chaulssin . Specifically , he was the Patron Father of Ched Nasad . Description . Zammzt ' s humanoid form was notably plain , with most characters comparing his features to those of a common artisan or slave . It was often noted that if not for his compelling charisma and shrewd negotiating skills he would likely be very limited in Underdark society due to his nondescript face .
