On a side note he had excellent hearing , a likely side effect of his Shadow Dragon heritage . History . Zammzt was involved in the slave uprising in Menzoberranzan during the Silence of Lolth . Shortly after , Zammzt was a key ( but secret ) figure in the destruction of Ched Nasad in 1372 DR . He instructed the duergar Clan Xornbane , who had been hired by Matron Mother Ssipriina Zauvirr , to act prematurely in attacking House Melarn , thus drawing House Zauvirr ' s wrath , and action to brought about the downfall of the city .

title: Zamogedi
description: Zamogedi The Zamogedi were a tribe of nomadic human s living in the Hordelands . Territory . The Zamogedi lived in the eastern Hordelands near Shou Lung , near the Tuigan tribe .
description_long: Zamogedi The Zamogedi were a tribe of nomadic human s living in the Hordelands . Territory . The Zamogedi lived in the eastern Hordelands near Shou Lung , near the Tuigan tribe . Their lands also bordered those of the Gur s , the Fankiang , and the Quirish . Society . They spoke their own language . They were a highly warlike tribe and were known to disrespect the elves of the Pleasant Valley Gateway Oasis and often raided them . Despite this , they got along quite well with the Naican and Quirish tribes of the region . History . The Zamogedi shared a common ancestor with the Quirish peoples . Before the rise of the Tuigan to dominance , the Zamogedi held much territory in the northern steppes . During this time , there were many marriages between the the Zamogedi and the Naican , solidifying the friendship between these two people groups .

title: Zamogedi language
description: Zamogedi language Zamogedi was a tribal tongue of the Hordelands bordering Shou Lung . Description . Zamogedi was an nasal language , with long I and E vowels drawn out .
description_long: Zamogedi language Zamogedi was a tribal tongue of the Hordelands bordering Shou Lung . Description . Zamogedi was an nasal language , with long I and E vowels drawn out . Speakers . Zamogedi was spoken primarily by the nomadic Zamogedi tribe . Script . Zamogedi did not have a written script . History . Scholars classified Zamogedi as an Eastern Imaskari language . It was strongly influenced by the Shou Chiang languages of Shou Lung .

title: Zan - akar Zeraez
description: Zan - akar Zeraez Zan - akar Zeraez was a stormsoul genasi who served as the ambassador of Akanûl . Description . Zan - akar had long and slender silver spikes projecting from his scalp , and his skin color was like the duskiest grapes .
description_long: Zan - akar Zeraez Zan - akar Zeraez was a stormsoul genasi who served as the ambassador of Akanûl . Description . Zan - akar had long and slender silver spikes projecting from his scalp , and his skin color was like the duskiest grapes . The pattern of argent lines etched into his face was so intricate that it looked like if was a mask . History . In 1479 DR , Zan - akar was the Akanûlan ambassador in Chessenta . He urged Shala Karanok to expel the tymanther ans from Chessenta , as Akanûl was and old enemy of the dragonborn nation . Although his efforts were almost fruitless when Shala Karanok discovered Akanûl had started diplomatic talks with High Imaskar , when a group of abishai disguised as dragonborn began to kill chessentan citizens and allied themselves with enemies of Chessenta , Zan - akar was able to convince Shala Karanok to banish the tymantheran ambassador from the country .

title: Zanda Tholing
description: Zanda Tholing Zanda Tholing , also called the Place of Kings or the Resting Place of Kings , was an important ritual site for the royalty of Khazari . Description . Located far outside the borders of Khazari , Zanda Tholing was an important pilgrimage site for the royal family , and was treated as a site of supreme holiness , dedicated to the Enlightened One .
description_long: Zanda Tholing Zanda Tholing , also called the Place of Kings or the Resting Place of Kings , was an important ritual site for the royalty of Khazari . Description . Located far outside the borders of Khazari , Zanda Tholing was an important pilgrimage site for the royal family , and was treated as a site of supreme holiness , dedicated to the Enlightened One . At the center of the site was the exposure ground , where the body was left to decay . When a king or prince died , their body was brought here to be exposed to the elements until the flesh was gone . The bones were then returned to Khazari for burial , a tradition that had gone on for centuries . No one except priests of the Zanda were allowed in this area . The site was littered with markers commemorating deceased rulers . Centuries of the tradition caused the area to become a " forest of steel " , due to the number of markers jutting out from the landscape . It was said that the greatest of leaders had their bodies consumed in a flash of blue fire , leaving only their untouched bones behind . This was treated as a sign of that person ' s greatness . Inhabitants .

title: Zandess Danthiir
description: Zandess Danthiir Zandess Danthiir ( pronounced " ZAHN - dess DAN - theer " ) , titled the " Strong Arm of Tyr " , was a human paladin from Tethyr in the 14th century DR and a senior member of the Moonstars . Personality . As a paladin , Zandess was supremely zealous in her faith and highly principled .
description_long: Zandess Danthiir Zandess Danthiir ( pronounced " ZAHN - dess DAN - theer " ) , titled the " Strong Arm of Tyr " , was a human paladin from Tethyr in the 14th century DR and a senior member of the Moonstars . Personality . As a paladin , Zandess was supremely zealous in her faith and highly principled . She preferred to travel alone , but was quite willing to temporarily ally with others of similar views , for deeds well within the law . Instead of a personal crest , she used the holy symbol of Tyr , a warhammer and scales , as her own . Description . Zandess was described as beautiful and dusky skinned . History . Zandess Darthiir was born a noble of Tethyr , but ran away from her decadent and feuding parents while still a child . She fled to Amn and was taken in by the priests and paladins of Tyr . They raised young Zandess in the Amnian mountains and trained her to be an " arm of justice " , as a paladin of the Just God . Upon completion of her training , Zandess was sent to the Inner Sea lands to do the church ' s work and aid Tyrran priests there . By 1367 DR , she was operating in the Western Heartlands and along the Dragon Coast .

title: Zandever Eyredanus
description: Zandever Eyredanus Zandever " Nighteyes " Eyredanus is a guide in the town of Triboar . He earned his reputation for guiding parties through the woods during the night , in order to strike against the orc s . He often deals with wealthy Waterdhavians .
description_long: Zandever Eyredanus Zandever " Nighteyes " Eyredanus is a guide in the town of Triboar . He earned his reputation for guiding parties through the woods during the night , in order to strike against the orc s . He often deals with wealthy Waterdhavians . He advises people that if they cannot acquire a ring of warmth , they should instead use a ring of fire resistance and lie in a fire to keep warm .

title: Zandilar the Dancer
description: Zandilar the Dancer Zandilar the Dancer was a female deity in the Yuir elven pantheon . Her avatar appeared as a blue - skinned elf . Her portfolio was similar to that of Hanali Celanil and Sune , but it was focused on intense passionate love that burned quickly and died out .
description_long: Zandilar the Dancer Zandilar the Dancer was a female deity in the Yuir elven pantheon . Her avatar appeared as a blue - skinned elf . Her portfolio was similar to that of Hanali Celanil and Sune , but it was focused on intense passionate love that burned quickly and died out . She simultaneously managed the portfolios of joy and tragedy . She is said to have used her feminine side to garner information from other deities and to discourage attacks on the Yuir elves . She is assumed to have ceased to exist with the downfall of the Yuir elves . In truth , Zandilar was absorbed by the hedonistic goddess Bast , better known as Sharess . During the time that the Yuir elves were faring poorly against a drow force , Zandilar attempted to seduce the drow deity Vhaeraun either to gain information or to gain his assistance against Lolth . Vhaeraun saw through her machinations though , and trapped her avatar , intending to absorb her divine essence for himself . Bast managed to distract Vhaeraun long enough for Zandilar to escape however , and the weakened Zandilar agreed to merge her essence with that of Bast .

title: Zanhoriloch
description: Zanhoriloch Zanhoriloch was a dwarven city located on an island in Lake Thoroot . An aboleth colony in the lake was also known by this name . The dwarves often called their city Mhorilot , meaning " dark surface .
description_long: Zanhoriloch Zanhoriloch was a dwarven city located on an island in Lake Thoroot . An aboleth colony in the lake was also known by this name . The dwarves often called their city Mhorilot , meaning " dark surface . " Geography . The settlement and Lake Thoroot were located somewhere beneath Cormanthor and were connected to Battledale via a tunnel . Description . The dwarves reworked the original drow architecture on the island to fit their own tastes . The aboleth colony was located underwater . Inhabitants . The dwarves fished and farmed kelp for food , and also had mining expeditions on the shore of the lake to obtain silver , gold , and iron . After several centuries avoiding surfacers , they began trading weapons and precious metals with the inhabitants of Battledale for grain , beef , and wood . The aboleth colony was ruled ca . 1373 DR by the matriarch Oothoon . The aboleths used their slime to mutate drow into underwater creatures ( no ears , webbed hands and feet , fluked tail , no hair ) , possibly for use as slaves or food . The level of interaction between the dwarves and the aboleth was unknown . History .

title: Zann
description: Zann Zann was the scholarly deity of learning and intelligence of Zakhara . He was one of the eight Great Gods of the Land of Fate and preached the value of studying and understanding , of seeking new and preserving old knowledge . Zann ' s symbol was a fountain ' s jet .
description_long: Zann Zann was the scholarly deity of learning and intelligence of Zakhara . He was one of the eight Great Gods of the Land of Fate and preached the value of studying and understanding , of seeking new and preserving old knowledge . Zann ' s symbol was a fountain ' s jet . Zann was portrayed as a man in city dress with all the paraphernalia of a scribe . Like other Zakharan gods he was above such concerns as alignment , as knowledge and intelligence could be used to build a peaceful society or to subvert it . < br > Zann ' s priests kept the greatest universities and libraries of Zakhara . Further Reading . Related information can be found here :

title: Zaor Moonflower
description: Zaor Moonflower Zaor Moonflower was the husband of Queen Amlaruil Moonflower and king of Evermeet . Description . Zaor had blue hair .
description_long: Zaor Moonflower Zaor Moonflower was the husband of Queen Amlaruil Moonflower and king of Evermeet . Description . Zaor had blue hair . History . Zaor was born in Semberholme in 572 DR . For a time he served in Myth Drannor , before eventually taking on the mantle of leadership in Myth Drannor . He was known as the bearer of one the most powerful elven moonblade s , known as the King ' s Blade . In 652 DR , Zaor Moonflower becomes one of the youngest officers of the Akh ' Velahr in Cormanthyr . Zaor became king of Evermeet in 888 DR . King Zaor was murdered at the end of his 432nd year of reign on Ches 2 , 1321 DR , in the gardens of the Moonstone Palace by Fenian Ni ’ Tessine , an assassin sent by Kymil Nimesin . Fenian was originally seeking Princess Amnestria , so he considered the assassination of Zaor a fortunate accident . After the king ' s death , Queen Amlaruil became sole ruler of Evermeet . Relationships . Zaor and Amlaruil were the parents of Princess Amnestria and therefore the grandparents of the half - elf Arilyn Moonblade .

title: Zar ' ithra
description: Zar ' ithra A zar ' ithra ( plural " zar ' ithra ' rin " ) or shadow draconic drow was a member of an offshoot of the drow race primarily found in the city of Chaulssin . They were the non - first - generation drow offspring of the shadow dragon s of Clan Jaezred and thus were not half - dragon s . Abilities .
description_long: Zar ' ithra A zar ' ithra ( plural " zar ' ithra ' rin " ) or shadow draconic drow was a member of an offshoot of the drow race primarily found in the city of Chaulssin . They were the non - first - generation drow offspring of the shadow dragon s of Clan Jaezred and thus were not half - dragon s . Abilities . A " zar ' ithra " exhibited some draconic characteristics and possessed stronger ties to the Plane of Shadow than their " zekyl " compatriots . These stronger ties manifested in them being able to derive additional abilities from the Plane of Shadow and unlike a " zekyl " , a " zar ' ithra " ' s planar home was the Plane of Shadow instead of the Prime Material Plane . Collectively , they had a predisposition towards sorcerous magic . A genetic quirk of theirs was that any offspring between them and a drow - dragon was almost always a male " zekyl " . History . As mentioned above , " zar ' ithra " was the name of the non - first - generation offspring of Clan Jaezred ' s shadow dragons and the drow of Chaulssin , who were enslaved by the dragons .

title: Zar - Dandan
description: Zar - Dandan Zar - Dandan , who was also called the Wanderer or Gold - Teeth , was a half - elven traveler in the Hordelands in 1367 DR . Description . Zar - Dandan earned his nickname of Gold - Teeth for the many gold - capped teeth lining his mouth .
description_long: Zar - Dandan Zar - Dandan , who was also called the Wanderer or Gold - Teeth , was a half - elven traveler in the Hordelands in 1367 DR . Description . Zar - Dandan earned his nickname of Gold - Teeth for the many gold - capped teeth lining his mouth . Personality . Though roguish , Zar - Dandan was charming and likable . He enjoyed sharing entertaining stories with fellow travelers , so long as they had nothing to do with his past , of which he was quite secretive . Possessions . Zar - Dandan owned a " ring of jumping " , a " potion of fire resistance " , and a magical sword and shield . History . Zar - Dandan ' s father was killed by a man named Rukn , whom he searched relentlessly for across the breadth of the Hordelands with the hopes of slitting his throat in his sleep .

title: Zara Dalkor
description: Zara Dalkor Zara Dalkor was a knight of Helm in Helm ' s Hold sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . History . Zara was a member of the Order of the Gilded Eye .
description_long: Zara Dalkor Zara Dalkor was a knight of Helm in Helm ' s Hold sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . History . Zara was a member of the Order of the Gilded Eye . In the late 1480s or early 1490s DR Zara and her squire Thora Tamlarrin went to South in order to defeat a group of frost giant s that attacked caravans .

title: Zarad Duskmarrow
description: Zarad Duskmarrow Zarad Duskmarrow was a wizard who dwelled in a great clock tower hidden in the depths of the Cloak Wood . According to rumor , he studied necromancy and other strange arts . Ysuran Auondril served him as an apprentice , and wrote his black tome under his tutelage .
description_long: Zarad Duskmarrow Zarad Duskmarrow was a wizard who dwelled in a great clock tower hidden in the depths of the Cloak Wood . According to rumor , he studied necromancy and other strange arts . Ysuran Auondril served him as an apprentice , and wrote his black tome under his tutelage .

title: Zaralda
description: Zaralda Zaralda was a necromancer and Red Wizard of Thay in Kryptgarden Forest in 1489 DR . History . In 1489 DR , she went to Kryptgarden where , in order to broker an alliance with the old or new factions of the Cult of the Dragon , she helped Claugiyliamatar to corrupt the forest .
description_long: Zaralda Zaralda was a necromancer and Red Wizard of Thay in Kryptgarden Forest in 1489 DR . History . In 1489 DR , she went to Kryptgarden where , in order to broker an alliance with the old or new factions of the Cult of the Dragon , she helped Claugiyliamatar to corrupt the forest . In the end , however , an adventuring party hired to defeat Old Gnawbones , aided by the archfey Whitchthorn , assaulted and defeated her and her wight minions .

title: Zaranda Rhindaun II
description: Zaranda Rhindaun II Zaranda Rhindaun II was the third queen of the Rhindaun Dynasty and the second queen of Tethyr by that name . Relationships . Zaranda was the granddaughter of Zaranda Star , the famous adventuress and first queen of the Rhindaun Dynasty , through her mother Queen Sybille .
description_long: Zaranda Rhindaun II Zaranda Rhindaun II was the third queen of the Rhindaun Dynasty and the second queen of Tethyr by that name . Relationships . Zaranda was the granddaughter of Zaranda Star , the famous adventuress and first queen of the Rhindaun Dynasty , through her mother Queen Sybille . Her younger brother was Prince Nishan . History . Zaranda II took the throne in 1422 DR and was succeeded by her niece , Prince Nishan ' s daughter , Cyriana III in 1445 DR .

title: Zaranda Star
description: Zaranda Star Zaranda Star Rhindaun was a former human adventuress , countess , and then Queen of Tethyr . Description . Zaranda was very tall , standing at six feet , one inch , and had an athletic build .
description_long: Zaranda Star Zaranda Star Rhindaun was a former human adventuress , countess , and then Queen of Tethyr . Description . Zaranda was very tall , standing at six feet , one inch , and had an athletic build . Her hair was dark brown with a white forelock . Her eyes were gray , and she had a thin nose and lips . By the late 1360s DR , she had a skewed nose ( from having had it broken ) and several scars and burns on her face . After her coronation , when she was blessed by the goddess Siamorphe , her facial scars vanished and she began appearing some fifteen years younger physically . In battle , Zaranda wore a steel breastplate and backplate and a small helmet . In court , she favored soft , dark colors and velvet gowns . Personality . Zaranda was the epitome of free - spiritedness ; she decided her own destiny . This trait is probably why she gave up her training as a mage at an early age ; she preferred the savage excitement of a fighter ' s life over that of a studious pupil . She could be calm , however , when the situation called for it , such as during matters of court or negotiations .

title: Zaratan
description: Zaratan The zaratan ( " pl " zaratani ) was a huge that lived in the seas surrounding Zakhara . A zaratan ' s shell could easily measure hundreds of feet in diameter . Combat .
description_long: Zaratan The zaratan ( " pl " zaratani ) was a huge that lived in the seas surrounding Zakhara . A zaratan ' s shell could easily measure hundreds of feet in diameter . Combat . Under most circumstances a zaratan woken from its slumber would immediately withdraw into its giant shell just like a regular turtle . They would remain withdrawn for up to a decade . If wounded or pestered enough , a zaratan would attack with all of its awesome fury . Habitat / Society . Due to their slow metabolism , these creatures had incredibly long lives , often measured by millenia . It was said that the zaratani floated in the seas before the genies first came to Zakhara . A zaratan spent nearly all of its time sleeping . They slept with their mouths open and reflexively swallowed any man - sized creatures ( or smaller ) that ventured too close . Zaratani that happened to bump into each other while floating around in slumber would mate if they were of the opposite sex . A single mating session could last up to one year . Zaratani communicated by a method similar to that used by whales . A single conversation between two zaratan could last decades . Telepathy was used on rare occasions . Ecology .

title: Zarbrina
description: Zarbrina Zarbrina was the name given in the " Realms " to , an extremely soft lead - like mineral , colorless and easily cut into brilliant gems . Description . Due to its softness , this ornamental stone was often used in ceremonial or little - used jewelry , or set in small protective metal claw mounts on sleeves or collar - hems of gowns .
description_long: Zarbrina Zarbrina was the name given in the " Realms " to , an extremely soft lead - like mineral , colorless and easily cut into brilliant gems . Description . Due to its softness , this ornamental stone was often used in ceremonial or little - used jewelry , or set in small protective metal claw mounts on sleeves or collar - hems of gowns . Because it felt soapy to the touch , small zarbrina stones could be used on fancy intimate apparel or sewn into bed linens without causing discomfort . A typical stone had a base value of 10 gp . Powers . Powdered zarbrina could be used as an ingredient for magical ink when dealing with illusion magic .

title: Zardazik
description: Zardazik Zardazik was a soft metal used to create alloyed weapons that were undetectable and could be easily hidden inside a person . Appearance . In its raw state , zardazik was an amber to red color , similar to raw iron in some respects .
description_long: Zardazik Zardazik was a soft metal used to create alloyed weapons that were undetectable and could be easily hidden inside a person . Appearance . In its raw state , zardazik was an amber to red color , similar to raw iron in some respects . It was also rather soft for a metal . Locations . This metal was scarce and in the mid – 14th century DR , it was found only in mountains and mines around the Lake of Steam and in sandy fissures in the heart of the Raurin desert . Uses . Any item partially or wholly composed of zardazik became intangible to the first being whose blood it spilled , similar to the " ironguard " spell . When done deliberately , it allowed a person to carry it without detection , usually on a non - metal necklace . Ardrethra Laurindar , a professional slayer , as well as at least three Waterdhavian noble ladies were said to have used it in this manner .

title: Zarell Tahaladar
description: Zarell Tahaladar Zarell Tahaladar was a drow scroll merchant in Mantol - Derith . Personality . Zarell was an elegant drow with a passion for books .
description_long: Zarell Tahaladar Zarell Tahaladar was a drow scroll merchant in Mantol - Derith . Personality . Zarell was an elegant drow with a passion for books . She read and kept more volumes than she sold . History . Around 1479 DR , Zarell sold scrolls and books in Mantol - Derith . She wrote the scrolls herself using paper from Tawar Kroul . Zarell also had a vast network of contacts to buy and sell rare books .

title: Zargon
description: Zargon Zargon the Returner was an elder evil abomination who hungered to drown the world in its slime . Legends indicate that Zargon may have been the first master of the Nine Hells . Other stories say he was a Demon Prince that was thrown out of the Abyss .
description_long: Zargon Zargon the Returner was an elder evil abomination who hungered to drown the world in its slime . Legends indicate that Zargon may have been the first master of the Nine Hells . Other stories say he was a Demon Prince that was thrown out of the Abyss . He was known to take on selected warlock s as their patron .

title: Zariel
description: Zariel Zariel is an archdevil of the Nine Hells , Lord of Avernus . Background . Once favored by Asmodeus , Zariel sided against him in the Reckoning of Hell .
description_long: Zariel Zariel is an archdevil of the Nine Hells , Lord of Avernus . Background . Once favored by Asmodeus , Zariel sided against him in the Reckoning of Hell . She was overthrown when Bel , the leader of her military forces , turned against her and sided with Asmodeus . Bel was installed as Lord of the First in her stead . Zariel reclaimed her title as Lord of Avernus following Bel ' s demotion by Asmodeus . Bel fell out of favor with the Archduke , and was forced to serve as Zariel ' s advisor .

title: Zarif
description: Zarif Zarif was a small town located on Dihl al - Taif in Zakhara in 1367 DR . Description . Zarif was surrounded in every direction by hundreds of miles of scorching desert .
description_long: Zarif Zarif was a small town located on Dihl al - Taif in Zakhara in 1367 DR . Description . Zarif was surrounded in every direction by hundreds of miles of scorching desert . History . Since it was the only place within reasonable distance along Dihl al - Taif to rest and procure water and supplies , Zarif gouged the prices of their wares . This served to bring animated displays of bargaining between caravan masters and local merchants among the caravanserais surrounding the town .

title: Zarifar
description: Zarifar Zarifar was a drow wizard from Sshamath . Personality . Zarifar was a very talented geometer wizard , with his mind always full of geometric designs .
description_long: Zarifar Zarifar was a drow wizard from Sshamath . Personality . Zarifar was a very talented geometer wizard , with his mind always full of geometric designs . However , in normal life he was totally naive . History . In 1377 DR , Q ' arlynd Melarn invited him to his new College of Ancient Arcana and he accepted . In 1379 DR Zarifar , like all his fellows , was one of the masters of the new school , despite the worries of Q ' arlynd about his skills as teacher . Later together with his fellow and the Masters Urlryn Khalazza , Seldszar Elpragh and Masoj Dhuunyl he helped Q ' Arlynd when he engineered ( with the aid of Eilistraee ) the ritual that transformed all drow not tainted by Wendonai ' s blood into brown - skinned dark elves . After they all relocated to Rhymanthiin .

title: Zarifrax
description: Zarifrax Zarifrax was a lich in the Neverdeath Graveyard of Neverwinter . History . Zarifrax was a very powerful lich but at one time his mortal body was destroyed and only his phylactery remained .
description_long: Zarifrax Zarifrax was a lich in the Neverdeath Graveyard of Neverwinter . History . Zarifrax was a very powerful lich but at one time his mortal body was destroyed and only his phylactery remained . Trapped in this state for a long time he became bored and tired of the eternal fighting between good and evil . He desired only to find a place to remain in peace for some centuries . In 1480 DR , he was disturbed by the Doomguide s ' activities in the Neverdeath Graveyard . Zarifrax possessed an undead creature in order to find his perfect resting place but an adventurer destroyed the undead being . Zarifrax manifested himself but instead of fighting he asked the adventurer to help him . The adventurer ultimately agreed but all places in the cemetery were in danger from the Doomguides , adventurers , or Thay an necromancers . Finally , Zarifrax sorrowfully agreed to be consigned to the Doomguides for destruction . However , Doomguide Volahk said Zarifrax was too powerful an undead creature to destroy , but they had constructed an impenetrable vault in a secure location that could safely hold such evils for centuries . Zarifrax laughed to hear his fate . Personality .

title: Zarod
description: Zarod Zarod was a fallen angel in the Labyrinth during the Rage of Demons . History . The gods condemned Zarod and seven other fallen angels to remain as stone statues in the depths of the Labyrinth for unknown crimes .
description_long: Zarod Zarod was a fallen angel in the Labyrinth during the Rage of Demons . History . The gods condemned Zarod and seven other fallen angels to remain as stone statues in the depths of the Labyrinth for unknown crimes . Powers . Zarod could use divination powers within seven days for people in the vicinity who talked with it .

title: Zarr
description: Zarr Zarr was a mad half - elf mercenary in Undermountain in 1479 DR . History . In 1479 DR he during a work in Dalelands saw a strange glyph .
description_long: Zarr Zarr was a mad half - elf mercenary in Undermountain in 1479 DR . History . In 1479 DR he during a work in Dalelands saw a strange glyph . Later Zarr went in Waterdeep where was hired by the young Rutherford Urmbrusk for the rescue mission of Quarren Urmbrusk inside Undermountain . however during the travel in the dungeon Zarr saw a glyph very similar to the one in Dalelands that afflicted his mind . Quickly Zarr turned his blade on a companion and meantime Rutherford disappeared . After killing the companion the now mad Zarr went in search of an army to lead . Soon he met a kobold ' s tribe and killing their chieftain gained the command of them . The kobold were at war with a nearby goblin tribe but Zarr defeated and absorbed the goblins in his growing army . After he gained control of a small section of the dungeon and started to train his troops . He decided to attack all the adventurers arriving from the Yawning Portal and thank to a bride to Sanfin Lotte he gained the informations he need to ambush them . Zarr was with his advisors studying maps for his campaign when an adventuring party hired to find Rutherford found and defeated him . Personality .

title: Zarracee Ambroanye
description: Zarracee Ambroanye Zarracee Ambroanye was a spectral harpist that haunted the Whistling Wizard inn and specifically the Wizard Well located in the basement of that establishment . People throughout the Moonsea region thought of her and the water - filled cistern as a single entity , usually referred to as " the Well " . Activities .
description_long: Zarracee Ambroanye Zarracee Ambroanye was a spectral harpist that haunted the Whistling Wizard inn and specifically the Wizard Well located in the basement of that establishment . People throughout the Moonsea region thought of her and the water - filled cistern as a single entity , usually referred to as " the Well " . Activities . Zarracee maintained a presence in or near the Wizard Well and accepted visitors one at a time . Visitors had to come into the room alone and bar the door behind them , then gaze quietly into the still waters of the Well . Within a minute or two , if she was satisfied that the individual came in peace , she would cause the water to glow faintly and then she would whisper , " Yes ? " . Zarracee would listen to whatever the person had to say , whether it was news about the grandchildren , court intrigue in Cormyr , confessions of secret desires , rumors of treasure hoards , or a recipe for crumbcake . Any attempts to bind , banish , control , or investigate the Well caused her to flee the room until the threat was over . For the Harpers , Zarracee was a way for agents to pass messages and receive instructions whenever they traveled through Voonlar .

title: Zarrick
description: Zarrick Zarrick the Sorcerer was an evil magic - user member of the Assassins Guild of the Galenas in 1357 DR . History . Zarrick originally served in Vaasa ' s army .
description_long: Zarrick Zarrick the Sorcerer was an evil magic - user member of the Assassins Guild of the Galenas in 1357 DR . History . Zarrick originally served in Vaasa ' s army . After the war ' s end , he started wandering until he was recruited by the Grandfather of Assassins . In 1357 DR , he was a key member of the punitive army that went to attack Bloodstone Village . Personality . Zarrick was specialized in battle - magic . He was a boisterous and outgoing individual . He was fast in making friends but also in losing them . Zarrick was greedy and selfish despite his manners and most people quickly abandoned him .

title: Zarwu Koi
description: Zarwu Koi Zarwu Koi was a stocky bushi in Shou Lung . History . Zarwu was an experienced soldier acting as a guard for caravans along the Ningtang Road in order to eliminate the growing menace of bandits in the hills of Ching Ring in 1358 DR .
description_long: Zarwu Koi Zarwu Koi was a stocky bushi in Shou Lung . History . Zarwu was an experienced soldier acting as a guard for caravans along the Ningtang Road in order to eliminate the growing menace of bandits in the hills of Ching Ring in 1358 DR . Disguised as a bandit himself , Zarwu roamed the hills , searching for the bandits . After meeting a bandit group , he discovered that they were from the far Chukei Plains and questioning them , Zarwu discovered they had gone south in order to reach Chu ' Yuan in order to rob people visiting the komite at Suijeng . During the night , Zarwu killed the sleeping bandits and took their heads to the merchants ' guild that had hired him . Afterward , he decided to go south in order to participate in the komite .

title: Zasheena Drethyl
description: Zasheena Drethyl Zasheena Drethyl was one of the leaders of the Shadowkiss , a criminal organization that operated in the Dusk Ports of Returned Abeir . Description . Zasheena was beautiful by dragonborn standards , though she was also big and had an imposing figure .
description_long: Zasheena Drethyl Zasheena Drethyl was one of the leaders of the Shadowkiss , a criminal organization that operated in the Dusk Ports of Returned Abeir . Description . Zasheena was beautiful by dragonborn standards , though she was also big and had an imposing figure . She had many scars due to her colorful way of life . She had scarlet scales and golden eyes . Personality . Zasheena was a no - nonsense , strong - willed and pragmatical woman . Activities . Unknown for most people , Zasheena was a head member of the criminal organization " Shadowkiss " . She usually hired adventurers to fulfill special tasks on her behalf , and even seduced them when she believed was productive for her current goals . Her main goal was to eventually using the drugs sell by the Shadowkiss to control the green dragon Orlarrakh . History . Zasheena spent most of her life building the Shadowkiss organization , using the fortune of her partner , Nandrel Gostur , to fulfill her own ends .

title: Zasian Menz
description: Zasian Menz Zasian Menz was a priest of Cyric , who posed as a Banite in order to enter Dweomerheart and steal Azuth ' s staff , enabling Cyric to kill Mystra . Description . Zasian was described as young and handsome .
description_long: Zasian Menz Zasian Menz was a priest of Cyric , who posed as a Banite in order to enter Dweomerheart and steal Azuth ' s staff , enabling Cyric to kill Mystra . Description . Zasian was described as young and handsome . He was tall with long dark hair and a long mustache . He wore black leather trousers and a black and gold tunic . History . In 1373 DR , Zasian was serving as the seneschal of Helm Dwarf - Friend in Sundabar . Masquerading as a high priest of Bane , he allied with Kaanyr Vhok , who intended to discredit Dwarf - Friend and take over the city for himself . Zasian and Vhok concocted a plan to have Aliisza captured by angel servants of Tyr . He explained the plan to her , which revolved around opening a portal from inside the House of the Triad , and placed a " geas " on her so that she would not remember the plan until she saw her son for the first time . He and Vhok , accompanied by Myshik Morueme , then traveled to the Elemental Plane of Fire to reach the other end of the portal . Upon passing through the portal , Zasian possessed the storm dragon Tekthyrios and was revealed to be a priest of Cyric rather than Bane .

title: Zayir
description: Zayir Zayir was a small town located on the Pilgrims ' Route in Zakhara in 1367 DR . Description . Nestled between the Golden Gulf to the south and the Al - Akara Mountains to the north , Zayir was one of the few stops along the Pilgrim ' s Route heading south into the Cities of the Pantheon .
description_long: Zayir Zayir was a small town located on the Pilgrims ' Route in Zakhara in 1367 DR . Description . Nestled between the Golden Gulf to the south and the Al - Akara Mountains to the north , Zayir was one of the few stops along the Pilgrim ' s Route heading south into the Cities of the Pantheon .

title: Zaynal
description: Zaynal Zaynal was a half - elven sorcerer and scribe living in Huzuz , the City of Delights , in 1367 DR . Activities . Zaynal was a bit of a cheat and liar .
description_long: Zaynal Zaynal was a half - elven sorcerer and scribe living in Huzuz , the City of Delights , in 1367 DR . Activities . Zaynal was a bit of a cheat and liar . When her scrivening business was slow , she enjoyed closing her shop , disguising herself with magic , and roaming the caravanserai and Warehouse District selling false " relics " to foolish customers . Some of these items included chips of bone from the first Grand Caliph , scraps of the original scrolls of the Loregiver , and pieces of the House of the Loregiver . Zaynal used her skills to supply forged documents , all signed by Renn min Zann , to authenticate her wares .

title: Zaynal ibn Sabur
description: Zaynal ibn Sabur Zaynal ibn Sabur was one of Grand Caliph Khalil al - Assad al - Zahir ' s wives in Huzuz in 1367 DR . Description . Zaynal was a dark and passionate beauty and one of Khalil ' s favorite wives .
description_long: Zaynal ibn Sabur Zaynal ibn Sabur was one of Grand Caliph Khalil al - Assad al - Zahir ' s wives in Huzuz in 1367 DR . Description . Zaynal was a dark and passionate beauty and one of Khalil ' s favorite wives . She moved with the sultry , predatory grace of a hunting cat . Personality . Zaynal had a fiery temper that mellowed a bit over the years to the point where she tolerated Khalil ' s younger wives and concubines . Abilities . Trained in Kadarasto , she was a legendary dancer of the highest proficiency . History . During her first decade in the Royal Harim , Zaynal ' s rivals were known to disappear for days at a time . Upon their return , these shaken rivals always deferred to Zaynal with respect . Only two people knew Zaynal ' s true identity — the Grand Vizier and Khalil ' s maternal aunt , Sitt Ramah . Zaynal was in fact a holy slayer of the Soft Whisper , sworn to protect the Grand Caliph . Zaynal had 50 slaves at the Royal Harim , all of whom were female holy slayers as well .

title: Zazspar Bronzefire
description: Zazspar Bronzefire Zazspar Bronzefire was a shield dwarf mage and a member of the Harpers in Mirabar sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . Activities . Zazspar posed as a stablehand .
description_long: Zazspar Bronzefire Zazspar Bronzefire was a shield dwarf mage and a member of the Harpers in Mirabar sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . Activities . Zazspar posed as a stablehand . His duty was to rotect one of " teleportation circle s " of Krowen Valharrow ' s network even from the city ' s authorities .

title: Zbavra
description: Zbavra Zbavra the Witch - Queen was a human cleric , sorcerer and Disciple of Mammon who served in the Servants of Mammon and had joined Mammon ' s court in his palace in Minauros , in the Nine Hells . Background . Zbavra was originally a cleric of Hextor and chose to move to the Nine Hells to serve him , but decided that she wanted more power and joined forces with Mammon instead .
description_long: Zbavra Zbavra the Witch - Queen was a human cleric , sorcerer and Disciple of Mammon who served in the Servants of Mammon and had joined Mammon ' s court in his palace in Minauros , in the Nine Hells . Background . Zbavra was originally a cleric of Hextor and chose to move to the Nine Hells to serve him , but decided that she wanted more power and joined forces with Mammon instead . Equipment . Zbavra wore a " ring of protection " , " amulet of natural armor " , " bracers of armor " and a " mantle of spell resistance " . She wielded a dagger and carried a " wand of stoneskin " and a " wand of magic vestment " .

title: Zeboaster
description: Zeboaster Zeboaster the Blunt was a sage who lived in Ordulin in Sembia in the 1350s DR . Zeboaster named the god of suffering Ilmater " the Stupid God " , and called the zulkir s of Thay the " Dumb Wizards of Thay " after they failed to conquer Rashemen . Zeboaster disappeared in 1358 DR .
description_long: Zeboaster Zeboaster the Blunt was a sage who lived in Ordulin in Sembia in the 1350s DR . Zeboaster named the god of suffering Ilmater " the Stupid God " , and called the zulkir s of Thay the " Dumb Wizards of Thay " after they failed to conquer Rashemen . Zeboaster disappeared in 1358 DR .

title: Zedarr T ' sarran
description: Zedarr T ' sarran Zedarr T ' sarran was a male drow from Maerimydra , the son of Irae T ' sarran and an unholy champion of Kiaransalee . Description . Although Zedarr was of average height for a male drow , he was an imposing figure in his black full plate armor .
description_long: Zedarr T ' sarran Zedarr T ' sarran was a male drow from Maerimydra , the son of Irae T ' sarran and an unholy champion of Kiaransalee . Description . Although Zedarr was of average height for a male drow , he was an imposing figure in his black full plate armor . He kept his visor down most of the time ( especially in combat ) due to terrible scars across his face . Zedarr ' s dark skin was mottled with pink burns marks . Personality . After Zedarr was captured and hideously scarred by ranger s of the Dalelands he became consumed by the retributive tenets of his goddess , Kiaransalee . The blackguard fully embraced by the virtue of " " answer any slight a thousandfold " " to the extent he held an eternal grudge against all the people of the Dales . He took a fierce delight in battle and had an appreciation of fine furnishings . Relationship . Zedarr had developed a strong bond with the fiendish displacer beast , Ripper . Abilities . A skilled warrior and commanding leader , in combat Zedarr whirled both ends of his double - ended dire flail faster than the eye could see , often crippling his foes weapons with his blows .

title: Zeeahd
description: Zeeahd Zeeahd was a spellscar ed diviner agent of Mephistopheles in Faerûn . History . Zeehad and Sayeed fought in the Twilight War of 1374 DR , where they were killed by Abelar Corrinthal ' s troops .
description_long: Zeeahd Zeeahd was a spellscar ed diviner agent of Mephistopheles in Faerûn . History . Zeehad and Sayeed fought in the Twilight War of 1374 DR , where they were killed by Abelar Corrinthal ' s troops . When Zeeahd died , his soul went to Cania . There he bargained with Mephistopheles to become one of his agents on Faerûn in exchange for being returned to life there . In 1484 DR , Zeeahd and his brother Sayeed went in search of the Abbey of the Rose , in order to capture Vasen Cale . They arrived in the village of Fairelm where they discovered that the local peddler Minser had just visited the Abbey . So Sayeed and Zeeahd unleashed their pack of spined devil s to slaughter all inhabitants except Minser and Elle , who had spoken against them , in order to force Minser to show them the right way . Afterward , Sayeed and Zeeahd invaded the Abbey . Zeeahd confronted the Oracle , discovering him to be Elden Corrinthal , the son of Abelar . Elden managed to humiliate Zeehad and so he ordered his spined devil s to kill Elden . However , the Oracle was well prepared for his death and died with a smile .

title: Zeearie
description: Zeearie Zeearie was a female githyanki operating on the Sword Coast North in the 1370s DR . History . Zeearie was one of the Sword Stalker knights serving the Lich Queen , Vlaakith , on the Astral Plane .
description_long: Zeearie Zeearie was a female githyanki operating on the Sword Coast North in the 1370s DR . History . Zeearie was one of the Sword Stalker knights serving the Lich Queen , Vlaakith , on the Astral Plane . Since the githyanki were in need of their silver sword s , the Lich Queen sent Zeearie and some of the githyanki to retrieve silver shard s on the Sword Coast . Gameplay . After Shandra Jerro was captured , the Kalach - Cha and companions needed to track the githyanki to their base . Zeearie expected them in the cave and recited the Kalach - Cha ' s crimes , as well as her intent on probing Shandra ' s mind . Once done , Zeearie took Kalach - Cha ' s silver shards , only to see one of them was inside the chest . To defeat her , the Kalach - Cha and the companions had to destroy the pillars that sustained the portal ( which prevented her from aging ) , or use the object that Mephasm gave them before he departed . Once defeated , Zeearie warned the Kalach - Cha that the King of Shadows was going after them . She could ' ve been slayed on the spot , which made Bishop pleased .

title: Zeerith Q ' Xorlarrin
description: Zeerith Q ' Xorlarrin Zeerith Q ' Xorlarrin was the matron mother of House Xorlarrin of Menzoberranzan . She was matron mother in 1361 DR and still remained in that position in 1484 DR , when House Xorlarrin moved to the city of Q ' Xorlarrin . Personality .
description_long: Zeerith Q ' Xorlarrin Zeerith Q ' Xorlarrin was the matron mother of House Xorlarrin of Menzoberranzan . She was matron mother in 1361 DR and still remained in that position in 1484 DR , when House Xorlarrin moved to the city of Q ' Xorlarrin . Personality . She was known for her diplomatic skills and other houses often called upon her to mediate in disputes . History . Zeerith moved her house from Menzoberranzan to the new city of Q ' Xorlarrin in 1484 DR . Her family was deeply involved with the Darkening . Although Matron Mother Quenthel Baenre called Xorlarrin house wizard Tsabrak Xorlarrin to be the house wizard for the restored House Do ' Urden , Zeerith refused to allow him to leave Q ' Xorlarrin because she wanted him to become Archmage of Q ' Xorlarrin , since his channeling of Lolth ( the first since the destruction of House Oblodra ) made him a rival to Gromph Baenre , the Archmage of Menzoberranzan . Relationships . Zeerith ' s brother was the mage and later lich Kharza - kzad Xorlarrin . Her house patron was the mage Horroodissomoth Xorlarrin until his death during the Spellplague . . Zeerith had a number of children , including Brack ' thal and Ravel Xorlarrin .

title: Zegdar
description: Zegdar Zegdar was a minotaur chieftain and an ally of the Cult of the Eternal Flame at the Fane of the Eye under Tyar - Besil during the Elemental Evil crisis . Relationships . Zegdar led the Emberhorn tribe .
description_long: Zegdar Zegdar was a minotaur chieftain and an ally of the Cult of the Eternal Flame at the Fane of the Eye under Tyar - Besil during the Elemental Evil crisis . Relationships . Zegdar led the Emberhorn tribe . History . In 1491 DR , Vanifer sent Wyx , a nothic fire cultist , to Zegdar . Wyx convinced Zegdar to ally with the Eternal Flame . However , some adventurers infiltrated the Fane and confronted and defeated him .

title: Zehir
description: Zehir Zehir was an apparent interloper deity who came to Toril around the time of the Spellplague and took up residence in the Sea of Poison near Talona ' s realm in the Towers of Night . Personality . His methods were aggressive , yet subtle .
description_long: Zehir Zehir was an apparent interloper deity who came to Toril around the time of the Spellplague and took up residence in the Sea of Poison near Talona ' s realm in the Towers of Night . Personality . His methods were aggressive , yet subtle . He liked his wishes to be carried out quietly , but boldly and did not forgive failure , though those who continued to please him could expect to be richly rewarded . Worshipers . Zehiric cleric s were called Venomers and he drew many worshipers from the ranks of the yuan - ti that were unhappy with the detachment of Sseth . High - ranking clerics were referred to as " Low Priests " . In a society of snake men , being low was considered a positive attribute . The unholy gesture of Zehir was the sign of fangs . History . Zehir was Set , a member of another pantheon who managed to join the Faerûnian one under a different name . Dragonborn of Abeir believed that Zehir had part in Asgorath ' s death during the Dawn War . Those who believed that myth , said that Zehir wanted to control the Dragon domain that was Asgorath ' s portfolio , and betrayed him to the primordial Erek - Hus in order to obtain it .

title: Zekaqux
description: Zekaqux Zekaqux was one of the leading ixzan members of the Xendreth , ruling council of Malydren in 1370 DR , as well as the city ' s high priest of Ilxendren . History . Zekaqux born in the year of Malydren ' s founding , 602 DR , and together with Phiaqiv was transformed into a greater vampire by an avatar of Ilxendren .
description_long: Zekaqux Zekaqux was one of the leading ixzan members of the Xendreth , ruling council of Malydren in 1370 DR , as well as the city ' s high priest of Ilxendren . History . Zekaqux born in the year of Malydren ' s founding , 602 DR , and together with Phiaqiv was transformed into a greater vampire by an avatar of Ilxendren . In time , thank to their experience , he and Phiaqiv became the leading members of the Xendreth . Activities . Zekaqux was one of the leading clerics of the city and master of the Ziggurat of the Demonray . He liked to swim in the deepest catacombs beneath the temple of Ilxendren . From this habit and his undead nature he received his nickname , " Netherhaunt " .

title: Zekyl
description: Zekyl The zekyl ( plural " zekylyn " ; feminine " zebeyl " , plural " zebylyn " ) or half – shadow dragon drow , were an offshoot of the drow race . Abilities . A " zekyl " had the abilities of a drow and that of a half - dragon of shadow dragon patronage .
description_long: Zekyl The zekyl ( plural " zekylyn " ; feminine " zebeyl " , plural " zebylyn " ) or half – shadow dragon drow , were an offshoot of the drow race . Abilities . A " zekyl " had the abilities of a drow and that of a half - dragon of shadow dragon patronage . Their drow blood gave them a natural dexterity but unlike normal drow , their dragon blood erased their drow ’ s physical frailty and made them stronger and their already keen mind sharper and personality stronger . Them being drow gave them protection against magic that specifically tried to mess with their will , including an immunity against sleep , and also against magic in general . Their dragon side provided them not only an outright immunity against being paralysed but protected them also from physical attacks . They were the owners of darkvision as well as low - light vision and could cast " dancing light " , " faerie fire " and " darkness " like any other drow , furthermore they owned the ability to breathe life sapping energy against their foes . They didn ’ t necessarily need weapons because their claws and bite already were usable as one .

title: Zel Tregarthen
description: Zel Tregarthen Zel Tregarthen was a high - ranking member of the Brotherhood of the Cloak in Mulmaster . Relationships . Tregarthen was an internal investigator for the Cloaks , tasked with rooting out corruption .
description_long: Zel Tregarthen Zel Tregarthen was a high - ranking member of the Brotherhood of the Cloak in Mulmaster . Relationships . Tregarthen was an internal investigator for the Cloaks , tasked with rooting out corruption . History . In 1491 DR , after discovering a mole inside the Cloaks , Zel started an investigation . During his investigation , he interviewed an adventuring party , but at that moment the cultist assassin Little Wing killed him , framing the adventurers . Appendix . References . \

title: Zelatar
description: Zelatar Zelatar was the capital and political hub of the Abyssal realm of Azzagrat . Geography . Zelatar occupied a place on all three Abyssal planes that made up Azzagrat .
description_long: Zelatar Zelatar was the capital and political hub of the Abyssal realm of Azzagrat . Geography . Zelatar occupied a place on all three Abyssal planes that made up Azzagrat . The city spanned and connected the 45th , 46th , and 47th levels of the Abyss . The city was divided into neighbourhoods by its spanning . Fogtown was the name given to the neighborhood on the 45th layer . Gallenghast was what denizens of the city ' s 46th layer called their ward while the 47th layer was called Darkflame . Its extra - planar existence gave its streets and byways an often confusing and seemingly impossible layout . History . By Graz ' zt ' s decree , all merchants were afforded protection while in Azzagrat and Zelatar , although this protection was often subverted , especially by Graz ' zt himself .

title: Zelbross
description: Zelbross Zelbross was a hamlet lying on the Delimbiyr Route , halfway between Loudwater and Secomber . In the 1360s DR , it was home to about 120 people . Zelbross was famous for its clay smoking pipes .
description_long: Zelbross Zelbross was a hamlet lying on the Delimbiyr Route , halfway between Loudwater and Secomber . In the 1360s DR , it was home to about 120 people . Zelbross was famous for its clay smoking pipes . These iron - hard , mottled , tortoise - shell finish pipes could be found all over Faerûn . This was an old settlement possibly established here because of the rich clay along the River Shining that could be found in the vicinity . History . By 1479 DR , Zelbross lay in ruins .

title: Zeld Mizzrym
description: Zeld Mizzrym Zeld Mizzrym was a drow priestess of House Mizzrym in Menzoberranzan . History . Around 1361 DR , Zeld was a Mizzrym priestess and an instructor at Arach - Tinilith .
description_long: Zeld Mizzrym Zeld Mizzrym was a drow priestess of House Mizzrym in Menzoberranzan . History . Around 1361 DR , Zeld was a Mizzrym priestess and an instructor at Arach - Tinilith . She was in charge of teaching first - year students and was the first person to notice the rivalry between Shakti Hunzrin and Liriel Baenre .

title: Zelia
description: Zelia Zelia was a powerful yuan - ti psionicist who planted mental seeds in people all over Toril , who were taken over and became her agents with their own psionic powers , albeit lesser than hers . She used them in a plot of world domination . Her demise started when she became interested in the young psion Arvin , who had powers similar to hers .
description_long: Zelia Zelia was a powerful yuan - ti psionicist who planted mental seeds in people all over Toril , who were taken over and became her agents with their own psionic powers , albeit lesser than hers . She used them in a plot of world domination . Her demise started when she became interested in the young psion Arvin , who had powers similar to hers . In the end , Arvin defeatd Zelia .

title: Zellix
description: Zellix Zellix was a mind flayer who founded and managed an asylum in the Underdark during the Rage of Demons . History . Zellix discovered that brains of people infected by the demon lord s ' madness were more succulent and tasty than others .
description_long: Zellix Zellix was a mind flayer who founded and managed an asylum in the Underdark during the Rage of Demons . History . Zellix discovered that brains of people infected by the demon lord s ' madness were more succulent and tasty than others . So it founded an asylum where it could keep them until the right time . It also sent intellect devourer servants to lure new subjects into its asylum . .

title: Zelphar Arunsun
description: Zelphar Arunsun Zelphar Arunsun was a powerful human wizard , originally from Neverwinter . He was the son of Khelben " Blackstaff " Arunsun and married Lhestyn . His son is Khelben Arunsun the Younger , who is often confused with the Blackstaff .
description_long: Zelphar Arunsun Zelphar Arunsun was a powerful human wizard , originally from Neverwinter . He was the son of Khelben " Blackstaff " Arunsun and married Lhestyn . His son is Khelben Arunsun the Younger , who is often confused with the Blackstaff . Zelphar was killed by magical means , although his killer was never discovered . Background . In 1311 DR , Zelphar was killed by " Bigby ' s crushing hand " , a spell cast by a lich of the Twisted Rune , as a favour to the Shadow Thieves .

title: Zelphar Thann
description: Zelphar Thann Zelphar Thann was the fourth son of Rhammas and Cassandra Thann of Waterdeep and an older brother of Danilo Thann . He served as Tethyr ' s Count of Rivershire and Estate Chancellor . He was in charge of public works and maintained the siegeworks in the Reclamation Army .
description_long: Zelphar Thann Zelphar Thann was the fourth son of Rhammas and Cassandra Thann of Waterdeep and an older brother of Danilo Thann . He served as Tethyr ' s Count of Rivershire and Estate Chancellor . He was in charge of public works and maintained the siegeworks in the Reclamation Army . However , his passion was wine , so he took care of most of his family ' s vineyards in the south . Personality . Zelphar Thann was known to be quiet , thoughtful , and reserved , which made him appear weak and ineffective . He was well aware of how he was perceived and preferred to use others ' misconceptions to his advantage . Abilities . Not only was Lord Zelphar a superb architect , but he was also an excellent leader , managing the county assigned to him well in spite of his unpopularity with the landed families . ( Of the seven land - owning families of Rivershire , only two of them liked the new count . ) Holdings . Count Thann ' s manor was Lhestyn ' s Hearth , which he named after his grandmother . Zelphar redesigned the formerly abandoned manor ' s defenses . It was twelve miles north of Darromar . Activities .

title: Zelpir
description: Zelpir Zelpir was a small city in Var the Golden in the Shining Lands in 1367 DR . Geography . Zelpir sat on the southwest shore of the Golden Water near Pyratar .
description_long: Zelpir Zelpir was a small city in Var the Golden in the Shining Lands in 1367 DR . Geography . Zelpir sat on the southwest shore of the Golden Water near Pyratar . Its location as the closest port to Heldapan made it the prime choice for those wishing to ship their wares north . Activites . Known for its production of fine jewelry and mechanical devices , some believed Zelpir ' s products rivaled those of the Lantannan Gondsmen . Water clocks , mechanical toys , and field glass es were just a few of the wonders that could be purchased here . Zelpir transported grain via ship or caravan north to Unther and Mulhorand . Inhabitants . Though it only possessed a population of 8 , 000 inhabitants , Zelpir was growing quickly . However , the merchants were cautious about who they allowed to start a business within their city . All new businesses needed to be licensed and approved by the city council .

title: Zelraun Roaringhorn
description: Zelraun Roaringhorn Zelraun Roaringhorn was a wizard member of the Harper s during the Rage of Demons . History . Zelraun hailed from the noble Roaringhorn family .
description_long: Zelraun Roaringhorn Zelraun Roaringhorn was a wizard member of the Harper s during the Rage of Demons . History . Zelraun hailed from the noble Roaringhorn family . He trained as a wizard . During the Rage of Demons , Zelraun was the Harper delegate to King Bruenor Battlehammer of Gauntlgrym to discuss the madness spreading in the Underdark . Personality . Zelraun always maintained an attitude of self - assurance and pride that derived from his family . He never forgot his roots and used the money of his family on the finer things in life . He lived to gamble . Possession . He always had with him a shield guardian .

title: Zendalure
description: Zendalure Zendalure was a gemstone with remarkable preservative properties , unique to the Realms . Description . Zendalure crystals could be found in places where lava had cooled and become solid .
description_long: Zendalure Zendalure was a gemstone with remarkable preservative properties , unique to the Realms . Description . Zendalure crystals could be found in places where lava had cooled and become solid . These blotchy blue - white crystals formed egg - shaped nodules approximately 2 to 6 inches ( 5 to 15 cm ) in diameter and could be polished to a mirror - like finish . They were frequently used as inlays or cut into small cabochons for rings , earrings , and pendants . A typical specimen had a base value of 1 , 000gp . Powers . Zendalure could be made into a syrup by crushing the stones into a powder and mixing it with water . This syrup could completely and indefinitely protect flesh and bone from all rot and decay . The meat or body parts had to be fully immersed in the mixture and not allowed exposure to sunlight directly . This preservative was known to keep fresh mammalian , reptilian , or avian flesh .

title: Zendaros Rallogar
description: Zendaros Rallogar Zendaros Rallogar was a Tethyrian human man living in the city of Wheloon in Cormyr . He was the proprietor of Rallogar Hardware . Zendaros was in business with Rallogar Hardware by 1358 DR .
description_long: Zendaros Rallogar Zendaros Rallogar was a Tethyrian human man living in the city of Wheloon in Cormyr . He was the proprietor of Rallogar Hardware . Zendaros was in business with Rallogar Hardware by 1358 DR . He was still in business through 1369 DR , and in 1374 DR . He pretended to have an extreme hatred for magic , and forced customers who asked about magic item s out of the store . However , he was a practicing wizard and actually ran a prosperous black market trade in magic items , weapons , armor and so on . One of his employees later approached the curious customer to broker a deal . Zendaros had a large and unkempt mustache .

title: Zenobia
description: Zenobia Zenobia was a dwarf fighter from the world of Oerth who , along with her companions , was sent to Toril after angering an evil mage . Description . Zenobia had long , braided blonde hair , and a substantial blonde beard .
description_long: Zenobia Zenobia was a dwarf fighter from the world of Oerth who , along with her companions , was sent to Toril after angering an evil mage . Description . Zenobia had long , braided blonde hair , and a substantial blonde beard . She was clad in chain mail , and wore a voluminous dark red cloak . Possessions . She owned a pair of gauntlets of ogre power , which magically enhanced her strength , and allowed her to carry twin warhammer s in combat . Activities . Along with her similarly transported companions , Zenobia worked as an adventurer in the name of goodness . She hoped to grow powerful enough to return home to Oerth .

title: Zephyros
description: Zephyros Zephyros was an eccentric cloud giant wizard sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . Activities . Zephyros lived in his floating Tower of Zephyros .
description_long: Zephyros Zephyros was an eccentric cloud giant wizard sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . Activities . Zephyros lived in his floating Tower of Zephyros . History . For fifty years he studied the Moonshae Isles . In the late 1480s or early 1490s DR , after the shattering of the " ordning " , Zephyros started working to find a solution for this crisis using the " contact other plane " spell . This somehow led him to Nightstone village just after some others cloud giants had bombarded the place . Zephyros was instructed by a Planar Sphere creature that an adventuring party he would find there could reconstruct the " ordning " . Personality . Zephyros was very open - minded to " small folks " .

title: Zerath
description: Zerath Zerath was a dragonborn of Abeir , and one of the ancestors of Clan Kepeshkmolik . History . Zerath was one of the seven wise elders who raised Shasphur .
description_long: Zerath Zerath was a dragonborn of Abeir , and one of the ancestors of Clan Kepeshkmolik . History . Zerath was one of the seven wise elders who raised Shasphur . One day , Shaspur came with a plan to free the dragonborn slaves from the gold dragon Raurokhymdhar . His plan , however , had a flaw : he could not save the elders . The elders decided that Shaspur should flee without them . Zerath was killed by Raurokhymdhar while misleading the dragon so Shaspur and the other slaves could flee to freedom .

title: Zerbin Gethrik
description: Zerbin Gethrik Zerbin Gethrik was a cleric of Tempus in Chondath in 1358 DR . History . Once Zerbin was a murderer on the Sword Coast until he escaped to Chondath to flee justice .
description_long: Zerbin Gethrik Zerbin Gethrik was a cleric of Tempus in Chondath in 1358 DR . History . Once Zerbin was a murderer on the Sword Coast until he escaped to Chondath to flee justice . There , however , he joined the church of Tempus and changed his life , settling in Timindar . He became involved in the Battle of Thurgabanteth . Personality . Zerbin , despite his unusual conversion , had become a true devotee of Tempus , following all the few rules of his church . However he complained about everything , mostly because nobody took his advice seriously . Zerbin ate and drank too much but was an able fighter and a good companion . Relationship . Zerbin was the best friend of Araband Tymin , son of the city ' s lord .

title: Zern Xerkstil
description: Zern Xerkstil Zern Xerkstil was an agent of the Order of the Gauntlet in the Moonsea in 1489 DR . Personality . Zern was a brash and headstrong warrior .
description_long: Zern Xerkstil Zern Xerkstil was an agent of the Order of the Gauntlet in the Moonsea in 1489 DR . Personality . Zern was a brash and headstrong warrior . The Hammer of Impiltur was loud , boisterous and zealous in pursuit of evil . History . Zern was possibly involved in the case of dracolich es and ghost ships wandering the Moonsea . He said that the Order believed that fiend ish forces were involved . In 1491 DR he resurfaced in Mulmaster asking to the adventurers to indagate about the Silkroot , recently arrived in the streets of that city . Later he assisted Lana of the Monastery of the Yellow Rose at the Mulmaster ' s Ilmater temple and helped her to told to an adventuring party , hired to investigate about a strange storm , about the suspect situation at the monastery . During the Rage of Demons Zern was in Elventree where possibly hired some adventurers to help Elanil Elassidil with some Drow arriving in the surface .

title: Zerth
description: Zerth Within githzerai culture , zerths are those who mix arcane arts with other skills and powers — particularly martial or psionic ones . These githzerai follow the example of Zerthimon , even if they do so unintentionally . Any githzerai who multiclass es or hybrids an arcane class with a non - arcane class can claim the honorific " zerth .
description_long: Zerth Within githzerai culture , zerths are those who mix arcane arts with other skills and powers — particularly martial or psionic ones . These githzerai follow the example of Zerthimon , even if they do so unintentionally . Any githzerai who multiclass es or hybrids an arcane class with a non - arcane class can claim the honorific " zerth . " However , it is considered presumptuous to do so until other githzerai , other zerths especially , have recognized a would - be zerth ' s prowess . Such recognition rarely occurs before a githzerai has proven him or herself worthy with success on a few challenging ventures . Among githzerai , zerths are the philosophical offspring of Zerthimon . For this reason , most zerths pay at least some honor to Zerthimon . Some githzerai , zerths and otherwise , believe that when Zerthimon returns the zerths will be his preferred assistants .

title: Zespara Alather
description: Zespara Alather Zespara Alather is a talented swordsmith who runs the House of the Bright Blade in Mirabar . Occasionally one to partake in adventuring , Zespara has powerful friends , notably , several anonymous mage s . Also a members of the Harpers , she also sometimes operates as an agent of the Lords ' Alliance ; as such , Zespara Alather has slain many dangerous members of evil organizations such as the Zhentarim , the Red Wizards and the Arcane Brotherhood .
description_long: Zespara Alather Zespara Alather is a talented swordsmith who runs the House of the Bright Blade in Mirabar . Occasionally one to partake in adventuring , Zespara has powerful friends , notably , several anonymous mage s . Also a members of the Harpers , she also sometimes operates as an agent of the Lords ' Alliance ; as such , Zespara Alather has slain many dangerous members of evil organizations such as the Zhentarim , the Red Wizards and the Arcane Brotherhood .

title: Zesstra Aleanrahel
description: Zesstra Aleanrahel Zesstra Aleanrahel was a member of House Aleanrahel and a secret cleric of Shar in Ched Nasad in the year 1370 DR . and 1372 History . Zesstra was the third daughter of Matron Mother Jyslin Aleanrahel .
description_long: Zesstra Aleanrahel Zesstra Aleanrahel was a member of House Aleanrahel and a secret cleric of Shar in Ched Nasad in the year 1370 DR . and 1372 History . Zesstra was the third daughter of Matron Mother Jyslin Aleanrahel . One day , patrolling near Ched Nasad , she found the " Gorothir ' s Girdle " , a sacred Sharran artifact , on the skeletal remains of an alhoon . This caused Zesstra ' s conversion to Shar and she also started a small cult inside the city . In 1370 DR , finally Jyslin discovered the heresy of her daughter but waited for the right time to expose her . However , the destruction of Ched Nasad during the Silence of Lolth ruined the plots of Zesstra ' s enemies . On the contrary , she survived and expanded her cult by recruiting new members from the survivors . Her growing power , however , exposed Zesstra ' s failings as a cult leader . With no grand schemes in mind , she plotted only to get revenge on her enemies . Unable to ruin them any further thanks to the city ' s destruction , she directed her followers to kill all her enemies . However , these actions also caused the death of many of her cultists .

title: Zet
description: Zet Zet was an efreeti who lived in the Pantheist League in Zakhara in 1367 DR . Relationships . Zet was the genie servant and bodyguard of the sha ' ir Othmar bin Jaqal .
description_long: Zet Zet was an efreeti who lived in the Pantheist League in Zakhara in 1367 DR . Relationships . Zet was the genie servant and bodyguard of the sha ' ir Othmar bin Jaqal . Though Othmar constantly berated him , Zet encouraged his master to pursue his goals because of ulterior motives . Activities . Zet actively persuaded his master to undertake goals that had a greater chance of either destroying him or granting him glory as well . He hoped to be freed from his servitude should his master perish , or share the glory of any successes . One of his schemes involved Othmar seizing the throne of Mahabba to become its Caliph .

title: Zetharmas
description: Zetharmas Zetharmas was a tiefling warlock in the Plane of Shadow in 1374 DR . History . Zetharmas was rumored to be the scion of a powerful demon lord , but nobody knew if this was true .
description_long: Zetharmas Zetharmas was a tiefling warlock in the Plane of Shadow in 1374 DR . History . Zetharmas was rumored to be the scion of a powerful demon lord , but nobody knew if this was true . He was one of the main leaders of the Church of Cyric faction involved in the Despayr ' s plot in 1374 DR . Zetharmas was the one that materially opened the hole in the Weave . He and his fellow Cyricists resided in the Monastery of Ebon Dome on the Plane of Shadow for the duration of the plot . However , an adventurers party defeated him .

title: Zethrindor
description: Zethrindor Zethrindor was an ancient white dragon dracolich who allied with Sammaster during the Rage of Dragons of 1373 DR . History . In 1373 DR , Sammaster realized that the reemergence of metallic dragon s threatened his plan , so he allied with the Ice Witch Iyraclea and sent Zethrindor and a host of dragons to her .
description_long: Zethrindor Zethrindor was an ancient white dragon dracolich who allied with Sammaster during the Rage of Dragons of 1373 DR . History . In 1373 DR , Sammaster realized that the reemergence of metallic dragon s threatened his plan , so he allied with the Ice Witch Iyraclea and sent Zethrindor and a host of dragons to her . Zethrindor helped Iyraclea to conquer all the Great Glacier and afterward they marched over Sossal . The conquest of the druid ic nation proceeded well until Brimstone approached Zethrindor , whispering that Iyraclea plotted to betray Sammaster with power hidden in ruins in the Novularond Mountains . Soon after , the white dracolich went to the ruins , hoping to achieve that power for himself . There he met Iyraclea ' s army and Dorn Graybrook ' s party . During the three - sided battle , Zethrindor killed the Ice Witch in a terrible battle but it was Dorn and his allies who occupied the ruin . So the white dracolich went back to Sossal to become the dragon - king of that nation . In the decisive battle against the Sossrim , Zethrindor was challenged to a duel by the enemy commander .

title: Zezania Tarth - Kelet
description: Zezania Tarth - Kelet Zezania Tarth - Kelet was a Chultan human woman from Tashalar . She was a priestess of Shar and a member of Demarch ' s Folly , an organization dedicated to learning shadow magic . Abilities .
description_long: Zezania Tarth - Kelet Zezania Tarth - Kelet was a Chultan human woman from Tashalar . She was a priestess of Shar and a member of Demarch ' s Folly , an organization dedicated to learning shadow magic . Abilities . Zezania was a wizard and cleric of Shar who studied divine magic , arcane magic , and shadow magic , and was able to use the Shadow Weave . She combined these diverse paths of study as a mystic theurge , and also developed as a child of night . History . Interested in shadow magic and curious about the Shadow Weave , members of Demarch ' s Folly sought out someone who could use both . They discovered Zezania . She agreed to join their organization and provided guidance in their efforts .

title: Zezen Washio
description: Zezen Washio Zezen Washio was a samurai adventurer in Kozakura . History . Washio hailed from the illustrious and noble Zezen clan and he was the eldest son of an eldest son .
description_long: Zezen Washio Zezen Washio was a samurai adventurer in Kozakura . History . Washio hailed from the illustrious and noble Zezen clan and he was the eldest son of an eldest son . His family had a long history , with his ancestor Zezen Ito penning the " Great Interpretation of the Way of Enlightenment " and winning in 1287 DR in the Battle of Falling Water together with powerful the lowland Hirimaki clan . In the 1350s DR , many of Washio ' s female relatives married into the mercantile Ko clan . In 1357 DR , Washio was among the candidates considered by Ko Mei Kho for a mission to Akari . In 1358 , he was offered a shugo in his native home vale but at the last moment he went out to fight a monster and kept on going , unclear whether he ever wished to return to bureaucratic duties . After this , he was possibly approached by Ko Ho San . Appendix . Behind the scenes . Zezen Washio is a pregenerated PC for use in adventures in Akari . He was presented again and upgraded for an adventure in T ' u Lung .

title: Zhai
description: Zhai Zhai was a half - drow , half - wood elf rogue of the 14th century DR . Abilities . She was able to use twin dagger s and had skill at hiding herself .
description_long: Zhai Zhai was a half - drow , half - wood elf rogue of the 14th century DR . Abilities . She was able to use twin dagger s and had skill at hiding herself . History . Zhai was raised in the wood elf village of Cedarleaf by her drow mother and wood elf father , until they were killed indirectly by the slaad Ygorl in a raid against the town . Feeling insecure in the home of the wood elves , Zhai left them and became a rogue . She was captured by orc s attacking a town but was freed by Rannek during the battle . Soon thereafter , Zhai acquired a " ring of jumping " . Zhai eventually gained a reputation for herself , her deeds in Damara gaining the attention of Ellery Dragonsbane , who related them to Jarlaxle Baenre . Appendix . Behind the scenes . She is voiced by .

title: Zhengyi
description: Zhengyi Zhengyi the Witch - King was once a Red Wizard of Thay , but later became an enormously powerful lich and servant of the demon prince Orcus . In the far north of Vaasa in northeast Faerûn , Zhengyi created Castle Perilous in just one night in 1347 DR , and summoned the various goblin s , giant s and orc s of the lands to him . History .
description_long: Zhengyi Zhengyi the Witch - King was once a Red Wizard of Thay , but later became an enormously powerful lich and servant of the demon prince Orcus . In the far north of Vaasa in northeast Faerûn , Zhengyi created Castle Perilous in just one night in 1347 DR , and summoned the various goblin s , giant s and orc s of the lands to him . History . Zhengyi was born in the second half of the 900s DR , and became a Red Wizard of Thay before becoming a lich with the help of his patron , Orcus . Zhengyi ' s first known appearance on Faerûn was when he created Castle Perilous in a single night in 1347 DR . He immediately set about winning the favour of the goblin s , giant s and orc s in the area . He gained support from priests of Orcus , allowing him control of many undead creatures , and enlisted the help of the Grandfather of Assassins . A year later , in 1348 DR , Zhengyi attacked Damara . He began by occupying Bloodstone Pass , isolating a lot of mining operations crucial to Damara ' s prosperity . The armies invaded Damara itself , massacring at every opportunity .

title: Zhentarim
description: Zhentarim The Zhentarim were a mercenary company who , over their 200 years of existence , experienced several leaps and bounds in terms of successes , but also several major defeats . As of 1479 DR they were a shadow of their former glory , but still an organization of great power and influence . Hierarchy .
description_long: Zhentarim The Zhentarim were a mercenary company who , over their 200 years of existence , experienced several leaps and bounds in terms of successes , but also several major defeats . As of 1479 DR they were a shadow of their former glory , but still an organization of great power and influence . Hierarchy . Post Bane Re - emergence . The Zhentarim followed a strict linear hierarchy with Fzoul Chembryl at the head of the organization . He had several subordinates that reported directly to him . Each of those " Lords " had many underlings that handled reports and requests . The Zhentarim did not typically skip ranks in the hierarchy . The only exception to this rule was Manshoon who had permission to use any of the resources of the Zhents as he saw fit . Here is a short list of major figures at this time . History . Founded in 1261 DR in Zhentil Keep by Manshoon , the Zhentarim were originally created for Manshoon ' s ambitions for expansion . Fzoul Chembryl joined in 1263 DR and was able to dispose of the high ranking priests and convert low ranking priests to the cause of Bane .

title: Zhentil Keep
description: Zhentil Keep Zhentil Keep ( also called Thargate Keep ) was once the most powerful city in the Moonsea region as well as the main base of operation for the Zhentarim . Along with the Citadel of the Raven , Zhentil Keep was destroyed by the Shadovar in 1383 DR after it was discovered that the Zhentarim had forged an alliance with the phaerimm . History .
