description_long: Zhentil Keep Zhentil Keep ( also called Thargate Keep ) was once the most powerful city in the Moonsea region as well as the main base of operation for the Zhentarim . Along with the Citadel of the Raven , Zhentil Keep was destroyed by the Shadovar in 1383 DR after it was discovered that the Zhentarim had forged an alliance with the phaerimm . History . Early History . Zhentil Keep began as a small trading camp located on the north side of the Moonsea around 640 DR . In 747 DR , a Chancelgauntian ship owner named Orlephar Flostren , began hiring workers and mercenaries to construct fortifications and patrol the surrounding areas . By the next spring , a group of 12 Sembian merchants purchased the hold and began a major project of expansion . It was during this period that a large keep was raised in the northwestern quarter . Following its completion , a merchant by the name of Elephstron quickly moved into the keep , titling himself " Lord of the Keep .

title: Zhentilar
description: Zhentilar The Zhentilar were the standing army of Zhentil Keep . History . The Zhentilar were formed sometime after the death of Zhentar in 753 DR as a group loyal to his vision .
description_long: Zhentilar The Zhentilar were the standing army of Zhentil Keep . History . The Zhentilar were formed sometime after the death of Zhentar in 753 DR as a group loyal to his vision . It was in response to the event in Zhentil Keep known as the Night Plague in 882 DR , that the group was expanded to form something similar to a an official army . The Zhentilar continued to expand with the rapid growth of the Keep to become one of the largest militaries in the Moonsea . The Zhentilar were ultimately disbanded after the destruction of Zhentil Keep and the Zhentilar base of the Citadel of the Raven by the shadovar sometime between 1376 DR and 1479 DR

title: Zhessae
description: Zhessae Zhessae was a member of the Zhentarim in Mulmaster in the Year of the Tankard , 1370 DR . Relationships . Zhessae was a follower of Fzoul Chembryl .
description_long: Zhessae Zhessae was a member of the Zhentarim in Mulmaster in the Year of the Tankard , 1370 DR . Relationships . Zhessae was a follower of Fzoul Chembryl . History . As a trusted member of Fzoul ' s faction , Zhessae was peripherally involved in the hunt for Shandril Shessair .

title: Zhindia Melarn
description: Zhindia Melarn Zhindia Melarn was the first matron mother of House Melarn in Menzoberranzan . Personality . Zhindia was known for being extremely fanatical to Lolth , and because of that and her status as the youngest matron on the Ruling Council , she was rarely taken seriously by other matron mothers .
description_long: Zhindia Melarn Zhindia Melarn was the first matron mother of House Melarn in Menzoberranzan . Personality . Zhindia was known for being extremely fanatical to Lolth , and because of that and her status as the youngest matron on the Ruling Council , she was rarely taken seriously by other matron mothers . History . Zhindia was born " circa " 1130 DR , being 253 years old in 1383 DR . Zhindia became the first matron mother of the newly formed House Melarn in 1383 DR . At time of Rage of Demons she was respected for her zeal in rooting out drow apostates , especially within nobility . Relationships . Zhindia was the daughter of Jerlys Horlbar , one of the former co - matrons of House Horlbar . Zhindia ' s cousin Jhelnae Melarn , an apostate , was the target of her greatest hatred , although the two had once been friends . Zhindia ' s patron was Sornafein Melarn , whom she truly loved , although she never allowed her feelings to show for fear of being seen as weak .

title: Zhjaeve
description: Zhjaeve Zhjaeve was a githzerai planewalker who famously traveled to the Prime Material Plane to do battle with the King of Shadows at the Kalach - Cha ' s side . Physical description . Like other githzerai , Zhjaeve exhibited several seemingly alien features , in spite of her human ancestry .
description_long: Zhjaeve Zhjaeve was a githzerai planewalker who famously traveled to the Prime Material Plane to do battle with the King of Shadows at the Kalach - Cha ' s side . Physical description . Like other githzerai , Zhjaeve exhibited several seemingly alien features , in spite of her human ancestry . Such features included her green skin , which was stretched tightly across her facial features , accentuated the lines of her bones , slender features , and unusually long fingers . Her alien features carried over also into her subtle body language , including her tendency to watch those she was interested in silently with grey - yellow eyes , for purposes that were often hard to read . Additionally , her appearance was more than a little similar to that of a githyanki , though with slightly rounder features , often causing some confusion and resulting in occasional cases of mistaken identity . Personality . Zhjaeve was a stoic and unassuming individual whose dedication to her goals was absolute . Because of her role as a " zerth " amongst her people , Zhjaeve had a mental discipline that was not easily equaled .

title: Zhora Hallen
description: Zhora Hallen Zhora Hallen was a drow explorer and hunter during the Rage of Demons . Relationship . Zhora was very close to her daughter Hanne .
description_long: Zhora Hallen Zhora Hallen was a drow explorer and hunter during the Rage of Demons . Relationship . Zhora was very close to her daughter Hanne . Her family were allies of House Mizzrym . Activities . Zhora led the Dark Hunters , a group of ten drow explorers who normally hunted for purple worm eggs in the Wormwrithings in order to sell them to wizards in the city . . History . During the Rage of Demons , Hanne went on an egg run with Zhora and the Dark Hunters in the Wormwrithings , but the passage of a purple worm separated her from the group . Zhora believed her daughter dead and was greatly worried but continued the hunt .

title: Zhundult Ulblesk
description: Zhundult Ulblesk Zhundult " Stormhand " Ulblesk was a male human wizard who made his home in Tantras in 1358 DR . He was one of the more notable mages of the city at the time . He was a dangerous and quite possibly insane mage who aggressively defended his privacy .
description_long: Zhundult Ulblesk Zhundult " Stormhand " Ulblesk was a male human wizard who made his home in Tantras in 1358 DR . He was one of the more notable mages of the city at the time . He was a dangerous and quite possibly insane mage who aggressively defended his privacy . He was , however , a well - known researcher on planar powers and conditions and how to use them for destructive spell s . As such , he wielded an array of strange and lethal blasting spells .

title: Zi Liang
description: Zi Liang Zi Liang was was an acolyte of Chauntea in Goldenfields sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . Activities . Often Zi Liang tried to convince Father Ellardin Darovik to no affide the defense of the place to incompetent military leaders .
description_long: Zi Liang Zi Liang was was an acolyte of Chauntea in Goldenfields sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . Activities . Often Zi Liang tried to convince Father Ellardin Darovik to no affide the defense of the place to incompetent military leaders . Zi was often on patrol . History . In the late 1480s or early 1490s DR she was at the Harvesthome Abbey when giant s attacked the city . Personality . Zi Liang was a truly devotee of Chauntea . She believed that Goldenfields was a beacon of hope in the North and he must protect it . Zi trusted only her hearth . Behind the scenes . Zi Liang was one of the special NPCs that could be played by the players during the campaign ' s arc in their city .

title: Zikthann
description: Zikthann Zikthann of the Six Scepters was a human lich living in Sshamath in the year 1370 DR . History . Zikthann was a wizard from Illusk .
description_long: Zikthann Zikthann of the Six Scepters was a human lich living in Sshamath in the year 1370 DR . History . Zikthann was a wizard from Illusk . After the fall of his country in 1244 DR , he wandered around north Faerûn for many years , eventually entering the Arcane Brotherhood to become one of the Old One s . While exploring the Netherese Caverns , Zikthann covertly followed a Sshamathan patrol to the city . He acted as chief trade representative of the Host Tower of the Arcane in Sshamath , although Zikthann never told his fellows the source of the spells and magic items he exported to Luskan , giving him tight control over the new magic .

title: Zilchyn Q ' Leptin
description: Zilchyn Q ' Leptin Zilchyn Q ' Leptin , or simply Zilch , was a drow wizard in Mantol - Derith during the Rage of Demons . . Personality .
description_long: Zilchyn Q ' Leptin Zilchyn Q ' Leptin , or simply Zilch , was a drow wizard in Mantol - Derith during the Rage of Demons . . Personality . Zilchyn was a kleptomaniac . This behavior increased with the arrival of the demon lord . History . Zilchyn was a wizard from Menzoberranzan until , during the Rage of Demons , he stole some spell components and was discovered . He fled the city , losing his spellbook , and had an encounter with a black pudding that gave him many scars over the left part of his body . Zilchyn finally arrived in Mantol - Derith , where he hoped to begin a new life .

title: Zillak
description: Zillak Zillak was a member of House Baenre and an assassin in the service of the Archmage of Menzoberranzan Gromph Baenre in 1373 DR . History . Zillak was one of Gromph ' s most trusted agents .
description_long: Zillak Zillak was a member of House Baenre and an assassin in the service of the Archmage of Menzoberranzan Gromph Baenre in 1373 DR . History . Zillak was one of Gromph ' s most trusted agents . During the Siege of Menzoberranzan , his master , after being blinded in a fight with Nimor Imphraezl , requested the assistance of Zillak and the wizard Jaemas Xorlarrin to perform an eye transplant from a prisoner who was a member of House Agrach Dyrr .

title: Zilvreen
description: Zilvreen Zilvreen was one of the Wearers of Purple in the Cult of the Dragon . He was the master thief of the cult and a member of the Wearers of Purple council . He usually resided in Saerloon .
description_long: Zilvreen Zilvreen was one of the Wearers of Purple in the Cult of the Dragon . He was the master thief of the cult and a member of the Wearers of Purple council . He usually resided in Saerloon . He was one of the leaders who ordered the hunt for Shandril Shessair in 1357 DR .

title: Zilzmaer
description: Zilzmaer Zilzmaer was a drow warrior of House Faen Tlabbar , the fourth house of Menzoberranzan until the Silence of Lolth . History . Zilzmaer was one of the guards of Faen Tlabbar ' s complex .
description_long: Zilzmaer Zilzmaer was a drow warrior of House Faen Tlabbar , the fourth house of Menzoberranzan until the Silence of Lolth . History . Zilzmaer was one of the guards of Faen Tlabbar ' s complex . In 1372 , Nimor Imphraezl of the Jaezred Chaulssin infiltrated the complex . On the way he killed Zilzmaer .

title: Zima al - Hatik
description: Zima al - Hatik Zima al - Hatik was a sage who lived in Huzuz in 1367 DR . Description . Zima was a cranky old man .
description_long: Zima al - Hatik Zima al - Hatik was a sage who lived in Huzuz in 1367 DR . Description . Zima was a cranky old man . Activities . Zima was the proprietor of a rare book shop . Though he only made one appointment per night , he would meet with anyone at anytime if they had a rare book to sell . He charged 10 dinar for an appointment . The steep price helped eliminate foolish customers wasting his precious time . Possessions . Zima owned a pair of magical spectacles that he acquired from a Lantan merchant . The spectacles allowed him to glance at any page of a book and instantly commit it to memory . These wondrous spectacles gave Zima a degree of specialization in a huge variety of sage topics .

title: Zimrilim
description: Zimrilim Zimrilim was the ruler of Unthalass in Unther in 1357 DR . Activities . Zimrilim was the right hand of Gilgeam .
description_long: Zimrilim Zimrilim was the ruler of Unthalass in Unther in 1357 DR . Activities . Zimrilim was the right hand of Gilgeam . He planned to hire a great army of Chessenta n mercenaries to crush the revolt . Personality . Zimrilim was a brilliant man . He was well aware that he was the perfect scapegoat for the current situation and that many Great Lords wanted his position .

title: Zin
description: Zin Zin were spirit snakes that inhabited rivers and lake beds of Zakhara . They could shapeshift at will and enjoyed a good prank . Their bard ic nature meant they enjoyed spreading song and merriment , along with mischief , to those who traveled near their habitat .
description_long: Zin Zin were spirit snakes that inhabited rivers and lake beds of Zakhara . They could shapeshift at will and enjoyed a good prank . Their bard ic nature meant they enjoyed spreading song and merriment , along with mischief , to those who traveled near their habitat . Zin naturally appeared as large pale blue or green snakes . A mosaic pattern covered their back that provided excellent camouflage while they swam but made them easy to see while resting outside of water . Combat . Zin had infravision , which they used to move about during the night . They could polymorph at will and used this ability when interacting with travelers . All zin had basic magical abilities and enjoyed using a wide array of magical items found during their travels . A group of zin singing together could implement a unique magical power in their voice , making any spell cast extremely difficult to resist . The bite of a zin had a chance to make the target fall into a catatonic slumber for one full day . Upon waking , a victim would often find themselves completely naked and perilously close to the lair of a dangerous beast . Habitat / Society .

title: Zin - carla
description: Zin - carla Zin - carla , " spirit - wraith " in the Drow language , was a special type of undead created through a ritual performed by arachne . Lolth only granted the zin - carla ritual for specific tasks , which may never be purely to work revenge or bring harm on other drow . Failure brought the disfavor of Lolth .
description_long: Zin - carla Zin - carla , " spirit - wraith " in the Drow language , was a special type of undead created through a ritual performed by arachne . Lolth only granted the zin - carla ritual for specific tasks , which may never be purely to work revenge or bring harm on other drow . Failure brought the disfavor of Lolth . Zin - carla was , literally , the restoration of a spirit to that spirit ' s deceased body . For all intents and purposes , the spirit - wraith was the same as it was before death ; however , the thing ' s free will was repressed , and under the control of a matron mother .

title: Zin - carla ( spell )
description: Zin - carla ( spell ) Zin - carla was a practice of the drow , given only to those who have most pleased Lolth the Spider Queen . Zin - carla was a spell that could give a corpse a semblance of life . It was a more advanced form of reanimation where the reanimated corpse was not simply a mindless zombie , but retained all the capabilities it had while it was alive .
description_long: Zin - carla ( spell ) Zin - carla was a practice of the drow , given only to those who have most pleased Lolth the Spider Queen . Zin - carla was a spell that could give a corpse a semblance of life . It was a more advanced form of reanimation where the reanimated corpse was not simply a mindless zombie , but retained all the capabilities it had while it was alive . The corpse was also bound to do a single task , chosen by the person that reanimated it and approved by Lolth . To give the corpse the abilities it had while it was alive , the spirit of the person who the corpse belonged to in life was called to inhabit the body , but was given very little control over the corpse ' s actions beyond the use of its abilities . Zaknafein Do ' Urden , weapons master of House Do ' Urden was reanimated in this grisly way ten years after being killed in sacrifice to Lolth . Appendix . Appearances . Exile . In the book " Exile " by R . A . Salvatore , Shi ' nayne , Vierna Do ' Urden and the others of the house gathered . At the last moment , right before Matron Malice was about to kill Rizzen Do ' Urden , Malice stabbed Shi ' Nayne , actually SiNafay Hun ' ett through the heart .

title: Zindalankh
description: Zindalankh Zindalankh was a coastal city of Murghôm . Location . Zindalankh sat on the western rim of the Semphar Water within the southern portion of Gbor Nor .
description_long: Zindalankh Zindalankh was a coastal city of Murghôm . Location . Zindalankh sat on the western rim of the Semphar Water within the southern portion of Gbor Nor . History . Zindalankh was a fierce rival of Dhaztanar , which was located on the opposite bank of the Semphar Water in Semphar . Being located at the end of the Road of the Dawn , it controlled trade to the west , just as Dhaztanar controlled trade to the east , and both cities vied for control over the trade in Gbor Nor . Ultimately , Dhaztanar won the power struggle by lobbying to make the River Rauthenflow navigable by boats , allowing people to bypass Zindalankh , and sail straight from the Inner Sea to Dhaztanar ' s docks , destroying the city ' s power . By 1359 DR , Zindalankh had shrunk . Its fortunes were gone and its people were poor and destitute . The city became a haven for the pirates of Gbor Nor . People came to the city to sell stolen items , and buy others for far less than their value . Thievery , and the sword , were the only law . Though officially under the rule of the Bey of Murghom , few followed his laws , and only tolerated him for the protection he gave to the city .

title: Zindira
description: Zindira Zindira was a priestess of Eilistraee . Activities . Zindira was one of the Protectors of the Song in the Promenade of the Dark Maiden .
description_long: Zindira Zindira was a priestess of Eilistraee . Activities . Zindira was one of the Protectors of the Song in the Promenade of the Dark Maiden . History . In 1377 DR , she was one of the six protectors chosen by Cavatina Xarann to lead an assault on the main temple of Kiaransalee . In 1379 DR , Zindira was on guard at one the entrances of the Promenade when the - then immaterial Cavatina tried to call her attention .

title: Zinjir al - Muqi
description: Zinjir al - Muqi Zinjir al - Muqi , also known as the Twelvefold Master or the Shackle - breaker , was a wizard from Hiyal in 1367 DR . Activities . Zinjir was able to overcome the powerful magic used upon holy slayer s designed to keep them from breaking their oaths of silence .
description_long: Zinjir al - Muqi Zinjir al - Muqi , also known as the Twelvefold Master or the Shackle - breaker , was a wizard from Hiyal in 1367 DR . Activities . Zinjir was able to overcome the powerful magic used upon holy slayer s designed to keep them from breaking their oaths of silence .

title: Zinnirit Yauntyrr
description: Zinnirit Yauntyrr Zinnirit Yauntyrr was the former house wizard of House Yauntyrr of Eryndlyn . Description . Zinnirit was aged .
description_long: Zinnirit Yauntyrr Zinnirit Yauntyrr was the former house wizard of House Yauntyrr of Eryndlyn . Description . Zinnirit was aged . He normally wore spiky armor . He had red - orange eyes and his breath smelled of cinnamon and pipeweed . He was a powerful spellcaster and teleport er . History . Zinnirit was the house wizard of House Yauntyrr in Eryndlyn until its fall " circa " 1362 DR . While house wizard , he gave lessons , magical and otherwise , to Danifae Yauntyrr , a noble daughter of the house . < After his house ' s destruction , he fled to Sschindylryn , where he obtained a gatehouse with three portal s , which he protected with zombie s . In 1373 DR , Zinnirit was approached by Danifae , who had been taken as a battle captive by Halisstra Melarn of Ched Nasad . Danifae had had a " binding " placed on her , which she had Zinnirit remove . She then killed him and took his " ring of teleportation " , which had originally belonged to her mother .

title: Zinzerena
description: Zinzerena Zinzerena was the drow goddess of chaos and assassins until Lolth killed her and took her portfolio . Her symbol is a shortsword draped in a black cloak , symbolizing her hidden menace . Zinzerena was a female drow illusionist and assassin of supreme skill .
description_long: Zinzerena Zinzerena was the drow goddess of chaos and assassins until Lolth killed her and took her portfolio . Her symbol is a shortsword draped in a black cloak , symbolizing her hidden menace . Zinzerena was a female drow illusionist and assassin of supreme skill . Her mother faked her death in order to smuggle her away from the priestesses of Lolth . She grew in power , studying alone as an illusionist and assassin specializing in the use of poison and disguise . Zinzerena plotted against Lolth much like Vhaeraun does , opposing her tyrannical methods . At one time she resided in Menzoberranzan . Lolth killed her during or shortly after the Time of Troubles and now uses her name and image as a disguise , attracting rebels and dissidents to her own worship through this ruse . Rumors . There has been rumors of Lolth killing an illusory Zinzerena . That Zinzerena has since then been in hiding and only a select few Drow know of her continued survival . She is greatly reduced in her abilities , as she had to make the copy real enough to fool a Goddess . As of 1484 DR , Zinzerena ' s followers have started to move again .

title: Ziose
description: Ziose Ziose was the name given by sages to a particularly transparent variety of rosaline . Description . Ziose was a rare mineral that yielded facet - grade stones that flashed three different colors depending on how the light refracted through them or at what angle they were viewed — purple , blue , and red , or purple , green , and red ( see Gallery ) .
description_long: Ziose Ziose was the name given by sages to a particularly transparent variety of rosaline . Description . Ziose was a rare mineral that yielded facet - grade stones that flashed three different colors depending on how the light refracted through them or at what angle they were viewed — purple , blue , and red , or purple , green , and red ( see Gallery ) . Very large ( fist - , foot - , or human - head sized ) specimens of these fancy stones were sometimes found and prized for use in pendants by very tall humans , demihumans , and humanoids . A typical stone had a base value of 100 gp . Powers . A ziose gem could fire multiple barrages of " magic missile s " at the command of the last creature to touch it , provided that creature had intelligence and knowledge of this ability . This being had to be within a few yards ( meters ) of the gemstone and only had to will it to happen . Salvos of missiles would continue for a few minutes and then cease . The ziose could not be activated again until it had time to recharge .

title: Ziran
description: Ziran Ziran or bloodfast was a magical drug made from a number of subterranean fungi . The drow were the first to produce it . Description .
description_long: Ziran Ziran or bloodfast was a magical drug made from a number of subterranean fungi . The drow were the first to produce it . Description . It was eaten as either as a white powder or as a tablet . Uses . Upon ingestion , ziran left one dazed for several seconds . After about a minute , ziran heightened the base agility and reflexes of its user for one to three hours . After the aforementioned boost ended , the user experienced a feeling of detachment or an out - of - body experience , as though they were looking at themselves from a distance . Their body , meanwhile , suffer real physical damage , though not of an irrecoverable nature . Overdosing on Ziran was easy . When a person took two doses during the same day , they took a greater benefit but also suffered greater physical damage . While one could recover from the physical strain with sufficient rest , overdosing too often could lead to death . Ziran was highly addictive . Users . The drug was known to the drow and was distributed among the military , for example among those of House Jaelre . Valas Jaelre , second cousin to Jezz the Lame , was a known producer of ziran alongside Kammarth .

title: Zircon
description: Zircon Zircon was a mineral that could be cut into faceted gem s . Description . Zircon was volcanic in origin , found in igneous rock formations .
description_long: Zircon Zircon was a mineral that could be cut into faceted gem s . Description . Zircon was volcanic in origin , found in igneous rock formations . It was a brownish crystal that turned pale blue when heated sufficiently and could be cut into faceted gemstones . Zircons were sometimes substituted for more valuable gems to fool the uninitiated , but anyone with a passing knowledge of gemology ( a jeweler , a dwarf , or even a seasoned adventurer ) could notice the difference . Zircons had an affinity for magic and could be enchanted easily , making them a favorite for use in creating . A typical specimen had a base value of 50 gp .

title: Ziss al - Waran
description: Ziss al - Waran Ziss al - Waran , or Ziss the Lizard , was a lizardfolk merchant living in Huzuz , the City of Delights , in 1367 DR . Description . Green scales covered Ziss ' skin .
description_long: Ziss al - Waran Ziss al - Waran , or Ziss the Lizard , was a lizardfolk merchant living in Huzuz , the City of Delights , in 1367 DR . Description . Green scales covered Ziss ' skin . She tattooed herself with several geometric patterns . Activities . Ziss specialized in the sale of trained monkey s . She cared deeply for the animals and refused to sell them to anyone known to mistreat animals . She would even refuse to sell one of her monkeys to anyone who had recently purchased one , believing that these people were only using her animals to trigger traps while adventuring . Though she maintained a stall in the Grand Bazaar , Ziss often roamed the city with a dozen of her monkeys on leashes , luring potential customers with their tricks . Ziss ' monkeys were very well - trained . They were capable of obeying an impressive number of commands and , for an additional fee , could even be trained in more elicit ventures such as pick - pocketing . History . Ziss first came to Huzuz in 1347 DR via a spelljamming vessel with some other lizardfolk . Relationships . Ziss had two sons — Zina and Kreel .

title: Zither
description: Zither The zither was a stringed instrument with a flat box as its resonating body . It was played by plucking its strings , usually on a table . Description .
description_long: Zither The zither was a stringed instrument with a flat box as its resonating body . It was played by plucking its strings , usually on a table . Description . Zithers were described as having the clear and beautiful sound of dulcimer s and the flexibility of yarting s . Their lower strings were fretted and the upper strings were tuned in fourths in order to be played with the thumb of the strumming hand . They were available for purchase through " Aurora ' s Whole Realms Catalogue " . Distribution . The use of the zither was gaining more and more popularity in Faerûn around 1367 DR , while it was long established in the lands of Zakhara . Zakharan rawun s also used the variants of the lap zither and the qanun . Religious significance . The zither was the symbol of the Zakharan deity of music , Bala . In religious iconography , the goddess herself was depicted playing that instrument .

title: Zitli
description: Zitli Zitli was the high priest of Zaltec in Palul . History . In 1361 DR , his prime assistant was Shatil , brother of Erixitl .
description_long: Zitli Zitli was the high priest of Zaltec in Palul . History . In 1361 DR , his prime assistant was Shatil , brother of Erixitl . Zitli conspired with the Nexal high priest Hoxitl in order to arrange an ambush against the Golden Legion at Palul . Under Shatil ' s suggestion , Zitli decided to use Erixitl as a translator . He and Zitli were at Zaltec ' s pyramid during the false party . However , when the legionaries started attacking the hidden Nexalan warriors , it became clear that they had uncovered the plot . Zitli sacrificed his life to allow Shatil to escape via a secret passage in order to explain the situation to Hoxitl .

title: Ziyero Ridge
description: Ziyero Ridge Ziyero Ridge , also called Zigero Range , was a mountain range running through Koguryo in Koryo . Locations . The vast Dang Caverns lay beneath the range ' s northern tip .
description_long: Ziyero Ridge Ziyero Ridge , also called Zigero Range , was a mountain range running through Koguryo in Koryo . Locations . The vast Dang Caverns lay beneath the range ' s northern tip . Creatures . The mountains were heavily populated by foo dog s , foo lion s , and griffon s . It was not uncommon for dauntless folk to try to steal a pup , cub , or egg of these creatures in order to raise it as a dangerous yet loyal mount .

title: Zo
description: Zo Zo was the proprietor of the Lord Cyric ' s Bane tavern in Priapurl on the Dragon Coast in 1372 DR . Personality . Formerly a priest of Bane , Zo claimed he became disinterested in the politics of the Zhentarim and vowed to become an honest citizen instead .
description_long: Zo Zo was the proprietor of the Lord Cyric ' s Bane tavern in Priapurl on the Dragon Coast in 1372 DR . Personality . Formerly a priest of Bane , Zo claimed he became disinterested in the politics of the Zhentarim and vowed to become an honest citizen instead .

title: Zoartik
description: Zoartik Zoartik was one of the most violent mind flayer s of Ch ' Chitl in 1370 DR . Personality . Zoartik suffered from a mental problem : he could not completely sublimate the mind of his original drow host .
description_long: Zoartik Zoartik was one of the most violent mind flayer s of Ch ' Chitl in 1370 DR . Personality . Zoartik suffered from a mental problem : he could not completely sublimate the mind of his original drow host . This caused homicidal reactions every time that Zoartik saw drow or even drow - made items . Unconsciously , Zoartik was trying to finally suppress the remains of the drow personality

title: Zobeida bint Maneira
description: Zobeida bint Maneira Zobeida bint Maneira was a sorcerer within the Palace of the Enlightened Throne in Huzuz , the City of Delights , in 1367 DR . Activities . Zobeida served as an assistant of the Grand Vizier , Alyana al - Azzazi .
description_long: Zobeida bint Maneira Zobeida bint Maneira was a sorcerer within the Palace of the Enlightened Throne in Huzuz , the City of Delights , in 1367 DR . Activities . Zobeida served as an assistant of the Grand Vizier , Alyana al - Azzazi . She was particular skilled with warding magic .

title: Zochimaloc
description: Zochimaloc Zochimaloc was the ruler of Tulom - Itzi in 1361 DR . Personality . He was very wise and knew much concerning the coming of the Golden Legion in Maztica , but was very enigmatic in speaking about it .
description_long: Zochimaloc Zochimaloc was the ruler of Tulom - Itzi in 1361 DR . Personality . He was very wise and knew much concerning the coming of the Golden Legion in Maztica , but was very enigmatic in speaking about it . History . He ordered the kidnapping of Gultec , a young Jaguar Knight from Payit , and transported him to his city . There , Zochimaloc tutored Gultec , who , thanks to this training , learned to use all of his hidden powers . Just before the Night of Wailing , he encouraged Gultec to go to Nexal . Zochimaloc died destroying the Darien ' s army of giant ant s .

title: Zofia
description: Zofia Zofia ( often named with her title as Zofia Othlor , which meant " elder among witches " ) was one of the Witches of Rashemen and an oracle and elder of the witches in her community in Dernovia , Rashemen . Description . Zofia was old and plump and had blue eyes .
description_long: Zofia Zofia ( often named with her title as Zofia Othlor , which meant " elder among witches " ) was one of the Witches of Rashemen and an oracle and elder of the witches in her community in Dernovia , Rashemen . Description . Zofia was old and plump and had blue eyes . History . In 1360 DR , after the Battle of Immil Dale , Zofia deemed Fyodor a " nydeshka " ( " blunt sword , " meaning he was dangerous to others ) , but rather than sending him to his death , she gave him the quest to return the Windwalker amulet to Rashemen . Relationships . Zofia had a twin sister , Zhanna . who bore the Mask of Danigar and who was killed at the Watchtower by the Red Wizards of Thay in 1360 DR . Zofia ' s eldest son was Mahryon , who was killed at the Battle of Immil Dale . His son was Fyodor , who was thus Zofia ' s own grandson . Zofia had been acquainted with Sylune , Witch of Shadowdale , before her passing .

title: Zokan Thunderer
description: Zokan Thunderer Zokan Thunderer was the chieftain of the Elk Tribe of the Uthgardt Personality . Zokan was well known for his barbaric exaggeration . He was regarded as possibly the ugliest , rudest , richest , wiliest , and the most feared and hated bandit leader in the North .
description_long: Zokan Thunderer Zokan Thunderer was the chieftain of the Elk Tribe of the Uthgardt Personality . Zokan was well known for his barbaric exaggeration . He was regarded as possibly the ugliest , rudest , richest , wiliest , and the most feared and hated bandit leader in the North . Activities . His warriors raided incessantly , at least where the usual tribal migrations of the Elk took them , which ranged around the Evermoors and the plains east of the Dessarin . Under Zokan , almost any traveler or region was fair game , including other Uthgardt tribes . They were suspected of having links to Luskan , and under Zokan cleric s of Talos gained ground . He worshiped Auril and Talos .

title: Zola Sethrakt
description: Zola Sethrakt Zola Sethrakt was a necromancer and a member of the council of zulkirs during the war of Thay . Appearance . Zola was a youthful - looking woman , appearing quite comely .
description_long: Zola Sethrakt Zola Sethrakt was a necromancer and a member of the council of zulkirs during the war of Thay . Appearance . Zola was a youthful - looking woman , appearing quite comely . She never went anywhere without numerous bone and jet ornaments swinging from her neck and sliding on her arms . As a result , a clatter accompanied her every breath . Activities . Zola was the representative of a small group of necromancers in the council of zulkirs during the war of Thay . These mages evaded Szass Tam ' s control but were not the most powerful or even intelligent of their order . History . When it became apparent that a war against Szass Tam could not be won , Nevron had her killed by one of his demon s , being annoyed of her constant claims to be his equal as zulkir .

title: Zombie
description: Zombie A zombie is an undead creature usually created by the re - animation of a corpse . Unlike animated skeletons , zombies still retain some flesh on their bodies , and give off a horrid , rank smell . They are almost mindless , but can be given simple commands , such as " kill anyone who opens the treasure chest .
description_long: Zombie A zombie is an undead creature usually created by the re - animation of a corpse . Unlike animated skeletons , zombies still retain some flesh on their bodies , and give off a horrid , rank smell . They are almost mindless , but can be given simple commands , such as " kill anyone who opens the treasure chest . " Virtually any solid creature can be turned into a zombie ; in addition to humanoids , troglodytes , minotaurs , and even beholders can turned into zombies . Zombies drag their feet and so do not leave clear prints . Basically , a zombie is the corpse of a creature which has been animated by someone who can manipulate negative energy , such as a cleric . For example , a cleric would be able to use negative energy on a corpse and make it move its body , arms , legs , etc .

title: Zomir
description: Zomir Zomir was a Calishite human bounty hunter active in 1357 DR . He was one of a trio of bounty hunters hired by Baron Abon Duum of Manshaka to recover or slay the escaped slave - gladiator Vajra Valmeyjar . In 1357 DR , they went to the Selûne ' s Smile in Waterdeep and used a poison dart and a club to subdue Vajra and kidnap her , though even beaten and drugged she put up a fight .
description_long: Zomir Zomir was a Calishite human bounty hunter active in 1357 DR . He was one of a trio of bounty hunters hired by Baron Abon Duum of Manshaka to recover or slay the escaped slave - gladiator Vajra Valmeyjar . In 1357 DR , they went to the Selûne ' s Smile in Waterdeep and used a poison dart and a club to subdue Vajra and kidnap her , though even beaten and drugged she put up a fight . Conner , Timoth Eyesbright , and Salabak eventually caught up with the band , distracted them with the illusion of a dracolich , and slew them with arrows , rescuing Vajra .

title: Zomith
description: Zomith Zomith was a half - orc caravan guard during the Elemental Evil crisis . Activities . Zomith worked as a caravan guard .
description_long: Zomith Zomith was a half - orc caravan guard during the Elemental Evil crisis . Activities . Zomith worked as a caravan guard . History . In 1491 DR , Zomith was one of the guards of a diplomatic caravan from Mirabar passing through the Dessarin Valley . However , she quit the caravan at Beliard and went alone to Red Larch . There , at the Helm at Highsun tavern , Zomith discovered that the caravan had since gone missing , but did not care .

title: Zone of sweet air
description: Zone of sweet air Zone of sweet air was an abjuration spell that protected a large area from unhealthy vapors . Effects . All natural and magical ( e .
description_long: Zone of sweet air Zone of sweet air was an abjuration spell that protected a large area from unhealthy vapors . Effects . All natural and magical ( e . g . , " stinking cloud " ) poisonous or otherwise damaging gasses are blocked by this spell , except those from dragon breath . Fresh air could get through without hindrance . The barrier was invisible to the naked eye and only prevented the entry of noxious vapors . If any fumes were present when the spell was cast , or created inside the area of protection , they were unaffected . However , the duration of such spells as " stinking cloud " was cut in half by this spell . Components . In addition to verbal and somatic components , this spell required the priest ' s holy symbol or divine focus , a strand of spider silk , and a silk handkerchief .

title: Zone of truth
description: Zone of truth Zone of truth was an enchantment spell that prevented lies from being spoken within the area of effect . Effects . For a few minutes , an area designated by the caster became a no - lie zone .
description_long: Zone of truth Zone of truth was an enchantment spell that prevented lies from being spoken within the area of effect . Effects . For a few minutes , an area designated by the caster became a no - lie zone . Creatures within the area knew they were being compelled not to speak falsehoods , and could resist the spell , but those who could not resist could not lie for the duration of the spell . Note that affected creatures were not compelled to tell the truth ; they could remain silent or evade questions as long as they were truthful . The area of effect was either a square with sides as big as 5 ft ( 1 . 5 m ) per level of the caster , or a 20 ft ( 6 . 1 m ) radius sphere , depending on which version was being cast . Components . In addition to verbal and somatic components , and the priest ' s holy symbol or divine focus , the older version of this spell required a cheap imitation emerald , ruby , or diamond to cast .

title: Zook
description: Zook Zook was a yellow faerie dragon in Cormanthor . Activities . The goddess Mielikki herself tasked Zook with a mission to protect the Cormanthor forest .
description_long: Zook Zook was a yellow faerie dragon in Cormanthor . Activities . The goddess Mielikki herself tasked Zook with a mission to protect the Cormanthor forest . History . During the Rage of Demons , a family of jackalwere s established themselves in the area and Zook didn ' t have the power to defeat them , so sge used her magic powers to scare away people until an adventuring party arrived . Personality . Zook was a little too serious for a faerie dragon . Although she enjoyed a joke at someone else ' s expense as much as the next faerie dragon , Zook just didn ' t laugh for quite as long . Zook liked company , so her tactic of scaring of people away was difficult for her . Relationship . Zook was an ally of the Harpers .

title: Zoran Baenre
description: Zoran Baenre Zoran Baenre was a member of House Baenre who was a second - year apprentice at Sorcere " circa " 1373 DR . Gromph considered him annoying . History .
description_long: Zoran Baenre Zoran Baenre was a member of House Baenre who was a second - year apprentice at Sorcere " circa " 1373 DR . Gromph considered him annoying . History . He was one of the Baenre magic - users that Gromph Baenre gathered during the Siege of Menzoberranzan for an attack on Nimor Imphraezl through a scrying crystal .

title: Zorkh
description: Zorkh Zorkh was a stone giant hermit sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . Description . Zorkh was mute ; he could understand the Giant language but could not speak .
description_long: Zorkh Zorkh was a stone giant hermit sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . Description . Zorkh was mute ; he could understand the Giant language but could not speak . Activities . Zorkh lived as hermit in the Greypeak Mountains . He was always followed by six goat s . He reacted friendlily to people . History . In the late 1480s or early 1490s DR , the stone giants of Thane Kayalithica destroyed every building of the village Orlbar . Afterward , Zorkh decided to collect all the stones of the destroyed buildings , stacking them in creative ways , thus obtaining a " forest " of piled - up stones .

title: Zormarq
description: Zormarq Zormarq the Phantyrant was the last beholder hive mother of Ooltul , who survived as an undead doomsphere in 1370 DR . History . Zormarq was the last beholder hive mother to claim the title of ocularch .
description_long: Zormarq Zormarq the Phantyrant was the last beholder hive mother of Ooltul , who survived as an undead doomsphere in 1370 DR . History . Zormarq was the last beholder hive mother to claim the title of ocularch . Her survival , although as an undead , and her continued ability to use clerical powers seemed miraculous and retained a measure of her authority about the Hive . Her plan was obviously to reconquer Ooltul from the phaerimm . In 1370 DR , her drow agents found the mythical artifact Yuthla , the Eye of the Beholder , an artifact created by Menzoberra the Kinless which fallen into Zhent hands , but they lost it before going back to their master ' s lair . Her agents , the Zhentarim , and the agents of many beholders competed to find it again . If Zormarq found it , she would rally the Anaurian Hive under herself .

title: Zorquan
description: Zorquan Zorquan ( pronounced " ZORE - kwon " ) was the neutral dragon god of dragon kind and " dragonness " , that is , the essence of what it was to be a dragon . Zorquan was supposed to encompass all alignments dragonkind could have , but was often regarded as neutral . Description .
description_long: Zorquan Zorquan ( pronounced " ZORE - kwon " ) was the neutral dragon god of dragon kind and " dragonness " , that is , the essence of what it was to be a dragon . Zorquan was supposed to encompass all alignments dragonkind could have , but was often regarded as neutral . Description . Myths held that Zorquan could take the form of a perfect specimen of whatever species of dragonkind he wished to . His eyes crackled with sparks , sometimes spitting lightning bolts that flashed and cracked around his body . Realm . It was believed Zorquan had a castle in the Prime Material Plane . Legends told of dragons with the temerity to visit his halls , but gave no details on how to get there . History . It was widely believed that it was Zorquan who influenced the dragon ' s apathy toward their gods during the Time of Dragons , as a way to stop the wars between the different religious factions of dragons , as those wars threatened to extinguish the whole dragon population of Toril . Worshipers . Members of all species of dragonkind worshiped Zorquan . Dogma .

title: Zosker Anthalar
description: Zosker Anthalar Zosker Anthalar was a sage in Escalant , Thay . Personality . Anthalar believed there was a great need for strong and brave companions to fight evil during the Year of the Shadows .
description_long: Zosker Anthalar Zosker Anthalar was a sage in Escalant , Thay . Personality . Anthalar believed there was a great need for strong and brave companions to fight evil during the Year of the Shadows . History . In 1358 DR , as part of a speech to the city ' s council , Zosker said :

title: Zotha
description: Zotha Zotha was a godlike being who , according to the " Book of the World " , created a Crystal Sun at the beginning of time , while the god Asgorath created Toril . Asgorath casted Zotha down from the heavens , and Zotha was not mentioned again . Historically , Asgorath actually casted down an " ice moon , " to the surface of Abeir - Toril in an event known as the Tearfall , wiping out the Batrachi civilization and creating the Sea of Fallen Stars .
description_long: Zotha Zotha was a godlike being who , according to the " Book of the World " , created a Crystal Sun at the beginning of time , while the god Asgorath created Toril . Asgorath casted Zotha down from the heavens , and Zotha was not mentioned again . Historically , Asgorath actually casted down an " ice moon , " to the surface of Abeir - Toril in an event known as the Tearfall , wiping out the Batrachi civilization and creating the Sea of Fallen Stars . Some scholars from Candlekeep had the theory that this ice moon was one of the Tears of Selûne .

title: Zrie Prakis
description: Zrie Prakis Zrie Prakis was a lich . History . Zrie Prakis lived several centuries before the 14th century DR .
description_long: Zrie Prakis Zrie Prakis was a lich . History . Zrie Prakis lived several centuries before the 14th century DR . He fell in love with Cassana but parted ways with her early in their careers . When they were reunited , they developed a hateful rivalry to see who had become stronger in the time they had been apart . This rivalry ended with his death at Cassana ' s hands . Cassana kept his remains at her side until she transformed him into a lich , and developed a magical wand to keep him in check and as her salve . All the while , he quietly plotted Cassana ' s destruction but was unable to act upon those plans . Zrie was destroyed in 1357 DR during the final confrontation with Alias and her allies when the wand that Cassana used to bind him was destroyed by being thrown into another dimension , severing his link to the dark energies that sustained him . Personality . Like his former lover , Zrie was vain and hateful . Description . Zrie appeared as most liches do . He had taut age - worn translucent skin stretched over his bones . His hollow black eye sockets each contained a pinpoint of evil red light .

title: Zrintor
description: Zrintor Zrintor , also known as the Viper Forest , was a region on the 45th layer of the Abyss that was populated by viper tree s . Geography . Located somewhere along the banks of the River of Salt , Zrintor was a salty marsh pockmarked by pits of " quicksalt " .
description_long: Zrintor Zrintor , also known as the Viper Forest , was a region on the 45th layer of the Abyss that was populated by viper tree s . Geography . Located somewhere along the banks of the River of Salt , Zrintor was a salty marsh pockmarked by pits of " quicksalt " . A road passed through it leading to the city of Zelatar . The forest was devoid of animal life due to the viper trees which attacked and ate most anything that wandered into the forest . Atmosphere . The 45th layer of the Abyss was a gloomy place where the sunlight was similar to that during an eclipse — muted . Sights and sounds were also muted throughout this layer , making details difficult to notice in the grayness . Being stealthy was easier here , with plenty of shadows to hide in and inadvertent noises absorbed . On the other hand , it was easier to be surprised by a sneak attack for the same reasons .

title: Zstulkk Ssarmn
description: Zstulkk Ssarmn Zstulkk Ssarmn was a slaver of Skullport and one of the founders of the Iron Ring . Description . Zstulkk Ssarmn ' s head closely resembled a human , but the rest of his body was that of a large snake with no arms or legs .
description_long: Zstulkk Ssarmn Zstulkk Ssarmn was a slaver of Skullport and one of the founders of the Iron Ring . Description . Zstulkk Ssarmn ' s head closely resembled a human , but the rest of his body was that of a large snake with no arms or legs . He wore a magical neckband that made him appear fully human with a low - sloping forehead but with skin that did not quite conceal a pattern of scales . Possessions . In order to appear human , Zstulkk had a magical neckband that altered his appearance . He was also known to wear a " brooch of shielding " and a " ring of protection + 2 " . Relationships . The leaders of the consortium , known as the Lords of Iron , were reluctant partners at best and despised enemies at worst , but worked together enough to make a successful slave trade organization , all the while scheming to take control of the consortium for themselves . In Nightal 1369 DR , Zstulkk Ssarmn threatened another Lord of Iron , Ahmaergo of the Xanathar Thieves ' Guild , in front of the general populace and then later that night staged a symbolic attack on Ahmaergo ' s residence using yuan - ti agents .

title: Zthyz al - Zin
description: Zthyz al - Zin Zthyz al - Zin was a zin living among the waters of the River of Gold on the Island of Gardens in 1367 DR . Personality . Zthyz enjoyed playing tricks and pranks on any visitors to the River of Gold .
description_long: Zthyz al - Zin Zthyz al - Zin was a zin living among the waters of the River of Gold on the Island of Gardens in 1367 DR . Personality . Zthyz enjoyed playing tricks and pranks on any visitors to the River of Gold . Activities . Zthyz would confront anyone attempting to take water from the river , claiming to be a servant of the great noble marid s .

title: Zuggtmoy
description: Zuggtmoy Zuggtmoy , also know as the Demon Queen of Fungi , and the Lady of Rot and Decay , was a demon lord . Activities . Her only desire was to infect living creatures with her spores , making them her mindless slaves and , eventually , into rotting and decomposing hosts for mushrooms , moulds and spores that she spawned .
description_long: Zuggtmoy Zuggtmoy , also know as the Demon Queen of Fungi , and the Lady of Rot and Decay , was a demon lord . Activities . Her only desire was to infect living creatures with her spores , making them her mindless slaves and , eventually , into rotting and decomposing hosts for mushrooms , moulds and spores that she spawned . Zuggtmoy ' s lair was Shedaklah , a massive palace of two dozen mushrooms , all interconnected with bridges and lined with countless chambers and tunnels . It was located on the same layer as Juiblex ' s Slime Pit . The Demon Queen of Fungi and the Faceless Lord were driven by their insatiable hunger to destroy and devour others . Description . This foul demoness resembles a human only from the torso up . This portion of her body is composed of thick rancid sheets and coils of fungus that just happens to have grown into the shape of what would , otherwise , be an attractive woman . Four fibrous antlers grow from her brow , and her hands bear cruel talons . Her lower torso is a coiling pillar of lashing ropey tentacles and other fungus growths . Her skin is a nauseating swirl of greys , blues , purples and blacks .

title: Zukimoto Chikitada
description: Zukimoto Chikitada Zukimoto Chikitada was a samurai in Wa . Personality . Zukimoto was deeply loyal to his master but never admitted it to anyone .
description_long: Zukimoto Chikitada Zukimoto Chikitada was a samurai in Wa . Personality . Zukimoto was deeply loyal to his master but never admitted it to anyone . He cared a lot about Hiro ' s safety . He always looked as if everything displeased him . At times of laughter , he only showed a less grunting face . Activities . Zukimoto was the right - hand man , aide , and secretary of the lord Hiro Matsu . He also acted as leader of his bodyguards . History . Zukimoto went together with his master to Aru .

title: Zulifein T ' orgh
description: Zulifein T ' orgh Zulifein T ' orgh held the position of secondwizard of a group belonging to Clan Auzkovyn in 1372 DR . History . Zulifein T ' orgh was born in Sshamath and enjoyed a privileged life as a wizard .
description_long: Zulifein T ' orgh Zulifein T ' orgh held the position of secondwizard of a group belonging to Clan Auzkovyn in 1372 DR . History . Zulifein T ' orgh was born in Sshamath and enjoyed a privileged life as a wizard . At some point , he grew bored and started torturing and murdering , first animals but gradually escalating to citizens of his city . His father bribed city guards to keep him out of trouble , until he killed a favored slave and pet of a powerful wizard called Ryld Corborel . He had to flee and managed to escape to the surface , where joined Clan Auzkovyn . The group he joined with lost its leader in a fight against Lolth - worshipers and he was pressured to lead but he didn ' t want the responsibility . In fact , he was glad that the Widower appeared to relieve him of this burden before he had to carry it . He gained the position of secondwizard under the Widower and when he left , he was the one who inherited the " Obsul Ssussun " to use it in the fight against Lolth . He had other plans . After leaving the ranger Divolg Lun with the burden of leadership , he left for Sshamath , remaining incognito through the " elf disguise " spell .

title: Zulkir
description: Zulkir Zulkir was a title of power among the Red Wizards of Thay . There were eight zulkirs , one for each School of Magic ; together they ruled the Red Wizards and , by extension , Thay itself . They did not directly control the country , as the day - to - day governing was left to the tharchion s .
description_long: Zulkir Zulkir was a title of power among the Red Wizards of Thay . There were eight zulkirs , one for each School of Magic ; together they ruled the Red Wizards and , by extension , Thay itself . They did not directly control the country , as the day - to - day governing was left to the tharchion s . However , they had the ears of the tharchions , and " what the zulkirs want , they get " . This truth explains many of the failures of Thay — as there was no one ruler of the Red Wizards , the constant in - fighting among the zulkirs often resulted in ruined plans . Zulkirs held their positions for life , or until he or she renounced the title . When a position opened , wizards of the same school of magic selected the replacement , but often other zulkirs tried to sway the election , making the appointment an intrigue - filled and ruthless event . As of 1385 DR the zulkirs were : All the remaining zulkirs were killed in 1478 DR while stopping Szass Tam ' s plan to destroy the multiverse and build it anew as he saw fit .

title: Zulkoon
description: Zulkoon A zulkoon was a wind musical instrument that functioned like a portable pump organ . Description . A zulkoon player pumped air into the instrument and through its organ pipes using a foot pump .
description_long: Zulkoon A zulkoon was a wind musical instrument that functioned like a portable pump organ . Description . A zulkoon player pumped air into the instrument and through its organ pipes using a foot pump . This produced a droning sound over other notes due to the constant flow of air through the instrument and conferred it a sinister and dramatic sound . Zulkoons were available for purchase through " Aurora ' s Whole Realms Catalogue " . History . Zulkoons were created by the zulkir s of Thay and were used originally to aid in the casting of spells .

title: Zundaerazylym
description: Zundaerazylym Zundaerazylym , or Amundra Nelaerdra , was an ancient steel dragon in Neverwinter in 1374 DR . History . Zundaerazylym came to believe that the two greatest menaces to the North were the harsh climate and orc hordes .
description_long: Zundaerazylym Zundaerazylym , or Amundra Nelaerdra , was an ancient steel dragon in Neverwinter in 1374 DR . History . Zundaerazylym came to believe that the two greatest menaces to the North were the harsh climate and orc hordes . She decided that her duty was to resolve the orc problem . So , circa 1344 DR , Zundaerazylym hatched a plan : to manipulate the evil dragon s to make their lairs in orc territories in order that they would fight each other , and to use alchemy make it easier for good dragons to live in harmony with humanoid races . Understanding that for so great a plan she needed help , Zundaerazylym adopted the disguise of " Amundra Nelaerdra " , a laundress living and working at the Moonstone Mask , and using this alias she started recruiting agents to spread rumors to attract evil dragons to orc territories . She named her organization the Soft Claws . In 1374 DR , Zundaerazylym was busy in her alchemical research , which had created some substances useful for good dragons . Relationship . Zundaerazylym ' s most trusted friend and ally was Ophala Cheldarstorn , her boss at the Moonstone Mask , and one of the few that knew her true nature .

title: Zundbridge
description: Zundbridge Zundbridge was a massive , squat bridge located about 10 miles southeast of Waterdeep , where the Trade Way crossed the Dessarin River . The bridge was named after the wizard Zund , who created it . As of 1370 DR , the bridge had held firm without repairs for more than 90 winters .
description_long: Zundbridge Zundbridge was a massive , squat bridge located about 10 miles southeast of Waterdeep , where the Trade Way crossed the Dessarin River . The bridge was named after the wizard Zund , who created it . As of 1370 DR , the bridge had held firm without repairs for more than 90 winters . Waterdeep maintained a castle there on a rocky outcropping above the river gorge . The castle ' s outer wall protected a large area used to inspect caravans while the inner wall protected garrison buildings . The castle had three griffons at its disposal . Zund was said to have used a stone golem to build the bridge , and over the years many have sought to find it and command it .

title: Zuras el Ireen
description: Zuras el Ireen Zuras el Ireen was the Grand Yrshelem of Ships of the Rundeen in 1370 DR . History . Zuras started as a pirate in service to the Rundeen .
description_long: Zuras el Ireen Zuras el Ireen was the Grand Yrshelem of Ships of the Rundeen in 1370 DR . History . Zuras started as a pirate in service to the Rundeen . When he became bored of life at sea , he asked his masters for permission to join a shipping business . In five years , Zuras became the leader of the shipping business and so , with the blessing of the Rundeen , he started a new shipping business in an other city . His business skills and his pirate contacts guaranteed a premier position for his company in that city . Slowly , Zuras retired from the company , which remained in the control of his heirs , and started overseeing all shipping business for the Rundeen . It was only natural in 1357 DR to promote Zuras to Grand Yrshelem of Ships when his predecessor died of old age .

title: Zurkhwood
description: Zurkhwood Zurkhwood was a fungus that grew in the Underdark . It had edible spores and the tree - like stems could be used as a building material . Description .
description_long: Zurkhwood Zurkhwood was a fungus that grew in the Underdark . It had edible spores and the tree - like stems could be used as a building material . Description . Zurkhwood mushrooms grew 30 – 40 ft ( 9 . 1 – 12 m ) tall when in a cavern with enough height . The stems were hard and sturdy like wood . When cut , it exhibited unique patterns , analogous to the grain found in lumber . Uses . Zurkhwood was primarily used as a building material . Its long stems could be used to make bridges and skilled carpenters could use it to make furniture , shipping containers , and almost anything that could be made from wood . Zurkhwood floated in water and could also be used to make boats and rafts . The woody substance could be sanded , stained , and polished to bring out the decorative patterns in the heart of the mushroom stem . The spores of the zurkhwood were large , like grains of wheat , and if harvested from a typical specimen , yielded 5 to 8 pounds ( 2 . 3 to 3 . 6 kilograms ) of food .

title: Zvopua
description: Zvopua Zvopua was a foulwing involved in the Zhent invasion of Shadowdale in 1375 DR . History . Zvopua was the loyal mount of the high ranking member of Zhentarim Eregul the Freestave ; like his master Zvopua was part of the Zhentarim Occupation Army in Shadowdale in 1375 .
description_long: Zvopua Zvopua was a foulwing involved in the Zhent invasion of Shadowdale in 1375 DR . History . Zvopua was the loyal mount of the high ranking member of Zhentarim Eregul the Freestave ; like his master Zvopua was part of the Zhentarim Occupation Army in Shadowdale in 1375 . Eregul and Zvopua were escorting a Zhent supply caravan when they were attacked by some adventurers and Eregul and Zvopua were killed .

title: Zwei
description: Zwei Zwei was the first Netherese arcanist to be credited with the creation of new spells . The variator introduced the three successively more powerful " extension " spells in the years 1280 to 1300 NY of Netheril ' s Silver Age . All other facts about Zwei ' s life ( including his or her gender ) were lost to history .

The Zweihausen were a pair of enormous houses on Netherese territory that were destroyed during the rise of human civilization . It is not known if Zwei was related to the Zweihausen or the namesake Zweihaus River .

title: Zyl
description: Zyl Zyl was a fire spirit in the service of the Stag King , a dark fey lord who lived in Ashenwood forest . He was sent by the Stag King to spy on a stronghold in the Feywild that belonged to a tribe of cyclops and their fomorian queen . Zyl had shapechanged into the form of a giant rat but was captured by the cyclops ' goblin servants who were about to prepare him to eat .
description_long: Zyl Zyl was a fire spirit in the service of the Stag King , a dark fey lord who lived in Ashenwood forest . He was sent by the Stag King to spy on a stronghold in the Feywild that belonged to a tribe of cyclops and their fomorian queen . Zyl had shapechanged into the form of a giant rat but was captured by the cyclops ' goblin servants who were about to prepare him to eat . Aoth Fezim rescued Zyl who agreed to take Aoth to meet the Stag King . Zyl traveled with his master ' s army to the Fortress of the Half - Demon and was killed defending his master during the Battle of the Fortress of the Half - Demon Description . Zyl could change shape but his natural form was a giant black hare .

title: Zz ' Pzora
description: Zz ' Pzora Zz ' Pzora was a mutated deep dragon . Description . Zz ' Pzora had two heads with different personalities .
description_long: Zz ' Pzora Zz ' Pzora was a mutated deep dragon . Description . Zz ' Pzora had two heads with different personalities . One was the adventurer - type who wanted to travel across Faerûn . The second was a fine lady who loved good clothes and hated the dust and dirt of adventures . History . Zz ' Pzora was a friend of the drow mage Liriel Baenre ( who called her " Zip " and traded her scales to make money ) . She lived in a " faerzress " - filled cave near Menzoberranzan known as Zz ' Pzora ' s Lair , accessible only by a wild river or a steep vertical shaft . In 1361 DR , Zz ' Pzora died in a battle near Skullport , when she helped Liriel against another deep dragon Pharx , another deep dragon ( whom she bedded before she fought ) in the service of the Dragon ' s Hoard band . She was able to kill him , but was herself also mortally wounded .

title: Zzar
description: Zzar Zzar was a fortified sherry wine popular in Waterdeep . Description . Zzar had an orange color and an almondy scent ( and flavor ) .
description_long: Zzar Zzar was a fortified sherry wine popular in Waterdeep . Description . Zzar had an orange color and an almondy scent ( and flavor ) . Most elves disdained it . It was made by fortifying sluth ( a dry , sparkling white wine ) with an almond liqueur . Locations . Zzar was produced at wineries such as the House of Good Spirits in Waterdeep .
